meaning: वर्षतु ते पर्जन्यस् \\ इति वेदिम्̐ यजमानं च प्रेक्षते //
text_mt: With the mantra: “May Parjanya rain for you,” he looks at the altar and at the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: vadhāna deva savitar iti pāṇikoṣṭhe nivapati //
meaning: वधान देव सवितर् इति पाणिकोष्ठे निवपति //
text_mt: With the mantra: “Bind, divine Savitṛ,” he pours it into the [āgnīdhra's] hollowed hands.

sanskrit_iast: mā vaḥ śivā oṣadhayas \\ iti dvitīyaṃ drapsas te \\ iti tṛtīyam̐ / samānam anyat tūṣṇīṃ caturtham /
meaning: मा वः शिवा ओषधयस् \\ इति द्वितीयं द्रप्सस् ते \\ इति तृतीयम्̐ / समानम् अन्यत् तूष्णीं चतुर्थम् /
text_mt: With: “May the plants be propitious to you,” [he cuts] the second; with: “Your drop,” the third; the rest is the same; silently the fourth time.

sanskrit_iast: sphyena vediṃ parigṛhṇāti vasavas tvā parigṛhṇantu \\ iti dakṣiṇatas \\ rudrās tvā \\ iti paścāt \\ ādityās tvā \\ ity uttarataḥ //
meaning: स्फ्येन वेदिं परिगृह्णाति वसवस् त्वा परिगृह्णन्तु \\ इति दक्षिणतस् \\ रुद्रास् त्वा \\ इति पश्चात् \\ आदित्यास् त्वा \\ इत्य् उत्तरतः //
text_mt: With the wooden sword he outlines the altar: with the mantra: “May the Vasus enclose you,” on the south; with: “May the Rudras you,” on the west; with: “May the Ādityas you,” on the north.

sanskrit_iast: apāraruṃ pṛthivyās \\ iti khanati dvyaṅgulaṃ caturaṅgulam̐ vā /
meaning: अपाररुं पृथिव्यास् \\ इति खनति द्व्यङ्गुलं चतुरङ्गुलम्̐ वा /
text_mt: With the mantra: “The non-injuring one of the earth,” he digs two finger-breadths or four finger-breadths deep.

sanskrit_iast: uddhatād āgnīdhras trir harati /
meaning: उद्धताद् आग्नीध्रस् त्रिर् हरति /
text_mt: The āgnīdhra priest carries away [earth] from the dug-out [ground] three times.

sanskrit_iast:
devasya savituḥ save \ karma kṛṇvanto mānuṣāḥ / \ mā him̐sīs tvam oṣadhīḥ śivāḥ //
iti sphyena mūlāni chinatti / satṛṇān pām̐sūn harati /
meaning:
देवस्य सवितुः सवे \ कर्म कृण्वन्तो मानुषाः / \ मा हिम्̐सीस् त्वम् ओषधीः शिवाः //
इति स्फ्येन मूलानि छिनत्ति / सतृणान् पाम्̐सून् हरति /
text_mt:
“At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, / men performing the ritual work, / do not injure the propitious plants.”

With this mantra he cuts the roots with the wooden sword; he carries away the loose earth together with the grass.

sanskrit_iast:
imāṃ naraḥ kṛṇuta vedim etad \ devebhyo juṣṭām adityā upasthe /
imāṃ devā ajuṣanta viśve \ rāyaspoṣāya yajamānam̐ viśantu //
iti karoti madhye saṃnatāṃ prāgudakpravaṇām̐ ślakṣṇām̐ sādhukṛtām am̐sābhyām āhavanīyaṃ parigṛhṇāti śroṇibhyāṃ gārhapatyam āhāryapurīṣāṃ paśukāmasya /
meaning:
इमां नरः कृणुत वेदिम् एतद् \ देवेभ्यो जुष्टाम् अदित्या उपस्थे /
इमां देवा अजुषन्त विश्वे \ रायस्पोषाय यजमानम्̐ विशन्तु //
इति करोति मध्ये संनतां प्रागुदक्प्रवणाम्̐ श्लक्ष्णाम्̐ साधुकृताम् अम्̐साभ्याम् आहवनीयं परिगृह्णाति श्रोणिभ्यां गार्हपत्यम् आहार्यपुरीषां पशुकामस्य /

sanskrit_iast: sphyaṃ prakṣālayaty apratimṛśann agram /
meaning: स्फ्यं प्रक्षालयत्य् अप्रतिमृशन्न् अग्रम् /
text_mt: He washes the wooden sword, not touching its tip.

sanskrit_iast: avokṣya vediṃ brahmāṇam āmantryottaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhṇāti satyasad asi \\ iti dakṣiṇatas \\ ṛtasad asi \\ iti paścād gharmasad asi \\ ity uttarataḥ //
meaning: अवोक्ष्य वेदिं ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्योत्तरं परिग्राहं परिगृह्णाति सत्यसद् असि \\ इति दक्षिणतस् \\ ऋतसद् असि \\ इति पश्चाद् घर्मसद् असि \\ इत्य् उत्तरतः //
text_mt: Having sprinkled the altar and addressed the brahman priest, he makes the second outlining: with the mantra: “You are seated in truth,” on the south; with: “You are seated in cosmic order,” on the west; with: “You are seated in heat,” on the north.

sanskrit_iast: purā krūrasya \\ iti sphyena vediṃ pratīcīm anumārṣṭi vartma kurvan /
meaning: पुरा क्रूरस्य \\ इति स्फ्येन वेदिं प्रतीचीम् अनुमार्ष्टि वर्त्म कुर्वन् /
text_mt: With the mantra: “Before the cruel,” he smooths over the altar towards the west with the wooden sword, making a furrow.

sanskrit_iast: paścārdhe vedyā vitṛtīyamātre tiryañcam̐ sphyam̐ stabdhvā prokṣaṇīr āsādaya \\ idhmābarhir upasādaya \ srucaḥ saṃmṛḍḍhi \ patnīm̐ saṃnahya \\ ājyenodehi \\ iti sam̐śāsti /
meaning: पश्चार्धे वेद्या वितृतीयमात्रे तिर्यञ्चम्̐ स्फ्यम्̐ स्तब्ध्वा प्रोक्षणीर् आसादय \\ इध्माबर्हिर् उपसादय \ स्रुचः संमृड्ढि \ पत्नीम्̐ संनह्य \\ आज्येनोदेहि \\ इति सम्̐शास्ति /
text_mt: Having planted the wooden sword crosswise in the western half of the altar at a measure of one-third [its length], he gives the order: "Set down the sprinkling waters; set near the sacrificial fuel and the sacrificial grass; wipe clean the offering ladles; gird the wife; bring forth the clarified butter."

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇena prokṣaṇīr abhyudānayaty agram upaninīya sphyam udyachati /
meaning: दक्षिणेन प्रोक्षणीर् अभ्युदानयत्य् अग्रम् उपनिनीय स्फ्यम् उद्यछति /
text_mt: He leads the sprinkling waters up towards the south, pours out [water] at the tip [of the wooden sword], and lifts the wooden sword.

sanskrit_iast: vartmani sādayati prokṣnaṇīr abhipūrayati //
meaning: वर्त्मनि सादयति प्रोक्ष्नणीर् अभिपूरयति //
text_mt: He sets it down on the track, and fills up the sprinkling waters.

sanskrit_iast: dviṣato vadho 'si \\ iti purastāt pratyaṅmukhaḥ sphyenotkaram abhihanti /
meaning: द्विषतो वधो ऽसि \\ इति पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ्मुखः स्फ्येनोत्करम् अभिहन्ति /
text_mt: Facing west from the east, he strikes the rubbish heap with the wooden sword, [reciting:] "You are the weapon against the hater."

sanskrit_iast: abhyukṣya pratyāsādayati
meaning: अभ्युक्ष्य प्रत्यासादयति
text_mt: Having sprinkled it, he sets it back down.

sanskrit_iast: uttarata āhavanīyasyedhmābarhir upasādayed dakṣiṇam idhmam uttaraṃ barhiḥ /
meaning: उत्तरत आहवनीयस्येध्माबर्हिर् उपसादयेद् दक्षिणम् इध्मम् उत्तरं बर्हिः /
text_mt: He should set near the sacrificial fuel and the sacrificial grass to the north of the āhavanīya fire: the sacrificial fuel to the south, the sacrificial grass to the north.

sanskrit_iast: sruvam̐ saṃmārṣṭi srucaḥ prāśitraharaṇaṃ ca /
meaning: स्रुवम्̐ संमार्ष्टि स्रुचः प्राशित्रहरणं च /
text_mt: He wipes clean the dipping spoon, the offering ladles, and the vessel for the prāśitra portion.

sanskrit_iast: pratyuṣṭam̐ rakṣas \\ ity āhavanīye pātrāṇi niṣṭapati /
meaning: प्रत्युष्टम्̐ रक्षस् \\ इत्य् आहवनीये पात्राणि निष्टपति /
text_mt: He scorches the vessels in the āhavanīya fire with: "Burnt is the evil spirit."

sanskrit_iast: vedapralavān prativibhajyāvibhajya vābhyāhavaṃ tiraścīḥ srucaḥ saṃmārṣṭy agrair agrāṇi mūlair daṇḍān saṃmṛjyābhyukṣyāgnau pratapati //
meaning: वेदप्रलवान् प्रतिविभज्याविभज्य वाभ्याहवं तिरश्चीः स्रुचः संमार्ष्ट्य् अग्रैर् अग्राणि मूलैर् दण्डान् संमृज्याभ्युक्ष्याग्नौ प्रतपति //
text_mt: Having divided or not divided the tips of the veda-grass, bending over, he wipes clean the offering ladles crosswise: the bowls with the tips, the handles with the roots; having wiped them clean and sprinkled them, he warms them at the fire.

sanskrit_iast: sruvo 'sy anādhṛṣṭaḥ sapatnasāhas \\ iti sruvam ādatta // āyuḥ prāṇaṃ mā nirmārjīr iti saṃmārṣṭi yathā juhūṃ prāśitraharaṇaṃ ca //
meaning: स्रुवो ऽस्य् अनाधृष्टः सपत्नसाहस् \\ इति स्रुवम् आदत्त // आयुः प्राणं मा निर्मार्जीर् इति संमार्ष्टि यथा जुहूं प्राशित्रहरणं च //
text_mt: He takes the dipping spoon with: "You are the dipping spoon, unassailable, conqueror of rivals." He wipes it clean with: "Do not wipe away my life and breath," as [he does] the juhū and the vessel for the prāśitra portion.

sanskrit_iast: juhūr asy anādhṛṣṭā sapatnasāhī \\ iti juhūm ādatte // cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ mā nirmārjīr iti prācīm antarataḥ pratīcīṃ bāhyataḥ saṃmārṣṭi //
meaning: जुहूर् अस्य् अनाधृष्टा सपत्नसाही \\ इति जुहूम् आदत्ते // चक्षुः श्रोत्रं मा निर्मार्जीर् इति प्राचीम् अन्तरतः प्रतीचीं बाह्यतः संमार्ष्टि //
text_mt: He takes the juhū with: "You are the juhū, unassailable, conqueror of rivals." He wipes it clean from the inside towards the east, and on the outside towards the west, with: "Do not wipe away my eye and ear."

sanskrit_iast: upabhṛd asy anādhṛṣṭā sapatnasāhī \\ ity upabhṛtam ādatte // vācaṃ paśūnmā nirmārjīr iti pratīcīm anatarataḥ prācīṃ bāhyataḥ //
meaning: उपभृद् अस्य् अनाधृष्टा सपत्नसाही \\ इत्य् उपभृतम् आदत्ते // वाचं पशून्मा निर्मार्जीर् इति प्रतीचीम् अनतरतः प्राचीं बाह्यतः //
text_mt: He takes the upabhṛt with: "You are the upabhṛt, unassailable, conqueror of rivals." [He wipes it clean] from the inside towards the west, and on the outside towards the east, with: "Do not wipe away my speech and cattle."

sanskrit_iast: dhruvāsy anādhṛṣṭā sapatnasāhī \\ iti dhruvām ādatte // yajñaṃ prajāṃ mā nirmārjīr iti sarvataḥ prācīm //
meaning: ध्रुवास्य् अनाधृष्टा सपत्नसाही \\ इति ध्रुवाम् आदत्ते // यज्ञं प्रजां मा निर्मार्जीर् इति सर्वतः प्राचीम् //
text_mt: He takes the dhruvā with: "You are the dhruvā, unassailable, conqueror of rivals." [He wipes it clean] everywhere towards the east with: "Do not wipe away my sacrifice and offspring."

sanskrit_iast: prāśitraharaṇam asy anādhṛṣṭam̐ sapatnasāham iti prāśitraharaṇam ādatte // rūpād varṇaṃ mā nirmṛkṣam \\ vāji tvā sapatnasāham̐ saṃmārjmi \\ iti saṃmārṣṭi /
meaning: प्राशित्रहरणम् अस्य् अनाधृष्टम्̐ सपत्नसाहम् इति प्राशित्रहरणम् आदत्ते // रूपाद् वर्णं मा निर्मृक्षम् \\ वाजि त्वा सपत्नसाहम्̐ संमार्ज्मि \\ इति संमार्ष्टि /
text_mt: He takes the vessel for the prāśitra portion with: "You are the vessel for the prāśitra portion, unassailable, conqueror of rivals." He wipes it clean with: "May I not wipe out color from form; vigorous, I wipe you clean, conqueror of rivals."

sanskrit_iast:
divi śilpam avatatam \ pṛthivyāḥ kakubhiḥ śritam /
tena sahasrakāṇḍena \ dviṣantaṃ tāpayāmasi / \ dvipantas tapyantāṃ bahu //
iti saṃmārjanāny avasṛjyābhyukṣyāgnāv adhyasyati /
meaning:
दिवि शिल्पम् अवततम् \ पृथिव्याः ककुभिः श्रितम् /
तेन सहस्रकाण्डेन \ द्विषन्तं तापयामसि / \ द्विपन्तस् तप्यन्तां बहु //
इति संमार्जनान्य् अवसृज्याभ्युक्ष्याग्नाव् अध्यस्यति /
text_mt:
"A marvel stretched down in heaven, / resting on the summits of the earth:

With that of a thousand joints / do we afflict our hater; / let our haters be afflicted greatly!"

Having cast down the cleansing grasses [with this mantra], and having sprinkled them, he throws them into the fire.

sanskrit_iast: saṃmṛṣṭā yathāsthānam uttānāḥ srucaḥ sādayati //
meaning: संमृष्टा यथास्थानम् उत्तानाः स्रुचः सादयति //
text_mt: He sets down the wiped ladles in their proper places, facing upward.

sanskrit_iast: patni patnīlokopasthānaṃ kuru \\ iti preṣyati // patni patny eṣa te lokas \\ namas te astu \ mā mā him̐sīr iti dakṣiṇataḥpaścād aparasya patnīlokam upasthāpayati /
meaning: पत्नि पत्नीलोकोपस्थानं कुरु \\ इति प्रेष्यति // पत्नि पत्न्य् एष ते लोकस् \\ नमस् ते अस्तु \ मा मा हिम्̐सीर् इति दक्षिणतःपश्चाद् अपरस्य पत्नीलोकम् उपस्थापयति /
text_mt: He gives the order: "Wife, perform the attendance at the wife's seat." He causes her to attend the wife's seat to the south and west of the western [fire], with: "Wife, wife, this is your place; homage be to you; do not harm me."

sanskrit_iast:
agne gṛhapata upa mā hvayasva \ devānāṃ patnīr upa mā hvayadhvam /
aditir iva tvā saputropaniṣade yeyam indrāṇīvāvidhavā //
ity upaviśati jānunī prabhujya /
meaning:
अग्ने गृहपत उप मा ह्वयस्व \ देवानां पत्नीर् उप मा ह्वयध्वम् /
अदितिर् इव त्वा सपुत्रोपनिषदे येयम् इन्द्राणीवाविधवा //
इत्य् उपविशति जानुनी प्रभुज्य /
text_mt:
"O Agni, lord of the house, call upon me; wives of the gods, call upon me!

Like Aditi with her sons, may I sit down by you, unwidowed like Indrāṇī!"

With [these verses] she sits down, bending her knees.

sanskrit_iast:
āśāsānā saumanasam \ prajāṃ puṣṭimatho bhagam /
agner anuvratā bhūtvā \ saṃnahye sukṛtāya kam //
ity antarato vastrasya yoktreṇa patnīm̐ saṃnahyāpa upaspṛśya vedopayāmād abdhena tvā cakṣuṣāvekṣe \\ iti patny ājyam avekṣate //
meaning:
आशासाना सौमनसम् \ प्रजां पुष्टिमथो भगम् /
अग्नेर् अनुव्रता भूत्वा \ संनह्ये सुकृताय कम् //
इत्य् अन्तरतो वस्त्रस्य योक्त्रेण पत्नीम्̐ संनह्याप उपस्पृश्य वेदोपयामाद् अब्धेन त्वा चक्षुषावेक्षे \\ इति पत्न्य् आज्यम् अवेक्षते //
text_mt:
"Hoping for benevolence, / offspring, nourishment, and good fortune,

devoted to Agni, / I gird myself for good deeds."

Having girded the wife beneath her garment with a girdle with [these verses], and having touched water, with the underside of the veda-broom [placed beneath the vessel], the wife looks at the clarified butter with: "With an undefeated eye I gaze upon you."

sanskrit_iast: tejo 'si \\ ity ājyaṃ gārhapatye 'dhiśrayati //
meaning: तेजो ऽसि \\ इत्य् आज्यं गार्हपत्ये ऽधिश्रयति //
text_mt: He places the clarified butter over the gārhapatya fire with: "You are splendor."

sanskrit_iast: tejo 'si \ tejo 'nuprehi \ vāyuṣ ṭvāntarikṣāt pātu sūryo divas \\ ity āhavanīyaṃ prati harati //
meaning: तेजो ऽसि \ तेजो ऽनुप्रेहि \ वायुष् ट्वान्तरिक्षात् पातु सूर्यो दिवस् \\ इत्य् आहवनीयं प्रति हरति //
text_mt: He carries it towards the āhavanīya fire with: "You are splendor; follow after splendor; may Vāyu protect you from the intermediate space, Sūrya from heaven."

sanskrit_iast: agniṣ ṭe tejo mā vinait \\ ity āhavanīye 'dhiśrayati //
meaning: अग्निष् टे तेजो मा विनैत् \\ इत्य् आहवनीये ऽधिश्रयति //
text_mt: He places it over the āhavanīya fire with: "May Agni not cause your splendor to depart."

sanskrit_iast: idam̐ viṣṇur vicakrame \\ ity etayottarataḥ prokṣaṇīnām̐ sādayati vedaṃ ca //
meaning: इदम्̐ विष्णुर् विचक्रमे \\ इत्य् एतयोत्तरतः प्रोक्षणीनाम्̐ सादयति वेदं च //
text_mt: With: "Here Viṣṇu strode...", he sets it down to the north of the sprinkling waters, and also the veda-broom.

sanskrit_iast: tejo 'si \\ ity ājyam̐ yajamāno 'vekṣata utpūtam anutpūtam̐ vā //
meaning: तेजो ऽसि \\ इत्य् आज्यम्̐ यजमानो ऽवेक्षत उत्पूतम् अनुत्पूतम्̐ वा //
text_mt: The sacrificer looks at the clarified butter, whether purified or unpurified, with: "You are splendor."

sanskrit_iast: devas tvā savitotpunātu \\ ity etayā paccha ājyam utpunāti // devo vaḥ savitā \\ iti prokṣaṇīḥ //
meaning: देवस् त्वा सवितोत्पुनातु \\ इत्य् एतया पच्छ आज्यम् उत्पुनाति // देवो वः सविता \\ इति प्रोक्षणीः //
text_mt: With: "May god Savitṛ purify you...", verse-quarter by verse-quarter, he purifies the clarified butter; and the sprinkling waters with: "May god Savitṛ [purify] you..."

sanskrit_iast: dhāmāsi \\ iti sruveṇājyāni gṛhṇāti catur juhvām aṣṭau kṛtva upabhṛti kanīyaḥ pañca kṛtvo dhruvāyāṃ bhūyiṣṭham /
meaning: धामासि \\ इति स्रुवेणाज्यानि गृह्णाति चतुर् जुह्वाम् अष्टौ कृत्व उपभृति कनीयः पञ्च कृत्वो ध्रुवायां भूयिष्ठम् /
text_mt: With: "You are a dwelling...", he takes portions of clarified butter with the dipping spoon: four times into the juhū, eight times into the upabhṛt—less in quantity, and five times into the dhruvā—the largest quantity.

sanskrit_iast: ājyasthālīm̐ sruvam̐ vedaṃ ca gārhapatyānte nidadhāti /
meaning: आज्यस्थालीम्̐ स्रुवम्̐ वेदं च गार्हपत्यान्ते निदधाति /
text_mt: He sets down the clarified butter pot, the dipping spoon, and the veda-broom beside the gārhapatya fire.

sanskrit_iast: darbhamuṣṭim upādāyārdham̐ veder dakṣiṇataḥ prakṣipya devīr āpas \\ iti prokṣaṇīr udīrayati /
meaning: दर्भमुष्टिम् उपादायार्धम्̐ वेदेर् दक्षिणतः प्रक्षिप्य देवीर् आपस् \\ इति प्रोक्षणीर् उदीरयति /
text_mt: Taking a handful of darbha grass and throwing half [of it] to the south of the altar, he raises the sprinkling waters with: "O divine waters..."

sanskrit_iast: prokṣaṇīr apādāya vedyāṃ padāni lobhayanti /
meaning: प्रोक्षणीर् अपादाय वेद्यां पदानि लोभयन्ति /
text_mt: Taking the sprinkling waters, they confuse the footprints on the altar.

sanskrit_iast: utkare lobhanāni pravidhyāpa upaspṛśya viṣāyedhmam apādāya paridhīn brahmāṇam āmantrya prokṣati kṛṣṇo 'sy ākhareṣṭhas \\ itīdhmam \\ vedir asi \ barhiṣe tvā \\ iti vedim \\ barhir asi \ vedyai tvā \\ iti barhiḥ /
meaning: उत्करे लोभनानि प्रविध्याप उपस्पृश्य विषायेध्मम् अपादाय परिधीन् ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्य प्रोक्षति कृष्णो ऽस्य् आखरेष्ठस् \\ इतीध्मम् \\ वेदिर् असि \ बर्हिषे त्वा \\ इति वेदिम् \\ बर्हिर् असि \ वेद्यै त्वा \\ इति बर्हिः /
text_mt: Having cast the confusers on the rubbish heap and touched water, untying the sacrificial fuel and taking off the enclosing sticks, he addresses the brahman priest and sprinkles: the sacrificial fuel with "You are black, dwelling in the lair"; the altar with "You are the altar, for the sacrificial grass [I sprinkle] you"; the sacrificial grass with "You are the sacrificial grass, for the altar [I sprinkle] you."

sanskrit_iast: prokṣya paścārdhe vedyā vitṛtīyamātre barhiḥ sādayati /
meaning: प्रोक्ष्य पश्चार्धे वेद्या वितृतीयमात्रे बर्हिः सादयति /
text_mt: Having sprinkled it, he sets down the sacrificial grass in the western half of the altar at a measure of one-third [its length].

sanskrit_iast: purastādgranthiṃ nidadhāti /
meaning: पुरस्ताद्ग्रन्थिं निदधाति /
text_mt: He places the knot toward the east.

sanskrit_iast: agrāṇi prokṣaṇīṣūpapāyayati //
meaning: अग्राणि प्रोक्षणीषूपपाययति //
text_mt: He brings the tips [of the grass] into contact with the sprinkling waters.

sanskrit_iast: svāhā pitṛbhyo gharmapāvabhyas \\ iti mūladeśe barhiṣaḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ prokṣaṇīr ninayati /
meaning: स्वाहा पितृभ्यो घर्मपावभ्यस् \\ इति मूलदेशे बर्हिषः प्रदक्षिणं प्रोक्षणीर् निनयति /
text_mt: He pours out the sprinkling waters clockwise at the root-part of the sacrificial grass with: "Svāhā to the Fathers who drink the warm libation!"

sanskrit_iast: uduhya srucam ādāya pavitre dakṣiṇataḥ parikramya pūṣā te granthim̐ viṣyatu \\ iti barhiṣo granthim̐ viṣyati /
meaning: उदुह्य स्रुचम् आदाय पवित्रे दक्षिणतः परिक्रम्य पूषा ते ग्रन्थिम्̐ विष्यतु \\ इति बर्हिषो ग्रन्थिम्̐ विष्यति /
text_mt: Taking a ladle and drawing it up, stepping around to the south with the two strainers, he unbinds the knot of the sacrificial grass with: "May Pūṣan unbind your knot."

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇoḥ stupo 'si \\ iti prastaram apādatta //
meaning: विष्णोः स्तुपो ऽसि \\ इति प्रस्तरम् अपादत्त //
text_mt: He takes off the sacred grass bundle with: "You are the tuft of Viṣṇu."

sanskrit_iast: yajamāne prāṇāpānau dadhāmi \\ iti pavitre prastare vimṛjati /
meaning: यजमाने प्राणापानौ दधामि \\ इति पवित्रे प्रस्तरे विमृजति /
text_mt: He wipes the two strainers onto the sacred grass bundle with: "I place the out-breath and in-breath in the sacrificer."

sanskrit_iast: agreṇāhavanīyaṃ paryāhṛtya prastaraṃ brahmaṇe prayachati yajamānāya vā //
meaning: अग्रेणाहवनीयं पर्याहृत्य प्रस्तरं ब्रह्मणे प्रयछति यजमानाय वा //
text_mt: Carrying the sacred grass bundle around the front of the āhavanīya fire, he hands it to the brahman priest, or to the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: puṣṭir asi \ poṣāya tvā \ rayimantaṃ tvā puṣṭimantaṃ gṛhṇāmi \\ iti mukhataḥ prastaraṃ gṛhṇāti /
meaning: पुष्टिर् असि \ पोषाय त्वा \ रयिमन्तं त्वा पुष्टिमन्तं गृह्णामि \\ इति मुखतः प्रस्तरं गृह्णाति /
text_mt: He receives the sacred grass bundle at the top with: "You are prosperity; for nourishment [I take] you; endowed with wealth, endowed with nourishment, I take you."

sanskrit_iast: nonmṛjyān nāvamṛjyān na vidhūnuyād yad upatiṣṭhet tad upasaṃgṛhṇīyāt /
meaning: नोन्मृज्यान् नावमृज्यान् न विधूनुयाद् यद् उपतिष्ठेत् तद् उपसंगृह्णीयात् /
text_mt: He should not wipe it upwards, nor wipe it downwards, nor shake it; whatever remains upright, that he should gather up together.

sanskrit_iast: visram̐sya śulbaṃ [ dakṣiṇato ye darbhā udīraṇasamaye prakṣiptās teṣāṃ ] darbhāṇām upasam̐yamya vediṃ dakṣiṇārdhe stṛṇāti //
meaning: विस्रम्̐स्य शुल्बं [ दक्षिणतो ये दर्भा उदीरणसमये प्रक्षिप्तास् तेषां ] दर्भाणाम् उपसम्̐यम्य वेदिं दक्षिणार्धे स्तृणाति //
text_mt: Having untied the cord, holding together the darbha blades [of those darbha blades that were thrown to the south at the time of raising], he strews the altar on the southern half.

sanskrit_iast: uru prathasva \\ iti vedim̐ stṛṇāty aparamaparam ayugdhātu bahulam anārokam /
meaning: उरु प्रथस्व \\ इति वेदिम्̐ स्तृणात्य् अपरमपरम् अयुग्धातु बहुलम् अनारोकम् /
text_mt: He strews the altar with: "Spread out wide!", layer after layer, in odd-numbered layers, thick, without gaps.

sanskrit_iast: apareṇa vediṃ parikramya prastaraṃ dhārayan paridhīn paridadhāti gandharvo 'si \\ iti madhyamam indrasya bāhur asi \\ iti dakṣiṇam \\ mitrāvaruṇau tvā \\ ity uttaram /
meaning: अपरेण वेदिं परिक्रम्य प्रस्तरं धारयन् परिधीन् परिदधाति गन्धर्वो ऽसि \\ इति मध्यमम् इन्द्रस्य बाहुर् असि \\ इति दक्षिणम् \\ मित्रावरुणौ त्वा \\ इत्य् उत्तरम् /
text_mt: Having walked around behind the altar, holding the sacred grass bundle, he lays around the enclosing sticks: the middle one with "You are the gandharva", the southern one with "You are Indra's arm", the northern one with "May Mitra and Varuṇa [lay] you around."

sanskrit_iast: avyatyādadhat saṃdadhāty abhihitatamaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ paridhisaṃdhiṃ karoti /
meaning: अव्यत्यादधत् संदधात्य् अभिहिततमं दक्षिणं परिधिसंधिं करोति /
text_mt: Without crossing them over, he joins them together; he makes the southern junction of enclosing sticks the closest.

sanskrit_iast: idhmadārv ādāya nityahotāraṃ tvā \\ ity āghārasamidham ādadhāti varṣiṣṭhe adhi nāke \\ iti dvitīyām //
meaning: इध्मदार्व् आदाय नित्यहोतारं त्वा \\ इत्य् आघारसमिधम् आदधाति वर्षिष्ठे अधि नाके \\ इति द्वितीयाम् //
text_mt: Taking a piece of fuel wood, he lays down the kindling stick for the libation with: "You the regular hotṛ..."; the second with: "On the highest firmament..."

sanskrit_iast: sūryas tvā raśmibhir ity ādityaṃ purastāt paridadhāti //
meaning: सूर्यस् त्वा रश्मिभिर् इत्य् आदित्यं पुरस्तात् परिदधाति //
text_mt: He lays around the sun-stick in front with: "May the sun with its rays [protect you]."

sanskrit_iast: viśvajanasya vidhṛtī sthas \\ iti tṛṇe tiraścī sādayati caturaṅgulamātram antarā //
meaning: विश्वजनस्य विधृती स्थस् \\ इति तृणे तिरश्ची सादयति चतुरङ्गुलमात्रम् अन्तरा //
text_mt: With: "You two are the dividers of all people", he lays down two grass blades crosswise, four finger-breadths apart.

sanskrit_iast: vasūnām̐ rudrāṇām iti vidhṛtyor upari prastaram̐ sādayati //
meaning: वसूनाम्̐ रुद्राणाम् इति विधृत्योर् उपरि प्रस्तरम्̐ सादयति //
text_mt: He sets down the sacred grass bundle on top of the two dividers with: "[Belonging to] the Vasus, the Rudras..."

sanskrit_iast: dyaur asi janmanā \\ iti juhūṃ prastare sādayati /
meaning: द्यौर् असि जन्मना \\ इति जुहूं प्रस्तरे सादयति /
text_mt: With [the sacred formula], "You are heaven by birth," he sets down the juhū spoon on the sacred grass bundle.

sanskrit_iast: na riktam avasṛjati / samaṃ mūlair daṇḍaṃ karoti //
meaning: न रिक्तम् अवसृजति / समं मूलैर् दण्डं करोति //
text_mt: He does not let go of it empty. He aligns its handle evenly with the roots [of the grass bundle].

sanskrit_iast: antarikṣam asi janmanā \\ ity adhastād vidhṛtyor upabhṛtam \\ pṛthivy asi janmanā \\ ity upariṣṭād vidhṛtyor dhruvāmasam̐saktāḥ sruco 'nūcīḥ sādayaty abhihitatamāṃ juhūm [ karoti ] //
meaning: अन्तरिक्षम् असि जन्मना \\ इत्य् अधस्ताद् विधृत्योर् उपभृतम् \\ पृथिव्य् असि जन्मना \\ इत्य् उपरिष्टाद् विधृत्योर् ध्रुवामसम्̐सक्ताः स्रुचो ऽनूचीः सादयत्य् अभिहिततमां जुहूम् [ करोति ] //
text_mt: With "You are the intermediate region by birth," [he sets down] the upabhṛt spoon below the two dividing grass blades; with "You are the earth by birth," [he sets down] the dhruvā spoon above the two dividing grass blades; not touching one another, he sets down the offering spoons pointing east, [and he makes] the juhū spoon the foremost.

sanskrit_iast: idam aham̐ senāyā abhītvaryā mukham apohāmi \\ iti vedena puroḍāśayor bhasmāpohati /
meaning: इदम् अहम्̐ सेनाया अभीत्वर्या मुखम् अपोहामि \\ इति वेदेन पुरोडाशयोर् भस्मापोहति /
text_mt: With [the formula], "Here I sweep away the face of the attacking army," he sweeps away the ashes from the two sacrificial cakes with the veda.

sanskrit_iast:
vedopayāma ājayasthālyāḥ sruveṇa
āpyāyatāṃ ghṛtayonir \ agnir havyā no manyatām /
kham aṅkṣva tvacam aṅkṣva \ surūpaṃ tvā vasuvidaṃ paśūnāṃ tejasāgnaye tvā juṣṭam abhighārayāmi \\ ity āgneyaṃ puroḍāśam abhighārayati yathādevatam uttaram //
meaning:
वेदोपयाम आजयस्थाल्याः स्रुवेण
आप्यायतां घृतयोनिर् \ अग्निर् हव्या नो मन्यताम् /
खम् अङ्क्ष्व त्वचम् अङ्क्ष्व \ सुरूपं त्वा वसुविदं पशूनां तेजसाग्नये त्वा जुष्टम् अभिघारयामि \\ इत्य् आग्नेयं पुरोडाशम् अभिघारयति यथादेवतम् उत्तरम् //
text_mt:
Holding the veda as a support, [taking clarified butter] from the clarified-butter pot with the dipping spoon,

"May Agni, whose womb is clarified butter, swell; / may he think well of our sacrificial offerings.

Anoint your eye, anoint your skin; beautiful, finding wealth, with the splendor of cattle, I baste you with clarified butter agreeable to Agni"—with [this formula], he bastes the sacrificial cake destined for Agni with clarified butter, and the subsequent one according to its deity.

sanskrit_iast: syonaṃ te sadanaṃ kṛṇomi \ ghṛtasya dhārayā suśevaṃ kalpayāmi \\ iti pātryām upastṛṇāti /
meaning: स्योनं ते सदनं कृणोमि \ घृतस्य धारया सुशेवं कल्पयामि \\ इति पात्र्याम् उपस्तृणाति /
text_mt: With "I make a comfortable seat for you; with a stream of clarified butter I fashion it to be very pleasant," he spreads an underlayer [of clarified butter] in the vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
ārdraḥ pṛthusnur bhuvanasya gopāḥ \ śṛta utsnātu janitā matīnām /
ity udañcam udvāsayati /
meaning:
आर्द्रः पृथुस्नुर् भुवनस्य गोपाः \ शृत उत्स्नातु जनिता मतीनाम् /
इत्य् उदञ्चम् उद्वासयति /
text_mt:
"Moist, broad-backed, guardian of the world; / well-cooked, let the generator of thoughts bathe [in butter],"

with [this formula] he takes it off [the fire] towards the north.

sanskrit_iast: vedenāpabhasmānaṃ karoty anabhighnan pāṇinā vedaśirasā ca /
meaning: वेदेनापभस्मानं करोत्य् अनभिघ्नन् पाणिना वेदशिरसा च /
text_mt: He clears it of ashes with the veda, without striking it, using his hand and the tip of the veda.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmin sīdāmṛte pratitiṣṭha \ vrīhīṇāṃ medhaḥ sumanasyamānaḥ /
ity upastīrṇe sādayati // yavānāṃ medhas \\ iti yavānām //
meaning:
तस्मिन् सीदामृते प्रतितिष्ठ \ व्रीहीणां मेधः सुमनस्यमानः /
इत्य् उपस्तीर्णे सादयति // यवानां मेधस् \\ इति यवानाम् //
text_mt:
"Sit upon that [underlayer] in the nectar; be firmly established, / O essence of rice, being well-disposed,"

with [this formula] he sets it down upon the underlayer. With "O essence of barley," in the case of barley [cakes].

sanskrit_iast: irā bhūtiḥ pṛthivyā raso motkramīt \\ iti prathamopahite kapāle 'bhighārayati //
meaning: इरा भूतिः पृथिव्या रसो मोत्क्रमीत् \\ इति प्रथमोपहिते कपाले ऽभिघारयति //
text_mt: With "May refreshment, prosperity, the sap of the earth not depart," he bastes with clarified butter [the cake] on the first placed potsherd.

sanskrit_iast: tṛptir asi gāyatraṃ chandas tarpaya mā tejasā brahmavarcasena \ tṛptir asi traiṣṭubhaṃ chandas tarpaya mendriyeṇa vīryeṇa \ tṛptir asi jāgataṃ chandas tarpaya mā prajayā paśubhir ity alaṃkaroti svaktam aniṣkāṣam apṛṣantam aparyāvartayan adhastāc copānakti /
meaning: तृप्तिर् असि गायत्रं छन्दस् तर्पय मा तेजसा ब्रह्मवर्चसेन \ तृप्तिर् असि त्रैष्टुभं छन्दस् तर्पय मेन्द्रियेण वीर्येण \ तृप्तिर् असि जागतं छन्दस् तर्पय मा प्रजया पशुभिर् इत्य् अलंकरोति स्वक्तम् अनिष्काषम् अपृषन्तम् अपर्यावर्तयन् अधस्ताच् चोपानक्ति /
text_mt: With "You are satisfaction, the gāyatrī meter; satisfy me with luster and spiritual radiance. You are satisfaction, the triṣṭubh meter; satisfy me with vigor and strength. You are satisfaction, the jagatī meter; satisfy me with offspring and cattle," he adorns [the cake], well-anointed, not scraped, not broken, without turning it over, and he anoints it from below.

sanskrit_iast:
yas ta ātmā paśuṣu praviṣṭas\ divo vābhiṣṭhām anu yo vicaṣṭe /
ātmanvān soma ghṛtavān ihaihi \ divaṃ gacha svar vinda yajamānāya mahyam //
iti dohāv alaṃkaroti /
meaning:
यस् त आत्मा पशुषु प्रविष्टस्\ दिवो वाभिष्ठाम् अनु यो विचष्टे /
आत्मन्वान् सोम घृतवान् इहैहि \ दिवं गछ स्वर् विन्द यजमानाय मह्यम् //
इति दोहाव् अलंकरोति /
text_mt:
"That self of yours which has entered into the cattle, / or which gazes upon the heavenly station,

possessing a self, O Soma, rich in clarified butter, come here; / go to heaven, find the light of the sun for me, the sacrificer"—

sanskrit_iast: abhyudāharati havīm̐ṣi //
meaning: अभ्युदाहरति हवीम्̐षि //
text_mt: He brings forward the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣabho 'si śākvaras \\ iti dakṣiṇato juhvāḥ pūrṇasruvam̐ sādayaty agreṇa dhruvām̐ vedam uttareṇa dhruvām ājyasthālīm apareṇa srugdaṇḍān pātrīṃ dakṣiṇasyām̐ vediśroṇau sāyaṃdoham uttarasyāṃ prātardoham /
meaning: ऋषभो ऽसि शाक्वरस् \\ इति दक्षिणतो जुह्वाः पूर्णस्रुवम्̐ सादयत्य् अग्रेण ध्रुवाम्̐ वेदम् उत्तरेण ध्रुवाम् आज्यस्थालीम् अपरेण स्रुग्दण्डान् पात्रीं दक्षिणस्याम्̐ वेदिश्रोणौ सायंदोहम् उत्तरस्यां प्रातर्दोहम् /
text_mt: With "You are the bull of the Śakvarī [verses]," he sets down the full dipping spoon to the south of the juhū spoon, the veda in front of the dhruvā spoon, the clarified-butter pot to the north of the dhruvā spoon, the vessel behind the handles of the offering spoons, the evening milking on the southern hip of the altar, and the morning milking on the northern [hip].

sanskrit_iast: vedim̐ stṛṇāty anadhistṛṇann antān /
meaning: वेदिम्̐ स्तृणात्य् अनधिस्तृणन्न् अन्तान् /
text_mt: He strews the altar, without overlapping the ends [of the grass].

sanskrit_iast: paścād dhotre tridhātūpastṛṇāti dakṣiṇātūlān madhye /
meaning: पश्चाद् धोत्रे त्रिधातूपस्तृणाति दक्षिणातूलान् मध्ये /
text_mt: Behind, for the hotṛ priest, he spreads a threefold layer [of grass], with the tips pointing south, in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: apa upaspṛśya dhruvā asadan \\ ity ājyāni saṃmṛśati saṃmṛśati /
meaning: अप उपस्पृश्य ध्रुवा असदन् \\ इत्य् आज्यानि संमृशति संमृशति /
text_mt: Having touched water, with "Firm they have sat," he touches the clarified butters repeatedly.

sanskrit_iast: hotaryavasthite \\ agnaye samidhyamānāyānubrūhi \\ ity uktvā [ hotuḥ ] praṇavepraṇave samidham ādadhāti /
meaning: होतर्यवस्थिते \\ अग्नये समिध्यमानायानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा [ होतुः ] प्रणवेप्रणवे समिधम् आदधाति /
text_mt: When the hotṛ priest has taken his position, having said, "Recite for Agni being kindled," he places a stick of firewood on [the fire] at each sacred syllable oṃ [recited by the hotṛ].

sanskrit_iast: ānuyājikīm̐ śiṣṭvā nedhmasyātirecayati /
meaning: आनुयाजिकीम्̐ शिष्ट्वा नेध्मस्यातिरेचयति /
text_mt: Leaving [one stick] for the after-offerings, he does not let [any other] from the sacrificial fuel remain over.

sanskrit_iast: idhmasaṃnahanam̐ visram̐syaikagranthim̐ saṃmārgaṃ karoti /
meaning: इध्मसंनहनम्̐ विस्रम्̐स्यैकग्रन्थिम्̐ संमार्गं करोति /
text_mt: Having untied the cord of the sacrificial fuel, he makes a sweeping-bundle with a single knot.

sanskrit_iast: oḍhāsu devatāsv apa upaspṛśya vedenāgniṃ trir upavājayaty agram̐ vedyāḥ saṃmṛjan /
meaning: ओढासु देवतास्व् अप उपस्पृश्य वेदेनाग्निं त्रिर् उपवाजयत्य् अग्रम्̐ वेद्याः संमृजन् /
text_mt: When the deities have been conveyed, having touched water, he fans the fire three times with the veda, brushing the front part of the altar.

sanskrit_iast: pūrṇasruvaṃ dhruvāyām avanīya tasyopahatya vedopayāma uttaraṃ paridhisaṃdhim̐ sparśayitvottarārdhe 'bhyāhitasya prācīnaṃ manasā prajāpataye svāhā \\ iti jvalati juhoti /
meaning: पूर्णस्रुवं ध्रुवायाम् अवनीय तस्योपहत्य वेदोपयाम उत्तरं परिधिसंधिम्̐ स्पर्शयित्वोत्तरार्धे ऽभ्याहितस्य प्राचीनं मनसा प्रजापतये स्वाहा \\ इति ज्वलति जुहोति /
text_mt: Having poured the full dipping spoon into the dhruvā spoon and dipped from it, holding the veda as a support, making [the ladle] touch the northern junction of the enclosing sticks, on the northern half of what has been piled on, facing eastward, with his mind, with "To Prajāpati, svāhā!" he offers into the blaze.

sanskrit_iast: saṃpātena dhruvām āpyāyya yathāsthānam̐ sruvam̐ vedaṃ ca nidadhāti //
meaning: संपातेन ध्रुवाम् आप्याय्य यथास्थानम्̐ स्रुवम्̐ वेदं च निदधाति //
text_mt: Having replenished the dhruvā spoon with the residue of the offering, he puts down the dipping spoon and the veda in their respective places.

sanskrit_iast: agnīt paridhīm̐ś cāgniṃ ca tristriḥ saṃmṛḍḍhi \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: अग्नीत् परिधीम्̐श् चाग्निं च त्रिस्त्रिः संमृड्ढि \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He gives the order: "O āgnīdhra, cleanse the enclosing sticks and the fire, three times each."

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhraḥ saṃmārgaṃ sphyam upasam̐yamya yathāparidhitam anulomaṃ triḥ saṃmārṣṭi //
meaning: आग्नीध्रः संमार्गं स्फ्यम् उपसम्̐यम्य यथापरिधितम् अनुलोमं त्रिः संमार्ष्टि //
text_mt: The āgnīdhra priest, holding the sweeping-bundle and the wooden sword together, sweeps three times along the enclosing sticks, in the natural direction [of their placement].

sanskrit_iast: ājiṃ tvāgne sariṣyantam̐ sanim̐ saniṣyantaṃ devebhyo havyam̐ vakṣyantam̐ vājinaṃ tvā vājajityāyai saṃmārjmi \\ agne vājaṃ jaya \\ ity ṛte sphyād agnim upakṣipam̐s triḥ samunmārṣṭi /
meaning: आजिं त्वाग्ने सरिष्यन्तम्̐ सनिम्̐ सनिष्यन्तं देवेभ्यो हव्यम्̐ वक्ष्यन्तम्̐ वाजिनं त्वा वाजजित्यायै संमार्ज्मि \\ अग्ने वाजं जय \\ इत्य् ऋते स्फ्याद् अग्निम् उपक्षिपम्̐स् त्रिः समुन्मार्ष्टि /
text_mt: "O Agni, who are about to run the race, about to win the prize, who will bear the oblation to the gods, a courser, for winning the prize I cleanse you; O Agni, win the prize!"—with [this formula], without the wooden sword, making sweeping motions upward toward the fire, he sweeps three times.

sanskrit_iast: apaharati /
meaning: अपहरति /

sanskrit_iast: uttānau pāṇī kṛtvā juhūpabhṛtor agre sūyame me 'dya stam iti japati //
meaning: उत्तानौ पाणी कृत्वा जुहूपभृतोर् अग्रे सूयमे मे ऽद्य स्तम् इति जपति //
text_mt: Having turned his hands palms upwards, he mutters at the tips of the juhū and upabhṛt spoons: "May you two be easily managed for me today."

sanskrit_iast: juhv ehi \\ agniṣ ṭvā hvayati \ devān yakṣyāvo devayajyāyai \\ iti juhūm ādatta // upabhṛd ehi \ devas tvā savitā hvayati \ devān yakṣyāvo devayajyāyai \\ ity upabhṛtam /
meaning: जुह्व् एहि \\ अग्निष् ट्वा ह्वयति \ देवान् यक्ष्यावो देवयज्यायै \\ इति जुहूम् आदत्त // उपभृद् एहि \ देवस् त्वा सविता ह्वयति \ देवान् यक्ष्यावो देवयज्यायै \\ इत्य् उपभृतम् /
text_mt: "Come, juhū; Agni calls you; let us two sacrifice to the gods for the sacrifice to the gods"—with [this formula] he takes up the juhū spoon. "Come, upabhṛt; god Savitṛ calls you; let us two sacrifice to the gods for the sacrifice to the gods"—with [this formula he takes up] the upabhṛt spoon.

sanskrit_iast: samādāya srucau \\ agnāviṣṇū vijihāthām iti dakṣiṇātikrāmati /
meaning: समादाय स्रुचौ \\ अग्नाविष्णू विजिहाथाम् इति दक्षिणातिक्रामति /
text_mt: Taking up both offering spoons, with "O Agni and Viṣṇu, step apart!" he steps across to the south.

sanskrit_iast: āspṛṣṭam̐ savyaṃ pādam avasthāpayaty antarvedi dakṣiṇam̐ // viṣṇoḥ sthāmāsi \\ iti japati /
meaning: आस्पृष्टम्̐ सव्यं पादम् अवस्थापयत्य् अन्तर्वेदि दक्षिणम्̐ // विष्णोः स्थामासि \\ इति जपति /
text_mt: He places his left foot touching [the border], and his right foot inside the altar. He mutters, "You are the place of Viṣṇu."

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇaṃ paridhisaṃdhim̐ sparśayitvā dakṣiṇārdhe 'bhyāhitasya \\ ūrdhvo adhvaras \\ iti saṃtataṃ prāñcaṃ dīrgham ṛjum ūrdhvam avichinnam āghāram āghārayati /
meaning: दक्षिणं परिधिसंधिम्̐ स्पर्शयित्वा दक्षिणार्धे ऽभ्याहितस्य \\ ऊर्ध्वो अध्वरस् \\ इति संततं प्राञ्चं दीर्घम् ऋजुम् ऊर्ध्वम् अविछिन्नम् आघारम् आघारयति /
text_mt: Having made [the spoon] touch the southern junction of the enclosing sticks, on the southern half of what has been piled on, with "Upward is the sacrifice," he pours a continuous, eastward, long, straight, upward, unbroken libation of clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: prayājebhyaḥ śiṣṭvā bhūyiṣṭham ājyāhutīnāṃ juhoti /
meaning: प्रयाजेभ्यः शिष्ट्वा भूयिष्ठम् आज्याहुतीनां जुहोति /
text_mt: Leaving [a portion] for the fore-offerings, he offers the largest part of the butter libations.

sanskrit_iast: āghāryānuprāṇiti /
meaning: आघार्यानुप्राणिति /

sanskrit_iast:
pāhi māgne duścaritāt\ ā mā sucaritādbhaja /
ity asam̐sparśayan srucāv atyākrāmati //
meaning:
पाहि माग्ने दुश्चरितात्\ आ मा सुचरिताद्भज /
इत्य् असम्̐स्पर्शयन् स्रुचाव् अत्याक्रामति //
text_mt:
"Protect me, O Agni, from bad conduct; / grant me a share in good conduct"—

with [this formula], without letting the two offering spoons touch, he steps back across.

sanskrit_iast: saṃ jyotiṣā jyotir iti juhvā dhruvāṃ triḥ samanakti / juhvāpyāyayati dhruvām /
meaning: सं ज्योतिषा ज्योतिर् इति जुह्वा ध्रुवां त्रिः समनक्ति / जुह्वाप्याययति ध्रुवाम् /
text_mt: With "Light [united] with light," he anoints the dhruvā spoon three times with the juhū spoon. With the juhū spoon he replenishes the dhruvā spoon.

sanskrit_iast: yathāsthānam̐ srucau sādayati //
meaning: यथास्थानम्̐ स्रुचौ सादयति //
text_mt: He sets down the two offering spoons in their proper places.

sanskrit_iast: unnītam̐ rāye \\ iti dhruvāyāḥ sruveṇonnayati // suvīrāya svāhā \\ iti juhūm āpyāyayati //
meaning: उन्नीतम्̐ राये \\ इति ध्रुवायाः स्रुवेणोन्नयति // सुवीराय स्वाहा \\ इति जुहूम् आप्याययति //
text_mt: With "Drawn out for wealth," he draws out [butter] from the dhruvā spoon with the dipping spoon. With "For a good hero, svāhā!" he fills up the juhū spoon.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇena prāṇaḥ saṃtatas \\ iti dhruvāyām̐ sruvaṃ nidadhāti /
meaning: प्राणेन प्राणः संततस् \\ इति ध्रुवायाम्̐ स्रुवं निदधाति /
text_mt: With "Breath is linked with breath," he puts down the dipping spoon into the dhruvā spoon.

sanskrit_iast: samidhaḥ śakalam ādāyāvatiṣṭhate /
meaning: समिधः शकलम् आदायावतिष्ठते /
text_mt: Having taken a piece of a kindling stick, he stands still.

sanskrit_iast: prakṛṣya dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ barhiṣas tṛṇam̐ saṃtatam upodyamya brahman pravarāyāśrāvayiṣyāmi \\ ity uktvo *\\ śrāvaya \\ ity āśrāvayati /
meaning: प्रकृष्य दक्षिणं पादं बर्हिषस् तृणम्̐ संततम् उपोद्यम्य ब्रह्मन् प्रवरायाश्रावयिष्यामि \\ इत्य् उक्त्वो *\\ श्रावय \\ इत्य् आश्रावयति /
text_mt: Having advanced his right foot and continuously raised up a blade of sacrificial grass, having said, "O brahman priest, I shall call for the recitation of the ancestral line," he calls out, "Cause to hear!"

sanskrit_iast: sphyasaṃmārgapāṇir āgnīdhraḥ paścād utkarasyordhvas tiṣṭhann astu śrauṣaṭ \\ iti pratyāśrāvayati /
meaning: स्फ्यसंमार्गपाणिर् आग्नीध्रः पश्चाद् उत्करस्योर्ध्वस् तिष्ठन्न् अस्तु श्रौषट् \\ इति प्रत्याश्रावयति /
text_mt: The āgnīdhra priest, holding the wooden sword and the sweeping-bundle in his hand, standing upright behind the rubbish heap, responds with the formula: "Let it be heard!"

sanskrit_iast: pratyāśrute \\ agnir devo daivyo hotā devān yakṣad vidvām̐ś cikitvān manuṣvad bharatavad amuvad amuvat \\ ity ūrdhvān yajamānasyarṣīn pravṛṇīta ekaṃ dvau trīn pañca vā // brahmaṇvad ā ca vakṣat \\ brāhmaṇā asya yajñasya prāvitāras \\ iti japati / hotrā viyuktas tasyopām̐śu nāma gṛhītvā mānuṣas \\ ity uccaiḥ /
meaning: प्रत्याश्रुते \\ अग्निर् देवो दैव्यो होता देवान् यक्षद् विद्वाम्̐श् चिकित्वान् मनुष्वद् भरतवद् अमुवद् अमुवत् \\ इत्य् ऊर्ध्वान् यजमानस्यर्षीन् प्रवृणीत एकं द्वौ त्रीन् पञ्च वा // ब्रह्मण्वद् आ च वक्षत् \\ ब्राह्मणा अस्य यज्ञस्य प्रावितारस् \\ इति जपति / होत्रा वियुक्तस् तस्योपाम्̐शु नाम गृहीत्वा मानुषस् \\ इत्य् उच्चैः /
text_mt: When the response has been given, reciting, "Agni the divine hotṛ priest, may he sacrifice to the gods, being wise, knowing, as did Manu, as did Bharata, as did so-and-so, as did so-and-so," he names the remote ancestors of the sacrificer—one, two, three, or five. He mutters: "Endowed with the sacred word may he bring them here; the brāhmaṇas are the protectors of this sacrifice." Having separated [himself] from the hotṛ priest, having mentioned his name in a whisper, [he says] aloud, "A human!"

sanskrit_iast: śakalam agnāv adhyasyati /
meaning: शकलम् अग्नाव् अध्यस्यति /
text_mt: He throws the piece of kindling into the fire.

sanskrit_iast: yady abrāhmaṇo yajeta purohitasya pravareṇa pravṛṇīyāt /
meaning: यद्य् अब्राह्मणो यजेत पुरोहितस्य प्रवरेण प्रवृणीयात् /
text_mt: If a non-brāhmaṇa should sacrifice, he should choose the ancestral line with the recitation of the ancestral line of his domestic priest.

sanskrit_iast: juhūm upabhṛto 'greṇāvadadhyād uddharec ca /
meaning: जुहूम् उपभृतो ऽग्रेणावदध्याद् उद्धरेच् च /
text_mt: He should put down the juhū spoon in front of the upabhṛt spoon, and take it up [in the same manner].

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇena [ pādena ] dakṣiṇātikrāmati savyenodak /
meaning: दक्षिणेन [ पादेन ] दक्षिणातिक्रामति सव्येनोदक् /
text_mt: He steps across to the south with his right [foot], and to the north with his left.

sanskrit_iast: paridhisaṃdhī anvavahāram āsīna uttarato juhoti svāhākāravatīr vaṣaṭkāravatīr dakṣiṇataḥ prāgudaṅmukha ūrdhvas tiṣṭhan /
meaning: परिधिसंधी अन्ववहारम् आसीन उत्तरतो जुहोति स्वाहाकारवतीर् वषट्कारवतीर् दक्षिणतः प्रागुदङ्मुख ऊर्ध्वस् तिष्ठन् /
text_mt: Sitting down at the intersections of the enclosing sticks, he makes the offerings accompanied by svāhā from the north; standing upright facing north-east, [he makes] those accompanied by the vaṣaṭ-call from the south.

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya na viceṣṭed ā homāt /
meaning: आश्राव्य न विचेष्टेद् आ होमात् /
text_mt: Having called for the response, he should not move until the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: samaṃ prativaṣaṭkāram̐ vaṣaṭkṛte vā juhoti /
meaning: समं प्रतिवषट्कारम्̐ वषट्कृते वा जुहोति /
text_mt: He offers simultaneously with each vaṣaṭ-call, or when the vaṣaṭ-call has been uttered.

sanskrit_iast: mandreṇa svareṇājyabhāgābhyāṃ pracarati madhyamenānuyājebhya uttamenā śam̐yoḥ /
meaning: मन्द्रेण स्वरेणाज्यभागाभ्यां प्रचरति मध्यमेनानुयाजेभ्य उत्तमेना शम्̐योः /
text_mt: He proceeds with the two clarified butter portions in a low tone, up to the after-offerings in a medium [tone], and up to the Śaṃyu-formula in the highest [tone].

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtavatī adhvaryo \\ ity ucyamāne srucāv ādāya dakṣiṇātikrāmati /
meaning: घृतवती अध्वर्यो \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने स्रुचाव् आदाय दक्षिणातिक्रामति /
text_mt: When "[The ladles are] full of clarified butter, O adhvaryu" is being said, he takes the two ladles and steps across toward the south.

sanskrit_iast: abhikrāmam āśrāvaṃ pañca prayājān yajati // samidho yaja \\ iti prathamam \\ yaja yaja \\ ity uttarān /
meaning: अभिक्रामम् आश्रावं पञ्च प्रयाजान् यजति // समिधो यज \\ इति प्रथमम् \\ यज यज \\ इत्य् उत्तरान् /
text_mt: Advancing at each call for the response, he offers the five fore-offerings: "Offer to the fuels" for the first; "Offer, offer" for the subsequent ones.

sanskrit_iast: tribhiḥ pracaryaupabhṛtasya juhvām ānīya samānatra juhoti /
meaning: त्रिभिः प्रचर्यौपभृतस्य जुह्वाम् आनीय समानत्र जुहोति /
text_mt: Having proceeded with three, having poured [the butter] of the upabhṛt into the juhū, he offers in the same place.

sanskrit_iast: atyākramyābhighārayati dhruvāṃ dakṣiṇaṃ puroḍāśaṃ punar dhruvām upām̐śuyājāyottaraṃ puroḍāśam̐ sāyaṃdohaṃ prātardoham upabhṛtam antataḥ /
meaning: अत्याक्रम्याभिघारयति ध्रुवां दक्षिणं पुरोडाशं पुनर् ध्रुवाम् उपाम्̐शुयाजायोत्तरं पुरोडाशम्̐ सायंदोहं प्रातर्दोहम् उपभृतम् अन्ततः /
text_mt: Having stepped across, he bastes the dhruvā, the southern sacrificial cake, the dhruvā again for the whispered offering, the northern sacrificial cake, the evening milking, the morning milking, and the upabhṛt last of all.

sanskrit_iast: sruveṇāvadyati catuḥ pañcakṛtvo jāmadagnyasyechan pañcāvattaṃ jāmadagnyam āmantrya kurvīta /
meaning: स्रुवेणावद्यति चतुः पञ्चकृत्वो जामदग्न्यस्येछन् पञ्चावत्तं जामदग्न्यम् आमन्त्र्य कुर्वीत /
text_mt: He cuts portions with the sruva four times, [or] five times if he desires [a rite] for a descendant of Jamadagni; after addressing [the sacrificer], he should make it five portions for a descendant of Jamadagni.

sanskrit_iast: ājyabhāgau yajaty āgneyam uttarārdhe saumyaṃ dakṣiṇārdhe samāvanakṣṇayā /
meaning: आज्यभागौ यजत्य् आग्नेयम् उत्तरार्धे सौम्यं दक्षिणार्धे समावनक्ष्णया /
text_mt: He offers the two clarified butter portions: the one to Agni in the northern half, the one to Soma in the southern half, equally [and] diagonally.

sanskrit_iast:
dhrauvasyāvadāya
āpyāyatāṃ dhruvā ghṛtena \ yajñam̐ yajñaṃ prati devayadbhyaḥ /
sūryāyā ūdhar aditer upasthe\ utso bhava yajamānasya dhenuḥ //
ity avadāyāvadāyājyasthālyā dhruvāṃ pratyāpyāyayati //
meaning:
ध्रौवस्यावदाय
आप्यायतां ध्रुवा घृतेन \ यज्ञम्̐ यज्ञं प्रति देवयद्भ्यः /
सूर्याया ऊधर् अदितेर् उपस्थे\ उत्सो भव यजमानस्य धेनुः //
इत्य् अवदायावदायाज्यस्थाल्या ध्रुवां प्रत्याप्याययति //
text_mt:
"May the dhruvā swell with clarified butter, / at each sacrifice for those devoted to the gods.

The udder of Sūryā in the lap of Aditi; / be an overflowing spring, a milch-cow for the sacrificer!"

With this [formula], after each cutting, he causes the dhruvā to swell again from the clarified butter pot.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
meaning: अग्नये ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: He causes [the hotṛ] to recite: "Recite for Agni."

sanskrit_iast: anuvākyāyāḥ praṇavena sam̐srutyāśrāvayati /
meaning: अनुवाक्यायाः प्रणवेन सम्̐स्रुत्याश्रावयति /
text_mt: Harmonising with the praṇava of the invitatory verse, he calls for the response.

sanskrit_iast: pratyāśrute \\ agnim̐ yaja \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: प्रत्याश्रुते \\ अग्निम्̐ यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: When the response has been made, he prompts: "Offer to Agni."

sanskrit_iast: evam̐ saumyena pracarati /
meaning: एवम्̐ सौम्येन प्रचरति /
text_mt: In this manner he proceeds with the [offering] to Soma.

sanskrit_iast: upastīryāpa upaspṛśya dakṣiṇasya madhyāt \\ mā bhair \ mā sam̐vikthās \\ mā tvā him̐siṣam \\ bharatam uddharema \ vanuṣanty avadānāni te pratyavadāsyāmi \ namas te astu \ mā mā him̐sīr ity abhiparigṛhṇan sam̐hatābhyām aṅgulībhyām aṅguṣṭhena cāṅguṣṭhaparvamātrāṇy avadānāny avadyati madhyāt pūrvārdhād dvitīyaṃ / paścārdhāt tṛtīyam̐ yadi pañcāvadānasya /
meaning: उपस्तीर्याप उपस्पृश्य दक्षिणस्य मध्यात् \\ मा भैर् \ मा सम्̐विक्थास् \\ मा त्वा हिम्̐सिषम् \\ भरतम् उद्धरेम \ वनुषन्त्य् अवदानानि ते प्रत्यवदास्यामि \ नमस् ते अस्तु \ मा मा हिम्̐सीर् इत्य् अभिपरिगृह्णन् सम्̐हताभ्याम् अङ्गुलीभ्याम् अङ्गुष्ठेन चाङ्गुष्ठपर्वमात्राण्य् अवदानान्य् अवद्यति मध्यात् पूर्वार्धाद् द्वितीयं / पश्चार्धात् तृतीयम्̐ यदि पञ्चावदानस्य /
text_mt: Having spread an under-layer [of butter] and touched water, grasping from the middle of the southern [cake] with the words, "Do not fear, do not tremble; may I not harm you; let us lift up the portion; they covet, I shall cut off portions for you; homage be to you; do not harm me," he cuts off portions the size of a thumb-joint using his joined fingers and thumb: [first] from the middle, a second from the eastern half, and a third from the western half if it is for a five-portion cutting.

sanskrit_iast:
avattam abhighārya
yad avadānāni te 'vadyan \ vilomākārṣam ātmanaḥ /
ājyena pratyanajmi tat \ tat ta āpyāyatāṃ punaḥ //
iti puroḍāśaṃ pratyabhidhārayati //
meaning:
अवत्तम् अभिघार्य
यद् अवदानानि ते ऽवद्यन् \ विलोमाकार्षम् आत्मनः /
आज्येन प्रत्यनज्मि तत् \ तत् त आप्यायतां पुनः //
इति पुरोडाशं प्रत्यभिधारयति //
text_mt:
"What portions of you cutting / I have done against the grain,

that I anoint again with clarified butter; / let that swell again for you!"

with this [formula], he bastes the sacrificial cake in return.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
meaning: अग्नये ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: He causes [the hotṛ] to recite: "Recite for Agni."

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya \\ agnim̐ yaja \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: आश्राव्य \\ अग्निम्̐ यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Having called for the response, he prompts: "Offer to Agni."

sanskrit_iast: antarājyabhāgāvāhutīḥ prāgudīcīr apāyātayati /
meaning: अन्तराज्यभागावाहुतीः प्रागुदीचीर् अपायातयति /
text_mt: Between the two clarified butter portions, he directs the oblations towards the north-east.

sanskrit_iast: dhrauvasyāvadāyopām̐śuyājāv agnīṣomīyaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vaiṣṇavam amāvāsyāyām upām̐śu devate nirdiśati /
meaning: ध्रौवस्यावदायोपाम्̐शुयाजाव् अग्नीषोमीयं पौर्णमास्यां वैष्णवम् अमावास्यायाम् उपाम्̐शु देवते निर्दिशति /
text_mt: Having cut [a portion] from the dhruvā, he indicates the two deities in a whisper: Agni-Soma on the full-moon day and Viṣṇu on the new-moon day for the two whispered offerings.

sanskrit_iast: evam uttarasyāvadāya yathādevataṃ pracarati /
meaning: एवम् उत्तरस्यावदाय यथादेवतं प्रचरति /
text_mt: Having cut similarly from the northern [cake], he proceeds according to the deity.

sanskrit_iast: saṃnayata upastīrya yathāvadānam̐ samavadyati puroḍāśasya dohayoś ca \\ indrāyānubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati mahendrāya \\ iti vā /
meaning: संनयत उपस्तीर्य यथावदानम्̐ समवद्यति पुरोडाशस्य दोहयोश् च \\ इन्द्रायानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति महेन्द्राय \\ इति वा /
text_mt: For one who performs the curd and milk offering, having spread an under-layer, he cuts portions together according to the rule from the sacrificial cake and from the two milkings; he causes [the hotṛ] to recite: "Recite for Indra," or "for Mahendra."

sanskrit_iast: sāṃnāyyacarupaśupuroḍāśānāṃ pārśvena juhuyād dravāṇāṃ prasravaṇena / vyākhyātaṃ pracaraṇam /
meaning: सांनाय्यचरुपशुपुरोडाशानां पार्श्वेन जुहुयाद् द्रवाणां प्रस्रवणेन / व्याख्यातं प्रचरणम् /
text_mt: He should offer [the portions] of the curd and milk offering, the boiled oblation, and the animal cake from the side [of the ladle], [and those] of liquid substances by pouring. The procedure has been explained.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣabham̐ vājinam̐ vayam\ pūrṇamāsam̐ havāmahe /
sa no dohatām̐ suvīram\ rāyaspoṣam̐ sahasriṇam //
pūrṇamāsāya surādhase svāhā \\ iti paurṇamāsyām̐ sruveṇa juhoti /
amāvāsyā subhagā suśevā \ dhenur iva bhūya āpyāyamānā /
mā no dohatām̐ suvīram\ rāyaspoṣam̐ sahasriṇam //
amāvāsyāyai surādhase svāhā \\ ity amāvāsyāyām /
meaning:
ऋषभम्̐ वाजिनम्̐ वयम्\ पूर्णमासम्̐ हवामहे /
स नो दोहताम्̐ सुवीरम्\ रायस्पोषम्̐ सहस्रिणम् //
पूर्णमासाय सुराधसे स्वाहा \\ इति पौर्णमास्याम्̐ स्रुवेण जुहोति /
अमावास्या सुभगा सुशेवा \ धेनुर् इव भूय आप्यायमाना /
मा नो दोहताम्̐ सुवीरम्\ रायस्पोषम्̐ सहस्रिणम् //
अमावास्यायै सुराधसे स्वाहा \\ इत्य् अमावास्यायाम् /
text_mt:
"The bull, the vigorous one, / we invoke the full-moon.

May he yield for us good heroes, / abundance of wealth in thousands!"

With "To the full-moon of abundant gifts, svāhā!" he offers with the sruva on the full-moon day.

"The new-moon, auspicious and very benevolent, / swelling like an abundant milch-cow,

may she yield for us good heroes, / abundance of wealth in thousands!"

With "To the new-moon of abundant gifts, svāhā!" [he offers] on the new-moon day.

sanskrit_iast: sviṣṭakṛte samavadyaty uttarārdhātmakṛd dvimātraṃ / dvir vā yadi pañcāvadānasya /
meaning: स्विष्टकृते समवद्यत्य् उत्तरार्धात्मकृद् द्विमात्रं / द्विर् वा यदि पञ्चावदानस्य /
text_mt: He cuts portions together for the Sviṣṭakṛt offering once from the northern half, twice the size, or twice if it is for a five-portion cutting.

sanskrit_iast: avattaṃ dvir abhighārya nāta ūrdhvam̐ havīm̐ṣi pratyabhighārayati //
meaning: अवत्तं द्विर् अभिघार्य नात ऊर्ध्वम्̐ हवीम्̐षि प्रत्यभिघारयति //
text_mt: Having basted the cut portion twice, he does not baste the oblations in return after this point.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye sviṣṭakṛte 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
meaning: अग्नये स्विष्टकृते ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: He causes [the hotṛ] to recite: "Recite for Agni Sviṣṭakṛt."

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya [ pratyāśrute ] agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtam̐ yaja \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: आश्राव्य [ प्रत्याश्रुते ] अग्निं स्विष्टकृतम्̐ यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Having called for the response, [and when the response has been made,] he prompts: "Offer to Agni Sviṣṭakṛt."

sanskrit_iast: asam̐saktam uttarārdhapūrvārdhe juhoti /
meaning: असम्̐सक्तम् उत्तरार्धपूर्वार्धे जुहोति /
text_mt: Without touching [the other offerings], he offers in the north-eastern part.

sanskrit_iast: atyākramya yathāsthānam̐ srucau sādayati /
meaning: अत्याक्रम्य यथास्थानम्̐ स्रुचौ सादयति /
text_mt: Having stepped across, he sets down the two ladles in their proper place.

sanskrit_iast: prāśitraharaṇam uttarasya paścāt paridhisaṃdher vyuhyauṣadhīr avokṣite sādayati /
meaning: प्राशित्रहरणम् उत्तरस्य पश्चात् परिधिसंधेर् व्युह्यौषधीर् अवोक्षिते सादयति /
text_mt: Having moved aside the herbs behind the northern intersection of the enclosing sticks, he places the vessel for the prāśitra portion on the sprinkled spot.

sanskrit_iast: tasmin prāśitram avadyati dakṣiṇasya madhyād yavamātram aṅguṣṭhenopamadhyamayā cādāyābhighārayati /
meaning: तस्मिन् प्राशित्रम् अवद्यति दक्षिणस्य मध्याद् यवमात्रम् अङ्गुष्ठेनोपमध्यमया चादायाभिघारयति /
text_mt: Into it he cuts the prāśitra portion of the size of a barley corn from the middle of the southern [cake], having taken it with his thumb and ring finger, and bastes it.

sanskrit_iast: niṣṭapyeḍāpātrīṃ tasyām upastīryeḍāyai dvirdvir avadyati sthavīyo daivatebhyaḥ /
meaning: निष्टप्येडापात्रीं तस्याम् उपस्तीर्येडायै द्विर्द्विर् अवद्यति स्थवीयो दैवतेभ्यः /
text_mt: Having heated the iḍā dish over the fire and spread an under-layer in it, he cuts twice for the iḍā portion, thicker than [the portions] for the deities.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇasya bhakṣān avadyati /
meaning: दक्षिणस्य भक्षान् अवद्यति /
text_mt: He cuts the consumable portions from the southern [cake].

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇasya dakṣiṇārdhād avadāya pūrvārdhād yajamānabhāgam aṇuṃ dīrgham ājyalepe paryasya vede nidadhāti / madhyād dvitīyam aiḍam̐ saṃbhindann avadānāni /
meaning: दक्षिणस्य दक्षिणार्धाद् अवदाय पूर्वार्धाद् यजमानभागम् अणुं दीर्घम् आज्यलेपे पर्यस्य वेदे निदधाति / मध्याद् द्वितीयम् ऐडम्̐ संभिन्दन्न् अवदानानि /
text_mt: Having cut [a portion] from the southern half of the southern [cake], having rolled a thin, long portion for the sacrificer's share from the eastern half in the clarified butter smear, he places it on the veda bundle; a second portion from the middle for the iḍā portion, joining the cut portions.

sanskrit_iast: dhrauvasyāvadāyānupūrvam itareṣām /
meaning: ध्रौवस्यावदायानुपूर्वम् इतरेषाम् /
text_mt: Having cut [a portion] from the dhruvā, [he cuts] successively from the others.

sanskrit_iast: iḍām abhighārya pratyaṅṅ āsīno hotre prayachati /
meaning: इडाम् अभिघार्य प्रत्यङ्ङ् आसीनो होत्रे प्रयछति /
text_mt: Having basted the iḍā portion, sitting facing west, he hands it to the hotṛ.

sanskrit_iast: antareṇa hotāram iḍāṃ cādhvaryur dakṣiṇātikrāmati /
meaning: अन्तरेण होतारम् इडां चाध्वर्युर् दक्षिणातिक्रामति /
text_mt: Between the hotṛ and the iḍā portion, the adhvaryu steps across toward the south.

sanskrit_iast: paripragṛhṇāti hotānanusṛjan hotur aṅguliparvaṇī anakty antaram agre 'tha bāhyam /
meaning: परिप्रगृह्णाति होताननुसृजन् होतुर् अङ्गुलिपर्वणी अनक्त्य् अन्तरम् अग्रे ऽथ बाह्यम् /
text_mt: The hotṛ takes hold of it from all sides without letting go; he anoints the two joints of the hotṛ's fingers, first the inner, then the outer.

sanskrit_iast: hotuḥ pāṇau dvir lepenopastṛṇāti /
meaning: होतुः पाणौ द्विर् लेपेनोपस्तृणाति /
text_mt: He spreads an under-layer twice on the hotṛ's hand with the butter smear.

sanskrit_iast: avadānam̐ hotā randhayati / tad anyac ca lepād upastīrya lepād dvir abhighārayati /
meaning: अवदानम्̐ होता रन्धयति / तद् अन्यच् च लेपाद् उपस्तीर्य लेपाद् द्विर् अभिघारयति /
text_mt: The hotṛ readies the cut portion; having spread an under-layer of that and of something other than the smear, he bastes it twice with the smear.

sanskrit_iast: upahūyamānāyām ṛtvijo 'nvārabhante yajamānaś ca /
meaning: उपहूयमानायाम् ऋत्विजो ऽन्वारभन्ते यजमानश् च /
text_mt: While it is being invoked, the officiating priests and the sacrificer touch it from behind.

sanskrit_iast: upahūtāṃ pṛthak pāṇyor āgnīdhrāyāvadyati /
meaning: उपहूतां पृथक् पाण्योर् आग्नीध्रायावद्यति /
text_mt: When it has been invoked, he cuts off a portion into the separate hands of the āgnīdhra priest.

sanskrit_iast: saṃpreṣyati / ya uttaratas tān dakṣiṇataḥ parīta \\ iti brūyād ye vā dakṣiṇatas tān uttarataḥ parīta \\ iti /
meaning: संप्रेष्यति / य उत्तरतस् तान् दक्षिणतः परीत \\ इति ब्रूयाद् ये वा दक्षिणतस् तान् उत्तरतः परीत \\ इति /
text_mt: He issues the direction: he should say, "Those who are on the north, go around to the south," or "Those who are on the south, go around to the north."

sanskrit_iast: upahūtāṃ prāśnanty ṛtvijo yajamānaś ca /
meaning: उपहूतां प्राश्नन्त्य् ऋत्विजो यजमानश् च /
text_mt: When it has been invoked, the officiating priests and the sacrificer consume it.

sanskrit_iast: hotā prathamo bhakṣayate pṛthivyās tvā dātrā prāśnāmi \\ antarikṣasya tvā dātrā prāśnāmi \ divas tvā dātrā prāśnāmi \ diśāṃ tvā dātrā prāśnāmi \\ iti prāśnāty āgnīdhraḥ /
meaning: होता प्रथमो भक्षयते पृथिव्यास् त्वा दात्रा प्राश्नामि \\ अन्तरिक्षस्य त्वा दात्रा प्राश्नामि \ दिवस् त्वा दात्रा प्राश्नामि \ दिशां त्वा दात्रा प्राश्नामि \\ इति प्राश्नात्य् आग्नीध्रः /
text_mt: The hotṛ consumes it first with "I consume you by the giver of the earth; I consume you by the giver of the intermediate space; I consume you by the giver of heaven; I consume you by the giver of the quarters"—thus the āgnīdhra consumes it.

sanskrit_iast: śākhāpavitram̐ visram̐sya hotāgnihotrahavaṇyām avadhāyāntarvedi nidadhāti /
meaning: शाखापवित्रम्̐ विस्रम्̐स्य होताग्निहोत्रहवण्याम् अवधायान्तर्वेदि निदधाति /
text_mt: Having untied the strainer made of a branch, the hotṛ puts it in the agnihotra-ladle and places it within the altar.

sanskrit_iast: tatrāpohiṣṭhīyaṃ japanto mārjayante /
meaning: तत्रापोहिष्ठीयं जपन्तो मार्जयन्ते /
text_mt: There, muttering the hymn beginning with Āpohiṣṭhā, they sprinkle themselves with water.

sanskrit_iast: brahmabhāgam̐ sthavīyām̐sam̐ yajamānabhāgād avadāyājyalepe paryasya vede nidadhāti /
meaning: ब्रह्मभागम्̐ स्थवीयाम्̐सम्̐ यजमानभागाद् अवदायाज्यलेपे पर्यस्य वेदे निदधाति /
text_mt: Having cut off the portion for the brahman priest, thicker than the sacrificer's portion, and having turned it in the butter scrapings, he places it on the veda.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇaṃ [ puroḍāśaṃ ] caturantaṃ kṛtvā barhiṣi sādayati /
meaning: दक्षिणं [ पुरोडाशं ] चतुरन्तं कृत्वा बर्हिषि सादयति /
text_mt: Having made the southern [sacrificial cake] four-cornered, he sets it down on the sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: abhimṛṣṭaṃ pātryāṃ nidadhāti /
meaning: अभिमृष्टं पात्र्यां निदधाति /
text_mt: He places what was touched on the vessel.

sanskrit_iast: prāśitraharaṇam agreṇāhavanīyaṃ paryāhṛtya brahmaṇe prayachati /
meaning: प्राशित्रहरणम् अग्रेणाहवनीयं पर्याहृत्य ब्रह्मणे प्रयछति /
text_mt: Having carried around the vessel for the prāśitra portion in front of the āhavanīya fire, he hands it to the brahman priest.

sanskrit_iast: vedena bhāgau paryāhṛtya brahmaṇe prayachati yajamānāya ca /
meaning: वेदेन भागौ पर्याहृत्य ब्रह्मणे प्रयछति यजमानाय च /
text_mt: Having carried around the two portions with the veda, he hands them to the brahman priest and to the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: pratiparyāhṛtya yathāsthānam̐ vedaṃ nidadhāti /
meaning: प्रतिपर्याहृत्य यथास्थानम्̐ वेदं निदधाति /
text_mt: Having brought it back, he places the veda in its proper place.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāgnāv odanam̐ śṛtaṃ mahāntam abhighāryāpareṇa srugdaṇḍān udañcam udvāsayati / dohau pātrīṃ ca /
meaning: दक्षिणाग्नाव् ओदनम्̐ शृतं महान्तम् अभिघार्यापरेण स्रुग्दण्डान् उदञ्चम् उद्वासयति / दोहौ पात्रीं च /
text_mt: Having basted with clarified butter the large cooked rice oblation on the southern fire, he takes it off [the fire] to the north, behind the handles of the ladles; also the two milkings and the vessel.

sanskrit_iast: ānuyājikīm̐ samidham ādāya brahman prasthāsyāmaḥ [ iti brahmāṇam āmantrya ] samidham ādhāyāgnīt paridhīm̐ś cāgniṃ ca sakṛtsakṛt saṃmṛḍḍhi \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: आनुयाजिकीम्̐ समिधम् आदाय ब्रह्मन् प्रस्थास्यामः [ इति ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्य ] समिधम् आधायाग्नीत् परिधीम्̐श् चाग्निं च सकृत्सकृत् संमृड्ढि \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Taking the fuel-stick for the after-offerings, [having addressed the brahman priest with,] “Brahman, we shall set out,” and having placed the fuel-stick on [the fire], he issues the call: “Āgnīdhra, cleanse the enclosing sticks and the fire each once.”

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhraḥ saṃmārgam̐ sphyam upasam̐yamya yathāparidhitam anulomam̐ sakṛt saṃmārṣṭi \\ ājiṃ tvāgne sasṛvām̐sam̐ sanim̐ sasanivām̐saṃ devebhyo havyam ohivām̐sam̐ vājinaṃ tvā vājajitam̐ saṃmārjmi \\ agne vājam ajair ity agnim /
meaning: आग्नीध्रः संमार्गम्̐ स्फ्यम् उपसम्̐यम्य यथापरिधितम् अनुलोमम्̐ सकृत् संमार्ष्टि \\ आजिं त्वाग्ने ससृवाम्̐सम्̐ सनिम्̐ ससनिवाम्̐सं देवेभ्यो हव्यम् ओहिवाम्̐सम्̐ वाजिनं त्वा वाजजितम्̐ संमार्ज्मि \\ अग्ने वाजम् अजैर् इत्य् अग्निम् /
text_mt: The āgnīdhra priest, holding the sweeping [brush] together with the wooden sword, cleanses each enclosing stick once with the grain [of the wood, with the formula]: “You, O Agni, who have run the course, who have gained the gain, who have borne the oblation to the gods, a steed who wins the prize, I cleanse;” [and] with “O Agni, you have won the prize,” [he cleanses] the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
yo devānām asi śreṣṭhas\ ugras tanticaro vṛṣā /
mṛḍa tvam asmabhyam̐ rudra\ etad astu hutaṃ tava / svāhā //
iti saṃmārjam̐ visram̐syābhyukṣyāgnāv adhyasyati /
meaning:
यो देवानाम् असि श्रेष्ठस्\ उग्रस् तन्तिचरो वृषा /
मृड त्वम् अस्मभ्यम्̐ रुद्र\ एतद् अस्तु हुतं तव / स्वाहा //
इति संमार्जम्̐ विस्रम्̐स्याभ्युक्ष्याग्नाव् अध्यस्यति /
text_mt:
“You who are the best among the gods, / fierce, moving in a pack, a bull; /”}, disappointment: null,

“Be gracious to us, O Rudra; / let this be offered to you. Svāhā!” /”}, disappointment: null,

With these words, having untied the sweeping brush and sprinkled it with water, he throws it into the fire.

sanskrit_iast: aupabhṛtaṃ juhvām ānīyāśrāvaṃ trīn anuyājān yajati // devān yaja \\ iti prathamam̐ yaja yaja \\ ity uttarau / samidhaḥ pratīcaḥ /
meaning: औपभृतं जुह्वाम् आनीयाश्रावं त्रीन् अनुयाजान् यजति // देवान् यज \\ इति प्रथमम्̐ यज यज \\ इत्य् उत्तरौ / समिधः प्रतीचः /
text_mt: Having poured the [clarified butter] of the upabhṛt into the juhū, and having called for the response, he sacrifices the three after-offerings: with “Sacrifice to the gods” for the first; with “Sacrifice, sacrifice” for the latter two; the fuel-sticks westward.

sanskrit_iast: paśvārdhād uttamena prāñcāv anusaṃbhinatti /
meaning: पश्वार्धाद् उत्तमेन प्राञ्चाव् अनुसंभिनत्ति /
text_mt: From the middle of the animal [quarter] with the last [stick] he joins the two pointing forward.

sanskrit_iast: atyākramya yathāsthānam̐ srucau sādayati /
meaning: अत्याक्रम्य यथास्थानम्̐ स्रुचौ सादयति /
text_mt: Stepping across, he sets down the two ladles in their proper place.

sanskrit_iast: yajamānas \\ vājasya mā prasavena \\ iti dakṣiṇenottānena pāṇinā juhūm̐ saprastarām udgṛhṇāti \\ athā sapatnān indro me \\ iti nīcā savyenopabhṛtaṃ nigṛhṇāti \\ udgrābhaś ca nigrābhaś ca \\ iti vyudgṛhṇāti //
meaning: यजमानस् \\ वाजस्य मा प्रसवेन \\ इति दक्षिणेनोत्तानेन पाणिना जुहूम्̐ सप्रस्तराम् उद्गृह्णाति \\ अथा सपत्नान् इन्द्रो मे \\ इति नीचा सव्येनोपभृतं निगृह्णाति \\ उद्ग्राभश् च निग्राभश् च \\ इति व्युद्गृह्णाति //
text_mt: The sacrificer lifts the juhū together with the sacred grass bundle with his right hand turned upward with: “By the impulse of strength me…”; with his left hand turned downward he holds down the upabhṛt with: “Now my rivals Indra…”; he raises them apart with: “Lifting up and holding down…”

sanskrit_iast: athā sapatnān indrāgnī me \\ iti vyudūhati prācīṃ juhūṃ prastarātpratīcīm upabhṛtaṃ / bahirvedi nirasyati /
meaning: अथा सपत्नान् इन्द्राग्नी मे \\ इति व्युदूहति प्राचीं जुहूं प्रस्तरात्प्रतीचीम् उपभृतं / बहिर्वेदि निरस्यति /
text_mt: With: “Now my rivals Indra and Agni me…,” he pushes apart the juhū toward the east from the sacred grass bundle, and the upabhṛt toward the west; he casts it outside the sacrificial altar.

sanskrit_iast: abhyukṣya pratyāsādayati na juhūm prastare /
meaning: अभ्युक्ष्य प्रत्यासादयति न जुहूम् प्रस्तरे /
text_mt: Having sprinkled [them] with water, he sets [them] back down, [but] not the juhū on the sacred grass bundle.

sanskrit_iast: juhvānakti paridhīn vasur asi \\ iti madhyamam upāvasur asi \\ iti dakṣiṇam \\ viśvāvasur asi \\ ity uttaram /
meaning: जुह्वानक्ति परिधीन् वसुर् असि \\ इति मध्यमम् उपावसुर् असि \\ इति दक्षिणम् \\ विश्वावसुर् असि \\ इत्य् उत्तरम् /
text_mt: With the juhū he anoints the enclosing sticks: the middle one with “You are Vasu,” the southern with “You are Upāvasu,” the northern with “You are Viśvāvasu.”

sanskrit_iast: madhyame sruco 'gram̐ saṃdhāya srugdaṇḍe prastarasyāgrāṇy upasam̐yamyāśrāvayati /
meaning: मध्यमे स्रुचो ऽग्रम्̐ संधाय स्रुग्दण्डे प्रस्तरस्याग्राण्य् उपसम्̐यम्याश्रावयति /
text_mt: Joining the tip of the ladle onto the middle [enclosing stick] and holding the tips of the sacred grass bundle together on the handle of the ladle, he calls for the response.

sanskrit_iast: pratyāśrute \\ iṣitā daivyāhotāro bhadravācyāya preṣito mānuṣaḥ sūktavākāya \ sūktā brūhi \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: प्रत्याश्रुते \\ इषिता दैव्याहोतारो भद्रवाच्याय प्रेषितो मानुषः सूक्तवाकाय \ सूक्ता ब्रूहि \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: When the response has been given, he issues the call: “The divine hotṛs have been sent for speaking well; the human [hotṛ] has been urged for the sūktavāka recitation; recite the well-spoken hymns.”

sanskrit_iast: prastaram apādatte //

meaning: यजमाने प्राणापानौ दधामि \\ इति बर्हिषि विधृती प्रत्यवसृजति \\ आयुषे त्वा \\ इति तृणम्̐ सम्̐सृजति //
text_mt: With: “I place the out-breath and the in-breath in the sacrificer,” he throws down the two separating blades upon the sacrificial grass; with: “For long life, you,” he joins a grass blade [with them].

sanskrit_iast: aptubhī rihāṇā vyantu vayas \\ iti srukṣu prastaram anakty agrāṇi juhvāṃ madhyāny upabhṛti mūlāni dhruvāyām /
meaning: अप्तुभी रिहाणा व्यन्तु वयस् \\ इति स्रुक्षु प्रस्तरम् अनक्त्य् अग्राणि जुह्वां मध्यान्य् उपभृति मूलानि ध्रुवायाम् /
text_mt: With: “Licking with drops, let them enjoy the bird,” he anoints the sacred grass bundle in the ladles: the tips in the juhū, the middles in the upabhṛt, the roots in the dhruvā.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīṃ juhvām agrāṇy aktvā vaśā pṛśnir bhūtvā \\ ity anatiharan prastarasyāgrāṇy ādīpayati //

text_mt: Silently having anointed the tips in the juhū, without taking it across, he sets fire to the tips of the sacred grass bundle with: “Having become a speckled barren cow…”

sanskrit_iast: āśāste 'yam̐ yajamānas \\ ity ucyamāne saha śākhayā prastaram anupraharati //
meaning: आशास्ते ऽयम्̐ यजमानस् \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने सह शाखया प्रस्तरम् अनुप्रहरति //
text_mt: While “This sacrificer hopes for…” is being spoken, he throws the sacred grass bundle into the fire together with the branch.

sanskrit_iast: agnīd gamaya \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: अग्नीद् गमय \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He issues the call: “Āgnīdhra, make it go.”

sanskrit_iast: prastaram āgnīdhras triḥ pāṇinā gamayati //
meaning: प्रस्तरम् आग्नीध्रस् त्रिः पाणिना गमयति //

sanskrit_iast: anuprahara \ sam̐vadasva \\ iti cāha //
meaning: अनुप्रहर \ सम्̐वदस्व \\ इति चाह //
text_mt: And he says: “Throw after! Converse!”

sanskrit_iast: tato no vṛṣṭyāvata \\ iti tṛṇam agnāv adhyasyati //
meaning: ततो नो वृष्ट्यावत \\ इति तृणम् अग्नाव् अध्यस्यति //

sanskrit_iast: pratiṣṭhāsi \\ iti pṛthivīm ālabhate /

text_mt: With: “You are a firm support,” he touches the earth.

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast: apa upaspṛśya madhyamaṃ paridhim anvārabhya agān agnīt \\ ity āha \\ agan \\ ity āgnīdhraḥ // śrāvaya \\ ity adhvaryuḥ // śrauṣaṭ \\ ity āgnīdhraḥ //

text_mt: Having touched water and taken hold of the middle enclosing stick, he says: “Has he gone, Āgnīdhra?” “He has gone,” says the āgnīdhra priest. “Call for the response,” says the adhvaryu priest. “Śrauṣaṭ,” says the āgnīdhra priest.

sanskrit_iast: svagā daivyāhotṛbhyaḥ \ svastir mānuṣebhyaḥ \ śam̐yor brūhi \\ iti preṣyati //

text_mt: He issues the call: “Hail to the divine hotṛs! Welfare to the human ones! Recite the Śaṃyu formula.”

yaṃ paridhiṃ paryadhatthās\ agne deva paṇibhir vīyamānaḥ /

तञ् शम्̐योर् आवृणीमहे \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने मध्यमं दक्षिणं चादाय /
यं परिधिं पर्यधत्थास्\ अग्ने देव पणिभिर् वीयमानः /

With: “The path of the sacrifice has gathered,” he draws it obliquely from beneath the sacred grass bundle.

sanskrit_iast: upabhṛto 'graṃ juhvām ādhāya sam̐srāvabhāgāḥ stha \\ iti paridhīn abhijuhoti //
meaning: उपभृतो ऽग्रं जुह्वाम् आधाय सम्̐स्रावभागाः स्थ \\ इति परिधीन् अभिजुहोति //
text_mt: Placing the tip of the upabhṛt into the juhū, he offers over the enclosing sticks with: “You are the portions of the residue.”

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtācyau stho yajamānasya dhuryau pātam iti vedyam̐sayoḥ srucau vimuñcati / kastambadeśe vā yato yuñjānas tato vimuñcāmi \\ iti vimuñcati /
meaning: घृताच्यौ स्थो यजमानस्य धुर्यौ पातम् इति वेद्यम्̐सयोः स्रुचौ विमुञ्चति / कस्तम्बदेशे वा यतो युञ्जानस् ततो विमुञ्चामि \\ इति विमुञ्चति /
text_mt: With: “You two are anointed with clarified butter; protect the two yoke-pins of the sacrificer,” he unyokes the two ladles at the two shoulders of the sacrificial altar; or at the place of the peg, he unyokes them with: “From where yoking, from there I unyoke.”

sanskrit_iast: na vimukte barhiṣi pratyāsādayati /
meaning: न विमुक्ते बर्हिषि प्रत्यासादयति /
text_mt: When unyoked, he does not set them back down on the sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: sruvaṃ juhūṃ cādāyādhvaryuḥ pratyupakrāmati barhiṣas tṛṇam̐ vedaṃ ca hotā / ājyasthālīm āgnīdhraḥ paścād gārhapatyasya prāktūle tṛṇe sādayati /
meaning: स्रुवं जुहूं चादायाध्वर्युः प्रत्युपक्रामति बर्हिषस् तृणम्̐ वेदं च होता / आज्यस्थालीम् आग्नीध्रः पश्चाद् गार्हपत्यस्य प्राक्तूले तृणे सादयति /
text_mt: Taking the sruva spoon and the juhū, the adhvaryu priest steps back; the hotṛ priest takes a blade of the sacrificial grass and the veda; the āgnīdhra priest sets down the pot of clarified butter to the west of the gārhapatya fire on two blades of grass with their tips pointing east.

sanskrit_iast: antareṇa hotāram agniṃ cādhvaryuḥ pratyupakrāmati /
meaning: अन्तरेण होतारम् अग्निं चाध्वर्युः प्रत्युपक्रामति /
text_mt: Between the hotṛ priest and the fire, the adhvaryu priest steps back.

sanskrit_iast: madhye hotāsīno dhvānena patnīḥ sam̐yājayati /
meaning: मध्ये होतासीनो ध्वानेन पत्नीः सम्̐याजयति /
text_mt: Seated in the middle, the hotṛ priest performs the offerings to the wives [of the gods] with a murmering voice.

sanskrit_iast: vedopayāmo 'vadyan somāyānubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /

sanskrit_iast: uttarārdhe somam̐ yajati dakṣiṇārdhe tvaṣṭāram /

sanskrit_iast: pariśrityāhavanīyato devānāṃ patnīr yajati /

text_mt: Having screened off [the place] from the āhavanīya fire, he sacrifices to the wives of the gods.

sanskrit_iast: purastād devapatnīnām̐ sinīvālīṃ paśukāmasya yajed upariṣṭād rākām̐ vīrakāmasya kuhūṃ pratiṣṭhākāmasya //
meaning: पुरस्ताद् देवपत्नीनाम्̐ सिनीवालीं पशुकामस्य यजेद् उपरिष्टाद् राकाम्̐ वीरकामस्य कुहूं प्रतिष्ठाकामस्य //
text_mt: Before the wives of the gods he should sacrifice to Sinīvālī for one who desires cattle; after them to Rākā for one who desires heroic sons, to Kuhū for one who desires a firm standing.

text_mt: With: “May the wife go together with the husband to the world of good deeds,” while the wife holds on [to him], he offers with the sruva spoon.

sanskrit_iast: pariśrayaṇam upoddhṛtyāgniṃ gṛhapatim̐ yajati sviṣṭakṛtsthāne /

text_mt: Having lifted up the screen, he sacrifices to Agni, Lord of the House, in place of the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

text_mt: Having cut off [portions] ten times, the hotṛ not letting go, he anoints two finger joints of the hotṛ: first the outer, then the inner.

sanskrit_iast: hotuḥ pāṇau dvir lepenopastṛṇāti /
meaning: होतुः पाणौ द्विर् लेपेनोपस्तृणाति /

text_mt: The hotṛ prepares the cut-off portion; having spread an underlayer of it and of another [substance] besides the scrapings, he bastes it twice from the scrapings.

sanskrit_iast: upahūyamānāyāṃ patny anvārabhata āgnīdhraś ca /

text_mt: While the iḍā is being invoked, the wife and the āgnīdhra priest hold on.

sanskrit_iast: upahūtāṃ prāśnīto hotāgnīdhraś ca /
meaning: उपहूतां प्राश्नीतो होताग्नीध्रश् च /
text_mt: When it has been invoked, the hotṛ priest and the āgnīdhra priest eat it.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāgnāv idhmaparivāsanāny upasamādhāya caturgṛhīta ājye phalīkaraṇāny opya yā sarasvatī veśayamani \\ iti juhoti /

"I mix together the drops and the sparks; / may the All-gods enjoy this oblation, svāhā!"

sanskrit_iast: vedena nirmṛjyājyasyāvadāya \\ aindropānasyakehamanaso veśān kuru sumanasaḥ sajātān svāhā \\ iti grāmakāmasya juhoti /

sanskrit_iast: patnyai vedaṃ prayachati // vedo 'si \ vedo mā ābhara \\ iti japati //
meaning: पत्न्यै वेदं प्रयछति // वेदो ऽसि \ वेदो मा आभर \\ इति जपति //
text_mt: He hands the veda to the wife. She whispers: "You are the veda; bring me knowledge (or wealth)!"

sanskrit_iast: tṛptāhaṃ tṛptas tvam iti pratigṛhṇāty upasthe putrakāmā nidadhīta /

text_mt: She receives it with: "I am satisfied, you are satisfied." If she desires a son, she should place it in her lap.

sanskrit_iast:
imam̐ viṣyāmi varuṇasya pāśam\ yaj jagrantha savitā satyadharmā /
dhātuś ca yonau sukṛtasya loke\ ariṣṭāṃ mā saha patyā dadhātu //
iti yoktrapāśam̐ viṣāya sayoktram añjaliṃ kurute /

इमम्̐ विष्यामि वरुणस्य पाशम्\ यज् जग्रन्थ सविता सत्यधर्मा /
धातुश् च योनौ सुकृतस्य लोके\ अरिष्टां मा सह पत्या दधातु //
इति योक्त्रपाशम्̐ विषाय सयोक्त्रम् अञ्जलिं कुरुते /

"I untie this noose of Varuṇa, / which Savitṛ of true ordinances knotted.

In the womb of the Creator, in the world of good deeds, / may he place me unharmed together with my husband."

With this [mantra], having untied the loop of the girdle, she folds her hands together with the girdle.

sanskrit_iast:
sam āyuṣā saṃ prajayā \ sam agne varcasā punaḥ /
saṃ patnī patyāhaṃ gache \ sam ātmā tanvā mama //
ity udakāñjaliṃ ninīya mukhaṃ vimṛṣṭe /
meaning:
सम् आयुषा सं प्रजया \ सम् अग्ने वर्चसा पुनः /
सं पत्नी पत्याहं गछे \ सम् आत्मा तन्वा मम //
इत्य् उदकाञ्जलिं निनीय मुखं विमृष्टे /
text_mt:
"Together with lifespan, together with offspring, / together with luster again, O Agni,

may I, the wife, unite with my husband, / may my self unite with my body."

Having poured out a cavity of water with this [mantra], she wipes her face.

text_mt: With: "You are unyielding, O Agni..." he offers a single portion cut from the dhruvā ladle.

sanskrit_iast: sakṛd dhruvām āpyāyya barhiṣo darbhamuṣṭim apādāyāntarvedy ūrdhvas tiṣṭhan devā gātuvidas \\ iti dhruvayā saṃtatam̐ samiṣṭayajur juhoty ā mantrasya samāpanāt prāksvāhākārād darbhamuṣṭim anupraharati //
meaning: सकृद् ध्रुवाम् आप्याय्य बर्हिषो दर्भमुष्टिम् अपादायान्तर्वेद्य् ऊर्ध्वस् तिष्ठन् देवा गातुविदस् \\ इति ध्रुवया संततम्̐ समिष्टयजुर् जुहोत्य् आ मन्त्रस्य समापनात् प्राक्स्वाहाकाराद् दर्भमुष्टिम् अनुप्रहरति //
text_mt: Having replenished the dhruvā ladle once and taken a fistful of darbha from the sacrificial grass, standing upright within the sacrificial altar, he offers continuously with the dhruvā ladle the samiṣṭayajus with: "O gods, finders of the path...", [and] throws the fistful of darbha after [it] before the utterance of 'svāhā' until the completion of the mantra.

sanskrit_iast: yāni gharme kapālāni \\ ity etayā kapālāni vimuñcati /
meaning: यानि घर्मे कपालानि \\ इत्य् एतया कपालानि विमुञ्चति /
text_mt: With: "Which potsherds in the hot ritual vessel..." he releases the potsherds.

sanskrit_iast: saṃkhyāyodīcīnāny udvāsayati ye gharme \\ iti dve yad gharme \\ ity ekam //
meaning: संख्यायोदीचीनान्य् उद्वासयति ये घर्मे \\ इति द्वे यद् घर्मे \\ इत्य् एकम् //
text_mt: Having counted them, he removes them facing north: two with "Which [potsherds] in the hot ritual vessel..." and one with "Whichever in the hot ritual vessel..."

sanskrit_iast: ko vo vimuñcati \\ iti praṇītā manasā vimucyāgreṇāhavanīyaṃ paryāhṛtya poṣāya tvā \\ ity antarvedi nidadhāti //
meaning: को वो विमुञ्चति \\ इति प्रणीता मनसा विमुच्याग्रेणाहवनीयं पर्याहृत्य पोषाय त्वा \\ इत्य् अन्तर्वेदि निदधाति //
text_mt: With: "Who releases you?" he mentally releases the praṇītā waters, carries them round in front of the āhavanīya, and sets them down inside the sacrificial altar with: "For prospering thee."

sanskrit_iast: divi śilpam avatatam ity etayā barhir anupraharati /
meaning: दिवि शिल्पम् अवततम् इत्य् एतया बर्हिर् अनुप्रहरति /
text_mt: With: "A work of art stretched out in heaven..." he throws the sacrificial grass after.

sanskrit_iast:
stṛṇīta barhiḥ paridhatta vedim\ jāmiṃ mā him̐sīr anu yā śayānā /
darbhaiḥ stṛṇīta haritaiḥ suparṇair \ niṣkā hy ete yajamānasya bradhnam //
iti hotṛṣadanair vedim̐ saṃchādayati //
meaning:
स्तृणीत बर्हिः परिधत्त वेदिम्\ जामिं मा हिम्̐सीर् अनु या शयाना /
दर्भैः स्तृणीत हरितैः सुपर्णैर् \ निष्का ह्य् एते यजमानस्य ब्रध्नम् //
इति होतृषदनैर् वेदिम्̐ संछादयति //
text_mt:
"Spread out the sacrificial grass, encompass the sacrificial altar; / do not harm the sister lying alongside.

Spread it with green, well-winged darbha shoots; / for these are golden ornaments for the sacrificer's sun."

With this [verse] he covers the sacrificial altar with the hotṛ's seats.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇām̐s tarpaya \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: ब्राह्मणाम्̐स् तर्पय \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He issues the call: "Gratify the brahmins!"

sanskrit_iast: paurṇamāsīm̐ sam̐sthāpyendrāya vaimṛdhāyaikādaśakapālaṃ nirvaped abhrātṛvyavān tatra yathākāmaṃ dadyāt /
meaning: पौर्णमासीम्̐ सम्̐स्थाप्येन्द्राय वैमृधायैकादशकपालं निर्वपेद् अभ्रातृव्यवान् तत्र यथाकामं दद्यात् /
text_mt: Having concluded the full-moon sacrifice, one who has no rival should apportion [a cake] on eleven potsherds to Indra Vaimṛdha; there he may give [a gift] according to his wish.

sanskrit_iast: pravṛttau vikalpo nopakramya viramet /
meaning: प्रवृत्तौ विकल्पो नोपक्रम्य विरमेत् /
text_mt: There is an option regarding its commencement, but having begun it, he should not cease.

sanskrit_iast: adityā ghṛte carur amāvāsyām iṣṭvā paśukāmaḥ paśukāmaḥ /
meaning: अदित्या घृते चरुर् अमावास्याम् इष्ट्वा पशुकामः पशुकामः /
text_mt: Having sacrificed on the new-moon day, one who desires cattle, one who desires cattle, [prepares] a boiled oblation in clarified butter to Aditi.

sanskrit_iast: pūrṇe candramasy upavaset paurṇamāsīm adarśane 'māvāsyām / pūrve vā /
meaning: पूर्णे चन्द्रमस्य् उपवसेत् पौर्णमासीम् अदर्शने ऽमावास्याम् / पूर्वे वा /
text_mt: He should observe the fast for the full-moon sacrifice when the moon is full, and for the new-moon sacrifice when it is invisible; or on the preceding [day].

sanskrit_iast: keśaśmaśru yajamāno vāpayate dakṣiṇopakramān keśān /
meaning: केशश्मश्रु यजमानो वापयते दक्षिणोपक्रमान् केशान् /
text_mt: The sacrificer has his hair and beard shaved, the hair beginning from the right.

sanskrit_iast: savyopakramān nakhān adhyātmaṃ kaniṣṭhikātaḥ kārayate / na kakṣau /
meaning: सव्योपक्रमान् नखान् अध्यात्मं कनिष्ठिकातः कारयते / न कक्षौ /
text_mt: He has his nails pared toward himself beginning from the left, from the little finger; not the armpits.

sanskrit_iast: patnī nakhām̐ś ca kārayīta /
meaning: पत्नी नखाम्̐श् च कारयीत /
text_mt: The wife should also have her nails pared.

sanskrit_iast:
payasvatīr oṣadhayaḥ \ payasvad vīrudhāṃ payaḥ /
apāṃ payaso yat payas \ tena mām indra sam̐sṛjasva //
iti pāṇī prakṣālyopavatsv aśanam aśnīto 'nyan māṣebhyo mām̐sāc ca sarpiṣmat /
meaning:
पयस्वतीर् ओषधयः \ पयस्वद् वीरुधां पयः /
अपां पयसो यत् पयस् \ तेन माम् इन्द्र सम्̐सृजस्व //
इति पाणी प्रक्षाल्योपवत्स्व् अशनम् अश्नीतो ऽन्यन् माषेभ्यो माम्̐साच् च सर्पिष्मत् /
text_mt:
"Rich in sap are the plants, / rich in sap is the sap of the herbs.

What is the sap of the sap of waters, / with that, O Indra, unite me!"

Having washed their hands with this [mantra], the two fasting ones should eat food with clarified butter, other than māṣa beans and meat.

sanskrit_iast: paurṇamāsyāṃ bhuktvāmāvāsyāyāṃ na suhitau syātām //
meaning: पौर्णमास्यां भुक्त्वामावास्यायां न सुहितौ स्याताम् //
text_mt: Having eaten on the full-moon day, they should not be fully sated on the new-moon day.

sanskrit_iast: mamāgne varcas \\ ity āhavanīye samidham ādadhāti purastāt pratyaṅmukha ūrdhvas tiṣṭham̐s tūṣṇīm aparayoḥ /
meaning: ममाग्ने वर्चस् \\ इत्य् आहवनीये समिधम् आदधाति पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ्मुख ऊर्ध्वस् तिष्ठम्̐स् तूष्णीम् अपरयोः /
text_mt: With: "Mine, O Agni, is luster..." he places a kindling-stick on the āhavanīya in front, facing west, standing upright; silently on the two other [fires].

sanskrit_iast: hastā avanijya dakṣiṇato vratam upaiti //
meaning: हस्ता अवनिज्य दक्षिणतो व्रतम् उपैति //
text_mt: Having washed his hands, he enters upon the vow from the south.
