meaning: अन्तरितम्̐ रक्षो \ अन्तरिता अरातयस् \\ इति तृणेन त्रिः पर्यग्निं करोति /
text_mt: With a blade of grass, he carries fire around it three times, with: 'Warded off is the demon; warded off are the enemies.'

sanskrit_iast:
ud ehi vediṃ prajayā vardhayāsmān \ ud asya dveṣo abhayaṃ no astu /
mā no him̐sīḥ śapatho mābhicāraḥ \ śive kṣetre anamitre virāje //
ity udag udvāsayati vartma kurvan //
meaning:
उद् एहि वेदिं प्रजया वर्धयास्मान् \ उद् अस्य द्वेषो अभयं नो अस्तु /
मा नो हिम्̐सीः शपथो माभिचारः \ शिवे क्षेत्रे अनमित्रे विराजे //
इत्य् उदग् उद्वासयति वर्त्म कुर्वन् //
text_mt:
[Saying:] 'Come up to the vedi, increase us with offspring; / cast away hatred, let there be freedom from danger for us!

May no curse harm us, nor malevolent magic, / in an auspicious, friend-filled, radiant realm!'

—with this he takes it off [the fire] towards the north, making a path.

sanskrit_iast: pratyūḍhaṃ janyaṃ bhayam \\ pratyūḍhāḥ senā abhītvarīr ity aṅgārān pratyūhati vartma ca lopayati /
meaning: प्रत्यूढं जन्यं भयम् \\ प्रत्यूढाः सेना अभीत्वरीर् इत्य् अङ्गारान् प्रत्यूहति वर्त्म च लोपयति /
text_mt: With: 'Repulsed is the danger from enemies; repulsed are the attacking armies,' he shoves the embers back and effaces the path.

sanskrit_iast: payasā juhoti dadhnā yavāgvājyena vā /
meaning: पयसा जुहोति दध्ना यवाग्वाज्येन वा /
text_mt: He offers with milk, curd, barley gruel, or clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: dadhyājyayor adhiśrayaṇaṃ na syād abhitāpanaṃ ca //
meaning: दध्याज्ययोर् अधिश्रयणं न स्याद् अभितापनं च //
text_mt: For curd and clarified butter there should be neither setting on the fire nor heating around.

sanskrit_iast: niṣṭaptam̐ rakṣas \\ niṣṭaptā arātayas \\ iti gārhapatye sruksruvau niṣṭapati /
meaning: निष्टप्तम्̐ रक्षस् \\ निष्टप्ता अरातयस् \\ इति गार्हपत्ये स्रुक्स्रुवौ निष्टपति /
text_mt: He heats the offering ladle and the dipping spoon over the gārhapatya fire, with: 'Burned away is the demon; burned away are the enemies.'

sanskrit_iast: sruve samidham upasaṃyamya \\ unneṣyāmi \\ ity uktvā \\ unnayāmi \\ iti prātar bhūr iḍā \ bhuva iḍā \ svar iḍā \ jana iḍā \\ ity ekaikenonnayaty uttaramuttaraṃ bhūyām̐saṃ pūrṇam uttamam̐ sarvān vā samān //
meaning: स्रुवे समिधम् उपसंयम्य \\ उन्नेष्यामि \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा \\ उन्नयामि \\ इति प्रातर् भूर् इडा \ भुव इडा \ स्वर् इडा \ जन इडा \\ इत्य् एकैकेनोन्नयत्य् उत्तरमुत्तरं भूयाम्̐सं पूर्णम् उत्तमम्̐ सर्वान् वा समान् //
text_mt: Holding the kindling stick together with the dipping spoon, having said: 'I shall scoop out,' [in the evening], and 'I scoop out' in the morning, he scoops out with each [formula]: 'Bhūḥ, Iḍā; Bhuvaḥ, Iḍā; Svaḥ, Iḍā; Janaḥ, Iḍā'—each successive [ladleful] larger, the last one full; or all of them equal.

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ devānām ity unnītam abhimṛśati \\ idam u naḥ saha \\ iti śeṣam //
meaning: इदं देवानाम् इत्य् उन्नीतम् अभिमृशति \\ इदम् उ नः सह \\ इति शेषम् //
text_mt: He touches the scooped-out [milk] with: 'This is of the gods,' and the remainder with: 'And this is ours together.'

sanskrit_iast: paśūn me yacha \\ iti darbheṣu sādayati prāktarām̐ vā /
meaning: पशून् मे यछ \\ इति दर्भेषु सादयति प्राक्तराम्̐ वा /
text_mt: He places [the ladle] on the darbha-grass with: 'Grant me cattle,' or further to the east.

sanskrit_iast: daśahotrāgnihotram unnītam abhimṛśati /
meaning: दशहोत्राग्निहोत्रम् उन्नीतम् अभिमृशति /
text_mt: He touches the scooped-out agnihotra milk with the Daśahotṛ formula.

sanskrit_iast: upariṣṭāt srugdaṇḍe samidham upasam̐yamya \\ urv antarikṣam̐ vīhi \\ iti samayāgnim̐ harati //
meaning: उपरिष्टात् स्रुग्दण्डे समिधम् उपसम्̐यम्य \\ उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम्̐ वीहि \\ इति समयाग्निम्̐ हरति //
text_mt: Holding the kindling stick on top of the handle of the ladle, he carries it along the middle of the fires with: 'Enter the wide middle region!'

sanskrit_iast: svāhāgnaye vaiśvānarāya \\ iti samayārdhe niyachati //
meaning: स्वाहाग्नये वैश्वानराय \\ इति समयार्धे नियछति //
text_mt: Halfway along, he lowers it with: 'Svāhā to Agni Vaiśvānara!'

sanskrit_iast: vāyave tvā \\ ity udyachati //
meaning: वायवे त्वा \\ इत्य् उद्यछति //
text_mt: He raises it with: 'To Vāyu thee!'

sanskrit_iast: āyur me yacha \\ iti darbheṣu sādayati //
meaning: आयुर् मे यछ \\ इति दर्भेषु सादयति //
text_mt: He places it down on the darbha-grass with: 'Grant me life!'

sanskrit_iast: eṣā te agne samit tayā tvam̐ vardhasva cā ca pyāyasva \ vardhiṣīmahi ca vayam ā ca pyāyiṣīmahi ca svāhā \\ iti samidham ādadhāti /
meaning: एषा ते अग्ने समित् तया त्वम्̐ वर्धस्व चा च प्यायस्व \ वर्धिषीमहि च वयम् आ च प्यायिषीमहि च स्वाहा \\ इति समिधम् आदधाति /
text_mt: He puts the kindling stick [on the fire] with: 'This is your kindling stick, O Agni; grow by it and swell! May we also grow and swell, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāpāne nimiṣe dhyāyet /
meaning: प्राणापाने निमिषे ध्यायेत् /
text_mt: He should meditate on out-breath and in-breath during the twinkling of an eye.

sanskrit_iast: dvyaṅgule samidham abhijuhoti śenīṃ jvalantīm̐ vā //
meaning: द्व्यङ्गुले समिधम् अभिजुहोति शेनीं ज्वलन्तीम्̐ वा //
text_mt: He pours the oblation over the kindling stick at a height of two finger-breadths, or while it is whitish or flaming.

sanskrit_iast: bhūr bhuvaḥ svar agnihotram \ agnir jyotir jyotir agniḥ svāhā \\ iti sāyaṃ juhoti // bhūr bhuvaḥ svar agnihotram \\ sūryo jyotir jyotiḥ sūryaḥ svāhā \\ iti prātaḥ //
meaning: भूर् भुवः स्वर् अग्निहोत्रम् \ अग्निर् ज्योतिर् ज्योतिर् अग्निः स्वाहा \\ इति सायं जुहोति // भूर् भुवः स्वर् अग्निहोत्रम् \\ सूर्यो ज्योतिर् ज्योतिः सूर्यः स्वाहा \\ इति प्रातः //
text_mt: In the evening he offers with: 'Bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ, the agnihotra! Agni is light, light is Agni, svāhā!' In the morning with: 'Bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ, the agnihotra! Sūrya is light, light is Sūrya, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: varco me yacha \\ iti darbheṣu sādayati //
meaning: वर्चो मे यछ \\ इति दर्भेषु सादयति //
text_mt: He places [the ladle] down on the darbha-grass with: 'Grant me splendor!'

sanskrit_iast: prajāpate paśūn me yacha \\ iti gārhapatyam avekṣate //
meaning: प्रजापते पशून् मे यछ \\ इति गार्हपत्यम् अवेक्षते //
text_mt: He looks towards the gārhapatya fire with: 'O Prajāpati, grant me cattle!'

sanskrit_iast: prajāpataye svāhā \\ iti manasottarāṃ bhūyasīm /
meaning: प्रजापतये स्वाहा \\ इति मनसोत्तरां भूयसीम् /
text_mt: Mentally, he makes the second offering, larger [than the first], with: 'To Prajāpati svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: śiṣṭvā bhūyiṣṭham anābho mṛḍa dhūrta \\ iti samayāgniṃ trir udaṅṅ uddiśati //
meaning: शिष्ट्वा भूयिष्ठम् अनाभो मृड धूर्त \\ इति समयाग्निं त्रिर् उदङ्ङ् उद्दिशति //
text_mt: Leaving the greater part, he points northwards along the line of the fire three times with: 'Uninjured one, be gracious, O deceiver!'

sanskrit_iast: iṣe tvā \\ ity avācīnam̐ sāyam avamārṣṭi \\ ūrje tvā \\ ity ūrdhvaṃ divonmārṣṭi //
meaning: इषे त्वा \\ इत्य् अवाचीनम्̐ सायम् अवमार्ष्टि \\ ऊर्जे त्वा \\ इत्य् ऊर्ध्वं दिवोन्मार्ष्टि //
text_mt: In the evening he wipes [the ladle] downward with: 'For sap thee!' In the morning he wipes it upward towards the sky with: 'For strength thee!'

sanskrit_iast: prajāṃ me yacha \\ ity udagdaṇḍāṃ nidadhāti //
meaning: प्रजां मे यछ \\ इत्य् उदग्दण्डां निदधाति //
text_mt: He puts it down with its handle pointing north, with: 'Grant me offspring!'

sanskrit_iast: oṣadhīr jinva \\ iti darbheṣu lepaṃ nimārṣṭi //
meaning: ओषधीर् जिन्व \\ इति दर्भेषु लेपं निमार्ष्टि //
text_mt: He wipes off the residue on the darbha-grass with: 'Quicken the plants!'

sanskrit_iast: pitṛbhyaḥ svadhā \\ iti dakṣiṇata uttānaṃ pāṇiṃ nidadhāti //
meaning: पितृभ्यः स्वधा \\ इति दक्षिणत उत्तानं पाणिं निदधाति //
text_mt: He places his palm turned upwards to the south with: 'Svadhā to the fathers!'

sanskrit_iast: pūṣāsi \\ ity aṅgulyā dviḥ prāśnāty asparśayan dantān //
meaning: पूषासि \\ इत्य् अङ्गुल्या द्विः प्राश्नात्य् अस्पर्शयन् दन्तान् //
text_mt: With his finger he eats twice without touching his teeth, with: 'You are Pūṣan.'

sanskrit_iast: itarajanebhyaḥ svāhā \\ iti nirleḍhi // gandhrvetarajanebhyaḥ svāhā \\ iti prātaḥ /
meaning: इतरजनेभ्यः स्वाहा \\ इति निर्लेढि // गन्ध्र्वेतरजनेभ्यः स्वाहा \\ इति प्रातः /
text_mt: He licks [the finger] clean with: 'To the other folk svāhā!' In the morning: 'To the Gandharvas and other folk svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: anirmṛṣṭāyām asicya sarpān pipīlikāḥ prīṇāmi sarpapipīlikābhyaḥ svāhā \\ iti prāgudīcīs trir apo niḥsārayati /
meaning: अनिर्मृष्टायाम् असिच्य सर्पान् पिपीलिकाः प्रीणामि सर्पपिपीलिकाभ्यः स्वाहा \\ इति प्रागुदीचीस् त्रिर् अपो निःसारयति /
text_mt: Having poured water into the uncleaned [ladle], he discharges the water three times towards the north-east with: 'I gladden the snakes and ants; to the snakes and ants svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: darbhaiḥ prakṣālyāsicya tūṣṇīṃ trir ninayati /
meaning: दर्भैः प्रक्षाल्यासिच्य तूष्णीं त्रिर् निनयति /
text_mt: Having cleansed it with darbha-grass and poured [water in], he pours it out silently three times.

sanskrit_iast: pūrṇām ādāya \\ amṛte pra ṇaṃ juhomi svāhā \\ iti paścād āhavanīyasyodīcīṃ ninayati // prāṇam amṛte prāṇaṃ juhomi svāhā \\ iti prātaḥ /
meaning: पूर्णाम् आदाय \\ अमृते प्र णं जुहोमि स्वाहा \\ इति पश्चाद् आहवनीयस्योदीचीं निनयति // प्राणम् अमृते प्राणं जुहोमि स्वाहा \\ इति प्रातः /
text_mt: Taking it full [of water], he pours it out to the north behind the āhavanīya fire with: 'Into the immortal I offer the out-breath, svāhā!' In the morning with: 'The out-breath into the immortal, I offer the out-breath, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: agnihotrahavanīṃ pratapya hastam avadadhāti hastam̐ vā pratapyāgnihotrahavaṇyām avadhāyodgṛhyodīcīṃ nidadhāti /
meaning: अग्निहोत्रहवनीं प्रतप्य हस्तम् अवदधाति हस्तम्̐ वा प्रतप्याग्निहोत्रहवण्याम् अवधायोद्गृह्योदीचीं निदधाति /
text_mt: Having heated the agnihotra ladle, he places his hand on it; or having heated his hand and placed it on the agnihotra ladle, he lifts it up and sets it down pointing to the north.

sanskrit_iast: sruveṇāparayor juhoti \\ agne gṛhapate \\ iti gārhapatye sruvārdham \\ svāhā \\ iti śeṣam annapate annasya no dehi \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnau sruvārdham \\ svāhā \\ iti śeṣam ahomo vāparayoḥ /
meaning: स्रुवेणापरयोर् जुहोति \\ अग्ने गृहपते \\ इति गार्हपत्ये स्रुवार्धम् \\ स्वाहा \\ इति शेषम् अन्नपते अन्नस्य नो देहि \\ इति दक्षिणाग्नौ स्रुवार्धम् \\ स्वाहा \\ इति शेषम् अहोमो वापरयोः /
text_mt: With the dipping spoon he makes offerings in the two other fires: in the gārhapatya fire, half the spoon with: 'O Agni, lord of the house,' and the remainder with: 'svāhā'; in the southern fire, half the spoon with: 'O lord of food, give us food,' and the remainder with: 'svāhā'; or there is no offering in the two other fires.

sanskrit_iast: yāṃ prathamāgnihotrāya duhyāt sā dakṣiṇā payo vā /
meaning: यां प्रथमाग्निहोत्राय दुह्यात् सा दक्षिणा पयो वा /
text_mt: The cow that one milks for the first agnihotra is the sacrificial gift, or milk.

sanskrit_iast: rājanyasyāgnihotraṃ dhārmukasya nityaṃ parvasv itarasya / bhaktaṃ ca nityaṃ brāhmaṇāya dadyāt /
meaning: राजन्यस्याग्निहोत्रं धार्मुकस्य नित्यं पर्वस्व् इतरस्य / भक्तं च नित्यं ब्राह्मणाय दद्यात् /
text_mt: The agnihotra of a continuous performer among nobles is regular; for another, [it is performed] on the parvan days; and he should always give cooked food to a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: vāgyato 'dhiśrita unnīyamāne vā pāṇī prakṣālyamāno vihavyasya catasra ṛco japati /
meaning: वाग्यतो ऽधिश्रित उन्नीयमाने वा पाणी प्रक्षाल्यमानो विहव्यस्य चतस्र ऋचो जपति /
text_mt: Restraining speech, while [the milk] is set on the fire or being scooped out, or while washing his hands, he mutters the four verses of the Vihavya hymn.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇataḥ prāgudaṅmukha ūrdhvas tiṣṭhan \\ unneṣyāmi \\ ity ukte bhūr bhuvaḥ svar \ om unnaya \\ ity anujānāti /
meaning: दक्षिणतः प्रागुदङ्मुख ऊर्ध्वस् तिष्ठन् \\ उन्नेष्यामि \\ इत्य् उक्ते भूर् भुवः स्वर् \ ओम् उन्नय \\ इत्य् अनुजानाति /
text_mt: Standing upright to the south, facing north-east, when it is said: 'I shall scoop out,' he grants permission with: 'Bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ, Om, scoop out!'

sanskrit_iast: upaviśyābhyudāhṛtaṃ daśahotrābhimṛśati prathamāgnihotram̐ vyāhṛtibhiś ca /
meaning: उपविश्याभ्युदाहृतं दशहोत्राभिमृशति प्रथमाग्निहोत्रम्̐ व्याहृतिभिश् च /
text_mt: Having sat down, he touches the [milk] brought forward with the Daśahotṛ formula, and at the first agnihotra, with the vyāhṛtis as well.

sanskrit_iast: sam̐vatsaresam̐vatsare ca hutāyāṃ pūrvasyām upotthāya \\ upaprayanto adhvaram iti dve nigadya yuvam etāni \\ ity agnīṣomīyayā jyautsna upatiṣṭhata aindrāgnyā tāmisre \\ ayam iha prathamo dhāyi dhātṛbhir iti /
meaning: सम्̐वत्सरेसम्̐वत्सरे च हुतायां पूर्वस्याम् उपोत्थाय \\ उपप्रयन्तो अध्वरम् इति द्वे निगद्य युवम् एतानि \\ इत्य् अग्नीषोमीयया ज्यौत्स्न उपतिष्ठत ऐन्द्राग्न्या तामिस्रे \\ अयम् इह प्रथमो धायि धातृभिर् इति /
text_mt: Year after year, when the first oblation has been offered, standing up, having recited the two verses beginning: 'Approaching the sacrifice,' he reverences [the fires] during the bright fortnight with the Agnīṣoma verse: 'You two have [placed] these,' and during the dark fortnight with the Indrāgni verse: 'This one was placed here first by the creators.'

sanskrit_iast: agnīṣomīyāyāḥ purastād vihavyasya catasra ṛco japati //
meaning: अग्नीषोमीयायाः पुरस्ताद् विहव्यस्य चतस्र ऋचो जपति //
text_mt: Before the Agnīṣoma verse, he mutters the four verses of the Vihavya hymn.

sanskrit_iast: agnīṣomā imam̐ su me \\ itiprabhṛtyā samilliṅgair tais tisraḥ samidha ādadhāti /
meaning: अग्नीषोमा इमम्̐ सु मे \\ इतिप्रभृत्या समिल्लिङ्गैर् तैस् तिस्रः समिध आदधाति /
text_mt: Beginning with: 'O Agni and Soma, this [prayer] of mine,' he lays on three kindling sticks with those [verses] containing the characteristic word 'kindling stick'.

sanskrit_iast: samānam ā citrāvaso svasti te pāram aśīya \\ iti triḥ //
meaning: समानम् आ चित्रावसो स्वस्ति ते पारम् अशीय \\ इति त्रिः //
text_mt: The same [is done] up to: 'O Citrāvasu, may I reach your other side in well-being,' three times.

sanskrit_iast: ambhaḥ sthāmbho vo bhakṣīya \\ iti vatsam ālabhate //
meaning: अम्भः स्थाम्भो वो भक्षीय \\ इति वत्सम् आलभते //
text_mt: He touches the calf with: 'You are water, may I partake of your water.'

sanskrit_iast: upa tvāgne divedive \\ ity aṣṭābhir gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate //
meaning: उप त्वाग्ने दिवेदिवे \\ इत्य् अष्टाभिर् गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते //
text_mt: He reverences the gārhapatya fire with the eight verses beginning: 'Unto thee, O Agni, day by day.'

sanskrit_iast: ūrjā vaḥ paśyāmi \\ iti gām ālabhate //
meaning: ऊर्जा वः पश्यामि \\ इति गाम् आलभते //
text_mt: He touches the cow with: 'With nourishment I look upon you.'

sanskrit_iast: mahi trīṇām avo 'stu \\ ity āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhate //
meaning: महि त्रीणाम् अवो ऽस्तु \\ इत्य् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठते //
text_mt: With 'May the great help of the three be ours', he reverences the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: nimrado 'si \\ iti yathopadiṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇena //
meaning: निम्रदो ऽसि \\ इति यथोपदिष्टं ब्राह्मणेन //
text_mt: With 'You are humbling…', according as taught by the Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: pūṣā mā pathipāḥ pātu \\ ity ekaikenopatiṣṭhate pṛthivīm antarikṣaṃ divaṃ ca //
meaning: पूषा मा पथिपाः पातु \\ इत्य् एकैकेनोपतिष्ठते पृथिवीम् अन्तरिक्षं दिवं च //
text_mt: With 'May Pūṣan, the path-protector, protect me', he reverences one by one the earth, the intermediate space, and the sky.

sanskrit_iast: prācī dik \\ agnir devatā \\ iti pratidiśam̐ yathāmnātaṃ // dharmo mā dharmaṇaḥ pātu \\ iti ca yathāmnātam /
meaning: प्राची दिक् \\ अग्निर् देवता \\ इति प्रतिदिशम्̐ यथाम्नातं // धर्मो मा धर्मणः पातु \\ इति च यथाम्नातम् /
text_mt: With 'The eastern quarter… Agni is the deity…', according to the sacred text for each quarter; and with 'May dharma protect me from [falling from] dharma', according to the sacred text.

sanskrit_iast: upaviśyāntarāgnī jyotiṣe tantave tvā \\ iti japati /
meaning: उपविश्यान्तराग्नी ज्योतिषे तन्तवे त्वा \\ इति जपति /
text_mt: Having sat down between the two fires, he mutters: 'For light, for offspring [I place] you.'

sanskrit_iast: sāyaṃ patny anvāste na prātaḥ /
meaning: सायं पत्न्य् अन्वास्ते न प्रातः /
text_mt: The wife sits by in the evening, not in the morning.

sanskrit_iast:
śvobhūte
sūryapatnīr upāsaran \ devīr uṣasa āyatīḥ /
tā mā yajñasya mātaras\ abhiṣiñcantu varcasā //
varcasā draviṇena ca \ devīr mām abhiṣiñcantu /
dviṣanto radhyantāṃ mahyam\ mā tv ahaṃ dviṣṭām̐ radham //
ṛṣir asmy ekavīras\ virājo 'smi nṛṣāsahiḥ /
āvalgo 'smi sam̐valgas\ vajro hāsmi sapatnahā //
sapatnān ahanam̐ ripūn \ pratiṣiktā arātayaḥ /
pratiṣiktā arātayas\ ariṣṭāḥ saṃcaremahi //
arvāgvasur iti trir uktvā vihavyasya catasra ṛco japati /
meaning:
श्वोभूते
सूर्यपत्नीर् उपासरन् \ देवीर् उषस आयतीः /
ता मा यज्ञस्य मातरस्\ अभिषिञ्चन्तु वर्चसा //
वर्चसा द्रविणेन च \ देवीर् माम् अभिषिञ्चन्तु /
द्विषन्तो रध्यन्तां मह्यम्\ मा त्व् अहं द्विष्टाम्̐ रधम् //
ऋषिर् अस्म्य् एकवीरस्\ विराजो ऽस्मि नृषासहिः /
आवल्गो ऽस्मि सम्̐वल्गस्\ वज्रो हास्मि सपत्नहा //
सपत्नान् अहनम्̐ रिपून् \ प्रतिषिक्ता अरातयः /
प्रतिषिक्ता अरातयस्\ अरिष्टाः संचरेमहि //
अर्वाग्वसुर् इति त्रिर् उक्त्वा विहव्यस्य चतस्र ऋचो जपति /
text_mt:
'The divine Dawns, wives of the Sun, approaching, have stepped forth; /'

'May they, the mothers of the sacrifice, sprinkle me with splendor! /'

'With splendor and with wealth may the goddesses sprinkle me; /'

'May those who hate me be subdued to me; may I not be subdued to him who hates me! /'

'I am a seer, a sole hero; I am sovereign, conqueror of men; /'

'I am an attacker, a crusher; I am indeed a thunderbolt, the slayer of rivals! /'

'I have slain the rivals, the enemies; poured out are the foes; /'

'Poured out are the foes; uninjured may we go about!'

Having said 'Arvāgvasu' three times, he mutters the four verses of the Vihavya hymn.

sanskrit_iast: yo yajamāno na śreyān syāt sa vihavyenopatiṣṭheta /
meaning: यो यजमानो न श्रेयान् स्यात् स विहव्येनोपतिष्ठेत /
text_mt: A sacrificer who is not prosperous should reverence [the fires] with the Vihavya hymn.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāvarā rātrīr uṣitvā sahadhanaḥ prayāsyann ādhāyāneyāny anapohyāny apoddhṛtyordhvam̐ prātarāhuteḥ sarveṣu yukteṣu \\ amīvahā vāstoṣpate \ vāstoṣpate \\ ity ete nigadyāhutiṃ juhoti /
tubhyaṃ tā aṅgirastama \ viśvāḥ sukṣitayaḥ pṛthak / \ agne kāmāya yemire //
iti dvitīyām /
meaning:
दशावरा रात्रीर् उषित्वा सहधनः प्रयास्यन्न् आधायानेयान्य् अनपोह्यान्य् अपोद्धृत्योर्ध्वम्̐ प्रातराहुतेः सर्वेषु युक्तेषु \\ अमीवहा वास्तोष्पते \ वास्तोष्पते \\ इत्य् एते निगद्याहुतिं जुहोति /
तुभ्यं ता अङ्गिरस्तम \ विश्वाः सुक्षितयः पृथक् / \ अग्ने कामाय येमिरे //
इति द्वितीयाम् /
text_mt:
Having dwelt at least ten nights, when about to depart with his property, having loaded the things to be taken, having set aside the things not to be abandoned, after the morning offering, when all [the draught animals] are harnessed, having recited 'O slayer of disease, Lord of the dwelling! O Lord of the dwelling!', he offers an oblation.

'To you, O most Angiras-like, all those good dwellings singly / have yielded to your desire, O Agni.'

sanskrit_iast: pravatsyan \\ ayaṃ te yonir ṛtviyas \\ ity araṇyoḥ samāropayati / yadi gataśrīḥ sarvān //
meaning: प्रवत्स्यन् \\ अयं ते योनिर् ऋत्वियस् \\ इत्य् अरण्योः समारोपयति / यदि गतश्रीः सर्वान् //
text_mt: When about to set out on a journey, he mounts [the fires] into the two churning sticks with: 'This is your seasonal womb...'; if he is one who has attained prosperity, [he mounts] all [the fires].

sanskrit_iast: yā te agne yajñiyā tanūs tayehi \\ ārohātmanātmānam achā \ vasūni kurvann aryā purūṇi \ yajño bhūtvā yajñam āsīda svam̐ yoniṃ bhuva ājāyamānaḥ svakṣaya ehi \\ ity ātmani vā samāropayati /
meaning: या ते अग्ने यज्ञिया तनूस् तयेहि \\ आरोहात्मनात्मानम् अछा \ वसूनि कुर्वन्न् अर्या पुरूणि \ यज्ञो भूत्वा यज्ञम् आसीद स्वम्̐ योनिं भुव आजायमानः स्वक्षय एहि \\ इत्य् आत्मनि वा समारोपयति /
text_mt: Or he mounts them into himself with: 'Agni, that sacrificial body of yours, with that come! Mount into me yourself through yourself! Making noble and many treasures, becoming sacrifice, sit upon the sacrifice! Coming into your own womb, the earth, being born, come into your own dwelling!'

sanskrit_iast: saṃkṣāpyāvadāhyān prayāya samavihāro yāyāvaraḥ prayāti /
meaning: संक्षाप्यावदाह्यान् प्रयाय समविहारो यायावरः प्रयाति /
text_mt: Having caused the parts to be burned to be consumed, having set out, a wandering ascetic who travels with his sacrificial fires proceeds.

sanskrit_iast:
upāvaroha jātavedaḥ punas tvam\ devebhyo havyā vahatu prajānan /
āyuḥ prajām̐ rayim asmāsu dhehi\ ajasro dīdihi no duroṇe //
iti manthiṣyañ japati /
meaning:
उपावरोह जातवेदः पुनस् त्वम्\ देवेभ्यो हव्या वहतु प्रजानन् /
आयुः प्रजाम्̐ रयिम् अस्मासु धेहि\ अजस्रो दीदिहि नो दुरोणे //
इति मन्थिष्यञ् जपति /
text_mt:
'Descend again, O Jātavedas; / knowing, let him carry the offerings to the gods. /'

'Place in us lifespan, offspring, and wealth; / shine unceasingly in our home.'

sanskrit_iast: evam evāharahar adhvānam eṣyan samāropayati \\ upāvaroha \\ iti ca //
meaning: एवम् एवाहरहर् अध्वानम् एष्यन् समारोपयति \\ उपावरोह \\ इति च //
text_mt: In this very manner, day after day, when about to undertake a journey, he mounts [the fires], and [churns them down] with 'Descend...'

sanskrit_iast: agnīñ jyotiṣmataḥ kuru \\ ity uktvā pravatsyañ jvalata upatiṣṭhate // ahirbudhnya mantraṃ me pāhi \ taṃ me gopāyāsmākaṃ punar āgamāt \\ ity āvasathyam upatiṣṭhate saprathaḥ sabhāṃ me pāhi tāṃ me gopāyāsmākaṃ punar āgamāt \\ iti sabhyam \\ paśūn me śam̐sya pāhi \\ ity āhavanīyam \\ prajāṃ me narya pāhi \\ iti gārhapatyam annaṃ me budhya pāhi \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnim //
meaning: अग्नीञ् ज्योतिष्मतः कुरु \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा प्रवत्स्यञ् ज्वलत उपतिष्ठते // अहिर्बुध्न्य मन्त्रं मे पाहि \ तं मे गोपायास्माकं पुनर् आगमात् \\ इत्य् आवसथ्यम् उपतिष्ठते सप्रथः सभां मे पाहि तां मे गोपायास्माकं पुनर् आगमात् \\ इति सभ्यम् \\ पशून् मे शम्̐स्य पाहि \\ इत्य् आहवनीयम् \\ प्रजां मे नर्य पाहि \\ इति गार्हपत्यम् अन्नं मे बुध्य पाहि \\ इति दक्षिणाग्निम् //
text_mt: Having said, 'Make the fires bright', when about to set out on a journey, he reverences them while blazing: with 'O Ahirbudhnya, protect my sacred formula; guard it for me until our return', he reverences the āvasathya fire; with 'O wide-extending one, protect my assembly hall; guard it for me until our return', the sabhya fire; with 'O praiseworthy one, protect my cattle', the āhavanīya fire; with 'O protector of men, protect my offspring', the gārhapatya fire; with 'O wise one, protect my food', the southern fire.

sanskrit_iast: imān me mitrāvaruṇau gṛhān gopāyatam̐ yuvam ity antarāgnī tiṣṭhañ japati /
meaning: इमान् मे मित्रावरुणौ गृहान् गोपायतम्̐ युवम् इत्य् अन्तराग्नी तिष्ठञ् जपति /
text_mt: Standing between the two fires, he mutters: 'O Mitra and Varuṇa, do you two guard these dwellings of mine.'

sanskrit_iast:
mama nāma prathamaṃ jātavedaḥ \ pitā mātā ca dadhatur nv agre /
tat tvaṃ bibhṛhi punar ā mamaitos \ tavāham agne bibharāṇi nāma //
ity āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhate /
meaning:
मम नाम प्रथमं जातवेदः \ पिता माता च दधतुर् न्व् अग्रे /
तत् त्वं बिभृहि पुनर् आ ममैतोस् \ तवाहम् अग्ने बिभराणि नाम //
इत्य् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt:
'My first name, O Jātavedas, / which father and mother gave [me] formerly, /'

'Hold that until my return; / I will bear your name, O Agni.'

With this he reverences the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast:
mā pragāma patho vayam\ mā yajñād indra sominaḥ / \ mānta sthur no arātayaḥ //
ity abhipravrajyāgnisakāśe vācam̐ yachaty asakāśe [ vācam̐ ] visṛjati /
meaning:
मा प्रगाम पथो वयम्\ मा यज्ञाद् इन्द्र सोमिनः / \ मान्त स्थुर् नो अरातयः //
इत्य् अभिप्रव्रज्याग्निसकाशे वाचम्̐ यछत्य् असकाशे [ वाचम्̐ ] विसृजति /
text_mt:
'May we not stray from the path, / nor from the sacrifice of Soma, O Indra! / Let not enemies bar our way!'

Having set out with this, within sight of the fires he restrains speech; out of sight [of the fires], he releases speech.

sanskrit_iast: pravasan homavelāyāṃ pratidiśam agnīn upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: प्रवसन् होमवेलायां प्रतिदिशम् अग्नीन् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: While dwelling away from home, at the time of the offering, he reverences the fires towards each quarter.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvadānīm ābharantas\ anātureṇa manasā / \ agne mā te prativeśā riṣāma //
iti pratyetya samidhāv āharaty asakāśe vācam̐ yachaty agnisakāśe visṛjati //
meaning:
विश्वदानीम् आभरन्तस्\ अनातुरेण मनसा / \ अग्ने मा ते प्रतिवेशा रिषाम //
इति प्रत्येत्य समिधाव् आहरत्य् असकाशे वाचम्̐ यछत्य् अग्निसकाशे विसृजति //
text_mt:
'Bringing [offerings] at all times / with an unperturbed mind, / O Agni, may we, your neighbors, not come to harm!'

Having returned with this, he brings two kindling-sticks; out of sight [of the fires], he restrains speech; within sight of the fires, he releases [speech].

sanskrit_iast: agnim̐ samādhehi \\ ity uktvā bhasma tva upatiṣṭhate //
meaning: अग्निम्̐ समाधेहि \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा भस्म त्व उपतिष्ठते //
text_mt: Having said, 'Put the fire together', he reverences the ashes.

sanskrit_iast: ahirbudhnya mantraṃ me 'jugupas taṃ me punar dehi \\ ity āvasathyam upatiṣṭhate saprathaḥ sabhāṃ me 'jugupas tāṃ me punar dehi \\ iti sabhyam \\ paśūn me śam̐syājugupas \\ ity āhavanīyam \\ prajāṃ me naryājugupas \\ iti gārhapatyam annaṃ me budhyājugupas \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnim //
meaning: अहिर्बुध्न्य मन्त्रं मे ऽजुगुपस् तं मे पुनर् देहि \\ इत्य् आवसथ्यम् उपतिष्ठते सप्रथः सभां मे ऽजुगुपस् तां मे पुनर् देहि \\ इति सभ्यम् \\ पशून् मे शम्̐स्याजुगुपस् \\ इत्य् आहवनीयम् \\ प्रजां मे नर्याजुगुपस् \\ इति गार्हपत्यम् अन्नं मे बुध्याजुगुपस् \\ इति दक्षिणाग्निम् //
text_mt: With 'O Ahirbudhnya, you have guarded my sacred formula; give it back to me', he reverences the āvasathya fire; with 'O wide-extending one, you have guarded my assembly hall; give it back to me', the sabhya fire; with 'O praiseworthy one, you have guarded my cattle', the āhavanīya fire; with 'O protector of men, you have guarded my offspring', the gārhapatya fire; with 'O wise one, you have guarded my food', the southern fire.

sanskrit_iast: imān me mitrāvaruṇau gṛhāñ jugupatam̐ yuvam ity antarāgnī tiṣṭhañ japati /
meaning: इमान् मे मित्रावरुणौ गृहाञ् जुगुपतम्̐ युवम् इत्य् अन्तराग्नी तिष्ठञ् जपति /
text_mt: Standing between the two fires, he mutters: 'O Mitra and Varuṇa, you two have guarded these dwellings of mine.'

sanskrit_iast:
tava ca nāma mama ca jātavedas\ vāsasī iva vivasānau carāvaḥ /
te hi bibhṛvo mahase jīvase ca \ yathāyathaṃ nau tan nau jātavedaḥ //
iti samidho 'gniṣv ādadhat tūṣṇīm̐ sabhyāvasathyayoḥ /
meaning:
तव च नाम मम च जातवेदस्\ वाससी इव विवसानौ चरावः /
ते हि बिभृवो महसे जीवसे च \ यथायथं नौ तन् नौ जातवेदः //
इति समिधो ऽग्निष्व् आदधत् तूष्णीम्̐ सभ्यावसथ्ययोः /
text_mt:
'Your name and mine, O Jātavedas, / wearing like two garments, let us go about; /'

'For we two bear them for greatness and for life; / properly for each other, that [is our bond], O Jātavedas!'

Putting the kindling-sticks into the fires with this, [he puts them] silently into the sabhya and āvasathya fires.

sanskrit_iast: samilliṅgair itareṣūpasthāya cen na pravaset punaretyopatiṣṭheta /
meaning: समिल्लिङ्गैर् इतरेषूपस्थाय चेन् न प्रवसेत् पुनरेत्योपतिष्ठेत /
text_mt: Having reverenced the other [fires] with verses containing the characteristic word 'kindling-stick', if he should not set out, he should reverence them after returning.

sanskrit_iast:
yady anupasthitāgniḥ pravāsam āpadyeta
ihaiva sam̐s tatra santaṃ tvāgne \ hṛdā vācā manasā bibharmi /
tiro me yajña āyur mā prahāsīr \ vaiśvānarasya tvā cakṣuṣopatiṣṭhe //
ity upatiṣṭhate /
meaning:
यद्य् अनुपस्थिताग्निः प्रवासम् आपद्येत
इहैव सम्̐स् तत्र सन्तं त्वाग्ने \ हृदा वाचा मनसा बिभर्मि /
तिरो मे यज्ञ आयुर् मा प्रहासीर् \ वैश्वानरस्य त्वा चक्षुषोपतिष्ठे //
इत्य् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt:
If he should happen to go on a journey without having reverenced the fires, [then]:

'Being here, O Agni, you who are there / I bear with heart, voice, and mind; /'

'Do not forsake my sacrifice, [nor] my lifespan; / I reverence you with the eye of Vaiśvānara.'

sanskrit_iast: parvaṇy āgrayaṇaṃ kurvīta vasante yavānāṃ śaradi vrīhīṇām /
meaning: पर्वण्य् आग्रयणं कुर्वीत वसन्ते यवानां शरदि व्रीहीणाम् /
text_mt: On a new- or full-moon day, he should perform the Āgrayaṇa sacrifice: of barley in the spring, of rice in the autumn.

sanskrit_iast: agrapākasyeṣṭvā navasyāśnīyāt /
meaning: अग्रपाकस्येष्ट्वा नवस्याश्नीयात् /
text_mt: Having sacrificed of the first-fruits, he may eat of the new [grain].

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā nirvapaṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ निर्वपणात् /

sanskrit_iast: āgnendrān nirvapati vaiśvadevān dyāvāpṛthivīyān /
meaning: आग्नेन्द्रान् निर्वपति वैश्वदेवान् द्यावापृथिवीयान् /
text_mt: He apportions [oblations] to Agni and Indra, to the Viśvedevas, and to Dyāvāpṛthivī.

sanskrit_iast: śaradi somāya śyāmākānām anyasyāṃ pātryām /
meaning: शरदि सोमाय श्यामाकानाम् अन्यस्यां पात्र्याम् /
text_mt: In autumn, [he apportions an oblation] of millet to Soma in a different vessel.

sanskrit_iast: nānābījānāṃ dharmam̐ vidhāsyāmo vaṣaṭkārapradānānāṃ caikakapālānāṃ ca /
meaning: नानाबीजानां धर्मम्̐ विधास्यामो वषट्कारप्रदानानां चैककपालानां च /
text_mt: We shall prescribe the rule for different grains, for offerings made with the vaṣaṭ-call, and for single-potsherd cakes.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthag abhimarśanaṃ nānābījānām /
meaning: पृथग् अभिमर्शनं नानाबीजानाम् /
text_mt: The touching of the different grains is performed separately.

sanskrit_iast: mukhyeṣu haviṣkṛtam āhvayati /
meaning: मुख्येषु हविष्कृतम् आह्वयति /
text_mt: He summons the preparer of the oblation over the principal ones.

sanskrit_iast: āvapanaprabhṛti phalīkaraṇāntam ekaikasya niṣpavaṇāntam̐ yavānām /
meaning: आवपनप्रभृति फलीकरणान्तम् एकैकस्य निष्पवणान्तम्̐ यवानाम् /
text_mt: Beginning with the pouring into the mortar up to the end of the dehusking [is done] for each one [separately]; up to the winnowing for barley.

sanskrit_iast: siddham opadhānāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् ओपधानात् /

sanskrit_iast: āgnendrāya dvādaśakapālāny upadadhāty ekaṃ dyāvāpṛthivīyāya /
meaning: आग्नेन्द्राय द्वादशकपालान्य् उपदधात्य् एकं द्यावापृथिवीयाय /
text_mt: He places twelve potsherds for [the cake to] Agni and Indra, and one for [the cake to] Dyāvāpṛthivī.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ādhiśrayaṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आधिश्रयणात् /

sanskrit_iast: āgnendram adhiśritya vaiśvadevaṃ carum adhiśrayati /
meaning: आग्नेन्द्रम् अधिश्रित्य वैश्वदेवं चरुम् अधिश्रयति /
text_mt: Having set [the milk] for Agni-Indra on the fire, he sets the boiled oblation for the Viśvedevas on the fire.

sanskrit_iast: pavitrāntarhite paya ānīya taṇḍulān opyāṅguṣṭhaparvamātraṃ kūtīpalāśamātram̐ vā dyāvāpṛthivīyam adhiśritya saumyaṃ carum adhiśrayati /
meaning: पवित्रान्तर्हिते पय आनीय तण्डुलान् ओप्याङ्गुष्ठपर्वमात्रं कूतीपलाशमात्रम्̐ वा द्यावापृथिवीयम् अधिश्रित्य सौम्यं चरुम् अधिश्रयति /
text_mt: Having poured milk into [a vessel] lined with a strainer and thrown in the rice grains, having placed [the cake] for Dyāvāpṛthivī on the fire—the size of a thumb-joint or of a *kūtīpalāśa* leaf—he places the boiled oblation for Soma on the fire.

sanskrit_iast: pavitrāntarhite 'pa ānīya taṇḍulān opya mekṣaṇena pradakṣiṇaṃ carū śrapayati /
meaning: पवित्रान्तर्हिते ऽप आनीय तण्डुलान् ओप्य मेक्षणेन प्रदक्षिणं चरू श्रपयति /
text_mt: Having poured water into [a vessel] lined with a strainer and thrown in the rice grains, he cooks the boiled oblations clockwise with the stirring stick.

sanskrit_iast: siddham odvāsanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् ओद्वासनात् /

sanskrit_iast: ekakapālam anyasyāṃ pātryām alaṃkurvann abhipūrayati /
meaning: एककपालम् अन्यस्यां पात्र्याम् अलंकुर्वन्न् अभिपूरयति /
text_mt: While garnishing the single-potsherd cake in another dish, he covers it completely [with clarified butter].

sanskrit_iast: pracaraṇavelāyāṃ barhiṣi sādayitvopastīryaikakapālam̐ sakṛt sarvam avadyati /
meaning: प्रचरणवेलायां बर्हिषि सादयित्वोपस्तीर्यैककपालम्̐ सकृत् सर्वम् अवद्यति /
text_mt: At the time of proceeding, having placed [the oblations] on the sacrificial grass and having spread [clarified butter as an underlayer], he cuts off the single-potsherd cake entirely at once.

sanskrit_iast: āśayasyānvāsicya dvir abhighāryopām̐śv ekakapālena pracarya vaṣaṭkṛte madhye pāṇinā juhoty ṛjuṃ pratiṣṭhitam āśayenābhijuhoti /
meaning: आशयस्यान्वासिच्य द्विर् अभिघार्योपाम्̐श्व् एककपालेन प्रचर्य वषट्कृते मध्ये पाणिना जुहोत्य् ऋजुं प्रतिष्ठितम् आशयेनाभिजुहोति /
text_mt: Having poured after it from the resting-pan and basted twice with clarified butter, having proceeded with the single-potsherd cake in a whisper, when the *vaṣaṭ* call is uttered, he offers it with the hand in the middle [of the fire]; he pours [clarified butter] over it from the resting-pan while it is resting upright.

sanskrit_iast: yadi paryāvarteta brāhmaṇavyākhyātam /
meaning: यदि पर्यावर्तेत ब्राह्मणव्याख्यातम् /
text_mt: If it should turn over, it has been explained in the Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
prāk sviṣṭakṛtaḥ ṣaḍ ājyāhutīr juhoti
śatāyudhāya śatavīryāya \ śatotaye 'bhimātiṣāhe /
śatam̐ yo naḥ śarado nayat\ indro viśvasya duritasya pāram //
ime catvāro rajaso vimāne\ antarā dyāvāpṛthivī viyantu panthānaḥ /
teṣām ajyānam̐ yatamo na āvahāt \ tasmai no devāḥ paridatta viśve //
vasanto grīṣmo madhumanti varṣāḥ \ śarad dhemantaḥ suvite dadhātu /
teṣām ṛtūnām̐ śataśāradānām\ nivāta eṣām abhayāḥ syāma //
sam̐vatsarāya parivatsarāyedāvatsarāyānuvatsarāyodvatsarāya kṛṇutā bṛhan namaḥ /
teṣām̐ vayam̐ sumatau yajñiyānām\ jyogjīvā ahatāḥ syāma //
iyam̐ svastiḥ sam̐vatsarīyā parivatsarīyedāvatsarīyānuvatsarīyodvatsarīyā /
sā naḥ pipartv ahṛṇīyamānā\ enāhnedam ahar aśīya //
ā naḥ prajāṃ janayatu prajāpatir iti ṣaṣṭhī /
meaning:
प्राक् स्विष्टकृतः षड् आज्याहुतीर् जुहोति
शतायुधाय शतवीर्याय \ शतोतये ऽभिमातिषाहे /
शतम्̐ यो नः शरदो नयत्\ इन्द्रो विश्वस्य दुरितस्य पारम् //
इमे चत्वारो रजसो विमाने\ अन्तरा द्यावापृथिवी वियन्तु पन्थानः /
तेषाम् अज्यानम्̐ यतमो न आवहात् \ तस्मै नो देवाः परिदत्त विश्वे //
वसन्तो ग्रीष्मो मधुमन्ति वर्षाः \ शरद् धेमन्तः सुविते दधातु /
तेषाम् ऋतूनाम्̐ शतशारदानाम्\ निवात एषाम् अभयाः स्याम //
सम्̐वत्सराय परिवत्सरायेदावत्सरायानुवत्सरायोद्वत्सराय कृणुता बृहन् नमः /
तेषाम्̐ वयम्̐ सुमतौ यज्ञियानाम्\ ज्योग्जीवा अहताः स्याम //
इयम्̐ स्वस्तिः सम्̐वत्सरीया परिवत्सरीयेदावत्सरीयानुवत्सरीयोद्वत्सरीया /
सा नः पिपर्त्व् अहृणीयमाना\ एनाह्नेदम् अहर् अशीय //
आ नः प्रजां जनयतु प्रजापतिर् इति षष्ठी /

sanskrit_iast: ekakapālāśayasya sviṣṭakṛte samavadyatīḍāyai ca /
meaning: एककपालाशयस्य स्विष्टकृते समवद्यतीडायै च /
text_mt:
The sixth [verse is]: "May Prajāpati bring forth offspring for us..."

He cuts off [portions] from the resting-pan of the single-potsherd cake for the Sviṣṭakṛt offering and for the iḍā portion.

sanskrit_iast: yajamāna iḍāyāḥ prāśnāti /
meaning: यजमान इडायाः प्राश्नाति /
text_mt: The sacrificer consumes [his part] of the iḍā portion:

sanskrit_iast:
etam u tyaṃ madhunā sam̐yutam̐ yavam\ sarasvatyā adhi manāv acarkṛṣuḥ /
indra āsīt sīrapatiḥ śatakratuḥ \ kīnāśā āsan marutaḥ sudānavaḥ //
iti yavānām /
meaning:
एतम् उ त्यं मधुना सम्̐युतम्̐ यवम्\ सरस्वत्या अधि मनाव् अचर्कृषुः /
इन्द्र आसीत् सीरपतिः शतक्रतुः \ कीनाशा आसन् मरुतः सुदानवः //
इति यवानाम् /
text_mt:
"Indeed, that barley mixed with honey, / which they plowed along the Sarasvatī under Manu;

Indra of a hundred rites was the lord of the plow; / the generous Maruts were the plowmen"—

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrānnaḥ śreyaḥ samanaiṣṭa devās \ tvayāvasena samaśīmahi tvā /
sa no mayobhūḥ pitur āviveśa \ śivas tokāya tanvo na edhi //
iti vrīhīṇām /
meaning:
भद्रान्नः श्रेयः समनैष्ट देवास् \ त्वयावसेन समशीमहि त्वा /
स नो मयोभूः पितुर् आविवेश \ शिवस् तोकाय तन्वो न एधि //
इति व्रीहीणाम् /
text_mt:
"The gods have led us from good to better; / through thee as our food may we reach thee!

May it enter us, bringing delight to the father; / be auspicious to our progeny and to our body!"—

sanskrit_iast:
agniḥ prāśnātu prathamaḥ \ sa hi veda yathā haviḥ /
śivā asmabhyam oṣadhīḥ \ kṛṇotu viśvacarṣaṇiḥ //
iti śyāmākānām̐ vasante veṇuyavānām /
meaning:
अग्निः प्राश्नातु प्रथमः \ स हि वेद यथा हविः /
शिवा अस्मभ्यम् ओषधीः \ कृणोतु विश्वचर्षणिः //
इति श्यामाकानाम्̐ वसन्ते वेणुयवानाम् /

sanskrit_iast: vatsaḥ prathamajo dakṣiṇā /
meaning: वत्सः प्रथमजो दक्षिणा /
text_mt: A first-born calf is the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: bubhukṣan śyāmākeneṣṭvā babhruṃ piṅgalam̐ vatsataraṃ dadyād vasanaṃ ca /
meaning: बुभुक्षन् श्यामाकेनेष्ट्वा बभ्रुं पिङ्गलम्̐ वत्सतरं दद्याद् वसनं च /
text_mt: One who desires food, having sacrificed with *śyāmāka* grain, should give a brown, reddish-brown young bull and a garment.

sanskrit_iast: āhiteṣu vyṛdhyamānaḥ pūrvāṃ paurṇamāsīm upoṣyāgnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet /
meaning: आहितेषु व्यृध्यमानः पूर्वां पौर्णमासीम् उपोष्याग्नये वैश्वानराय द्वादशकपालं निर्वपेत् /
text_mt: If he suffers misfortune after the fires have been established, having fasted on the previous full-moon day, he should apportion a twelve-potsherd cake to Agni Vaiśvānara.

sanskrit_iast: paurṇamāsyāṃ jvalato visṛjet /
meaning: पौर्णमास्यां ज्वलतो विसृजेत् /
text_mt: On the full-moon day, he should let them go while blazing.

sanskrit_iast: agnyādheyena punarādheyam̐ vyākhyātam /
meaning: अग्न्याधेयेन पुनराधेयम्̐ व्याख्यातम् /
text_mt: The re-establishment [of the fires] is explained by the establishment of the fires.

sanskrit_iast: vikārān anukramiṣyāmaḥ /
meaning: विकारान् अनुक्रमिष्यामः /
text_mt: We shall set forth the modifications.

sanskrit_iast: yathāmnātam̐ varṣāsu śaradi punarvasvor anurādhāsu vā /
meaning: यथाम्नातम्̐ वर्षासु शरदि पुनर्वस्वोर् अनुराधासु वा /
text_mt: As handed down: in the rainy season, in the autumn, or under the Punarvasus or Anurādhās.

sanskrit_iast: saṃbhāreṣu darbhān upolapān kuryāt /
meaning: संभारेषु दर्भान् उपोलपान् कुर्यात् /
text_mt: Among the materials, he should make coarse grass into reed-grass.

sanskrit_iast: parigītaṃ parigītam̐ // yat tvā kruddhaḥ parovapa manyunā \\ iti tisṛbhis triḥ saminddhe //
meaning: परिगीतं परिगीतम्̐ // यत् त्वा क्रुद्धः परोवप मन्युना \\ इति तिसृभिस् त्रिः समिन्द्धे //
text_mt: He kindles [the fire] three times, sung around each time, with three [verses]: "Because in anger, with wrath, I scattered thee away..."

sanskrit_iast: punas tvādityā rudrā vasavaḥ samindhatām iti prāk pūrṇāhuteḥ ṣaṭ saṃtatihomāñ juhoti /
meaning: पुनस् त्वादित्या रुद्रा वसवः समिन्धताम् इति प्राक् पूर्णाहुतेः षट् संततिहोमाञ् जुहोति /
text_mt: Before the full offering, he offers six continuity offerings with: "May the Ādityas, Rudras, and Vasus kindle thee again..."

sanskrit_iast: āgneyam eva pañcakapālam̐ vibhaktīḥ prayājānuyājeṣv āgneyāv ājayabhāgau //
meaning: आग्नेयम् एव पञ्चकपालम्̐ विभक्तीः प्रयाजानुयाजेष्व् आग्नेयाव् आजयभागौ //
text_mt: There is only a five-potsherd cake for Agni, case-endings in the fore-offerings and after-offerings, and two clarified butter portions for Agni.

sanskrit_iast: punar ūrjā nivartasva \\ iti purastāt prayājānām āhutiṃ juhoti
meaning: पुनर् ऊर्जा निवर्तस्व \\ इति पुरस्तात् प्रयाजानाम् आहुतिं जुहोति
text_mt: Before the fore-offerings he offers an oblation with: "Return again with strength..."

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇākāle punarutsyūtam̐ vāso deyaṃ punarṇavo rathaḥ punarutsṛṣṭo 'naḍvān sauvarṇaśātamāniko rukmo 'gnyādheyikyaś ca dakṣiṇāḥ //
meaning: दक्षिणाकाले पुनरुत्स्यूतम्̐ वासो देयं पुनर्णवो रथः पुनरुत्सृष्टो ऽनड्वान् सौवर्णशातमानिको रुक्मो ऽग्न्याधेयिक्यश् च दक्षिणाः //
text_mt: At the time of the sacrificial gift, a resewn garment is to be given, a renovated chariot, a released ox, a golden ornament weighing a hundred *mānas*, and the sacrificial gifts belonging to the establishment of the fires.

sanskrit_iast: saha rayyā nivartasva \\ ity upariṣṭād anuyājānāṃ catasra āhutīr juhoti /
meaning: सह रय्या निवर्तस्व \\ इत्य् उपरिष्टाद् अनुयाजानां चतस्र आहुतीर् जुहोति /
text_mt: After the after-offerings he offers four oblations with: "Return with wealth..."

sanskrit_iast: akāmavichinne na samindhanīḥ kuryāt /
meaning: अकामविछिन्ने न समिन्धनीः कुर्यात् /
text_mt: When [the fires] are interrupted without intention, he should not perform the kindling verses.

sanskrit_iast: sarvatrārambhaṇīyā sarvatrārambhaṇīyā /
meaning: सर्वत्रारम्भणीया सर्वत्रारम्भणीया /
text_mt: The introductory sacrifice is performed everywhere; the introductory sacrifice is performed everywhere.

sanskrit_iast: cāturmāsyāny ārapsyamānaḥ pūrvā paurṇamāsīm upoṣyāgnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati pārjanyaṃ ca carum /
meaning: चातुर्मास्यान्य् आरप्स्यमानः पूर्वा पौर्णमासीम् उपोष्याग्नये वैश्वानराय द्वादशकपालं निर्वपति पार्जन्यं च चरुम् /
text_mt: One about to begin the four-monthly sacrifices, having fasted on the previous full-moon day, apportions a twelve-potsherd cake to Agni Vaiśvānara and a boiled oblation to Parjanya.

sanskrit_iast: apaḥ praṇeṣyan pañcahotāraṃ manasānudrutya juhoti /
meaning: अपः प्रणेष्यन् पञ्चहोतारं मनसानुद्रुत्य जुहोति /
text_mt: About to bring forward the water, he recites the five-priest formula mentally and offers.

sanskrit_iast: dhenur anaḍvām̐ś ca dakṣiṇā /
meaning: धेनुर् अनड्वाम्̐श् च दक्षिणा /
text_mt: A milch-cow and an ox are the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: siddheṣṭiḥ saṃtiṣṭhate /
meaning: सिद्धेष्टिः संतिष्ठते /
text_mt: The sacrifice concludes when completed.

sanskrit_iast: prācīnapravaṇe vaiśvadevena yajeta phālgunyāṃ caitryām̐ vasante vā /
meaning: प्राचीनप्रवणे वैश्वदेवेन यजेत फाल्गुन्यां चैत्र्याम्̐ वसन्ते वा /
text_mt: One should sacrifice with the Vaiśvadeva on ground sloping to the east, on the full-moon day of Phālguna, or of Caitra, or in spring.

sanskrit_iast: nopavasathe cāturmāsyeṣu keśaśmaśru yajamāno vāpayate /
meaning: नोपवसथे चातुर्मास्येषु केशश्मश्रु यजमानो वापयते /
text_mt: On the preparation day of the four-monthly sacrifices, the sacrificer does not have his hair and beard shaved.

sanskrit_iast: vratopetasya śākhām āhṛtya vatsān apākaroti //
meaning: व्रतोपेतस्य शाखाम् आहृत्य वत्सान् अपाकरोति //
text_mt: Having fetched a branch for one who has undertaken the vow, he separates the calves.

sanskrit_iast: āpyāyadhvam aghnyā devebhyo viśvebhyo devebhyo bhāgam iti gāḥ prārpayati /
meaning: आप्यायध्वम् अघ्न्या देवेभ्यो विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यो भागम् इति गाः प्रार्पयति /
text_mt: He drives the cows forward with: "Swell, O inviolable ones, for the gods, a portion for the All-Gods!"

sanskrit_iast: prasūnaḥ prastaraḥ / tredhā saṃnaddham idhmābarhir dvau bhāgau tūṣṇīm̐ saṃnahyāsaṃnaddhaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tad ekadhā mantreṇa saṃnahyati tūṣṇīm idhmam /
meaning: प्रसूनः प्रस्तरः / त्रेधा संनद्धम् इध्माबर्हिर् द्वौ भागौ तूष्णीम्̐ संनह्यासंनद्धं तृतीयं तद् एकधा मन्त्रेण संनह्यति तूष्णीम् इध्मम् /
text_mt: The sacred grass bundle is flowered. The sacrificial fuel and sacrificial grass are tied in three parts: having tied two parts silently, the third untied [part]—he ties that together as one with a sacred formula; the sacrificial fuel silently.

sanskrit_iast: samānaṃ dohanam /
meaning: समानं दोहनम् /

sanskrit_iast: tisṛṣu dugdhāsu bahu dugdhi viśvebhyo devebhyo havir iti trir uktvā vācam̐ visṛjate //
meaning: तिसृषु दुग्धासु बहु दुग्धि विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यो हविर् इति त्रिर् उक्त्वा वाचम्̐ विसृजते //
text_mt: When three [cows] are milked, having said three times: "Yield abundantly the oblation for the All-Gods!", he releases his speech.

sanskrit_iast: viśvebhyas tvā devebhyo bhāgaṃ somenātanacmi \\ ity ātanakti /
meaning: विश्वेभ्यस् त्वा देवेभ्यो भागं सोमेनातनच्मि \\ इत्य् आतनक्ति /
text_mt: He curdles it with: "For the All-Gods, as their share, I curdle thee with Soma."

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā pātraprayojanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ पात्रप्रयोजनात् /
text_mt: [The procedure is] established up to the employment of the vessels.

sanskrit_iast: carukapālaṃ prayunakti dvitīyam ājyasthālīṃ pṛṣadājyāya srucaṃ copabhṛto 'nantarā /
meaning: चरुकपालं प्रयुनक्ति द्वितीयम् आज्यस्थालीं पृषदाज्याय स्रुचं चोपभृतो ऽनन्तरा /
text_mt: He sets out the pot for the boiled oblation, a second [pot], a clarified-butter pot for the spotted butter, and a ladle right after the upabhṛt.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā nirvapaṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ निर्वपणात् /

sanskrit_iast: āgneyo 'ṣṭākapāla itiprabhṛtīni pañca nirvapati marudbhyaḥ svatavadbhyaḥ saptakapālaṃ dyāvāpṛthivīyam ekakapālam /
meaning: आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपाल इतिप्रभृतीनि पञ्च निर्वपति मरुद्भ्यः स्वतवद्भ्यः सप्तकपालं द्यावापृथिवीयम् एककपालम् /
text_mt: He apportions five [oblations] beginning with the eight-potsherd [cake] for Agni, a seven-potsherd [cake] for the powerful Maruts, [and] a one-potsherd [cake] for Dyāvāpṛthivī.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ādhivapanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आधिवपनात् /

sanskrit_iast: prāg adhivapanāc caravyān apāyātayati /
meaning: प्राग् अधिवपनाच् चरव्यान् अपायातयति /
text_mt: Before pouring [the grains], he sets aside those destined for the boiled oblations.

sanskrit_iast: adhyupya kapālāny upadadhaḥti /
meaning: अध्युप्य कपालान्य् उपदधःति /
text_mt: Having poured out [the grains], he places the potsherds [on the fire].

sanskrit_iast: prātardohaṃ dohayati /
meaning: प्रातर्दोहं दोहयति /

sanskrit_iast: utpūtānāṃ pūṣṇe piṣṭāny apāyātayati /
meaning: उत्पूतानां पूष्णे पिष्टान्य् अपायातयति /
text_mt: From among those winnowed, he sets aside flour for Pūṣan.

sanskrit_iast: caruṣu piṣṭabhāk pūṣā sarvatra /
meaning: चरुषु पिष्टभाक् पूषा सर्वत्र /
text_mt: In boiled oblations, Pūṣan receives flour everywhere.

sanskrit_iast: anupūrvam̐ havīm̐ṣy adhiśrayati /
meaning: अनुपूर्वम्̐ हवीम्̐ष्य् अधिश्रयति /
text_mt: He sets the oblations on the fire in succession.

sanskrit_iast: mārutam adhiśritya tapte prātardohe sāyaṃdoham ānīyāmikṣāṃ karoti /
meaning: मारुतम् अधिश्रित्य तप्ते प्रातर्दोहे सायंदोहम् आनीयामिक्षां करोति /
text_mt: Having put [the cake] for the Maruts on the fire, he pours the evening milk into the heated morning milk and makes the curd mixture.

sanskrit_iast: etenāmikṣā sarvatra vyākhyātā /
meaning: एतेनामिक्षा सर्वत्र व्याख्याता /
text_mt: By this, the curd mixture is explained everywhere.

sanskrit_iast: ājyaṃ nirupya pṛṣadājyāya dadhi nirvapati samānadharmam ājyena /
meaning: आज्यं निरुप्य पृषदाज्याय दधि निर्वपति समानधर्मम् आज्येन /
text_mt: Having apportioned the clarified butter, he apportions curd for the spotted butter, with the same procedure as for clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā srucām̐ saṃmārjanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ स्रुचाम्̐ संमार्जनात् /
text_mt: [The ritual is] established up to the cleansing of the ladles.

sanskrit_iast: samānam̐ saṃmārjanam upabhṛtaḥ pṛṣadājyadhānyāś ca /
meaning: समानम्̐ संमार्जनम् उपभृतः पृषदाज्यधान्याश् च /
text_mt: The cleansing of the upabhṛt and of the vessel for spotted butter is the same.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ājyagrahebhyaḥ /
meaning: सिद्धम् आज्यग्रहेभ्यः /
text_mt: [The ritual is] established up to the drawing of the clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: caturgṛhītāny ājyāni pṛṣadājyadhānyāṃ dvir upastīrya dadhy ānīya sakṛd abhighārayan pṛṣat karoti /
meaning: चतुर्गृहीतान्य् आज्यानि पृषदाज्यधान्यां द्विर् उपस्तीर्य दध्य् आनीय सकृद् अभिघारयन् पृषत् करोति /
text_mt: Having spread an underlayer twice in the vessel for spotted butter with the portions of clarified butter drawn four times, he pours in the curd and, basting it once with clarified butter, makes it spotted butter.

sanskrit_iast: sakṛd upastīrya dvir abhighārayed varṣāsu /
meaning: सकृद् उपस्तीर्य द्विर् अभिघारयेद् वर्षासु /
text_mt: In the rainy season, he should spread an underlayer once and baste twice.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ājyānām̐ sādanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आज्यानाम्̐ सादनात् /
text_mt: [The ritual is] established up to the depositing of the clarified butter portions.

sanskrit_iast: samānam̐ sādanam upabhṛtaḥ pṛṣadājyadhānyāś ca /
meaning: समानम्̐ सादनम् उपभृतः पृषदाज्यधान्याश् च /
text_mt: The depositing of the upabhṛt and of the vessel for spotted butter is the same.

sanskrit_iast: siddham odvāsanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् ओद्वासनात् /

sanskrit_iast: prāg abhighāraṇād āmikṣām̐ vivājināṃ kṛtvotkare vājinam āsādayati /
meaning: प्राग् अभिघारणाद् आमिक्षाम्̐ विवाजिनां कृत्वोत्करे वाजिनम् आसादयति /
text_mt: Before basting with clarified butter, having separated the whey from the curd mixture, he places the whey on the heap of rubbish.

sanskrit_iast: alaṃkṛtyānupūrvam̐ havīm̐ṣy abhyudāharati /
meaning: अलंकृत्यानुपूर्वम्̐ हवीम्̐ष्य् अभ्युदाहरति /
text_mt: Having adorned [them], he brings the oblations near in succession.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ābhimarśanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आभिमर्शनात् /

sanskrit_iast: prāg abhimarśanān nirmanthena pracarati /
meaning: प्राग् अभिमर्शनान् निर्मन्थेन प्रचरति /
text_mt: Before the touching, he proceeds with the churned [fire].

sanskrit_iast: uttarasya paścātparidhisaṃdher agner janitram asi \\ ity adhimanthanam̐ śakalam avasthāpayati //
meaning: उत्तरस्य पश्चात्परिधिसंधेर् अग्नेर् जनित्रम् असि \\ इत्य् अधिमन्थनम्̐ शकलम् अवस्थापयति //
text_mt: With the mantra, "You are the birthplace of Agni," he places the churning-chip behind the northern junction of the enclosing sticks.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣaṇau sthas \\ iti tatra prāñcāv aprachinnaprāntau darbhau nidhāya \\ urvaśy asi \\ iti tayor udaktūlām adharāraṇiṃ paścāt prajananāṃ mūlata uttarāraṇim āyur asi \\ ity ājyasthālyā [ ājyena ] bile snehayám̐s triḥ samanakti //
meaning: वृषणौ स्थस् \\ इति तत्र प्राञ्चाव् अप्रछिन्नप्रान्तौ दर्भौ निधाय \\ उर्वश्य् असि \\ इति तयोर् उदक्तूलाम् अधरारणिं पश्चात् प्रजननां मूलत उत्तरारणिम् आयुर् असि \\ इत्य् आज्यस्थाल्या [ आज्येन ] बिले स्नेहय्áम्̐स् त्रिः समनक्ति //
text_mt: With "You two are the testicles," having placed there two darbha blades pointing eastward with uncut tips, with "You are Urvaśī," [he places] upon them the lower churning stick with its tips pointing northward and its socket to the west; with "You are Āyus," moistening the upper churning stick at its base in the socket with [clarified butter] from the clarified-butter pot, he anoints it three times.

sanskrit_iast: purūravā asi \\ iti saṃdadhāti //
meaning: पुरूरवा असि \\ इति संदधाति //
text_mt: With "You are Purūravas," he joins [them].

sanskrit_iast: agnaye mathyamānāyānubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati //
meaning: अग्नये मथ्यमानायानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति //
text_mt: He prompts [the hotṛ]: "Recite for Agni as he is being churned."

sanskrit_iast: gāyatram asi \ triṣṭub asi \ jagad asi \\ iti pradakṣiṇaṃ trir adhimanthati //
meaning: गायत्रम् असि \ त्रिष्टुब् असि \ जगद् असि \\ इति प्रदक्षिणं त्रिर् अधिमन्थति //
text_mt: With "You are the Gāyatrī," "You are the Triṣṭubh," "You are the Jagatī," he churns clockwise three times.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye jātāya \\ iti jāte //
meaning: अग्नये जाताय \\ इति जाते //

sanskrit_iast: agnaye prahriyamānāya \\ iti prahriyamāṇe /
meaning: अग्नये प्रह्रियमानाय \\ इति प्रह्रियमाणे /
text_mt: When it is being carried forward, [he prompts]: "[Recite] for Agni as he is being carried forward."

sanskrit_iast: agreṇottaraṃ paridhim anvavahṛtyānvārabdhe yajamāne vācayan bhavataṃ naḥ samanasau \\ iti svāhākārāntena prahṛtya śakalam agnāv adhyasyati //
meaning: अग्रेणोत्तरं परिधिम् अन्ववहृत्यान्वारब्धे यजमाने वाचयन् भवतं नः समनसौ \\ इति स्वाहाकारान्तेन प्रहृत्य शकलम् अग्नाव् अध्यस्यति //
text_mt: Bringing [the fire] down in front along the northern enclosing stick, while the sacrificer holds onto him from behind, making him recite, he throws [the fire] with the mantra ending in Svāhā: "Be of one mind with us," and tosses the chip onto the fire.

sanskrit_iast: agnā agniś carati \\ iti sruveṇābhijuhoti /
meaning: अग्ना अग्निश् चरति \\ इति स्रुवेणाभिजुहोति /
text_mt: With "Agni moves within Agni," he offers an oblation [of clarified butter] with the sruva ladle.

sanskrit_iast: pūrṇasruvam̐ sādayitvā pañcahotrā cāturmāsyāny abhimarśayati /
meaning: पूर्णस्रुवम्̐ सादयित्वा पञ्चहोत्रा चातुर्मास्यान्य् अभिमर्शयति /
text_mt: Having deposited the full sruva ladle, he makes [the sacrificer] touch the seasonal offerings with the pañcahotṛ formula.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā prayājebhyaḥ /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ प्रयाजेभ्यः /
text_mt: [The ritual is] established up to the fore-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvaṃ nava prayājān yajati /
meaning: आश्रावं नव प्रयाजान् यजति /
text_mt: Having called for the response, he offers nine fore-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: trīn hutvā samānayati trīn hutvā samānayati / dvau hutvā sarvam̐ samānīyaikam̐ hutvātyākramyānupūrvam̐ havīm̐ṣy abhighārayaty antataḥ pṛṣadājyaṃ nopabhṛtam /
meaning: त्रीन् हुत्वा समानयति त्रीन् हुत्वा समानयति / द्वौ हुत्वा सर्वम्̐ समानीयैकम्̐ हुत्वात्याक्रम्यानुपूर्वम्̐ हवीम्̐ष्य् अभिघारयत्य् अन्ततः पृषदाज्यं नोपभृतम् /
text_mt: Having offered three, he pours together; having offered three, he pours together; having offered two, he pours all together; having offered one, stepping across, he bastes the oblations in succession; at the end [he bastes] the spotted butter, not the upabhṛt.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā pracaraṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ प्रचरणात् /

sanskrit_iast: upām̐śu sāvitraikakapālābhyāṃ pracarati /
meaning: उपाम्̐शु सावित्रैककपालाभ्यां प्रचरति /
text_mt: He proceeds in a whisper with [the cake] for Savitṛ and the one-potsherd cake.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā sviṣṭakṛtaḥ /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ स्विष्टकृतः /

sanskrit_iast: prāk sviṣṭakṛtas \\ madhave svāhā \\ itiprabhṛtīni māsanāmāni juhoti catvāri vaiśvadeve catvāri varuṇapraghāseṣu catvāri sākamedheṣvekam̐ śunāsīrye /
meaning: प्राक् स्विष्टकृतस् \\ मधवे स्वाहा \\ इतिप्रभृतीनि मासनामानि जुहोति चत्वारि वैश्वदेवे चत्वारि वरुणप्रघासेषु चत्वारि साकमेधेष्वेकम्̐ शुनासीर्ये /
text_mt: Before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, he offers the names of the months beginning with: "To Madhu, svāhā!"—four at the Vaiśvadeva, four at the Varuṇapraghāsa, four at the Sākamedha, [and] one at the Śunāsīrya.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇākāle vatsaḥ prathamajo dakṣiṇā /
meaning: दक्षिणाकाले वत्सः प्रथमजो दक्षिणा /
text_mt: At the time of the sacrificial gifts, a first-born calf is the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ānuyājebhyaḥ /
meaning: सिद्धम् आनुयाजेभ्यः /

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣadājyaṃ juhvām ānīyāśrāvaṃ navānuyājān yajati /
meaning: पृषदाज्यं जुह्वाम् आनीयाश्रावं नवानुयाजान् यजति /
text_mt: Pouring the spotted butter into the juhū and having called for the response, he offers nine after-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: vājavatyopabhṛtā saha pṛṣadājyadhānīṃ nigṛhṇāti vyudgṛhṇāti saṃpragṛhṇāti nirasyati //
meaning: वाजवत्योपभृता सह पृषदाज्यधानीं निगृह्णाति व्युद्गृह्णाति संप्रगृह्णाति निरस्यति //
text_mt: Together with the upabhṛt with the vājavatī verse, he holds down the spotted butter vessel, raises it, holds it firmly together, and casts it away.

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtācyau stho yajamānasya dhuryau pātam iti vedyam̐sayoḥ srucau vimuñcati /
meaning: घृताच्यौ स्थो यजमानस्य धुर्यौ पातम् इति वेद्यम्̐सयोः स्रुचौ विमुञ्चति /
text_mt: With "You two are full of ghee; protect the yoked bearers of the sacrificer," he puts down the two ladles on the shoulders of the altar.

sanskrit_iast: sruci camase vāntarvedy ūrdhvas tiṣṭhan barhir anuviṣiñcan vājinaṃ gṛhṇāti //
meaning: स्रुचि चमसे वान्तर्वेद्य् ऊर्ध्वस् तिष्ठन् बर्हिर् अनुविषिञ्चन् वाजिनं गृह्णाति //
text_mt: In a ladle or in a cup, standing upright within the altar and sprinkling over the sacrificial grass, he takes the whey.

sanskrit_iast: vājibhyo 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
meaning: वाजिभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: He prompts [the hotṛ]: "Recite for the Vājins."

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya vājino yaja \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: आश्राव्य वाजिनो यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Having called for the response, he gives the call: "Sacrifice to the Vājins!"

sanskrit_iast: vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣṭkṛte hutvoccheṣeṇa diśaḥ pratiyajati diśaḥ svāhā \\ iti dikṣu pūrvārdhād upakramya pradakṣiṇaṃ pañcamena madhye ṣaṣṭhena pūrvārdhe /
meaning: वषट्कृतानुवष्ट्कृते हुत्वोच्छेषेण दिशः प्रतियजति दिशः स्वाहा \\ इति दिक्षु पूर्वार्धाद् उपक्रम्य प्रदक्षिणं पञ्चमेन मध्ये षष्ठेन पूर्वार्धे /
text_mt: Having offered at the vaṣaṭ-call and the second vaṣaṭ-call, with the remainder he makes offerings to the quarters, starting from the eastern quarter clockwise with "To the quarters, svāhā!", with the fifth in the middle, [and] with the sixth in the eastern quarter.

sanskrit_iast: śeṣam̐ samadhā vibhajya \\ upahūtopahvayasva \\ ity uktvā \\ upahūtā upahvayadhvam iti vā /
meaning: शेषम्̐ समधा विभज्य \\ उपहूतोपह्वयस्व \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा \\ उपहूता उपह्वयध्वम् इति वा /
text_mt: Dividing the remainder into equal portions, having said, "Invited, do you invite," or "Invited ones, do you invite,"

sanskrit_iast:
ā mā viśantv indavas \\ ā galdā dhamanīnām /
rasena me rasaṃ pṛṇa \ vājino me yajñam̐ vahān //
ity ṛtvijaḥ prāśnanti yajamānaś ca / hotā prathamo bhakṣayate /
meaning:
आ मा विशन्त्व् इन्दवस् \\ आ गल्दा धमनीनाम् /
रसेन मे रसं पृण \ वाजिनो मे यज्ञम्̐ वहान् //
इत्य् ऋत्विजः प्राश्नन्ति यजमानश् च / होता प्रथमो भक्षयते /
text_mt:
with:
"May the drops enter me, the trickling stream of the veins;
fill my sap with sap; may the Vājins convey my sacrifice,"
the officiating priests and the sacrificer eat; the hotṛ priest consumes first.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā samiṣṭayajuṣaḥ /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ समिष्टयजुषः /
text_mt: [The ritual is] established up to the samiṣṭayajus formulas.

sanskrit_iast: dvir dhruvām āpyāyya \\ eṣa te yajñas \\ devā gātuvidas \\ iti dve samiṣṭayajuṣī juhoti //
meaning: द्विर् ध्रुवाम् आप्याय्य \\ एष ते यज्ञस् \\ देवा गातुविदस् \\ इति द्वे समिष्टयजुषी जुहोति //
text_mt: Having replenished the dhruvā ladle twice, he offers the two samiṣṭayajus formulas: "This is your sacrifice..." and "O path-finding gods..."

sanskrit_iast: sam̐vatsarīyām̐ svastim āśāse \\ ity āha yajamānaḥ /
meaning: सम्̐वत्सरीयाम्̐ स्वस्तिम् आशासे \\ इत्य् आह यजमानः /
text_mt: The sacrificer says: "I pray for a year's welfare."

sanskrit_iast: siddheṣṭiḥ saṃtiṣṭhate /
meaning: सिद्धेष्टिः संतिष्ठते /
text_mt: The established sacrifice is concluded.

sanskrit_iast:
sadyaḥ paurṇamāsīm̐ sam̐sthāpya
ṛtam eva parameṣṭhi \\ ṛtaṃ nātyeti kiṃcana /
ṛte samudra āhitaḥ \ samudreṇa pṛthivī dṛḍhā //
agnis tigmena śociṣā \ tapa ākrāntam uṣṇihā /
śiras tapasy āhitam \\ vaiśvānarasya tejasi //
ṛtenāsya nivartaya \ satyena parivartaya \ tapasāsyānuvartaya /
śivenāsyopavartaya \ śagmenāsyābhivartaya //
iti triśyetayā śalalyā lauhāyasena kṣureṇa nivartayati keśān vapati śmaśrūṇi //
meaning:
सद्यः पौर्णमासीम्̐ सम्̐स्थाप्य
ऋतम् एव परमेष्ठि \\ ऋतं नात्येति किंचन /
ऋते समुद्र आहितः \ समुद्रेण पृथिवी दृढा //
अग्निस् तिग्मेन शोचिषा \ तप आक्रान्तम् उष्णिहा /
शिरस् तपस्य् आहितम् \\ वैश्वानरस्य तेजसि //
ऋतेनास्य निवर्तय \ सत्येन परिवर्तय \ तपसास्यानुवर्तय /
शिवेनास्योपवर्तय \ शग्मेनास्याभिवर्तय //
इति त्रिश्येतया शलल्या लौहायसेन क्षुरेण निवर्तयति केशान् वपति श्मश्रूणि //

sanskrit_iast: tad ṛtam \\ tat satyam \\ tañ śakeyam \\ tena śakeyam \\ tena rādhyāsam \\ tan me rādhyatām iti japati yajamānaḥ /
meaning: तद् ऋतम् \\ तत् सत्यम् \\ तञ् शकेयम् \\ तेन शकेयम् \\ तेन राध्यासम् \\ तन् मे राध्यताम् इति जपति यजमानः /
text_mt: The sacrificer mutters: "That is cosmic order; that is truth; may I be capable of that; by that may I be able; through that may I succeed; may that succeed for me."

sanskrit_iast: caturo māsān na mām̐sam aśnāti na striyam upaiti noparyāste / jugupsetānṛtāt prāṅ śete / madhv aśnāty ṛtau bhāryām upaiti /
meaning: चतुरो मासान् न माम्̐सम् अश्नाति न स्त्रियम् उपैति नोपर्यास्ते / जुगुप्सेतानृतात् प्राङ् शेते / मध्व् अश्नात्य् ऋतौ भार्याम् उपैति /
text_mt: For four months he does not eat meat, does not approach a woman, does not sit on a raised seat; he should shrink from falsehood; he sleeps facing east; he eats honey; he approaches his wife in her season.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇapraghāsāś caturṣu māseṣu /
meaning: वरुणप्रघासाश् चतुर्षु मासेषु /
text_mt: The Varuṇapraghāsa rites take place in four months.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvadevikam̐ vidhānam /
meaning: वैश्वदेविकम्̐ विधानम् /
text_mt: The ritual procedure is that of the Vaiśvadeva [sacrifice].

sanskrit_iast: pañca saṃcarāṇām /
meaning: पञ्च संचराणाम् /

sanskrit_iast: mārutyai pratiprasthātā vatsān apākaroty adhvaryur vāruṇyai /
meaning: मारुत्यै प्रतिप्रस्थाता वत्सान् अपाकरोत्य् अध्वर्युर् वारुण्यै /
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ drives away the calves for the [offering] to the Maruts; the adhvaryu, for the [offering] to Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthag idhmābarhiṣī saṃnahyataḥ / sakṛt saṃnaddhaṃ pratiprasthātā /
meaning: पृथग् इध्माबर्हिषी संनह्यतः / सकृत् संनद्धं प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
text_mt: They bind the sacrificial fuel and sacrificial grass separately. The pratiprasthātṛ binds it once.

sanskrit_iast: yathākālaṃ pṛthag dohayataḥ /
meaning: यथाकालं पृथग् दोहयतः /
text_mt: At the proper time they milk separately.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā pātraprayojanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ पात्रप्रयोजनात् /
text_mt: It is established up to the setting out of the utensils.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthak pātrāṇi prayunakti sruvapañcamāḥ srucaḥ pratiprasthātā dve carusthālyau sphyam̐ vedaṃ ca /
meaning: पृथक् पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति स्रुवपञ्चमाः स्रुचः प्रतिप्रस्थाता द्वे चरुस्थाल्यौ स्फ्यम्̐ वेदं च /
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ sets out the utensils separately: the spoons with the sruva spoon as fifth, two pots for boiled oblation, the wooden sword, and the veda bundle.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā nirvapaṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ निर्वपणात् /

sanskrit_iast: pañca saṃcarāṇi nirupyādhvaryur aindrāgnaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati kāyam ekakapālam /
meaning: पञ्च संचराणि निरुप्याध्वर्युर् ऐन्द्राग्नं द्वादशकपालं निर्वपति कायम् एककपालम् /
text_mt: Having apportioned the five common oblations, the adhvaryu apportions [the oblation] on twelve potsherds for Indra and Agni, [and] the [cake] on one potsherd for Ka.

sanskrit_iast: yathākālam āmikṣe pṛthak saṃpādayataḥ /
meaning: यथाकालम् आमिक्षे पृथक् संपादयतः /
text_mt: At the proper time they prepare the two curd portions separately.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ābhivāsanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आभिवासनात् /

sanskrit_iast: piṣṭalepaṃ nidhāyāgreṇāhavanīyaṃ triṣu prakrameṣv aparimite vāvakāśe pṛṣṭhyāśaṅkuṃ nihatya vedādānaprabhṛti vedim̐ vidadhāti ṣaṭśayāṃ prācīṃ catuḥśayāṃ paścāt triśayāṃ purastāt /
meaning: पिष्टलेपं निधायाग्रेणाहवनीयं त्रिषु प्रक्रमेष्व् अपरिमिते वावकाशे पृष्ठ्याशङ्कुं निहत्य वेदादानप्रभृति वेदिम्̐ विदधाति षट्शयां प्राचीं चतुःशयां पश्चात् त्रिशयां पुरस्तात् /
text_mt: Having placed down the dough scrapings, having driven in the spinal peg in front of the āhavanīya fire at three paces or in an unmeasured space, [the adhvaryu] arranges the altar beginning with the taking of the veda bundle: six spans long towards the east, four spans wide behind, [and] three spans wide in front.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvārdhe vedyā vitṛtīyamātre 'ratnimātrīṃ caturdiṣṭim uttaravedim̐ vidadhāti /
meaning: पूर्वार्धे वेद्या वितृतीयमात्रे ऽरत्निमात्रीं चतुर्दिष्टिम् उत्तरवेदिम्̐ विदधाति /
text_mt: In the eastern half of the altar, at the distance of one third, he arranges the high altar measuring a cubit [or] four spans.

sanskrit_iast: agreṇotkaraṃ prakramamātre veder uddhaty āvokṣya cātvālam̐ śamyayā parimimīte taptāyanī me 'si \\ iti dakṣiṇatas \\ vittāyanī me 'si \\ iti paścāt \\ avatān mā nāthitam ity uttaratas \\ avatād vyathitam iti purastāt //
meaning: अग्रेणोत्करं प्रक्रममात्रे वेदेर् उद्धत्य् आवोक्ष्य चात्वालम्̐ शम्यया परिमिमीते तप्तायनी मे ऽसि \\ इति दक्षिणतस् \\ वित्तायनी मे ऽसि \\ इति पश्चात् \\ अवतान् मा नाथितम् इत्य् उत्तरतस् \\ अवताद् व्यथितम् इति पुरस्तात् //
text_mt: In front of the rubbish heap, at the distance of a pace, having dug up from the altar and sprinkled with water, he measures out the cātvāla trench with the yoke-pin, [saying] to the south: 'You are Taptāyanī to me'; to the west: 'You are Vittāyanī to me'; to the north: 'May you protect me who am distressed'; to the east: 'May you protect the afflicted.'

sanskrit_iast: agne aṅgiras \\ iti purastāt pratyaṅmukhaś cātvālam̐ sphyenābhihanti //
meaning: अग्ने अङ्गिरस् \\ इति पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ्मुखश् चात्वालम्̐ स्फ्येनाभिहन्ति //
text_mt: Facing west, from the east he strikes the cātvāla trench with the wooden sword, [saying:] 'O Agni, Aṅgiras.'

sanskrit_iast: āyunā nāmnehi \\ iti pām̐sūn pāṇau kurute //
meaning: आयुना नाम्नेहि \\ इति पाम्̐सून् पाणौ कुरुते //
text_mt: He takes dust in his hand, [saying:] 'Come with the name of living.'

sanskrit_iast: vasavas tvā harantu \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ prāṅmukha uttaravedyāṃ nivapati // yo dvitīyasyām iti dvitīyam \\ yas tṛtīyasyām iti tṛtīyam̐ samānam anyat tūṣṇīṃ caturtham //
meaning: वसवस् त्वा हरन्तु \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः प्राङ्मुख उत्तरवेद्यां निवपति // यो द्वितीयस्याम् इति द्वितीयम् \\ यस् तृतीयस्याम् इति तृतीयम्̐ समानम् अन्यत् तूष्णीं चतुर्थम् //
text_mt: Facing east, he scatters it on the high altar with the [mantras] beginning with: 'May the Vasus bear you.' With 'Who in the second [heaven]' for the second [scattering]; with 'Who in the third [heaven]' for the third; the rest is identical; silently the fourth.

sanskrit_iast: vider agne nabho nāma yat te \\ iti jānudaghnam ṛjuṃ caturasraṃ khātvottaravedyāṃ nivapati //
meaning: विदेर् अग्ने नभो नाम यत् ते \\ इति जानुदघ्नम् ऋजुं चतुरस्रं खात्वोत्तरवेद्यां निवपति //
text_mt: Having dug [the trench] knee-deep, straight, [and] four-cornered, [saying:] 'May I know, O Agni, that name of yours which is the sky,' he scatters [the earth] on the high altar.

sanskrit_iast: sim̐hīr asi \ mahiṣīr asi \\ ity uttaravediṃ karoti /
meaning: सिम्̐हीर् असि \ महिषीर् असि \\ इत्य् उत्तरवेदिं करोति /
text_mt: He shapes the high altar, [saying:] 'You are a lioness; you are a buffalo cow.'

sanskrit_iast: tasyāṃ madhye prādeśamātriṃ caturasrāṃ nābhiṃ karoti //
meaning: तस्यां मध्ये प्रादेशमात्रिं चतुरस्रां नाभिं करोति //
text_mt: In the middle of it he makes a four-cornered navel measuring a span.

sanskrit_iast: devebhyaḥ śundhasva \\ ity adbhir avokṣate //
meaning: देवेभ्यः शुन्धस्व \\ इत्य् अद्भिर् अवोक्षते //
text_mt: He sprinkles it with water, [saying:] 'Cleanse yourself for the gods.'

sanskrit_iast: devebhyaḥ śumbhasva \\ iti sikatābhiḥ prarocayati //
meaning: देवेभ्यः शुम्भस्व \\ इति सिकताभिः प्ररोचयति //
text_mt: He makes it shine with sand, [saying:] 'Be adorned for the gods.'

sanskrit_iast: āpo ripraṃ nirvahata \\ iti nābher adhi prāgudīcīr apo niḥsārayati /
meaning: आपो रिप्रं निर्वहत \\ इति नाभेर् अधि प्रागुदीचीर् अपो निःसारयति /
text_mt: He leads the water out towards the northeast from the navel, [saying:] 'O waters, carry away the defilement.'

sanskrit_iast: pratiprasthātā dakṣiṇām̐ vediṃ karoty ottarasmāt parigrahād aratnimātram antarā /
meaning: प्रतिप्रस्थाता दक्षिणाम्̐ वेदिं करोत्य् ओत्तरस्मात् परिग्रहाद् अरत्निमात्रम् अन्तरा /
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ makes the southern altar up to the northern boundary, leaving an interval of a cubit.

sanskrit_iast: same prācī bhavato yathā havīm̐ṣi saṃbhaveyus tathā tiraścī /
meaning: समे प्राची भवतो यथा हवीम्̐षि संभवेयुस् तथा तिरश्ची /
text_mt: They are equal towards the east; across, [they are of such a size] that the oblations may fit.

sanskrit_iast: eka utkaraḥ /
meaning: एक उत्करः /

sanskrit_iast: apareṇottarām̐ stambayajur harati /
meaning: अपरेणोत्तराम्̐ स्तम्बयजुर् हरति /
text_mt: He carries away the grass tuft formula behind the northern [altar].

sanskrit_iast: prokṣaṇīḥ sam̐skṛtya \\ indraghoṣās tvā purastād vasubhiḥ pāntu \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ prāṅmukha uttaravediṃ prokṣati pradakṣiṇam uttarair anuparikrāman /
meaning: प्रोक्षणीः सम्̐स्कृत्य \\ इन्द्रघोषास् त्वा पुरस्ताद् वसुभिः पान्तु \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः प्राङ्मुख उत्तरवेदिं प्रोक्षति प्रदक्षिणम् उत्तरैर् अनुपरिक्रामन् /
text_mt: Having prepared the sprinkling waters, facing east, he sprinkles the high altar with the [mantras] beginning with: 'May the roaring Indras protect you from the east together with the Vasus,' circumambulating clockwise with the subsequent ones.

sanskrit_iast: pratiparikramya pitṝṇāṃ bhāgadheyīḥ stha \\ iti śeṣaṃ dakṣiṇata uttaraveder ninayati /
meaning: प्रतिपरिक्रम्य पितॄणां भागधेयीः स्थ \\ इति शेषं दक्षिणत उत्तरवेदेर् निनयति /
text_mt: Having circumambulated back, he pours out the remainder to the south of the high altar, [saying:] 'You are the shares of the fathers.'

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyam antardhāya pañcagṛhītena nābhim̐ vyāghārayati sim̐hīr asi sapatnasāhī svāhā \\ itiprabhṛtibhir dakṣiṇe 'm̐se savyāyām̐ śroṇau dakṣiṇāyām̐ śroṇau savye 'm̐se madhye pañcamam //
meaning: हिरण्यम् अन्तर्धाय पञ्चगृहीतेन नाभिम्̐ व्याघारयति सिम्̐हीर् असि सपत्नसाही स्वाहा \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् दक्षिणे ऽम्̐से सव्यायाम्̐ श्रोणौ दक्षिणायाम्̐ श्रोणौ सव्ये ऽम्̐से मध्ये पञ्चमम् //
text_mt: Having interposed gold, he bastes the navel with a fivefold-drawn [offering of clarified butter], with [the mantras] beginning with: 'You are a lioness, conquering rivals, svāhā,' at the right shoulder, at the left buttock, at the right buttock, at the left shoulder, [and] the fifth in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: bhūtebhyas tvā \\ ity ūrdhvām̐ srucam udgṛhṇāti /
meaning: भूतेभ्यस् त्वा \\ इत्य् ऊर्ध्वाम्̐ स्रुचम् उद्गृह्णाति /
text_mt: He lifts up the upright ladle, [saying:] 'For the beings, you.'

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīye 'gnipraṇayanāni pratyādhattaḥ /
meaning: आहवनीये ऽग्निप्रणयनानि प्रत्याधत्तः /
text_mt: They place the fire-bringing [emplements/sticks] upon the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: nābhiṃ pautadāravaiḥ paridadhāti // viśvāyur asi \\ iti madhyamaṃ dhruvakṣitir asi \\ iti dakṣiṇam acyutakṣid asi \\ ity uttaram //
meaning: नाभिं पौतदारवैः परिदधाति // विश्वायुर् असि \\ इति मध्यमं ध्रुवक्षितिर् असि \\ इति दक्षिणम् अच्युतक्षिद् असि \\ इत्य् उत्तरम् //
text_mt: He encloses the navel with [sticks] of pūtadāru wood: the middle one, [saying:] 'You are all-sustaining life'; the southern one, [saying:] 'You are a firm dwelling'; the northern one, [saying:] 'You are an unshakeable dwelling.'

sanskrit_iast: agner bhasmāsi \\ agne purīṣam asi \\ iti saṃbhārān nivapati pūtadāruguggulakerusugandhitejanam̐ vṛṣṇer alūnapūrvasyāntarāśṛṅgād ūrṇāstukam //
meaning: अग्नेर् भस्मासि \\ अग्ने पुरीषम् असि \\ इति संभारान् निवपति पूतदारुगुग्गुलकेरुसुगन्धितेजनम्̐ वृष्णेर् अलूनपूर्वस्यान्तराशृङ्गाद् ऊर्णास्तुकम् //
text_mt: He strews the ingredients, [saying:] 'You are the ash of Agni,' 'You are the soil of Agni': pūtadāru wood, bdellium, keru, fragrant reed grass, and a tuft of wool from between the horns of a ram never previously sheared.

sanskrit_iast: vibhrāḍ bṛhat pibatu \\ iti saṃbhārān abhimṛśati /
meaning: विभ्राड् बृहत् पिबतु \\ इति संभारान् अभिमृशति /
text_mt: He touches the ingredients, [saying:] 'May the shining, great one drink.'

sanskrit_iast: cātvālād upayamanīḥ kurute vedipurīṣāt pratiprasthātā //
meaning: चात्वालाद् उपयमनीः कुरुते वेदिपुरीषात् प्रतिप्रस्थाता //
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ takes supporting [earth] from the cātvāla trench, [or] from the loose earth of the altar.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye praṇīyamānāyānubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayaty agnibhyām̐ vā /
meaning: अग्नये प्रणीयमानायानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयत्य् अग्निभ्याम्̐ वा /
text_mt: He prompts [the hotṛ]: 'Recite for Agni being brought forward,' or 'for the two fires.'

sanskrit_iast: trir anūktāyām agnipraṇayanāny udyachataḥ /
meaning: त्रिर् अनूक्तायाम् अग्निप्रणयनान्य् उद्यछतः /
text_mt: When it has been recited three times, they raise the fire-bringing [sticks].

sanskrit_iast:
adhvaryur āgnīdhrāya pradāya
yat te pāvaka cakṛmā kaccid āgaḥ \ pūrvo yaḥ sann aparo bhavāsi /
ghṛtena tvaṃ tanvam̐ vardhayasva \ mā mā him̐sīr adhigataṃ purastāt / svāhā //
iti śeṣe juhoti /
meaning:
अध्वर्युर् आग्नीध्राय प्रदाय
यत् ते पावक चकृमा कच्चिद् आगः \ पूर्वो यः सन्न् अपरो भवासि /
घृतेन त्वं तन्वम्̐ वर्धयस्व \ मा मा हिम्̐सीर् अधिगतं पुरस्तात् / स्वाहा //
इति शेषे जुहोति /
text_mt:
The adhvaryu, having given [them] over to the āgnīdhra,

‘Whatever fault we have committed against you, O purifier, / you who were former and will be later,

increase your body with ghee; / do not injure me who have approached [you] from before. Svāhā!’—

sanskrit_iast: agnipraṇayanāny ādāya prācīm anu pradiśaṃ prehi vidvān iti harataḥ //
meaning: अग्निप्रणयनान्य् आदाय प्राचीम् अनु प्रदिशं प्रेहि विद्वान् इति हरतः //
text_mt: Having taken the fire-bringing [sticks], they carry [them], [saying:] 'Go forward, knowing, along the eastern direction.'

sanskrit_iast:
ūrṇāvantam ity ucyamāne
yajñaḥ praty u ṣṭhāt sumatau matīnām\ yatrāvahanti kavayaḥ purūṇi /
dīrgham āyur yajamānāya vinda\ athāsīdasva mahate sībhagāya //
iti saṃbhāreṣv agniṃ nidadhāty avokṣya pratiprasthātā samayā dakṣiṇasyāḥ pūrvārdhe /
meaning:
ऊर्णावन्तम् इत्य् उच्यमाने
यज्ञः प्रत्य् उ ष्ठात् सुमतौ मतीनाम्\ यत्रावहन्ति कवयः पुरूणि /
दीर्घम् आयुर् यजमानाय विन्द\ अथासीदस्व महते सीभगाय //
इति संभारेष्व् अग्निं निदधात्य् अवोक्ष्य प्रतिप्रस्थाता समया दक्षिणस्याः पूर्वार्धे /
text_mt:
While 'Endowed with wool' is being recited,

‘The sacrifice has stood upright in the good favor of thoughts, / where the wise poets bring many [gifts].

Obtain long life for the sacrificer; / then sit down here for great good fortune’—

with [these verses], having sprinkled [with water], he deposits the fire on the ingredients; the pratiprasthātṛ, directly in the eastern half of the southern [altar].

sanskrit_iast:
manuṣvat tvā nidhīmahi \ manuṣvat samidhīmahi /
agne manuṣvad aṅgiras\ devān devāyate yajamānāya svāhā //
iti samidhāvādadhataḥ //
meaning:
मनुष्वत् त्वा निधीमहि \ मनुष्वत् समिधीमहि /
अग्ने मनुष्वद् अङ्गिरस्\ देवान् देवायते यजमानाय स्वाहा //
इति समिधावादधतः //
text_mt:
‘Like Manu may we place you down, / like Manu may we kindle you.

O Agni, Aṅgiras, like Manu, / to the gods, for the god-seeking sacrificer, svāhā!’—

with [these verses] they lay on two kindling sticks.

sanskrit_iast: agneḥ kulāyam asi \\ iti dakṣiṇata āhavanīyasyopayamanīr nivapati /
meaning: अग्नेः कुलायम् असि \\ इति दक्षिणत आहवनीयस्योपयमनीर् निवपति /
text_mt: He scatters the supporting [earth] to the south of the āhavanīya fire, [saying:] 'You are the nest of Agni.'

sanskrit_iast: ulaparājibhyām āhavanīyau paristīrya sapta te agne samidhas \\ iti pūrṇāhutī juhutaḥ /
meaning: उलपराजिभ्याम् आहवनीयौ परिस्तीर्य सप्त ते अग्ने समिधस् \\ इति पूर्णाहुती जुहुतः /
text_mt: Having strewn round the two āhavanīya fires with two rows of grass, they offer two full-ladle offerings, [saying:] 'Seven are your kindling sticks, O Agni.'

sanskrit_iast: pratiprasthātā dakṣiṇasyā veder uttarasyāḥ śroṇer adhi sphyena sakṛt saṃbhinatty ottarasyā dakṣiṇasmād am̐sāt /
meaning: प्रतिप्रस्थाता दक्षिणस्या वेदेर् उत्तरस्याः श्रोणेर् अधि स्फ्येन सकृत् संभिनत्त्य् ओत्तरस्या दक्षिणस्माद् अम्̐सात् /
text_mt: With the wooden sword, the pratiprasthātṛ cuts across once from the northern buttock of the southern altar up to the southern shoulder of the northern [altar].

sanskrit_iast: pṛthak karmāṇi kurutaḥ /
meaning: पृथक् कर्माणि कुरुतः /
text_mt: They perform the ritual acts separately.

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryuḥ praiṣān āha /
meaning: अध्वर्युः प्रैषान् आह /

sanskrit_iast: piṣṭalepau ninīyottarau parigrāhau parigṛhṇītaḥ /
meaning: पिष्टलेपौ निनीयोत्तरौ परिग्राहौ परिगृह्णीतः /
text_mt: Having poured out the two dough scrapings, they trace the two subsequent boundaries.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ājyagrahebhyaḥ /
meaning: सिद्धम् आज्यग्रहेभ्यः /
text_mt: It is established up to the portions of clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: caturgṛhītāny ājyāni pṛṣadājyavanti gṛhṇāti /
meaning: चतुर्गृहीतान्य् आज्यानि पृषदाज्यवन्ति गृह्णाति /
text_mt: He draws four-times-drawn clarified butter containing mixed clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ājyānām̐ sādanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आज्यानाम्̐ सादनात् /
text_mt: It is established up to the placing of the clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: uttarato gārhapatyasya pratiprasthātāmayavapiṣṭānāṃ dadhnā karambhapātrāṇi karoty ekoddhīny aṅguṣṭhaparvamātrāṇi yāvanto 'mātyā yajamānasyaikaṃ cādhikam /
meaning: उत्तरतो गार्हपत्यस्य प्रतिप्रस्थातामयवपिष्टानां दध्ना करम्भपात्राणि करोत्य् एकोद्धीन्य् अङ्गुष्ठपर्वमात्राणि यावन्तो ऽमात्या यजमानस्यैकं चाधिकम् /
text_mt: To the north of the gārhapatya fire, with curd, the pratiprasthātṛ makes porridge vessels out of raw barley flour, having a single rim and measuring the joint of a thumb, as many as there are members of the sacrificer's household, and one extra.

sanskrit_iast: śamīparṇaiḥ pūrayitvā śūrpe nidadhāti /
meaning: शमीपर्णैः पूरयित्वा शूर्पे निदधाति /
text_mt: Having filled [them] with leaves of the śamī tree, he places [them] in a winnowing basket.

sanskrit_iast: meṣaṃ kṛtvā meṣīṃ karoti yāvanti pulliṅgāni śavayeran strīliṅgāni meṣyāḥ pratiprasthātā /
meaning: मेषं कृत्वा मेषीं करोति यावन्ति पुल्लिङ्गानि शवयेरन् स्त्रीलिङ्गानि मेष्याः प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
text_mt: Having made a ram, the pratiprasthātā makes an ewe, as many masculine marks [on the ram as there may be] and feminine marks on the ewe.

sanskrit_iast: prakṣālyorṇāḥ śleṣayataḥ /
meaning: प्रक्षाल्योर्णाः श्लेषयतः /
text_mt: Having washed sheep's wool, the two stick [it] on.

sanskrit_iast: paraḥśatāni paraḥsahasrāṇi cāgrataḥ śamīparṇāni nivapataḥ /
meaning: परःशतानि परःसहस्राणि चाग्रतः शमीपर्णानि निवपतः /
text_mt: They strew more than a hundred and more than a thousand śamī leaves in front.

sanskrit_iast: visrāvyāmikṣe pātryor avadhattaḥ /
meaning: विस्राव्यामिक्षे पात्र्योर् अवधत्तः /
text_mt: Having drained off [the whey], they place the two curd messes into two vessels.

sanskrit_iast: vāruṇyai niṣkāṣam̐ śiṣṭvā payasyayoḥ karīrasaktūn āvapataḥ /
meaning: वारुण्यै निष्काषम्̐ शिष्ट्वा पयस्ययोः करीरसक्तून् आवपतः /
text_mt: Having left the scrapings for [the offering to] Varuṇa, they scatter karīra groats into the two curd offerings.

sanskrit_iast: mārutyāṃ meṣamavadadhāti vāruṇyāṃ meṣīm /
meaning: मारुत्यां मेषमवदधाति वारुण्यां मेषीम् /
text_mt: He places the ram into the [offering] to the Maruts, and the ewe into the [offering] to Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: āsādayantau vipariharata aindrāgnaṣaṣṭhāny uttarasyāṃ mārutīṃ pratiprasthātā dakṣiṇasyām̐ vāruṇyekakapālāv uttarasyām ubhayatra nirmathyaḥ /
meaning: आसादयन्तौ विपरिहरत ऐन्द्राग्नषष्ठान्य् उत्तरस्यां मारुतीं प्रतिप्रस्थाता दक्षिणस्याम्̐ वारुण्येककपालाव् उत्तरस्याम् उभयत्र निर्मथ्यः /
text_mt: Setting [the oblations] down, the two transpose them: [the adhvaryu places] the six oblations ending with that to Indra-Agni on the northern [fire-altar]; the pratiprasthātā [places] that to the Maruts on the southern [altar]; that to Varuṇa and the single potsherd [cake] on the northern [altar]; in both places fire is to be churned out.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā saṃmārjanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ संमार्जनात् /

sanskrit_iast: saṃmṛṣṭa uttarasmin pratiprasthātā gārhapatyānte pṛchati patni kati te kāntā yadi mithyā vakṣyasi priyatamas te sam̐sthāsyati \\ iti / yaṃ nirdiśet tam̐ varuṇo gṛhṇātu \\ iti brūyāt //
meaning: संमृष्ट उत्तरस्मिन् प्रतिप्रस्थाता गार्हपत्यान्ते पृछति पत्नि कति ते कान्ता यदि मिथ्या वक्ष्यसि प्रियतमस् ते सम्̐स्थास्यति \\ इति / यं निर्दिशेत् तम्̐ वरुणो गृह्णातु \\ इति ब्रूयात् //
text_mt: When [the spoons] have been wiped on the northern [altar], the pratiprasthātā asks at the edge of the gārhapatya: "Wife, how many lovers do you have? If you speak falsely, your dearest [relative] will perish." Whomever she indicates, he should say, "May Varuṇa seize him!"

sanskrit_iast: praghāsyān havāmahe \\ iti patnī /
meaning: प्रघास्यान् हवामहे \\ इति पत्नी /
text_mt: The wife [recites]: "We invoke the Praghāsyas..."

sanskrit_iast: karambhapātrāṇy ādāyāpareṇa vihāraṃ dakṣiṇātikramyāgreṇa dakṣiṇam agniṃ purastāt pratyañcāv avatiṣṭhete śūrpam̐ śirasoravadhāya //
meaning: करम्भपात्राण्य् आदायापरेण विहारं दक्षिणातिक्रम्याग्रेण दक्षिणम् अग्निं पुरस्तात् प्रत्यञ्चाव् अवतिष्ठेते शूर्पम्̐ शिरसोरवधाय //
text_mt: Taking the groat dishes, having stepped to the south along the west of the sacrificial enclosure, in front of the southern fire facing west, having placed the winnowing baskets on their heads, the two stand [there].

sanskrit_iast: mo ṣū ṇa indra \\ iti japati yajamāna uttaratas tiṣṭhan //
meaning: मो षू ण इन्द्र \\ इति जपति यजमान उत्तरतस् तिष्ठन् //
text_mt: Standing to the north, the sacrificer mutters: "Do not, O Indra..."

sanskrit_iast: yad grāme yad araṇye \\ iti juhutaḥ śūrpeṇa karambhapātrāṇi //
meaning: यद् ग्रामे यद् अरण्ये \\ इति जुहुतः शूर्पेण करम्भपात्राणि //
text_mt: With the winnowing basket they both offer the groat dishes with [the mantra]: "Whatever [sin] in village, whatever in wilderness..."

sanskrit_iast: akran karma karmakṛtas \\ iti vyutkrāmataḥ /
meaning: अक्रन् कर्म कर्मकृतस् \\ इति व्युत्क्रामतः /
text_mt: They step out in different directions with: "The workers have done the work..."

sanskrit_iast: saṃmṛṣṭe dakṣiṇasmin siddham ā pravarāt /
