text_mt: The formula beginning with 'From every abode' has been explained.

sanskrit_iast:
āśāsānaḥ saumanasam\ prajāṃ puṣṭimatho bhagam /
svagākārakṛto mahyam\ yajamānāya tiṣṭhatu //
eṣa te vāyo \ namaḥ svarubhyo bṛhadbhyo mārutebhyaḥ \ sannān māvagām \ apaścāddaghvānnaṃ bhūyāsam ity anudiśati yūpam̐ yajamānaḥ /
meaning:
आशासानः सौमनसम्\ प्रजां पुष्टिमथो भगम् /
स्वगाकारकृतो मह्यम्\ यजमानाय तिष्ठतु //
एष ते वायो \ नमः स्वरुभ्यो बृहद्भ्यो मारुतेभ्यः \ सन्नान् मावगाम् \ अपश्चाद्दघ्वान्नं भूयासम् इत्य् अनुदिशति यूपम्̐ यजमानः /
text_mt:
'Praying for goodwill, offspring, nourishment, and fortune,

may that which was offered with the svagā-call stand for me, the sacrificer!'

With the formulas: 'This is yours, o Vāyu,' 'Homage to the chips, the lofty ones of the Maruts,' 'May I not fall away from the firm ground,' 'May I not be one whose food fails,' the sacrificer addresses the sacrificial post.

sanskrit_iast: vediṃ paryoṣati /
meaning: वेदिं पर्योषति /

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṭsuṣaṭsu māseṣu paśunā yajeta sam̐vatsaresaṃvatsare vā /
meaning: षट्सुषट्सु मासेषु पशुना यजेत सम्̐वत्सरेसंवत्सरे वा /
text_mt: Every six months he should sacrifice with an animal, or every year.

sanskrit_iast: nainam anījānam̐ saṃvatsaro 'tīyāt / yady atīyān na mām̐sam aśnīyād ā paśubandhāt /
meaning: नैनम् अनीजानम्̐ संवत्सरो ऽतीयात् / यद्य् अतीयान् न माम्̐सम् अश्नीयाद् आ पशुबन्धात् /
text_mt: A year should not pass him by without having sacrificed. If it should pass by, he should not eat meat until the animal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: nātipraṇīteṣu praṇītā syād anyatra vacanāt /
meaning: नातिप्रणीतेषु प्रणीता स्याद् अन्यत्र वचनात् /
text_mt: Water should not be brought forward when [the fires] have been brought forward in an excessive manner, except by special statement.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇukramaprabhṛti samānam̐ yājamānam̐ yājamānam /
meaning: विष्णुक्रमप्रभृति समानम्̐ याजमानम्̐ याजमानम् /
text_mt: The duties of the sacrificer, beginning with the steps of Viṣṇu, are the same.

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭomena vasante yajeta /
meaning: अग्निष्टोमेन वसन्ते यजेत /
text_mt: He should sacrifice with the Agniṣṭoma in the spring.

sanskrit_iast: āmnātāni devayajanāni /
meaning: आम्नातानि देवयजनानि /
text_mt: The sacrificial grounds are handed down in tradition.

sanskrit_iast: prācīnapravaṇaṃ nityārtham /
meaning: प्राचीनप्रवणं नित्यार्थम् /
text_mt: [The ground] sloping to the east is for the regular [sacrifice].

sanskrit_iast: ṛtvijo vṛṇīte mahato yūna ārṣeyān ādityo 'dhvaryuḥ sa me 'dhvaryur \ adhvaryo tvaṃ me 'dhvaryur asi \\ ity adhvaryuṃ // candramā brahmā sa me brahmā \ brahmam̐s tvaṃ me brahmāsi \\ iti brahmāṇam agnir hotā sa me hotā \ hotas tvaṃ me hotāsi \\ iti hotāraṃ // parjanya udgātā sa ma udgātā \\ udgātas tvaṃ ma udgātāsi \\ ity udgātāraṃ // diśo hotrāśam̐sinyas tā me hotrāśam̐sinyas \\ hotrāśam̐sinyo yūyaṃ me hotrāśam̐sinyaḥ stha \\ iti dvādaśa hotṛkān //
meaning: ऋत्विजो वृणीते महतो यून आर्षेयान् आदित्यो ऽध्वर्युः स मे ऽध्वर्युर् \ अध्वर्यो त्वं मे ऽध्वर्युर् असि \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युं // चन्द्रमा ब्रह्मा स मे ब्रह्मा \ ब्रह्मम्̐स् त्वं मे ब्रह्मासि \\ इति ब्रह्माणम् अग्निर् होता स मे होता \ होतस् त्वं मे होतासि \\ इति होतारं // पर्जन्य उद्गाता स म उद्गाता \\ उद्गातस् त्वं म उद्गातासि \\ इत्य् उद्गातारं // दिशो होत्राशम्̐सिन्यस् ता मे होत्राशम्̐सिन्यस् \\ होत्राशम्̐सिन्यो यूयं मे होत्राशम्̐सिन्यः स्थ \\ इति द्वादश होतृकान् //
text_mt: He chooses the officiating priests—distinguished, young, and of ṛṣi descent: 'Āditya is the adhvaryu; he is my adhvaryu; o adhvaryu, you are my adhvaryu,'—thus the adhvaryu; 'The Moon is the brahman; he is my brahman; o brahman, you are my brahman,'—thus the brahman; 'Agni is the hotṛ; he is my hotṛ; o hotṛ, you are my hotṛ,'—thus the hotṛ; 'Parjanya is the udgātṛ; he is my udgātṛ; o udgātṛ, you are my udgātṛ,'—thus the udgātṛ; 'The quarters are the hotrā-reciters; they are my hotrā-reciters; o hotrā-reciters, you are my hotrā-reciters,'—thus the twelve subordinate priests.

sanskrit_iast: maho me 'vocas \\ iti vṛtā japanti /
meaning: महो मे ऽवोचस् \\ इति वृता जपन्ति /
text_mt: Having been chosen, they mutter: 'Great things have you spoken of me.'

sanskrit_iast:
edam aganma devayajanaṃ pṛthivyās\ yatra devāso ajuṣanta viśve /
ṛksāmābhyām̐ saṃtaranto yajurbhis\ rāyaspoṣeṇa sam iṣā madema //
iti samūlaṃ devayajanam adhyavasyati /
meaning:
एदम् अगन्म देवयजनं पृथिव्यास्\ यत्र देवासो अजुषन्त विश्वे /
ऋक्सामाभ्याम्̐ संतरन्तो यजुर्भिस्\ रायस्पोषेण सम् इषा मदेम //
इति समूलं देवयजनम् अध्यवस्यति /

sanskrit_iast: tatra prācīnavam̐śaṃ kurvanty udyataṃ purastān niyataṃ paścāt /
meaning: तत्र प्राचीनवम्̐शं कुर्वन्त्य् उद्यतं पुरस्तान् नियतं पश्चात् /
text_mt: There they make a hall with beams pointing eastward, raised in front and lowered behind.

sanskrit_iast: tanumiśreṇa pariśrayanti /
meaning: तनुमिश्रेण परिश्रयन्ति /
text_mt: They enclose it with thin [mats] interwoven.

sanskrit_iast: pariśrayanto 'tirokān kurvanti /
meaning: परिश्रयन्तो ऽतिरोकान् कुर्वन्ति /
text_mt: While enclosing it, they leave openings for light.

sanskrit_iast: dikṣu dvārāṇi kurvanti dviśayāni sāṃkāśanāni /
meaning: दिक्षु द्वाराणि कुर्वन्ति द्विशयानि सांकाशनानि /
text_mt: They make doors in the cardinal directions, having two leaves [and] providing an outlook.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvayā dvārā praviśya kratunirdeśaṃ kṛtvā tasminn agnīn viharati //
meaning: पूर्वया द्वारा प्रविश्य क्रतुनिर्देशं कृत्वा तस्मिन्न् अग्नीन् विहरति //
text_mt: Entering by the eastern door and having made the specification of the rite, he spreads the fires in it.

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ dāsyāmi \\ iti nirdeśaḥ /
meaning: इदं दास्यामि \\ इति निर्देशः /
text_mt: "I shall give this" is the specification.

sanskrit_iast: daikṣam aśanam aśnīto dadhnā madhumiśreṇa yajamānaḥ patnī ca /
meaning: दैक्षम् अशनम् अश्नीतो दध्ना मधुमिश्रेण यजमानः पत्नी च /
text_mt: The sacrificer and his wife eat the food proper for initiation with curd mixed with honey.

sanskrit_iast: amāvāsyāyāṃ dīkṣeta yathā vā parvaṇi sutyā syāt /
meaning: अमावास्यायां दीक्षेत यथा वा पर्वणि सुत्या स्यात् /
text_mt: He should be initiated on the new-moon day, or so that the pressing day will be on a lunar conjunction.

sanskrit_iast: saptahotāram̐ manasānudrutya vidhe nāman \\ iti graheṇa juhoti /
meaning: सप्तहोतारम्̐ मनसानुद्रुत्य विधे नामन् \\ इति ग्रहेण जुहोति /
text_mt: Having mentally recited the saptahotṛ formula, he offers with the ladle [saying]: "O name, in worship..."

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣaṇīyāṃ nirvapaty āgnāvaiṣṇavam ekādaśakapālaṃ ghṛte vā carum /
meaning: दीक्षणीयां निर्वपत्य् आग्नावैष्णवम् एकादशकपालं घृते वा चरुम् /
text_mt: He apportions the initiation offering: [a cake] on eleven potsherds to Agni and Viṣṇu, or a boiled oblation in clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: apaḥ praṇeṣyann agnir yajurbhir itiprabhṛtīni dvādaśa saṃbhārayajūm̐ṣi teṣāṃ catvāricatvāri nigadya juhoti /
meaning: अपः प्रणेष्यन्न् अग्निर् यजुर्भिर् इतिप्रभृतीनि द्वादश संभारयजूम्̐षि तेषां चत्वारिचत्वारि निगद्य जुहोति /
text_mt: When about to lead forth the waters, he recites the twelve gathering-formulas beginning with "Agni with the formulas...", and offers them pronouncing them four by four.

sanskrit_iast: patnīsam̐yājāntā dīkṣaṇīyā saṃtiṣṭhate /
meaning: पत्नीसम्̐याजान्ता दीक्षणीया संतिष्ठते /
text_mt: The initiation offering concludes with the offerings to the wives of the gods.

sanskrit_iast: tasyāṃ mradīyān svaro darśapaurṇamāsikān mradīyān prāyaṇīyāyāṃ mradīyān ātithyāyāṃ dhvānenopasadaḥ / sarvā upām̐śudevatāḥ /
meaning: तस्यां म्रदीयान् स्वरो दर्शपौर्णमासिकान् म्रदीयान् प्रायणीयायां म्रदीयान् आतिथ्यायां ध्वानेनोपसदः / सर्वा उपाम्̐शुदेवताः /
text_mt: At it, the tone is softer than that of the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices, softer at the introductory rite, softer at the guest-offering; the upasad rites are [performed] in an undertone. All deities are [addressed] in a whisper.

sanskrit_iast: sam̐vṛtya dvārāṇi pracarati /
meaning: सम्̐वृत्य द्वाराणि प्रचरति /
text_mt: Having closed the doors, he proceeds.

sanskrit_iast: uttarataḥ pṛṣṭhayādeśasya pariśritya \\ āpo devīr ity abhyundati //
meaning: उत्तरतः पृष्ठयादेशस्य परिश्रित्य \\ आपो देवीर् इत्य् अभ्युन्दति //
text_mt: Having enclosed [a space] to the north of the place of the central spine, he moistens [the hair] saying: "O divine waters..."

sanskrit_iast: oṣadhe trāyasvainam iti dakṣiṇasmin keśānte darbham antardadhāti //
meaning: ओषधे त्रायस्वैनम् इति दक्षिणस्मिन् केशान्ते दर्भम् अन्तर्दधाति //
text_mt: He places a blade of darbha grass in the right hair-part, saying: "O herb, protect him!"

sanskrit_iast: svadhite mainam̐ him̐sīr iti kṣureṇābhinidadhāti //
meaning: स्वधिते मैनम्̐ हिम्̐सीर् इति क्षुरेणाभिनिदधाति //
text_mt: He applies the razor, saying: "O axe, do not harm him!"

sanskrit_iast: devaśrud imān pravape \\ iti pravapate //
meaning: देवश्रुद् इमान् प्रवपे \\ इति प्रवपते //
text_mt: He shaves, saying: "Listening to the gods, I shave these [hairs]."

sanskrit_iast: svasty uttaraṃ aśīya \\ iti yajamāno japati /
meaning: स्वस्त्य् उत्तरं अशीय \\ इति यजमानो जपति /
text_mt: The sacrificer mutters: "May I attain well-being beyond!"

sanskrit_iast: keśaśmaśru yajamāno vāpayate /
meaning: केशश्मश्रु यजमानो वापयते /
text_mt: The sacrificer has his head-hair and beard shaved.

sanskrit_iast: dato dhāvate /
meaning: दतो धावते /

sanskrit_iast: lomāni sam̐hāya nakhān kārayate / na kakṣau /
meaning: लोमानि सम्̐हाय नखान् कारयते / न कक्षौ /
text_mt: Collecting the body hair, he has his nails cut, but not [the hair of] the armpits.

sanskrit_iast: patnī nakhām̐ś ca kārayīta /
meaning: पत्नी नखाम्̐श् च कारयीत /
text_mt: The wife also should have her nails cut.

sanskrit_iast: tīrthenāvagāhya sāvakāsu hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayas iti sthāvarāsu snātvānūpamrakṣam ācamya \\ ud id ābhyaḥ śucir ā pūta emi \\ ity utkrāmati //
meaning: तीर्थेनावगाह्य सावकासु हिरण्यवर्णाः शुचयस् इति स्थावरासु स्नात्वानूपम्रक्षम् आचम्य \\ उद् इद् आभ्यः शुचिर् आ पूत एमि \\ इत्य् उत्क्रामति //
text_mt: Having plunged into the water by the ford, having bathed in standing [waters] containing avakā plants, saying: "Golden-colored, pure...", having rubbed [himself] dry with water, having sipped water, he steps out, saying: "From these waters I come forth pure and cleansed."

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇoḥ śarmāsi \\ iti kṣaumam āchādayate //
meaning: विष्णोः शर्मासि \\ इति क्षौमम् आछादयते //
text_mt: He puts on a linen garment, saying: "You are Viṣṇu's shelter."

sanskrit_iast: ūrje tvā \\ iti nīvīṃ kurute /
meaning: ऊर्जे त्वा \\ इति नीवीं कुरुते /
text_mt: He makes a tuck, saying: "For strength, thee!"

sanskrit_iast: daikṣaṃ patnī tūṣṇīm /
meaning: दैक्षं पत्नी तूष्णीम् /

sanskrit_iast: snātvā prācīnamātṛkaṃ kṣaumaṃ patny āchādayate //
meaning: स्नात्वा प्राचीनमातृकं क्षौमं पत्न्य् आछादयते //
text_mt: Having bathed, the wife puts on a linen garment whose warp-threads run eastward.

sanskrit_iast: mahīnāṃ payo 'si \\ iti darbhapiñjūlābhyāṃ navanītam āyauti //
meaning: महीनां पयो ऽसि \\ इति दर्भपिञ्जूलाभ्यां नवनीतम् आयौति //
text_mt: He stirs the fresh butter with two darbha grass-blades, saying: "You are the milk of the great ones."

sanskrit_iast: varodhā asi \\ ity anulomaṃ trirabhyaṅkte mukham agre 'tha śiraḥ / svabhyavato bhavaty ā pādābhyām /
meaning: वरोधा असि \\ इत्य् अनुलोमं त्रिरभ्यङ्क्ते मुखम् अग्रे ऽथ शिरः / स्वभ्यवतो भवत्य् आ पादाभ्याम् /
text_mt: He anoints himself from head to foot three times, saying: "You are the restrainer", first the face, then the head. He becomes well-anointed down to the two feet.

sanskrit_iast: śeṣeṇa patny abhyaṅkte /
meaning: शेषेण पत्न्य् अभ्यङ्क्ते /
text_mt: With the remainder, the wife anoints herself.

sanskrit_iast: catasṛbhir darbheṣīkābhiḥ śareṣīkābhir vā samuñjābhiḥ satūlābhir ity ekakaikayā traikakubhasyāñjanasya saṃniṣkṛṣya vṛtrasyāsi kanīnikā \\ iti dakṣiṇam akṣi trir āṅkte 'nyayānyayāniṣevayan savyaṃ ca /
meaning: चतसृभिर् दर्भेषीकाभिः शरेषीकाभिर् वा समुञ्जाभिः सतूलाभिर् इत्य् एककैकया त्रैककुभस्याञ्जनस्य संनिष्कृष्य वृत्रस्यासि कनीनिका \\ इति दक्षिणम् अक्षि त्रिर् आङ्क्ते ऽन्ययान्ययानिषेवयन् सव्यं च /
text_mt: With four reeds of darbha or reeds of reed-grass, along with muñja grass and tufts, drawing out one by one [some] ointment from Mount Trikakubh, he anoints his right eye three times, saying: "You are the pupil of Vṛtra", and the left eye using another and another, without dropping it.

sanskrit_iast: śeṣeṇa patny āṅkte /
meaning: शेषेण पत्न्य् आङ्क्ते /

sanskrit_iast: darbhapiñjūlais triḥ pāvayaty ekavim̐śatyā tredhā vibhajya citpatis tvā \\ ity ūrdhvam \\ vācaspatis tvā \\ ity avāñcam \\ devas tvā savitā \\ ity ūrdhvam achidreṇa pavitreṇa \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati //
meaning: दर्भपिञ्जूलैस् त्रिः पावयत्य् एकविम्̐शत्या त्रेधा विभज्य चित्पतिस् त्वा \\ इत्य् ऊर्ध्वम् \\ वाचस्पतिस् त्वा \\ इत्य् अवाञ्चम् \\ देवस् त्वा सविता \\ इत्य् ऊर्ध्वम् अछिद्रेण पवित्रेण \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति //
text_mt: He purifies [him] three times with twenty-one darbha grass-blades, dividing them into three parts, upwards saying: "May the lord of thought [purify] you", downwards saying: "May the lord of speech [purify] you", upwards saying: "May the divine Savitṛ [purify] you", appending everywhere: "with an undamaged strainer."

sanskrit_iast: tasya te pavitrapate pavitreṇa \\ iti yajamāno japati /
meaning: तस्य ते पवित्रपते पवित्रेण \\ इति यजमानो जपति /
text_mt: The sacrificer mutters: "Of that strainer-lord, with your strainer..."

sanskrit_iast: na prāṇān atipāvayet /
meaning: न प्राणान् अतिपावयेत् /

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ dviṣyāt tam akṣṇayā pāvayet /
meaning: यं द्विष्यात् तम् अक्ष्णया पावयेत् /
text_mt: He whom he might hate, him he should purify diagonally.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvayā dvārā yajamānaṃ prapādyottareṇāhavanīyaṃ parikramya paścād āhavanīyasyopaveśayati /
meaning: पूर्वया द्वारा यजमानं प्रपाद्योत्तरेणाहवनीयं परिक्रम्य पश्चाद् आहवनीयस्योपवेशयति /
text_mt: Having made the sacrificer enter through the eastern door and having walked around to the north of the āhavanīya fire, he seats him behind the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: pratiprasthātā tūṣṇīṃ patnīṃ pāvayitvāparayā dvārā prapādya dakṣiṇataḥpaścād aparasya patnīlokam upasthāpyopaveśayati /
meaning: प्रतिप्रस्थाता तूष्णीं पत्नीं पावयित्वापरया द्वारा प्रपाद्य दक्षिणतःपश्चाद् अपरस्य पत्नीलोकम् उपस्थाप्योपवेशयति /
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ priest, having silently purified the wife and made her enter through the western door, having made her stand south of the western [fire] in the place of the wife, seats her.

sanskrit_iast: ākūtyai prayuje \\ iti sruveṇādhītayajūm̐ṣi juhoti // āpo devīr iti srucā pañcamīm / ṣaṣṭhīṃ dvādaśagṛhītāṃ pūrṇāhutim \\ viśvo devasya netur iti nigadya juhoti /
meaning: आकूत्यै प्रयुजे \\ इति स्रुवेणाधीतयजूम्̐षि जुहोति // आपो देवीर् इति स्रुचा पञ्चमीम् / षष्ठीं द्वादशगृहीतां पूर्णाहुतिम् \\ विश्वो देवस्य नेतुर् इति निगद्य जुहोति /
text_mt: With the dipping spoon he offers the learned formulas, saying: "For intention, for the yoke-mate..."; the fifth with the offering ladle, saying: "O divine waters..."; the sixth, a full-spoon offering taken twelve times, he offers having pronounced: "Of every divine leader..."

sanskrit_iast: paścād āhavanīyasya kṛṣṇājine mām̐sataḥ samasya prāggrīve lomataḥ sam̐stṛṇāti /
meaning: पश्चाद् आहवनीयस्य कृष्णाजिने माम्̐सतः समस्य प्राग्ग्रीवे लोमतः सम्̐स्तृणाति /
text_mt: Behind the āhavanīya fire, he spreads out two black antelope skins, joined flesh-side to flesh-side, with the necks pointing eastward, hair-side [upwards].

sanskrit_iast: yady ekam̐ syād dakṣiṇaṃ kṛṣṇājinapādaṃ mām̐sataḥ samasya pratiṣīvyet //
meaning: यद्य् एकम्̐ स्याद् दक्षिणं कृष्णाजिनपादं माम्̐सतः समस्य प्रतिषीव्येत् //
text_mt: If there should be only one, he should sew together the right foot of the black antelope skin, joining it flesh-side to [flesh-side].

sanskrit_iast: ṛksāmayoḥ śilpe sthas \\ iti kṛṣṇaśukle rājī saṃmṛśati //
meaning: ऋक्सामयोः शिल्पे स्थस् \\ इति कृष्णशुक्ले राजी संमृशति //
text_mt: He touches the black and white stripes, saying: "You two are the artworks of the ṛgveda and the sāmaveda."

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇoḥ śarmāsi \\ iti bhasata ārohati //
meaning: विष्णोः शर्मासि \\ इति भसत आरोहति //
text_mt: He steps onto the hind-part, saying: "You are Viṣṇu's shelter."

sanskrit_iast: sūryāgnī dyāvāpṛthivī iti prāñjalir japati /
meaning: सूर्याग्नी द्यावापृथिवी इति प्राञ्जलिर् जपति /
text_mt: With folded hands he mutters: "O sun and Agni, heaven and earth..."

sanskrit_iast:
jālam ubhayataḥpāśaṃ patnyāḥ śirasy āmucya
saṃ tvā nahyāmi payasā pṛthivyāḥ \ saṃ tvā nahyāmy adbhir oṣadhībhiḥ /
saṃ tvā nahyāmi prajayā dhanena \ sā dīkṣitā sanavo vācam asmāt //
iti pratiprasthātā yoktreṇa patnīm̐ saṃnahyati /
meaning:
जालम् उभयतःपाशं पत्न्याः शिरस्य् आमुच्य
सं त्वा नह्यामि पयसा पृथिव्याः \ सं त्वा नह्याम्य् अद्भिर् ओषधीभिः /
सं त्वा नह्यामि प्रजया धनेन \ सा दीक्षिता सनवो वाचम् अस्मात् //
इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता योक्त्रेण पत्नीम्̐ संनह्यति /
text_mt:
Having placed a net with loops on both sides on the wife's head,

"I gird you with the sap of the earth; / I gird you with the waters, with the herbs;

I gird you with offspring, with wealth; / as an initiated woman, may you win speech from this [sacrificer]!"

saying thus, the pratiprasthātṛ priest girds the wife with a girdle-cord.

sanskrit_iast: mekhalāṃ dīkṣito mauñjīṃ pṛthvīṃ triguṇām̐ samastām udakpāśām ūrg asi \\ ity ābadhnāti /
meaning: मेखलां दीक्षितो मौञ्जीं पृथ्वीं त्रिगुणाम्̐ समस्ताम् उदक्पाशाम् ऊर्ग् असि \\ इत्य् आबध्नाति /
text_mt: The initiated one ties around himself a broad, threefold, intertwined girdle of muñja grass, with the loop turned north, saying: "You are sap."

sanskrit_iast: ucyarti granthiṃ karoti /
meaning: उच्यर्ति ग्रन्थिं करोति /
text_mt: He ties a knot that pulls upward.

sanskrit_iast: ayugmavalīṃ kṛṣṇaviṣāṇām ādāya \\ indrasya yonir asi \\ iti viṣāṇām anumantrayate //
meaning: अयुग्मवलीं कृष्णविषाणाम् आदाय \\ इन्द्रस्य योनिर् असि \\ इति विषाणाम् अनुमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: Taking a black antelope horn with an odd number of rings, he accompanies the horn with the mantra: "You are the womb of Indra."

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣim̐ susasyām utkṛṣe \\ iti viṣāṇayā bahirvedi prācīm uddhanti //
meaning: कृषिम्̐ सुसस्याम् उत्कृषे \\ इति विषाणया बहिर्वेदि प्राचीम् उद्धन्ति //
text_mt: He digs up [the ground] eastward outside the altar with the horn, saying: "For agriculture producing good crops, I dig."

sanskrit_iast: viṣāṇe viṣya \\ iti sicyābadhnāti /
meaning: विषाणे विष्य \\ इति सिच्याबध्नाति /
text_mt: He ties it to the fringe of his garment, saying: "O horn, loosen [the knot]!"

sanskrit_iast: tayā kaṇḍūyate kṛṣim̐ susasyām utkṛṣe \\ ity aṅgāni supippalā oṣadhīs kṛdhi \\ iti śiraḥ /
meaning: तया कण्डूयते कृषिम्̐ सुसस्याम् उत्कृषे \\ इत्य् अङ्गानि सुपिप्पला ओषधीस् कृधि \\ इति शिरः /
text_mt: With it he scratches himself: his limbs saying: "For agriculture producing good crops, I dig", his head saying: "Make the herbs possess good fruit!"

sanskrit_iast: vānaspatyena śaṅkunā patnnī kaṇḍūyeta /
meaning: वानस्पत्येन शङ्कुना पत्न्नी कण्डूयेत /
text_mt: The wife should scratch herself with a wooden peg.

sanskrit_iast: audumbaram āsyadaghnaṃ daṇḍam agreṇāhavanīyaṃ paryāhṛtya bṛhann asi vānaspatyas \\ iti yajamānāya prayachati //
meaning: औदुम्बरम् आस्यदघ्नं दण्डम् अग्रेणाहवनीयं पर्याहृत्य बृहन्न् असि वानस्पत्यस् \\ इति यजमानाय प्रयछति //
text_mt: Having brought around the staff of udumbara wood, reaching up to the mouth, in front of the āhavanīya fire, he hands it to the sacrificer, saying: "Great are you, made of wood."

sanskrit_iast: sūpasthā asi vānaspatyas \\ ūrjo mā pāhy odṛcam iti pratigṛhṇāti //
meaning: सूपस्था असि वानस्पत्यस् \\ ऊर्जो मा पाह्य् ओदृचम् इति प्रतिगृह्णाति //
text_mt: He accepts it, saying: "You are easy to lean upon, made of wood; protect me from exhaustion until the end."

sanskrit_iast: nakṣatrāṇāṃ mātīkāśāt \\ ity uttarāntena prorṇute //
meaning: नक्षत्राणां मातीकाशात् \\ इत्य् उत्तरान्तेन प्रोर्णुते //
text_mt: He covers his head with the upper fringe of the garment, saying: "May I not be visible to the stars!"

sanskrit_iast: ā vo devāsa īmahe \\ iti japati /
meaning: आ वो देवास ईमहे \\ इति जपति /
text_mt: He mutters: "Unto you, O gods, we approach..."

sanskrit_iast: nāpachādayed ā krayāt //
meaning: नापछादयेद् आ क्रयात् //

sanskrit_iast: svāhā yajñaṃ manasas \\ itiprabhṛtibhir aṅgulī dvedve nibhujan muṣṭī kurute / vācam̐ yachati /
meaning: स्वाहा यज्ञं मनसस् \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् अङ्गुली द्वेद्वे निभुजन् मुष्टी कुरुते / वाचम्̐ यछति /
text_mt: With [the formulas] beginning with “Svāhā, the sacrifice from the mind…”, bending two fingers at a time, he makes fists [and] restrains his speech.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīṃ patnī muṣṭī kṛtvā vācam̐ yachati /
meaning: तूष्णीं पत्नी मुष्टी कृत्वा वाचम्̐ यछति /
text_mt: Silently having made fists, the wife restrains her speech.

sanskrit_iast: lomataḥ kṛṣṇājinam āchādayeta / yadi dve viṣūcī pratimucya /
meaning: लोमतः कृष्णाजिनम् आछादयेत / यदि द्वे विषूची प्रतिमुच्य /
text_mt: He should put on the black antelope skin with the hair turned inwards; if there are two, having fastened them facing opposite directions.

sanskrit_iast: agreṇa prāgvam̐śaṃ dīkṣitam anvārabdham āvedayati // dīkṣito 'yam asau \\ iti nāma gṛhṇāti \\ āmuṣyāyaṇas \\ iti gotram amuṣya putras \\ iti pitur nāmnā \\ amuṣya pautras \\ iti pitāmahasya \\ amuṣya naptā \\ iti prapitāmahasya // sa indrāgnibhyāṃ dīkṣāṃ prāha \ mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ dīkṣāṃ prāha \ viśvebhyo devebhyo brāhmaṇebhyaḥ somyebhyaḥ somapebhyo dīkṣāṃ prāha \\ iti /
meaning: अग्रेण प्राग्वम्̐शं दीक्षितम् अन्वारब्धम् आवेदयति // दीक्षितो ऽयम् असौ \\ इति नाम गृह्णाति \\ आमुष्यायणस् \\ इति गोत्रम् अमुष्य पुत्रस् \\ इति पितुर् नाम्ना \\ अमुष्य पौत्रस् \\ इति पितामहस्य \\ अमुष्य नप्ता \\ इति प्रपितामहस्य // स इन्द्राग्निभ्यां दीक्षां प्राह \ मित्रावरुणाभ्यां दीक्षां प्राह \ विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यो ब्राह्मणेभ्यः सोम्येभ्यः सोमपेभ्यो दीक्षां प्राह \\ इति /
text_mt: In front of the hall with rafters pointing east, he announces the consecrated sacrificer who holds on to him: “This N.N. has become consecrated,” he mentions his name; “descendant of N.N.,” the gotra; “son of N.N.,” with the name of the father; “grandson of N.N.,” of the grandfather; “great-grandson of N.N.,” of the great-grandfather. “He has announced his consecration to Indra and Agni; he has announced his consecration to Mitra and Varuṇa; he has announced his consecration to the Viśve Devas, to the brāhmaṇas rich in Soma, drinking Soma.”

sanskrit_iast: evam uccais trir āvedayati //
meaning: एवम् उच्चैस् त्रिर् आवेदयति //
text_mt: Thus he announces aloud three times.

sanskrit_iast: eṣṭrīḥ stha \\ iti tisro 'nyasya pāṇer aṅgulīr utsṛjati tisro 'nyasya /
meaning: एष्ट्रीः स्थ \\ इति तिस्रो ऽन्यस्य पाणेर् अङ्गुलीर् उत्सृजति तिस्रो ऽन्यस्य /
text_mt: With “You are seekers,” he releases three fingers of one hand and three of the other.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīṃ patnī //
meaning: तूष्णीं पत्नी //

sanskrit_iast: nakṣatrāṇām̐ sakāśāt \\ iti nakṣatraṃ dṛṣṭvā vācam̐ visṛjate // vrataṃ carata \ yāḥ paśūnām ity udite /
meaning: नक्षत्राणाम्̐ सकाशात् \\ इति नक्षत्रं दृष्ट्वा वाचम्̐ विसृजते // व्रतं चरत \ याः पशूनाम् इत्य् उदिते /
text_mt: Having seen a constellation with “From the presence of the constellations…,” he releases his speech, [or] when it has risen, with “Observe the vow, which of the animals…”.

sanskrit_iast: maṅgalyam uktvā patnī vācam̐ visṛjate /
meaning: मङ्गल्यम् उक्त्वा पत्नी वाचम्̐ विसृजते /
text_mt: Having spoken an auspicious word, the wife releases her speech.

sanskrit_iast: na pratyakṣanāmnācakṣīta // canasita \\ ity arhatā saha saṃbhāṣamāṇo brūyāt \\ vicakṣaṇa \\ itītaraiḥ /
meaning: न प्रत्यक्षनाम्नाचक्षीत // चनसित \\ इत्य् अर्हता सह संभाषमाणो ब्रूयात् \\ विचक्षण \\ इतीतरैः /
text_mt: He should not address [the consecrated one] by his actual name. Conversing with an arhat, he should say “O Canasita”; with others, “O Vicakṣaṇa”.

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣitasaṃcaraḥ / uttareṇāhavanīyam apareṇa vediṃ dakṣiṇātikramya dakṣiṇata āhavanīyasyodaṅmukha upaviśaty eṣa saṃcaraḥ /
meaning: दीक्षितसंचरः / उत्तरेणाहवनीयम् अपरेण वेदिं दक्षिणातिक्रम्य दक्षिणत आहवनीयस्योदङ्मुख उपविशत्य् एष संचरः /
text_mt: The movement of the consecrated one: passing to the north of the āhavanīya fire, to the west of the altar, along the south, he sits down to the south of the āhavanīya fire facing north; this is the movement.

sanskrit_iast: lomataḥ kṛṣṇājinasya śayyāsanam āchādanaṃ ca /
meaning: लोमतः कृष्णाजिनस्य शय्यासनम् आछादनं च /
text_mt: The bed, seat, and clothing [are made] of the black antelope skin with the hair turned inwards.

sanskrit_iast: pratiṣiddhaṃ niṣṭhīvanam̐ hasanam avavarṣaṇaṃ dantāviṣkaraṇam amedhyadarśanam apāṃgāhanam̐ homo 'nṛtaṃ ca /
meaning: प्रतिषिद्धं निष्ठीवनम्̐ हसनम् अववर्षणं दन्ताविष्करणम् अमेध्यदर्शनम् अपांगाहनम्̐ होमो ऽनृतं च /
text_mt: Spitting, laughing, being rained upon, exposing the teeth, looking at an impure thing, plunging into water, offering an oblation, and untruth are forbidden.

sanskrit_iast: ārāt prāgvam̐śād udayāstamayāv abhyāśrāvaṇaṃ ca na syāt /
meaning: आरात् प्राग्वम्̐शाद् उदयास्तमयाव् अभ्याश्रावणं च न स्यात् /
text_mt: Sunrise and sunset should not take place far away from the hall with rafters pointing east, nor should there be calling out to [him].

sanskrit_iast: naktaṃ mūtrapurīṣe kuryād yadi divā chāyāyām /
meaning: नक्तं मूत्रपुरीषे कुर्याद् यदि दिवा छायायाम् /
text_mt: He should void urine and feces at night; if by day, in the shade.

sanskrit_iast: yadi hased apidhāya mukham //
meaning: यदि हसेद् अपिधाय मुखम् //
text_mt: If he should laugh, [he should do so] covering his mouth.

sanskrit_iast: undatīr ojo dhatta \ balaṃ dhatta \ mā me dīkṣāṃ mā tapo nirvadhiṣṭa \\ ity avavṛṣṭo japet \\ adabdhaṃ cakṣur ariṣṭaṃ manaḥ sūryo jyotiṣām̐ śreṣṭhas \\ dīkṣen mā mā hāsīt satapā \\ ity amedhyaṃ dṛṣṭvā /
meaning: उन्दतीर् ओजो धत्त \ बलं धत्त \ मा मे दीक्षां मा तपो निर्वधिष्ट \\ इत्य् अववृष्टो जपेत् \\ अदब्धं चक्षुर् अरिष्टं मनः सूर्यो ज्योतिषाम्̐ श्रेष्ठस् \\ दीक्षेन् मा मा हासीत् सतपा \\ इत्य् अमेध्यं दृष्ट्वा /
text_mt: If rained upon, he should murmur: “Moistening waters, bestow strength, bestow power, do not destroy my consecration nor my ascetic heat.” Having seen an impure thing, [he murmurs]: “Undefeated sight, uninjured mind, the sun is the best of lights; may consecration not abandon me, possessed of ascetic heat.”

sanskrit_iast: adīkṣitavādaṃ ced brūyāt tvam agne vratapā asi \\ iti japet /
meaning: अदीक्षितवादं चेद् ब्रूयात् त्वम् अग्ने व्रतपा असि \\ इति जपेत् /
text_mt: If he should speak the speech of the unconsecrated, he should murmur: “You, O Agni, are the guardian of vows.”

sanskrit_iast: akāle vācam̐ visṛjya vaiṣṇavīm āgnāvaiṣṇavīm̐ sārasvatīṃ bārhaspatyām ity etā nigadya vācam̐ yachati /
meaning: अकाले वाचम्̐ विसृज्य वैष्णवीम् आग्नावैष्णवीम्̐ सारस्वतीं बार्हस्पत्याम् इत्य् एता निगद्य वाचम्̐ यछति /
text_mt: Having released his speech at an unseasonable time, having recited these [formulas] addressed to Viṣṇu, Agni-Viṣṇu, Sarasvatī, and Bṛhaspati, he restrains his speech.

sanskrit_iast: vāgvisarjanāt prāg ekadugdhe vrate dohayati /
meaning: वाग्विसर्जनात् प्राग् एकदुग्धे व्रते दोहयति /
text_mt: Prior to the release of speech, he milks [the cow] for the vow-food into one milk-pail.

sanskrit_iast: payo brāhmaṇasya vratam̐ yavāgū rājanyasyāmikṣā vaiśyasyopasatsu payaḥ sarveṣām /
meaning: पयो ब्राह्मणस्य व्रतम्̐ यवागू राजन्यस्यामिक्षा वैश्यस्योपसत्सु पयः सर्वेषाम् /
text_mt: Milk is the vow-food of a brāhmaṇa, barley gruel of a rājanya, curd mixture of a vaiśya; during the upasad days, milk is [the vow-food] of all.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīm agnihotropacāraṃ gārhapatye vratam̐ śrapayati dakṣiṇāgnau patnyai / śṛtaṃ gārhapatye paścād āhavanīyasyopasādayati /
meaning: तूष्णीम् अग्निहोत्रोपचारं गार्हपत्ये व्रतम्̐ श्रपयति दक्षिणाग्नौ पत्न्यै / शृतं गार्हपत्ये पश्चाद् आहवनीयस्योपसादयति /
text_mt: Silently, following the procedure for the agnihotra, he cooks the vow-food on the gārhapatya fire, [and] on the southern fire for the wife. When cooked on the gārhapatya fire, he sets it down to the west of the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: yāgnihotrasya skannasya prāyaścittiḥ sā vratasya /
meaning: याग्निहोत्रस्य स्कन्नस्य प्रायश्चित्तिः सा व्रतस्य /
text_mt: Whatever is the expiation for spilled agnihotra milk, that is [the expiation] for the vow-food.

sanskrit_iast: atinīya sāyamaśanam̐ vratam̐ vratayaty upodayam̐ vātinīya prātaraśanam upāstamayam̐ vā /
meaning: अतिनीय सायमशनम्̐ व्रतम्̐ व्रतयत्य् उपोदयम्̐ वातिनीय प्रातरशनम् उपास्तमयम्̐ वा /
text_mt: Having brought it past the evening meal-time, he consumes the vow-food, or towards daybreak; having brought it past the morning meal-time, or towards sunset.

sanskrit_iast: nādīkṣito vratayantaṃ paśyet //
meaning: नादीक्षितो व्रतयन्तं पश्येत् //
text_mt: An unconsecrated person should not see him consuming the vow-food.

sanskrit_iast: agnīñ jyotiṣmataḥ kuru \ vratam upehi vratya \\ ity uktvā dīkṣitasaṃcareṇātihṛtya dakṣiṇata āhavanīyasya kām̐sye camase vā vrataṃ prayachati //
meaning: अग्नीञ् ज्योतिष्मतः कुरु \ व्रतम् उपेहि व्रत्य \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा दीक्षितसंचरेणातिहृत्य दक्षिणत आहवनीयस्य काम्̐स्ये चमसे वा व्रतं प्रयछति //
text_mt: Having said: “Make the fires radiant; come to the vow, O observer of the vow,” having carried it along the path of the consecrated one, he hands over the vow-food in a bronze vessel or in a wooden cup to the south of the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: daivīṃ dhiyaṃ manāmahe \\ iti pāṇī prakṣālayate //
meaning: दैवीं धियं मनामहे \\ इति पाणी प्रक्षालयते //
text_mt: With “We ponder divine wisdom…,” he washes his two hands.

sanskrit_iast: ye devā manujātā manoyujas \\ iti vratayati //
meaning: ये देवा मनुजाता मनोयुजस् \\ इति व्रतयति //
text_mt: With “The gods who are born of man, harnessed by thought…,” he consumes the vow-food.

sanskrit_iast: śivāḥ pītā bhavata \\ iti nābhideśam ārabhya japati /
meaning: शिवाः पीता भवत \\ इति नाभिदेशम् आरभ्य जपति /
text_mt: With “Being drunk, be auspicious,” touching the region of the navel, he murmurs.

sanskrit_iast: paścārdhe patnī vratayati /
meaning: पश्चार्धे पत्नी व्रतयति /
text_mt: In the western half, the wife consumes the vow-food.

sanskrit_iast: upodayam̐ vrataprado vācam̐ yamayati dīkṣita vācam̐ yacha \ patni vācam̐ yacha \\ ity upāstamayaṃ ca /
meaning: उपोदयम्̐ व्रतप्रदो वाचम्̐ यमयति दीक्षित वाचम्̐ यछ \ पत्नि वाचम्̐ यछ \\ इत्य् उपास्तमयं च /
text_mt: Towards daybreak, the giver of the vow-food causes [them] to restrain their speech with “O consecrated one, restrain your speech; O wife, restrain your speech,” and towards sunset.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇata āhavanīyasyodaṅmukho 'paryāvartamānaḥ prākśirāḥ śayīta //
meaning: दक्षिणत आहवनीयस्योदङ्मुखो ऽपर्यावर्तमानः प्राक्शिराः शयीत //
text_mt: He should lie down to the south of the āhavanīya fire, facing north, not turning over, with his head towards the east.

sanskrit_iast: kāmo haviṣāṃ mandiṣṭhas \ tvam agne vratapā asi \\ iti svapsyañ japet punar manas \ tvam agne vratapā asi \\ iti prabudhyan /
meaning: कामो हविषां मन्दिष्ठस् \ त्वम् अग्ने व्रतपा असि \\ इति स्वप्स्यञ् जपेत् पुनर् मनस् \ त्वम् अग्ने व्रतपा असि \\ इति प्रबुध्यन् /
text_mt: About to sleep, he should murmur: “The most delightful desire of oblations… You, O Agni, are the guardian of vows”; awaking: “Mind again… You, O Agni, are the guardian of vows.”

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣito bhṛtim̐ vanvīta //
meaning: दीक्षितो भृतिम्̐ वन्वीत //
text_mt: The consecrated one should solicit subsistence.

sanskrit_iast: pūṣā sanīnām iti yācakān vrajato 'numantrayate // devaḥ savitā \\ iti pratyāgatān /
meaning: पूषा सनीनाम् इति याचकान् व्रजतो ऽनुमन्त्रयते // देवः सविता \\ इति प्रत्यागतान् /
text_mt: With “Pūṣan of acquisitions,” he accompanies with a mantra the solicitors setting out; with “Divine Savitṛ,” those who have returned.

sanskrit_iast: pravatsyann ayaṃ te yonir ṛtviyas \\ ity araṇyoḥ samāropayati / yadi gataśrīḥ sarvān /
meaning: प्रवत्स्यन्न् अयं ते योनिर् ऋत्वियस् \\ इत्य् अरण्योः समारोपयति / यदि गतश्रीः सर्वान् /
text_mt: About to go on a journey, he mounts [the fires] onto the two fire-drills with “This is your seasonal womb…”; if he has achieved prosperity, all [fires].

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrād abhi śreyaḥ prehi \ bṛhaspatiḥ puraetā te astu /
athem avasya vara ā pṛthivyās\ āre śatrūn kṛṇuhi sarvavīraḥ //
iti prayāty araṇibhyām̐ saha rathāṅgena ca //
meaning:
भद्राद् अभि श्रेयः प्रेहि \ बृहस्पतिः पुरएता ते अस्तु /
अथेम् अवस्य वर आ पृथिव्यास्\ आरे शत्रून् कृणुहि सर्ववीरः //
इति प्रयात्य् अरणिभ्याम्̐ सह रथाङ्गेन च //
text_mt:
“Go forth from good to better; / let Bṛhaspati be your guide.

Then settle this one upon the best place of the earth; / put the enemies afar, possessed of all heroes.”

With this [formula] he departs together with the two fire-drills and a wheel-part.

sanskrit_iast: devīr āpo apāṃ napāt \\ ity apo 'vagāhamāna ā pārāl loṣṭaṃ mṛdnīyāt /
meaning: देवीर् आपो अपां नपात् \\ इत्य् अपो ऽवगाहमान आ पाराल् लोष्टं मृद्नीयात् /
text_mt: Stepping into waters with “O divine waters, grandson of waters…,” he should crush a clod of earth all the way to the other bank.

sanskrit_iast: yadi nāvā tared anyena vā \\ achinnaṃ tantuṃ pṛthivyā anugeṣam ity ā pārālloṣṭaṃ mṛdnīyāt /
meaning: यदि नावा तरेद् अन्येन वा \\ अछिन्नं तन्तुं पृथिव्या अनुगेषम् इत्य् आ पाराल्लोष्टं मृद्नीयात् /
text_mt: If he should cross by boat or by other means, with “May I follow the unbroken thread of the earth,” he should crush a clod of earth all the way to the other bank.

sanskrit_iast: udayāstamayau vihārānte syāt /
meaning: उदयास्तमयौ विहारान्ते स्यात् /
text_mt: Sunrise and sunset should take place at the edge of the sacrificial enclosure.

sanskrit_iast: aparimitā dīkṣās tāsāṃ prathamāṃ jāgarti / tisra upasado 'parimitā vā trir abhyāsās tāsām prathamāṃ jāgarti śvaḥsutyeti ca /
meaning: अपरिमिता दीक्षास् तासां प्रथमां जागर्ति / तिस्र उपसदो ऽपरिमिता वा त्रिर् अभ्यासास् तासाम् प्रथमां जागर्ति श्वःसुत्येति च /
text_mt: There are unlimited consecration days; of them, he keeps vigil on the first. There are three upasad days or unlimited, in three repetitions; of them, he keeps vigil on the first, and [on the one known as] ‘Soma-pressing tomorrow’.

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣābhya ūrdhvaṃ prāyaṇīyaṃ nirvapaty adityai payasi carum /
meaning: दीक्षाभ्य ऊर्ध्वं प्रायणीयं निर्वपत्य् अदित्यै पयसि चरुम् /
text_mt: After the consecration days, he apportions the introductory offering, a boiled oblation in milk for Aditi.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā sam̐śāsanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ सम्̐शासनात् /

sanskrit_iast: na dīkṣitasya patnīm̐ saṃnahyati /
meaning: न दीक्षितस्य पत्नीम्̐ संनह्यति /
text_mt: He does not gird the wife of the consecrated sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: patnīṃ mantreṇopasthāpayati /
meaning: पत्नीं मन्त्रेणोपस्थापयति /
text_mt: He makes the wife take her place with a mantra.

sanskrit_iast: nājyabhāgau yajati /
meaning: नाज्यभागौ यजति /

sanskrit_iast: dhrauvasyāvadāya pathyām̐svastiṃ pūrvārdhe yajaty agniṃ dakṣiṇārdhe somaṃ paścārdhe savitāram uttarārdhe / caror aditiṃ madhye /
meaning: ध्रौवस्यावदाय पथ्याम्̐स्वस्तिं पूर्वार्धे यजत्य् अग्निं दक्षिणार्धे सोमं पश्चार्धे सवितारम् उत्तरार्धे / चरोर् अदितिं मध्ये /
text_mt: Having cut off from the fixed ladle, he offers to Pathyā Svasti in the eastern half, to Agni in the southern half, to Soma in the western half, to Savitṛ in the northern half, and to Aditi in the middle from the boiled oblation.

sanskrit_iast: sviṣṭakṛtā pracarati / dhrauvasyāvadāya caror avadyati dvir abhighārayati /
meaning: स्विष्टकृता प्रचरति / ध्रौवस्यावदाय चरोर् अवद्यति द्विर् अभिघारयति /
text_mt: He proceeds with the Sviṣṭakṛt offering; having cut off from the fixed ladle, he cuts off from the boiled oblation [and] bastes twice with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: śam̐yvantā saṃtiṣṭhate /
meaning: शम्̐य्वन्ता संतिष्ठते /
text_mt: It concludes with the śaṃyu formula.

sanskrit_iast: caruniṣkāṣaṃ mekṣaṇam udayanīyāya nidadhāti /
meaning: चरुनिष्काषं मेक्षणम् उदयनीयाय निदधाति /
text_mt: He puts aside the scraping of the boiled oblation and the stirring stick for the concluding offering.

sanskrit_iast: ājyaprarekaṃ dhruvāyāś caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhṇāti /
meaning: आज्यप्ररेकं ध्रुवायाश् चतुर्गृहीतं गृह्णाति /
text_mt: He takes four ladlings from the residue of the clarified butter of the fixed ladle.

sanskrit_iast: āmnātā rājakrayaṇy adhikarṇī ṣoḍaśini /
meaning: आम्नाता राजक्रयण्य् अधिकर्णी षोडशिनि /
text_mt: The cow with which the King [Soma] is bought is prescribed as having markings on the ears, [or] being sixteen months old.

sanskrit_iast: agreṇa prāgvam̐śam abhiparigṛhya purastāt pratyaṅmukhīm avasthāpayati /
meaning: अग्रेण प्राग्वम्̐शम् अभिपरिगृह्य पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ्मुखीम् अवस्थापयति /
text_mt: Having enclosed her in front of the hall with rafters pointing east, he halts her facing west in front.

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyaṃ baddhvā darbheṇocyartim iyaṃ te śukra tanūr iti caturgṛhīte 'vadadhāti /
meaning: हिरण्यं बद्ध्वा दर्भेणोच्यर्तिम् इयं ते शुक्र तनूर् इति चतुर्गृहीते ऽवदधाति /
text_mt: Having tied gold with a darbha grass blade, with “… this is your bright body,” he places it into the four ladlings.

sanskrit_iast: rājakrayaṇīṃ prekṣamāṇas \\ jūr asi \\ iti juhoti /
meaning: राजक्रयणीं प्रेक्षमाणस् \\ जूर् असि \\ इति जुहोति /
text_mt: Looking at the cow with which the King [Soma] is bought, he offers with “You are swift.”

sanskrit_iast: tasyāṃ punar gṛhītvā śukram asi \ candram asi \\ iti hiraṇyam uddharati //
meaning: तस्यां पुनर् गृहीत्वा शुक्रम् असि \ चन्द्रम् असि \\ इति हिरण्यम् उद्धरति //
text_mt: Having taken up [clarified butter] again into it, he takes out the gold with “You are bright, you are shining.”

sanskrit_iast: cid asi \ manāsi \ dhīr asi \\ iti rājakrayaṇīm̐ sam̐stauti //
meaning: चिद् असि \ मनासि \ धीर् असि \\ इति राजक्रयणीम्̐ सम्̐स्तौति //
text_mt: With “You are thought, you are intellect, you are meditation,” he praises the cow with which the King [Soma] is bought.

sanskrit_iast: anu tvā mātā manyatām ity anumānayati //
meaning: अनु त्वा माता मन्यताम् इत्य् अनुमानयति //
text_mt: With “May your mother consent to you…,” he causes [her mother] to consent.

sanskrit_iast: rudras tvāvartayatu \\ iti pradakṣiṇam āvartayati / prācīṃ prakramayati //
meaning: रुद्रस् त्वावर्तयतु \\ इति प्रदक्षिणम् आवर्तयति / प्राचीं प्रक्रमयति //
text_mt: With [the sacred formula], 'May Rudra turn you around,' he turns [the cow] clockwise. He makes [her] step forward toward the east.

sanskrit_iast: vasvy asi \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ ṣaṭ padāny anuniṣkrāmati dakṣiṇasya pūrvapadasya /
meaning: वस्व्य् असि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः षट् पदान्य् अनुनिष्क्रामति दक्षिणस्य पूर्वपदस्य /
text_mt: With the [sacred formulas] beginning with, 'You are Vasvī,' he steps out after the six footprints of her right forefoot.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīm̐ saptamaṃ padam abhiparigṛhya bṛhaspatiṣ ṭvā sumne ramṇātu \\ ity abhimṛśati /
meaning: तूष्णीम्̐ सप्तमं पदम् अभिपरिगृह्य बृहस्पतिष् ट्वा सुम्ने रम्णातु \\ इत्य् अभिमृशति /
text_mt: Enclosing the seventh footprint silently, he touches [it] with, 'May Bṛhaspati delight you in happiness.'

sanskrit_iast: tasmin hiraṇyaṃ nidhāya pṛthivyās tvā mūrdhann ājigharmi \\ ity abhijuhoti /
meaning: तस्मिन् हिरण्यं निधाय पृथिव्यास् त्वा मूर्धन्न् आजिघर्मि \\ इत्य् अभिजुहोति /
text_mt: Having placed a piece of gold in it, he pours an offering over it with, 'On the head of the earth I pour clarified butter on you.'

sanskrit_iast: sphyena padaṃ parilikhya vipāṇayānuparilikhati /
meaning: स्फ्येन पदं परिलिख्य विपाणयानुपरिलिखति /
text_mt: Having drawn a line around the footprint with the wooden sword, he traces [the line] along [it] with the wooden sword.

sanskrit_iast: yāvad ghṛtaṃ padam̐ samuddhṛtya \\ asme ramasva \\ iti carusthālyāṃ padam̐ sam̐vapati //
meaning: यावद् घृतं पदम्̐ समुद्धृत्य \\ अस्मे रमस्व \\ इति चरुस्थाल्यां पदम्̐ सम्̐वपति //
text_mt: Having scooped up as much of the footprint as has clarified butter [on it], he puts the footprint [dust] into a pot for the boiled oblation with, 'Delight in us.'

sanskrit_iast: unnambhaya \\ iti khāte 'po ninayati //
meaning: उन्नम्भय \\ इति खाते ऽपो निनयति //
text_mt: With [the sacred formula], 'Make [the waters] swell,' he pours water into the dug-out [footprint].

sanskrit_iast: mā rāyaspoṣeṇa \\ ity ārabhya japati yajamānaḥ /
meaning: मा रायस्पोषेण \\ इत्य् आरभ्य जपति यजमानः /
text_mt: Beginning with, 'Not with the increase of wealth,' the sacrificer mutters [the sacred formulas].

sanskrit_iast: gṛheṣu padaṃ nidadhāti /
meaning: गृहेषु पदं निदधाति /
text_mt: He deposits the footprint [dust] in [his] house.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇa lakṣaṇaṃ parikramya tvaṣṭrimantas tvā \\ iti patnīm̐ rājakrayaṇyā samīkṣayate /
meaning: उत्तरेण लक्षणं परिक्रम्य त्वष्ट्रिमन्तस् त्वा \\ इति पत्नीम्̐ राजक्रयण्या समीक्षयते /
text_mt: Having walked around north of the mark, he causes the wife to look at the cow for purchasing King [Soma] with, 'Rich in fashioners, may you...'

sanskrit_iast: sachadiṣkeṇānasā rājānam achayanti //
meaning: सछदिष्केणानसा राजानम् अछयन्ति //
text_mt: They fetch King [Soma] with a covered cart.

sanskrit_iast: sūryasya cakṣur āruham ity anuvrajato 'dhvaryur yajamānaś ca /
meaning: सूर्यस्य चक्षुर् आरुहम् इत्य् अनुव्रजतो ऽध्वर्युर् यजमानश् च /
text_mt: With [the sacred formula], 'I have mounted the eye of the Sun,' the adhvaryu and the sacrificer follow along.

sanskrit_iast: anunayanti rājakrayaṇīm /
meaning: अनुनयन्ति राजक्रयणीम् /
text_mt: They lead the cow for purchasing King [Soma] along.

sanskrit_iast: uttaravedyante pariśrita uparavāṇām̐ vā somavikrayī kutsaḥ śūdro vā rohite carmaṇy ānaḍuhe prāggrīve lomato rājānaṃ nivapati /
meaning: उत्तरवेद्यन्ते परिश्रित उपरवाणाम्̐ वा सोमविक्रयी कुत्सः शूद्रो वा रोहिते चर्मण्य् आनडुहे प्राग्ग्रीवे लोमतो राजानं निवपति /
text_mt: At the edge of the high altar, [in a space] enclosed with screens, or near the sounding-holes, the Soma-seller—a Kutsa or a Śūdra—pours out King [Soma] onto a red bull's hide with the neck to the east, on the hairy side.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇataḥ prāṅmukham ano vimuñcati //
meaning: दक्षिणतः प्राङ्मुखम् अनो विमुञ्चति //
text_mt: South [of it], he unyokes the cart facing east.

sanskrit_iast: śundha somam āpannaṃ nirasya \\ iti somavikrayiṇaṃ preṣyati /
meaning: शुन्ध सोमम् आपन्नं निरस्य \\ इति सोमविक्रयिणं प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He urges the Soma-seller: 'Purify the Soma, throwing away what is fallen [into it].'

sanskrit_iast: nādhvaryuḥ somam̐ vicinuyād iti pratiṣiddham̐ vicayanaṃ prekṣaṇaṃ ca /
meaning: नाध्वर्युः सोमम्̐ विचिनुयाद् इति प्रतिषिद्धम्̐ विचयनं प्रेक्षणं च /
text_mt: Regarding 'The adhvaryu should not pick through the Soma,' both picking through and looking closely are forbidden [for him].

sanskrit_iast: upamadhyamāyām̐ hiraṇyam ābadhya \\ āsmāko 'si \\ iti pariśritaṃ praviśanti //
meaning: उपमध्यमायाम्̐ हिरण्यम् आबध्य \\ आस्माको ऽसि \\ इति परिश्रितं प्रविशन्ति //
text_mt: Having tied gold to the ring finger, they enter the screen with, 'You belong to us.'

sanskrit_iast: śukras te grahas \\ iti sahiraṇyena pāṇinābhimṛśati /
meaning: शुक्रस् ते ग्रहस् \\ इति सहिरण्येन पाणिनाभिमृशति /
text_mt: With [the sacred formula], 'Bright is your cup,' he touches [King Soma] with the hand holding the gold.

sanskrit_iast: prāgdaśe kṣaume rājānaṃ mimīta ṛjvībhir aṅgulībhir aṅguṣṭhena copasam̐yamya kaniṣṭhikāprabhṛtibhir ekaikayā kaniṣṭhikātas \\ abhi tyaṃ devam̐ savitāram iti pañcakṛtvas tūṣṇīṃ pañcakṛtvo yayā prathamaṃ na tayā pañcamaṃ tayaivottamam //
meaning: प्राग्दशे क्षौमे राजानं मिमीत ऋज्वीभिर् अङ्गुलीभिर् अङ्गुष्ठेन चोपसम्̐यम्य कनिष्ठिकाप्रभृतिभिर् एकैकया कनिष्ठिकातस् \\ अभि त्यं देवम्̐ सवितारम् इति पञ्चकृत्वस् तूष्णीं पञ्चकृत्वो यया प्रथमं न तया पञ्चमं तयैवोत्तमम् //
text_mt: He measures King [Soma] out onto a linen cloth with fringes to the east, clasping [him] with the straight fingers and the thumb, one finger at a time beginning from the little finger: five times with 'Toward that god Savitṛ,' silently five times; [the finger] with which [he measures] the first, not with that the fifth; with that same [finger he measures] the last.

sanskrit_iast: prajābhyas tvā \\ iti bhūyām̐sam abhyūhati //
meaning: प्रजाभ्यस् त्वा \\ इति भूयाम्̐सम् अभ्यूहति //
text_mt: With [the sacred formula], 'For offspring, you,' he sweeps together the larger quantity.

sanskrit_iast: prajās tvānuprāṇantu \\ iti kṣauma uṣṇīṣeṇopanahyati lāṅgalabandham //
meaning: प्रजास् त्वानुप्राणन्तु \\ इति क्षौम उष्णीषेणोपनह्यति लाङ्गलबन्धम् //
text_mt: With [the sacred formula], 'May offspring breathe after you,' he ties [the bundle] in the linen cloth with a turban in the manner of a plough-tie.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa te gāyatro bhāga iti me somāya brūtāt \\ eṣa te traiṣṭubho bhāga iti me somāya brūtāt \\ eṣa te jāgato bhāga iti me somāya brūtāt \\ eṣa ta ānuṣṭubho bhāga iti me somāya brūtāt \\ eṣa te pāṅkto bhāga iti me somāya brūtāt \\ chandomānām̐ sāmrājyaṃ gached iti me somāya brūtāt \\ iti yajamāno rājānam upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: एष ते गायत्रो भाग इति मे सोमाय ब्रूतात् \\ एष ते त्रैष्टुभो भाग इति मे सोमाय ब्रूतात् \\ एष ते जागतो भाग इति मे सोमाय ब्रूतात् \\ एष त आनुष्टुभो भाग इति मे सोमाय ब्रूतात् \\ एष ते पाङ्क्तो भाग इति मे सोमाय ब्रूतात् \\ छन्दोमानाम्̐ साम्राज्यं गछेद् इति मे सोमाय ब्रूतात् \\ इति यजमानो राजानम् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: 'This is your portion in the gāyatrī meter, say this for me to Soma; this is your portion in the triṣṭubh meter, say this for me to Soma; this is your portion in the jagatī meter, say this for me to Soma; this is your portion in the anuṣṭubh meter, say this for me to Soma; this is your portion in the paṅkti meter, say this for me to Soma; may he attain sovereignty among the meters, say this for me to Soma'—with these words the sacrificer stands revering King [Soma].

sanskrit_iast: udakumbhe somavikrayī rājānam ādadhāti //
meaning: उदकुम्भे सोमविक्रयी राजानम् आदधाति //
text_mt: The Soma-seller places King [Soma] on a water jar.

sanskrit_iast: somavikrayin somaṃ te krīṇāni \\ ity āmantrayate // krīṇīhi \\ iti pratyāha //
meaning: सोमविक्रयिन् सोमं ते क्रीणानि \\ इत्य् आमन्त्रयते // क्रीणीहि \\ इति प्रत्याह //
text_mt: He addresses [him]: 'O Soma-seller, let me buy your Soma.' He responds: 'Buy [it]!'

sanskrit_iast: kalayā te krīṇāni \\ iti yathāmnātam ekaikena paṇate // bhūyo vā ataḥ somo rājārhati \\ iti pratyāha //
meaning: कलया ते क्रीणानि \\ इति यथाम्नातम् एकैकेन पणते // भूयो वा अतः सोमो राजार्हति \\ इति प्रत्याह //
text_mt: 'Let me buy [it] from you for a sixteenth part'—thus he barters with each [item] as traditionally prescribed. [The other] responds: 'King Soma is worth more than that.'

sanskrit_iast: iyaṃ gaus tayā te krīṇāni \\ iti tasyā rūpaṃ tasyā varṇaṃ tasyā ātmā tasyāḥ prajās tasyāḥ payas \\ iti // krītas \\ iti pratyāha /
meaning: इयं गौस् तया ते क्रीणानि \\ इति तस्या रूपं तस्या वर्णं तस्या आत्मा तस्याः प्रजास् तस्याः पयस् \\ इति // क्रीतस् \\ इति प्रत्याह /
text_mt: 'This is a cow; with her let me buy [it] from you: her appearance, her color, her self, her offspring, her milk.' He responds: '[It is] bought.'

sanskrit_iast: yathāmnātam̐ somakrayaṇān apākaroti // śukraṃ te śukra śukreṇa \\ iti hiraṇyam \\ tapasas tanūr asi \\ ity ajāṃ pratyāchidya somakrayaṇāt suvāṅ nabhrāḍ ity anudiśati /
meaning: यथाम्नातम्̐ सोमक्रयणान् अपाकरोति // शुक्रं ते शुक्र शुक्रेण \\ इति हिरण्यम् \\ तपसस् तनूर् असि \\ इत्य् अजां प्रत्याछिद्य सोमक्रयणात् सुवाङ् नभ्राड् इत्य् अनुदिशति /
text_mt: He removes the means of purchasing the Soma as traditionally prescribed. With, 'Bright [art thou], O bright one, with the bright,' [he removes] the gold; having taken back the she-goat from the means of purchasing the Soma with, 'You are the body of ascetic heat,' he points to [it] with, 'Suvāṅ, Nabhrāṭ...'

sanskrit_iast: somavikrayiṇe kiṃcid dadyāt /
meaning: सोमविक्रयिणे किंचिद् दद्यात् /
text_mt: He should give something to the Soma-seller.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇaśuklayor ūrṇāstukayor asme jyotir iti śuklām̐ yajamānāya prayachati / tāṃ pavitrasya nābhiṃ kuryāt //
meaning: कृष्णशुक्लयोर् ऊर्णास्तुकयोर् अस्मे ज्योतिर् इति शुक्लाम्̐ यजमानाय प्रयछति / तां पवित्रस्य नाभिं कुर्यात् //
text_mt: Of two tufts of wool, black and white, he hands the white one to the sacrificer with, 'Light is for us.' He should make that the navel of the strainer.

sanskrit_iast: idam aham̐ sarpāṇāṃ dandaśūkānāṃ grīvā upagrathnāmi \\ iti kṛṣṇāyā granthiṃ kṛtvā somavikrayiṇi tamas \\ iti tam abhinyasyet //
meaning: इदम् अहम्̐ सर्पाणां दन्दशूकानां ग्रीवा उपग्रथ्नामि \\ इति कृष्णाया ग्रन्थिं कृत्वा सोमविक्रयिणि तमस् \\ इति तम् अभिन्यस्येत् //
text_mt: Having made a knot in the black [tuft] with, 'Here I bind the necks of the serpents, the biters,' he should cast it at the Soma-seller with, 'Darkness [upon you].'

sanskrit_iast: svajā asi \\ iti rājānam ādatte /
meaning: स्वजा असि \\ इति राजानम् आदत्ते /
text_mt: With [the sacred formula], 'You are self-born,' he takes King [Soma].

sanskrit_iast: āhriyamāṇe yajamāno 'pāvṛtyopaviśati //
meaning: आह्रियमाणे यजमानो ऽपावृत्योपविशति //
text_mt: While [King Soma] is being brought, the sacrificer sits down turning away.

sanskrit_iast: mitro na ehi \\ iti japati /
meaning: मित्रो न एहि \\ इति जपति /

sanskrit_iast: vastrāntam utkṛṣya \\ indrasyorum āviśa \\ iti dakṣiṇasminn ūrāv āsādayati //
meaning: वस्त्रान्तम् उत्कृष्य \\ इन्द्रस्योरुम् आविश \\ इति दक्षिणस्मिन्न् ऊराव् आसादयति //
text_mt: Having drawn back the edge of his garment, he places [King Soma] on his right thigh with, 'Enter Indra's thigh.'

sanskrit_iast: ud āyuṣā \\ ity ādāyottiṣṭhati //
meaning: उद् आयुषा \\ इत्य् आदायोत्तिष्ठति //
text_mt: With [the sacred formula], 'Up with life,' taking [King Soma], he stands up.

sanskrit_iast: urv antarikṣam̐ vīhi \\ ity ano 'bhipravrajya pūrvārdhe nīḍe \\ adityās tvag asi \\ iti kṛṣṇājinam āstṛṇāti //
meaning: उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम्̐ वीहि \\ इत्य् अनो ऽभिप्रव्रज्य पूर्वार्धे नीडे \\ अदित्यास् त्वग् असि \\ इति कृष्णाजिनम् आस्तृणाति //
text_mt: Having walked toward the cart with, 'Traverse the wide intermediate space,' he spreads the black antelope skin in the front seat [of the cart] with, 'You are the skin of Aditi.'

sanskrit_iast: adityāḥ sada āsīda \\ iti tasmin rājānam āsādayati //
meaning: अदित्याः सद आसीद \\ इति तस्मिन् राजानम् आसादयति //
text_mt: With [the sacred formula], 'Sit on the seat of Aditi,' he sets King [Soma] down upon it.

sanskrit_iast: astabhnād dyām ity ana upatiṣṭhate //
meaning: अस्तभ्नाद् द्याम् इत्य् अन उपतिष्ठते //
text_mt: With [the sacred formula], 'He propped up the sky,' he attends the cart.

sanskrit_iast: vaneṣu vy antarikṣam ity ano vāsasā paryāṇahyati //
meaning: वनेषु व्य् अन्तरिक्षम् इत्य् अनो वाससा पर्याणह्यति //
text_mt: With [the sacred formula], '[He spread] the intermediate space across the woods,' he covers the cart around with a cloth.

sanskrit_iast: dhūr asi \\ iti dhuram abhimṛśaty uttarāṃ ca /
meaning: धूर् असि \\ इति धुरम् अभिमृशत्य् उत्तरां च /
text_mt: With [the sacred formula], 'You are the yoke-pin,' he touches the yoke-pin, and the northern one [as well].

sanskrit_iast: udaṅṅ atikramya vāruṇam asi \\ ity uttarām īṣām ārabhya japati //
meaning: उदङ्ङ् अतिक्रम्य वारुणम् असि \\ इत्य् उत्तराम् ईषाम् आरभ्य जपति //
text_mt: Stepping to the north, having taken hold of the northern shaft, he mutters with, 'You belong to Varuṇa.'

sanskrit_iast: varuṇas tvottabhnātu \\ ity upastabhnoti //
meaning: वरुणस् त्वोत्तभ्नातु \\ इत्य् उपस्तभ्नोति //
text_mt: With [the sacred formula], 'May Varuṇa prop you up,' he props [the cart] up.

sanskrit_iast: usrāv etaṃ dhūrvāhau yujyethām anaśrū avīrahaṇau brahmacodanau \ yajñasyāyuḥ pratirantau \ svasti yajamānasya gṛhān gachatam iti dhuryāv upājate //
meaning: उस्राव् एतं धूर्वाहौ युज्येथाम् अनश्रू अवीरहणौ ब्रह्मचोदनौ \ यज्ञस्यायुः प्रतिरन्तौ \ स्वस्ति यजमानस्य गृहान् गछतम् इति धुर्याव् उपाजते //
text_mt: 'O two red draught-bulls, yoke-bearers, be yoked, tearless, non-slayers of heroes, impelled by sacred utterance, prolonging the life of the sacrifice; go safely to the sacrificer's house'—with these words they drive up the two yoke-oxen.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇasya skambho 'si \\ iti yunakty evam uttaram /
meaning: वरुणस्य स्कम्भो ऽसि \\ इति युनक्त्य् एवम् उत्तरम् /
text_mt: With [the sacred formula], 'You are the prop of Varuṇa,' he yokes [the right ox]; in the same manner the northern [ox].

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇaṃ chadirantam ārabhya somāya krītāya prohyamāṇāyānubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
meaning: दक्षिणं छदिरन्तम् आरभ्य सोमाय क्रीताय प्रोह्यमाणायानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: Taking hold of the right edge of the roof [of the cart], he causes [the hotṛ] to recite: 'Recite for King Soma who has been bought and is being carried forward.'

sanskrit_iast: triranūktāyām \\ subrahmaṇya subrahmaṇyām āhvaya \\ iti preṣyati //
meaning: त्रिरनूक्तायाम् \\ सुब्रह्मण्य सुब्रह्मण्याम् आह्वय \\ इति प्रेष्यति //
text_mt: When [the verse] has been recited three times, he gives the call: 'Subrahmaṇya, call the Subrahmaṇyā formula!'

sanskrit_iast: pracyavasva bhuvanaspate \\ iti prāṅ abhiprayāya pradakṣiṇam āvartayati /
meaning: प्रच्यवस्व भुवनस्पते \\ इति प्राङ् अभिप्रयाय प्रदक्षिणम् आवर्तयति /
text_mt: Having moved toward the east with, 'Move forward, O Lord of the world,' he turns [the cart] clockwise.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvaḥ paretya mahad āhavanīye 'bhyādadhāti /
meaning: पूर्वः परेत्य महद् आहवनीये ऽभ्यादधाति /
text_mt: Going forward first, he puts a large [fuel stick] on the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: agreṇa prāgvam̐śaṃ karṇagṛhītam ajam agnīṣomīyaṃ kālālaṃ pīvānam avasthāpayati /
meaning: अग्रेण प्राग्वम्̐शं कर्णगृहीतम् अजम् अग्नीषोमीयं कालालं पीवानम् अवस्थापयति /
text_mt: In front of the eastern hall, he makes the black-necked, fat goat sacred to Agni and Soma stand, held by the ear.

sanskrit_iast: āsandīm udgṛhṇāty ukhadaghnapādām aratnimātrāṃ muñjair vyutām audumbarīm //
meaning: आसन्दीम् उद्गृह्णात्य् उखदघ्नपादाम् अरत्निमात्रां मुञ्जैर् व्युताम् औदुम्बरीम् //
text_mt: He takes up a chair made of udumbara wood, with legs reaching up to the pot, of the measure of a cubit, woven with muñja grass.

sanskrit_iast: namo mitrasya \\ ity ohyamāne yajamāno japati /
meaning: नमो मित्रस्य \\ इत्य् ओह्यमाने यजमानो जपति /
text_mt: While [the cart] is being conveyed, the sacrificer mutters: 'Homage to the friend's...'

sanskrit_iast: agreṇa prāgvam̐śam \\ vāruṇam asi \\ ity udaṅmukham ano 'vasthāpayati //
meaning: अग्रेण प्राग्वम्̐शम् \\ वारुणम् असि \\ इत्य् उदङ्मुखम् अनो ऽवस्थापयति //
text_mt: In front of the eastern hall, he stops the cart facing north with, 'You belong to Varuṇa.'

sanskrit_iast: varuṇas tvottabhnātu \\ ity upastabhnoti //
meaning: वरुणस् त्वोत्तभ्नातु \\ इत्य् उपस्तभ्नोति //
text_mt: With [the sacred formula], 'May Varuṇa prop you up,' he props [it] up.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇasya skambhasarjanam asi \\ iti dakṣiṇām̐ śamyām utkarṣati //
meaning: वरुणस्य स्कम्भसर्जनम् असि \\ इति दक्षिणाम्̐ शम्याम् उत्कर्षति //
text_mt: With [the sacred formula], 'You are the release of Varuṇa's prop,' he pulls up the southern yoke-pin.

sanskrit_iast: vicṛtto varuṇasya pāśas \\ iti yoktrapāśam̐ viṣyati //
meaning: विचृत्तो वरुणस्य पाशस् \\ इति योक्त्रपाशम्̐ विष्यति //
text_mt: With [the sacred formula], 'Loosed is Varuṇa's noose,' he unloosens the loop of the yoke-strap.

sanskrit_iast: pratyasto varuṇasya pāśas \\ iti pratyasyati //
meaning: प्रत्यस्तो वरुणस्य पाशस् \\ इति प्रत्यस्यति //
text_mt: With [the sacred formula], 'Cast away is Varuṇa's noose,' he casts [it] away.

sanskrit_iast: namo varuṇasya pāśāya \\ iti namas karoti /
meaning: नमो वरुणस्य पाशाय \\ इति नमस् करोति /
text_mt: With [the sacred formula], 'Homage to Varuṇa's noose,' he pays homage.

sanskrit_iast: ātithyāyedhmābarhiḥ saṃnahyati yathā paśubandhe /
meaning: आतिथ्यायेध्माबर्हिः संनह्यति यथा पशुबन्धे /
text_mt: He binds the sacrificial fuel and sacrificial grass for the guest-offering, as in the animal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā nirvapaṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ निर्वपणात् /

sanskrit_iast: patny avadhārayed yasmān nirvapet /
meaning: पत्न्य् अवधारयेद् यस्मान् निर्वपेत् /
text_mt: The wife should touch [the oblation] from which he apportions.

sanskrit_iast: sāvitrādibhir agnes tanūr asi \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ pañcakṛtvo nirvapati / vaiṣṇavaṃ navakapālam /
meaning: सावित्रादिभिर् अग्नेस् तनूर् असि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः पञ्चकृत्वो निर्वपति / वैष्णवं नवकपालम् /
text_mt: With the formulas beginning with the Savitṛ formula and with 'Thou art the body of Agni', he apportions five times: a nine-potsherd [cake] for Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā haviṣkṛṭaḥ /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ हविष्कृटः /

sanskrit_iast: haviṣkṛtā vācam̐ visṛjyottaram anaḍvāham̐ vimuñcati / tam adhvaryave dadāty anaś ca /
meaning: हविष्कृता वाचम्̐ विसृज्योत्तरम् अनड्वाहम्̐ विमुञ्चति / तम् अध्वर्यवे ददात्य् अनश् च /
text_mt: Having released speech with the call to the preparer of the oblation, he unyokes the north draft-ox. He gives it to the adhvaryu, and the cart as well.

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣitasaṃcareṇātihṛtya dakṣiṇata āhavanīyasya vāruṇam asi \\ ity āsandīm avasthāpayati //
meaning: दीक्षितसंचरेणातिहृत्य दक्षिणत आहवनीयस्य वारुणम् असि \\ इत्य् आसन्दीम् अवस्थापयति //
text_mt: Carrying [the chair] across by the path of the consecrated (dīkṣitasaṃcara), south of the āhavanīya fire, he sets down the chair with: 'Thou art Varuṇa's.'

sanskrit_iast: varuṇo 'si dhṛtavratas \\ iti rājānam upāvaharati savyām īṣāṃ prati sārdhaṃ kṛṣṇājinena ca /
meaning: वरुणो ऽसि धृतव्रतस् \\ इति राजानम् उपावहरति सव्याम् ईषां प्रति सार्धं कृष्णाजिनेन च /
text_mt: With: 'Thou art Varuṇa, of firm vows', he brings down King [Soma] toward the left cart-pole together with the black antelope skin.

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣitasaṃcareṇātihṛtya dakṣiṇata āhavanīyasya varuṇasya ṛtasadanam āsīda \\ ity āsandyām̐ rājānam āsādayati //
meaning: दीक्षितसंचरेणातिहृत्य दक्षिणत आहवनीयस्य वरुणस्य ऋतसदनम् आसीद \\ इत्य् आसन्द्याम्̐ राजानम् आसादयति //
text_mt: Carrying [King Soma] across by the path of the consecrated, south of the āhavanīya fire, he seats King [Soma] on the chair with: 'Sit upon Varuṇa's seat of truth.'

sanskrit_iast: varuṇāya tvā \\ iti vāsasā prachādayati /
meaning: वरुणाय त्वा \\ इति वाससा प्रछादयति /
text_mt: With: 'For Varuṇa thee', he covers [him] with a garment.

sanskrit_iast: śūrpādānaprabhṛti siddham ājyagrahebhyaḥ /
meaning: शूर्पादानप्रभृति सिद्धम् आज्यग्रहेभ्यः /
text_mt: [The procedure] from the taking of the winnowing basket is established up to the ladlefuls of clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: caturgṛhītāny ājyāni /
meaning: चतुर्गृहीतान्य् आज्यानि /

sanskrit_iast: siddham ābhimarśanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आभिमर्शनात् /

sanskrit_iast: prāg abhimarśanān nirmanthena pracarati /
meaning: प्राग् अभिमर्शनान् निर्मन्थेन प्रचरति /
text_mt: Before the touching, he proceeds with the fire produced by friction.

sanskrit_iast: saṃbhārayajurbhir abhimarśayati /
meaning: संभारयजुर्भिर् अभिमर्शयति /
text_mt: He causes [the sacrificer] to touch with the saṃbhārayajus formulas.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā pravarāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ प्रवरात् /

sanskrit_iast: pravṛte 'nanuyājāsu saṃmārgam̐ visram̐syābhyukṣya vraje paregoṣṭhe vodasyati /
meaning: प्रवृते ऽननुयाजासु संमार्गम्̐ विस्रम्̐स्याभ्युक्ष्य व्रजे परेगोष्ठे वोदस्यति /
text_mt: When [the priest] has been chosen, since there are no after-offerings (anuyāja), having loosened the broom and sprinkled it, he throws it out in an enclosure or in another cowpen.

sanskrit_iast: samānayanavelāyām aupabhṛtaṃ juhvām̐ sarvam ānīya nopabhṛtaṃ pratyabhighārayati /
meaning: समानयनवेलायाम् औपभृतं जुह्वाम्̐ सर्वम् आनीय नोपभृतं प्रत्यभिघारयति /
text_mt: At the time of bringing [the butter] together, having poured all the butter from the upabhṛt into the juhū, he does not baste the upabhṛt in return.

sanskrit_iast: sviṣṭakṛtā pracarya srucau vimucya bahirvedi nirasyati /
meaning: स्विष्टकृता प्रचर्य स्रुचौ विमुच्य बहिर्वेदि निरस्यति /
text_mt: Having proceeded with the sviṣṭakṛt and unyoked the two spoons, he casts [them] outside the sacrificial altar.

sanskrit_iast: na prāśitram avadyati na yajamānabhāgam /
meaning: न प्राशित्रम् अवद्यति न यजमानभागम् /
text_mt: He does not cut the prāśitra portion, nor the sacrificer's portion.

sanskrit_iast: iḍāntā saṃtiṣṭhata iḍāntā saṃtiṣṭhate /
meaning: इडान्ता संतिष्ठत इडान्ता संतिष्ठते /
text_mt: It concludes with the iḍā portion; it concludes with the iḍā portion.

sanskrit_iast: tānūnaptraṃ gṛhṇāti kām̐sye camase vā //
meaning: तानूनप्त्रं गृह्णाति काम्̐स्ये चमसे वा //
text_mt: He takes the tānūnaptra [butter] in a bronze cup or in a wooden goblet.

sanskrit_iast: āpataye tvā gṛhṇāmi \ paripataye tvā gṛhṇāmi \ tanūnaptre tvā gṛhṇāmi \ śakmane śākvarāya śakmanā ojiṣṭhāya tvā gṛhṇāmi \\ ity etair dhrauvaṃ catur ānayati /
meaning: आपतये त्वा गृह्णामि \ परिपतये त्वा गृह्णामि \ तनूनप्त्रे त्वा गृह्णामि \ शक्मने शाक्वराय शक्मना ओजिष्ठाय त्वा गृह्णामि \\ इत्य् एतैर् ध्रौवं चतुर् आनयति /
text_mt: With these [formulas]: 'For the Lord of the fall I take thee; for the Lord of the flight I take thee; for the descendant of the body I take thee; for the powerful, the mighty, with power, the most powerful I take thee', he pours out the butter from the dhruvā spoon four times.

sanskrit_iast: paścād āhavanīyasya tānūnaptram upayanty ṛtvijo yajamānaś ca /
meaning: पश्चाद् आहवनीयस्य तानूनप्त्रम् उपयन्त्य् ऋत्विजो यजमानश् च /
text_mt: Behind the āhavanīya fire, the officiating priests and the sacrificer approach the tānūnaptra [butter].

sanskrit_iast: yugapat samavamṛśya \\ anādhṛṣṭam asi \\ iti japanti yo nas tan napāt \\ iti ca //
meaning: युगपत् समवमृश्य \\ अनाधृष्टम् असि \\ इति जपन्ति यो नस् तन् नपात् \\ इति च //
text_mt: Touching it together simultaneously, they murmur: 'Thou art unassailable' and 'Whosoever is our descendant of the body...'

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatau tvā manasi juhomi svāhā \\ iti yajamānas trir avajighrati /
meaning: प्रजापतौ त्वा मनसि जुहोमि स्वाहा \\ इति यजमानस् त्रिर् अवजिघ्रति /
text_mt: With: 'In Prajāpati, in the mind, I offer thee, svāhā', the sacrificer smells [it] three times.

sanskrit_iast: avāntaradīkṣām upaiti //
meaning: अवान्तरदीक्षाम् उपैति //
text_mt: He enters upon the intermediate consecration (avāntaradīkṣā).

sanskrit_iast: agne vratapate yā mama tanūr eṣā sā tvayi \\ iti samidham ādadhāti \\ agne vratapate yā tava tanūr iyam̐ sā mayi \\ iti japati //
meaning: अग्ने व्रतपते या मम तनूर् एषा सा त्वयि \\ इति समिधम् आदधाति \\ अग्ने व्रतपते या तव तनूर् इयम्̐ सा मयि \\ इति जपति //
text_mt: With: 'O Agni, lord of vows, what body of mine [there is], that is in thee', he places a kindling-stick; he murmurs: 'O Agni, lord of vows, what body of thine [there is], this is in me.'

sanskrit_iast: saha nau vratapate \\ iti mekhalām̐ samāyamya sādhīyo 'ṅgulīr nyañcati / tūṣṇīṃ patnī yoktram̐ samāyamya sādhīyo nyañcati /
meaning: सह नौ व्रतपते \\ इति मेखलाम्̐ समायम्य साधीयो ऽङ्गुलीर् न्यञ्चति / तूष्णीं पत्नी योक्त्रम्̐ समायम्य साधीयो न्यञ्चति /
text_mt: With: 'Together for us both, O lord of vows', having tightened his girdle, he bends his fingers more closely. Silently, the wife, having tightened her girdle-cord, bends [her fingers] more closely.

sanskrit_iast: gārhapatye madantīr adhiśritya taptasyodakārthān kurvanti /
meaning: गार्हपत्ये मदन्तीर् अधिश्रित्य तप्तस्योदकार्थान् कुर्वन्ति /
text_mt: Having set the boiling waters (madantī) on the gārhapatya fire, they perform the rites requiring water using hot [water].

sanskrit_iast: yatrājyebhyo 'dhi rājānam upacareyuḥ prakṣālayeran pāṇīn rājño vādhyājyāni //
meaning: यत्राज्येभ्यो ऽधि राजानम् उपचरेयुः प्रक्षालयेरन् पाणीन् राज्ञो वाध्याज्यानि //
text_mt: Wherever they attend to King [Soma] from the clarified butter, they wash their hands, or [perform the rites] with the clarified butter from King [Soma].

sanskrit_iast: agnīn madanty āpā \\ ity adhvaryur āvedayati // madanti devīr amṛtā ṛtāvṛdhas \\ ity āgnīdhraḥ // tābhir ādrava \\ ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: अग्नीन् मदन्त्य् आपा \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युर् आवेदयति // मदन्ति देवीर् अमृता ऋतावृधस् \\ इत्य् आग्नीध्रः // ताभिर् आद्रव \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: 'O Āgnīdhra, the waters are boiling', the adhvaryu announces. 'Divine, immortal, increasing the cosmic order, they boil', [replies] the āgnīdhra. 'Run up with them', [says] the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: brahmā rājānam̐ visram̐sya hiraṇyam avadadhāty āpyāyanāya \\ am̐śuram̐śuṣ ṭe deva soma \\ ity ārabhya japanty ṛtvijo yajamānaś ca /
meaning: ब्रह्मा राजानम्̐ विस्रम्̐स्य हिरण्यम् अवदधात्य् आप्यायनाय \\ अम्̐शुरम्̐शुष् टे देव सोम \\ इत्य् आरभ्य जपन्त्य् ऋत्विजो यजमानश् च /
text_mt: The brahman, having loosened King [Soma], puts in gold for the swelling (āpyāyana); starting with: 'May each stalk of thine swell, O divine Soma', the officiating priests and the sacrificer murmur.

sanskrit_iast: prastare pāṇīn nidhāya nihnavate nīcaḥ savyān uttānān dakṣiṇān nīco dakṣiṇān uttānān savyān āparāhṇikyām eṣṭā rāyā eṣṭā vāmāni \\ iti japanti /
meaning: प्रस्तरे पाणीन् निधाय निह्नवते नीचः सव्यान् उत्तानान् दक्षिणान् नीचो दक्षिणान् उत्तानान् सव्यान् आपराह्णिक्याम् एष्टा राया एष्टा वामानि \\ इति जपन्ति /
text_mt: Placing their hands upon the sacred grass bundle, they make the reverential gesture (nihnava): the left hands turned down and the right hands turned up; at the afternoon [rite], the right hands turned down and the left hands turned up; they murmur: 'Sought are riches, sought are precious things.'

sanskrit_iast: pravargyeṇa pracaryopasadā pracaranti yadi pravṛñjanti /
meaning: प्रवर्ग्येण प्रचर्योपसदा प्रचरन्ति यदि प्रवृञ्जन्ति /
text_mt: Having proceeded with the pravargya, they proceed with the upasad, if they perform the pravargya.

sanskrit_iast: sakṛtstīrṇam̐ barhir ātithyāyām upasatsu cānyat prastarāt /
meaning: सकृत्स्तीर्णम्̐ बर्हिर् आतिथ्यायाम् उपसत्सु चान्यत् प्रस्तरात् /
text_mt: The sacrificial grass is strewn once for the ātithyā offering and for the upasads, except for the sacred grass bundle.

sanskrit_iast: daśadārvidhmam̐ saṃnahyati /
meaning: दशदार्विध्मम्̐ संनह्यति /
text_mt: He binds a sacrificial fuel [bundle] of ten sticks.

sanskrit_iast: pātrāṇi prayunakti sruvatṛtīye srucāv ājyasthālīm̐ sphyam̐ vedaṃ ca /
meaning: पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति स्रुवतृतीये स्रुचाव् आज्यस्थालीम्̐ स्फ्यम्̐ वेदं च /
text_mt: He sets out the utensils: the two spoons with the sruva as the third, the clarified butter pot, the wooden sword, and the grass brush.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā sam̐sādanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ सम्̐सादनात् /

sanskrit_iast: yajurutpūtābhiḥ pātrāṇi prokṣyājyaṃ nirupya paryagniṃ karoti /
meaning: यजुरुत्पूताभिः पात्राणि प्रोक्ष्याज्यं निरुप्य पर्यग्निं करोति /
text_mt: Having sprinkled the utensils with the waters purified with a sacred formula, and having apportioned the clarified butter, he carries fire around [it].

sanskrit_iast: stīrṇaṃ barhiḥ śayāḥ paridhayaḥ /
meaning: स्तीर्णं बर्हिः शयाः परिधयः /
text_mt: The sacrificial grass is strewn; the enclosing sticks are laid down.

sanskrit_iast: barhiṣo 'dhi stambayajur harati //
meaning: बर्हिषो ऽधि स्तम्बयजुर् हरति //
text_mt: He takes away the grass rubbish with the stambayajus formula from off the sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: prokṣaṇīr āsādaya \\ idhmam upasādaya \ srucau saṃmṛḍḍhi \\ ājyenodehi \\ iti sam̐śāsti /
meaning: प्रोक्षणीर् आसादय \\ इध्मम् उपसादय \ स्रुचौ संमृड्ढि \\ आज्येनोदेहि \\ इति सम्̐शास्ति /
text_mt: He gives the directions: 'Set down the sprinkling waters; set down the sacrificial fuel; cleanse the two spoons; come forward with the clarified butter.'

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇataḥ prokṣaṇīṣv akṛtsnasam̐sthānāṃ praṇītā apavarjayati /
meaning: दक्षिणतः प्रोक्षणीष्व् अकृत्स्नसम्̐स्थानां प्रणीता अपवर्जयति /
text_mt: To the south, at the sprinkling waters, he removes the praṇītā waters of the uncompleted rituals.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ājyagrahebhyaḥ /
meaning: सिद्धम् आज्यग्रहेभ्यः /
text_mt: [The procedure is] established up to the ladlefuls of clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭau kṛtvo juhvāṃ gṛhṇāti catur upabhṛti /
meaning: अष्टौ कृत्वो जुह्वां गृह्णाति चतुर् उपभृति /
text_mt: He takes eight ladlings into the juhū spoon, and four into the upabhṛt.

sanskrit_iast: idhmaṃ prokṣya mūladeśe barhiṣaḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ prokṣaṇīr ninayati /
meaning: इध्मं प्रोक्ष्य मूलदेशे बर्हिषः प्रदक्षिणं प्रोक्षणीर् निनयति /
text_mt: Having sprinkled the sacrificial fuel, he pours out the sprinkling waters at the base of the sacrificial grass in a clockwise direction.

sanskrit_iast: idhmadārv ādāya vidhṛtyoḥ prastaram̐ sādayati /
meaning: इध्मदार्व् आदाय विधृत्योः प्रस्तरम्̐ सादयति /
text_mt: Taking a stick of sacrificial fuel, he sets down the sacred grass bundle upon the two blade dividers (vidhṛti).

sanskrit_iast: ājyāni sādayati sruvatṛtīye srucāv ājyasthālīm̐ sphyam̐ vedaṃ ca /
meaning: आज्यानि सादयति स्रुवतृतीये स्रुचाव् आज्यस्थालीम्̐ स्फ्यम्̐ वेदं च /
text_mt: He sets down the clarified butter portions: the two spoons with the sruva as the third, the clarified butter pot, the wooden sword, and the grass brush.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā samindhanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ समिन्धनात् /

sanskrit_iast: trir idhmam ādadhāti /
meaning: त्रिर् इध्मम् आदधाति /

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā saṃpraiṣāt //
meaning: सिद्धम् आ संप्रैषात् //

sanskrit_iast: agnim agnīt triḥ saṃmṛḍḍhi \ sīda hotar iti preṣyati /
meaning: अग्निम् अग्नीत् त्रिः संमृड्ढि \ सीद होतर् इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He commands: 'O Āgnīdhra, cleanse the fire three times; sit down, O Hotṛ.'

sanskrit_iast: lupyate sraucaḥ pravaraś ca //
meaning: लुप्यते स्रौचः प्रवरश् च //
text_mt: The formula concerning the spoons and the pravara recitation are omitted.

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtavatī adhvarya ity ucyamāne srucāv ādāya dakṣiṇātikramya yathādevatam anuvācayati /
meaning: घृतवती अध्वर्य इत्य् उच्यमाने स्रुचाव् आदाय दक्षिणातिक्रम्य यथादेवतम् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: When '[Recite for the fires] rich in clarified butter, O adhvaryu' is being said, having taken the two spoons and stepped across to the south, he causes [the hotṛ] to recite according to the respective deities.

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ pūrvārdhe yajati madhye somam aupabhṛtaṃ juhvām̐ sarvam ānīya viṣṇuṃ paścārdhe /
meaning: अग्निं पूर्वार्धे यजति मध्ये सोमम् औपभृतं जुह्वाम्̐ सर्वम् आनीय विष्णुं पश्चार्धे /
text_mt: He sacrifices to Agni in the eastern part; to Soma in the middle; having brought all the butter from the upabhṛt into the juhū spoon, [he sacrifices] to Viṣṇu in the western part.

sanskrit_iast: srucau vimucya bahirvedi nirasyati /
meaning: स्रुचौ विमुच्य बहिर्वेदि निरस्यति /
text_mt: Having unyoked the two spoons, he casts [the remnants] outside the sacrificial altar.

sanskrit_iast: rājānam āpyāyya nihnuvate /
meaning: राजानम् आप्याय्य निह्नुवते /
text_mt: Having made King [Soma] swell, they make the reverential gesture.

sanskrit_iast: brahmā rājānam upanahyati /
meaning: ब्रह्मा राजानम् उपनह्यति /
text_mt: The brahman ties up King [Soma].

sanskrit_iast: prastaram̐ vidhṛtī ādāya sruveṇopasado juhoti // yā te agne 'yāśayā \\ iti prathame 'hani yā te agne rajāśayā \\ iti madhyame yā te agne harāśayā \\ ity uttame // tanūr varṣiṣṭhā \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati /
meaning: प्रस्तरम्̐ विधृती आदाय स्रुवेणोपसदो जुहोति // या ते अग्ने ऽयाशया \\ इति प्रथमे ऽहनि या ते अग्ने रजाशया \\ इति मध्यमे या ते अग्ने हराशया \\ इत्य् उत्तमे // तनूर् वर्षिष्ठा \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति /
text_mt: Taking the sacred grass bundle and the two blade dividers, he offers the upasad offerings with the sruva spoon: on the first day with 'What body of thine, O Agni, lies in iron...', on the middle [day] with 'What body of thine, O Agni, lies in silver...', on the last [day] with 'What body of thine, O Agni, lies in gold...'; in each case he appends: '...highest body.'

sanskrit_iast: samayāhavanīyaṃ prastaram atiharan subrahmaṇya subrahmaṇyām āhvaya \\ agnīd devapatnīr vyācakṣva \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: समयाहवनीयं प्रस्तरम् अतिहरन् सुब्रह्मण्य सुब्रह्मण्याम् आह्वय \\ अग्नीद् देवपत्नीर् व्याचक्ष्व \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Passing the sacred grass bundle across the āhavanīya fire, he commands: 'O Subrahmaṇya, call forth the subrahmaṇyā chant; O Āgnīdhra, announce the wives of the gods.'

sanskrit_iast: gārhapatyānte devapatnīr āgnīdhro vyācaṣṭe // vāg vāyoḥ patnī \ pathyā pūṣṇaḥ patnī \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati /
meaning: गार्हपत्यान्ते देवपत्नीर् आग्नीध्रो व्याचष्टे // वाग् वायोः पत्नी \ पथ्या पूष्णः पत्नी \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति /
text_mt: At the edge of the gārhapatya fire, the āgnīdhra announces the wives of the gods; he appends in all cases: 'Speech, the wife of Vāyu; Pathyā, the wife of Pūṣan.'

sanskrit_iast: pūrvāhṇe pravargyopasadbhyāṃ pracaraty aparāhṇe ca /
meaning: पूर्वाह्णे प्रवर्ग्योपसद्भ्यां प्रचरत्य् अपराह्णे च /
text_mt: In the forenoon he proceeds with the Pravargya and Upasad rites, and in the afternoon as well.

sanskrit_iast: antaropasadau vratayato yathākālam̐ sāyam /
meaning: अन्तरोपसदौ व्रतयतो यथाकालम्̐ सायम् /
text_mt: Between the two Upasad rites [the sacrificer and his wife] consume the fast-food, in the evening according to the proper time.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ tryaham upasadbhiś caranti /
meaning: एवं त्र्यहम् उपसद्भिश् चरन्ति /
text_mt: In this manner they perform the Upasad rites for three days.

sanskrit_iast: tānūnaptram̐ vrate prayachati //
meaning: तानूनप्त्रम्̐ व्रते प्रयछति //
text_mt: He gives [them] the Tānūnaptra [butter] during the fast-milk [rite].

sanskrit_iast: yā te agne rudriyā tanūr iti vratayati /
meaning: या ते अग्ने रुद्रिया तनूर् इति व्रतयति /
text_mt: He makes [the sacrificer] consume the fast-milk with: 'Whatever fearful body is thine, O Agni…'

sanskrit_iast: taptavratau bhavataḥ //
meaning: तप्तव्रतौ भवतः //

sanskrit_iast: vratya vācam̐ yacha \ patni vācam̐ yacha \\ iti yathākālam̐ vrataprado vācam̐ yamayati /
meaning: व्रत्य वाचम्̐ यछ \ पत्नि वाचम्̐ यछ \\ इति यथाकालम्̐ व्रतप्रदो वाचम्̐ यमयति /
text_mt: The giver of the fast-food restrains [their] speech at the proper time, saying: 'O [sacrificer] observing the fast, restrain your speech! O wife, restrain your speech!'

sanskrit_iast: catuḥstane prathame 'hani tristanadvistane madhyama ekastana uttame /
meaning: चतुःस्तने प्रथमे ऽहनि त्रिस्तनद्विस्तने मध्यम एकस्तन उत्तमे /
text_mt: [The milk of] four teats is on the first day, of three teats and two teats on the middle day, and of one teat on the last day.

sanskrit_iast: upasadvṛddhau stanavyūhau vivardhayetaupasadām̐ś ca homān /
meaning: उपसद्वृद्धौ स्तनव्यूहौ विवर्धयेतौपसदाम्̐श् च होमान् /
text_mt: In case of an increase in the Upasad days, he should increase the distribution of teats and the Upasad offerings.

sanskrit_iast: madhyamāyām upasadi pūrvāhṇikīṃ kṛtvā yūpam achaiti /
meaning: मध्यमायाम् उपसदि पूर्वाह्णिकीं कृत्वा यूपम् अछैति /
text_mt: On the middle Upasad day, having performed the morning rite, he goes to fetch the sacrificial post.

sanskrit_iast: agreṇa prāgvam̐śaṃ triṣu prakrameṣv aparimite vāvakāśe pṛṣṭhyāśaṅkuṃ nihatya vedādānaprabhṛti vedim̐ vidadhāti / ṣaṭtrim̐śat prakramā prācītyāmnātaṃ pramāṇam /
meaning: अग्रेण प्राग्वम्̐शं त्रिषु प्रक्रमेष्व् अपरिमिते वावकाशे पृष्ठ्याशङ्कुं निहत्य वेदादानप्रभृति वेदिम्̐ विदधाति / षट्त्रिम्̐शत् प्रक्रमा प्राचीत्याम्नातं प्रमाणम् /
text_mt: In front of the hall with the eastward beam, at three paces, or in an unmeasured space, having driven in the spinal peg, he lays out the altar beginning with the taking of the Veda grass; the traditional measure is thirty-six paces eastward.

sanskrit_iast: uparavadeśāt stambayajur harati /
meaning: उपरवदेशात् स्तम्बयजुर् हरति /
text_mt: He carries away the Stambayajus from the site of the sounding-holes.

sanskrit_iast: daśapadām uttaravediṃ niḥsāraṇāntāṃ kurvīta /
meaning: दशपदाम् उत्तरवेदिं निःसारणान्तां कुर्वीत /
text_mt: He should make the high altar ten feet [wide], ending with the border-mounds.

sanskrit_iast: uttamāyām upasadi pūrvāhṇikīṃ kṛtvā śākhām achaiti /
meaning: उत्तमायाम् उपसदि पूर्वाह्णिकीं कृत्वा शाखाम् अछैति /
text_mt: On the last Upasad day, having performed the morning rite, he goes to fetch the branch.

sanskrit_iast: ardhavrate pradāya sadyaḥ kuryād āparāhṇīkīm /
meaning: अर्धव्रते प्रदाय सद्यः कुर्याद् आपराह्णीकीम् /
text_mt: Having given half the fast-food, he should immediately perform the afternoon rite.

sanskrit_iast: utsādya gharmapātrāṇy agnīṣomīyāyaupasadaṃ barhiḥ śulbaprabhṛtinā kalpena saṃnahyati /
meaning: उत्साद्य घर्मपात्राण्य् अग्नीषोमीयायौपसदं बर्हिः शुल्बप्रभृतिना कल्पेन संनह्यति /
text_mt: Having put aside the Gharma vessels, he ties up the Upasad sacrificial grass for the Agni-Soma animal sacrifice according to the procedure beginning with the cord.

sanskrit_iast: idhme paridhīn upasaṃnahyati /
meaning: इध्मे परिधीन् उपसंनह्यति /
text_mt: He ties up the enclosing sticks with the sacrificial fuel.

sanskrit_iast: uttaravedeḥ prokṣaṇaprabhṛti siddham ā purṇāhuteḥ /
meaning: उत्तरवेदेः प्रोक्षणप्रभृति सिद्धम् आ पुर्णाहुतेः /
text_mt: From the sprinkling of the high altar up to the full offering, [the procedure] is established.

sanskrit_iast: vedyāṃ padāni lobhayante yāvanto dakṣiṇatas tāvanta uttarataḥ /
meaning: वेद्यां पदानि लोभयन्ते यावन्तो दक्षिणतस् तावन्त उत्तरतः /
text_mt: They confuse the footprints on the altar: as many on the south as on the north.

sanskrit_iast: avyatikrāmantaḥ pṛṣṭhyāṃ parāñco 'bhyavasarpanti /
meaning: अव्यतिक्रामन्तः पृष्ठ्यां पराञ्चो ऽभ्यवसर्पन्ति /
text_mt: Without stepping across the spine, turning away, they creep down [from the altar].

sanskrit_iast: utkare lobhanāni pravidhyanti /
meaning: उत्करे लोभनानि प्रविध्यन्ति /
text_mt: They throw the tools of confusion onto the rubbish heap.

sanskrit_iast: nāprokṣitām ākrāmanti /
meaning: नाप्रोक्षिताम् आक्रामन्ति /
text_mt: They do not step upon [the altar] before it is sprinkled.

sanskrit_iast: uttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhya pratyavamṛjyāgreṇa pṛṣṭhyāśaṅkuṃ tiryañcam̐ sphyam̐ stabdhvā prokṣaṇīr āsādaya \\ idhmābarhir upasādaya \ srucaḥ saṃmṛḍḍhi \\ ājyenodehi \\ iti sam̐śāsti /
meaning: उत्तरं परिग्राहं परिगृह्य प्रत्यवमृज्याग्रेण पृष्ठ्याशङ्कुं तिर्यञ्चम्̐ स्फ्यम्̐ स्तब्ध्वा प्रोक्षणीर् आसादय \\ इध्माबर्हिर् उपसादय \ स्रुचः संमृड्ढि \\ आज्येनोदेहि \\ इति सम्̐शास्ति /
text_mt: Having grasped the northern enclosing line and wiped downwards, holding the wooden sword crosswise in front of the spinal peg, he gives the orders: 'Set down the sprinkling waters! Set down the sacrificial fuel and sacrificial grass! Cleanse the ladles! Come forward with the clarified butter!'

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇataḥ prokṣaṇīr āsādyottaram idhmābarhir upasādayati /
meaning: दक्षिणतः प्रोक्षणीर् आसाद्योत्तरम् इध्माबर्हिर् उपसादयति /
text_mt: Having set down the sprinkling waters to the south, he sets down the sacrificial fuel and sacrificial grass to the north.

sanskrit_iast: udīraṇaprabhṛti siddham ā barhiṣaḥ prokṣaṇāt /
meaning: उदीरणप्रभृति सिद्धम् आ बर्हिषः प्रोक्षणात् /
text_mt: From the raising up [of the sacrificial grass] up to the sprinkling of the sacrificial grass, [the procedure] is established.

sanskrit_iast: idhmābarhir nidhāya saṃtatām ulaparājim̐ stṛṇāti pṛṣṭhyāśaṅkor adhy ottaravedeḥ /
meaning: इध्माबर्हिर् निधाय संतताम् उलपराजिम्̐ स्तृणाति पृष्ठ्याशङ्कोर् अध्य् ओत्तरवेदेः /
text_mt: Having deposited the sacrificial fuel and sacrificial grass, he spreads a continuous line of reed-grass from the spinal peg over to the high altar.

sanskrit_iast: havirdhānayoḥ prathamakṛtān granthīn visram̐sya prakṣālyābhyajyābhinahyābhitaḥ pṛṣṭhyām aratnimātre 'vasthāpayanti / barhir vedi cakrāṇy antarvedy upastambhanāni //
meaning: हविर्धानयोः प्रथमकृतान् ग्रन्थीन् विस्रम्̐स्य प्रक्षाल्याभ्यज्याभिनह्याभितः पृष्ठ्याम् अरत्निमात्रे ऽवस्थापयन्ति / बर्हिर् वेदि चक्राण्य् अन्तर्वेद्य् उपस्तम्भनानि //
text_mt: Having loosened the knots first tied on the two Havirdhāna carts, washed them, anointed them, and tied them around, they set them up on both sides of the spine at the distance of an aratni: the wheels outside the altar, the props inside the altar.

sanskrit_iast: yuñjate mana uta yuñjate dhiyas \\ iti śālāmukhīye juhoti /
meaning: युञ्जते मन उत युञ्जते धियस् \\ इति शालामुखीये जुहोति /
text_mt: He makes an offering in the Śālāmukhīya fire with: 'They yoke the mind and they yoke the thoughts…'

sanskrit_iast: havirdhānayor dakṣiṇe 'kṣadhurau rājakrayaṇīpadārdhena devaśrutau deveṣv āghoṣethām iti patny upānakti trir anyāṃ tir anyāṃ prācīm anivartayantī //
meaning: हविर्धानयोर् दक्षिणे ऽक्षधुरौ राजक्रयणीपदार्धेन देवश्रुतौ देवेष्व् आघोषेथाम् इति पत्न्य् उपानक्ति त्रिर् अन्यां तिर् अन्यां प्राचीम् अनिवर्तयन्ती //
