text_mt: On the two southern axle-pins of the two Havirdhāna carts, with half [the dust of] the footprint of the cow that bought the soma, the wife anoints, with: 'Famed among the gods, make yourselves heard among the gods,' three times the one and three times the other, facing east and not turning back.

sanskrit_iast: havirdhānābhyāṃ pravartyamānābhyām anubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
meaning: हविर्धानाभ्यां प्रवर्त्यमानाभ्याम् अनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: He causes [the Hotṛ] to recite: 'Recite for the two Havirdhāna carts being rolled forward.'

sanskrit_iast: triranūktāyām apa janyaṃ bhayaṃ nuda \\ iti sachadiṣke pravartayanti /
meaning: त्रिरनूक्तायाम् अप जन्यं भयं नुद \\ इति सछदिष्के प्रवर्तयन्ति /
text_mt: When it has been recited three times, they roll forward the carts with roofs, with: 'Drive away foreign danger!'

sanskrit_iast: udgṛhṇanto 'varāvaram antarvedy avasthāpya ye dhurāv upāñjanti tayor vartmani vedisaṃdhau hiraṇyaṃ nidhāyābhijuhoti \\ idam̐ viṣṇur vicakrame \\ iti dakṣiṇasminn irāvatī dhenumatī \\ ity uttarasmin /
meaning: उद्गृह्णन्तो ऽवरावरम् अन्तर्वेद्य् अवस्थाप्य ये धुराव् उपाञ्जन्ति तयोर् वर्त्मनि वेदिसंधौ हिरण्यं निधायाभिजुहोति \\ इदम्̐ विष्णुर् विचक्रमे \\ इति दक्षिणस्मिन्न् इरावती धेनुमती \\ इत्य् उत्तरस्मिन् /
text_mt: Lifting [them] and setting [them] down inside the altar, lower and lower, having placed a piece of gold at the junction of the altar in the tracks of the two [carts] whose axles they anoint, he offers upon it: with 'Here Viṣṇu strode…' in the southern track, and with 'Rich in food, rich in cattle…' in the northern track.

sanskrit_iast: udgṛhṇanto 'nuvrajanti /
meaning: उद्गृह्णन्तो ऽनुव्रजन्ति /
text_mt: Lifting [the carts], they follow along.

sanskrit_iast: yady akṣa utkṣvedet suvāg āvada deva duryān iti japet /
meaning: यद्य् अक्ष उत्क्ष्वेदेत् सुवाग् आवद देव दुर्यान् इति जपेत् /
text_mt: If the axle should creak, he should murmur: 'Speak auspiciously, O divine door-props!'

sanskrit_iast: paścād uttaravedes triṣu prakrameṣu \\ atra ramethām̐ varṣman pṛthivyā adhi \\ iti nabhyasthe 'vasthāpya paridadhāti //
meaning: पश्चाद् उत्तरवेदेस् त्रिषु प्रक्रमेषु \\ अत्र रमेथाम्̐ वर्ष्मन् पृथिव्या अधि \\ इति नभ्यस्थे ऽवस्थाप्य परिदधाति //
text_mt: Three paces to the west of the high altar, having stopped [them] while on their naves with 'Rest here on the summit of the earth…', he encloses them.

sanskrit_iast: vaiṣṇavam asi \\ ity uttarām īṣām ārabhya japati //
meaning: वैष्णवम् असि \\ इत्य् उत्तराम् ईषाम् आरभ्य जपति //
text_mt: Having touched the northern pole, he murmurs: 'Thou art belonging to Viṣṇu.'

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇus tvottabhnātu \\ ity upastabhnoty evam uttaram /
meaning: विष्णुस् त्वोत्तभ्नातु \\ इत्य् उपस्तभ्नोत्य् एवम् उत्तरम् /
text_mt: He supports [it] with: 'May Viṣṇu support thee'; likewise the northern [cart].

sanskrit_iast: havirdhānayor īṣe dakṣiṇe methyāv upanihanti divo viṣṇa iti dakṣiṇām \\ viṣṇor nu kam ity uttarām /
meaning: हविर्धानयोर् ईषे दक्षिणे मेथ्याव् उपनिहन्ति दिवो विष्ण इति दक्षिणाम् \\ विष्णोर् नु कम् इत्य् उत्तराम् /
text_mt: He drives in two pegs at the two southern poles of the two Havirdhāna carts: the southern one with 'From heaven, O Viṣṇu…', the northern one with 'Now I will proclaim the deeds of Viṣṇu…'

sanskrit_iast: īṣe methyor nibadhnāti granthim akurvan //
meaning: ईषे मेथ्योर् निबध्नाति ग्रन्थिम् अकुर्वन् //
text_mt: He ties the two poles to the two pegs without making a knot.

sanskrit_iast: ā vām upastham adruhā \\ iti prācīnavam̐śam̐ havirdhānaṃ minoti //
meaning: आ वाम् उपस्थम् अद्रुहा \\ इति प्राचीनवम्̐शम्̐ हविर्धानं मिनोति //
text_mt: With: 'Into your lap, free from deceit…', he erects the Havirdhāna shed with its beams pointing east.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇoḥ pṛṣṭham asi \\ iti madhye chadir ādadhāti / paścāt prathīyaḥ /
meaning: विष्णोः पृष्ठम् असि \\ इति मध्ये छदिर् आदधाति / पश्चात् प्रथीयः /
text_mt: With: 'Thou art the back of Viṣṇu,' he places the roof in the middle, wider at the west.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvārdhe chadir anteṣv am̐sadaghnīm̐ś catasraḥ sthūṇā nihatyodañcam̐ vam̐śam avadadhāty evaṃ paścād dhrasīyasīṣu /
meaning: पूर्वार्धे छदिर् अन्तेष्व् अम्̐सदघ्नीम्̐श् चतस्रः स्थूणा निहत्योदञ्चम्̐ वम्̐शम् अवदधात्य् एवं पश्चाद् ध्रसीयसीषु /
text_mt: Having driven in four shoulder-high posts at the ends of the roof in the eastern half, he lays down a beam pointing north; likewise in the western half on shorter [posts].

sanskrit_iast: tejanyāṃ madhye darbhāṇām̐ varasaṃ karoti /
meaning: तेजन्यां मध्ये दर्भाणाम्̐ वरसं करोति /
text_mt: He makes a fringe of Darbha grass in the middle of a reed-mat.

sanskrit_iast: darbhān pratyupakarṣam̐ rajjvānuparihāram̐ samasya tejanyantau viṣṇo rarāṭam asi \\ iti pūrvārdhe vam̐śe 'bhyādadhāti /
meaning: दर्भान् प्रत्युपकर्षम्̐ रज्ज्वानुपरिहारम्̐ समस्य तेजन्यन्तौ विष्णो रराटम् असि \\ इति पूर्वार्धे वम्̐शे ऽभ्यादधाति /
text_mt: Drawing the Darbha grasses together and winding a cord around, having gathered them, he puts the two ends of the reed-mat on the beam in the eastern half with: 'Thou art the forehead of Viṣṇu.'

sanskrit_iast: pariśritya dakṣiṇasmin vam̐śānte tejanyāṃ darbhān ādhāya viṣṇoḥ śipre sthas \\ ity antau vyavāsyati //
meaning: परिश्रित्य दक्षिणस्मिन् वम्̐शान्ते तेजन्यां दर्भान् आधाय विष्णोः शिप्रे स्थस् \\ इत्य् अन्तौ व्यवास्यति //
text_mt: Having enclosed it, having placed Darbha grasses on the reed-mat at the southern end of the beam, he joins the two ends with: 'Ye two are the corners of Viṣṇu's mouth.'

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇoḥ syūr asi \\ iti pravayati //
meaning: विष्णोः स्यूर् असि \\ इति प्रवयति //
text_mt: He weaves [it] together with: 'Thou art the seam of Viṣṇu.'

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇor dhruvo 'si \\ iti prathamaṃ granthiṃ karoti /
meaning: विष्णोर् ध्रुवो ऽसि \\ इति प्रथमं ग्रन्थिं करोति /
text_mt: He ties the first knot with: 'Thou art the steadfast knot of Viṣṇu.'

sanskrit_iast: āntāt pratiṣīvyet /
meaning: आन्तात् प्रतिषीव्येत् /

sanskrit_iast: aparam̐ vam̐śaṃ pratiṣīvya dvāryāḥ pratiṣīvyati /
meaning: अपरम्̐ वम्̐शं प्रतिषीव्य द्वार्याः प्रतिषीव्यति /
text_mt: Having sewn the other beam, he sews the door-posts.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvāḥ śamyā utkṛṣya saṃbadhnāti //
meaning: ऊर्ध्वाः शम्या उत्कृष्य संबध्नाति //
text_mt: Drawing up the upright pegs, he ties them together.

sanskrit_iast: vaiṣṇavam asi \ viṣṇave tvā \\ iti saṃmitam abhimantryāhavanīyād yajamānaḥ prācas trīn prakramān prakramya pra tad viṣṇur iti japati /
meaning: वैष्णवम् असि \ विष्णवे त्वा \\ इति संमितम् अभिमन्त्र्याहवनीयाद् यजमानः प्राचस् त्रीन् प्रक्रमान् प्रक्रम्य प्र तद् विष्णुर् इति जपति /
text_mt: Having addressed the measured [shed] with: 'Thou art belonging to Viṣṇu; for Viṣṇu thee!', the sacrificer, having stepped three paces eastward from the Āhavanīya fire, murmurs: 'For this Viṣṇu…'

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya paścād upastambhanasya dviprādeśaṃ caturasram̐ vidhāya /
meaning: दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य पश्चाद् उपस्तम्भनस्य द्विप्रादेशं चतुरस्रम्̐ विधाय /
text_mt: To the west of the southern Havirdhāna cart's prop, having laid out a square of two spans;

sanskrit_iast: uttarato gārhapatyasya devasya tvā savituḥ prasave \\ ity abhrim ādatte //
meaning: उत्तरतो गार्हपत्यस्य देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे \\ इत्य् अभ्रिम् आदत्ते //
text_mt: To the north of the Gārhapatya fire, he takes the spade with: 'At the instigation of the divine Savitṛ…'

sanskrit_iast: abhrir asi \ nārir asi \\ ity abhimantrayate //
meaning: अभ्रिर् असि \ नारिर् असि \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: He addresses it with: 'Thou art the spade; thou art the woman.'

sanskrit_iast: idam aham̐ rakṣaso grīvā apikṛntāmi \\ iti dakṣiṇasmād am̐sād abhipradakṣiṇaṃ prādeśamātrān kuṣṭhāsūparavān parilikhati yathāyūpāvaṭaṃ bāhumātrān khanati /
meaning: इदम् अहम्̐ रक्षसो ग्रीवा अपिकृन्तामि \\ इति दक्षिणस्माद् अम्̐साद् अभिप्रदक्षिणं प्रादेशमात्रान् कुष्ठासूपरवान् परिलिखति यथायूपावटं बाहुमात्रान् खनति /
text_mt: With: 'Here do I cut off the neck of the Rakṣas,' turning clockwise from the southern shoulder, he marks out sounding-holes of a span's measure at the elbows, and digs them out a cubit deep, like the hole for a sacrificial post.

sanskrit_iast: auparavāṇāṃ pām̐sūnām agreṇopastambhanaṃ bāhumātraṃ caturasraṃ kharaṃ karoti /
meaning: औपरवाणां पाम्̐सूनाम् अग्रेणोपस्तम्भनं बाहुमात्रं चतुरस्रं खरं करोति /
text_mt: In front of the prop, he makes a square mound of a cubit's measure with the earth from the sounding-holes.

sanskrit_iast: avokṣya sikatābhiḥ prarocayati //
meaning: अवोक्ष्य सिकताभिः प्ररोचयति //
text_mt: Having sprinkled it, he adorns it with sand.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhann asi bṛhadrāyas \\ ity anupūrvaṃ khanati //
meaning: बृहन्न् असि बृहद्रायस् \\ इत्य् अनुपूर्वं खनति //
text_mt: He digs [them] in succession with: 'Great art thou, possessing great wealth…'

sanskrit_iast: samrāḍ asi \\ iti prathamam udvapati svarāḍ asi \\ iti dvitīyam \\ virāḍ asi \\ iti tṛtīyam \\ satrarāḍ asi \\ iti caturtham //
meaning: सम्राड् असि \\ इति प्रथमम् उद्वपति स्वराड् असि \\ इति द्वितीयम् \\ विराड् असि \\ इति तृतीयम् \\ सत्रराड् असि \\ इति चतुर्थम् //
text_mt: He empties the first with: 'Thou art the supreme ruler'; the second with: 'Thou art the self-ruler'; the third with: 'Thou art the wide ruler'; the fourth with: 'Thou art the ruler of the assembly.'

sanskrit_iast: bṛhann asi bṛhadrāyas \\ ity adhastāt saṃtṛdya sarvarāḍ asi \\ iti sarvān udvapati /
meaning: बृहन्न् असि बृहद्रायस् \\ इत्य् अधस्तात् संतृद्य सर्वराड् असि \\ इति सर्वान् उद्वपति /
text_mt: Having connected them from underneath with 'Great art thou, possessing great wealth…', he hollows them all out with: 'Thou art the ruler of all.'

sanskrit_iast: uduptān utkare pravidhyati //
meaning: उदुप्तान् उत्करे प्रविध्यति //
text_mt: He throws [the earth] that has been dug out onto the rubbish-heap.

sanskrit_iast: saṃmṛśe \\ ity uparavān saṃmṛśati /
meaning: संमृशे \\ इत्य् उपरवान् संमृशति /
text_mt: With [the mantra]: "For mutual contact...", he touches the sounding-holes together.

sanskrit_iast: anumṛśataḥ pūrvayor dakṣiṇam anv adhvaryur aparayor uttaram̐ yajamānaḥ // kim atra \\ iti pṛchati bhadram ity adhvaryus tan nau saha \\ iti yajamāna / uttaram anv adhvaryur dakṣiṇayor aparam̐ yajamānaḥ // kim atra \\ iti pṛchati bhadram ity adhvaryus tan me \\ ity āha yajamānaḥ /
meaning: अनुमृशतः पूर्वयोर् दक्षिणम् अन्व् अध्वर्युर् अपरयोर् उत्तरम्̐ यजमानः // किम् अत्र \\ इति पृछति भद्रम् इत्य् अध्वर्युस् तन् नौ सह \\ इति यजमान / उत्तरम् अन्व् अध्वर्युर् दक्षिणयोर् अपरम्̐ यजमानः // किम् अत्र \\ इति पृछति भद्रम् इत्य् अध्वर्युस् तन् मे \\ इत्य् आह यजमानः /
text_mt: The two touch through [the connecting channels]: of the two eastern [holes], the adhvaryu [touches] through the southern one, the sacrificer through the northern one. "What is here?" he asks. "Prosperity," the adhvaryu [answers]. "May that be with us together," the sacrificer [says]. Of the two western ones, the adhvaryu [touches] through the northern one, the sacrificer through the southern one. "What is here?" he asks. "Prosperity," the adhvaryu [answers]. "May that be mine," the sacrificer says.

sanskrit_iast: uttarataḥ sadohavirdhānayoḥ samayārdhe catuḥsthūṇaṃ dakṣiṇādvāraṃ prāgvam̐śam āgnīdhraṃ minoti / tasyārdham antarvedy ardhaṃ bahirvedi /
meaning: उत्तरतः सदोहविर्धानयोः समयार्धे चतुःस्थूणं दक्षिणाद्वारं प्राग्वम्̐शम् आग्नीध्रं मिनोति / तस्यार्धम् अन्तर्वेद्य् अर्धं बहिर्वेदि /
text_mt: To the north of the sadas and the havirdhāna shed, halfway between them, he erects the āgnīdhra shed having four posts, with its door to the south, with its crossbeams facing east. Half of it is inside the altar ground, half outside the altar ground.

sanskrit_iast: aparasmād vedyantāt triṣu prakrameṣv aparimite vāvakāśe sado vidadhāti navāratni prācīnaṃ trinavaṃ tiryak tasya madhye dakṣiṇataḥ pṛṣṭhyāyāḥ prakramamātra audumbaryai gartaṃ khanati yathāyūpāvaṭam̐ samānam ā staraṇāt /
meaning: अपरस्माद् वेद्यन्तात् त्रिषु प्रक्रमेष्व् अपरिमिते वावकाशे सदो विदधाति नवारत्नि प्राचीनं त्रिनवं तिर्यक् तस्य मध्ये दक्षिणतः पृष्ठ्यायाः प्रक्रममात्र औदुम्बर्यै गर्तं खनति यथायूपावटम्̐ समानम् आ स्तरणात् /
text_mt: Three paces from the western end of the altar, or in an unmeasured space, he arranges the sadas: nine cubits long towards the east, twenty-seven across; in the middle of it, south of the spine, at the distance of one pace, he digs a pit for the audumbarī post, equal to the sacrificial post's pit up to the strewing.

sanskrit_iast: yajamānamātrīm audumbarīm ucchrīyamāṇām udgātānvārabhate //
meaning: यजमानमात्रीम् औदुम्बरीम् उच्छ्रीयमाणाम् उद्गातान्वारभते //
text_mt: While the audumbarī post, equal in height to the sacrificer, is being raised, the udgātṛ priest holds onto it.

sanskrit_iast: uñ śrayasva vanaspate \\ ity ucchrayati //
meaning: उञ् श्रयस्व वनस्पते \\ इत्य् उच्छ्रयति //
text_mt: With: "Erect yourself, lord of the forest!", he raises it.

sanskrit_iast: nitānas tvā māruto nihantu \\ iti prākkarṇīm avadadhāti //
meaning: नितानस् त्वा मारुतो निहन्तु \\ इति प्राक्कर्णीम् अवदधाति //
text_mt: With: "May Nitāna the Māruta strike you down!", he sets it down with its branches pointing east.

sanskrit_iast: brahmavaniṃ tvā kṣatravaniṃ paryūhāmi \\ iti pām̐subhiḥ paryūhati //
meaning: ब्रह्मवनिं त्वा क्षत्रवनिं पर्यूहामि \\ इति पाम्̐सुभिः पर्यूहति //
text_mt: With: "I heap earth around you, winner of the priesthood, winner of the nobility!", he heaps it around with earth.

sanskrit_iast: brahma dṛm̐ha \ kṣatraṃ dṛm̐ha \\ iti yajamāno dīkṣitadaṇḍena pradakṣiṇam̐ saṃmṛśati /
meaning: ब्रह्म दृम्̐ह \ क्षत्रं दृम्̐ह \\ इति यजमानो दीक्षितदण्डेन प्रदक्षिणम्̐ संमृशति /
text_mt: With: "Strengthen the priesthood! Strengthen the nobility!", the sacrificer strokes it clockwise with the staff of the consecrated one.

sanskrit_iast: apo 'nupariṣiñcati /
meaning: अपो ऽनुपरिषिञ्चति /

sanskrit_iast: antarā karṇau hiraṇyaṃ nidhāya ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī āpṛṇa \\ ity abhijuhoti /
meaning: अन्तरा कर्णौ हिरण्यं निधाय घृतेन द्यावापृथिवी आपृण \\ इत्य् अभिजुहोति /
text_mt: Having placed a piece of gold between the forks, he offers over it with: "Fill heaven and earth with clarified butter!"

sanskrit_iast: ā mūlād avasrāvayati /
meaning: आ मूलाद् अवस्रावयति /

sanskrit_iast: udagvam̐śam̐ sado 'ntarmāyu minoti /
meaning: उदग्वम्̐शम्̐ सदो ऽन्तर्मायु मिनोति /
text_mt: He erects the sadas with its crossbeams facing north, with interior measuring.

sanskrit_iast: audumbarī varṣiṣṭhā sthūṇānām̐ hrasīyasyo 'nyā antyā hrasiṣṭhāḥ /
meaning: औदुम्बरी वर्षिष्ठा स्थूणानाम्̐ ह्रसीयस्यो ऽन्या अन्त्या ह्रसिष्ठाः /
text_mt: The audumbarī post is the tallest of the posts; the others are shorter; the end ones are the shortest.

sanskrit_iast: nava chadīm̐ṣy agniṣṭoma udaktūlāni pañcadaśokthye saptadaśātirātra ekavim̐śatiḥ sattrāhīnayor ekādaśa ṣoḍaśini vājapeye ca //
meaning: नव छदीम्̐ष्य् अग्निष्टोम उदक्तूलानि पञ्चदशोक्थ्ये सप्तदशातिरात्र एकविम्̐शतिः सत्त्राहीनयोर् एकादश षोडशिनि वाजपेये च //
text_mt: There are nine roof-mats in the agniṣṭoma, with their tips facing north; fifteen in the ukthya; seventeen in the atirātra; twenty-one in the sattra and the ahīna; eleven in the ṣoḍaśin and in the vājapeya.

sanskrit_iast: viśvajanasya chāyāsi \\ ity audumbaryāṃ madhyamaṃ chadir ādadhāti / pūrvam ādhāyāparam ādadhāti / dakṣiṇair abhinidadhāty uttarāṇy upakarṣati //
meaning: विश्वजनस्य छायासि \\ इत्य् औदुम्बर्यां मध्यमं छदिर् आदधाति / पूर्वम् आधायापरम् आदधाति / दक्षिणैर् अभिनिदधात्य् उत्तराण्य् उपकर्षति //
text_mt: With: "You are the shelter of all people!", he places the middle roof-mat on the audumbarī post. Having placed the eastern one, he places the western one. He puts on the southern ones [and] pulls up the northern ones.

sanskrit_iast: pari tvā girvaṇo giras \\ iti pariśrayati /
meaning: परि त्वा गिर्वणो गिरस् \\ इति परिश्रयति /
text_mt: With: "Around you, O lover of praise, songs [have encircled]...", he encloses [it].

sanskrit_iast: madhyamāparayoḥ saṃdhau \\ indrāya tvā \\ ity ārabhya japati //
meaning: मध्यमापरयोः संधौ \\ इन्द्राय त्वा \\ इत्य् आरभ्य जपति //
text_mt: At the junction of the middle and western [mats], having begun with: "For Indra you...", he mutters.

sanskrit_iast: indrasya syūr asi \\ iti pravayati //
meaning: इन्द्रस्य स्यूर् असि \\ इति प्रवयति //
text_mt: With: "You are the stitch of Indra!", he weaves [the cord through].

sanskrit_iast: indrasya dhruvo 'si \\ iti prathamaṃ granthiṃ karoti /
meaning: इन्द्रस्य ध्रुवो ऽसि \\ इति प्रथमं ग्रन्थिं करोति /
text_mt: With: "You are the firm knot of Indra!", he ties the first knot.

sanskrit_iast: āntāt pratiṣīvyet /
meaning: आन्तात् प्रतिषीव्येत् /

sanskrit_iast: aparān saṃdhīn pratiṣīvya dvāryāḥ pratiṣīvyati //
meaning: अपरान् संधीन् प्रतिषीव्य द्वार्याः प्रतिषीव्यति //
text_mt: Having sewn the other junctions, he sews the two door-posts.

sanskrit_iast: aindram asi \\ indrāya tvā \\ iti saṃmitam abhimantrya prokṣaṇīḥ sam̐skṛtya rakṣoghno vo valagaghnaḥ prokṣāmi vaiṣṇavān ity uparavān prokṣati //
meaning: ऐन्द्रम् असि \\ इन्द्राय त्वा \\ इति संमितम् अभिमन्त्र्य प्रोक्षणीः सम्̐स्कृत्य रक्षोघ्नो वो वलगघ्नः प्रोक्षामि वैष्णवान् इत्य् उपरवान् प्रोक्षति //
text_mt: Having addressed the measured [shed] with: "You belong to Indra; for Indra you!", and prepared the sprinkling waters, he sprinkles the sounding-holes with: "Slayers of demons, slayers of sorceries, I sprinkle you belonging to Viṣṇu!"

sanskrit_iast: rakṣohaṇaṃ tvā valagahanam avasiñcāmi \\ ity adbhir ekaikam avasiñcati //
meaning: रक्षोहणं त्वा वलगहनम् अवसिञ्चामि \\ इत्य् अद्भिर् एकैकम् अवसिञ्चति //
text_mt: With: "You, slayer of demons, slayer of sorceries, I pour upon!", he pours water into each [hole].

sanskrit_iast: rakṣohaṇaṃ tvā valagahanam avastṛṇāmi \\ iti darbhair ekaikam avastṛṇāti /
meaning: रक्षोहणं त्वा वलगहनम् अवस्तृणामि \\ इति दर्भैर् एकैकम् अवस्तृणाति /
text_mt: With: "You, slayer of demons, slayer of sorceries, I strew!", he strews [each] with darbha-grass one by one.

sanskrit_iast: audumbare 'dhiṣavaṇaphalake samopavṛkṇe paścātpurastāt pradhiprakāre bāhumātre / dvyaṅgulaṃ paścād asam̐hatam /
meaning: औदुम्बरे ऽधिषवणफलके समोपवृक्णे पश्चात्पुरस्तात् प्रधिप्रकारे बाहुमात्रे / द्व्यङ्गुलं पश्चाद् असम्̐हतम् /
text_mt: The two pressing-boards are made of udumbara wood, felled evenly together, shaped like felloes at the back and front, an arm's length; at the back they are separated by two finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast: atihṛtyāntareṇeṣe rakṣoghnī vām̐ valagaghnī upadadhāmi \\ ity uparaveṣūpadadhāti //
meaning: अतिहृत्यान्तरेणेषे रक्षोघ्नी वाम्̐ वलगघ्नी उपदधामि \\ इत्य् उपरवेषूपदधाति //
text_mt: Having brought them across between the shafts, with: "Slayers of demons, slayers of sorceries, I place you two!", he sets them upon the sounding-holes.

sanskrit_iast: rakṣoghnī vām̐ valagaghnī paryūhāmi \\ iti pām̐subhiḥ paryūhati /
meaning: रक्षोघ्नी वाम्̐ वलगघ्नी पर्यूहामि \\ इति पाम्̐सुभिः पर्यूहति /
text_mt: With: "Slayers of demons, slayers of sorceries, I heap around you two!", he heaps earth around them with soil.

sanskrit_iast: adhivicayanasya carmaṇo 'dhiṣavaṇaṃ karoti /
meaning: अधिविचयनस्य चर्मणो ऽधिषवणं करोति /
text_mt: He makes the pressing-board [pad] from the skin for spreading over.

sanskrit_iast: atihṛtyāntareṇeṣe rakṣohaṇaṃ tvā valagahanam āstṛṇāmi \\ ity adhiṣavaṇaphalakayor āstīrya lomataḥ kuṣṭhāḥ saṃbadhnāti /
meaning: अतिहृत्यान्तरेणेषे रक्षोहणं त्वा वलगहनम् आस्तृणामि \\ इत्य् अधिषवणफलकयोर् आस्तीर्य लोमतः कुष्ठाः संबध्नाति /
text_mt: Having brought it across between the shafts, with: "You, slayer of demons, slayer of sorceries, I spread out!", having spread [the skin] over the two pressing-boards, he fastens the edges with the hairy side [up].

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇata āgnīdhrasyāgnīdhrīyāya lakṣaṇaṃ karoti /
meaning: दक्षिणत आग्नीध्रस्याग्नीध्रीयाय लक्षणं करोति /
text_mt: To the south of the āgnīdhra shed, he makes a mark for the āgnīdhrīya hearth.

sanskrit_iast: uddhatyāvokṣya cātvālāt pām̐sūn nivapati /
meaning: उद्धत्यावोक्ष्य चात्वालात् पाम्̐सून् निवपति /
text_mt: Having dug up and sprinkled [the ground], he pours out earth from the cātvāla pit.

sanskrit_iast: vyuhyāvokṣya sikatābhiḥ prarocayati /
meaning: व्युह्यावोक्ष्य सिकताभिः प्ररोचयति /
text_mt: Having spread it out and sprinkled it, he makes it bright with sand.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ dhiṣṇyān nivapati ṣaḍ antaḥsadasaḥ / pṛṣṭhyādeśe hotrīyaṃ bāhumātre paścād dvārasya dakṣiṇaṃ maitrāvaruṇīyam̐ yathainayoḥ samayārdha audumbarī bhaviṣyaty udīca itarān bāhumātrāntarān brāhmaṇācham̐syaṃ potrīyaṃ neṣṭrīyam achāvakyam /
meaning: एवं धिष्ण्यान् निवपति षड् अन्तःसदसः / पृष्ठ्यादेशे होत्रीयं बाहुमात्रे पश्चाद् द्वारस्य दक्षिणं मैत्रावरुणीयम्̐ यथैनयोः समयार्ध औदुम्बरी भविष्यत्य् उदीच इतरान् बाहुमात्रान्तरान् ब्राह्मणाछम्̐स्यं पोत्रीयं नेष्ट्रीयम् अछावक्यम् /
text_mt: In this way he sets up the hearths, six inside the sadas: in the position of the spine, the hotṛ's hearth; an arm's length behind the door, to the south, the maitrāvaruṇa's hearth, so that the audumbarī post will be halfway between them; to the north, the other [hearths] separated by an arm's length: the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin's, the potṛ's, the neṣṭṛ's, [and] the acchāvāka's.

sanskrit_iast: yāvati hotrīyād āgnīdhrīyas tāvati dakṣiṇataḥpurastān mārjālīyaḥ /
meaning: यावति होत्रीयाद् आग्नीध्रीयस् तावति दक्षिणतःपुरस्तान् मार्जालीयः /
text_mt: As far as the āgnīdhrīya hearth is from the hotṛ's hearth, so far to the south-east is the mārjālīya hearth.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇataś cātvālasyāntarvedy āstāvāya sam̐stṛṇāti /
meaning: दक्षिणतश् चात्वालस्यान्तर्वेद्य् आस्तावाय सम्̐स्तृणाति /
text_mt: To the south of the cātvāla pit, inside the altar ground, he strews [grass] for the chant-ground.

sanskrit_iast: uttarataś cātvālasya śāmitrāya lakṣaṇaṃ karoti /
meaning: उत्तरतश् चात्वालस्य शामित्राय लक्षणं करोति /
text_mt: To the north of the cātvāla pit, he makes a mark for the slaughtering place.

sanskrit_iast: uddhatyāvokṣyānuparikrāmantau dhiṣṇyān upatiṣṭhete 'dhvaryur yajamānaś ca vibhūr asi pravāhaṇas \\ itiprabhṛtibhir yathānyuptam̐ samrāḍ asi \\ itiprabhṛtibhir āhavanīyam āstāvam antarvedi tiṣṭhantau cātvālam̐ śāmitram̐ sada audumbarīṃ brahmalokam uttareṇāgnīdhrīyaṃ parikramya śālāmukhīyaṃ gārhapatyaṃ dakṣiṇāgnim̐ // raudreṇānīkena \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati /
meaning: उद्धत्यावोक्ष्यानुपरिक्रामन्तौ धिष्ण्यान् उपतिष्ठेते ऽध्वर्युर् यजमानश् च विभूर् असि प्रवाहणस् \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् यथान्युप्तम्̐ सम्राड् असि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् आहवनीयम् आस्तावम् अन्तर्वेदि तिष्ठन्तौ चात्वालम्̐ शामित्रम्̐ सद औदुम्बरीं ब्रह्मलोकम् उत्तरेणाग्नीध्रीयं परिक्रम्य शालामुखीयं गार्हपत्यं दक्षिणाग्निम्̐ // रौद्रेणानीकेन \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति /
text_mt: Having dug up and sprinkled [the ground], the adhvaryu and the sacrificer, walking around successively, venerate the hearths: with the formulas beginning with: "You are the widely-reaching, the conveyer...", in the order in which they were set up; with the formulas beginning with: "You are the sovereign ruler...", [they venerate] the āhavanīya fire, the chant-ground, while standing inside the altar ground, the cātvāla pit, the slaughtering place, the sadas, the audumbarī post, the place of the brahman; having walked around to the north of the āgnīdhrīya hearth, [they venerate] the śālāmukhīya fire, the gārhapatya fire, [and] the southern fire. Everywhere he subjoins: "...with your Rudra-like force."

sanskrit_iast: tīrtham antarā cātvālam āgnīdhraṃ ca /
meaning: तीर्थम् अन्तरा चात्वालम् आग्नीध्रं च /
text_mt: The passage is between the cātvāla pit and the āgnīdhra shed.

sanskrit_iast: na dhiṣṇyān vyaveyāt / adhvaryuś cet pratyaṅ dhiṣṇyān atikrāmed aindrīṃ nigadet /
meaning: न धिष्ण्यान् व्यवेयात् / अध्वर्युश् चेत् प्रत्यङ् धिष्ण्यान् अतिक्रामेद् ऐन्द्रीं निगदेत् /
text_mt: He should not walk between the hearths. If the adhvaryu should step across the hearths towards the west, he should recite a verse addressed to Indra.

sanskrit_iast: antarāgnīdhram āgnīdhrīyaṃ ca prāgvam̐śāya saṃcaraḥ /
meaning: अन्तराग्नीध्रम् आग्नीध्रीयं च प्राग्वम्̐शाय संचरः /
text_mt: The passage between the āgnīdhra shed and the āgnīdhrīya hearth is for [approaching] the old hall.

sanskrit_iast: vedim̐ stṛṇanti yathāpadalobhā dhātuśo dhunvanto vānapachādayanto dhiṣṇyān kharoparavottaravediṃ ca /
meaning: वेदिम्̐ स्तृणन्ति यथापदलोभा धातुशो धुन्वन्तो वानपछादयन्तो धिष्ण्यान् खरोपरवोत्तरवेदिं च /
text_mt: They strew the altar, shaking [the grass] according to the natural directions so as not to miss the proper spots, not covering the hearths, the mound, the sounding-holes, and the high altar.

sanskrit_iast: ardhavrate pradāyottarata āhavanīyasyedhmābarhir upasādayati /
meaning: अर्धव्रते प्रदायोत्तरत आहवनीयस्येध्माबर्हिर् उपसादयति /
text_mt: Having given [the sacrificer] half his food-portion, he deposits the sacrificial fuel and barhis north of the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: pāṇī prakṣālayate 'dhvaryur yajamānaś ca /
meaning: पाणी प्रक्षालयते ऽध्वर्युर् यजमानश् च /
text_mt: The adhvaryu and the sacrificer wash their hands.

sanskrit_iast: śālāmukhīye 'gnipraṇayanāny ādhāya prāgvam̐śe pāśukāni pātrāṇi prayunakti sruvād dakṣiṇām̐ srucaṃ pracaraṇīṃ / tasyāḥ prathamaṃ tūṣṇīm̐ saṃmārjanam /
meaning: शालामुखीये ऽग्निप्रणयनान्य् आधाय प्राग्वम्̐शे पाशुकानि पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति स्रुवाद् दक्षिणाम्̐ स्रुचं प्रचरणीं / तस्याः प्रथमं तूष्णीम्̐ संमार्जनम् /
text_mt: Having placed the utensils for bringing forward the fire near the śālāmukhīya fire, he sets out the animal-sacrifice utensils in the old hall: to the south of the sruva ladle, the operating spoon. Its first cleansing is silent.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ājyagrahebhyaḥ /
meaning: सिद्धम् आज्यग्रहेभ्यः /
text_mt: The procedure up to the scoops of clarified butter is established.

sanskrit_iast: caturgṛhītāny ājyāni pṛṣadājyavanti gṛhṇāti /
meaning: चतुर्गृहीतान्य् आज्यानि पृषदाज्यवन्ति गृह्णाति /
text_mt: He takes four scoops of clarified butter together with the speckled butter.

sanskrit_iast: brahmaṇa upasthe rājānam ādadhāti yajamānāya vā //
meaning: ब्रह्मण उपस्थे राजानम् आदधाति यजमानाय वा //
text_mt: He places King [Soma] in the lap of the brahman priest, or of the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: praitu brahmaṇaḥ patnī \ vedim̐ varṇena sīdatu \\ iti dīkṣitasaṃcareṇa patnīm abhyudānīya \\ athāham anugāminī \ sve loke viśa iha \\ iti paścād yajamānasyopaveśayati /
meaning: प्रैतु ब्रह्मणः पत्नी \ वेदिम्̐ वर्णेन सीदतु \\ इति दीक्षितसंचरेण पत्नीम् अभ्युदानीय \\ अथाहम् अनुगामिनी \ स्वे लोके विश इह \\ इति पश्चाद् यजमानस्योपवेशयति /
text_mt: With: "May the wife of the brahman priest come forth; may she sit upon the altar with beauty!", having led the wife forward by the consecrated one's path, with: "Now I, following along, enter here in my own world!", he makes her sit behind the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā \\ agnīṣomābhyāṃ praṇīyamānābhyām anubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
meaning: चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वा \\ अग्नीषोमाभ्यां प्रणीयमानाभ्याम् अनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: Having taken four scoops [of clarified butter], he prompts [the hotṛ]: "Recite for Agni and Soma being brought forward!"

sanskrit_iast: triranūktāyām agnipraṇayanāny udyachati /
meaning: त्रिरनूक्तायाम् अग्निप्रणयनान्य् उद्यछति /
text_mt: When it has been recited three times, he lifts up the utensils for bringing forward the fire.

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryur āgnīdhrāya pradāya prāgdaśena vāsasāmātyān yajamānaṃ ca prachādayanti /
meaning: अध्वर्युर् आग्नीध्राय प्रदाय प्राग्दशेन वाससामात्यान् यजमानं च प्रछादयन्ति /
text_mt: The adhvaryu having given [them] to the āgnīdhra priest, they cover the attendants and the sacrificer with a garment whose fringes face east.

sanskrit_iast: pumām̐so yajamānam anvārabhante striyaḥ patnīm /
meaning: पुमाम्̐सो यजमानम् अन्वारभन्ते स्त्रियः पत्नीम् /
text_mt: The men touch the sacrificer from behind; the women touch the wife.

sanskrit_iast: upasam̐yamya daśām̐ srugdaṇḍe tvam̐ soma tanūkṛdbhyas \\ iti juhoti // juṣāṇo aptur iti dvitīyām /
meaning: उपसम्̐यम्य दशाम्̐ स्रुग्दण्डे त्वम्̐ सोम तनूकृद्भ्यस् \\ इति जुहोति // जुषाणो अप्तुर् इति द्वितीयाम् /
text_mt: Having held together the fringe on the handle of the ladle, he offers with: 'You, Soma, to those who form the body...'; a second [oblation] with: 'Enjoying, quick...'

sanskrit_iast: eṣo 'ta ūrdhvaṃ gārhapatyo bhavati / tasya śītabhasmani padārdham upavapati /
meaning: एषो ऽत ऊर्ध्वं गार्हपत्यो भवति / तस्य शीतभस्मनि पदार्धम् उपवपति /
text_mt: This henceforth becomes the gārhapatya. In its cool ashes he throws half of the footprint.

sanskrit_iast: agnim agrato nayanti / yasyopasthe so 'nantarā rājānam anupaścād ājyāny āsandīṃ grāvavāyavyāni droṇakalaśam ajaṃ cāgnīṣomīyam anunayanti /
meaning: अग्निम् अग्रतो नयन्ति / यस्योपस्थे सो ऽनन्तरा राजानम् अनुपश्चाद् आज्यान्य् आसन्दीं ग्राववायव्यानि द्रोणकलशम् अजं चाग्नीषोमीयम् अनुनयन्ति /
text_mt: They lead the fire ahead. The one in whose lap [King Soma is placed], immediately after him they bring King [Soma]; following behind, the clarified butters, the low stool, the pressing stones, the vāyavya cups, the droṇakalaśa trough, and the goat for Agni and Soma.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇa sado yanti /
meaning: उत्तरेण सदो यन्ति /

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhrīye dhiṣṇye 'gniṃ nidhāya \\ agne naya \\ ity abhijuhoti /
meaning: आग्नीध्रीये धिष्ण्ये ऽग्निं निधाय \\ अग्ने नय \\ इत्य् अभिजुहोति /
text_mt: Having placed the fire on the āgnīdhra hearth, he offers over it with: 'O Agni, lead...'

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhre yajñapātrāṇi sādayaty āsandīṃ grāvavāyavyāni droṇakalaśam ajaṃ ca badhnāti /
meaning: आग्नीध्रे यज्ञपात्राणि सादयत्य् आसन्दीं ग्राववायव्यानि द्रोणकलशम् अजं च बध्नाति /
text_mt: In the āgnīdhra shed he sets down the sacrificial utensils: the low stool, the pressing stones, the vāyavya cups, the droṇakalaśa trough, and ties the goat.

sanskrit_iast: brahmā rājānam ādāya paścād dhavirdhānayor avatiṣṭhate /
meaning: ब्रह्मा राजानम् आदाय पश्चाद् धविर्धानयोर् अवतिष्ठते /
text_mt: The brahman priest, having taken King [Soma], stands behind the two havirdhāna carts.

sanskrit_iast: ājyair uttaravedyanta uru viṣṇo vikramasva \\ ity āhavanīye hutvāgrāṇy upapāyya paścād uttaraveder ekavṛd barhiḥ stṛṇāti /
meaning: आज्यैर् उत्तरवेद्यन्त उरु विष्णो विक्रमस्व \\ इत्य् आहवनीये हुत्वाग्राण्य् उपपाय्य पश्चाद् उत्तरवेदेर् एकवृद् बर्हिः स्तृणाति /
text_mt: Having offered on the āhavanīya fire with clarified butters near the border of the uttaravedi with: 'Stride widely, O Viṣṇu...', making the tips drink [the butter], he spreads a single layer of barhis behind the uttaravedi.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ājyānām̐ sādanāt //
meaning: सिद्धम् आज्यानाम्̐ सादनात् //
text_mt: [The procedure is] established up to the placing of the clarified butters.

sanskrit_iast: evā vandasva \\ iti pūrvayā dvārā yajamānaḥ prapadyate 'parayādhvaryū rājānam atiharati //
meaning: एवा वन्दस्व \\ इति पूर्वया द्वारा यजमानः प्रपद्यते ऽपरयाध्वर्यू राजानम् अतिहरति //
text_mt: With: 'Praise thus...', the sacrificer enters by the eastern door; the two adhvaryus carry King [Soma] across by the western [door].

sanskrit_iast: urv antarikṣam̐ vīhi \\ iti dakṣiṇam ano 'bhipravrajya pūrvārdhe nīḍe \\ adityās tvag asi \\ iti kṛṣṇājinam āstṛṇāti //
meaning: उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम्̐ वीहि \\ इति दक्षिणम् अनो ऽभिप्रव्रज्य पूर्वार्धे नीडे \\ अदित्यास् त्वग् असि \\ इति कृष्णाजिनम् आस्तृणाति //
text_mt: Having stepped forward to the southern cart with: 'Go through the wide intermediate space...', he spreads the black antelope skin in the front seat with: 'You are the skin of Aditi.'

sanskrit_iast: adityāḥ sada āsīda \\ iti tasmin rājānam āsādayati //
meaning: अदित्याः सद आसीद \\ इति तस्मिन् राजानम् आसादयति //
text_mt: With: 'Sit on the seat of Aditi', he sets down King [Soma] upon it.

sanskrit_iast: deva savitar eṣa te somas \\ iti japati \\ etat tvaṃ deva soma \\ iti yajamānaḥ //
meaning: देव सवितर् एष ते सोमस् \\ इति जपति \\ एतत् त्वं देव सोम \\ इति यजमानः //
text_mt: With: 'O god Savitṛ, this is your Soma...', he mutters; the sacrificer [mutters] with: 'This, you, O divine Soma...'

sanskrit_iast: idam ahaṃ manuṣyān ity uktvāvartate //
meaning: इदम् अहं मनुष्यान् इत्य् उक्त्वावर्तते //
text_mt: Having said: 'Here do I [turn away from] men...', he turns around.

sanskrit_iast: namo devebhyas \\ iti namaskaroti //
meaning: नमो देवेभ्यस् \\ इति नमस्करोति //
text_mt: With: 'Homage to the gods', he pays homage.

sanskrit_iast: nirvaruṇasya pāśāt \\ iti niḥsarpati //
meaning: निर्वरुणस्य पाशात् \\ इति निःसर्पति //
text_mt: With: '[Freed] from Varuṇa's noose', he creeps out.

sanskrit_iast: svar abhivyakśam ity abhivīkṣate 'gnim ādityam̐ vā //
meaning: स्वर् अभिव्यक्शम् इत्य् अभिवीक्षते ऽग्निम् आदित्यम्̐ वा //
text_mt: With: 'May I behold the light', he looks at the fire or at the sun.

sanskrit_iast: agne vratapate yā tava tanūr mayy abhūd eṣā sā tvayi \\ iti samidham ādadhāti //
meaning: अग्ने व्रतपते या तव तनूर् मय्य् अभूद् एषा सा त्वयि \\ इति समिधम् आदधाति //
text_mt: With: 'O Agni, lord of vows, what body of yours was in me, that is now in you', he lays on a kindling stick.

sanskrit_iast: agne vratapate yā mama tanūs tvayy abhūd iyam̐ sā mayi \\ iti japati //
meaning: अग्ने व्रतपते या मम तनूस् त्वय्य् अभूद् इयम्̐ सा मयि \\ इति जपति //
text_mt: He mutters: 'O Agni, lord of vows, what body of mine was in you, this is now in me.'

sanskrit_iast: punar nau vratapate \\ iti vratāni visṛjate /
meaning: पुनर् नौ व्रतपते \\ इति व्रतानि विसृजते /
text_mt: With: 'Again for both of us, O lord of vows...', he releases the vows.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇājina āsīta / yajuṣā kaṇḍūyeta / haviṣyaṃ patnī prāśnīyād dhavirucchiṣṭam̐ yajamānaḥ /
meaning: कृष्णाजिन आसीत / यजुषा कण्डूयेत / हविष्यं पत्नी प्राश्नीयाद् धविरुच्छिष्टम्̐ यजमानः /
text_mt: He should sit on the black antelope skin. He should scratch himself with the formula. The wife should eat the havis-food; the sacrificer, the remnant of the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: agreṇa havirdhāne 'pareṇa srugdaṇḍān dakṣiṇātikramyāparo brahmaṇa upaviśaty eṣa saṃcaraḥ /
meaning: अग्रेण हविर्धाने ऽपरेण स्रुग्दण्डान् दक्षिणातिक्रम्यापरो ब्रह्मण उपविशत्य् एष संचरः /
text_mt: Passing across to the south in front of the two havirdhāna carts and behind the handles of the ladles, another sits behind the brahman priest; this is the passage.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍḍhotā pāśuky ārambhaṇīyā dakṣiṇādānaṃ parāṅgabhūteṣu nivarteta /
meaning: षड्ढोता पाशुक्य् आरम्भणीया दक्षिणादानं पराङ्गभूतेषु निवर्तेत /
text_mt: The ṣaḍḍhotṛ formula, the introductory offering of the animal sacrifice, and the giving of dakṣiṇā cease when they have become secondary limbs [of the Soma sacrifice].

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣitasya cet prāk krayād yūpam achaiyāt /
meaning: दीक्षितस्य चेत् प्राक् क्रयाद् यूपम् अछैयात् /
text_mt: If, while he is consecrated, he should go fetch the sacrificial post before the purchase [of Soma],

sanskrit_iast: sruvam araṇī cādāya yūpasyānte 'gniṃ mathitvā yūpāhutiṃ juhuyāt /
meaning: स्रुवम् अरणी चादाय यूपस्यान्ते ऽग्निं मथित्वा यूपाहुतिं जुहुयात् /
text_mt: taking the dipping spoon and the two churning sticks, churning out fire near the sacrificial post, he should offer the post-libation.

sanskrit_iast: krīte ced āhavanīye hutvā yūpāvatāprabhṛti siddham opākaraṇāt /
meaning: क्रीते चेद् आहवनीये हुत्वा यूपावताप्रभृति सिद्धम् ओपाकरणात् /
text_mt: If [Soma has been] purchased, having offered on the āhavanīya fire, [the ritual] from the hole for the sacrificial post onward is established up to the dedication [of the victim].

sanskrit_iast: agnīṣomīyam ajam upākaroti /
meaning: अग्नीषोमीयम् अजम् उपाकरोति /
text_mt: He dedicates the goat for Agni and Soma.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā pravarāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ प्रवरात् /

sanskrit_iast: pravṛte maitrāvaruṇāya dīkṣitadaṇḍaṃ prayachati /
meaning: प्रवृते मैत्रावरुणाय दीक्षितदण्डं प्रयछति /
text_mt: When the chosen [priests have been chosen], he hands the staff of the consecrated one to the maitrāvaruṇa.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā vapāyā homāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ वपाया होमात् /

sanskrit_iast: hutāyām̐ vapāyāṃ cātvāle mārjayitvā subrahmaṇya subrahmaṇyām āhvaya \\ iti preṣyati / pitāputrīyām̐ subrahmaṇyām āhvayati /
meaning: हुतायाम्̐ वपायां चात्वाले मार्जयित्वा सुब्रह्मण्य सुब्रह्मण्याम् आह्वय \\ इति प्रेष्यति / पितापुत्रीयाम्̐ सुब्रह्मण्याम् आह्वयति /
text_mt: When the omentum has been offered, having purified themselves at the cātvāla pit, he gives the call: 'O subrahmaṇya, call out the subrahmaṇyā formula!' He calls out the pitāputrīya subrahmaṇyā formula.

sanskrit_iast: nāgnīṣomīye hṛdayaśūlaṃ karoti na savanīye /
meaning: नाग्नीषोमीये हृदयशूलं करोति न सवनीये /
text_mt: He does not make the heart-spit for the victim for Agni and Soma, nor for the savanīya victim.

sanskrit_iast: na svarum anupraharati /
meaning: न स्वरुम् अनुप्रहरति /
text_mt: He does not throw the sacrificial chip into the fire afterwards.

sanskrit_iast: nāntarāpo devayajanaṃ ca panthā vyaveyāt /
meaning: नान्तरापो देवयजनं च पन्था व्यवेयात् /
text_mt: No path should pass between the waters and the sacrificial ground.

sanskrit_iast: prāg astamayān niṣkramya vasatīvarīr gṛhṇāti /
meaning: प्राग् अस्तमयान् निष्क्रम्य वसतीवरीर् गृह्णाति /
text_mt: Going out before sunset, he takes the vasatīvarī waters.

sanskrit_iast: vahantīnāṃ pratīpastiṣṭhan haviṣmatīr imā āpas \\ iti pratīpaṃ kalaśam upamārayati chāyātapayoḥ saṃdhāv apidhāya darbhaiḥ pāṇinā vā //
meaning: वहन्तीनां प्रतीपस्तिष्ठन् हविष्मतीर् इमा आपस् \\ इति प्रतीपं कलशम् उपमारयति छायातपयोः संधाव् अपिधाय दर्भैः पाणिना वा //
text_mt: Standing against the current of the flowing [waters], with: 'Rich in oblation are these waters...', he pushes the jar against the current, covering it at the junction of shade and sunlight with darbha grass or with his hand.

sanskrit_iast: agner vo 'pannagṛhasya sadasi sādayāmi \\ iti paścāc chālāmukhīyasya sādayati /
meaning: अग्नेर् वो ऽपन्नगृहस्य सदसि सादयामि \\ इति पश्चाच् छालामुखीयस्य सादयति /
text_mt: With: 'I place you in the seat of Agni of fallen home...', he sets it down behind the śālāmukhīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: yady astamitaḥ syāt somayājinaḥ kumbhād gṛhṇīyāt /
meaning: यद्य् अस्तमितः स्यात् सोमयाजिनः कुम्भाद् गृह्णीयात् /
text_mt: If [the sun] has set, he should take [them] from the jar of one who has performed a Soma sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: somayājinaṃ cen na vinded dhiraṇyam̐ haste syād agnim upariṣṭād dhārayeyur atha gṛhṇīyāt /
meaning: सोमयाजिनं चेन् न विन्देद् धिरण्यम्̐ हस्ते स्याद् अग्निम् उपरिष्टाद् धारयेयुर् अथ गृह्णीयात् /
text_mt: If he does not find one who has performed a Soma sacrifice, gold should be in his hand, they should hold fire above, and then he should take [them].

sanskrit_iast: yad dakṣiṇāsv adāsyan syāt tasyādhvaryave varaṃ dadyāt /
meaning: यद् दक्षिणास्व् अदास्यन् स्यात् तस्याध्वर्यवे वरं दद्यात् /
text_mt: Whatever he would not give among the sacrificial gifts, he should give a boon of that to the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: paśupuroḍāśaprabhṛti siddham ā paśviḍāyāḥ /
meaning: पशुपुरोडाशप्रभृति सिद्धम् आ पश्विडायाः /
text_mt: Beginning from the animal cake, [the procedure is] established up to the animal iḍā.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇena havirdhānamārjālīyamaitrāvaruṇīyānām atihṛtya hotre paśviḍāṃ prayachati /
meaning: दक्षिणेन हविर्धानमार्जालीयमैत्रावरुणीयानाम् अतिहृत्य होत्रे पश्विडां प्रयछति /
text_mt: Having carried it across to the south of the havirdhāna shed, the mārjālīya, and the maitrāvaruṇa hearth, he gives the animal iḍā to the hotṛ.

sanskrit_iast: siddham opayaḍbhyaḥ /
meaning: सिद्धम् ओपयड्भ्यः /

sanskrit_iast: śāmitrīyād aṅgārān āgnīdhro hotrīye nivapati /
meaning: शामित्रीयाद् अङ्गारान् आग्नीध्रो होत्रीये निवपति /
text_mt: The āgnīdhra priest pours embers from the śāmitra fire onto the hotṛ's hearth.

sanskrit_iast: iḍāpathena gudajāghanī harati /
meaning: इडापथेन गुदजाघनी हरति /
text_mt: He carries the rectum and the tail along the path of the iḍā.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā sam̐srāvabhāgebhyaḥ /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ सम्̐स्रावभागेभ्यः /
text_mt: [The procedure is] established up to the portions of the tricklings.

sanskrit_iast: sarvāḥ srucaḥ saṃpragṛhṇāti /
meaning: सर्वाः स्रुचः संप्रगृह्णाति /
text_mt: He holds together all the ladles.

sanskrit_iast: naktaṃ patnīsam̐yājāntaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate /
meaning: नक्तं पत्नीसम्̐याजान्तः संतिष्ठते /
text_mt: At night, [the rite] concludes ending with the patnīsaṃyāja offerings.

sanskrit_iast: pāśubnadhikam idhmābarhiḥ saṃnahyati /
meaning: पाशुब्नधिकम् इध्माबर्हिः संनह्यति /
text_mt: He ties up the fuel and sacrificial grass for the animal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: yā yajamānasya vratadhuktām āśire duhanti yā pantyās tāṃ maitrāvaruṇyai payasyāyai yā pravargyasya tāṃ dadhigharmāya /
meaning: या यजमानस्य व्रतधुक्ताम् आशिरे दुहन्ति या पन्त्यास् तां मैत्रावरुण्यै पयस्यायै या प्रवर्ग्यस्य तां दधिघर्माय /
text_mt: The milk of the cow giving milk for the sacrificer's vow, they milk for the hot milk mixture; that of the wife's, for the curd offering for Mitra and Varuṇa; that of the pravargya, for the sour-milk draught.

sanskrit_iast: payām̐si viśiṣya nidadhyād dadhi dadhigrahāya / śṛtaśītaṃ maitrāvaruṇāya / hiraṇyaśakalau śukrāya / saktūn manthine / taptātaṅkyaśītātaṅkye dadhinī ādityagrahāya / dhānā hāriyojanāya /
meaning: पयाम्̐सि विशिष्य निदध्याद् दधि दधिग्रहाय / शृतशीतं मैत्रावरुणाय / हिरण्यशकलौ शुक्राय / सक्तून् मन्थिने / तप्तातङ्क्यशीतातङ्क्ये दधिनी आदित्यग्रहाय / धाना हारियोजनाय /
text_mt: Having separated the milks, he should deposit them: curd for the dadhigraha cup; boiled and cooled [milk] for the maitrāvaruṇa cup; two pieces of gold for the śukra cup; barley meal for the manthin cup; warm-curdled and cold-curdled curds for the ādityagraha cup; parched grains for the hāriyojana cup.

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhre yajñapātrāṇi vāsayati / tasmin yajamāno jāgrad upavasati prāgvam̐śe patnī /
meaning: आग्नीध्रे यज्ञपात्राणि वासयति / तस्मिन् यजमानो जाग्रद् उपवसति प्राग्वम्̐शे पत्नी /
text_mt: He keeps the sacrificial utensils overnight in the āgnīdhra shed. In it the sacrificer, remaining awake, fasts; the wife in the eastern hall.

sanskrit_iast: niśāyām̐ vasatīvarīḥ pariharati / nādīkṣitam abhiparihareyuḥ /
meaning: निशायाम्̐ वसतीवरीः परिहरति / नादीक्षितम् अभिपरिहरेयुः /
text_mt: At night he carries the vasatīvarī waters around. They should not carry them around past anyone who is not consecrated.

sanskrit_iast: antarvedi tiṣṭhed yajamānaḥ patnī ca /
meaning: अन्तर्वेदि तिष्ठेद् यजमानः पत्नी च /
text_mt: The sacrificer and the wife should stand inside the vedi.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvayā dvārā praviśya vasatīvarīr gṛhṇāti /
meaning: पूर्वया द्वारा प्रविश्य वसतीवरीर् गृह्णाति /
text_mt: Entering by the eastern door, he takes the vasatīvarī waters.

sanskrit_iast: apareṇa vihāraṃ dakṣiṇātikramya pūrvayā dvārā niḥsṛtya dakṣiṇena sadomārjālīyahavirdhānaṃ gatvā \\ indrāgnyor bhāgadheyīḥ stha \\ iti dakṣiṇasyām uttaravediśroṇau sādayati / yathetaṃ pratyetya pūrvayā dvārā niḥsṛtyottareṇa sadaāgnīdhrīyahavirdhānaṃ gatvā mitrāvaruṇayor bhāgadheyīḥ stha \\ ity uttarasyām uttaravediśroṇau sādayati viśveṣāṃ devānām ity āgnīdhre // sumnāyuvas \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati //
meaning: अपरेण विहारं दक्षिणातिक्रम्य पूर्वया द्वारा निःसृत्य दक्षिणेन सदोमार्जालीयहविर्धानं गत्वा \\ इन्द्राग्न्योर् भागधेयीः स्थ \\ इति दक्षिणस्याम् उत्तरवेदिश्रोणौ सादयति / यथेतं प्रत्येत्य पूर्वया द्वारा निःसृत्योत्तरेण सदआग्नीध्रीयहविर्धानं गत्वा मित्रावरुणयोर् भागधेयीः स्थ \\ इत्य् उत्तरस्याम् उत्तरवेदिश्रोणौ सादयति विश्वेषां देवानाम् इत्य् आग्नीध्रे // सुम्नायुवस् \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति //
text_mt: Having stepped across to the south behind the sacrificial enclosure, gone out by the eastern door, and gone south of the sadas, mārjālīya, and havirdhāna shed, he sets them down on the southern hip of the uttaravedi with: 'You are the shares of Indra and Agni.' Having returned the way he came, gone out by the eastern door, and gone north of the sadas, āgnīdhra hearth, and havirdhāna shed, he sets them down on the northern hip of the uttaravedi with: 'You are the shares of Mitra and Varuṇa'; on the āgnīdhra hearth with: '[You are the shares] of the All-Gods'. Everywhere he attaches: 'Desiring favor...'

sanskrit_iast: subrahmaṇya subrahmaṇyām āhvaya \\ iti preṣyati / pitāputrīyām̐ subrahmaṇyām āhvayatyāhvayati /
meaning: सुब्रह्मण्य सुब्रह्मण्याम् आह्वय \\ इति प्रेष्यति / पितापुत्रीयाम्̐ सुब्रह्मण्याम् आह्वयत्याह्वयति /
text_mt: He gives the call: 'O subrahmaṇya, call out the subrahmaṇyā formula!' He calls out, calls out the pitāputrīya subrahmaṇyā formula.

sanskrit_iast: upatiṣṭhate vyuchantyām aindryā sada āgneyyāgnīdhram̐ vaiṣṇavyā havirdhānam //
meaning: उपतिष्ठते व्युछन्त्याम् ऐन्द्र्या सद आग्नेय्याग्नीध्रम्̐ वैष्णव्या हविर्धानम् //
text_mt: At dawn he attends: the sadas with a verse to Indra, the āgnīdhra hearth with a verse to Agni, the havirdhāna shed with a verse to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast: āsanyān mā mantrāt pāhi purā kasyāś cid abhiśastyās \\ ity āgnīdhrīye juhoti /
meaning: आसन्यान् मा मन्त्रात् पाहि पुरा कस्याश् चिद् अभिशस्त्यास् \\ इत्य् आग्नीध्रीये जुहोति /
text_mt: He offers on the āgnīdhra hearth with: 'Protect me from formula from the mouth, before any reproach whatsoever...'

sanskrit_iast: uttarata āhavanīyasyedhmābarhir upasādayati /
meaning: उत्तरत आहवनीयस्येध्माबर्हिर् उपसादयति /
text_mt: He deposits the sacrificial fuel and barhis north of the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: pāṇī prakṣālayate 'dhvaryuḥ pratiprasthātā ca /
meaning: पाणी प्रक्षालयते ऽध्वर्युः प्रतिप्रस्थाता च /
text_mt: The adhvaryu and the pratiprasthātṛ wash their hands.

sanskrit_iast: paścād āgnīdhrīyasya pāśukāni pātrāṇi prayunakti prāgvam̐śe 'parāṇi / sruvād dakṣiṇām̐ srucam̐ pracaraṇīṃ tasyāḥ prathamaṃ tūṣṇīm̐ saṃmārjanam //
meaning: पश्चाद् आग्नीध्रीयस्य पाशुकानि पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति प्राग्वम्̐शे ऽपराणि / स्रुवाद् दक्षिणाम्̐ स्रुचम्̐ प्रचरणीं तस्याः प्रथमं तूष्णीम्̐ संमार्जनम् //
text_mt: Behind the āgnīdhra hearth he arranges the animal vessels; in the eastern hall, the others. To the south of the dipping-spoon, [he places] the operating ladle; its cleansing is first [performed] silently.

sanskrit_iast: agne tvaṃ pārayā \\ ity etayā sruca upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: अग्ने त्वं पारया \\ इत्य् एतया स्रुच उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: He attends upon the ladles with: 'Agni, do you deliver...'

sanskrit_iast: siddham ājyagrahebhyaḥ /
meaning: सिद्धम् आज्यग्रहेभ्यः /
text_mt: [The procedure] up to the drawings of clarified butter is established.

sanskrit_iast: yathā pūrvedyur āgnīdhrīye tu srucām̐ saṃmārjanam ājyānāṃ grahaṇaṃ ca /
meaning: यथा पूर्वेद्युर् आग्नीध्रीये तु स्रुचाम्̐ संमार्जनम् आज्यानां ग्रहणं च /
text_mt: Just as on the preceding day, but the cleansing of the ladles and the drawing of the portions of clarified butter [take place] at the āgnīdhra hearth.

sanskrit_iast: uttaravedyanta ājyāny abhyudāharanti /
meaning: उत्तरवेद्यन्त आज्यान्य् अभ्युदाहरन्ति /
text_mt: They carry the portions of clarified butter up to the border of the high altar.

sanskrit_iast: udīraṇaprabhṛti siddham ā staraṇāt /
meaning: उदीरणप्रभृति सिद्धम् आ स्तरणात् /
text_mt: From the lifting [of the grass] onward, [the procedure] is established up to the strewing.

sanskrit_iast: barhiṣa itarārdham̐ saprastaraṃ dakṣiṇataḥpurastāt kharasya stīrtvā tasmin srucaḥ sādayati //
meaning: बर्हिष इतरार्धम्̐ सप्रस्तरं दक्षिणतःपुरस्तात् खरस्य स्तीर्त्वा तस्मिन् स्रुचः सादयति //
text_mt: Having strewn the other half of the sacrificial grass along with the sacred grass bundle to the south-east of the mound, he sets down the ladles upon it.

sanskrit_iast: yunajmi te pṛthivīṃ jyotiṣā saha \\ iti dhruvām abhimṛśati yunajmi vāyum antarikṣeṇa tena saha \\ ity upabhṛtam \\ yunajmi vācam̐ saha divā saha sūryeṇa tena saha \\ iti juhūm \\ yunajmi tisro vivṛtaḥ sūryasya te \\ iti sarvāḥ /
meaning: युनज्मि ते पृथिवीं ज्योतिषा सह \\ इति ध्रुवाम् अभिमृशति युनज्मि वायुम् अन्तरिक्षेण तेन सह \\ इत्य् उपभृतम् \\ युनज्मि वाचम्̐ सह दिवा सह सूर्येण तेन सह \\ इति जुहूम् \\ युनज्मि तिस्रो विवृतः सूर्यस्य ते \\ इति सर्वाः /
text_mt: With 'I harness thy earth together with the light', he touches the dhruvā ladle; with 'I harness the wind together with the intermediate space', the upabhṛt ladle; with 'I harness speech together with heaven, together with the sun', the juhū ladle; with 'I harness the three folds of the sun for thee', all of them.

sanskrit_iast: vāyavyāny ūrdhvapātrāṇi prādeśamātrāṇi sam̐saktamadhyāni tṛtīyoduptāni //
meaning: वायव्यान्य् ऊर्ध्वपात्राणि प्रादेशमात्राणि सम्̐सक्तमध्यानि तृतीयोदुप्तानि //
text_mt: The vāyavya cups are upright vessels, a span in size, constricted in the middle, hollowed out to one-third.

sanskrit_iast: ko vo yunakti sa vo yunaktu \\ iti khare pātrāṇi prayunakti / dakṣiṇasminn am̐se dadhigrahapātram audumbaraṃ catuḥsrakty uttarasminn upām̐śvantaryāmayor dakṣiṇam upām̐śupātraṃ tayor madhya upām̐śusavanaṃ grāvāṇam /
meaning: को वो युनक्ति स वो युनक्तु \\ इति खरे पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति / दक्षिणस्मिन्न् अम्̐से दधिग्रहपात्रम् औदुम्बरं चतुःस्रक्त्य् उत्तरस्मिन्न् उपाम्̐श्वन्तर्यामयोर् दक्षिणम् उपाम्̐शुपात्रं तयोर् मध्य उपाम्̐शुसवनं ग्रावाणम् /
text_mt: With 'Who harnesses you? May he harness you', he arranges the vessels on the mound: on the southern shoulder, the vessel for the curds cup made of udumbara wood, four-cornered; on the northern, of the upāṃśu and antaryāma cups, the southern is the upāṃśu cup; between them, the pressing stone for the upāṃśu [offering].

sanskrit_iast: aparāṇi dvidevatyapātrāṇi parisragaindravāyavasyājāgalaṃ maitrāvaruṇasya vikarṇam āśvinasya / dakṣiṇottare śukrāmanthinor bailvam̐ śukrasya dakṣiṇam̐ vaikaṅkatam uttaraṃ manthina / āśvatthe ṛtupātre aśvaśaphabudhne yathā srugubhayatomukhe tayor dakṣiṇam adhvaryupātram uttaraṃ pratiprasthātur dakṣiṇasyām̐ śroṇāv āgrāyaṇasthālīm uttarasyām ukthyasthālīm ukthyapātraṃ ca tribhṛṣṭhy aśvaśaphabudhnam agreṇopastambhanam ādityasthālīm ādityapātraṃ cāṣṭābhṛṣṭi / khādiram̐ ṣoḍaśipātraṃ catuḥsrakti /
meaning: अपराणि द्विदेवत्यपात्राणि परिस्रगैन्द्रवायवस्याजागलं मैत्रावरुणस्य विकर्णम् आश्विनस्य / दक्षिणोत्तरे शुक्रामन्थिनोर् बैल्वम्̐ शुक्रस्य दक्षिणम्̐ वैकङ्कतम् उत्तरं मन्थिन / आश्वत्थे ऋतुपात्रे अश्वशफबुध्ने यथा स्रुगुभयतोमुखे तयोर् दक्षिणम् अध्वर्युपात्रम् उत्तरं प्रतिप्रस्थातुर् दक्षिणस्याम्̐ श्रोणाव् आग्रायणस्थालीम् उत्तरस्याम् उक्थ्यस्थालीम् उक्थ्यपात्रं च त्रिभृष्ठ्य् अश्वशफबुध्नम् अग्रेणोपस्तम्भनम् आदित्यस्थालीम् आदित्यपात्रं चाष्टाभृष्टि / खादिरम्̐ षोडशिपात्रं चतुःस्रक्ति /
text_mt: The other cups for two deities: the one for Indra-Vāyu has a rim around it; the one for Mitra-Varuṇa is goat-throated; the one for the Aśvins is ear-shaped. The southern and northern of the śukra and manthin cups: the southern one made of bilva wood is for the śukra cup, the northern one made of vikaṅkata wood is for the manthin cup. The two seasonal cups are made of aśvattha wood, shaped like a horse's hoof at the bottom, double-spouted like a ladle; of the two, the southern is the adhvaryu priest's vessel, the northern is the pratiprasthātṛ priest's; on the southern hip [is] the āgrāyaṇa vessel; on the northern, the ukthya vessel and the ukthya cup, three-cornered and shaped like a horse's hoof at the bottom; in front of the prop, the āditya vessel and the āditya cup, eight-cornered; the vessel for the ṣoḍaśin cup is made of khadira wood, four-cornered.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyav āyāhi darśata\ ime somā araṃkṛtāḥ / \ teṣāṃ pāhi śrudhī havam //
iti vāyavyāny upatiṣṭhate /
meaning:
वायव् आयाहि दर्शत\ इमे सोमा अरंकृताः / \ तेषां पाहि श्रुधी हवम् //
इति वायव्यान्य् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt:
'Come, O visible Vāyu, these somas are prepared; drink of them, listen to our call!'

With this [verse] he attends upon the vāyavya cups.

sanskrit_iast: uttarasya havirdhānasyāgreṇopastambhanaṃ dhruvasthālīm /
meaning: उत्तरस्य हविर्धानस्याग्रेणोपस्तम्भनं ध्रुवस्थालीम् /
text_mt: In front of the prop of the northern cart [he places] the dhruva vessel.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya paścādakṣam̐ satsaruṃ droṇakalaśaṃ / tasminn avadadhāti pariplavām̐ srucam adaṇḍikāṃ / daśāpavitre ca śuklānām ūrṇānām amātyote yajamānasyāratnimātraṃ pavitraṃ prādeśamātrī daśā /
meaning: दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य पश्चादक्षम्̐ सत्सरुं द्रोणकलशं / तस्मिन्न् अवदधाति परिप्लवाम्̐ स्रुचम् अदण्डिकां / दशापवित्रे च शुक्लानाम् ऊर्णानाम् अमात्योते यजमानस्यारत्निमात्रं पवित्रं प्रादेशमात्री दशा /
text_mt: Behind the axle of the southern cart, the droṇakalaśa trough with a handle. In it he places the handleless ladle used for dipping, and the woollen strainer made of white wool woven by unmarried girls, [consisting of] the strainer measuring a cubit of the sacrificer and a fringe measuring a span.

sanskrit_iast: uttarasyādhastāt savanīyakalaśān prayunakti sthaviṣṭhaṃ prātaḥsavanikaṃ paścārdhaṃ pūrvaṃ mādhyaṃdinīyaṃ pūrvārdhaṃ tārtīyasavanikam agniṣṭome hrasiṣṭham ukthyād ūrdhvam̐ varṣiṣṭhaṃ / nīḍa ādhavanīyaṃ / pradhure pūtabhṛtam /
meaning: उत्तरस्याधस्तात् सवनीयकलशान् प्रयुनक्ति स्थविष्ठं प्रातःसवनिकं पश्चार्धं पूर्वं माध्यंदिनीयं पूर्वार्धं तार्तीयसवनिकम् अग्निष्टोमे ह्रसिष्ठम् उक्थ्याद् ऊर्ध्वम्̐ वर्षिष्ठं / नीड आधवनीयं / प्रधुरे पूतभृतम् /
text_mt: Beneath the northern [cart] he arranges the tubs for the soma pressings: the thickest for the morning pressing in the western half; the one for the midday pressing in front [of it]; the one for the third pressing in the eastern half; in an agniṣṭoma the shortest, beyond an ukthya the tallest. In the cart-box, the ādhavanīya vessel; at the front pole, the pūtabhṛt vessel.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇasyāvālambe daśa camasān naiyagrodhān rauhitakān vā nānālakṣaṇān tsarumataḥ //
meaning: दक्षिणस्यावालम्बे दश चमसान् नैयग्रोधान् रौहितकान् वा नानालक्षणान् त्सरुमतः //
text_mt: On the peg of the southern [cart], ten cups made of nyagrodha or rohitaka wood, marked with various signs, provided with handles.

sanskrit_iast: rakṣoghno vo valagaghnaḥ sam̐sādāmi vaiṣṇavān ity adhiṣavaṇe pañca grāvṇaḥ prayunakti teṣām upalaḥ sthaviṣṭho madhye 'bhimukhān itarān /
meaning: रक्षोघ्नो वो वलगघ्नः सम्̐सादामि वैष्णवान् इत्य् अधिषवणे पञ्च ग्राव्णः प्रयुनक्ति तेषाम् उपलः स्थविष्ठो मध्ये ऽभिमुखान् इतरान् /
text_mt: With 'Killing the Rakṣases, killing the charms, I set you down, belonging to Viṣṇu', he arranges five pressing stones on the pressing board: among them, the thickest pestle-stone in the middle, and the others facing it.

sanskrit_iast: vāsasā rājānam atihṛtyāntareṇeṣe hṛde tvā \ manase tvā \\ iti grāvasūpāvaharati /
meaning: वाससा राजानम् अतिहृत्यान्तरेणेषे हृदे त्वा \ मनसे त्वा \\ इति ग्रावसूपावहरति /
text_mt: Having carried the king [Soma] across with the cloth between the two shafts, he brings him down onto the stones with: 'For desire! For thy heart! For thy mind!'

sanskrit_iast: saptahotrā yajamāno 'bhimṛśati /
meaning: सप्तहोत्रा यजमानो ऽभिमृशति /
text_mt: The sacrificer touches him with the seven-hotṛ formula.

sanskrit_iast: vyuṣṭāyāṃ purā vācaḥ pravaditoḥ prātaranuvākam upākaroti /
meaning: व्युष्टायां पुरा वाचः प्रवदितोः प्रातरनुवाकम् उपाकरोति /
text_mt: At dawn, before speech begins to sound, he undertakes the morning recitation.

sanskrit_iast: devebhyaḥ prātaryāvabhyo 'nubrūhi \ brahman vācam̐ yacha \ subrahmaṇya subrahmaṇyām āhvaya \ pratiprasthātaḥ savanīyān nirvapasva \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: देवेभ्यः प्रातर्यावभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \ ब्रह्मन् वाचम्̐ यछ \ सुब्रह्मण्य सुब्रह्मण्याम् आह्वय \ प्रतिप्रस्थातः सवनीयान् निर्वपस्व \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He gives the calls: 'Recite for the gods who come early! Brahman, restrain speech! Subrahmaṇya, call out the Subrahmaṇyā litany! Pratiprasthātṛ, apportion [the ingredients for] the pressing oblations!'

sanskrit_iast: prāgvam̐śe pratiprasthātā savanīyān nirvapatīndrāya harivate yavān dhānābhya indrāya pūṣaṇvate karambhāyendrāya sarasvatīvate bhāratīvate parivāpāyendrāya vrīhīn puroḍāśāya /
meaning: प्राग्वम्̐शे प्रतिप्रस्थाता सवनीयान् निर्वपतीन्द्राय हरिवते यवान् धानाभ्य इन्द्राय पूषण्वते करम्भायेन्द्राय सरस्वतीवते भारतीवते परिवापायेन्द्राय व्रीहीन् पुरोडाशाय /
text_mt: In the eastern hall the pratiprasthātṛ priest apportions [the materials for] the pressing oblations: barley for the parched grains for Indra accompanied by the bay steeds; for Indra accompanied by Pūṣan, for the groats; for Indra accompanied by Sarasvatī and accompanied by Bhāratī, for the fried grains; rice for Indra, for the sacrificial cake.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭākapālaḥ pātaḥsavanika ekādaśakapālo mādhyaṃdinīyo dvādaśakapālas tārtīyasavanikaḥ /
meaning: अष्टाकपालः पातःसवनिक एकादशकपालो माध्यंदिनीयो द्वादशकपालस् तार्तीयसवनिकः /
text_mt: The morning pressing [cake] is on eight potsherds; the midday one on eleven potsherds; the third pressing one on twelve potsherds.

sanskrit_iast: ekadugdha āmikṣāṃ karoti / nottarayoḥ savanayoḥ payasyā /
meaning: एकदुग्ध आमिक्षां करोति / नोत्तरयोः सवनयोः पयस्या /
text_mt: With the milk of one cow he prepares the clotted curds; at the latter two pressings there is no curd offering.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ādhiśrayaṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आधिश्रयणात् /

sanskrit_iast: bhṛjyamānāsu paryagniṃ karoti /
meaning: भृज्यमानासु पर्यग्निं करोति /
text_mt: While [the grains] are being roasted, he carries fire around them.

sanskrit_iast: dhānānāṃ dvibhāgaṃ pinaṣṭi //
meaning: धानानां द्विभागं पिनष्टि //
text_mt: He grinds two parts of the parched grains.

sanskrit_iast: abhūd uṣā ruśat paśur ity ucyamāne śṛṇotv agniḥ samidhā havaṃ me \\ iti pracaraṇyā juhoti /
meaning: अभूद् उषा रुशत् पशुर् इत्य् उच्यमाने शृणोत्व् अग्निः समिधा हवं मे \\ इति प्रचरण्या जुहोति /
text_mt: While 'Dawn has appeared, the gleaming beast...' is being recited, he offers with the operating ladle: 'May Agni with his fuel hear my call...'

sanskrit_iast: tasyāṃ punar gṛhītvā \\ apa iṣya hotar \ maitrāvaruṇasya camasādhvarya ādrava \\ ekadhanina eta \ neṣṭaḥ patnīm abhyudānaya \ pratiprasthātar vasatīvarīṇām̐ hotṛcamasaṃ pūrayitvā dakṣiṇena hotāram abhiprayamya cātvālānte pratyupāsva \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: तस्यां पुनर् गृहीत्वा \\ अप इष्य होतर् \ मैत्रावरुणस्य चमसाध्वर्य आद्रव \\ एकधनिन एत \ नेष्टः पत्नीम् अभ्युदानय \ प्रतिप्रस्थातर् वसतीवरीणाम्̐ होतृचमसं पूरयित्वा दक्षिणेन होतारम् अभिप्रयम्य चात्वालान्ते प्रत्युपास्व \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Taking [clarified butter] again in it, he gives the order: 'Send out the waters, O hotṛ! Camasādhvaryu priest of the Maitrāva-ruṇa, run forth! Come, drawers of the single-vessel waters! Neṣṭṛ, lead forth the wife! Pratiprasthātṛ, having filled the hotṛ's cup with the vasatīvarī waters and having carried it forward to the south of the hotṛ, wait near the edge of the pit!'

sanskrit_iast: yathāpreṣitaṃ cātvālam abhyudāyanti //
meaning: यथाप्रेषितं चात्वालम् अभ्युदायन्ति //
text_mt: As ordered, they go forward to the pit.

sanskrit_iast: ekadhaninas \\ iti savanīyakalaśānām̐ saṃpraiṣaḥ /
meaning: एकधनिनस् \\ इति सवनीयकलशानाम्̐ संप्रैषः /
text_mt: 'Drawers of the single-vessel waters...' is the call for the tubs used for the pressings.

sanskrit_iast: pratiprasthātā vasatīvarīṇām̐ hotṛcamasaṃ pūrayitvā dakṣiṇena hotāram abhiprayamya cātvālānte kāṅkṣati //
meaning: प्रतिप्रस्थाता वसतीवरीणाम्̐ होतृचमसं पूरयित्वा दक्षिणेन होतारम् अभिप्रयम्य चात्वालान्ते काङ्क्षति //
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ priest, having filled the hotṛ's cup with the vasatīvarī waters and having carried it forward to the south of the hotṛ, waits at the edge of the pit.

sanskrit_iast: ehy udehi \\ agniṣ ṭe agraṃ nayatām \\ vāyuṣ ṭe madhyaṃ nayatām \\ rudrāvasṛṣṭā yuvā nāmāsi \ namas te astu \ mā mā him̐sīr iti neṣṭā patnīm abhyudānayati pānnejanapāṇinīm /
meaning: एह्य् उदेहि \\ अग्निष् टे अग्रं नयताम् \\ वायुष् टे मध्यं नयताम् \\ रुद्रावसृष्टा युवा नामासि \ नमस् ते अस्तु \ मा मा हिम्̐सीर् इति नेष्टा पत्नीम् अभ्युदानयति पान्नेजनपाणिनीम् /
text_mt: With 'Come, arise! May Agni lead thy front! May Vāyu lead thy middle! Released by Rudra, thou art young by name; homage be to thee; harm me not', the neṣṭṛ leads forth the wife holding the foot-washing water in her hand.

sanskrit_iast: yatra hotuḥ prātaranuvākam anubruvata upaśṛṇuyāt tad apo 'dhvaryur vahatīnāṃ gṛhṇīyāt /
meaning: यत्र होतुः प्रातरनुवाकम् अनुब्रुवत उपशृणुयात् तद् अपो ऽध्वर्युर् वहतीनां गृह्णीयात् /
text_mt: Where he hears the hotṛ priest reciting the morning recitation, there the adhvaryu priest should draw water from flowing [waters].

sanskrit_iast: yadi dūre syuś cātvālānte gṛhṇīyāt /
meaning: यदि दूरे स्युश् चात्वालान्ते गृह्णीयात् /
text_mt: If they are far away, he should draw them at the edge of the pit.

sanskrit_iast: apsu tṛṇaṃ prāsya devīr āpo apāṃ napād ity abhijuhoti //
meaning: अप्सु तृणं प्रास्य देवीर् आपो अपां नपाद् इत्य् अभिजुहोति //
text_mt: Having thrown a blade of grass into the water, he makes an offering over it with: 'Divine Waters, Child of the Waters...'

sanskrit_iast: kārṣy asi \\ iti darbhair āhutim apaplāvayati /
meaning: कार्ष्य् असि \\ इति दर्भैर् आहुतिम् अपप्लावयति /
text_mt: With 'Thou art of the black one', he floats the oblation away with darbha grass blades.

sanskrit_iast: maitrāvaruṇacamase darbhān antardhāya samudrasya vo 'kṣityā unnaye \\ iti pratīpaṃ camasam upasārayati /
meaning: मैत्रावरुणचमसे दर्भान् अन्तर्धाय समुद्रस्य वो ऽक्षित्या उन्नये \\ इति प्रतीपं चमसम् उपसारयति /
text_mt: Having placed darbha grass blades into the cup of the Maitrāvaruṇa, he moves the cup against the current with: 'For the imperishableness of the ocean I draw you up.'

sanskrit_iast: evam anupūrvam̐ savanīyakalaśān /
meaning: एवम् अनुपूर्वम्̐ सवनीयकलशान् /
text_mt: In the same manner, successively, the tubs for the pressings.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīṃ pānnejanam \\ vasūnām̐ rudrāṇām ity abhimantrya patnyai prayachati /
meaning: तूष्णीं पान्नेजनम् \\ वसूनाम्̐ रुद्राणाम् इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य पत्न्यै प्रयछति /
text_mt: Silently [he draws] the foot-washing water; having addressed it with 'Of the Vasus, of the Rudras...', he hands it to the wife.

sanskrit_iast: adhi cātvālaṃ maitrāvaruṇacamasīyānām̐ hotṛcamasīyāsv avanayati hotṛcamasīyānāṃ maitrāvaruṇacamasīyāsu //
meaning: अधि चात्वालं मैत्रावरुणचमसीयानाम्̐ होतृचमसीयास्व् अवनयति होतृचमसीयानां मैत्रावरुणचमसीयासु //
text_mt: Over the pit he pours some of the water of the Maitrāvaruṇa's cup into the hotṛ's cup, and some of the water of the hotṛ's cup into the Maitrāvaruṇa's cup.

sanskrit_iast: yathādhuraṃ dhuro dhūrbhiḥ kalpantām iti pracaraṇyā camasau samanakti /
meaning: यथाधुरं धुरो धूर्भिः कल्पन्ताम् इति प्रचरण्या चमसौ समनक्ति /
text_mt: With 'In accordance with each yoke-pole, let the yoke-poles be fitted with the yoke-pins', he anoints the two cups together with the operating ladle.

sanskrit_iast: aparayā dvārā patnī sadaḥ praviśya vasavo rudrā ādityās \\ iti paścān neṣṭrīyasya sādayati pānnejanam /
meaning: अपरया द्वारा पत्नी सदः प्रविश्य वसवो रुद्रा आदित्यास् \\ इति पश्चान् नेष्ट्रीयस्य सादयति पान्नेजनम् /
text_mt: Entering the sadas by the western door, the wife sets down the foot-washing water behind the neṣṭṛ's hearth with: 'Vasus, Rudras, Ādityas...'

sanskrit_iast: havirdhānam abhyudānayanty agrato maitrāvaruṇacamasīyā hotṛcamasīyā vasatīvarīr anupūrvam̐ savanīyakalaśān //
meaning: हविर्धानम् अभ्युदानयन्त्य् अग्रतो मैत्रावरुणचमसीया होतृचमसीया वसतीवरीर् अनुपूर्वम्̐ सवनीयकलशान् //
text_mt: They bring forward to the havirdhāna shed the [waters] destined for the cup of the Maitrāvaruṇa first, then those for the cup of the Hotṛ, the vasatīvarī waters, [and] in order the jars for the pressing days.

sanskrit_iast: aver apo 'dhvaryāu iti ced dhotā pṛched utem anannamur \ utemaṃ paśya \\ iti pratibrūyāt /
meaning: अवेर् अपो ऽध्वर्याउ इति चेद् धोता पृछेद् उतेम् अनन्नमुर् \ उतेमं पश्य \\ इति प्रतिब्रूयात् /
text_mt: If the Hotṛ asks: "Have you obtained the waters, Adhvaryu?", he should reply: "Indeed, they have bowed; indeed, look at this!"

sanskrit_iast: pracaraṇyāgniṣṭome yam agne pṛtsu martyam iti kratukaraṇiṃ juhoti /
meaning: प्रचरण्याग्निष्टोमे यम् अग्ने पृत्सु मर्त्यम् इति क्रतुकरणिं जुहोति /
text_mt: In the Agniṣṭoma, using the pracaraṇī ladle, he offers the kratukaraṇī libation with: "Whichever mortal, O Agni, in the battles..."

sanskrit_iast: etenokthye paridhim añjyād etena ṣoḍaśini rarātīṃ droṇakalaśam̐ vopaspṛśet /
meaning: एतेनोक्थ्ये परिधिम् अञ्ज्याद् एतेन षोडशिनि ररातीं द्रोणकलशम्̐ वोपस्पृशेत् /
text_mt: In the Ukthya, with this [mantra], he should anoint an enclosing stick; in the Ṣoḍaśin, with this [mantra], he should touch the forehead-garland or the droṇakalaśa trough.

sanskrit_iast: havirdhāne pracaraṇīm ādhāya pradhure vaitaj japan havirdhānaṃ prapadyetātirātre vājapeye 'ptoryāmṇi /
meaning: हविर्धाने प्रचरणीम् आधाय प्रधुरे वैतज् जपन् हविर्धानं प्रपद्येतातिरात्रे वाजपेये ऽप्तोर्याम्णि /
text_mt: Having placed the pracaraṇī ladle in the havirdhāna shed or at the fore-axle, muttering this, he should enter the havirdhāna shed at the Atirātra, the Vājapeya, [or] the Aptoryāma.

sanskrit_iast: audumbare pavitravati \\ upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ prajāpataye tvā \\ iti dadhigrahaṃ gṛhṇāti /
meaning: औदुम्बरे पवित्रवति \\ उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ प्रजापतये त्वा \\ इति दधिग्रहं गृह्णाति /
text_mt: In an audumbara vessel provided with a strainer, he draws the dadhigraha with: "You are taken with a support; for Prajāpati [I take] you!"

sanskrit_iast: asanno hūyate /
meaning: असन्नो हूयते /

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇena hotur gachati /
meaning: दक्षिणेन होतुर् गछति /
text_mt: He walks south of the Hotṛ.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇābhiprayamya grahaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ paridhisaṃdhiṃ pratyavasthāya yena prajā achidrās \\ ity abhijuhoti //
meaning: उत्तरेणाभिप्रयम्य ग्रहं दक्षिणं परिधिसंधिं प्रत्यवस्थाय येन प्रजा अछिद्रास् \\ इत्य् अभिजुहोति //
text_mt: Having extended the cup to the north, stepping opposite the southern junction of the enclosing sticks, he offers over [the fire] with: "Whereby the offspring are undamaged..."

sanskrit_iast: tisro jihvasya \\ ity upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: तिस्रो जिह्वस्य \\ इत्य् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: He attends [the fire] with: "Three [are the bodies] of his tongue..."

sanskrit_iast: pratiparikramya yathāsthānaṃ pātram̐ sādayati /
meaning: प्रतिपरिक्रम्य यथास्थानं पात्रम्̐ सादयति /
text_mt: Having walked back, he sets the vessel down in its proper place.

sanskrit_iast: uduhyādhavanīyaṃ maitrāvaruṇacamasīyā avanīya prātaḥsavanikam avanayati /
meaning: उदुह्याधवनीयं मैत्रावरुणचमसीया अवनीय प्रातःसवनिकम् अवनयति /
text_mt: Having moved the ādhavanīya vessel away, having poured out the [waters] destined for the cup of the Maitrāvaruṇa, he pours out that which belongs to the morning pressing.

sanskrit_iast: uttarasya havirdhānasya dakṣiṇasyā akṣadhuro 'dhastād vasatīvarīḥ sādayaty uttarau savanīyakalaśau / dakṣiṇasyottarasyā adhastād dhotṛcamasam̐ sādayitvā tasmin nigrābhyāḥ stha \\ iti yajamānam̐ vācayati /
meaning: उत्तरस्य हविर्धानस्य दक्षिणस्या अक्षधुरो ऽधस्ताद् वसतीवरीः सादयत्य् उत्तरौ सवनीयकलशौ / दक्षिणस्योत्तरस्या अधस्ताद् धोतृचमसम्̐ सादयित्वा तस्मिन् निग्राभ्याः स्थ \\ इति यजमानम्̐ वाचयति /
text_mt: Under the southern axle of the northern havirdhāna cart, he sets down the vasatīvarī waters [and] the two northern jars for the pressing days. Having set down the cup of the Hotṛ under the northern [axle] of the southern [cart], he makes the sacrificer recite over it: "You are the Nigrābhyā waters."

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave \\ ity upām̐śusavanam ādatte //
meaning: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शुसवनम् आदत्ते //
text_mt: He takes the upāṃśusavana stone with: "At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ..."

sanskrit_iast: grāvāsi \\ ity abhimantrya vācam̐ yachati /
meaning: ग्रावासि \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य वाचम्̐ यछति /
text_mt: Having addressed [it] with: "You are a pressing-stone...", he restrains his speech.

sanskrit_iast: visram̐sya rājānam indrāya tvā suṣuttamam iti sahiraṇyena pāṇinābhimṛśati /
meaning: विस्रम्̐स्य राजानम् इन्द्राय त्वा सुषुत्तमम् इति सहिरण्येन पाणिनाभिमृशति /
text_mt: Having untied King [Soma], he touches [him] with a hand accompanied by gold, [saying]: "For Indra, you are best pressed!"

sanskrit_iast: upām̐śusavanam upale nidhāya tasmin rājānam̐ sarvaṃ mimīta indrāya tvābhimātighne \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ pañcakṛtvo yathākraye //
meaning: उपाम्̐शुसवनम् उपले निधाय तस्मिन् राजानम्̐ सर्वं मिमीत इन्द्राय त्वाभिमातिघ्ने \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः पञ्चकृत्वो यथाक्रये //
text_mt: Having placed the upāṃśusavana stone on the upper stone, he measures the whole King [Soma] upon it five times with [the mantras] beginning with: "For Indra, the slayer of enemies, [I take] you...", in the same manner as during the purchase.

sanskrit_iast: śvātrāḥ stha vṛtraturas \\ iti hotṛcamasād upasṛjya yat te soma divi jyotir ity abhimarśanena satanuṃ karoti /
meaning: श्वात्राः स्थ वृत्रतुरस् \\ इति होतृचमसाद् उपसृज्य यत् ते सोम दिवि ज्योतिर् इत्य् अभिमर्शनेन सतनुं करोति /
text_mt: Having sprinkled [water] from the cup of the Hotṛ with: "You are invigorating, overcoming Vṛtra...", he makes [the Soma] whole of body by touching [it] with: "What light of yours, O Soma, is in heaven..."

sanskrit_iast: pratiprasthātālpīyo 'rdham̐ rājño vāsasoddhṛtya kṛṣṇājine nidadhāti /
meaning: प्रतिप्रस्थाताल्पीयो ऽर्धम्̐ राज्ञो वाससोद्धृत्य कृष्णाजिने निदधाति /
text_mt: The Pratiprasthātṛ, having taken up a lesser half of the King [Soma] with a garment, deposits it upon the black antelope skin.

sanskrit_iast:
avīvṛdham̐ vo manasā sujātās\ ṛtaprajātā bhaga id vaḥ syāma /
indreṇa devīr vīrudhaḥ sam̐vidānās\ anumanyantām̐ savanāya somam //
iti rājānaṃ niryātya dvaudvau ṣaḍ am̐śūn apāyātayati /
meaning:
अवीवृधम्̐ वो मनसा सुजातास्\ ऋतप्रजाता भग इद् वः स्याम /
इन्द्रेण देवीर् वीरुधः सम्̐विदानास्\ अनुमन्यन्ताम्̐ सवनाय सोमम् //
इति राजानं निर्यात्य द्वौद्वौ षड् अम्̐शून् अपायातयति /
text_mt:
"I have magnified you with my mind, O well-born ones, / born from the cosmic order! May we be your Bhaga!

May the divine plants, in agreement with Indra, / grant the Soma for the pressing!"

Having led forth the King [Soma] with [these two verses], he separates six stalks, two by two.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīm̐ hotṛcamasād upasṛjya mā bhair \ mā sam̐vikthās \\ ity upām̐śusavanam udyamya japati //
meaning: तूष्णीम्̐ होतृचमसाद् उपसृज्य मा भैर् \ मा सम्̐विक्थास् \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शुसवनम् उद्यम्य जपति //
text_mt: Having sprinkled [water] silently from the cup of the Hotṛ, having lifted up the upāṃśusavana stone, he mutters: "Do not fear! Do not tremble!"

sanskrit_iast: dhiṣaṇe īḍite īḍethām ity adhiṣavaṇaphalake abhimantrayate /
meaning: धिषणे ईडिते ईडेथाम् इत्य् अधिषवणफलके अभिमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: He addresses the two pressing boards with: "O two Dhiṣaṇās, praised ones, be praised!"

sanskrit_iast: yo 'bhiṣutasya prathamo 'm̐śuḥ parāpated ā māskān saha prajayā saha paśubhiḥ saha rāyaspoṣeṇa \\ indriyaṃ me vīryaṃ mā nirvadhiṣṭa \\ iti tam abhimantrya pratyāharati /
meaning: यो ऽभिषुतस्य प्रथमो ऽम्̐शुः परापतेद् आ मास्कान् सह प्रजया सह पशुभिः सह रायस्पोषेण \\ इन्द्रियं मे वीर्यं मा निर्वधिष्ट \\ इति तम् अभिमन्त्र्य प्रत्याहरति /
text_mt: Whichever first stalk of the pressed [Soma] should fall away, he addresses it with: "May it reach me together with offspring, together with cattle, together with abundance of wealth; do not cut off my faculty [and] virility!", and brings it back.

sanskrit_iast: mūle 'bhiṣuṇoti / yadi mūlaṃ na vindet tṛṇaṃ dāru vāntardadhyāt /
meaning: मूले ऽभिषुणोति / यदि मूलं न विन्देत् तृणं दारु वान्तर्दध्यात् /
text_mt: He presses at the base. If he cannot find a base, he should place a blade of grass or a piece of wood underneath.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭau kṛtvo 'bhiṣutya vācaspataye pavasva \\ ity upām̐śupātre 'ñjalinā tṛtīyagraham ānayaty evam ekādaśakṛtvo 'bhiṣutyaivaṃ dvādaśakṛtvaḥ /
meaning: अष्टौ कृत्वो ऽभिषुत्य वाचस्पतये पवस्व \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शुपात्रे ऽञ्जलिना तृतीयग्रहम् आनयत्य् एवम् एकादशकृत्वो ऽभिषुत्यैवं द्वादशकृत्वः /
text_mt: Having pressed eight times, he brings in the third portion with his folded hands into the upāṃśu cup with: "Purify yourself for the Lord of Speech!"; thus having pressed eleven times; thus twelve times.

sanskrit_iast: avagṛhītānāṃ pratiprasthātāsicyamāne dvaudvāv am̐śū antardadhāti //
meaning: अवगृहीतानां प्रतिप्रस्थातासिच्यमाने द्वौद्वाव् अम्̐शू अन्तर्दधाति //
text_mt: Of the stalks that were set aside, the Pratiprasthātṛ inserts two stalks each time [the juice] is being poured.

sanskrit_iast: madhumatīr nā iṣas kṛdhi \\ iti japati //
meaning: मधुमतीर् ना इषस् कृधि \\ इति जपति //
text_mt: He mutters: "Make our refreshments full of honey!"

sanskrit_iast: svāṃkṛto 'si \\ ity ādāyottiṣṭhati //
meaning: स्वांकृतो ऽसि \\ इत्य् आदायोत्तिष्ठति //
text_mt: Having taken [the cup] with: "You are self-made!", he stands up.

sanskrit_iast: urv antarikṣam̐ vīhi \\ iti vrajati /
meaning: उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम्̐ वीहि \\ इति व्रजति /
text_mt: He walks with: "Traverse the wide intermediate space!"

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇena hotur gachati /
meaning: दक्षिणेन होतुर् गछति /
text_mt: He walks south of the Hotṛ.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇābhiprayamya grahaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ paridhisaṃdhiṃ pratyavasthāya viśvebhya indriyebhyas \\ iti juhoti /
meaning: उत्तरेणाभिप्रयम्य ग्रहं दक्षिणं परिधिसंधिं प्रत्यवस्थाय विश्वेभ्य इन्द्रियेभ्यस् \\ इति जुहोति /
text_mt: Having extended the cup to the north, stepping opposite the southern junction of the enclosing sticks, he offers with: "For all the sense-faculties!"

sanskrit_iast: yato hutaṃ tataḥ pātrasyordhvam unmṛjyād vṛṣṭikāmasya devebhyas tvā sarīcipebhyas \\ iti madhyamasya paridheḥ paścād ūrdhvam unmṛjyād avṛṣṭikāmasyāntarataḥ pātrasyāvamṛjyāt paridher antarato 'vamṛjyāt /
meaning: यतो हुतं ततः पात्रस्योर्ध्वम् उन्मृज्याद् वृष्टिकामस्य देवेभ्यस् त्वा सरीचिपेभ्यस् \\ इति मध्यमस्य परिधेः पश्चाद् ऊर्ध्वम् उन्मृज्याद् अवृष्टिकामस्यान्तरतः पात्रस्यावमृज्यात् परिधेर् अन्तरतो ऽवमृज्यात् /
text_mt: He should wipe the vessel upwards from where the offering was made; for one desiring rain, he should wipe upwards behind the middle enclosing stick with: "For the creeping gods [I wipe] you!"; for one desiring absence of rain, he should wipe downwards on the inner side of the vessel, [and] he should wipe downwards on the inner side of the enclosing stick.

sanskrit_iast: āgrāyaṇasthālyām̐ saṃpātam avanayati //
meaning: आग्रायणस्थाल्याम्̐ संपातम् अवनयति //
text_mt: He pours the residue into the āgrāyaṇa vessel.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāya tvā \\ ity upām̐śupātram̐ sādayati / tasminn am̐śum avadadhāti //
meaning: प्राणाय त्वा \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शुपात्रम्̐ सादयति / तस्मिन्न् अम्̐शुम् अवदधाति //
text_mt: He sets down the upāṃśu cup with: "For out-breath [I set] you!". He places a stalk into it.

sanskrit_iast: yat te somādābhyam ity avagṛhītānāṃ pratiprasthātām̐śuṣu dvaudvāv am̐śū pratyavasṛjati /
meaning: यत् ते सोमादाभ्यम् इत्य् अवगृहीतानां प्रतिप्रस्थाताम्̐शुषु द्वौद्वाव् अम्̐शू प्रत्यवसृजति /
text_mt: With: "What of you, O Soma, is undeceived...", the Pratiprasthātṛ puts back two stalks at a time among the stalks that were set aside.

sanskrit_iast: abhiṣavāyopaviśanty adhiṣavaṇasya dakṣiṇataḥ pratiprasthātā paścād yajamāna uttarato 'dhvaryuḥ purastād unnetā /
meaning: अभिषवायोपविशन्त्य् अधिषवणस्य दक्षिणतः प्रतिप्रस्थाता पश्चाद् यजमान उत्तरतो ऽध्वर्युः पुरस्ताद् उन्नेता /
text_mt: They sit down for the pressing: the Pratiprasthātṛ south of the pressing [board], the sacrificer behind, the Adhvaryu north, [and] the Unnetṛ in front.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīm̐ hotṛcamasād upasṛjya grāvabhir abhiṣuṇvanti /
meaning: तूष्णीम्̐ होतृचमसाद् उपसृज्य ग्रावभिर् अभिषुण्वन्ति /
text_mt: Having sprinkled [water] silently from the cup of the Hotṛ, they press with the pressing-stones.

sanskrit_iast: tato nigrābham upaiti /
meaning: ततो निग्राभम् उपैति /

sanskrit_iast: abhiṣutān am̐śūn prāg apāg adharāg udag iti hotṛcamase pariplāvayati /
meaning: अभिषुतान् अम्̐शून् प्राग् अपाग् अधराग् उदग् इति होतृचमसे परिप्लावयति /
text_mt: He washes the pressed stalks around in the cup of the Hotṛ [in all directions]: east, west, downwards, north.

sanskrit_iast: prapīḍya pratyāharati /
meaning: प्रपीड्य प्रत्याहरति /
text_mt: Having squeezed [them], he brings [them] back.

sanskrit_iast: ata ūrdhvam unnetā vasatīvarīṇām upasṛjati /
meaning: अत ऊर्ध्वम् उन्नेता वसतीवरीणाम् उपसृजति /
text_mt: From here on, the Unnetṛ pours out [some] of the vasatīvarī waters.

sanskrit_iast: abhiṣuṇvanti /
meaning: अभिषुण्वन्ति /

sanskrit_iast: punar nigrābham upaiti /
meaning: पुनर् निग्राभम् उपैति /
text_mt: He performs the nigrābha again.

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ saṃbharati /
meaning: ततः संभरति /

sanskrit_iast: prapīḍyonnetādhavanīye pariplāvayati /
meaning: प्रपीड्योन्नेताधवनीये परिप्लावयति /
text_mt: Having squeezed [them], the Unnetṛ washes [them] around in the ādhavanīya vessel.

sanskrit_iast: tato dohayati /
meaning: ततो दोहयति /

sanskrit_iast: abhiṣutam̐ hotṛcamase 'vanīya pūrṇasya prātaḥsavanike 'vanayati /
meaning: अभिषुतम्̐ होतृचमसे ऽवनीय पूर्णस्य प्रातःसवनिके ऽवनयति /
text_mt: Having poured the pressed [juice] into the cup of the Hotṛ, he pours [it] from the full [cup] into the vessel belonging to the morning pressing.

sanskrit_iast: prāpīḍyonnetādhiṣavaṇe nivapaty upasṛjati /
meaning: प्रापीड्योन्नेताधिषवणे निवपत्य् उपसृजति /
text_mt: Having squeezed [them], the Unnetṛ throws [them] out onto the pressing board [and] pours water on [them].

sanskrit_iast: abhiṣuṇvanti /
meaning: अभिषुण्वन्ति /

sanskrit_iast: catur nigrābham upaiti / triḥ saṃbharati /
meaning: चतुर् निग्राभम् उपैति / त्रिः संभरति /
text_mt: Four times he performs the nigrābha; three times he collects.

sanskrit_iast: yadi navakṛtvo nigrābham upeyād upasarjanaprabhṛti trir nigrābham upaiti saṃbharati dohayati /
meaning: यदि नवकृत्वो निग्राभम् उपेयाद् उपसर्जनप्रभृति त्रिर् निग्राभम् उपैति संभरति दोहयति /
text_mt: If he should perform the nigrābha nine times, starting with the pouring on of water, three times he performs the nigrābha, collects, [and] milks out.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ dvitīyaḥ paryāyas tathā tṛtīyaḥ /
meaning: एवं द्वितीयः पर्यायस् तथा तृतीयः /
text_mt: Such is the second round; likewise the third.

sanskrit_iast: ṛjīṣeṇa grāvṇaḥ parivapati /
meaning: ऋजीषेण ग्राव्णः परिवपति /
text_mt: He scatters the Soma dregs around the pressing-stones.

sanskrit_iast: prāñcam udgātā droṇakalaśaṃ prohaty atyasyati daśāpavitram antarākṣam̐ viṣkambhaṃ ca / yaṃ dviṣyāt tasyākṣam upahanyāt /
meaning: प्राञ्चम् उद्गाता द्रोणकलशं प्रोहत्य् अत्यस्यति दशापवित्रम् अन्तराक्षम्̐ विष्कम्भं च / यं द्विष्यात् तस्याक्षम् उपहन्यात् /
text_mt: The Udgātṛ pushes the droṇakalaśa trough forward [and] throws across the fringed strainer between the axle and the prop-stick. He should knock against the axle of him whom he may hate.

sanskrit_iast: daśayā droṇakalaśam̐ saṃmārṣṭi vasavastvā saṃmṛjantu \\ iti prātaḥsavane rudrās tvā \\ iti mādhyaṃdina // ādityās tvā \\ iti tṛtīyasavane pūtabhṛtam /
meaning: दशया द्रोणकलशम्̐ संमार्ष्टि वसवस्त्वा संमृजन्तु \\ इति प्रातःसवने रुद्रास् त्वा \\ इति माध्यंदिन // आदित्यास् त्वा \\ इति तृतीयसवने पूतभृतम् /
text_mt: He wipes the droṇakalaśa trough clean with the fringe: "May the Vasus wipe you clean!" at the morning pressing; "May the Rudras [wipe] you [clean]!" at the midday pressing; "May the Ādityas [wipe] you [clean]!" at the third pressing over the pūtabhṛt jar.

sanskrit_iast: grāvasu droṇakalaśam ādadhāti / tasyopary udgātāro 'dhastān nābhi pavitram̐ vitanvanti / tasmin yajamāno hotṛcamasena saṃtatām̐ śukradhārām̐ srāvayaty ā dhruvagrahaṇāt /
meaning: ग्रावसु द्रोणकलशम् आदधाति / तस्योपर्य् उद्गातारो ऽधस्तान् नाभि पवित्रम्̐ वितन्वन्ति / तस्मिन् यजमानो होतृचमसेन संतताम्̐ शुक्रधाराम्̐ स्रावयत्य् आ ध्रुवग्रहणात् /
text_mt: He places the droṇakalaśa trough upon the pressing-stones. Above it, the Udgātṛs stretch the strainer below the navel [of the trough]. Over it, the sacrificer, with the cup of the Hotṛ, pours a continuous bright stream until the drawing of the dhruva cup.

sanskrit_iast: prātaḥsavanikād unnetā hotṛcamase 'vanayati /
meaning: प्रातःसवनिकाद् उन्नेता होतृचमसे ऽवनयति /
text_mt: The Unnetṛ pours [the juice] from the vessel of the morning pressing into the cup of the Hotṛ.

sanskrit_iast: śukradhārāyā grahān gṛhṇāty upabilān pūrṇān vṛṣṭikāmasya /
meaning: शुक्रधाराया ग्रहान् गृह्णात्य् उपबिलान् पूर्णान् वृष्टिकामस्य /
text_mt: He draws the cups from the bright stream up to the brim, [or] full for one desiring rain.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhītvā daśayā parimṛjya yathāsthānam̐ sādayati //
meaning: गृहीत्वा दशया परिमृज्य यथास्थानम्̐ सादयति //
text_mt: Having drawn [it] and wiped it with the fringe, he deposits it in its proper place.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ antar yacha maghavan \\ ity antaryāmaṃ gṛhṇāti /
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ अन्तर् यछ मघवन् \\ इत्य् अन्तर्यामं गृह्णाति /
