text_mt: With: 'You are taken with a support; hold within, O bounteous one,' he draws the antaryāma cup.

sanskrit_iast: asanno hūyate /
meaning: असन्नो हूयते /

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇa hotur gachati /
meaning: उत्तरेण होतुर् गछति /
text_mt: He goes to the north of the hotṛ priest.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇenābhiprayamya graham uttaraṃ paridhisaṃdhiṃ pratyṛjus tiṣṭhan vāk tvāṣṭu \\ iti juhoti /
meaning: दक्षिणेनाभिप्रयम्य ग्रहम् उत्तरं परिधिसंधिं प्रत्यृजुस् तिष्ठन् वाक् त्वाष्टु \\ इति जुहोति /
text_mt: Holding out the cup with his right hand, standing straight opposite the northern joint of the enclosing sticks, he offers it with: 'May speech enjoy you.'

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātam unmārjanam //
meaning: व्याख्यातम् उन्मार्जनम् //
text_mt: The wiping off is explained.

sanskrit_iast: apānāya tvā \\ ity antaryāmapātram̐ sūdavat sādayati // vyānāya tvā \\ ity upām̐śusavanam /
meaning: अपानाय त्वा \\ इत्य् अन्तर्यामपात्रम्̐ सूदवत् सादयति // व्यानाय त्वा \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शुसवनम् /
text_mt: With: 'For the down-breathing, to you,' he deposits the antaryāma cup with the sūda formula; with: 'For the diffused breathing, to you,' the upāṃśusavana pressing stone.

sanskrit_iast: udita upām̐śvantaryāmau juhoti /
meaning: उदित उपाम्̐श्वन्तर्यामौ जुहोति /
text_mt: When the sun has risen, he offers the upāṃśu and antaryāma cups.

sanskrit_iast: yadi tvareta purodayād upām̐śuṃ juhuyāt /
meaning: यदि त्वरेत पुरोदयाद् उपाम्̐शुं जुहुयात् /
text_mt: If he should make haste, he may offer the upāṃśu before sunrise.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvam antaryāmād grahāgrāṇi /
meaning: ऊर्ध्वम् अन्तर्यामाद् ग्रहाग्राणि /
text_mt: After the antaryāma cup come the order-leading cups.

sanskrit_iast: yadi rathaṃtarasāmā somaḥ syād aindravāyavāgrān grahān gṛhṇīyād yadi bṛhatsāmā śukrāgrān yadi jagatsāmāgrāyaṇāgrān /
meaning: यदि रथंतरसामा सोमः स्याद् ऐन्द्रवायवाग्रान् ग्रहान् गृह्णीयाद् यदि बृहत्सामा शुक्राग्रान् यदि जगत्सामाग्रायणाग्रान् /
text_mt: If the soma sacrifice has the rathaṃtara saman, he should draw the cups led by the aindravāyava; if having the bṛhat saman, led by the śukra; if having the jagat saman, led by the āgrāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: yo jyeṣṭhabandhur ity āmnātaṃ grahāgram /
meaning: यो ज्येष्ठबन्धुर् इत्य् आम्नातं ग्रहाग्रम् /
text_mt: The order of the cups is handed down [in the sacred text with]: 'He who has elder brothers...'

sanskrit_iast: aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti \\ ā vāyo bhūṣa \\ ity ardhagraham indravāyū ime sutās \\ iti śeṣam eṣa te yoniḥ \ sajoṣobhyāṃ tvā \\ iti sādayati /
meaning: ऐन्द्रवायवं गृह्णाति \\ आ वायो भूष \\ इत्य् अर्धग्रहम् इन्द्रवायू इमे सुतास् \\ इति शेषम् एष ते योनिः \ सजोषोभ्यां त्वा \\ इति सादयति /
text_mt: He draws the aindravāyava cup: half the cup with: 'Come, O Vāyu, enter upon,' [and] the rest with: 'O Indra and Vāyu, these pressed [soma juices]'; he deposits it with: 'This is your womb; for the two who act in unison, to you.'

sanskrit_iast: yam anyam aindravāyavāt pūrvaṃ gṛhṇīyād aindravāyavam̐ sādayitvā tam̐ sādayet //
meaning: यम् अन्यम् ऐन्द्रवायवात् पूर्वं गृह्णीयाद् ऐन्द्रवायवम्̐ सादयित्वा तम्̐ सादयेत् //
text_mt: Whichever other cup he may draw prior to the aindravāyava, he should deposit it only after depositing the aindravāyava.

sanskrit_iast: ayam̐ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā \\ iti maitrāvaruṇaṃ gṛhītvā śṛtaśītena payasā śrīṇāti \\ eṣa te yonir \ ṛtāyubhyāṃ tvā \\ iti sādayati //
meaning: अयम्̐ वां मित्रावरुणा \\ इति मैत्रावरुणं गृहीत्वा शृतशीतेन पयसा श्रीणाति \\ एष ते योनिर् \ ऋतायुभ्यां त्वा \\ इति सादयति //
text_mt: Having drawn the maitrāvaruṇa cup with: 'This of you two, O Mitra and Varuṇa,' he mixes it with boiled and cooled milk; he deposits it with: 'This is your womb; for the two who cherish cosmic order, to you.'

sanskrit_iast: ayam̐ venas \\ iti śukraṃ gṛhītvā hiraṇyena śrīṇāti \\ eṣa te yonir \ vīratāyai tvā \\ iti sādayati //
meaning: अयम्̐ वेनस् \\ इति शुक्रं गृहीत्वा हिरण्येन श्रीणाति \\ एष ते योनिर् \ वीरतायै त्वा \\ इति सादयति //
text_mt: Having drawn the śukra cup with: 'This luminous one,' he mixes it with gold; he deposits it with: 'This is your womb; for heroism, to you.'

sanskrit_iast: taṃ pratnathā \\ iti manthinaṃ gṛhītvānabhidhvam̐sayan pātrāṇi saktubhiḥ śrīṇāti \\ eṣa te yoniḥ \ prajābhyas tvā \\ iti sādayati /
meaning: तं प्रत्नथा \\ इति मन्थिनं गृहीत्वानभिध्वम्̐सयन् पात्राणि सक्तुभिः श्रीणाति \\ एष ते योनिः \ प्रजाभ्यस् त्वा \\ इति सादयति /
text_mt: Having drawn the manthin cup with: 'Him, as of old,' he mixes it with barley flour without spraying the vessels; he deposits it with: 'This is your womb; for offspring, to you.'

sanskrit_iast: ya āgrāyaṇasthālyām̐ somas tam̐ hotṛcamase 'vanīya ye devā divy ekādaśa stha \\ ity āgrāyaṇaṃ dvābhyāṃ dhārābhyāṃ gṛhṇāti \\ āgrāyaṇo 'si svāgrāyaṇas \\ ity abhimantryopām̐śu hiṅṅ iti trir abhihiṅkṛtya vācam̐ visṛjya \\ eṣa te yonir \ viśvebhyas tvā devebhyas \\ iti sādayati //
meaning: य आग्रायणस्थाल्याम्̐ सोमस् तम्̐ होतृचमसे ऽवनीय ये देवा दिव्य् एकादश स्थ \\ इत्य् आग्रायणं द्वाभ्यां धाराभ्यां गृह्णाति \\ आग्रायणो ऽसि स्वाग्रायणस् \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्योपाम्̐शु हिङ्ङ् इति त्रिर् अभिहिङ्कृत्य वाचम्̐ विसृज्य \\ एष ते योनिर् \ विश्वेभ्यस् त्वा देवेभ्यस् \\ इति सादयति //
text_mt: Having poured the soma that is in the āgrāyaṇa vessel into the hotṛ priest's cup, he draws the āgrāyaṇa cup in two streams with: 'O gods who are eleven in heaven'; having addressed it with: 'You are the āgrāyaṇa, well-drawn,' having murmured 'hiṅ' in a whisper three times, having released his voice, he deposits it with: 'This is your womb; for the All-gods, to you.'

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ indrāya tvā bṛhadvate \\ ity ukthyaṃ gṛhṇāti \\ eṣa te yonir \ indrāya tvā \\ iti sādayati //
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ इन्द्राय त्वा बृहद्वते \\ इत्य् उक्थ्यं गृह्णाति \\ एष ते योनिर् \ इन्द्राय त्वा \\ इति सादयति //
text_mt: With: 'You are taken with a support; for Indra accompanied by the Bṛhat,' he draws the ukthya cup; he deposits it with: 'This is your womb; for Indra, to you.'

sanskrit_iast: mūrdhānaṃ divas \\ iti dhruvaṃ gṛhṇāti // dhruvo 'si dhruvakṣitir ity abhimantrya \\ eṣa te yonir \ vaiśvānarāya tvā \\ iti sādayaty āyuṣkāmasya hiraṇye /
meaning: मूर्धानं दिवस् \\ इति ध्रुवं गृह्णाति // ध्रुवो ऽसि ध्रुवक्षितिर् इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य \\ एष ते योनिर् \ वैश्वानराय त्वा \\ इति सादयत्य् आयुष्कामस्य हिरण्ये /
text_mt: With: 'The head of heaven,' he draws the dhruva cup; having addressed it with: 'You are steadfast, of steadfast abode,' he deposits it with: 'This is your womb; for Vaiśvānara, to you'—on gold, for one desiring a full lifetime.

sanskrit_iast: rājaputro dhruvaṃ gopāyati /
meaning: राजपुत्रो ध्रुवं गोपायति /
text_mt: A prince guards the dhruva cup.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ dviṣyāt tasya dhruvaṃ pravartayet /
meaning: यं द्विष्यात् तस्य ध्रुवं प्रवर्तयेत् /
text_mt: In the case of one whom he hates, he should roll the dhruva cup over.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ prātaḥsavanike somas tam̐ hotṛcamase 'vanīyātipāvya rājānaṃ prapīḍya pavitraṃ pārśvato nidadhāti /
meaning: यः प्रातःसवनिके सोमस् तम्̐ होतृचमसे ऽवनीयातिपाव्य राजानं प्रपीड्य पवित्रं पार्श्वतो निदधाति /
text_mt: Having poured into the hotṛ's cup whatever soma is in the morning pressing trough, having strained it through, and having squeezed the king [soma], he lays down the strainer to the side.

sanskrit_iast: pariplavayā droṇakalaśāt pūtabhṛty avanīya daśayā parimṛjya yathāsthānam̐ sādayati //
meaning: परिप्लवया द्रोणकलशात् पूतभृत्य् अवनीय दशया परिमृज्य यथास्थानम्̐ सादयति //
text_mt: Having poured [soma] from the droṇakalaśā trough into the pūtabhṛt trough with the dipping ladle, and having wiped it with the fringe, he deposits it in its proper place.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si prajāpataye tvā \\ iti droṇakalaśam abhimṛśati \\ upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ indrāya tvā \\ ity ādhavanīyam upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ viśvebhyas tvā devebhyas \\ iti pūtabhṛtam //
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि प्रजापतये त्वा \\ इति द्रोणकलशम् अभिमृशति \\ उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ इन्द्राय त्वा \\ इत्य् आधवनीयम् उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ विश्वेभ्यस् त्वा देवेभ्यस् \\ इति पूतभृतम् //
text_mt: With: 'You are taken with a support; for Prajāpati, to you,' he touches the droṇakalaśa trough; with: 'You are taken with a support; for Indra, to you,' the ādhavanīya trough; with: 'You are taken with a support; for the All-gods, to you,' the pūtabhṛt trough.

sanskrit_iast: drapsaś caskanda \\ ity abhito droṇakalaśam̐ skannam abhimantrayate /
meaning: द्रप्सश् चस्कन्द \\ इत्य् अभितो द्रोणकलशम्̐ स्कन्नम् अभिमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: With: 'The drop spilled,' he accompanies the spilth on both sides of the droṇakalaśa trough with a mantra.

sanskrit_iast: saptahotāraṃ manasānudrutya juhoti //
meaning: सप्तहोतारं मनसानुद्रुत्य जुहोति //
text_mt: Having mentally recited the saptahotṛ formula, he offers.

sanskrit_iast: prastotar vācam̐ yacha \\ unnetar ya ādhavanīye rājā taṃ prāñcam̐ saṃpāvayasva \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: प्रस्तोतर् वाचम्̐ यछ \\ उन्नेतर् य आधवनीये राजा तं प्राञ्चम्̐ संपावयस्व \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He issues the call: 'Prastotṛ, restrain your speech; unnetṛ, strain eastward the king [soma] which is in the ādhavanīya trough.'

sanskrit_iast: havirdhānād adhyāstāvāt prahāṇāḥ sarpanti /
meaning: हविर्धानाद् अध्यास्तावात् प्रहाणाः सर्पन्ति /
text_mt: From the havirdhāna shed, leaving it behind, they glide towards the chant-place.

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryuṃ prastotānvārabhate prastotāram udgātodgātāraṃ pratihartā pratihartāraṃ maitrāvaruṇo maitrāvaruṇam̐ yajamāno yajamānaṃ brahmā //
meaning: अध्वर्युं प्रस्तोतान्वारभते प्रस्तोतारम् उद्गातोद्गातारं प्रतिहर्ता प्रतिहर्तारं मैत्रावरुणो मैत्रावरुणम्̐ यजमानो यजमानं ब्रह्मा //
text_mt: The prastotṛ priest grasps the adhvaryu from behind, the udgātṛ the prastotṛ, the pratihartṛ the udgātṛ, the maitrāvaruṇa the pratihartṛ, the sacrificer the maitrāvaruṇa, the brahman the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: mano jyotir \ vardhatāṃ bhūtir ity etābhyāṃ tūṣṇīm upacaritaṃ pṛṣadājyaṃ juhvati //
meaning: मनो ज्योतिर् \ वर्धतां भूतिर् इत्य् एताभ्यां तूष्णीम् उपचरितं पृषदाज्यं जुह्वति //
text_mt: They offer the speckled clarified butter that was treated silently, with these two [verses]: 'Mind, light...' and 'May prosperity increase.'

sanskrit_iast: vāg agregā agre yātv ṛjugā devebhyo yaśo mayi dadhatī prāṇān paśuṣu prajāṃ mayi ca yajamāne ca \\ ity adhvaryur agrato darbhamuṣṭim āyuvānaḥ sarpati /
meaning: वाग् अग्रेगा अग्रे यात्व् ऋजुगा देवेभ्यो यशो मयि दधती प्राणान् पशुषु प्रजां मयि च यजमाने च \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युर् अग्रतो दर्भमुष्टिम् आयुवानः सर्पति /
text_mt: With: 'May speech go foremost, going first, going straight, establishing glory among the gods, upon me, breath in animals, offspring upon me and upon the sacrificer,' the adhvaryu priest glides forward, gathering a handful of darbha grass before him.

sanskrit_iast: āstāvaṃ prāpyopaviśanti prastotuḥ savyam anu yajamāno dakṣiṇam anv adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: आस्तावं प्राप्योपविशन्ति प्रस्तोतुः सव्यम् अनु यजमानो दक्षिणम् अन्व् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Having reached the chant-place, they sit down: the sacrificer along the left of the prastotṛ priest, the adhvaryu along his right.

sanskrit_iast: prastotre darbhamuṣṭiṃ prayachan somaḥ pavate \\ iti stotram upākaroti /
meaning: प्रस्तोत्रे दर्भमुष्टिं प्रयछन् सोमः पवते \\ इति स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति /
text_mt: Handing the handful of darbha grass to the prastotṛ priest, he initiates the chant with: 'Soma purifies itself.'

sanskrit_iast: nādhvaryur upagāyāt /
meaning: नाध्वर्युर् उपगायात् /

sanskrit_iast: daśahotāram̐ yajamāno japati purastād bahiṣpavamānasya vasvyai hiṅkuru \\ iti ca śyeno 'si gāyatrachandās \\ anu tvārabhe \ svasti mā saṃpāraya \\ iti ca /
meaning: दशहोतारम्̐ यजमानो जपति पुरस्ताद् बहिष्पवमानस्य वस्व्यै हिङ्कुरु \\ इति च श्येनो ऽसि गायत्रछन्दास् \\ अनु त्वारभे \ स्वस्ति मा संपारय \\ इति च /
text_mt: The sacrificer mutters the daśahotṛ formula before the bahiṣpavamāna chant, and [the mantras]: 'Sound

sanskrit_iast: stoṣyamāṇa unnetā pūtabhṛti pavitram̐ vitatyāvanayaty ādhavanīyam /
meaning: स्तोष्यमाण उन्नेता पूतभृति पवित्रम्̐ वितत्यावनयत्य् आधवनीयम् /
text_mt: When [the chant] is about to be praised, the unnetṛ priest stretches the strainer over the pūtabhṛt vessel and pours down [the soma from] the ādhavanīya vessel.

sanskrit_iast: dásayā parimṛjya yathāsthānaṃ nyubjati /
meaning: द्áसया परिमृज्य यथास्थानं न्युब्जति /
text_mt: Wiping [the vessel] with the fringe [of the strainer], he turns it upside down in its proper place.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ dviṣyāt taṃ bahiṣpavamānāt paribādheta /
meaning: यं द्विष्यात् तं बहिष्पवमानात् परिबाधेत /
text_mt: Whomever he hates, him he should shut out from the bahiṣpavamāna [chant].

sanskrit_iast: stute \\ agnīd agnīn vihara \ barhiḥ stṛṇāhi \ puroḍāśaṃ alaṃkuru \ pratiprasthātaḥ paśum upakalpayasva \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: स्तुते \\ अग्नीद् अग्नीन् विहर \ बर्हिः स्तृणाहि \ पुरोडाशं अलंकुरु \ प्रतिप्रस्थातः पशुम् उपकल्पयस्व \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: When [the chant] is praised, he gives the call: 'Āgnīdhra, distribute the fires; spread the barhis; decorate the sacrificial cake; Pratiprasthātṛ, prepare the animal victim.'

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhrīyād aṅgārān āgnīdhro hotrīyaprabhṛti yathānyuptaṃ dhiṣṇyeṣu vihṛtya pūrvaiḥ sāṃkāśanadvāraiḥ praviśyottareṇa hotrīyaṃ parikramya saṃtatām ulaparājim̐ stṛṇāti pṛṣṭhyāśaṅkor adhy ottaravedeḥ /
meaning: आग्नीध्रीयाद् अङ्गारान् आग्नीध्रो होत्रीयप्रभृति यथान्युप्तं धिष्ण्येषु विहृत्य पूर्वैः सांकाशनद्वारैः प्रविश्योत्तरेण होत्रीयं परिक्रम्य संतताम् उलपराजिम्̐ स्तृणाति पृष्ठ्याशङ्कोर् अध्य् ओत्तरवेदेः /
text_mt: Having distributed burning embers from the āgnīdhra hearth to the dhiṣṇya hearths according to where they were placed, beginning with that of the hotṛ, entering through the eastern sām-kāśana doors and going around to the north of the hotṛ's hearth, the āgnīdhra priest spreads a continuous line of dry grass starting from the peg of the central axis up to the uttara-vedi.

sanskrit_iast: pariplavayā droṇakalaśād grahaṃ gṛhṇāti yā vāṃ kaśā \\ ity āśvinam eṣa te yonir \ mādhvībhyāṃ tvā \\ iti sādayati /
meaning: परिप्लवया द्रोणकलशाद् ग्रहं गृह्णाति या वां कशा \\ इत्य् आश्विनम् एष ते योनिर् \ माध्वीभ्यां त्वा \\ इति सादयति /
text_mt: With the dipping ladle he draws a cup from the droṇakalaśa trough with the verse: 'Whatever whip of yours...'; [this is] the Āśvina cup. He deposits it with the formula: 'This is your womb; for the two lovers of sweetness, [I deposit] you.'

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇo tvaṃ no antamaḥ \ śarma yacha yaśaś ca /
pra te dhārā madhuścutas\ utsaṃ duhrate akṣitim //
iti vaiṣṇavyā pātrāṇi saṃmṛśyotkṛṣya raśanāṃ trivṛtā yūpaṃ parivīya paśūn upākaroty āgneyam ajam agniṣṭoma aindrāgnaṃ dvitīyam ukthya aindram̐ vṛṣṇiṃ tṛtīyam̐ ṣoḍaśini sārasvatīṃ meṣīṃ caturthīm atīrātre /
meaning:
विष्णो त्वं नो अन्तमः \ शर्म यछ यशश् च /
प्र ते धारा मधुश्चुतस्\ उत्सं दुह्रते अक्षितिम् //
इति वैष्णव्या पात्राणि संमृश्योत्कृष्य रशनां त्रिवृता यूपं परिवीय पशून् उपाकरोत्य् आग्नेयम् अजम् अग्निष्टोम ऐन्द्राग्नं द्वितीयम् उक्थ्य ऐन्द्रम्̐ वृष्णिं तृतीयम्̐ षोडशिनि सारस्वतीं मेषीं चतुर्थीम् अतीरात्रे /

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā pravarāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ प्रवरात् /

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭāv idhmaśakalān ādāyāśrāvam ṛtupraiṣādibhir vṛṇīte / yathāmnātam̐ hotāram aśvinādhvaryū ādhvaryavād ity adhvaryur upām̐śv ātmano nāma gṛhītvā pratiprasthātuś ca mānuṣau \\ ity uccaiḥ śakalam agnāv adhyasyati \\ agnir agnīd āgnīdhrād ity āgnīdhraṃ // mitrāvaruṇau praśāstārau praśāstrād iti praśāstāram indro brahmā brāhmaṇād iti brāhmaṇācham̐sinaṃ // marutaḥ potāraḥ potrād iti potāraṃ // gnāvo neṣṭrīyo neṣṭrād iti neṣṭāram agnir daivīnām̐ viśāṃ puraetāyam̐ sunvan yajamāno manuṣyāṇām \\ tayor asthūri ṇau gārhapatyaṃ dīdāyañ śatam̐ himā dvā yū \ rādhām̐si saṃpṛñcānā asaṃpṛñcānau tanvas \ tan me \\ ity āha yajamānaḥ /
meaning: अष्टाव् इध्मशकलान् आदायाश्रावम् ऋतुप्रैषादिभिर् वृणीते / यथाम्नातम्̐ होतारम् अश्विनाध्वर्यू आध्वर्यवाद् इत्य् अध्वर्युर् उपाम्̐श्व् आत्मनो नाम गृहीत्वा प्रतिप्रस्थातुश् च मानुषौ \\ इत्य् उच्चैः शकलम् अग्नाव् अध्यस्यति \\ अग्निर् अग्नीद् आग्नीध्राद् इत्य् आग्नीध्रं // मित्रावरुणौ प्रशास्तारौ प्रशास्त्राद् इति प्रशास्तारम् इन्द्रो ब्रह्मा ब्राह्मणाद् इति ब्राह्मणाछम्̐सिनं // मरुतः पोतारः पोत्राद् इति पोतारं // ग्नावो नेष्ट्रीयो नेष्ट्राद् इति नेष्टारम् अग्निर् दैवीनाम्̐ विशां पुरएतायम्̐ सुन्वन् यजमानो मनुष्याणाम् \\ तयोर् अस्थूरि णौ गार्हपत्यं दीदायञ् शतम्̐ हिमा द्वा यू \ राधाम्̐सि संपृञ्चाना असंपृञ्चानौ तन्वस् \ तन् मे \\ इत्य् आह यजमानः /
text_mt: Taking eight chips of sacrificial fuel and having made the call, he chooses [the priests] with the calls for the season-cups and the like: the hotṛ priest as taught in the text; [with the words,] "The two Aśvins are the two adhvaryu priests from their office as adhvaryu," the adhvaryu priest, having taken his own name and that of the pratiprasthātṛ priest in a whisper, throws a chip onto the fire aloud with the words, "the two human ones"; [with the words,] "Agni is the āgnīdh priest from his office as āgnīdh," the āgnīdhra priest; with "Mitra and Varuṇa are the two commanders from their office of commander," the praśāstṛ; with "Indra is the brahman from his office of brāhmaṇa," the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin; with "The Maruts are the cleansers from their office of cleanser," the potṛ; with "The divine wives are the led wives from the office of neṣṭṛ," the neṣṭṛ. The sacrificer says: "Agni is the leader of the divine subjects; this pressing sacrificer [is the leader] of humans. May their domestic life not lack a yoke-fellow, shining for a hundred winters; uniting their wealths, not uniting their bodies, that for me..."

sanskrit_iast: pravṛtaḥpravṛtas \\ juṣṭo vāco bhūyāsam iti sruveṇa svāhā sarasvatyai \\ iti dvitīyam ṛcā stomam̐ samardhaya \\ iti tṛtīyam /
meaning: प्रवृतःप्रवृतस् \\ जुष्टो वाचो भूयासम् इति स्रुवेण स्वाहा सरस्वत्यै \\ इति द्वितीयम् ऋचा स्तोमम्̐ समर्धय \\ इति तृतीयम् /
text_mt: At each choice [he offers] with the wooden dipping ladle: with "May I be pleasing to speech," the first; with "Svāhā to Sarasvatī!" the second; with "Equip the chant with the verse!" the third.

sanskrit_iast: na savanīye paśupuroḍāśam anunirvapati /
meaning: न सवनीये पशुपुरोडाशम् अनुनिर्वपति /
text_mt: He does not apportion the animal cake along with the press-day oblation.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā vapāyā homāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ वपाया होमात् /

sanskrit_iast: hutāyām̐ vapāyāṃ cātvāle mārjayitvā dhiṣṇyān upatiṣṭhanta ṛtvijo yajamānaś ca /
meaning: हुतायाम्̐ वपायां चात्वाले मार्जयित्वा धिष्ण्यान् उपतिष्ठन्त ऋत्विजो यजमानश् च /
text_mt: When the omentum has been offered, having cleansed themselves at the cātvāla pit, the officiating priests and the sacrificer attend upon the dhiṣṇya hearths.

sanskrit_iast: avakāśair yajamāno grāhān avekṣate // prāṇāpānābhyāṃ me varcodasau pavethām ity upām̐śvantaryāmau // vyānāya me varcodāḥ pavasva \\ ity upām̐śusavanam̐ // vāce me varcodāḥ pavasva \\ ity aindravāyavaṃ // dakṣakratubhyāṃ me varcodāḥ pavasva \\ iti maitrāvaruṇam̐ // śrotrāya me varcodāḥ pavasva \\ ity āśvinaṃ // cakṣurbhyāṃ me varcodasau pavethām iti śukrāmanthinau // ātmane me varcodāḥ pavasva \\ ity āgrāyaṇam aṅgebhyo me varcodāḥ pavasva \\ ity ukthyam āyuṣe me varcodāḥ pavasva \\ iti dhruvam̐ // viṣṇor jaṭharam asi \ varcase me varcodāḥ pavasva \\ iti droṇakalaśam indrasya jaṭharam asi \ varcase me varcodāḥ pavasva \\ ity ādhavanīyam̐ // viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ jaṭharam asi \ varcase me varcodāḥ pavasva \\ iti pūtabhṛtaṃ // ko 'si \ katamo 'si \ katamo vā nāmāsi \ yaṃ tvā somenātītṛpan \ yaṃ tvā somenāmīmadan \ supoṣaḥ poṣaiḥ syāt suvīro vīraiḥ suprajāḥ prajayā \ sucakṣāś cakṣuṣā tvāvekṣe \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati //
meaning: अवकाशैर् यजमानो ग्राहान् अवेक्षते // प्राणापानाभ्यां मे वर्चोदसौ पवेथाम् इत्य् उपाम्̐श्वन्तर्यामौ // व्यानाय मे वर्चोदाः पवस्व \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शुसवनम्̐ // वाचे मे वर्चोदाः पवस्व \\ इत्य् ऐन्द्रवायवं // दक्षक्रतुभ्यां मे वर्चोदाः पवस्व \\ इति मैत्रावरुणम्̐ // श्रोत्राय मे वर्चोदाः पवस्व \\ इत्य् आश्विनं // चक्षुर्भ्यां मे वर्चोदसौ पवेथाम् इति शुक्रामन्थिनौ // आत्मने मे वर्चोदाः पवस्व \\ इत्य् आग्रायणम् अङ्गेभ्यो मे वर्चोदाः पवस्व \\ इत्य् उक्थ्यम् आयुषे मे वर्चोदाः पवस्व \\ इति ध्रुवम्̐ // विष्णोर् जठरम् असि \ वर्चसे मे वर्चोदाः पवस्व \\ इति द्रोणकलशम् इन्द्रस्य जठरम् असि \ वर्चसे मे वर्चोदाः पवस्व \\ इत्य् आधवनीयम्̐ // विश्वेषां देवानां जठरम् असि \ वर्चसे मे वर्चोदाः पवस्व \\ इति पूतभृतं // को ऽसि \ कतमो ऽसि \ कतमो वा नामासि \ यं त्वा सोमेनातीतृपन् \ यं त्वा सोमेनामीमदन् \ सुपोषः पोषैः स्यात् सुवीरो वीरैः सुप्रजाः प्रजया \ सुचक्षाश् चक्षुषा त्वावेक्षे \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति //
text_mt: With the avakāśa formulas the sacrificer looks at the cups: with "For out-breath and in-breath, bestow radiance on me and clarify yourselves," the upāṃśu and antaryāma cups; with "For through-breath, bestow radiance on me and clarify yourself," the upāṃśusavana pressing-stone; with "For speech, bestow radiance on me and clarify yourself," the cup for Indra and Vāyu; with "For skill and insight, bestow radiance on me and clarify yourself," the cup for Mitra and Varuṇa; with "For hearing, bestow radiance on me and clarify yourself," the cup for the Aśvins; with "For the two eyes, bestow radiance on me and clarify yourselves," the śukra and manthin cups; with "For myself, bestow radiance on me and clarify yourself," the āgrāyaṇa cup; with "For my limbs, bestow radiance on me and clarify yourself," the ukthya cup; with "For my life, bestow radiance on me and clarify yourself," the dhruva cup; with "You are the belly of Viṣṇu; for radiance, bestow radiance on me and clarify yourself," the droṇakalaśa trough; with "You are the belly of Indra; for radiance, bestow radiance on me and clarify yourself," the ādhavanīya trough; with "You are the belly of the All-gods; for radiance, bestow radiance on me and clarify yourself," the pūtabhṛt vessel. Everywhere he subjoins: "Who are you? Which one are you? Or what is your name? You whom they satisfied with soma, whom they gladdened with soma, may there be good nourishment with nourishment, good heroes with heroes, good offspring with offspring; with good sight, with sight I look upon you."

sanskrit_iast: tejase me varcodāḥ pavasva \\ ity ājyaṃ // paśubhyo me varcodāḥ pavasva \\ iti pṛṣadājyam āyur bṛhat tad aśīya tan mām avatu \ tasya nāmnā vṛścāvo yo asmān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmas \\ iti havirdhānam̐ // viśvāyur vāmadevyaṃ tad aśīya tan mām avatu \ tasya nāmnā vṛścāvo yo asmān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmas \\ ity āgnīdhram āyuḥpatī rathaṃtaraṃ tad aśīya tan mām avatu \ tasya nāmnā vṛścāvo yo asmān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmas \\ bhuvanam asi \ viprathasva \ namaḥ sade \ namaḥ sadasaspataye \\ iti sado // dṛḍhe stho 'śithire samīcī am̐hasas pātaṃ \ mā mā dyāvāpṛthivī saṃtāptaṃ mā mādyābhi śvaś ca caratam iti dvārye //
meaning: तेजसे मे वर्चोदाः पवस्व \\ इत्य् आज्यं // पशुभ्यो मे वर्चोदाः पवस्व \\ इति पृषदाज्यम् आयुर् बृहत् तद् अशीय तन् माम् अवतु \ तस्य नाम्ना वृश्चावो यो अस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मस् \\ इति हविर्धानम्̐ // विश्वायुर् वामदेव्यं तद् अशीय तन् माम् अवतु \ तस्य नाम्ना वृश्चावो यो अस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मस् \\ इत्य् आग्नीध्रम् आयुःपती रथंतरं तद् अशीय तन् माम् अवतु \ तस्य नाम्ना वृश्चावो यो अस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मस् \\ भुवनम् असि \ विप्रथस्व \ नमः सदे \ नमः सदसस्पतये \\ इति सदो // दृढे स्थो ऽशिथिरे समीची अम्̐हसस् पातं \ मा मा द्यावापृथिवी संताप्तं मा माद्याभि श्वश् च चरतम् इति द्वार्ये //
text_mt: With "For fiery energy, bestow radiance on me and clarify yourself," [he looks at] the clarified butter; with "For cattle, bestow radiance on me and clarify yourself," the speckled clarified butter; with "May I attain that Great Life; may that protect me; by its name we cut off him who hates us and whom we hate," the cart-shed; with "May I attain that all-life Vāmadevya; may that protect me; by its name we cut off him who hates us and whom we hate," the āgnīdhra shed; with "May I attain that Rathantara, lords of life; may that protect me; by its name we cut off him who hates us and whom we hate; you are the world, expand; homage to the sadas; homage to the lord of the sadas," the sadas shed; with "You two are firm, unslackened, harmonious; protect [me] from distress; do not burn me, O Heaven and Earth; do not run against me today and tomorrow," the two doorposts.

sanskrit_iast: namaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ pūrvasadbhyo namo aparasadbhyas \\ āganta pitaraḥ somyāsas teṣām̐ vaḥ prativittā ariṣṭāḥ syāma \ supitaro vayam̐ yuṣmābhir bhūyāsma suprajaso yūyam asmābhir bhūyāsta \ pitaro hoyi \ pitaro hoyi \ pitaro hoyi \\ iti dakṣiṇārdham̐ sadasaḥ prekṣamāṇā japanti /
meaning: नमः पितृभ्यः पूर्वसद्भ्यो नमो अपरसद्भ्यस् \\ आगन्त पितरः सोम्यासस् तेषाम्̐ वः प्रतिवित्ता अरिष्टाः स्याम \ सुपितरो वयम्̐ युष्माभिर् भूयास्म सुप्रजसो यूयम् अस्माभिर् भूयास्त \ पितरो होयि \ पितरो होयि \ पितरो होयि \\ इति दक्षिणार्धम्̐ सदसः प्रेक्षमाणा जपन्ति /
text_mt: Looking at the southern half of the sadas, they mutter: "Homage to the fathers seated in front, homage to those seated behind! Come, O soma-loving fathers; found by you, may we be unharmed; may we be blessed with good fathers through you; may you be blessed with good offspring through us; O fathers hoyi, O fathers hoyi, O fathers hoyi!"

sanskrit_iast:
ghorā ṛṣayo namo astvadya yebhyas\ cakṣur yeṣāṃ tapa uccabhīmam /
bṛhaspate mahiṣa dyuman namas\ namo viśvakarmaṇe ma u pātv asmān //
iti dhiṣṇyān //
meaning:
घोरा ऋषयो नमो अस्त्वद्य येभ्यस्\ चक्षुर् येषां तप उच्चभीमम् /
बृहस्पते महिष द्युमन् नमस्\ नमो विश्वकर्मणे म उ पात्व् अस्मान् //
इति धिष्ण्यान् //
text_mt:
"Homage today be to the dread seers, / whose eye and heat of asceticism are lofty and terrible!

O Bṛhaspati, great, radiant, homage! / Homage to Viśvakarman; may he protect us!"

sanskrit_iast: svasti vayaṃ tvayā vasema deva soma sūrya gāyatryā tvā śam̐sīmahi \\ ity ādityam /
meaning: स्वस्ति वयं त्वया वसेम देव सोम सूर्य गायत्र्या त्वा शम्̐सीमहि \\ इत्य् आदित्यम् /
text_mt: With "May we dwell in well-being with you, O divine Soma; O Sūrya, with the gāyatrī may we praise you," [he looks at] the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
upa mā dyāvāpṛthivī hvayetām \ upāstāvāḥ kalásāḥ somadhānāḥ /
upa mā hotrā upahave hvayantām \ upahūtā gāva upahūto 'haṃ gavām //
iti prāṅmukhāḥ kalaśān /
meaning:
उप मा द्यावापृथिवी ह्वयेताम् \ उपास्तावाः कल्áसाः सोमधानाः /
उप मा होत्रा उपहवे ह्वयन्ताम् \ उपहूता गाव उपहूतो ऽहं गवाम् //
इति प्राङ्मुखाः कलशान् /
text_mt:
"May Heaven and Earth invite me! / May the laud-chanting cups holding soma invite me!

May the hotrās invite me at the invitation! / Invited are the cows; invited am I of the cows!"

Facing east, [they address] the jars [with this formula].

sanskrit_iast: sadaḥ prasṛpyopaviśanti / dakṣiṇataḥpurastād dhotrīyasya yajamāna upaviśaty uttarāv adhvaryū /
meaning: सदः प्रसृप्योपविशन्ति / दक्षिणतःपुरस्ताद् धोत्रीयस्य यजमान उपविशत्य् उत्तराव् अध्वर्यू /
text_mt: Having crept into the sadas, they sit down. To the south and east of the hotṛ's post the sacrificer sits down, and the two adhvaryu priests to the north.

sanskrit_iast: pratiprasthātā pātryām upastīrya savanīyān udvāsayati pūrvārdhe dhānā dakṣiṇārdhe saktūn karambhāya dadhnā prayutān sarpiṣā vā paścārdhe saktūn parivāpāya madhye puroḍāśam̐ visrāvyāmikṣām uttarārdhe /
meaning: प्रतिप्रस्थाता पात्र्याम् उपस्तीर्य सवनीयान् उद्वासयति पूर्वार्धे धाना दक्षिणार्धे सक्तून् करम्भाय दध्ना प्रयुतान् सर्पिषा वा पश्चार्धे सक्तून् परिवापाय मध्ये पुरोडाशम्̐ विस्राव्यामिक्षाम् उत्तरार्धे /
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ, having spread an underlayer [of clarified butter] in the dish, takes off the press-day oblations: parched grains in the eastern half; barley meal mixed with curd or melted butter for groats in the southern half; barley meal for puffed grains in the western half; the sacrificial cake in the middle; having drained [the whey], the clotted curd in the northern half.

sanskrit_iast: alaṃkṛtya juhūpabhṛtor avadāya prātaḥ prātaḥsāvasyendrāya puroḍāśānām anubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayaty āśrāvya prātaḥ prātaḥsāvasyendrāya puroḍāśān preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
meaning: अलंकृत्य जुहूपभृतोर् अवदाय प्रातः प्रातःसावस्येन्द्राय पुरोडाशानाम् अनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयत्य् आश्राव्य प्रातः प्रातःसावस्येन्द्राय पुरोडाशान् प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
text_mt: Having garnished them and cut portions into the juhū and upabhṛt spoons, he causes [the hotṛ] to recite the invitatory verse: "For Indra of the morning pressing, recite for the sacrificial cakes [and other oblations]." Having made the call, he proceeds [with the offering]: "For Indra of the morning pressing, summon [the hotṛ to recite the offering verse] for the sacrificial cakes."

sanskrit_iast: aupabhṛtaṃ juhvām ānīya \\ agnaye puroḍāśānām anubrūhi \\ agnaye puroḍāśān prasthitān preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
meaning: औपभृतं जुह्वाम् आनीय \\ अग्नये पुरोडाशानाम् अनुब्रूहि \\ अग्नये पुरोडाशान् प्रस्थितान् प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
text_mt: Having poured the portion from the upabhṛt into the juhū, he proceeds [with the offering]: "For Agni recite for the sacrificial cakes; for Agni summon [the hotṛ to recite the offering verse] for the sacrificial cakes that have been brought forward."

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā kapālavimocanād anyad iḍopahavāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ कपालविमोचनाद् अन्यद् इडोपहवात् /
text_mt: [The procedure is] established up to the disposal of the potsherds, except for the invitation to the iḍā.

sanskrit_iast: srucau camasm̐ vāyavyam̐ vādāya vācam̐ yachaty ā yaja \\ iti vacanāt /
meaning: स्रुचौ चमस्म्̐ वायव्यम्̐ वादाय वाचम्̐ यछत्य् आ यज \\ इति वचनात् /
text_mt: Taking the two offering ladles, a cup, or a vāyavya beaker, he restrains speech until the utterance "Recite the offering verse."

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhre sphyasaṃmārgapāṇir āgnīdhraḥ paścād āsandīm ārabhyordhvas tiṣṭhann astu śrauṣat \\ iti pratyāśrāvayati /
meaning: आग्नीध्रे स्फ्यसंमार्गपाणिर् आग्नीध्रः पश्चाद् आसन्दीम् आरभ्योर्ध्वस् तिष्ठन्न् अस्तु श्रौषत् \\ इति प्रत्याश्रावयति /
text_mt: In the āgnīdhra shed, holding the wooden sword and sweeping-brush in hand, taking hold of the chair from behind and standing upright, the āgnīdhra priest responds to the call with: "Let it be heard!"

sanskrit_iast: pratyāśrute dakṣiṇaṃ paridhisaṃdhiṃ pratyavasthāya juhoty adhvaryur uttaraṃ pratiprasthātā madhye 'gner ājyāhutīḥ puroḍāśāhutīḥ paśvāhutīś cābhitaḥ somāhutīḥ /
meaning: प्रत्याश्रुते दक्षिणं परिधिसंधिं प्रत्यवस्थाय जुहोत्य् अध्वर्युर् उत्तरं प्रतिप्रस्थाता मध्ये ऽग्नेर् आज्याहुतीः पुरोडाशाहुतीः पश्वाहुतीश् चाभितः सोमाहुतीः /
text_mt: When the call has been responded to, stepping down opposite the southern junction of the enclosing sticks, the adhvaryu offers, and the pratiprasthātṛ opposite the northern [junction]: clarified-butter offerings in the middle of the fire, sacrificial-cake offerings and animal offerings on either side, soma offerings [all around].

sanskrit_iast: dvidevatyaiḥ pracarataḥ /
meaning: द्विदेवत्यैः प्रचरतः /
text_mt: The two proceed with the cups for two deities.

sanskrit_iast: pratiprasthātādityapātreṇa pratinigrāhyān grāham asannāñ juhoti //
meaning: प्रतिप्रस्थातादित्यपात्रेण प्रतिनिग्राह्यान् ग्राहम् असन्नाञ् जुहोति //
text_mt: With the āditya cup, taking the pratinigrāhya cups, the pratiprasthātṛ offers those that are not set down.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ vāyava indravāyubhyāṃ tvā \\ iti gṛhṇāti /
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ वायव इन्द्रवायुभ्यां त्वा \\ इति गृह्णाति /
text_mt: He draws [the soma] with: "You are taken with a support; for Vāyu, for Indra and Vāyu, [I take] you."

sanskrit_iast:
mukhyam ādāyādhvaryuḥ pariplavayā droṇakalaśāt
adhvaryo 'yam̐ yajño 'stu devās\ oṣadhībhyaḥ paśubhyo me dhanāya /
viśvasmai bhūtāya dhruvo 'stu devāḥ \ sa pinvasva ghṛtavad devayajyāyai svāhā //
iti somam āghāram āghārayati //
meaning:
मुख्यम् आदायाध्वर्युः परिप्लवया द्रोणकलशात्
अध्वर्यो ऽयम्̐ यज्ञो ऽस्तु देवास्\ ओषधीभ्यः पशुभ्यो मे धनाय /
विश्वस्मै भूताय ध्रुवो ऽस्तु देवाः \ स पिन्वस्व घृतवद् देवयज्यायै स्वाहा //
इति सोमम् आघारम् आघारयति //
text_mt:
Having taken the principal [vessel], the adhvaryu, with the pariplavā ladle from the droṇakalaśa trough,

"O adhvaryu, may this sacrifice be, O gods, / for herbs, for cattle, for my wealth!

For every living being may it be firm, O gods! / Swell, full of clarified butter, for worship of the gods, svāhā!"

— with this he pours a continuous stream of soma.

sanskrit_iast: vāyava indravāyubhyām anubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayatyāśrāvya vāyava indravāyubhyāṃ preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
meaning: वायव इन्द्रवायुभ्याम् अनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयत्याश्राव्य वायव इन्द्रवायुभ्यां प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
text_mt: He causes [the hotṛ] to recite the invitatory verse, saying: 'Recite for Vāyu and Indra-Vāyu.' Having called for [the āgnīdhra's] response, he proceeds [to offer], saying: 'Prompt [the hotṛ to recite the offering verse] for Vāyu and Indra-Vāyu.'

sanskrit_iast: vaṣaṭkṛte juhutaḥ /
meaning: वषट्कृते जुहुतः /

sanskrit_iast: punarvaṣaṭkṛte hutvā vyavanayataḥ /
meaning: पुनर्वषट्कृते हुत्वा व्यवनयतः /
text_mt: When the second vaṣaṭ-call is uttered, having offered, they pour out [residues] into each other's cups.

sanskrit_iast: pratiprasthātādhvaryupātre sarvam ānayati /
meaning: प्रतिप्रस्थाताध्वर्युपात्रे सर्वम् आनयति /
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ pours everything into the adhvaryu's vessel.

sanskrit_iast: tasyāgram adhvaryuḥ pratiprasthāne 'vanīya tvaramāṇo bhakṣam̐ harati //
meaning: तस्याग्रम् अध्वर्युः प्रतिप्रस्थाने ऽवनीय त्वरमाणो भक्षम्̐ हरति //
text_mt: The adhvaryu, having poured off the first portion of it into the pratiprasthātṛ's [vessel], brings the portion for consumption in haste.

sanskrit_iast: ayam̐ vasuḥ purovasur iti hotre prayachati //
meaning: अयम्̐ वसुः पुरोवसुर् इति होत्रे प्रयछति //
text_mt: He hands [it] over to the hotṛ with: 'This is the good, possessing foremost wealth.'

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ devebhyas tvā \\ iti pratiprasthātādityapātreṇādityasthālyām̐ saṃpātam avanayati //
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ देवेभ्यस् त्वा \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थातादित्यपात्रेणादित्यस्थाल्याम्̐ संपातम् अवनयति //
text_mt: With: 'You are taken with a base; for the gods, you,' the pratiprasthātṛ pours the remnant into the āditya pot by means of the āditya cup.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tvā \\ iti gṛhṇāti /
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ मित्रावरुणाभ्यां त्वा \\ इति गृह्णाति /
text_mt: He draws [the cup] with: 'You are taken with a base; for Mitra and Varuṇa, you.'

sanskrit_iast: mukhyam ādāyādhvaryur yathādevatam anuvācayati /
meaning: मुख्यम् आदायाध्वर्युर् यथादेवतम् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: Taking the primary [vessel], the adhvaryu causes [the hotṛ] to recite the invitatory verse according to the deity.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā pradānāt //
meaning: सिद्धम् आ प्रदानात् //

sanskrit_iast: ayam̐ vasur vidadvasur iti hotre prayachati //
meaning: अयम्̐ वसुर् विदद्वसुर् इति होत्रे प्रयछति //
text_mt: He hands [it] over to the hotṛ with: 'This is the good, obtaining wealth.'

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ viśvadevebhyas tvā \\ iti pratiprasthātādityapātreṇādityasthālyām̐ saṃpātam avanayati //
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ विश्वदेवेभ्यस् त्वा \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थातादित्यपात्रेणादित्यस्थाल्याम्̐ संपातम् अवनयति //
text_mt: With: 'You are taken with a base; for the Viśvedevas, you,' the pratiprasthātṛ pours the remnant into the āditya pot by means of the āditya cup.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ aśvibhyāṃ tvā \\ iti gṛhṇāti /
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ अश्विभ्यां त्वा \\ इति गृह्णाति /
text_mt: He draws [the cup] with: 'You are taken with a base; for the Aśvins, you.'

sanskrit_iast: mukhyam ādāyādhvaryur yathādevatam anuvācayati /
meaning: मुख्यम् आदायाध्वर्युर् यथादेवतम् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: Taking the primary [vessel], the adhvaryu causes [the hotṛ] to recite the invitatory verse according to the deity.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā pradānāt //
meaning: सिद्धम् आ प्रदानात् //

sanskrit_iast: ayam̐ vasuḥ sam̐yadvasur iti hotre prayachati //
meaning: अयम्̐ वसुः सम्̐यद्वसुर् इति होत्रे प्रयछति //
text_mt: He hands [it] over to the hotṛ with: 'This is the good, holding wealth together.'

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ viśvebhyas tvā devebhyas \\ iti pratiprasthātādityapātreṇādityasthālyām̐ saṃpātam avanayati //
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ विश्वेभ्यस् त्वा देवेभ्यस् \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थातादित्यपात्रेणादित्यस्थाल्याम्̐ संपातम् अवनयति //
text_mt: With: 'You are taken with a base; for all the gods, you,' the pratiprasthātṛ pours the remnant into the āditya pot by means of the āditya cup.

sanskrit_iast: diteḥ putrāṇām ity ādityasthālīm abhipūrayati pariplavayā droṇakalaśāt //
meaning: दितेः पुत्राणाम् इत्य् आदित्यस्थालीम् अभिपूरयति परिप्लवया द्रोणकलशात् //
text_mt: With: '[Sons] of Diti...', he fills the āditya pot from the droṇakalaśa by means of the dipping ladle.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ viṣṇos tvorukrame gṛhṇāmi \\ ity ādityasthālīm abhimṛśati //
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ विष्णोस् त्वोरुक्रमे गृह्णामि \\ इत्य् आदित्यस्थालीम् अभिमृशति //
text_mt: With: 'You are taken with a base; I grasp you in the wide stride of Viṣṇu,' he touches the āditya pot.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇa urukramaiṣa te somas \\ iti pratiprasthātādityapātreṇādityasthālīm apidadhāty apidadhāti /
meaning: विष्ण उरुक्रमैष ते सोमस् \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थातादित्यपात्रेणादित्यस्थालीम् अपिदधात्य् अपिदधाति /
text_mt: With: 'O wide-striding Viṣṇu, this is your Soma,' the pratiprasthātṛ covers, covers the āditya pot with the āditya cup.

sanskrit_iast: pūtabhṛto 'nte madhyataḥkāricamasān upasādayati hotur brahmaṇa udgātur yajamānasya /
meaning: पूतभृतो ऽन्ते मध्यतःकारिचमसान् उपसादयति होतुर् ब्रह्मण उद्गातुर् यजमानस्य /
text_mt: At the rim of the pūtabhṛt [vat], he places the cups of the principal officiants: of the hotṛ, the brahman, the udgātṛ, and the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: hotṛkacamasām̐ś cānyānṛte 'chāvākacamasād unnayati //
meaning: होतृकचमसाम्̐श् चान्यानृते ऽछावाकचमसाद् उन्नयति //
text_mt: And he draws [Soma into] the cups of the subordinate hotṛ priests, except the cup of the acchāvāka.

sanskrit_iast: unnīyamānebhyo 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
meaning: उन्नीयमानेभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: He causes [the hotṛ] to recite the invitatory verse, saying: 'Recite for [the cups] being drawn.'

sanskrit_iast: ubhayataḥśukrān unnetonnayati /
meaning: उभयतःशुक्रान् उन्नेतोन्नयति /
text_mt: The unnetṛ draws [the cups], having śukra [drawn] on both sides.

sanskrit_iast: droṇakalaśād upastīrya pūtabhṛta upabilān kṛtvā droṇakalaśād abhipūrayati //
meaning: द्रोणकलशाद् उपस्तीर्य पूतभृत उपबिलान् कृत्वा द्रोणकलशाद् अभिपूरयति //
text_mt: Having made an underlayer from the droṇakalaśa, and having filled up to the brim from the pūtabhṛt, he tops [them] off from the droṇakalaśa.

sanskrit_iast: tutho 'si janadhāyās \\ devās tvā śukrapāḥ praṇayantu \\ iti śukram ādatte // tutho 'si janadhāyās \\ devās tvā manthipāḥ praṇayantu \\ iti manthinaṃ pratiprasthātā //
meaning: तुथो ऽसि जनधायास् \\ देवास् त्वा शुक्रपाः प्रणयन्तु \\ इति शुक्रम् आदत्ते // तुथो ऽसि जनधायास् \\ देवास् त्वा मन्थिपाः प्रणयन्तु \\ इति मन्थिनं प्रतिप्रस्थाता //
text_mt: With: 'You are Tutha, the supporter of people; may the gods who drink śukra lead you forward,' [the adhvaryu] takes the śukra [cup]; with: 'You are Tutha, the supporter of people; may the gods who drink manthin lead you forward,' the pratiprasthātṛ takes the manthin [cup].

sanskrit_iast: apanuttau śaṇḍāmarkau \\ iti pām̐sūn apadhvam̐sayataḥ /
meaning: अपनुत्तौ शण्डामर्कौ \\ इति पाम्̐सून् अपध्वम्̐सयतः /
text_mt: With: 'Śaṇḍa and Marka are expelled,' the two brush away the dust.

sanskrit_iast: adhastād yūpaśakalāv upayachete /
meaning: अधस्ताद् यूपशकलाव् उपयछेते /
text_mt: Underneath, they hold two chips of the sacrificial post.

sanskrit_iast: prokṣitedhmaśakalābhyām achinnasya te deva soma \\ ity apidhattaḥ /
meaning: प्रोक्षितेध्मशकलाभ्याम् अछिन्नस्य ते देव सोम \\ इत्य् अपिधत्तः /
text_mt: With two sprinkled chips of firewood, they cover [the cups] with: 'Of you unbroken, O divine Soma...'

sanskrit_iast: ādānābhyām upaniṣkrāmataḥ //
meaning: आदानाभ्याम् उपनिष्क्रामतः //
text_mt: They step out together holding [the cups].

sanskrit_iast: āyuḥ saṃdhattam \\ prāṇam̐ saṃdhattam \\ cakṣuḥ saṃdhattam \\ śrotram̐ saṃdhattam \\ manaḥ saṃdhattam \\ vācam̐ saṃdhattam iti paścād uttaravedera vayamya grahāv aratnī saṃdhattaḥ //
meaning: आयुः संधत्तम् \\ प्राणम्̐ संधत्तम् \\ चक्षुः संधत्तम् \\ श्रोत्रम्̐ संधत्तम् \\ मनः संधत्तम् \\ वाचम्̐ संधत्तम् इति पश्चाद् उत्तरवेदेर वयम्य ग्रहाव् अरत्नी संधत्तः //
text_mt: With: 'Unite life; unite breath; unite sight; unite hearing; unite mind; unite speech,' having held down [the cups] to the west of the high altar, they join their elbows.

sanskrit_iast: anādhṛṣṭāsi \\ ity aṅguṣṭhābhyām uttaravedim ākrāmata upari likhantāv uttaravediṃ parikrāmataḥ /
meaning: अनाधृष्टासि \\ इत्य् अङ्गुष्ठाभ्याम् उत्तरवेदिम् आक्रामत उपरि लिखन्ताव् उत्तरवेदिं परिक्रामतः /
text_mt: With: 'You are unassailable,' they step onto the high altar with their thumbs, and scratch above as they step around the high altar.

sanskrit_iast: śukram̐ yajamāno 'nvārabhate //
meaning: शुक्रम्̐ यजमानो ऽन्वारभते //
text_mt: The sacrificer takes hold of the śukra [cup] from behind.

sanskrit_iast: suvīrāḥ prajās \\ iti dakṣiṇenādhvaryuḥ [ gachati ] // suprajāḥ prajās \\ ity uttareṇa pratiprasthātā //
meaning: सुवीराः प्रजास् \\ इति दक्षिणेनाध्वर्युः [ गछति ] // सुप्रजाः प्रजास् \\ इत्य् उत्तरेण प्रतिप्रस्थाता //
text_mt: With: '[May] progeny [be] rich in heroes,' the adhvaryu [walks] along the south; with: '[May] progeny [be] well-off,' the pratiprasthātṛ [walks] along the north.

sanskrit_iast: indreṇa manyunā \\ iti yajamāno japati /
meaning: इन्द्रेण मन्युना \\ इति यजमानो जपति /
text_mt: The sacrificer mutters: 'With Indra's wrath...'

sanskrit_iast: purastāt pratyañcāv avatiṣṭhete //
meaning: पुरस्तात् प्रत्यञ्चाव् अवतिष्ठेते //
text_mt: The two stand in front, facing west.

sanskrit_iast: saṃjagmānau \\ ity aratnī saṃdhattaḥ //
meaning: संजग्मानौ \\ इत्य् अरत्नी संधत्तः //
text_mt: With: 'Meeting together,' they join their elbows.

sanskrit_iast: śukrasyādhiṣṭhānam asi \\ itīdhmaśakalam agnāv adhyasyati // manthino 'dhiṣṭhānam asi \\ iti pratiprasthātā //
meaning: शुक्रस्याधिष्ठानम् असि \\ इतीध्मशकलम् अग्नाव् अध्यस्यति // मन्थिनो ऽधिष्ठानम् असि \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता //
text_mt: With: 'You are the resting place of śukra,' he throws the chip of firewood onto the fire; the pratiprasthātṛ [does likewise] with: 'You are the resting place of manthin.'

sanskrit_iast: nirastaḥ śaṇḍas \\ iti yūpaśakalaṃ bahirvedi nirasyati // nirasto markas \\ iti pratiprasthātā /
meaning: निरस्तः शण्डस् \\ इति यूपशकलं बहिर्वेदि निरस्यति // निरस्तो मर्कस् \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
text_mt: With: 'Śaṇḍa is cast out,' he casts the chip of the sacrificial post outside the altar ground; the pratiprasthātṛ [does likewise] with: 'Marka is cast out.'

sanskrit_iast: prāñcaś camasaiś caranti pratyañcau śukrāmanthibhyām /
meaning: प्राञ्चश् चमसैश् चरन्ति प्रत्यञ्चौ शुक्रामन्थिभ्याम् /
text_mt: They move facing east with the cups, and the two [move] facing west with the śukra and manthin [cups].

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvyādhvaryuḥ prātaḥ prātaḥsāvasya śukravato manthivato madhuścuta indrāya somān prasthitān preṣya \ hotar yaja \ madhyataḥkāriṇāṃ camasādhvaryavo vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛte juhuta \ hotṛkāṇāṃ camasādhvaryavaḥ [ sakṛt ] sakṛd dhutām̐ś camasān śukrasyābhyunnīyopāvartadhvam iti preṣyati /
meaning: आश्राव्याध्वर्युः प्रातः प्रातःसावस्य शुक्रवतो मन्थिवतो मधुश्चुत इन्द्राय सोमान् प्रस्थितान् प्रेष्य \ होतर् यज \ मध्यतःकारिणां चमसाध्वर्यवो वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृते जुहुत \ होतृकाणां चमसाध्वर्यवः [ सकृत् ] सकृद् धुताम्̐श् चमसान् शुक्रस्याभ्युन्नीयोपावर्तध्वम् इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Having called for [the āgnīdhra's] response, the adhvaryu gives the prompts: 'At the morning pressing, prompt [the hotṛ to recite] for Indra the Soma libations that have set forth, accompanied by śukra, accompanied by manthin, dripping sweetness! Hotṛ, recite the offering verse! Camasādhvaryus of the principal officiants, make the offerings at the vaṣaṭ-call and the second vaṣaṭ-call! Camasādhvaryus of the subordinate hotṛ priests, having once drawn Soma [for] the cups from the śukra, turn back!'

sanskrit_iast: yathāpreṣitaṃ camasānām /
meaning: यथाप्रेषितं चमसानाम् /
text_mt: The [handling] of the cups is according to the prompt.

sanskrit_iast: śukrāmanthinau pratinigadya homau //
meaning: शुक्रामन्थिनौ प्रतिनिगद्य होमौ //
text_mt: The two offerings of śukra and manthin take place after reciting the prompt.

sanskrit_iast: yā prathamā sam̐skṛtir ity ubhau nigadya tasmā indrāya sutam ājuhota \\ ity adhvaryuḥ sarvahutaṃ karoti // tasmai sūryāya sutam ājuhota \\ iti pratiprasthātā /
meaning: या प्रथमा सम्̐स्कृतिर् इत्य् उभौ निगद्य तस्मा इन्द्राय सुतम् आजुहोत \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युः सर्वहुतं करोति // तस्मै सूर्याय सुतम् आजुहोत \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
text_mt: Both having recited: 'The first arrangement...', the adhvaryu makes a complete offering with: 'Pour out the pressed [Soma] to that Indra!'; the pratiprasthātṛ [does so] with: 'Pour out the pressed [Soma] to that Sūrya!'

sanskrit_iast: hutvā rudrāya svāhā \\ iti śeṣam uttarārdhapūrvārdhe juhoti //
meaning: हुत्वा रुद्राय स्वाहा \\ इति शेषम् उत्तरार्धपूर्वार्धे जुहोति //
text_mt: Having offered, he offers the remnant on the north-eastern part with: 'To Rudra, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: praitu hotuś camasaḥ pra brahmaṇaḥ prodgātuḥ pra yajamānasya \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: प्रैतु होतुश् चमसः प्र ब्रह्मणः प्रोद्गातुः प्र यजमानस्य \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He gives the prompt: 'Let the cup of the hotṛ go forward; let that of the brahman go forward; let that of the udgātṛ go forward; let that of the sacrificer go forward!'

sanskrit_iast: pratiparikramya yathāsthānaṃ pātre sādayataḥ /
meaning: प्रतिपरिक्रम्य यथास्थानं पात्रे सादयतः /
text_mt: Having stepped back, the two place the vessels in their respective places.

sanskrit_iast: punarabhyunnītānām ekaikaṃ grāham āśrāvam \\ praśāstar yaja \ brahman yaja \ potar yaja \ neṣṭar yaja \\ agnīd yaja \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: पुनरभ्युन्नीतानाम् एकैकं ग्राहम् आश्रावम् \\ प्रशास्तर् यज \ ब्रह्मन् यज \ पोतर् यज \ नेष्टर् यज \\ अग्नीद् यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Taking one cup at a time of those that were refilled, and having called for the response, he prompts: 'Praśāstṛ, recite the offering verse! Brahman, recite the offering verse! Potṛ, recite the offering verse! Neṣṭṛ, recite the offering verse! Agnīdh, recite the offering verse!'

sanskrit_iast: vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛte hutvā harati bhakṣān //
meaning: वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृते हुत्वा हरति भक्षान् //
text_mt: Having offered at the vaṣaṭ-call and the second vaṣaṭ-call, he takes the portions for consumption.

sanskrit_iast: ayāḍ agnīd iti ced dhotā pṛched ayāḍ iti pratyāha /
meaning: अयाड् अग्नीद् इति चेद् धोता पृछेद् अयाड् इति प्रत्याह /
text_mt: If the hotṛ should ask: 'Has the agnīdh made the offering?', he replies: 'He has made the offering.'

sanskrit_iast: somabhakṣān sadasi bhakṣayanti vaṣaṭkartā homābhiṣavakārī camasinaś ca \\ upahūtopahvayasva \\ ity uktvā \\ upahūtā upahvayadhvam iti vā /
meaning: सोमभक्षान् सदसि भक्षयन्ति वषट्कर्ता होमाभिषवकारी चमसिनश् च \\ उपहूतोपह्वयस्व \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा \\ उपहूता उपह्वयध्वम् इति वा /
text_mt: In the sadas hut, the utterer of the vaṣaṭ-call, the performers of the offering and the pressing, and the cup-bearers consume the Soma portions, having said: 'Invited, invite me,' or: 'Invited, invite [us]!'

sanskrit_iast: dvidevatyān bhakṣayitvā hotā prayachati //
meaning: द्विदेवत्यान् भक्षयित्वा होता प्रयछति //
text_mt: Having consumed the [cups] dedicated to two deities, the hotṛ hands [them] over.

sanskrit_iast: bhakṣehi māviśa dīrghāyutvāya śaṃtanutvāya \\ ehi vaso purovaso \ priyo me hito bhava \\ aśvinos tvā bāhubhyāṃ saghyāsam iti pratigṛhṇāti yam̐yam̐ hotā prayachati //
meaning: भक्षेहि माविश दीर्घायुत्वाय शंतनुत्वाय \\ एहि वसो पुरोवसो \ प्रियो मे हितो भव \\ अश्विनोस् त्वा बाहुभ्यां सघ्यासम् इति प्रतिगृह्णाति यम्̐यम्̐ होता प्रयछति //
text_mt: With: 'O portion for consumption, enter into me for long life, for bodily welfare! Come, O good, foremost in wealth, be dear to me, beneficial! May I grasp you with the arms of the Aśvins,' he receives each one that the hotṛ hands over.

sanskrit_iast: nṛcakṣasaṃ tvā deva soma sucakṣā avakśeṣam ity avekṣate /
meaning: नृचक्षसं त्वा देव सोम सुचक्षा अवक्शेषम् इत्य् अवेक्षते /
text_mt: He looks at it with: 'May I, clear-sighted, look upon you, the man-beholding divine Soma.'

sanskrit_iast:
hinva me gātrā harivas\ gaṇān me mā vitītṛṣat /
śivo me sapta ṛṣīn upatiṣṭha \ mā me 'vāṅ nābhim atigāḥ //
iti dvir aindravāyavaṃ bhakṣayataḥ prāṇeṣūpaniyamya /
meaning:
हिन्व मे गात्रा हरिवस्\ गणान् मे मा वितीतृषत् /
शिवो मे सप्त ऋषीन् उपतिष्ठ \ मा मे ऽवाङ् नाभिम् अतिगाः //
इति द्विर् ऐन्द्रवायवं भक्षयतः प्राणेषूपनियम्य /
text_mt:
'Invigorate my limbs, O lord of the bays; do not torment my vital organs with thirst!

Benevolent to me, attend upon the seven seers; do not pass downward beyond my navel!'

Holding [the cup] near their vital breaths, they consume the cup for Indra and Vāyu twice with this [formula].

sanskrit_iast: avyatihāraṃ cakṣuṣor upaniyamya maitrāvaruṇam \\ mandrā vibhūtiḥ ketur yajñiyā vāg juṣāṇā somasya pibatu \\ iti bhakṣayataḥ /
meaning: अव्यतिहारं चक्षुषोर् उपनियम्य मैत्रावरुणम् \\ मन्द्रा विभूतिः केतुर् यज्ञिया वाग् जुषाणा सोमस्य पिबतु \\ इति भक्षयतः /
text_mt: Holding [it] near the two eyes without interchange, they consume the cup for Mitra and Varuṇa with: 'Pleasing, powerful, the sign, worthy of sacrifice, may Speech enjoy and drink the Soma.'

sanskrit_iast: sarvata āśvinaṃ parihāram̐ śrotrayor upaniyamya pratiparyāhṛtya mandrā svarvācy aditir anāhataśīrṣṇī vāg juṣāṇā somasya pibatu \\ iti bhakṣayataḥ /
meaning: सर्वत आश्विनं परिहारम्̐ श्रोत्रयोर् उपनियम्य प्रतिपर्याहृत्य मन्द्रा स्वर्वाच्य् अदितिर् अनाहतशीर्ष्णी वाग् जुषाणा सोमस्य पिबतु \\ इति भक्षयतः /
text_mt: Bringing [it] around completely, holding [it] near the ears, and turning it back around, they consume the cup for the Aśvins with: 'Pleasing, heaven-sounding, Aditi, whose head is uninjured, may Speech enjoy and drink the Soma.'

sanskrit_iast: hotṛcamase saṃpātam avanayati bhakṣayitvābhakṣayitvā /
meaning: होतृचमसे संपातम् अवनयति भक्षयित्वाभक्षयित्वा /
text_mt: Having consumed [each], he pours the remnant into the hotṛ's cup after each consumption.

sanskrit_iast:
mā mā rājan vibībhiṣas\ mā me hārdi dviṣā vadhīḥ /
vṛṣaṇam̐ śuṣmam āyuṣe varcase kṛdhi //
iti taṃtaṃ bhakṣayitvā hṛdayadeśam ārabhya japati /
meaning:
मा मा राजन् विबीभिषस्\ मा मे हार्दि द्विषा वधीः /
वृषणम्̐ शुष्मम् आयुषे वर्चसे कृधि //
इति तंतं भक्षयित्वा हृदयदेशम् आरभ्य जपति /

sanskrit_iast: nānavadhāyāvasṛjed aindravāyave puroḍāśavṛgalaṃ maitrāvaruṇe payasyāṃ dhānā āśvine /
meaning: नानवधायावसृजेद् ऐन्द्रवायवे पुरोडाशवृगलं मैत्रावरुणे पयस्यां धाना आश्विने /
text_mt: He should not release [them] without putting in: into [the cup] for Indra and Vāyu, a crumb of the sacrificial cake; into [the cup] for Mitra and Varuṇa, curd offering; into [the cup] for the Aśvins, parched grains.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasyottarasyā vartanyāḥ paścād dvidevatyapātrāṇi sādayati /
meaning: दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्योत्तरस्या वर्तन्याः पश्चाद् द्विदेवत्यपात्राणि सादयति /
text_mt: He places the vessels for the dual deities behind the northern track of the southern cart-shed.

sanskrit_iast: hotre 'vāntareḍām avadyati /
meaning: होत्रे ऽवान्तरेडाम् अवद्यति /
text_mt: He cuts off the intermediate iḍā for the hotṛ.

sanskrit_iast: upahūyamānāyām asam̐sparśayantaś camasān upodyachanti /
meaning: उपहूयमानायाम् असम्̐स्पर्शयन्तश् चमसान् उपोद्यछन्ति /
text_mt: While it is being invoked, they raise the cups without letting them touch one another.

sanskrit_iast: hotrā samudyamya samupahūya vasumadgaṇasya soma deva te matividaḥ prātaḥsavanasya gāyatrachandaso 'gnihuta indrapītasya madhumata upahūta upahūtaṃ bhakṣayāmi \\ iti camasān bhakṣayanti /
meaning: होत्रा समुद्यम्य समुपहूय वसुमद्गणस्य सोम देव ते मतिविदः प्रातःसवनस्य गायत्रछन्दसो ऽग्निहुत इन्द्रपीतस्य मधुमत उपहूत उपहूतं भक्षयामि \\ इति चमसान् भक्षयन्ति /
text_mt: Having raised them together with the hotṛ and mutually invited [one another], they consume the cups with: "Of you, O divine Soma, who belong to the troop of the Vasus, knower of prayers, belonging to the morning pressing, whose meter is gāyatrī, offered in the fire, drunk by Indra, sweet—being invited, I consume what is invited."

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃ no bhava hṛda ā pīta indo \ piteva soma sūnave suśevaḥ /
sakheva sakhya uruśaṃma dhīraḥ \ pra ṇa āyur jīvase soma tārīḥ //
iti taṃtaṃ bhakṣayitvā hṛdayadeśam ārabhya japati //
meaning:
शं नो भव हृद आ पीत इन्दो \ पितेव सोम सूनवे सुशेवः /
सखेव सख्य उरुशंम धीरः \ प्र ण आयुर् जीवसे सोम तारीः //
इति तंतं भक्षयित्वा हृदयदेशम् आरभ्य जपति //
text_mt:
"Be auspicious to our heart when drunk, O drop! As a father is most gentle to his son, O Soma,

as a friend to a friend, O wide-sheltering, wise one: prolong our life that we may live, O Soma!"

Having consumed each [portion] with this [verse], he mutters while touching the heart region.

sanskrit_iast: āpyāyasva \ saṃ te payām̐si \\ iti bhakṣaśeṣān [ āpyāyayanti ] /
meaning: आप्यायस्व \ सं ते पयाम्̐सि \\ इति भक्षशेषान् [ आप्याययन्ति ] /
text_mt: [They swell] the remnants of the consumed [draughts] with: "Swell up," "May your juices gather together."

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya paścādakṣaṃ nārāśam̐sacamasān sādayanti /
meaning: दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य पश्चादक्षं नाराशम्̐सचमसान् सादयन्ति /
text_mt: They place the nārāśaṃsa cups behind the axle of the southern cart-shed.

sanskrit_iast: upaviśaty achāvāko 'greṇa svaṃ dhiṣṇyaṃ bahiḥ sadasaḥ /
meaning: उपविशत्य् अछावाको ऽग्रेण स्वं धिष्ण्यं बहिः सदसः /
text_mt: The acchāvāka priest sits down in front of his own hearth outside the sadas.

sanskrit_iast: tasmai puroḍāśavṛgalaṃ pradāya \\ achāvāka vada \\ ity anuvācayati //
meaning: तस्मै पुरोडाशवृगलं प्रदाय \\ अछावाक वद \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति //
text_mt: Having handed him a crumb of the sacrificial cake, he causes him to recite: "Speak, O acchāvāka!"

sanskrit_iast: upo asmān brāhmaṇān brāhmaṇā hvayadhvam ity ucyamāne puṇyam ayaṃ brāhmaṇa upahavakāmo vadatīmam̐ hotar upahvayasva \\ iti preṣyati //
meaning: उपो अस्मान् ब्राह्मणान् ब्राह्मणा ह्वयध्वम् इत्य् उच्यमाने पुण्यम् अयं ब्राह्मण उपहवकामो वदतीमम्̐ होतर् उपह्वयस्व \\ इति प्रेष्यति //
text_mt: When he says, "Invite us, O Brahmins, Brahmins!," he prompts: "This Brahmin desiring an invitation speaks auspiciously; invite him, O hotṛ!"

sanskrit_iast: unnīyamānāyānubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
meaning: उन्नीयमानायानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: He causes him to recite: "Recite [the invitatory verse] for [the cup] being drawn!"

sanskrit_iast: ubhayataḥ śukram achāvākacamasam unnayati /
meaning: उभयतः शुक्रम् अछावाकचमसम् उन्नयति /
text_mt: He draws the acchāvāka's cup with pure [soma] on both sides.

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya \\ achāvāka yaja \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: आश्राव्य \\ अछावाक यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Having called for recitation, he prompts: "O acchāvāka, recite the offering verse!"

sanskrit_iast: vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛte hutvā harati bhakṣam /
meaning: वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृते हुत्वा हरति भक्षम् /
text_mt: Having offered at the vaṣaṭ and the secondary vaṣaṭ, he carries the portion to be consumed.

sanskrit_iast: na tena saṃbhakṣayed yady asminn upahavam ichet \\ bhakṣaya \\ iti brūyāt /
meaning: न तेन संभक्षयेद् यद्य् अस्मिन्न् उपहवम् इछेत् \\ भक्षय \\ इति ब्रूयात् /
text_mt: He should not consume together with him; if he desires an invitation from him, he should say, "Consume!"

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātaṃ bhakṣaṇam āpyāyanaṃ ca /
meaning: व्याख्यातं भक्षणम् आप्यायनं च /
text_mt: The consuming and the swelling have been explained.

sanskrit_iast: antarā neṣṭuś camasam āgnīdhrasya cāchāvākacamasam̐ sādayati /
meaning: अन्तरा नेष्टुश् चमसम् आग्नीध्रस्य चाछावाकचमसम्̐ सादयति /
text_mt: He places the cup of the acchāvāka between the cup of the neṣtṛ and [that] of the āgnīdhra.

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhre savanīyān bhakṣayanty antarvedi bahirvedi mārjayante / bahirvedi vā bhakṣayitvāntarvedi mārjayante /
meaning: आग्नीध्रे सवनीयान् भक्षयन्त्य् अन्तर्वेदि बहिर्वेदि मार्जयन्ते / बहिर्वेदि वा भक्षयित्वान्तर्वेदि मार्जयन्ते /
text_mt: In the āgnīdhra shed they consume the press-offerings; they purify themselves inside the altar [ground] or outside the altar [ground]; or having consumed outside the altar [ground], they purify themselves inside the altar [ground].

sanskrit_iast: anusavanam \\ brāhmaṇām̐s tarpaya \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: अनुसवनम् \\ ब्राह्मणाम्̐स् तर्पय \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: At each pressing, he prompts: "Satisfy the Brahmins!"

sanskrit_iast: ṛtugrahaiḥ pracarataḥ //
meaning: ऋतुग्रहैः प्रचरतः //
text_mt: The two perform the ritual with the season-cups.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ madhave tvā \\ itiprabhṛtayo grahaṇāḥ /
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ मधवे त्वा \\ इतिप्रभृतयो ग्रहणाः /
text_mt: The drawings begin with: "You are taken with a support;" "For Madhu, thee!"

sanskrit_iast: saha prathamau gṛhṇītaḥ / pariplavām uduhya madhave tvā \\ ity adhvaryur upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ sam̐sarpo 'si \\ am̐haspatyāya tvā \\ iti pratiprasthātā /
meaning: सह प्रथमौ गृह्णीतः / परिप्लवाम् उदुह्य मधवे त्वा \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युर् उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ सम्̐सर्पो ऽसि \\ अम्̐हस्पत्याय त्वा \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
text_mt: Together the two take the first two [cups]. Having moved the pariplavā ladle, the adhvaryu [takes] with: "For Madhu, thee!"; the pratiprasthātṛ [takes] with: "You are taken with a support; you are the Saṃsarpa; for Aṃhaspatya, thee!"

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya preṣyaty adhvaryus tasya praiṣe yugapaj juhutaḥ /
meaning: आश्राव्य प्रेष्यत्य् अध्वर्युस् तस्य प्रैषे युगपज् जुहुतः /
text_mt: Having called for recitation, the adhvaryu prompts; at his prompt, the two offer simultaneously.

sanskrit_iast: na ṛtugraheṣv anuvaṣaṭkaroti /
meaning: न ऋतुग्रहेष्व् अनुवषट्करोति /
text_mt: He does not utter the secondary vaṣaṭ for the season-cups.

sanskrit_iast: hutvā gṛhītvā ca pratiprasthātā dakṣiṇenādhvaryum abhiprayamya pātram̐ harati /
meaning: हुत्वा गृहीत्वा च प्रतिप्रस्थाता दक्षिणेनाध्वर्युम् अभिप्रयम्य पात्रम्̐ हरति /
text_mt: Having offered and having taken [the draught], the pratiprasthātṛ, moving towards the adhvaryu from the south, carries the vessel.

sanskrit_iast: nānyo'nyam abhiprapadyete /
meaning: नान्योऽन्यम् अभिप्रपद्येते /
text_mt: The two do not cross each other's path.

sanskrit_iast: śeṣe pūrvasyottaram abhiparigṛhṇītaḥ /
meaning: शेषे पूर्वस्योत्तरम् अभिपरिगृह्णीतः /
text_mt: In the remainder, the two take each the next after the preceding.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvaḥ pratiprasthātā mādhavāya tvā \\ iti gṛhṇāti / vyatyāsam uttaraiḥ / samānam āśrāvayatoḥ sthānam //
meaning: पूर्वः प्रतिप्रस्थाता माधवाय त्वा \\ इति गृह्णाति / व्यत्यासम् उत्तरैः / समानम् आश्रावयतोः स्थानम् //
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ takes first with: "For Mādhava, thee!" Alternately with the following ones. The standing place of the two who call for recitation is the same.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtunā preṣya \\ iti ṣaḍbhiḥ pracarato / yato hutaṃ tataḥ pātre gṛhītvā ṛtubhiḥ preṣya \\ iti caturbhir yathāditas tathā gṛhītvā ṛtunā preṣya \\ iti dvābhyām /
meaning: ऋतुना प्रेष्य \\ इति षड्भिः प्रचरतो / यतो हुतं ततः पात्रे गृहीत्वा ऋतुभिः प्रेष्य \\ इति चतुर्भिर् यथादितस् तथा गृहीत्वा ऋतुना प्रेष्य \\ इति द्वाभ्याम् /
text_mt: They proceed with six [cups] with: "Prompt with the season!"; having taken into the vessel from where the offering was made, with four [cups] with: "Prompt with the seasons!"; having taken just as at first, with two [cups] with: "Prompt with the season!"

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśe praiṣe adhvaryū yajatam ity ukte tayor anyataro madhyamasya paridheḥ paścād upaviśya ye3 yajāmahe \\ aśvinādhvaryū ādhvaryavāt \\ ṛtunā somaṃ pibatām \\ vauṣaṭ \\ iti yajed atha ced ṛcā ye3 yajāmahe
aśvinā pibataṃ madhu \ dīdyagnī śucivratā \ ṛtunā yajñavāhasā //
vauṣaṭ \\ ity anavānam̐ yajati //
meaning:
एकादशे प्रैषे अध्वर्यू यजतम् इत्य् उक्ते तयोर् अन्यतरो मध्यमस्य परिधेः पश्चाद् उपविश्य ये3 यजामहे \\ अश्विनाध्वर्यू आध्वर्यवात् \\ ऋतुना सोमं पिबताम् \\ वौषट् \\ इति यजेद् अथ चेद् ऋचा ये3 यजामहे
अश्विना पिबतं मधु \ दीद्यग्नी शुचिव्रता \ ऋतुना यज्ञवाहसा //
वौषट् \\ इत्य् अनवानम्̐ यजति //
text_mt: At the eleventh prompt, when "O two adhvaryus, offer!" is said, one of the two, having sat down behind the middle enclosing stick, should recite the offering verse: "We who sacrifice […] May the Aśvins, the two adhvaryus, by virtue of their adhvaryu-ship, drink Soma according to the season! Vauṣaṭ!"; or if with a verse, he recites the offering verse without taking breath: "We who sacrifice […]: / O Aśvins, drink the sweet [soma], / shining with fires, of pure vows, / bringing the sacrifice according to the season! / Vauṣaṭ!"

sanskrit_iast: hotar etad yaja \\ iti vātipreṣyaty uttame praiṣe yajamānasya yājyātipraiṣo vā /
meaning: होतर् एतद् यज \\ इति वातिप्रेष्यत्य् उत्तमे प्रैषे यजमानस्य याज्यातिप्रैषो वा /
text_mt: Or at the last prompt he prompts beyond with: "O hotṛ, recite the offering verse for this!"; or there is an extra prompting of the offering verse for the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: sahottamau gṛhṇītas tapasyāya tvā \\ iti pratiprasthātā sam̐sarpeṇādhvaryuḥ /
meaning: सहोत्तमौ गृह्णीतस् तपस्याय त्वा \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता सम्̐सर्पेणाध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Together the two take the last two [cups]: the pratiprasthātṛ with: "For Tapasya, thee!"; the adhvaryu with the Saṃsarpa [formula].

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇataḥ pratiprasthātāvatiṣṭhate / tasya praiṣe yugapaj juhutaḥ /
meaning: दक्षिणतः प्रतिप्रस्थातावतिष्ठते / तस्य प्रैषे युगपज् जुहुतः /
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ stands to the south. At his prompt, the two offer simultaneously.

sanskrit_iast: hutvā vyavanayataḥ /
meaning: हुत्वा व्यवनयतः /

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryuḥ pratiprasthāne sarvam ānayati /
meaning: अध्वर्युः प्रतिप्रस्थाने सर्वम् आनयति /
text_mt: The adhvaryu pours everything into the vessel of the pratiprasthātṛ.

sanskrit_iast: tasyāgraṃ pratiprasthātādhvaryupātre 'vanīya \\ indrāgnī āgatam̐ sutam iti pratiprasthātādhvaryupātra aindrāgnaṃ gṛhṇāti \\ eṣa te yonir \ indrāgnibhyāṃ tvā \\ iti sādayati /
meaning: तस्याग्रं प्रतिप्रस्थाताध्वर्युपात्रे ऽवनीय \\ इन्द्राग्नी आगतम्̐ सुतम् इति प्रतिप्रस्थाताध्वर्युपात्र ऐन्द्राग्नं गृह्णाति \\ एष ते योनिर् \ इन्द्राग्निभ्यां त्वा \\ इति सादयति /
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ, having poured the foremost portion of it into the vessel of the adhvaryu, draws [the cup] for Indra and Agni into the vessel of the adhvaryu with: "O Indra and Agni, come to the pressed [soma]!"; he puts it down with: "This is your womb; for Indra and Agni, thee!"

sanskrit_iast: pratiprasthānenādhvaryurbhakṣam̐ harati //
meaning: प्रतिप्रस्थानेनाध्वर्युर्भक्षम्̐ हरति //
text_mt: The adhvaryu carries the portion to be consumed with the vessel of the pratiprasthātṛ.

sanskrit_iast: vāg devī somasya pibatu \\ iti bhakṣayanti samupahūya yathejyam̐ vyatihāram /
meaning: वाग् देवी सोमस्य पिबतु \\ इति भक्षयन्ति समुपहूय यथेज्यम्̐ व्यतिहारम् /
text_mt: Having mutually invited [each other], they consume with: "May the divine speech drink of Soma!" alternately according to the order of offering.

sanskrit_iast: prasadasi pātram ādadhāti /
meaning: प्रसदसि पात्रम् आदधाति /
text_mt: He places the vessel in front of the sadas.

sanskrit_iast: pratiprasthātā savanīyān nirvapati /
meaning: प्रतिप्रस्थाता सवनीयान् निर्वपति /
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ apportions the press-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: yathā vaiśvadevasya stotropākaraṇakāle haviṣkṛd āhūyeta /
meaning: यथा वैश्वदेवस्य स्तोत्रोपाकरणकाले हविष्कृद् आहूयेत /
text_mt: Just as the havis-preparer would be summoned at the time of the preliminary performance of the stotra of the vaiśvadeva [śastra].

sanskrit_iast: agreṇa hotāraṃ bahiḥ sadasaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ pratigarāyopaviśati //
meaning: अग्रेण होतारं बहिः सदसः प्राङ्मुखः प्रतिगरायोपविशति //
text_mt: In front of the hotṛ, outside the sadas, facing east, he sits down for the response.

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryo śom̐3sāvo3m ity ucyamāne śom̐3sāvo daivóm iti pratiparyāvartate /
meaning: अध्वर्यो शोम्̐3सावो3म् इत्य् उच्यमाने शोम्̐3सावो दैव्óम् इति प्रतिपर्यावर्तते /
text_mt: When "O adhvaryu, let us two praise, om!" is said, he turns around with: "Let us two praise, divine one!"

sanskrit_iast: ṛtupātram ārabhyordhvas tiṣṭhan sadobile samānasvaram̐ hotrā vyavasāneṣu pratigṛṇāti \\ othā modaiva \\ ity apraṇuteṣu \\ othā modaivo3m iti praṇuteṣv ṛganteṣu ca /
meaning: ऋतुपात्रम् आरभ्योर्ध्वस् तिष्ठन् सदोबिले समानस्वरम्̐ होत्रा व्यवसानेषु प्रतिगृणाति \\ ओथा मोदैव \\ इत्य् अप्रणुतेषु \\ ओथा मोदैवो3म् इति प्रणुतेष्व् ऋगन्तेषु च /
text_mt: Having touched the season-vessel, standing upright at the opening of the sadas, he responds at the pauses in a tone identical with the hotṛ: with "Othā modaiva" at the unprolated [pauses], and with "Othā modaivom" at the prolated [pauses] and at the ends of verses.

sanskrit_iast: yathā vā hotā brūyād āhutaḥ śom̐3sāvo daivo3m iti pratyāhvayati /
meaning: यथा वा होता ब्रूयाद् आहुतः शोम्̐3सावो दैवो3म् इति प्रत्याह्वयति /
text_mt: Or, as the hotṛ might say when addressed, he calls back with: "Let us two praise, divine one, om!"

sanskrit_iast: samāpte śastre graham ādatte 'dhvaryuś camasādhvaryavaś camasān /
meaning: समाप्ते शस्त्रे ग्रहम् आदत्ते ऽध्वर्युश् चमसाध्वर्यवश् चमसान् /
text_mt: When the śastra is finished, the adhvaryu takes the cup, and the cup-adhvaryus take their cups.

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya \\ ukthaśā yaja somasya \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: आश्राव्य \\ उक्थशा यज सोमस्य \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Having called for recitation, he prompts: "O uktha-reciter, recite the offering verse of Soma!"

sanskrit_iast: vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛte juhoti /
meaning: वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृते जुहोति /
text_mt: He offers at the vaṣaṭ and the secondary vaṣaṭ.

sanskrit_iast: camasādhvaryavo dviś camasān anu prāṅ nayanti //
meaning: चमसाध्वर्यवो द्विश् चमसान् अनु प्राङ् नयन्ति //
text_mt: The cup-adhvaryus bring the cups forward along [the altar] twice.

sanskrit_iast: vāg devī somasya pibatu \\ ity aindrāgnam̐ sarvabhakṣaṃ bhakṣayataḥ //
meaning: वाग् देवी सोमस्य पिबतु \\ इत्य् ऐन्द्राग्नम्̐ सर्वभक्षं भक्षयतः //
text_mt: With: "May the divine speech drink of Soma!," the two consume the entire draught of the [cup] for Indra and Agni.

sanskrit_iast: narāśam̐sapītasya soma deva te matividaḥ prātaḥsavanasya gāyatrachandasaḥ pitṛpītasya \\ iti vikṛto bhakṣamantraḥ /
meaning: नराशम्̐सपीतस्य सोम देव ते मतिविदः प्रातःसवनस्य गायत्रछन्दसः पितृपीतस्य \\ इति विकृतो भक्षमन्त्रः /
text_mt: The modified consumption mantra is: "Of you, O divine Soma, who belong to the morning pressing, whose meter is gāyatrī, drunk by Narāśaṃsa, knower of prayers, drunk by the fathers..."

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā sādanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ सादनात् /

sanskrit_iast: ṛtupātre mārjālīye prakṣālya yathāsthānam̐ sādayati //
meaning: ऋतुपात्रे मार्जालीये प्रक्षाल्य यथास्थानम्̐ सादयति //
text_mt: Having washed the two season-vessels at the mārjālīya [hearth], he places them down in their proper places.

sanskrit_iast: omāsaś carṣaṇīdhṛtas \\ iti śukrapātre vaiśvadevaṃ gṛhṇāti \\ eṣa te yonir \ viśvebhyas tvā devebhyas \\ iti sādayati /
meaning: ओमासश् चर्षणीधृतस् \\ इति शुक्रपात्रे वैश्वदेवं गृह्णाति \\ एष ते योनिर् \ विश्वेभ्यस् त्वा देवेभ्यस् \\ इति सादयति /
text_mt: With "Protectors of men, supporters of folks...," he draws the cup for the All-gods in the śukra vessel; he places it down with: "This is your womb; for the All-gods, thee!"

sanskrit_iast: pratiprasthātā droṇakalaśaṃ pūtabhṛty avanīya daśayā parimṛjya yathāsthānaṃ nyubjati /
meaning: प्रतिप्रस्थाता द्रोणकलशं पूतभृत्य् अवनीय दशया परिमृज्य यथास्थानं न्युब्जति /
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ priest, having poured [the soma from] the droṇakalaśa trough into the pūtabhṛt vat and wiped it all around with the fringe, sets it turned upside down in its proper place.

sanskrit_iast: caturhotāram̐ yajamāno japati purastād ājyānām iḍāyai hiṅkuru \\ iti ca /
meaning: चतुर्होतारम्̐ यजमानो जपति पुरस्ताद् आज्यानाम् इडायै हिङ्कुरु \\ इति च /
text_mt: Before the ājyastotras, the sacrificer murmurs the Caturhotṛ formula and: 'Utter the sound hiṅ for the iḍā.'

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇena hotrīyaṃ prastotre darbhau prayachann upāvartadhvam \ abhisarpa yajamāna \\ iti stotram upākaroti /
meaning: दक्षिणेन होत्रीयं प्रस्तोत्रे दर्भौ प्रयछन्न् उपावर्तध्वम् \ अभिसर्प यजमान \\ इति स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति /
text_mt: Giving two darbha-blades to the prastotṛ priest along the south of the hotṛ's post, he brings near the stotra with: 'Turn towards [us]; glide forward, O sacrificer.'

sanskrit_iast: evam ata ūrdhvam̐ stotrāṇy upākaroty anyatra pavamānābhyām //
meaning: एवम् अत ऊर्ध्वम्̐ स्तोत्राण्य् उपाकरोत्य् अन्यत्र पवमानाभ्याम् //
text_mt: From here onwards he brings near the stotras in this manner, except for the two pavamāna chants.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa \\ ity ukte pratigarāyopaviśati / sa vyākhyātaḥ /
meaning: एष \\ इत्य् उक्ते प्रतिगरायोपविशति / स व्याख्यातः /
text_mt: When 'eṣa' has been spoken, he sits down to make the response; that has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: praugam̐ śastraṃ pratigīrya grahādānaprabhṛti samānam aindrāgnenā bhakṣaṇāt //
meaning: प्रौगम्̐ शस्त्रं प्रतिगीर्य ग्रहादानप्रभृति समानम् ऐन्द्राग्नेना भक्षणात् //
text_mt: Having responded to the Prauga recitation, [the procedure] from the taking of the drawing onwards is identical with that of the [offering] to Indra and Agni up to the consuming.

sanskrit_iast: narāśam̐sapītasya \\ iti vikṛto bhakṣamantraḥ /
meaning: नराशम्̐सपीतस्य \\ इति विकृतो भक्षमन्त्रः /
text_mt: '[Of that which has been] drunk by Narāśaṃsa...' is the modified consuming formula.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā sādanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ सादनात् /

sanskrit_iast: mārjālīye prakṣālya pūtabhṛto 'nte sādayanti yathāsthānaṃ pātram /
meaning: मार्जालीये प्रक्षाल्य पूतभृतो ऽन्ते सादयन्ति यथास्थानं पात्रम् /
text_mt: Having rinsed [the cups] at the mārjālīya fire, they set down the cup next to the pūtabhṛt vat in its proper place.

sanskrit_iast: ukthyavigrahaiḥ pracarataḥ //
meaning: उक्थ्यविग्रहैः प्रचरतः //
text_mt: The two perform the rites with the portions of the ukthya vessel.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tvā \\ iti gṛhṇāty ukthyasthālyās tṛtīyam ukthyapātra // eṣa te yonir \ mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tvā \\ iti sādayati //
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ मित्रावरुणाभ्यां त्वा \\ इति गृह्णात्य् उक्थ्यस्थाल्यास् तृतीयम् उक्थ्यपात्र // एष ते योनिर् \ मित्रावरुणाभ्यां त्वा \\ इति सादयति //
text_mt: With: 'You are taken with a support; for Mitra and Varuṇa [I take] you,' he draws one third of the ukthya vessel into the ukthya cup. With: 'This is your womb; for Mitra and Varuṇa [I set] you,' he sets it down.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ devebhyas tvā devāyuvaṃ gṛhṇāmi \ punarhavir asi \\ ity ukthyasthālīm abhimrśati /
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ देवेभ्यस् त्वा देवायुवं गृह्णामि \ पुनर्हविर् असि \\ इत्य् उक्थ्यस्थालीम् अभिम्र्शति /
text_mt: With: 'You are taken with a support; I take you seeking the gods for the gods; you are an oblation renewed,' he touches the ukthya vessel.

sanskrit_iast: pūtabhṛto maitrāvaruṇacamasamukhyān unnayati /
meaning: पूतभृतो मैत्रावरुणचमसमुख्यान् उन्नयति /
text_mt: From the pūtabhṛt vat, he draws [soma] beginning with the Maitrāvaruṇa's goblet.

sanskrit_iast: stutaśastre bhavataḥ /
meaning: स्तुतशस्त्रे भवतः /

sanskrit_iast: maitrāvaruṇāya pratigīrya graham ādatte 'dhvaryuś camasādhvaryavaś camasān /
meaning: मैत्रावरुणाय प्रतिगीर्य ग्रहम् आदत्ते ऽध्वर्युश् चमसाध्वर्यवश् चमसान् /
text_mt: Having responded to the Maitrāvaruṇa, the adhvaryu priest takes the cup, and the camasādhvaryu priests take the goblets.

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya \\ ukthaśā yaja somānām iti preṣyati /
meaning: आश्राव्य \\ उक्थशा यज सोमानाम् इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Having called for the śrauṣaṭ, he summons with: 'Reciter of the uktha, offer of the somas.'

sanskrit_iast: vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛte juhoti camasādhvaryavaś ca /
meaning: वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृते जुहोति चमसाध्वर्यवश् च /
text_mt: At the vaṣaṭ and the second vaṣaṭ, he offers, and the camasādhvaryu priests [also offer].

sanskrit_iast: sada ālabhya devebhyas tvā devāyuvaṃ pṛṇacami \\ ity ukthyapātreṇa maitrāvaruṇacamase saṃpātam avanayati //
meaning: सद आलभ्य देवेभ्यस् त्वा देवायुवं पृणचमि \\ इत्य् उक्थ्यपात्रेण मैत्रावरुणचमसे संपातम् अवनयति //
text_mt: Touching the sadas with: 'I unite you seeking the gods with the gods,' he pours the residue with the ukthya cup into the Maitrāvaruṇa's goblet.

sanskrit_iast: vāg devī somasya pibatu \\ iti bhakṣayanti /
meaning: वाग् देवी सोमस्य पिबतु \\ इति भक्षयन्ति /
text_mt: They consume it with: 'May the goddess Vāc drink of the soma.'

sanskrit_iast: mārjālīye prakṣālya yathāsthānaṃ camasān sādayanti /
meaning: मार्जालीये प्रक्षाल्य यथास्थानं चमसान् सादयन्ति /
text_mt: Having rinsed them at the mārjālīya fire, they set down the goblets in their proper places.

sanskrit_iast: pratiprasthātottarābhyāṃ pracarati //
meaning: प्रतिप्रस्थातोत्तराभ्यां प्रचरति //
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ priest performs the rite with the remaining two [portions].

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ indrāya tvā \\ iti gṛhṇāty ukthyasthālyā ardham ukthyapātra // eṣa te yonir \ indrāya tvā \\ iti sādayati /
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ इन्द्राय त्वा \\ इति गृह्णात्य् उक्थ्यस्थाल्या अर्धम् उक्थ्यपात्र // एष ते योनिर् \ इन्द्राय त्वा \\ इति सादयति /
text_mt: With: 'You are taken with a support; for Indra [I take] you,' he draws half of [what remains in] the ukthya vessel into the ukthya cup. With: 'This is your womb; for Indra [I set] you,' he sets it down.

sanskrit_iast: tathaiva punarhaviṣaṃ karoti /
meaning: तथैव पुनर्हविषं करोति /
text_mt: In the very same way he makes it a renewed oblation.

sanskrit_iast: pūtabhṛto brāhmaṇācham̐sicamasamukhyān unnayati /
meaning: पूतभृतो ब्राह्मणाछम्̐सिचमसमुख्यान् उन्नयति /
text_mt: From the pūtabhṛt vat, he draws [soma] beginning with the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin's goblet.

sanskrit_iast: stutaśastre bhavataḥ /
meaning: स्तुतशस्त्रे भवतः /

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇācham̐sī śam̐sati / tasya camase saṃpātam avanayati /
meaning: ब्राह्मणाछम्̐सी शम्̐सति / तस्य चमसे संपातम् अवनयति /
text_mt: The Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin recites. He pours the residue into his goblet.

sanskrit_iast: samānam anyat /
meaning: समानम् अन्यत् /

sanskrit_iast: savanam abhyāsṛjati /
meaning: सवनम् अभ्यासृजति /

sanskrit_iast: ṛjīṣaṃ kṛṣṇājine nidadhāti /
meaning: ऋजीषं कृष्णाजिने निदधाति /
text_mt: He places the pressed residue on the black antelope skin.

sanskrit_iast: vāsasā rājānaṃ grāvasūpāvaharati /
meaning: वाससा राजानं ग्रावसूपावहरति /
text_mt: He takes down King Soma on the pressing-stones with a garment.

sanskrit_iast: mādhyaṃdinīyaṃ kalaśam ādhavanīye 'vanayati //
meaning: माध्यंदिनीयं कलशम् आधवनीये ऽवनयति //
text_mt: He pours the jar of the midday pressing into the ādhavanīya vat.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ indrāgnibhyāṃ tvā \\ iti gṛhṇāty ukthyasthālyāḥ sarvam ukthyapātra // eṣa te yonir \ indrāgnibhyāṃ tvā \\ iti sādayati /
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ इन्द्राग्निभ्यां त्वा \\ इति गृह्णात्य् उक्थ्यस्थाल्याः सर्वम् उक्थ्यपात्र // एष ते योनिर् \ इन्द्राग्निभ्यां त्वा \\ इति सादयति /
text_mt: With: 'You are taken with a support; for Indra and Agni [I take] you,' he draws all that remains of the ukthya vessel into the ukthya cup. With: 'This is your womb; for Indra and Agni [I set] you,' he sets it down.

sanskrit_iast: na punarhaviṣaṃ karoti /
meaning: न पुनर्हविषं करोति /
text_mt: He does not make it a renewed oblation.

sanskrit_iast: achāvākacamasamukhyeṣu sarvaṃ pūtabhṛtaḥ /
meaning: अछावाकचमसमुख्येषु सर्वं पूतभृतः /
text_mt: He draws all that is in the pūtabhṛt vat into [the goblets] beginning with the Acchāvāka's goblet.

sanskrit_iast: achāvākāya pratigīrya \\ ukthaśās \\ iti brūyāt tasya camase saṃpātam avanayati /
meaning: अछावाकाय प्रतिगीर्य \\ उक्थशास् \\ इति ब्रूयात् तस्य चमसे संपातम् अवनयति /
text_mt: Having responded to the Acchāvāka, he should say: 'Reciter of the uktha...'; he pours the residue into his goblet.

sanskrit_iast: samānam anyat /
meaning: समानम् अन्यत् /

sanskrit_iast: vasatīvarīṇām̐ hotṛcamasaṃ pūrayitvā yathāsthānam̐ sādayati //
meaning: वसतीवरीणाम्̐ होतृचमसं पूरयित्वा यथास्थानम्̐ सादयति //
text_mt: Having filled the hotṛ priest's goblet with the vasatīvarī waters, he sets it down in its proper place.

sanskrit_iast:
agniḥ prātaḥsavanād iti savanakaraṇiṃ juhoti /
yas te drapsa skandati yas te am̐śur \ bāhucyuto dhiṣaṇāyā upasthāt /
adhvaryor vā pari vā yaḥ pavitrāt \ taṃ te juhomi manasā vaṣaṭkṛtam //
iti dvitīyām //
meaning:
अग्निः प्रातःसवनाद् इति सवनकरणिं जुहोति /
यस् ते द्रप्स स्कन्दति यस् ते अम्̐शुर् \ बाहुच्युतो धिषणाया उपस्थात् /
अध्वर्योर् वा परि वा यः पवित्रात् \ तं ते जुहोमि मनसा वषट्कृतम् //
इति द्वितीयाम् //
text_mt: With: 'Agni from the morning pressing...', he offers the libation that effects the press-session. With: 'That drop of yours which falls away, that stalk of yours which, loosened from the arm, from the lap of the pressing board, / or from the adhvaryu priest or from the strainer, that I offer unto you with mind consecrated by vaṣaṭ,' he offers the second.

sanskrit_iast: praśāstaḥ prasuva \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: प्रशास्तः प्रसुव \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He summons: 'O director, impel!'

sanskrit_iast: prasūtāḥ sarpanti /
meaning: प्रसूताः सर्पन्ति /

sanskrit_iast: mādhyaṃdināya savanāya prasarpanti //
meaning: माध्यंदिनाय सवनाय प्रसर्पन्ति //
text_mt: They glide forward for the midday pressing.

sanskrit_iast: nigrābhyāḥ stha \\ iti yajamānam̐ vācayitvā somopanahanaṃ grāvastute prayachaty unnetre ca vasane /
meaning: निग्राभ्याः स्थ \\ इति यजमानम्̐ वाचयित्वा सोमोपनहनं ग्रावस्तुते प्रयछत्य् उन्नेत्रे च वसने /
text_mt: Having made the sacrificer recite: 'You are the nigrābhya waters,' he hands the soma wrapping-cloth to the grāvastut priest, and the two garments to the unnetṛ priest.

sanskrit_iast: apreṣito grāvastotriyā anvāha /
meaning: अप्रेषितो ग्रावस्तोत्रिया अन्वाह /
text_mt: Without being prompted, the grāvastut recites the verses to the pressing-stones.

sanskrit_iast: niryātya rājānam abhiṣuṇvanti /
meaning: निर्यात्य राजानम् अभिषुण्वन्ति /
text_mt: Having led forth King [Soma], they press.

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyāto 'bhiṣavaḥ //
meaning: व्याख्यातो ऽभिषवः //

sanskrit_iast: ihā ihā \\ ity abhiṣunvanti /
meaning: इहा इहा \\ इत्य् अभिषुन्वन्ति /
text_mt: They press with: 'Here, here!'

sanskrit_iast: uttamasya paryāyasya madhyame paryāye bṛhad bṛhad ity abhiṣuṇvanti /
meaning: उत्तमस्य पर्यायस्य मध्यमे पर्याये बृहद् बृहद् इत्य् अभिषुण्वन्ति /
text_mt: In the middle turn of the last turn, they press with: 'Great, great!'

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā śukradhārāyāḥ /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ शुक्रधारायाः /
text_mt: [The procedure is] established up to the continuous stream of the śukra cup.

sanskrit_iast: śukrāmanthiprabhṛtīn gṛhṇāti /
meaning: शुक्रामन्थिप्रभृतीन् गृह्णाति /
text_mt: He draws [the cups] beginning with the śukra and manthin cups.

sanskrit_iast: ya āgrāyaṇasthālyām̐ somastam̐ hotṛcamase 'vanīyādhavanīyāc codañcanena ye devā divy ekādaśa stha \\ ity āgrāyaṇaṃ tisṛbhyo dhārābhyo gṛhṇāty uccaistarām̐ hiṅkaroti /
meaning: य आग्रायणस्थाल्याम्̐ सोमस्तम्̐ होतृचमसे ऽवनीयाधवनीयाच् चोदञ्चनेन ये देवा दिव्य् एकादश स्थ \\ इत्य् आग्रायणं तिसृभ्यो धाराभ्यो गृह्णात्य् उच्चैस्तराम्̐ हिङ्करोति /
text_mt: Having poured the soma that is in the āgrāyaṇa vessel into the hotṛ priest's goblet, he draws from the ādhavanīya vat with the dipping ladle the āgrāyaṇa drawing from three streams with: 'O gods who are eleven in heaven...', and utters the sound hiṅ very loudly.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtupātrābhyāṃ marutvatīyau gṛhṇīta indra marutva iha pāhi somam ity adhvaryur janiṣṭhā ugras \\ iti pratiprasthātā \\ eṣa te yonir \ indrāya tvā marutvate \\ iti sādayati /
meaning: ऋतुपात्राभ्यां मरुत्वतीयौ गृह्णीत इन्द्र मरुत्व इह पाहि सोमम् इत्य् अध्वर्युर् जनिष्ठा उग्रस् \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता \\ एष ते योनिर् \ इन्द्राय त्वा मरुत्वते \\ इति सादयति /
text_mt: The two draw the two Marutvatīya cups with the two season-cups: the adhvaryu priest with 'O Indra accompanied by the Maruts, drink the soma here,' and the pratiprasthātṛ priest with 'Born fierce...'; with 'This is your womb; for Indra accompanied by the Maruts [I set] you,' he sets it down.

sanskrit_iast: ukthyaṃ gṛhītvātipāvya rājānaṃ prapīḍya pavitram̐ siddham ā sarpaṇāt /
