meaning: उक्थ्यं गृहीत्वातिपाव्य राजानं प्रपीड्य पवित्रम्̐ सिद्धम् आ सर्पणात् /
text_mt: Having drawn the ukthya cup, having clarified King [Soma] thoroughly, and having squeezed out the strainer, [the procedure is] established up to the gliding forward.

sanskrit_iast: ṛjūdarā mādhyaṃdināya savanāya prasarpanti /
meaning: ऋजूदरा माध्यंदिनाय सवनाय प्रसर्पन्ति /
text_mt: With straight bellies, they glide forward for the midday pressing.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇa havirdhāne pūrvayā dvārā sadaḥ praviśya sadasi stuvante /
meaning: उत्तरेण हविर्धाने पूर्वया द्वारा सदः प्रविश्य सदसि स्तुवन्ते /
text_mt: Having entered the sadas by the east door along the north of the two havirdhāna carts, they chant the stotra in the sadas.

sanskrit_iast: anatikrāman dhiṣṇyān adhvaryur upaviśati /
meaning: अनतिक्रामन् धिष्ण्यान् अध्वर्युर् उपविशति /
text_mt: Without stepping across the hearth mounds, the adhvaryu priest sits down.

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātam̐ saṃpāvanaṃ / tathopākaraṇaṃ pavamānasya /
meaning: व्याख्यातम्̐ संपावनं / तथोपाकरणं पवमानस्य /
text_mt: The purification has been explained; likewise the bringing near of the pavamāna chant.

sanskrit_iast: pañcahotāram̐ yajamāno japati purastān mādhyaṃdinasya pavamānasya jyotiṣe hiṅkuru \\ iti ca // suparṇo 'si triṣṭubchandās \\ anu tvārabhe \ svasti mā saṃpāraya \\ iti ca /
meaning: पञ्चहोतारम्̐ यजमानो जपति पुरस्तान् माध्यंदिनस्य पवमानस्य ज्योतिषे हिङ्कुरु \\ इति च // सुपर्णो ऽसि त्रिष्टुब्छन्दास् \\ अनु त्वारभे \ स्वस्ति मा संपारय \\ इति च /
text_mt: Before the midday pavamāna chant, the sacrificer murmurs the Pañcahotṛ formula, and: 'Utter the sound hiṅ for the light,' and: 'You are the fair-winged bird, your metre is triṣṭubh; I take hold of you from behind; carry me safely across.'

sanskrit_iast: stute \\ agnīd agnīn vihara \ barhiḥ stṛṇāhi \ puroḍāśaṃ alaṃkuru \ pratiprasthātar dadhigharmāya dadhy upakalpayasva \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: स्तुते \\ अग्नीद् अग्नीन् विहर \ बर्हिः स्तृणाहि \ पुरोडाशं अलंकुरु \ प्रतिप्रस्थातर् दधिघर्माय दध्य् उपकल्पयस्व \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: When the stotra has been chanted, he summons: 'O āgnīdhra priest, distribute the fires! Spread the sacrificial grass! Adorn the sacrificial cake! O pratiprasthātṛ priest, prepare curd for the curd-gharma!'

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātam̐ viharaṇam ulaparājī ca /
meaning: व्याख्यातम्̐ विहरणम् उलपराजी च /
text_mt: The distribution [of the fires] and the reed-line have been explained.

sanskrit_iast: vaiṣṇavyā pātrāṇi saṃmṛśya dadhigharmeṇa pracaranti yadi pravṛñjanti /
meaning: वैष्णव्या पात्राणि संमृश्य दधिघर्मेण प्रचरन्ति यदि प्रवृञ्जन्ति /
text_mt: Having touched the vessels with the verse to Viṣṇu, they proceed with the curd-gharma if they perform the pravargya rite.

sanskrit_iast: savanīyānām udvāsanaprabhṛti siddham ā saṃpraiṣāt //
meaning: सवनीयानाम् उद्वासनप्रभृति सिद्धम् आ संप्रैषात् //
text_mt: From the taking off of the savanīya oblations onward, [the ritual] is established up to the call.

sanskrit_iast: mādhyaṃdinasya savanasyendrāya puroḍāśānām iti vikṛtaḥ saṃpraiṣaḥ /
meaning: माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्येन्द्राय पुरोडाशानाम् इति विकृतः संप्रैषः /
text_mt: The call is modified: 'For the midday pressing, of the sacrificial cakes for Indra.'

sanskrit_iast: savanīyaiḥ pracarya \\ unnīyamānebhyo 'nubrūhi \\ itya nuvācayati /
meaning: सवनीयैः प्रचर्य \\ उन्नीयमानेभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य नुवाचयति /
text_mt: Having performed the ritual acts with the savanīya oblations, he prompts [the hotṛ] to recite: 'Recite for those [cups] being drawn!'

sanskrit_iast: sāchāvākacamasān unnayati /
meaning: साछावाकचमसान् उन्नयति /
text_mt: He draws the cups including the achāvāka's cup.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā saṃpraiṣāt //
meaning: सिद्धम् आ संप्रैषात् //

sanskrit_iast: mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya śukravato manthivato niṣkevalyasya bhāgasyendrāya somān prasthitān preṣya \\ iti vikṛtaḥ saṃpraiṣaḥ /
meaning: माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य शुक्रवतो मन्थिवतो निष्केवल्यस्य भागस्येन्द्राय सोमान् प्रस्थितान् प्रेष्य \\ इति विकृतः संप्रैषः /
text_mt: The call is modified: 'For the midday pressing, prompt [the hotṛ] for the soma juices set forth for Indra, containing the Śukra, containing the Manthin, the unmixed portion!'

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā sam̐yājanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ सम्̐याजनात् /

sanskrit_iast: pūrvo 'chāvāko yajaty āgnīdhrāt /
meaning: पूर्वो ऽछावाको यजत्य् आग्नीध्रात् /
text_mt: The achāvāka offers first, before the āgnīdhra.

sanskrit_iast: hotrā samudyamya samupahūya rudravadgaṇasya soma deva te mativido mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya triṣṭupchandaso 'gnihuta indrapītasya \\ iti vikṛto bhakṣamantraḥ /
meaning: होत्रा समुद्यम्य समुपहूय रुद्रवद्गणस्य सोम देव ते मतिविदो माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य त्रिष्टुप्छन्दसो ऽग्निहुत इन्द्रपीतस्य \\ इति विकृतो भक्षमन्त्रः /
text_mt: Having lifted [the cups] together with the hotṛ and invited each other, the consumption mantra is modified: 'O divine soma, who knowest the mind, of the host accompanied by the Rudras, of the midday pressing having the triṣṭubh metre, offered in fire, drunk by Indra...'

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā sādanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ सादनात् /

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhre savanīyān bhakṣayanti / tad vyākhyātam /
meaning: आग्नीध्रे सवनीयान् भक्षयन्ति / तद् व्याख्यातम् /
text_mt: In the āgnīdhra shed they consume the savanīya oblations. That has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: śālāmukhīye dākṣiṇau juhoti /
meaning: शालामुखीये दाक्षिणौ जुहोति /
text_mt: In the śālāmukhīya fire he offers the two dākṣiṇa oblations.

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyaṃ baddhvā darbheṇocyartiṃ caturgṛhīte 'vadadhāti /
meaning: हिरण्यं बद्ध्वा दर्भेणोच्यर्तिं चतुर्गृहीते ऽवदधाति /
text_mt: Having tied a piece of gold with a darbha blade, he places the ucyarti into the four-times scooped clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātaṃ prachādanam /
meaning: व्याख्यातं प्रछादनम् /
text_mt: The covering has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: upasam̐yamya daśām̐ srugdaṇḍa ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam iti juhoti // citraṃ devānām iti dvitīyām /
meaning: उपसम्̐यम्य दशाम्̐ स्रुग्दण्ड उद् उ त्यं जातवेदसम् इति जुहोति // चित्रं देवानाम् इति द्वितीयाम् /
text_mt: Having gathered up the fringe on the handle of the ladle, he offers [with the verse]: 'Up that all-knowing god...' [and] the second [offering] with: 'The wonderful [face] of the gods...'

sanskrit_iast: tasyāṃ punar gṛhītvā dyāṃ gacha \ svar gacha \\ iti hiraṇyam uddharati /
meaning: तस्यां पुनर् गृहीत्वा द्यां गछ \ स्वर् गछ \\ इति हिरण्यम् उद्धरति /
text_mt: Having scooped again in that [ladle], he extracts the gold with: 'Go to heaven! Go to the light!'

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇām̐ vediśroṇiṃ pratyavasthitāsu hiraṇyam ājyaṃ ca dhārayamāṇas \\ rūpam̐ vo rūpeṇābhyemi \\ iti dakṣiṇā abhyeti //
meaning: दक्षिणाम्̐ वेदिश्रोणिं प्रत्यवस्थितासु हिरण्यम् आज्यं च धारयमाणस् \\ रूपम्̐ वो रूपेणाभ्येमि \\ इति दक्षिणा अभ्येति //
text_mt: While [the cows] stand opposite the southern buttock of the vedi, holding the gold and the clarified butter, he approaches the sacrificial gifts with: 'With form I approach your form.'

sanskrit_iast: tutho vo viśvavedā vibhajatu \\ iti vibhajati / yāvan madhyataḥkāribhyas tasyārdham ardhibhyas tṛtīyaṃ tṛtīyibhyas tuyam̐ pādibhyaḥ /
meaning: तुथो वो विश्ववेदा विभजतु \\ इति विभजति / यावन् मध्यतःकारिभ्यस् तस्यार्धम् अर्धिभ्यस् तृतीयं तृतीयिभ्यस् तुयम्̐ पादिभ्यः /
text_mt: He distributes them with: 'May Tutha, the all-knower, distribute you.' As much as [is given] to the principal priests, half of that to the second-rank priests, a third to the third-rank priests, a fourth to the fourth-rank priests.

sanskrit_iast: madhyataḥkāriṇo brahmodgātā hotādhvaryus teṣām ardhino brāhmaṇācham̐sī prastotā maitrāvaruṇaḥ pratiprasthātā tṛtīyina āgnīdhraḥ pratihartāchāvāko neṣṭā pādinaḥ potā subrahmaṇyo grāvastud unnetā /
meaning: मध्यतःकारिणो ब्रह्मोद्गाता होताध्वर्युस् तेषाम् अर्धिनो ब्राह्मणाछम्̐सी प्रस्तोता मैत्रावरुणः प्रतिप्रस्थाता तृतीयिन आग्नीध्रः प्रतिहर्ताछावाको नेष्टा पादिनः पोता सुब्रह्मण्यो ग्रावस्तुद् उन्नेता /
text_mt: The principal priests are the brahman, the udgātṛ, the hotṛ, and the adhvaryu. Their second-rank priests are the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin, the prastotṛ, the maitrāvaruṇa, and the pratiprasthātṛ. The third-rank priests are the āgnīdhra, the pratihartṛ, the achāvāka, and the neṣṭṛ. The fourth-rank priests are the potṛ, the subrahmaṇya, the grāvastut, and the unnetṛ.

sanskrit_iast: ajaṃ dadāty aviṃ māṣām̐s tilān kṛtānnam̐ vāso 'śvam̐ hiraṇyaṃ / gavām̐ saṃkhyā śataṃ dvādaśam̐ vāparimitā vaikavim̐śatyavarā /
meaning: अजं ददात्य् अविं माषाम्̐स् तिलान् कृतान्नम्̐ वासो ऽश्वम्̐ हिरण्यं / गवाम्̐ संख्या शतं द्वादशम्̐ वापरिमिता वैकविम्̐शत्यवरा /
text_mt: He gives a goat, a sheep, black beans, sesame seeds, cooked food, a garment, a horse, [and] gold. The number of cows is one hundred and twelve, or unlimited, with twenty-one as the minimum.

sanskrit_iast: aparārdhād dhiraṇyapāṇir dakṣiṇā nayaty agreṇa gārhapatyaṃ jaghanena sada āgnīdhrabhāgam agrataḥ / sam̐hatān itarān //
meaning: अपरार्धाद् धिरण्यपाणिर् दक्षिणा नयत्य् अग्रेण गार्हपत्यं जघनेन सद आग्नीध्रभागम् अग्रतः / सम्̐हतान् इतरान् //
text_mt: Holding gold in his hand, he leads the sacrificial gifts from the western side, in front of the gārhapatya and behind the sadas, with the share for the āgnīdhra in front, [and] the others close together.

sanskrit_iast: etat te agne rādhas \\ ity āgnīdhrabhāgam anumantrayate /
meaning: एतत् ते अग्ने राधस् \\ इत्य् आग्नीध्रभागम् अनुमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: He accompanies the share for the āgnīdhra with the mantra: 'This is your wealth, O Agni.'

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇato 'vasthitāsu \\ ayaṃ no agnir ity āgnīdhrīye juhoti // vaneṣu vy antarikṣam iti dvitīyām̐ yadi cakrīvatprājāpatyāṃ tṛtīyām̐ yadi hastinaṃ puruṣam̐ vā //
meaning: दक्षिणतो ऽवस्थितासु \\ अयं नो अग्निर् इत्य् आग्नीध्रीये जुहोति // वनेषु व्य् अन्तरिक्षम् इति द्वितीयाम्̐ यदि चक्रीवत्प्राजापत्यां तृतीयाम्̐ यदि हस्तिनं पुरुषम्̐ वा //
text_mt: While [the cows] stand to the south, he offers into the āgnīdrīya fire with: 'May this fire of ours...'; a second [oblation] with: 'In the woods through the intermediate space...', if there is a vehicle; a third with a verse to Prajāpati if there is an elephant or a man.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtasya pathā preta \\ ity antarā cātvālam āgnīdhraṃ codīcīr utsṛjati //
meaning: ऋतस्य पथा प्रेत \\ इत्य् अन्तरा चात्वालम् आग्नीध्रं चोदीचीर् उत्सृजति //
text_mt: With: 'Go forth by the path of truth,' he releases [the cows] facing north between the pit and the āgnīdhra shed.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇam adya ṛdhyāsaṃ pitṛmantaṃ paitṛmatyam ṛṣim ārṣeyam̐ sudhātudakṣiṇam \ idaṃ candram imāś ca bhavate dakṣiṇā dadāmi \\ ity antarvedi tiṣṭhann ṛtvigbhyaḥ sahiraṇyā dakṣiṇā dadāty agnīdhe prathamaṃ tato madhyataḥkāribhyo 'nupūrvam̐ hotṛkebhyaś cāntataḥ pratihartre /
meaning: ब्राह्मणम् अद्य ऋध्यासं पितृमन्तं पैतृमत्यम् ऋषिम् आर्षेयम्̐ सुधातुदक्षिणम् \ इदं चन्द्रम् इमाश् च भवते दक्षिणा ददामि \\ इत्य् अन्तर्वेदि तिष्ठन्न् ऋत्विग्भ्यः सहिरण्या दक्षिणा ददात्य् अग्नीधे प्रथमं ततो मध्यतःकारिभ्यो ऽनुपूर्वम्̐ होतृकेभ्यश् चान्ततः प्रतिहर्त्रे /
text_mt: Standing inside the vedi, he gives the sacrificial gifts accompanied by gold to the officiating priests with: 'May I today satisfy a brāhmaṇa who has fathers, whose father has fathers, a ṛṣi, of ṛṣi descent, with abundant sacrificial gifts. This shining [gold] and these sacrificial gifts I give to you, sir'—first to the āgnīdhra, then to the principal priests in order, and to the minor hotṛ priests, and finally to the pratihartṛ.

sanskrit_iast: prāsarpakaṃ dakṣiṇāpathena nītvā sadasyaprathamebhyo dadyād ātreyāya tato hiraṇyam //
meaning: प्रासर्पकं दक्षिणापथेन नीत्वा सदस्यप्रथमेभ्यो दद्याद् आत्रेयाय ततो हिरण्यम् //
text_mt: Having brought [the gifts] for the uninvited spectators along the southern path, he should give them first to those seated in the sadas, and then gold to the Ātreya.

sanskrit_iast: vi svaḥ paśya \\ iti sadaḥ praviśya yajamānam̐ vācayati //
meaning: वि स्वः पश्य \\ इति सदः प्रविश्य यजमानम्̐ वाचयति //
text_mt: Having entered the sadas, he has the sacrificer recite: 'Look upon the light!'

sanskrit_iast: asmadrātās \\ iti dakṣiṇā anumantrayate /
meaning: अस्मद्रातास् \\ इति दक्षिणा अनुमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: He accompanies the sacrificial gifts with: 'Given by us...'

sanskrit_iast: cātvāle kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāṃ pravidhyati /
meaning: चात्वाले कृष्णविषाणां प्रविध्यति /
text_mt: He throws away the black antelope horn into the pit.

sanskrit_iast: nordhvaṃ marutvatīyābhyāṃ dadāti /
meaning: नोर्ध्वं मरुत्वतीयाभ्यां ददाति /
text_mt: He does not give after the two Marutvatīya cups.

sanskrit_iast: yebhyo 'tra na dadyād anūbandhyāyai hutāyām̐ vapāyāṃ tebhyo dadyāt /
meaning: येभ्यो ऽत्र न दद्याद् अनूबन्ध्यायै हुतायाम्̐ वपायां तेभ्यो दद्यात् /
text_mt: To whomsoever he should not give at this point, he should give when the omentum of the anūbandhyā cow has been offered.

sanskrit_iast: marutvatīyābhyāṃ pracarataḥ //
meaning: मरुत्वतीयाभ्यां प्रचरतः //
text_mt: The two [adhvaryu and pratiprasthātṛ] proceed with the two Marutvatīya cups.

sanskrit_iast: indrāya marutvate 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
meaning: इन्द्राय मरुत्वते ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: He prompts [the hotṛ] to recite: 'Recite for Indra accompanied by the Maruts!'

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya \\ indrāya marutvate preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
meaning: आश्राव्य \\ इन्द्राय मरुत्वते प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
text_mt: Having called for the response, he proceeds with: 'Prompt [the hotṛ] for Indra accompanied by the Maruts!'

sanskrit_iast: vaṣaṭkṛte juhutaḥ /
meaning: वषट्कृते जुहुतः /

sanskrit_iast: punarvaṣaṭkṛte hutvā vyavanayataḥ /
meaning: पुनर्वषट्कृते हुत्वा व्यवनयतः /
text_mt: Having offered at the second vaṣaṭ-call, the two pour out [the residue] together.

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryuḥ pratiprasthāne sarvam ānayati / tasyāgra pratiprasthātādhvaryupātre 'vanayati //
meaning: अध्वर्युः प्रतिप्रस्थाने सर्वम् आनयति / तस्याग्र प्रतिप्रस्थाताध्वर्युपात्रे ऽवनयति //
text_mt: The adhvaryu pours everything into the pratiprasthātṛ's vessel. Then the pratiprasthātṛ pours the first part into the adhvaryu's vessel.

sanskrit_iast: sajoṣā indra \\ ity adhvaryuḥ svasmin pātre marutvatīyaṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇāti \\ eṣa te yonir \ indrāya tvā marutvate \\ iti sādayati /
meaning: सजोषा इन्द्र \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युः स्वस्मिन् पात्रे मरुत्वतीयं ग्रहं गृह्णाति \\ एष ते योनिर् \ इन्द्राय त्वा मरुत्वते \\ इति सादयति /
text_mt: With: 'Unanimous, O Indra...', the adhvaryu draws the Marutvatīya cup into his own vessel. He sets it down with: 'This is your womb; for Indra accompanied by the Maruts thee!'

sanskrit_iast: pratiprasthānenādhvaryur bhakṣam̐ harati //
meaning: प्रतिप्रस्थानेनाध्वर्युर् भक्षम्̐ हरति //
text_mt: The adhvaryu carries the portion for consumption with the pratiprasthātṛ's vessel.

sanskrit_iast: vāg devī somasya pibatu \\ iti bhakṣayanti samupahūya /
meaning: वाग् देवी सोमस्य पिबतु \\ इति भक्षयन्ति समुपहूय /
text_mt: Having invited each other, they consume [the soma] with: 'May the divine speech drink of the soma!'

sanskrit_iast: prasadasi pātram ādadhāti /
meaning: प्रसदसि पात्रम् आदधाति /
text_mt: He places the vessel in front of the sadas.

sanskrit_iast: pratiprasthātā savanīyān nirvapati saumyaṃ ca carum /
meaning: प्रतिप्रस्थाता सवनीयान् निर्वपति सौम्यं च चरुम् /
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ apportions the savanīya oblations and the caru for Soma.

sanskrit_iast: yathā māhendrasya stotropākaraṇakāle haviṣkṛd āhūyeta /
meaning: यथा माहेन्द्रस्य स्तोत्रोपाकरणकाले हविष्कृद् आहूयेत /
text_mt: So that at the time of beginning the Māhendra chant, the preparer of the oblation may be summoned.

sanskrit_iast: pratigarāyopaviśati / sa vyākhyātaḥ /
meaning: प्रतिगरायोपविशति / स व्याख्यातः /
text_mt: He sits down for the response. That has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: marutvatīyam̐ śastraṃ pratigīrya grahādānaprabhṛti samānam aindrāgnenā bhakṣaṇāt //
meaning: मरुत्वतीयम्̐ शस्त्रं प्रतिगीर्य ग्रहादानप्रभृति समानम् ऐन्द्राग्नेना भक्षणात् //
text_mt: Having responded to the Marutvatīya recitation, from the taking of the cup onward, it is the same as the offering to Indra and Agni, up to the consumption.

sanskrit_iast: narāśam̐sapītasya soma deva te mativido mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya triṣṭupchandasaḥ pitṛpītasya \\ iti vikṛto bhakṣamantraḥ /
meaning: नराशम्̐सपीतस्य सोम देव ते मतिविदो माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य त्रिष्टुप्छन्दसः पितृपीतस्य \\ इति विकृतो भक्षमन्त्रः /
text_mt: The consumption mantra is modified: 'O divine soma, who knowest the mind, drunk by Narāśaṃsa, of the midday pressing having the triṣṭubh metre, drunk by the fathers...'

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā sādanāt //
meaning: सिद्धम् आ सादनात् //

sanskrit_iast: mahaṃ indro nṛvad iti śukrapātre māhendraṃ gṛhṇāti \\ eṣa te yonir \ mahendrāya tvā \\ iti sādayati /
meaning: महं इन्द्रो नृवद् इति शुक्रपात्रे माहेन्द्रं गृह्णाति \\ एष ते योनिर् \ महेन्द्राय त्वा \\ इति सादयति /
text_mt: With: 'Great Indra like men...', he draws the Māhendra cup into the Śukra vessel. He sets it down with: 'This is your womb; for Great Indra thee!'

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvadevena vyākhyātam okthyavigrahebhyo 'nyad yājamānāt //
meaning: वैश्वदेवेन व्याख्यातम् ओक्थ्यविग्रहेभ्यो ऽन्यद् याजमानात् //
text_mt: [The ritual] up to the separate Ukthya drawings, other than what belongs to the sacrificer, has been explained by the Vaiśvadeva cup.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ indrāya tvā \\ ity ukthyo vigṛhyata // eṣa te yonir \ indrāya tvā \\ iti sādayati /
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ इन्द्राय त्वा \\ इत्य् उक्थ्यो विगृह्यत // एष ते योनिर् \ इन्द्राय त्वा \\ इति सादयति /
text_mt: The Ukthya cup is drawn separately with: 'Thou art taken with a support; for Indra thee!' He sets it down with: 'This is your womb; for Indra thee!'

sanskrit_iast: samānam anyat /
meaning: समानम् अन्यत् /

sanskrit_iast: savanam abhyāsṛjati /
meaning: सवनम् अभ्यासृजति /

sanskrit_iast: ṛjīṣaṃ grāvasu nivapati /
meaning: ऋजीषं ग्रावसु निवपति /
text_mt: He pours out the pressed soma dregs onto the pressing stones.

sanskrit_iast: tārtīyasavanikaṃ kalaśam ādhavanīye 'vanayati /
meaning: तार्तीयसवनिकं कलशम् आधवनीये ऽवनयति /
text_mt: He pours the jar of the third pressing into the ādhavanīya trough.

sanskrit_iast: achāvākacamasamukhyeṣu sarvaṃ pūtabhṛtaḥ /
meaning: अछावाकचमसमुख्येषु सर्वं पूतभृतः /
text_mt: He pours the entire [contents] of the pūtabhṛt into the cups, beginning with the achāvāka's cup.

sanskrit_iast: achāvākāya pratigīrya \\ uktham̐ vāci \\ iti brūyāt /
meaning: अछावाकाय प्रतिगीर्य \\ उक्थम्̐ वाचि \\ इति ब्रूयात् /
text_mt: Having responded to the achāvāka, he should say: 'The praise has been spoken!'

sanskrit_iast:
viśve devā maruta indro asmān \ asmin dvitīye savane na jahyuḥ /
sumedhasaḥ priyam eṣām̐ vadantas\ vayam̐ syāma patayo rayīṇām //
iti savanakaraṇiṃ juhoti /
yo drapso am̐śuḥ patitaḥ pṛthivyām\ parivāpāt puroḍāśāt karambhāt /
dhānāsomān manthina indraḥ śukrāt \ taṃ te juhomi manasā vaṣaṭkṛtam //
iti dvitīyām //
meaning:
विश्वे देवा मरुत इन्द्रो अस्मान् \ अस्मिन् द्वितीये सवने न जह्युः /
सुमेधसः प्रियम् एषाम्̐ वदन्तस्\ वयम्̐ स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् //
इति सवनकरणिं जुहोति /
यो द्रप्सो अम्̐शुः पतितः पृथिव्याम्\ परिवापात् पुरोडाशात् करम्भात् /
धानासोमान् मन्थिन इन्द्रः शुक्रात् \ तं ते जुहोमि मनसा वषट्कृतम् //
इति द्वितीयाम् //
text_mt:
'May the All-gods, the Maruts, [and] Indra not forsake us / at this second pressing;

Wise, speaking what is dear to them, / may we be lords of riches!'

With this [verse] he offers the savanakaraṇī oblation.

'Whatever drop, whatever stalk has fallen to the earth / from the roasted barley grains, from the sacrificial cake, from the groats meal...'

from the parched-grain Soma, from the Manthin cup, Indra [partook] from the Śukra cup; / that of yours, made into the vaṣaṭ-call by the mind, I offer to you.

sanskrit_iast: praśāstaḥ prasuva \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: प्रशास्तः प्रसुव \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He directs: "Praśāstṛ, give the impulse!"

sanskrit_iast: prasūtāḥ sarpanti sarpanti /
meaning: प्रसूताः सर्पन्ति सर्पन्ति /
text_mt: Impelled, they creep forward, they creep forward.

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīyasavanāya prasarpanti /
meaning: तृतीयसवनाय प्रसर्पन्ति /
text_mt: They creep forward for the third pressing.

sanskrit_iast: ādityagrahaṃ gṛhṇāty apidhāya havirdhāne kadā cana starīr asi \\ ity ādityasthālyās tṛtīyam ādityapātre // yajño devānām iti tasmim̐s taptātaṅkyaṃ dadhi //
meaning: आदित्यग्रहं गृह्णात्य् अपिधाय हविर्धाने कदा चन स्तरीर् असि \\ इत्य् आदित्यस्थाल्यास् तृतीयम् आदित्यपात्रे // यज्ञो देवानाम् इति तस्मिम्̐स् तप्तातङ्क्यं दधि //
text_mt: Having closed the two Soma-carts, he draws the Āditya cup with: "Never art thou barren..."—one third from the Āditya vessel into the Āditya cup. With: "The sacrifice of the gods...", [he puts] curd thickened while hot into it.

sanskrit_iast: kadā cana prayuchasi \\ ity ādityasthālyā abhipūrayati //
meaning: कदा चन प्रयुछसि \\ इत्य् आदित्यस्थाल्या अभिपूरयति //
text_mt: With: "Never dost thou neglect...", he fills it up from the Āditya vessel.

sanskrit_iast: yā divyā vṛṣṭis tayā tvā śrīṇāmi \\ iti śītātaṅkyena dadhnā śrīṇāti //
meaning: या दिव्या वृष्टिस् तया त्वा श्रीणामि \\ इति शीतातङ्क्येन दध्ना श्रीणाति //
text_mt: With: "With the heavenly rain I mix thee", he mixes it with curd thickened while cold.

sanskrit_iast: vivasvann ādityaiṣa te somapīthas \\ ity upām̐śusavanena paryāsaṃ mekṣayati /
meaning: विवस्वन्न् आदित्यैष ते सोमपीथस् \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शुसवनेन पर्यासं मेक्षयति /
text_mt: With: "O brilliant Āditya, this is thy Soma-draught...", he stirs it around with the pressing stone for the Upāṃśu cup.

sanskrit_iast: apidhāyopaniṣkrāmati darbhaiḥ pāṇinā ca //
meaning: अपिधायोपनिष्क्रामति दर्भैः पाणिना च //
text_mt: Having covered it with darbha grass and with his hand, he steps out.

sanskrit_iast: ahaṃ parastād iti yajamāno 'nvārabhate //
meaning: अहं परस्ताद् इति यजमानो ऽन्वारभते //
text_mt: The sacrificer touches him from behind with: "I [follow] behind..."

sanskrit_iast: ādityebhyaḥ priyebhyaḥ priyadhāmabhyaḥ priyavratebhyo mahaḥ svasarasya patibhya uror antarikṣasyādhyakṣebhyo 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
meaning: आदित्येभ्यः प्रियेभ्यः प्रियधामभ्यः प्रियव्रतेभ्यो महः स्वसरस्य पतिभ्य उरोर् अन्तरिक्षस्याध्यक्षेभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: He causes [the hotṛ] to recite the invitatory verse: "To the Ādityas, the dear ones, whose abodes are dear, whose vows are dear, the lords of the great fold, the overseers of the broad intermediate space, recite!"

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya \\ ādityebhyaḥ priyebhyaḥ priyadhāmabhyaḥ priyavratebhyo mahaḥ svasarasya patibhya uror antarikṣasyādhyakṣebhyaḥ preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
meaning: आश्राव्य \\ आदित्येभ्यः प्रियेभ्यः प्रियधामभ्यः प्रियव्रतेभ्यो महः स्वसरस्य पतिभ्य उरोर् अन्तरिक्षस्याध्यक्षेभ्यः प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
text_mt: Having called for the śrauṣaṭ, he proceeds with the direction: "To the Ādityas, the dear ones, whose abodes are dear, whose vows are dear, the lords of the great fold, the overseers of the broad intermediate space, summon!"

sanskrit_iast: prāsya darbhān anyatrekṣamāṇa unnambhaya \\ iti pratinigadya vaṣaṭkṛte na sarvaṃ juhoti //
meaning: प्रास्य दर्भान् अन्यत्रेक्षमाण उन्नम्भय \\ इति प्रतिनिगद्य वषट्कृते न सर्वं जुहोति //
text_mt: Having thrown down the darbha blades while looking elsewhere, having repeated: "Cause [the cloud] to rise!", he does not offer all of it when the vaṣaṭ-call is uttered.

sanskrit_iast: abhiṣotāro 'bhiṣuṇuta \\ agnīd āśiram̐ vinaya \ pratiprasthātar ya upām̐śupātre 'm̐śus tam ṛjīṣe 'pyasyābhiṣutyodañcam̐ hṛtvādhavanīye praskandayasva \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: अभिषोतारो ऽभिषुणुत \\ अग्नीद् आशिरम्̐ विनय \ प्रतिप्रस्थातर् य उपाम्̐शुपात्रे ऽम्̐शुस् तम् ऋजीषे ऽप्यस्याभिषुत्योदञ्चम्̐ हृत्वाधवनीये प्रस्कन्दयस्व \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He gives the direction: "Pressers, press! Agnīdh, pour out the milk mixture! Pratiprasthātṛ, having thrown the shoot that is in the Upāṃśu cup into the pressed Soma-residue, having pressed it, having carried it northwards, cause it to trickle into the Ādhavanīya trough!"

sanskrit_iast: vasatīvarībhir abhiṣuṇvanti /
meaning: वसतीवरीभिर् अभिषुण्वन्ति /
text_mt: They press with the Vasatīvarī waters.

sanskrit_iast: paścād āgnīdhrīyasyāśiraṃ manthati /
meaning: पश्चाद् आग्नीध्रीयस्याशिरं मन्थति /
text_mt: Behind the Āgnīdhra fire, he churns the milk mixture.

sanskrit_iast: pūtabhṛti pavitram̐ vitatya śukradhārām̐ saṃpragṛhṇāti /
meaning: पूतभृति पवित्रम्̐ वितत्य शुक्रधाराम्̐ संप्रगृह्णाति /
text_mt: Having spread the strainer over the Pūtabhṛt vat, he holds the stream of clear [Soma].

sanskrit_iast: adhi viparyasyaty āgrāyaṇasthālīm ādityasthālīm ādityapātraṃ ca /
meaning: अधि विपर्यस्यत्य् आग्रायणस्थालीम् आदित्यस्थालीम् आदित्यपात्रं च /
text_mt: He turns upside down the Āgrayaṇa vessel, the Āditya vessel, and the Āditya cup.

sanskrit_iast: ādhavanīyāc codañcanena ye devā divy ekādaśa stha \\ ity āgrāyaṇaṃ catasṛbhyo dhārābhyo gṛhṇāti / sūccaistarām̐ hiṅkaroti /
meaning: आधवनीयाच् चोदञ्चनेन ये देवा दिव्य् एकादश स्थ \\ इत्य् आग्रायणं चतसृभ्यो धाराभ्यो गृह्णाति / सूच्चैस्तराम्̐ हिङ्करोति /
text_mt: With the dipping-ladle from the Ādhavanīya trough, he draws the Āgrayaṇa cup from four streams with: "Ye gods who are eleven in heaven..." He sounds hiṅ very loudly.

sanskrit_iast: nāgniṣṭome tṛtīyasavana ukthyaṃ gṛhṇāti /
meaning: नाग्निष्टोमे तृतीयसवन उक्थ्यं गृह्णाति /
text_mt: In the Agniṣṭoma rite, he does not draw the Ukthya cup at the third pressing.

sanskrit_iast: yadi ṣoḍaśy ukthyaṃ gṛhītvā \\ indram id dharī vahatas \\ ity āgrāyaṇāt ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti /
meaning: यदि षोडश्य् उक्थ्यं गृहीत्वा \\ इन्द्रम् इद् धरी वहतस् \\ इत्य् आग्रायणात् षोडशिनं गृह्णाति /
text_mt: If it is a Ṣoḍaśin rite, having drawn the Ukthya cup, he draws the Ṣoḍaśin cup from the Āgrayaṇa vessel with: "Indra verily the two bay horses carry..."

sanskrit_iast: aṣoḍaśika ukthyaṃ gṛhītvātipāvya rājānaṃ prapīḍya pavitram̐ siddham ā sarpaṇāt /
meaning: अषोडशिक उक्थ्यं गृहीत्वातिपाव्य राजानं प्रपीड्य पवित्रम्̐ सिद्धम् आ सर्पणात् /
text_mt: In a non-Ṣoḍaśin rite, having drawn the Ukthya cup, having clarified King [Soma], having squeezed the strainer, the procedure is established up to the creeping forward.

sanskrit_iast: ṛjudehīyāḥ sarpanty ārbhavaṃ pavamānam̐ yena mādhyaṃdinam /
meaning: ऋजुदेहीयाः सर्पन्त्य् आर्भवं पवमानम्̐ येन माध्यंदिनम् /
text_mt: The priests with upright bodies creep forward for the Ārbhava-pavamāna laud along the path by which [they crept for] the midday [laud].

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātam̐ saṃpāvanaṃ / tathopākaraṇaṃ pavamānasya /
meaning: व्याख्यातम्̐ संपावनं / तथोपाकरणं पवमानस्य /
text_mt: The mutual purification has been explained; likewise the preparation for the Pavamāna laud.

sanskrit_iast: saptahotāram̐ yajamāno japati purastād ārbhavasya pavamānasya \\ āyuṣe hiṅkuru \\ iti ca // sakhāsi jagacchandās \\ anu tvārabhe \ svasti mā saṃpāraya \\ iti ca /
meaning: सप्तहोतारम्̐ यजमानो जपति पुरस्ताद् आर्भवस्य पवमानस्य \\ आयुषे हिङ्कुरु \\ इति च // सखासि जगच्छन्दास् \\ अनु त्वारभे \ स्वस्ति मा संपारय \\ इति च /
text_mt: Before the Ārbhava-pavamāna laud, the sacrificer murmurs the Saptahotṛ formula, and: "Sound hiṅ for long life!", and: "Thou art a friend, possessing the jagatī meter; / I touch thee from behind; / bring me safely across!"

sanskrit_iast: stute \\ agnīd agnīn vihara \ barhiḥ stṛṇāhi \ puroḍāśāṃ alaṃkuru \ pratiprasthātaḥ paśum̐ sam̐vadasva \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: स्तुते \\ अग्नीद् अग्नीन् विहर \ बर्हिः स्तृणाहि \ पुरोडाशां अलंकुरु \ प्रतिप्रस्थातः पशुम्̐ सम्̐वदस्व \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: When [the laud] has been chanted, he gives the direction: "Agnīdh, distribute the fires! Strew the sacrificial grass! Adorn the sacrificial cakes! Pratiprasthātṛ, converse [concerning the parts] of the animal!"

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātam̐ viharaṇam ulaparājī ca /
meaning: व्याख्यातम्̐ विहरणम् उलपराजी च /
text_mt: The distribution [of fires] and the row of reed-grass have been explained.

sanskrit_iast: vaiṣṇavyā pātrāṇi saṃmṛśya pratiprasthātā patnī ca pūtabhṛti pavitram̐ vitatya \\ āśīr nā ūrjam ity āśiram avanayataḥ /
meaning: वैष्णव्या पात्राणि संमृश्य प्रतिप्रस्थाता पत्नी च पूतभृति पवित्रम्̐ वितत्य \\ आशीर् ना ऊर्जम् इत्य् आशिरम् अवनयतः /
text_mt: Having touched the vessels with [the verse] to Viṣṇu, the Pratiprasthātṛ and the [sacrificer's] wife, having spread the strainer over the Pūtabhṛt vat, pour in the milk mixture with: "Milk mixture is our vigor..."

sanskrit_iast: apaśunā pracarati sam̐vādaprabhṛtīḍāntena /
meaning: अपशुना प्रचरति सम्̐वादप्रभृतीडान्तेन /
text_mt: He performs the rite without an animal victim, beginning with the conversation and ending with the iḍā portion.

sanskrit_iast: savanīyānām udvāsanaprabhṛti siddham ā saṃpraiṣāt //
meaning: सवनीयानाम् उद्वासनप्रभृति सिद्धम् आ संप्रैषात् //
text_mt: For the cakes of the pressings, the procedure is established from the taking off the fire up to the direction.

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīyasya savanasyendrāya puroḍāśānām iti vikṛtaḥ saṃpraiṣaḥ /
meaning: तृतीयस्य सवनस्येन्द्राय पुरोडाशानाम् इति विकृतः संप्रैषः /
text_mt: The modified direction is: "... of the sacrificial cakes for Indra of the third pressing."

sanskrit_iast: savanīyaiḥ pracarya \\ unnīyamānebhyo 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
meaning: सवनीयैः प्रचर्य \\ उन्नीयमानेभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: Having performed the rite with the pressings' cakes, he causes [the hotṛ] to recite the invitatory verse: "Recite for [the cups] being filled!"

sanskrit_iast: sāchāvākacamasān unnayati /
meaning: साछावाकचमसान् उन्नयति /
text_mt: He fills the cups including that of the Achāvāka.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā saṃpraiṣāt //
meaning: सिद्धम् आ संप्रैषात् //

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīyasya savanasya ṛbhumato vibhumato vājavato bṛhaspativato viśvadevvyāvatas tīvraṃ āśīrvata indrāya somān prasthitān preṣya \\ iti siddham̐ yathā mādhyaṃdine //
meaning: तृतीयस्य सवनस्य ऋभुमतो विभुमतो वाजवतो बृहस्पतिवतो विश्वदेव्व्यावतस् तीव्रं आशीर्वत इन्द्राय सोमान् प्रस्थितान् प्रेष्य \\ इति सिद्धम्̐ यथा माध्यंदिने //
text_mt: "To Indra, accompanied by the Ṛbhus, accompanied by Vibhvan, accompanied by Vāja, accompanied by Bṛhaspati, accompanied by all the gods, summon for the set-forth strong Soma-draughts accompanied by milk mixture of the third pressing!"—thus it is established as at the midday pressing.

sanskrit_iast: ādityavadgaṇasya soma deva te matividas tṛtīyasya savanasya jagacchandaso 'gnihuta indrapītasya \\ iti vikṛto bhakṣamantraḥ /
meaning: आदित्यवद्गणस्य सोम देव ते मतिविदस् तृतीयस्य सवनस्य जगच्छन्दसो ऽग्निहुत इन्द्रपीतस्य \\ इति विकृतो भक्षमन्त्रः /
text_mt: The modified formula for consuming is: "Of thee, divine Soma, who hast the Ādityas as troop, who knowest the thought, of the third pressing, possessing the jagatī meter, offered into the fire, drunk by Indra..."

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā sādanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ सादनात् /

sanskrit_iast: [ dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya paścān ] mārjālīyadeśe prācīnāvavītinaḥ puroḍāśapiṇḍān aṇumiśrān atra pitaro mādayadhvam̐ yathābhāgam āvṛṣāyadhvam iti paścāt praticamasaṃ trīm̐strīn piṇḍān upāsyanti svam̐svaṃ camasam̐ hotṛcamasam adhvaryavaḥ /
meaning: [ दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य पश्चान् ] मार्जालीयदेशे प्राचीनाववीतिनः पुरोडाशपिण्डान् अणुमिश्रान् अत्र पितरो मादयध्वम्̐ यथाभागम् आवृषायध्वम् इति पश्चात् प्रतिचमसं त्रीम्̐स्त्रीन् पिण्डान् उपास्यन्ति स्वम्̐स्वं चमसम्̐ होतृचमसम् अध्वर्यवः /
text_mt: [Behind the southern Soma-cart], in the place of the Mārjālīya fire, wearing the sacred thread over the right shoulder, behind each cup the adhvaryus throw down three balls of sacrificial cake mixed with small grains, for their respective cups, and for the hotṛ's cup, with: "Here, O fathers, rejoice; according to your portions, become exhilarated!"

sanskrit_iast: visram̐sya prācīnāvavītāni yathāsthānaṃ camasān sādayanti /
meaning: विस्रम्̐स्य प्राचीनाववीतानि यथास्थानं चमसान् सादयन्ति /
text_mt: Having rearranged the sacred thread [over the left shoulder], they place the cups in their respective positions.

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhre savanīyān bhakṣayanti / tad vyākhyātam /
meaning: आग्नीध्रे सवनीयान् भक्षयन्ति / तद् व्याख्यातम् /
text_mt: In the Āgnīdhra fire chamber, they consume the pressings' offerings; that has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: antaryāmapātre sāvitram āgrayaṇād adabdhebhiḥ savitar iti gṛhṇāti /
meaning: अन्तर्यामपात्रे सावित्रम् आग्रयणाद् अदब्धेभिः सवितर् इति गृह्णाति /
text_mt: In the Antaryāma cup, he draws the Sāvitra cup from the Āgrayaṇa vessel with: "With undefiled [protections], O Savitṛ..."

sanskrit_iast: asanno hūyate //
meaning: असन्नो हूयते //

sanskrit_iast: devāya savitre 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
meaning: देवाय सवित्रे ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: He causes [the hotṛ] to recite the invitatory verse: "Recite for the god Savitṛ!"

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya devāya savitre preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
meaning: आश्राव्य देवाय सवित्रे प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
text_mt: Having called for the śrauṣaṭ, he proceeds with the direction: "Summon for the god Savitṛ!"

sanskrit_iast: vaṣaṭkṛte na sarvaṃ juhoti /
meaning: वषट्कृते न सर्वं जुहोति /
text_mt: When the vaṣaṭ-call is uttered, he does not offer all of it.

sanskrit_iast: sāvitrasam̐srave pūtabhṛto vaiśvadevaṃ gṛhṇāti //
meaning: सावित्रसम्̐स्रवे पूतभृतो वैश्वदेवं गृह्णाति //
text_mt: Into the residue of the Sāvitra cup, he draws the Vaiśvadeva cup from the Pūtabhṛt vat.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ suśarmāsi supratiṣṭhānas \\ iti gṛhṇāti \\ eṣa te yonir \ viśvebhyas tvā devebhyas iti sādayati /
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ सुशर्मासि सुप्रतिष्ठानस् \\ इति गृह्णाति \\ एष ते योनिर् \ विश्वेभ्यस् त्वा देवेभ्यस् इति सादयति /
text_mt: With: "Thou art taken with a support; thou art providing good shelter, well founded...", he draws it. With: "This is thy womb; for the All-gods thee!", he places it.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvadevaṃ pratigṛṇāti //
meaning: वैश्वदेवं प्रतिगृणाति //
text_mt: He responds to the Vaiśvadeva recitation.

sanskrit_iast: ekayā ca daśabhiś ca \\ ity ucyamāne pratiprasthātā dvidevatyapātrāṇi prakṣālya khare sādayati //
meaning: एकया च दशभिश् च \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने प्रतिप्रस्थाता द्विदेवत्यपात्राणि प्रक्षाल्य खरे सादयति //
text_mt: While: "With one and with ten..." is being recited, the Pratiprasthātṛ, having washed the cups for the twin deities, places them on the mound.

sanskrit_iast: pra dyāvā yajñaiḥ pṛthivī ṛtāvṛdhā \\ iti dyāvāpṛthivīyaṃ tasmin madā modaiva \ modā modaiva \\ iti madvān pratigaraḥ /
meaning: प्र द्यावा यज्ञैः पृथिवी ऋतावृधा \\ इति द्यावापृथिवीयं तस्मिन् मदा मोदैव \ मोदा मोदैव \\ इति मद्वान् प्रतिगरः /
text_mt: To [the verse] to Heaven and Earth: "Forward, Heaven and Earth, with sacrifices, increasers of order...", the response containing the word mada is: "Joy, joy indeed! Exhilaration, exhilaration indeed!"

sanskrit_iast: kṛtākṛtaḥ surūpakṛtnum ūtaye \\ itiprabhṛti samāpadyate pratigaraḥ /
meaning: कृताकृतः सुरूपकृत्नुम् ऊतये \\ इतिप्रभृति समापद्यते प्रतिगरः /
text_mt: The response ends with [the verses] beginning with: "To him who makes fair forms for aid...", whether [certain verses are] recited or not.

sanskrit_iast: samāpte śastre grahādānaprabhṛti samānam aindrāgnenā bhakṣaṇāt //
meaning: समाप्ते शस्त्रे ग्रहादानप्रभृति समानम् ऐन्द्राग्नेना भक्षणात् //
text_mt: When the recitation is finished, the procedure from taking the cup up to consuming is the same as for the cup to Indra and Agni.

sanskrit_iast: narāśam̐sīpītasya soma deva te matividas tṛtīyasya savanasya jagacchandasaḥ pitṛpītasya \\ iti vikṛto bhakṣamantraḥ /
meaning: नराशम्̐सीपीतस्य सोम देव ते मतिविदस् तृतीयस्य सवनस्य जगच्छन्दसः पितृपीतस्य \\ इति विकृतो भक्षमन्त्रः /
text_mt: The modified formula for consuming is: "Of thee, divine Soma, who hast been drunk by the Narāśaṃsa, who knowest the thought, of the third pressing, possessing the jagatī meter, drunk by the fathers..."

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā sādanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ सादनात् /

sanskrit_iast: abhyudāharati saumyam /
meaning: अभ्युदाहरति सौम्यम् /
text_mt: He brings forward the boiled rice oblation for Soma.

sanskrit_iast: ājyasyāvadāyāpareṇa srugdaṇḍān dakṣiṇātikramya dakṣiṇaṃ paridhisaṃdhiṃ pratyavasthāyāśrāvya ghṛtasya yaja \\ iti preṣyati / dakṣiṇārdhe juhoti /
meaning: आज्यस्यावदायापरेण स्रुग्दण्डान् दक्षिणातिक्रम्य दक्षिणं परिधिसंधिं प्रत्यवस्थायाश्राव्य घृतस्य यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति / दक्षिणार्धे जुहोति /
text_mt: Having portioned out the clarified butter, having stepped past southwards behind the handles of the ladles, having stationed himself facing the southern junction of the enclosing sticks, having called for the śrauṣaṭ, he gives the direction: "Recite the offering verse for the clarified butter!" He offers on the southern half [of the fire].

sanskrit_iast: ata eva tiṣṭhan prācīnāvavītī saumyasyāvadāyodaṅṅ atikramyottaraṃ paridhisaṃdhiṃ pratyavasthāyāśrāvya saumyasya yaja \\ iti preṣyati / dakṣiṇā tiṣṭhan madhye juhoti /
meaning: अत एव तिष्ठन् प्राचीनाववीती सौम्यस्यावदायोदङ्ङ् अतिक्रम्योत्तरं परिधिसंधिं प्रत्यवस्थायाश्राव्य सौम्यस्य यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति / दक्षिणा तिष्ठन् मध्ये जुहोति /
text_mt: Standing right there, wearing the sacred thread over the right shoulder, having portioned out the boiled rice oblation for Soma, having stepped past northwards, having stationed himself facing the northern junction of the enclosing sticks, having called for the śrauṣaṭ, he gives the direction: "Recite the offering verse for the boiled rice oblation for Soma!" Standing facing south, he offers into the middle [of the fire].

sanskrit_iast: pratiparikramya visram̐sya prācīnāvavītam ājyasyāvadāyodaṅṅ atikramyottaraṃ praidhisaṃdhiṃ pratyavasthāyāśrāvya ghṛtasya yaja \\ iti preṣyaty uttarārdhe juhoti /
meaning: प्रतिपरिक्रम्य विस्रम्̐स्य प्राचीनाववीतम् आज्यस्यावदायोदङ्ङ् अतिक्रम्योत्तरं प्रैधिसंधिं प्रत्यवस्थायाश्राव्य घृतस्य यज \\ इति प्रेष्यत्य् उत्तरार्धे जुहोति /
text_mt: Having walked back around, having untied [the garment] worn over the right shoulder, having taken portions of clarified butter, having stepped across toward the north, having stationed himself facing the northern junction of the enclosing sticks, and having called for the śraushat, he gives the prompt: 'Recite the offering verse for the clarified butter'; he offers into the northern half [of the fire].

sanskrit_iast: vyuduhya saumyam ājyasyābhipūrayati //
meaning: व्युदुह्य सौम्यम् आज्यस्याभिपूरयति //
text_mt: Having pushed the Saumya [caru] aside, he fills it with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: satrā ta etad yad u ta iha \\ iti yajamāno 'vekṣate /
meaning: सत्रा त एतद् यद् उ त इह \\ इति यजमानो ऽवेक्षते /
text_mt: The sacrificer gazes at it with the mantra: 'Truly yours is this, and what is yours here...'

sanskrit_iast: yadi na paripaśyed yan me mano yamaṃ gatam iti japet /
meaning: यदि न परिपश्येद् यन् मे मनो यमं गतम् इति जपेत् /
text_mt: If he does not see [his reflection], he should whisper: 'Whatever mind of mine has gone to Yama...'

sanskrit_iast: avekṣyodgātṛbhyaḥ prayachati /
meaning: अवेक्ष्योद्गातृभ्यः प्रयछति /
text_mt: Having gazed at it, he hands it to the udgātṛ priests.

sanskrit_iast: darbhamuṣṭīn aṣṭau śalākodgāḍhān kṛtvā pracaraṇyām aṣṭagṛhītenādhyadhi dhiṣṇyāñ jvalato dhriyamāṇān pratyaṅṅ āsīna upasthānair vyāghārayati /
meaning: दर्भमुष्टीन् अष्टौ शलाकोद्गाढान् कृत्वा प्रचरण्याम् अष्टगृहीतेनाध्यधि धिष्ण्याञ् ज्वलतो ध्रियमाणान् प्रत्यङ्ङ् आसीन उपस्थानैर् व्याघारयति /
text_mt: Having made eight handfuls of darbha grass tied tightly with splints, seated facing west, he sprinkles [clarified butter] over the blazing dhiṣṇya hearths that are being maintained, with eight ladlings [of butter] in the pracaraṇī ladle, with the upasthāna formulas.

sanskrit_iast: upām̐śupātre pātnīvatam āgrāyaṇād upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ bṛhaspatisutasya te \\ iti gṛhṇāti /
meaning: उपाम्̐शुपात्रे पात्नीवतम् आग्रायणाद् उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ बृहस्पतिसुतस्य ते \\ इति गृह्णाति /
text_mt: Into the upāṃśupātra vessel he draws the pātnīvata cup from the āgrāyaṇa vessel with: 'You are taken with a support; of you, pressed for Bṛhaspati...'

sanskrit_iast: asanno hūyate //
meaning: असन्नो हूयते //

sanskrit_iast: agnā3 patnīvān iti dhiṣṇyavyāghāraṇasaṃpātena śrīṇāti /
meaning: अग्ना3 पत्नीवान् इति धिष्ण्यव्याघारणसंपातेन श्रीणाति /
text_mt: With the formula: 'O Agni, possessing a wife...', he mixes it with the residue from the sprinkling of the dhiṣṇya hearths.

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya \\ agnīt pātnīvatasya yaja \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: आश्राव्य \\ अग्नीत् पात्नीवतस्य यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Having called for the śraushat, he gives the prompt: 'O Āgnīdhra, recite the offering verse for the pātnīvata cup.'

sanskrit_iast: vaṣaṭkṛte na sarvaṃ juhoti /
meaning: वषट्कृते न सर्वं जुहोति /
text_mt: When the vaṣaṭ has been uttered, he does not offer all of it.

sanskrit_iast: bhakṣam āgnīdhrāya prayachati /
meaning: भक्षम् आग्नीध्राय प्रयछति /
text_mt: He hands the portion to be consumed to the āgnīdhra priest.

sanskrit_iast: neṣṭur upastham āruhyodaṅṅ avasṛpya paścān neṣṭrīyasya vāg devī somasya pibatu \\ iti bhakṣayati /
meaning: नेष्टुर् उपस्थम् आरुह्योदङ्ङ् अवसृप्य पश्चान् नेष्ट्रीयस्य वाग् देवी सोमस्य पिबतु \\ इति भक्षयति /
text_mt: Having mounted the lap of the neṣṭṛ priest, having crept away to the north, behind the neṣṭrīya hearth, he consumes it with: 'May the goddess Vāc drink of the soma.'

sanskrit_iast: hotṛcamasamukhyā agniṣṭomacamasās teṣu sarvam unnayaty agniṣṭome /
meaning: होतृचमसमुख्या अग्निष्टोमचमसास् तेषु सर्वम् उन्नयत्य् अग्निष्टोमे /
text_mt: The Agniṣṭoma drinking cups have the Hotṛ's cup as the primary one; he draws out all of it into them in the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: atiśam̐syād ukthye /
meaning: अतिशम्̐स्याद् उक्थ्ये /

sanskrit_iast: hotṛcamase dhrauvasyāvakāśaṃ kṛtvāgniṣṭomastotram upākaroti / tasya purastāt saptahotāram̐ yajamāno japati /
meaning: होतृचमसे ध्रौवस्यावकाशं कृत्वाग्निष्टोमस्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति / तस्य पुरस्तात् सप्तहोतारम्̐ यजमानो जपति /
text_mt: Having made room for the dhruva cup's portion in the Hotṛ's cup, he introduces the Agniṣṭoma stotra; before that, the sacrificer whispers the saptahotṛ formula.

sanskrit_iast: ākarṇaprāvṛtāḥ stūyamāne sadasy āsīran /
meaning: आकर्णप्रावृताः स्तूयमाने सदस्य् आसीरन् /
text_mt: Covered up to their ears, they should sit in the sadas while the praise song is being sung.

sanskrit_iast: prastute patnī pānnejanaṃ kalaśam antarata ūruṇā dakṣiṇena samudraṃ gandharveṣṭhām ity udañcaṃ pravartayati /
meaning: प्रस्तुते पत्नी पान्नेजनं कलशम् अन्तरत ऊरुणा दक्षिणेन समुद्रं गन्धर्वेष्ठाम् इत्य् उदञ्चं प्रवर्तयति /
text_mt: When the prelude has been sung, the wife rolls the foot-washing jar inside with her right thigh toward the north with: 'The ocean standing among the gandharvas...'

sanskrit_iast: neṣṭā patnīm udgātrā tisṛṣu stotriyāsūdgīthaṃ prati prāk pratihārād vāmī te saṃdṛśi \\ iti triḥ samīkṣayati /
meaning: नेष्टा पत्नीम् उद्गात्रा तिसृषु स्तोत्रियासूद्गीथं प्रति प्राक् प्रतिहाराद् वामी ते संदृशि \\ इति त्रिः समीक्षयति /
text_mt: The neṣṭṛ makes the wife look at the udgātṛ priest three times during the three stotra verses toward the udgītha before the pratihāra, with: 'Beautiful are they in your sight...'

sanskrit_iast: abhyagram āgnimārutaṃ pratigṛṇāti / viyatam āpohiṣṭhīyaṃ / tasmin hotāram anvārabhante //
meaning: अभ्यग्रम् आग्निमारुतं प्रतिगृणाति / वियतम् आपोहिष्ठीयं / तस्मिन् होतारम् अन्वारभन्ते //
text_mt: He responds to the beginning of the Āgnimāruta recitation; the āpohiṣṭhīya verses are recited separated; during it, they touch the hotṛ priest from behind.

sanskrit_iast: svāduṣ kilāyam itiprabhṛti svāduṣkilīyaṃ / tasmin madvat pratigṛṇāti //
meaning: स्वादुष् किलायम् इतिप्रभृति स्वादुष्किलीयं / तस्मिन् मद्वत् प्रतिगृणाति //
text_mt: The svāduṣkilīya hymn begins with: 'Sweet indeed is this...'; during it, he responds with the madvat formula.

sanskrit_iast: yayor ojasā skabhitā rajām̐si \\ itiprabhṛti samāpadyate pratigaraḥ //
meaning: ययोर् ओजसा स्कभिता रजाम्̐सि \\ इतिप्रभृति समापद्यते प्रतिगरः //
text_mt: Beginning with: 'By whose power the spaces were propped up...', the response is concluded.

sanskrit_iast: evā na indro maghavā virapśī \\ iti paridhānīyā / tasyāḥ punarukte 'rdharce pratiprasthātā pratyaṅmukha ūrdhvas tiṣṭhann anvārabdhe yajamāne vācayan dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa \\ iti hotṛcamase dhruvam avanayati svayaṃbhūr asi śreṣṭho raśmir iti ca \\ evam aham̐ viśvadarśato bhūyāsam ityantena /
meaning: एवा न इन्द्रो मघवा विरप्शी \\ इति परिधानीया / तस्याः पुनरुक्ते ऽर्धर्चे प्रतिप्रस्थाता प्रत्यङ्मुख ऊर्ध्वस् तिष्ठन्न् अन्वारब्धे यजमाने वाचयन् ध्रुवं ध्रुवेण \\ इति होतृचमसे ध्रुवम् अवनयति स्वयंभूर् असि श्रेष्ठो रश्मिर् इति च \\ एवम् अहम्̐ विश्वदर्शतो भूयासम् इत्यन्तेन /
text_mt: The concluding verse is: 'Thus may Indra, bounteous, exuberant...'; at its repeated half-verse, the pratiprasthātṛ priest, standing upright facing west, while the sacrificer holds onto him from behind and while making him recite: 'Firm with the firm...', pours down the dhruva soma into the Hotṛ's cup with: 'You are self-existent, the best ray...', ending with: '...thus may I become visible to all.'

sanskrit_iast: uttamam̐ śastramṃ pratigīrya \\ uktham̐ vācīndrāya \\ iti brūyāt /
meaning: उत्तमम्̐ शस्त्रम्ं प्रतिगीर्य \\ उक्थम्̐ वाचीन्द्राय \\ इति ब्रूयात् /
text_mt: Having responded to the last recitation, he should say: 'The recitation has been spoken for Indra.'

sanskrit_iast: hotṛcamasam ādatte 'dhvaryuś camasādhvaryavaś camasān /
meaning: होतृचमसम् आदत्ते ऽध्वर्युश् चमसाध्वर्यवश् चमसान् /
text_mt: The adhvaryu priest takes up the Hotṛ's cup, and the cup-adhvaryus take up their cups.

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya \\ ukthaśā yaja somānām iti preṣyati /
meaning: आश्राव्य \\ उक्थशा यज सोमानाम् इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Having called for the śraushat, he gives the prompt: 'O reciter of the uktha, recite the offering verse of the somas.'

sanskrit_iast: vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛte juhoti camasādhvaryavaś ca /
meaning: वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृते जुहोति चमसाध्वर्यवश् च /
text_mt: At the vaṣaṭ and the second vaṣaṭ, he offers, and the cup-adhvaryus also offer.

sanskrit_iast: evam ata ūrdhvaṃ praiṣaḥ somānām̐ homaś ca //
meaning: एवम् अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रैषः सोमानाम्̐ होमश् च //
text_mt: Such is the prompt and the offering of the somas from here onward.

sanskrit_iast: vāg devī somasya pibatu \\ iti sarvabhakṣān bhakṣayanti /
meaning: वाग् देवी सोमस्य पिबतु \\ इति सर्वभक्षान् भक्षयन्ति /
text_mt: With: 'May the goddess Vāc drink of the soma', they consume all the consumption portions.

sanskrit_iast: mārjālīye prakṣālya cātvālānte sādayanty agniṣṭome / pūtabhṛto 'nte yady ukthyaḥ /
meaning: मार्जालीये प्रक्षाल्य चात्वालान्ते सादयन्त्य् अग्निष्टोमे / पूतभृतो ऽन्ते यद्य् उक्थ्यः /
text_mt: Having rinsed [the cups] at the mārjālīya hearth, they set them down at the edge of the cātvāla trench in the Agniṣṭoma; at the edge of the pūtabhṛt vessel if it is an Ukthya.

sanskrit_iast: yady ukthya ukthyo vigṛhyate \\ upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ indrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tvā \\ iti prathamam upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ indrābṛhaspatibhyāṃ tvā \\ iti dvitīyam upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ indrāviṣṇubhyāṃ tvā \\ iti tṛtīyam /
meaning: यद्य् उक्थ्य उक्थ्यो विगृह्यते \\ उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ इन्द्रावरुणाभ्यां त्वा \\ इति प्रथमम् उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ इन्द्राबृहस्पतिभ्यां त्वा \\ इति द्वितीयम् उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ इन्द्राविष्णुभ्यां त्वा \\ इति तृतीयम् /
text_mt: If it is an Ukthya, the Ukthya cup is drawn separately: the first with 'You are taken with a support; for Indra and Varuṇa, you...', the second with 'You are taken with a support; for Indra and Bṛhaspati, you...', the third with 'You are taken with a support; for Indra and Viṣṇu, you...'

sanskrit_iast: samānam anyat /
meaning: समानम् अन्यत् /

sanskrit_iast: sarvam unnayaty ukthye /
meaning: सर्वम् उन्नयत्य् उक्थ्ये /
text_mt: He draws out all of it in the Ukthya.

sanskrit_iast: atiśam̐syāt ṣoḍaśini /
meaning: अतिशम्̐स्यात् षोडशिनि /

sanskrit_iast: ṣoḍaśicamaseṣu sarvam unnayati /
meaning: षोडशिचमसेषु सर्वम् उन्नयति /
text_mt: He draws out all of it into the Ṣoḍaśin cups.

sanskrit_iast: atiśam̐syād atirātre /
meaning: अतिशम्̐स्याद् अतिरात्रे /

sanskrit_iast: samayādhyuṣite sūrye darbhābhyām̐ hiraṇyena ca \\ aindram̐ saho 'sarji \\ upāvartadhvam \ abhisarpa yajamāna \\ iti ṣoḍaśini stotram upākaroti /
meaning: समयाध्युषिते सूर्ये दर्भाभ्याम्̐ हिरण्येन च \\ ऐन्द्रम्̐ सहो ऽसर्जि \\ उपावर्तध्वम् \ अभिसर्प यजमान \\ इति षोडशिनि स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति /
text_mt: When the sun has just set, with two blades of darbha grass and gold, he introduces the stotra in the Ṣoḍaśin with: 'Indra's power has been released; turn toward it; creep forward, O sacrificer.'

sanskrit_iast: prothann aśvaḥ śyāva upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: प्रोथन्न् अश्वः श्याव उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: A snorting dark-brown horse stands near.

sanskrit_iast: stotrāpavarga udgātre 'śvatarīṃ dadāti /
meaning: स्तोत्रापवर्ग उद्गात्रे ऽश्वतरीं ददाति /
text_mt: At the conclusion of the stotra, he gives a she-mule to the udgātṛ priest.

sanskrit_iast: śikṣyaḥ pratigaras tārtīyasavanikaḥ /
meaning: शिक्ष्यः प्रतिगरस् तार्तीयसवनिकः /
text_mt: The response belonging to the third pressing is to be learned.

sanskrit_iast: ata ūrdhvaṃ bhakṣamantras \\ anuṣṭupchanadaso 'gnihuta indraharivatpītasya \\ iti vikṛtaḥ ṣoḍaśini /
meaning: अत ऊर्ध्वं भक्षमन्त्रस् \\ अनुष्टुप्छनदसो ऽग्निहुत इन्द्रहरिवत्पीतस्य \\ इति विकृतः षोडशिनि /
text_mt: From here onward, the consumption formula is modified in the Ṣoḍaśin as: '...having the anuṣṭubh meter, offered in Agni, drunk by Indra possessing bay steeds...'

sanskrit_iast: yady aṣoḍaśiko 'tirātra ukthyaiḥ pracaryāstamite rātriparyāyeṇa pracarati /
meaning: यद्य् अषोडशिको ऽतिरात्र उक्थ्यैः प्रचर्यास्तमिते रात्रिपर्यायेण प्रचरति /
text_mt: If the Atirātra is without the Ṣoḍaśin, having performed [the rites] with the Ukthya cups, when the sun has set, he proceeds with the nocturnal round.

sanskrit_iast: catvāraś camasagaṇāḥ stutaśastravantaḥ / teṣām̐ hotuḥ prathamas tato maitrāvaruṇasya brāhmaṇācham̐sino 'chāvākasya ca //
meaning: चत्वारश् चमसगणाः स्तुतशस्त्रवन्तः / तेषाम्̐ होतुः प्रथमस् ततो मैत्रावरुणस्य ब्राह्मणाछम्̐सिनो ऽछावाकस्य च //
text_mt: There are four sets of cups accompanied by stotras and śastras; of them, the first belongs to the Hotṛ, then that of the Maitrāvaruṇa, of the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin, and of the Acchāvāka.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ indrāya tvābhiśarvarāya juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi \\ iti mukhyaṃmukhyaṃ camasam unnayati //
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ इन्द्राय त्वाभिशर्वराय जुष्टं गृह्णामि \\ इति मुख्यंमुख्यं चमसम् उन्नयति //
text_mt: With: 'You are taken with a support; I take you pleasing to Indra, the night-dweller', he draws each primary cup.

sanskrit_iast: anuṣṭupchandaso 'gnihuta indrābhiśarvarapītasya \\ iti vikṛto bhakṣamantraḥ /
meaning: अनुष्टुप्छन्दसो ऽग्निहुत इन्द्राभिशर्वरपीतस्य \\ इति विकृतो भक्षमन्त्रः /
text_mt: The consumption formula is modified as: '...having the anuṣṭubh meter, offered in Agni, drunk by Indra, the night-dweller...'

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ dvitīyaḥ paryāyo niśāyāṃ mahārātre tṛtīyaḥ /
meaning: एवं द्वितीयः पर्यायो निशायां महारात्रे तृतीयः /
text_mt: Thus the second round is [performed] at night, and the third in the dead of night.

sanskrit_iast: hotṛcamasamukhyāḥ saṃdhicamasās teṣu sarvam unnayaty atirātre /
meaning: होतृचमसमुख्याः संधिचमसास् तेषु सर्वम् उन्नयत्य् अतिरात्रे /
text_mt: The twilight cups have the Hotṛ's cup as primary; he draws out all of it into them in the Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: atiśam̐syād aptoryāmṇi /
meaning: अतिशम्̐स्याद् अप्तोर्याम्णि /
text_mt: Except for what is to be recited over in the Aptoryāma.

sanskrit_iast: upākṛte stotre pratiprasthātāśvinaṃ dvikapālaṃ tūṣṇīm upacaritam̐ sam̐skaroti /
meaning: उपाकृते स्तोत्रे प्रतिप्रस्थाताश्विनं द्विकपालं तूष्णीम् उपचरितम्̐ सम्̐स्करोति /
text_mt: When the stotra has been introduced, the pratiprasthātṛ priest prepares the Āśvina cake on two potsherds, treated silently.

sanskrit_iast: mahadāśvinaṃ pratigṛṇāti / param̐ sahasrāc cham̐saty ākramaṇād udite sauryāṇi /
meaning: महदाश्विनं प्रतिगृणाति / परम्̐ सहस्राच् छम्̐सत्य् आक्रमणाद् उदिते सौर्याणि /
text_mt: He responds to the Great Āśvina recitation; he recites beyond a thousand [verses] until the stepping forward; when the sun has risen, [he recites] the solar verses.

sanskrit_iast: samāpte śastre pratiprasthātāśvinam̐ sakṛt sarvam avadyati /
meaning: समाप्ते शस्त्रे प्रतिप्रस्थाताश्विनम्̐ सकृत् सर्वम् अवद्यति /
text_mt: When the recitation is finished, the pratiprasthātṛ cuts off all of the Āśvina cake at once.

sanskrit_iast: hotṛcamasam ādatte 'dhvaryuś camasādhvaryavaś camasān //
meaning: होतृचमसम् आदत्ते ऽध्वर्युश् चमसाध्वर्यवश् चमसान् //
text_mt: The adhvaryu priest takes up the Hotṛ's cup, and the cup-adhvaryus take up their cups.

sanskrit_iast: aśvibhyāṃ tiro'hnyānām̐ somānām anubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
meaning: अश्विभ्यां तिरोऽह्न्यानाम्̐ सोमानाम् अनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: He bids [the Hotṛ] recite the invitatory verse: 'Recite for the Aśvins for the somas left overnight.'

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya \\ aśvibhyāṃ tiro'hnyān somān prasthitān preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
meaning: आश्राव्य \\ अश्विभ्यां तिरोऽह्न्यान् सोमान् प्रस्थितान् प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
text_mt: Having called for the śraushat, he proceeds with the prompt: 'Prompt [the Hotṛ] for the Aśvins for the somas left overnight that have been set forth.'

sanskrit_iast: pūrvasmin vaṣaṭkāre pratiprasthātāśvinam̐ sarvahutaṃ karoti //
meaning: पूर्वस्मिन् वषट्कारे प्रतिप्रस्थाताश्विनम्̐ सर्वहुतं करोति //
text_mt: At the first vaṣaṭ-call, the pratiprasthātṛ makes the Āśvina cake offered wholly into the fire.

sanskrit_iast: paṅktiś chandaso 'gnihuto 'śvipītasya \\ iti vikṛto bhakṣamantraḥ /
meaning: पङ्क्तिश् छन्दसो ऽग्निहुतो ऽश्विपीतस्य \\ इति विकृतो भक्षमन्त्रः /
text_mt: The consumption formula is modified as: '...having the paṅkti meter, offered in Agni, drunk by the Aśvins...'

sanskrit_iast: aptoryāmā yathaiko rātriparyāyaḥ /

sanskrit_iast:
abhūd devaḥ savitā vandyo nu nas\ idānīm ahna upavācyo nṛbhiḥ /
vi yo ratnā bhajati mānavebhyaḥ \ śreṣṭhaṃ no atra draviṇam̐ yathā dadhat //
ā śarīraṃ payasā parādād \ anyadanyad bhavati rūpam asya /
tasmin vayam upahūtās tava sma\ ā no vīram̐ vahatā jāyamānāḥ //
yat te grāvṇā vichindat soma rājan \ dhruvam aṅgaṃ priyam̐ yat tanūs te /
tat saṃdhatsvota rohayasva \ viśvair viśvāṅgaiḥ saha saṃbhavāmi //
mā naḥ soma hvarito vihvaras tvammm\ mā naḥ param adhanaṃ mā rajo naiḥ /
mā no andhe tamasy antarādhāt\ mā no rudrāso adhigur vadhe nu //
sucakṣāḥ soma uta suśrud astu \ am̐śuś cāsya punar āpīno astu /
sa no rayim iha graheṣu dadhātu\ ūrjā sam̐rabdhā irayā madema //
ity etābhir ṛjīṣam adhiṣavaṇe dadhnābhijuhoti //
meaning:
अभूद् देवः सविता वन्द्यो नु नस्\ इदानीम् अह्न उपवाच्यो नृभिः /
वि यो रत्ना भजति मानवेभ्यः \ श्रेष्ठं नो अत्र द्रविणम्̐ यथा दधत् //
आ शरीरं पयसा परादाद् \ अन्यदन्यद् भवति रूपम् अस्य /
तस्मिन् वयम् उपहूतास् तव स्म\ आ नो वीरम्̐ वहता जायमानाः //
यत् ते ग्राव्णा विछिन्दत् सोम राजन् \ ध्रुवम् अङ्गं प्रियम्̐ यत् तनूस् ते /
तत् संधत्स्वोत रोहयस्व \ विश्वैर् विश्वाङ्गैः सह संभवामि //
मा नः सोम ह्वरितो विह्वरस् त्वम्म्म्\ मा नः परम् अधनं मा रजो नैः /
मा नो अन्धे तमस्य् अन्तराधात्\ मा नो रुद्रासो अधिगुर् वधे नु //
सुचक्षाः सोम उत सुश्रुद् अस्तु \ अम्̐शुश् चास्य पुनर् आपीनो अस्तु /
स नो रयिम् इह ग्रहेषु दधातु\ ऊर्जा सम्̐रब्धा इरया मदेम //
इत्य् एताभिर् ऋजीषम् अधिषवणे दध्नाभिजुहोति //
text_mt:
abhūd devaḥ savitā vandyo nu nas\ idānīm ahna upavācyo nṛbhiḥ

vi yo ratnā bhajati mānavebhyaḥ \ śreṣṭhaṃ no atra draviṇam̐ yathā dadhat

ā śarīraṃ payasā parādād \ anyadanyad bhavati rūpam asya

tasmin vayam upahūtās tava sma\ ā no vīram̐ vahatā jāyamānāḥ

yat te grāvṇā vichindat soma rājan \ dhruvam aṅgaṃ priyam̐ yat tanūs te

tat saṃdhatsvota rohayasva \ viśvair viśvāṅgaiḥ saha saṃbhavāmi

mā naḥ soma hvarito vihvaras tvammm\ mā naḥ param adhanaṃ mā rajo naiḥ

mā no andhe tamasy antarādhāt\ mā no rudrāso adhigur vadhe nu

sucakṣāḥ soma uta suśrud astu \ am̐śuś cāsya punar āpīno astu

sa no rayim iha graheṣu dadhātu\ ūrjā sam̐rabdhā irayā madema

meaning: आस्यदेशे निगृह्णाति /

sanskrit_iast: priyatamāya kṛṣṇājinaṃ prayachati / tad adhi peṣaṇaṃ kurvanti //
meaning: प्रियतमाय कृष्णाजिनं प्रयछति / तद् अधि पेषणं कुर्वन्ति //
text_mt: priyatamāya kṛṣṇājinaṃ prayachati / tad adhi peṣaṇaṃ kurvanti

sanskrit_iast: vicṛtto varuṇasya pāśas \\ iti mekhalām̐ viṣyati vasanaṃ ca / tūṣṇīṃ patnī yoktraṃ jālaṃ ca /
meaning: विचृत्तो वरुणस्य पाशस् \\ इति मेखलाम्̐ विष्यति वसनं च / तूष्णीं पत्नी योक्त्रं जालं च /
text_mt: vicṛtto varuṇasya pāśas \\ iti mekhalām̐ viṣyati vasanaṃ ca / tūṣṇīṃ patnī yoktraṃ jālaṃ ca

sanskrit_iast: avabhṛthe snātāv anyo'nyasya pṛṣṭham prakṣālayataḥ /
meaning: अवभृथे स्नाताव् अन्योऽन्यस्य पृष्ठम् प्रक्षालयतः /
text_mt: avabhṛthe snātāv anyo'nyasya pṛṣṭham prakṣālayataḥ

sanskrit_iast: somopanahanam̐ yajamānaḥ paridhatte paryāṇahanaṃ patnī / te udavasānīyāyāṃ dakṣiṇākāle 'dhvaryave dattaḥ //
meaning: सोमोपनहनम्̐ यजमानः परिधत्ते पर्याणहनं पत्नी / ते उदवसानीयायां दक्षिणाकाले ऽध्वर्यवे दत्तः //
text_mt: somopanahanam̐ yajamānaḥ paridhatte paryāṇahanaṃ patnī / te udavasānīyāyāṃ dakṣiṇākāle 'dhvaryave dattaḥ

sanskrit_iast: unnetar vasīyas \\ ity āhonnetāram̐ yajamānaḥ //
meaning: उन्नेतर् वसीयस् \\ इत्य् आहोन्नेतारम्̐ यजमानः //
text_mt: unnetar vasīyas \\ ity āhonnetāram̐ yajamānaḥ

sanskrit_iast: udut te madhumattamā giras \\ ity unnetā prakramayati /
meaning: उदुत् ते मधुमत्तमा गिरस् \\ इत्य् उन्नेता प्रक्रमयति /
text_mt: udut te madhumattamā giras \\ ity unnetā prakramayati

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātaṃ pratyasanaṃ mārjanaṃ ca /
meaning: व्याख्यातं प्रत्यसनं मार्जनं च /
text_mt: vyākhyātaṃ pratyasanaṃ mārjanaṃ ca

sanskrit_iast:
apāma somam amṛtā abhūma\ aganma jyotir avidāma devān /
kiṃ nūnam asmān kṛṇavad arātiḥ \ kim u dhūrtir amṛta martyasya //
iti japanti /
meaning:
अपाम सोमम् अमृता अभूम\ अगन्म ज्योतिर् अविदाम देवान् /
किं नूनम् अस्मान् कृणवद् अरातिः \ किम् उ धूर्तिर् अमृत मर्त्यस्य //
इति जपन्ति /
text_mt:
"We have drunk the soma, we have become immortal; / we have reached the light, we have found the gods.

What now could hostility do to us, / or what, O immortal one, the malice of a mortal?" —

sanskrit_iast: unnetāraṃ puraskṛtyānapekṣamāṇāḥ pratyāyanti / tad vyākhyātam /
meaning: उन्नेतारं पुरस्कृत्यानपेक्षमाणाः प्रत्यायन्ति / तद् व्याख्यातम् /
text_mt: Placing the unnetṛ priest in front, they walk back without looking around. That has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaṇīyenodayanīyo vyākhyātaḥ /
meaning: प्रायणीयेनोदयनीयो व्याख्यातः /
text_mt: By the introductory rite the concluding rite is explained.

sanskrit_iast: niṣkāṣe prāyaṇīyasyodayanīyam anunirvapati /
meaning: निष्काषे प्रायणीयस्योदयनीयम् अनुनिर्वपति /
text_mt: Upon the scraped-off portion of the introductory rite he apportions [the materials of] the concluding rite.

sanskrit_iast: śālāmukhīye pracarati /
meaning: शालामुखीये प्रचरति /
text_mt: He performs the ritual at the śālāmukhīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: prāg aditeḥ pathyām̐ svastiṃ pūrvārdhe yajati /
meaning: प्राग् अदितेः पथ्याम्̐ स्वस्तिं पूर्वार्धे यजति /
text_mt: Before Aditi, he sacrifices to Pathyā Svasti in the eastern half.

sanskrit_iast: anūbandhyāyai vedaṃ nidadhāti /
meaning: अनूबन्ध्यायै वेदं निदधाति /
text_mt: He deposits the veda grass bundle for the anūbandhyā cow offering.

sanskrit_iast: pāśubandhikam idhmābarhiḥ saṃnahyati /
meaning: पाशुबन्धिकम् इध्माबर्हिः संनह्यति /
text_mt: He binds the sacrificial fuel and the sacrificial grass pertaining to the animal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: maitrāvaruṇīm̐ vaśām anūbandhyām ālabhate /
meaning: मैत्रावरुणीम्̐ वशाम् अनूबन्ध्याम् आलभते /
text_mt: He seizes the sterile cow dedicated to Mitra-Varuṇa as the anūbandhyā.

sanskrit_iast: chāgakāle \\ usrāyās \\ iti saṃpraiṣaḥ /
meaning: छागकाले \\ उस्रायास् \\ इति संप्रैषः /
text_mt: At the time for the goat, the call to recite is: "For the cow..."

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā vapāyā homāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ वपाया होमात् /

sanskrit_iast: hutāyām̐ vapāyāṃ cātvāle mārjayitvā dakṣiṇasyām̐ vediśroṇau pariśrite keśaśmaśru yajamāno vāpayate /
meaning: हुतायाम्̐ वपायां चात्वाले मार्जयित्वा दक्षिणस्याम्̐ वेदिश्रोणौ परिश्रिते केशश्मश्रु यजमानो वापयते /
text_mt: When the omentum has been offered, having cleansed himself at the pit, the sacrificer has his hair and beard shaved in an enclosure on the southern buttress of the altar.

sanskrit_iast: paśupuroḍāśam anu devikāhavīm̐ṣi nirvapaty anumatyai carū rākāyai sinīvālyai kuhvai dhātre dvādaśakapālam̐ somasthālīṣu śrapayati /
meaning: पशुपुरोडाशम् अनु देविकाहवीम्̐षि निर्वपत्य् अनुमत्यै चरू राकायै सिनीवाल्यै कुह्वै धात्रे द्वादशकपालम्̐ सोमस्थालीषु श्रपयति /
text_mt: Following the animal sacrificial cake, he apportions the oblations for the Devikās: boiled oblations for Anumati, for Rākā, for Sinīvālī, [and] for Kuhū, and [a sacrificial cake] on twelve potsherds for Dhātṛ; he cooks them in the soma vessels.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā pracaraṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ प्रचरणात् /

sanskrit_iast: paśupuroḍāśena pracaryopām̐śu devikāhavirbhiḥ pracarati /
meaning: पशुपुरोडाशेन प्रचर्योपाम्̐शु देविकाहविर्भिः प्रचरति /
text_mt: Having performed the offering with the animal sacrificial cake, he performs the offering with the Devikā oblations in a whisper.

sanskrit_iast: eṣo 'nvayane kalpaḥ /
meaning: एषो ऽन्वयने कल्पः /

sanskrit_iast: paśupuroḍāśasya devikāhaviṣāṃ ca samavadāyāniruktena sviṣṭakṛtā pracarati /
meaning: पशुपुरोडाशस्य देविकाहविषां च समवदायानिरुक्तेन स्विष्टकृता प्रचरति /
text_mt: Having cut portions together from the animal sacrificial cake and from the Devikā oblations, he performs the offering with the unexpressed Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: siddhaḥ paśubandhaḥ / payasyā vā /
meaning: सिद्धः पशुबन्धः / पयस्या वा /
text_mt: The animal sacrifice is established, or else [he offers] a curd offering.

sanskrit_iast: havirdhānayoḥ prathamakṛtān granthīn visram̐syodīcī pravartayanti pūrvārdhenānyad āhavanīyasya paścārdhenānyat /
meaning: हविर्धानयोः प्रथमकृतान् ग्रन्थीन् विस्रम्̐स्योदीची प्रवर्तयन्ति पूर्वार्धेनान्यद् आहवनीयस्य पश्चार्धेनान्यत् /
text_mt: Having untied the knots tied first on the two soma-cart sheds, they roll them out northward, one along the eastern half of the āhavanīya fire, the other along the western half.

sanskrit_iast:
yat kusīdam apratītaṃ mayeha \ yena yamasya nidhinā carāvaḥ /
etat tad agne anṛṇo bhavāmi \ jīvann eva pratidatte dadāmi //
ity āhavanīyād yajamāno vediṃ paryoṣati //
meaning:
यत् कुसीदम् अप्रतीतं मयेह \ येन यमस्य निधिना चरावः /
एतत् तद् अग्ने अनृणो भवामि \ जीवन्न् एव प्रतिदत्ते ददामि //
इत्य् आहवनीयाद् यजमानो वेदिं पर्योषति //
text_mt:
"Whatever debt not repaid by me [remains] here, / with whatever deposit of Yama we two move about,

thereof, O Agni, I become free from debt: / living indeed, I give it back to him who gave it," —

with this the sacrificer scorches the altar [with fire brought] from the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: viśloka viśvadāvye tvā saṃjuhomi svāhā \\ iti pradāvye yajamānaḥ saktvañjaliṃ juhoti //
meaning: विश्लोक विश्वदाव्ये त्वा संजुहोमि स्वाहा \\ इति प्रदाव्ये यजमानः सक्त्वञ्जलिं जुहोति //
text_mt: "O wide-striding one, in the all-consuming one I offer you, svāhā!" — with this the sacrificer offers a folded-handful of barley flour into the fire-place.

sanskrit_iast: adhvād eko 'ddhād eko hutād eko 'hutād ekaḥ kṛtād ekaḥ kṛtākṛtād ekaḥ sanād ekaḥ sanāsanād ekas \ te naḥ kṛṇvantu bheṣajam \\ sadaḥ saho vareṇyam iti pradāvye yajamāna upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: अध्वाद् एको ऽद्धाद् एको हुताद् एको ऽहुताद् एकः कृताद् एकः कृताकृताद् एकः सनाद् एकः सनासनाद् एकस् \ ते नः कृण्वन्तु भेषजम् \\ सदः सहो वरेण्यम् इति प्रदाव्ये यजमान उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: "One from eating, one from not eating; one from offered, one from unoffered; one from made, one from made-and-unmade; one from old, one from not old: may they prepare healing for us, the assembly, strength, the choice portion!" — with this the sacrificer reveres [the fires] in the fire-place.

sanskrit_iast:
etam̐ sadhastha pari te dadāmi \ yam āvahāc chevadhiṃ jātavedāḥ /
anvāgantā yajñapatir vo atra \ tam̐ sma jānīta parame vyoman //
jānītād enaṃ parame vyoman \ devāḥ sadhasthā vida rūpam asya /
ya āgachāt pathibhir devayānair \ iṣṭāpūrte kṛṇutād āvir asmāt //
iti yajamānaḥ paridadāti /
meaning:
एतम्̐ सधस्थ परि ते ददामि \ यम् आवहाच् छेवधिं जातवेदाः /
अन्वागन्ता यज्ञपतिर् वो अत्र \ तम्̐ स्म जानीत परमे व्योमन् //
जानीताद् एनं परमे व्योमन् \ देवाः सधस्था विद रूपम् अस्य /
य आगछात् पथिभिर् देवयानैर् \ इष्टापूर्ते कृणुताद् आविर् अस्मात् //
इति यजमानः परिददाति /
text_mt:
"This [sacrifice], O assembly-place, I entrust to you, / which treasure Jātavedas shall bring;

the master of sacrifice will come after you here: / recognize him in the highest heaven!

Recognize him in the highest heaven, / O gods, companions of the seat; know his form!

He who shall come by the paths trodden by gods, / make manifest to him his sacrifices and charitable gifts!" —

sanskrit_iast:
anṛṇā asminn anṛṇāḥ parasmin\ tṛtīye loke anṛṇāḥ syāma /
ye devayānāḥ pitṛyāṇāś ca lokāḥ \ sarvām̐l lokān anṛṇāḥ saṃcaremahi //
iti japati yajamānaḥ /
meaning:
अनृणा अस्मिन्न् अनृणाः परस्मिन्\ तृतीये लोके अनृणाः स्याम /
ये देवयानाः पितृयाणाश् च लोकाः \ सर्वाम्̐ल् लोकान् अनृणाः संचरेमहि //
इति जपति यजमानः /
text_mt:
with this the sacrificer entrusts [it].

"Free from debt in this [world], free from debt in the other, / may we be free from debt in the third world!

Whatever worlds are trodden by gods and trodden by the fathers, / through all worlds may we wander free from debt!" —

sanskrit_iast: samāropayaty aparāvagnī / yadi gataśrīḥ śālāmukhīyaṃ ca /
meaning: समारोपयत्य् अपरावग्नी / यदि गतश्रीः शालामुखीयं च /
text_mt: He causes the two western fires to mount [into the churning sticks]; if he is of established prosperity, the śālāmukhīya fire as well.

sanskrit_iast: udaṅṅ udavasāyāraṇibhyām agniṃ mathitvodavasānīyām iṣṭiṃ nirvapati /
meaning: उदङ्ङ् उदवसायारणिभ्याम् अग्निं मथित्वोदवसानीयाम् इष्टिं निर्वपति /
text_mt: Having migrated northward and churned out fire with the two churning sticks, he apportions [the materials for] the departure sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyam eva pañcakapālam̐ vibhaktīḥ prayājānuyājeṣv āgneyāv ājyabhāgau /
meaning: आग्नेयम् एव पञ्चकपालम्̐ विभक्तीः प्रयाजानुयाजेष्व् आग्नेयाव् आज्यभागौ /
text_mt: [It consists] of [a sacrificial cake] on five potsherds for Agni alone, divided [portions] in the fore-offerings and after-offerings, [and] two clarified butter portions for Agni.

sanskrit_iast: anaḍvān dakṣiṇā /
meaning: अनड्वान् दक्षिणा /

sanskrit_iast: api vā vaiṣṇavīṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā /
meaning: अपि वा वैष्णवीं पूर्णाहुतिं हुत्वा /
text_mt: Or else having offered a full-spoon offering to Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
agnir ajahitaḥ praitu prathamo yajñiyānām /
avasānaṃ me 'vasānapatir vindat /
dīdivām̐saṃ tvā vyam anvāgamemahi //
iti yajamāno vihāraṃ puraskṛtya gṛhān āgachaty āgachati /
meaning:
अग्निर् अजहितः प्रैतु प्रथमो यज्ञियानाम् /
अवसानं मे ऽवसानपतिर् विन्दत् /
दीदिवाम्̐सं त्वा व्यम् अन्वागमेमहि //
इति यजमानो विहारं पुरस्कृत्य गृहान् आगछत्य् आगछति /

sanskrit_iast: brahmā prāyaścittāni sruveṇa juhoty ṛkto bhreṣe bhuḥ svāhā \\ iti gārhapatye yajuṣṭas \\ bhuvaḥ svāhā \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnau sāmataḥ svaḥ svāhā \\ ity āhavanīye sarvatas \\ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā \\ ity āhavanīya eva /
meaning: ब्रह्मा प्रायश्चित्तानि स्रुवेण जुहोत्य् ऋक्तो भ्रेषे भुः स्वाहा \\ इति गार्हपत्ये यजुष्टस् \\ भुवः स्वाहा \\ इति दक्षिणाग्नौ सामतः स्वः स्वाहा \\ इत्य् आहवनीये सर्वतस् \\ भूर् भुवः स्वः स्वाहा \\ इत्य् आहवनीय एव /
text_mt: The brahman priest offers expiations with the dipping spoon: in case of a flaw concerning a Ṛgverse, with "bhūḥ svāhā" in the gārhapatya fire; concerning a Yajus formula, with "bhuvaḥ svāhā" in the southern fire; concerning a Sāman chant, with "svaḥ svāhā" in the āhavanīya fire; concerning all, with "bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā" in the āhavanīya fire itself.

sanskrit_iast: duṣṭam apo 'bhyavahared atha pātrāṇi parimṛjyāl lohaṃ nirlikhed dārumayaṃ niṣṭapen mārtikam adbhiḥ sauvarṇam̐ rājatam /
meaning: दुष्टम् अपो ऽभ्यवहरेद् अथ पात्राणि परिमृज्याल् लोहं निर्लिखेद् दारुमयं निष्टपेन् मार्तिकम् अद्भिः सौवर्णम्̐ राजतम् /
text_mt: He should discard defiled water; then, wiping the vessels, he should scrape iron, heat wooden [vessels], [cleanse] earthenware with water, [as well as] gold and silver [vessels].

sanskrit_iast: dravyāpacāre sāmānyam̐ yajñiyaṃ pratinidadhyāt /
meaning: द्रव्यापचारे सामान्यम्̐ यज्ञियं प्रतिनिदध्यात् /
text_mt: In case of the loss of a substance, he should substitute a similar one fit for sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: karmāntaritaṃ kuryāt sam̐skārāntare prāyaścittam eva juhuyāt /
meaning: कर्मान्तरितं कुर्यात् सम्̐स्कारान्तरे प्रायश्चित्तम् एव जुहुयात् /
text_mt: He should perform a omitted ritual act; if another consecratory act intervenes, he should simply offer an expiation.

sanskrit_iast: dravyāvṛttau sahamantram āvartayet tūṣṇīm̐ vā /
meaning: द्रव्यावृत्तौ सहमन्त्रम् आवर्तयेत् तूष्णीम्̐ वा /
text_mt: When a substance is repeated, he should repeat it together with the sacred formula, or silently.

sanskrit_iast: devatāvadānayājyānuvākyāhavirmantrakarmaviparyāse 'nāmnātaprāyaścittānāṃ cāpadi tvaṃ no agne \ sa tvaṃ no agne \ ayāś cāgne 'si \\ ity etābhir juhuyād vyāhṛtibhiś cāthavā vyāhṛtibhir eva / homakāle 'pi sarvatrānāmnātaprāyaścitteṣu vyāhṛtibhir eva juhuyāt /
meaning: देवतावदानयाज्यानुवाक्याहविर्मन्त्रकर्मविपर्यासे ऽनाम्नातप्रायश्चित्तानां चापदि त्वं नो अग्ने \ स त्वं नो अग्ने \ अयाश् चाग्ने ऽसि \\ इत्य् एताभिर् जुहुयाद् व्याहृतिभिश् चाथवा व्याहृतिभिर् एव / होमकाले ऽपि सर्वत्रानाम्नातप्रायश्चित्तेषु व्याहृतिभिर् एव जुहुयात् /
text_mt: In case of confusion of deity, portion, offering verse, invitatory verse, oblation, sacred formula, or ritual act, and in distress for which no expiations are prescribed, he should offer with these: "You to us, O Agni...", "So you to us, O Agni...", and "You are Ayās, O Agni...", and with the mystical utterances, or else with the mystical utterances alone. At the time of offering also, in all cases of expiations that are not prescribed, he should offer with the mystical utterances alone.

sanskrit_iast: akāle vācam̐ visṛjya vaiṣṇavīṃ nigadya punar yachet /
meaning: अकाले वाचम्̐ विसृज्य वैष्णवीं निगद्य पुनर् यछेत् /
text_mt: Having uttered speech out of time, having recited a verse to Viṣṇu, he should restrain it again.

sanskrit_iast: vratopetasya ced āhavanīyo 'nugachet praṇīte manasā vratamupetya bhūr ity upatiṣṭheta /
meaning: व्रतोपेतस्य चेद् आहवनीयो ऽनुगछेत् प्रणीते मनसा व्रतमुपेत्य भूर् इत्य् उपतिष्ठेत /
text_mt: If the āhavanīya fire goes out while he has undertaken the vow, when [the fires] have been carried forward, having mentally undertaken the vow, he should revere [the fire] with "bhūḥ".

sanskrit_iast: yadi vatsā apākṛtā dhayeyur vāyavyā yavāgvā pracarya prātardohena pracared yadi prātardohe 'param̐ vāyavyā /
meaning: यदि वत्सा अपाकृता धयेयुर् वायव्या यवाग्वा प्रचर्य प्रातर्दोहेन प्रचरेद् यदि प्रातर्दोहे ऽपरम्̐ वायव्या /
text_mt: If the calves, after being set apart, should suckle, having performed the ritual with barley gruel for Vāyu, he should perform the ritual with the morning milking; if in the case of the morning milking [another suckling occurs, he should perform the ritual] with [another barley gruel] for Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast: yadi sāyaṃdoham apahared duṣyed vā prātardohaṃ dvaidhaṃ dohayitvārdham ātacya pracaret /
meaning: यदि सायंदोहम् अपहरेद् दुष्येद् वा प्रातर्दोहं द्वैधं दोहयित्वार्धम् आतच्य प्रचरेत् /
text_mt: If they should take away the evening milking or it should become spoiled, having caused the morning milking to be milked in two parts and having curdled half of it, he should perform the ritual.

sanskrit_iast: yadi sāyaṃdoha ārtim iyād indrāya vrīhīn nirvapec chvobhūte teṣv anunirpavet /
meaning: यदि सायंदोह आर्तिम् इयाद् इन्द्राय व्रीहीन् निर्वपेच् छ्वोभूते तेष्व् अनुनिर्पवेत् /
text_mt: If the evening milking should suffer damage, he should apportion rice for Indra; on the next day he should apportion upon them.

sanskrit_iast: yadi prātardoha aindraṃ puroḍāśam̐ yady ubhāv aindraṃ pañcaśarāv amodanaṃ paced ājyenāgniṃ prathamam̐ yajeta /
meaning: यदि प्रातर्दोह ऐन्द्रं पुरोडाशम्̐ यद्य् उभाव् ऐन्द्रं पञ्चशराव् अमोदनं पचेद् आज्येनाग्निं प्रथमम्̐ यजेत /
text_mt: If the morning milking [suffers damage], [he should offer] a sacrificial cake for Indra; if both [suffer damage], he should cook a boiled rice oblation of five plates for Indra [and] sacrifice first to Agni with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: hīneṣv ārtigate vā vatsān apākṛtya punar yajeta /
meaning: हीनेष्व् आर्तिगते वा वत्सान् अपाकृत्य पुनर् यजेत /
text_mt: When [the offerings] are deficient or have suffered damage, having set apart the calves, he should sacrifice again.

sanskrit_iast: yasya sāṃnāyyaṃ candramā abhyudiyād vatsān pratinudet /
meaning: यस्य सांनाय्यं चन्द्रमा अभ्युदियाद् वत्सान् प्रतिनुदेत् /
text_mt: For whom the moon rises upon the curd and milk offering, he should drive the calves back.

sanskrit_iast: sāyaṃdoho havirātañcanaṃ tadvrato yathākālam̐ yajeta /
meaning: सायंदोहो हविरातञ्चनं तद्व्रतो यथाकालम्̐ यजेत /
text_mt: The evening milking is the oblation-curdling agent; having undertaken that vow, he should sacrifice at the proper time.

sanskrit_iast: vratam anutsahamānasyābhyuditeṣṭir nirupteṣu ca vatsān apākṛtya punar yajeta /
meaning: व्रतम् अनुत्सहमानस्याभ्युदितेष्टिर् निरुप्तेषु च वत्सान् अपाकृत्य पुनर् यजेत /
text_mt: For one incapable of [observing] the vow, there is the sacrifice on the moonrise; and when [the portions] have been apportioned, having set apart the calves, he should sacrifice again.

sanskrit_iast: yadi havīm̐ṣy apahareyur duṣyeyur vājyena sam̐sthāpya punar yajeta /
meaning: यदि हवीम्̐ष्य् अपहरेयुर् दुष्येयुर् वाज्येन सम्̐स्थाप्य पुनर् यजेत /
text_mt: If they should take away the oblations or they should become spoiled, having concluded [the rite] with clarified butter, he should sacrifice again.

sanskrit_iast: yadi havīm̐ṣi muhyeyuḥ pātryām̐ samadhā vibhajyānupūrveṇa pracaret /
meaning: यदि हवीम्̐षि मुह्येयुः पात्र्याम्̐ समधा विभज्यानुपूर्वेण प्रचरेत् /
text_mt: If the oblations become confused, he should divide [them] equally into vessels and proceed successively in order.

sanskrit_iast: sarvaskanne naṣṭe duṣṭe vā yathāpūrvaṃ punaḥ sam̐skaraṇam //
meaning: सर्वस्कन्ने नष्टे दुष्टे वा यथापूर्वं पुनः सम्̐स्करणम् //
text_mt: If all has spilled, been lost, or corrupted, the preparation takes place anew as before.

sanskrit_iast: devāñ janam agan yajñas \\ iti skannam abhimantryāpo ninayet /
meaning: देवाञ् जनम् अगन् यज्ञस् \\ इति स्कन्नम् अभिमन्त्र्यापो निनयेत् /
text_mt: Addressing the spilled portion with the mantra, "The sacrifice has gone to the divine people," he should pour water on it.

sanskrit_iast: ājye skanne dadāty anutpūte citram utpūyamāne prāṇy utpūte varam /
meaning: आज्ये स्कन्ने ददात्य् अनुत्पूते चित्रम् उत्पूयमाने प्राण्य् उत्पूते वरम् /
text_mt: When the clarified butter spills before being purified, he gives a spotted [cow]; while being purified, a living animal; after being purified, a boon.

sanskrit_iast: duḥśṛtayor avadānamātre suśṛtena prāyaścittaṃ tathā kṣāmayoḥ /
meaning: दुःशृतयोर् अवदानमात्रे सुशृतेन प्रायश्चित्तं तथा क्षामयोः /
text_mt: If two portions are ill-cooked, only as much as an oblation portion is the expiation with a well-cooked [portion]; likewise if two are burnt.

sanskrit_iast: adakṣiṇeneṣṭvorvarām̐ samṛddhāṃ dadyāt /
meaning: अदक्षिणेनेष्ट्वोर्वराम्̐ समृद्धां दद्यात् /
text_mt: Having sacrificed without a sacrificial gift, he should give a fertile, rich field.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kapālaṃ bhidyeta gāyatryā tvā śatākṣarayā saṃdadhāmi \\ iti saṃdhānakaraiḥ śucidravyaiḥ saṃdhāyāthaitat kapālam \\ dhātā dhātuḥ pituḥ pitābhinno gharmo viśvāyur yato jātaṃ tad apyagāt svāhā \\ ity apsu prahared athānyat kapālam āhṛtya sādanābhimarśanaprokṣaṇādi kṛtvā pūrvayukteṣu kapāleṣv apisṛjet / upahitasya bhede tu tasya saṃdhānādi pūrvavat kṛtvānyat sam̐skṛtyopahitaṃ kapālam upadhānakāle yena mantreṇopahitaṃ tenaivopadadhyāt tatsthāne /
meaning: यदि कपालं भिद्येत गायत्र्या त्वा शताक्षरया संदधामि \\ इति संधानकरैः शुचिद्रव्यैः संधायाथैतत् कपालम् \\ धाता धातुः पितुः पिताभिन्नो घर्मो विश्वायुर् यतो जातं तद् अप्यगात् स्वाहा \\ इत्य् अप्सु प्रहरेद् अथान्यत् कपालम् आहृत्य सादनाभिमर्शनप्रोक्षणादि कृत्वा पूर्वयुक्तेषु कपालेष्व् अपिसृजेत् / उपहितस्य भेदे तु तस्य संधानादि पूर्ववत् कृत्वान्यत् सम्̐स्कृत्योपहितं कपालम् उपधानकाले येन मन्त्रेणोपहितं तेनैवोपदध्यात् तत्स्थाने /
text_mt: If a potsherd breaks, having joined it with clean substances that join [it] with the mantra, "I unite you with the hundred-syllabled Gāyatrī," he should throw this potsherd into water with the mantra, "Dhātṛ, father of the dispenser, the father, the unbroken cauldron, possessing all life, has gone back to that from which it was born, svāhā!" Then, bringing another potsherd and performing the setting down, touching, sprinkling, and other rites, he should place it among the previously arranged potsherds. But when an already set down potsherd breaks, having performed its joining and other rites as before, having prepared another potsherd, he should place it in its spot at the time of placing potsherds with the very mantra with which it had been set down.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kapālaṃ naśyed brāhmaṇavyākhyātaṃ // dhātā dhātuḥ pituḥ pitānaṣṭo dharmas \\ iti naṣṭādhigatam apsu prahṛtya namas te rudrāyate \ namo 'stu parāyate \ namo yatra niṣīdasi \\ iti cābhimantrayeta /
meaning: यदि कपालं नश्येद् ब्राह्मणव्याख्यातं // धाता धातुः पितुः पितानष्टो धर्मस् \\ इति नष्टाधिगतम् अप्सु प्रहृत्य नमस् ते रुद्रायते \ नमो ऽस्तु परायते \ नमो यत्र निषीदसि \\ इति चाभिमन्त्रयेत /
text_mt: If a potsherd is lost, it has been explained in the Brāhmaṇa. Having thrown into water that which was found after being lost, with the mantra, "Dhātṛ, father of the dispenser, the father, the lost law...," he should address it with the verse: "Homage to you as you approach; / homage be to you as you depart; / homage to where you sit down!"

sanskrit_iast: yadi prāk prayājebhyo bahiṣparidhy aṅgāraḥ skandet tam abhimantrayeta \\ adhvaryuṃ mā him̐sīr \ yajñaṃ mā him̐sīr iti purastād brahmāṇaṃ mā him̐sīḥ \ prajāṃ mā him̐sīr iti dakṣiṇatas \\ hotāraṃ mā him̐sīḥ \ patnīṃ mā him̐sīr iti paścād āgnīdhraṃ mā him̐sīḥ \ paśūn mā him̐sīr ity uttaratas \\ yajamānaṃ mā him̐sīr iti sarvatrānuṣajati /
meaning: यदि प्राक् प्रयाजेभ्यो बहिष्परिध्य् अङ्गारः स्कन्देत् तम् अभिमन्त्रयेत \\ अध्वर्युं मा हिम्̐सीर् \ यज्ञं मा हिम्̐सीर् इति पुरस्ताद् ब्रह्माणं मा हिम्̐सीः \ प्रजां मा हिम्̐सीर् इति दक्षिणतस् \\ होतारं मा हिम्̐सीः \ पत्नीं मा हिम्̐सीर् इति पश्चाद् आग्नीध्रं मा हिम्̐सीः \ पशून् मा हिम्̐सीर् इत्य् उत्तरतस् \\ यजमानं मा हिम्̐सीर् इति सर्वत्रानुषजति /
text_mt: If an ember spills outside the enclosing sticks before the fore-offerings, he should address it: with "Do not harm the adhvaryu priest; do not harm the sacrifice" on the east; with "Do not harm the brahman priest; do not harm the offspring" on the south; with "Do not harm the hotṛ priest; do not harm the wife" on the west; with "Do not harm the āgnīdhra priest; do not harm the cattle" on the north; everywhere he subjoins: "Do not harm the sacrificer."

sanskrit_iast:
sruvabudhnenāktvā
āham̐ yajñaṃ dadhe nirṛter upasthāt \ taṃ deveṣu paridadāmi vidvān /
suprajāstvam̐ śatam̐ hi māmadantas \\ iha no devā mayi śarma yachata //
ity ādatte /
meaning:
स्रुवबुध्नेनाक्त्वा
आहम्̐ यज्ञं दधे निरृतेर् उपस्थात् \ तं देवेषु परिददामि विद्वान् /
सुप्रजास्त्वम्̐ शतम्̐ हि मामदन्तस् \\ इह नो देवा मयि शर्म यछत //
इत्य् आदत्ते /
text_mt:
"I have taken the sacrifice from the lap of Nirṛti; / knowing, I entrust it to the gods.

A hundred [years] of good offspring have delighted me; / here, O gods, bestow peace upon me!"—

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraśṛṅgo vṛṣabho jātavedās \\ ghṛtāhutaḥ stomapṛṣṭhaḥ suvīraḥ /
mā mā hāsīr nāthito na tvā jahāmi \ gopoṣaṃ ca no vīrapoṣaṃ ca dhehi //
mā no mahāntam uta mā no arbhakam \\ mā na ukṣantam uta mā na ukṣitam /
mā no vadhīḥ pitaraṃ mota mātaram \\ mā naḥ priyās tanvo rudra rīriṣaḥ //
ity anupraharati //
meaning:
सहस्रशृङ्गो वृषभो जातवेदास् \\ घृताहुतः स्तोमपृष्ठः सुवीरः /
मा मा हासीर् नाथितो न त्वा जहामि \ गोपोषं च नो वीरपोषं च धेहि //
मा नो महान्तम् उत मा नो अर्भकम् \\ मा न उक्षन्तम् उत मा न उक्षितम् /
मा नो वधीः पितरं मोत मातरम् \\ मा नः प्रियास् तन्वो रुद्र रीरिषः //
इत्य् अनुप्रहरति //
text_mt:
