text_mt: Having kindled the broom-trimmings, with their points pointing in various directions, with the formulas beginning with “For the flame thee…”, he ignites the mahāvīra pot with them with “Thou art the flame.”

sanskrit_iast: sūryasya tapas tapas \\ iti tān khare sādayati //
meaning: सूर्यस्य तपस् तपस् \\ इति तान् खरे सादयति //
text_mt: With [the mantra,] “May the heat of the sun heat…,” he places them on the mound.

sanskrit_iast: añjanti \\ ity aktvā sam̐sīdasva \\ iti teṣu mahāvīraṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati //
meaning: अञ्जन्ति \\ इत्य् अक्त्वा सम्̐सीदस्व \\ इति तेषु महावीरं प्रतिष्ठापयति //
text_mt: Having anointed [it] with [the verse,] “They anoint…,” he establishes the mahāvīra pot upon them with [the formula,] “Sit down firmly!”

sanskrit_iast: anādhṛṣṭā \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ prādeśenādhyadhi pratidiśaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ mahāvīraṃ sarvato vyuddiśati // manor iti dakṣiṇataḥprācīnaṃ bhūmyām //
meaning: अनाधृष्टा \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः प्रादेशेनाध्यधि प्रतिदिशं प्रदक्षिणं महावीरं सर्वतो व्युद्दिशति // मनोर् इति दक्षिणतःप्राचीनं भूम्याम् //
text_mt: With [the formulas] beginning with "Unassailable...", he points all around the Mahāvīra pot, direction by direction, clockwise, at the distance of a span above it. With "Of Manu..." [he points] southwards, towards the east, on the ground.

sanskrit_iast: cid asi \\ iti gārhapatyād aṅgārān abhyūhati //
meaning: चिद् असि \\ इति गार्हपत्याद् अङ्गारान् अभ्यूहति //
text_mt: With "You are intelligence...", he heaps burning coals from the gārhapatya [around it].

sanskrit_iast: svāhā marudbhyas \\ iti sarvataḥ pariśrayati / [ tūṣṇīm̐ rukmam apidadhāti ] //
meaning: स्वाहा मरुद्भ्यस् \\ इति सर्वतः परिश्रयति / [ तूष्णीम्̐ रुक्मम् अपिदधाति ] //
text_mt: With "Svāhā to the Maruts...", he encloses it all around. Silently, he covers it with the gold plate.

sanskrit_iast: māsi \\ itiprabhṛtibhir dvādaśabhir vaikaṅkatībhir dvābhyāṃdvābhyām̐ śalaparicāyyaṃ paricitya trayodaśyām̐ rukmaṃ pratimucya mahāvīram̐ sarpiṣaḥ pūrayitvā \\ antarikṣasyāntardhir asi \\ iti tayā mahāvīram apidadhāti //
meaning: मासि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् द्वादशभिर् वैकङ्कतीभिर् द्वाभ्यांद्वाभ्याम्̐ शलपरिचाय्यं परिचित्य त्रयोदश्याम्̐ रुक्मं प्रतिमुच्य महावीरम्̐ सर्पिषः पूरयित्वा \\ अन्तरिक्षस्यान्तर्धिर् असि \\ इति तया महावीरम् अपिदधाति //
text_mt: With the twelve [formulas] beginning with "In the month...", having arranged firewood of Vikankata in groups of two, and having fastened the gold plate on the thirteenth [stick], having filled the Mahāvīra pot with clarified butter, he covers the Mahāvīra pot with that [stick] reciting: "You are the covering of the intermediate space...".

sanskrit_iast: arhan bibharṣi \\ ity upatiṣṭhanta ṛtvijo yajamānaś ca //
meaning: अर्हन् बिभर्षि \\ इत्य् उपतिष्ठन्त ऋत्विजो यजमानश् च //
text_mt: The officiating priests and the sacrificer venerate it with: "Worthy, you bear...".

sanskrit_iast: gāyatram asi \\ ity etair dhavitrāṇy ādatte /
meaning: गायत्रम् असि \\ इत्य् एतैर् धवित्राण्य् आदत्ते /
text_mt: With these [formulas], "You are of Gāyatrī metre...", he takes up the fans.

sanskrit_iast: tair mahāvīram upavījayati madhu \\ iti trir avācīnaṃ jinva \\ iti trir ūrdhvam api vā jinva \\ iti trir avācīnaṃ madhu \\ iti trir ūrdhvam /
meaning: तैर् महावीरम् उपवीजयति मधु \\ इति त्रिर् अवाचीनं जिन्व \\ इति त्रिर् ऊर्ध्वम् अपि वा जिन्व \\ इति त्रिर् अवाचीनं मधु \\ इति त्रिर् ऊर्ध्वम् /
text_mt: With them he fans the Mahāvīra pot: three times downwards with "Sweet...", three times upwards with "Quicken...", or three times downwards with "Quicken...", three times upwards with "Sweet...".

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ traiṣṭubhajāgate pratiprasthātre prayachati pratiprasthātā jāgatam āgnīdhrāya //
meaning: तेषां त्रैष्टुभजागते प्रतिप्रस्थात्रे प्रयछति प्रतिप्रस्थाता जागतम् आग्नीध्राय //
text_mt: Among them, he hands the Triṣṭubh-metered and Jagatī-metered ones to the pratiprasthātṛ; the pratiprasthātṛ hands the Jagatī-metered one to the āgnīdhra.

sanskrit_iast: pari tvā girvaṇo giras \\ iti śrutvā prāṇo 'si \\ ity adhvaryuprathamā dhūnvantaḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ mahāvīraṃ tirḥ pariyanti / vaikalpikaś caturthas \\ āyuṣ ṭe \\ iti yajamānaḥ //
meaning: परि त्वा गिर्वणो गिरस् \\ इति श्रुत्वा प्राणो ऽसि \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युप्रथमा धून्वन्तः प्रदक्षिणं महावीरं तिर्ः परियन्ति / वैकल्पिकश् चतुर्थस् \\ आयुष् टे \\ इति यजमानः //
text_mt: Having heard, "Praises enclose you, O fond of praise...", fanning, beginning with the adhvaryu, they circumambulate the Mahāvīra pot three times clockwise, reciting: "You are the vital breath...". As a fourth, optionally, the sacrificer [circumambulates] with: "May your life...".

sanskrit_iast: śukraṃ te \\ iti śrutvā samidham agnau prahṛtya rukmaṃ pātryāṃ nidadhāti /
meaning: शुक्रं ते \\ इति श्रुत्वा समिधम् अग्नौ प्रहृत्य रुक्मं पात्र्यां निदधाति /
text_mt: Having heard, "Your bright [radiance]...", having thrown a fuel stick into the fire, he places the gold plate in the dish.

sanskrit_iast: ata ūrdhvam adhvaryuḥ praṇavepraṇava ājyena gharmam̐ rocayate //
meaning: अत ऊर्ध्वम् अध्वर्युः प्रणवेप्रणव आज्येन घर्मम्̐ रोचयते //
text_mt: From then on, the adhvaryu causes the Gharma pot to glow with clarified butter at each praṇava [call].

sanskrit_iast: samyak samyañcas \\ iti śrutvā sarve dhūnvanta ā pavitravatyāḥ /
meaning: सम्यक् सम्यञ्चस् \\ इति श्रुत्वा सर्वे धून्वन्त आ पवित्रवत्याः /
text_mt: Having heard, "Coming together, united...", all fan until the verse containing the word "strainer" [is recited].

sanskrit_iast: etasmin kāle pratiprasthātā piṣṭānām̐ rauhiṇau nirvapati / tūṣṇīṃ puroḍāśau kṛtvā sam̐skṛtya grāvāṇā \\ iti śrutvānuduptayor āsādayati //
meaning: एतस्मिन् काले प्रतिप्रस्थाता पिष्टानाम्̐ रौहिणौ निर्वपति / तूष्णीं पुरोडाशौ कृत्वा सम्̐स्कृत्य ग्रावाणा \\ इति श्रुत्वानुदुप्तयोर् आसादयति //
text_mt: At this time the pratiprasthātṛ apportions [the materials] of flour for the two Rauhiṇa cakes. Having prepared the two sacrificial cakes silently and consecrated them, having heard, "The two press-stones...", he places them upon the two [potsherds] placed beneath.

sanskrit_iast: īḷe dyāvāpṛthivī iti śrutvottareṇa mahāvīraṃ gatvā haviṣpathena dakṣiṇaṃ paridhisaṃdhiṃ pratyavasthāpayaty uttaram anyam //
meaning: ईऌए द्यावापृथिवी इति श्रुत्वोत्तरेण महावीरं गत्वा हविष्पथेन दक्षिणं परिधिसंधिं प्रत्यवस्थापयत्य् उत्तरम् अन्यम् //
text_mt: Having heard, "I praise Heaven and Earth...", having gone along the north of the Mahāvīra pot along the path of the oblation, he establishes the one at the southern junction of the enclosing sticks, and the other at the northern [junction].

sanskrit_iast: yābhiḥ kṛśānum iti śrutvāgnīdhraprathamā dhūnvantaḥ prasavyaṃ mahāvīraṃ triḥ pariyanti //
meaning: याभिः कृशानुम् इति श्रुत्वाग्नीध्रप्रथमा धून्वन्तः प्रसव्यं महावीरं त्रिः परियन्ति //
text_mt: Having heard, "With those [aids] with which to Kṛśānu...", fanning, beginning with the āgnīdhra, they circumambulate the Mahāvīra pot three times counter-clockwise.

sanskrit_iast: apnasvatīm iti śrutvā rucito gharma iti preṣyati //
meaning: अप्नस्वतीम् इति श्रुत्वा रुचितो घर्म इति प्रेष्यति //
text_mt: Having heard, "[Heaven and Earth] possessing wealth...", he prompts: "The Gharma pot has glowed!"

sanskrit_iast: daśa prācīr iti sarvata upatiṣṭhanta ṛtvijo yajamānaś ca //
meaning: दश प्राचीर् इति सर्वत उपतिष्ठन्त ऋत्विजो यजमानश् च //
text_mt: The officiating priests and the sacrificer venerate it all around with: "Ten [fingers] pointing forward...".

sanskrit_iast: tvaṣṭrimantas tvā \\ iti patnyā sahāvekṣate /
meaning: त्वष्ट्रिमन्तस् त्वा \\ इति पत्न्या सहावेक्षते /
text_mt: Along with his wife, he looks at it with: "Possessing Tvaṣṭṛ, you...".

sanskrit_iast: sāvitreṇa nidāne ādatte tūṣṇīṃ dogdhrīṃ methīm /
meaning: सावित्रेण निदाने आदत्ते तूष्णीं दोग्ध्रीं मेथीम् /
text_mt: With [the formula] dedicated to Savitṛ, he takes the two hobbling cords, silently the milking vessel, and the peg.

sanskrit_iast: abhidhānīm ādāya \\ iḍā ehi \\ iti trir ahanyahany upām̐śv āhvayati /
meaning: अभिधानीम् आदाय \\ इडा एहि \\ इति त्रिर् अहन्यहन्य् उपाम्̐श्व् आह्वयति /
text_mt: Having taken up the halter cord, he summons [the cow] in a whisper three times each day with: "Come, O Iḍā!"

sanskrit_iast: pūrvayā dvārā niḥsṛtya \\ asau \\ iti trir uccair yas te stanas \\ ity āhvayati /
meaning: पूर्वया द्वारा निःसृत्य \\ असौ \\ इति त्रिर् उच्चैर् यस् ते स्तनस् \\ इत्य् आह्वयति /
text_mt: Having gone out through the eastern door, he calls out aloud three times: "O N.N.!", and summons her with: "That udder of yours...".

sanskrit_iast: uttarataḥ pṛṣṭhyādeśasya methīṃ nihatya tasyāṃ nibadhnāti //
meaning: उत्तरतः पृष्ठ्यादेशस्य मेथीं निहत्य तस्यां निबध्नाति //
text_mt: Having driven the peg into the ground to the north of the region of the spinal line, he ties her to it.

sanskrit_iast: adityā uṣṇīṣam asi \\ ity abhinidadhānaḥ //
meaning: अदित्या उष्णीषम् असि \\ इत्य् अभिनिदधानः //
text_mt: With "You are Aditi's turban..." [he binds her], fastening it down.

sanskrit_iast: pūṣā tvā \\ ity upasarjane //
meaning: पूषा त्वा \\ इत्य् उपसर्जने //
text_mt: With "May Pūṣan [lead] you..." [he acts] when letting [the calf] loose to her.

sanskrit_iast: vāyur asi \\ ity āvrajataḥ //
meaning: वायुर् असि \\ इत्य् आव्रजतः //
text_mt: With "You are Vāyu..." the two [priests] come forward.

sanskrit_iast: gharmāya tvā \\ ity uccham̐ṣaṇe //
meaning: घर्माय त्वा \\ इत्य् उच्छम्̐षणे //
text_mt: With "For the Gharma [I milk] you..." [he acts] when drawing out [the calf].

sanskrit_iast: adityā rāsnāsi \\ iti nidīyamāne //
meaning: अदित्या रास्नासि \\ इति निदीयमाने //
text_mt: With "You are Aditi's girdle..." [he acts] while she is being hobbled.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspatiṣ ṭvopasīdatu \\ ity upasīdati //
meaning: बृहस्पतिष् ट्वोपसीदतु \\ इत्य् उपसीदति //
text_mt: With "May Bṛhaspati sit beside you...", he sits beside her.

sanskrit_iast: dānavaḥ stha \ peravaḥ stha \\ iti stanān saṃmṛśati //
meaning: दानवः स्थ \ पेरवः स्थ \\ इति स्तनान् संमृशति //
text_mt: With "You are gifts... You are flowing...", he strokes the teats.

sanskrit_iast: aśvibhyām iti dohane /
meaning: अश्विभ्याम् इति दोहने /

sanskrit_iast: etasmin kāle pratiprasthātā tūṣṇīṃ dogdhrīm ajāṃ pinvati //
meaning: एतस्मिन् काले प्रतिप्रस्थाता तूष्णीं दोग्ध्रीम् अजां पिन्वति //
text_mt: At this time the pratiprasthātṛ silently causes the milch goat to yield milk.

sanskrit_iast: uttiṣṭha \\ iti śrutvā \\ upamehi \\ ity āvrajataḥ //
meaning: उत्तिष्ठ \\ इति श्रुत्वा \\ उपमेहि \\ इत्य् आव्रजतः //
text_mt: Having heard, "Rise up...", the two come forward with: "Come near to me...".

sanskrit_iast: ā gharme siñcasva \\ iti śrutvā madhu havir asi \\ iti dogdhryā mahāvīra ānayati /
meaning: आ घर्मे सिञ्चस्व \\ इति श्रुत्वा मधु हविर् असि \\ इति दोग्ध्र्या महावीर आनयति /
text_mt: Having heard, "Pour into the Gharma...", with "Sweet oblation are you...", he pours [the milk] from the milking vessel into the Mahāvīra pot.

sanskrit_iast: etena dharmeṇa vyatyāsaṃ trir adhvaryus triḥ pratiprasthātā /
meaning: एतेन धर्मेण व्यत्यासं त्रिर् अध्वर्युस् त्रिः प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
text_mt: By this procedure, alternating, three times the adhvaryu [pours], and three times the pratiprasthātṛ.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīṃ pratiprasthātādhvaryupātre sarvam ānīya śeṣam ādhāya gāyatro 'si \\ iti parigrāhāv ādatte // jāgato 'si \\ ity upayāmam //
meaning: तूष्णीं प्रतिप्रस्थाताध्वर्युपात्रे सर्वम् आनीय शेषम् आधाय गायत्रो ऽसि \\ इति परिग्राहाव् आदत्ते // जागतो ऽसि \\ इत्य् उपयामम् //
text_mt: Silently, the pratiprasthātṛ, having poured everything into the vessel of the adhvaryu, and having deposited the remainder, takes the two holders with "You are of Gāyatrī metre...", and the support-vessel with "You are of Jagatī metre...".

sanskrit_iast: dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ tvā parigṛhṇāmi \\ iti parigṛhya \\ antarikṣeṇopayachāmi \\ ity upayāme niyachati //
meaning: द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां त्वा परिगृह्णामि \\ इति परिगृह्य \\ अन्तरिक्षेणोपयछामि \\ इत्य् उपयामे नियछति //
text_mt: Having gripped it with "With Heaven and Earth I take hold of you...", he holds it over the support-vessel with "With the intermediate space I hold you underneath...".

sanskrit_iast: devānām iti dhārayamāṇo japati //
meaning: देवानाम् इति धारयमाणो जपति //
text_mt: Holding it, he mutters: "Of the gods...".

sanskrit_iast: divispṛg iti yathālokaṃ niyachati //
meaning: दिविस्पृग् इति यथालोकं नियछति //
text_mt: With "Touching the sky...", he steadies it in its proper place.

sanskrit_iast: tejo 'si \\ iti saptadaśa preṅkhaṇe //
meaning: तेजो ऽसि \\ इति सप्तदश प्रेङ्खणे //
text_mt: With the seventeen [formulas beginning with] "You are brilliance...", [he acts] during the swinging.

sanskrit_iast: divi dhās \\ ity upotthāya devam̐ savitāram ity abhipravrajya nāke suparṇam iti śrutvā viśvā āśās \\ iti dakṣiṇātikrāmati //
meaning: दिवि धास् \\ इत्य् उपोत्थाय देवम्̐ सवितारम् इत्य् अभिप्रव्रज्य नाके सुपर्णम् इति श्रुत्वा विश्वा आशास् \\ इति दक्षिणातिक्रामति //
text_mt: Having stood up with "Place in heaven...", having stepped forward with "The god Savitṛ...", having heard, "The fair-winged eagle in the vault...", he strides across towards the south with "All quarters of the sky...".

sanskrit_iast: viśvān devān ayāḍ iha \\ iti yajamānam̐ vācayati /
meaning: विश्वान् देवान् अयाड् इह \\ इति यजमानम्̐ वाचयति /
text_mt: He causes the sacrificer to recite: "He has sacrificed here to all the gods...".

sanskrit_iast: sthānaṃ gatvāśrāvayati /
meaning: स्थानं गत्वाश्रावयति /
text_mt: Having gone to his station, he causes the call to be made.

sanskrit_iast: pratyāśrute gharmasya yaja \\ iti preṣyati //
meaning: प्रत्याश्रुते घर्मस्य यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति //
text_mt: When the response has been made, he prompts: "Recite the offering verse for the Gharma!"

sanskrit_iast: aśvinā gharmam iti nigadya vaṣaṭkṛte na sarvaṃ juhoti // svāhendrāya vaṣaḍ ity anuvaṣaṭkṛte /
meaning: अश्विना घर्मम् इति निगद्य वषट्कृते न सर्वं जुहोति // स्वाहेन्द्राय वषड् इत्य् अनुवषट्कृते /
text_mt: Having recited, "O Aśvins, the Gharma...", when the vaṣaṭ call is made, he offers, [but] not the whole. When the secondary vaṣaṭ call is made, [he offers] with: "Svāhā to Indra, vaṣaṭ!"

sanskrit_iast: etasmin kāle pratiprasthātā \\ ahaḥ ketunā \\ iti rauhiṇau juhoti purastād anyam̐ vaṣaṭkārasya purastād anyam anuvaṣaṭkārasya //
meaning: एतस्मिन् काले प्रतिप्रस्थाता \\ अहः केतुना \\ इति रौहिणौ जुहोति पुरस्ताद् अन्यम्̐ वषट्कारस्य पुरस्ताद् अन्यम् अनुवषट्कारस्य //
text_mt: At this time, the pratiprasthātṛ offers the two Rauhiṇa cakes with "Day with its banner...": one before the vaṣaṭ call, the other before the secondary vaṣaṭ call.

sanskrit_iast: svāhākṛtasya gharmasya \\ iti yajamānam̐ vācayati //
meaning: स्वाहाकृतस्य घर्मस्य \\ इति यजमानम्̐ वाचयति //
text_mt: He causes the sacrificer to recite: "Of the Gharma made consecrated with svāhā...".

sanskrit_iast: iṣe \\ iti pratiprasthātā dogdhryā mahāvīra ānayati //
meaning: इषे \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता दोग्ध्र्या महावीर आनयति //
text_mt: With "For refreshment...", the pratiprasthātṛ brings [goat's milk] from the milking vessel into the Mahāvīra pot.

sanskrit_iast: tviṣe tvā \ dyumnāya tvā \\ indriyāya tvā \ bhūtyai tvā svāhā \\ iti pratidiśam̐ sarvato vyuttārayati //
meaning: त्विषे त्वा \ द्युम्नाय त्वा \\ इन्द्रियाय त्वा \ भूत्यै त्वा स्वाहा \\ इति प्रतिदिशम्̐ सर्वतो व्युत्तारयति //
text_mt: With "For luster to you...", "For splendour to you...", "For sensory power to you...", "For prosperity to you, svāhā!", he takes it out towards all directions on every side.

sanskrit_iast: gharmo 'si \\ ity upayāme śeṣam ānīya \\ amuṣmai tvā \\ iti mahāvīraṃ khare sādayati / yaṃ dviṣyāt tasya nāma gṛhṇīyāt tūṣṇīm anabhicaran /
meaning: घर्मो ऽसि \\ इत्य् उपयामे शेषम् आनीय \\ अमुष्मै त्वा \\ इति महावीरं खरे सादयति / यं द्विष्यात् तस्य नाम गृह्णीयात् तूष्णीम् अनभिचरन् /
text_mt: With "You are the Gharma...", having poured the remainder into the support-vessel, he sets down the Mahāvīra pot on the mound with: "For N.N. [I place] you!". He should utter the name of him whom he hates, [or do so] silently if not performing malevolent sorcery.

sanskrit_iast: upayāme 'ñjan samidha ādadhāti pūṣṇe \\ iti pañcabhiḥ /
meaning: उपयामे ऽञ्जन् समिध आदधाति पूष्णे \\ इति पञ्चभिः /
text_mt: Anointing [fuel sticks] in the support-vessel, he lays on the fuel sticks with the five [formulas beginning with] "To Pūṣan...".

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṣṭhīm upayāme 'nuduptayoḥ parigrāhayor mahāvīre 'ktām \\ rudrāya rudrahotre svāhā \\ ity uttarapūrvasyāṃ diśi pravidhyāya upaspṛśyānaktām ādāya \\ apīparo māhnas \\ iti samidham ādadhāti //
meaning: षष्ठीम् उपयामे ऽनुदुप्तयोः परिग्राहयोर् महावीरे ऽक्ताम् \\ रुद्राय रुद्रहोत्रे स्वाहा \\ इत्य् उत्तरपूर्वस्यां दिशि प्रविध्याय उपस्पृश्यानक्ताम् आदाय \\ अपीपरो माह्नस् \\ इति समिधम् आदधाति //
text_mt: Having anointed the sixth on the support-vessel, on the two [potsherds] placed beneath, on the two holders, and on the Mahāvīra pot, and having thrown it towards the north-eastern direction with "To Rudra, the Rudra-hotṛ, svāhā!", having touched water, and having taken an unanointed fuel stick, he puts it on the fire with: "You have brought me across the day...".

sanskrit_iast: hutam̐ havir iti prātaragnihotradharmeṇa juhoti //
meaning: हुतम्̐ हविर् इति प्रातरग्निहोत्रधर्मेण जुहोति //
text_mt: With "The oblation is offered...", he offers according to the procedure of the morning agnihotra.

sanskrit_iast: aśyāma te deva gharma \\ iti samupahūya bhakṣayanty ṛtvijo yajamānaś ca / prāṇabhakṣeṇādīkṣitā bhakṣayanti /
meaning: अश्याम ते देव घर्म \\ इति समुपहूय भक्षयन्त्य् ऋत्विजो यजमानश् च / प्राणभक्षेणादीक्षिता भक्षयन्ति /
text_mt: Having mutually invited one another with "May we partake of your, O divine Gharma...", the officiating priests and the sacrificer consume [the remainder]. Those who are not consecrated consume by breath-consumption.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmam adhinirṇejanīye prakṣālya ninayanaprabhṛti siddham ā bhakṣaṇāt //
meaning: उपयामम् अधिनिर्णेजनीये प्रक्षाल्य निनयनप्रभृति सिद्धम् आ भक्षणात् //
text_mt: Having cleansed the support-vessel over the wash-pot, the rites from the pouring-down [of wash-water] onwards up to the consumption are established by standard rule.

sanskrit_iast: āyurdās \\ iti rukmavatībhir antarvedi mārjayante /
meaning: आयुर्दास् \\ इति रुक्मवतीभिर् अन्तर्वेदि मार्जयन्ते /
text_mt: With the verses containing the word "gold plate", [beginning with] "Giver of life...", they cleanse themselves inside the altar ground.

sanskrit_iast: parigrāhābhyāṃ mahāvīram ādāya sam̐sādyamānāyānubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
meaning: परिग्राहाभ्यां महावीरम् आदाय सम्̐साद्यमानायानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: Taking the Mahāvīra pot with the two holders, he prompts [the hotṛ] to recite: "Recite for [the Gharma] being set down!"

sanskrit_iast: aparamaparaṃ pūrvaṃpūrvam̐ vottaramuttaram̐ vā tasyāṃ ca parigharmyāṇi // svāhā tvā sūryasya raśmibhyas \\ iti darbhaiḥ prachādya kṛṣṇājinena ca dīkṣitasaṃcareṇātihṛtya dakṣiṇata āhavanīyāsyāsandīm upakṛṣya namo vāce \\ ity oṣadhipāṇayo 'dhinirṇejanīye mārjayante //
meaning: अपरमपरं पूर्वंपूर्वम्̐ वोत्तरमुत्तरम्̐ वा तस्यां च परिघर्म्याणि // स्वाहा त्वा सूर्यस्य रश्मिभ्यस् \\ इति दर्भैः प्रछाद्य कृष्णाजिनेन च दीक्षितसंचरेणातिहृत्य दक्षिणत आहवनीयास्यासन्दीम् उपकृष्य नमो वाचे \\ इत्य् ओषधिपाणयो ऽधिनिर्णेजनीये मार्जयन्ते //
text_mt: each further west or each further east, or each further north, and upon it the utensils connected with the gharma. Having covered [it] with darbha grass and with the black antelope skin with [the mantra], "Hail to you, to the rays of the sun!", having carried it past along the path of the consecrated [sacrificer], having drawn near the chair to the south of the āhavanīya, holding plants in their hands, they cleanse themselves over the wash-water vessel with [the mantra], "Homage to speech!"

sanskrit_iast: iḍāyās padam asi \\ iti prādeśaiḥ pratyaksavyair loṣṭāny upāsyanti /
meaning: इडायास् पदम् असि \\ इति प्रादेशैः प्रत्यक्सव्यैर् लोष्टान्य् उपास्यन्ति /
text_mt: With [the mantra], "You are the step of Iḍā," they throw away the clods with thumb and forefinger extended, towards the west and north.

sanskrit_iast: apa upaspṛśya pṛthivī śāntir ity abhyukṣya \\ ud vayaṃ tamasas pari \\ ity ādityam avekṣate //
meaning: अप उपस्पृश्य पृथिवी शान्तिर् इत्य् अभ्युक्ष्य \\ उद् वयं तमसस् परि \\ इत्य् आदित्यम् अवेक्षते //
text_mt: Having touched water, having sprinkled [the ground] with [the formula], "Earth is peace," he gazes at the sun with [the verse], "Up out of darkness [we have risen]…"

sanskrit_iast: mitrasya \\ iti prekṣamāṇasamīkṣaṇe //
meaning: मित्रस्य \\ इति प्रेक्षमाणसमीक्षणे //
text_mt: With [the formula], "Of Mitra…," [they follow] the mutual gazing of him who looks.

sanskrit_iast: brahmaṇa upastaraṇam asi \\ iti mārjanāny avasṛjya vāmadevyaṃ japitvā pañcaindrīṃ japitvā svasti na indro vṛddhaśravā [ japitvā ] āpo hi ṣṭha \\ iti śāntikarmaṇa āntād anuvākasya /
meaning: ब्रह्मण उपस्तरणम् असि \\ इति मार्जनान्य् अवसृज्य वामदेव्यं जपित्वा पञ्चैन्द्रीं जपित्वा स्वस्ति न इन्द्रो वृद्धश्रवा [ जपित्वा ] आपो हि ष्ठ \\ इति शान्तिकर्मण आन्ताद् अनुवाकस्य /
text_mt: Having cast down the cleansing [materials] with [the mantra], "You are the spread of the Brahman," having muttered the Vāmadevya [sāman], having muttered the five verses to Indra, [having muttered], "May Indra of rich renown [grant] us welfare," [he mutters] up to the end of the section for the appeasement rite [beginning with], "O waters, you are truly [refreshing]."

sanskrit_iast: etena dharmeṇāparāhṇiko vyākhyāto 'nyayoḥ kapālayo rauhiṇayoḥ //
meaning: एतेन धर्मेणापराह्णिको व्याख्यातो ऽन्ययोः कपालयो रौहिणयोः //
text_mt: By this rule the afternoon [performance] has been explained, on the other two rauhiṇa potsherds.

sanskrit_iast: rātrir iti rauhiṇastomaḥ //
meaning: रात्रिर् इति रौहिणस्तोमः //
text_mt: "Night" is the rauhiṇa chant.

sanskrit_iast: apīparo mā rātryās \\ iti samidham ādadhāti //
meaning: अपीपरो मा रात्र्यास् \\ इति समिधम् आदधाति //
text_mt: He puts on a piece of sacrificial fuel with [the formula], "You have brought me safely through the night."

sanskrit_iast: hutam̐ havir iti sāyamagnihotradharmeṇa juhoti //
meaning: हुतम्̐ हविर् इति सायमग्निहोत्रधर्मेण जुहोति //
text_mt: With [the formula], "The oblation is offered," he offers according to the rule of the evening agnihotra.

sanskrit_iast: svāhā tvā nakṣatrebhyas \\ iti prachādya śaṃ no vātas \\ ity abhyastamite homaḥ /
meaning: स्वाहा त्वा नक्षत्रेभ्यस् \\ इति प्रछाद्य शं नो वातस् \\ इत्य् अभ्यस्तमिते होमः /
text_mt: Having covered [the pot] with [the mantra], "Hail to you, to the constellations!", when the sun has set, the offering is made with [the formula], "May the wind [be auspicious] to us."

sanskrit_iast: etena dharmeṇa trirupasatko vyākhyāto 'hanyahany ekaiko mahāvīro bhavati /
meaning: एतेन धर्मेण त्रिरुपसत्को व्याख्यातो ऽहन्यहन्य् एकैको महावीरो भवति /
text_mt: By this rule the three-day upasads ritual is explained: on each successive day there is one mahāvīra [pot].

sanskrit_iast: etena dharmeṇa ṣaḍupasatko vyākhyāto dvyahaṃdvyaham ekaiko mahāvīro bhavati /
meaning: एतेन धर्मेण षडुपसत्को व्याख्यातो द्व्यहंद्व्यहम् एकैको महावीरो भवति /
text_mt: By this rule the six-day upasads ritual is explained: on every two days there is one mahāvīra [pot].

sanskrit_iast: etena dharmeṇa dvādaśopasatko vyākhyātaś caturahaṃcaturaham ekaiko mahāvīro bhavati mahāvīro bhavati /
meaning: एतेन धर्मेण द्वादशोपसत्को व्याख्यातश् चतुरहंचतुरहम् एकैको महावीरो भवति महावीरो भवति /
text_mt: By this rule the twelve-day upasads ritual is explained: on every four days there is one mahāvīra [pot], there is one mahāvīra [pot].

sanskrit_iast: athāta utsādanam /
meaning: अथात उत्सादनम् /

sanskrit_iast: upayāmaṃ dadhigharmāya nidadhāti /
meaning: उपयामं दधिघर्माय निदधाति /
text_mt: He sets down the upayāma vessel for the dadhigharma.

sanskrit_iast: kharāv antarīkṛtya sam̐vapaty ayutaṃ bahir adhinirṇejanīyam /
meaning: खराव् अन्तरीकृत्य सम्̐वपत्य् अयुतं बहिर् अधिनिर्णेजनीयम् /
text_mt: Separating the two mounds, he heaps [them] together, unmixed, outside, on the wash-water vessel.

sanskrit_iast: saṃpraiṣaḥ sakṛd uttareṇa vedīm āharaty ṛtvijāṃ gatyā /
meaning: संप्रैषः सकृद् उत्तरेण वेदीम् आहरत्य् ऋत्विजां गत्या /
text_mt: There is a summons; he brings [the utensils] once to the north of the altar according to the movement of the officiating priests.

sanskrit_iast: agreṇāhavanīyam āsandīm avasthāpya tasyāṃ mahāvīrān nidadhāty aparamaparaṃ pūrvaṃpūrvam̐ vottaramuttaram̐ vā tasyāṃ ca parigharmyāṇi /
meaning: अग्रेणाहवनीयम् आसन्दीम् अवस्थाप्य तस्यां महावीरान् निदधात्य् अपरमपरं पूर्वंपूर्वम्̐ वोत्तरमुत्तरम्̐ वा तस्यां च परिघर्म्याणि /
text_mt: Having placed the chair to the east of the āhavanīya, he sets down the mahāvīra [pots] upon it, each further west or each further east, or each further north, and upon it the utensils connected with the gharma.

sanskrit_iast: paścād āhavanīyasya gāyatrīṃ chandas \\ iti prayadyanta ṛtvijo yajamānaś ca //
meaning: पश्चाद् आहवनीयस्य गायत्रीं छन्दस् \\ इति प्रयद्यन्त ऋत्विजो यजमानश् च //
text_mt: Behind the āhavanīya, the officiating priests and the sacrificer enter with [the formula], "Gāyatrī is the metre…"

sanskrit_iast: paśūnāṃ jyotir asi \\ iti mahāvīre sarpir ānayaty uttarābhyāṃ madhudadhītarayoḥ /
meaning: पशूनां ज्योतिर् असि \\ इति महावीरे सर्पिर् आनयत्य् उत्तराभ्यां मधुदधीतरयोः /
text_mt: With [the formula], "You are the light of cattle," he pours clarified butter into the mahāvīra [pot], with the two following [formulas] honey and curds into the other two.

sanskrit_iast: ājyam̐ sam̐skṛtya darbhakūrcān ādīpyāsyadaghne dhārayamāṇas \\ gharma yā te divi śuk \\ iti juhoty uttarābhyāṃ nābhidaghnajānudaghnayoḥ //
meaning: आज्यम्̐ सम्̐स्कृत्य दर्भकूर्चान् आदीप्यास्यदघ्ने धारयमाणस् \\ घर्म या ते दिवि शुक् \\ इति जुहोत्य् उत्तराभ्यां नाभिदघ्नजानुदघ्नयोः //
text_mt: Having prepared clarified butter, having kindled darbha bundles, holding them at the height of the mouth, he offers with [the verse], "O gharma, that heat of yours which is in heaven…"; with the two following [formulas] at the height of the navel and the height of the knees.

sanskrit_iast: anv adya nas \\ ity upaviśati //
meaning: अन्व् अद्य नस् \\ इत्य् उपविशति //
text_mt: He sits down with [the verse], "Today along our [path]…"

sanskrit_iast: pūṣṇe \\ iti pañcāhutīr juhoty uttarābhyāṃ pratidiśaṃ pratyeti /
meaning: पूष्णे \\ इति पञ्चाहुतीर् जुहोत्य् उत्तराभ्यां प्रतिदिशं प्रत्येति /
text_mt: With [the formulas beginning with], "To Pūṣan…," he offers five oblations; with the two following [formulas] he goes around to each direction.

sanskrit_iast: upotthāya \\ udgātaḥ sāma gāya \\ iti preṣyati prastotar iti vā / tasya sarve nidhanam upayanti /
meaning: उपोत्थाय \\ उद्गातः साम गाय \\ इति प्रेष्यति प्रस्तोतर् इति वा / तस्य सर्वे निधनम् उपयन्ति /
text_mt: Having risen up, he gives the order: "O udgātṛ, sing the sāman!" or: "O prastotṛ!" All join in its finale.

sanskrit_iast: anv adya no anumatir \ anv id anumate \\ iti sarve japanti //
meaning: अन्व् अद्य नो अनुमतिर् \ अन्व् इद् अनुमते \\ इति सर्वे जपन्ति //
text_mt: All mutter: "Today along our [path] may Anumati…", "Favor [us], O Anumati…"

sanskrit_iast: brahmaṇas tvā paraspāyās \\ ity anuniṣkrāmati // prāṇasya tvā \\ iti samayārdhe dvitīyaṃ // divas tvā \\ iti prāpya tṛtīyam //
meaning: ब्रह्मणस् त्वा परस्पायास् \\ इत्य् अनुनिष्क्रामति // प्राणस्य त्वा \\ इति समयार्धे द्वितीयं // दिवस् त्वा \\ इति प्राप्य तृतीयम् //
text_mt: He steps out after [the others] with [the mantra], "From the supreme protection of the Brahman [may I be shielded]!"; a second [time] at the midpoint with [the mantra], "From the [supreme protection] of breath…"; a third [time] having reached [the destination] with [the mantra], "From the [supreme protection] of heaven…"

sanskrit_iast: apa dveṣas \\ iti cātvāle 'dhinirṇejanīyaṃ pratiṣṭhāpyāpa upaspṛśyottarata uttavedeḥ svayamātṛṇṇāyā vā kharau nyupya puruṣākṛtim̐ vidadhāty ādityākṛtim̐ vā /
meaning: अप द्वेषस् \\ इति चात्वाले ऽधिनिर्णेजनीयं प्रतिष्ठाप्याप उपस्पृश्योत्तरत उत्तवेदेः स्वयमातृण्णाया वा खरौ न्युप्य पुरुषाकृतिम्̐ विदधात्य् आदित्याकृतिम्̐ वा /
text_mt: Having set down the wash-water vessel in the cātvāla with [the formula], "Away [with] hostility!", having touched water, having heaped up the two mounds to the north of the high altar or of the svayamātṛṇṇā brick, he makes [them] into the shape of a man or into the shape of the sun.

sanskrit_iast: vyuhyāvokṣyāvakām āstīrya tasyām̐ vyāhṛtibhir hiraṇyaśakaleṣu mahāvīrān sādayaty aparamaparaṃ pūrvaṃpūrvam̐ vottaramuttaram̐ vā tasyāṃ ca parigharmyāṇi /
meaning: व्युह्यावोक्ष्यावकाम् आस्तीर्य तस्याम्̐ व्याहृतिभिर् हिरण्यशकलेषु महावीरान् सादयत्य् अपरमपरं पूर्वंपूर्वम्̐ वोत्तरमुत्तरम्̐ वा तस्यां च परिघर्म्याणि /
text_mt: Having swept it, having sprinkled it, having spread out avakā plants, he sets down the mahāvīra [pots] on gold chips upon it with the sacred utterances, each further west or each further east, or each further north, and upon it the utensils connected with the gharma.

sanskrit_iast: dadhnaḥ pātrāṇi pūrayitvābhito nidadhāti /
meaning: दध्नः पात्राणि पूरयित्वाभितो निदधाति /
text_mt: Having filled the vessels with curds, he places them on both sides.

sanskrit_iast: vedaṃ pramucyābhitaḥ sam̐stṛṇāti /
meaning: वेदं प्रमुच्याभितः सम्̐स्तृणाति /
text_mt: Having untied the broom, he spreads it out on both sides.

sanskrit_iast: darbhaiḥ prachādya kṛṣṇājinena ca catuḥsraktir ity āsandyābhivikramayati //
meaning: दर्भैः प्रछाद्य कृष्णाजिनेन च चतुःस्रक्तिर् इत्य् आसन्द्याभिविक्रमयति //
text_mt: Having covered [them] with darbha grass and with the black antelope skin, he makes [them] step across with the chair with [the mantra], "Four-cornered…"

sanskrit_iast: gharmaitat te kṛtam ity upatiṣṭhanta ṛtvijo yajamānaś ca // vy asau \\ iti ca yaṃ dviṣyāt tasya nāma gṛhṇīyāt tūṣṇīm anabhicaran //
meaning: घर्मैतत् ते कृतम् इत्य् उपतिष्ठन्त ऋत्विजो यजमानश् च // व्य् असौ \\ इति च यं द्विष्यात् तस्य नाम गृह्णीयात् तूष्णीम् अनभिचरन् //
text_mt: The officiating priests and the sacrificer attend [the pots] with [the formula], "O gharma, this has been done for you." And with [the formula], "Separated is so-and-so," he should utter the name of him whom he hates, silently if he is not performing malevolent sorcery.

sanskrit_iast: valgur iti pariṣecanam \\ samudrasya tvāvakayā \ himasya tvā jarāyuṇā \\ iti ca //
meaning: वल्गुर् इति परिषेचनम् \\ समुद्रस्य त्वावकया \ हिमस्य त्वा जरायुणा \\ इति च //
text_mt: With [the formula], "Splendid…," there is the pouring around [of water], and with, "With the ocean's avakā plant…", "With the afterbirth of snow…"

sanskrit_iast: punar ūrjā \ saha rayyā nivartasva \\ ity uktvāvartate /
meaning: पुनर् ऊर्जा \ सह रय्या निवर्तस्व \\ इत्य् उक्त्वावर्तते /
text_mt: Having said, "With vigor again…", "Return with wealth…", he turns around.

sanskrit_iast: etasmin kāle yajamāna uttarata uttaravedeḥ prāṅmukha ūrdhvas tiṣṭhan sumitrā nas \\ ity apo 'ñjalinā gṛhītvā durmitrās \\ iti prācīr bahirvedi nirasyati /
meaning: एतस्मिन् काले यजमान उत्तरत उत्तरवेदेः प्राङ्मुख ऊर्ध्वस् तिष्ठन् सुमित्रा नस् \\ इत्य् अपो ऽञ्जलिना गृहीत्वा दुर्मित्रास् \\ इति प्राचीर् बहिर्वेदि निरस्यति /
text_mt: At this time the sacrificer, standing upright to the north of the high altar facing east, having taken water with folded hands with [the formula], "Friendly to us…", casts it out towards the east outside the altar with [the formula], "Unfriendly [to them]…"

sanskrit_iast: trir eṣa kalpaḥ pariṣicyamāne /
meaning: त्रिर् एष कल्पः परिषिच्यमाने /
text_mt: This is the threefold procedure while [water] is being poured around.

sanskrit_iast: apa upaspṛśya vārṣāharam̐ sāma gāya \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: अप उपस्पृश्य वार्षाहरम्̐ साम गाय \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Having touched water, he gives the order: "Sing the Vārṣāhara sāman!"

sanskrit_iast: pariṣikta iṣṭāhotrīyam /
meaning: परिषिक्त इष्टाहोत्रीयम् /
text_mt: When [water] has been poured around, [the order is given to sing] the Iṣṭāhotrīya [sāman].

sanskrit_iast: pariṣikte rantir nāmāsi \\ iti gandharvanāmabhiḥ sarvata upatiṣṭhanta ṛtvijo yajamānaś ca //
meaning: परिषिक्ते रन्तिर् नामासि \\ इति गन्धर्वनामभिः सर्वत उपतिष्ठन्त ऋत्विजो यजमानश् च //
text_mt: When [water] has been poured around, the officiating priests and the sacrificer stand by from all sides with the names of the Gandharvas: "Ranti is your name…"

sanskrit_iast: etat tvaṃ deva gharma \\ iti yajamānaḥ [ japati ] //
meaning: एतत् त्वं देव घर्म \\ इति यजमानः [ जपति ] //
text_mt: The sacrificer mutters: "This, O divine gharma…"

sanskrit_iast: idam aham āvarte \\ ity uktvāvartate //
meaning: इदम् अहम् आवर्ते \\ इत्य् उक्त्वावर्तते //
text_mt: Having said, "Here I turn around," he turns around.

sanskrit_iast: namo devebhyas \\ iti namaskaroti //
meaning: नमो देवेभ्यस् \\ इति नमस्करोति //
text_mt: He pays homage with [the formula], "Homage to the gods!"

sanskrit_iast: punar ūrjā \ saha rayyā nivartasva \\ iti pratiparyāvartate /
meaning: पुनर् ऊर्जा \ सह रय्या निवर्तस्व \\ इति प्रतिपर्यावर्तते /
text_mt: With [the verses], "With vigor again…", "Return with wealth…", he turns back around in the opposite direction.

sanskrit_iast: ājyasthālīm̐ sruvaṃ cādāya śyaitam̐ sāma gāya \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: आज्यस्थालीम्̐ स्रुवं चादाय श्यैतम्̐ साम गाय \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Taking the vessel for clarified butter and the dipping spoon, he gives the order: "Sing the Śyaita sāman!"

sanskrit_iast: āvrajan gāyate / tasya yajamāno nidhanam upaiti //
meaning: आव्रजन् गायते / तस्य यजमानो निधनम् उपैति //
text_mt: Approaching, he sings; the sacrificer joins in its finale.

sanskrit_iast: idam̐ viṣṇur iti padalobhanaḥ //
meaning: इदम्̐ विष्णुर् इति पदलोभनः //
text_mt: With [the verse], "Through this Viṣṇu [strode]…," [the chant] is padalobhana.

sanskrit_iast: tvam agne gṛhapatir iti dvābhyāṃ gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate //
meaning: त्वम् अग्ने गृहपतिर् इति द्वाभ्यां गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते //
text_mt: With the two [verses beginning with], "You, O Agni, are the lord of the house," he attends the gārhapatya.

sanskrit_iast: pra tad viṣṇur iti homa // imam ū ṣu tvam asmākam iti dvitīyo / vyāhṛtibhiś catvāraḥ //
meaning: प्र तद् विष्णुर् इति होम // इमम् ऊ षु त्वम् अस्माकम् इति द्वितीयो / व्याहृतिभिश् चत्वारः //
text_mt: With [the verse], "Forth this Viṣṇu…," there is an oblation; with [the verse], "This our [prayer], O you…," a second; with the sacred utterances, four.

sanskrit_iast: vāmadevyam̐ sāma gāya \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: वामदेव्यम्̐ साम गाय \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He gives the order: "Sing the Vāmadevya sāman!"

sanskrit_iast: ājyasthālīm̐ sruvaṃ ca dadhnaḥ pūrayitvāsandīm upakṛṣya namo vāce \\ ity oṣadhipāṇayaś cātvāle mārjayante /
meaning: आज्यस्थालीम्̐ स्रुवं च दध्नः पूरयित्वासन्दीम् उपकृष्य नमो वाचे \\ इत्य् ओषधिपाणयश् चात्वाले मार्जयन्ते /
text_mt: Having filled the vessel for clarified butter and the dipping spoon with curds, having drawn near the chair, holding plants in their hands, they cleanse themselves at the cātvāla with [the mantra], "Homage to speech!"

sanskrit_iast: yadi mahāvīra upadasyet pra vāṃ dam̐sām̐si \\ ity upadasta āpyāyyamānaḥ /
meaning: यदि महावीर उपदस्येत् प्र वां दम्̐साम्̐सि \\ इत्य् उपदस्त आप्याय्यमानः /
text_mt: If the mahāvīra [pot] should fail [in contents], with [the verse], "Forth your wondrous powers…," [the pot] is restored while it has failed.

sanskrit_iast: yadi mahāvīro bhidyeta mā no gharma hvaritas \\ ity etābhyāṃ pratyṛcam āhutīr juhuyād vyāhṛtibhiś ca /
meaning: यदि महावीरो भिद्येत मा नो घर्म ह्वरितस् \\ इत्य् एताभ्यां प्रत्यृचम् आहुतीर् जुहुयाद् व्याहृतिभिश् च /
text_mt: If the mahāvīra [pot] should break, he should offer oblations verse by verse with the two [verses beginning with], "May not the gharma, crooked, [harm] us," and with the sacred utterances.

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātaṃ karaṇam //
meaning: व्याख्यातं करणम् //

sanskrit_iast: gharmaḥ śiras \\ iti yathākālaṃ gharmeṣṭakām upadadhāti //
meaning: घर्मः शिरस् \\ इति यथाकालं घर्मेष्टकाम् उपदधाति //
text_mt: With [the formula], "The gharma is the head," he lays down the gharmeṣṭakā brick at the proper time.

sanskrit_iast: pūṣṇa āghṛṇaye svāhā \\ iti yathākālam̐ svayam eva pañcāhutīr juhoti //
meaning: पूष्ण आघृणये स्वाहा \\ इति यथाकालम्̐ स्वयम् एव पञ्चाहुतीर् जुहोति //
text_mt: With [the formula], "To the glowing Pūṣan, hail!", he himself offers five oblations at the proper time.

sanskrit_iast: ugraś ca bhīmaś ca \\ iti yathākālam araṇye 'nuvākyo gaṇo gaṇaḥ /
meaning: उग्रश् च भीमश् च \\ इति यथाकालम् अरण्ये ऽनुवाक्यो गणो गणः /
text_mt: The troop [of mantras] beginning with "The fierce and the terrible" is to be recited in the forest at the proper time, troop by troop.

sanskrit_iast: athāto dadhigharmeṇa caranti /
meaning: अथातो दधिघर्मेण चरन्ति /
text_mt: Now they proceed with the dadhigharma.

sanskrit_iast: mādhyaṃdine savane grahān saṃmṛśyopayāmaṃ darbhaiḥ prakṣālya paścād āgnīdhrīyasya gāyatrīṃ chandas \\ iti prapadyanta ṛtvijo yajamānaś ca //
meaning: माध्यंदिने सवने ग्रहान् संमृश्योपयामं दर्भैः प्रक्षाल्य पश्चाद् आग्नीध्रीयस्य गायत्रीं छन्दस् \\ इति प्रपद्यन्त ऋत्विजो यजमानश् च //
text_mt: At the midday pressing, having touched the cups, having washed the upayāma vessel with darbha grass, behind the āgnīdhra's fire the officiating priests and the sacrificer enter with [the formula], "Gāyatrī is the metre…"

sanskrit_iast: hotar vadasva \\ ity uktvā jyotir asi \\ ity upayāme dadhy ānīya śrātam̐ haviḥ śrātaṃ devebhyas \\ iti preṣyati //
meaning: होतर् वदस्व \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा ज्योतिर् असि \\ इत्य् उपयामे दध्य् आनीय श्रातम्̐ हविः श्रातं देवेभ्यस् \\ इति प्रेष्यति //
text_mt: Having said, "Speak, O hotṛ!", and having poured curd into the support-vessel with "You are light...", he prompts: "The oblation is cooked! Cooked for the gods!"

sanskrit_iast: yadi śrāto juhotana \ yady aśrāto mamattana \\ iti śrutvā sthānaṃ gatvāśrāvayati /
meaning: यदि श्रातो जुहोतन \ यद्य् अश्रातो ममत्तन \\ इति श्रुत्वा स्थानं गत्वाश्रावयति /
text_mt: Having heard, "If it is cooked, offer it! If it is not cooked, exhilarate!", having gone to his station, he causes the call to be made.

sanskrit_iast: pratyāśrute dadhigharmasya yaja \\ iti preṣyati //
meaning: प्रत्याश्रुते दधिघर्मस्य यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति //
text_mt: When the response has been made, he prompts: "Recite the offering verse for the curd-Gharma!"

sanskrit_iast: yam indram iti pratinigadya vaṣaṭkṛte na sarvaṃ juhoti // tābhyām̐ svāhā vaṣaḍ ity anuvaṣaṭkṛte /
meaning: यम् इन्द्रम् इति प्रतिनिगद्य वषट्कृते न सर्वं जुहोति // ताभ्याम्̐ स्वाहा वषड् इत्य् अनुवषट्कृते /
text_mt: Having recited the response with "yam indram...", when the vaṣaṭ-call is uttered, he does not sacrifice all [of it]. When the second vaṣaṭ-call is uttered with "tābhyāṃ svāhā vaṣaṭ",

sanskrit_iast: upayāme bhakṣam̐ harati /
meaning: उपयामे भक्षम्̐ हरति /
text_mt: he takes the portion for consumption in the upayāma [ladle].

sanskrit_iast: sado gatvā \\ upahūtopahvayasva \\ ity uktvā \\ upahūtā upahvayadhvam iti vā //
meaning: सदो गत्वा \\ उपहूतोपह्वयस्व \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा \\ उपहूता उपह्वयध्वम् इति वा //
text_mt: Going to the sadas and saying, "Summoned, do you invite [me]!" or "Summoned, do you invite [us]!"

sanskrit_iast: bhūr bhuvaḥ svar \ mayi tyad iti bhakṣayanti /
meaning: भूर् भुवः स्वर् \ मयि त्यद् इति भक्षयन्ति /
text_mt: they consume [it] with: "bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ; mayi tyad..."

sanskrit_iast: gharmam upayāmaṃ mārjālīye darbhaiḥ prakṣālya dadhnā pūrayitvā \\ udasya śuṣmād ity āhavanīya ādadhāti /
meaning: घर्मम् उपयामं मार्जालीये दर्भैः प्रक्षाल्य दध्ना पूरयित्वा \\ उदस्य शुष्माद् इत्य् आहवनीय आदधाति /
text_mt: Having washed the gharma [pot] and the upayāma [ladle] at the mārjālīya with darbha grass and filled [them] with curd, he places [the pot] on the āhavanīya fire with "udasya śuṣmāt..."

sanskrit_iast: uttame 'hany ahargaṇāḥ //
meaning: उत्तमे ऽहन्य् अहर्गणाः //

sanskrit_iast: namo vāce \\ ity oṣadhipāṇayaś cātvālānte mārjayante /
meaning: नमो वाचे \\ इत्य् ओषधिपाणयश् चात्वालान्ते मार्जयन्ते /
text_mt: With "namo vāce...", holding plants in their hands, they sprinkle themselves at the edge of the cātvāla trench.

sanskrit_iast: athāsurigavyaḥ //
meaning: अथासुरिगव्यः //

sanskrit_iast: vijre vikṣipe vidhame \\ iti tisro vijra ehi \\ ity aṣṭau /
meaning: विज्रे विक्षिपे विधमे \\ इति तिस्रो विज्र एहि \\ इत्य् अष्टौ /
text_mt: [There are] three [verses beginning with] "vijre vikṣipe vidhame..." and eight [verses beginning with] "vijra ehi..."

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ dviṣyāt tasya gavāṃ madhye vijre vikṣipe vidhame \\ ity āhūya prāgudayān niṣkramya dakṣiṇato grāmasya paścād vā śucau deśe svakṛta iriṇe 'gniṃ prajvālya kṛṣṇāyāḥ kṛṣṇānām̐ vrīhīṇām̐ payasi sthālīpākam̐ śrapayitvā / tasminn upasamādhāya parisamuhya paryukṣya śaraiḥ paristīrya \\ asṛṅmukhas \\ iti sthālīpākasya hutvā / prāk sviṣṭakṛtaḥ śarabhṛṣṭinā dakṣiṇasyoror deśasya savyam asyāṅge dakṣiṇā niḥkāsya sthalam /
meaning: यं द्विष्यात् तस्य गवां मध्ये विज्रे विक्षिपे विधमे \\ इत्य् आहूय प्रागुदयान् निष्क्रम्य दक्षिणतो ग्रामस्य पश्चाद् वा शुचौ देशे स्वकृत इरिणे ऽग्निं प्रज्वाल्य कृष्णायाः कृष्णानाम्̐ व्रीहीणाम्̐ पयसि स्थालीपाकम्̐ श्रपयित्वा / तस्मिन्न् उपसमाधाय परिसमुह्य पर्युक्ष्य शरैः परिस्तीर्य \\ असृङ्मुखस् \\ इति स्थालीपाकस्य हुत्वा / प्राक् स्विष्टकृतः शरभृष्टिना दक्षिणस्योरोर् देशस्य सव्यम् अस्याङ्गे दक्षिणा निःकास्य स्थलम् /
text_mt: Having called out in the midst of the cows of one whom he hates, "vijre vikṣipe vidhame...", going out before sunrise to the south or west of the village, in a clean place, having kindled a fire in a naturally formed barren spot, having cooked a boiled pot-oblation of black rice in the milk of a black cow; having added fuel to that [fire], swept around, sprinkled around, and strewn around with reeds, having offered of the boiled pot-oblation with "asṛṅmukhaḥ...", before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, [piercing] with the point of a reed the left side in the body of a [clay] figure [placed] south of the region of the right thigh, having scraped out [the residue],

sanskrit_iast: vṛkṣam āruhya grāmaṃ nagaraṃ janapadam̐ vā yaṃ dviṣyāt taṃ dhruvor ity avekṣeta sa sadyo vinaśyati //
meaning: वृक्षम् आरुह्य ग्रामं नगरं जनपदम्̐ वा यं द्विष्यात् तं ध्रुवोर् इत्य् अवेक्षेत स सद्यो विनश्यति //
text_mt: having climbed a tree, he should look towards the village, town, or country of him whom he hates, with "dhruvoḥ..."; he perishes immediately.

sanskrit_iast: ud vayaṃ tamasas pari \\ ity ādityam avekṣate /
meaning: उद् वयं तमसस् परि \\ इत्य् आदित्यम् अवेक्षते /
text_mt: He looks at the sun with "ud vayaṃ tamasas pari..."

sanskrit_iast: pratyetya namo vāce \\ ity oṣadhipāṇir mārjayate mārjayate /
meaning: प्रत्येत्य नमो वाचे \\ इत्य् ओषधिपाणिर् मार्जयते मार्जयते /
text_mt: Returning, holding a plant in his hand, he sprinkles himself with "namo vāce..."

sanskrit_iast: avāntaradīkṣām upaiṣyann udagayane jyautsne puṇye nakṣatre 'nyatra navamyāḥ prāg astamayān niṣkramyottarato grāmasya purastād vā śucau deśe 'hatena vāsasā pariṇaddhaḥ sarvarātraṃ tiṣṭhet strīśūdram anabhibhāṣamāṇaḥ /
meaning: अवान्तरदीक्षाम् उपैष्यन्न् उदगयने ज्यौत्स्ने पुण्ये नक्षत्रे ऽन्यत्र नवम्याः प्राग् अस्तमयान् निष्क्रम्योत्तरतो ग्रामस्य पुरस्ताद् वा शुचौ देशे ऽहतेन वाससा परिणद्धः सर्वरात्रं तिष्ठेत् स्त्रीशूद्रम् अनभिभाषमाणः /
text_mt: When about to undertake the intermediate consecration during the northern course of the sun, in the bright fortnight, under an auspicious lunar mansion, except on the ninth day, having gone out before sunset to the north or east of the village, wrapped in an unwashed garment in a clean place, he should stand all night without speaking to a woman or a Śūdra.

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte 'gnim̐ sūryaṃ gām̐ hiraṇyaṃ brāhmaṇam udakām̐syaṃ ca kanyāṃ patikāmām iti nidarśayet /
meaning: श्वोभूते ऽग्निम्̐ सूर्यं गाम्̐ हिरण्यं ब्राह्मणम् उदकाम्̐स्यं च कन्यां पतिकामाम् इति निदर्शयेत् /
text_mt: On the next day, he should display fire, the sun, a cow, gold, a brāhmaṇa, a bronze vessel of water, and a maiden desiring a husband.

sanskrit_iast: tatraivāgnim upasamādhāya caityasyāśvatthasyārdrāś catasraḥ samidhaḥ stibhigavatīḥ sahapalāśāḥ prādeśamātrīḥ sarpiṣi paryastāḥ pṛthivī samid iti svāhākārāntābhir ādadhāti //
meaning: तत्रैवाग्निम् उपसमाधाय चैत्यस्याश्वत्थस्यार्द्राश् चतस्रः समिधः स्तिभिगवतीः सहपलाशाः प्रादेशमात्रीः सर्पिषि पर्यस्ताः पृथिवी समिद् इति स्वाहाकारान्ताभिर् आदधाति //
text_mt: Having added fuel to the fire right there, he places on [it] four moist firewood sticks from a caitya-aśvattha tree, possessing shoots, with leaves, a span in length, soaked in clarified butter, with the [formulas] ending in svāhā: "pṛthivī samit..."

sanskrit_iast: agne vratapate \\ iti vrataṃ pradāyāditaḥ pañcavim̐śatim anuvākān anuvācayet /
meaning: अग्ने व्रतपते \\ इति व्रतं प्रदायादितः पञ्चविम्̐शतिम् अनुवाकान् अनुवाचयेत् /
text_mt: Having imparted the vow with "agne vratapate...", he should have him recite the twenty-five sections from the beginning.

sanskrit_iast: pariṇahanaṃ gāṃ kām̐syaṃ ca gurave dadyāt /
meaning: परिणहनं गां काम्̐स्यं च गुरवे दद्यात् /
text_mt: He should give the wrap, a cow, and a bronze vessel to the teacher.

sanskrit_iast: na naktaṃ bhuñjīta / yadi bhuñjītāpajvalitaṃ bhuñjīta /
meaning: न नक्तं भुञ्जीत / यदि भुञ्जीतापज्वलितं भुञ्जीत /
text_mt: He should not eat at night. If he should eat, he should eat by the light of a flame.

sanskrit_iast: ahas tiṣṭhed rātrāv āsīnaḥ / parvasu caivam̐ syāt /
meaning: अहस् तिष्ठेद् रात्राव् आसीनः / पर्वसु चैवम्̐ स्यात् /
text_mt: He should stand by day, seated at night. And it should be thus on the new- and full-moon days.

sanskrit_iast: evam̐yuktaḥ sam̐vatsaraṃ caret trīn pañca sapta vā / traividyakaṃ ca caret /
meaning: एवम्̐युक्तः सम्̐वत्सरं चरेत् त्रीन् पञ्च सप्त वा / त्रैविद्यकं च चरेत् /
text_mt: Engaged in this way, he should observe it for a year, or three, five, or seven [years]. And he should observe the study of the three Vedas.

sanskrit_iast: samāpte ca tāny utsṛjya namo vāce \\ ity oṣadhipāṇir mārjayate mārjayate /
meaning: समाप्ते च तान्य् उत्सृज्य नमो वाचे \\ इत्य् ओषधिपाणिर् मार्जयते मार्जयते /
text_mt: And when it is completed, having relinquished them, holding a plant in his hand, he sprinkles himself with "namo vāce..."

sanskrit_iast: āraṇyam̐ svādhyāyam adhyeṣyamāṇa udagayane jyautsne śukriyaṃ pūrvāhṇe na naktaṃ na bhuktvā na yāme na śoṇitaṃ dṛṣṭvāmam̐ vā mām̐sam anyad vāmedhyaṃ parvasu ca partiṣiddham /
meaning: आरण्यम्̐ स्वाध्यायम् अध्येष्यमाण उदगयने ज्यौत्स्ने शुक्रियं पूर्वाह्णे न नक्तं न भुक्त्वा न यामे न शोणितं दृष्ट्वामम्̐ वा माम्̐सम् अन्यद् वामेध्यं पर्वसु च पर्तिषिद्धम् /
text_mt: When about to study the forest lesson, in the northern course of the sun, in the bright fortnight, [he studies] the Śukriya [text] in the morning, not at night, not after eating, not at a forbidden watch [of the day], not after seeing blood, raw meat, or anything else impure, and it is prohibited on the new- and full-moon days;

sanskrit_iast: prāg astamayād dhaviṣyam annam upayuñjānaḥ /
meaning: प्राग् अस्तमयाद् धविष्यम् अन्नम् उपयुञ्जानः /
text_mt: eating oblation-food before sunset;

sanskrit_iast: prāg udayān niṣkramyottarato grāmasya purastād vā śucau deśe viṣṭarapāṇayo 'bhimukhās tad anucakṣuṣo yathākālam̐ svādhyāyam adhītya namo vāce \\ ity oṣadhipāṇayo mārjayante /
meaning: प्राग् उदयान् निष्क्रम्योत्तरतो ग्रामस्य पुरस्ताद् वा शुचौ देशे विष्टरपाणयो ऽभिमुखास् तद् अनुचक्षुषो यथाकालम्̐ स्वाध्यायम् अधीत्य नमो वाचे \\ इत्य् ओषधिपाणयो मार्जयन्ते /
text_mt: having gone out before sunrise to the north or east of the village, in a clean place, holding grass bunches in their hands, facing [the sun], with eyes fixed upon that [text], having studied the sacred text according to the proper time, holding plants in their hands, they sprinkle themselves with "namo vāce..."

sanskrit_iast: sarvatra rahasyamantraprayoge pratipattir mārjanaṃ ca pratipattir mārjanaṃ ca /
meaning: सर्वत्र रहस्यमन्त्रप्रयोगे प्रतिपत्तिर् मार्जनं च प्रतिपत्तिर् मार्जनं च /
text_mt: Everywhere in the application of secret formulas, [there is] disposal and sprinkling, disposal and sprinkling.

sanskrit_iast: iṣṭibhir yajeta paurṇamāsyām amāvāsyāyām̐ vā pūrvapakṣe vā puṇye nakṣatre 'nyatra navamyāḥ /
meaning: इष्टिभिर् यजेत पौर्णमास्याम् अमावास्यायाम्̐ वा पूर्वपक्षे वा पुण्ये नक्षत्रे ऽन्यत्र नवम्याः /
text_mt: One should sacrifice with iṣṭis on a full-moon day, or on a new-moon day, or in the bright fortnight under an auspicious lunar mansion, except on the ninth day.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścitteṣṭir āpatkālā / sadyaḥ kuryāt /
meaning: प्रायश्चित्तेष्टिर् आपत्काला / सद्यः कुर्यात् /
text_mt: An expiatory iṣṭi occurs at a time of emergency; one should perform it immediately.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīm agniṣv anvādhāya vratam upaity anyatra niyatakālābhyaḥ samṛtayajñāc ca /
meaning: तूष्णीम् अग्निष्व् अन्वाधाय व्रतम् उपैत्य् अन्यत्र नियतकालाभ्यः समृतयज्ञाच् च /
text_mt: Having added fuel silently to the fires, he enters upon the vow, except in those rites that have fixed times and except at a gathering-sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīyotkarāv antarā tīrthaṃ cātvālotkarāv antarā sacātvālāsu /
meaning: आहवनीयोत्कराव् अन्तरा तीर्थं चात्वालोत्कराव् अन्तरा सचात्वालासु /
text_mt: The path lies between the āhavanīya fire and the rubbish heap; in rites with a cātvāla trench, between the cātvāla trench and the rubbish heap.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśa sāmidhenyaḥ //
meaning: सप्तदश सामिधेन्यः //
text_mt: Seventeen are the kindling verses.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthupājās \ tam̐ sabādhas \\ iti pṛthupājavatyau dhāyye / samidvatyāvantarā dhāyyāsthānam /
meaning: पृथुपाजास् \ तम्̐ सबाधस् \\ इति पृथुपाजवत्यौ धाय्ये / समिद्वत्यावन्तरा धाय्यास्थानम् /
text_mt: "pṛthupājāḥ..." and "taṃ sabādhaḥ..." are the two inserting verses containing the word pṛthupājas; the place of the inserting verses is between the two [verses] containing the word samidh.

sanskrit_iast: ājyabhāgasviṣṭakṛtāv antarejyānāmāv āpaḥ /
meaning: आज्यभागस्विष्टकृताव् अन्तरेज्यानामाव् आपः /
text_mt: The insertion of the deities to be worshipped is between the clarified butter portion and the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: nigadamāvāhana uttame prayāje sviṣṭakṛti sūktavāke ca /
meaning: निगदमावाहन उत्तमे प्रयाजे स्विष्टकृति सूक्तवाके च /
text_mt: [Their] invocation [occurs] in the invitation-formula, in the last fore-offering, in the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, and in the sūktavāka recitation.

sanskrit_iast: avyavahitāḥ samānadevatāḥ sakṛd āvapet pratīcyam̐ vyavahitāḥ /
meaning: अव्यवहिताः समानदेवताः सकृद् आवपेत् प्रतीच्यम्̐ व्यवहिताः /
text_mt: He should insert consecutive [names of deities] having the same divinity once; [names that are] separated, towards the end [of each].

sanskrit_iast: vājino nāvāhayati /
meaning: वाजिनो नावाहयति /

sanskrit_iast: paśupuroḍāśam̐ yāni cānvāyatante trimātrāṇi bhavati // ye3 yajāmahe \\ ādir \ ehi \\ āvaha \\ iti co śrāvaya \\ ity ādito dve brūhipreṣyaśrauṣaḍvauṣaṭsūpottamam̐ yājyāntaś ca / tasmin saṃdhyakṣarāṇy apragṛhyāṇi vivekena plavante /
meaning: पशुपुरोडाशम्̐ यानि चान्वायतन्ते त्रिमात्राणि भवति // ये3 यजामहे \\ आदिर् \ एहि \\ आवह \\ इति चो श्रावय \\ इत्य् आदितो द्वे ब्रूहिप्रेष्यश्रौषड्वौषट्सूपोत्तमम्̐ याज्यान्तश् च / तस्मिन् संध्यक्षराण्य् अप्रगृह्याणि विवेकेन प्लवन्ते /
text_mt: The animal cake and whatever [syllables] follow become protracted to three morae: the beginning of "ye3 yajāmahe", "ehi" and "āvaha", the first two of "oṃ śrāvaya", the penultimate [syllables] in "brūhi", "preṣya", "vauṣaṭ", and the end of the offering verse; in that, diphthongs that are not pragṛhya become protracted distinctly.

sanskrit_iast: śastrānuvacanayor uttamam akṣaram̐ svarādy okārī bhavati /
meaning: शस्त्रानुवचनयोर् उत्तमम् अक्षरम्̐ स्वराद्य् ओकारी भवति /
text_mt: In the recitation of a śastra and the reciting of a text, the final syllable, beginning with a vowel, turns into an o-sound.

sanskrit_iast: ṛksamavāye triḥ prathamottame /
meaning: ऋक्समवाये त्रिः प्रथमोत्तमे /
text_mt: In an aggregate of verses, [he repeats] the first and the last three times.

sanskrit_iast: praṇavenarcaḥ saṃdadhāti /
meaning: प्रणवेनर्चः संदधाति /
text_mt: He connects the verses with the praṇava [om].

sanskrit_iast: agnyādheyeṣṭiṣv ārambhaṇīyānunirvāpyā /
meaning: अग्न्याधेयेष्टिष्व् आरम्भणीयानुनिर्वाप्या /
text_mt: In the iṣṭis of the establishment of the sacred fires, the introductory offering is to be performed as a subsidiary offering.

sanskrit_iast: anīkavatasāṃtapanakrīḍineṣu pañcadaśa sāmidhenyaḥ /
meaning: अनीकवतसांतपनक्रीडिनेषु पञ्चदश सामिधेन्यः /
text_mt: In the Anīkavat, Sāṃtapana, and Krīḍin [offerings], fifteen are the kindling verses.

sanskrit_iast: rājanyāśrivadhryaśvavasiṣṭhavaiśyaśunakānāṃ kaṇvakaśyapasaṃkṛtīnāṃ narāśam̐so dvitīyaḥ prayājas tanūnapād anyeṣām ubhau yatra samāmnātau /
meaning: राजन्याश्रिवध्र्यश्ववसिष्ठवैश्यशुनकानां कण्वकश्यपसंकृतीनां नराशम्̐सो द्वितीयः प्रयाजस् तनूनपाद् अन्येषाम् उभौ यत्र समाम्नातौ /
text_mt: For royal seers, the Avadhryāśvas, Vasiṣṭhas, Vaiśyas, and Śunakas, and for the Kaṇvas, Kaśyapas, and Saṃkṛtis, Narāśaṃsa is the second fore-offering; Tanūnapāt is for others; where both are handed down by tradition, [both are used].

sanskrit_iast: yasyai devatāyai vaṣaṭkuryāt tāṃ manasā dhyāyet /
meaning: यस्यै देवतायै वषट्कुर्यात् तां मनसा ध्यायेत् /
text_mt: To whichever deity he would utter the vaṣaṭ-call, he should meditate upon that [deity] in his mind.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyenāṣṭākapālena svargakāmo yajeta paurṇamāsatantreṇa //
meaning: आग्नेयेनाष्टाकपालेन स्वर्गकामो यजेत पौर्णमासतन्त्रेण //
text_mt: One who desires heaven should sacrifice with an offering on eight potsherds to Agni according to the ritual framework of the full-moon sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: agnir vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanat \ tvam̐ somāsi satpatir iti vārtraghnāv ājyabhāgau //
meaning: अग्निर् वृत्राणि जङ्घनत् \ त्वम्̐ सोमासि सत्पतिर् इति वार्त्रघ्नाव् आज्यभागौ //
text_mt: "agnir vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanat..." and "tvaṃ somāsi satpatiḥ..." are the two clarified butter portions celebrating the slaying of Vṛtra.

sanskrit_iast: agnir mūrdhā \ bhuvo yajñasya \\ iti haviṣaḥ //
meaning: अग्निर् मूर्धा \ भुवो यज्ञस्य \\ इति हविषः //
text_mt: "agnir mūrdhā..." and "bhuvo yajñasya..." are [the invitatory and offering verses] of the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: piprīhi devān \ agne yad adya \\ iti sviṣṭakṛtaḥ sam̐yājye /
meaning: पिप्रीहि देवान् \ अग्ने यद् अद्य \\ इति स्विष्टकृतः सम्̐याज्ये /
text_mt: "piprīhi devān..." and "agne yad adya..." are the two concluding offering verses of the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: paurṇamāsatantram anādeśe /
meaning: पौर्णमासतन्त्रम् अनादेशे /
text_mt: In the absence of an explicit rule, the ritual framework of the full-moon sacrifice [applies].

sanskrit_iast: kapāle naṣṭe prayuktānāṃ prāg udvāsanād agnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet /
meaning: कपाले नष्टे प्रयुक्तानां प्राग् उद्वासनाद् अग्नये वैश्वानराय द्वादशकपालं निर्वपेत् /
text_mt: When a potsherd among those used is lost before taking [the cake] off the fire, one should apportion an oblation on twelve potsherds for Agni Vaiśvānara.

sanskrit_iast: bhārgavo hotā /
meaning: भार्गवो होता /

sanskrit_iast: ekahāyano gaur dakṣiṇā /
meaning: एकहायनो गौर् दक्षिणा /
text_mt: A one-year-old cow is the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścittiḥ kalpaḥ //
meaning: प्रायश्चित्तिः कल्पः //

sanskrit_iast: agne rakṣā ṇas \ tvaṃ naḥ soma \\ iti rakṣitavantāv ājyabhāgau //
meaning: अग्ने रक्षा णस् \ त्वं नः सोम \\ इति रक्षितवन्ताव् आज्यभागौ //
text_mt: "agne rakṣā ṇaḥ..." and "tvaṃ naḥ soma..." are the two clarified butter portions containing the word rakṣat.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvānaro na ūtyā \ pṛṣṭo divi \\ iti haviṣaḥ //
meaning: वैश्वानरो न ऊत्या \ पृष्टो दिवि \\ इति हविषः //
text_mt: "vaiśvānaro na ūtyā..." and "pṛṣṭo divi..." are [the verses] of the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: viśvāni nas \\ agne tvaṃ pārayā \\ iti pārayadvatyau sam̐yājye /
meaning: विश्वानि नस् \\ अग्ने त्वं पारया \\ इति पारयद्वत्यौ सम्̐याज्ये /
text_mt: "viśvāni naḥ..." and "agne tvaṃ pārayā..." are the two concluding offering verses containing the word pārayat.

sanskrit_iast: sarvāsv ārambhaṇīyāsu paurṇamāsatantram /
meaning: सर्वास्व् आरम्भणीयासु पौर्णमासतन्त्रम् /
text_mt: In all introductory offerings, the ritual framework of the full-moon sacrifice [applies].

sanskrit_iast: agnyādheye trihavir ārambhaṇīyā caturhavir vā //
meaning: अग्न्याधेये त्रिहविर् आरम्भणीया चतुर्हविर् वा //
text_mt: In the establishment of the sacred fires, the introductory offering has three oblations or four oblations.

sanskrit_iast: agnāviṣṇū sajoṣasā \\ iti ṣaṭtrihaviṣaḥ //
meaning: अग्नाविष्णू सजोषसा \\ इति षट्त्रिहविषः //
text_mt: "agnāviṣṇū sajoṣasā..." are the six [verses] of that with three oblations.

sanskrit_iast: tvam agne vīravat \ tvaṃ bhago nas \\ ity āgnāvaiṣṇavād anantare caturhaviṣaḥ /
meaning: त्वम् अग्ने वीरवत् \ त्वं भगो नस् \\ इत्य् आग्नावैष्णवाद् अनन्तरे चतुर्हविषः /
text_mt: "tvam agne vīravat..." and "tvaṃ bhago naḥ..." immediately follow the [verses] to Agni-Viṣṇu for that with four oblations.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmyo bhagī nānātantraḥ /
meaning: यदि काम्यो भगी नानातन्त्रः /
text_mt: If [the sacrifice to] Bhaga is performed for a wish, it has a separate ritual framework.

sanskrit_iast: vairājaḥ kalpaḥ //
meaning: वैराजः कल्पः //

sanskrit_iast: agniḥ pratnena manmanā \ soma gīrbhiṣ ṭvā vayam iti vṛdhanvantāv ājyabhāgau /
meaning: अग्निः प्रत्नेन मन्मना \ सोम गीर्भिष् ट्वा वयम् इति वृधन्वन्ताव् आज्यभागौ /
text_mt: "Agni by ancient thought…", "O Soma, we [praise] you with songs…" are the two clarified butter portions containing the word vṛdh- [vṛdhanvant].

sanskrit_iast: āmnāte haviṣaḥ //
meaning: आम्नाते हविषः //

sanskrit_iast: preddho agne \\ iti virājau sam̐yājye /
meaning: प्रेद्धो अग्ने \\ इति विराजौ सम्̐याज्ये /
text_mt: "Kindled, O Agni…" are the two virāj concluding offering verses.

sanskrit_iast: agnyādheyeṣṭīnāṃ pavamānasya \\ agna āyūm̐ṣi pavase \\ iti dve haviṣa uttare sviṣṭakṛtaḥ //
meaning: अग्न्याधेयेष्टीनां पवमानस्य \\ अग्न आयूम्̐षि पवसे \\ इति द्वे हविष उत्तरे स्विष्टकृतः //
text_mt: Among the sacrifices for the establishment of the fires (Agnyādheya), in that for [Agni] Pavamāna, "O Agni, you purify lifespans…" are the two subsequent [verses] for the oblation, [followed by those] for the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: agne pāvaka rociṣā \\ ity uttarayoś catasra uttare sviṣṭakṛtaḥ /
meaning: अग्ने पावक रोचिषा \\ इत्य् उत्तरयोश् चतस्र उत्तरे स्विष्टकृतः /
text_mt: "O purifying Agni, with radiant light…": the four subsequent [verses] for the two following [oblations], [followed by those] for the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: caturhaviṣo vairājaḥ kalpaḥ /
meaning: चतुर्हविषो वैराजः कल्पः /
text_mt: For the one of four oblations, the ritual procedure is vairāja.

sanskrit_iast: āgnāvaiṣṇavasyāmnāte //
meaning: आग्नावैष्णवस्याम्नाते //
text_mt: The two [verses] for the [oblation] to Agni and Viṣṇu are those handed down by tradition.

sanskrit_iast: kim it te viṣṇa iti ṣaḍ uttareṣām /
meaning: किम् इत् ते विष्ण इति षड् उत्तरेषाम् /
text_mt: "What, O Viṣṇu, is your…" are the six [verses] for the subsequent [three oblations].

sanskrit_iast: punarādheye prayājānuyājānāṃ purastād vopariṣṭād vā vibhaktīḥ kuryāt \\ ye3 yajāmahe \ samidhaḥsamidho 'gnā ājyasya vyantu \\ agnir agnis \ tanūnapād agnā ājyasya vetu \\ agnimagnim \ iḍo 'gnā ājyasya vyantu \\ agneragner \ barhir agnā ājyasya vetu \\ agneragner iti / yathāmnāta uttamaḥ //
meaning: पुनराधेये प्रयाजानुयाजानां पुरस्ताद् वोपरिष्टाद् वा विभक्तीः कुर्यात् \\ ये3 यजामहे \ समिधःसमिधो ऽग्ना आज्यस्य व्यन्तु \\ अग्निर् अग्निस् \ तनूनपाद् अग्ना आज्यस्य वेतु \\ अग्निमग्निम् \ इडो ऽग्ना आज्यस्य व्यन्तु \\ अग्नेरग्नेर् \ बर्हिर् अग्ना आज्यस्य वेतु \\ अग्नेरग्नेर् इति / यथाम्नात उत्तमः //
text_mt: At the re-establishment of the fires (Punarādheya), one may make case-inflections (vibhaktis) of [the word] Agni either before or after the fore-offerings and after-offerings: "We who sacrifice… May the kindling-sticks, the kindling-sticks, O Agni, partake of the clarified butter. Agni, Agni. May Tanūnapāt, O Agni, partake of the clarified butter. Agni, Agni. May the iḍā offerings, O Agni, partake of the clarified butter. Agni's, Agni's. May the sacrificial grass, O Agni, partake of the clarified butter. Agni's, Agni's." The last [fore-offering] is as handed down by tradition.

sanskrit_iast: agnim̐ stomena bodhaya \\ iti ṣaḍ ājyabhāgahaviḥsviṣṭakṛtām /
meaning: अग्निम्̐ स्तोमेन बोधय \\ इति षड् आज्यभागहविःस्विष्टकृताम् /
text_mt: "Awaken Agni with praise…" are the six [verses] for the clarified butter portions, the oblation, and the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyāvājyabhāgau \\ agnir mūrdhā \\ iti prajākāmasya paśukāmasya vā somasya loke kuryāt //
meaning: आग्नेयावाज्यभागौ \\ अग्निर् मूर्धा \\ इति प्रजाकामस्य पशुकामस्य वा सोमस्य लोके कुर्यात् //
text_mt: The two clarified butter portions are addressed to Agni; in place of Soma, for one desiring offspring or one desiring cattle, he should recite: "Agni is the head…".

sanskrit_iast: devaṃ barhir vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu \\ agneragner \ devo narāśam̐so vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu \\ agneragner iti / yathāmnāta uttamaḥ /
meaning: देवं बर्हिर् वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु \\ अग्नेरग्नेर् \ देवो नराशम्̐सो वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु \\ अग्नेरग्नेर् इति / यथाम्नात उत्तमः /
text_mt: "May the divine sacrificial grass, in the winning of wealth, partake of the treasure-store. Agni's, Agni's. May the divine Narāśaṃsa, in the winning of wealth, partake of the treasure-store. Agni's, Agni's." The last [after-offering] is as handed down by tradition.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye jyotiṣmate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvaped vāruṇam̐ yavamayaṃ carum //
meaning: अग्नये ज्योतिष्मते ऽष्टाकपालं निर्वपेद् वारुणम्̐ यवमयं चरुम् //
text_mt: He should apportion [a cake] on eight potsherds to lustrous Agni, [and] a boiled oblation made of barley to Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: tvam agne saprathā asi \ vṛṣā soma \\ iti vṛṣaṇvantāv ājyabhāgau //
meaning: त्वम् अग्ने सप्रथा असि \ वृषा सोम \\ इति वृषण्वन्ताव् आज्यभागौ //
text_mt: "O Agni, you are widespread…", "Soma, the bull…" are the two clarified butter portions containing the word 'bull' (vṛṣaṇvant).

sanskrit_iast: agnir jāto arocata \\ iti haviṣaś catasraḥ /
meaning: अग्निर् जातो अरोचत \\ इति हविषश् चतस्रः /
text_mt: "Agni, being born, shone forth…" are the four [verses] of the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye 'gnimate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapen maitraṃ carum̐ sauryam ekakapālam agnaye vratapataye 'gnaye pathikṛte 'gnaye śucaye 'gnaye kṣāmavate 'gnaye tapasvate janadvate pāvakavate 'gnaye tantumate 'gnaye vivice 'ṣṭākapālān /
meaning: अग्नये ऽग्निमते ऽष्टाकपालं निर्वपेन् मैत्रं चरुम्̐ सौर्यम् एककपालम् अग्नये व्रतपतये ऽग्नये पथिकृते ऽग्नये शुचये ऽग्नये क्षामवते ऽग्नये तपस्वते जनद्वते पावकवते ऽग्नये तन्तुमते ऽग्नये विविचे ऽष्टाकपालान् /
text_mt: He should apportion [a cake] on eight potsherds to Agni possessed of fires, a boiled oblation to Mitra, [a cake] on one potsherd to Sūrya, [and cakes] on eight potsherds to Agni lord of vows, to Agni path-maker, to pure Agni, to scorched Agni, to ascetic Agni, to Agni with progeny, to Agni with purifiers, to Agni possessed of the thread, [and] to discriminating Agni.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścittiḥ kalpaḥ //
meaning: प्रायश्चित्तिः कल्पः //

sanskrit_iast: agnināgniḥ samidhyate \\ iti ṣoḍaśa haviṣām //
meaning: अग्निनाग्निः समिध्यते \\ इति षोडश हविषाम् //
text_mt: "Agni is kindled by Agni…" are the sixteen [verses] of the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: svayaṃ kṛṇvānas \ tvaṃ tantur iti tantumatyau /
meaning: स्वयं कृण्वानस् \ त्वं तन्तुर् इति तन्तुमत्यौ /
text_mt: "Making by oneself…", "You are the thread…" are the two verses addressed to Agni possessed of the thread (tantumant).

sanskrit_iast:
vi te viṣvag vātajūtāso agne \ bhāmāsaḥ śuce śucayaś caranti /
tuvimrakṣāso divyā navagvās \ vanā vananti dhṛṣatā rujantaḥ //
tvām agne mānuṣīr īḍate viśas\ hotrāvidam̐ vivicim̐ ratnadhātamam /
guhā santam̐ subhaga viśvadarśatam\ tuviṣvaṇasam̐ suyajaṃ ghṛtaśriyam //
iti vaivicyau /
meaning:
वि ते विष्वग् वातजूतासो अग्ने \ भामासः शुचे शुचयश् चरन्ति /
तुविम्रक्षासो दिव्या नवग्वास् \ वना वनन्ति धृषता रुजन्तः //
त्वाम् अग्ने मानुषीर् ईडते विशस्\ होत्राविदम्̐ विविचिम्̐ रत्नधातमम् /
गुहा सन्तम्̐ सुभग विश्वदर्शतम्\ तुविष्वणसम्̐ सुयजं घृतश्रियम् //
इति वैविच्यौ /

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvadeve \\ agnaye mathyamānāyānubrūhi \\ ity ukte \\ abhi tvā deva savitar iti pratipadyate // dasyuhantamam iti viramati //
meaning: वैश्वदेवे \\ अग्नये मथ्यमानायानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् उक्ते \\ अभि त्वा देव सवितर् इति प्रतिपद्यते // दस्युहन्तमम् इति विरमति //
text_mt: At the Vaiśvadeva [seasonal offering], when it is said: "Recite for Agni being churned", he begins with: "Towards you, divine Savitṛ…"; he stops at: "…the greatest slayer of Dasyus".

sanskrit_iast: agnaye jātāyānubrūhi \\ ity ukte dhanaṃjayam̐ raṇeraṇo3m iti pratipadyate // bibhrati \\ iti viramati //
meaning: अग्नये जातायानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् उक्ते धनंजयम्̐ रणेरणो3म् इति प्रतिपद्यते // बिभ्रति \\ इति विरमति //
text_mt: When it is said: "Recite for Agni who is born", he begins with: "Winner of booty, in battle after battle…"; he stops at: "…bearing".

sanskrit_iast: agnaye prahriyamānāyānubrūhi \\ ity ukte viśām agnim̐ svadhvaro3m iti pratipadyate //
meaning: अग्नये प्रह्रियमानायानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् उक्ते विशाम् अग्निम्̐ स्वध्वरो3म् इति प्रतिपद्यते //
text_mt: When it is said: "Recite for Agni being carried forward", he begins with: "Agni of the clans, performing good sacrifices…".

sanskrit_iast: yajñena yajñam iti paridadhāti /
meaning: यज्ञेन यज्ञम् इति परिदधाति /
text_mt: He concludes with: "With sacrifice the sacrifice…".

sanskrit_iast: atraiva tiṣṭhan sāmidhenīr anvāha //
meaning: अत्रैव तिष्ठन् सामिधेनीर् अन्वाह //
text_mt: Standing right there, he recites the kindling verses (sāmidhenīs).

sanskrit_iast: samidho agne \\ iti nava prayājāḥ //
meaning: समिधो अग्ने \\ इति नव प्रयाजाः //
text_mt: "O Agni, the kindling-sticks…" are the nine fore-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: agne yam \\ tvaṃ naḥ soma \\ iti viśvatavantāv ājyabhāgau //
meaning: अग्ने यम् \\ त्वं नः सोम \\ इति विश्वतवन्ताव् आज्यभागौ //
text_mt: "O Agni, whom…", "O Soma, you to us…" are the two clarified butter portions containing the word 'all-around' (viśvatas).

sanskrit_iast: agnir mūrdhā \ bhuvo yajñasya \\ iti ṣoḍaśa haviṣām //
meaning: अग्निर् मूर्धा \ भुवो यज्ञस्य \\ इति षोडश हविषाम् //
text_mt: "Agni is the head…", "Become of the sacrifice…" are the sixteen [verses] of the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: sa havyavāṭ \\ agnim̐ stomena \\ iti gāyatryau sam̐yājye //
meaning: स हव्यवाट् \\ अग्निम्̐ स्तोमेन \\ इति गायत्र्यौ सम्̐याज्ये //
text_mt: "He, the conveyer of oblations…", "Awaken Agni with praise…" are the two gāyatrī concluding offering verses.

sanskrit_iast: devaṃ barhir iti navānuyājāḥ //
meaning: देवं बर्हिर् इति नवानुयाजाः //
text_mt: "Divine sacrificial grass…" are the nine after-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: śaṃ nas \\ vājevāje \\ iti vājinasyāvyavānam̐ hotordhvajñur āsīno yajati / vājinasya \\ agne vīhi \\ ity anuvaṣaṭkaroti /
meaning: शं नस् \\ वाजेवाजे \\ इति वाजिनस्याव्यवानम्̐ होतोर्ध्वज्ञुर् आसीनो यजति / वाजिनस्य \\ अग्ने वीहि \\ इत्य् अनुवषट्करोति /
text_mt: Without interruption, the hotṛ priest, seated with his right knee raised, makes the offering of the whey (vājina) with: "May [the horses] be auspicious to us…", "In every contest…"; he pronounces the secondary vaṣaṭ-call with: "Of the whey… O Agni, partake!".

sanskrit_iast: varuṇapraghāseṣv agnipraṇayanakāle paścād āhavanīyasyopaviśati //
meaning: वरुणप्रघासेष्व् अग्निप्रणयनकाले पश्चाद् आहवनीयस्योपविशति //
text_mt: In the Varuṇapraghāsa rites, at the time of carrying forward the fire, he sits behind the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye praṇīyamānāyānubrūhi \\ ity ukte pra devam iti pratipadyate / trir vacanasyārdharcam̐ śiṣṭvā viramati /
meaning: अग्नये प्रणीयमानायानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् उक्ते प्र देवम् इति प्रतिपद्यते / त्रिर् वचनस्यार्धर्चम्̐ शिष्ट्वा विरमति /
text_mt: When it is said: "Recite for Agni being carried forward", he begins with: "Forward to the god…"; having left over half a verse of the three-fold recitation, he pauses.

sanskrit_iast: hute havyā no vakṣad ānuṣak \\ ity upottiṣṭhati \\ amṛtād iva janmanas \\ iti viramati /
meaning: हुते हव्या नो वक्षद् आनुषक् \\ इत्य् उपोत्तिष्ठति \\ अमृताद् इव जन्मनस् \\ इति विरमति /
text_mt: When [the oblation] has been offered, he rises up with: "May he continuously convey our oblations…"; he stops at: "…as if from immortal birth".

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīm anvety ādhānavelāyām \\ sahasaś cit sahīyān iti pratipadyate //
meaning: तूष्णीम् अन्वेत्य् आधानवेलायाम् \\ सहसश् चित् सहीयान् इति प्रतिपद्यते //
text_mt: He follows silently; at the moment of setting down [the fire], he begins with: "Stronger even than the strong…".

sanskrit_iast: tvaṃ dūtas \\ iti paridadhāti /
meaning: त्वं दूतस् \\ इति परिदधाति /
text_mt: He concludes with: "You are the messenger…".

sanskrit_iast: agnimanthanaprabhṛti vaiśvadevena vyākhyātam //
meaning: अग्निमन्थनप्रभृति वैश्वदेवेन व्याख्यातम् //
text_mt: From the churning of fire onward, it is explained by the Vaiśvadeva [ritual].

sanskrit_iast: agninā rayim aśnavat \\ gayasphānas \\ iti rayimantāv ājyabhāgau /
meaning: अग्निना रयिम् अश्नवत् \\ गयस्फानस् \\ इति रयिमन्ताव् आज्यभागौ /
text_mt: "Through Agni one may attain wealth…", "Increaser of the home…" are the two clarified butter portions containing the word 'wealth' (rayimant).

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvaṃ pañca saṃcarebhyaḥ / caturṇām indrāgnī rocanā \\ ity aṣṭau //
meaning: ऊर्ध्वं पञ्च संचरेभ्यः / चतुर्णाम् इन्द्राग्नी रोचना \\ इत्य् अष्टौ //
text_mt: After the five communal oblations, for the four [remaining ones], "Indra and Agni, lights…" are the eight [verses].

sanskrit_iast: piprīhi devān \ agne yad adya \\ iti sviṣṭakṛtaḥ sam̐yājye /
meaning: पिप्रीहि देवान् \ अग्ने यद् अद्य \\ इति स्विष्टकृतः सम्̐याज्ये /
text_mt: "Please the gods…", "O Agni, what today…" are the two concluding offering verses of the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: avabhṛthe 'ṣṭau dhvānena carati /
meaning: अवभृथे ऽष्टौ ध्वानेन चरति /
text_mt: At the purificatory bath (avabhṛtha), he performs eight [offerings] with a low murmuring tone.

sanskrit_iast: prayājaprabhṛti yajati /
meaning: प्रयाजप्रभृति यजति /
text_mt: He sacrifices starting from the fore-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: barhiṣmantam udūhati //
meaning: बर्हिष्मन्तम् उदूहति //

sanskrit_iast: svāhāgnīvaruṇau hotārau \\ iti sviṣṭakṛtsthāne //
meaning: स्वाहाग्नीवरुणौ होतारौ \\ इति स्विष्टकृत्स्थाने //
text_mt: "Svāhā to Agni and Varuṇa, the two hotṛ priests…" in place of the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: apsv agne sadhiṣ ṭava \\ apsu me somas \\ ity apsumantāv ājyabhāgau //
meaning: अप्स्व् अग्ने सधिष् टव \\ अप्सु मे सोमस् \\ इत्य् अप्सुमन्ताव् आज्यभागौ //
text_mt: "In the waters, O Agni, is your seat…", "In the waters, for me, Soma…" are the two clarified butter portions containing the word 'waters' (apsumant).

sanskrit_iast: ud uttamam \ ava te heḍas \\ iti haviṣaḥ //
meaning: उद् उत्तमम् \ अव ते हेडस् \\ इति हविषः //
text_mt: "Highest…", "Loosen your anger…" are the two [verses] of the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: tvaṃ no agne \\ ity anūcya ye3 yajāmahe \\ agnīvaruṇau sviṣṭakṛtau \\ ayāṣṭām agnīvaruṇāv agneḥ priyā dhāmāni \\ ayāṣṭām̐ somasya priyā dhāmāni \\ ayāṣṭām̐ varuṇasya priyā dhāmāni \\ ayāṣṭāṃ devānām ājyapānāṃ priyā dhāmāni \ yakṣato 'gnīvaruṇayor hotroḥ priyā dhāmāni \ yakṣataḥ svau mahimānau \\ āyajeyātām ejyā iṣaḥ \ kṛṇutāṃ tāv adhvarā jātavedasau \ juṣetām̐ haviḥ \ sa tvaṃ nas \\ iti yajati /
meaning: त्वं नो अग्ने \\ इत्य् अनूच्य ये3 यजामहे \\ अग्नीवरुणौ स्विष्टकृतौ \\ अयाष्टाम् अग्नीवरुणाव् अग्नेः प्रिया धामानि \\ अयाष्टाम्̐ सोमस्य प्रिया धामानि \\ अयाष्टाम्̐ वरुणस्य प्रिया धामानि \\ अयाष्टां देवानाम् आज्यपानां प्रिया धामानि \ यक्षतो ऽग्नीवरुणयोर् होत्रोः प्रिया धामानि \ यक्षतः स्वौ महिमानौ \\ आयजेयाताम् एज्या इषः \ कृणुतां ताव् अध्वरा जातवेदसौ \ जुषेताम्̐ हविः \ स त्वं नस् \\ इति यजति /
text_mt: Having recited: "You to us, O Agni…", he makes the offering saying: "We who sacrifice… Agni and Varuṇa, the two Sviṣṭakṛt deities. Agni and Varuṇa have sacrificed to Agni's dear dwellings; they have sacrificed to Soma's dear dwellings; they have sacrificed to Varuṇa's dear dwellings; they have sacrificed to the dear dwellings of the gods who drink clarified butter. May they two sacrifice to the dear dwellings of the hotṛ offices of Agni and Varuṇa; may they sacrifice to their own two greatnesses. May the two obtain by sacrifice refreshing foods to be obtained by sacrifice; may those two Jātavedases make the sacrificial rites; may they enjoy the oblation. So you to us…".

sanskrit_iast: sākamedheṣu \\ agnir vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanad iti ṣaḍ anīkavatasyaiṣa eva mṛte kalpaḥ /
meaning: साकमेधेषु \\ अग्निर् वृत्राणि जङ्घनद् इति षड् अनीकवतस्यैष एव मृते कल्पः /
text_mt: In the Sākamedha rites, "Agni will slay the Vṛtras…" are the six [verses] for [Agni] Anīkavat; this very ritual procedure applies, except [for what is noted].

sanskrit_iast: sāṃtapanasyottare haviṣaḥ //
meaning: सांतपनस्योत्तरे हविषः //
text_mt: The two subsequent [verses] of the oblation are for [the Maruts] Sāṃtapana.

sanskrit_iast: agniḥ pratnena manmanā \\ iti ṣaḍ gṛhamedhīyasya /
meaning: अग्निः प्रत्नेन मन्मना \\ इति षड् गृहमेधीयस्य /
text_mt: "Agni by ancient thought…" are the six [verses] of the Gṛhamedhīya offering.

sanskrit_iast: ājyabhāgaprabhṛti yajati /
meaning: आज्यभागप्रभृति यजति /
text_mt: He sacrifices starting from the clarified butter portions.

sanskrit_iast: ṛcam anūcyarcā sviṣṭakṛtam /
meaning: ऋचम् अनूच्यर्चा स्विष्टकृतम् /
text_mt: Having recited a verse [as the invitatory verse], he performs the Sviṣṭakṛt offering with a verse [as the offering verse].

sanskrit_iast: iḍāntā saṃtiṣṭhate //
meaning: इडान्ता संतिष्ठते //

sanskrit_iast: agnim īḍe \\ iti ṣaṭ krīḍinasya /
meaning: अग्निम् ईडे \\ इति षट् क्रीडिनस्य /
text_mt: "I praise Agni…" are the six [verses] for [the Maruts] Krīḍin.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvakarmaṇāntānām̐ vārtraghnaḥ kalpaḥ /
meaning: वैश्वकर्मणान्तानाम्̐ वार्त्रघ्नः कल्पः /
text_mt: For [rites] ending with the Vaiśvakarmaṇa [offering], the ritual procedure is that relating to Vṛtra-slaying.

sanskrit_iast: agnipraṇayanaprabhṛti siddham̐ yathā varuṇapraghāseṣu /
meaning: अग्निप्रणयनप्रभृति सिद्धम्̐ यथा वरुणप्रघासेषु /
text_mt: From the bringing forward of the fire onward, it is established as in the Varuṇapraghāsa rites.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvaṃ pañca saṃcarebhya // indrāgnī navatim iti ṣaṭ trayāṇām /
meaning: ऊर्ध्वं पञ्च संचरेभ्य // इन्द्राग्नी नवतिम् इति षट् त्रयाणाम् /
text_mt: Above the five common [oblations], the six [verses] beginning with "Indra and Agni, ninety" belong to the three [oblations].

sanskrit_iast: pitṛyajñe \\ uśantas tvā havāmahe \\ ity ekām̐ sāmidhenīṃ trir anvāha //
meaning: पितृयज्ञे \\ उशन्तस् त्वा हवामहे \\ इत्य् एकाम्̐ सामिधेनीं त्रिर् अन्वाह //
text_mt: In the ancestral sacrifice, he recites the single kindling verse "Desiring thee, we summon" three times.

sanskrit_iast: agne mahaṃ asi brāhmaṇa bhārata mānuṣa \\ iti na pravṛṇīte //
meaning: अग्ने महं असि ब्राह्मण भारत मानुष \\ इति न प्रवृणीते //
text_mt: He does not choose [the hotṛ] with "Agni, thou art great, O brāhmaṇa, Bhārata, descendant of Manu."

sanskrit_iast: deveddho manviddhas \\ iti yathāmnātam //
meaning: देवेद्धो मन्विद्धस् \\ इति यथाम्नातम् //
text_mt: He recites "Kindled by the gods, kindled by Manu" as handed down [in the sacred text].

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ kavyavāhanam āvaha \\ iti sviṣṭakṛtpravāde kavyavāhanapravādaḥ /
meaning: अग्निं कव्यवाहनम् आवह \\ इति स्विष्टकृत्प्रवादे कव्यवाहनप्रवादः /
text_mt: Instead of the mention of Sviṣṭakṛt, there is mention of Kavyavāhana: "Bring hither Agni Kavyavāhana."

sanskrit_iast: apabarhiṣaḥ prayājānuyājān yajati //
meaning: अपबर्हिषः प्रयाजानुयाजान् यजति //
text_mt: He performs the fore-offerings and after-offerings without sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: ā no agne \ tvam̐ soma \\ iti jīvitavantāv ājyabhāgau /
meaning: आ नो अग्ने \ त्वम्̐ सोम \\ इति जीवितवन्ताव् आज्यभागौ /
text_mt: The two clarified butter portions contain [the word] "life": "Come to us, O Agni" [and] "Thou, O Soma."

sanskrit_iast: uttarā dvādaśa haviḥsviṣṭakṛtām //
meaning: उत्तरा द्वादश हविःस्विष्टकृताम् //
text_mt: The next twelve [verses] belong to the oblations and the Sviṣṭakṛt offerings.

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ pitṛbhyas \\ udīratām ity udūhyete /
meaning: इदं पितृभ्यस् \\ उदीरताम् इत्य् उदूह्येते /
text_mt: "This to the fathers" [and] "Let them arise" are transposed.

sanskrit_iast: dvedve puronuvākye /
meaning: द्वेद्वे पुरोनुवाक्ये /

sanskrit_iast: tāsām ṛcam adharmarcabhāgaṃ karoti /
meaning: तासाम् ऋचम् अधर्मर्चभागं करोति /
text_mt: Of them, he makes one verse a half-verse portion.

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīyayā yajati //
meaning: तृतीयया यजति //

sanskrit_iast: ye svadhāmahe \\ ity āgūḥ //
meaning: ये स्वधामहे \\ इत्य् आगूः //

sanskrit_iast: svadhā namas \\ iti vaṣaṭkaroti /
meaning: स्वधा नमस् \\ इति वषट्करोति /
text_mt: He utters the vaṣaṭ-call with "Svadhā, homage!"

sanskrit_iast: ādityasya paurṇamāsatantram //
meaning: आदित्यस्य पौर्णमासतन्त्रम् //
text_mt: For the [offering to] the Ādityas, the ritual framework is that of the full-moon sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: sutrāmāṇam \\ mahīm ū ṣu \\ ity upām̐śuhaviṣaḥ /
meaning: सुत्रामाणम् \\ महीम् ऊ षु \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शुहविषः /
text_mt: "The good protector" [and] "Indeed, the great [mother]" belong to the oblation [offered] in a whisper.

sanskrit_iast: śunāsīryam̐ vaiśvadevena vyākhyātam /
meaning: शुनासीर्यम्̐ वैश्वदेवेन व्याख्यातम् /
text_mt: The Śunāsīrīya is explained by the Vaiśvadeva.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvaṃ pañca saṃcarebhyaḥ // pra vāyum iti ṣaṭ trayāṇām /
meaning: ऊर्ध्वं पञ्च संचरेभ्यः // प्र वायुम् इति षट् त्रयाणाम् /
text_mt: Above the five common [oblations], the six [verses] beginning with "Forth to Vāyu" belong to the three [oblations].

sanskrit_iast: upām̐śudevatānām upām̐śudevatām ādiśati yājyānuvākye ca \\ ajuṣata \\ avīvṛdhata \\ akṛta \\ iti copām̐śuvāyavyāḥ /
meaning: उपाम्̐शुदेवतानाम् उपाम्̐शुदेवताम् आदिशति याज्यानुवाक्ये च \\ अजुषत \\ अवीवृधत \\ अकृत \\ इति चोपाम्̐शुवायव्याः /
text_mt: For the whisper deities, he designates the whisper deity and the two offering and invitatory verses; and "they enjoyed," "they increased," [and] "they made" belong to the whisper Vāyavya [offerings].

sanskrit_iast: kāmyā upām̐śudevatāḥ / tāsv ekadhanam anādiṣṭadakṣiṇāsu dadyāt /
meaning: काम्या उपाम्̐शुदेवताः / तास्व् एकधनम् अनादिष्टदक्षिणासु दद्यात् /
text_mt: The whisper deities belong to the desire-prompted rites. In those where no sacrificial gift is specified, he should give a single article of wealth.

sanskrit_iast: sāṃgrāmikīṣu vārtraghnaḥ kalpaḥ /
meaning: सांग्रामिकीषु वार्त्रघ्नः कल्पः /
text_mt: In the battle rites, the ritual procedure is that relating to Vṛtra-slaying.

sanskrit_iast: abhicaraṇīyāsu ca sa yadādīnāṃ prāyaścittikalpaḥ /
meaning: अभिचरणीयासु च स यदादीनां प्रायश्चित्तिकल्पः /
text_mt: And in the sorcery rites, the ritual procedure is the expiation [procedure] of the "He who..." [rites].

sanskrit_iast: grāmakāmabhūtikāmapaśukāmānām̐ rayimantāv ājyabhāgau /
meaning: ग्रामकामभूतिकामपशुकामानाम्̐ रयिमन्ताव् आज्यभागौ /
text_mt: For one desirous of a village, one desirous of prosperity, [and] one desirous of cattle, the two clarified butter portions contain [the word] "wealth".

sanskrit_iast: grāmakāmabhūtikāmayoḥ sam̐vatyau sam̐yājye sahasravatyau paśukāmasya /
meaning: ग्रामकामभूतिकामयोः सम्̐वत्यौ सम्̐याज्ये सहस्रवत्यौ पशुकामस्य /
text_mt: For one desirous of a village and one desirous of prosperity, the two concluding offering verses contain [the word] "together"; for one desirous of cattle, they contain [the word] "thousand".

sanskrit_iast: grāmakāmatantreṇaindrāgnena viyātsu viyāteṣu vā sajāteṣu yajeta /
meaning: ग्रामकामतन्त्रेणैन्द्राग्नेन वियात्सु वियातेषु वा सजातेषु यजेत /
text_mt: With the ritual framework for one desirous of a village, one should sacrifice with the [offering] to Indra-and-Agni when kinsmen are about to depart or have departed.

sanskrit_iast: tasyās \\ indrāgnī rocanā \\ iti dve haviṣaḥ /
meaning: तस्यास् \\ इन्द्राग्नी रोचना \\ इति द्वे हविषः /
text_mt: For this rite, the two [verses] "Indra and Agni, the bright realms" belong to the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: vārtraghnakalpena bhrātṛvyavān /
