meaning: वार्त्रघ्नकल्पेन भ्रातृव्यवान् /
text_mt: One who has a rival [sacrifices] according to the ritual procedure relating to Vṛtra-slaying.

sanskrit_iast: vārtraghnāv ājyabhāgau //
meaning: वार्त्रघ्नाव् आज्यभागौ //
text_mt: The two clarified butter portions relate to Vṛtra-slaying.

sanskrit_iast: indrāgnī navatim iti dve haviṣaḥ //
meaning: इन्द्राग्नी नवतिम् इति द्वे हविषः //
text_mt: The two [verses] "Indra and Agni, ninety" belong to the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: juṣṭo damūnā \ agne śardha \\ iti śardhavatyau sam̐yājye /
meaning: जुष्टो दमूना \ अग्ने शर्ध \\ इति शर्धवत्यौ सम्̐याज्ये /
text_mt: "Enjoyed, the dweller in the house" [and] "O Agni, strength" are the two concluding offering verses containing [the word] "strength".

sanskrit_iast: prajākāmasya vṛṣaṇvantāv ājyabhāgau //
meaning: प्रजाकामस्य वृषण्वन्ताव् आज्यभागौ //
text_mt: For one desirous of offspring, the two clarified butter portions contain [the word] "bull".

sanskrit_iast: pra vām arcanti \\ iti dve haviṣa / uttare sviṣṭakṛtaḥ /
meaning: प्र वाम् अर्चन्ति \\ इति द्वे हविष / उत्तरे स्विष्टकृतः /
text_mt: The two [verses] "They sing to you two" belong to the oblation; the two subsequent ones belong to the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: saṃgrāmam abhiprayān saṃgrāmasam̐yājye / sam̐yatyaitābhyām iṣṭvā vāniṣṭvā vā / jitvottarayā yajeta /
meaning: संग्रामम् अभिप्रयान् संग्रामसम्̐याज्ये / सम्̐यत्यैताभ्याम् इष्ट्वा वानिष्ट्वा वा / जित्वोत्तरया यजेत /
text_mt: When advancing toward battle, [he employs] the two concluding offering verses for battle; having joined [in battle], whether he has sacrificed with these two or not, having conquered he should sacrifice with the subsequent one.

sanskrit_iast: tasyās \\ indrāgnī rocanā \\ iti dve haviṣa / uttare pūrvayoḥ /
meaning: तस्यास् \\ इन्द्राग्नी रोचना \\ इति द्वे हविष / उत्तरे पूर्वयोः /
text_mt: For this [sacrifice], the two [verses] "Indra and Agni, the bright realms" belong to the oblation; the two subsequent ones are [the concluding verses] of the earlier two.

sanskrit_iast: paraṃ janapadam abhiprayān dvihaviṣā yajeta / yadi senayā vārtraghnaḥ kalpa / yadi janena grāmakāmaṃ tantram //
meaning: परं जनपदम् अभिप्रयान् द्विहविषा यजेत / यदि सेनया वार्त्रघ्नः कल्प / यदि जनेन ग्रामकामं तन्त्रम् //
text_mt: When setting out toward another country, he should sacrifice with a two-oblation [rite]; if with an army, the ritual procedure relates to Vṛtra-slaying; if with common people, the ritual framework is for one desirous of a village.

sanskrit_iast: yā vām̐ santi \\ iti dvihaviṣoś catasraḥ /
meaning: या वाम्̐ सन्ति \\ इति द्विहविषोश् चतस्रः /
text_mt: The four [verses] beginning with "Those which are yours" belong to the two oblations.

sanskrit_iast: kṣetram adhyavasyam̐s trihaviṣā yajeta /
meaning: क्षेत्रम् अध्यवस्यम्̐स् त्रिहविषा यजेत /
text_mt: When settling on a field, he should sacrifice with a three-oblation [rite].

sanskrit_iast: tasyā grāmakāmaṃ tantram //
meaning: तस्या ग्रामकामं तन्त्रम् //
text_mt: For this [sacrifice], the ritual framework is for one desirous of a village.

sanskrit_iast: yā vām̐ santi \\ iti ṣaḍḍhaviṣām //
meaning: या वाम्̐ सन्ति \\ इति षड्ढविषाम् //
text_mt: The six [verses] beginning with "Those which are yours" belong to the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: sam̐sam it \ sakhāyas \\ iti sam̐vatyau sam̐yājye /
meaning: सम्̐सम् इत् \ सखायस् \\ इति सम्̐वत्यौ सम्̐याज्ये /
text_mt: "Together indeed" [and] "Friends" are the two concluding offering verses containing [the word] "together".

sanskrit_iast: agnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet kāmāya sarvakāmāya /
meaning: अग्नये वैश्वानराय द्वादशकपालं निर्वपेत् कामाय सर्वकामाय /
text_mt: He should apportion a twelve-potsherd [cake] to Agni Vaiśvānara for a desire, for all desires.

sanskrit_iast: yathākāmaṃ tantram //
meaning: यथाकामं तन्त्रम् //

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvānaro na ūtyā \ pṛṣṭo divi \\ iti haviṣo / 'nāmnātayājyānuvākyānām ete vaiśvānarīyāṇām //
meaning: वैश्वानरो न ऊत्या \ पृष्टो दिवि \\ इति हविषो / ऽनाम्नातयाज्यानुवाक्यानाम् एते वैश्वानरीयाणाम् //
text_mt: "Vaiśvānara, for our protection" [and] "Touching the sky" belong to the oblation; these belong to the Vaiśvānara [oblations] whose offering and invitatory verses are not explicitly handed down.

sanskrit_iast: agnir mūrdhā \ bhuvo yajñasya \\ ity āgneyānām //
meaning: अग्निर् मूर्धा \ भुवो यज्ञस्य \\ इत्य् आग्नेयानाम् //
text_mt: "Agni is the head" [and] "Be of the sacrifice" belong to the offerings to Agni.

sanskrit_iast: agnīṣomā savedasā \ yuvam etāni \\ ity agnīṣomīyāṇām /
meaning: अग्नीषोमा सवेदसा \ युवम् एतानि \\ इत्य् अग्नीषोमीयाणाम् /
text_mt: "Agni and Soma, possessing possessions" [and] "You two, these" belong to the offerings to Agni-and-Soma.

sanskrit_iast: liṅgavatyo 'nyāsām /
meaning: लिङ्गवत्यो ऽन्यासाम् /

sanskrit_iast: arvāk kālāt saṃdhāv abhidhrokṣyan yajeta /
meaning: अर्वाक् कालात् संधाव् अभिध्रोक्ष्यन् यजेत /
text_mt: If he intends to violate an agreement before the appointed time, he should sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścittiḥ kalpaḥ /
meaning: प्रायश्चित्तिः कल्पः /

sanskrit_iast: sanim abhyutthāsyan yajeta /
meaning: सनिम् अभ्युत्थास्यन् यजेत /
text_mt: If he intends to rise up for the acquisition of gain, he should sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: rayimantāv ājyabhāgau //
meaning: रयिमन्ताव् आज्यभागौ //
text_mt: The two clarified butter portions contain [the word] "wealth".

sanskrit_iast: ṛtāvānam iti dve haviṣaḥ //
meaning: ऋतावानम् इति द्वे हविषः //
text_mt: The two [verses] beginning with "The righteous one" belong to the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: iḍām agne \ tvaṃ no agne \\ iti sanimatyau sam̐yājye /
meaning: इडाम् अग्ने \ त्वं नो अग्ने \\ इति सनिमत्यौ सम्̐याज्ये /
text_mt: "Refreshment, O Agni" [and] "Thou to us, O Agni" are the two concluding offering verses containing [the word] "gain".

sanskrit_iast: sa yadā vanvītāthottarayā yajeta /
meaning: स यदा वन्वीताथोत्तरया यजेत /
text_mt: When he has acquired [the gain], then he should sacrifice with the subsequent one.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ dviṣyāt tasmai sanim̐ sātāṃ gāṃ kaṇṭhabandham ekahāyanaṃ dadyāt //
meaning: यं द्विष्यात् तस्मै सनिम्̐ सातां गां कण्ठबन्धम् एकहायनं दद्यात् //
text_mt: To him whom he hates, he should give as a sacrificial gift a cow obtained [as gain], bound by the neck, one year old.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvānarasya \\ iti dve haviṣaḥ /
meaning: वैश्वानरस्य \\ इति द्वे हविषः /
text_mt: The two [verses] beginning with "Of Vaiśvānara" belong to the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: duṣṭam abhojyasya vānnam aśiṣyan yajeta /
meaning: दुष्टम् अभोज्यस्य वान्नम् अशिष्यन् यजेत /
text_mt: If he is about to eat food that is spoiled or unfit to be eaten, he should sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: sīsaṃ dakṣiṇā kṛṣṇam̐ vā vāsaḥ /
meaning: सीसं दक्षिणा कृष्णम्̐ वा वासः /
text_mt: The sacrificial gift is lead or a black garment.

sanskrit_iast: rakṣitavantāv ājyabhāgau //
meaning: रक्षितवन्ताव् आज्यभागौ //
text_mt: The two clarified butter portions contain [the word] "protector".

sanskrit_iast: viśvam̐ vivyāca \\ iti dve haviṣa / uttare sviṣṭakṛtaḥ /
meaning: विश्वम्̐ विव्याच \\ इति द्वे हविष / उत्तरे स्विष्टकृतः /
text_mt: "He encompassed all"—these two are for the oblation; the subsequent two are for the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: etayeṣṭvā vāniṣṭvā vā jagdhvottarayā yajeta /
meaning: एतयेष्ट्वा वानिष्ट्वा वा जग्ध्वोत्तरया यजेत /
text_mt: Having sacrificed with this, or without having sacrificed, having consumed [the food], one should sacrifice with the subsequent one.

sanskrit_iast: samānīya dakṣiṇā /
meaning: समानीय दक्षिणा /

sanskrit_iast: yājyānuvākye ca vyākhyāte /
meaning: याज्यानुवाक्ये च व्याख्याते /
text_mt: And the offering and invitatory verses are explained.

sanskrit_iast: tathā sāṃgrāmikyau ya iched ayam eva rājā syād yāvad imān yavān vrīhīn vādadhīyet /
meaning: तथा सांग्रामिक्यौ य इछेद् अयम् एव राजा स्याद् यावद् इमान् यवान् व्रीहीन् वादधीयेत् /
text_mt: Similarly the two battle rites: he who desires, 'May this one alone be king, as long as he should store these barleys or rices.'

sanskrit_iast: tasya ced aparo dhāveta vārtraghnaḥ kalpaḥ / yadi mṛtyor jīvitavān /
meaning: तस्य चेद् अपरो धावेत वार्त्रघ्नः कल्पः / यदि मृत्योर् जीवितवान् /
text_mt: If another should attack him, the ritual procedure is the Vṛtra-slaying one; if he has survived death, [the same].

sanskrit_iast: dvihavir āmayāvinaḥ /
meaning: द्विहविर् आमयाविनः /

sanskrit_iast: jīvitavantāv ājyabhāgau /
meaning: जीवितवन्ताव् आज्यभागौ /
text_mt: The two clarified butter portions contain [words denoting] 'life'.

sanskrit_iast: pārayadvatyau sam̐yājye /
meaning: पारयद्वत्यौ सम्̐याज्ये /
text_mt: The two concluding offering verses contain [the word] 'pārayat'.

sanskrit_iast: jīvitavān kalpaḥ /
meaning: जीवितवान् कल्पः /

sanskrit_iast: dvihavir bhūtikāmasya /
meaning: द्विहविर् भूतिकामस्य /
text_mt: A two-oblation rite is for one desiring prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: iyām̐ś caruḥ / prādeśamātram /
meaning: इयाम्̐श् चरुः / प्रादेशमात्रम् /
text_mt: This boiled oblation is the measure of a span.

sanskrit_iast: āmnātā haviṣām /
meaning: आम्नाता हविषाम् /

sanskrit_iast: sarvasvaṃ dattvāgnaye jātavedasa iti trihaviṣā yajeta /
meaning: सर्वस्वं दत्त्वाग्नये जातवेदस इति त्रिहविषा यजेत /
text_mt: Having given away all his possessions, one should sacrifice with a three-oblation rite to Agni Jātavedas.

sanskrit_iast: tasyāḥ paśukāmaṃ tantram //
meaning: तस्याः पशुकामं तन्त्रम् //
text_mt: Its ritual framework is that for one desiring cattle.

sanskrit_iast: ny agniṃ jātavedasam iti dvihaviṣoś catasraḥ /
meaning: न्य् अग्निं जातवेदसम् इति द्विहविषोश् चतस्रः /
text_mt: "Down [bring] Agni Jātavedas": [these are] the four [verses] for the two oblations.

sanskrit_iast: āmnāte vaiśvānarīyasya /
meaning: आम्नाते वैश्वानरीयस्य /
text_mt: [The verses] for the Vaiśvānara [oblation] have been handed down by tradition.

sanskrit_iast: abhiśasyamānasya /
meaning: अभिशस्यमानस्य /

sanskrit_iast: upavatsv aśanaṃ bhuktvā sam̐srave grāmasya purastād vāgyato vasati /
meaning: उपवत्स्व् अशनं भुक्त्वा सम्̐स्रवे ग्रामस्य पुरस्ताद् वाग्यतो वसति /
text_mt: Having eaten fasting food during the fasting days, he stays, restrained in speech, in the confluent waters [or water gathering] in front of the village.

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte 'gnim̐ samāropya mathitvā yajñāyudhair anvetyāgnaye surabhimate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet /
meaning: श्वोभूते ऽग्निम्̐ समारोप्य मथित्वा यज्ञायुधैर् अन्वेत्याग्नये सुरभिमते ऽष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत् /
text_mt: On the next day, having mounted the fire [into the kindling sticks], having churned it out, and having accompanied it with the sacrificial utensils, he should apportion an eight-potsherd [cake] to fragrant Agni.

sanskrit_iast: rakṣitavantāv ājyabhāgau //
meaning: रक्षितवन्ताव् आज्यभागौ //
text_mt: The two clarified butter portions contain [words denoting] 'guarding'.

sanskrit_iast: dve haviṣa / uttare sviṣṭakṛtaḥ /
meaning: द्वे हविष / उत्तरे स्विष्टकृतः /
text_mt: Two [verses] are for the oblation; the subsequent two are for the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye pavamānāyeti trihaviṣā gṛhān etya yajeta /
meaning: अग्नये पवमानायेति त्रिहविषा गृहान् एत्य यजेत /
text_mt: Having come to the house, he should sacrifice with a three-oblation rite to Agni Pavamāna.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścittiḥ kalpaḥ /
meaning: प्रायश्चित्तिः कल्पः /

sanskrit_iast: āmnātā haviṣām /
meaning: आम्नाता हविषाम् /

sanskrit_iast: āgneyam aṣṭākapālam iti trihaviṣā /
meaning: आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालम् इति त्रिहविषा /
text_mt: "An eight-potsherd cake to Agni": [he sacrifices] with a three-oblation rite.

sanskrit_iast: āmnātaḥ kāmaḥ /
meaning: आम्नातः कामः /

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ parajanapadāt senayābhinirjitya harati sa nṛjyāyaṃ jitvottarayā yajeta /
meaning: यः परजनपदात् सेनयाभिनिर्जित्य हरति स नृज्यायं जित्वोत्तरया यजेत /
text_mt: He who, having conquered [the enemy] from a foreign territory by means of an army, carries off [booty], having won superiority over men, should sacrifice with the subsequent [offering].

sanskrit_iast: tasyāṃ mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca nas \\ ghṛtavatī bhuvanānām iti dyāvāpṛthivīyasya /
meaning: तस्यां मही द्यौः पृथिवी च नस् \\ घृतवती भुवनानाम् इति द्यावापृथिवीयस्य /
text_mt: In it: "Great Heaven and Earth for us", "Possessing clarified butter, of the creatures" are for that to Heaven and Earth.

sanskrit_iast: agnīṣomīyam ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvaped brāhmaṇaḥ kāmāya sarvakāmāya /
meaning: अग्नीषोमीयम् एकादशकपालं निर्वपेद् ब्राह्मणः कामाय सर्वकामाय /
text_mt: A brahmin desiring any wish should apportion an eleven-potsherd [cake] to Agni-Soma.

sanskrit_iast: yathākāmaṃ tantram /
meaning: यथाकामं तन्त्रम् /

sanskrit_iast: uttarā bhūtikāmasya /
meaning: उत्तरा भूतिकामस्य /

sanskrit_iast: agnīṣomīyam ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapec chyāmākam̐ vasantā brahmavarcasakāmaḥ /
meaning: अग्नीषोमीयम् एकादशकपालं निर्वपेच् छ्यामाकम्̐ वसन्ता ब्रह्मवर्चसकामः /
text_mt: One desiring spiritual luster should apportion an eleven-potsherd [cake] of wild millet to Agni-Soma in spring.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthupājāstam̐ sabādhas \\ iti ṣaḍ dhāyyāḥ / ṣaḍ uttarā ājyabhāgahaviḥsviṣṭakṛtām /
meaning: पृथुपाजास्तम्̐ सबाधस् \\ इति षड् धाय्याः / षड् उत्तरा आज्यभागहविःस्विष्टकृताम् /
text_mt: "Of broad splendor", "With distress": [these are] the six insertion verses; the six subsequent ones are for the clarified butter portions, the oblation, and the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: saumāpauṣṇaṃ caruṃ nirvaped ardhapiṣṭaṃ paśukāmaḥ //
meaning: सौमापौष्णं चरुं निर्वपेद् अर्धपिष्टं पशुकामः //
text_mt: One desiring cattle should apportion a boiled oblation of half-ground [grains] to Soma-Pūṣan.

sanskrit_iast: somāpūṣaṇā \\ iti dve haviṣaḥ //
meaning: सोमापूषणा \\ इति द्वे हविषः //
text_mt: "O Soma and Pūṣan": these two are for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: uta no brahman \ nū no rāsva \\ iti sahasravatyau sam̐yājye /
meaning: उत नो ब्रह्मन् \ नू नो रास्व \\ इति सहस्रवत्यौ सम्̐याज्ये /
text_mt: "And to us, O Brahman", "Now give to us": these two concluding offering verses contain [the word] 'thousand'.

sanskrit_iast: saumendraṃ caruṃ nirvapet purodhākāmaḥ /
meaning: सौमेन्द्रं चरुं निर्वपेत् पुरोधाकामः /
text_mt: One desiring the office of domestic priest should apportion a boiled oblation to Soma-Indra.

sanskrit_iast: tasyā grāmakāmaṃ tantram //
meaning: तस्या ग्रामकामं तन्त्रम् //
text_mt: Its ritual framework is that for one desiring a village.

sanskrit_iast: tvā yujā tava tat soma \\ iti dve haviṣaḥ /
meaning: त्वा युजा तव तत् सोम \\ इति द्वे हविषः /
text_mt: "With you as ally", "That of yours, O Soma": these two are for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: āgnivāruṇaṃ caruṃ nirvapet samāntam abhidruhyāmayāvī vā /
meaning: आग्निवारुणं चरुं निर्वपेत् समान्तम् अभिद्रुह्यामयावी वा /
text_mt: One who is chronically ill or having plotted against an enemy for a full year should apportion a boiled oblation to Agni-Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: yathākāmaṃ tantram //
meaning: यथाकामं तन्त्रम् //

sanskrit_iast: tvaṃ no agne \ sa tvaṃ no agne \\ iti haviṣaḥ /
meaning: त्वं नो अग्ने \ स त्वं नो अग्ने \\ इति हविषः /
text_mt: "You to us, O Agni", "So you to us, O Agni": these are for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: saumāraudraṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapec chuklānām̐ vrīhīṇāṃ prādeśamātraṃ brahmavarcasakāmaḥ /
meaning: सौमारौद्रं घृते चरुं निर्वपेच् छुक्लानाम्̐ व्रीहीणां प्रादेशमात्रं ब्रह्मवर्चसकामः /
text_mt: One desiring spiritual luster should apportion a boiled oblation of white rice in clarified butter, the measure of a span, to Soma-Rudra.

sanskrit_iast: śvetānāṃ gavām ājyam /
meaning: श्वेतानां गवाम् आज्यम् /

sanskrit_iast: taiṣyāṃ paurṇamāsyām̐ yajeta /
meaning: तैष्यां पौर्णमास्याम्̐ यजेत /
text_mt: One should sacrifice on the full-moon day in the month of Taiṣa.

sanskrit_iast: nāsya tām̐ rātrīm apo gṛhān prahareyuḥ /
meaning: नास्य ताम्̐ रात्रीम् अपो गृहान् प्रहरेयुः /
text_mt: They should not carry water to his house during that night.

sanskrit_iast: ājyasyodakārthān kurvantīṣṭyām agnihotre ca /
meaning: आज्यस्योदकार्थान् कुर्वन्तीष्ट्याम् अग्निहोत्रे च /
text_mt: They perform the functions of water with clarified butter, in the sacrifice and in the Agnihotra.

sanskrit_iast: pariśrityodyatsu raśmiṣu pracarati //
meaning: परिश्रित्योद्यत्सु रश्मिषु प्रचरति //
text_mt: Having enclosed [the space], he proceeds when the [sun's] rays are rising.

sanskrit_iast: agnim̐ vaḥ pūrvyaṃ girā \ makṣū devavatas \\ iti manor ṛcaḥ ṣaḍdhāyyāḥ /
meaning: अग्निम्̐ वः पूर्व्यं गिरा \ मक्षू देववतस् \\ इति मनोर् ऋचः षड्धाय्याः /
text_mt: "Agni to you, the first, with song", "Quickly, of him who has gods": these verses of Manu are the six insertion verses.

sanskrit_iast: vārtraghnāv ājyabhāgau //
meaning: वार्त्रघ्नाव् आज्यभागौ //
text_mt: The two clarified butter portions are Vṛtra-slaying.

sanskrit_iast: somārudrā yuvam iti dve haviṣaḥ /
meaning: सोमारुद्रा युवम् इति द्वे हविषः /
text_mt: "O Soma and Rudra, you two": these two are for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatryau sam̐yājye /
meaning: गायत्र्यौ सम्̐याज्ये /

sanskrit_iast: sadyaḥ saumāpauṣṇena yajetāntataḥ paurṇamāsyā /
meaning: सद्यः सौमापौष्णेन यजेतान्ततः पौर्णमास्या /
text_mt: One should sacrifice on the same day with the offering to Soma-Pūṣan at the end of the full-moon sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: saumāraudraṃ caruṃ nirvapet kṛṣṇānām̐ vrīhīṇām abhicaran /
meaning: सौमारौद्रं चरुं निर्वपेत् कृष्णानाम्̐ व्रीहीणाम् अभिचरन् /
text_mt: Practicing sorcery, one should apportion a boiled oblation of black rice to Soma-Rudra.

sanskrit_iast: śaramayaṃ barhir vaibhīdaka idhmaḥ //
meaning: शरमयं बर्हिर् वैभीदक इध्मः //
text_mt: The sacrificial grass is made of reed; the sacrificial fuel is of Vibhīdaka wood.

sanskrit_iast: somārudrā vivṛhatam iti dve haviṣaḥ /
meaning: सोमारुद्रा विवृहतम् इति द्वे हविषः /
text_mt: The two [verses] beginning 'O Soma and Rudra, tear away' are for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: saumāraudraṃ caruṃ nirvapet kṛṣṇaśuklānām̐ vrīhīṇām̐ yaḥ kāmayeta dvitīyo 'sya sapatno viṣaye syād iti /
meaning: सौमारौद्रं चरुं निर्वपेत् कृष्णशुक्लानाम्̐ व्रीहीणाम्̐ यः कामयेत द्वितीयो ऽस्य सपत्नो विषये स्याद् इति /
text_mt: One should apportion a boiled oblation to Soma and Rudra of black and white rice for one who desires, 'May a second rival of his be in the realm.'

sanskrit_iast: ardham̐ śaramayaṃ barhir bhavaty ardho vaibhīdaka idhmaḥ /
meaning: अर्धम्̐ शरमयं बर्हिर् भवत्य् अर्धो वैभीदक इध्मः /
text_mt: Half of the sacrificial grass is made of reed; half of the sacrificial fuel is of bibhītaka wood.

sanskrit_iast: kṣīrotsikte śrapayati /
meaning: क्षीरोत्सिक्ते श्रपयति /
text_mt: He cooks [it] when milk is poured over it.

sanskrit_iast: saumāraudrīm āmikṣāṃ nirvapet /
meaning: सौमारौद्रीम् आमिक्षां निर्वपेत् /
text_mt: One should apportion a curd oblation to Soma and Rudra.

sanskrit_iast: āmayāvinam̐ yājayet /
meaning: आमयाविनम्̐ याजयेत् /

sanskrit_iast: jīvitavān kalpaḥ /
meaning: जीवितवान् कल्पः /

sanskrit_iast: sāmidhenīr anuvakṣyan hotā svapāṭhaḥ saṃmukhaṃ pariṇahyate / samāpte 'raṇyaṃ parāṇīya vidarśayet /
meaning: सामिधेनीर् अनुवक्ष्यन् होता स्वपाठः संमुखं परिणह्यते / समाप्ते ऽरण्यं पराणीय विदर्शयेत् /
text_mt: About to recite the kindling verses, the hotṛ priest, knowing his recitation well, ties himself up in front; when it is finished, having led him away into the forest, he should cause him to see [it].

sanskrit_iast: tasmā anaḍvāhaṃ dadyāt taṃ ghnīta tasyāśnīyād anneṣṭidakṣiṇā /
meaning: तस्मा अनड्वाहं दद्यात् तं घ्नीत तस्याश्नीयाद् अन्नेष्टिदक्षिणा /
text_mt: To him he should give an ox; he may slaughter it; he should eat of it; [this is] the sacrificial gift of the food-offering.

sanskrit_iast: āgnāvaiṣṇavam ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvaped abhicarann abhicaryamāṇo vā /
meaning: आग्नावैष्णवम् एकादशकपालं निर्वपेद् अभिचरन्न् अभिचर्यमाणो वा /
text_mt: One should apportion a sacrificial cake on eleven potsherds to Agni and Viṣṇu, practicing sorcery or when being targeted by sorcery.

sanskrit_iast: sarasvatīm apy ājyasya yajet /
meaning: सरस्वतीम् अप्य् आज्यस्य यजेत् /
text_mt: He should also sacrifice with clarified butter to Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast: abhicaryamāṇasya prāyaścittiḥ kalpo vārtraghno 'bhicarataḥ //
meaning: अभिचर्यमाणस्य प्रायश्चित्तिः कल्पो वार्त्रघ्नो ऽभिचरतः //
text_mt: For one targeted by sorcery, the ritual procedure is the expiation; for one practicing sorcery, [it is] the vārtraghna.

sanskrit_iast: agnāviṣṇū sajoṣasā \\ agnāviṣṇū mahi dhāma priyam̐ vām ity āgnāvaiṣṇavasya // pāvakā naḥ sarasvatī \ sarasvaty abhi no neṣi vasyas \\ iti sārasvatasya /
meaning: अग्नाविष्णू सजोषसा \\ अग्नाविष्णू महि धाम प्रियम्̐ वाम् इत्य् आग्नावैष्णवस्य // पावका नः सरस्वती \ सरस्वत्य् अभि नो नेषि वस्यस् \\ इति सारस्वतस्य /
text_mt: 'O Agni and Viṣṇu, in harmony', 'O Agni and Viṣṇu, your great dear abode'—these are for the [oblation] to Agni and Viṣṇu; 'Purifying us, Sarasvatī', 'O Sarasvatī, lead us to greater fortune'—these are for the [oblation] to Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast: cakṣuṣkāmasya viśvavantāv ājyabhāgau /
meaning: चक्षुष्कामस्य विश्ववन्ताव् आज्यभागौ /
text_mt: For one desiring sight, the two clarified butter portions contain the word viśva.

sanskrit_iast: virājau sam̐yājye /
meaning: विराजौ सम्̐याज्ये /

sanskrit_iast: śatamāno dakṣiṇā /
meaning: शतमानो दक्षिणा /

sanskrit_iast: āgnāvaiṣṇavam ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvaped abhicaryamāṇasya vyākhyātāḥ /
meaning: आग्नावैष्णवम् एकादशकपालं निर्वपेद् अभिचर्यमाणस्य व्याख्याताः /
text_mt: [The rules for] one who should apportion [a cake] on eleven potsherds to Agni and Viṣṇu when targeted by sorcery have been explained.

sanskrit_iast: tathā sāṃgrāmikīm̐ yadi manyeta prati purastāc carantīti \\ agnāviṣṇū sajoṣasā \\ iti tisraḥ / tāsāṃ dve puronuvākye kuryād ekām̐ yājyāṃ tathā sārasvatasya /
meaning: तथा सांग्रामिकीम्̐ यदि मन्येत प्रति पुरस्ताच् चरन्तीति \\ अग्नाविष्णू सजोषसा \\ इति तिस्रः / तासां द्वे पुरोनुवाक्ये कुर्याद् एकाम्̐ याज्यां तथा सारस्वतस्य /
text_mt: Likewise [the rite] concerning battle; if he should think: 'They are approaching from the front', [there are] three verses beginning 'O Agni and Viṣṇu, in harmony'; of them he should make two invitatory verses and one offering verse; likewise for the [oblation] to Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast: āgnāvaiṣṇavaṃ prātaraṣṭākapālam ity adhvarakalpāhnaḥ kāleṣu / pṛthaktantrānūbandhyākāle maitrāvaruṇa ekakapālaḥ payasyā vā /
meaning: आग्नावैष्णवं प्रातरष्टाकपालम् इत्य् अध्वरकल्पाह्नः कालेषु / पृथक्तन्त्रानूबन्ध्याकाले मैत्रावरुण एककपालः पयस्या वा /
text_mt: The [cake] on eight potsherds to Agni and Viṣṇu in the morning, [this is] during the times of the adhvarakalpa day; [there is] a separate ritual framework: at the time of the anūbandhyā cow, [a cake] on one potsherd to Mitra and Varuṇa, or a curd offering.

sanskrit_iast: yasya bhrātṛvyaḥ somena yajeta sutyādhvarakalpam̐ saṃdadhyāt /
meaning: यस्य भ्रातृव्यः सोमेन यजेत सुत्याध्वरकल्पम्̐ संदध्यात् /
text_mt: He whose rival sacrifices with Soma should connect the soma-pressing day with the adhvarakalpa.

sanskrit_iast: vārtraghnaḥ kalpaḥ /
meaning: वार्त्रघ्नः कल्पः /

sanskrit_iast: āgnāvaiṣṇavasyāmnāte / tathā sārasvatasya //
meaning: आग्नावैष्णवस्याम्नाते / तथा सारस्वतस्य //
text_mt: The two [verses] for the [oblation] to Agni and Viṣṇu are traditionally handed down; likewise for the [oblation] to Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspate juṣasva nas \\ evā pitre \\ iti bārhaspatyasyottare maitrāvaruṇasya /
meaning: बृहस्पते जुषस्व नस् \\ एवा पित्रे \\ इति बार्हस्पत्यस्योत्तरे मैत्रावरुणस्य /
text_mt: 'O Bṛhaspati, take pleasure in us', 'Thus to the Father'—these are for the [oblation] to Bṛhaspati; the next two are for the [oblation] to Mitra and Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭame catasro nigadavyākhyātāḥ /
meaning: अष्टमे चतस्रो निगदव्याख्याताः /
text_mt: On the eighth, four [verses] are explained by recitation.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣṭikāmasya \\ aurvabhṛguvad \ āsavam iti dhāyye / ṣaḍ uttarā ājyabhāgahaviḥsviṣṭakṛtām /
meaning: वृष्टिकामस्य \\ और्वभृगुवद् \ आसवम् इति धाय्ये / षड् उत्तरा आज्यभागहविःस्विष्टकृताम् /
text_mt: For one desiring rain, 'Like Aurva and Bhṛgu', 'The pressing' are the two inserting verses; the next six are for the clarified butter portions, the oblation, and the Sviṣṭakṛt.

sanskrit_iast: mārutam adhiśritya prāk paryagnikaraṇāt priyaṅgave gomūtrasyāścotayet //
meaning: मारुतम् अधिश्रित्य प्राक् पर्यग्निकरणात् प्रियङ्गवे गोमूत्रस्याश्चोतयेत् //
text_mt: Having placed the [caru] to the Maruts on the fire, before carrying fire around it, he should sprinkle cow's urine on the panic-seed.

sanskrit_iast: priyā vo nāma \ śriyase \\ iti dve haviṣaḥ /
meaning: प्रिया वो नाम \ श्रियसे \\ इति द्वे हविषः /
text_mt: 'Dear are your names', 'For glory' are the two [verses] for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: trayodaśakapāle yadi gauḥ sā dakṣiṇā / yathākāmaṃ putrayoḥ /
meaning: त्रयोदशकपाले यदि गौः सा दक्षिणा / यथाकामं पुत्रयोः /
text_mt: In the case of the [cake] on thirteen potsherds, if there is a cow, that is the sacrificial gift; according to desire in the case of the two sons.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścittiḥ kalpaḥ //
meaning: प्रायश्चित्तिः कल्पः //

sanskrit_iast: maruto yad dha vo divaḥ \ praiṣām ajmeṣu \\ iti haviṣaḥ /
meaning: मरुतो यद् ध वो दिवः \ प्रैषाम् अज्मेषु \\ इति हविषः /
text_mt: 'O Maruts, whatever from heaven', 'In their courses forth' are for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: saptakapāle kayāśubhīyasyaikādaśa sāmidhenīḥ / triḥ prathamottame //
meaning: सप्तकपाले कयाशुभीयस्यैकादश सामिधेनीः / त्रिः प्रथमोत्तमे //
text_mt: In the case of the [cake] on seven potsherds, there are eleven kindling verses of the Kayāśubhīya hymn; three times the first and the last.

sanskrit_iast: agnī rakṣām̐si sedhati \\ ity ājyabhāgau /
meaning: अग्नी रक्षाम्̐सि सेधति \\ इत्य् आज्यभागौ /
text_mt: 'Agni drives away the demons'—[with this verse and its companion are] the two clarified butter portions.

sanskrit_iast: catasro 'tiśiṣṭā haviḥsviṣṭakṛtām /
meaning: चतस्रो ऽतिशिष्टा हविःस्विष्टकृताम् /
text_mt: The remaining four are for the oblation and the Sviṣṭakṛt.

sanskrit_iast: aindram ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapen mārutam̐ saptakapālam̐ rājanyaṃ bhūtikāmam̐ yājayet //
meaning: ऐन्द्रम् एकादशकपालं निर्वपेन् मारुतम्̐ सप्तकपालम्̐ राजन्यं भूतिकामम्̐ याजयेत् //
text_mt: One should apportion [a cake] on eleven potsherds to Indra and [a cake] on seven potsherds to the Maruts; he should sacrifice for a noble who desires prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: indram̐ vo viśvatas pari \\ ā te śuṣmas \\ ity aindrasyottare mārutasya /
meaning: इन्द्रम्̐ वो विश्वतस् परि \\ आ ते शुष्मस् \\ इत्य् ऐन्द्रस्योत्तरे मारुतस्य /
text_mt: 'Indra from all sides for you', 'Unto you your strength'—these are for the [oblation] to Indra; the next two are for that to the Maruts.

sanskrit_iast: aindram ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapen mārutam̐ saptakapālam̐ yaḥ kāmayeta viṭ ca kṣatraṃ ca samāsādyeyātām iti /
meaning: ऐन्द्रम् एकादशकपालं निर्वपेन् मारुतम्̐ सप्तकपालम्̐ यः कामयेत विट् च क्षत्रं च समासाद्येयाताम् इति /
text_mt: One should apportion [a cake] on eleven potsherds to Indra and [a cake] on seven potsherds to the Maruts for one who desires, 'May the people and the nobility come into agreement.'

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayetāturmuhyam̐ syād iti haviṣī āsādya pūrvārdhe 'nyāṃ grāmasya gām apākuryāt paścārdhe 'nyām api / te saṃgachete /
meaning: यदि कामयेतातुर्मुह्यम्̐ स्याद् इति हविषी आसाद्य पूर्वार्धे ऽन्यां ग्रामस्य गाम् अपाकुर्यात् पश्चार्धे ऽन्याम् अपि / ते संगछेते /
text_mt: If he desires: 'May there be mutual infatuation', having set down the two oblations, he should drive away one cow to the eastern part of the village and another also to the western part; let them meet together.

sanskrit_iast: vārtraghnaḥ kalpaḥ /
meaning: वार्त्रघ्नः कल्पः /

sanskrit_iast: aindrasyāvadāya \\ indrāyānubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati //
meaning: ऐन्द्रस्यावदाय \\ इन्द्रायानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति //
text_mt: Having cut off a portion of the [cake] to Indra, he causes [the hotṛ] to recite: 'Recite [the invitatory verse] for Indra.'

sanskrit_iast: ā tū na indra \\ ity anvāha /
meaning: आ तू न इन्द्र \\ इत्य् अन्वाह /

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya maruto yaja \\ iti preṣyati //
meaning: आश्राव्य मरुतो यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति //
text_mt: Having caused to call out, he issues the call: 'Sacrifice to the Maruts.'

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣṭayo vo marutas \\ iti yajati /
meaning: ऋष्टयो वो मरुतस् \\ इति यजति /
text_mt: He sacrifices with: 'Your spears, O Maruts.'

sanskrit_iast: mārutasyāvadāya marudbhyo 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati //
meaning: मारुतस्यावदाय मरुद्भ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति //
text_mt: Having cut off a portion of the [cake] to the Maruts, he causes [the hotṛ] to recite: 'Recite [the invitatory verse] for the Maruts.'

sanskrit_iast: maruto yad dha vo balam ity anvāha /
meaning: मरुतो यद् ध वो बलम् इत्य् अन्वाह /
text_mt: He recites: 'O Maruts, whatever is your strength.'

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya \\ indram̐ yaja \\ iti preṣyati //
meaning: आश्राव्य \\ इन्द्रम्̐ यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति //
text_mt: Having caused to call out, he issues the call: 'Sacrifice to Indra.'

sanskrit_iast: tvaṃ mahaṃ indra \\ iti yajati //
meaning: त्वं महं इन्द्र \\ इति यजति //
text_mt: He sacrifices with: 'You, O great Indra.'

sanskrit_iast: purutrā hi sadṛṅṅ asi \\ iti sam̐yājye /
meaning: पुरुत्रा हि सदृङ्ङ् असि \\ इति सम्̐याज्ये /
text_mt: 'For in many places you are uniform'—these two are the concluding offering verses.

sanskrit_iast: yathejyam upalakṣyate sviṣṭakṛti sūktavāke ca /
meaning: यथेज्यम् उपलक्ष्यते स्विष्टकृति सूक्तवाके च /
text_mt: In the Sviṣṭakṛt and in the sūktavāka recitation, it is indicated according to what is sacrificed.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayeta kalpetety ete eva haviṣī nirupya yathāyatham̐ yajet / kalpate 'ha /
meaning: यदि कामयेत कल्पेतेत्य् एते एव हविषी निरुप्य यथायथम्̐ यजेत् / कल्पते ऽह /
text_mt: If he desires: 'May it succeed', having apportioned these same two oblations, he should sacrifice according to the proper order; indeed, it succeeds.

sanskrit_iast: aindram ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapen mārutam̐ saptakapālam abhicaran /
meaning: ऐन्द्रम् एकादशकपालं निर्वपेन् मारुतम्̐ सप्तकपालम् अभिचरन् /
text_mt: One should apportion [a cake] on eleven potsherds to Indra and [a cake] on seven potsherds to the Maruts, practicing sorcery.

sanskrit_iast: upariṣṭād aindrasyāvadyed aparyāvartayann adhastān mārutasya /
meaning: उपरिष्टाद् ऐन्द्रस्यावद्येद् अपर्यावर्तयन्न् अधस्तान् मारुतस्य /
text_mt: He should cut off a portion from the top of the [cake] to Indra without turning it over, and from the bottom of the [cake] to the Maruts.

sanskrit_iast: aindram ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapen mārutīm āmikṣām̐ rājanyaṃ grāmakāmam̐ yājayet /
meaning: ऐन्द्रम् एकादशकपालं निर्वपेन् मारुतीम् आमिक्षाम्̐ राजन्यं ग्रामकामम्̐ याजयेत् /
text_mt: One should apportion [a cake] on eleven potsherds to Indra and a curd oblation to the Maruts; he should sacrifice for a noble who desires a village.

sanskrit_iast: pātryām̐ vyuduhyāmikṣāmadhye puroḍāśaṃ nidhāya samavadāya pracarati //
meaning: पात्र्याम्̐ व्युदुह्यामिक्षामध्ये पुरोडाशं निधाय समवदाय प्रचरति //
text_mt: Having pushed aside [the curd] in the vessel and placed the sacrificial cake in the middle of the curd oblation, he cuts off together and proceeds.

sanskrit_iast: indramarudbhyo 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
meaning: इन्द्रमरुद्भ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: He causes [the hotṛ] to recite: 'Recite [the invitatory verse] for Indra and the Maruts.'

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya \\ indramaruto yaja \\ iti preṣyati /
meaning: आश्राव्य \\ इन्द्रमरुतो यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Having caused to call out, he issues the call: 'Sacrifice to Indra and the Maruts.'

sanskrit_iast: aindrāmārutyau yājyānuvākye /
meaning: ऐन्द्रामारुत्यौ याज्यानुवाक्ये /
text_mt: The offering verse and invitatory verse are addressed to Indra and the Maruts.

sanskrit_iast: mārutam ekavim̐śatikapālaṃ nirvaped abhicaran /
meaning: मारुतम् एकविम्̐शतिकपालं निर्वपेद् अभिचरन् /
text_mt: One should apportion [a cake] on twenty-one potsherds to the Maruts, practicing sorcery.

sanskrit_iast: ājyabhāgābhyāṃ pracarya barhiṣi puroḍāśaṃ nidhāya sphyena \\ idam aham amuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasya \\ iti sphyena prāñcam̐ saṃbhinatti //
meaning: आज्यभागाभ्यां प्रचर्य बर्हिषि पुरोडाशं निधाय स्फ्येन \\ इदम् अहम् अमुष्यामुष्यायणस्य \\ इति स्फ्येन प्राञ्चम्̐ संभिनत्ति //
text_mt: Having proceeded with the two clarified butter portions, having placed the sacrificial cake on the sacrificial grass, he cleaves it forwards with the wooden sword, saying: 'Here I, of such and such lineage, [cleave] such and such.'

sanskrit_iast: enā vyāghram iti sphyam̐ sam̐stauti /
meaning: एना व्याघ्रम् इति स्फ्यम्̐ सम्̐स्तौति /
text_mt: He praises the wooden sword with: 'With this, a tiger.'

sanskrit_iast: kālātipattau pāthikṛtī paśau darśapūrṇamāsayoś cāturmāsyaparvasu navāśane vāgrāyaṇasya /
meaning: कालातिपत्तौ पाथिकृती पशौ दर्शपूर्णमासयोश् चातुर्मास्यपर्वसु नवाशने वाग्रायणस्य /
text_mt: In the case of a lapse of time, the [two cakes] for Pathikṛt [are offered] in the animal sacrifice, in the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices, in the seasonal sacrifices, or at the first-fruits sacrifice in the eating of new grain.

sanskrit_iast: vrātapatyakāmāśruṣu vrātapatī /
meaning: व्रातपत्यकामाश्रुषु व्रातपती /
text_mt: For those desiring chieftainship of a troop or those who are disobedient, the offering is to the lord of troops.

sanskrit_iast: catasṛṇāṃ prāyaścittiḥ kalpo vārtraghnas tisṛṇām //
meaning: चतसृणां प्रायश्चित्तिः कल्पो वार्त्रघ्नस् तिसृणाम् //
text_mt: The ritual procedure for the four [oblations] is the expiatory one; for the three, it is the Vṛtra-slaying one.

sanskrit_iast: agne naya \\ iti ṣoḍaśa haviṣām /
meaning: अग्ने नय \\ इति षोडश हविषाम् /
text_mt: "O Agni, lead": [these] sixteen are for the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇum apyājyasya yajet /
meaning: विष्णुम् अप्याज्यस्य यजेत् /
text_mt: He should sacrifice also to Viṣṇu with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye rudravate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvaped yaḥ kāmayetarudrāyāsya paśūn apidadhyād iti /
meaning: अग्नये रुद्रवते ऽष्टाकपालं निर्वपेद् यः कामयेतरुद्रायास्य पशून् अपिदध्याद् इति /
text_mt: He should apportion [a cake] on eight potsherds to Agni accompanied by Rudra, if he wishes: 'May he shut up his cattle for Rudra.'

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayeta śāmyed ity agnaye surabhimate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet /
meaning: यदि कामयेत शाम्येद् इत्य् अग्नये सुरभिमते ऽष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत् /
text_mt: If he wishes: 'May it be appeased,' he should apportion [a cake] on eight potsherds to Agni possessing fragrance.

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātam ājyabhāgahaviḥsviṣṭakṛtām /
meaning: व्याख्यातम् आज्यभागहविःस्विष्टकृताम् /
text_mt: The [mantras] for the clarified butter portions, the oblations, and the Sviṣṭakṛt offerings have been explained.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye 'nnavate 'nnādāyānnapataye 'ṣṭākapālam aṣṭākapālān vā /
meaning: अग्नये ऽन्नवते ऽन्नादायान्नपतये ऽष्टाकपालम् अष्टाकपालान् वा /
text_mt: [He should apportion a cake] on eight potsherds, or [three cakes each] on eight potsherds, to Agni possessing food, eating food, [and] the lord of food.

sanskrit_iast: vairājaḥ kalpaḥ //
meaning: वैराजः कल्पः //

sanskrit_iast: ukṣānnāya \ vātopadhūtas \\ iti haviṣaḥ /
meaning: उक्षान्नाय \ वातोपधूतस् \\ इति हविषः /
text_mt: "For him whose food is oxen" [and] "Blown upon by the wind" are the two [verses] for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye rakṣoghne 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvaped yo rakṣobhyo bibhīyāt /
meaning: अग्नये रक्षोघ्ने ऽष्टाकपालं निर्वपेद् यो रक्षोभ्यो बिभीयात् /
text_mt: He should apportion [a cake] on eight potsherds to Agni the slayer of Rakṣases, if he fears Rakṣases.

sanskrit_iast: naktam̐ yājayet //
meaning: नक्तम्̐ याजयेत् //

sanskrit_iast: kṛṇuṣva pājas \\ ity ekādaśa sāmidhenīḥ / triḥ prathamottame //
meaning: कृणुष्व पाजस् \\ इत्य् एकादश सामिधेनीः / त्रिः प्रथमोत्तमे //
text_mt: With "Display your strength" [there are] eleven kindling verses; three times the first and the last.

sanskrit_iast: agnī rakṣām̐si sedhati \\ ity ājyabhāgau /
meaning: अग्नी रक्षाम्̐सि सेधति \\ इत्य् आज्यभागौ /
text_mt: "Agni drives away the Rakṣases" are the two clarified butter portions.

sanskrit_iast: catasro 'tiśiṣṭā haviḥsviṣṭakṛtām /
meaning: चतस्रो ऽतिशिष्टा हविःस्विष्टकृताम् /
text_mt: The remaining four are for the oblation and the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvaped yo rāṣṭre spardhetānnādyakāmo vā /
meaning: आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपेद् यो राष्ट्रे स्पर्धेतान्नाद्यकामो वा /
text_mt: He should apportion [a cake] on eight potsherds to Agni, if he contends for a realm or is desirous of food.

sanskrit_iast: siddham āsādanāt //
meaning: सिद्धम् आसादनात् //

sanskrit_iast: ojo 'si \\ iti havīm̐ṣy āsannāny abhimṛśet /
meaning: ओजो ऽसि \\ इति हवीम्̐ष्य् आसन्नान्य् अभिमृशेत् /
text_mt: He should touch the placed oblations with: "You are vigour."

sanskrit_iast: etenaiva prāk sviṣṭakṛto juhoti //
meaning: एतेनैव प्राक् स्विष्टकृतो जुहोति //
text_mt: With this very [mantra] he offers before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: yukṣvā hi devahūtamān iti nava dhāyyāḥ / ṣaḍ uttarā ājyabhāgahaviḥsviṣṭakṛtām /
meaning: युक्ष्वा हि देवहूतमान् इति नव धाय्याः / षड् उत्तरा आज्यभागहविःस्विष्टकृताम् /
text_mt: "Harness indeed the best invoker of the gods" are the nine supplementary verses; the following six are for the clarified butter portions, the oblation, and the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: aindrābārhaspatyam̐ havir nirvaped yo rāṣṭrīyo na vijayeta /
meaning: ऐन्द्राबार्हस्पत्यम्̐ हविर् निर्वपेद् यो राष्ट्रीयो न विजयेत /
text_mt: He should apportion an oblation to Indra and Bṛhaspati, if he is an heir to a realm and does not conquer.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspataye nirupyendrāya sam̐skṛtyobhābhyāṃ pracaret /
meaning: बृहस्पतये निरुप्येन्द्राय सम्̐स्कृत्योभाभ्यां प्रचरेत् /
text_mt: Having apportioned for Bṛhaspati [and] having prepared for Indra, he should proceed with both.

sanskrit_iast: vārtraghnaḥ kalpaḥ //
meaning: वार्त्रघ्नः कल्पः //

sanskrit_iast: idam̐ vām āsye \\ iti dve haviṣaḥ /
meaning: इदम्̐ वाम् आस्ये \\ इति द्वे हविषः /
text_mt: "This in the mouth of both of you" are the two [verses] for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: ādityaṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapen niruddham̐ yājayet /
meaning: आदित्यं घृते चरुं निर्वपेन् निरुद्धम्̐ याजयेत् /
text_mt: He should apportion a boiled oblation in clarified butter to the Ādityas; he should make an expelled [king] sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā nirvapaṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ निर्वपणात् /

sanskrit_iast: purastāt sāvitrasya japet //
meaning: पुरस्तात् सावित्रस्य जपेत् //
text_mt: Before the Savitṛ formula he should murmur:

sanskrit_iast: ādityā bhāgam̐ vaḥ kariṣyāmy amum āmuṣyāyaṇam avagamayata \\ iti niruddhasya nāma gṛhṇīyāt /
meaning: आदित्या भागम्̐ वः करिष्याम्य् अमुम् आमुष्यायणम् अवगमयत \\ इति निरुद्धस्य नाम गृह्णीयात् /
text_mt: "O Ādityas, I will make a share for you; restore such-and-such, son of such-and-such"; he should speak the name of the expelled one.

sanskrit_iast: havīm̐ṣy āsādya saptāśvatthān mayūkhān antarvedi purastāt prakṣṇutān nidadhāti /
meaning: हवीम्̐ष्य् आसाद्य सप्ताश्वत्थान् मयूखान् अन्तर्वेदि पुरस्तात् प्रक्ष्णुतान् निदधाति /
text_mt: Having placed the oblations, he puts down inside the altar, in front, seven pegs of aśvattha wood, sharpened at the tip.

sanskrit_iast: tān sam̐sthite rathavāhanasya madhyameṣāyām atihanyāt //
meaning: तान् सम्̐स्थिते रथवाहनस्य मध्यमेषायाम् अतिहन्यात् //
text_mt: When [the sacrifice] is completed, he should drive them through into the middle pole of the chariot stand.

sanskrit_iast: idam aham ādityān badhnāmy āmuṣyāvagamas \\ iti niruddhasya nāma gṛhṇīyāt /
meaning: इदम् अहम् आदित्यान् बध्नाम्य् आमुष्यावगमस् \\ इति निरुद्धस्य नाम गृह्णीयात् /
text_mt: "Here I bind the Ādityas; let such-and-such return"; he should speak the name of the expelled one.

sanskrit_iast: yadi saptāhe nāvagached idhme mayūkhān upasaṃnahyaivaṃ dviḥ saptāhe saptāhe yajeta /
meaning: यदि सप्ताहे नावगछेद् इध्मे मयूखान् उपसंनह्यैवं द्विः सप्ताहे सप्ताहे यजेत /
text_mt: If he does not return in seven days, having tied the pegs to the sacrificial fuel, he should sacrifice thus every seven days for two seven-day periods.

sanskrit_iast: yadi prathame nāvagached uttarābhyām iṣṭvā dhārayadvatyā yajeta /
meaning: यदि प्रथमे नावगछेद् उत्तराभ्याम् इष्ट्वा धारयद्वत्या यजेत /
text_mt: If he does not return at the first, having sacrificed with the following two, he should sacrifice with the Dhārayadvatī [verse].

sanskrit_iast: yadi dvitīya uttarayā yajeta / yady uttame 'ntato dhārayadvatyā /
meaning: यदि द्वितीय उत्तरया यजेत / यद्य् उत्तमे ऽन्ततो धारयद्वत्या /
text_mt: If at the second, he should sacrifice with the following; if at the last, with the Dhārayadvatī at the end.

sanskrit_iast: dārśapaurṇamāsika idhme mayūkhān upasaṃnahyāpi vā \\ adite 'numanyasva \ satyāśīr iha manas \\ iti niruddhasya dakṣiṇāt padāt pām̐sūn apādadīta / tadyaḥ purastādgrāmyavādīva syāttasminsabhāyāmupapiṣṭe 'bhivātaṃ pām̐sūndhvam̐sayeyuḥ preta marutaḥ svatavasa enā viśpatyāmum̐ rājānamabhīti /
meaning: दार्शपौर्णमासिक इध्मे मयूखान् उपसंनह्यापि वा \\ अदिते ऽनुमन्यस्व \ सत्याशीर् इह मनस् \\ इति निरुद्धस्य दक्षिणात् पदात् पाम्̐सून् अपाददीत / तद्यः पुरस्ताद्ग्राम्यवादीव स्यात्तस्मिन्सभायामुपपिष्टे ऽभिवातं पाम्̐सून्ध्वम्̐सयेयुः प्रेत मरुतः स्वतवस एना विश्पत्यामुम्̐ राजानमभीति /
text_mt: Having tied the pegs to the sacrificial fuel of the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices, or rather: with "O Aditi, consent," "True is the wish, here the mind," he should take dust from the right foot of the expelled one. Then, whoever is like a village-pleader ahead of him—when he is crushed in the assembly, they should scatter the dust toward the wind with: "Go forth, Maruts of independent might, unto this people, unto such-and-such king."

sanskrit_iast: grāmyavādino gṛhād vrīhīn āhṛtya tredhā tān vicinuyād ye kṛṣṇās tān kṛṣṇājina upanahya nidadhyād ye śuklās tam ādityaṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapet /
meaning: ग्राम्यवादिनो गृहाद् व्रीहीन् आहृत्य त्रेधा तान् विचिनुयाद् ये कृष्णास् तान् कृष्णाजिन उपनह्य निदध्याद् ये शुक्लास् तम् आदित्यं घृते चरुं निर्वपेत् /
text_mt: Having brought rice from the house of the village-pleader, he should divide it into three: those that are black, he should tie up in a black antelope skin and put aside; those that are white, he should apportion as that boiled oblation in clarified butter to the Ādityas.

sanskrit_iast: ādityam̐ sam̐sthāpya yebhyo 'dhi vicinuyāt tān udaṅ paretya valmīkavapām udrujya yad adya te ghora āsan \\ iti juhoti /
meaning: आदित्यम्̐ सम्̐स्थाप्य येभ्यो ऽधि विचिनुयात् तान् उदङ् परेत्य वल्मीकवपाम् उद्रुज्य यद् अद्य ते घोर आसन् \\ इति जुहोति /
text_mt: Having completed the [offering to the] Ādityas, having gone north with those from which he separated [the white grains], having broken open the moist earth of an anthill, he offers with: "What terrible [poison] was in your mouth today."

sanskrit_iast: pratyetya vāruṇena yajetāntato dhārayadvatyā /
meaning: प्रत्येत्य वारुणेन यजेतान्ततो धारयद्वत्या /
text_mt: Having returned, he should sacrifice with the offering to Varuṇa, [and] with the Dhārayadvatī at the end.

sanskrit_iast: tāsām ehy ū ṣu bravāṇi te \\ imam̐ yajñam iti hūtavantāv ājyabhāgau //
meaning: तासाम् एह्य् ऊ षु ब्रवाणि ते \\ इमम्̐ यज्ञम् इति हूतवन्ताव् आज्यभागौ //
text_mt: For these [offerings], "Come well, let me speak to you" [and] "This sacrifice" are the two clarified butter portions containing an invitation.

sanskrit_iast: tyān nu kṣatriyān \ yebhyo mātā \\ iti haviṣaḥ /
meaning: त्यान् नु क्षत्रियान् \ येभ्यो माता \\ इति हविषः /
text_mt: "Those kṣatriyas now" [and] "To whom the mother" are the two [verses] for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: nitye sam̐yājye /
meaning: नित्ये सम्̐याज्ये /

sanskrit_iast: dhārayadvatyām̐ vārtraghnaḥ kalpaḥ //
meaning: धारयद्वत्याम्̐ वार्त्रघ्नः कल्पः //
text_mt: In the Dhārayadvatī [offering], the ritual procedure is the Vārtraghna.

sanskrit_iast: dhārayanta ādityāsas \\ iti dve haviṣaḥ /
meaning: धारयन्त आदित्यासस् \\ इति द्वे हविषः /
text_mt: "The Ādityas maintain" are the two [verses] for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: sauryaṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapec chuklānām̐ vrīhīṇāṃ brahmavarcasakāmaḥ /
meaning: सौर्यं घृते चरुं निर्वपेच् छुक्लानाम्̐ व्रीहीणां ब्रह्मवर्चसकामः /
text_mt: Desirous of spiritual brilliance, he should apportion a boiled oblation of white rice in clarified butter to Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast: udvāsayañ śātamānikau rukmau rājatam adhastāt kuryād dharitam upariṣṭāt /
meaning: उद्वासयञ् शातमानिकौ रुक्मौ राजतम् अधस्तात् कुर्याद् धरितम् उपरिष्टात् /
text_mt: Taking it off the fire, he should put two hundred-māna gold plates, a silver one underneath and a golden one above.

sanskrit_iast: prayājeprayāje triyavaṃ kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti /
meaning: प्रयाजेप्रयाजे त्रियवं कृष्णलं जुहोति /
text_mt: At each fore-offering he offers a three-barleycorn piece of gold.

sanskrit_iast: saumāraudraṃ tantram //
meaning: सौमारौद्रं तन्त्रम् //

sanskrit_iast: tat sūryasya \ bhadrā aśvās \\ iti haviṣaḥ /
meaning: तत् सूर्यस्य \ भद्रा अश्वास् \\ इति हविषः /
text_mt: "That of Sūrya" [and] "Auspicious are the horses" are the two [verses] for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: śatakṛṣṇalāyāṃ catvāricatvāri kṛṣṇalāny avadānam ekaṃ prāśitram ekam avāntareḍā /
meaning: शतकृष्णलायां चत्वारिचत्वारि कृष्णलान्य् अवदानम् एकं प्राशित्रम् एकम् अवान्तरेडा /
text_mt: In the [offering] of a hundred pieces of gold, the cutting consists of four pieces of gold each: one is the priest's portion, one the intermediate iḍā.

sanskrit_iast: caruṃ brahmaṇe pariharati /
meaning: चरुं ब्रह्मणे परिहरति /
text_mt: He hands the boiled oblation around to the brahman priest.

sanskrit_iast: niścūṣya bhakṣān upayachanti /
meaning: निश्चूष्य भक्षान् उपयछन्ति /
text_mt: Having sucked them clean, they hold the consumable portions.

sanskrit_iast: jīvitavān kalpaḥ //
meaning: जीवितवान् कल्पः //

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyagarbhas \\ yaḥ prāṇatas \\ iti haviṣaḥ /
meaning: हिरण्यगर्भस् \\ यः प्राणतस् \\ इति हविषः /
text_mt: "The Golden Germ" [and] "Who by his breath" are the two [verses] for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: bārhaspatyaṃ caruṃ nirvapet purodhākāmaḥ /
meaning: बार्हस्पत्यं चरुं निर्वपेत् पुरोधाकामः /
text_mt: Desirous of the office of domestic priest, he should apportion a boiled oblation to Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: tasyā grāmakāmaṃ tantram /
meaning: तस्या ग्रामकामं तन्त्रम् /
text_mt: Its ritual framework is that for one desiring a village.

sanskrit_iast: aindrābārhaspatyasyāmnāte /
meaning: ऐन्द्राबार्हस्पत्यस्याम्नाते /
text_mt: Those of the [offering] to Indra and Bṛhaspati are traditionally handed down [as the verses].

sanskrit_iast: bārhaspatyaṃ caruṃ nirvapet payasi grāmakāmaḥ paśukāmo vā /
meaning: बार्हस्पत्यं चरुं निर्वपेत् पयसि ग्रामकामः पशुकामो वा /
text_mt: Desirous of a village or desirous of cattle, he should apportion a boiled oblation in milk to Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: bahupuṣṭasya gṛhāt kṣīram āhṛtya svāsāṃ ca gavāṃ praṇītodakena sam̐sṛjya carum̐ śrapayati /
meaning: बहुपुष्टस्य गृहात् क्षीरम् आहृत्य स्वासां च गवां प्रणीतोदकेन सम्̐सृज्य चरुम्̐ श्रपयति /
text_mt: Having brought milk from the house of a prosperous man and from his own cows, having mixed it with the brought-forward water, he cooks the boiled oblation.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇaspatyaṃ caruṃ nirvapet saṃgrāmaṃ jigīṣan senayoḥ saṃdṛśyamānayoḥ /
meaning: ब्राह्मणस्पत्यं चरुं निर्वपेत् संग्रामं जिगीषन् सेनयोः संदृश्यमानयोः /
text_mt: Wishing to win a battle when two armies are in sight of each other, he should apportion a boiled oblation to Brahmaṇaspati.

sanskrit_iast: udbarhiḥ prastara iṣuṇāṃ bāṇavantaḥ paridhayaḥ pattrato mūlāni /
meaning: उद्बर्हिः प्रस्तर इषुणां बाणवन्तः परिधयः पत्त्रतो मूलानि /
text_mt: The sacred grass bundle is pulled up; the enclosing sticks are arrows possessing reed-shafts, their bases by the feathering.

sanskrit_iast: prastaram anupraharan pātryām upādadhīta /
meaning: प्रस्तरम् अनुप्रहरन् पात्र्याम् उपादधीत /
text_mt: Throwing the sacred grass bundle after [the oblation], he should place it upon the vessel.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇaspatyaṃ caruṃ nirvaped yatra kāmayeta brahmabalam̐ syād iti //
meaning: ब्राह्मणस्पत्यं चरुं निर्वपेद् यत्र कामयेत ब्रह्मबलम्̐ स्याद् इति //
text_mt: He should apportion a boiled oblation to Brahmaṇaspati where he wishes: 'May there be the power of the brahman.'

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspatiḥ prathamaṃ jāyamānas \\ ity aṣṭau haviṣām /
meaning: बृहस्पतिः प्रथमं जायमानस् \\ इत्य् अष्टौ हविषाम् /
text_mt: "Bṛhaspati, being born first" are the eight [verses] for the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: na bṛhatyā vaṣaṭkaroti /
meaning: न बृहत्या वषट्करोति /
text_mt: He does not utter the vaṣaṭ-call with a bṛhatī verse.

sanskrit_iast: anuvākyāyāścatvāryakṣarāṇi yājyāmabhyatyūhati /
meaning: अनुवाक्यायाश्चत्वार्यक्षराणि याज्यामभ्यत्यूहति /
text_mt: He shifts four syllables of the invitatory verse over into the offering verse.

sanskrit_iast:
uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate \ devayantas tvemahe /
upa prayantu marutaḥ sudānavās \ indra prāśom //
ity anvāha // bhavā sacā \\ agnir ukthe \\ iti yaja /
meaning:
उत्तिष्ठ ब्रह्मणस्पते \ देवयन्तस् त्वेमहे /
उप प्रयन्तु मरुतः सुदानवास् \ इन्द्र प्राशोम् //
इत्य् अन्वाह // भवा सचा \\ अग्निर् उक्थे \\ इति यज /
text_mt:
“Arise, O Brahmaṇaspati, seeking the gods we implore you...”

“Let the bountiful Maruts advance, Indra drink the offering...”

thus he recites. “Be our companion...”, “Agni in praise...”: recite the offering verse with these.

sanskrit_iast: gārmute bṛhaspate juṣasva nas \\ evā pitre \\ iti bārhaspatyasya / saumāpauṣṇasyāmnāte /
meaning: गार्मुते बृहस्पते जुषस्व नस् \\ एवा पित्रे \\ इति बार्हस्पत्यस्य / सौमापौष्णस्याम्नाते /
text_mt: For the Gārmuta offering: “O Bṛhaspati, take pleasure in us...”, “Thus to the father...”—these are for that belonging to Bṛhaspati. Those of the offering to Soma and Pūṣan are traditionally taught.

sanskrit_iast: prājāpatyam adhiśritya prāk paryagnikaraṇād gārmute gomūtrasyāścotayet /
meaning: प्राजापत्यम् अधिश्रित्य प्राक् पर्यग्निकरणाद् गार्मुते गोमूत्रस्याश्चोतयेत् /
text_mt: Having placed [the oblation] for Prajāpati on the fire, before the carrying of fire around it, he should sprinkle cow's urine into the Gārmuta oblation.

sanskrit_iast: vāstvamayaḥ kaṇikaḥ /
meaning: वास्त्वमयः कणिकः /

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścittiḥ kalpaḥ //
meaning: प्रायश्चित्तिः कल्पः //

sanskrit_iast: namas te rudra manyave \\ imā rudrāya \\ iti haviṣaḥ /
meaning: नमस् ते रुद्र मन्यवे \\ इमा रुद्राय \\ इति हविषः /
text_mt: “Homage to your wrath, O Rudra...”, “These to Rudra...”—these are for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: niṣādasthapater iṣṭiḥ /
meaning: निषादस्थपतेर् इष्टिः /
text_mt: [This is] the sacrifice of a Niṣāda chieftain.

sanskrit_iast: āmnātā dakṣiṇā /
meaning: आम्नाता दक्षिणा /

sanskrit_iast: rājā parameṣṭhikāmaḥ parameṣṭhine dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet /
meaning: राजा परमेष्ठिकामः परमेष्ठिने द्वादशकपालं निर्वपेत् /
text_mt: A king desiring the highest station should apportion a twelve-potsherd [cake] to Parameṣṭhin.

sanskrit_iast: prāk sviṣṭakṛto 'dhijyaṃ dhanus tisraś ceṣūr agniṣ ṭe tejas \\ iti yajamānāya prayachati / sā dakṣiṇā /
meaning: प्राक् स्विष्टकृतो ऽधिज्यं धनुस् तिस्रश् चेषूर् अग्निष् टे तेजस् \\ इति यजमानाय प्रयछति / सा दक्षिणा /
text_mt: Before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, he hands over to the sacrificer a strung bow and three arrows with: “May Agni [grant] you splendor...”. That is the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvadevaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvaped bhrātṛvyavān /
meaning: वैश्वदेवं द्वादशकपालं निर्वपेद् भ्रातृव्यवान् /
text_mt: One who has a rival should apportion a twelve-potsherd [cake] to the Viśve Devas.

sanskrit_iast: ājyabhāgābhyāṃ pracarya barhiṣi puroḍāśaṃ nidhāya sphyena \\ idam ahaṃ māṃ cāmuṃ ca vyūhāmi \\ iti yaṃ dviṣyāt tasya nāma gṛhṇīyād barhiṣy avasannam̐ sphye ca śliṣṭaṃ tad viṣṇava urukramāyāvadyet /
meaning: आज्यभागाभ्यां प्रचर्य बर्हिषि पुरोडाशं निधाय स्फ्येन \\ इदम् अहं मां चामुं च व्यूहामि \\ इति यं द्विष्यात् तस्य नाम गृह्णीयाद् बर्हिष्य् अवसन्नम्̐ स्फ्ये च श्लिष्टं तद् विष्णव उरुक्रमायावद्येत् /
text_mt: Having performed the two clarified butter portions, having placed the sacrificial cake upon the sacrificial grass, with the wooden sword [reciting]: “Here I push apart myself and so-and-so”, he should utter the name of him whom he hates; whatever [part of the cake] settles on the sacrificial grass and clings to the wooden sword, that he should cut off for Viṣṇu of wide strides.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ punaḥ samūhet \\ idam ahaṃ māṃ cāmuṃ ca samūhāmi \\ iti yo 'sya priyaḥ syāt tasya nāma gṛhṇīyād anāvāhya pūrvam̐ viṣṇum urukramam̐ yajet /
meaning: तं पुनः समूहेत् \\ इदम् अहं मां चामुं च समूहामि \\ इति यो ऽस्य प्रियः स्यात् तस्य नाम गृह्णीयाद् अनावाह्य पूर्वम्̐ विष्णुम् उरुक्रमम्̐ यजेत् /
text_mt: He should push it together again [reciting]: “Here I bring together myself and so-and-so”, uttering the name of him who is dear to him. Without having invoked him beforehand, he sacrifices to Viṣṇu of wide strides.

sanskrit_iast: indrāṇyai caruṃ nirvapet senāyām uttiṣṭhantyām idhme balbajān upasaṃnahya /
meaning: इन्द्राण्यै चरुं निर्वपेत् सेनायाम् उत्तिष्ठन्त्याम् इध्मे बल्बजान् उपसंनह्य /
text_mt: He should apportion a boiled oblation to Indrāṇī when an army is setting out, having tied Balbaja-grass to the sacrificial fuel.

sanskrit_iast: śrīkāmasya bhūtikāmaṃ tantram //
meaning: श्रीकामस्य भूतिकामं तन्त्रम् //
text_mt: For one desiring fortune, the ritual framework is that of one desiring prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: ko addhā veda \\ iti daśa haviṣām /
meaning: को अद्धा वेद \\ इति दश हविषाम् /
text_mt: “Who truly knows...” [and following verses]: [there are] ten [verses] for the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye vasumate \\ iti caturhaviṣaḥ saṃjñānī /
meaning: अग्नये वसुमते \\ इति चतुर्हविषः संज्ञानी /
text_mt: [The sacrifice with the words] “To Agni accompanied by the Vasus...” having four oblations, is the Saṃjñānī offering.

sanskrit_iast: ya ichet samānaṃ mā śreṣṭhibhiḥ saṃmanyerann iti sa etayā yajeta /
meaning: य इछेत् समानं मा श्रेष्ठिभिः संमन्येरन्न् इति स एतया यजेत /
text_mt: He who desires, “May the prominent men think equally with me,” should sacrifice with this.

sanskrit_iast: tasyā grāmakāmaṃ tantram /
meaning: तस्या ग्रामकामं तन्त्रम् /
text_mt: Its ritual framework is that of one desiring a village.

sanskrit_iast: samavadāya pracarati //
meaning: समवदाय प्रचरति //

sanskrit_iast: agnaye vasumate somāya rudravata indrāya marutvate varuṇāyādityavate 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
meaning: अग्नये वसुमते सोमाय रुद्रवत इन्द्राय मरुत्वते वरुणायादित्यवते ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: He makes [the hotṛ] recite: “Recite for Agni accompanied by the Vasus, for Soma accompanied by the Rudras, for Indra accompanied by the Maruts, for Varuṇa accompanied by the Ādityas!”

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya \\ agnim̐ vasumantam̐ somam̐ rudravantam indraṃ marutvantam̐ varuṇam ādityavantam̐ yaja \\ iti preṣyati //
meaning: आश्राव्य \\ अग्निम्̐ वसुमन्तम्̐ सोमम्̐ रुद्रवन्तम् इन्द्रं मरुत्वन्तम्̐ वरुणम् आदित्यवन्तम्̐ यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति //
text_mt: Having called for the response, he prompts: “Sacrifice to Agni accompanied by the Vasus, to Soma accompanied by the Rudras, to Indra accompanied by the Maruts, to Varuṇa accompanied by the Ādityas!”

sanskrit_iast: agniḥ prathamaḥ \ sam agnir iti haviṣaḥ /
meaning: अग्निः प्रथमः \ सम् अग्निर् इति हविषः /
text_mt: “Agni first...”, “Together Agni...”—these are for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: saṃjñāta evaindreṇa yajeta //
meaning: संज्ञात एवैन्द्रेण यजेत //
text_mt: When agreement is achieved, he should sacrifice with the Aindra [offering].

sanskrit_iast: saṃjñānaṃ no divā \\ ity etābhir ubhayoḥ prāksviṣṭakṛto juhoti /
meaning: संज्ञानं नो दिवा \\ इत्य् एताभिर् उभयोः प्राक्स्विष्टकृतो जुहोति /
text_mt: Before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, he offers with these verses: “Concord for us by day...” in both [offerings].

sanskrit_iast: āgneyam aṣṭākapālam iti caturhaviṣā hiraṇye naṣṭe yajeta /
meaning: आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालम् इति चतुर्हविषा हिरण्ये नष्टे यजेत /
text_mt: He should sacrifice with the four-oblation [rite beginning with] “An eight-potsherd cake to Agni...” when gold has been lost.

sanskrit_iast: rayimantāv ājyabhāgau //
meaning: रयिमन्ताव् आज्यभागौ //
text_mt: The two clarified butter portions are endowed with [the word] rayi.

sanskrit_iast: agne dās \\ ity aṣṭau haviṣām /
meaning: अग्ने दास् \\ इत्य् अष्टौ हविषाम् /
text_mt: “Agni, give...”—[there are] eight [verses] for the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: sanimatyau sam̐yājye /
meaning: सनिमत्यौ सम्̐याज्ये /

sanskrit_iast: vindetaiva punar yajeta /
meaning: विन्देतैव पुनर् यजेत /
text_mt: Only if he finds [the gold] should he sacrifice again.

sanskrit_iast: rājayakṣmagṛhīto 'māvāsyāyām ācamanāntaṃ kṛtvānyad idhmābarhiḥ saṃnahya niśi vaiśvadevena yajeta /
meaning: राजयक्ष्मगृहीतो ऽमावास्यायाम् आचमनान्तं कृत्वान्यद् इध्माबर्हिः संनह्य निशि वैश्वदेवेन यजेत /
text_mt: One seized by consumption, having performed the rites ending with sipping water on the new-moon day, having tied another set of sacrificial fuel and grass, should sacrifice at night with the Vaiśvadeva offering.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścittiḥ kalpaḥ //
meaning: प्रायश्चित्तिः कल्पः //

sanskrit_iast: pūrvāparam iti dve haviṣaḥ //
meaning: पूर्वापरम् इति द्वे हविषः //
text_mt: “The former and the latter...”—two verses are for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: yathādityās \\ iti prāk sviṣṭakṛto juhoti //
meaning: यथादित्यास् \\ इति प्राक् स्विष्टकृतो जुहोति //
text_mt: Before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, he offers with: “As the Ādityas...”.

sanskrit_iast: indrāya rājñe \\ iti trihaviṣarddhir uttarauttaraḥ puroḍāśo varṣīyān /
meaning: इन्द्राय राज्ञे \\ इति त्रिहविषर्द्धिर् उत्तरौत्तरः पुरोडाशो वर्षीयान् /
text_mt: [The sacrifice with the words] “To Indra the king...” is a three-oblation prosperity rite; each successive sacrificial cake is larger.

sanskrit_iast: tasyā grāmakāmaṃ tantram //
meaning: तस्या ग्रामकामं तन्त्रम् //
text_mt: Its ritual framework is that of one desiring a village.

sanskrit_iast: prācyāṃ diśi \\ iti tisro haviṣām //
meaning: प्राच्यां दिशि \\ इति तिस्रो हविषाम् //
text_mt: “In the eastern quarter...”—[there are] three verses for the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: indrāya rājñe 'nubrūhi \\ i-- prathamām anvāha \\ indram̐ svarājānam̐ yaja madhyamayā yajati //
meaning: इन्द्राय राज्ञे ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इ-- प्रथमाम् अन्वाह \\ इन्द्रम्̐ स्वराजानम्̐ यज मध्यमया यजति //
text_mt: He prompts: “Recite for Indra the king”, and [the hotṛ] recites the first [verse]; he prompts: “Sacrifice to Indra the independent ruler”, and he sacrifices with the middle [verse].

sanskrit_iast: indrāya svarājñe 'nubrūhi \\ i-- madhyamām anvāha \\ indram adhirājānam̐ yaja uttamayā yajati //
meaning: इन्द्राय स्वराज्ञे ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इ-- मध्यमाम् अन्वाह \\ इन्द्रम् अधिराजानम्̐ यज उत्तमया यजति //
text_mt: He prompts: “Recite for Indra the independent ruler”, and he recites the middle [verse]; he prompts: “Sacrifice to Indra the supreme ruler”, and he sacrifices with the last [verse].

sanskrit_iast: indrāyādhirājāyānubrūhi \\ etām evānvāha \\ indram̐ rājānam̐ yaja pūrvayā yajati /
meaning: इन्द्रायाधिराजायानुब्रूहि \\ एताम् एवान्वाह \\ इन्द्रम्̐ राजानम्̐ यज पूर्वया यजति /
text_mt: He prompts: “Recite for Indra the supreme ruler”, and he recites this very [last verse]; he prompts: “Sacrifice to Indra the king”, and he sacrifices with the first [verse].

sanskrit_iast: yathejyam upalakṣyate sviṣṭakṛti sūktavāke ca /
meaning: यथेज्यम् उपलक्ष्यते स्विष्टकृति सूक्तवाके च /
text_mt: [The deities are named] in the Sviṣṭakṛt offering and in the sūktavāka recitation according as the deity sacrificed to is designated.

sanskrit_iast: tejaskāmasya bhūtikāmaṃ tantram /
meaning: तेजस्कामस्य भूतिकामं तन्त्रम् /
text_mt: For one desiring spiritual luster, the ritual framework is that of one desiring prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: uttarā paśukāmasya //
meaning: उत्तरा पशुकामस्य //

sanskrit_iast: ā yasmin \\ iti haviṣoś catasraḥ /
meaning: आ यस्मिन् \\ इति हविषोश् चतस्रः /
text_mt: “In whom...”—there are four [verses] for the two oblations.

sanskrit_iast: ārkavatasyottaraḥ /
meaning: आर्कवतस्योत्तरः /

sanskrit_iast: indrāyārkavate \\ iti catasraḥ /
meaning: इन्द्रायार्कवते \\ इति चतस्रः /
text_mt: “To Indra accompanied by the praise-hymn...”—there are four [oblations].

sanskrit_iast: niruddhasya hūtavantāv ājyabhāgau /
meaning: निरुद्धस्य हूतवन्ताव् आज्यभागौ /
text_mt: For an expelled [sacrificer], the two clarified butter portions contain [the word] hūta.

sanskrit_iast: nitye sam̐yājye /
meaning: नित्ये सम्̐याज्ये /

sanskrit_iast: vaśā dakṣiṇā /
meaning: वशा दक्षिणा /

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ kāmayeta parajanapade ma ṛdhyeteti / tasyā grāmakāmaṃ tantram /
meaning: यः कामयेत परजनपदे म ऋध्येतेति / तस्या ग्रामकामं तन्त्रम् /
text_mt: For one who desires, “May I prosper in a foreign country”, its ritual framework is that of one desiring a village.

sanskrit_iast: gataśrīḥ śriyo na vyacyeya \\ iti yajeta /
meaning: गतश्रीः श्रियो न व्यच्येय \\ इति यजेत /
text_mt: One who has attained fortune should sacrifice, [thinking]: “May I not fall away from fortune.”

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścittiḥ kalpaḥ /
meaning: प्रायश्चित्तिः कल्पः /

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ kāmayeta bahudakṣiṇena yajñena yajeyeti / tasyāḥ paśukāmaṃ tantram /
meaning: यः कामयेत बहुदक्षिणेन यज्ञेन यजेयेति / तस्याः पशुकामं तन्त्रम् /
text_mt: For one who desires, “May I sacrifice with a sacrifice rich in sacrificial gifts”, its ritual framework is that of one desiring cattle.

sanskrit_iast: indrāya gharmavata iti caturhaviḥ //
meaning: इन्द्राय घर्मवत इति चतुर्हविः //
text_mt: [The sacrifice with the words] “To Indra accompanied by the hot drink...” has four oblations.

sanskrit_iast: ā te mahas \\ yo jāta eva \\ iti manasvataḥ / āmnāta itareṣām /
meaning: आ ते महस् \\ यो जात एव \\ इति मनस्वतः / आम्नात इतरेषाम् /
text_mt: “To your greatness...”, “He who as soon as born...”—these are for [the oblation] with Manasvat; the verses for the others are traditionally taught.

sanskrit_iast: indrāyām̐homuca iti sapta /
meaning: इन्द्रायाम्̐होमुच इति सप्त /
text_mt: There are seven [oblations in the rite] “To Indra the deliverer from distress”.

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīyayā jyeṣṭhaḥ kulīnaḥ saṃpanno yajeta /
meaning: तृतीयया ज्येष्ठः कुलीनः संपन्नो यजेत /
text_mt: An elder, of noble family, and prosperous, should sacrifice with the third [offering].

sanskrit_iast: dvayoḥ prāyaścittiḥ kalpo / grāmakāmaṃ tantram ekasyām̐ / vārtraghna uttarāsām //
meaning: द्वयोः प्रायश्चित्तिः कल्पो / ग्रामकामं तन्त्रम् एकस्याम्̐ / वार्त्रघ्न उत्तरासाम् //
text_mt: For two [rites], the ritual procedure is that of an expiation; on one [rite], the ritual framework is according to one desirous of a village; for the subsequent [rites], [the two clarified butter portions are] vārtraghna.

sanskrit_iast: viveṣa yad iti caturdaśa haviṣām /
meaning: विवेष यद् इति चतुर्दश हविषाम् /
text_mt: "He who entered" [is the first] of the fourteen [verses] for the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: aindram ekakapālam iti sapta /
meaning: ऐन्द्रम् एककपालम् इति सप्त /
text_mt: "A cake on one potsherd for Indra"—[these are] seven [verses].

sanskrit_iast: indrāya vajriṇa iti trihavir yasya bhrātṛvyaḥ somena yajeta /
meaning: इन्द्राय वज्रिण इति त्रिहविर् यस्य भ्रातृव्यः सोमेन यजेत /
text_mt: "To Indra the wielder of the vajra" is a three-oblation rite for one whose rival performs a Soma sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: sutyeṣṭim̐ saṃdadhyāt /
meaning: सुत्येष्टिम्̐ संदध्यात् /

sanskrit_iast: hūtavantau pūrvayor vārtraghna uttarāsām //
meaning: हूतवन्तौ पूर्वयोर् वार्त्रघ्न उत्तरासाम् //
text_mt: For the first two, [the two clarified butter portions are] containing the word hūta; for the subsequent [rites], [they are] vārtraghna.

sanskrit_iast: arvāvato na āgahi \\ iti caturdaśa haviṣām //
meaning: अर्वावतो न आगहि \\ इति चतुर्दश हविषाम् //
text_mt: "Come to us from nearby" [is the first] of the fourteen [verses] for the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: indraṃ naras \\ iti trayodaśakapāle prāk sviṣṭakṛto juhoti /
meaning: इन्द्रं नरस् \\ इति त्रयोदशकपाले प्राक् स्विष्टकृतो जुहोति /
text_mt: With "Indra the men," he offers on [the offering of] the cake on thirteen potsherds before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: indrāya manyumata iti tisraḥ /
meaning: इन्द्राय मन्युमत इति तिस्रः /
text_mt: "To Indra possessed of wrath"—[these are] three [verses].

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ jīvagrāhaṃ gṛhṇīyus tam̐ vikṛnteyuḥ /
meaning: यं जीवग्राहं गृह्णीयुस् तम्̐ विकृन्तेयुः /
text_mt: Whomever they might capture alive, they should cut him into pieces.

sanskrit_iast: ya iched āḍhyo 'nupavādaḥ syām iti sa yakṣyamāṇaḥ sam̐vatsaraṃ mana iti na brūyāt //
meaning: य इछेद् आढ्यो ऽनुपवादः स्याम् इति स यक्ष्यमाणः सम्̐वत्सरं मन इति न ब्रूयात् //
text_mt: He who desires, "May I be wealthy and blameless," being about to sacrifice, should not speak [evil with] the mind for a year.

sanskrit_iast: ā te mahas \\ yo jāta eva \\ iti catasro haviṣām /
meaning: आ ते महस् \\ यो जात एव \\ इति चतस्रो हविषाम् /
text_mt: "To you great," and "He who was born" [are the first] of the four [verses] for the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: pūrve prathamottamayoḥ /
meaning: पूर्वे प्रथमोत्तमयोः /
text_mt: The earlier [verses] are for the first and the last.

sanskrit_iast: yasya sāṃnāyyaṃ candramā abhyudiyād vaikṛtībhyo nirupya taṇḍulām̐s tredhā vibhajet /
meaning: यस्य सांनाय्यं चन्द्रमा अभ्युदियाद् वैकृतीभ्यो निरुप्य तण्डुलाम्̐स् त्रेधा विभजेत् /
text_mt: For one upon whose curd and milk offering the moon rises, having apportioned [the portions] for the modified deities, he should divide the husked rice grains into three parts.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīṃ prātardohaṃ piṣṭeṣu piṣṭacarum /
meaning: तूष्णीं प्रातर्दोहं पिष्टेषु पिष्टचरुम् /
text_mt: Silently, [he prepares] the morning milk, and among the flours, the boiled oblation of flour.

sanskrit_iast: śṛte vibhajya pracarati /
meaning: शृते विभज्य प्रचरति /
text_mt: Having divided it when cooked, he proceeds [with the offering].

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścittiḥ kalpaḥ //
meaning: प्रायश्चित्तिः कल्पः //

sanskrit_iast: agne dās \\ dā no agne \\ ity āgneyasya //
meaning: अग्ने दास् \\ दा नो अग्ने \\ इत्य् आग्नेयस्य //
text_mt: "O Agni, give," and "Give us, O Agni" are for the oblation to Agni.

sanskrit_iast: kim it te viṣṇo \\ ity uttarayoś catasra uttare pūrvasya /
meaning: किम् इत् ते विष्णो \\ इत्य् उत्तरयोश् चतस्र उत्तरे पूर्वस्य /
text_mt: "What [praise] of yours, O Viṣṇu" is for the subsequent two; the subsequent four are for the earlier one.

sanskrit_iast: paśukāmo 'māvāsyāyām iṣṭvā tūṣṇīm̐ sarvān vatsān apākaroti //
meaning: पशुकामो ऽमावास्यायाम् इष्ट्वा तूष्णीम्̐ सर्वान् वत्सान् अपाकरोति //
text_mt: One desirous of cattle, having sacrificed on the new-moon day, drives away all the calves silently.

sanskrit_iast: iḍām agne \\ iti ṣaḍ ḍhaviṣām /
meaning: इडाम् अग्ने \\ इति षड् ढविषाम् /
text_mt: "The refreshing drink, O Agni" [is the first] of the six [verses] for the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyam aṣṭākapālam iti trihaviḥ /
meaning: आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालम् इति त्रिहविः /
text_mt: "A cake on eight potsherds for Agni" is a three-oblation rite.

sanskrit_iast: uttamāyāṃ girim upanipīḍya yajetāpo vā /
meaning: उत्तमायां गिरिम् उपनिपीड्य यजेतापो वा /
text_mt: On the last, pressing against a mountain or water, he should sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: somavāminaḥ prāyaścittiḥ kalpaḥ //
meaning: सोमवामिनः प्रायश्चित्तिः कल्पः //
text_mt: For one who has vomited Soma, the ritual procedure is that of an expiation.

sanskrit_iast: tvā yujā tava tat soma \\ iti dve haviṣaḥ /
meaning: त्वा युजा तव तत् सोम \\ इति द्वे हविषः /
text_mt: "With you as ally," and "Yours is that, O Soma" are the two [verses] for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: āmnātam̐ śrayaṇam āmnātam̐ śrayaṇam /
meaning: आम्नातम्̐ श्रयणम् आम्नातम्̐ श्रयणम् /
text_mt: The mixing milk is prescribed by the sacred tradition, the mixing milk is prescribed by the sacred tradition.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapen maitrāvaruṇīṃ payasyāṃ / tasyāḥ samānadevatam ekādaśakapālaṃ dvādaśakapālam̐ vā / tūṣṇīm upacaritām̐ś caikakapālān /
meaning: आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपेन् मैत्रावरुणीं पयस्यां / तस्याः समानदेवतम् एकादशकपालं द्वादशकपालम्̐ वा / तूष्णीम् उपचरिताम्̐श् चैककपालान् /
text_mt: He should apportion a cake on eight potsherds for Agni, a curd offering for Mitra and Varuṇa, for it [a cake] on eleven potsherds or twelve potsherds to the same deity, and cakes on one potsherd treated silently.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā pracaraṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ प्रचरणात् /

sanskrit_iast: āgneyena pracaryottaraṃ puroḍāśam ābhikṣayā prachādya tāṃ caturdhā vyudūhati yā vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā ojasvyā \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ prācīnaṃ prathamaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ brāhmaṇasya \\ indrāvaruṇau iti rājanyasya \\ agnivaruṇau \\ iti vaiśyasya / samavadāya pracaraty upastaraṇābhighāraṇaiḥ saṃpātam ekakapālāñ juhoti yas te rājan varuṇa deveṣu \\ anne \ dvipātsu catuṣpātsu paśuṣu \\ oṣadhīṣu vanaspatiṣv apsu pṛthivyāṃ dikṣu \ yas te rājan varuṇa \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati //
meaning: आग्नेयेन प्रचर्योत्तरं पुरोडाशम् आभिक्षया प्रछाद्य तां चतुर्धा व्युदूहति या वां मित्रावरुणा ओजस्व्या \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः प्राचीनं प्रथमं प्रदक्षिणं ब्राह्मणस्य \\ इन्द्रावरुणौ इति राजन्यस्य \\ अग्निवरुणौ \\ इति वैश्यस्य / समवदाय प्रचरत्य् उपस्तरणाभिघारणैः संपातम् एककपालाञ् जुहोति यस् ते राजन् वरुण देवेषु \\ अन्ने \ द्विपात्सु चतुष्पात्सु पशुषु \\ ओषधीषु वनस्पतिष्व् अप्सु पृथिव्यां दिक्षु \ यस् ते राजन् वरुण \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति //
text_mt: Having proceeded with the oblation to Agni, having covered the subsequent sacrificial cake with the curd mixture, he divides it into four parts with the mantras beginning with "O Mitra and Varuṇa, that vigorous [power] of yours"; [first] eastward, then clockwise for a brāhmaṇa; with "O Indra and Varuṇa" for a rājanya; with "O Agni and Varuṇa" for a vaiśya. Taking cuttings, he proceeds; with the under-spreadings and bastings, he offers the residues [and] the cakes on one potsherd with "O King Varuṇa, what [harm] of yours is among the gods, in food, in two-footed and four-footed cattle, in plants, in trees, in the waters, on the earth, in the directions," attaching "O King Varuṇa, what [harm] of yours" everywhere.

sanskrit_iast: yā vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā ojasyā \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ samuhya sviṣṭakṛte samavadyatīḍāyai ca /
meaning: या वां मित्रावरुणा ओजस्या \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः समुह्य स्विष्टकृते समवद्यतीडायै च /
text_mt: Having pushed [the portions] together with [the verses] beginning with "O Mitra and Varuṇa, that vigorous [power] of yours," he cuts portions for the Sviṣṭakṛt offering and for the iḍā portion.

sanskrit_iast: yathākāmaṃ tantram //
meaning: यथाकामं तन्त्रम् //

sanskrit_iast: indrāvaruṇā \ samrāḍ ity aindravāruṇasya /
meaning: इन्द्रावरुणा \ सम्राड् इत्य् ऐन्द्रवारुणस्य /
text_mt: "O Indra and Varuṇa" and "Sovereign" are for the oblation to Indra and Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvadevaṃ caruṃ nirvaped bhrātṛvyavān /
meaning: वैश्वदेवं चरुं निर्वपेद् भ्रातृव्यवान् /
text_mt: One who has a rival should apportion a boiled oblation for the Viśvedevas.

sanskrit_iast: navanītena śrapayati //
meaning: नवनीतेन श्रपयति //

sanskrit_iast: viśvāhendras \\ iti dve haviṣaḥ /
meaning: विश्वाहेन्द्रस् \\ इति द्वे हविषः /
text_mt: "Indra always" are the two [verses] for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: etayā grāmakāmo yajeta /
meaning: एतया ग्रामकामो यजेत /
text_mt: One desirous of a village should sacrifice with this.

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣāṃ grāmiṇāṃ gṛhād ājyam āhṛtya caruṃ śrapayati /
meaning: सर्वेषां ग्रामिणां गृहाद् आज्यम् आहृत्य चरुं श्रपयति /
text_mt: Having brought clarified butter from the house of every villager, he cooks the boiled oblation.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā paridhīnāṃ paridhānāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ परिधीनां परिधानात् /
text_mt: [The procedure] is established up to the placing of the enclosing sticks.

sanskrit_iast: paridhīn anumantrayate dhruvo 'si \\ iti madhyamam ugro 'si \\ iti dakṣiṇam abhibhūr asi \\ ity uttaraṃ // paribhūr asi \\ ity āhavanīyam \\ sūrir asi \\ ity ādityam /
meaning: परिधीन् अनुमन्त्रयते ध्रुवो ऽसि \\ इति मध्यमम् उग्रो ऽसि \\ इति दक्षिणम् अभिभूर् असि \\ इत्य् उत्तरं // परिभूर् असि \\ इत्य् आहवनीयम् \\ सूरिर् असि \\ इत्य् आदित्यम् /
text_mt: He accompanies the enclosing sticks with mantras: the middle one with "You are firm"; the southern with "You are fierce"; the northern with "You are overpowering"; the āhavanīya fire with "You are encompassing"; the sun with "You are wise."

sanskrit_iast: siddham odvāsanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् ओद्वासनात् /

sanskrit_iast: śuktyākṛtyāmanapātraṃ mṛnmayaṃ dārumayam̐ vā tasmim̐ś caror avasrāvayati //
meaning: शुक्त्याकृत्यामनपात्रं मृन्मयं दारुमयम्̐ वा तस्मिम्̐श् चरोर् अवस्रावयति //
text_mt: Into an āmana-vessel having the shape of a mother-of-pearl shell, made of clay or made of wood, he drains off [the liquid] from the boiled oblation.

sanskrit_iast: āmanasya deva ye sajātāḥ samanasas \\ itiprabhṛtibhir āmanapātreṇa prāk sviṣṭakṛtaś catasra āhutīr juhoti //
meaning: आमनस्य देव ये सजाताः समनसस् \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् आमनपात्रेण प्राक् स्विष्टकृतश् चतस्र आहुतीर् जुहोति //
text_mt: With the mantras beginning with "O god of the āmana, whatever kinsmen are like-minded," he offers four oblations with the āmana-vessel before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: kutrā cid iti sam̐yājye /
meaning: कुत्रा चिद् इति सम्̐याज्ये /

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣatī gaur dhenur dakṣiṇā /
meaning: पृषती गौर् धेनुर् दक्षिणा /
text_mt: A spotted milch cow is the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: yāvato 'śvān pratigṛhṇīyāt tāvataś catuṣkapālān vāruṇān nirvaped ekaṃ cādhyaponaptrīyaṃ carum //
meaning: यावतो ऽश्वान् प्रतिगृह्णीयात् तावतश् चतुष्कपालान् वारुणान् निर्वपेद् एकं चाध्यपोनप्त्रीयं चरुम् //
text_mt: As many horses as he might accept, so many cakes on four potsherds for Varuṇa should he apportion, and one additional boiled oblation for Apāṃ Napāt.

sanskrit_iast: yas te rājan varuṇa gāyatrachandās \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ prāk sviṣṭakṛtaś catasra āhutīr juhoti /
meaning: यस् ते राजन् वरुण गायत्रछन्दास् \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः प्राक् स्विष्टकृतश् चतस्र आहुतीर् जुहोति /
text_mt: With the mantras beginning with "O King Varuṇa, whose metre is the gāyatrī," he offers four oblations before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: evam̐ yadi punaḥ pratigrahīṣyan syād atha ca punaḥ pratigṛhṇīyād ardhān vāruṇān nirvapet sauryavāruṇān ardhān /
meaning: एवम्̐ यदि पुनः प्रतिग्रहीष्यन् स्याद् अथ च पुनः प्रतिगृह्णीयाद् अर्धान् वारुणान् निर्वपेत् सौर्यवारुणान् अर्धान् /
text_mt: In this manner, if he is about to accept [horses] again and then does accept again, he should apportion half for Varuṇa and half for Sūrya and Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: yukṣvādhikaḥ sauryavāruṇānām ity aponaptrīyaḥ /
meaning: युक्ष्वाधिकः सौर्यवारुणानाम् इत्य् अपोनप्त्रीयः /
text_mt: There is an additional [verse] "Yoke..." for those to Sūrya and Varuṇa; [that] is for the one to Apāṃ Napāt.

sanskrit_iast: samānam anyat /
meaning: समानम् अन्यत् /

sanskrit_iast: ekavim̐śatiḥ sāmidhenīḥ //
meaning: एकविम्̐शतिः सामिधेनीः //
text_mt: There are twenty-one kindling verses.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthupājās \ tam̐ sabādhas \\ iti ṣaḍ dhāyyāḥ /
meaning: पृथुपाजास् \ तम्̐ सबाधस् \\ इति षड् धाय्याः /
text_mt: "Broad-beamed" and "Him oppressed" are the six intercalated verses.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścittiḥ kalpaḥ /
meaning: प्रायश्चित्तिः कल्पः /

sanskrit_iast: āmnāte vāruṇānām /
meaning: आम्नाते वारुणानाम् /

sanskrit_iast: yad adya sūrya \\ iti sauryavāruṇānām //
meaning: यद् अद्य सूर्य \\ इति सौर्यवारुणानाम् //
text_mt: "Whatever today, O Sūrya" is for the offerings to Sūrya and Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: upemasṛkṣītyaponaptrīyasya /
meaning: उपेमसृक्षीत्यपोनप्त्रीयस्य /
text_mt: "I have sent forth here" is for the offering to Apāṃ Napāt.

sanskrit_iast: uttarābhyām apsu juhoti /
meaning: उत्तराभ्याम् अप्सु जुहोति /
text_mt: With the subsequent two, he offers into water.

sanskrit_iast: āmayāvyāyuṣkāmeṣṭyā yajeta /
meaning: आमयाव्यायुष्कामेष्ट्या यजेत /
text_mt: A diseased person should sacrifice with the sacrifice of one desirous of a full life-span.

sanskrit_iast: āgnāvaiṣṇavam ekādaśakapālam iti trihaviḥ pūrvedyuḥ pañcahavir aparedyuḥ /
meaning: आग्नावैष्णवम् एकादशकपालम् इति त्रिहविः पूर्वेद्युः पञ्चहविर् अपरेद्युः /
text_mt: "A cake on eleven potsherds for Agni and Viṣṇu"—this is a three-oblation rite on the preceding day, a five-oblation rite on the following day.

sanskrit_iast: tasyāṃ prāk sviṣṭakṛtaḥ kām̐sye camase vā pañcagṛhītaṃ gṛhṇāti /
meaning: तस्यां प्राक् स्विष्टकृतः काम्̐स्ये चमसे वा पञ्चगृहीतं गृह्णाति /
text_mt: In that [sacrifice], before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, he takes five ladlings of clarified butter in a bronze vessel or a wooden cup.

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyaṃ baddhvā darbheṇa \\ agner āyur asi \\ iti pañcagṛhīte 'vadadhāti //
meaning: हिरण्यं बद्ध्वा दर्भेण \\ अग्नेर् आयुर् असि \\ इति पञ्चगृहीते ऽवदधाति //
text_mt: Having tied gold with a darbha blade, he puts it into the five-ladled clarified butter with "You are the life of Agni."

sanskrit_iast: indrasya prāṇo 'si \\ iti pūrvārdhe juhoti pradakṣiṇam uttarair anuparikrāman pratiparikramya pañcamena madhye //
meaning: इन्द्रस्य प्राणो ऽसि \\ इति पूर्वार्धे जुहोति प्रदक्षिणम् उत्तरैर् अनुपरिक्रामन् प्रतिपरिक्रम्य पञ्चमेन मध्ये //
text_mt: With the sacred formula, “You are the breath of Indra,” he offers into the eastern half [of the fire], walking around clockwise with the following [mantras], and having walked back around, [he offers] in the middle with the fifth.

sanskrit_iast: yan navam aid iti pānāya ghṛtam ānīya hiraṇyam uddharati pāvamānasya \\ iti tṛtīyamātraṃ bṛhatā tvā \\ iti dvibhāgam agneṣ ṭvā \\ ity uddhṛtya tīre nidadhāti /
meaning: यन् नवम् ऐद् इति पानाय घृतम् आनीय हिरण्यम् उद्धरति पावमानस्य \\ इति तृतीयमात्रं बृहता त्वा \\ इति द्विभागम् अग्नेष् ट्वा \\ इत्य् उद्धृत्य तीरे निदधाति /
text_mt: Having poured clarified butter into a cup for drinking with the mantra, “What came fresh…”, he lifts out the piece of gold; with the mantra, “Of the purifying…,” he lifts out a third portion; with the mantra, “You by the Bṛhat…,” a two-fold portion; with the mantra, “You, O Agni…,” having lifted [it] out, he deposits it on the brim.

sanskrit_iast: agreṇāhavanīyaṃ paryāhṛtya tejo 'si \\ iti yajamānāya prayachati //
meaning: अग्रेणाहवनीयं पर्याहृत्य तेजो ऽसि \\ इति यजमानाय प्रयछति //
text_mt: Carrying it around in front of the āhavanīya fire, he hands it to the sacrificer with the mantra, “You are splendor.”

sanskrit_iast: idam̐ varcas \\ iti yajamānaḥ pratigṛhṇāti /
meaning: इदम्̐ वर्चस् \\ इति यजमानः प्रतिगृह्णाति /
text_mt: The sacrificer accepts it with the mantra, “This luster…”

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyam abhivyādāya nirdhayan pibati /
meaning: हिरण्यम् अभिव्यादाय निर्धयन् पिबति /
text_mt: Opening his mouth wide over the gold, he drinks, sucking it.

sanskrit_iast: prakṣālya \\ imam agne \\ iti yajamānāya badhnāti //
meaning: प्रक्षाल्य \\ इमम् अग्ने \\ इति यजमानाय बध्नाति //
text_mt: Having washed it, he binds it on the sacrificer with the mantra, “This, O Agni…”

sanskrit_iast: agnir āyur iti brahmaṇo hastam ālabhya sarva ṛtvijaḥ paryāhur brahmā yajamānasya /
meaning: अग्निर् आयुर् इति ब्रह्मणो हस्तम् आलभ्य सर्व ऋत्विजः पर्याहुर् ब्रह्मा यजमानस्य /
text_mt: Taking hold of the brahman's hand, all the officiating priests recite around [the fire] with the mantra, “Agni is life,” and the brahman [takes hold] of the sacrificer's [hand].

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇākāle daśataṃ dadāti /
meaning: दक्षिणाकाले दशतं ददाति /
text_mt: At the time of the sacrificial gift, he gives a decade [of cows].

sanskrit_iast: jīvitavān kalpaḥ //
meaning: जीवितवान् कल्पः //

sanskrit_iast: agna āyūm̐ṣi \\ āyurdā deva \\ iti daśa haviṣām /
meaning: अग्न आयूम्̐षि \\ आयुर्दा देव \\ इति दश हविषाम् /
text_mt: The mantras, “O Agni, [give] life-spans…” and “O divine giver of life…,” are the ten [verses] for the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyam aṣṭākapālam iti caturhaviḥ pañcahavir vā [ ye paśavo ] ya ichet prajananena me paśavo bahavaḥ syur iti /
meaning: आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालम् इति चतुर्हविः पञ्चहविर् वा [ ये पशवो ] य इछेत् प्रजननेन मे पशवो बहवः स्युर् इति /
text_mt: The cake on eight potsherds for Agni, etc., is [a sacrifice] of four oblations, or of five oblations, for one who desires, “May my cattle become many through procreation.”

sanskrit_iast: atha ced upanameta purastāt sam̐sṛṣṭasyendrāyaikādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet prājāpatyam̐ sam̐sṛṣṭam /
meaning: अथ चेद् उपनमेत पुरस्तात् सम्̐सृष्टस्येन्द्रायैकादशकपालं निर्वपेत् प्राजापत्यम्̐ सम्̐सृष्टम् /
