text_mt: Then, if it falls to him, he should apportion beforehand a cake on eleven potsherds for Indra combined [with the other offering], [and] the mixed offering to Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: udvāsanavelāyāṃ kām̐sye camase vopastīrya dadhi madhu ghṛtaṃ dhānā udakaṃ pavitrāntarhita ānayati //
meaning: उद्वासनवेलायां काम्̐स्ये चमसे वोपस्तीर्य दधि मधु घृतं धाना उदकं पवित्रान्तर्हित आनयति //
text_mt: At the time of taking [the oblations] off the fire, having spread under [a layer of clarified butter] in a bronze vessel or a wooden cup, separated by a strainer, he pours in curd, honey, clarified butter, parched grains, and water.

sanskrit_iast: ā no agne sucetunā \ no agne rayiṃ bhara \\ iti daśa haviṣām /
meaning: आ नो अग्ने सुचेतुना \ नो अग्ने रयिं भर \\ इति दश हविषाम् /
text_mt: The verses, “Come to us, O Agni, with good will…” and “Bring us wealth, O Agni,” are the ten [verses] for the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye bhrājasvata iti trihaviś cakṣuṣkāmasya /
meaning: अग्नये भ्राजस्वत इति त्रिहविश् चक्षुष्कामस्य /
text_mt: The sacrifice of three oblations to radiant Agni is for one who desires [good] eyesight.

sanskrit_iast: śuklā vrīhayo bhavanti śvetānāṃ gavām ājyaṃ payasi caruḥ /
meaning: शुक्ला व्रीहयो भवन्ति श्वेतानां गवाम् आज्यं पयसि चरुः /
text_mt: There are white rice grains, clarified butter of white cows, and a boiled oblation in milk.

sanskrit_iast: brahmabhāgayajamānabhāgābhyām̐ saha sauryaṃ caruṃ brahmaṇe pariharati /
meaning: ब्रह्मभागयजमानभागाभ्याम्̐ सह सौर्यं चरुं ब्रह्मणे परिहरति /
text_mt: Along with the brahman's portion and the sacrificer's portion, he carries around the boiled oblation to Sūrya for the brahman priest.

sanskrit_iast: hute samiṣṭayajuṣi sauryaṃ carum /
meaning: हुते समिष्टयजुषि सौर्यं चरुम् /
text_mt: When the samiṣṭayajus oblation has been offered, [he takes] the boiled oblation to Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast: catasraḥ piṇḍīḥ kṛtvā saurībhir hasta ādadhāti /
meaning: चतस्रः पिण्डीः कृत्वा सौरीभिर् हस्त आदधाति /
text_mt: Having made four balls, he places them in [his] hand with the verses addressed to Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast: tāḥ prāśya yajamānabhāgaṃ prāśnāti //
meaning: ताः प्राश्य यजमानभागं प्राश्नाति //
text_mt: Having consumed them, he consumes the sacrificer's portion.

sanskrit_iast: ud agne śucayas tava \\ ayam agnir iti catasro haviṣām /
meaning: उद् अग्ने शुचयस् तव \\ अयम् अग्निर् इति चतस्रो हविषाम् /
text_mt: The verses, “Upwards, O Agni, your bright [flames]…” and “This Agni…,” are the four [verses] for the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: pūrve prathamottamayor ādānīyā uttarāḥ /
meaning: पूर्वे प्रथमोत्तमयोर् आदानीया उत्तराः /
text_mt: The former two are the taking verses of the first and the last [oblations], and the subsequent are [the corresponding offering verses].

sanskrit_iast: sarvapṛṣṭhayā bhūtikāmo yajetābhiśasyamāno vā /
meaning: सर्वपृष्ठया भूतिकामो यजेताभिशस्यमानो वा /
text_mt: One who desires prosperity, or one who is being defamed, should sacrifice with the Sarvapṛṣṭhā sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa kapālāni prayunakti /
meaning: द्वादश कपालानि प्रयुनक्ति /
text_mt: He sets down twelve potsherds.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā nirvapaṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ निर्वपणात् /

sanskrit_iast: indrāya rāthaṃtarāyendrāya bārhatāyendrāya vairūpāyendrāya vairājāyendrāya raivatāyendrāya śākvarāyety ekaikasyai devatāyai caturaścaturo muṣṭīn nirvapati sarvā vā devatā anuhṛtya catura eva muṣṭīn /
meaning: इन्द्राय राथंतरायेन्द्राय बार्हतायेन्द्राय वैरूपायेन्द्राय वैराजायेन्द्राय रैवतायेन्द्राय शाक्वरायेत्य् एकैकस्यै देवतायै चतुरश्चतुरो मुष्टीन् निर्वपति सर्वा वा देवता अनुहृत्य चतुर एव मुष्टीन् /
text_mt: With the mantras, “For Indra connected with Rathantara, for Indra connected with Bṛhat, for Indra connected with Vairūpa, for Indra connected with Vairāja, for Indra connected with Śākvara,” he apportions four handfuls for each deity, or, enumerating all deities, only four handfuls [in all].

sanskrit_iast: siddham opadhānāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् ओपधानात् /

sanskrit_iast: uttānāni kapālāny upadadhāti / tat svic caruḥ /
meaning: उत्तानानि कपालान्य् उपदधाति / तत् स्विच् चरुः /
text_mt: He places the potsherds facing upwards; or is that a boiled oblation?

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā pracaraṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ प्रचरणात् /

sanskrit_iast:
madhyamasya pūrvārdhād avadāya pūrvārdhāc ca \\ indrāya rāthaṃtarāyānubrūhi
abhi tvā śūra nonumas\ adugdhā iva dhenavaḥ /
īśānam asya jagataḥ svardṛśam \ īśānam om //
ity anvāha //
meaning:
मध्यमस्य पूर्वार्धाद् अवदाय पूर्वार्धाच् च \\ इन्द्राय राथंतरायानुब्रूहि
अभि त्वा शूर नोनुमस्\ अदुग्धा इव धेनवः /
ईशानम् अस्य जगतः स्वर्दृशम् \ ईशानम् ओम् //
इत्य् अन्वाह //

sanskrit_iast:
indraṃ bārhatam̐ yaja // \ ye yajāmahe \\ indraṃ bārhatam
indra tasthuṣas \ tvām id dhi havāmahe \ sātā vājasya kāravaḥ /
tvām̐ vṛtreṣv indra satpatiṃ naras \ tvāṃ kāṣṭhāsv arvatā vā //
iti yajati /
meaning:
इन्द्रं बार्हतम्̐ यज // \ ये यजामहे \\ इन्द्रं बार्हतम्
इन्द्र तस्थुषस् \ त्वाम् इद् धि हवामहे \ साता वाजस्य कारवः /
त्वाम्̐ वृत्रेष्व् इन्द्र सत्पतिं नरस् \ त्वां काष्ठास्व् अर्वता वा //
इति यजति /
text_mt:
[The adhvaryu commands:] “Recite the offering verse for Indra connected with Bṛhat.” / “We who sacrifice to Indra connected with Bṛhat…”

“…O Indra, of the stationary; / you indeed we invoke, / we, the singers, for the winning of the prize.

You, O Indra, the true lord, men [invoke] among the Vṛtras; / you [we invoke] with steed in the contests; vaṣaṭ!”

sanskrit_iast: pratiparikṛṣyābhiparikarṣan pradakṣiṇam uttarābhyo 'vadyati //
meaning: प्रतिपरिकृष्याभिपरिकर्षन् प्रदक्षिणम् उत्तराभ्यो ऽवद्यति //
text_mt: Drawing around in the opposite direction and then drawing forward, he cuts off portions for the subsequent deities in a clockwise direction.

sanskrit_iast:
idrāya bārhatāyānubrūhi
tvām id dhi havāmahe \ sātā vājasya kāravaḥ /
tvām̐ vṛtreṣv indra satpatiṃ naras \ tvāṃ kom //
ity anvāha //
meaning:
इद्राय बार्हतायानुब्रूहि
त्वाम् इद् धि हवामहे \ साता वाजस्य कारवः /
त्वाम्̐ वृत्रेष्व् इन्द्र सत्पतिं नरस् \ त्वां कोम् //
इत्य् अन्वाह //

sanskrit_iast:
indram̐ rāthaṃtaram̐ yaja // \ ye yajāmahe \\ indram̐ rāthaṃtaram
ṣṭhāsv arvata \ abhi tvā śūra nonumas\ adugdhā iva dhenavaḥ /
īśānam asya jagataḥ svardṛśam \ īśānam indra tasthuṣā vā //
iti yajati //
meaning:
इन्द्रम्̐ राथंतरम्̐ यज // \ ये यजामहे \\ इन्द्रम्̐ राथंतरम्
ष्ठास्व् अर्वत \ अभि त्वा शूर नोनुमस्\ अदुग्धा इव धेनवः /
ईशानम् अस्य जगतः स्वर्दृशम् \ ईशानम् इन्द्र तस्थुषा वा //
इति यजति //

sanskrit_iast: indrāya vairūpāyānubrūhi \\ āpaprātha \\ ity anvāha //
meaning: इन्द्राय वैरूपायानुब्रूहि \\ आपप्राथ \\ इत्य् अन्वाह //
text_mt: “Recite the invitatory verse for Indra connected with Vairūpa.” He recites: “You filled…”

sanskrit_iast: indram̐ vairājam̐ yaja // \ bodhā su me \\ iti yajati //
meaning: इन्द्रम्̐ वैराजम्̐ यज // \ बोधा सु मे \\ इति यजति //
text_mt: “Recite the offering verse for Indra connected with Vairāja.” He recites the offering verse: “Heed well for me…”

sanskrit_iast: indrāya vairājāyānubrūhi \\ etām evānvāha //
meaning: इन्द्राय वैराजायानुब्रूहि \\ एताम् एवान्वाह //
text_mt: “Recite the invitatory verse for Indra connected with Vairāja.” He recites that very same [verse].

sanskrit_iast: indram̐ vairūpam̐ yaja \\ āpaprātha \\ iti yajati //
meaning: इन्द्रम्̐ वैरूपम्̐ यज \\ आपप्राथ \\ इति यजति //
text_mt: “Recite the offering verse for Indra connected with Vairūpa.” He recites the offering verse: “You filled…”

sanskrit_iast: indrāya raivatāyānubrūhi // \ revatīr nas \\ ity anvāha //
meaning: इन्द्राय रैवतायानुब्रूहि // \ रेवतीर् नस् \\ इत्य् अन्वाह //
text_mt: “Recite the invitatory verse for Indra connected with Raivata.” He recites: “The wealthy ones to us…”

sanskrit_iast: indram̐ śākvaram̐ yaja // \ pro ṣv asmai \\ iti yajati //
meaning: इन्द्रम्̐ शाक्वरम्̐ यज // \ प्रो ष्व् अस्मै \\ इति यजति //
text_mt: “Recite the offering verse for Indra connected with Śākvara.” He recites the offering verse: “Forth indeed to him…”

sanskrit_iast: indrāya śākvarāyānubrūhi \\ etām evānvāha //
meaning: इन्द्राय शाक्वरायानुब्रूहि \\ एताम् एवान्वाह //
text_mt: “Recite the invitatory verse for Indra connected with Śākvara.” He recites that very same [verse].

sanskrit_iast: indram̐ raivatam̐ yaja / pūrvayā yajati /
meaning: इन्द्रम्̐ रैवतम्̐ यज / पूर्वया यजति /
text_mt: “Recite the offering verse for Indra connected with Raivata.” He recites the offering verse with the former [verse].

sanskrit_iast: yathejyam upalakṣyate sviṣṭakṛti sūktavāke ca /
meaning: यथेज्यम् उपलक्ष्यते स्विष्टकृति सूक्तवाके च /
text_mt: In accordance with what is offered, [the deity] is designated in the Sviṣṭakṛt offering and in the sūktavāka recitation.

sanskrit_iast: pratiparikṛṣyābhiparikarṣan sviṣṭakṛte samavadyatīḍāyai ca /
meaning: प्रतिपरिकृष्याभिपरिकर्षन् स्विष्टकृते समवद्यतीडायै च /
text_mt: Drawing around in the opposite direction and then drawing forward, he cuts off together [portions] for the Sviṣṭakṛt offering and for the iḍā portion.

sanskrit_iast: yathākāmaṃ tantram /
meaning: यथाकामं तन्त्रम् /

sanskrit_iast: aiṣṭikyā sautrāmaṇyā yajeta somātipavito rājasūyenābhiṣiṣicāno bhūtikāmo jyogāmayāvī vā /
meaning: ऐष्टिक्या सौत्रामण्या यजेत सोमातिपवितो राजसूयेनाभिषिषिचानो भूतिकामो ज्योगामयावी वा /
text_mt: One who has vomited Soma, one who has been consecrated by the Rājasūya, one who desires prosperity, or one who has been ill for a long time should sacrifice with the Sautrāmaṇī performed as an iṣṭi.

sanskrit_iast: sīsena klībāt pariśrite surādravyaṃ krīṇāti nagnahuvrīhiyavagodhūmaśaṣpāṇi //
meaning: सीसेन क्लीबात् परिश्रिते सुराद्रव्यं क्रीणाति नग्नहुव्रीहियवगोधूमशष्पाणि //
text_mt: With lead, in an enclosure, he purchases from a eunuch the ingredients for the surā liquor: the ferment (nagnahu), rice, barley, wheat, and young sprouts.

sanskrit_iast: surāsomavikrayinn etena te sīsena surāsomān krīṇāni \\ ity uktvā krīṇāti //
meaning: सुरासोमविक्रयिन्न् एतेन ते सीसेन सुरासोमान् क्रीणानि \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा क्रीणाति //
text_mt: Having said, “O seller of the surā-Soma, with this lead let me buy the surā-Somas from you,” he purchases [them].

sanskrit_iast: svādvīṃ tvā svādunā \\ iti saṃdadhāti //
meaning: स्वाद्वीं त्वा स्वादुना \\ इति संदधाति //
text_mt: With the text, 'You, sweet one, with the sweet…' he mixes [them].

sanskrit_iast: somo 'si \\ aśvibhyāṃ pacyasva \\ ity abhimṛśati /
meaning: सोमो ऽसि \\ अश्विभ्यां पच्यस्व \\ इत्य् अभिमृशति /
text_mt: With the text, 'You are Soma; mature for the two Aśvins,' he touches [it].

sanskrit_iast: śvaḥ surā janitā \\ iti paśubandhāyopavasati /
meaning: श्वः सुरा जनिता \\ इति पशुबन्धायोपवसति /
text_mt: With the text, 'Tomorrow the surā will be born,' he fasts for the animal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā vedikālāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ वेदिकालात् /

sanskrit_iast: vedikāle pratiprasthātā dakṣiṇato vedirūpaṃ kharaṃ karoty uttarato 'dhvaryuḥ payograhebhyo hrasīyām̐sam /
meaning: वेदिकाले प्रतिप्रस्थाता दक्षिणतो वेदिरूपं खरं करोत्य् उत्तरतो ऽध्वर्युः पयोग्रहेभ्यो ह्रसीयाम्̐सम् /
text_mt: At the time of the altar, the pratiprasthātṛ makes an earthen mound in the form of an altar to the south, and the adhvaryu a shorter one to the north for the milk draughts.

sanskrit_iast: agnī praṇayataḥ /
meaning: अग्नी प्रणयतः /

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇato dakṣiṇāgneḥ pratiprasthātā kharād upayamanīḥ kṛtvāvokṣya pūrvārdhe kharasya sādayati /
meaning: दक्षिणतो दक्षिणाग्नेः प्रतिप्रस्थाता खराद् उपयमनीः कृत्वावोक्ष्य पूर्वार्धे खरस्य सादयति /
text_mt: To the south of the southern fire, the pratiprasthātṛ, having made the supporting earthen mounds [and] sprinkled them, places [the vessels] on the front half of the mound.

sanskrit_iast: pāśukāni pātrāṇi prayunakti / dakṣiṇasmin khare pratiprasthātā trīn mārttikān upayāmān vālaṃ droṇaṃ śatātṛṇṇāṃ trīṇi vāyavyāny uttarasminn adhvaryuḥ śaṣpapavitre trīṇi vāyavyāni /
meaning: पाशुकानि पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति / दक्षिणस्मिन् खरे प्रतिप्रस्थाता त्रीन् मार्त्तिकान् उपयामान् वालं द्रोणं शतातृण्णां त्रीणि वायव्यान्य् उत्तरस्मिन्न् अध्वर्युः शष्पपवित्रे त्रीणि वायव्यानि /
text_mt: He arranges the utensils of the animal sacrifice: on the southern mound the pratiprasthātṛ [places] three earthen upayāma cups, the hair sieve, the wooden trough, the perforated vessel, and three vāyavya vessels; on the northern one the adhvaryu [places] the young-sprout strainers and three vāyavya vessels.

sanskrit_iast: ājyaṃ payaś cābhyudāharati /
meaning: आज्यं पयश् चाभ्युदाहरति /
text_mt: He brings near clarified butter and milk.

sanskrit_iast: vedyām ājyam̐ sādayati khare payaḥ /
meaning: वेद्याम् आज्यम्̐ सादयति खरे पयः /
text_mt: He sets down the clarified butter on the altar, and the milk on the mound.

sanskrit_iast: surākalaśaṃ pratiprasthātotkaradeśa āgnīdhrasya mūrdhani sādayitvāpareṇa vihāraṃ dakṣiṇātikramya svasmin khare sādayati /
meaning: सुराकलशं प्रतिप्रस्थातोत्करदेश आग्नीध्रस्य मूर्धनि सादयित्वापरेण विहारं दक्षिणातिक्रम्य स्वस्मिन् खरे सादयति /
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ, having placed the jar of surā at the rubbish heap upon the head of the āgnīdhra, steps across the sacrificial enclosure to the south by the west, and places it on his own mound.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ājyagrahebhyaḥ /
meaning: सिद्धम् आज्यग्रहेभ्यः /
text_mt: [The procedure is] established up to the clarified butter draughts.

sanskrit_iast: caturgṛhītāny ājyāni pṛṣadājyavanti gṛhṇāti /
meaning: चतुर्गृहीतान्य् आज्यानि पृषदाज्यवन्ति गृह्णाति /
text_mt: He takes the fourfold ladlings of clarified butter with clotted butter.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ājyānām̐ sādanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आज्यानाम्̐ सादनात् /
text_mt: [The procedure is] established up to the setting down of the portions of clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: droṇe vālam̐ vitatya pratiprasthātā punātu te parisrutam iti surām atipāvayati //
meaning: द्रोणे वालम्̐ वितत्य प्रतिप्रस्थाता पुनातु ते परिस्रुतम् इति सुराम् अतिपावयति //
text_mt: Having spread the hair [sieve] over the trough, the pratiprasthātṛ strains the surā with the mantra: 'May he purify your liquor...'

sanskrit_iast: kuvid aṅga yavamantas \\ iti gṛhṇīto 'dhvaryuḥ payograhān adhyadhi śaṣpapavitre dhārayamāṇa āśvinam̐ sārasvatam indrāya sutrāmṇe /
meaning: कुविद् अङ्ग यवमन्तस् \\ इति गृह्णीतो ऽध्वर्युः पयोग्रहान् अध्यधि शष्पपवित्रे धारयमाण आश्विनम्̐ सारस्वतम् इन्द्राय सुत्राम्णे /
text_mt: With the verse: 'Indeed, where they possess barley...', the adhvaryu takes the milk draughts, holding the young-sprout strainer over them: [the draught] for the Aśvins, for Sarasvatī, and for Indra the good protector.

sanskrit_iast: yathādevatam upayāmasādanaṃ ca //
meaning: यथादेवतम् उपयामसादनं च //
text_mt: And the setting down in the upayāma cups corresponds to the deity.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ achidrāṃ tvāchidreṇa \\ iti pratiprasthātopayāmeṣu surāgrahān kuvalasaktubhir āśvinam̐ śrītvā sādayati karkandhusaktubhiḥ sārasvataṃ badarasaktubhir aindram /
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ अछिद्रां त्वाछिद्रेण \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थातोपयामेषु सुराग्रहान् कुवलसक्तुभिर् आश्विनम्̐ श्रीत्वा सादयति कर्कन्धुसक्तुभिः सारस्वतं बदरसक्तुभिर् ऐन्द्रम् /
text_mt: With the mantra: 'You are taken with a base; you, unpierced, with an unpierced...', the pratiprasthātṛ sets down the surā draughts into the upayāma cups, having mixed that for the Aśvins with jujube groats, that for Sarasvatī with wild-jujube groats, and that for Indra with berry groats.

sanskrit_iast: yūpāvaṭaprabhṛti siddham opākaraṇāt /
meaning: यूपावटप्रभृति सिद्धम् ओपाकरणात् /
text_mt: [The procedure] from the sacrificial post hole onwards is established up to the dedication [of the victim].

sanskrit_iast: āśvinam ajam upākaroti sārasvatīṃ meṣīm aindram ṛṣabham /
meaning: आश्विनम् अजम् उपाकरोति सारस्वतीं मेषीम् ऐन्द्रम् ऋषभम् /
text_mt: He dedicates a he-goat to the Aśvins, a ewe to Sarasvatī, and a bull to Indra.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā mārjanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ मार्जनात् /

sanskrit_iast: upayāmān vāyavyeṣv avanīyāntarāgnī grahān ādāyāvatiṣṭhante dakṣiṇaiḥ surāgrahān savyaiḥ payograhān pūrvo 'dhvaryur aparaḥ pratiprasthātāparo yajamānaḥ //
meaning: उपयामान् वायव्येष्व् अवनीयान्तराग्नी ग्रहान् आदायावतिष्ठन्ते दक्षिणैः सुराग्रहान् सव्यैः पयोग्रहान् पूर्वो ऽध्वर्युर् अपरः प्रतिप्रस्थातापरो यजमानः //
text_mt: Having poured the upayāma cups into the vāyavya vessels and taken up the cups between the two fires, they stand: the surā draughts in their right hands, the milk draughts in their left hands, the adhvaryu in front, the pratiprasthātṛ behind him, and the sacrificer behind him.

sanskrit_iast: aśvibhyām̐ sarasvatyā indrāya sutrāmṇe somānām̐ surāmṇām anubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
meaning: अश्विभ्याम्̐ सरस्वत्या इन्द्राय सुत्राम्णे सोमानाम्̐ सुराम्णाम् अनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: He has [the hotṛ] recite: 'For the Aśvins, for Sarasvatī, for Indra the good protector, recite the invitatory verse for the Somas rich in surā.'

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya \\ aśvibhyām̐ sarasvatyā indrāya sutrāmṇe somān surāmṇaḥ prasthitān preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
meaning: आश्राव्य \\ अश्विभ्याम्̐ सरस्वत्या इन्द्राय सुत्राम्णे सोमान् सुराम्णः प्रस्थितान् प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
text_mt: Having caused [the āgnīdhra] to call, he proceeds with the command: 'For the Aśvins, for Sarasvatī, for Indra the good protector, summon [the deities] for the set-forth Somas rich in surā.'

sanskrit_iast: vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛte hutvā dhyānāni dhyāyati sim̐hayor imam̐ yaśa āgachatv ity adhvaryur vyāghrayor iti pratiprasthātā vṛkayor mām iti yajamānaḥ /
meaning: वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृते हुत्वा ध्यानानि ध्यायति सिम्̐हयोर् इमम्̐ यश आगछत्व् इत्य् अध्वर्युर् व्याघ्रयोर् इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता वृकयोर् माम् इति यजमानः /
text_mt: Having offered at the vaṣaṭ-call and at the secondary vaṣaṭ-call, he meditates upon thoughts: 'May this fame of the two lions come,' the adhvaryu [thinks]; 'of the two tigers,' the pratiprasthātṛ; 'of the two wolves, to me,' the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: mukhyayoḥ saṃpātān avanīyāgreṇāgnī paryāhṛtya dakṣiṇato yajamāno bhakṣayati yad atra śiṣṭam iti payograhān nānā hi vām iti surāgrahān avaghreṇa surāpaḥ //
meaning: मुख्ययोः संपातान् अवनीयाग्रेणाग्नी पर्याहृत्य दक्षिणतो यजमानो भक्षयति यद् अत्र शिष्टम् इति पयोग्रहान् नाना हि वाम् इति सुराग्रहान् अवघ्रेण सुरापः //
text_mt: Having poured the residues into the two chief vessels and brought them around in front of the two fires, the sacrificer consumes to the south the milk draughts with the mantra: 'What is left here...', and the surā-drinkers the surā draughts by smelling with: 'Different indeed are you two...'

sanskrit_iast: dve srutī itiprabhṛtibhiḥ prāk sviṣṭakṛtaś catasra āhutīr juhoti /
meaning: द्वे स्रुती इतिप्रभृतिभिः प्राक् स्विष्टकृतश् चतस्र आहुतीर् जुहोति /
text_mt: Before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, he offers four oblations beginning with the words: 'The two paths...'

sanskrit_iast: pratiprasthātādhyadhi dakṣiṇam agnim̐ śatātṛṇṇām avasthāpya surāśeṣam ānīya tvam̐ soma pracikitas \\ itiprabhṛtibhir dvādaśabhiḥ kṣarantīm anumantrayate tisṛbhistisṛbhir ekaiko dakṣiṇato brahmā paścād yajamāna uttarato 'dhvaryuḥ purastāt pratiprasthātā /
meaning: प्रतिप्रस्थाताध्यधि दक्षिणम् अग्निम्̐ शतातृण्णाम् अवस्थाप्य सुराशेषम् आनीय त्वम्̐ सोम प्रचिकितस् \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् द्वादशभिः क्षरन्तीम् अनुमन्त्रयते तिसृभिस्तिसृभिर् एकैको दक्षिणतो ब्रह्मा पश्चाद् यजमान उत्तरतो ऽध्वर्युः पुरस्तात् प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ, having fixed the perforated vessel over the southern fire and poured the remainder of the surā, accompanies the flowing [liquid] with the twelve [verses] beginning with: 'You, Soma, well-disposed...', each [priest reciting] three verses: the brahman to the south, the sacrificer to the west, the adhvaryu to the north, and the pratiprasthātṛ to the east.

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśakapālān paśupuroḍāśān nirvapatīndrāya sutrāmṇe savitre varuṇāya /
meaning: एकादशकपालान् पशुपुरोडाशान् निर्वपतीन्द्राय सुत्राम्णे सवित्रे वरुणाय /
text_mt: He apportions eleven-potsherd animal cakes for Indra the good protector, for Savitṛ, and for Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: ṛte sviṣṭakṛtaḥ paśubhiḥ pracarya paśupuroḍāśaiḥ pracaraty aindreṇa prathamaṃ / paśūnāṃ paśupuroḍāśānāṃ ca sviṣṭakṛte samavadyatīḍāyai ca /
meaning: ऋते स्विष्टकृतः पशुभिः प्रचर्य पशुपुरोडाशैः प्रचरत्य् ऐन्द्रेण प्रथमं / पशूनां पशुपुरोडाशानां च स्विष्टकृते समवद्यतीडायै च /
text_mt: Having proceeded with the animals except for the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, he proceeds with the animal cakes, first with the one for Indra; and he cuts off [portions] from the animals and from the animal cakes for the Sviṣṭakṛt offering and for the iḍā portion.

sanskrit_iast: yathākāmaṃ tantram /
meaning: यथाकामं तन्त्रम् /

sanskrit_iast: mārjayitvā vaḍabā dakṣiṇā /
meaning: मार्जयित्वा वडबा दक्षिणा /
text_mt: Having performed the cleansing, the sacrificial gift is a mare.

sanskrit_iast: siddhaḥ paśubandhaḥ /
meaning: सिद्धः पशुबन्धः /

sanskrit_iast: paśor hotram āmnātam /
meaning: पशोर् होत्रम् आम्नातम् /

sanskrit_iast: surāpayoliptāny apsu praharati //
meaning: सुरापयोलिप्तान्य् अप्सु प्रहरति //
text_mt: He throws into water the utensils smeared with surā and milk.

sanskrit_iast: yuvam̐ surāmam iti grahāṇām anuvākyā //
meaning: युवम्̐ सुरामम् इति ग्रहाणाम् अनुवाक्या //
text_mt: 'You two, rich in surā…' is the invitatory verse for the draughts.

sanskrit_iast: hotā yakṣad aśvinau \\ iti praiṣaḥ //
meaning: होता यक्षद् अश्विनौ \\ इति प्रैषः //
text_mt: 'May the hotṛ worship the two Aśvins…' is the command.

sanskrit_iast: putram iva pitarau \\ viti yājyā //
meaning: पुत्रम् इव पितरौ \\ विति याज्या //
text_mt: 'Like two parents to a son…' is the offering verse.

sanskrit_iast: somānām̐ surāmṇām agne vīhi \\ ity anuvaṣaṭkaroti //
meaning: सोमानाम्̐ सुराम्णाम् अग्ने वीहि \\ इत्य् अनुवषट्करोति //
text_mt: He utters the secondary vaṣaṭ-call with: 'Partake, O Agni, of the Somas rich in surā.'

sanskrit_iast: indraḥ sutrāmā \ tasya vayam \\ tat savitur \ acittī \\ imaṃ me varuṇa \ tat tvā yāmi \\ iti paśupuroḍāśānām /
meaning: इन्द्रः सुत्रामा \ तस्य वयम् \\ तत् सवितुर् \ अचित्ती \\ इमं मे वरुण \ तत् त्वा यामि \\ इति पशुपुरोडाशानाम् /
text_mt: 'Indra the good protector…' [and] 'May we of him…', 'That of Savitṛ…' [and] 'In ignorance…', 'This my prayer, O Varuṇa…' [and] 'That I ask of you…' are [the invitatory and offering verses] for the animal cakes.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśarātraṃ tapas taptvā traidhātavyayā yajeta trirātropepsyāgūrty abhicaran vā /
meaning: द्वादशरात्रं तपस् तप्त्वा त्रैधातव्यया यजेत त्रिरात्रोपेप्स्यागूर्त्य् अभिचरन् वा /
text_mt: Having practiced austerity for twelve nights, one should sacrifice with the Traidhātavīyā [offering] if one wishes to obtain [a wish] for three nights, or if one has resolved upon an undertaking, or if one is performing an incantation.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa kapālāni prayunakti /
meaning: द्वादश कपालानि प्रयुनक्ति /
text_mt: He arranges twelve potsherds.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā nirvapaṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ निर्वपणात् /

sanskrit_iast: aindrāvaiṣṇavān vrīhīn nirupya yavān nirvapati tato vrīhīn /
meaning: ऐन्द्रावैष्णवान् व्रीहीन् निरुप्य यवान् निर्वपति ततो व्रीहीन् /
text_mt: Having apportioned rice grains for Indra and Viṣṇu, he apportions barley grains, and then rice grains.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ādhiśrayaṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आधिश्रयणात् /

sanskrit_iast: vrīhimayam adhiśrityāparyagnikṛtam̐ śrapayitvā tasmin varṣīyām̐sam̐ yavamayam adhiśrityāparyagnikṛtam̐ śrapayitvā tasmin varṣiṣṭham̐ vrīhimayam adhiśritya paryagniṃ karoti /
meaning: व्रीहिमयम् अधिश्रित्यापर्यग्निकृतम्̐ श्रपयित्वा तस्मिन् वर्षीयाम्̐सम्̐ यवमयम् अधिश्रित्यापर्यग्निकृतम्̐ श्रपयित्वा तस्मिन् वर्षिष्ठम्̐ व्रीहिमयम् अधिश्रित्य पर्यग्निं करोति /
text_mt: Having placed [the cake] made of rice [on the potsherds] and cooked it without carrying fire around it, and having placed upon it a larger one made of barley and cooked it without carrying fire around it, and having placed upon it the largest one made of rice, he carries fire around it.

sanskrit_iast: siddham odvāsanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् ओद्वासनात् /

sanskrit_iast: abhighāryottarāv upariṣṭād dhārayann adharam abhighāryodvāsyālaṃkaroti /
meaning: अभिघार्योत्तराव् उपरिष्टाद् धारयन्न् अधरम् अभिघार्योद्वास्यालंकरोति /
text_mt: Having basted with clarified butter, holding the two upper ones above, having basted the bottom one and taken it off the fire, he decorates it.

sanskrit_iast: ādhāyottarau sarveṣām atighātam avadyati havirāhutisviṣṭakṛdiḍebhya ekasya bhakṣān /
meaning: आधायोत्तरौ सर्वेषाम् अतिघातम् अवद्यति हविराहुतिस्विष्टकृदिडेभ्य एकस्य भक्षान् /
text_mt: Having placed the two upper ones [back], he cuts off from all of them together for the oblation-offerings, the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, and the iḍā portions, [and] from one of them the portions for eating.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇākāle sahasraṃ dakṣiṇākāle tisro dhenavas trīṇi hiraṇyāni trīṇi tārpyāṇy anyat sahasrād āgūrtino 'bhicarato vā dakṣiṇā //
meaning: दक्षिणाकाले सहस्रं दक्षिणाकाले तिस्रो धेनवस् त्रीणि हिरण्यानि त्रीणि तार्प्याण्य् अन्यत् सहस्राद् आगूर्तिनो ऽभिचरतो वा दक्षिणा //
text_mt: At the time of the sacrificial gift, [the gift is] a thousand [cows]; [or] at the time of the sacrificial gift, three milch cows, three gold pieces, and three silken garments; for one who has resolved upon an undertaking or is performing an incantation, the sacrificial gift is other than a thousand.

sanskrit_iast: agne vājasya gomatas \\ iti pañca dhāyyā jagatī ṣaṣṭhī //
meaning: अग्ने वाजस्य गोमतस् \\ इति पञ्च धाय्या जगती षष्ठी //
text_mt: 'O Agni, possessor of prize, rich in cows…' are five introductory verses; the sixth is in the jagatī metre.

sanskrit_iast: agne trī te vājinā trī ṣadhasthā \\ iti triṣṭubhā paridadhāti //
meaning: अग्ने त्री ते वाजिना त्री षधस्था \\ इति त्रिष्टुभा परिदधाति //
text_mt: He concludes with a triṣṭubh: 'Three, O Agni, are your prizes, three your seats…'

sanskrit_iast: trir agnir balabhit \ trir ahnas \\ ity ājyabhāgau //
meaning: त्रिर् अग्निर् बलभित् \ त्रिर् अह्नस् \\ इत्य् आज्यभागौ //
text_mt: 'Thrice Agni, the smiter of strongholds…' and 'Thrice a day…' are the two clarified butter portions.

sanskrit_iast: sam̐ vāṃ karmaṇā \\ iti dve haviṣaḥ //
meaning: सम्̐ वां कर्मणा \\ इति द्वे हविषः //
text_mt: 'Together for you two through ritual action…' are the two [verses] for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: trīṇy āyūm̐ṣi \\ agnir asmi \\ iti sam̐yājye /
meaning: त्रीण्य् आयूम्̐षि \\ अग्निर् अस्मि \\ इति सम्̐याज्ये /
text_mt: 'Three lifespans…' and 'Agni am I…' are the two concluding offering verses.

sanskrit_iast: vārtraghno 'bhicarataḥ //
meaning: वार्त्रघ्नो ऽभिचरतः //
text_mt: For one who is performing an incantation, the two [verses] are the Vṛtra-slaying ones.

sanskrit_iast: indrāviṣṇū dṛm̐hitāḥ śambarasya \\ iti dve haviṣaḥ /
meaning: इन्द्राविष्णू दृम्̐हिताः शम्बरस्य \\ इति द्वे हविषः /
text_mt: "O Indra and Viṣṇu, made firm of Śambara…" are the two [verses] for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: putraḥ somena yajeta /
meaning: पुत्रः सोमेन यजेत /

sanskrit_iast: pārjanyaṃ caruṃ nirvaped vṛṣṭikāmaḥ //
meaning: पार्जन्यं चरुं निर्वपेद् वृष्टिकामः //
text_mt: One desiring rain should apportion a boiled oblation to Parjanya.

sanskrit_iast: parjanyāya pragāyata \\ iti dve haviṣaḥ /
meaning: पर्जन्याय प्रगायत \\ इति द्वे हविषः /
text_mt: "Sing forth to Parjanya…" are the two [verses] for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyam aṣṭākapālam iti trihavir adhiśrayaṇāt prabhṛti sam̐sṛjyāhutīś ca vidmā te agne \\ iti dve haviṣoś catasras \\ yas tastambha \\ iti ṣaṣṭhyau /
meaning: आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालम् इति त्रिहविर् अधिश्रयणात् प्रभृति सम्̐सृज्याहुतीश् च विद्मा ते अग्ने \\ इति द्वे हविषोश् चतस्रस् \\ यस् तस्तम्भ \\ इति षष्ठ्यौ /
text_mt: The three-oblation [rite] starting with the cake on eight potsherds to Agni: having combined [them] from the setting on the fire onward, and [having offered] the libations, "We know thee, O Agni…" are two [verses] for the two oblations; four [verses]; "He who sustained…" are the two sixth [verses].

sanskrit_iast: rājā purohito vā kārīryā vṛṣṭikāmo yajeta /
meaning: राजा पुरोहितो वा कारीर्या वृष्टिकामो यजेत /
text_mt: A king or a domestic priest, desiring rain, should sacrifice with the Kārīrī [offering].

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇam āchādya pūrvāhṇe vratam upaiti /
meaning: कृष्णम् आछाद्य पूर्वाह्णे व्रतम् उपैति /
text_mt: Having clothed himself in black, he enters upon the vow in the forenoon.

sanskrit_iast: vaitasam idhmam ājyaṃ madhu karīrasaktūn kṛṣṇājine paścād āhavanīyasyopasādayati /
meaning: वैतसम् इध्मम् आज्यं मधु करीरसक्तून् कृष्णाजिने पश्चाद् आहवनीयस्योपसादयति /
text_mt: He sets down reed sacrificial fuel, clarified butter, honey, [and] flour of karīra [fruits] upon a black antelope skin to the west of the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: anvārabdhe yajamāne vācayan purovāta \\ itiprabhṛtibhir iṣṭau vātahomāñ juhoti //
meaning: अन्वारब्धे यजमाने वाचयन् पुरोवात \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् इष्टौ वातहोमाञ् जुहोति //
text_mt: While the sacrificer holds onto him from behind, causing him to recite, he offers the wind-libations in the offering with [the mantras] beginning with "O forward-wind…".

sanskrit_iast: māndā vaśās \\ iti madhunā karīrasaktūn saṃnīya catasraḥ piṇḍīḥ kṛtvā kṛṣṇājine nidadhāti //
meaning: मान्दा वशास् \\ इति मधुना करीरसक्तून् संनीय चतस्रः पिण्डीः कृत्वा कृष्णाजिने निदधाति //
text_mt: With "The mild, the cows…", having mixed the flour of karīra [fruits] with honey and made four lumps, he places them on the black antelope skin.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣṇo aśvasya saṃdānam asi \\ iti śyāvasyāśvasya saṃdānam anumantrayate //
meaning: वृष्णो अश्वस्य संदानम् असि \\ इति श्यावस्याश्वस्य संदानम् अनुमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: With "You are the tether of the vigorous horse…", he accompanies the tether of a dark-brown horse with the mantra.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣṭyai tvopanahyāmi \\ iti kṛṣṇājine piṇḍīr upanahyati //
meaning: वृष्ट्यै त्वोपनह्यामि \\ इति कृष्णाजिने पिण्डीर् उपनह्यति //
text_mt: With "For rain I tie you up…", he ties up the lumps in the black antelope skin.

sanskrit_iast: devā vasavyās \\ iti pūrvārdhe gadhākarṇe pratimucyāhnas tṛtīyaṃ kāṅkṣet /
meaning: देवा वसव्यास् \\ इति पूर्वार्धे गधाकर्णे प्रतिमुच्याह्नस् तृतीयं काङ्क्षेत् /
text_mt: With "O gods possessing wealth…", having fastened [it] in the eastern part onto a peg, he should wait for a third of the day.

sanskrit_iast: yadi varṣed uttarābhyām aparayoḥ pratimucyeṣṭiṃ nirvapet /
meaning: यदि वर्षेद् उत्तराभ्याम् अपरयोः प्रतिमुच्येष्टिं निर्वपेत् /
text_mt: If it rains, having fastened [it] to the two latter [pegs] with the subsequent two [mantras], he should apportion [the oblations of] the offering.

sanskrit_iast: na ced varṣed devāḥ śarmaṇyās \\ iti madhyame pratimucyāhna uttarārdhaṃ kāṅkṣet /
meaning: न चेद् वर्षेद् देवाः शर्मण्यास् \\ इति मध्यमे प्रतिमुच्याह्न उत्तरार्धं काङ्क्षेत् /
text_mt: If it does not rain, having fastened [it] to the middle one with "O gods who provide shelter…", he should wait for the later part of the day.

sanskrit_iast: yadi varṣed uttamena paścārdhe pratimucyeṣṭiṃ nirvapet /
meaning: यदि वर्षेद् उत्तमेन पश्चार्धे प्रतिमुच्येष्टिं निर्वपेत् /
text_mt: If it rains, having fastened [it] in the western part with the last [mantra], he should apportion [the oblations of] the offering.

sanskrit_iast: na ced varṣed devāḥ sapītayas \\ iti pratimucyāhnaḥ śeṣaṃ kāṅkṣet /
meaning: न चेद् वर्षेद् देवाः सपीतयस् \\ इति प्रतिमुच्याह्नः शेषं काङ्क्षेत् /
text_mt: If it does not rain, having fastened [it] with "O gods who drink together…", he should wait for the remainder of the day.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣṭe sadyo nirvapet /
meaning: वृष्टे सद्यो निर्वपेत् /

sanskrit_iast: yadi na varṣet tatraiva vaseyuḥ /
meaning: यदि न वर्षेत् तत्रैव वसेयुः /
text_mt: If it does not rain, they should stay right there.

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte 'gnaye dhāmachade 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapen mārutam̐ saptakapālam̐ sauryam ekakapālam /
meaning: श्वोभूते ऽग्नये धामछदे ऽष्टाकपालं निर्वपेन् मारुतम्̐ सप्तकपालम्̐ सौर्यम् एककपालम् /
text_mt: On the next day, he should apportion [a cake] on eight potsherds to Agni Dhāmachad, [a cake] on seven potsherds to the Maruts, [and a cake] on one potsherd to Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast: udvāsanavelāyāṃ kām̐sye camase vopastīrya piṇḍīr alaṃkaroti /
meaning: उद्वासनवेलायां काम्̐स्ये चमसे वोपस्तीर्य पिण्डीर् अलंकरोति /
text_mt: At the time of taking off the fire, having spread under [a layer of clarified butter] in a bell-metal vessel or a cup, he prepares the lumps.

sanskrit_iast: prāk sviṣṭakṛtaḥ piṇḍīm avadāya divā cit tamas \\ iti nigadya devā vasavyās \\ iti juhoti \\ āyan naras \\ iti nigadya devāḥ śarmaṇyās \\ iti dvitīyām udīrayatā \\ iti nigadya devāḥ sapītayas \\ iti tṛtīyām̐ // sṛjā vṛṣṭiṃ divas \\ ity apsu caturthīm //
meaning: प्राक् स्विष्टकृतः पिण्डीम् अवदाय दिवा चित् तमस् \\ इति निगद्य देवा वसव्यास् \\ इति जुहोति \\ आयन् नरस् \\ इति निगद्य देवाः शर्मण्यास् \\ इति द्वितीयाम् उदीरयता \\ इति निगद्य देवाः सपीतयस् \\ इति तृतीयाम्̐ // सृजा वृष्टिं दिवस् \\ इत्य् अप्सु चतुर्थीम् //
text_mt: Before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, having cut off a portion from a lump, having uttered "Even by day darkness…", he offers with "O gods possessing wealth…"; having uttered "The men coming…", he offers the second with "O gods who provide shelter…"; having uttered "Send forth…", he offers the third with "O gods who drink together…"; with "Release rain from heaven…", [he throws] the fourth into water.

sanskrit_iast: ye devā divibhāgāḥ stha \\ iti barhiṣi kṛṣṇājinam avadhūnoti /
meaning: ये देवा दिविभागाः स्थ \\ इति बर्हिषि कृष्णाजिनम् अवधूनोति /
text_mt: With "O gods who have your portion in heaven…", he shakes out the black antelope skin over the sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast:
ramayata marutaḥ pretam̐ vājinam\ manojavasam̐ vṛṣaṇam̐ suvṛktim /
yenedam ugram avasṛṣṭam eti \ tam aśvinā paridhattam̐ svastaye //
ity uttarato vārṣikam̐ vātam anumantrayate //
meaning:
रमयत मरुतः प्रेतम्̐ वाजिनम्\ मनोजवसम्̐ वृषणम्̐ सुवृक्तिम् /
येनेदम् उग्रम् अवसृष्टम् एति \ तम् अश्विना परिधत्तम्̐ स्वस्तये //
इत्य् उत्तरतो वार्षिकम्̐ वातम् अनुमन्त्रयते //

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇaṃ niyānam iti ṣaṭtrihaviṣām /
meaning: कृष्णं नियानम् इति षट्त्रिहविषाम् /
text_mt: "Black is the path…" are the six [verses] for the three oblations.

sanskrit_iast: āgnimārutaṃ tantram /
meaning: आग्निमारुतं तन्त्रम् /

sanskrit_iast: uttamayā sauryam abhijuhoti /
meaning: उत्तमया सौर्यम् अभिजुहोति /
text_mt: With the last [verse], he makes an offering over the oblation to Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast: saiṣā kārīrī nāmeṣṭir ya etayā yajeta sam̐vatsaraṃ karīrāṇāṃ nāśnīyād iti vratam /
meaning: सैषा कारीरी नामेष्टिर् य एतया यजेत सम्̐वत्सरं करीराणां नाश्नीयाद् इति व्रतम् /
text_mt: This is the sacrifice named Kārīrī; whoever should sacrifice with this, he should not eat karīra [fruits] for a year: such is the vow.

sanskrit_iast: rājasūyāt kāmyānāṃ nirhāro bibhyad ādityebhyo bhuvadvadbhyo ghṛte caruḥ //
meaning: राजसूयात् काम्यानां निर्हारो बिभ्यद् आदित्येभ्यो भुवद्वद्भ्यो घृते चरुः //
text_mt: The removal of the optional offerings from the Rājasūya: [one who is] afraid [offers] a boiled oblation in clarified butter to the Ādityas accompanied by Bhuvadvat.

sanskrit_iast: arvāñco adya \\ iti dve haviṣaḥ /
meaning: अर्वाञ्चो अद्य \\ इति द्वे हविषः /
text_mt: "Hitherward today…" are the two [verses] for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: āgrāyaṇa / vairājaḥ kalpaḥ //
meaning: आग्रायण / वैराजः कल्पः //
text_mt: The Āgrāyaṇa [or] the Vairāja is the ritual procedure.

sanskrit_iast: agna indraś ca dāśuṣas \\ yābhyām̐ svar ajanan \\ ity āgnīndrasya //
meaning: अग्न इन्द्रश् च दाशुषस् \\ याभ्याम्̐ स्वर् अजनन् \\ इत्य् आग्नीन्द्रस्य //
text_mt: "Agni and Indra, to the worshipper…" and "By whom they generated the sun…" are for the [oblation] to Agni and Indra.

sanskrit_iast: viśve devā ṛtāvṛdhas \\ viśve devāso asridhas \\ iti vaiśvadevasya //
meaning: विश्वे देवा ऋतावृधस् \\ विश्वे देवासो अस्रिधस् \\ इति वैश्वदेवस्य //
text_mt: "All-gods, increasers of cosmic order…" and "All-gods who do not fail…" are for the [oblation] to the All-gods.

sanskrit_iast: dyāvā naḥ pṛthivī \ pra pūrvaje iti dyāvāpṛthivīyasya //
meaning: द्यावा नः पृथिवी \ प्र पूर्वजे इति द्यावापृथिवीयस्य //
text_mt: "Heaven and earth to us…" and "Forth, the two first-born…" are for the [oblation] to Heaven and Earth.

sanskrit_iast: soma yās te mayobhuvas \\ yā te dhāmāni \\ iti saumyasya /
meaning: सोम यास् ते मयोभुवस् \\ या ते धामानि \\ इति सौम्यस्य /
text_mt: "O Soma, those which are your delight-giving…" and "Those which are your abodes…" are for the [oblation] to Soma.

sanskrit_iast: śunāsīrye catvāraḥ /
meaning: शुनासीर्ये चत्वारः /

sanskrit_iast: kāmaḥ paśukāmānnakāmayor varṣasyodakārthe /
meaning: कामः पशुकामान्नकामयोर् वर्षस्योदकार्थे /
text_mt: The desire is for one desiring cattle or one desiring food; for one in need of water, [it is] for rain.

sanskrit_iast: dvāv indraturīye /
meaning: द्वाव् इन्द्रतुरीये /

sanskrit_iast: devikāsu catvāraḥ //
meaning: देविकासु चत्वारः //

sanskrit_iast: anv adya no anumatir \ anv id anumate \\ iti daśa haviṣām /
meaning: अन्व् अद्य नो अनुमतिर् \ अन्व् इद् अनुमते \\ इति दश हविषाम् /
text_mt: "May Anumati today…" and "Follow along indeed, O Anumati…" are the ten [verses] for the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: āśvinaṃ dvikapālam̐ svastikāmaḥ pūrvāhṇe nirvapet /
meaning: आश्विनं द्विकपालम्̐ स्वस्तिकामः पूर्वाह्णे निर्वपेत् /
text_mt: One desiring well-being should apportion [a cake] on two potsherds to the Aśvins in the forenoon.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścittiḥ kalpaḥ //
meaning: प्रायश्चित्तिः कल्पः //

sanskrit_iast: prātar yajadhvam aśvinā \\ iti dve haviṣaḥ /
meaning: प्रातर् यजध्वम् अश्विना \\ इति द्वे हविषः /
text_mt: "Sacrifice in the morning to the Aśvins…" are the two [verses] for the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: triṣam̐yuktena yajñakāmo yajetottareṇa paśukāmaḥ //
meaning: त्रिषम्̐युक्तेन यज्ञकामो यजेतोत्तरेण पशुकामः //
text_mt: One desiring sacrifice should sacrifice with the threefold combination; one desiring cattle with the subsequent [rite].

sanskrit_iast: indrā nu pūṣṇā \ yan nirṇijā \\ ity aindrāpauṣṇasya /
meaning: इन्द्रा नु पूष्णा \ यन् निर्णिजा \\ इत्य् ऐन्द्रापौष्णस्य /
text_mt: "Indra now and Pūṣan…" and "When with the garment…" are for the [oblation] to Indra and Pūṣan.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvānaravāruṇena yo jyogāmayāvī yajeta /
meaning: वैश्वानरवारुणेन यो ज्योगामयावी यजेत /
text_mt: One who is chronically ill should sacrifice with [the offering] to Vaiśvānara and Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: yasya rāṣṭram̐ śithiram iva syāt tam etena yājayen maitrābārhaspatyena /
meaning: यस्य राष्ट्रम्̐ शिथिरम् इव स्यात् तम् एतेन याजयेन् मैत्राबार्हस्पत्येन /
text_mt: One whose kingdom appears loose, him one should cause to sacrifice with this [offering] to Mitra and Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: devasuvām̐ havirbhiriṣṭiḥ sarvakāmo yajeta /
meaning: देवसुवाम्̐ हविर्भिरिष्टिः सर्वकामो यजेत /
text_mt: The offering with the oblations to the divine instigators: one desiring everything should sacrifice [with it].

sanskrit_iast: prāk sviṣṭakṛta ājyasya vājaprasavyam̐ hutvābhiṣiñcati //
meaning: प्राक् स्विष्टकृत आज्यस्य वाजप्रसव्यम्̐ हुत्वाभिषिञ्चति //
text_mt: Before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, having offered the Vājaprasavya formula of clarified butter, he sprinkles [the sacrificer].

sanskrit_iast: tvam agne bṛhad vayas \\ iti ṣoḍaśa haviṣām /
meaning: त्वम् अग्ने बृहद् वयस् \\ इति षोडश हविषाम् /
text_mt: "Thou, O Agni, great vitality…" are the sixteen [verses] for the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: diśām aveṣṭibhir annādyakāmo yajeta /
meaning: दिशाम् अवेष्टिभिर् अन्नाद्यकामो यजेत /
text_mt: One desiring proper food should sacrifice with the Aveṣṭis of the directions.

sanskrit_iast: vairājaḥ kalpaḥ /
meaning: वैराजः कल्पः /

sanskrit_iast: satyadūtahavirbhiḥ svastikāmo yajeta /
meaning: सत्यदूतहविर्भिः स्वस्तिकामो यजेत /
text_mt: One desiring well-being should sacrifice with the Satyadūta oblations.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaścittiḥ kalpaḥ //
meaning: प्रायश्चित्तिः कल्पः //

sanskrit_iast: ya imā viśvā jātāni \\ iti ṣaḍ ḍhaviṣām /
meaning: य इमा विश्वा जातानि \\ इति षड् ढविषाम् /
text_mt: "He who [created] all these creatures…" are the six [verses] for the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: atha hautram /
meaning: अथ हौत्रम् /

sanskrit_iast: yathā sāmidhenyas tathāgnipraṇayanīyā yūpyā agnimanthanīyās tathā maitrāvaruṇasya paryagnikaraṇam̐ stokyā manotāsūktam anuvākyā /
meaning: यथा सामिधेन्यस् तथाग्निप्रणयनीया यूप्या अग्निमन्थनीयास् तथा मैत्रावरुणस्य पर्यग्निकरणम्̐ स्तोक्या मनोतासूक्तम् अनुवाक्या /
text_mt: As the kindling verses, so are the verses for carrying forward the fire, the verses for the sacrificial post, [and] the verses for churning the fire; similarly for the Maitrāvaruṇa priest, the carrying of fire around [the victim], the verses for the drops, [and] the Manotā hymn are the invitatory verses.

sanskrit_iast: praiṣaṃ kartṛpratyayam anvāha /
meaning: प्रैषं कर्तृप्रत्ययम् अन्वाह /
text_mt: He recites the direction that designates the agent.

sanskrit_iast: maitrāvaruṇacodito hotā yajet /
meaning: मैत्रावरुणचोदितो होता यजेत् /
text_mt: Prompted by the maitrāvaruṇa, the hotṛ priest should sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: praṇīyamānāya preṣitaḥ pra devam ity anūcya \\ ayam u ṣya \\ ity utthāya \\ ayam agnir iti gachann uttarām̐ vediśroṇim apareṇa tiṣṭhann ūrṇāvantam ity ardharce kāṅkṣet /
meaning: प्रणीयमानाय प्रेषितः प्र देवम् इत्य् अनूच्य \\ अयम् उ ष्य \\ इत्य् उत्थाय \\ अयम् अग्निर् इति गछन्न् उत्तराम्̐ वेदिश्रोणिम् अपरेण तिष्ठन्न् ऊर्णावन्तम् इत्य् अर्धर्चे काङ्क्षेत् /
text_mt: When prompted for [the fire] being carried forward, having recited "pra devam…", having stood up with "ayam u ṣya…", walking with "ayam agniḥ…", standing behind the northern buttock of the altar, he should wait at the half-verse "ūrṇāvantam…".

sanskrit_iast: nihate śeṣam uktvā tvaṃ dūtas \\ iti paridadhāti /
meaning: निहते शेषम् उक्त्वा त्वं दूतस् \\ इति परिदधाति /
text_mt: When [the fire] has been laid down, having spoken the remainder, he concludes with "tvaṃ dūtaḥ…".

sanskrit_iast: upaviśet /
meaning: उपविशेत् /

sanskrit_iast: āsīno yūpāyājyamānāya preṣitas \\ añjanti tvām iti tṛtīyasyānuvacanasyārdharce kāṅkṣet /
meaning: आसीनो यूपायाज्यमानाय प्रेषितस् \\ अञ्जन्ति त्वाम् इति तृतीयस्यानुवचनस्यार्धर्चे काङ्क्षेत् /
text_mt: Seated, when prompted for the sacrificial post being anointed, he should wait at the half-verse of the third recitation: "añjanti tvām…".

sanskrit_iast: ucchriyamāṇāya preṣito yad ūrdhvas \\ uñśrayasva \\ iti saṃtatya sam atriṇaṃ daha \\ iti kāṅkṣet /
meaning: उच्छ्रियमाणाय प्रेषितो यद् ऊर्ध्वस् \\ उञ्श्रयस्व \\ इति संतत्य सम् अत्रिणं दह \\ इति काङ्क्षेत् /
text_mt: When prompted for [the post] being erected, having connected "yad ūrdhvaḥ…" and "ucchrayasva…", he should wait at "sam atriṇaṃ daha…".

sanskrit_iast: parivīyamāṇāya preṣitaḥ kṛdhī nas \\ ity anūcya yuvā suvāsās \\ iti paridhāyāvatiṣṭhet /
meaning: परिवीयमाणाय प्रेषितः कृधी नस् \\ इत्य् अनूच्य युवा सुवासास् \\ इति परिधायावतिष्ठेत् /
text_mt: When prompted for [the post] being girded, having recited "kṛdhī naḥ…", having concluded with "yuvā suvāsāḥ…", he stands waiting.

sanskrit_iast: mathyamānāya preṣitaḥ siddham̐ yathā vaiśvadeve /
meaning: मथ्यमानाय प्रेषितः सिद्धम्̐ यथा वैश्वदेवे /
text_mt: When prompted for [the fire] being churned, the procedure is established as in the vaiśvadeva sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśa sāmidhenyaḥ /
meaning: सप्तदश सामिधेन्यः /
text_mt: There are seventeen kindling verses.

sanskrit_iast: siddham āvāhanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आवाहनात् /

sanskrit_iast: na paśupuroḍāśāya / prāgājyapebhyo vanaspatim /
meaning: न पशुपुरोडाशाय / प्रागाज्यपेभ्यो वनस्पतिम् /
text_mt: Not for the animal cake; [he inserts] Vanaspati before the ājyapas.

sanskrit_iast: ājyapādi siddham /
meaning: आज्यपादि सिद्धम् /

sanskrit_iast: tīrthena maitrāvaruṇo 'greṇa hotāram apareṇa kartāraṃ dakṣiṇām̐ vediśroṇim apareṇa tiṣṭhann avakro 'vithuro bhūyāsam \\ phalagrahir asi phalagrahir aham \\ tvayā sākṣād ṛdhyāsam iti bāhubhyāṃ daṇḍaṃ parigṛhya tena vedim avaṣṭabhya dakṣiṇe 'm̐se pratiṣṭhāpya prahvas tiṣṭhan saṃpraiṣaṃ kāṅkṣet /
meaning: तीर्थेन मैत्रावरुणो ऽग्रेण होतारम् अपरेण कर्तारं दक्षिणाम्̐ वेदिश्रोणिम् अपरेण तिष्ठन्न् अवक्रो ऽविथुरो भूयासम् \\ फलग्रहिर् असि फलग्रहिर् अहम् \\ त्वया साक्षाद् ऋध्यासम् इति बाहुभ्यां दण्डं परिगृह्य तेन वेदिम् अवष्टभ्य दक्षिणे ऽम्̐से प्रतिष्ठाप्य प्रह्वस् तिष्ठन् संप्रैषं काङ्क्षेत् /
text_mt: Along the pilgrimage path (tīrtha), the maitrāvaruṇa, standing in front of the hotṛ priest, behind the performer, and behind the southern buttock of the altar, taking the staff with both arms with "May I not be bent, may I not be shaken; you are fruit-bearing, I am fruit-bearing; may I prosper directly through you", leaning with it on the altar, resting it on his right shoulder, standing bent forward, should wait for the command.

sanskrit_iast: samidbhyaḥ preṣito hotā yakṣad agnim̐ samidhā \\ iti daśa praiṣāḥ //
meaning: समिद्भ्यः प्रेषितो होता यक्षद् अग्निम्̐ समिधा \\ इति दश प्रैषाः //
text_mt: Prompted for the samidh offerings, the hotṛ: "May he sacrifice to Agni with the kindling stick…"—these are the ten call-formulas (praiṣa).

sanskrit_iast: samiddho adya manuṣo duroṇe \\ iti daśabhir hotāprībhir yajet /
meaning: समिद्धो अद्य मनुषो दुरोणे \\ इति दशभिर् होताप्रीभिर् यजेत् /
text_mt: With the ten āprī verses "samiddho adya manuṣo duroṇe…", the hotṛ priest should sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: ubhāv anavānantau vyavānantau vā /
meaning: उभाव् अनवानन्तौ व्यवानन्तौ वा /
text_mt: Both without pausing for breath, or pausing for breath.

sanskrit_iast: vāmasya \ gopām \\ syāt \\ amūras \\ devebhyaḥ \ śrayantām \\ kṛṇvāne \ pracetasā \ tanvatām \\ yaśodhām \\ naras \\ havyasūktīnām iti praiṣeṣu vyavaset /
meaning: वामस्य \ गोपाम् \\ स्यात् \\ अमूरस् \\ देवेभ्यः \ श्रयन्ताम् \\ कृण्वाने \ प्रचेतसा \ तन्वताम् \\ यशोधाम् \\ नरस् \\ हव्यसूक्तीनाम् इति प्रैषेषु व्यवसेत् /
text_mt: He should pause in the call-formulas at: "vāmasya", "gopām", "syāt", "amūraḥ", "devebhyaḥ", "śrayantām", "kṛṇvāne", "pracetasā", "tanvatām", "yaśodhām", "naraḥ", and "havyasūktīnām".

sanskrit_iast: paryagnaye kriyamāṇāya preṣitas \\ agnir hotā nas \\ iti tisraḥ //
meaning: पर्यग्नये क्रियमाणाय प्रेषितस् \\ अग्निर् होता नस् \\ इति तिस्रः //
text_mt: When prompted for the fire being carried around [the victim], [he recites] the three verses: "agnir hotā naḥ…".

sanskrit_iast: upapreṣya \\ ity ukte \\ ajaid agnir iti maitrāvaruṇo daivyāḥ śamitāras \\ iti hotā //
meaning: उपप्रेष्य \\ इत्य् उक्ते \\ अजैद् अग्निर् इति मैत्रावरुणो दैव्याः शमितारस् \\ इति होता //
text_mt: When "Prompt [the slaughterers]!" is said, the maitrāvaruṇa [recites] "ajaid agniḥ…" and the hotṛ [recites] "daivyāḥ śamitāraḥ…".

sanskrit_iast: asnā rakṣaḥ sam̐sṛjatād ity upām̐śu // vaniṣṭhum asya mā rāviṣṭa \\ ity uccaiḥ //
meaning: अस्ना रक्षः सम्̐सृजताद् इत्य् उपाम्̐शु // वनिष्ठुम् अस्य मा राविष्ट \\ इत्य् उच्चैः //
text_mt: "asnā rakṣaḥ saṃsṛjatāt…" in a whisper; "vaniṣṭhum asya mā rāviṣṭa…" aloud.

sanskrit_iast: adhrigo3 iti paridadhyāt //
meaning: अध्रिगो3 इति परिदध्यात् //
text_mt: He should conclude with "adhrigo3".

sanskrit_iast: adhriguś ca vipāpaś ca \\ ity upām̐śu japati /
meaning: अध्रिगुश् च विपापश् च \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शु जपति /
text_mt: He mutters in a whisper: "adhriguś ca vipāpaś ca…".

sanskrit_iast: stokebhyaḥ preṣito juṣasva saprathastam iti ṣaṭ /
meaning: स्तोकेभ्यः प्रेषितो जुषस्व सप्रथस्तम् इति षट् /
text_mt: Prompted for the drops, [he recites] the six verses: "juṣasva saprathastam…".

sanskrit_iast: svāhākṛtibhyaḥ preṣito hotā yakṣad agnim̐ svāhā \\ iti praiṣaḥ //
meaning: स्वाहाकृतिभ्यः प्रेषितो होता यक्षद् अग्निम्̐ स्वाहा \\ इति प्रैषः //
text_mt: Prompted for the svāhākṛti offerings, the call-formula is: "May the hotṛ sacrifice to Agni with svāhā…".

sanskrit_iast: sadyo jātas \\ ity ṛcā hotā yajet /
meaning: सद्यो जातस् \\ इत्य् ऋचा होता यजेत् /
text_mt: With the verse "sadyo jātaḥ…", the hotṛ priest should sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: vārtraghnāv ājyabhāgau sapraiṣau //
meaning: वार्त्रघ्नाव् आज्यभागौ सप्रैषौ //
text_mt: The two clarified butter portions are vṛtra-slaying, accompanied by call-formulas.

sanskrit_iast: agne naya \\ iti ṣaḍarcam̐ vapāyāḥ paśupuroḍāśasya paśos tisraḥ pūrvāḥpūrvāḥ puronuvākyā uttarottarā yājyā ity uktaḥ ṣaḍarcadharmaḥ /
meaning: अग्ने नय \\ इति षडर्चम्̐ वपायाः पशुपुरोडाशस्य पशोस् तिस्रः पूर्वाःपूर्वाः पुरोनुवाक्या उत्तरोत्तरा याज्या इत्य् उक्तः षडर्चधर्मः /
text_mt: "agne naya…" is a six-verse hymn; for the omentum, the animal cake, and the animal, the three preceding verses are the invitatory verses and the three subsequent verses are the offering verses: this is stated as the rule of the six-verse hymn.

sanskrit_iast: athaindrāgnasya śuciṃ nu stomam \\ śnathad vṛtram \ ubhā vām indrāgnī \ pra carṣaṇibhyā \ ā vṛtrahaṇā \ gīrbhir vipras \\ ity uktaḥ ṣaḍarcadharmaḥ /
meaning: अथैन्द्राग्नस्य शुचिं नु स्तोमम् \\ श्नथद् वृत्रम् \ उभा वाम् इन्द्राग्नी \ प्र चर्षणिभ्या \ आ वृत्रहणा \ गीर्भिर् विप्रस् \\ इत्य् उक्तः षडर्चधर्मः /
text_mt: Now for the [offering] dedicated to Indra and Agni: "śuciṃ nu stomam…", "śnathad vṛtram…", "ubhā vām indrāgnī…", "pra carṣaṇibhyaḥ…", "ā vṛtrahaṇā…", and "gīrbhir vipraḥ…"—this is stated as the rule of the six-verse hymn.

sanskrit_iast: vapāyai preṣitaḥ prathamām anūcya hotā yakṣad indrāgnī chāgasya vapāyās \\ iti praiṣo dvitīyā yājyā /
meaning: वपायै प्रेषितः प्रथमाम् अनूच्य होता यक्षद् इन्द्राग्नी छागस्य वपायास् \\ इति प्रैषो द्वितीया याज्या /
text_mt: Prompted for the omentum, having recited the first [verse], the call-formula is "May the hotṛ sacrifice to Indra and Agni [with the offering] of the goat's omentum…", and the second is the offering verse.

sanskrit_iast: puroḍāśāya preṣitas tṛtīyām anūcya hotā yakṣad indrāgnī puroḍāśasya \\ iti praiṣaś caturthī yājyā //
meaning: पुरोडाशाय प्रेषितस् तृतीयाम् अनूच्य होता यक्षद् इन्द्राग्नी पुरोडाशस्य \\ इति प्रैषश् चतुर्थी याज्या //
text_mt: Prompted for the sacrificial cake, having recited the third [verse], the call-formula is "May the hotṛ sacrifice to Indra and Agni [with the offering] of the cake…", and the fourth is the offering verse.

sanskrit_iast: iḍām agnā iti vyaktasyānuvākyāpraiṣas \\ agnim̐ sudītim iti yājyā /
meaning: इडाम् अग्ना इति व्यक्तस्यानुवाक्याप्रैषस् \\ अग्निम्̐ सुदीतिम् इति याज्या /
text_mt: For the clear [cake offering], the invitatory call-formula is "iḍām agne…", and the offering verse is "agnim sudītim…".

sanskrit_iast: siddha iḍopahavaḥ /
meaning: सिद्ध इडोपहवः /

sanskrit_iast: manotāyai preṣitas tvam̐ hy agne prathamo manotā \\ iti trayodaśa /
meaning: मनोतायै प्रेषितस् त्वम्̐ ह्य् अग्ने प्रथमो मनोता \\ इति त्रयोदश /
text_mt: Prompted for the Manotā hymn, [he recites] the thirteen verses: "tvaṃ hy agne prathamo manotā…".

sanskrit_iast: haviṣe preṣitaḥ pañcamīm anūcya hotā yakṣad indrāgnī chāgasya haviṣas \\ iti praiṣaḥ / ṣaṣṭhī yājyā / tasyā ardharce vasāhomaṃ kāṅkṣet /
meaning: हविषे प्रेषितः पञ्चमीम् अनूच्य होता यक्षद् इन्द्राग्नी छागस्य हविषस् \\ इति प्रैषः / षष्ठी याज्या / तस्या अर्धर्चे वसाहोमं काङ्क्षेत् /
text_mt: Prompted for the oblation, having recited the fifth [verse], the call-formula is "May the hotṛ sacrifice to Indra and Agni [with the offering] of the goat's oblation…"; the sixth is the offering verse; at its half-verse he should wait for the fat-offering.

sanskrit_iast: vanaspataye preṣito devebhyo vanaspate \\ ity anuvākyāpraiṣo vanaspate raśanayā \\ iti yājyā /
meaning: वनस्पतये प्रेषितो देवेभ्यो वनस्पते \\ इत्य् अनुवाक्याप्रैषो वनस्पते रशनया \\ इति याज्या /
text_mt: Prompted for Vanaspati, the invitatory call-formula is "devebhyo vanaspate…", and the offering verse is "vanaspate raśanayā…".

sanskrit_iast: sviṣṭakṛte preṣitaḥ piprīhi devān ity anuvākyāpraiṣas \\ agne yad adya \\ iti yājyā /
meaning: स्विष्टकृते प्रेषितः पिप्रीहि देवान् इत्य् अनुवाक्याप्रैषस् \\ अग्ने यद् अद्य \\ इति याज्या /
text_mt: Prompted for Sviṣṭakṛt, the invitatory call-formula is "piprīhi devān…", and the offering verse is "agne yad adya…".

sanskrit_iast: siddha iḍopahavaḥ /
meaning: सिद्ध इडोपहवः /

sanskrit_iast: anuyājebhyaḥ preṣito devaṃ barhir ity ekādaśīnuyājāḥ /
meaning: अनुयाजेभ्यः प्रेषितो देवं बर्हिर् इत्य् एकादशीनुयाजाः /
text_mt: Prompted for the after-offerings, the eleven after-offerings begin with "devaṃ barhiḥ…".

sanskrit_iast: teṣām ādyavasānair hotā yajet /
meaning: तेषाम् आद्यवसानैर् होता यजेत् /
text_mt: With their opening and concluding parts, the hotṛ priest should sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: ubhāv uttamam anudraveyātām /
meaning: उभाव् उत्तमम् अनुद्रवेयाताम् /
text_mt: Both should recite the last [after-offering] continuously.

sanskrit_iast: sūktavākāya preṣitas \\ agnim adya \\ iti maitrāvaruṇaḥ sūktā brūhi \\ iti viramyātipraṇīte tūṣṇīṃ daṇḍam avadadhāti /
meaning: सूक्तवाकाय प्रेषितस् \\ अग्निम् अद्य \\ इति मैत्रावरुणः सूक्ता ब्रूहि \\ इति विरम्यातिप्रणीते तूष्णीं दण्डम् अवदधाति /
text_mt: Prompted for the sūktavāka recitation, the maitrāvaruṇa [says] "agnim adya…"; having ceased with "Recite the hymns!", he silently deposits the staff in the atipraṇīta fire.

sanskrit_iast: śiṣṭam̐ hotuḥ /
meaning: शिष्टम्̐ होतुः /

sanskrit_iast: paśubandhe devatāyajamānapaśuvācinām ekāvacanadvivacanabahuvacanāni /
meaning: पशुबन्धे देवतायजमानपशुवाचिनाम् एकावचनद्विवचनबहुवचनानि /
text_mt: In the animal sacrifice, singular, dual, and plural forms are used for words expressing the deity, the sacrificer, and the animal.

sanskrit_iast: trīṇitrīṇi svaśabdāni pum̐si pūrvāṇi parāṇi striyāḥ / strīpum̐soḥ samavāye pum̐savat /
meaning: त्रीणित्रीणि स्वशब्दानि पुम्̐सि पूर्वाणि पराणि स्त्रियाः / स्त्रीपुम्̐सोः समवाये पुम्̐सवत् /
text_mt: There are triplets of each word: the former in the masculine, the latter in the feminine; when masculine and feminine are combined, it is treated as masculine.

sanskrit_iast: medhapataya iti yajamānavāci paśuvāci devatāvāci vā / medhapataye medhapatibhyāṃ medhapatibhyo medhapatnyai medhapatnībhyāṃ medhapatnībhyo / medhīṃ medhyau medhīḥ / prāsmā agniṃ prābhyām agniṃ praibhyo 'gniṃ prāsyā agniṃ prābhyām agniṃ prābhyo 'gnim ity evam ata ūrdhvam ūhyam ūhet /
meaning: मेधपतय इति यजमानवाचि पशुवाचि देवतावाचि वा / मेधपतये मेधपतिभ्यां मेधपतिभ्यो मेधपत्न्यै मेधपत्नीभ्यां मेधपत्नीभ्यो / मेधीं मेध्यौ मेधीः / प्रास्मा अग्निं प्राभ्याम् अग्निं प्रैभ्यो ऽग्निं प्रास्या अग्निं प्राभ्याम् अग्निं प्राभ्यो ऽग्निम् इत्य् एवम् अत ऊर्ध्वम् ऊह्यम् ऊहेत् /
text_mt: The word "medhapataye" expresses the sacrificer, the animal, or the deity: "medhapataye", "medhapatibhyām", "medhapatibhyaḥ"; "medhapatnyai", "medhapatnībhyām", "medhapatnībhyaḥ"; "medhīm", "medhyau", "medhīḥ"; "prāsmā agnim", "prābhyām agnim", "praibhyo 'gnim"; "prāsyā agnim", "prābhyām agnim", "prābhyo 'gnim"—in this way, from here on, one should modify what is to be modified (ūha).

sanskrit_iast: dvipaśuprabhṛtipratyaṅgānāṃ bahuvacanāni / praśasā bāhū \ śalā doṣaṇī \ kaśyapevām̐sā \\ achidre śroṇī \ kavaṣorū srekaparṇāṣṭhīvantā /
meaning: द्विपशुप्रभृतिप्रत्यङ्गानां बहुवचनानि / प्रशसा बाहू \ शला दोषणी \ कश्यपेवाम्̐सा \\ अछिद्रे श्रोणी \ कवषोरू स्रेकपर्णाष्ठीवन्ता /
text_mt: For two or more animals, the words for the individual limbs are in the plural: "praśasā bāhū", "śalā doṣaṇī", "kaśyapevāṃsau", "achidre śroṇī", "kavaṣorū", and "srekaparṇāṣṭhīvantā".

sanskrit_iast: yāny avyayāny anekāni tāni dvir abhyasyante / tāni vyākhyāsyāmo yathaikadhaikadhā purā purāntarantaḥ ṣaḍvim̐śatiḥ ṣaḍvim̐śatir madhyato madhyataḥ pārśvataḥ pārśvataḥ śroṇitaḥ śroṇitaḥ śitāmataḥ śitāmata utsādata utsādataḥ prastuty eva prastuty evopastuty evopastuty eva medasto medasta iti /
meaning: यान्य् अव्ययान्य् अनेकानि तानि द्विर् अभ्यस्यन्ते / तानि व्याख्यास्यामो यथैकधैकधा पुरा पुरान्तरन्तः षड्विम्̐शतिः षड्विम्̐शतिर् मध्यतो मध्यतः पार्श्वतः पार्श्वतः श्रोणितः श्रोणितः शितामतः शितामत उत्सादत उत्सादतः प्रस्तुत्य् एव प्रस्तुत्य् एवोपस्तुत्य् एवोपस्तुत्य् एव मेदस्तो मेदस्त इति /
text_mt: Those indeclinables that are multiple are repeated twice; we shall explain them, as in: "aikadhaikadhā", "purā purā", "antarantaḥ", "ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ", "madhyato madhyataḥ", "pārśvataḥ pārśvataḥ", "śroṇitaḥ śroṇitaḥ", "śitāmataḥ śitāmataḥ", "utsādata utsādataḥ", "prastuty eva prastuty eva", "upastuty evopastuty eva", and "medasto medastaḥ".

sanskrit_iast: haviṣi praiṣe sūktavāke ca adat adatāṃ adan ghasat ghastāṃ ghasan aghasat aghastāṃ aghasan karat karatāṃ karan agrabhīt agrabhīṣṭāṃ agrabhīṣuḥ akṣan /
meaning: हविषि प्रैषे सूक्तवाके च अदत् अदतां अदन् घसत् घस्तां घसन् अघसत् अघस्तां अघसन् करत् करतां करन् अग्रभीत् अग्रभीष्टां अग्रभीषुः अक्षन् /
text_mt: In the oblation, the call-formula, and the sūktavāka recitation: "adat", "adatām", "adan"; "ghasat", "ghastām", "ghasan"; "aghasat", "aghastām", "aghasan"; "karat", "karatām", "karan"; "agrabhīt", "agrabhīṣṭām", "agrabhīṣuḥ"; and "akṣan".

sanskrit_iast: mātā pitā bhrātā sagarbhyo [ 'nu ] sakhā sayūthonābhirūpam āsam̐sargi śabdāś cakṣuḥ śrotram̐ vāṅ manas tvaṅ medo havir barhiḥ śyenam̐ vakṣa ity anūhyāni /
meaning: माता पिता भ्राता सगर्भ्यो [ ऽनु ] सखा सयूथोनाभिरूपम् आसम्̐सर्गि शब्दाश् चक्षुः श्रोत्रम्̐ वाङ् मनस् त्वङ् मेदो हविर् बर्हिः श्येनम्̐ वक्ष इत्य् अनूह्यानि /
text_mt: The words "mātā", "pitā", "bhrātā sagarbhyaḥ", "anu sakhā", "sayūthyaḥ", "anābhirūpam", "āsaṃsargi", "cakṣuḥ", "śrotram", "vāṅ", "manaḥ", "tvak", "medaḥ", "haviḥ", "barhiḥ", and "śyenaṃ vakṣaḥ" are not to be modified.

sanskrit_iast: aindrāgnena paśūnām̐ vidhir āmnātaḥ /
meaning: ऐन्द्राग्नेन पशूनाम्̐ विधिर् आम्नातः /
text_mt: By the [procedure] dedicated to Indra and Agni, the rule for animals is taught.

sanskrit_iast: varam anādiṣṭadakṣiṇāsu dadyād gāṃ trihāyaṇīṃ caturhāyaṇīm̐ vā /
meaning: वरम् अनादिष्टदक्षिणासु दद्याद् गां त्रिहायणीं चतुर्हायणीम्̐ वा /
text_mt: In rites where the sacrificial gift is not specified, he should give a boon, or a three-year-old cow, or a four-year-old cow.

sanskrit_iast: ijyāsūpām̐śudevatāḥ prajāpatir vāyur devāḥ sūryo 'ditir viṣṇur viṣṇuvaruṇau savitauṣadhayo dyāvāpṛthivī bhūmir yamaś ca /
meaning: इज्यासूपाम्̐शुदेवताः प्रजापतिर् वायुर् देवाः सूर्यो ऽदितिर् विष्णुर् विष्णुवरुणौ सवितौषधयो द्यावापृथिवी भूमिर् यमश् च /
text_mt: In sacrifices, the whisper deities are: Prajāpati, Vāyu, the Viśve Devas, Sūrya, Aditi, Viṣṇu, Viṣṇu-and-Varuṇa, Savitṛ, the Plants, Heaven-and-Earth, the Earth, and Yama.

sanskrit_iast: saumyaṃ babhrum iti prabhṛtayo yamāntāḥ kāmyāḥ paśubandhāḥ / teṣām̐ somo dhenum itiprabhṛtīni yamāntāni ṣaḍ arcāni /
meaning: सौम्यं बभ्रुम् इति प्रभृतयो यमान्ताः काम्याः पशुबन्धाः / तेषाम्̐ सोमो धेनुम् इतिप्रभृतीनि यमान्तानि षड् अर्चानि /
text_mt: The wish-granting animal sacrifices are those beginning with 'A brown [victim] to Soma' up to those ending with Yama; their six-verse hymns are those beginning with 'Soma, the milch cow…' up to those ending with Yama.

sanskrit_iast: karmādhikyam̐ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: कर्माधिक्यम्̐ व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: We shall explain the addition of ritual acts.

sanskrit_iast: yas traitānām uttamo jāyeta tam̐ saumāpauṣṇam ālabheta paśukāmaḥ /
meaning: यस् त्रैतानाम् उत्तमो जायेत तम्̐ सौमापौष्णम् आलभेत पशुकामः /
text_mt: Whichever is born the last among triplets, that one one who desires cattle should slaughter for Soma and Pūṣan.

sanskrit_iast: audumbaro yūpaḥ /
meaning: औदुम्बरो यूपः /

sanskrit_iast: prājāpatyaṃ tūparam ālabheta paśukāmaḥ /
meaning: प्राजापत्यं तूपरम् आलभेत पशुकामः /
text_mt: One who desires cattle should seize a hornless [goat] for Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: āghārāprīsāmidhenya āgnicitike vyākhyātāḥ /
meaning: आघाराप्रीसामिधेन्य आग्निचितिके व्याख्याताः /
text_mt: The butter-libations, āprī-hymns, and sāmidhenī-verses are explained in [the section on] the piling of the fire altar.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇākāle hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇā tārpyam adhivāsaś ca /
meaning: दक्षिणाकाले हिरण्यं दक्षिणा तार्प्यम् अधिवासश् च /
text_mt: At the time of the sacrificial gifts, gold, a woven garment, and an upper cloth are the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: pariharaṇakāle prāśitrasya dvādaśabrahmaudanān paktvā madhyataḥkāribhyo dadyāt tebhyo dvādaśadvādaśa varān dadāti /
meaning: परिहरणकाले प्राशित्रस्य द्वादशब्रह्मौदनान् पक्त्वा मध्यतःकारिभ्यो दद्यात् तेभ्यो द्वादशद्वादश वरान् ददाति /
text_mt: At the time of carrying around the prāśitra portion, having cooked twelve brahmaudanacarus, he should give [them] to the principal officiating priests; he gives twelve choices [of gifts] to each of them.

sanskrit_iast: devebhyo 'vim̐ vaśām ālabhetādityebhyo vā prajākāmaḥ paśukāmaḥ kāmāyakāmāya /
meaning: देवेभ्यो ऽविम्̐ वशाम् आलभेतादित्येभ्यो वा प्रजाकामः पशुकामः कामायकामाय /
text_mt: One who desires offspring or who desires cattle should seize a barren sheep for the gods, or for the Ādityas, for whatever desire [he may have].

sanskrit_iast: malhā gṛṣṭiḥ /
meaning: मल्हा गृष्टिः /

sanskrit_iast: viṣame samaṃ kṛtvā vaiṣṇavam̐ vāmanam ālabheta bhrātṛvyavān /
meaning: विषमे समं कृत्वा वैष्णवम्̐ वामनम् आलभेत भ्रातृव्यवान् /
text_mt: Having made [the ground] level when it was uneven, one who has rivals should seize a dwarf [bull] for Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ pāpmanā tamasā gṛhīto manyeta sa etam aindram ṛṣabham ālabhetāgneyaṃ tu pūrvam ajam ālabheta /
meaning: यः पाप्मना तमसा गृहीतो मन्येत स एतम् ऐन्द्रम् ऋषभम् आलभेताग्नेयं तु पूर्वम् अजम् आलभेत /
text_mt: He who considers himself seized by evil [and] darkness should seize this bull for Indra; but he should first seize a goat for Agni.

sanskrit_iast: kṣutpāpmanā tamobhir hataḥ sāvitraṃ punarutsṛṣṭam ālabheta /
meaning: क्षुत्पाप्मना तमोभिर् हतः सावित्रं पुनरुत्सृष्टम् आलभेत /
text_mt: One stricken by the evil of hunger and by darkness should seize a [bull] let loose again for Savitṛ.

sanskrit_iast: oṣadhībhyo vehatam ālabheta prajākāmaḥ /
meaning: ओषधीभ्यो वेहतम् आलभेत प्रजाकामः /
text_mt: One who desires offspring should seize a cow that miscarries for the Plants.

sanskrit_iast: dyāvāpṛthivīye dhenū saṃmātarā ālabhetānnakāmaḥ /
meaning: द्यावापृथिवीये धेनू संमातरा आलभेतान्नकामः /
text_mt: One who desires food should seize two milch cows having a common mother for Heaven and Earth.

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte vatsam̐ vāyava ālabheta /
meaning: श्वोभूते वत्सम्̐ वायव आलभेत /
text_mt: On the next day, he should seize a calf for Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast: aindrīm̐ sūtavaśām ālabheta rājanyo bhūtikāmaḥ /
meaning: ऐन्द्रीम्̐ सूतवशाम् आलभेत राजन्यो भूतिकामः /
text_mt: A noble who desires prosperity should seize a barren cow after bearing a calf for Indra.

sanskrit_iast: sūtavaśāyāḥ putram aindram ṛṣabham ālabheta tejaskāmaḥ /
meaning: सूतवशायाः पुत्रम् ऐन्द्रम् ऋषभम् आलभेत तेजस्कामः /
text_mt: One who desires fiery splendour should seize the son of the barren cow after bearing a calf, a bull for Indra.

sanskrit_iast: sārasvatīṃ dhenuṣṭarīm ālabhetānusṛṣṭim /
meaning: सारस्वतीं धेनुष्टरीम् आलभेतानुसृष्टिम् /
text_mt: He should seize a sterile milch cow that has calved after for Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast: dyāvāpṛthivīyāṃ dhenuṃ paryāriṇīm ālabheta parisṛtvatīm /
meaning: द्यावापृथिवीयां धेनुं पर्यारिणीम् आलभेत परिसृत्वतीम् /
text_mt: He should seize a cow prone to abortion, running about, for Heaven and Earth.

sanskrit_iast: gomṛgam̐ vāyava ālabheta gāṃ mṛgam /
meaning: गोमृगम्̐ वायव आलभेत गां मृगम् /
text_mt: He should seize a wild ox—a cow-deer—for Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast: aindrāgnam anusṛṣṭam ālabheta yasya pitā pitāmahaḥ somaṃ na pibet /
meaning: ऐन्द्राग्नम् अनुसृष्टम् आलभेत यस्य पिता पितामहः सोमं न पिबेत् /
text_mt: He whose father and grandfather did not drink soma should seize a [beast] born after for Indra and Agni.

sanskrit_iast: paṇḍako yatra bhūmer jāyeta tad adhyavasāyeta / saumāpauṣṇaṃ napum̐sakam ālabheta paṇḍakam̐ yājayet /
meaning: पण्डको यत्र भूमेर् जायेत तद् अध्यवसायेत / सौमापौष्णं नपुम्̐सकम् आलभेत पण्डकम्̐ याजयेत् /
text_mt: Where a eunuch is born of the land, he should settle there; he should seize a gelded [beast] for Soma and Pūṣan [and] make the eunuch sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: prāg ghavirāhuter anavadānīyānām aṅgānāṃ dakṣiṇāprātīco 'ṅgārān upohya nirṛtyai svāhā \\ iti juhoti /
meaning: प्राग् घविराहुतेर् अनवदानीयानाम् अङ्गानां दक्षिणाप्रातीचो ऽङ्गारान् उपोह्य निरृत्यै स्वाहा \\ इति जुहोति /
text_mt: Before the oblation offering of the parts not to be cut off, having pushed the embers towards the south-west, he offers with: 'To Nirṛti, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: vāruṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ petva ekaśitipāt tenāmayāvī dvīpe yajeta yam̐ samantam āpaḥ parivaheyuḥ /
meaning: वारुणः कृष्णः पेत्व एकशितिपात् तेनामयावी द्वीपे यजेत यम्̐ समन्तम् आपः परिवहेयुः /
text_mt: A black castrated ram with one white foot is for Varuṇa; with that, a sick man should sacrifice on an island around which waters flow on all sides.

sanskrit_iast: sarvakṛṣṇo 'bhicarataḥ /
meaning: सर्वकृष्णो ऽभिचरतः /
text_mt: An entirely black one is for one who performs sorcery.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā niyojanāt //
meaning: सिद्धम् आ नियोजनात् //

sanskrit_iast: paśuṃ badhnāmi \\ iti niyunakti /
meaning: पशुं बध्नामि \\ इति नियुनक्ति /
text_mt: He ties [the victim] with: 'I bind the animal.'

sanskrit_iast: vaśānām̐ saptamo 'nuvākaḥ /
meaning: वशानाम्̐ सप्तमो ऽनुवाकः /
text_mt: [This is] the seventh anuvāka, [the section] of the barren cows.

sanskrit_iast: ukṣā brāhmaṇaspatyaḥ /
meaning: उक्षा ब्राह्मणस्पत्यः /

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇaśabalyāś carma viśasanena jahyāt /
meaning: कृष्णशबल्याश् चर्म विशसनेन जह्यात् /
text_mt: He should remove the skin of a black-spotted [cow] by dissecting.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣabhāṇām aṣṭamaḥ /
meaning: ऋषभाणाम् अष्टमः /

sanskrit_iast: indrāya vajriṇa ṛṣabham ālabheta rājanyo bhūtikāmaḥ /
meaning: इन्द्राय वज्रिण ऋषभम् आलभेत राजन्यो भूतिकामः /
text_mt: A noble who desires prosperity should seize a bull for Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt.

sanskrit_iast: havirāhutau hūyamānāyām̐ yaṃ dviṣyāt taṃ manasā dhyāyet /
meaning: हविराहुतौ हूयमानायाम्̐ यं द्विष्यात् तं मनसा ध्यायेत् /
text_mt: While the oblation-offering is being offered, he should meditate in his mind on him whom he hates.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ prathama ekāṣṭakāyāṃ jāyeta tam utsrakṣyann āgneyam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirupyotsṛjyāthāgnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālaṃ māsimāsi nirvapet sam̐vatsaram /
meaning: यः प्रथम एकाष्टकायां जायेत तम् उत्स्रक्ष्यन्न् आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालं निरुप्योत्सृज्याथाग्नये वैश्वानराय द्वादशकपालं मासिमासि निर्वपेत् सम्̐वत्सरम् /
text_mt: He who is born first on the Ekāṣṭakā day—intending to release him, having apportioned an eight-potsherd [cake] for Agni and released [the bull], he should then apportion a twelve-potsherd [cake] for Agni Vaiśvānara month by month for a year.

sanskrit_iast: atha yo 'parasyām ekāṣṭakāyāṃ jāyeta tam evam evotsṛjet /
meaning: अथ यो ऽपरस्याम् एकाष्टकायां जायेत तम् एवम् एवोत्सृजेत् /
text_mt: Then, he who is born on the second Ekāṣṭakā day, he should release in the very same way.

sanskrit_iast: yadā pūrvotsṛṣṭo medhaṃ gached athendrāyābhimātighna ālabhetāśvo 'vyuptavaho dakṣiṇā /
meaning: यदा पूर्वोत्सृष्टो मेधं गछेद् अथेन्द्रायाभिमातिघ्न आलभेताश्वो ऽव्युप्तवहो दक्षिणा /
text_mt: When the one released first attains fitness for sacrifice, then he should seize [him] for Indra, the slayer of adversaries; a horse with an unbroken neck is the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: tad yadā dvitīyotsṛṣṭo medhaṃ gached athendrāya vṛtratura ālabheta / śatam avyuptavahā dakṣiṇā /
meaning: तद् यदा द्वितीयोत्सृष्टो मेधं गछेद् अथेन्द्राय वृत्रतुर आलभेत / शतम् अव्युप्तवहा दक्षिणा /
text_mt: Then when the one released second attains fitness for sacrifice, then he should seize [him] for Indra, the overcome of Vṛtra; a hundred [draught animals] with unbroken necks are the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: etābhyām iṣṭvā pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyam apahatya citrāyāḥ putram aruṇaṃ tūparaṃ brāhmaṇaspatyam ālabhetābhicaran /
meaning: एताभ्याम् इष्ट्वा पाप्मानं भ्रातृव्यम् अपहत्य चित्रायाः पुत्रम् अरुणं तूपरं ब्राह्मणस्पत्यम् आलभेताभिचरन् /
text_mt: Having sacrificed with these two, having struck away evil, his rival, he should, when performing sorcery, seize a reddish hornless [bull], the son of a spotted cow, for Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ pāpmanā tamasā gṛhīto manyeta sa etam āśvinam añjim ālabheta /
meaning: यः पाप्मना तमसा गृहीतो मन्येत स एतम् आश्विनम् अञ्जिम् आलभेत /
text_mt: He who considers himself seized by evil [and] darkness should seize this painted [victim] for the Aśvins.

sanskrit_iast: tejaskāmo vasante lalāmam̐s trīn ṛṣabhān ālabheta / prāvṛṣi śitikakudaḥ śaradi śvetānūkāśāḥ / prājāpatyaṃ daśamaṃ dvādaśe māse //
meaning: तेजस्कामो वसन्ते ललामम्̐स् त्रीन् ऋषभान् आलभेत / प्रावृषि शितिककुदः शरदि श्वेतानूकाशाः / प्राजापत्यं दशमं द्वादशे मासे //
text_mt: One who desires fiery splendour should seize three bulls with white forehead marks in spring; white-humped ones in the rainy season; white-backed ones in autumn; a tenth one for Prajāpati in the twelfth month.

sanskrit_iast: namo mahimne \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ prāk sviṣṭakṛtaḥ sarveṣu pañcāhutīr juhoti /
meaning: नमो महिम्ने \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः प्राक् स्विष्टकृतः सर्वेषु पञ्चाहुतीर् जुहोति /
text_mt: Prior to the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, he offers five libations in all of them with the [verses] beginning with: 'Homage to greatness.'

sanskrit_iast: nānātantrāḥ kṛṣṇagrīvāḥ samānatantrā vā /
meaning: नानातन्त्राः कृष्णग्रीवाः समानतन्त्रा वा /
text_mt: The black-necked ones have separate ritual frameworks, or they share a common ritual framework.

sanskrit_iast: kaukilyāḥ sautrāmaṇyāḥ sa kalpo ya aiṣṭikyāḥ /
meaning: कौकिल्याः सौत्रामण्याः स कल्पो य ऐष्टिक्याः /
text_mt: The ritual procedure of the Kaukilī Sautrāmaṇī is that of the sacrifice of cake and boiled oblation.

sanskrit_iast: te kāmāḥ somavāminaś ca /
meaning: ते कामाः सोमवामिनश् च /
text_mt: Those are desires, and [it is] for one who has vomited soma.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā saṃdhānāt //
meaning: सिद्धम् आ संधानात् //

sanskrit_iast: parīto ṣiñcatā sutam iti pratiduhā pariṣiñcaty ekasyā dugdhena prathamāyām̐ vyuṣṭāyāṃ dvayor dvitīyasyām /
meaning: परीतो षिञ्चता सुतम् इति प्रतिदुहा परिषिञ्चत्य् एकस्या दुग्धेन प्रथमायाम्̐ व्युष्टायां द्वयोर् द्वितीयस्याम् /
text_mt: With 'Pour out the pressed [soma] all around', he pours [the liquor] all around with fresh milk: with the milk of one [cow] on the first dawn, of two on the second.

sanskrit_iast: tryahe surā janitā \\ iti paśubandhāyopavasati /
meaning: त्र्यहे सुरा जनिता \\ इति पशुबन्धायोपवसति /
text_mt: Saying 'The liquor is produced in three days', he fasts for the animal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: siddha upavasathaḥ /
meaning: सिद्ध उपवसथः /

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūta aindra ṛṣabhas tasyāprīprathamo 'nuvākaḥ /
meaning: श्वोभूत ऐन्द्र ऋषभस् तस्याप्रीप्रथमो ऽनुवाकः /
text_mt: On the next day, there is a bull for Indra; its first anuvāka contains the āprī-verses.

sanskrit_iast: nityāḥ praiṣāḥ //
ā carṣaṇiprās \\ iti ṣaḍarcam /
meaning: आ चर्षणिप्रास् \\ इति षडर्चम् /
text_mt: [The hymn] 'Approaching the active ones' consists of six verses.

sanskrit_iast: siddha upavasathaḥ /
meaning: सिद्ध उपवसथः /

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūta udaṅṅ avasṛpya tripaśus tasmin surā /
meaning: श्वोभूत उदङ्ङ् अवसृप्य त्रिपशुस् तस्मिन् सुरा /
text_mt: On the next day, having crept towards the north, there is the rite of three animals; in it is the liquor.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ātipāvanāt //
meaning: सिद्धम् आतिपावनात् //

sanskrit_iast: vāyuḥ pūtas \\ iti tām̐ somavāminaḥ kuryād vāyoḥ pūtas \\ iti tām̐ somātipavitasya //
meaning: वायुः पूतस् \\ इति ताम्̐ सोमवामिनः कुर्याद् वायोः पूतस् \\ इति ताम्̐ सोमातिपवितस्य //
text_mt: He should perform that [formula] 'Purified by Vāyu' for one who has vomited soma, [and] 'Purified from Vāyu' for one excessively purged by soma.

sanskrit_iast: brahma kṣatram ity anunigadati //
meaning: ब्रह्म क्षत्रम् इत्य् अनुनिगदति //
text_mt: He recites after: 'The spiritual power, the temporal power...'

sanskrit_iast: kuvid aṅga yavamantas \\ iti gṛhṇīto 'dhvaryuḥ payograhān /
meaning: कुविद् अङ्ग यवमन्तस् \\ इति गृह्णीतो ऽध्वर्युः पयोग्रहान् /
text_mt: With 'Truly, indeed, those who have barley...', the adhvaryu draws the cups of milk.

sanskrit_iast: kuvalasaktubhir godhūmasaktubhir vṛkalomnāśvinam̐ śrītvā sādayati karkandhusaktubhir upavākāsaktubhir vyāghralomnā sārasvataṃ badarasaktubhis tokmasaktubhiḥ sim̐halomnaindram /
meaning: कुवलसक्तुभिर् गोधूमसक्तुभिर् वृकलोम्नाश्विनम्̐ श्रीत्वा सादयति कर्कन्धुसक्तुभिर् उपवाकासक्तुभिर् व्याघ्रलोम्ना सारस्वतं बदरसक्तुभिस् तोक्मसक्तुभिः सिम्̐हलोम्नैन्द्रम् /
text_mt: Having mixed [the cup] for the Aśvins with jujube-groats, wheat-groats, and wolf-hair, he deposits it; the one for Sarasvatī with berry-groats, upavāka-groats, and tiger-hair; the one for Indra with common jujube-groats, malted-grain-groats, and lion-hair.

sanskrit_iast: yūpāvaṭaprabhṛti siddham opākaraṇāt /
meaning: यूपावटप्रभृति सिद्धम् ओपाकरणात् /
text_mt: From the hole for the sacrificial post onward, [the procedure is] established up to the dedication [of the animals].

sanskrit_iast: aśvibhyām̐ sarasvatyā indrāyājam̐ sarasvatyā indrāyāśvibhyāṃ meṣīm indrāyāśvibhyām̐ sarasvatyā ṛṣabham /
meaning: अश्विभ्याम्̐ सरस्वत्या इन्द्रायाजम्̐ सरस्वत्या इन्द्रायाश्विभ्यां मेषीम् इन्द्रायाश्विभ्याम्̐ सरस्वत्या ऋषभम् /
text_mt: [He dedicates] a goat to the Aśvins, to Sarasvatī, and to Indra; a ewe to Sarasvatī, to Indra, and to the Aśvins; a bull to Indra, to the Aśvins, and to Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā mārjanāt //
meaning: सिद्धम् आ मार्जनात् //

sanskrit_iast: yā vyāghram̐ viṣūcikā \\ iti śyenapattreṇa yajamānaṃ pāvayati /
meaning: या व्याघ्रम्̐ विषूचिका \\ इति श्येनपत्त्रेण यजमानं पावयति /
text_mt: With 'The cholera which [attacks] the tiger...', he purifies the sacrificer with a falcon feather.

sanskrit_iast: pāvitaḥ somo rājā \\ ity anuvākena grahān upatiṣṭhate //
meaning: पावितः सोमो राजा \\ इत्य् अनुवाकेन ग्रहान् उपतिष्ठते //
text_mt: With the anuvāka beginning with 'Purified is King Soma...', he reveres the cups.

sanskrit_iast: surāvantam iti pratinigadya vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛte juhvati /
meaning: सुरावन्तम् इति प्रतिनिगद्य वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृते जुह्वति /
text_mt: Having responded with "surāvantam...", they offer when the vaṣaṭ and the second vaṣaṭ have been made.

sanskrit_iast: dhyānāni dhyātvā yam aśvinā \\ iti payograhān bhakṣayati // nānā hi vām iti surāgrahān /
meaning: ध्यानानि ध्यात्वा यम् अश्विना \\ इति पयोग्रहान् भक्षयति // नाना हि वाम् इति सुराग्रहान् /
text_mt: Having meditated on the meditations, he consumes the milk-cups with "yam aśvinā...", and the surā-cups with "nānā hi vām...".

sanskrit_iast: pratiduho vājaprasavyam̐ hutvottarata uttaraveder āsandyām āsīnaṃ devasya tvā savituḥ prasave \\ iti saṃpātenābhiṣiñcati śiraso 'dhy ā mukhād avasrāvayati / śeṣaṃ pratiprasthātā dakṣiṇasmin bhūḥ svāhā \\ iti juhoti //
meaning: प्रतिदुहो वाजप्रसव्यम्̐ हुत्वोत्तरत उत्तरवेदेर् आसन्द्याम् आसीनं देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे \\ इति संपातेनाभिषिञ्चति शिरसो ऽध्य् आ मुखाद् अवस्रावयति / शेषं प्रतिप्रस्थाता दक्षिणस्मिन् भूः स्वाहा \\ इति जुहोति //
text_mt: Having offered the fresh milk counter-clockwise, he sprinkles [the sacrificer], who is seated on a stool to the north of the uttaravedi, with the residue [of the offering] using "devasya tvā savituḥ prasave...", and causes it to flow down over the head down to the mouth. The pratiprasthātṛ priest offers the remainder in the southern [fire] with "bhūḥ svāhā".

sanskrit_iast: śiro me śrīr yaśo mukham iti yathāliṅgam aṅgāni saṃmṛśati //
meaning: शिरो मे श्रीर् यशो मुखम् इति यथालिङ्गम् अङ्गानि संमृशति //
text_mt: With "śiro me śrīr yaśo mukham...", he touches his limbs according to the characteristic marks [in the sacred formula].

sanskrit_iast: prati brahmann iti pratyavarohati /
meaning: प्रति ब्रह्मन्न् इति प्रत्यवरोहति /
text_mt: With "prati brahmann...", he steps down [from the stool].

sanskrit_iast: yūṣṇaḥ śṛṅgaśaphaiḥ sīsena tantram itiprabhṛtibhiḥ prāk sviṣṭakṛtaḥ ṣoḍaśāhutīr juhoti /
meaning: यूष्णः शृङ्गशफैः सीसेन तन्त्रम् इतिप्रभृतिभिः प्राक् स्विष्टकृतः षोडशाहुतीर् जुहोति /
text_mt: Before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, he offers sixteen oblations with [the sacred formulas] beginning with "yūṣṇaḥ śṛṅgaśaphaiḥ sīsena tantram...".

sanskrit_iast: śatātṛṇṇām̐ vyutkṣārayati //
meaning: शतातृण्णाम्̐ व्युत्क्षारयति //
text_mt: He causes [water] to trickle through the hundred-holed strainer.

sanskrit_iast: punantu mā pitaras \\ iti yajamānam̐ vācayati //
meaning: पुनन्तु मा पितरस् \\ इति यजमानम्̐ वाचयति //
text_mt: He makes the sacrificer recite "punantu mā pitaras...".

sanskrit_iast: ye samānāḥ samanasas \\ ity adhvaryur juhoti // ye samānāḥ samanasas \\ jīvā jīveṣu māmakās \\ iti pratiprasthātā //
meaning: ये समानाः समनसस् \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युर् जुहोति // ये समानाः समनसस् \\ जीवा जीवेषु मामकास् \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता //
text_mt: The adhvaryu priest offers with "ye samānāḥ samanasas..."; the pratiprasthātṛ priest with "ye samānāḥ samanaso jīvā jīveṣu māmakāḥ...".

sanskrit_iast: dve srutī ity adhvaryur idam̐ havir iti pratiprasthātā /
meaning: द्वे स्रुती इत्य् अध्वर्युर् इदम्̐ हविर् इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
text_mt: The adhvaryu priest [offers] with "dve srutī..."; the pratiprasthātṛ priest with "idam havir...".

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśakapālān paśupuroḍāśān nirvapatīndrāya sutrāmṇe savitre varuṇāya savitre varuṇāyendrāya sutrāmṇe varuṇāyendrāya sutrāmṇe savitre /
meaning: एकादशकपालान् पशुपुरोडाशान् निर्वपतीन्द्राय सुत्राम्णे सवित्रे वरुणाय सवित्रे वरुणायेन्द्राय सुत्राम्णे वरुणायेन्द्राय सुत्राम्णे सवित्रे /
text_mt: He apportions animal-cakes on eleven potsherds: to Indra Sutrāman, to Savitṛ, to Varuṇa; [or] to Savitṛ, to Varuṇa, to Indra Sutrāman; [or] to Varuṇa, to Indra Sutrāman, to Savitṛ.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā dakṣiṇākālāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ दक्षिणाकालात् /
text_mt: [The ritual is] established up to the time of the sacrificial gifts.

sanskrit_iast: trayastrim̐śad dakṣiṇās tāsāṃ dhenur vaḍabā cānukiśorā //
meaning: त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शद् दक्षिणास् तासां धेनुर् वडबा चानुकिशोरा //
text_mt: The sacrificial gifts are thirty-three; among them are a milch cow and a mare with a foal.

sanskrit_iast: yad devā devaheḍanam itiprabhṛtibhiḥ prāk samiṣṭayajurbhyas tisra āhutīr juhoti //
meaning: यद् देवा देवहेडनम् इतिप्रभृतिभिः प्राक् समिष्टयजुर्भ्यस् तिस्र आहुतीर् जुहोति //
text_mt: Before the samiṣṭayajus formulas, he offers three oblations with [the sacred formulas] beginning with "yad devā devaheḍanam...".

sanskrit_iast: dhāmnodhāmnas \\ ity avabhṛthe 'psu juhoti // yad grāme yad araṇye \\ iti dvitīyām //
meaning: धाम्नोधाम्नस् \\ इत्य् अवभृथे ऽप्सु जुहोति // यद् ग्रामे यद् अरण्ये \\ इति द्वितीयाम् //
text_mt: At the purificatory bath, he offers into the water with "dhāmnodhāmnaḥ..."; the second with "yad grāme yad araṇye...".

sanskrit_iast: pavitram asi \\ iti snātāv anyonyasya pṛṣṭhaṃ prakṣālayataḥ //
meaning: पवित्रम् असि \\ इति स्नाताव् अन्योन्यस्य पृष्ठं प्रक्षालयतः //
text_mt: With "pavitram asi...", having bathed, the two wash each other's back.

sanskrit_iast: samāvṛtat pṛthivī \\ iti sruveṇa gārhapatye juhoti /
meaning: समावृतत् पृथिवी \\ इति स्रुवेण गार्हपत्ये जुहोति /
text_mt: With "samāvṛtat pṛthivī...", he offers into the gārhapatya fire with the dipping spoon.

sanskrit_iast: dvitīyatṛtīyāv āprīpraiṣau / caturthe vapāgrahāḥ /
meaning: द्वितीयतृतीयाव् आप्रीप्रैषौ / चतुर्थे वपाग्रहाः /
text_mt: The second and third are the calls for the āprī verses. At the fourth are the portions of omentum.

sanskrit_iast: paśupuroḍāśahaviḥsv iṣṭakṛtām̐ yājyānuvākyā yā yājyās tāḥ puronuvākyā yāḥ puronuvākyās tā yājyā vapāpaśupuroḍāśahaviṣām /
meaning: पशुपुरोडाशहविःस्व् इष्टकृताम्̐ याज्यानुवाक्या या याज्यास् ताः पुरोनुवाक्या याः पुरोनुवाक्यास् ता याज्या वपापशुपुरोडाशहविषाम् /
text_mt: For the Sviṣṭakṛt offerings of the animal-cakes and oblations, the offering verses are the invitatory verses, and the invitatory verses are the offering verses of the omentum, animal-cakes, and oblations.

sanskrit_iast: pañcamo 'nuyājaḥ /
meaning: पञ्चमो ऽनुयाजः /

sanskrit_iast: siddha upavasathaḥ /
meaning: सिद्ध उपवसथः /

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūta indrāya vayodhasa ṛṣabhas tasyāpryupottamaḥ /
meaning: श्वोभूत इन्द्राय वयोधस ऋषभस् तस्याप्र्युपोत्तमः /
text_mt: On the next day, there is a bull for Indra Vayodhas; his penultimate [verse] is the āprī verse.

sanskrit_iast: nityāḥ praiṣāḥ /
meaning: नित्याः प्रैषाः /

sanskrit_iast: uttamam̐ ṣaḍarcam̐ yājyānuvākyāḥ /
meaning: उत्तमम्̐ षडर्चम्̐ याज्यानुवाक्याः /
text_mt: The final six verses are the invitatory and offering verses.

sanskrit_iast: sarvapṛṣṭhāyā upottamaḥ /
meaning: सर्वपृष्ठाया उपोत्तमः /
text_mt: The penultimate [verse] is for the sarvapṛṣṭhā [oblation].
