sanskrit_iast: aśvamedhasyottamo mṛgāreṣṭes tantram /
meaning: अश्वमेधस्योत्तमो मृगारेष्टेस् तन्त्रम् /
text_mt: The final [verse] is for the horse sacrifice; the ritual framework is that of the mṛgāreṣṭi.

sanskrit_iast: tantram̐ yūpāhuteḥ /
meaning: तन्त्रम्̐ यूपाहुतेः /

sanskrit_iast: prāg vedikālād ekādaśa yūpān achaity upaśayaṃ pātnīvataṃ ca /
meaning: प्राग् वेदिकालाद् एकादश यूपान् अछैत्य् उपशयं पात्नीवतं च /
text_mt: Prior to the time of the altar, he cuts eleven sacrificial posts, as well as the upaśaya post and the one for the wife's sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: joṣaṇādy ānupūrvyā pṛthakpṛthak /
meaning: जोषणाद्य् आनुपूर्व्या पृथक्पृथक् /
text_mt: Beginning with the selection, each [is handled] individually in sequence.

sanskrit_iast: prathamotpatitam̐ svarucaṣālam agniṣṭham abhito yūpān asthūlān anaṇūn tulyān samūlān /
meaning: प्रथमोत्पतितम्̐ स्वरुचषालम् अग्निष्ठम् अभितो यूपान् अस्थूलान् अनणून् तुल्यान् समूलान् /
text_mt: The first that has fallen, having its own post-ring, is the central post; around it are posts that are not too thick, not too thin, equal, and possessing roots.

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśa yūpān parimāya traidham̐ saṃbhujya tṛtīyaiḥ pramāya vedim̐ vidadhāti /
meaning: एकादश यूपान् परिमाय त्रैधम्̐ संभुज्य तृतीयैः प्रमाय वेदिम्̐ विदधाति /
text_mt: Having measured the eleven sacrificial posts, dividing [the length] into three and measuring by the thirds, he lays out the altar.

sanskrit_iast: siddham āgnīṣomīyāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आग्नीषोमीयात् /

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭhe dve raśane parivīya tūṣṇīm̐ vim̐śatiṃ parivyayati /
meaning: अग्निष्ठे द्वे रशने परिवीय तूष्णीम्̐ विम्̐शतिं परिव्ययति /
text_mt: Having wound two cords around the central post, he winds twenty around silently.

sanskrit_iast: siddha upavasathaḥ /
meaning: सिद्ध उपवसथः /

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūta āśvinaṃ gṛhītvāgniṣṭhād udañcam̐ rathākṣaṃ pramāya sphyena yūpāvaṭaṃ parilikhati vyatyāsam itarān /
meaning: श्वोभूत आश्विनं गृहीत्वाग्निष्ठाद् उदञ्चम्̐ रथाक्षं प्रमाय स्फ्येन यूपावटं परिलिखति व्यत्यासम् इतरान् /
text_mt: On the next day, having drawn the cup for the Aśvins, measuring a chariot axle northwards from the central post, he outlines the post-hole with the wooden sword, and alternately for the others.

sanskrit_iast: siddham añjanaprabhṛty ekaikasminn ā parivyayaṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् अञ्जनप्रभृत्य् एकैकस्मिन्न् आ परिव्ययणात् /
text_mt: Beginning with the anointing, each [action] is established for each individual post up to the wrapping [with the cord].

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇasmin yūpāntare prāñcam upaśayaṃ nidhāya yūpā āñjanīyās tūṣṇīm̐ svaruraśanam /
meaning: दक्षिणस्मिन् यूपान्तरे प्राञ्चम् उपशयं निधाय यूपा आञ्जनीयास् तूष्णीम्̐ स्वरुरशनम् /
text_mt: Having placed the upaśaya post pointing east in the southern interval between the posts, the posts are to be anointed, and the post-chip and cord [are attached] silently.

sanskrit_iast: yady abhicared idam aham amum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram indravajreṇābhinidadhāmi \\ ity abhinidadhyāt /
meaning: यद्य् अभिचरेद् इदम् अहम् अमुम् आमुष्यायणम् अमुष्याः पुत्रम् इन्द्रवज्रेणाभिनिदधामि \\ इत्य् अभिनिदध्यात् /
text_mt: If he performs sorcery, he should set it down with: "Here I set down so-and-so, descendant of so-and-so, son of such-and-such a woman, with Indra's thunderbolt."

sanskrit_iast: udakpravaṇa ekādaśinīm̐ saṃminoti trīn vā madhyataḥ samān /
meaning: उदक्प्रवण एकादशिनीम्̐ संमिनोति त्रीन् वा मध्यतः समान् /
text_mt: He erects the set of eleven posts sloping towards the north, or three equal ones in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: sam̐srāviṇī vṛṣṭikāmasyāgniṣṭho hrasiṣṭho 'nupūrvam itare varṣīyām̐sa ārāgrābhicarato 'gniṣṭho varṣiṣṭho 'nupūrvam itare hrasīyām̐saḥ samāḥ pratiṣṭhākāmasya /
meaning: सम्̐स्राविणी वृष्टिकामस्याग्निष्ठो ह्रसिष्ठो ऽनुपूर्वम् इतरे वर्षीयाम्̐स आराग्राभिचरतो ऽग्निष्ठो वर्षिष्ठो ऽनुपूर्वम् इतरे ह्रसीयाम्̐सः समाः प्रतिष्ठाकामस्य /
text_mt: For one desirous of rain, [they are] flowing together: the central post is shortest, and the others successively taller; for one practicing sorcery, [they are shaped like] the point of an awl: the central post is tallest, and the others successively shorter; for one desirous of a firm standing, they are equal.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvedyur vā saṃminuyāt /
meaning: पूर्वेद्युर् वा संमिनुयात् /
text_mt: Or he may erect them on the preceding day.

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭhāt tu śvobhūte raśanāḥ parivīya paśūn upākaroti /
meaning: अग्निष्ठात् तु श्वोभूते रशनाः परिवीय पशून् उपाकरोति /
text_mt: On the next day, however, having wound the cords starting from the central post, he brings forward the sacrificial animals.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇaśirasam ajam āgneyam agniṣṭhe niyunakti sārasvatīṃ meṣīm uttarasmin saumyaṃ babhruṃ dakṣiṇasmin vyatyāsam itarān vāruṇaṃ dakṣiṇārdhe /
meaning: कृष्णशिरसम् अजम् आग्नेयम् अग्निष्ठे नियुनक्ति सारस्वतीं मेषीम् उत्तरस्मिन् सौम्यं बभ्रुं दक्षिणस्मिन् व्यत्यासम् इतरान् वारुणं दक्षिणार्धे /
text_mt: He binds a black-headed he-goat sacred to Agni to the central post; a ewe sacred to Sarasvatī to the northern one; a brown one sacred to Soma to the southern one; the others alternately; and the one sacred to Varuṇa in the southern half.

sanskrit_iast: upaśayāyāraṇyaṃ nirdiśet /
meaning: उपशयायारण्यं निर्दिशेत् /
text_mt: For the upaśaya post, he should designate a wild animal.

sanskrit_iast: abhicarann asau te paśur iti dveṣyaṃ nirdiśet /
meaning: अभिचरन्न् असौ ते पशुर् इति द्वेष्यं निर्दिशेत् /
text_mt: If practicing sorcery, he should designate the hated person with: "That one is your animal."

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā prakramaṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ प्रक्रमणात् /

sanskrit_iast: ekaikam anvārabhate /
meaning: एकैकम् अन्वारभते /

sanskrit_iast: agreṇa yūpāvaṭam apareṇottarān paśūn mukhyaprathamāñ śāmitrāya nayanti /
meaning: अग्रेण यूपावटम् अपरेणोत्तरान् पशून् मुख्यप्रथमाञ् शामित्राय नयन्ति /
text_mt: In front of the post-hole and to the west of the northern ones, they lead the animals to the slaughtering place, beginning with the principal one.

sanskrit_iast: uttaramuttaram avasthāpayanti pūrvaṃpūrvam̐ vā /
meaning: उत्तरमुत्तरम् अवस्थापयन्ति पूर्वंपूर्वम्̐ वा /
text_mt: They place them each to the north, or each to the east.

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣūpāsanāḥ saha raśanā anuprāsyanti darbhān vapāśrapaṇīḥ svarūm̐ś ca /
meaning: सर्वेषूपासनाः सह रशना अनुप्रास्यन्ति दर्भान् वपाश्रपणीः स्वरूम्̐श् च /
text_mt: At all [posts], they throw in the attendants together with the cords, sacrificial grass, omentum-spits, and post-chips.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā vapoddharaṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ वपोद्धरणात् /
text_mt: [The ritual is] established up to the extraction of the omentum.

sanskrit_iast: apareṇottarān paśūn mukhyaprathamāḥ śāmitrād dharanti samayā paśuṃpaśuṃ parigrāhaṃ pūrvāṅgārān āhavanīyāya //
meaning: अपरेणोत्तरान् पशून् मुख्यप्रथमाः शामित्राद् धरन्ति समया पशुंपशुं परिग्राहं पूर्वाङ्गारान् आहवनीयाय //
text_mt: To the west of the northern animals, beginning with the principal one, they carry the enclosure around animal by animal from the slaughtering place, and the eastern coals for the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: svāhā devebhyas \\ iti purastād vapānāṃ juhuyād viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ svāhā \\ ity upariṣṭāt /
meaning: स्वाहा देवेभ्यस् \\ इति पुरस्ताद् वपानां जुहुयाद् विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः स्वाहा \\ इत्य् उपरिष्टात् /
text_mt: He should offer before the omenta with "svāhā devebhyaḥ...", and after them with "viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ svāhā...".

sanskrit_iast: anyatra savanīyebhyo hṛdayaśūlāḥ paśupuroḍāśāś ca /
meaning: अन्यत्र सवनीयेभ्यो हृदयशूलाः पशुपुरोडाशाश् च /
text_mt: Except for the soma-day victims, there are heart-spits and animal-cakes.

sanskrit_iast: samānadevateṣv avyavahiteṣu sakṛnmanotā pratipaśu vyavahiteṣu /
meaning: समानदेवतेष्व् अव्यवहितेषु सकृन्मनोता प्रतिपशु व्यवहितेषु /
text_mt: When they have the same deity and are uninterrupted, there is a single recitation of the manotā verse; when interrupted, [one] for each animal.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthagvasāhomāḥ /
meaning: पृथग्वसाहोमाः /

sanskrit_iast: śeṣair antar anto diśaḥ pratījyādhyūdhnīm̐ hotre haranti vaniṣṭhum agnīdhe /
meaning: शेषैर् अन्तर् अन्तो दिशः प्रतीज्याध्यूध्नीम्̐ होत्रे हरन्ति वनिष्ठुम् अग्नीधे /
text_mt: Having offered with the remainders towards the various directions within the boundaries, they carry the portion above the udder to the hotṛ priest, and the entrails to the āgnīdhra priest.

sanskrit_iast: gudānām̐ samavadāyopayajati /
meaning: गुदानाम्̐ समवदायोपयजति /
text_mt: Having cut off together [portions] of the entrails, he makes an additional offering.

sanskrit_iast: jāghanībhiḥ patnīḥ sam̐yājayanti /
meaning: जाघनीभिः पत्नीः सम्̐याजयन्ति /
text_mt: They cause the wives to offer the wife-offerings with the tail-portions.

sanskrit_iast: prāganūbandhyāyāḥ prāgvam̐śe pātnīvatena caranti /
meaning: प्रागनूबन्ध्यायाः प्राग्वम्̐शे पात्नीवतेन चरन्ति /
text_mt: Before the anūbandhyā cow, they proceed in the east-roofed hall with the victim for the wife's sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: dārśikī vedir pāśukāny ājyāni /
meaning: दार्शिकी वेदिर् पाशुकान्य् आज्यानि /
text_mt: The vedi is according to the New-Moon sacrifice; the clarified butters are according to the animal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: agreṇa gārhapatyam adhonābhim acaṣālam̐ yūpaṃ saṃminoti /
meaning: अग्रेण गार्हपत्यम् अधोनाभिम् अचषालम्̐ यूपं संमिनोति /
text_mt: East of the gārhapatya, below the navel [in height], without a top-ring, he erects the sacrificial post.

sanskrit_iast: anavastīrṇo yūpāvaṭaḥ /
meaning: अनवस्तीर्णो यूपावटः /
text_mt: The post-hole is not strewn [with grass].

sanskrit_iast: madhye parivyayati /
meaning: मध्ये परिव्ययति /

sanskrit_iast: tvāṣṭraṃ paśum upākaroti /
meaning: त्वाष्ट्रं पशुम् उपाकरोति /
text_mt: He assigns the animal sacred to Tvaṣṭṛ.

sanskrit_iast: paryagnikṛtam̐ saharaśanam utsṛjyājyena sam̐sthāpayati /
meaning: पर्यग्निकृतम्̐ सहरशनम् उत्सृज्याज्येन सम्̐स्थापयति /
text_mt: Having released it, fire having been carried around it together with the halter, he concludes [the rite] with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: yāvanti paśor avadānāni tāvat kṛtva ājyasyāvadāya tvaṣṭra ājyasyānubrūhi \\ iti tvaṣṭra ājyasya preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
meaning: यावन्ति पशोर् अवदानानि तावत् कृत्व आज्यस्यावदाय त्वष्ट्र आज्यस्यानुब्रूहि \\ इति त्वष्ट्र आज्यस्य प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
text_mt: Having cut off as many portions of clarified butter as there are portions of the animal, he proceeds with: 'Recite [the invitatory verse] for Tvaṣṭṛ of the clarified butter', and 'Prompt [the offering verse] for Tvaṣṭṛ of the clarified butter'.

sanskrit_iast: vapāsthāne paśupuroḍāśasya paśor ājyena sviṣṭakṛd ājyenopayajaḥ /
meaning: वपास्थाने पशुपुरोडाशस्य पशोर् आज्येन स्विष्टकृद् आज्येनोपयजः /
text_mt: In place of the omentum [is the offering] of the animal cake; the Sviṣṭakṛt offering of the animal is made with clarified butter; the auxiliary offering is made with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: śam̐yvantā saṃtiṣṭhate /
meaning: शम्̐य्वन्ता संतिष्ठते /
text_mt: It concludes with the śaṃyu [formula].

sanskrit_iast: sarvāḥ srucaḥ saṃpragṛhṇāti /
meaning: सर्वाः स्रुचः संप्रगृह्णाति /
text_mt: He takes hold of all the ladles together.

sanskrit_iast: anūbandhyām̐ sam̐sthāpya yūpān anudiśati /
meaning: अनूबन्ध्याम्̐ सम्̐स्थाप्य यूपान् अनुदिशति /
text_mt: Having concluded the anūbandhyā cow, he assigns the sacrificial posts.

sanskrit_iast: kratupaśubhir ekādaśinī nirvarteta / niyatā sāgnicityeṣv ekādaśiny ekayūpe yūpaikādaśinī sarvastomeṣu /
meaning: क्रतुपशुभिर् एकादशिनी निर्वर्तेत / नियता साग्निचित्येष्व् एकादशिन्य् एकयूपे यूपैकादशिनी सर्वस्तोमेषु /
text_mt: A set of eleven [animals] should be performed with the sacrificial animals of the rite. The set of eleven [animals] is fixed in the rites with the piling of the fire altar; in a single sacrificial post, [or] a set of eleven sacrificial posts in all-stoma sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: yajamānayajñapativādān ūhet samavāye // anu vām \ anu vaḥ / \ anumantau \ anumantaḥ / \ āvahataṃ \ āvahata / \ devāyadbhyāṃ \ devāyadbhyaḥ / \ ye badhyāmānau \ ye badhyamānān / \ svarvidau sthaḥ \ svarvidaḥ stha / \ svar itam \\ svar ita / \ lokavidau sthas \\ lokavidaḥ stha / \ lokam itam \\ lokamita / \ nāthavidau sthas \\ nāthavidaḥ stha / \ nātham itam \\ nātham ita / \ gātuvidau sthas \\ gātuvidaḥ stha / \ gātum itam \\ gātum ita / \ mriyethe \ mriyadhve / \ riṣyathaḥ \ riṣyatha / \ idithaḥ \ iditha / \ pāśābhyāṃ paśū \ pāśebhyaḥ paśūn / \ mārutaṃ devaṃ gachatam \\ mārutaṃ devaṃ gachata / \ śamitārā3u \ śamitāraḥ / \ tatra vām \\ tatra vaḥ / \ bhūri vām \\ bhūri vaḥ / \ divam̐ vām \\ divam̐ vaḥ / \ yantau \ yataḥ /
meaning: यजमानयज्ञपतिवादान् ऊहेत् समवाये // अनु वाम् \ अनु वः / \ अनुमन्तौ \ अनुमन्तः / \ आवहतं \ आवहत / \ देवायद्भ्यां \ देवायद्भ्यः / \ ये बध्यामानौ \ ये बध्यमानान् / \ स्वर्विदौ स्थः \ स्वर्विदः स्थ / \ स्वर् इतम् \\ स्वर् इत / \ लोकविदौ स्थस् \\ लोकविदः स्थ / \ लोकम् इतम् \\ लोकमित / \ नाथविदौ स्थस् \\ नाथविदः स्थ / \ नाथम् इतम् \\ नाथम् इत / \ गातुविदौ स्थस् \\ गातुविदः स्थ / \ गातुम् इतम् \\ गातुम् इत / \ म्रियेथे \ म्रियध्वे / \ रिष्यथः \ रिष्यथ / \ इदिथः \ इदिथ / \ पाशाभ्यां पशू \ पाशेभ्यः पशून् / \ मारुतं देवं गछतम् \\ मारुतं देवं गछत / \ शमितारा3उ \ शमितारः / \ तत्र वाम् \\ तत्र वः / \ भूरि वाम् \\ भूरि वः / \ दिवम्̐ वाम् \\ दिवम्̐ वः / \ यन्तौ \ यतः /
text_mt: In case of combination [of two or more animals], he should adapt the expressions concerning the sacrificer and the lord of sacrifice: 'after you two' / 'after you [all]'; 'two assenters' / 'assenters'; 'bring you two' / 'bring you [all]'; 'for the two seeking the gods' / 'for those seeking the gods'; 'who [are] being bound' [dual] / 'who [are] being bound' [plural]; 'you two are finders of heaven' / 'you [all] are finders of heaven'; 'go to heaven' [dual] / 'go to heaven' [plural]; 'you two are finders of the world' / 'you [all] are finders of the world'; 'go to the world' [dual] / 'go to the world' [plural]; 'you two are finders of a protector' / 'you [all] are finders of a protector'; 'go to a protector' [dual] / 'go to a protector' [plural]; 'you two are finders of the path' / 'you [all] are finders of the path'; 'go to the path' [dual] / 'go to the path' [plural]; 'you two die' / 'you [all] die'; 'you two are injured' / 'you [all] are injured'; 'you two go' / 'you [all] go'; 'the two animals from the two fetters' / 'the animals from the fetters'; 'go you two to the Marut god' / 'go you [all] to the Marut god'; 'O two slaughterers' / 'O slaughterers'; 'there for you two' / 'there for you [all]'; 'abundant for you two' / 'abundant for you [all]'; 'the sky for you two' / 'the sky for you [all]'; 'the two going' / 'those going'.

sanskrit_iast: śéṣo 'nūhyo mātā piteti vyākhyātam /
meaning: श्éषो ऽनूह्यो माता पितेति व्याख्यातम् /
text_mt: The remainder is not to be adapted; 'mother, father' has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: cittiḥ srug iti daśahotā \\ indraṃ gacha svāhā \\ iti homaḥ //
meaning: चित्तिः स्रुग् इति दशहोता \\ इन्द्रं गछ स्वाहा \\ इति होमः //
text_mt: 'Thought is the ladle' is the Daśahotṛ formula; the oblation is with: 'Go to Indra, svāhā'.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivī hotā \\ iti caturhotā // vācaspate vāco vīryeṇa \\ iti grahaḥ // somaḥ somasya pibatu \\ iti dvitīyaḥ /
meaning: पृथिवी होता \\ इति चतुर्होता // वाचस्पते वाचो वीर्येण \\ इति ग्रहः // सोमः सोमस्य पिबतु \\ इति द्वितीयः /
text_mt: 'Earth is the hotṛ' is the Caturhotṛ formula. The drawing [formula] is: 'O lord of speech, by the power of speech'. The second is: 'Let Soma drink of Soma'.

sanskrit_iast: agnir hotā \\ iti pañcahotā // vācaspate hinvidhe nāman \\ iti grahaḥ // somaḥ somasya pibatu \\ iti dvitīyaḥ //
meaning: अग्निर् होता \\ इति पञ्चहोता // वाचस्पते हिन्विधे नामन् \\ इति ग्रहः // सोमः सोमस्य पिबतु \\ इति द्वितीयः //
text_mt: 'Agni is the hotṛ' is the Pañcahotṛ formula. The drawing [formula] is: 'O lord of speech, stimulate into the name of the rite'. The second is: 'Let Soma drink of Soma'.

sanskrit_iast: mahāhavir hotā \\ iti saptahotā // vidhe nāman \\ iti grahaḥ /
meaning: महाहविर् होता \\ इति सप्तहोता // विधे नामन् \\ इति ग्रहः /
text_mt: 'The great oblation is the hotṛ' is the Saptahotṛ formula. The drawing [formula] is: 'Into the name of the rite'.

sanskrit_iast: apa upaspṛśya prāṅmukhaḥ pratigṛhṇāti deyam̐ vābhimukhaḥ /
meaning: अप उपस्पृश्य प्राङ्मुखः प्रतिगृह्णाति देयम्̐ वाभिमुखः /
text_mt: Having touched water, facing east he accepts [the gift], or facing that which is to be given.

sanskrit_iast: sāvitraḥ purastāt sarveṣām //
meaning: सावित्रः पुरस्तात् सर्वेषाम् //
text_mt: [The formula] sacred to Savitṛ is placed before all [acceptances].

sanskrit_iast: yamāya tvā \\ ity aśvam̐ yac caikaśapham //
meaning: यमाय त्वा \\ इत्य् अश्वम्̐ यच् चैकशफम् //
text_mt: 'To Yama thee' for a horse and whatever has uncloven hooves.

sanskrit_iast: rudrāya tvā \\ iti dviśapham //
meaning: रुद्राय त्वा \\ इति द्विशफम् //
text_mt: 'To Rudra thee' for an animal with cloven hooves.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye tvā \\ iti hiraṇyamṃ trapuḥ sīsamayo lohaṃ ca //
meaning: अग्नये त्वा \\ इति हिरण्यम्ं त्रपुः सीसमयो लोहं च //
text_mt: 'To Agni thee' for gold, tin, lead, iron, and copper.

sanskrit_iast: gnās tvākṛntan \\ apaso 'tanvata \ dhiyo 'vayan \ bṛhaspataye tvā \\ iti vāsaḥ //
meaning: ग्नास् त्वाकृन्तन् \\ अपसो ऽतन्वत \ धियो ऽवयन् \ बृहस्पतये त्वा \\ इति वासः //
text_mt: 'The wives cut thee, the active women stretched [thee], the thoughtful women wove [thee], to Bṛhaspati thee' for a garment.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpataye tvā \\ iti hastinaṃ puruṣam̐ vrīhiyavau bhūmiṃ prāṇi cānyat //
meaning: प्रजापतये त्वा \\ इति हस्तिनं पुरुषम्̐ व्रीहियवौ भूमिं प्राणि चान्यत् //
text_mt: 'To Prajāpati thee' for an elephant, a human being, rice and barley, land, and other living beings.

sanskrit_iast: uttānāya tvā \\ ity aprāṇi //
meaning: उत्तानाय त्वा \\ इत्य् अप्राणि //
text_mt: 'To Uttāna thee' for what is inanimate.

sanskrit_iast: ka idaṃ kasmā adād iti sarvatrānuṣajati kāmaitat te \\ ity antam /
meaning: क इदं कस्मा अदाद् इति सर्वत्रानुषजति कामैतत् ते \\ इत्य् अन्तम् /
text_mt: He connects everywhere: 'Who gave this to whom?', ending with: 'O desire, this to thee'.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ prajayā paśubhir na prajāyeta drahilam ahatam̐ vāsaḥ paridhāya dvādaśarātraṃ taptaṃ payaḥ piban vratacāry adhaḥ śayīta /
meaning: यः प्रजया पशुभिर् न प्रजायेत द्रहिलम् अहतम्̐ वासः परिधाय द्वादशरात्रं तप्तं पयः पिबन् व्रतचार्य् अधः शयीत /
text_mt: He who does not multiply in offspring and animals, having put on a strong, unwashed garment, drinking heated milk for twelve nights, observing a vow, should sleep on the ground.

sanskrit_iast: trayodaśyām udite daśahotāraṃ nigadya \\ indraṃ gacha svāhā \\ iti homaḥ /
meaning: त्रयोदश्याम् उदिते दशहोतारं निगद्य \\ इन्द्रं गछ स्वाहा \\ इति होमः /
text_mt: At sunrise on the thirteenth day, having pronounced the Daśahotṛ formula, the oblation is with: 'Go to Indra, svāhā'.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇya \\ indraṃ gacha svāhā \\ ity apāne /
meaning: प्राण्य \\ इन्द्रं गछ स्वाहा \\ इत्य् अपाने /
text_mt: Having inhaled, [he offers] on the out-breath with: 'Go to Indra, svāhā'.

sanskrit_iast: caturhotāraṃ nigaded vyākhyātaḥ /
meaning: चतुर्होतारं निगदेद् व्याख्यातः /
text_mt: He should pronounce the Caturhotṛ formula; it has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: tathā pañcahotrā ṣaḍḍhotrā yaśaskāmaḥ /
meaning: तथा पञ्चहोत्रा षड्ढोत्रा यशस्कामः /
text_mt: Likewise, one desiring glory [should act] with the Pañcahotṛ and the Ṣaḍḍhotṛ formulas.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtumukheṣu sam̐vatsaraṃ juhuyāt /
meaning: ऋतुमुखेषु सम्̐वत्सरं जुहुयात् /
text_mt: He should offer at the beginnings of the seasons for a year.

sanskrit_iast: someneṣṭvā pāpīyān manyamānaḥ saptahotāraṃ manasānudrutya vidhe nāman \\ iti graheṇa juhoti /
meaning: सोमेनेष्ट्वा पापीयान् मन्यमानः सप्तहोतारं मनसानुद्रुत्य विधे नामन् \\ इति ग्रहेण जुहोति /
text_mt: Having sacrificed with Soma, one who considers himself worse off, having mentally recited the Saptahotṛ formula, offers with the drawing [formula]: 'Into the name of the rite'.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām̐ vratāni / tribhiḥ sahaikataḥ sam̐vatsaraṃ nāśnīyāt trayāṇām ucchiṣṭaṃ na bhuñjīta / tribhyo na prayachet /
meaning: तेषाम्̐ व्रतानि / त्रिभिः सहैकतः सम्̐वत्सरं नाश्नीयात् त्रयाणाम् उच्छिष्टं न भुञ्जीत / त्रिभ्यो न प्रयछेत् /
text_mt: Their vows: he should not eat together with three persons for a year; he should not eat the leftovers of three; he should not give to three.

sanskrit_iast: yo 'dhītaḥ san na virodheta so 'raṇyaṃ paretya brāhmaṇaṃ bahuvidam upaveśya darbhastambam udgrathya caturhotṝn svakarmaṇo vyācakṣīta /
meaning: यो ऽधीतः सन् न विरोधेत सो ऽरण्यं परेत्य ब्राह्मणं बहुविदम् उपवेश्य दर्भस्तम्बम् उद्ग्रथ्य चतुर्होतॄन् स्वकर्मणो व्याचक्षीत /
text_mt: He who, having studied, does not prosper, having gone to the wilderness and seated a learned brahmin, having tied a clump of darbha grass, should explain the Caturhotṛ formulas according to his own ritual.

sanskrit_iast: nadīparvatamaryādāvyavahitāḥ sutyāḥ samānakālāḥ samṛtayajñāḥ /
meaning: नदीपर्वतमर्यादाव्यवहिताः सुत्याः समानकालाः समृतयज्ञाः /
text_mt: Soma-pressing days separated by boundaries of rivers or mountains, occurring at the same time, are conflicting sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: tasya purastāt prātaranuvākasya samiddhe 'gnau saṃbhārayajūm̐ṣi juhoti yathā dīkṣaṇīyāyāḥ /
meaning: तस्य पुरस्तात् प्रातरनुवाकस्य समिद्धे ऽग्नौ संभारयजूम्̐षि जुहोति यथा दीक्षणीयायाः /
text_mt: Before the morning recitation, on the kindled fire, he offers the saṃbhāra-yajus formulas, as in the case of the initiatory offering.

sanskrit_iast: etair dvādaśāhe purastāt prāyaṇīyasya juhuyāt /
meaning: एतैर् द्वादशाहे पुरस्तात् प्रायणीयस्य जुहुयात् /
text_mt: With these he should offer before the introductory rite at the twelve-day sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: etair evātithyam abhimṛśet /
meaning: एतैर् एवातिथ्यम् अभिमृशेत् /
text_mt: With these very [formulas] he should touch the hospitality offering.

sanskrit_iast: etāny evāgnīdhe 'nubrūyāt /
meaning: एतान्य् एवाग्नीधे ऽनुब्रूयात् /
text_mt: These very [formulas] he should recite to the āgnīdhra.

sanskrit_iast: etair antarā tvaṣṭāraṃ ca patnīś ca sam̐vatsaraṃ prajākāmo juhuyāt /
meaning: एतैर् अन्तरा त्वष्टारं च पत्नीश् च सम्̐वत्सरं प्रजाकामो जुहुयात् /
text_mt: One desiring offspring should offer with these between Tvaṣṭṛ and the wives for a year.

sanskrit_iast: bhūpate bhuvanapate mahato bhūtasya pate brahmāṇaṃ tyā vṛṇe \\ iti śrutavantam ārṣeyaṃ brahmāṇam̐ vṛṇīte vedikāle 'māvāsyāyām̐ śvobhūte paurṇamāsyām //
meaning: भूपते भुवनपते महतो भूतस्य पते ब्रह्माणं त्या वृणे \\ इति श्रुतवन्तम् आर्षेयं ब्रह्माणम्̐ वृणीते वेदिकाले ऽमावास्यायाम्̐ श्वोभूते पौर्णमास्याम् //
text_mt: With 'Lord of the earth, lord of the world, lord of great being, I choose thee as brahman priest', he chooses as brahman priest a learned [brahmin] of ṛṣi descent at the time of the vedi, on the new-moon day, or on the full-moon day on the morrow.

sanskrit_iast: bhūr bhuvaḥ svar \ deva savitar etaṃ tvā vṛṇate bṛhaspatiṃ brahmāṇam \\ tam ahaṃ manase prabravīmi \ mano vāce \ vāg gāyatryai \ gāyatrī triṣṭubhe \ triṣṭub jagatyai \ jagaty anuṣṭubhe \\ anuṣṭup paṅktaye \ paṅktiḥ prajāpataye \ prajāpatir bṛhaspataye \ bṛhaspatir devānāṃ brahmāhaṃ manuṣyāṇām \\ bṛhaspate yajñaṃ gopāya \\ ahaṃ bhūpatir ahaṃ bhuvanapatir ahaṃ mahato bhūtasya patir aham \\ maho me 'vocas \\ bhargo me 'vocaḥ \ stomaṃ me 'vocas \\ yaśo me 'vocas \\ annādyaṃ me 'vocaḥ \ prajāṃ me 'vocaḥ \ pratiṣṭhāṃ me 'vocas \\ iti vṛto japati /
meaning: भूर् भुवः स्वर् \ देव सवितर् एतं त्वा वृणते बृहस्पतिं ब्रह्माणम् \\ तम् अहं मनसे प्रब्रवीमि \ मनो वाचे \ वाग् गायत्र्यै \ गायत्री त्रिष्टुभे \ त्रिष्टुब् जगत्यै \ जगत्य् अनुष्टुभे \\ अनुष्टुप् पङ्क्तये \ पङ्क्तिः प्रजापतये \ प्रजापतिर् बृहस्पतये \ बृहस्पतिर् देवानां ब्रह्माहं मनुष्याणाम् \\ बृहस्पते यज्ञं गोपाय \\ अहं भूपतिर् अहं भुवनपतिर् अहं महतो भूतस्य पतिर् अहम् \\ महो मे ऽवोचस् \\ भर्गो मे ऽवोचः \ स्तोमं मे ऽवोचस् \\ यशो मे ऽवोचस् \\ अन्नाद्यं मे ऽवोचः \ प्रजां मे ऽवोचः \ प्रतिष्ठां मे ऽवोचस् \\ इति वृतो जपति /
text_mt: Having been chosen, he mutters: 'Bhūr, bhuvas, svar! O divine Savitṛ, they choose this Bṛhaspati as brahman priest; / him I proclaim to the mind, the mind to speech, speech to the gāyatrī, the gāyatrī to the triṣṭubh, the triṣṭubh to the jagatī, the jagatī to the anuṣṭubh, / the anuṣṭubh to the paṅkti, the paṅkti to Prajāpati, Prajāpati to Bṛhaspati; Bṛhaspati is the brahman priest of the gods, I of men. / O Bṛhaspati, protect the sacrifice! / I am the lord of the earth, I am the lord of the world, I am the lord of great being. / Greatness hast thou spoken for me; splendour hast thou spoken for me; praise hast thou spoken for me; glory hast thou spoken for me; food hast thou spoken for me; offspring hast thou spoken for me; stability hast thou spoken for me.'

sanskrit_iast: tīrthenānvety apareṇa vihāraṃ dakṣiṇātikramya yajñopavīty apramatto dakṣiṇata āsīta //
meaning: तीर्थेनान्वेत्य् अपरेण विहारं दक्षिणातिक्रम्य यज्ञोपवीत्य् अप्रमत्तो दक्षिणत आसीत //
text_mt: Having approached along the ford, having crossed south to the west of the sacrificial enclosure, wearing the sacred thread over the left shoulder, not negligent, he should sit to the south.

sanskrit_iast: ahe daidhiṣavyod atas tiṣṭhānyasya sadane sīda yo 'smat pākataras \\ ity āsanam anumantrayeta /
meaning: अहे दैधिषव्योद् अतस् तिष्ठान्यस्य सदने सीद यो ऽस्मत् पाकतरस् \\ इत्य् आसनम् अनुमन्त्रयेत /
text_mt: With 'O son of a didhiṣū, stand up from here, sit in the seat of another who is simpler than us', he should accompany the seat with the formula.

sanskrit_iast: āsanāt tṛṇam ubhayataḥ prachidya nirastaḥ parāvasuḥ saha pāpmanā \\ iti dakṣiṇāpratyak savyena nirasyati //
meaning: आसनात् तृणम् उभयतः प्रछिद्य निरस्तः परावसुः सह पाप्मना \\ इति दक्षिणाप्रत्यक् सव्येन निरस्यति //
text_mt: Having cut off a blade of grass from both sides from the seat, he casts it towards the south-west with the left hand, with: 'Parāvasu is cast away together with evil.'

sanskrit_iast: idam aham arvāgvasoḥ sadane sīdāmi \\ iti dakṣiṇaṃ pādam āsanam abhyantare dadāti tadantareṇa savyam //
meaning: इदम् अहम् अर्वाग्वसोः सदने सीदामि \\ इति दक्षिणं पादम् आसनम् अभ्यन्तरे ददाति तदन्तरेण सव्यम् //
text_mt: With 'Here I sit in the seat of Arvāgvasu', he places his right foot inside the seat, and after it his left.

sanskrit_iast: devena savitrā prasūtas \ tad agnaye prabravīmi \ tad vāyave \ tat sūryāya \\ ity upaviśati //
meaning: देवेन सवित्रा प्रसूतस् \ तद् अग्नये प्रब्रवीमि \ तद् वायवे \ तत् सूर्याय \\ इत्य् उपविशति //
text_mt: "Impelled by the god Savitṛ, that I announce to Agni, that to Vāyu, that to Sūrya,"—[with this mantra] he sits down.

sanskrit_iast: sūryo divo yajñaṃ pātu \ vāyur antarikṣād yajñapatiṃ pātu \\ agnir māṃ pātu mānuṣam iti japati /
meaning: सूर्यो दिवो यज्ञं पातु \ वायुर् अन्तरिक्षाद् यज्ञपतिं पातु \\ अग्निर् मां पातु मानुषम् इति जपति /
text_mt: "May Sūrya protect the sacrifice from heaven; may Vāyu protect the lord of the sacrifice from the intermediate space; may Agni protect me, the mortal,"—he murmurs [this].

sanskrit_iast: brahmaṇy upacaraty anyasya vā karma kurvāṇe yo nediṣṭhī ṛtvijām̐ syāt sa upāsītāpi vā darbhamuṣṭim udapātram̐ vā brahmāsane nyasyed aśūnyāsanam evam̐ syāt //
meaning: ब्रह्मण्य् उपचरत्य् अन्यस्य वा कर्म कुर्वाणे यो नेदिष्ठी ऋत्विजाम्̐ स्यात् स उपासीतापि वा दर्भमुष्टिम् उदपात्रम्̐ वा ब्रह्मासने न्यस्येद् अशून्यासनम् एवम्̐ स्यात् //
text_mt: When the brahman priest attends to [another ritual task] or performs another's act, whoever among the officiating priests is nearest should sit near [his place]; or he should place a handful of darbha grass or a water vessel on the brahman priest's seat, so that the seat may thus not be empty.

sanskrit_iast: brahmann apaḥ praṇeṣyāmi \\ ity ukte praṇaya yajñam \\ devatā vardhaya tvam \\ nākasya pṛṣṭhe svarge loke yajamāno astu // \ saptarṣīṇām̐ sukṛtām̐ yatra lokas \ tatremam̐ yajñam̐ yajamānaṃ ca dhehi // \ bṛhaspatiḥ prasūtas \\ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar \ oṃ praṇaya \\ ity anujānāti /
meaning: ब्रह्मन्न् अपः प्रणेष्यामि \\ इत्य् उक्ते प्रणय यज्ञम् \\ देवता वर्धय त्वम् \\ नाकस्य पृष्ठे स्वर्गे लोके यजमानो अस्तु // \ सप्तर्षीणाम्̐ सुकृताम्̐ यत्र लोकस् \ तत्रेमम्̐ यज्ञम्̐ यजमानं च धेहि // \ बृहस्पतिः प्रसूतस् \\ भूर् भुवः स्वर् \ ओं प्रणय \\ इत्य् अनुजानाति /
text_mt: When it is said, "O brahman, I shall lead forth the waters," he gives permission: "Lead forth the sacrifice; increase the deities; may the sacrificer be in the heavenly world on the back of the firmament; where the world of the seven sages, the well-doers, is, there place this sacrifice and the sacrificer. Impelled by Bṛhaspati—bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ—oṃ, lead forth!"

sanskrit_iast: eṣo 'nujñātaḥ sarvatra yathāmnātam /
meaning: एषो ऽनुज्ञातः सर्वत्र यथाम्नातम् /
text_mt: This is the form of granting permission everywhere, as traditionally taught.

sanskrit_iast: anāmantrito 'nujānāti prokṣantam̐ haviḥ pūrvaṃ parigrāhaṃ parigrahīṣyantam̐ sāmidhenīr anuvakṣyantam /
meaning: अनामन्त्रितो ऽनुजानाति प्रोक्षन्तम्̐ हविः पूर्वं परिग्राहं परिग्रहीष्यन्तम्̐ सामिधेनीर् अनुवक्ष्यन्तम् /
text_mt: Without being summoned, he grants permission to [the priest] who is sprinkling the oblation, who is about to make the first enclosing outline, and who is about to recite the sāmidhenī verses.

sanskrit_iast: pravare cānumantrito 'nyāni mantraprayoge /
meaning: प्रवरे चानुमन्त्रितो ऽन्यानि मन्त्रप्रयोगे /
text_mt: And in the choosing of the hotṛ priest he is addressed with a mantra, and in other acts at the application of a mantra.

sanskrit_iast: vācam̐ yachaty akāle vācam̐ visṛjya vaiṣṇavīṃ nigadya punar yachet //
meaning: वाचम्̐ यछत्य् अकाले वाचम्̐ विसृज्य वैष्णवीं निगद्य पुनर् यछेत् //
text_mt: He restrains his speech; having released his speech at an improper time, he should recite a Vaiṣṇava verse and restrain it again.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtasya pathā paryehi \ mitrasya tvā cakṣuṣānvīkṣe \\ iti prāśitram āhriyamāṇam̐ vīkṣate /
meaning: ऋतस्य पथा पर्येहि \ मित्रस्य त्वा चक्षुषान्वीक्षे \\ इति प्राशित्रम् आह्रियमाणम्̐ वीक्षते /
text_mt: "Come around by the path of truth; I look upon you with the eye of Mitra,"—[with this mantra] he looks at the prāśitra portion being brought.

sanskrit_iast: sāvitreṇa pratigṛhya pṛthivyās tvā pṛṣṭhe sādayāmi \\ iti dakṣiṇato barhiṣi sādayati //
meaning: सावित्रेण प्रतिगृह्य पृथिव्यास् त्वा पृष्ठे सादयामि \\ इति दक्षिणतो बर्हिषि सादयति //
text_mt: Having received it with the Sāvitra formula, [with] "I set you down on the back of the earth," he sets it down to the south on the sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: suparṇasya tvā garutmataś cakṣuṣānvīkṣe \\ ity avekṣate /
meaning: सुपर्णस्य त्वा गरुत्मतश् चक्षुषान्वीक्षे \\ इत्य् अवेक्षते /
text_mt: "I look upon you with the eye of the fair-winged Garutmat,"—he gazes at it.

sanskrit_iast: aṅguṣṭhenopamadhyamayā cādāya \\ agneṣ ṭvāsyena prāśnāmi brāhmaṇasyodareṇa bṛhaspater brahmaṇā \\ indrasya tvā jaṭhare dadhur iti prāśnāty asparśayan dantān //
meaning: अङ्गुष्ठेनोपमध्यमया चादाय \\ अग्नेष् ट्वास्येन प्राश्नामि ब्राह्मणस्योदरेण बृहस्पतेर् ब्रह्मणा \\ इन्द्रस्य त्वा जठरे दधुर् इति प्राश्नात्य् अस्पर्शयन् दन्तान् //
text_mt: Having taken it with the thumb and the ring finger, [with] "With the mouth of Agni I eat you, with the belly of a brāhmaṇa, with the holy power of Bṛhaspati; they placed you in Indra's stomach," he eats it without letting it touch his teeth.

sanskrit_iast: satyena tvābhidhārayāmi \\ ity ācāmati //
meaning: सत्येन त्वाभिधारयामि \\ इत्य् आचामति //
text_mt: "I moisten you with truth,"—he sips water.

sanskrit_iast: vāṅ ma āsye \ nasoḥ prāṇo \ akṣṇoś cakṣuḥ \ karṇayoḥ śrotram \\ bāhvor balam \ ūrvor ojaḥ \ pādayoḥ pratiṣṭhā \\ iti yathāliṅgam aṅgāni saṃmṛśati /
meaning: वाङ् म आस्ये \ नसोः प्राणो \ अक्ष्णोश् चक्षुः \ कर्णयोः श्रोत्रम् \\ बाह्वोर् बलम् \ ऊर्वोर् ओजः \ पादयोः प्रतिष्ठा \\ इति यथालिङ्गम् अङ्गानि संमृशति /
text_mt: "Speech in my mouth, breath in the nostrils, sight in the eyes, hearing in the ears, strength in the arms, vigor in the thighs, firm foundation in the feet,"—according to their characteristic marks, he touches the limbs.

sanskrit_iast: apa upaspṛśya viṣṇor jaṭharam asi \\ iti nābhideśam ārabhya japati \\ ariṣṭā viśvāny aṅgāni \ tanūr me tanvā saha \\ iti gātrāṇi /
meaning: अप उपस्पृश्य विष्णोर् जठरम् असि \\ इति नाभिदेशम् आरभ्य जपति \\ अरिष्टा विश्वान्य् अङ्गानि \ तनूर् मे तन्वा सह \\ इति गात्राणि /
text_mt: Having touched water, [with] "You are the stomach of Viṣṇu," he murmurs, beginning from the navel region; [and with] "Uninjured be all limbs, my body together with my self," [touching] the limbs.

sanskrit_iast: prāśitraharaṇe brahmabhāgam ādadhāti /
meaning: प्राशित्रहरणे ब्रह्मभागम् आदधाति /
text_mt: He deposits the brahman's share in the prāśitra vessel.

sanskrit_iast: śam̐yvante prāśnāty ūrdhvam̐ vā samiṣṭayajuṣaḥ /
meaning: शम्̐य्वन्ते प्राश्नात्य् ऊर्ध्वम्̐ वा समिष्टयजुषः /
text_mt: He eats it at the end of the śaṃyu formula, or after the samiṣṭayajus offerings.

sanskrit_iast: eteneṣṭipaśusomānāṃ brahmatvam̐ vyākhyātam /
meaning: एतेनेष्टिपशुसोमानां ब्रह्मत्वम्̐ व्याख्यातम् /
text_mt: By this the function of the brahman priest in the iṣṭis, animal sacrifices, and Soma sacrifices has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: agnyādheye vṛto brāhmaudanikasya prāśanaṃ kṛtvā vasati /
meaning: अग्न्याधेये वृतो ब्राह्मौदनिकस्य प्राशनं कृत्वा वसति /
text_mt: In the establishment of the sacred fires, having been chosen, he stays after having performed the eating of the rice meant for brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte saṃbhāraprabhṛtyāvṛto 'dhvaryave /
meaning: श्वोभूते संभारप्रभृत्यावृतो ऽध्वर्यवे /
text_mt: On the following day, from the bringing of the materials onward, he is [ready] when chosen by the adhvaryu priest.

sanskrit_iast: sapatnavato bhrātṛvyavato vā rathacakram̐ vihāre triḥ parivartayet /
meaning: सपत्नवतो भ्रातृव्यवतो वा रथचक्रम्̐ विहारे त्रिः परिवर्तयेत् /
text_mt: For one having rivals or having an enemy, he should turn a chariot wheel three times in the sacrificial enclosure.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇapraghāseṣu vedī kriyamāṇe 'greṇāhavanīyād adhi sphyenānulikhed ā dakṣiṇasyāḥ śroṇer ā pṛṣṭhyāyāḥ śaṅkoḥ some /
meaning: वरुणप्रघासेषु वेदी क्रियमाणे ऽग्रेणाहवनीयाद् अधि स्फ्येनानुलिखेद् आ दक्षिणस्याः श्रोणेर् आ पृष्ठ्यायाः शङ्कोः सोमे /
text_mt: In the Varuṇapraghāsa rites, when the two altars are being made, he should trace with the wooden sword in front from the āhavanīya fire up to the southern hip and up to the peg of the spine line; [and likewise] in the Soma sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: apratirathenāgnicityāyām /
meaning: अप्रतिरथेनाग्निचित्यायाम् /
text_mt: In the piling of the fire altar, [he recites] with the Apratiratha hymn.

sanskrit_iast: tīrthena niḥsṛtyāvabhṛtham iyāt /
meaning: तीर्थेन निःसृत्यावभृथम् इयात् /
text_mt: Having gone out by the tīrtha path, he should go to the purificatory bath.

sanskrit_iast: pūrṇadarve yady āmantrayeta juhudhi \\ ity anujānīyāt /
meaning: पूर्णदर्वे यद्य् आमन्त्रयेत जुहुधि \\ इत्य् अनुजानीयात् /
text_mt: At the full-ladle offering, if he is summoned, he should grant permission [saying]: "Offer!"

sanskrit_iast: paśubandhe 'pareṇa vihāraṃ dakṣiṇātikramya hutāyām̐ vapāyāṃ cātvāle mārjayitvā /
meaning: पशुबन्धे ऽपरेण विहारं दक्षिणातिक्रम्य हुतायाम्̐ वपायां चात्वाले मार्जयित्वा /
text_mt: In the animal sacrifice, having crossed to the south behind the sacrificial enclosure, after the omentum has been offered, having cleansed himself at the cātvāla pit,

sanskrit_iast: dārśapaurṇamāsikam̐ varaṇam̐ some nivarteta /
meaning: दार्शपौर्णमासिकम्̐ वरणम्̐ सोमे निवर्तेत /
text_mt: the choice [of priests] belonging to the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices should cease in the Soma sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣaṇīyāprabhṛtīny upāste /
meaning: दीक्षणीयाप्रभृतीन्य् उपास्ते /
text_mt: He sits attending from the introductory offering onward.

sanskrit_iast: krīte sārdhaṃ prāṅ abhyupaiti /
meaning: क्रीते सार्धं प्राङ् अभ्युपैति /
text_mt: When [the Soma] has been purchased, he approaches eastward together [with the others].

sanskrit_iast: gārhapatyānte gharmam upāste /
meaning: गार्हपत्यान्ते घर्मम् उपास्ते /
text_mt: At the end of the gārhapatya fire, he sits attending the cauldron.

sanskrit_iast: utthāyopatiṣṭhate /
meaning: उत्थायोपतिष्ठते /

sanskrit_iast: āhriyamāṇeṣu parikrāmati /
meaning: आह्रियमाणेषु परिक्रामति /
text_mt: When the [materials] are being brought, he walks around.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇabhakṣeṇādīkṣito bhakṣayati /
meaning: प्राणभक्षेणादीक्षितो भक्षयति /
text_mt: If uninitiated, he consumes by inhalation.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyayā gharmapātrāṇy anveti /
meaning: पृष्ठ्यया घर्मपात्राण्य् अन्वेति /
text_mt: He follows along the spine line after the vessels of the cauldron.

sanskrit_iast: agnīṣomau praṇīyamānāv anveti /
meaning: अग्नीषोमौ प्रणीयमानाव् अन्वेति /
text_mt: He follows along after Agni and Soma being led forward.

sanskrit_iast: yadi rājānam̐ hared dhavirdhānānte 'dhvaryave pradāyottareṇāgnīdhrīyam apareṇa sado dakṣiṇena sadomārjālīyahavirdhānaṃ gatvājyānāṃ dakṣiṇata udaṅmukha upaviśaty eṣa saṃcaraḥ /
meaning: यदि राजानम्̐ हरेद् धविर्धानान्ते ऽध्वर्यवे प्रदायोत्तरेणाग्नीध्रीयम् अपरेण सदो दक्षिणेन सदोमार्जालीयहविर्धानं गत्वाज्यानां दक्षिणत उदङ्मुख उपविशत्य् एष संचरः /
text_mt: If he should carry King [Soma], having handed him over to the adhvaryu priest at the rear of the cart-shed, having gone north of the āgnīdhra shed, behind the sadas hut, and south of the sadas hut, the mārjālīya shed, and the cart-shed, he sits down to the south of the clarified butter portions facing north: this is the path of movement.

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte savanīya ājyāni gṛhyamāṇāny upāste /
meaning: श्वोभूते सवनीय आज्यानि गृह्यमाणान्य् उपास्ते /
text_mt: On the following day, during the animal offering, he sits attending while the clarified butter portions are being scooped.

sanskrit_iast: abhyudāhriyamāṇeṣu parikrāmati /
meaning: अभ्युदाह्रियमाणेषु परिक्रामति /
text_mt: When they are being brought forward, he walks around.

sanskrit_iast: grahān gṛhyamāṇān upāste /
meaning: ग्रहान् गृह्यमाणान् उपास्ते /
text_mt: He sits attending while the cups are being scooped.

sanskrit_iast: vaipruṣau homau hutvā pavamānam̐ sarpanti //
meaning: वैप्रुषौ होमौ हुत्वा पवमानम्̐ सर्पन्ति //
text_mt: Having offered the two drop-offerings, they glide toward the pavamāna stotra.

sanskrit_iast: brahman stoṣyāmaḥ praśāstar ity ukte stuta yaśam \\ devatā vardhaya tvam \\ nākasya pṛṣṭhe svarge loke yajamāno astu // \ saptarṣīṇām̐ sukṛtām̐ yatra lokas \ tatremam̐ yajñam̐ yajamānaṃ ca dhatta // \ raśminā kṣayāya kṣayaṃ jinva // \ bṛhaspatiḥ prasūtas \\ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar \ om̐ stuta \\ ity anujānāti /
meaning: ब्रह्मन् स्तोष्यामः प्रशास्तर् इत्य् उक्ते स्तुत यशम् \\ देवता वर्धय त्वम् \\ नाकस्य पृष्ठे स्वर्गे लोके यजमानो अस्तु // \ सप्तर्षीणाम्̐ सुकृताम्̐ यत्र लोकस् \ तत्रेमम्̐ यज्ञम्̐ यजमानं च धत्त // \ रश्मिना क्षयाय क्षयं जिन्व // \ बृहस्पतिः प्रसूतस् \\ भूर् भुवः स्वर् \ ओम्̐ स्तुत \\ इत्य् अनुजानाति /
text_mt: When it is said, "O brahman, we shall praise; O director!", he grants permission: "Praise glory; increase the deities; may the sacrificer be in the heavenly world on the back of the firmament; where the world of the seven sages, the well-doers, is, there place this sacrifice and the sacrificer. With the ray, quicken the dwelling for the dwelling! Impelled by Bṛhaspati—bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ—oṃ, praise!"

sanskrit_iast: etatprabhṛtayas trayastrim̐śat stomabhāgās trayastrim̐śat stotrāṇy aptoryāmṇi / tāny ekaikenānujānāti /
meaning: एतत्प्रभृतयस् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शत् स्तोमभागास् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शत् स्तोत्राण्य् अप्तोर्याम्णि / तान्य् एकैकेनानुजानाति /
text_mt: Beginning with this, there are thirty-three stomabhāga formulas, [corresponding to] thirty-three stotras in the aptoryāma; he grants permission to them one by one.

sanskrit_iast: hutāyām̐ vapāyāṃ cātvāle mārjayitvā dhiṣṇyān upasthāyāparayā dvārā sadaḥ praviśyaudumbaryā dakṣiṇata udaṅmukha upaviśaty eṣa saṃcaraḥ /
meaning: हुतायाम्̐ वपायां चात्वाले मार्जयित्वा धिष्ण्यान् उपस्थायापरया द्वारा सदः प्रविश्यौदुम्बर्या दक्षिणत उदङ्मुख उपविशत्य् एष संचरः /
text_mt: When the omentum has been offered, having cleansed himself at the cātvāla pit, having attended upon the dhiṣṇya hearths, having entered the sadas hut by the western door, he sits down south of the audumbarī post facing north: this is the path of movement.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇena hotrīyam adhiṣṇyānāṃ bhakṣasaṃcaraḥ /
meaning: दक्षिणेन होत्रीयम् अधिष्ण्यानां भक्षसंचरः /
text_mt: The path of movement for the consumption by those without dhiṣṇya hearths is to the south of the hotṛ priest's hearth.

sanskrit_iast: visam̐sthitasaṃcareṣu savanānteṣu vyutsarpanti /
meaning: विसम्̐स्थितसंचरेषु सवनान्तेषु व्युत्सर्पन्ति /
text_mt: At the completion of the pressings, they disperse along the paths of movement for completed rites.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvayā dvārā niḥsṛtya dhānāsomān bhakṣayati /
meaning: पूर्वया द्वारा निःसृत्य धानासोमान् भक्षयति /
text_mt: Having gone out by the eastern door, he consumes the parched-grain portions and the Soma portions.

sanskrit_iast: upām̐śūdavasānīyā /
meaning: उपाम्̐शूदवसानीया /

sanskrit_iast: sāvitraprabhṛtyagnicityāyām /
meaning: सावित्रप्रभृत्यग्निचित्यायाम् /
text_mt: In the piling of the fire altar, [he attends] from the Sāvitra libations onward.

sanskrit_iast: na kramān anveti /
meaning: न क्रमान् अन्वेति /

sanskrit_iast: nairṛtīś cīyamāne 'gnau dakṣiṇataḥ pakṣasya bahirvedy upāste //
meaning: नैरृतीश् चीयमाने ऽग्नौ दक्षिणतः पक्षस्य बहिर्वेद्य् उपास्ते //
text_mt: When the fire altar is being piled with the Nairṛta bricks, he sits attending south of the wing, outside the altar.

sanskrit_iast: satrā \\ iti preṣito vācam̐ yachati /
meaning: सत्रा \\ इति प्रेषितो वाचम्̐ यछति /
text_mt: Urged with "All together!", he restrains his speech.

sanskrit_iast: āhutāyām̐ subrahmaṇyāyām̐ vācam̐ visṛjate vācam̐ visṛjate /
meaning: आहुतायाम्̐ सुब्रह्मण्यायाम्̐ वाचम्̐ विसृजते वाचम्̐ विसृजते /
text_mt: When the Subrahmaṇyā formula has been invoked, he releases his speech, he releases his speech.

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ ceṣyamāṇa ukhām̐ saṃbharet paurṇamāsyām amāvāsyāyām ekāṣṭakāyām̐ vā /
meaning: अग्निं चेष्यमाण उखाम्̐ संभरेत् पौर्णमास्याम् अमावास्यायाम् एकाष्टकायाम्̐ वा /
text_mt: One intending to pile the fire altar should collect [clay for] the ukhā pot on a full-moon day, a new-moon day, or the ekāṣṭakā day.

sanskrit_iast: prākṛtīṣu sam̐sthāsu ṣoḍaśivarjam agnim uttaravedyāṃ cinvīta /
meaning: प्राकृतीषु सम्̐स्थासु षोडशिवर्जम् अग्निम् उत्तरवेद्यां चिन्वीत /
text_mt: In the basic forms of the Soma sacrifice, excluding the ṣoḍaśin, he should pile the fire on the high altar.

sanskrit_iast: sāvitranāciketo vānagnir vottaravediṃ cinvītā sattrāhīneṣu /
meaning: सावित्रनाचिकेतो वानग्निर् वोत्तरवेदिं चिन्वीता सत्त्राहीनेषु /
text_mt: He may pile the Sāvitra or Nāciketa [fire altar], or he may pile the high altar without a fire altar, in sattras and ahīna sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīṃ juhūm̐ saṃmṛjya sruvam̐ saṃmārṣṭi /
meaning: तूष्णीं जुहूम्̐ संमृज्य स्रुवम्̐ संमार्ष्टि /
text_mt: Silently having wiped the juhū ladle, he wipes the sruva ladle.

sanskrit_iast: juhūm aṣṭagṛhītena pūrayitvā yuñjānaḥ prathamaṃ manas \\ ity aṣṭau nigadyāhutiṃ juhoti /
meaning: जुहूम् अष्टगृहीतेन पूरयित्वा युञ्जानः प्रथमं मनस् \\ इत्य् अष्टौ निगद्याहुतिं जुहोति /
text_mt: Having filled the juhū ladle with eight portions [of clarified butter], having recited the eight [verses beginning with] "Yoking first the mind...", he offers the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayeta yajñam̐ yajñayaśasenārpayeyam iti deva savitaḥ prasuva yajñam ity etām ūrdhvam̐ yajuṣaḥ kuryāt //
meaning: यदि कामयेत यज्ञम्̐ यज्ञयशसेनार्पयेयम् इति देव सवितः प्रसुव यज्ञम् इत्य् एताम् ऊर्ध्वम्̐ यजुषः कुर्यात् //
text_mt: If he should desire, "May I unite the sacrifice with the glory of the sacrifice," he should perform [the offering with] this [verse], "O god Savitṛ, impel the sacrifice...", after the yajus formula.

sanskrit_iast: ṛcā stomam̐ samardhaya \\ iti caturgṛhītaṃ juhoti /
meaning: ऋचा स्तोमम्̐ समर्धय \\ इति चतुर्गृहीतं जुहोति /
text_mt: With "Make the stoma complete by the verse...", he offers a fourfold portion.

sanskrit_iast: uttarato gārhapatyasya devasya tvā savituḥ prasave \\ ity abhrim ādatte vaiṇavīṃ kalmāṣīm̐ suṣirām ubhayatastīkṣṇām anyatarato vā /
meaning: उत्तरतो गार्हपत्यस्य देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे \\ इत्य् अभ्रिम् आदत्ते वैणवीं कल्माषीम्̐ सुषिराम् उभयतस्तीक्ष्णाम् अन्यतरतो वा /
text_mt: North of the gārhapatya fire, [reciting] "At the impulse of the god Savitṛ...", he takes the spade, made of bamboo, speckled, hollow, sharp at both ends or at one end.

sanskrit_iast: agreṇāhavanīyaṃ pratūrtam̐ vājinn ādrava \\ ity aśvam abhimantrayate yuñjāthām̐ rāsabham iti gardabham //
meaning: अग्रेणाहवनीयं प्रतूर्तम्̐ वाजिन्न् आद्रव \\ इत्य् अश्वम् अभिमन्त्रयते युञ्जाथाम्̐ रासभम् इति गर्दभम् //
text_mt: To the front of the āhavanīya [fire], he addresses the horse with: 'Quickly, o courser, run forward...' [and] the donkey with: 'Yoke both of you the ass...'.

sanskrit_iast: yogeyoge tavastaram ity abhipravrajanty aśvam agrato nayanti //
meaning: योगेयोगे तवस्तरम् इत्य् अभिप्रव्रजन्त्य् अश्वम् अग्रतो नयन्ति //
text_mt: With 'At every yoke, the stronger...', they set out, leading the horse in front.

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ purīṣyam aṅgirasvad ābhara \\ iti japati //
meaning: अग्निं पुरीष्यम् अङ्गिरस्वद् आभर \\ इति जपति //
text_mt: He mutters: 'Bring the earth-born Agni like the Aṅgirases...'.

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ purīṣyam aṅgirasvad achemas \\ iti sametya puruṣam abhimantrayate yasya vājam̐ vivṛñjiṣet /
meaning: अग्निं पुरीष्यम् अङ्गिरस्वद् अछेमस् \\ इति समेत्य पुरुषम् अभिमन्त्रयते यस्य वाजम्̐ विवृञ्जिषेत् /
text_mt: Coming together, he addresses a person with: 'May we fetch the earth-born Agni like the Aṅgirases...', [the person] whose vigor he wishes to take away.

sanskrit_iast: yataḥ sūryasyodayanaṃ tato valmīkavapām apaghnann agniṃ purīṣyam aṅgirasvad bhariṣyāmas \\ iti brūyāt //
meaning: यतः सूर्यस्योदयनं ततो वल्मीकवपाम् अपघ्नन्न् अग्निं पुरीष्यम् अङ्गिरस्वद् भरिष्यामस् \\ इति ब्रूयात् //
text_mt: Breaking off an anthill mound from where the sun rises, he should say: 'We shall bring the earth-born Agni like the Aṅgirases...'.

sanskrit_iast: anv agnir uṣasām agram akśat \\ iti valmīkād abhipravrajanti //
meaning: अन्व् अग्निर् उषसाम् अग्रम् अक्शत् \\ इति वल्मीकाद् अभिप्रव्रजन्ति //
text_mt: With 'Agni looked upon the vanguard of the dawns...', they set out from the anthill.

sanskrit_iast: āgatya vājay adhvānam ity ākhānaṃ prāpya japati //
meaning: आगत्य वाजय् अध्वानम् इत्य् आखानं प्राप्य जपति //
text_mt: Having arrived, reaching the pit, he mutters: 'Having come, o swift runner, upon the path...'.

sanskrit_iast: ākramya vājin \ dyaus te pṛṣṭham iti dvābhyām aśvam ākramayati /
meaning: आक्रम्य वाजिन् \ द्यौस् ते पृष्ठम् इति द्वाभ्याम् अश्वम् आक्रमयति /
text_mt: With the two [mantras], 'Stepping upon, o courser...' [and] 'Heaven is your back...', he makes the horse step upon [the pit].

sanskrit_iast: ākramyamāṇe yajamāno yaṃ dviṣyāt taṃ brūyād amum abhitiṣṭha \\ iti //
meaning: आक्रम्यमाणे यजमानो यं द्विष्यात् तं ब्रूयाद् अमुम् अभितिष्ठ \\ इति //
text_mt: While [the horse] is stepping upon it, the sacrificer should say about the one he hates: 'Tread upon so-and-so!'.

sanskrit_iast: utkrāma \\ ity utkramayati //
meaning: उत्क्राम \\ इत्य् उत्क्रमयति //
text_mt: With 'Step out!', he makes [the horse] step out.

sanskrit_iast: ud akramīt \\ ity aśvam abhimantrayate //
meaning: उद् अक्रमीत् \\ इत्य् अश्वम् अभिमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: He addresses the horse with: 'He has stepped out...'.

sanskrit_iast: ā tvā jigharmi \\ ā viśvataḥ pratyañcam iti dvābhyām aśvapade juhoti //
meaning: आ त्वा जिघर्मि \\ आ विश्वतः प्रत्यञ्चम् इति द्वाभ्याम् अश्वपदे जुहोति //
text_mt: With the two [mantras], 'I sprinkle you...' [and] 'Hither from all sides facing backward...', he offers into the footprint of the horse.

sanskrit_iast: pari vājapatis \ tvam agne dyubhiḥ \ pari tvāgne puram̐ vayam ity ekaikayā parilikhati /
meaning: परि वाजपतिस् \ त्वम् अग्ने द्युभिः \ परि त्वाग्ने पुरम्̐ वयम् इत्य् एकैकया परिलिखति /
text_mt: With one each [of the mantras], 'The lord of food [has gone] around...', 'You, o Agni, through the days...', [and] 'Around you, o Agni, a fortress we...', he draws a line around.

sanskrit_iast: sāvitrair abhrim ādatte caturbhiś chando 'ntaiḥ //
meaning: सावित्रैर् अभ्रिम् आदत्ते चतुर्भिश् छन्दो ऽन्तैः //
text_mt: He takes the shovel with four Savitṛ formulas ending with meters.

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave \\ ity anuvākaśeṣeṇa khanati //
meaning: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे \\ इत्य् अनुवाकशेषेण खनति //
text_mt: With the remainder of the section, 'At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ...', he digs.

sanskrit_iast: apām̐ pṛṣṭham asi \\ iti puṣkaraparṇam̐ viveṣṭayati //
meaning: अपाम्̐ पृष्ठम् असि \\ इति पुष्करपर्णम्̐ विवेष्टयति //
text_mt: With 'You are the back of the waters...', he spreads out a lotus leaf.

sanskrit_iast: śarma ca sthaḥ \ sam̐vasethām ity uttarata ākhānasya kṛṣṇājinaṃ puṣkaraparṇaṃ ca sam̐stṛṇāty adhastāt kṛṣṇājinaṃ prāggrīvam uttaralomam upariṣṭānnābhi prāgdvāraṃ puṣkaraparṇam /
meaning: शर्म च स्थः \ सम्̐वसेथाम् इत्य् उत्तरत आखानस्य कृष्णाजिनं पुष्करपर्णं च सम्̐स्तृणात्य् अधस्तात् कृष्णाजिनं प्राग्ग्रीवम् उत्तरलोमम् उपरिष्टान्नाभि प्राग्द्वारं पुष्करपर्णम् /
text_mt: With 'You two are protection...' [and] 'May you two dwell together...', to the north of the pit, he spreads out a black antelope skin and a lotus leaf: the black antelope skin underneath, with neck toward the east and fur on top; the lotus leaf on top, with its stalk toward the east.

sanskrit_iast: tasmin purīṣyo 'si viśvabharās \\ iti yajuṣā purīṣam āvapaty ṛgbhis tisṛbhiś ca tvām agne puṣkarād adhi \ tam u tvā dadhyaṅṅ ṛṣis \ tam u tvā pāthyo vṛṣā \\ iti gāyatrībhir brāhmaṇasyottarābhis triṣṭubbhī rājanyasyottamābhir jagatībhir vaiśyasya /
meaning: तस्मिन् पुरीष्यो ऽसि विश्वभरास् \\ इति यजुषा पुरीषम् आवपत्य् ऋग्भिस् तिसृभिश् च त्वाम् अग्ने पुष्कराद् अधि \ तम् उ त्वा दध्यङ्ङ् ऋषिस् \ तम् उ त्वा पाथ्यो वृषा \\ इति गायत्रीभिर् ब्राह्मणस्योत्तराभिस् त्रिष्टुब्भी राजन्यस्योत्तमाभिर् जगतीभिर् वैश्यस्य /
text_mt: Upon it, he pours the earth with the yajus: 'Earth-born are you, all-bearing...'; and with three ṛcs: 'You, o Agni, from the lotus...' 'Him indeed [the sage] Dadhyac...' [and] 'Him indeed the manly Pāthya...': with gāyatrī [verses] for a brāhmaṇa, with the following triṣṭubh [verses] for a rājanya, [and] with the final jagatī [verses] for a vaiśya.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayetardhnuyād iti tasya gāyatrībhiś ca triṣṭubbhiś ca saṃbhared gāyatryābhyādāya triṣṭubhā nivapati //
meaning: यं कामयेतर्ध्नुयाद् इति तस्य गायत्रीभिश् च त्रिष्टुब्भिश् च संभरेद् गायत्र्याभ्यादाय त्रिष्टुभा निवपति //
text_mt: For one whom he wishes 'May he prosper', he should gather [the earth] with both gāyatrīs and triṣṭubhs: taking it up with a gāyatrī, he pours it out with a triṣṭubh.

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ te yonir ṛtviyas \\ iti nyuptam abhimṛśati //
meaning: अयं ते योनिर् ऋत्वियस् \\ इति न्युप्तम् अभिमृशति //
text_mt: With 'This is your seasonal womb...', he touches what has been poured out.

sanskrit_iast: apo devīḥ \ saṃ te vāyur ity adbhir ākhānam upasṛjati /
meaning: अपो देवीः \ सं ते वायुर् इत्य् अद्भिर् आखानम् उपसृजति /
text_mt: With 'O divine waters...' [and] 'May Vāyu [accord] with you...', he pours water onto the pit.

sanskrit_iast: sujāto jyotiṣā \\ iti purīṣam abhimantrayate //
meaning: सुजातो ज्योतिषा \\ इति पुरीषम् अभिमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: He addresses the earth with: 'Well born with light...'.

sanskrit_iast: vāso agne viśvarūpam ity upanahyati mauñjena dāmnārkamayeṇa vā //
meaning: वासो अग्ने विश्वरूपम् इत्य् उपनह्यति मौञ्जेन दाम्नार्कमयेण वा //
text_mt: With 'A garment of all colors, o Agni...', he ties it up with a cord of muñja grass or made of arka [fiber].

sanskrit_iast: ud u tiṣṭha svadhvara \\ ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇas \\ ity ādāyottiṣṭhati //
meaning: उद् उ तिष्ठ स्वध्वर \\ ऊर्ध्व ऊ षु णस् \\ इत्य् आदायोत्तिष्ठति //
text_mt: With 'Stand up, o you of good sacrifice...' [and] 'Upright unto us...', he takes it and stands up.

sanskrit_iast: sa jāto garbho asi rodasyor iti japati //
meaning: स जातो गर्भो असि रोदस्योर् इति जपति //
text_mt: He mutters: 'Born, you are the embryo of both heaven and earth...'.

sanskrit_iast: sthiro bhava vīḍvaṅgas \\ iti gardabha ādadhāti //
meaning: स्थिरो भव वीड्वङ्गस् \\ इति गर्दभ आदधाति //
text_mt: With 'Be firm, strong-limbed...', he places it on the donkey.

sanskrit_iast: śivo bhava prajābhyas \\ iti purīṣam abhimantrayate /
meaning: शिवो भव प्रजाभ्यस् \\ इति पुरीषम् अभिमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: He addresses the earth with: 'Be auspicious for the creatures...'.

sanskrit_iast: aśvaprathamāḥ pratyāyanti //
meaning: अश्वप्रथमाः प्रत्यायन्ति //
text_mt: They return with the horse in front.

sanskrit_iast: praitu vājī \\ ity aśvam abhimantrayate nānadad rāsabhaḥ patvā \\ iti gardabham agna āyāhi vītaye \\ iti purīṣam //
meaning: प्रैतु वाजी \\ इत्य् अश्वम् अभिमन्त्रयते नानदद् रासभः पत्वा \\ इति गर्दभम् अग्न आयाहि वीतये \\ इति पुरीषम् //
text_mt: He addresses the horse with: 'Let the courser advance...', the donkey with: 'Loudly braying, flying ass...', [and] the earth with: 'O Agni, come to the banquet...'

sanskrit_iast: ṛtam̐ satyam ṛtam̐ satyam iti puruṣam̐ yena saṃgacheta tam abhimantrayeta /
meaning: ऋतम्̐ सत्यम् ऋतम्̐ सत्यम् इति पुरुषम्̐ येन संगछेत तम् अभिमन्त्रयेत /
text_mt: With 'The right, the true! The right, the true!', he should address whatever person he encounters.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇata āhavanīyasya kharaṃ kṛtvā pariśrayati /
meaning: दक्षिणत आहवनीयस्य खरं कृत्वा परिश्रयति /
text_mt: Having made a mound to the south of the āhavanīya [fire], he encloses it.

sanskrit_iast: tasmin darbhān āstīrya \\ oṣadhayaḥ pratigṛbhṇīta \\ iti dvābhyāṃ khare sādayati /
meaning: तस्मिन् दर्भान् आस्तीर्य \\ ओषधयः प्रतिगृभ्णीत \\ इति द्वाभ्यां खरे सादयति /
text_mt: Having strewn darbha grass on it, he sets [the earth] down on the mound with the two [mantras]: 'O plants, receive...'

sanskrit_iast: aśvagardabhāv adhvaryave dadāti /
meaning: अश्वगर्दभाव् अध्वर्यवे ददाति /
text_mt: He gives the horse and the donkey to the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: vi pājasā \\ iti dvābhyām̐ viṣyati /
meaning: वि पाजसा \\ इति द्वाभ्याम्̐ विष्यति /
text_mt: With the two [mantras], 'With strength...', he unties [the bundle].

sanskrit_iast: parṇavalkalaphāṇṭābhir adbhir āpo hi ṣṭhā \\ iti tisṛbhir upasṛjati //
meaning: पर्णवल्कलफाण्टाभिर् अद्भिर् आपो हि ष्ठा \\ इति तिसृभिर् उपसृजति //
text_mt: With water decocted with the bark of a palāśa tree, he moistens [the earth] with the three [verses]: 'Since you are waters, refreshing...'.

sanskrit_iast: mitraḥ sam̐sṛjya \\ iti dvābhyāṃ pañcabhiḥ saṃbhāraiḥ sam̐sṛjaty ajalomabhiḥ kṛṣṇājinasya tribhiś cūrṇīkṛtaiḥ śarkarābhir veṇvaṅgārair armakapālaiḥ sikatābhiś ca //
meaning: मित्रः सम्̐सृज्य \\ इति द्वाभ्यां पञ्चभिः संभारैः सम्̐सृजत्य् अजलोमभिः कृष्णाजिनस्य त्रिभिश् चूर्णीकृतैः शर्कराभिर् वेण्वङ्गारैर् अर्मकपालैः सिकताभिश् च //
text_mt: With the two [mantras], 'Mitra, having mixed...', he mixes [the earth] with five ingredients: goat hair, three parts of black antelope skin reduced to powder, gravel, bamboo charcoal, potsherds from an old settlement, and sand.

sanskrit_iast: sam̐sṛṣṭām̐ vasubhir iti tisṛbhir abhimantrya patnyai prayachati //
meaning: सम्̐सृष्टाम्̐ वसुभिर् इति तिसृभिर् अभिमन्त्र्य पत्न्यै प्रयछति //
text_mt: Having addressed [the lump of clay] with the three [mantras], 'Mixed by the Vasus...', he hands it to the wife.

sanskrit_iast: makhasya śiro 'si \\ iti piṇḍam abhimṛśati /
meaning: मखस्य शिरो ऽसि \\ इति पिण्डम् अभिमृशति /
text_mt: With 'You are the head of Makha...', he touches the lump.

sanskrit_iast: patny ukhāṃ karoti tryuddhiṃ caturaśrām /
meaning: पत्न्य् उखां करोति त्र्युद्धिं चतुरश्राम् /
text_mt: The wife makes the ukhā pot, four-cornered and with three belts.

sanskrit_iast: āsnātaṃ pramāṇaṃ prathayitvā tām̐ samunnīyoddhīr madhya ādadhāti /
meaning: आस्नातं प्रमाणं प्रथयित्वा ताम्̐ समुन्नीयोद्धीर् मध्य आदधाति /
text_mt: Having spread [the clay] to the measure of a span, and having raised it up, she places belts in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: kriyamāṇām̐ yajamāno 'numantrayate vasavas tvā kṛṇvantu \\ iti prathamām uddhim \\ rudrās tvā \\ iti dvitīyām ādityās tvā \\ iti tṛtīyām \\ viśve tvā devā vaiśvānarāḥ kṛṇvantu \\ iiti sam̐lipyamānāṃ dhruvāprabhṛtibhiḥ /
meaning: क्रियमाणाम्̐ यजमानो ऽनुमन्त्रयते वसवस् त्वा कृण्वन्तु \\ इति प्रथमाम् उद्धिम् \\ रुद्रास् त्वा \\ इति द्वितीयाम् आदित्यास् त्वा \\ इति तृतीयाम् \\ विश्वे त्वा देवा वैश्वानराः कृण्वन्तु \\ इइति सम्̐लिप्यमानां ध्रुवाप्रभृतिभिः /
text_mt: While it is being made, the sacrificer accompanies [the action] with the mantras: 'May the Vasus make you...' for the first belt; 'May the Rudras make you...' for the second; 'May the Ādityas make you...' for the third; [and] 'May the All-Gods Vaiśvānarās make you...' as it is being smeared around, with [the verses] beginning with Dhruvā.

sanskrit_iast: patnī dvyaṅgule 'dhastād dvārasya \\ adityā rāsnāsi \\ iti rāsnāṃ karoti //
meaning: पत्नी द्व्यङ्गुले ऽधस्ताद् द्वारस्य \\ अदित्या रास्नासि \\ इति रास्नां करोति //
text_mt: Two fingers below the rim, the wife makes a girdle with: 'You are Aditi's girdle...'.

sanskrit_iast: aditiṣ ṭe bilam iti dvāram̐ rāsnāyāḥ /
meaning: अदितिष् टे बिलम् इति द्वारम्̐ रास्नायाः /
text_mt: With 'Aditi is your opening...', [she forms] the opening of the girdle.

sanskrit_iast: dikṣu dvau caturo 'ṣṭau vā stanān karoti /
meaning: दिक्षु द्वौ चतुरो ऽष्टौ वा स्तनान् करोति /
text_mt: In the cardinal directions, she makes two, four, or eight nipples.

sanskrit_iast: ikṣuśalākayā nilipya kṛtvāya sā mahīm ukhām iti viṣajati /
meaning: इक्षुशलाकया निलिप्य कृत्वाय सा महीम् उखाम् इति विषजति /
text_mt: Having smoothed [it] with a reed stalk, she fastens it [for drying] with: 'Having made this great ukhā pot...'.

sanskrit_iast: śeṣasya tryālikhitām aṣāḍhām iṣṭakāṃ karoti //
meaning: शेषस्य त्र्यालिखिताम् अषाढाम् इष्टकां करोति //
text_mt: From the remainder [of the clay], she makes the aṣāḍhā brick, marked with three lines.

sanskrit_iast: vasavas tvā dhūpayantu \\ itiprabhṛtibhir gārhapatyād aśvaśakena kharadeśe dhūpayati /
meaning: वसवस् त्वा धूपयन्तु \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् गार्हपत्याद् अश्वशकेन खरदेशे धूपयति /
text_mt: With [the formulas] beginning with 'May the Vasus fumigate you...', he fumigates it at the place of the mound with horse dung from the gārhapatya [fire].

sanskrit_iast: agreṇa gārhapatyam aditiṣ ṭvā devī \\ ity āpākaṃ khanati //
meaning: अग्रेण गार्हपत्यम् अदितिष् ट्वा देवी \\ इत्य् आपाकं खनति //
text_mt: In front of the gārhapatya [fire], with 'May the goddess Aditi...', he digs a baking pit.

sanskrit_iast: devānāṃ tvā patnīr ity ukhām ādhāyāṣāḍhām ādadhāti /
meaning: देवानां त्वा पत्नीर् इत्य् उखाम् आधायाषाढाम् आदधाति /
text_mt: With 'May the wives of the gods...', having placed the ukhā pot [in the pit], he places the aṣāḍhā [brick].

sanskrit_iast: kupinaiḥ pariśritya pacanam abhyudya dhiṣaṇā tvā devī \\ itiprabhṛtibhir gārhapatyāt pacati //
meaning: कुपिनैः परिश्रित्य पचनम् अभ्युद्य धिषणा त्वा देवी \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् गार्हपत्यात् पचति //
text_mt: Having enclosed it with mats and piled up fuel, he bakes [them] with [fuel from] the gārhapatya [fire], with [the mantras] beginning with 'May the divine Dhiṣaṇā...'.

sanskrit_iast: mitrasya carṣaṇīdhṛtas \\ ity abhīddhām upacarati //
meaning: मित्रस्य चर्षणीधृतस् \\ इत्य् अभीद्धाम् उपचरति //
text_mt: With 'Of Mitra, supporter of men...', he attends to [the pot] when it is fully ignited.

sanskrit_iast: devas tvā savitodvapatu \\ iti pakvām udvapati //
meaning: देवस् त्वा सवितोद्वपतु \\ इति पक्वाम् उद्वपति //
text_mt: With 'May the divine Savitṛ remove you...', he removes [the pot] when baked.

sanskrit_iast: uttiṣṭha bṛhatī bhava \\ ity ādāyottiṣṭhati /
meaning: उत्तिष्ठ बृहती भव \\ इत्य् आदायोत्तिष्ठति /
text_mt: With 'Stand up, become great...', he takes [it] and stands up.

sanskrit_iast: agreṇāhavanīyaṃ paryāhṛtya khare nidhāya mitraitāṃ ta ukhāṃ paridadāmi \\ iti mitrāya paridadāti /
meaning: अग्रेणाहवनीयं पर्याहृत्य खरे निधाय मित्रैतां त उखां परिददामि \\ इति मित्राय परिददाति /
text_mt: Having carried [it] around in front of the āhavanīya [fire] and set [it] down on the mound, he entrusts [it] to Mitra with: 'O Mitra, I entrust this ukhā pot to you!'.

sanskrit_iast: taptām ajakṣīreṇa vasavas tvāchṛndantu \\ itiprabhṛtibhiś caturbhir āchṛṇatti /
meaning: तप्ताम् अजक्षीरेण वसवस् त्वाछृन्दन्तु \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिश् चतुर्भिर् आछृणत्ति /
text_mt: While it is hot, he sprinkles it with goat milk using the four [formulas] beginning with: 'May the Vasus sprinkle you...'.

sanskrit_iast: śiraś chittvāharati vaiśyasya rājanyabandhor vāśanihatasyeṣuhatasya vā /
meaning: शिरश् छित्त्वाहरति वैश्यस्य राजन्यबन्धोर् वाशनिहतस्येषुहतस्य वा /
text_mt: Having cut off the head of a vaiśya or a rājanya-relative who was struck by lightning or struck by an arrow, he brings it.

sanskrit_iast:
ayam̐ yo asya yasya ta idam̐ śiras \\ etena tvam̐ śīrṣaṇyām edhi /
iti chede 'pinidadhāti saptadhā vidīrṇām̐ valmīkavapām̐ sapta ca māṣān /
meaning:
अयम्̐ यो अस्य यस्य त इदम्̐ शिरस् \\ एतेन त्वम्̐ शीर्षण्याम् एधि /
इति छेदे ऽपिनिदधाति सप्तधा विदीर्णाम्̐ वल्मीकवपाम्̐ सप्त च माषान् /
text_mt: With 'This one who of him, whose this head is... / By this be you having a head!', / he inserts into the cut an anthill mound split in seven parts and seven beans.

sanskrit_iast:
idam asmākaṃ bhuje bhogāya bhūyāsam //
iti śiraḥ pāṇau kurute /
meaning:
इदम् अस्माकं भुजे भोगाय भूयासम् //
इति शिरः पाणौ कुरुते /
text_mt: With 'May this be for our enjoyment and use!', / he takes the head into his hands.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'sya kauṣṭhya jagataḥ \ pārthivasyaiva id vaśī /
yamaṃ bhaṅgaśravo gāya \ yo rājānaparodhyaḥ //
yamaṃ gāya bhaṅgaśravas\ yo rājānaparodhyaḥ /
yenāpo nadyo dhanvāni \ yena dyauḥ pṛthivī dṛḍhā //
hiraṇyakeśān sudhurān \ hiraṇyākṣān ayaḥśaphān /
aśvān anaśvato dānam\ yamo rājādhitiṣṭhati //
aharahar nayamānas\ gā aśvān puruṣān paśūn /
vaivasvato na tṛpyati \ surayā iva durmadaḥ //
iti yamagāthā gāyañ śira āhṛtya mṛdā pralimpati /
meaning:
यो ऽस्य कौष्ठ्य जगतः \ पार्थिवस्यैव इद् वशी /
यमं भङ्गश्रवो गाय \ यो राजानपरोध्यः //
यमं गाय भङ्गश्रवस्\ यो राजानपरोध्यः /
येनापो नद्यो धन्वानि \ येन द्यौः पृथिवी दृढा //
हिरण्यकेशान् सुधुरान् \ हिरण्याक्षान् अयःशफान् /
अश्वान् अनश्वतो दानम्\ यमो राजाधितिष्ठति //
अहरहर् नयमानस्\ गा अश्वान् पुरुषान् पशून् /
वैवस्वतो न तृप्यति \ सुरया इव दुर्मदः //
इति यमगाथा गायञ् शिर आहृत्य मृदा प्रलिम्पति /
text_mt:
'He who is contained within this world, / who alone has power over what is earthly,'

'Sing of Yama, the glorious breaker, / who is the irresistible king.'

"Sing to Yama, O Bhaṅgaśravas, to the king who cannot be warded off,

by whom the waters, rivers, deserts, by whom heaven and earth are made firm,

golden-haired, well-yoked, golden-eyed, iron-hoofed,

horses—to the horseless the gift—King Yama presides [over them].

Day by day leading away cows, horses, men, beasts,

the son of Vivasvant is not satiated, like one madly drunk with surā."

Singing these verses to Yama, having fetched the [human] head, he smears it with clay.

sanskrit_iast: pañca sāṇḍān ālabhate prājāpatyam ajam agnibhyaḥ kāmebhyo 'śvam ṛṣabham̐ vṛṣṇiṃ bastam /
meaning: पञ्च साण्डान् आलभते प्राजापत्यम् अजम् अग्निभ्यः कामेभ्यो ऽश्वम् ऋषभम्̐ वृष्णिं बस्तम् /
text_mt: He immolates five uncastrated animals: a goat for Prajāpati, a horse, a bull, a ram, and a he-goat for the Agnis desiring [oblations].

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā sāmidhenībhyaḥ /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ सामिधेनीभ्यः /
text_mt: The ritual is established up to the kindling verses.

sanskrit_iast: anabhyāvartayam̐ś caturvim̐śatim̐ sāmidhenīr anvāha pra vo vājā abhidyavas \\ ity ekādaśa samās tvāgna ṛtavo vardhayantu \\ iti daśa / jyotiṣmatīṃ parihāyāprīr uttamā upem asṛkṣi \\ ity apsumatīs tisro jyotiṣmatyā paridadhāti /
meaning: अनभ्यावर्तयम्̐श् चतुर्विम्̐शतिम्̐ सामिधेनीर् अन्वाह प्र वो वाजा अभिद्यवस् \\ इत्य् एकादश समास् त्वाग्न ऋतवो वर्धयन्तु \\ इति दश / ज्योतिष्मतीं परिहायाप्रीर् उत्तमा उपेम् असृक्षि \\ इत्य् अप्सुमतीस् तिस्रो ज्योतिष्मत्या परिदधाति /
text_mt: Without repetition he recites twenty-four kindling verses: eleven with "Forth your waters, bright...", ten with "May the seasons increase you for years, O Agni..."; having omitted the verse containing the word jyotis, the last of the Āprī verses, he encloses with three verses containing the word ap, beginning with "I have sent forth...", [and] with the one containing the word jyotis.

sanskrit_iast: siddham āghārāt //
meaning: सिद्धम् आघारात् //

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyagarbhas \\ iti sraucam āghāram āghārayati /
meaning: हिरण्यगर्भस् \\ इति स्रौचम् आघारम् आघारयति /
text_mt: With "The golden germ..." he pours the ladle-pouring of clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā paryagnikaraṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ पर्यग्निकरणात् /
text_mt: The ritual is established up to the carrying of fire around [the victims].

sanskrit_iast: uttaraṃ prājāpatyaṃ nidhāya śiro triḥ paryagniṃ karoti /
meaning: उत्तरं प्राजापत्यं निधाय शिरो त्रिः पर्यग्निं करोति /
text_mt: Having placed the victim for Prajāpati to the north, [and] the head, he carries fire around three times.

sanskrit_iast: paryagnikṛtān utsṛjya prājāpatyena sam̐sthāpayanty upām̐śudevatena /
meaning: पर्यग्निकृतान् उत्सृज्य प्राजापत्येन सम्̐स्थापयन्त्य् उपाम्̐शुदेवतेन /
text_mt: Having released those around which fire has been carried, they conclude [the rite] with the victim for Prajāpati, whose deity is [invoked] in a whisper.

sanskrit_iast: tasyāgnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālaḥ paśupuroḍāśaḥ /
meaning: तस्याग्नये वैश्वानराय द्वादशकपालः पशुपुरोडाशः /
text_mt: Its animal sacrificial cake on twelve potsherds is for Agni Vaiśvānara.

sanskrit_iast: utsṛṣṭānām̐ śirām̐si chitvā nidadhyāt /
meaning: उत्सृष्टानाम्̐ शिराम्̐सि छित्वा निदध्यात् /
text_mt: Having severed the heads of the released [animals], he should deposit them.

sanskrit_iast: hrade kāyān pravidhyej jihvāś ca yasmād iṣṭakāś cikīrṣet /
meaning: ह्रदे कायान् प्रविध्येज् जिह्वाश् च यस्माद् इष्टकाश् चिकीर्षेत् /
text_mt: He should cast the trunks and the tongues into the pool from which he intends to make the bricks.

sanskrit_iast: athaitān pañcālabhetājam̐ vā śvetam̐ sāṇḍaṃ tūparam̐ vāyave niyutvate /
meaning: अथैतान् पञ्चालभेताजम्̐ वा श्वेतम्̐ साण्डं तूपरम्̐ वायवे नियुत्वते /
text_mt: Then he should immolate these five, or a white, uncastrated, hornless goat for Vāyu Niyutvat.

sanskrit_iast: tadāprīḥ sāmidhenīḥ /
meaning: तदाप्रीः सामिधेनीः /

sanskrit_iast: sa āghāraḥ /
meaning: स आघारः /

sanskrit_iast: tasya prājāpatyo dvādaśakapālaḥ paśupuroḍāśaḥ /
meaning: तस्य प्राजापत्यो द्वादशकपालः पशुपुरोडाशः /
text_mt: Its animal sacrificial cake on twelve potsherds is for Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: jihvām avadāneṣu kṛtvā śiraḥ paśor nidadhyāt /
meaning: जिह्वाम् अवदानेषु कृत्वा शिरः पशोर् निदध्यात् /
text_mt: Having included the tongue in the portions, he should deposit the head of the animal.

sanskrit_iast: siddhaḥ paśubandhaḥ /
meaning: सिद्धः पशुबन्धः /

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣaṇīyāṃ nirvapaty āgnāvaiṣṇavam ekādaśakapālam ādityebhyo ghṛte carum agnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālam /
meaning: दीक्षणीयां निर्वपत्य् आग्नावैष्णवम् एकादशकपालम् आदित्येभ्यो घृते चरुम् अग्नये वैश्वानराय द्वादशकपालम् /
text_mt: He apportions the initiatory offering: a cake on eleven potsherds for Agni and Viṣṇu, a boiled oblation in clarified butter for the Ādityas, and a cake on twelve potsherds for Agni Vaiśvānara.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ādhītayajurbhyaḥ //
meaning: सिद्धम् आधीतयजुर्भ्यः //
text_mt: The ritual is established up to the muttered formulas.

sanskrit_iast: ākūtyai prayuje \\ iti pañca hutvā \\ ākūtam agniṃ prayujam̐ svāhā \\ iti ṣaḍ juhoti viśvo devasya netur iti pūrṇāhutim /
meaning: आकूत्यै प्रयुजे \\ इति पञ्च हुत्वा \\ आकूतम् अग्निं प्रयुजम्̐ स्वाहा \\ इति षड् जुहोति विश्वो देवस्य नेतुर् इति पूर्णाहुतिम् /
text_mt: Having offered five with "To intention, to the yoker...", he offers six with "Svāhā to intention, to Agni the yoker...", and the full offering with "Of the divine leader everyone...".

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā muṣṭikaraṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ मुष्टिकरणात् /
text_mt: The ritual is established up to the clenching of the fists.

sanskrit_iast: ukhāṃ pravṛṇakty āhavanīye prabhūteṣv aṅgāreṣu // mā su bhitthā mā su riṣas \\ iti dvābhyām upadadhāti /
meaning: उखां प्रवृणक्त्य् आहवनीये प्रभूतेष्व् अङ्गारेषु // मा सु भित्था मा सु रिषस् \\ इति द्वाभ्याम् उपदधाति /
text_mt: He heats the pot in the āhavanīya fire on abundant coals; with two [verses], beginning with "Do not break, do not be harmed...", he sets it down.

sanskrit_iast: taptāyāṃ muñjān avadadhāty anyad vā kṣiprāgnim /
meaning: तप्तायां मुञ्जान् अवदधात्य् अन्यद् वा क्षिप्राग्निम् /
text_mt: When it is heated, he places inside it muñja grass, or some other quick-burning fuel.

sanskrit_iast: santāpenāgniṃ janayati /
meaning: सन्तापेनाग्निं जनयति /
text_mt: By the heat he generates fire.

sanskrit_iast: avasṛjed āhavanīyam /
meaning: अवसृजेद् आहवनीयम् /

sanskrit_iast: na kāmeṣu pravṛṇakti /
meaning: न कामेषु प्रवृणक्ति /

sanskrit_iast: āhṛtyāvadadhyān mathitvā gataśrīr bhraṣṭrād annādyakāmasya vaidyutād brahmavarcasakāmasyopari vṛkṣe dīpyamānaṃ pradāvād āhared yaṃ kāmayeta prasenenāsya rāṣṭraṃ jāyukam̐ syād iti /
meaning: आहृत्यावदध्यान् मथित्वा गतश्रीर् भ्रष्ट्राद् अन्नाद्यकामस्य वैद्युताद् ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्योपरि वृक्षे दीप्यमानं प्रदावाद् आहरेद् यं कामयेत प्रसेनेनास्य राष्ट्रं जायुकम्̐ स्याद् इति /
text_mt: Having fetched it, he should place it inside, having churned it for one of established fortune, from a baker's oven for one desirous of food, from lightning for one desirous of spiritual luster; he should fetch fire burning in a tree from a forest-fire for one of whom he desires, "May his kingdom be victorious with an advancing army."

sanskrit_iast: ukhyām̐ samidhya samidha ādadhāti drvannaḥ sarpirāsutir iti krumukaṃ ghṛtāktam \\ parasyā adhi sam̐vatas \\ ity audumbarīm \\ paramasyāḥ parāvatas \\ iti vaikaṅkatīm \\ yad agne yāni kāni ca \\ iti śamīmayīm aparaśuvṛkṇām \\ yad atty upajihvikā \\ iti pañcabhir audumbarīm aparaśuvṛkṇāṃ tailvakīm̐ vābhicaratas \\ dam̐ṣṭrābhyāṃ malimlūn agne \\ ity āśvatthīm //
meaning: उख्याम्̐ समिध्य समिध आदधाति द्र्वन्नः सर्पिरासुतिर् इति क्रुमुकं घृताक्तम् \\ परस्या अधि सम्̐वतस् \\ इत्य् औदुम्बरीम् \\ परमस्याः परावतस् \\ इति वैकङ्कतीम् \\ यद् अग्ने यानि कानि च \\ इति शमीमयीम् अपरशुवृक्णाम् \\ यद् अत्त्य् उपजिह्विका \\ इति पञ्चभिर् औदुम्बरीम् अपरशुवृक्णां तैल्वकीम्̐ वाभिचरतस् \\ दम्̐ष्ट्राभ्यां मलिम्लून् अग्ने \\ इत्य् आश्वत्थीम् //
text_mt: Having kindled the fire in the pot, he puts on kindling sticks: one of krumuka smeared with clarified butter with "Whose food is wood, whose drink is melted butter..."; one of udumbara with "From the beyond of the year..."; one of vikaṅkata with "From the farthest distance..."; one of śamī not felled with an axe with "Whatever, O Agni, any..."; with five [formulas] beginning with "What the ant eats...", an udumbara stick not felled with an axe, or one of tilvaka for someone practicing sorcery; one of aśvattha with "With your fangs, O Agni, the thieves...".

sanskrit_iast: yo asmabhyam arātīyāt \\ iti śamīmayīm aparaśuvṛkṇāṃ tailvakīm̐ vābhicarann ādadhad yajamāno yaṃ dviṣyāt taṃ manasā dhyāyet //
meaning: यो अस्मभ्यम् अरातीयात् \\ इति शमीमयीम् अपरशुवृक्णां तैल्वकीम्̐ वाभिचरन्न् आदधद् यजमानो यं द्विष्यात् तं मनसा ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: Putting on a stick of śamī not felled with an axe, or of tilvaka, with "Whoever acts with hostility toward us...", the sacrificer, practicing sorcery, should mentally meditate upon him whom he hates.

sanskrit_iast: ud eṣāṃ bāhūn atiram iti dvābhyām audumbarīm ādadhad yajamānam̐ vācayati //
meaning: उद् एषां बाहून् अतिरम् इति द्वाभ्याम् औदुम्बरीम् आदधद् यजमानम्̐ वाचयति //
text_mt: Putting on an udumbara stick with the two [formulas], "I have raised up their arms...", he makes the sacrificer recite [them].

sanskrit_iast: brahma kṣatram̐ sayujā \\ iti samidham ādadhāti /
meaning: ब्रह्म क्षत्रम्̐ सयुजा \\ इति समिधम् आदधाति /
text_mt: He puts on a kindling stick with "Priesthood and nobility united...".

sanskrit_iast: sauvarṇam̐ rukmam ekavim̐śatinirbādham \\ dṛśāno rukmas \\ iti pratimuñcati /
meaning: सौवर्णम्̐ रुक्मम् एकविम्̐शतिनिर्बाधम् \\ दृशानो रुक्मस् \\ इति प्रतिमुञ्चति /
text_mt: With "The golden disc seen...", he fastens on a golden ornament with twenty-one knobs.

sanskrit_iast: upariṣṭānnirbādhaṃ bibharti /
meaning: उपरिष्टान्निर्बाधं बिभर्ति /
text_mt: He wears it with the knobs facing outward.

sanskrit_iast: āsandīṃ nidadhāti /
meaning: आसन्दीं निदधाति /

sanskrit_iast: tasyāḥ prādeśamātrāḥ pādāḥ /
meaning: तस्याः प्रादेशमात्राः पादाः /
text_mt: Its legs are a span in height.

sanskrit_iast: samānam anyat /
meaning: समानम् अन्यत् /

sanskrit_iast: mauñjam̐ śikyam̐ ṣaḍudyāvaṃ dvādaśodyāvam̐ vāsandyāṃ nidadhāti //
meaning: मौञ्जम्̐ शिक्यम्̐ षडुद्यावं द्वादशोद्यावम्̐ वासन्द्यां निदधाति //
text_mt: He places a sling of muñja grass, having six cords or twelve cords, upon the chair.

sanskrit_iast: naktoṣāsā \\ ity ukhyam udyasya śikye 'vadadhāti //
meaning: नक्तोषासा \\ इत्य् उख्यम् उद्यस्य शिक्ये ऽवदधाति //
text_mt: With "Night and dawn...", having lifted the fire in the pot, he places it into the sling.

sanskrit_iast: viśvā rūpāṇi \\ iti śikyapāśaṃ pratimuñcati naktoṣāsā \\ iti kṛṣṇājinam //
meaning: विश्वा रूपाणि \\ इति शिक्यपाशं प्रतिमुञ्चति नक्तोषासा \\ इति कृष्णाजिनम् //
text_mt: With "All forms..." he fastens the noose of the sling; with "Night and dawn...", the black antelope skin.

sanskrit_iast: suparṇo 'si garutmān \\ trivṛt te śiras \\ iti japati //
meaning: सुपर्णो ऽसि गरुत्मान् \\ त्रिवृत् ते शिरस् \\ इति जपति //
text_mt: He mutters: "You are the fair-winged bird Garutmat... threefold is your head...".

sanskrit_iast: suparṇo 'si garutmān \ divaṃ gacha \ svaḥ pata \\ ity ukhyam udyāmyādhyadhi nābhim ukhāṃ dhārayamāṇas \\ viṣṇoḥ kramo 'si \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ prāṅ catuḥ prakrāmati //
meaning: सुपर्णो ऽसि गरुत्मान् \ दिवं गछ \ स्वः पत \\ इत्य् उख्यम् उद्याम्याध्यधि नाभिम् उखां धारयमाणस् \\ विष्णोः क्रमो ऽसि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः प्राङ् चतुः प्रक्रामति //
text_mt: Having raised the fire in the pot with "You are the fair-winged bird Garutmat, go to heaven, fly to the light", holding the pot above the navel, he strides four paces toward the east with [the formulas] beginning with "You are the stride of Viṣṇu...".

sanskrit_iast: akrandad agnir iti krandavatīṃ japati //
meaning: अक्रन्दद् अग्निर् इति क्रन्दवतीं जपति //
text_mt: He mutters the verse containing the word krand: "Agni cried aloud...".

sanskrit_iast: agne 'bhyāvartinn iti catasṛbhiḥ punarvatībhiḥ pradakṣiṇam āvartate //
meaning: अग्ने ऽभ्यावर्तिन्न् इति चतसृभिः पुनर्वतीभिः प्रदक्षिणम् आवर्तते //
text_mt: He turns around clockwise with the four verses containing the word punar, beginning with "O Agni, turning back...".

sanskrit_iast: ā tvāhārṣam ity āvṛtya japati //
meaning: आ त्वाहार्षम् इत्य् आवृत्य जपति //
text_mt: Having turned around, he mutters: "I have brought you back...".

sanskrit_iast: ud uttamam̐ varuṇa pāśam iti śikyapāśam unmuñcati //
meaning: उद् उत्तमम्̐ वरुण पाशम् इति शिक्यपाशम् उन्मुञ्चति //
text_mt: With "The highest noose, O Varuṇa...", he unfastens the noose of the sling.

sanskrit_iast: agne bṛhann ity ukhyam abhimantrayate //
meaning: अग्ने बृहन्न् इत्य् उख्यम् अभिमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: He addresses the fire in the pot with "O lofty Agni...".

sanskrit_iast: ham̐saḥ śuciṣad iti ham̐savatyāsandyāṃ nidadhāti //
meaning: हम्̐सः शुचिषद् इति हम्̐सवत्यासन्द्यां निदधाति //
text_mt: With the Haṃsavatī verse, "The goose dwelling in light...", he sets it down upon the chair.

sanskrit_iast: sīda tvaṃ mātur asyā upasthe \\ iti tisṛbhiḥ sannavatībhir ukhyam upatiṣṭhate //
meaning: सीद त्वं मातुर् अस्या उपस्थे \\ इति तिसृभिः सन्नवतीभिर् उख्यम् उपतिष्ठते //
text_mt: With the three verses containing the word sad, beginning with "Sit down in the lap of this mother...", he attends upon the fire in the pot.

sanskrit_iast: divas pari \\ itiprabhṛtibhir dvādaśabhir vātsapreṇopatiṣṭhate /
meaning: दिवस् परि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् द्वादशभिर् वात्सप्रेणोपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: He attends upon [it] with the twelve [verses] of the Vātsapra hymn, beginning with "From heaven...".

sanskrit_iast: muṣṭikaraṇaprabhṛti daikṣaṃ karma siddham /
meaning: मुष्टिकरणप्रभृति दैक्षं कर्म सिद्धम् /
text_mt: The ritual acts of the initiation from the clenching of the fists onwards are established.

sanskrit_iast: vratayiṣyan yena devā jyotiṣā \\ ity ukhyam̐ samidhya samidham ādadhāti ghṛtāktāṃ prathamām \\ samidhāgniṃ duvasyata \\ iti gāyatryā brāhmaṇasya praprāyam agnir iti triṣṭubhā rājanyasya dvābhyāṃ gāyatrībhyām̐ vaiśyasya //
meaning: व्रतयिष्यन् येन देवा ज्योतिषा \\ इत्य् उख्यम्̐ समिध्य समिधम् आदधाति घृताक्तां प्रथमाम् \\ समिधाग्निं दुवस्यत \\ इति गायत्र्या ब्राह्मणस्य प्रप्रायम् अग्निर् इति त्रिष्टुभा राजन्यस्य द्वाभ्यां गायत्रीभ्याम्̐ वैश्यस्य //
text_mt: Intending to take the vow-drink, having kindled the fire in the pot with "With which light the gods...", he puts on the first kindling stick smeared with clarified butter: with a gāyatrī verse, "Honor the fire with kindling...", for a brāhmaṇa; with a triṣṭubh verse, "Forth, forth this Agni...", for a rājanya; with two gāyatrī verses for a vaiśya.

sanskrit_iast: annapate annasya no dehi \\ iti ghṛtāktām //
meaning: अन्नपते अन्नस्य नो देहि \\ इति घृताक्ताम् //
text_mt: With "O Lord of food, give us food...", [he puts on one] smeared with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām agnaye tvā vaiśvānarāyāhar upadadhe \\ iti samidham ādadhāti rātrīm upadadhe \\ iti prātaḥ /
meaning: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम् अग्नये त्वा वैश्वानरायाहर् उपदधे \\ इति समिधम् आदधाति रात्रीम् उपदधे \\ इति प्रातः /
text_mt: With "At the impulse of the god Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I set down the day for you, O Agni Vaiśvānara", he puts on a kindling stick; in the morning with "...I set down the night...".

sanskrit_iast: ata ūrdhvam udita āditye kramā ahani /
meaning: अत ऊर्ध्वम् उदित आदित्ये क्रमा अहनि /
text_mt: Henceforth, after the sun has risen, are the strides during the day.

sanskrit_iast: pratimocanaprabhṛti siddham opasthānāt sannavatībhiḥ /
meaning: प्रतिमोचनप्रभृति सिद्धम् ओपस्थानात् सन्नवतीभिः /
text_mt: From the fastening onwards is established up to the reverential attendance with the [verses] containing the word 'sanna'.

sanskrit_iast: naktam̐ vātsapreṇopatiṣṭhate /
meaning: नक्तम्̐ वात्सप्रेणोपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: At night, he attends [the fire] with the Vātsapra hymn.

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣito bhṛtim̐ vanvīta /
meaning: दीक्षितो भृतिम्̐ वन्वीत /
text_mt: The initiated should beg for sustenance.

sanskrit_iast: prayāsyann ud u tvā viśve devās \\ ity ukhyam ādatte /
meaning: प्रयास्यन्न् उद् उ त्वा विश्वे देवास् \\ इत्य् उख्यम् आदत्ते /
text_mt: About to set forth, he takes the pan-fire with: 'The All-gods [have raised] thee up'.

sanskrit_iast: ham̐saḥ śuciṣad iti ham̐savatyā sannavatībhiś cānasy ādadhāti / pātryoḥ samopya parāv ādadhāti //
meaning: हम्̐सः शुचिषद् इति हम्̐सवत्या सन्नवतीभिश् चानस्य् आदधाति / पात्र्योः समोप्य पराव् आदधाति //
text_mt: With the haṃsavatī verse, 'The swan dwelling in purity,' and with the verses containing the word 'sit,' he places [the fire] into the cart. Having poured [the ashes/embers] into the two pans, he places them in the other [cart].

sanskrit_iast: pred agne jyotiṣmān yāhi \\ iti prayāti /
meaning: प्रेद् अग्ने ज्योतिष्मान् याहि \\ इति प्रयाति /
text_mt: He sets out with the formula, 'O Agni, bright one, go forward.'

sanskrit_iast: yadi kharjet krandavatyānumantrayeta /
meaning: यदि खर्जेत् क्रन्दवत्यानुमन्त्रयेत /
text_mt: If [the cart] should creak, he accompanies it with the formula containing the word 'call.'

sanskrit_iast: yady ukhā pūryeteṣṭakāsam̐yamanāya bhasma nidadhyāt paśukāmasya purīṣam /
meaning: यद्य् उखा पूर्येतेष्टकासम्̐यमनाय भस्म निदध्यात् पशुकामस्य पुरीषम् /
text_mt: If the ukhā pot is filled, he should deposit the ashes for settling the bricks, or loose soil in the case of one who desires cattle.
