sanskrit_iast: sahavihāro yāyāvaraḥ prayāti //
meaning: सहविहारो यायावरः प्रयाति //
text_mt: The wandering sacrificer sets out together with his sacrificial enclosure.

sanskrit_iast: āpo devīḥ pratigṛbhṇīta \\ iti tisṛbhir apsu bhasma pravapati //
meaning: आपो देवीः प्रतिगृभ्णीत \\ इति तिसृभिर् अप्सु भस्म प्रवपति //
text_mt: With three verses, 'O divine waters, receive,' he pours the ashes into water.

sanskrit_iast: prasadya bhasmanā \\ iti dvābhyāṃ bhasmamuṣṭī pratyāvapati /
meaning: प्रसद्य भस्मना \\ इति द्वाभ्यां भस्ममुष्टी प्रत्यावपति /
text_mt: With two verses, 'Having settled with ashes,' he puts two handfuls of ashes back.

sanskrit_iast: punarvatībhyāṃ pratyetya yathāsthānam̐ sādayitvā bodhadvatībhyām upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: पुनर्वतीभ्यां प्रत्येत्य यथास्थानम्̐ सादयित्वा बोधद्वतीभ्याम् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: Having returned with two verses containing the word 'return' and set it in its place, he stands worshiping it with two verses containing the word 'wake.'

sanskrit_iast: na prājāpatyenāniṣṭveṣṭakāḥ kurvīta /
meaning: न प्राजापत्येनानिष्ट्वेष्टकाः कुर्वीत /
text_mt: One should not make the bricks without having offered the Prājāpatya offering.

sanskrit_iast: tisro rātrīr bhṛtvetiprabhṛtyāmnātaṃ dīkṣāparimāṇam /
meaning: तिस्रो रात्रीर् भृत्वेतिप्रभृत्याम्नातं दीक्षापरिमाणम् /
text_mt: The duration of the initiation is traditionally taught beginning with the rule, 'Having borne it for three nights.'

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣite na punarvatībhir ukhyam upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: दीक्षिते न पुनर्वतीभिर् उख्यम् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: Once initiated, he does not worship the fire in the ukhā with the verses containing the word 'return.'

sanskrit_iast: mṛnmayīr iṣṭakāś caturaśrā ṛjulekhās tryālikhitā dakṣiṇāvṛto 'nyāḥ savyāvṛtaś ca khaṇḍakṛṣṇalakṣmavarjaṃ nairṛtīs tisraḥ kṛṣṇās tuṣapakvā nirmanthena paced dakṣiṇāgner vā /
meaning: मृन्मयीर् इष्टकाश् चतुरश्रा ऋजुलेखास् त्र्यालिखिता दक्षिणावृतो ऽन्याः सव्यावृतश् च खण्डकृष्णलक्ष्मवर्जं नैरृतीस् तिस्रः कृष्णास् तुषपक्वा निर्मन्थेन पचेद् दक्षिणाग्नेर् वा /
text_mt: Earthen bricks are four-cornered, marked with straight lines, scored with three marks; some turn clockwise, others turn counter-clockwise, excluding broken and black spots. The three Nairṛta bricks are black, baked with chaff; one should bake them with fire produced by churned wood or with the southern fire.

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣābhya ūrdhvaṃ kramavātsapram̐ samasya /
meaning: दीक्षाभ्य ऊर्ध्वं क्रमवात्सप्रम्̐ समस्य /
text_mt: After the initiation days, having combined the Viṣṇu strides and the Vātsapra hymn,

sanskrit_iast: apeta vīta \\ iti śālāmukhīyadeśaṃ joṣayate / tasmin vyāmam̐ vidhāya maṇḍalaṃ caturaśram̐ voddhatyāvokṣya cita stha \ paricita stha \\ ity ekavim̐śatyā pradakṣiṇam̐ śarkarābhiḥ pariśrayati //
meaning: अपेत वीत \\ इति शालामुखीयदेशं जोषयते / तस्मिन् व्यामम्̐ विधाय मण्डलं चतुरश्रम्̐ वोद्धत्यावोक्ष्य चित स्थ \ परिचित स्थ \\ इत्य् एकविम्̐शत्या प्रदक्षिणम्̐ शर्कराभिः परिश्रयति //
text_mt: he selects the site for the śālāmukhīya fire with the formula, 'Go away, depart.' Having measured a fathom there, circular or square, having dug it up and sprinkled it, he surrounds it with twenty-one pebbles clockwise with the formulas, 'You are built; you are built around.'

sanskrit_iast: agner bhasmāsi \\ agneḥ purīṣam asi \\ iti sikatā nivapati saṃjñānam asi \\ ity ūṣān //
meaning: अग्नेर् भस्मासि \\ अग्नेः पुरीषम् असि \\ इति सिकता निवपति संज्ञानम् असि \\ इत्य् ऊषान् //
text_mt: He scatters sand with the formulas, 'You are Agni's ash; you are Agni's loose soil,' and saline earth with, 'You are agreement.'

sanskrit_iast: mayi gṛhṇāmi \ yo no agniḥ pitaras \\ iti ceṣyañ japati yajamāno vā /
meaning: मयि गृह्णामि \ यो नो अग्निः पितरस् \\ इति चेष्यञ् जपति यजमानो वा /
text_mt: The one intending to build [the fire-altar], or the sacrificer, recites in a whisper: 'I take into myself,' and 'The fire which is ours, O fathers.'

sanskrit_iast: vyūhyoṣasikatam ayam̐ so agnir iti catasṛbhir madhye 'gneś catasraḥ prācīḥ samīcīr iṣṭakā upadadhāti \\ iḍām agne \\ iti dve samīcī purastāt \\ cid asi \ paricid asi \\ iti dve samīcī paścāt /
meaning: व्यूह्योषसिकतम् अयम्̐ सो अग्निर् इति चतसृभिर् मध्ये ऽग्नेश् चतस्रः प्राचीः समीचीर् इष्टका उपदधाति \\ इडाम् अग्ने \\ इति द्वे समीची पुरस्तात् \\ चिद् असि \ परिचिद् असि \\ इति द्वे समीची पश्चात् /
text_mt: Having pushed aside the saline earth and sand, he places four bricks facing east together in the center of the fire with the four verses, 'This is that Agni'; two facing together in front with the verse, 'O Agni, the oblation'; two facing together behind with, 'You are building; you are building around.'

sanskrit_iast: sarvatreṣṭakopadhānamantreṣv antatas tayā devatayā \\ ity anuṣajati //
meaning: सर्वत्रेष्टकोपधानमन्त्रेष्व् अन्ततस् तया देवतया \\ इत्य् अनुषजति //
text_mt: Everywhere in the mantras for laying the bricks, he attaches at the end the words, 'With that deity.'

sanskrit_iast: lokaṃ pṛṇa chidraṃ pṛṇa \\ ity etayā trayodaśabhiś citim̐ saṃpūrayati // tā asya sūdadohasas \\ ity anuṣaṅgaḥ /
meaning: लोकं पृण छिद्रं पृण \\ इत्य् एतया त्रयोदशभिश् चितिम्̐ संपूरयति // ता अस्य सूददोहसस् \\ इत्य् अनुषङ्गः /
text_mt: With this verse, 'Fill the space, fill the void,' he fills up the layer with thirteen bricks. The continuation is: 'His milk-providing drops.'

sanskrit_iast: cityāṃcityām̐ hiraṇyaśakalam upāsyati //
meaning: चित्यांचित्याम्̐ हिरण्यशकलम् उपास्यति //
text_mt: In each layer he throws a piece of gold.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭo divi \\ iti cātvāladeśāt purīṣeṇa citim̐ saṃchādayati /
meaning: पृष्टो दिवि \\ इति चात्वालदेशात् पुरीषेण चितिम्̐ संछादयति /
text_mt: With the verse, 'He was touched in heaven,' he covers the layer with loose soil from the place of the pit.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ prathame gārhapatyasya pañca citīr upadadhāti tisro dvitīya ekāṃ tṛtīye /
meaning: एवं प्रथमे गार्हपत्यस्य पञ्च चितीर् उपदधाति तिस्रो द्वितीय एकां तृतीये /
text_mt: Thus in the first [round] of the gārhapatya fire he lays five layers, in the second three, in the third one.

sanskrit_iast: saṃcite samitam̐ saṃkalpethām iti caturbhir ukhyaṃ nivapati //
meaning: संचिते समितम्̐ संकल्पेथाम् इति चतुर्भिर् उख्यं निवपति //
text_mt: When it is built up, he pours out the fire from the ukhā with the four verses, 'Be united, agree.'

sanskrit_iast: māteva putram ity ukhām̐ vimuñcati /
meaning: मातेव पुत्रम् इत्य् उखाम्̐ विमुञ्चति /
text_mt: With the verse, 'Like a mother her son,' he releases the ukhā pot.

sanskrit_iast: na riktām avekṣeta /
meaning: न रिक्ताम् अवेक्षेत /

sanskrit_iast: sikatābhiḥ pūrayitvā nidadhyād dadhnā ghṛtena madhunā vā //
meaning: सिकताभिः पूरयित्वा निदध्याद् दध्ना घृतेन मधुना वा //
text_mt: Having filled it with sand, he should set it down, or with curd, clarified butter, or honey.

sanskrit_iast: yad asya pāre rajasas \\ iti śikyam ādatte /
meaning: यद् अस्य पारे रजसस् \\ इति शिक्यम् आदत्ते /
text_mt: With the verse, 'Beyond this mist,' he takes the carrying harness.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāparam avāntaradeśam̐ yanti /
meaning: दक्षिणापरम् अवान्तरदेशम्̐ यन्ति /
text_mt: They go to the south-western intermediate direction.

sanskrit_iast: svakṛta iriṇe nairṛtīr upadadhāti \\ asunvantam ayajamānam icha \\ iti tisṛbhiḥ parāṅparāṅ /
meaning: स्वकृत इरिणे नैरृतीर् उपदधाति \\ असुन्वन्तम् अयजमानम् इछ \\ इति तिसृभिः पराङ्पराङ् /
text_mt: On naturally barren ground, he lays the Nairṛta bricks with three verses, 'Seek him who presses not, who sacrifices not,' facing away each time.

sanskrit_iast: na tayādevataṃ karoti //
meaning: न तयादेवतं करोति //

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ te devī nirṛtir ābabandha \\ iti jālam iṣṭakāsv adhyasyati /
meaning: यं ते देवी निरृतिर् आबबन्ध \\ इति जालम् इष्टकास्व् अध्यस्यति /
text_mt: With the verse, 'Which the goddess Nirṛti has bound on you,' he casts the net over the bricks.

sanskrit_iast: rukmasūtram anuprahṛtyāsandyābhivikramayati //
meaning: रुक्मसूत्रम् अनुप्रहृत्यासन्द्याभिविक्रमयति //
text_mt: Having thrown the cord of the gold plate after it, he makes [the sacrificer] step over it by means of the chair.

sanskrit_iast: yad asya pāre rajasas \\ ity udakumbheneṣṭakāḥ prasavyaṃ triḥ pariṣiñcan paryeti / nidhāya trir apariṣiñcan pratiparyeti //
meaning: यद् अस्य पारे रजसस् \\ इत्य् उदकुम्भेनेष्टकाः प्रसव्यं त्रिः परिषिञ्चन् पर्येति / निधाय त्रिर् अपरिषिञ्चन् प्रतिपर्येति //
text_mt: With the verse, 'Beyond this mist,' sprinkling around the bricks counter-clockwise three times with a water-jar, he goes around. Having set it down, he goes around again three times without sprinkling.

sanskrit_iast: bhūtyai namas \\ ity uktvāvartate /
meaning: भूत्यै नमस् \\ इत्य् उक्त्वावर्तते /
text_mt: Having said, 'Homage to prosperity,' he turns around.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃ no devīr abhiṣṭaye\ āpo bhavantu pītaye /
śam̐ yor abhisravantu naḥ //
śaṃ na āpo dhanvanyāḥ \ śaṃ naḥ santv anūpyāḥ /
śaṃ naḥ samudryā āpaḥ \ śam u naḥ santu kūpyāḥ //
śaṃ no mitraḥ śam̐ varuṇaḥ \ śaṃ no bhavatv aryamā /
śaṃ na indraś cāgniś ca \ śaṃ no viṣṇur urukramaḥ //
iti tisṛbhiḥ parogoṣṭhaṃ mārjayante /
meaning:
शं नो देवीर् अभिष्टये\ आपो भवन्तु पीतये /
शम्̐ योर् अभिस्रवन्तु नः //
शं न आपो धन्वन्याः \ शं नः सन्त्व् अनूप्याः /
शं नः समुद्र्या आपः \ शम् उ नः सन्तु कूप्याः //
शं नो मित्रः शम्̐ वरुणः \ शं नो भवत्व् अर्यमा /
शं न इन्द्रश् चाग्निश् च \ शं नो विष्णुर् उरुक्रमः //
इति तिसृभिः परोगोष्ठं मार्जयन्ते /

sanskrit_iast: anapekṣamāṇāḥ pratyāyanti //
meaning: अनपेक्षमाणाः प्रत्यायन्ति //
text_mt: Without looking back, they return.

sanskrit_iast: niveśanaḥ saṃgamano vasūnām ity aindryā gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: निवेशनः संगमनो वसूनाम् इत्य् ऐन्द्र्या गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: He worships the gārhapatya fire with the Aindrī verse, 'Resting-place, gatherer of riches.'

sanskrit_iast: prāyaṇīyāprabhṛti siddham opasadbhyaḥ /
meaning: प्रायणीयाप्रभृति सिद्धम् ओपसद्भ्यः /
text_mt: [The procedure] beginning with the introductory offering up to the upasad days is established.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍ upasadaḥ pravargyavatyaḥ /
meaning: षड् उपसदः प्रवर्ग्यवत्यः /
text_mt: There are six upasad days accompanied by the Pravargya rite.

sanskrit_iast: anūpasadam agniṃ cinvīta /
meaning: अनूपसदम् अग्निं चिन्वीत /
text_mt: At each upasad day he should build the fire-altar.

sanskrit_iast: prathamāyām upasadi pūrvāhṇikīṃ kṛtvā yūpam achaiti /
meaning: प्रथमायाम् उपसदि पूर्वाह्णिकीं कृत्वा यूपम् अछैति /
text_mt: On the first upasad day, having performed the morning rite, he goes to fetch the sacrificial post.

sanskrit_iast: agreṇa prāgvam̐śaṃ triṣu prakrameṣv aparimite vāvakāśe pṛṣṭhyāśaṅkuṃ nihatya vedādānaprabhṛti vedim̐ vidadhāti yathā some /
meaning: अग्रेण प्राग्वम्̐शं त्रिषु प्रक्रमेष्व् अपरिमिते वावकाशे पृष्ठ्याशङ्कुं निहत्य वेदादानप्रभृति वेदिम्̐ विदधाति यथा सोमे /
text_mt: In front of the eastern hall, at three paces or in an unmeasured space, having driven in the peg for the spine, he lays out the altar beginning with taking the grass brush, as in the Soma sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvabāhunā yajamānena veṇuṃ pramāyottaravedideśe saptapuruṣam agnim̐ vidadhāti /
meaning: ऊर्ध्वबाहुना यजमानेन वेणुं प्रमायोत्तरवेदिदेशे सप्तपुरुषम् अग्निम्̐ विदधाति /
text_mt: Having measured a bamboo with the sacrificer holding his arms raised, he lays out the seven-man fire-altar at the site of the high altar.

sanskrit_iast: tasya catuḥpuruṣa ātmā puruṣamātrāṇi pakṣapuchāni /
meaning: तस्य चतुःपुरुष आत्मा पुरुषमात्राणि पक्षपुछानि /
text_mt: Its body is four men; the wings and the tail are each of the measure of one man.

sanskrit_iast: aratniṃ pakṣayor atyupadadhāti prādeśaṃ puche /
meaning: अरत्निं पक्षयोर् अत्युपदधाति प्रादेशं पुछे /
text_mt: He lays an extra cubit onto the two wings, and a span onto the tail.

sanskrit_iast: turyapuruṣam̐ śiro vidhāya vihitasya madhyadeśe darbhastambe hiraṇyaṃ nidhāya sajūr abdo āyavobhir ity abhijuhoti //
meaning: तुर्यपुरुषम्̐ शिरो विधाय विहितस्य मध्यदेशे दर्भस्तम्बे हिरण्यं निधाय सजूर् अब्दो आयवोभिर् इत्य् अभिजुहोति //
text_mt: Having made the head a fourth of a man, and having placed gold in a clump of darbha grass in the center of what is laid out, he makes an oblation over it with the formula, 'In alliance with the year, with the mortals.'

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiṣ ṭvā sādayatu pṛthivyāḥ pṛṣṭhe \ tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda \\ iti vihitasya madhyadeśe pṛthivīm abhimṛśati /
meaning: प्रजापतिष् ट्वा सादयतु पृथिव्याः पृष्ठे \ तया देवतयाङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद \\ इति विहितस्य मध्यदेशे पृथिवीम् अभिमृशति /
text_mt: With the formula, 'May Prajāpati seat you on the back of the earth; with that deity, firmly seated like Aṅgiras, sit,' he touches the earth in the center of what has been laid out.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇataḥ pakṣasya \\ ud yojanam antaryāmam iti sīre yugavaratrāṇi saṃbadhnāti //
meaning: दक्षिणतः पक्षस्य \\ उद् योजनम् अन्तर्यामम् इति सीरे युगवरत्राणि संबध्नाति //
text_mt: To the south of the wing, with the formula, 'Upwards the yoking, the inner restraint,' he fastens the yoke-straps on the plow.

sanskrit_iast: pūṣā yunaktu savitā yunaktu \\ iti tisṛbhir yujyamānam anumantrayate /
meaning: पूषा युनक्तु सविता युनक्तु \\ इति तिसृभिर् युज्यमानम् अनुमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: With three verses, 'May Pūṣan yoke, may Savitṛ yoke,' he accompanies it being yoked.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍyuktena kṛṣati dvādaśayuktena vā //
meaning: षड्युक्तेन कृषति द्वादशयुक्तेन वा //
text_mt: He plows with a team of six, or with a team of twelve.

sanskrit_iast: udasthād gojid aśvajid ity ucchritam anumantrayata uṣṭārayoḥ pīlvayor ity anaḍuhaḥ //
meaning: उदस्थाद् गोजिद् अश्वजिद् इत्य् उच्छ्रितम् अनुमन्त्रयत उष्टारयोः पील्वयोर् इत्य् अनडुहः //
text_mt: He accompanies the raised [plow] with the verse, 'He has arisen, winning cattle, winning horses,' and the draft-oxen with the verse, 'Of the two draft animals, of the stout ones.'

sanskrit_iast: lāṅgalaṃ pavīravam iti pañca \\ imām indra hastacyutim iti ṣaṣṭhī / tāsām ekaikayā dvedve sīte kṛṣati /
meaning: लाङ्गलं पवीरवम् इति पञ्च \\ इमाम् इन्द्र हस्तच्युतिम् इति षष्ठी / तासाम् एकैकया द्वेद्वे सीते कृषति /
text_mt: There are five verses beginning with 'The sharp-pointed plow,' and the sixth is, 'O Indra, this furrow cast by hand.' With each one of them he plows two furrows.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇārdhāt pakṣasyopakramya madhyena sītā karoty uttarasmāt pakṣāntāt pradakṣiṇāvṛtā dakṣiṇāṃ pūrvām udīcīm aparām /
meaning: दक्षिणार्धात् पक्षस्योपक्रम्य मध्येन सीता करोत्य् उत्तरस्मात् पक्षान्तात् प्रदक्षिणावृता दक्षिणां पूर्वाम् उदीचीम् अपराम् /
text_mt: Beginning from the southern half of the wing, he makes a furrow through the middle; starting from the northern edge of the wing, turning clockwise, [he plows] the southern furrow first, the northern one second.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ tisrastisraḥ sītāḥ kṛṣati dakṣiṇasyāḥ śroṇer adhy ottarasmād am̐sāt puchād adhy ā śirasa uttarasyāḥ śroṇer adhy ā dakṣiṇasmād am̐sāt //
meaning: एवं तिस्रस्तिस्रः सीताः कृषति दक्षिणस्याः श्रोणेर् अध्य् ओत्तरस्माद् अम्̐सात् पुछाद् अध्य् आ शिरस उत्तरस्याः श्रोणेर् अध्य् आ दक्षिणस्माद् अम्̐सात् //
text_mt: In this way he plows three furrows each: from the southern hip to the northern shoulder, from the tail to the head, and from the northern hip to the southern shoulder.

sanskrit_iast: vimucyadhvam aghnyā devayānās \\ iti dakṣiṇāprāco vimuñcati /
meaning: विमुच्यध्वम् अघ्न्या देवयानास् \\ इति दक्षिणाप्राचो विमुञ्चति /
text_mt: "Be unyoked, O unslayable ones, who travel with the gods"—with this [mantra] he unyokes [the oxen] facing the southeast.

sanskrit_iast: tān adhvaryave dadāti sīraṃ ca /
meaning: तान् अध्वर्यवे ददाति सीरं च /
text_mt: He gives them and the plough to the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: oṣadhīr āraṇyā grāmyāś ca sarpiṣā sam̐sṛjya yā oṣadhayaḥ prathamajās \\ iti caturdaśabhiḥ sarvam agnim̐ vapati /
meaning: ओषधीर् आरण्या ग्राम्याश् च सर्पिषा सम्̐सृज्य या ओषधयः प्रथमजास् \\ इति चतुर्दशभिः सर्वम् अग्निम्̐ वपति /
text_mt: Having mixed wild and cultivated herbs with clarified butter, he sows the whole altar with the fourteen [verses beginning with]: "The plants which were born first".

sanskrit_iast: yā na vindet tābhyo yavān madhūdyutān vapet /
meaning: या न विन्देत् ताभ्यो यवान् मधूद्युतान् वपेत् /
text_mt: Whichever [plants] he cannot find, in their place he should sow barley sprinkled with honey.

sanskrit_iast: śeṣeṇoptam agnim upatiṣṭheta /
meaning: शेषेणोप्तम् अग्निम् उपतिष्ठेत /
text_mt: With the remaining [verses] he should worship the sown altar.

sanskrit_iast: digbhyo loṣṭān bahir veder mā no him̐sīj janitā \\ iti catasṛbhir madhye 'gneḥ samasyati /
meaning: दिग्भ्यो लोष्टान् बहिर् वेदेर् मा नो हिम्̐सीज् जनिता \\ इति चतसृभिर् मध्ये ऽग्नेः समस्यति /
text_mt: With the four [verses beginning with]: "May not the creator harm us", he piles up clods from the quarters outside the altar in the middle of the altar.

sanskrit_iast: yāṃ janatāṃ kāmayeta kṣodhukā syād iti \\ iṣam ūrjam aham ita ādi \\ iti tasyā diśo loṣṭān āharet //
meaning: यां जनतां कामयेत क्षोधुका स्याद् इति \\ इषम् ऊर्जम् अहम् इत आदि \\ इति तस्या दिशो लोष्टान् आहरेत् //
text_mt: If there is a people whom he would wish to be hungry, he should fetch clods from their quarter, [saying]: "Food and sap I take from here".

sanskrit_iast: kāmaṃ kāmadughe dhukṣva \\ iti sītām̐sītām abhimṛśati /
meaning: कामं कामदुघे धुक्ष्व \\ इति सीताम्̐सीताम् अभिमृशति /
text_mt: He touches each furrow with: "Yield desire, O wish-cow!"

sanskrit_iast: goyugena cātvālam̐ vidadhāti /
meaning: गोयुगेन चात्वालम्̐ विदधाति /
text_mt: With the pair of oxen he establishes the cātvāla [pit].

sanskrit_iast: daśapadām uttaravediṃ madhye 'gner vyāghāraṇāntāṃ kurvīta //
meaning: दशपदाम् उत्तरवेदिं मध्ये ऽग्नेर् व्याघारणान्तां कुर्वीत //
text_mt: He should make the uttaravedi ten paces [in size] in the middle of the altar, ending with the trickling of clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: cita stha \ paricita stha \\ ity agniṃ pradakṣiṇam̐ śarkarābhiḥ pariśrayati //
meaning: चित स्थ \ परिचित स्थ \\ इत्य् अग्निं प्रदक्षिणम्̐ शर्कराभिः परिश्रयति //
text_mt: With: "You are piled; you are enclosed", he encloses the altar clockwise with pebbles.

sanskrit_iast: agne tava śravo vayas \\ iti ṣaḍbhiḥ sikatā nivapati //
meaning: अग्ने तव श्रवो वयस् \\ इति षड्भिः सिकता निवपति //
text_mt: With the six [verses beginning with]: "Agni, your fame, your vigour", he pours sand.

sanskrit_iast: āpyāyasva \ saṃ te payām̐si \\ iti saumībhyām̐ vyūhati śirasi pakṣapuchānāṃ cāpyayā lokālokā madhye 'gneḥ svayamātṛṇṇāloke /
meaning: आप्यायस्व \ सं ते पयाम्̐सि \\ इति सौमीभ्याम्̐ व्यूहति शिरसि पक्षपुछानां चाप्यया लोकालोका मध्ये ऽग्नेः स्वयमातृण्णालोके /
text_mt: With the two verses addressed to Soma: "Swell up" and "May the milks unite in you", he shifts [the sand] on the head, on the junctions of the wings and tail, at each appropriate spot, and in the middle of the altar at the place of the naturally perforated [brick].

sanskrit_iast: uttaraṃ puchāpyayaṃ praty agner ākramaṇam /
meaning: उत्तरं पुछाप्ययं प्रत्य् अग्नेर् आक्रमणम् /
text_mt: The stepping-on point of the altar is opposite the northern junction of the tail.

sanskrit_iast: agreṇa śālāmukhīyam̐ rohite carmaṇy ānaḍuhe prāggrīve lomataś citīnāṃ prathameṣṭakāḥ samādadhāti /
meaning: अग्रेण शालामुखीयम्̐ रोहिते चर्मण्य् आनडुहे प्राग्ग्रीवे लोमतश् चितीनां प्रथमेष्टकाः समादधाति /
text_mt: In front of the śālāmukhīya fire, upon a red bull's hide with the neck turned to the east and hairy side up, he places the first bricks of the layers.

sanskrit_iast: anuvācayati cityagnibhyas \\ ity upām̐śu praṇīyamānebhyo 'nubrūhi \\ ity uccaiḥ /
meaning: अनुवाचयति चित्यग्निभ्यस् \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शु प्रणीयमानेभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् उच्चैः /
text_mt: He has [the hotṛ] recite: "For the fires to be piled"—in a whisper; "Recite for those being brought forward"—aloud.

sanskrit_iast: sakṛduktāyāṃ carmaṇāharanty aśvam agrato nayanti /
meaning: सकृदुक्तायां चर्मणाहरन्त्य् अश्वम् अग्रतो नयन्ति /
text_mt: When it has been spoken once, they carry [the bricks] by means of the hide; they lead a horse in front.

sanskrit_iast: śroṇeḥ paścāc carma nidadhāti /
meaning: श्रोणेः पश्चाच् चर्म निदधाति /
text_mt: He places the hide behind the buttocks [of the altar].

sanskrit_iast: samayottaravedim abhyasthām̐ viśvāḥ pṛtanās \\ iti dakṣiṇena pādena svayamātṛṇṇāloke 'śvam ākramayaty aparyāvartayan parikramayati /
meaning: समयोत्तरवेदिम् अभ्यस्थाम्̐ विश्वाः पृतनास् \\ इति दक्षिणेन पादेन स्वयमातृण्णालोके ऽश्वम् आक्रमयत्य् अपर्यावर्तयन् परिक्रमयति /
text_mt: With: "Across the uttaravedi, I have overcome all hostiles", he makes the horse step with its right foot on the place of the naturally perforated [brick]; he leads it around without letting it turn back.

sanskrit_iast: pratyavanīyāśvaṃ kumbheṣṭakā dvādaśodakena pūrayitvā sam anyā yanti \\ itiprabhṛtibhir dvādaśabhir madhyamāsu sītāsūpadadhāti kumbhaṃ kumbhīṃ ca dvedve lokeṣu catasro madhye //
meaning: प्रत्यवनीयाश्वं कुम्भेष्टका द्वादशोदकेन पूरयित्वा सम् अन्या यन्ति \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् द्वादशभिर् मध्यमासु सीतासूपदधाति कुम्भं कुम्भीं च द्वेद्वे लोकेषु चतस्रो मध्ये //
text_mt: Having led the horse back, having filled twelve jar-bricks with water, he lays them down with the twelve [verses] beginning with: "Together the others go", in the middle furrows: a jar and a pot, two in each space, four in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: āpo hi ṣṭha \\ iti tisraḥ kumbheṣṭakāḥ samanvīkṣamāṇo japati /
meaning: आपो हि ष्ठ \\ इति तिस्रः कुम्भेष्टकाः समन्वीक्षमाणो जपति /
text_mt: Looking continuously at the three jar-bricks, he mutters: "Waters, indeed, you are".

sanskrit_iast: naivāraṃ caruṃ payasi śṛtaṃ divi śrayasva \\ iti dakṣiṇataḥ purastāt svayamātṛṇṇālokasyopadadhāti /
meaning: नैवारं चरुं पयसि शृतं दिवि श्रयस्व \\ इति दक्षिणतः पुरस्तात् स्वयमातृण्णालोकस्योपदधाति /
text_mt: With: "Rest in the sky", he lays down a caru of wild rice cooked in milk to the south-east of the place of the naturally perforated [brick].

sanskrit_iast: pade puṣkaraparṇaṃ pratyagdvāram adhastānnābhi tapo yonir asi \\ ity upadadhāti /
meaning: पदे पुष्करपर्णं प्रत्यग्द्वारम् अधस्तान्नाभि तपो योनिर् असि \\ इत्य् उपदधाति /
text_mt: In the [horse's] footprint, with: "You are the womb of heat", he lays down a lotus leaf with its stem turned to the west, having its navel downward.

sanskrit_iast: puṣkaraparṇe rukmaṃ pratyakpāśam upariṣṭānnirbādhaṃ brahma jajñānam ity upadadhāti /
meaning: पुष्करपर्णे रुक्मं प्रत्यक्पाशम् उपरिष्टान्निर्बाधं ब्रह्म जज्ञानम् इत्य् उपदधाति /
text_mt: With: "Brahman, born first", he lays down a gold plate upon the lotus leaf, with its loop turned to the west and its unperforated side upward.

sanskrit_iast: rukme sauvarṇaṃ puruṣaṃ prākśirasam uttānam \\ hiraṇyagarbhas \\ iti dvābhyām upadadhāti // drapsaś caskanda \\ ity abhimṛśati //
meaning: रुक्मे सौवर्णं पुरुषं प्राक्शिरसम् उत्तानम् \\ हिरण्यगर्भस् \\ इति द्वाभ्याम् उपदधाति // द्रप्सश् चस्कन्द \\ इत्य् अभिमृशति //
text_mt: With the two [verses beginning with]: "The Golden Germ", he lays down a golden man on the gold plate, head to the east, facing upward. With: "The drop leaped down", he touches [him].

sanskrit_iast: namo 'stu sarpebhyas \\ iti tisṛbhiḥ sarpanāmabhir upatiṣṭhate //
meaning: नमो ऽस्तु सर्पेभ्यस् \\ इति तिसृभिः सर्पनामभिर् उपतिष्ठते //
text_mt: With the three [formulas] containing names of serpents: "Homage be to the serpents", he worships.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṇuṣva pājas \\ iti pañcabhir vyāghārayati yathā nābhim /
meaning: कृणुष्व पाजस् \\ इति पञ्चभिर् व्याघारयति यथा नाभिम् /
text_mt: With the five [verses beginning with]: "Assume your power", he trickles clarified butter all around, as at the navel.

sanskrit_iast: kārṣmaryamayīm̐ srucaṃ ghṛtasya pūrṇām ayam agniḥ sahasriṇas \\ agneṣ ṭvā tejasā sādayāmi \\ iti dakṣiṇata upadadhāty audumbarīṃ dadhnaḥ pūrṇām \\ bhuvo yajñasya \\ indrasya tvaujasā sādayāmi \\ ity uttarata upadadhāti /
meaning: कार्ष्मर्यमयीम्̐ स्रुचं घृतस्य पूर्णाम् अयम् अग्निः सहस्रिणस् \\ अग्नेष् ट्वा तेजसा सादयामि \\ इति दक्षिणत उपदधात्य् औदुम्बरीं दध्नः पूर्णाम् \\ भुवो यज्ञस्य \\ इन्द्रस्य त्वौजसा सादयामि \\ इत्य् उत्तरत उपदधाति /
text_mt: With: "This Agni of a thousandfold... By Agni's splendor I place you", he lays down to the south a ladle made of kārṣmarya wood filled with clarified butter; with: "Of the sacrifice, the being... By Indra's might I place you", he lays down to the north [a ladle] made of udumbara wood filled with curds.

sanskrit_iast: svayamātṛṇṇām̐ śarkarām aśvenopaghrāpya bhūr ity abhimantrayate //
meaning: स्वयमातृण्णाम्̐ शर्कराम् अश्वेनोपघ्राप्य भूर् इत्य् अभिमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: Having made the horse sniff the naturally perforated pebble, he addresses it with the mantra: "Bhūḥ!"

sanskrit_iast: dhruvāsi dharuṇā \\ iti sayajuṣaṃ karoti //
meaning: ध्रुवासि धरुणा \\ इति सयजुषं करोति //
text_mt: With: "You are firm, supporting", he makes it accompanied by a yajus formula.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiṣ ṭvā sādayatu \\ iti paryāyeṇopadadhāti puruṣe svayamātṛṇṇāṃ brāhmaṇena sahāviduṣā /
meaning: प्रजापतिष् ट्वा सादयतु \\ इति पर्यायेणोपदधाति पुरुषे स्वयमातृण्णां ब्राह्मणेन सहाविदुषा /
text_mt: Together with an unlearned brahmin, he lays down the naturally perforated [brick] over the [golden] man by turn, with: "May Prajāpati place you".

sanskrit_iast: śiraḥ pratyātṛṇṇam̐ syāt /
meaning: शिरः प्रत्यातृण्णम्̐ स्यात् /
text_mt: The perforation should be toward the head.

sanskrit_iast: abhiprāṇya citiṃ juhomi \\ ity adābhyātṛṇṇe 'bhijuhoti //
meaning: अभिप्राण्य चितिं जुहोमि \\ इत्य् अदाभ्यातृण्णे ऽभिजुहोति //
text_mt: Having breathed upon it, he makes an offering over the naturally perforated [brick], with: "I offer the layer".

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivīm ākramiṣam iti yajamāno japati /
meaning: पृथिवीम् आक्रमिषम् इति यजमानो जपति /
text_mt: The sacrificer mutters: "I have stepped upon the earth".

sanskrit_iast: aviduṣe varaṃ dadāti //
meaning: अविदुषे वरं ददाति //

sanskrit_iast: tejo 'si \ tejo me yacha \\ iti pūrvām̐ hiraṇyeṣṭakām udapurā nāmāsi \\ ity aparāṃ maṇḍalām \\ yās te agna ārdrā yonayas \\ iti dakṣiṇāṃ kulāyinīm uttaram̐ loṣṭaṃ dūrvāmiśraṃ kāṇḍātkāṇḍāt prarohanti \\ iti dvābhyām upadadhāti yathāpnuyur dūrvāḥ svayamātṛṇṇām /
meaning: तेजो ऽसि \ तेजो मे यछ \\ इति पूर्वाम्̐ हिरण्येष्टकाम् उदपुरा नामासि \\ इत्य् अपरां मण्डलाम् \\ यास् ते अग्न आर्द्रा योनयस् \\ इति दक्षिणां कुलायिनीम् उत्तरम्̐ लोष्टं दूर्वामिश्रं काण्डात्काण्डात् प्ररोहन्ति \\ इति द्वाभ्याम् उपदधाति यथाप्नुयुर् दूर्वाः स्वयमातृण्णाम् /
text_mt: With: "You are brilliance; grant me brilliance", [he lays down] the eastern gold-brick; with: "Udapurā by name are you", the western circular one; with: "Those moist origins of yours, O Agni", the southern nest-like one; with the two [verses]: "Sprouting from knot to knot", he lays down a northern clod mixed with dūrvā grass, so that the dūrvā grass reaches the naturally perforated [brick].

sanskrit_iast: pūrvām̐ hiraṇyamūrdhnīm̐ vāmabhṛtaṃ / kācāv am̐sayoḥ syātām̐ // yās te agne sūrye rucas \\ iti dvābhyām upadadhāti //
meaning: पूर्वाम्̐ हिरण्यमूर्ध्नीम्̐ वामभृतं / काचाव् अम्̐सयोः स्याताम्̐ // यास् ते अग्ने सूर्ये रुचस् \\ इति द्वाभ्याम् उपदधाति //
text_mt: The eastern [brick is] the hiraṇyamūrdhnī [gold-headed] and the vāmabhṛt [supporter of beauty]; two beads should be at the shoulders. With the two [verses beginning with]: "Those rays of yours, O Agni, in the sun", he lays [them] down.

sanskrit_iast: virāḍ jyotir adhārayad \ bhūr asi bhuvanasya retas \\ iti retaḥsicam //
meaning: विराड् ज्योतिर् अधारयद् \ भूर् असि भुवनस्य रेतस् \\ इति रेतःसिचम् //
text_mt: With: "The Virāj held the light; you are the earth, the seed of being", [he lays down] a semen-pouring brick.

sanskrit_iast: svarāḍ jyotir adhārayat \ sūr asi suvanasya retas \\ iti dvitīyāṃ / prathamāyāṃ citāv aputrasya putriṇo dvitīyām uttamāyām //
meaning: स्वराड् ज्योतिर् अधारयत् \ सूर् असि सुवनस्य रेतस् \\ इति द्वितीयां / प्रथमायां चिताव् अपुत्रस्य पुत्रिणो द्वितीयाम् उत्तमायाम् //
text_mt: With: "The Svarāj held the light; you are the sun, the seed of impulse", [he lays down] the second one—on the first layer for one without a son; for one having a son, on the top [layer].

sanskrit_iast: samrāḍ jyotir adhārayad iti jyotiṣo dhṛtiṃ pūrvām̐ retaḥsigbhyām //
meaning: सम्राड् ज्योतिर् अधारयद् इति ज्योतिषो धृतिं पूर्वाम्̐ रेतःसिग्भ्याम् //
text_mt: With: "The Samrāj held the light", [he lays down] the Jyotiṣmatī [holder of light] east of the two semen-pouring bricks.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspatiṣ ṭvā sādayatu \\ iti viśvajyotiṣam /
meaning: बृहस्पतिष् ट्वा सादयतु \\ इति विश्वज्योतिषम् /
text_mt: With: "May Bṛhaspati place you", [he lays down] the Viśvajyotis brick.

sanskrit_iast: tasyāḥ pūrvām̐ gharmeṣṭakām araṇye 'dhītenānuvākena //
meaning: तस्याः पूर्वाम्̐ घर्मेष्टकाम् अरण्ये ऽधीतेनानुवाकेन //
text_mt: East of it, [he lays down] the Gharma brick with the anuvāka learned in the forest.

sanskrit_iast: aṣāḍhāsi sahamānā \\ ity aṣāḍhām /
meaning: अषाढासि सहमाना \\ इत्य् अषाढाम् /
text_mt: With: "You are the invincible, the overcoming", [he lays down] the Aṣāḍhā brick.

sanskrit_iast: dadhnā madhumiśreṇa pṛṣataṃ kūrmaṃ madhu vātā ṛtāyate \\ iti tisṛbhir abhyanakti \\ apāṃ tvā gahmant sādayāmi \\ iti purastāt pratyañcam upadadhāti /
meaning: दध्ना मधुमिश्रेण पृषतं कूर्मं मधु वाता ऋतायते \\ इति तिसृभिर् अभ्यनक्ति \\ अपां त्वा गह्मन्त् सादयामि \\ इति पुरस्तात् प्रत्यञ्चम् उपदधाति /
text_mt: With the three [verses beginning with]: "The winds blow sweet to the righteous", he smears a tortoise with curds mixed with honey; with: "I place you in the depth of the waters", he lays it down in front, facing west.

sanskrit_iast:
prādeśamātram ulūkhalamusalam audumbaram
yac cid dhi tvaṃ gṛhegṛhe\ ulūkhalaka yujyase /
iha dyumattamam̐ vada \ jayatām iva dundubhiḥ //
ity abhimantrya tasmin vrīhīn avahanti //
meaning:
प्रादेशमात्रम् उलूखलमुसलम् औदुम्बरम्
यच् चिद् धि त्वं गृहेगृहे\ उलूखलक युज्यसे /
इह द्युमत्तमम्̐ वद \ जयताम् इव दुन्दुभिः //
इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य तस्मिन् व्रीहीन् अवहन्ति //
text_mt:
A mortar and pestle made of udumbara wood, a span in size;

"Even as you in house after house, / O little mortar, are harnessed,

Speak here most resplendently, / like the drum of conquerors!"—

having addressed [it] with this [mantra], he pounds rice in it.

sanskrit_iast: idam̐ viṣṇur vicakrame \\ iti dvābhyām upadadhāti dakṣiṇataḥ purastāt svayamātṛṇṇāyāḥ pra tad viṣṇur ity udañcaṃ musalam //
meaning: इदम्̐ विष्णुर् विचक्रमे \\ इति द्वाभ्याम् उपदधाति दक्षिणतः पुरस्तात् स्वयमातृण्णायाः प्र तद् विष्णुर् इत्य् उदञ्चं मुसलम् //
text_mt: With the two [verses beginning with]: "Through this Viṣṇu strode", he lays down [the mortar] to the south-east of the naturally perforated [brick]; with: "For this Viṣṇu [strode]", the pestle [pointing] north.

sanskrit_iast: naktoṣāsā \ syūtā devebhir ity anuvākaśeṣeṇokhām uttarataḥ purastāt svayamātṛṇṇāyā yāvaty ulūkhalam //
meaning: नक्तोषासा \ स्यूता देवेभिर् इत्य् अनुवाकशेषेणोखाम् उत्तरतः पुरस्तात् स्वयमातृण्णाया यावत्य् उलूखलम् //
text_mt: With the remainder of the anuvāka [beginning with]: "Night and Dawn, woven by the gods", [he lays down] the ukhā [pot] to the north-east of the naturally perforated [brick], at the same distance as the mortar.

sanskrit_iast: agne yukṣvā hi ye tava \\ iti dvābhyām agnim̐ yojayitvā dadhnā madhumiśreṇa sam it sravanti \\ iti śirasāṃ chidrāṇi pūrayitvā hiraṇyaśakalān apyasyati \\ ṛce tvā \\ iti karṇe ruce tvā \\ iti savye bhāse tvā \\ ity akṣiṇi jyotiṣe tvā \\ iti savye \\ abhūd idam iti nāsikāyām agnis tejasā \\ iti savyāyām \\ rukmo varcasā \\ ity āsye sahasradā asi \ sahasrāya tvā \\ iti vikartane //
meaning: अग्ने युक्ष्वा हि ये तव \\ इति द्वाभ्याम् अग्निम्̐ योजयित्वा दध्ना मधुमिश्रेण सम् इत् स्रवन्ति \\ इति शिरसां छिद्राणि पूरयित्वा हिरण्यशकलान् अप्यस्यति \\ ऋचे त्वा \\ इति कर्णे रुचे त्वा \\ इति सव्ये भासे त्वा \\ इत्य् अक्षिणि ज्योतिषे त्वा \\ इति सव्ये \\ अभूद् इदम् इति नासिकायाम् अग्निस् तेजसा \\ इति सव्यायाम् \\ रुक्मो वर्चसा \\ इत्य् आस्ये सहस्रदा असि \ सहस्राय त्वा \\ इति विकर्तने //
text_mt: Having yoked the fire with the two [verses beginning with]: "Agni, harness those which are yours", having filled the orifices of the heads with curds mixed with honey to the verse: "Together they flow", he inserts golden chips: with "For the Ṛc, to you" into the ear; with "For splendour, to you" into the left [ear]; with "For light, to you" into the eye; with "For radiance, to you" into the left [eye]; with "This has come into being" into the nostril; with "Agni by his brilliance" into the left [nostril]; with "The gold plate by luster" into the mouth; with "A thousand-giver are you; for a thousand to you" into the cut off [neck].

sanskrit_iast: ādityaṃ garbham ity ukhāyāṃ puruṣaśīrṣam upadadhāti pratyaṅmukham avākchedam /
meaning: आदित्यं गर्भम् इत्य् उखायां पुरुषशीर्षम् उपदधाति प्रत्यङ्मुखम् अवाक्छेदम् /
text_mt: With: "The embryo of the sun", he places the human head inside the ukhā pot, facing west, with the incision facing down.

sanskrit_iast: abhita itarāṇi parihāram̐ spṛṣṭvetyukhāyām̐ śravaṇakhair hanubhiḥ pratiṣṭhitāni vātasya jūtim ity aśvaśiraḥ purastād ajasram indum ity ṛṣabhasya paścāt tvaṣṭur varutrīm iti vṛṣṇer dakṣiṇatas \\ yo agnir agner iti bastasyottarataḥ //
meaning: अभित इतराणि परिहारम्̐ स्पृष्ट्वेत्युखायाम्̐ श्रवणखैर् हनुभिः प्रतिष्ठितानि वातस्य जूतिम् इत्य् अश्वशिरः पुरस्ताद् अजस्रम् इन्दुम् इत्य् ऋषभस्य पश्चात् त्वष्टुर् वरुत्रीम् इति वृष्णेर् दक्षिणतस् \\ यो अग्निर् अग्नेर् इति बस्तस्योत्तरतः //
text_mt: Around [it], he touches the others in circumambulation; they are placed in the cooking pot standing on their ear-tips and jaws: with "The speed of the wind..." the horse's head in the east, with "The unceasing drop..." the bull's [head] in the west, with "The protectress of Tvaṣṭṛ..." the ram's [head] in the south, [and] with "Which fire of fire..." the he-goat's [head] in the north.

sanskrit_iast: imaṃ mā him̐sīr dvipādam ity utsargair yathopahitam ekaikenopatiṣṭheta /
meaning: इमं मा हिम्̐सीर् द्विपादम् इत्य् उत्सर्गैर् यथोपहितम् एकैकेनोपतिष्ठेत /
text_mt: With the dismissals, beginning with "Do not harm this two-footed one...", he should revere each one in the order it was placed.

sanskrit_iast: puruṣaśiraso 'kṣiṇi citraṃ devānām ity ardharcenābhijuhoti \\ āprā dyāvāpṛthivī \\ iti savye /
meaning: पुरुषशिरसो ऽक्षिणि चित्रं देवानाम् इत्य् अर्धर्चेनाभिजुहोति \\ आप्रा द्यावापृथिवी \\ इति सव्ये /
text_mt: With the half-verse "The wonderful [presence] of the gods...", he offers upon the [right] eye of the human head; with "Filled heaven and earth..." upon the left.

sanskrit_iast: ekaṃ ced ajaśiraḥ syād ukhāyām upadhāyopadhānair utsargair lokān upatiṣṭheta parihāram̐ vā lokeṣu tair mantrair ukhāyām upadhāyopadhānair utsargair upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: एकं चेद् अजशिरः स्याद् उखायाम् उपधायोपधानैर् उत्सर्गैर् लोकान् उपतिष्ठेत परिहारम्̐ वा लोकेषु तैर् मन्त्रैर् उखायाम् उपधायोपधानैर् उत्सर्गैर् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: If there should be only a goat's head, having placed it in the cooking pot, he should revere the spaces with the placement formulas [and] the dismissals; or, touching them in circumambulation in the spaces, having placed it in the cooking pot with those mantras, he reveres [it] with the placement formulas [and] dismissals.

sanskrit_iast: paśuśirām̐si svayamātṛṇṇāṃ cāntareṇa na vyaveyād yadi vyaveyāt tvam̐ yaviṣṭha \\ iti japet /
meaning: पशुशिराम्̐सि स्वयमातृण्णां चान्तरेण न व्यवेयाद् यदि व्यवेयात् त्वम्̐ यविष्ठ \\ इति जपेत् /
text_mt: He should not step between the animal heads and the naturally perforated [brick]; if he should step between [them], he should mutter, "O youngest [Agni]...".

sanskrit_iast: uttarasminn am̐se puruṣacitim upadadhāti //
meaning: उत्तरस्मिन्न् अम्̐से पुरुषचितिम् उपदधाति //
text_mt: He sets down the layer of the man on the northern shoulder.

sanskrit_iast: mā chandas \\ itiprabhṛtayaḥ paryāsās teṣām ekaikena paryāyeṇa yugapat tisrastisra upadadhāti // dhruvāḥ sīdata \\ ityantena /
meaning: मा छन्दस् \\ इतिप्रभृतयः पर्यासास् तेषाम् एकैकेन पर्यायेण युगपत् तिस्रस्तिस्र उपदधाति // ध्रुवाः सीदत \\ इत्यन्तेन /
text_mt: The groups of formulas begin with "Mā meter..."; with each single group among them, he sets down three [bricks] together, ending with "Sit firm!".

sanskrit_iast: uttarārdhāt sarpaśiraḥ sarpanāmabhiḥ parācīnam upadadhāty anudiśed vā nopadadhyāt //
meaning: उत्तरार्धात् सर्पशिरः सर्पनामभिः पराचीनम् उपदधात्य् अनुदिशेद् वा नोपदध्यात् //
text_mt: From the northern half, he places the snake's head facing away with the names of the snake, or he may indicate it [mentally] without setting it down.

sanskrit_iast: apām̐ tvemant sādayāmi \\ itiprabhṛtibhir apasyā dikṣu pūrvārdhād upakramya pradakṣiṇaṃ pañcapañcopadadhāti // gāyatreṇa tvā chandasā sādayāmi \\ itiprabhṛtibhiś chandasyā uttarata upadadhāti //
meaning: अपाम्̐ त्वेमन्त् सादयामि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् अपस्या दिक्षु पूर्वार्धाद् उपक्रम्य प्रदक्षिणं पञ्चपञ्चोपदधाति // गायत्रेण त्वा छन्दसा सादयामि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिश् छन्दस्या उत्तरत उपदधाति //
text_mt: With the formulas beginning with "I seat thee in the path of the waters...", starting from the eastern half, he places five water-bricks in each direction in a clockwise manner. With the formulas beginning with "I seat thee with the Gāyatrī meter...", he places the meter-bricks in the north.

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ puro bhūr itiprabhṛtayaḥ paryāyās teṣām ekaikena paryāyeṇaikaikāṃ daśadaśa prāṇabhṛta upadadhāti dakṣiṇasminn am̐se savyāyām̐ śroṇau dakṣiṇāyām̐ śroṇau savye 'm̐se madhye pañcamam //
meaning: अयं पुरो भूर् इतिप्रभृतयः पर्यायास् तेषाम् एकैकेन पर्यायेणैकैकां दशदश प्राणभृत उपदधाति दक्षिणस्मिन्न् अम्̐से सव्यायाम्̐ श्रोणौ दक्षिणायाम्̐ श्रोणौ सव्ये ऽम्̐से मध्ये पञ्चमम् //
text_mt: The groups of formulas begin with "This one in front is the earth..."; with each single group among them, he sets down the breath-supporter bricks, one by one, ten by ten: on the right shoulder, on the left hip, on the right hip, on the left shoulder, and a fifth [group] in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: prācī dig \ vasanta ṛtur iti paryāyāḥ sam̐yata upadadhāti yathā prāṇabhṛtaḥ /
meaning: प्राची दिग् \ वसन्त ऋतुर् इति पर्यायाः सम्̐यत उपदधाति यथा प्राणभृतः /
text_mt: The groups of formulas are "The eastern direction... The spring season..."; he sets them down joined together, like the breath-supporters.

sanskrit_iast: avakāsv ṛtavyā // madhuś ca mādhavaś ca \\ itiprabhṛtayaḥ paryāyās teṣām ekaikena paryāyeṇa yugapad dvedve cityāṃcityām iṣṭake upadadhāti catasro madhyamāyām //
meaning: अवकास्व् ऋतव्या // मधुश् च माधवश् च \\ इतिप्रभृतयः पर्यायास् तेषाम् एकैकेन पर्यायेण युगपद् द्वेद्वे चित्यांचित्याम् इष्टके उपदधाति चतस्रो मध्यमायाम् //
text_mt: The seasonal bricks are placed upon avakā-plants; the groups of formulas begin with "Madhu and Mādhava..."; with each single group among them, he sets down two bricks together in each layer, and four in the middle [layer].

sanskrit_iast: agner antaḥśleṣo 'si \\ iti yathartu sarvatrānuṣajati dhruve sīdatam ityantena //
meaning: अग्नेर् अन्तःश्लेषो ऽसि \\ इति यथर्तु सर्वत्रानुषजति ध्रुवे सीदतम् इत्यन्तेन //
text_mt: He attaches throughout according to the season "Thou art the inner bond of Agni...", ending with "Sit both firm!".

sanskrit_iast: agner yāny asi \\ iti daśa sam̐yānyas tāsāṃ dvedve cityāṃcityām iṣṭake upadadhāti /
meaning: अग्नेर् यान्य् असि \\ इति दश सम्̐यान्यस् तासां द्वेद्वे चित्यांचित्याम् इष्टके उपदधाति /
text_mt: There are ten Saṃyānī bricks [with the formulas beginning with] "Thou art the vehicle of Agni..."; he sets down two of these bricks in each layer.

sanskrit_iast:
tvām agne vṛṣabhaṃ cekitānam \\ punar yuvānaṃ janayann upāgām /
asthūri nau gārhapatyāni santu \ tigmena nas tejasā sam̐śiśādhi //
ity ṛṣabheṇa cityāṃcityām iṣṭakā upadadhāty ṛjulekhāḥ puche samaṃ paścāt prācīṃ purastāt pratīcīm upadadhāti dakṣiṇāvṛto dakṣiṇata ātmany udagdvārāḥ pratyagdvārāḥ pakṣe savyāvṛta uttarata ātmani dakṣiṇādvārāḥ prāgdvārāḥ pakṣe /
meaning:
त्वाम् अग्ने वृषभं चेकितानम् \\ पुनर् युवानं जनयन्न् उपागाम् /
अस्थूरि नौ गार्हपत्यानि सन्तु \ तिग्मेन नस् तेजसा सम्̐शिशाधि //
इत्य् ऋषभेण चित्यांचित्याम् इष्टका उपदधात्य् ऋजुलेखाः पुछे समं पश्चात् प्राचीं पुरस्तात् प्रतीचीम् उपदधाति दक्षिणावृतो दक्षिणत आत्मन्य् उदग्द्वाराः प्रत्यग्द्वाराः पक्षे सव्यावृत उत्तरत आत्मनि दक्षिणाद्वाराः प्राग्द्वाराः पक्षे /
text_mt: With the bull-hymn: "To thee, O Agni, the attentive bull, / I have approached, generating the ever-young one; / may our household fires be unailing; / sharpen us with sharp radiance," / he sets down the straight-lined bricks in each layer: equal in the tail at the back; in the east he sets down [one] facing east, [and one] facing west; turning clockwise in the south on the body [they are] facing north, facing west on the wing; turning counter-clockwise in the north on the body [they are] facing south, facing east on the wing.

sanskrit_iast: lokaṃpṛṇayā citim̐ saṃpūrayati //
meaning: लोकंपृणया चितिम्̐ संपूरयति //
text_mt: He fills up the layer with the space-filling brick.

sanskrit_iast: agne dhāmāni \\ iti svayamātṛṇṇāloke citiṃcitim abhimṛśati //
meaning: अग्ने धामानि \\ इति स्वयमातृण्णालोके चितिंचितिम् अभिमृशति //
text_mt: With "The abodes of Agni...", he touches each layer at the space of the naturally perforated brick.

sanskrit_iast: agne kahya \\ iti svayamātṛṇṇāloke citiṃcitim abhijuhoti //
meaning: अग्ने कह्य \\ इति स्वयमातृण्णालोके चितिंचितिम् अभिजुहोति //
text_mt: With "O Agni, kahya...", he offers upon each layer at the space of the naturally perforated brick.

sanskrit_iast: yā ta iṣur yuvā nāma \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati //
meaning: या त इषुर् युवा नाम \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति //
text_mt: He attaches throughout: "Whose arrow is named the youthful...".

sanskrit_iast: yo apsv antar agnir ity ekaikayā citihomān anumantrayate dvābhyām uttamam /
meaning: यो अप्स्व् अन्तर् अग्निर् इत्य् एकैकया चितिहोमान् अनुमन्त्रयते द्वाभ्याम् उत्तमम् /
text_mt: With each single [verse beginning with] "The fire that is within the waters...", he accompanies the offerings of the layers; with two [verses], the last [offering].

sanskrit_iast: aśvam̐ śyāvam ālabhya pṛṣṭo divi \\ iti cātvālāt purīṣeṇa citim̐ saṃchādayati saṃchādayati /
meaning: अश्वम्̐ श्यावम् आलभ्य पृष्टो दिवि \\ इति चात्वालात् पुरीषेण चितिम्̐ संछादयति संछादयति /
text_mt: Having seized a dark horse, with "He who was searched out in heaven...", he completely covers the layer with earth from the pit—he completely covers [it].

sanskrit_iast: āparāhṇikyau pravargyopasadāv upetya vasanti /
meaning: आपराह्णिक्यौ प्रवर्ग्योपसदाव् उपेत्य वसन्ति /
text_mt: Having performed the Pravargya and Upasad rites of the afternoon, they stay [for the night].

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvaṃ pūrvāhṇikībhyām āśvinībhir dvitīyāṃ citim ārabhante dhruvakṣitir dhruvayonir itiprabhṛtibhiḥ pañca lokeṣu /
meaning: ऊर्ध्वं पूर्वाह्णिकीभ्याम् आश्विनीभिर् द्वितीयां चितिम् आरभन्ते ध्रुवक्षितिर् ध्रुवयोनिर् इतिप्रभृतिभिः पञ्च लोकेषु /
text_mt: After the morning rites, they begin the second layer with the Āśvinī bricks, five [bricks] in the spaces, with the formulas beginning with "Thou art firm-dwelling, thou art of firm origin...".

sanskrit_iast: āśvinīr ṛtavyā anūpadhīyante sajūr ṛtubhir itiprabhṛtibhiḥ pañca // sajūr devair vayunādhair iti sarvatrānuṣajati /
meaning: आश्विनीर् ऋतव्या अनूपधीयन्ते सजूर् ऋतुभिर् इतिप्रभृतिभिः पञ्च // सजूर् देवैर् वयुनाधैर् इति सर्वत्रानुषजति /
text_mt: The seasonal bricks are placed after the Āśvinī bricks: five with the formulas beginning with "In concord with the seasons..."; he attaches throughout: "In concord with the gods, the setters of bounds...".

sanskrit_iast: ṛtavyā vāyavyā anūpadhīyante prāṇaṃ me pāhi \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ pañca /
meaning: ऋतव्या वायव्या अनूपधीयन्ते प्राणं मे पाहि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः पञ्च /
text_mt: The wind-bricks are placed after the seasonal bricks: five with the formulas beginning with "Protect my out-breath...".

sanskrit_iast: vāyavyā apasyā anūpadhīyante \\ apaḥ pinva \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ pañca /
meaning: वायव्या अपस्या अनूपधीयन्ते \\ अपः पिन्व \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः पञ्च /
text_mt: The water-bricks are placed after the wind-bricks: five with the formulas beginning with "Swell the waters...".

sanskrit_iast: apasyā vayasyā anūpadhīyante kṣatram̐ vayas \\ mayantaṃ chandas \\ iti catasraḥ pūrvārdhe 'pyayeṣu pañcapañca /
meaning: अपस्या वयस्या अनूपधीयन्ते क्षत्रम्̐ वयस् \\ मयन्तं छन्दस् \\ इति चतस्रः पूर्वार्धे ऽप्ययेषु पञ्चपञ्च /
text_mt: The age-bricks are placed after the water-bricks: four [beginning with] "Dominion is age... Māyanta is the meter..." in the eastern half, [and] five in each of the junctions.

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātāḥ sārvacitikyo lokaṃpṛṇā purīṣaṃ ca /
meaning: व्याख्याताः सार्वचितिक्यो लोकंपृणा पुरीषं च /
text_mt: The space-filler [bricks] belonging to all layers and the earth are explained.

sanskrit_iast: āparāhṇikyau pravargyopasadāv upetya vasanti /
meaning: आपराह्णिक्यौ प्रवर्ग्योपसदाव् उपेत्य वसन्ति /
text_mt: Having performed the Pravargya and Upasad rites of the afternoon, they stay [for the night].

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvaṃ pūrvāhṇikībhyāṃ tṛtīyāṃ citim ārabhante /
meaning: ऊर्ध्वं पूर्वाह्णिकीभ्यां तृतीयां चितिम् आरभन्ते /
text_mt: After the morning rites, they begin the third layer.

sanskrit_iast: svayamātṛṇṇām̐ śarkarām aśvenopaghrāpya bhuvas \\ ity abhimantrayate //
meaning: स्वयमातृण्णाम्̐ शर्कराम् अश्वेनोपघ्राप्य भुवस् \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: Having made the horse sniff the naturally perforated gravel, he addresses it with "Bhuvas!".

sanskrit_iast: indrāgnī avyathamānām iti sayajuṣaṃ karoti //
meaning: इन्द्राग्नी अव्यथमानाम् इति सयजुषं करोति //
text_mt: With "Indra and Agni, unshakeable...", he makes it accompanied by a yajus formula.

sanskrit_iast: viśvakarmā tvā sādayatu \\ iti paryāyeṇopadadhāti /
meaning: विश्वकर्मा त्वा सादयतु \\ इति पर्यायेणोपदधाति /
text_mt: He sets it down with the formula "May Viśvakarman seat thee...".

sanskrit_iast: nātrāvidvān na varadānam /
meaning: नात्राविद्वान् न वरदानम् /
text_mt: Here, no unlearned person [may set it down], nor [is there] the granting of a wish.

sanskrit_iast: abhiprāṇyāpānya citiṃ juhomi \\ ity adābhyātṛṇṇe 'bhijuhoti //
meaning: अभिप्राण्यापान्य चितिं जुहोमि \\ इत्य् अदाभ्यातृण्णे ऽभिजुहोति //
text_mt: With "Breathing in and breathing out, I offer the layer...", he offers upon the undaunted-perforated [brick].

sanskrit_iast: antarikṣam ākramiṣam iti yajamāno japati //
meaning: अन्तरिक्षम् आक्रमिषम् इति यजमानो जपति //
text_mt: The sacrificer mutters: "I have traversed the intermediate space...".

sanskrit_iast: jyotir asi \ jyotir me yacha \\ iti pūrvām̐ hiraṇyeṣṭakām aparājitā nāmāsi \\ ity aparāṃ maṇḍalām //
meaning: ज्योतिर् असि \ ज्योतिर् मे यछ \\ इति पूर्वाम्̐ हिरण्येष्टकाम् अपराजिता नामासि \\ इत्य् अपरां मण्डलाम् //
text_mt: With "Thou art light; give me light!", [he places] the eastern gold brick; with "Thou art unconquered by name!", the western round [gold brick].

sanskrit_iast: viśvakarmā tvā sādayatu \\ iti viśvajyotiṣam //
meaning: विश्वकर्मा त्वा सादयतु \\ इति विश्वज्योतिषम् //
text_mt: With "May Viśvakarman seat thee...", [he places] the all-light brick.

sanskrit_iast: rājñy asi \ prācī dig itiprabhṛtibhiḥ pañca diśyā lokeṣu //
meaning: राज्ञ्य् असि \ प्राची दिग् इतिप्रभृतिभिः पञ्च दिश्या लोकेषु //
text_mt: Five directional bricks [are set down] in the spaces with the formulas beginning with "Thou art queen; the eastern direction...".

sanskrit_iast: āyur me pāhi \\ itiprabhṛtibhir apyayeṣu daśa pūrvārdhe dvādaśādvādaśetareṣu //
meaning: आयुर् मे पाहि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् अप्ययेषु दश पूर्वार्धे द्वादशाद्वादशेतरेषु //
text_mt: With the formulas beginning with "Protect my life...", [he sets down] ten at the junctions in the eastern half, and twelve in each of the others.

sanskrit_iast: mūrdhāsi rāḍ itiprabhṛtibhir ādityadhāmnīḥ sapta purastād yantrī rāḍ itiprabhṛtibhir aṅgirodhāmnīḥ sapta paścāt /
meaning: मूर्धासि राड् इतिप्रभृतिभिर् आदित्यधाम्नीः सप्त पुरस्ताद् यन्त्री राड् इतिप्रभृतिभिर् अङ्गिरोधाम्नीः सप्त पश्चात् /
text_mt: With the formulas beginning with "The head art thou, the ruler...", [he sets down] seven Āditya-abode bricks in the east; with the formulas beginning with "The supporter art thou, the ruler...", seven Aṅgiras-abode bricks in the west.

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātāḥ sārvacitikyo lokaṃpṛṇā purīṣaṃ ca /
meaning: व्याख्याताः सार्वचितिक्यो लोकंपृणा पुरीषं च /
text_mt: The space-filler [bricks] belonging to all layers and the earth are explained.

sanskrit_iast: āparāhṇikyau pravargyopasadāv upetya vasanti /
meaning: आपराह्णिक्यौ प्रवर्ग्योपसदाव् उपेत्य वसन्ति /
text_mt: Having performed the Pravargya and Upasad rites of the afternoon, they stay [for the night].

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvaṃ pūrvāhṇikībhyām akṣṇayāstomīyābhiś caturthīṃ citim ārabhanta āśus trivṛd iti purastād vyomā saptadaśas \\ iti dakṣiṇatas \\ bhāntaḥ pañcadaśas \\ ity uttaratas \\ dharuṇa ekavim̐śas \\ iti paścād garbhāḥ pañcavim̐śas \\ iti madhye / pañcadaśa śiṣṭās tisrastisro lokeṣūpadadhāti /
meaning: ऊर्ध्वं पूर्वाह्णिकीभ्याम् अक्ष्णयास्तोमीयाभिश् चतुर्थीं चितिम् आरभन्त आशुस् त्रिवृद् इति पुरस्ताद् व्योमा सप्तदशस् \\ इति दक्षिणतस् \\ भान्तः पञ्चदशस् \\ इत्य् उत्तरतस् \\ धरुण एकविम्̐शस् \\ इति पश्चाद् गर्भाः पञ्चविम्̐शस् \\ इति मध्ये / पञ्चदश शिष्टास् तिस्रस्तिस्रो लोकेषूपदधाति /
text_mt: After the morning rites, they begin the fourth layer with the crosswise-stoma bricks: with "Swift, the ninefold..." in the east, with "Sky, the seventeenfold..." in the south, with "Radiant, the fifteenfold..." in the north, with "Supporter, the twenty-onefold..." in the west, [and] with "Embryos, the twenty-fivefold..." in the middle; the fifteen remaining [bricks] he sets down three by three in the spaces.

sanskrit_iast: spṛta upadadhāti \\ agner bhāgo 'si \\ iti purastād indrasya bhāgo 'si \\ iti dakṣiṇatas \\ nṛcakṣasāṃ bhāgo 'si \\ ity uttaratas \\ mitrasya bhāgo 'si \\ iti paścād adityā bhāgo 'si \\ iti madhye / śiṣṭāḥ pañcānūpadadhāti //
meaning: स्पृत उपदधाति \\ अग्नेर् भागो ऽसि \\ इति पुरस्ताद् इन्द्रस्य भागो ऽसि \\ इति दक्षिणतस् \\ नृचक्षसां भागो ऽसि \\ इत्य् उत्तरतस् \\ मित्रस्य भागो ऽसि \\ इति पश्चाद् अदित्या भागो ऽसि \\ इति मध्ये / शिष्टाः पञ्चानूपदधाति //
text_mt: He sets down the saving bricks: with "Thou art the portion of Agni..." in the east, with "Thou art the portion of Indra..." in the south, with "Thou art the portion of the watchers of men..." in the north, with "Thou art the portion of Mitra..." in the west, [and] with "Thou art the portion of Aditi..." in the middle; the remaining five he sets down subsequently.

sanskrit_iast: ekayāstuvata \ prajā adhīyanta \\ iti saptadaśa sṛṣṭīr madhya upadadhāti //
meaning: एकयास्तुवत \ प्रजा अधीयन्त \\ इति सप्तदश सृष्टीर् मध्य उपदधाति //
text_mt: With "With the one they praised; creatures were created...", he sets down seventeen creation-bricks in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtūnāṃ patnī \\ iti pañcadaśa vyuṣṭīs tisrastisro lokeṣūpadadhāti /
meaning: ऋतूनां पत्नी \\ इति पञ्चदश व्युष्टीस् तिस्रस्तिस्रो लोकेषूपदधाति /
text_mt: With [the formulas beginning with] “Wife of the seasons,” he places fifteen vyuṣṭi [bricks], three in each region.

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātāḥ sārvacitikyo lokaṃpṛṇā purīṣaṃ ca /
meaning: व्याख्याताः सार्वचितिक्यो लोकंपृणा पुरीषं च /
text_mt: The lokaṃpṛṇā [bricks] common to all layers and the loose soil have already been explained.

sanskrit_iast: āparāhṇikyau pravargyopasadāv upetya vasanti /
meaning: आपराह्णिक्यौ प्रवर्ग्योपसदाव् उपेत्य वसन्ति /
text_mt: Having undertaken the afternoon Pravargya and Upasad rites, they stay overnight.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvaṃ pūrvāhṇikībhyām /
meaning: ऊर्ध्वं पूर्वाह्णिकीभ्याम् /
text_mt: [The following is done] after the morning [Pravargya and Upasad rites]:

sanskrit_iast: asapatnayottamāṃ citim ārabhanta agne jātān praṇudā naḥ sapatnān iti purastāt sahasā jātān praṇudā naḥ sapatnān iti paścāt \\ catuścatvārim̐śī stomas \\ varco draviṇam iti dakṣiṇataḥ sādayati ṣoḍaśī stomas \\ ojo draviṇam ity uttaratas \\ agneḥ purīṣam asi \\ iti purīṣavatīṃ paścāt svayamātṛṇṇāyāḥ //
meaning: असपत्नयोत्तमां चितिम् आरभन्त अग्ने जातान् प्रणुदा नः सपत्नान् इति पुरस्तात् सहसा जातान् प्रणुदा नः सपत्नान् इति पश्चात् \\ चतुश्चत्वारिम्̐शी स्तोमस् \\ वर्चो द्रविणम् इति दक्षिणतः सादयति षोडशी स्तोमस् \\ ओजो द्रविणम् इत्य् उत्तरतस् \\ अग्नेः पुरीषम् असि \\ इति पुरीषवतीं पश्चात् स्वयमातृण्णायाः //
text_mt: They begin the topmost layer with an asapatnā [brick]. With “O Agni, repel our born rivals,” [he places one] in the east; with “By might repel our born rivals,” in the west. With “The forty-fourfold stoma / splendor, wealth,” he places [one] in the south; with “The sixteenfold stoma / vigor, wealth,” in the north; with “You are the loose soil of Agni,” [he places] the purīṣavatī [brick] to the west of the naturally perforated stone.

sanskrit_iast: ekaś chandas \\ iti catvārim̐śatam̐ virājo 'pyayeṣu daśadaśa //
meaning: एकश् छन्दस् \\ इति चत्वारिम्̐शतम्̐ विराजो ऽप्ययेषु दशदश //
text_mt: With [the formulas beginning with] “One is the meter,” [he places] forty virāj [bricks], ten in each of the junctions.

sanskrit_iast: raśminā kṣayāya kṣayaṃ jinva \\ iti trayastrim̐śatam̐ stomabhāgā dikṣu / pūrvārdhād upakramya pradakṣiṇam̐ saptasapta pañca madhye //
meaning: रश्मिना क्षयाय क्षयं जिन्व \\ इति त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शतम्̐ स्तोमभागा दिक्षु / पूर्वार्धाद् उपक्रम्य प्रदक्षिणम्̐ सप्तसप्त पञ्च मध्ये //
text_mt: With [the formulas beginning with] “By a ray quicken dominion for dwelling,” [he places] thirty-three stomabhāgā [bricks] in the quarters: starting from the eastern half, clockwise, seven in each, [and] five in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: rājñy asi \ prācī dig itiprabhṛtibhiḥ pañca nākasado lokeṣu //
meaning: राज्ञ्य् असि \ प्राची दिग् इतिप्रभृतिभिः पञ्च नाकसदो लोकेषु //
text_mt: With [the formulas] beginning with “You are the queen; the eastern quarter,” [he places] five nākasad [bricks] in the regions.

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ puro harikeśas \\ iti nākasadām upariṣṭāt pañcacūḍāḥ paścāt prācīm uttamām //
meaning: अयं पुरो हरिकेशस् \\ इति नाकसदाम् उपरिष्टात् पञ्चचूडाः पश्चात् प्राचीम् उत्तमाम् //
text_mt: With [the formulas beginning with] “This one in front, the golden-haired,” [he places] five pañcacūḍā [bricks] above the nākasad [bricks], the last one facing east in the west.

sanskrit_iast: prācyā tvā diśā sādayāmi \\ iti kḷptīr upadadhāti śirasi pakṣapucheṣu madhye pañcamīm /
meaning: प्राच्या त्वा दिशा सादयामि \\ इति कॢप्तीर् उपदधाति शिरसि पक्षपुछेषु मध्ये पञ्चमीम् /
text_mt: With [the formulas beginning with] “I place you with the eastern quarter,” he places the kḷpti [bricks]: on the head, on the wings, on the tail, and the fifth in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: viharann atraiva retaḥsicam upadadhāti //
meaning: विहरन्न् अत्रैव रेतःसिचम् उपदधाति //
text_mt: Distributing them, he places a retaḥsic [brick] right here.

sanskrit_iast: parameṣṭhī tvā sādayatu \\ iti viśvajyotiṣam /
meaning: परमेष्ठी त्वा सादयतु \\ इति विश्वज्योतिषम् /
text_mt: With “May Parameṣṭhin place you,” [he places] the viśvajyotis [brick].

sanskrit_iast: ṛtavye upadhāya purovāta \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ pañca vṛṣṭisanīr lokeṣu /
meaning: ऋतव्ये उपधाय पुरोवात \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः पञ्च वृष्टिसनीर् लोकेषु /
text_mt: Having placed two seasonal bricks, [he places] five vṛṣṭisani [bricks] in the regions with [the formulas] beginning with “The forward wind.”

sanskrit_iast: sam̐yānye upadhāya vāca upadadhāti \\ ambā ca bulā ca \\ iti sapta pūrvārdhe //
meaning: सम्̐यान्ये उपधाय वाच उपदधाति \\ अम्बा च बुला च \\ इति सप्त पूर्वार्धे //
text_mt: Having placed two saṃyānī [bricks], he places the speech [bricks]—seven in the eastern half—with “Ambā and Bulā.”

sanskrit_iast: salilāya tvā \\ itiprabhṛtibhir ādityeṣṭakā apyayeṣu dvedve madhye ca //
meaning: सलिलाय त्वा \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् आदित्येष्टका अप्ययेषु द्वेद्वे मध्ये च //
text_mt: With [the formulas] beginning with “To the flood, you,” [he places] the ādityeṣṭakā bricks, two in each junction and [two] in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: adhidyaur nāmāsi \\ ity aparāṃ maṇḍalām /
meaning: अधिद्यौर् नामासि \\ इत्य् अपरां मण्डलाम् /
text_mt: With “Your name is Adhidyo,” [he places] another maṇḍalā [brick].

sanskrit_iast: uttarataḥ purastāt svayamātṛṇṇāyās \\ ayam̐ so agnir ity aṣṭau nānāyajuṣa upadadhāti yathā gārhapatye /
meaning: उत्तरतः पुरस्तात् स्वयमातृण्णायास् \\ अयम्̐ सो अग्निर् इत्य् अष्टौ नानायजुष उपदधाति यथा गार्हपत्ये /
text_mt: To the north-east of the naturally perforated stone, he places eight bricks with different sacrificial formulas with “This is that Agni,” as in the case of the gārhapatya.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvāṃ punaścitim \\ yena ṛṣayas tapasā satram āsata \\ iti mavatāsām aṣṭābhiḥ //
meaning: पूर्वां पुनश्चितिम् \\ येन ऋषयस् तपसा सत्रम् आसत \\ इति मवतासाम् अष्टाभिः //
text_mt: With the eight [formulas] belonging to Mavat, beginning with “By which austerity the seers sat at the sacrificial session,” [he places] the previous punaściti [bricks].

sanskrit_iast: samās tvāgna ṛtavo vardhayantu \\ iti daśa dvedve lokeṣu //
meaning: समास् त्वाग्न ऋतवो वर्धयन्तु \\ इति दश द्वेद्वे लोकेषु //
text_mt: With [the formulas beginning with] “May the years, O Agni, may the seasons make you grow,” [he places] ten [bricks], two in each region.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvā asya samidho bhavanti \\ iti dvādaśāprīr apyayeṣu tisrastisraḥ //
meaning: ऊर्ध्वा अस्य समिधो भवन्ति \\ इति द्वादशाप्रीर् अप्ययेषु तिस्रस्तिस्रः //
text_mt: With [the formulas beginning with] “Upright are his kindling sticks,” [he places] twelve āprī [bricks], three in each junction.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇād apānam̐ saṃtanu \\ iti nava saṃtatīḥ purastāt pratīcīr upadadhāti //
meaning: प्राणाद् अपानम्̐ संतनु \\ इति नव संततीः पुरस्तात् प्रतीचीर् उपदधाति //
text_mt: With [the formulas beginning with] “Join the out-breath with the in-breath,” he places nine saṃtati [bricks] in the east, facing west.

sanskrit_iast: ṛcā tvā chandasā sādayāmi \\ itiprabhṛtibhir apyayeṣu dvedve //
meaning: ऋचा त्वा छन्दसा सादयामि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् अप्ययेषु द्वेद्वे //
text_mt: With [the formulas] beginning with “I place you with the ṛc meter,” [he places] two in each junction.

sanskrit_iast: dūtam̐ vo viśvavedasam iti pañca lokeṣu //
meaning: दूतम्̐ वो विश्ववेदसम् इति पञ्च लोकेषु //
text_mt: With [the formulas beginning with] “The messenger for you, who knows all,” [he places] five in the regions.

sanskrit_iast: indro dadhīco asthabhir iti daśa pūrvārdhe /
meaning: इन्द्रो दधीचो अस्थभिर् इति दश पूर्वार्धे /
text_mt: With [the formulas beginning with] “Indra with Dadhīc’s bones,” [he places] ten in the eastern half.

sanskrit_iast:
chandaścitīr upadadhāty apyayeṣu tisrastisro 'ntarāantarā ayam agniḥ sahasriṇas \\ iti tisṛbhir gāyatrībhir abodhy agnir iti triṣṭubbhir janasya gopās \\ iti jagatībhiḥ sam̐sam id ity anuṣṭubbhir ā te agna idhīmahi \\ iti paṅktibhir enā vo agnim iti bṛhatībhir agne vājasya gomatas \\ ity uṣṇigbhir dve tisraḥ karoti
bhadro no agnir āhutas\ bhadrā rātiḥ subhaga bhadro adhvaraḥ /
bhadrā uta praśastayaḥ //
bhadrā uta praśastayas\ bhadraṃ manaḥ kṛṇuṣva vṛtratūrye /
yenā samatsu sāsahi //
yenā samatsu sāsahi\ ava sthirā tanuhi bhūri śardhatām /
vanemā te abhiṣṭibhiḥ //
iti kakudbhiḥ preddho agne \\ imo agne
agniṃ naro dīdhitibhir araṇyor \ hastacyutī janayanta praśastam /
dūredṛśaṃ gṛhapatim atharyum //
meaning:
छन्दश्चितीर् उपदधात्य् अप्ययेषु तिस्रस्तिस्रो ऽन्तराअन्तरा अयम् अग्निः सहस्रिणस् \\ इति तिसृभिर् गायत्रीभिर् अबोध्य् अग्निर् इति त्रिष्टुब्भिर् जनस्य गोपास् \\ इति जगतीभिः सम्̐सम् इद् इत्य् अनुष्टुब्भिर् आ ते अग्न इधीमहि \\ इति पङ्क्तिभिर् एना वो अग्निम् इति बृहतीभिर् अग्ने वाजस्य गोमतस् \\ इत्य् उष्णिग्भिर् द्वे तिस्रः करोति
भद्रो नो अग्निर् आहुतस्\ भद्रा रातिः सुभग भद्रो अध्वरः /
भद्रा उत प्रशस्तयः //
भद्रा उत प्रशस्तयस्\ भद्रं मनः कृणुष्व वृत्रतूर्ये /
येना समत्सु सासहि //
येना समत्सु सासहि\ अव स्थिरा तनुहि भूरि शर्धताम् /
वनेमा ते अभिष्टिभिः //
इति ककुद्भिः प्रेद्धो अग्ने \\ इमो अग्ने
अग्निं नरो दीधितिभिर् अरण्योर् \ हस्तच्युती जनयन्त प्रशस्तम् /
दूरेदृशं गृहपतिम् अथर्युम् //
text_mt:
He places chandaściti bricks, three in each junction between [the others]: with three gāyatrī verses, “This fire of a thousand”; with triṣṭubh verses, “Agni has been awakened”; with jagatī verses, “Guardian of the people”; with anuṣṭubh verses, “Kindle, kindle”; with paṅkti verses, “We would kindle you, O Agni”; with bṛhatī verses, “Thus to Agni, you”; with uṣṇih verses, “O Agni, of prize, rich in cattle”—he makes two [into] three.

“Auspicious to us is Agni when invoked; / auspicious is the gift, O fortunate one, auspicious the sacrifice;

and auspicious our praises.

And auspicious our praises; / make your mind auspicious in the slaying of Vṛtra,

Whereby you prevail in battles, / bend low the steadfast [bows] of the many who defy us;

With kakubh verses, [the verses beginning with] these [words; with] “Kindled, O Agni,” [and] “These, O Agni”,

“The men with thoughts have generated / Agni from the two fire-sticks with hands moving, praised,

sanskrit_iast: iti virāḍbhir agne tam adya \\ iti padapaṅktibhir agnim̐ hotāraṃ manye \\ iti chandobhir agne tvaṃ no antamas \ taṃ tvā śociṣṭha dīdivas \\ adhā hy agne \\ iti dvipadābhir uttarārdhe /
meaning: इति विराड्भिर् अग्ने तम् अद्य \\ इति पदपङ्क्तिभिर् अग्निम्̐ होतारं मन्ये \\ इति छन्दोभिर् अग्ने त्वं नो अन्तमस् \ तं त्वा शोचिष्ठ दीदिवस् \\ अधा ह्य् अग्ने \\ इति द्विपदाभिर् उत्तरार्धे /
text_mt:
far-seeing, lord of the house, burning.”

With virāj verses, [such as this;] with padapaṅkti verses, with “Agni today”; with chandas verses, with “I consider Agni the hotṛ priest”; with dvipadā verses, with “O Agni, you are nearest to us,” “To you, brightest, shining,” [and] “Then indeed, O Agni,” [he places them] in the northern half.

sanskrit_iast: mahāvratam upadadhāti \\ āyāhi saṣumā hi te \\ iti tisṛbhiḥ gāyatrībhiḥ śirasi / rathaṃtaraṃ pakṣe \\ abhi tvā śūra nonumas \\ iti dve tisras kāraṃ dakṣiṇārdhe madhye 'pyaye ca / bṛhad uttarasmin \\ tvām id dhi havāmahe \\ iti dve tisras kāram uttarārdhe madhye 'pyaye cātmani vāmadevyaṃ kayā naś citra ābhuvad iti tisro madhye / yajñāyajñiyaṃ puche yajñāyajñā vo agnaye \\ iti dve tisras kāraṃ paścārdhe madhye 'pyaye ca //
meaning: महाव्रतम् उपदधाति \\ आयाहि सषुमा हि ते \\ इति तिसृभिः गायत्रीभिः शिरसि / रथंतरं पक्षे \\ अभि त्वा शूर नोनुमस् \\ इति द्वे तिस्रस् कारं दक्षिणार्धे मध्ये ऽप्यये च / बृहद् उत्तरस्मिन् \\ त्वाम् इद् धि हवामहे \\ इति द्वे तिस्रस् कारम् उत्तरार्धे मध्ये ऽप्यये चात्मनि वामदेव्यं कया नश् चित्र आभुवद् इति तिस्रो मध्ये / यज्ञायज्ञियं पुछे यज्ञायज्ञा वो अग्नये \\ इति द्वे तिस्रस् कारं पश्चार्धे मध्ये ऽप्यये च //
text_mt: He places the Mahāvrata [sāman bricks]: with three gāyatrī verses, “Come, for you have been pressed,” on the head; the Rathaṃtara on the [right] wing, making two [verses] into three with “To you, hero, we shout,” in the southern half, in the middle, and at the junction; the Bṛhat on the northern [wing], making two [verses] into three with “You indeed we call upon,” in the northern half, in the middle, and at the junction; on the body, the Vāmadevya with three [verses], “In what wonderful way did he become ours,” in the middle; the Yajñāyajñiya on the tail, making two [verses] into three with “At every sacrifice to your Agni,” in the western half, in the middle, and at the junction.

sanskrit_iast: yavā ayavās \\ iti sapta pūrvārdhe //
meaning: यवा अयवास् \\ इति सप्त पूर्वार्धे //
text_mt: With [the formulas beginning with] “Barley, non-barley,” [he places] seven in the eastern half.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivy asi janmanā \\ itiprabhṛtibhir apyayeṣu dvedve //
meaning: पृथिव्य् असि जन्मना \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् अप्ययेषु द्वेद्वे //
text_mt: With [the formulas] beginning with “You are earth by birth,” [he places] two in each junction.

sanskrit_iast: yā devy asīṣṭake kumāry upaśīvarī \\ itiprabhṛtibhir apyayeṣu tisrastisras \\ yā devy asīṣṭaka āyurdās \\ iti navasv anuṣajati \\ upaśīvarī \\ ity upariṣṭād yā devīḥ stheṣṭakāḥ suśevās \\ iti madhye yugapat tisraḥ //
meaning: या देव्य् असीष्टके कुमार्य् उपशीवरी \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् अप्ययेषु तिस्रस्तिस्रस् \\ या देव्य् असीष्टक आयुर्दास् \\ इति नवस्व् अनुषजति \\ उपशीवरी \\ इत्य् उपरिष्टाद् या देवीः स्थेष्टकाः सुशेवास् \\ इति मध्ये युगपत् तिस्रः //
text_mt: With [the formulas] beginning with “Which goddess you are, O brick, young girl, lying beside,” [he places] three in each junction; with “Which goddess you are, O brick, granting life,” he attaches [it] to the nine; with “Lying beside,” above; with “Which goddesses you are, O bricks, very gracious,” [he places] three together in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: savayase tvā \\ itiprabhṛtibhir apyayeṣu tisrastisraḥ //
meaning: सवयसे त्वा \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् अप्ययेषु तिस्रस्तिस्रः //
text_mt: With [the formulas] beginning with “To you of equal strength,” [he places] three in each junction.

sanskrit_iast: bhūyaskṛd asi \\ itiprabhṛtibhir apyayeṣu pañcāpañcīnāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ pañcapañcopadadhāti //
meaning: भूयस्कृद् असि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् अप्ययेषु पञ्चापञ्चीनाः प्रदक्षिणं पञ्चपञ्चोपदधाति //
text_mt: With [the formulas] beginning with “You are an enhancer,” he places five in each junction, five clockwise, five facing each other.

sanskrit_iast: jyotiṣmatīṃ tvā sādayāmi \\ itiprabhṛtibhir apyayeṣu tisrastisro dve madhye //
meaning: ज्योतिष्मतीं त्वा सादयामि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् अप्ययेषु तिस्रस्तिस्रो द्वे मध्ये //
text_mt: With [the formulas] beginning with “I place you, full of light,” [he places] three in each junction and two in the middle.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛttikā nakṣatram \ agnir devatā \\ itiprabhṛtibhir nakṣatreṣṭakāḥ purastāt pratīcīr upadadhāti \\ agne rucaḥ stha \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati / purastād viśākhayoḥ
pūrṇā paścād uta pūrṇā purastād \ un madhyataḥ paurṇamāsī jigāya /
yasyāṃ devā abhi sam̐viśantas\ uttame nāka iha mādayadhvam //
iti paurṇamāsīm upariṣṭād bharaṇīnām
yat te devā adadhur bhāgadheyam \ amāvāsye sam̐viśanto mahitvā /
sā naḥ prajāṃ kṛṇuhi sarvavīre \ rayiṃ no dhehi subhage suvīre //
ity amāvāsyām //
meaning:
कृत्तिका नक्षत्रम् \ अग्निर् देवता \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् नक्षत्रेष्टकाः पुरस्तात् प्रतीचीर् उपदधाति \\ अग्ने रुचः स्थ \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति / पुरस्ताद् विशाखयोः
पूर्णा पश्चाद् उत पूर्णा पुरस्ताद् \ उन् मध्यतः पौर्णमासी जिगाय /
यस्यां देवा अभि सम्̐विशन्तस्\ उत्तमे नाक इह मादयध्वम् //
इति पौर्णमासीम् उपरिष्टाद् भरणीनाम्
यत् ते देवा अदधुर् भागधेयम् \ अमावास्ये सम्̐विशन्तो महित्वा /
सा नः प्रजां कृणुहि सर्ववीरे \ रयिं नो धेहि सुभगे सुवीरे //
इत्य् अमावास्याम् //
text_mt:
With [the formulas] beginning with “Kṛttikās the lunar mansion, Agni the deity,” he places the nakṣatreṣṭakā bricks in the east facing west. He attaches “You are the lights of Agni” to all of them. In front of the two Viśākhās,

“Full behind and full in front, / up from the middle the full moon has conquered.”

"in which the gods assemble together, / revel here in the highest heaven!"

[with this mantra he sets down] the Full-Moon brick above the Bharaṇīs;

"The share that the gods assigned to you, / O New Moon, entering together in your greatness,

make that our offspring, full of heroes; / bestow wealth upon us, fortunate one, rich in heroic sons!"

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyagarbhas \\ itiprabhṛtibhir apyayeṣu dvedve //
meaning: हिरण्यगर्भस् \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् अप्ययेषु द्वेद्वे //
text_mt: With [the mantras] beginning with "The golden embryo…" [he sets down] two [bricks] each at the joints.

sanskrit_iast: svar asi \ svar me yacha \\ iti pūrvām̐ hiraṇyeṣṭakām ṛṣabham upadhāya lokaṃpṛṇayā citim̐ saṃpūrayati /
meaning: स्वर् असि \ स्वर् मे यछ \\ इति पूर्वाम्̐ हिरण्येष्टकाम् ऋषभम् उपधाय लोकंपृणया चितिम्̐ संपूरयति /
text_mt: Having placed the former golden brick and the bull with "Light you are, grant me light", he completes the layer with the lokaṃpṛṇā [bricks].

sanskrit_iast: svayamātṛṇṇām̐ śarkarām aśvenopaghrāpya svar ity abhimantrayate /
meaning: स्वयमातृण्णाम्̐ शर्कराम् अश्वेनोपघ्राप्य स्वर् इत्य् अभिमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: Having made the horse sniff the naturally perforated pebble, he addresses it with "Light!"

sanskrit_iast: āyoṣ ṭvā sadane sādayāmi \\ iti sayajuṣaṃ karoti //
meaning: आयोष् ट्वा सदने सादयामि \\ इति सयजुषं करोति //
text_mt: He endows it with a yajus-mantra with: "I place you in the seat of vital strength."

sanskrit_iast: parameṣṭhī tvā sādayatu \\ iti paryāyeṇopadadhāti /
meaning: परमेष्ठी त्वा सादयतु \\ इति पर्यायेणोपदधाति /
text_mt: He sets it down in succession with: "May Parameṣṭhin set you down."

sanskrit_iast: nātrāvidvān na varadānam /
meaning: नात्राविद्वान् न वरदानम् /
text_mt: No ignorant person [may do this] here, nor is there a bestowing of wishes.

sanskrit_iast: abhiprāṇyāpanya citiṃ juhomi \\ ity adābhyātṛṇṇe 'bhijuhoti //
meaning: अभिप्राण्यापन्य चितिं जुहोमि \\ इत्य् अदाभ्यातृण्णे ऽभिजुहोति //
text_mt: Having breathed in and breathed out, he offers upon the naturally perforated [pebble] with: "I offer the layer."

sanskrit_iast: divam ākramiṣam iti yajamāno japati /
meaning: दिवम् आक्रमिषम् इति यजमानो जपति /
text_mt: The sacrificer mutters: "May I ascend to heaven."

sanskrit_iast: vāyavyām uttarām̐ vikarṇīm̐ śarkarāṃ pratiprasthātā prothad aśvo na yavase \\ iti madhye yugapat svayamātṛṇṇālokasyopadadhāti /
meaning: वायव्याम् उत्तराम्̐ विकर्णीम्̐ शर्करां प्रतिप्रस्थाता प्रोथद् अश्वो न यवसे \\ इति मध्ये युगपत् स्वयमातृण्णालोकस्योपदधाति /
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ simultaneously sets down the northern vikarṇī pebble dedicated to Vāyu in the middle of the space of the naturally perforated brick with: "Snorting like a horse in pasture…"

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātam̐ sārvacitikam /
meaning: व्याख्यातम्̐ सार्वचितिकम् /
text_mt: What applies to every layer has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: purīṣeṇa citim̐ sam̐sthāpayaty anyat svayamātṛṇṇāyāḥ /
meaning: पुरीषेण चितिम्̐ सम्̐स्थापयत्य् अन्यत् स्वयमातृण्णायाः /
text_mt: He completes the layer with loose earth, except for the naturally perforated brick.

sanskrit_iast: jānudaghnaṃ prathamaṃ cinvānaś cinvīteti vyākhyātam /
meaning: जानुदघ्नं प्रथमं चिन्वानश् चिन्वीतेति व्याख्यातम् /
text_mt: The rule: "One piling [the fire-altar] for the first time should pile [it] knee-high" has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: sauvarṇānām̐ śakalānām̐ sahasreṇa sahasrasya māsi \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ sarvam agniṃ prokṣya ghṛtena prokṣati vasavas tvā rudraiḥ paścāt pāntu \\ iti paścāt prāṅmukhas \\ nitānas tvā māruto marudbhir uttarataḥ pātu \\ ity uttarato dakṣiṇāmukhas \\ ādityās tvā viśvair devaiḥ purastāt pāntu \\ iti purastāt pratyaṅmukhaḥ pitaras tvā yamarājānaḥ pitṛbhir dakṣiṇataḥ pāntu \\ iti dakṣiṇata udaṅmukhas \\ devās tvendrajyeṣṭhā varuṇarājāno 'dhastāc copariṣṭāc ca pāntu \\ iti madhye prāṅmukhaḥ /
meaning: सौवर्णानाम्̐ शकलानाम्̐ सहस्रेण सहस्रस्य मासि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः सर्वम् अग्निं प्रोक्ष्य घृतेन प्रोक्षति वसवस् त्वा रुद्रैः पश्चात् पान्तु \\ इति पश्चात् प्राङ्मुखस् \\ नितानस् त्वा मारुतो मरुद्भिर् उत्तरतः पातु \\ इत्य् उत्तरतो दक्षिणामुखस् \\ आदित्यास् त्वा विश्वैर् देवैः पुरस्तात् पान्तु \\ इति पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ्मुखः पितरस् त्वा यमराजानः पितृभिर् दक्षिणतः पान्तु \\ इति दक्षिणत उदङ्मुखस् \\ देवास् त्वेन्द्रज्येष्ठा वरुणराजानो ऽधस्ताच् चोपरिष्टाच् च पान्तु \\ इति मध्ये प्राङ्मुखः /
text_mt: Having sprinkled the whole fire[-altar] with a thousand gold chips with [the mantras] beginning with "You are the measure of a thousand…", he sprinkles it with clarified butter: facing east from the west with "May the Vasus with the Rudras protect you from the west"; facing south from the north with "May Nitāna, the son of Marut, with the Maruts protect you from the north"; facing west from the east with "May the Ādityas with all the gods protect you from the east"; facing north from the south with "May the Fathers, whose king is Yama, protect you from the south with the Fathers"; facing east in the middle with "May the gods, chief among whom is Indra and whose king is Varuṇa, protect you from below and from above."

sanskrit_iast: pratiparikramya \\ imā me agnā iṣṭakā dhenavaḥ santu \\ iti duhenottaraṃ puchāpyayaṃ pratyāramya japati yajamānaḥ /
meaning: प्रतिपरिक्रम्य \\ इमा मे अग्ना इष्टका धेनवः सन्तु \\ इति दुहेनोत्तरं पुछाप्ययं प्रत्यारम्य जपति यजमानः /
text_mt: Having circumambulated back, touching the northern tail-joint, the sacrificer mutters: "May these bricks be milch cows for me, O Agni…"

sanskrit_iast: uttarasyām̐ śroṇāvantyāyām iṣṭakāyām̐ śatarudriyaṃ juhoty arkaparṇenājakṣīraṃ gavīdhukāsaktūn vā namas te rudra manyave \\ itiprabhṛtibhir jānudaghne dhārayamāṇo dakṣiṇāmukhas \\ namo bṛhadbhyo 'rbhakebhyas \\ iti nābhidaghna udaṅmukhas \\ namo vāstavyāya \\ ity āsyadaghne prāṅmukhaḥ /
meaning: उत्तरस्याम्̐ श्रोणावन्त्यायाम् इष्टकायाम्̐ शतरुद्रियं जुहोत्य् अर्कपर्णेनाजक्षीरं गवीधुकासक्तून् वा नमस् ते रुद्र मन्यवे \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् जानुदघ्ने धारयमाणो दक्षिणामुखस् \\ नमो बृहद्भ्यो ऽर्भकेभ्यस् \\ इति नाभिदघ्न उदङ्मुखस् \\ नमो वास्तव्याय \\ इत्य् आस्यदघ्ने प्राङ्मुखः /
text_mt: On the northern buttock, on the last brick, he offers the Śatarudriya with an arka leaf—goat's milk or groats of gavīdhukā grass—holding [the ladle] at knee-height facing south with [the formulas] beginning with "Homage to your wrath, O Rudra…"; holding it at navel-height facing north with "Homage to the great and to the small…"; holding it at mouth-height facing east with "Homage to him who dwells in the homestead…"

sanskrit_iast: pratyavarohāñ juhoti namo astu rudrebhyo ye divi \\ ity āsyādaghna uttareṇa paryāyeṇa nābhidaghna uttamena jānudaghne /
meaning: प्रत्यवरोहाञ् जुहोति नमो अस्तु रुद्रेभ्यो ये दिवि \\ इत्य् आस्यादघ्न उत्तरेण पर्यायेण नाभिदघ्न उत्तमेन जानुदघ्ने /
text_mt: He offers the descending oblations with "Homage be to the Rudras who are in heaven…" at mouth-height; with the next round at navel-height; with the last at knee-height.

sanskrit_iast:
yo rudro 'psu yo 'gnau ya oṣadhīṣu /
yo rudro viśvā bhuvanāviveśa \ tasmai rudrāya namo 'stu devāya //
svāhā \\ iti tasyām iṣṭakāyāṃ gāvīdhukaṃ carum upavapati /
meaning:
यो रुद्रो ऽप्सु यो ऽग्नौ य ओषधीषु /
यो रुद्रो विश्वा भुवनाविवेश \ तस्मै रुद्राय नमो ऽस्तु देवाय //
स्वाहा \\ इति तस्याम् इष्टकायां गावीधुकं चरुम् उपवपति /
text_mt:
“The Rudra who is in the waters, who is in the fire, who is in the plants,

the Rudra who has entered all beings: / to that divine Rudra be homage!

Svāhā!” On that brick he scatters a boiled oblation of gavidhukā seeds.

sanskrit_iast: āyudhaṃ tisṛdhanvam ayācito brāhmaṇāya dadyāt //
meaning: आयुधं तिसृधन्वम् अयाचितो ब्राह्मणाय दद्यात् //
text_mt: Without being asked, he should give a weapon and a bow with three arrows to a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast: aśmann ūrjaṃ parvate śiśriyāṇām ity udakumbhenāgniṃ prasavyaṃ triḥ pariṣiñcan paryeti / nidhāya trir apariṣiñcan pratiparyeti /
meaning: अश्मन्न् ऊर्जं पर्वते शिश्रियाणाम् इत्य् उदकुम्भेनाग्निं प्रसव्यं त्रिः परिषिञ्चन् पर्येति / निधाय त्रिर् अपरिषिञ्चन् प्रतिपर्येति /
text_mt: With "The strength in the stone that rests in the mountain…", pouring around with a water-jar, he goes around the fire counter-clockwise three times; setting it down, he goes around back three times without pouring around.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyapāvamānyām̐ śirasi gāyatraṃ gāyodgātā rathantaraṃ dakṣiṇe pakṣe bṛhad uttarasminn ātmani vāmadevyam̐ yajñāyajñiyaṃ puche prajāpaterhṛdayam anṛcaṃ dakṣiṇasmin nikakṣe stutam̐ hotānuśam̐sati /
meaning: आग्नेयपावमान्याम्̐ शिरसि गायत्रं गायोद्गाता रथन्तरं दक्षिणे पक्षे बृहद् उत्तरस्मिन्न् आत्मनि वामदेव्यम्̐ यज्ञायज्ञियं पुछे प्रजापतेर्हृदयम् अनृचं दक्षिणस्मिन् निकक्षे स्तुतम्̐ होतानुशम्̐सति /
text_mt: The udgātṛ sings the Gāyatra on an Agni-Pāvamāna verse on the head, the Rathantara on the right wing, the Bṛhat on the left, the Vāmadevya on the body, the Yajñāyajñiya on the tail, the verseless Prajāpatis-Heart on the right armpit; after it is chanted, the hotṛ recites the sastra.

sanskrit_iast: parigītaṃ nākrāmed ā svayamātṛṇṇāyā vyāghāraṇāt /
meaning: परिगीतं नाक्रामेद् आ स्वयमातृण्णाया व्याघारणात् /
text_mt: One should not step onto [the altar] that has been sung over, until the basting of the naturally perforated brick.

sanskrit_iast: maṇḍūkenāvakayā vetasaśākhayā ca samudrasya tvāvakayā \ himasya tvā jarāyuṇā \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ saptabhiḥ sarvam agnim̐ vikarṣati /
meaning: मण्डूकेनावकया वेतसशाखया च समुद्रस्य त्वावकया \ हिमस्य त्वा जरायुणा \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः सप्तभिः सर्वम् अग्निम्̐ विकर्षति /
text_mt: With a frog, an avakā plant, and a reed branch, he drags across the whole fire[-altar] with seven mantras beginning with "With the water-plant of the ocean…" and "With the skin of snow…"

sanskrit_iast: vinīya prāṇān maṇḍūkasya vikarṣaṇam utkare pravidhyati / yaṃ dviṣyāt tam etenopahanyāt //
meaning: विनीय प्राणान् मण्डूकस्य विकर्षणम् उत्करे प्रविध्यति / यं द्विष्यात् तम् एतेनोपहन्यात् //
text_mt: Having removed the breath of the frog, he throws the dragging instrument onto the rubbish heap; him whom he hates, he may strike down with this.

sanskrit_iast: iṣṭo yajño bhṛgubhir iti chandasāṃ doham̐ yajamānam̐ vācayati /
meaning: इष्टो यज्ञो भृगुभिर् इति छन्दसां दोहम्̐ यजमानम्̐ वाचयति /
text_mt: With "The sacrifice was performed by the Bhṛgus…", he has the sacrificer recite the milking of the metres.

sanskrit_iast: audumbarīr ghṛte vāsayati /
meaning: औदुम्बरीर् घृते वासयति /
text_mt: He steeps [sticks of] udumbara wood in clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: āparāhṇikyau pravargyopasadāv upetya vasanti /
meaning: आपराह्णिक्यौ प्रवर्ग्योपसदाव् उपेत्य वसन्ति /
text_mt: Having performed the afternoon Pravargya and Upasad rites, they dwell [there].

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvaṃ pūrvāhṇikībhyāṃ kṛṣṇājinasyopānahaṃ pratimucya \\ apām idaṃ nyayanam \\ namas te harase śociṣe \\ iti dvābhyām agnim ākrāmati /
meaning: ऊर्ध्वं पूर्वाह्णिकीभ्यां कृष्णाजिनस्योपानहं प्रतिमुच्य \\ अपाम् इदं न्ययनम् \\ नमस् ते हरसे शोचिषे \\ इति द्वाभ्याम् अग्निम् आक्रामति /
text_mt: After the morning rites, having put on sandals of black antelope skin, he steps onto the fire[-altar] with the two [mantras]: "This is the gathering-place of the waters…" and "Homage to your heat, to your blazing…"

sanskrit_iast: pañcagṛhīta ājye hiraṇyaśakalam ekaikam avadhāya druṣade vaḍ \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ svayamātṛṇṇām̐ vyāghārayati yathā nābhim //
meaning: पञ्चगृहीत आज्ये हिरण्यशकलम् एकैकम् अवधाय द्रुषदे वड् \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः स्वयमातृण्णाम्̐ व्याघारयति यथा नाभिम् //
text_mt: In fivefold-drawn clarified butter, having placed a chip of gold in each, he bastes the naturally perforated brick like a navel with [the formulas] beginning with "To the tree-dweller, vaṭ!"

sanskrit_iast: svarvide vaḍ ity ūrdhvām̐ srucam udgṛhṇāti /
meaning: स्वर्विदे वड् इत्य् ऊर्ध्वाम्̐ स्रुचम् उद्गृह्णाति /
text_mt: With "To the finder of heaven, vaṭ!", he raises the ladle upright.

sanskrit_iast: dadhini madhumiśre darbhamuṣṭiṃ paryāsam annapate annasya no dehi \\ iti tisṛbhiḥ sarvam agnim̐ vyavokṣati //
meaning: दधिनि मधुमिश्रे दर्भमुष्टिं पर्यासम् अन्नपते अन्नस्य नो देहि \\ इति तिसृभिः सर्वम् अग्निम्̐ व्यवोक्षति //
text_mt: Having dipped a handful of darbha grass into curd mixed with honey, he sprinkles all over the fire[-altar] with the three [verses beginning with]: "O Lord of food, give us food…"

sanskrit_iast: prāṇadā apāndās \\ iti pratyavarohati /
meaning: प्राणदा अपान्दास् \\ इति प्रत्यवरोहति /
text_mt: With "Givers of out-breath, givers of in-breath…", he steps down.

sanskrit_iast: āparāhṇikīm̐ sadyaḥ sam̐sthāpyotsādya gharmapātrāṇy agnīṣomīyāyaupasadaṃ barhis tad vyākhyātam /
meaning: आपराह्णिकीम्̐ सद्यः सम्̐स्थाप्योत्साद्य घर्मपात्राण्य् अग्नीषोमीयायौपसदं बर्हिस् तद् व्याख्यातम् /
text_mt: Having immediately concluded the afternoon [Upasad] and having set aside the gharma vessels, the Upasad sacrificial grass for the animal offering to Agni and Soma is used; that has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: agnis tigmena śociṣā \\ iti caturgṛhītaṃ juhoti /
meaning: अग्निस् तिग्मेन शोचिषा \\ इति चतुर्गृहीतं जुहोति /
text_mt: With "Agni with sharp blaze…", he offers a fourfold portion.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīm̐ ṣoḍaśagṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā ya imā viśvā bhuvanāni \\ ity aṣṭau nigadyārdhaṃ juhoty uttaram anuvākaṃ nigadya śeṣam /
meaning: तूष्णीम्̐ षोडशगृहीतं गृहीत्वा य इमा विश्वा भुवनानि \\ इत्य् अष्टौ निगद्यार्धं जुहोत्य् उत्तरम् अनुवाकं निगद्य शेषम् /
text_mt: Having silently taken a sixteenfold portion, having uttered the eight [verses beginning with] "He who all these worlds…", he offers half; having uttered the subsequent section, [he offers] the remainder.

sanskrit_iast: audumbarīr ghṛtoṣitās tisraḥ samidhas \\ ud enam uttaraṃ naya \\ iti tisṛbhiḥ svāhākārāntābhir ādadhāti /
meaning: औदुम्बरीर् घृतोषितास् तिस्रः समिधस् \\ उद् एनम् उत्तरं नय \\ इति तिसृभिः स्वाहाकारान्ताभिर् आदधाति /
