sanskrit_iast: antābhyām aṅguliparvaṇi daśabhāgam adhastād raśanāratnyantare lakṣaṇasyāpacaya evam evopariṣṭād raśanāratnyantare lakṣaṇasyāpacayaḥ /
meaning: अन्ताभ्याम् अङ्गुलिपर्वणि दशभागम् अधस्ताद् रशनारत्न्यन्तरे लक्षणस्यापचय एवम् एवोपरिष्टाद् रशनारत्न्यन्तरे लक्षणस्यापचयः /
text_mt: From both ends at the finger joint, a tenth part below: there is diminution of the mark in the space of a cubit of the cord; likewise above: diminution of the mark in the space of a cubit of the cord.

sanskrit_iast: kuṣṭhasaṃmitaṃ kharaṃ karoti /
meaning: कुष्ठसंमितं खरं करोति /
text_mt: He makes a mound measured by the leprosy [rule?].

sanskrit_iast: cātvālakarma vyākhyātam /
meaning: चात्वालकर्म व्याख्यातम् /
text_mt: The act of the pit has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: yady avadāya punar uddhriyeta pramāyuko yajamānaḥ syāt /
meaning: यद्य् अवदाय पुनर् उद्ध्रियेत प्रमायुको यजमानः स्यात् /
text_mt: If having cut it out it should be lifted up again, the sacrificer will be prone to death.

sanskrit_iast: punar anyathāvasyan idaṃ japen mā yajñam̐ him̐siṣṭam iti /
meaning: पुनर् अन्यथावस्यन् इदं जपेन् मा यज्ञम्̐ हिम्̐सिष्टम् इति /
text_mt: When setting it down differently again, he should murmur: 'Do not harm the sacrifice.'

sanskrit_iast: pañcabhāgoparā yūpā bhavanty uttarā ṣaḍ vā vibhajyanta ā dvādaśaratnes triratnir ity uttareṣām /
meaning: पञ्चभागोपरा यूपा भवन्त्य् उत्तरा षड् वा विभज्यन्त आ द्वादशरत्नेस् त्रिरत्निर् इत्य् उत्तरेषाम् /
text_mt: The sacrificial posts have five-part underground portions, or six upper portions are divided; up to twelve cubits, three cubits is [the division] of the upper ones.

sanskrit_iast: alekho hotṛścamasa utsṛṣṭo brahmaṇaḥ smṛto 'vamṛṣṭa udgātṝṇāṃ pārśvāvamṛṣṭo yajamānasyaikalekho maitrāvaruṇasya dvilekho brāhmaṇācham̐sinas trilekhaḥ potur mayūkho neṣṭur ajapādo 'chāvākasyābhrir āgnīdhrasya /
meaning: अलेखो होतृश्चमस उत्सृष्टो ब्रह्मणः स्मृतो ऽवमृष्ट उद्गातॄणां पार्श्वावमृष्टो यजमानस्यैकलेखो मैत्रावरुणस्य द्विलेखो ब्राह्मणाछम्̐सिनस् त्रिलेखः पोतुर् मयूखो नेष्टुर् अजपादो ऽछावाकस्याभ्रिर् आग्नीध्रस्य /
text_mt: Unmarked is the cup of the hotṛ; left aside, of the brahman priest; traditionally touched, of the udgātṛs; touched at the side, of the sacrificer; with one mark, of the maitrāvaruṇa; with two marks, of the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin; with three marks, of the potṛ; a peg, of the neṣṭṛ; a goat's foot, of the acchāvāka; a spade, of the āgnīdhra.

sanskrit_iast: atha sāvanasya paśor uddhṛtavapāvadānasya vibhāgam̐ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: अथ सावनस्य पशोर् उद्धृतवपावदानस्य विभागम्̐ व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: Now we shall explain the distribution of the animal of the pressing after the portions of omentum have been extracted.

sanskrit_iast: hanū sajihve prastotuḥ kaṇṭhaḥ kākud āgnīdhrasya śyenam̐ vakṣa udgātur dakṣiṇaṃ pārśvam adhvaryoḥ savyaṃ pratiprasthātur dakṣiṇa ūrur brahmaṇaḥ savyaḥ sadasyānām ubhau matasnau neṣṭur achāvākasya cauṣṭha enayoḥ sādhāraṇaḥ pādau gṛhapater avākskandhāś ca maṇikās tisraś ca kīkasā [ ardham̐ vaikartaṃ ca ] hotus tisraś ca kīkasā ardham̐ vaikartaṃ connetu[s tisraś ca kīkasā ] ardham̐ vaikartaṃ ca śamituḥ /
meaning: हनू सजिह्वे प्रस्तोतुः कण्ठः काकुद् आग्नीध्रस्य श्येनम्̐ वक्ष उद्गातुर् दक्षिणं पार्श्वम् अध्वर्योः सव्यं प्रतिप्रस्थातुर् दक्षिण ऊरुर् ब्रह्मणः सव्यः सदस्यानाम् उभौ मतस्नौ नेष्टुर् अछावाकस्य चौष्ठ एनयोः साधारणः पादौ गृहपतेर् अवाक्स्कन्धाश् च मणिकास् तिस्रश् च कीकसा [ अर्धम्̐ वैकर्तं च ] होतुस् तिस्रश् च कीकसा अर्धम्̐ वैकर्तं चोन्नेतु[स् तिस्रश् च कीकसा ] अर्धम्̐ वैकर्तं च शमितुः /
text_mt: The jaws together with the tongue belong to the prastotṛ; the throat and palate to the āgnīdhra; the hawk-like breast to the udgātṛ; the right flank to the adhvaryu; the left to the pratiprasthātṛ; the right thigh to the brahman; the left to the sadasyas; both kidneys to the neṣṭṛ and the acchāvāka, and the lip is common to both of them; the feet to the householder; the downward-turning shoulders and the ankles and three ribs [and half the vaakarta] to the hotṛ; three ribs and half the vaakarta to the unnetṛ; [three ribs] and half the vaakarta to the slaughterer.

sanskrit_iast: tac chamitā brāhmaṇāya dadyād yo 'brāhmaṇaḥ syāt /
meaning: तच् छमिता ब्राह्मणाय दद्याद् यो ऽब्राह्मणः स्यात् /
text_mt: The slaughterer should give that to a brahmin, if he should be a non-brahmin.

sanskrit_iast: jāghanī patnyās tām̐ sā brāhmaṇāya dadyāt /
meaning: जाघनी पत्न्यास् ताम्̐ सा ब्राह्मणाय दद्यात् /
text_mt: The hindquarters belong to the wife; she should give them to a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast: śiraḥ subrahmaṇyasya / yac chvaḥsutyāṃ prāhāsyājinam /
meaning: शिरः सुब्रह्मण्यस्य / यच् छ्वःसुत्यां प्राहास्याजिनम् /
text_mt: The head belongs to the subrahmaṇya. When he declares the next day's pressing, the skin [belongs] to him.

sanskrit_iast: tā evaitāḥ ṣaṭtrim̐śatam ekapadā yajñam̐ vahanti ṣaṭtrim̐śadakṣarā bṛhatī bārhatāḥ paśavo bārhataḥ puruṣo ya evam̐ vidvān vibhajet /
meaning: ता एवैताः षट्त्रिम्̐शतम् एकपदा यज्ञम्̐ वहन्ति षट्त्रिम्̐शदक्षरा बृहती बार्हताः पशवो बार्हतः पुरुषो य एवम्̐ विद्वान् विभजेत् /
text_mt: These thirty-six single-word portions carry the sacrifice; the Bṛhatī has thirty-six syllables, animals belong to the Bṛhatī, man belongs to the Bṛhatī—whoever, knowing thus, divides [it].

sanskrit_iast: ... yathaiva piśācāḥ saunikā vā...tādṛk /
meaning: ... यथैव पिशाचाः सौनिका वा...तादृक् /
text_mt: […] just as goblins or butchers […], such [it is].

sanskrit_iast: ...dyavadāya vāyavyāyāmānuṣaḥ purovāca / tata idaṃ manuṣyā viduḥ /
meaning: ...द्यवदाय वायव्यायामानुषः पुरोवाच / तत इदं मनुष्या विदुः /
text_mt: […] having apportioned for the Vāyavya cup, the human said formerly; hence humans know this.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍḍhotāgrahapāśukyārambhaṇīyādakṣiṇādānam iti parāṅgabhūtāsu nivartyeran /
meaning: षड्ढोताग्रहपाशुक्यारम्भणीयादक्षिणादानम् इति पराङ्गभूतासु निवर्त्येरन् /
text_mt: The formula of six Hotṛs, the Grahas, the animal victim, the introductory offering, the giving of the sacrificial gift—these should cease when they are subordinate limbs.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyābarhiḥ saṃnahyātithyabarhiḥ śulbaprabhṛtimantravat saṃnahyatīdhmaṃ ca tatparidhim /
meaning: पृष्ठ्याबर्हिः संनह्यातिथ्यबर्हिः शुल्बप्रभृतिमन्त्रवत् संनह्यतीध्मं च तत्परिधिम् /
text_mt: Having tied the sacrificial grass for the spinal line, he ties the sacrificial grass for the guest-offering with the mantras beginning with the cord, and the sacrificial fuel with its enclosing sticks.

sanskrit_iast: payasyā ced anūbandhyā savane svaruhomaḥ /
meaning: पयस्या चेद् अनूबन्ध्या सवने स्वरुहोमः /
text_mt: If there is a curd offering as the concluding animal victim, the offering of the chip takes place at the pressing.

sanskrit_iast: avabhṛthād udetya yūpānudeśaḥ /
meaning: अवभृथाद् उदेत्य यूपानुदेशः /
text_mt: Rising from the purificatory bath, the pointing out of the sacrificial posts [takes place].

sanskrit_iast: tisraḥ payasyā ity eke /
meaning: तिस्रः पयस्या इत्य् एके /

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ kāmayeta sarvo me yajñaḥ syāt sarasā iti sa etās tisro vaśā ālabheta yajñasya sarvatvāyātho sarasatvāya maitrāvaruṇyai ca /
meaning: यः कामयेत सर्वो मे यज्ञः स्यात् सरसा इति स एतास् तिस्रो वशा आलभेत यज्ञस्य सर्वत्वायाथो सरसत्वाय मैत्रावरुण्यै च /
text_mt: He who desires, 'May my sacrifice be whole, full of sap', should seize these three barren cows for the wholeness of the sacrifice, and also for its sap-richness, and for the curd offering to Mitra-Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: uttarato gārhapatyasya pātrebhyaḥ sam̐stīrya pātrāṇi prayunakti /
meaning: उत्तरतो गार्हपत्यस्य पात्रेभ्यः सम्̐स्तीर्य पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति /
text_mt: To the north of the gārhapatya fire, having spread out [grass] for the utensils, he arranges the utensils.

sanskrit_iast: sruksruvam ājyasthālīṃ dohapātrāṇi camasān sam̐sādya prokṣya pātrāṇi dohaṃ dohayitvājyaṃ nirupya paryagniṃ kṛtvā sruksruvaṃ pramṛjyotpūya payasyām abhighāryodvāsyālaṃkṛtya paścād uttaravedyāḥ sādayati /
meaning: स्रुक्स्रुवम् आज्यस्थालीं दोहपात्राणि चमसान् सम्̐साद्य प्रोक्ष्य पात्राणि दोहं दोहयित्वाज्यं निरुप्य पर्यग्निं कृत्वा स्रुक्स्रुवं प्रमृज्योत्पूय पयस्याम् अभिघार्योद्वास्यालंकृत्य पश्चाद् उत्तरवेद्याः सादयति /
text_mt: Having arranged the offering ladle and the dipping spoon, the butter-pot, the milking vessels, and the cups; having sprinkled the vessels; having caused the milk to be milked; having apportioned the clarified butter; having carried fire around; having wiped and purified the offering ladle and the dipping spoon; having basted the curd offering with clarified butter; having taken it off the fire and decorated it, he sets it down behind the high altar.

sanskrit_iast: ājyabhāgābhyāṃ pracarya payasyayānubandhyādevatā yajaty ājyena devikāḥ /
meaning: आज्यभागाभ्यां प्रचर्य पयस्ययानुबन्ध्यादेवता यजत्य् आज्येन देविकाः /
text_mt: Having performed the two clarified butter portions, he sacrifices to the deities of the anubandhyā with the curd offering, and to the Devikās with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: iḍāntaṃ karma /
meaning: इडान्तं कर्म /

sanskrit_iast: athobhāyājikalpaṃ kāmalāyinaḥ samāmananti /
meaning: अथोभायाजिकल्पं कामलायिनः समामनन्ति /
text_mt: Now the Kāmalāyins teach the procedure of double sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: vasante vaiśvadeveneṣṭvā grīṣme punar vaiśvadevena yajeta /
meaning: वसन्ते वैश्वदेवेनेष्ट्वा ग्रीष्मे पुनर् वैश्वदेवेन यजेत /
text_mt: Having sacrificed with the Vaiśvadeva in spring, he should sacrifice again with the Vaiśvadeva in summer.

sanskrit_iast: varṣāsu varuṇapraghāsair iṣṭvā śaradi punar varuṇapraghāsair yajeta /
meaning: वर्षासु वरुणप्रघासैर् इष्ट्वा शरदि पुनर् वरुणप्रघासैर् यजेत /
text_mt: Having sacrificed with the Varuṇapraghāsas in the rainy season, he should sacrifice again with the Varuṇapraghāsas in autumn.

sanskrit_iast: hemante sākamedhair iṣṭvā śiśire punaḥ sākamedhair yajeta /
meaning: हेमन्ते साकमेधैर् इष्ट्वा शिशिरे पुनः साकमेधैर् यजेत /
text_mt: Having sacrificed with the Sākamedhas in the cold season, he should sacrifice again with the Sākamedhas in winter.

sanskrit_iast: tatrobhāv ijyākālau /
meaning: तत्रोभाव् इज्याकालौ /

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte śunāsīryam̐ sadyo vā /
meaning: श्वोभूते शुनासीर्यम्̐ सद्यो वा /
text_mt: On the next day the Śunāsīrīya [offering is performed], or on the same day.

sanskrit_iast: atha pariplavair yajeta / tasya haviṣām ekaikenāharaho yajeta /
meaning: अथ परिप्लवैर् यजेत / तस्य हविषाम् एकैकेनाहरहो यजेत /
text_mt: Now he may sacrifice with the Pariplavas; he should sacrifice day by day with one each of its oblations.

sanskrit_iast: prasādyaskair yajeta /
meaning: प्रसाद्यस्कैर् यजेत /

sanskrit_iast: prakārāntare prātarāhutim̐ hutvā pūrvāhṇe vaiśvadevena yajeta madhyāhne varuṇapraghāsair aparāhṇe sākamedhaiḥ / śvobhūte śunāsīryam̐ sadyo vā /
meaning: प्रकारान्तरे प्रातराहुतिम्̐ हुत्वा पूर्वाह्णे वैश्वदेवेन यजेत मध्याह्ने वरुणप्रघासैर् अपराह्णे साकमेधैः / श्वोभूते शुनासीर्यम्̐ सद्यो वा /
text_mt: According to another method: having made the morning offering, he should sacrifice in the forenoon with the Vaiśvadeva, at midday with the Varuṇapraghāsas, [and] in the afternoon with the Sākamedhas. On the next day the Śunāsīrīya [is performed], or on the same day.

sanskrit_iast: atha samastair yajeta /
meaning: अथ समस्तैर् यजेत /

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte vaiśvadevam̐ śvobhūte varuṇapraghāsā dvyaham̐ sākamedhāḥ śvobhūte śunāsīryam̐ sadyo vāñjasā vā /
meaning: श्वोभूते वैश्वदेवम्̐ श्वोभूते वरुणप्रघासा द्व्यहम्̐ साकमेधाः श्वोभूते शुनासीर्यम्̐ सद्यो वाञ्जसा वा /
text_mt: On the next day the Vaiśvadeva; on the next day the Varuṇapraghāsas; the Sākamedhas for two days; on the next day the Śunāsīrīya, or on the same day, or immediately.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa yathā svargalokam eti yaḥ samastaiś cāturmāsyair yajeta /
meaning: एष यथा स्वर्गलोकम् एति यः समस्तैश् चातुर्मास्यैर् यजेत /
text_mt: Thus goes he to the heavenly world who sacrifices with the Cāturmāsyas combined.

sanskrit_iast: sa etair iṣṭyantaiḥ paśvantaiḥ somāntair vā yajeta /
meaning: स एतैर् इष्ट्यन्तैः पश्वन्तैः सोमान्तैर् वा यजेत /
text_mt: He may sacrifice with these [rites] concluding with an iṣṭi, concluding with an animal sacrifice, or concluding with a Soma sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: api vā varuṇapraghāsānte vaiśvānarapārjanyādīnāṃ ca vim̐śatihaviṣām iṣṭiṃ nirvapati /
meaning: अपि वा वरुणप्रघासान्ते वैश्वानरपार्जन्यादीनां च विम्̐शतिहविषाम् इष्टिं निर्वपति /
text_mt: Or else, at the conclusion of the Varuṇapraghāsas, he apportions an iṣṭi of twenty oblations beginning with those to Vaiśvānara and Parjanya.

sanskrit_iast: tryambakapunaruktavarjam̐ samāno 'vabhṛthaḥ /
meaning: त्र्यम्बकपुनरुक्तवर्जम्̐ समानो ऽवभृथः /
text_mt: Except for the Tryambaka [offerings] and the repetitions, the final purification bath is the same.

sanskrit_iast: pitṛyajñaś ca sākamedhikas tantrāvayavaḥ / sadyaḥ samāpnuyāt /
meaning: पितृयज्ञश् च साकमेधिकस् तन्त्रावयवः / सद्यः समाप्नुयात् /
text_mt: And the Pitṛyajña connected with the Sākamedhas is a part of the ritual framework; he should conclude it on the same day.

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyāto 'śvamedhaḥ puruṣamedhaś ca / sarvamedham̐ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: व्याख्यातो ऽश्वमेधः पुरुषमेधश् च / सर्वमेधम्̐ व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: The Aśvamedha and the Puruṣamedha have been explained; we shall explain the Sarvamedha.

sanskrit_iast: tasyāhargaṇas trīṇy āśvamedhikāni pañca pauruṣamedhikāni vājapeyo 'ptoryāmaḥ /
meaning: तस्याहर्गणस् त्रीण्य् आश्वमेधिकानि पञ्च पौरुषमेधिकानि वाजपेयो ऽप्तोर्यामः /
text_mt: Its series of days [consists of]: three [days] pertaining to the Aśvamedha, five pertaining to the Puruṣamedha, a Vājapeya, [and] an Aptoryāma.

sanskrit_iast: yad ahar aptoryāmas tad ahaḥ sarvāṇi /
meaning: यद् अहर् अप्तोर्यामस् तद् अहः सर्वाणि /
text_mt: On the day that is the Aptoryāma, all [takes place] on that day.

sanskrit_iast: sarvāṇām̐ vanaspatīnāṃ purastāt sviṣṭakṛto rasaṃ juhoty eṣa eva nirargalaḥ /
meaning: सर्वाणाम्̐ वनस्पतीनां पुरस्तात् स्विष्टकृतो रसं जुहोत्य् एष एव निरर्गलः /
text_mt: Before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, he offers the sap of all trees; this is indeed the Nirargala.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇākāle sarvasvaṃ dadyāt /
meaning: दक्षिणाकाले सर्वस्वं दद्यात् /
text_mt: At the time of the sacrificial gift, he should give away his entire property.

sanskrit_iast: sakulyān āmantryātmany agnīn samāropayet /
meaning: सकुल्यान् आमन्त्र्यात्मन्य् अग्नीन् समारोपयेत् /
text_mt: Having taken leave of his kinsmen, he should mount the fires onto himself.

sanskrit_iast: vijñāyate haitad vā agnidhānam̐ hastasya yat pāṇis tasmāt pāṇau samāropayet /
meaning: विज्ञायते हैतद् वा अग्निधानम्̐ हस्तस्य यत् पाणिस् तस्मात् पाणौ समारोपयेत् /
text_mt: It is indeed known [from the scriptures]: 'This palm of the hand is indeed the setting-place of the fire'; therefore he should mount them onto his palm.

sanskrit_iast: vijñāyate ha yasya vā amuṣya diśi yady agnayas tām abhimukho japet /
meaning: विज्ञायते ह यस्य वा अमुष्य दिशि यद्य् अग्नयस् ताम् अभिमुखो जपेत् /
text_mt: It is indeed known: 'In whichever direction that person's fires are, facing that [direction] he should mutter [the mantra].'

sanskrit_iast: vijñāyate yatra vā etat kvaca yajamānam̐ santam̐ yajñasyāśīr gached iti śrutiḥ /
meaning: विज्ञायते यत्र वा एतत् क्वच यजमानम्̐ सन्तम्̐ यज्ञस्याशीर् गछेद् इति श्रुतिः /
text_mt: 'Wherever the sacrificer may be, the blessing of the sacrifice reaches him,' so says the śruti.

sanskrit_iast: tatra yāni sām̐sparśikāni na tāni kriyeran dharmapātrāṇi /
meaning: तत्र यानि साम्̐स्पर्शिकानि न तानि क्रियेरन् धर्मपात्राणि /
text_mt: There, whatever vessels are touched [in common] should not be made [into] sacred vessels.

sanskrit_iast: devatā dravyam iti sāmānyasaṃnipāte 'kṣarasāmānyād viśeṣaḥ /
meaning: देवता द्रव्यम् इति सामान्यसंनिपाते ऽक्षरसामान्याद् विशेषः /
text_mt: When deity and substance coincide in common, a distinction [is made] through similarity of syllables.

sanskrit_iast: athāhitāgneḥ pramītasya vidhim̐ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: अथाहिताग्नेः प्रमीतस्य विधिम्̐ व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: Now we shall explain the rule for an āhitāgni who has died.

sanskrit_iast: abhivānyānyasyā gor vatsena yā gaur duhyate sābhivānyā gauḥ /
meaning: अभिवान्यान्यस्या गोर् वत्सेन या गौर् दुह्यते साभिवान्या गौः /
text_mt: An abhivānyā is a cow that is milked with the calf of another cow; that is an abhivānyā cow.

sanskrit_iast: dugdham adhastāt srugdaṇḍe samidhaṃ dhārayamāṇo hṛtvā juhoti /
meaning: दुग्धम् अधस्तात् स्रुग्दण्डे समिधं धारयमाणो हृत्वा जुहोति /
text_mt: Holding a piece of kindling stick on the handle of the ladle below the milk, he carries it and offers it.

sanskrit_iast: yadi naktaṃ pramīyeta prātarāhutiṃ prapādyāparapakṣe pramīyetāgnihotradarśābhyāṃ pūrvapakṣam̐ saṃpādayet /
meaning: यदि नक्तं प्रमीयेत प्रातराहुतिं प्रपाद्यापरपक्षे प्रमीयेताग्निहोत्रदर्शाभ्यां पूर्वपक्षम्̐ संपादयेत् /
text_mt: If he should die at night, having performed the morning offering; if he should die in the dark fortnight, he should complete the bright fortnight with the Agnihotra and the New-Moon sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: yadi dakṣiṇāyane pramīyetāgnihotreṇa darśapūrṇamāsābhyām iṣṭvā śarīradāhād ahatena vāsasā paḍatodaśena prachādya prehi prehi \\ iti dakṣiṇapūrvasyāṃ diśi nāyayet /
meaning: यदि दक्षिणायने प्रमीयेताग्निहोत्रेण दर्शपूर्णमासाभ्याम् इष्ट्वा शरीरदाहाद् अहतेन वाससा पडतोदशेन प्रछाद्य प्रेहि प्रेहि \\ इति दक्षिणपूर्वस्यां दिशि नाययेत् /
text_mt: If he should die during the southern course of the sun, having sacrificed with the Agnihotra and the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices, before the cremation of the body, having covered it with an unwashed cloth having tassels at the feet, he should have it carried toward the south-east direction with [the mantra]: 'Go forth, go forth...'

sanskrit_iast: cakrīvatā vāhayec chiram agrato nayati /
meaning: चक्रीवता वाहयेच् छिरम् अग्रतो नयति /
text_mt: He should have it conveyed by a wheeled cart; he leads the head forward.

sanskrit_iast: tasya vartmānunayanty agrato vihārān nāyayed yajñapātrāṇi paścād jñātayo 'nveyuḥ /
meaning: तस्य वर्त्मानुनयन्त्य् अग्रतो विहारान् नाययेद् यज्ञपात्राणि पश्चाद् ज्ञातयो ऽन्वेयुः /
text_mt: They follow his track; he should carry the sacrificial vessels ahead out of the sacrificial enclosure; the relatives should follow behind.

sanskrit_iast: paścāc catvāra ṛtvija uṣṇīṣiṇo 'hatāni vāsām̐sy apasavyam āvṛtya dakṣiṇapūrvasyāṃ diśy agniṃ praṇīyeṣṭiṃ kurvanti /
meaning: पश्चाच् चत्वार ऋत्विज उष्णीषिणो ऽहतानि वासाम्̐स्य् अपसव्यम् आवृत्य दक्षिणपूर्वस्यां दिश्य् अग्निं प्रणीयेष्टिं कुर्वन्ति /
text_mt: Behind, four officiating priests, wearing turbans and unwashed garments, having turned [their sacred threads] over the right shoulder, having brought forward the fire in the south-east direction, perform an iṣṭi.

sanskrit_iast: somāya pitṛmate ṣaṭkapālaḥ puroḍāśa uttānāni kapālāni / tūṣṇīṃ tam anavekṣamāṇāḥ pracareyur yathā pitryāyām /
meaning: सोमाय पितृमते षट्कपालः पुरोडाश उत्तानानि कपालानि / तूष्णीं तम् अनवेक्षमाणाः प्रचरेयुर् यथा पित्र्यायाम् /
text_mt: A six-potsherd sacrificial cake is for Soma accompanied by the fathers; the potsherds are [placed] turned upward. Silently, not looking at him, they should proceed as in the rite for the fathers.

sanskrit_iast: lupyeta yājamānam̐ sapatnīkam āvir bhūyāsam uttaram iti ceḍāntā saṃtiṣṭhate /
meaning: लुप्येत याजमानम्̐ सपत्नीकम् आविर् भूयासम् उत्तरम् इति चेडान्ता संतिष्ठते /
text_mt: The sacrificer's portion along with the wife's is omitted; with 'May I become manifest above,' it concludes with the iḍā portion.

sanskrit_iast: agreṇa gārhapatyam apareṇāhavanīyam̐ yajamānamātrīṃ karṣū khātvā tasyāṃ citiṃ cinvīta /
meaning: अग्रेण गार्हपत्यम् अपरेणाहवनीयम्̐ यजमानमात्रीं कर्षू खात्वा तस्यां चितिं चिन्वीत /
text_mt: In front of the gārhapatya [and] to the west of the āhavanīya, having dug a furrow of the measure of the sacrificer, he should pile up a pyre in it.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇājinam āstīrya tilair avakīryātīrthena śarīraṃ prapādya cityām āropya tilair avakīrya \\ asau svargāya lokāya svāhā \\ iti manasā pūrṇāhutiṃ juhuyāt /
meaning: कृष्णाजिनम् आस्तीर्य तिलैर् अवकीर्यातीर्थेन शरीरं प्रपाद्य चित्याम् आरोप्य तिलैर् अवकीर्य \\ असौ स्वर्गाय लोकाय स्वाहा \\ इति मनसा पूर्णाहुतिं जुहुयात् /
text_mt: Having spread out a black antelope skin, having scattered sesame seeds, having brought the body in by a non-standard passage, having placed it on the pyre, [and] having scattered sesame seeds, he should mentally offer a full offering with: 'To so-and-so for the heavenly world, svāhā.'

sanskrit_iast: chidreṣu hiraṇyaśakalān apyasyati \\ ṛce tvā \\ iti dakṣiṇasmin karṇachidre ruce tvā \\ iti savye bhāse tvā \\ iti dakṣiṇasminn akṣichidre jyotiṣe tvā \\ iti savye \\ abhūd idam iti dakṣiṇasmin nāsikāchidre \\ agner vaiśvānarasya \\ iti savye \\ agnis tejasā \\ ity āsye //
meaning: छिद्रेषु हिरण्यशकलान् अप्यस्यति \\ ऋचे त्वा \\ इति दक्षिणस्मिन् कर्णछिद्रे रुचे त्वा \\ इति सव्ये भासे त्वा \\ इति दक्षिणस्मिन्न् अक्षिछिद्रे ज्योतिषे त्वा \\ इति सव्ये \\ अभूद् इदम् इति दक्षिणस्मिन् नासिकाछिद्रे \\ अग्नेर् वैश्वानरस्य \\ इति सव्ये \\ अग्निस् तेजसा \\ इत्य् आस्ये //
text_mt: He throws gold pieces into the apertures: 'For the ṛc, to you,' into the right ear-hole; 'For splendour, to you,' into the left; 'For radiance, to you,' into the right eye-hole; 'For light, to you,' into the left; 'This has come into being,' into the right nostril; 'Of Agni Vaiśvānara,' into the left; 'Agni with brilliance,' into the mouth.

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyagarbhas \\ ity āsye juhuyād vyāhṛtibhiś ca /
meaning: हिरण्यगर्भस् \\ इत्य् आस्ये जुहुयाद् व्याहृतिभिश् च /
text_mt: He should offer [ghee] into the mouth with [the verse]: 'The golden embryo...' and with the sacred utterances.

sanskrit_iast: āsecanavanti pātrāṇi payasaḥ pūrayitvā dakṣiṇasminn am̐se juhūm̐ sahaprastarām̐ sādayati savya upabhṛtam urasi dhruvāṃ mukhe 'gnihotrahavanīṃ nāsikayoḥ sruvau lalāṭe prāśitraharaṇam̐ śirasi kapālāny ājyadhānīm̐ vedaṃ cāsye sahiraṇyaśakalaṃ puroḍāśaṃ kukṣyoḥ sāṃnāyyadhānyāv upasthe 'raṇī vakṣasi śamyāṃ pārśvayoḥ sphyopaveṣāv udara iḍāpātrīm ūrvor ulūkhalaṃ musalaṃ pādayoḥ śakaṭam antarorū itarāṇi yajñāṅgāni /
meaning: आसेचनवन्ति पात्राणि पयसः पूरयित्वा दक्षिणस्मिन्न् अम्̐से जुहूम्̐ सहप्रस्तराम्̐ सादयति सव्य उपभृतम् उरसि ध्रुवां मुखे ऽग्निहोत्रहवनीं नासिकयोः स्रुवौ ललाटे प्राशित्रहरणम्̐ शिरसि कपालान्य् आज्यधानीम्̐ वेदं चास्ये सहिरण्यशकलं पुरोडाशं कुक्ष्योः सांनाय्यधान्याव् उपस्थे ऽरणी वक्षसि शम्यां पार्श्वयोः स्फ्योपवेषाव् उदर इडापात्रीम् ऊर्वोर् उलूखलं मुसलं पादयोः शकटम् अन्तरोरू इतराणि यज्ञाङ्गानि /
text_mt: Having filled the pouring vessels with milk, he places the juhū spoon together with the sacred grass bundle on the right shoulder, the upabhṛt spoon on the left, the dhruvā ladle on the chest, the agnihotrahavanī ladle on the mouth, the two sruva ladles at the nostrils, the prāśitra vessel on the forehead, the potsherds, the clarified butter pot, and the grass broom on the head, the sacrificial cake containing a gold piece in the mouth, the two sāṃnāyya vessels on the sides of the belly, the two kindling sticks on the lap, the yoke-pin on the chest, the wooden sword and the poker on the sides, the iḍā vessel on the belly, the mortar and pestle on the thighs, the cart at the feet, [and] the other limbs of the sacrifice between the thighs.

sanskrit_iast: agnicitiś ced ekavim̐śatim iṣṭakāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ samantād upadadhyād atha vā lohitāḥ /
meaning: अग्निचितिश् चेद् एकविम्̐शतिम् इष्टकाः कृष्णाः समन्ताद् उपदध्याद् अथ वा लोहिताः /
text_mt: If he was a builder of the fire altar, he should place twenty-one black bricks all around, or else red ones.

sanskrit_iast: ajāṃ gām̐ vaikavarṇāṃ dakṣiṇāparasyāṃ diśi śavanirharaṇasya prathinā ghātayet /
meaning: अजां गाम्̐ वैकवर्णां दक्षिणापरस्यां दिशि शवनिर्हरणस्य प्रथिना घातयेत् /
text_mt: Along the path of carrying out the corpse, in the south-western direction, he should cause a goat or a cow of a single colour to be killed.

sanskrit_iast: tasyā vapām utkhidya mukhaṃ prachādya tilair avakīryāṅgeṣv aṅgāny abhividadhāti dakṣiṇeṣu dakṣiṇāni savyeṣu savyāni śirasi śiraś carmaṇā prachādya /
meaning: तस्या वपाम् उत्खिद्य मुखं प्रछाद्य तिलैर् अवकीर्याङ्गेष्व् अङ्गान्य् अभिविदधाति दक्षिणेषु दक्षिणानि सव्येषु सव्यानि शिरसि शिरश् चर्मणा प्रछाद्य /
text_mt: Having extracted its omentum, covered the face [with it], and scattered sesame seeds, he arranges the limbs onto the limbs—the right [animal limbs] on the right, the left on the left, [and] the head on the head, having covered [the body] with the hide.

sanskrit_iast: yadi tāṃ na ghātayed gārhapatye payaḥ śrapayitvā tasya santānam uddhṛtya mukhaṃ prachādya tilair avakīryolaparājībhis tisṛbhir ādīpayet /
meaning: यदि तां न घातयेद् गार्हपत्ये पयः श्रपयित्वा तस्य सन्तानम् उद्धृत्य मुखं प्रछाद्य तिलैर् अवकीर्योलपराजीभिस् तिसृभिर् आदीपयेत् /
text_mt: If he does not kill it, having boiled milk on the gārhapatya fire, having removed its cream, covered the face [with it], and scattered sesame seeds, he should set [the pyre] alight with three streaks of dried grass.

sanskrit_iast: yadi gārhapatyāt prathamaḥ śarīraṃ prāpnuyād devalokaṃ gamiṣyatīti vidyād yadi dakṣiṇāgneḥ pitṛlokam̐ yady āhavanīyād brahmalokam̐ yadi yugapat sarvām̐l lokān gamiṣyatīti vidyāt /
meaning: यदि गार्हपत्यात् प्रथमः शरीरं प्राप्नुयाद् देवलोकं गमिष्यतीति विद्याद् यदि दक्षिणाग्नेः पितृलोकम्̐ यद्य् आहवनीयाद् ब्रह्मलोकम्̐ यदि युगपत् सर्वाम्̐ल् लोकान् गमिष्यतीति विद्यात् /
text_mt: If [the fire] from the gārhapatya fire reaches the body first, he should know: 'He will go to the world of the gods'; if from the southern fire: 'To the world of the fathers'; if from the āhavanīya fire: 'To the world of Brahman'; if simultaneously: he should know: 'He will go to all worlds.'

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyena śakalena parilikhet tām̐ hiraṇyalekhāṃ manasādhvaryus triḥ pariṣiñced yathā pitryāyām //
meaning: हिरण्येन शकलेन परिलिखेत् ताम्̐ हिरण्यलेखां मनसाध्वर्युस् त्रिः परिषिञ्चेद् यथा पित्र्यायाम् //
text_mt: With a gold piece he should draw a line around [it]; the adhvaryu should mentally sprinkle water three times around that golden line, as in the rite for the fathers.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīṃ pratiparītya pādato 'vasthāya namo mahimne \\ iti pañcabhir upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: तूष्णीं प्रतिपरीत्य पादतो ऽवस्थाय नमो महिम्ने \\ इति पञ्चभिर् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: Having walked round silently and standing at the feet, he attends [the fire] with the five [mantras beginning with], 'Homage to greatness'.

sanskrit_iast: anāhitāgneḥ pramītasya vidhim̐ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: अनाहिताग्नेः प्रमीतस्य विधिम्̐ व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: Now we shall explain the rule for one who has died without having set up the sacred fires.

sanskrit_iast: śālāgninā dahanaṃ nirmanthena vā /
meaning: शालाग्निना दहनं निर्मन्थेन वा /
text_mt: The burning is with the domestic fire or with fire produced by friction.

sanskrit_iast: bālaś cet pramīyeta pṛthivī śarīram asi \\ iti manasā bhūmyām̐ śarīraṃ nikhaned araṇī ca / prāk cūḍākaraṇāt snātvā sadyaḥ śaucam̐ yajñādhyayanāni ca /
meaning: बालश् चेत् प्रमीयेत पृथिवी शरीरम् असि \\ इति मनसा भूम्याम्̐ शरीरं निखनेद् अरणी च / प्राक् चूडाकरणात् स्नात्वा सद्यः शौचम्̐ यज्ञाध्ययनानि च /
text_mt: If a child dies, one should bury the body in the ground silently with the thought, 'You are the earth, the body', and the two churning sticks as well. Prior to the tonsure ceremony, having bathed, there is immediate purification, as well as for sacrifice and recitation [of the Veda].

sanskrit_iast: vratopetaś cet pramīyeta vratam̐ visṛjya kāṣṭhānāṃ citim̐ saṃpūryāpasavyam ādāhaṃ kṛtvānapekṣamāṇāḥ pratyāyanti /
meaning: व्रतोपेतश् चेत् प्रमीयेत व्रतम्̐ विसृज्य काष्ठानां चितिम्̐ संपूर्यापसव्यम् आदाहं कृत्वानपेक्षमाणाः प्रत्यायन्ति /
text_mt: If one has died who has undertaken a vow, having discharged the vow, having completed a pyre of logs, and having performed the burning counter-clockwise, they return without looking back.

sanskrit_iast: sthirodakenopaspṛśya yatrauṣadhayo bahulā abhijāyante tatropaviśya yamagāthāṃ gāyanti /
meaning: स्थिरोदकेनोपस्पृश्य यत्रौषधयो बहुला अभिजायन्ते तत्रोपविश्य यमगाथां गायन्ति /
text_mt: Having touched standing water and sitting where plants grow abundantly, they sing a verse to Yama.

sanskrit_iast: dūrvākāṇḍapravālānām̐ śamīvaṭāpāmārgapravālānāṃ mūrdhani kṛtvā gavāṃ pṛṣṭhato grāmaṃ praviśeyuḥ /
meaning: दूर्वाकाण्डप्रवालानाम्̐ शमीवटापामार्गप्रवालानां मूर्धनि कृत्वा गवां पृष्ठतो ग्रामं प्रविशेयुः /
text_mt: Having placed sprouts of dūrvā stalks and sprouts of śamī, vaṭa, and apāmārga on their heads, they should enter the village behind the cows.

sanskrit_iast: goṣṭhadvāry akṣatam aśmānam agnim upaspṛśya praviśeyuḥ /
meaning: गोष्ठद्वार्य् अक्षतम् अश्मानम् अग्निम् उपस्पृश्य प्रविशेयुः /
text_mt: At the door of the cow-pen, having touched unhusked grain, a stone, and fire, they should enter.

sanskrit_iast: bahirdvāri karṣū khātvāśmānaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya payo 'dbhiḥ sam̐sṛjya pretasya nāmagotre gṛhītvā \\ atra piba snāyasva \\ iti ca brūyād yathākālaṃ ca piṇḍanidhānaṃ / dvādaśe 'hani śrāddhaṃ kurvīta /
meaning: बहिर्द्वारि कर्षू खात्वाश्मानं प्रतिष्ठाप्य पयो ऽद्भिः सम्̐सृज्य प्रेतस्य नामगोत्रे गृहीत्वा \\ अत्र पिब स्नायस्व \\ इति च ब्रूयाद् यथाकालं च पिण्डनिधानं / द्वादशे ऽहनि श्राद्धं कुर्वीत /
text_mt: Having dug a furrow outside the door, having set up a stone, having mixed milk with water, and having uttered the deceased's name and clan, one should say, 'Drink here, bathe here', and the laying down of rice-balls is according to the proper time. On the twelfth day he should perform a śrāddha.

sanskrit_iast: bahūn annavikārān upakalpayed ekasyaikān /
meaning: बहून् अन्नविकारान् उपकल्पयेद् एकस्यैकान् /
text_mt: He should prepare many varieties of food, one for each [brahmin].

sanskrit_iast: uddiṣṭaṃ kuryān nāgnau kuryāt //
meaning: उद्दिष्टं कुर्यान् नाग्नौ कुर्यात् //
text_mt: He should perform an rite directed to an individual (uddiṣṭa); he should not perform it in the fire.

sanskrit_iast: abhiramyatām iti visargo māsimāsi niyataṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayed ā sapiṇḍīkaraṇāt /
meaning: अभिरम्यताम् इति विसर्गो मासिमासि नियतं ब्राह्मणं भोजयेद् आ सपिण्डीकरणात् /
text_mt: The dismissal is with the words, 'May you take your pleasure'; month by month he should regularly feed a brahmin until the sapindisation rite (sapiṇḍīkaraṇa).

sanskrit_iast: deśāntarasthe prete saṃgrāmahate vā śarīram āhṛtya vidhinā dāhayet /
meaning: देशान्तरस्थे प्रेते संग्रामहते वा शरीरम् आहृत्य विधिना दाहयेत् /
text_mt: If the deceased died in another land or was killed in battle, having fetched the body, he should burn it according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast: yadi tan na vinded asthīny āhṛtya taiḥ puruṣākṛtiṃ kṛtvā madhusarpiṣābhyajya cityām āropya vidhinā dāhayet /
meaning: यदि तन् न विन्देद् अस्थीन्य् आहृत्य तैः पुरुषाकृतिं कृत्वा मधुसर्पिषाभ्यज्य चित्याम् आरोप्य विधिना दाहयेत् /
text_mt: If he does not find that, having brought the bones, having made a human shape with them, having anointed them with honey and clarified butter, and having mounted them on the pyre, he should burn them according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast: yadi sarvaṃ na vinded iṣṭaṃ kṛtvā kakṣam ādīpayed yajñapātrāṇi ca /
meaning: यदि सर्वं न विन्देद् इष्टं कृत्वा कक्षम् आदीपयेद् यज्ञपात्राणि च /
text_mt: If he does not find everything, having performed the sacrifice, he should set fire to dry grass and the sacrificial vessels.

sanskrit_iast: sarve jñātaya udakaṃ kurvanti / dauhitrān apy eke /
meaning: सर्वे ज्ञातय उदकं कुर्वन्ति / दौहित्रान् अप्य् एके /
text_mt: All kinsmen offer water. Some say even daughter's sons do so.

sanskrit_iast: savyakaniṣṭhikayā darbhāntarhitayā \\ amuṣmai prayachāmi \\ ity udakānte 'ñjaliṃ ninayed ekam ekasyāṃ catuś caturthām̐ sapta saptamyāṃ daśa dásamyām /
meaning: सव्यकनिष्ठिकया दर्भान्तर्हितया \\ अमुष्मै प्रयछामि \\ इत्य् उदकान्ते ऽञ्जलिं निनयेद् एकम् एकस्यां चतुश् चतुर्थाम्̐ सप्त सप्तम्यां दश द्áसम्याम् /
text_mt: With the left little finger wrapped with darbha grass, with the formula, 'To such-and-such a one I offer', he should pour a handful of water at the water's edge: one on the first [day], four on the fourth, seven on the seventh, and ten on the tenth.

sanskrit_iast: daśarātram āśaucavatāṃ guptāśanam̐ saṃcayanaṃ ca caturthyām /
meaning: दशरात्रम् आशौचवतां गुप्ताशनम्̐ संचयनं च चतुर्थ्याम् /
text_mt: For ten nights those under ritual impurity eat concealed food, and the gathering of bones takes place on the fourth [day].

sanskrit_iast: ayugmān brāhmaṇān bhojayet /
meaning: अयुग्मान् ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेत् /
text_mt: He should feed an odd number of brahmins.

sanskrit_iast: daśādamavakām̐ śamīm̐ vastrāvakṛtya ca haridraṃ kṣīrodakenāsthīny abhiṣicya savyakaniṣṭhikayā palāśavṛntena cāsthīni pattrapuṭe prasyati /
meaning: दशादमवकाम्̐ शमीम्̐ वस्त्रावकृत्य च हरिद्रं क्षीरोदकेनास्थीन्य् अभिषिच्य सव्यकनिष्ठिकया पलाशवृन्तेन चास्थीनि पत्त्रपुटे प्रस्यति /
text_mt: Having torn away a cloth with ten threads [of] avakā, śamī, and turmeric, and having sprinkled the bones with milk and water, he places the bones into a leaf receptacle with the left little finger and a palāśa petiole.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇapūrvasyāṃ diśi karṣū khātvā vāg iti nivapet /
meaning: दक्षिणपूर्वस्यां दिशि कर्षू खात्वा वाग् इति निवपेत् /
text_mt: Having dug a furrow in the south-eastern direction, he should scatter them with the word, 'Vāc'.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti daśa dhenūr daśānaḍuho daśa vāsām̐si daśa kām̐syāni /
meaning: दक्षिणां ददाति दश धेनूर् दशानडुहो दश वासाम्̐सि दश काम्̐स्यानि /
text_mt: He gives the sacrificial gift: ten milch-cows, ten draft-oxen, ten garments, ten bronze vessels.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāpānābhyām̐ vā ete vṛdhyante ye mṛtāya kurvanti /
meaning: प्राणापानाभ्याम्̐ वा एते वृध्यन्ते ये मृताय कुर्वन्ति /
text_mt: Verily, those who perform rites for the dead are separated from the in-breath and out-breath.

sanskrit_iast: tasmāt sam̐vatsaraṃ tapaś ca yogaśīlaḥ syāt ṣaṇmāsam ity eke /
meaning: तस्मात् सम्̐वत्सरं तपश् च योगशीलः स्यात् षण्मासम् इत्य् एके /
text_mt: Therefore, he should practice asceticism and yoga for a year; some say for six months.

sanskrit_iast: pitaraṃ bhrātaram upādhyāyam̐ vā yājayitvānulipyate /
meaning: पितरं भ्रातरम् उपाध्यायम्̐ वा याजयित्वानुलिप्यते /
text_mt: Having officiated for a father, a brother, or a teacher, one becomes tainted.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ kṛte ced āgached agnīn utpādyāyuṣyair iṣṭvāta ūrdhvam aparimitaiḥ kratubhir yajeta /
meaning: एवं कृते चेद् आगछेद् अग्नीन् उत्पाद्यायुष्यैर् इष्ट्वात ऊर्ध्वम् अपरिमितैः क्रतुभिर् यजेत /
text_mt: If he returns after this has been done, having produced the fires and having sacrificed with longevity offerings, he should thereafter sacrifice with unlimited sacrificial rites.

sanskrit_iast:
aśītyardham̐ śirasi dadyād grīvāyāṃ tu daśaiva tu /
bāhvos tu śataṃ dadyād aṅgulīṣu daśaiva tu /
urasi vim̐śatiṃ dadyāt trim̐śatiṃ jaghanodare /
aṣṭārdham̐ vṛṣaṇyor dadyād dvādaśārdham̐ prajanane /
ūrvos tu śataṃ dadyāt ṣaṣṭyardhaṃ jānujaṅghayoḥ /
pādāṅgulīṣu daśaiva eṣa pretavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ /
meaning:
अशीत्यर्धम्̐ शिरसि दद्याद् ग्रीवायां तु दशैव तु /
बाह्वोस् तु शतं दद्याद् अङ्गुलीषु दशैव तु /
उरसि विम्̐शतिं दद्यात् त्रिम्̐शतिं जघनोदरे /
अष्टार्धम्̐ वृषण्योर् दद्याद् द्वादशार्धम्̐ प्रजनने /
ऊर्वोस् तु शतं दद्यात् षष्ट्यर्धं जानुजङ्घयोः /
पादाङ्गुलीषु दशैव एष प्रेतविधिः स्मृतः /
text_mt: He should give forty [stalks] on the head, but exactly ten on the neck; / on the arms he should give a hundred, and on the fingers exactly ten; / on the chest he should give twenty, thirty on the hips and belly; / half of eight on the testicles, half of twelve on the generative organ; / on the thighs he should give a hundred, thirty on the knees and shanks; / and ten on the toes of the feet. This is handed down as the rule for the deceased.

sanskrit_iast: patyau prete 'nagnikāyāyājyā strīti śākalyaḥ /
meaning: पत्यौ प्रेते ऽनग्निकायायाज्या स्त्रीति शाकल्यः /
text_mt: When the husband is dead, a woman without sacred fires cannot be an offering-priestess: thus says Śākalya.

sanskrit_iast: sā kathaṃ pañcabhāgaṃ paricaret paricaryayety āha mārukaḥ /
meaning: सा कथं पञ्चभागं परिचरेत् परिचर्ययेत्य् आह मारुकः /
text_mt: 'How could she attend to the fifth portion by attendance?' says Māruka.

sanskrit_iast: yadi vicāritā suvratā syād adhvaryuḥ patnīm anubrūyād āvasathyam imaṃ paricaret /
meaning: यदि विचारिता सुव्रता स्याद् अध्वर्युः पत्नीम् अनुब्रूयाद् आवसथ्यम् इमं परिचरेत् /
text_mt: If, upon examination, she is of good conduct, the adhvaryu priest should say to the wife, 'Let her attend to this domestic fire (āvasathya)'.

sanskrit_iast: yadi vittā suvrateti citraseno vātsyāyana ācāryaḥ pretapatnyā vicāre /
meaning: यदि वित्ता सुव्रतेति चित्रसेनो वात्स्यायन आचार्यः प्रेतपत्न्या विचारे /
text_mt: 'If she is known to be of good conduct'—this is the teacher Citrasena Vātsyāyana's view regarding the examination of the deceased's wife.

sanskrit_iast: patitve prayuktā tadvratā tadduḥkhā tadācārā maladigdhaikaveṇī śucivāsā /
meaning: पतित्वे प्रयुक्ता तद्व्रता तद्दुःखा तदाचारा मलदिग्धैकवेणी शुचिवासा /
text_mt: Devoted to her state of wifehood, observing his vows, sharing his sorrow, keeping his conduct, wearing a single braid soiled with dirt, wearing pure clothes;

sanskrit_iast: notsaveṣu gachen nākāle snāyān na hṛṣyed ekakālam aśnīta paricarec chvaśrūm̐ śvaśuraṃ gurum /
meaning: नोत्सवेषु गछेन् नाकाले स्नायान् न हृष्येद् एककालम् अश्नीत परिचरेच् छ्वश्रूम्̐ श्वशुरं गुरुम् /
text_mt: She should not go to festivals, not bathe at improper times, not rejoice, eat once a day, and attend to her mother-in-law, father-in-law, and teacher.

sanskrit_iast: sugandhasragvivarjitāvasathyaṃ paricaret pākayajñadharmeṇa /
meaning: सुगन्धस्रग्विवर्जितावसथ्यं परिचरेत् पाकयज्ञधर्मेण /
text_mt: Free from fragrant garlands, she should attend to the domestic fire according to the rule of domestic cooked offerings (pākayajña).

sanskrit_iast: paurṇamāsyām amāvāsyāyām āgneyaḥ sthālīpākaḥ sāyaṃprātarhomaḥ / parvakāle cemā devatā yajeta somaṃ tvaṣṭāraṃ devānāṃ patnī rākām̐ sinīvālīm agniṃ gṛhapatim /
meaning: पौर्णमास्याम् अमावास्यायाम् आग्नेयः स्थालीपाकः सायंप्रातर्होमः / पर्वकाले चेमा देवता यजेत सोमं त्वष्टारं देवानां पत्नी राकाम्̐ सिनीवालीम् अग्निं गृहपतिम् /
text_mt: On the full-moon day and the new-moon day, there is a boiled oblation in a pot for Agni, and the evening and morning libations. And at the time of a junction, she should sacrifice to these deities: Soma, Tvaṣṭṛ, the Wives of the Gods, Rākā, Sinīvālī, and Agni Gṛhapati.

sanskrit_iast: ājyenaiva juhuyāt /
meaning: आज्येनैव जुहुयात् /

sanskrit_iast: sahāvad etau mithunau saṃbhavataḥ sahāgnīn ādhattaḥ saha prajāḥ prajanayataḥ /
meaning: सहावद् एतौ मिथुनौ संभवतः सहाग्नीन् आधत्तः सह प्रजाः प्रजनयतः /
text_mt: These two, coming together as a pair, set up the fires together and bring forth offspring together.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvo yajamānasya loko 'paraḥ patnyāḥ /
meaning: पूर्वो यजमानस्य लोको ऽपरः पत्न्याः /
text_mt: The former world is the sacrificer's; the latter is the wife's.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇārdhyā yasmāt proṣitasyāśaktivato patnī vrataṃ dhārayet tasmād ardhabhāginī bhavati /
meaning: दक्षिणार्ध्या यस्मात् प्रोषितस्याशक्तिवतो पत्नी व्रतं धारयेत् तस्माद् अर्धभागिनी भवति /
text_mt: Because the wife on the right-hand half observes the vow when he is away on a journey and unable, therefore she is an equal sharer of half.

sanskrit_iast: yājyāḥ striyo 'rdhabhāk patnī yajñe yajamānasya /
meaning: याज्याः स्त्रियो ऽर्धभाक् पत्नी यज्ञे यजमानस्य /
text_mt: Women are entitled to sacrificial rites; the wife is a sharer in half of the sacrificer's sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: yad āhavanīye juhoti tad iṣṭam̐ yajñam̐ yajamānasya gārhapatye hutaṃ patnyāḥ /
meaning: यद् आहवनीये जुहोति तद् इष्टम्̐ यज्ञम्̐ यजमानस्य गार्हपत्ये हुतं पत्न्याः /
text_mt: What he offers in the āhavanīya fire, that is the sacrificer's offered sacrifice; what is offered in the gārhapatya fire belongs to the wife.

sanskrit_iast: samavāye ca saṃ patnī patyā sukṛteṣu gachatām iti /
meaning: समवाये च सं पत्नी पत्या सुकृतेषु गछताम् इति /
text_mt: And in conjunction: 'May the wife go together with her husband to good deeds.'

sanskrit_iast: saha saṃbandhadarśanān mithunasya striyā vikṛtatvān mantrabrāhmaṇakalpeṣv evam eva darśayati śrutiḥ /
meaning: सह संबन्धदर्शनान् मिथुनस्य स्त्रिया विकृतत्वान् मन्त्रब्राह्मणकल्पेष्व् एवम् एव दर्शयति श्रुतिः /
text_mt: Because of seeing the mutual connection of the couple, even though the woman is altered [by widowhood], the revealed text (śruti) shows it thus in mantras, Brāhmaṇas, and manual rules.

sanskrit_iast: tatraike mṛtāṃ patnīm̐ śalāgninā dahanti nirmanthenānye sarvair agnibhir apare / tan na sūktam /
meaning: तत्रैके मृतां पत्नीम्̐ शलाग्निना दहन्ति निर्मन्थेनान्ये सर्वैर् अग्निभिर् अपरे / तन् न सूक्तम् /
text_mt: Here some burn a deceased wife with the domestic fire; others with fire produced by friction; others with all the fires. That is not correct.

sanskrit_iast:
yo dahed agnihotreṇa \ svena bhāryāṃ kathaṃcana /
sa strī saṃpadyate tena \ bhāryā cāsya pumān bhavet //
meaning:
यो दहेद् अग्निहोत्रेण \ स्वेन भार्यां कथंचन /
स स्त्री संपद्यते तेन \ भार्या चास्य पुमान् भवेत् //
text_mt:
Whoever burns his wife / with his own agnihotra fire in any way,

thereby he becomes a woman, / and his wife becomes a man.

sanskrit_iast: gārhapatyam upasamādhāya tasminn ukhām ādadhīta /
meaning: गार्हपत्यम् उपसमाधाय तस्मिन्न् उखाम् आदधीत /
text_mt: Having added fuel to the gārhapatya fire, he should place an ukhā pot upon it.

sanskrit_iast: taptāyāṃ kārpāsaṃ gośakṛccūrṇaṃ muñjāvalopam̐ śaṇam̐ śareṣikāḥ kramukam̐ sarpiḥ kṣipram agnijananyā vāpyaukhyam agnim avatārayet //
meaning: तप्तायां कार्पासं गोशकृच्चूर्णं मुञ्जावलोपम्̐ शणम्̐ शरेषिकाः क्रमुकम्̐ सर्पिः क्षिप्रम् अग्निजनन्या वाप्यौख्यम् अग्निम् अवतारयेत् //
text_mt: When it is heated, he should bring down the fire of the pot (aukhya) onto cotton, powdered cow dung, shreds of muñja grass, hemp, reed-stalks, areca nut, and clarified butter, or quickly with a fire-producing stick.

sanskrit_iast: yā te agne yogavatī priyā tanūḥ svarśokhārādvākhāta tayeda pātramārohati tasmai te namaḥ svāhā \\ iti hutvaukhyena vidhinā dāhayet /
meaning: या ते अग्ने योगवती प्रिया तनूः स्वर्शोखाराद्वाखात तयेद पात्रमारोहति तस्मै ते नमः स्वाहा \\ इति हुत्वौख्येन विधिना दाहयेत् /
text_mt: Having offered with the formula, 'Agni, that dear, union-possessing body of yours... to you homage, svāhā', he should burn [her] according to the rule with the pot-fire.

sanskrit_iast: atha yadi yajamānaḥ pūrvaṃ pramīyetādhānānupūrveṇa pañcadhāgnīn vihṛtyāvasathyaḥ patnyai pradeyaḥ /
meaning: अथ यदि यजमानः पूर्वं प्रमीयेताधानानुपूर्वेण पञ्चधाग्नीन् विहृत्यावसथ्यः पत्न्यै प्रदेयः /
text_mt: Now, if the sacrificer dies first, having divided the fires into five according to the order of their establishment, the domestic fire (āvasathya) is to be given to the wife.

sanskrit_iast: āvasathyaś cen na syād gārhapatyāt pañcabhāgaḥ pradeyaḥ /
meaning: आवसथ्यश् चेन् न स्याद् गार्हपत्यात् पञ्चभागः प्रदेयः /
text_mt: If there should not be a domestic fire, the fifth portion is to be given from the gārhapatya fire.

sanskrit_iast: nāraṇī striyo hy evāpatyāḥ /
meaning: नारणी स्त्रियो ह्य् एवापत्याः /
text_mt: The two churning sticks are not [given to her], for women are indeed non-churning [of fire].

sanskrit_iast: tam agnim upasamādhāya \\ ayaṃ no agnir varivas kṛṇotu \\ iti bhūṣaṇāni niṣṭapeyuḥ /
meaning: तम् अग्निम् उपसमाधाय \\ अयं नो अग्निर् वरिवस् कृणोतु \\ इति भूषणानि निष्टपेयुः /
text_mt: Having added fuel to that fire, they should heat her ornaments with the formula, 'May this Agni grant us wide space'.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣṭapteṣu
viśvaṃ jātam̐ viśvaṃ janitram \\ vaiśvānaram̐ viśvakarman huvema /
sabhyāvasathyau bahudhā nilīnau \ yoṣāgnayaḥ saṃbhavanti prātarkāḥ //
svāhā \\ iti juhoti /
meaning:
निष्टप्तेषु
विश्वं जातम्̐ विश्वं जनित्रम् \\ वैश्वानरम्̐ विश्वकर्मन् हुवेम /
सभ्यावसथ्यौ बहुधा निलीनौ \ योषाग्नयः संभवन्ति प्रातर्काः //
स्वाहा \\ इति जुहोति /
text_mt:
[with the verses,] 'Everything born, every origin, / Vaiśvānara, Viśvakarman we invoke;

The sabhya and āvasathya fires, deeply hidden in many places, / the woman-fires that arise in the morning,'

sanskrit_iast: svayamanugate sarva āyanti //
meaning: स्वयमनुगते सर्व आयन्ति //
text_mt: When it has gone out of itself, all return.

sanskrit_iast: ojo 'si \ saho 'si \ balam asi \ bhrājo 'si \\ iti svānisvāni bhūṣaṇāni punaragnikāle śālāgnau niṣṭapeyuḥ /
meaning: ओजो ऽसि \ सहो ऽसि \ बलम् असि \ भ्राजो ऽसि \\ इति स्वानिस्वानि भूषणानि पुनरग्निकाले शालाग्नौ निष्टपेयुः /
text_mt: With "You are vigor, you are overpowering power, you are strength, you are brilliance," they should warm their respective ornaments over the hall fire at the time of the renewed fire.

sanskrit_iast: yas tato 'bhisaṃkrāmet tam agnim upasamādhāya paricaret /
meaning: यस् ततो ऽभिसंक्रामेत् तम् अग्निम् उपसमाधाय परिचरेत् /
text_mt: Whichever [fire] he moves toward from there, having built up that fire, he should attend upon it.

sanskrit_iast: mṛtāyām̐ yāmyaś caruḥ saumyo nairṛto vā /
meaning: मृतायाम्̐ याम्यश् चरुः सौम्यो नैरृतो वा /
text_mt: When a woman has died, there is a boiled oblation for Yama, or for Soma, or for Nirṛti.

sanskrit_iast: athātas trayodaśe divase tripakṣe sam̐vatsare vṛddhau vā śrāddha ekodapātrasya sapiṇḍīkaraṇakalpam̐ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: अथातस् त्रयोदशे दिवसे त्रिपक्षे सम्̐वत्सरे वृद्धौ वा श्राद्ध एकोदपात्रस्य सपिण्डीकरणकल्पम्̐ व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: Now, therefore, we shall explain the procedure for the sapiṇḍīkaraṇa of the single water vessel, [performed] on the thirteenth day, after three fortnights, after a year, or at a rite of prosperity [in] the ancestral rite.

sanskrit_iast: paścād agneḥ sameṣu darbheṣu catvāry udapātrāṇi prayunakti /
meaning: पश्चाद् अग्नेः समेषु दर्भेषु चत्वार्य् उदपात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति /
text_mt: Behind the fire, on even darbha blades, he arranges four water vessels.

sanskrit_iast: tatraikaṃ pretīyaṃ pātraṃ trīṇi pitṛbhyaḥ /
meaning: तत्रैकं प्रेतीयं पात्रं त्रीणि पितृभ्यः /
text_mt: Among them, one vessel is for the deceased, and three are for the fathers.

sanskrit_iast: tat pretapātraṃ pitṛpātreṣv āsiñcati ye samānāḥ samanasas \\ iti dvābhyām /
meaning: तत् प्रेतपात्रं पितृपात्रेष्व् आसिञ्चति ये समानाः समनसस् \\ इति द्वाभ्याम् /
text_mt: He pours that vessel of the deceased into the vessels of the fathers with the two [verses]: "They who are equals, harmonious...".

sanskrit_iast: evam eva piṇḍapitṛyajñena vidhir vyākhyātaḥ /
meaning: एवम् एव पिण्डपितृयज्ञेन विधिर् व्याख्यातः /
text_mt: In this very way, the procedure has been explained by the ancestral ball-offering.

sanskrit_iast: athātaḥ saṃnyāsavidhim̐ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: अथातः संन्यासविधिम्̐ व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: Now, therefore, we shall explain the rule for renunciation.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhasthe prayogo 'patyam utpādya dṛṣṭvāpatye 'patyāni vā teṣām̐ vṛttiṃ kalpayitvā guṇavati putre kuṭumbam āveśyāthāsyāgniviniyogaḥ /
meaning: गृहस्थे प्रयोगो ऽपत्यम् उत्पाद्य दृष्ट्वापत्ये ऽपत्यानि वा तेषाम्̐ वृत्तिं कल्पयित्वा गुणवति पुत्रे कुटुम्बम् आवेश्याथास्याग्निविनियोगः /
text_mt: The performance for a householder: having begotten offspring, or having seen offspring upon offspring, having secured their livelihood, having entrusted the household to a virtuous son, then [takes place] his disposal of the fires.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye pathikṛte 'ṣṭākapālam agnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet /
meaning: अग्नये पथिकृते ऽष्टाकपालम् अग्नये वैश्वानराय द्वादशकपालं निर्वपेत् /
text_mt: He should apportion [the havis for] an eight-potsherd [cake] for Agni Pathikṛt and a twelve-potsherd [cake] for Agni Vaiśvānara.

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātaḥ prayogaḥ siddhaṃ nirvapaṇam /
meaning: व्याख्यातः प्रयोगः सिद्धं निर्वपणम् /
text_mt: The performance is explained; the apportioning is established.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇākāle sarvasvaṃ dadyāt /
meaning: दक्षिणाकाले सर्वस्वं दद्यात् /
text_mt: At the time of the sacrificial gift, he should give away his entire property.

sanskrit_iast: sakulyān āmantryātmany agnīn samāropayet sakhā hy agnir vai sākṣī sukṛtasya duṣkṛtasyety ayam arthaḥ //
meaning: सकुल्यान् आमन्त्र्यात्मन्य् अग्नीन् समारोपयेत् सखा ह्य् अग्निर् वै साक्षी सुकृतस्य दुष्कृतस्येत्य् अयम् अर्थः //
text_mt: Having taken leave of his kinsmen, he should deposit the fires into himself; for the fire is a friend, a witness of good deeds and evil deeds—this is the meaning.

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ te yonir ṛtviyas \\ ity āhavanīye gārhapatye dakṣiṇāgnau cātmānaṃ pratāpayet /
meaning: अयं ते योनिर् ऋत्वियस् \\ इत्य् आहवनीये गार्हपत्ये दक्षिणाग्नौ चात्मानं प्रतापयेत् /
text_mt: With "This is your seasonal womb...", he should warm himself over the āhavanīya fire, the gārhapatya fire, and the southern fire.

sanskrit_iast: sarvāṇi yajñapātrāṇy antarvedi puruṣākṛtiṃ kṛtvolaparajībhis tisṛbhir ādīpayet /
meaning: सर्वाणि यज्ञपात्राण्य् अन्तर्वेदि पुरुषाकृतिं कृत्वोलपरजीभिस् तिसृभिर् आदीपयेत् /
text_mt: Having arranged all the sacrificial vessels in the shape of a man within the altar, he should set them on fire with three bundles of reed grass.

sanskrit_iast: adyātra trayyā vācā vadai //
meaning: अद्यात्र त्रय्या वाचा वदै //
text_mt: "Today, here, let me speak with the threefold speech."

sanskrit_iast: yo no agnir \ mayi gṛhṇāmi \\ ity āhavanīyād gārhapatyād dakṣiṇāgneś ca bhasmamuṣṭiṃ gṛhṇāti / yathāyaṃ bhasmamuṣṭir digbhya āhṛto digbhya eva gachaty evam //
meaning: यो नो अग्निर् \ मयि गृह्णामि \\ इत्य् आहवनीयाद् गार्हपत्याद् दक्षिणाग्नेश् च भस्ममुष्टिं गृह्णाति / यथायं भस्ममुष्टिर् दिग्भ्य आहृतो दिग्भ्य एव गछत्य् एवम् //
text_mt: With "The fire which to us...", "I take into myself...", he takes a handful of ashes from the āhavanīya fire, from the gārhapatya fire, and from the southern fire. Just as this handful of ashes was brought from the quarters, in the same way it goes back to the quarters.

sanskrit_iast: atha bhava \\ ity ante 'pividhyaty anapekṣamāṇo vrajati /
meaning: अथ भव \\ इत्य् अन्ते ऽपिविध्यत्य् अनपेक्षमाणो व्रजति /
text_mt: With "Now become...", he casts it [into water] at the end, and walks away without looking back.

sanskrit_iast: yat sāyaṃ prāśnāti so 'sya sāyam̐homo yat prātaḥ so 'sya prātarhomo yad darśe tad vā darśam̐ yat pūrṇamāse tat paurṇamāsyam /
meaning: यत् सायं प्राश्नाति सो ऽस्य सायम्̐होमो यत् प्रातः सो ऽस्य प्रातर्होमो यद् दर्शे तद् वा दर्शम्̐ यत् पूर्णमासे तत् पौर्णमास्यम् /
text_mt: What he eats in the evening, that is his evening offering; what [he eats] in the morning, that is his morning offering; what [he eats] on the new moon, that is his New-Moon sacrifice; what [he eats] on the full moon, that is his Full-Moon sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: yan navasyāśnāti tenāsyāgrāyaṇam avāpnoti / yad vasante keśaśmaśru vāpayate so 'syāgniṣṭomaḥ /
meaning: यन् नवस्याश्नाति तेनास्याग्रायणम् अवाप्नोति / यद् वसन्ते केशश्मश्रु वापयते सो ऽस्याग्निष्टोमः /
text_mt: What he eats of the new [grain], through that he attains his first-fruits offering. When he has his hair and beard shaved in the spring, that is his Agniṣṭoma.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa saṃnyāso 'raṇyam̐ vrajati mūlaphalabhakṣo 'tyantabhaikṣabhakṣo vā /
meaning: एष संन्यासो ऽरण्यम्̐ व्रजति मूलफलभक्षो ऽत्यन्तभैक्षभक्षो वा /
text_mt: This is renunciation: he departs to the wilderness, subsisting on roots and fruits, or subsisting purely on alms.

sanskrit_iast: ata ūrdhvam agnipraveśanam̐ vīrādhvānam anāśakam̐ vā vṛddhāśramam̐ vāgachati /
meaning: अत ऊर्ध्वम् अग्निप्रवेशनम्̐ वीराध्वानम् अनाशकम्̐ वा वृद्धाश्रमम्̐ वागछति /
text_mt: From then on, he undertakes entering into fire, the hero's path, fasting unto death, or the stage of the aged.

sanskrit_iast: na punar āgachati / yady āgachati vīrahā bhavati /
meaning: न पुनर् आगछति / यद्य् आगछति वीरहा भवति /
text_mt: He does not return again. If he returns, he becomes a slayer of heroes.

sanskrit_iast: athātas tīrthasaṃcārān vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: अथातस् तीर्थसंचारान् व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: Now, therefore, we shall explain the movement through the passages.

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīyotkarāv antarā tīrthaṃ cātvālotkarāv antarā dvitīyaṃ cātvālāhavanīyāv antarā tṛtīyam āhavanīyam̐ srucaś cāntareṇa caturthaṃ dakṣiṇasmin paridhisaṃdhau pañcamam /
meaning: आहवनीयोत्कराव् अन्तरा तीर्थं चात्वालोत्कराव् अन्तरा द्वितीयं चात्वालाहवनीयाव् अन्तरा तृतीयम् आहवनीयम्̐ स्रुचश् चान्तरेण चतुर्थं दक्षिणस्मिन् परिधिसंधौ पञ्चमम् /
text_mt: Between the āhavanīya fire and the rubbish heap is a passage; between the pit and the rubbish heap is the second; between the pit and the āhavanīya fire is the third; between the āhavanīya fire and the srucs is the fourth; at the southern joint of the enclosing sticks is the fifth.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyaṃ prathamam̐ vāruṇaṃ dvitīyam̐ vāyavyaṃ tṛtīyam āśvinaṃ caturtham̐ vaiṣṇavaṃ pañcamam /
meaning: आग्नेयं प्रथमम्̐ वारुणं द्वितीयम्̐ वायव्यं तृतीयम् आश्विनं चतुर्थम्̐ वैष्णवं पञ्चमम् /
text_mt: The first belongs to Agni, the second to Varuṇa, the third to Vāyu, the fourth to the Aśvins, the fifth to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast: eteṣām ānupūrvyā pracārān vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: एतेषाम् आनुपूर्व्या प्रचारान् व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: We shall explain their operations in order.

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīyotkarāv antarā pātrāṇāṃ patnīnāṃ kanyānām udakānām ājyānām̐ haviṣām̐ samidhām̐ sam̐skārasamāharaṇadohanatīrtham /
meaning: आहवनीयोत्कराव् अन्तरा पात्राणां पत्नीनां कन्यानाम् उदकानाम् आज्यानाम्̐ हविषाम्̐ समिधाम्̐ सम्̐स्कारसमाहरणदोहनतीर्थम् /
text_mt: Between the āhavanīya fire and the rubbish heap is the passage for the vessels, the wives, the young women, the waters, the clarified butter portions, the oblations, the firewood, the ritual preparation, the bringing together, and the milking.

sanskrit_iast: cātvālotkarāv anatarartvijāṃ praveśanam̐ yajamānasya ca sadasaś copagamanam /
meaning: चात्वालोत्कराव् अनतरर्त्विजां प्रवेशनम्̐ यजमानस्य च सदसश् चोपगमनम् /
text_mt: Between the pit and the rubbish heap is the entry of the officiating priests and the sacrificer, and the approaching of the sadas.

sanskrit_iast: cātvālāhavanīyāv antarā jāghanīparikramaṇaṃ paśuparikramaṇam̐ vapāyā yūpasya cānvāhāram /
meaning: चात्वालाहवनीयाव् अन्तरा जाघनीपरिक्रमणं पशुपरिक्रमणम्̐ वपाया यूपस्य चान्वाहारम् /
text_mt: Between the pit and the āhavanīya fire is the circumambulation with the tail, the circumambulation with the animal, and the bringing up of the omentum and of the sacrificial post.

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīyam̐ srucaś cāntareṇādhvaryuyajamānayor dakṣiṇātikramaṇaṃ pratikramaṇam anuvyākhyātam /
meaning: आहवनीयम्̐ स्रुचश् चान्तरेणाध्वर्युयजमानयोर् दक्षिणातिक्रमणं प्रतिक्रमणम् अनुव्याख्यातम् /
text_mt: Between the āhavanīya fire and the srucs is explained the stepping across to the south and the returning of the adhvaryu priest and the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇasmin paridhisaṃdhāv āśrāvaṇapreṣaṇasvāhākāravaṣaṭkāranamaskārasamidāhutilokatīrtham /
meaning: दक्षिणस्मिन् परिधिसंधाव् आश्रावणप्रेषणस्वाहाकारवषट्कारनमस्कारसमिदाहुतिलोकतीर्थम् /
text_mt: At the southern joint of the enclosing sticks is the world-passage for the āśrāvaṇa call, the direction, the svāhā-call, the vaṣaṭ-call, the homage, and the firewood offering.

sanskrit_iast: etāni vai pañca tīrthāni bhavanti /
meaning: एतानि वै पञ्च तीर्थानि भवन्ति /
text_mt: These, indeed, are the five passages.

sanskrit_iast: ye pañca sam̐vatsarās tīrtheṣu pratiṣṭhitāḥ paṅktiriti vijñāyate /
meaning: ये पञ्च सम्̐वत्सरास् तीर्थेषु प्रतिष्ठिताः पङ्क्तिरिति विज्ञायते /
text_mt: It is known: "The five years that are established in the passages are a paṅkti."

sanskrit_iast: atīrthaprapannā ṛtvijaḥ purāyuṣaḥ pramāyukā bhavanti / tīrthaprapannāḥ sarvam āyur yanti /
meaning: अतीर्थप्रपन्ना ऋत्विजः पुरायुषः प्रमायुका भवन्ति / तीर्थप्रपन्नाः सर्वम् आयुर् यन्ति /
text_mt: The officiating priests who proceed along non-passages are liable to die before their full lifespan. Those who proceed along the passages reach their full lifespan.

sanskrit_iast: ya evam̐ vidvān pracaret sarve kāmā asya samṛdhyante /
meaning: य एवम्̐ विद्वान् प्रचरेत् सर्वे कामा अस्य समृध्यन्ते /
text_mt: For him who operates knowing thus, all desires are fulfilled.

sanskrit_iast: ato yad anyathā pracared ardham asya yajñasya varuṇapāśair badhyate / nāsya yajño devaṃgamo bhavati nāsya yajño devaṃgamo bhavatīti /
meaning: अतो यद् अन्यथा प्रचरेद् अर्धम् अस्य यज्ञस्य वरुणपाशैर् बध्यते / नास्य यज्ञो देवंगमो भवति नास्य यज्ञो देवंगमो भवतीति /
text_mt: If he operates otherwise than this, half of his sacrifice is bound by Varuṇa's fetters. His sacrifice does not go to the gods; his sacrifice does not go to the gods.

sanskrit_iast: atha rājasūyasūtraprārambhaḥ / rājā rājyakāmo rājasūyena yajeta /
meaning: अथ राजसूयसूत्रप्रारम्भः / राजा राज्यकामो राजसूयेन यजेत /
text_mt: Now begins the sūtra of the Rājasūya: A king desiring sovereignty should sacrifice with the Rājasūya.

sanskrit_iast: bhārgavo hotā /
meaning: भार्गवो होता /

sanskrit_iast: āśvayujyāmamāvāsyāyām̐ vā yajanīye 'hany agniṣṭomāya jyotiṣṭomāya dīkṣate /
meaning: आश्वयुज्याममावास्यायाम्̐ वा यजनीये ऽहन्य् अग्निष्टोमाय ज्योतिष्टोमाय दीक्षते /
text_mt: On the full-moon day of Āśvayuja or on the new-moon day, on the day of sacrifice, he undergoes consecration for an Agniṣṭoma or a Jyotiṣṭoma.

sanskrit_iast: sa siddhaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate /
meaning: स सिद्धः संतिष्ठते /
text_mt: It is completed in the established manner.

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte 'numatyā aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati /
meaning: श्वोभूते ऽनुमत्या अष्टाकपालं निर्वपति /
text_mt: On the next day, he apportions an eight-potsherd [cake] for Anumati.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ādhivapanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आधिवपनात् /

sanskrit_iast: prāgadhivapanāt śamyāśiṣṭaṃ dṛṣadā samaṃ kuryāt /
meaning: प्रागधिवपनात् शम्याशिष्टं दृषदा समं कुर्यात् /
text_mt: Before placing [the grains], he should make level with the upper mill-stone that which is left by the peg.

sanskrit_iast: ye pratyañcaḥ śamyām atiśīyante tan nairṛtam ekakapālam /
meaning: ये प्रत्यञ्चः शम्याम् अतिशीयन्ते तन् नैरृतम् एककपालम् /
text_mt: Those [grains] that fall beyond the peg to the west form the one-potsherd [cake] for Nirṛti.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīṃ dakṣiṇāgnau śrapayaty ānumataṃ gārhapatya / ubhau saha śṛtau kurvanti /
meaning: तूष्णीं दक्षिणाग्नौ श्रपयत्य् आनुमतं गार्हपत्य / उभौ सह शृतौ कुर्वन्ति /
text_mt: He bakes it silently on the southern fire, and that for Anumati on the gārhapatya fire; they cook both together.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā pracaraṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ प्रचरणात् /

sanskrit_iast: ājyabhāgābhyāṃ pracarya vīhi svāhāhutiṃ juṣāṇas \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnau juṣaṃ juhoti /
meaning: आज्यभागाभ्यां प्रचर्य वीहि स्वाहाहुतिं जुषाणस् \\ इति दक्षिणाग्नौ जुषं जुहोति /
text_mt: Having proceeded with the two clarified butter portions, he offers the pleasing offering on the southern fire with "Enjoy, pleasing, the svāhā-offering...".

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇā paretya svakṛta iriṇa ekolmukaṃ nidhāya visram̐sikāyāḥ kāṇḍābhyāṃ juhoti juṣāṇā nirṛtir vetu svāhā \\ iti juhoti /
meaning: दक्षिणा परेत्य स्वकृत इरिण एकोल्मुकं निधाय विस्रम्̐सिकायाः काण्डाभ्यां जुहोति जुषाणा निरृतिर् वेतु स्वाहा \\ इति जुहोति /
text_mt: Having gone away to the south, having placed a single firebrand on a naturally formed barren ground, he offers with two reeds of visraṃsikā-grass; he offers with "May Nirṛti, pleased, accept, svāhā!".

sanskrit_iast: vāsaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ bhinnāntaṃ dakṣiṇā //
meaning: वासः कृष्णं भिन्नान्तं दक्षिणा //
text_mt: A black garment with torn edges is the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: svāhā namo ya idaṃ cakāra \\ iti gārhapatye hutvānumatena pracaranti /
meaning: स्वाहा नमो य इदं चकार \\ इति गार्हपत्ये हुत्वानुमतेन प्रचरन्ति /
text_mt: Having offered in the gārhapatya fire with "Svāhā! Homage to him who has done this!", they proceed with that [cake] for Anumati.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇākāle dhenur dakṣiṇā /
meaning: दक्षिणाकाले धेनुर् दक्षिणा /
text_mt: At the time of the sacrificial gift, a milch cow is the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā vedastaraṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ वेदस्तरणात् /
text_mt: [The rite is] established up to the strewing of the altar.

sanskrit_iast: atha ya udañcaḥ śamyām atiśīyante tān udak paretya valmīkavapām uddhṛtya \\ idam aham amuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasya kṣetriyam avayaje \\ ity uktvā juhoti \\ idam aham amuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasya kṣetriyam apidadhāmi \\ iti loṣṭenāpidadhāti /
meaning: अथ य उदञ्चः शम्याम् अतिशीयन्ते तान् उदक् परेत्य वल्मीकवपाम् उद्धृत्य \\ इदम् अहम् अमुष्यामुष्यायणस्य क्षेत्रियम् अवयजे \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा जुहोति \\ इदम् अहम् अमुष्यामुष्यायणस्य क्षेत्रियम् अपिदधामि \\ इति लोष्टेनापिदधाति /
text_mt: Now, those [grains] that fall beyond the peg to the north: having gone away to the north with them, having extracted the heart of an ant-hill, having said, "Here I sacrifice away the hereditary disease of so-and-so, descendant of so-and-so," he offers; with "Here I cover up the hereditary disease of so-and-so, descendant of so-and-so," he covers it with a clod of earth.

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūta ādityebhyo bhuvadvadbhyo ghṛte carur itiprabhṛti yathāmnātam /
meaning: श्वोभूत आदित्येभ्यो भुवद्वद्भ्यो घृते चरुर् इतिप्रभृति यथाम्नातम् /
text_mt: On the next day, a boiled oblation in clarified butter for the prosperous Ādityas, and so forth, as handed down by tradition.

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūta āgrāyaṇo / vatsaḥ prathamajo dakṣiṇā /
meaning: श्वोभूत आग्रायणो / वत्सः प्रथमजो दक्षिणा /
text_mt: On the next day, the first-fruits sacrifice; a first-born calf is the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte cāturmāsyāni paurṇamāsyām ārabhya sam̐vatsare 'pavarjayet /
meaning: श्वोभूते चातुर्मास्यानि पौर्णमास्याम् आरभ्य सम्̐वत्सरे ऽपवर्जयेत् /
text_mt: On the next day, having begun the four-month sacrifices on a full-moon day, he should conclude them after a year.

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūta indraturīyam āgneyo 'ṣṭākapālo vāruṇo yavamayaś carū raudro gāvīdhukaś carur aindraṃ dadhi / dhenur anaḍvāhī dakṣiṇā /
meaning: श्वोभूत इन्द्रतुरीयम् आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपालो वारुणो यवमयश् चरू रौद्रो गावीधुकश् चरुर् ऐन्द्रं दधि / धेनुर् अनड्वाही दक्षिणा /
text_mt: On the next day, the Indraturīya [offering]: an eight-potsherd [cake] for Agni, a barley boiled oblation for Varuṇa, a gāvīdhuka boiled oblation for Rudra, and curds for Indra; a draft cow is the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: apāṃ nyayanād apāmārgān āharanti / tān saktūn kṛtvā śvobhūte prāgudayād apāmārgeṇa pracaranti /
meaning: अपां न्ययनाद् अपामार्गान् आहरन्ति / तान् सक्तून् कृत्वा श्वोभूते प्रागुदयाद् अपामार्गेण प्रचरन्ति /
text_mt: They bring apāmārga plants from a confluence of waters; having made them into groats, they proceed with the apāmārga offering on the next day before sunrise.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇā paretya svakṛta iriṇa ekolmukaṃ nidhāya parṇamayena sruveṇa devasya tvā savituḥ prasave \\ iti juhoti //
meaning: दक्षिणा परेत्य स्वकृत इरिण एकोल्मुकं निधाय पर्णमयेन स्रुवेण देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे \\ इति जुहोति //
text_mt: Having gone toward the south, having placed a single firebrand on a naturally barren piece of land, he offers with a sruva ladle made of palāśa wood: 'At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ...'

sanskrit_iast: hatam̐ rakṣas \\ avadhiṣma rakṣas \\ ity anūpatiṣṭhate / varo dakṣiṇā /
meaning: हतम्̐ रक्षस् \\ अवधिष्म रक्षस् \\ इत्य् अनूपतिष्ठते / वरो दक्षिणा /
text_mt: He stands worshipping with: 'Slain is the rakṣas,' 'We have slain the rakṣas.' A chosen wish is the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: sāyaṃ pañcedhmīyān avanīya pañcadhā vyudūhyedhmān ādadhāti //
meaning: सायं पञ्चेध्मीयान् अवनीय पञ्चधा व्युदूह्येध्मान् आदधाति //
text_mt: In the evening, having poured out five [portions of water] suitable for kindling sticks, having divided the kindling sticks into five parts, he lays them on.

sanskrit_iast: ye devāḥ puraḥsadas \\ iti pūrvārdhe juhoti pradakṣiṇam uttarair anuparikrāmaṃ na pratiparikramya pañcamena madhye //
meaning: ये देवाः पुरःसदस् \\ इति पूर्वार्धे जुहोति प्रदक्षिणम् उत्तरैर् अनुपरिक्रामं न प्रतिपरिक्रम्य पञ्चमेन मध्ये //
text_mt: With: 'Whichever gods sit in front...' he offers in the eastern half, moving around clockwise with the following [mantras] without turning back, [and offers] in the middle with the fifth.

sanskrit_iast: idam aham̐ rakṣo 'bhisamūhāmi \\ itiprabhṛtibhir āhavanīyam̐ samūhya \\ agnaye puraḥsade svāhā \\ iti pūrvārdhe juhoti pradakṣiṇam uttarair anuparikrāmaṃ na pratiparikramya pañcamena madhye /
meaning: इदम् अहम्̐ रक्षो ऽभिसमूहामि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् आहवनीयम्̐ समूह्य \\ अग्नये पुरःसदे स्वाहा \\ इति पूर्वार्धे जुहोति प्रदक्षिणम् उत्तरैर् अनुपरिक्रामं न प्रतिपरिक्रम्य पञ्चमेन मध्ये /
text_mt: Having swept together the āhavanīya fire with [the mantras] beginning with: 'Here I sweep together the rakṣas,' he offers in the eastern half with: 'To Agni who sits in front, svāhā,' moving around clockwise with the following [mantras] without turning back, [and offers] in the middle with the fifth.

sanskrit_iast: rathaḥ pañcavāhī dakṣiṇā /
meaning: रथः पञ्चवाही दक्षिणा /
text_mt: The sacrificial gift is a chariot drawn by five horses.

sanskrit_iast: amāvāsyāyāṃ niśi pañcedhmīyena yajeta yo rakṣobhyo bibhīyāt piśācebhyo vā /
meaning: अमावास्यायां निशि पञ्चेध्मीयेन यजेत यो रक्षोभ्यो बिभीयात् पिशाचेभ्यो वा /
text_mt: One who fears the Rakṣases or the Piśācas should sacrifice with [the rite of] five bundles of sacrificial fuel on the night of the new-moon day.

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte devikāpaṣṭhauhī dakṣiṇā /
meaning: श्वोभूते देविकापष्ठौही दक्षिणा /
text_mt: On the next day, [the rite of] the Devikās [is performed]; a two-year-old cow is the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte triṣam̐yuktam āgnāvaiṣṇava ekādaśakapāla aindrāvaiṣṇavaś carur vaiṣṇavas trikapālo vāmano dakṣiṇā /
meaning: श्वोभूते त्रिषम्̐युक्तम् आग्नावैष्णव एकादशकपाल ऐन्द्रावैष्णवश् चरुर् वैष्णवस् त्रिकपालो वामनो दक्षिणा /
text_mt: On the next day, the triple-combined [offering is performed]: an eleven-potsherd [cake] to Agni and Viṣṇu, a boiled oblation to Indra and Viṣṇu, and a three-potsherd [cake] to Viṣṇu; a dwarf [animal] is the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūta uttaram̐ somāpauṣṇa ekādaśakapāla aindrāpauṣṇaś caruḥ pauṣṇaś caruḥ / śyāmo dakṣiṇā /
meaning: श्वोभूत उत्तरम्̐ सोमापौष्ण एकादशकपाल ऐन्द्रापौष्णश् चरुः पौष्णश् चरुः / श्यामो दक्षिणा /
text_mt: On the next day, the subsequent [triple offering is performed]: an eleven-potsherd [cake] to Soma and Pūṣan, a boiled oblation to Indra and Pūṣan, and a boiled oblation to Pūṣan; a dark-grey [animal] is the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte vaiśvānaram̐ vāruṇam agnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapāla iyān vāruṇo yavamayaś carur hiraṇyaṃ cāśvaś ca dakṣiṇā /
meaning: श्वोभूते वैश्वानरम्̐ वारुणम् अग्नये वैश्वानराय द्वादशकपाल इयान् वारुणो यवमयश् चरुर् हिरण्यं चाश्वश् च दक्षिणा /
text_mt: On the next day, [the offering] to Vaiśvānara and Varuṇa: a twelve-potsherd [cake] to Agni Vaiśvānara, and this much boiled oblation made of barley to Varuṇa; gold and a horse are the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte bārhaspatyaś carur brahmaṇo gṛha itiprabhṛtayo ratninaḥ /
meaning: श्वोभूते बार्हस्पत्यश् चरुर् ब्रह्मणो गृह इतिप्रभृतयो रत्निनः /
text_mt: On the next day, a boiled oblation to Bṛhaspati at the house of the brahman priest, and so forth: [these are the offerings to] the jewel-holders.

sanskrit_iast: ta iṣṭipariveṣaṃ dadyur yeṣāṃ gṛheṣv anvaham̐ yajeta /
meaning: त इष्टिपरिवेषं दद्युर् येषां गृहेष्व् अन्वहम्̐ यजेत /
text_mt: Those in whose houses he sacrifices day after day should give the meal for the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: aṅguṣṭhaparvamātro nairṛtaś carur nakhanirbhinnānāṃ tūṣṇīṃ dakṣiṇāgnau śrapayati /
meaning: अङ्गुष्ठपर्वमात्रो नैरृतश् चरुर् नखनिर्भिन्नानां तूष्णीं दक्षिणाग्नौ श्रपयति /
text_mt: A boiled oblation to Nirṛti the size of a thumb-joint, prepared from grains split by fingernails, he cooks silently on the southern fire.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇā paretya svakṛta iriṇa ekolmukaṃ nidhāya pradare vā nirṛtyai svāhā \\ iti juhoti /
meaning: दक्षिणा परेत्य स्वकृत इरिण एकोल्मुकं निधाय प्रदरे वा निरृत्यै स्वाहा \\ इति जुहोति /
text_mt: Going away toward the south, having placed a single firebrand in a natural salt-bed or in a cleft [in the ground], he offers [it with]: "To Nirṛti, svāhā!"

sanskrit_iast: ratnibhya ūrdhvaḥ punar aindra ekādaśakapālo rājño gṛha ṛṣabho dakṣiṇā /
meaning: रत्निभ्य ऊर्ध्वः पुनर् ऐन्द्र एकादशकपालो राज्ञो गृह ऋषभो दक्षिणा /
text_mt: After the jewel-holders, there is again an eleven-potsherd [cake] to Indra at the house of the king; a bull is the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte prayogāv indrāyām̐homuca ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvaped indrāya sutrāmṇa ekādaśakapālam ṛṣabho dakṣiṇā /
meaning: श्वोभूते प्रयोगाव् इन्द्रायाम्̐होमुच एकादशकपालं निर्वपेद् इन्द्राय सुत्राम्ण एकादशकपालम् ऋषभो दक्षिणा /
text_mt: On the next day, the two Prayoga offerings: he should apportion an eleven-potsherd [cake] to Indra Aṃhomuc [and] an eleven-potsherd [cake] to Indra Sutrāman; a bull is the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: anvaham̐ yajeta /
meaning: अन्वहम्̐ यजेत /

sanskrit_iast: pārvaṇaḥ parvaṇi /
meaning: पार्वणः पर्वणि /

sanskrit_iast: traidhātavyayānyat sahasraṃ dakṣiṇā /
meaning: त्रैधातव्ययान्यत् सहस्रं दक्षिणा /
text_mt: With the Traidhātavīyā [offering, he performs] another [rite]; a thousand [cows are] the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: maitrābārhaspatyam abhiṣecanīyasya dīkṣaṇīyāyām /
meaning: मैत्राबार्हस्पत्यम् अभिषेचनीयस्य दीक्षणीयायाम् /
text_mt: [The offering] to Mitra and Bṛhaspati is [performed] during the initiatory offering of the consecration ceremony.

sanskrit_iast: svayam̐rugṇāyā aśvatthaśākhāyāḥ pātraṃ bhavati /
meaning: स्वयम्̐रुग्णाया अश्वत्थशाखायाः पात्रं भवति /
text_mt: A vessel of a naturally broken branch of an aśvattha tree is [used].

sanskrit_iast: purastāc chvetām̐ śvetavatsāṃ duhanti /
meaning: पुरस्ताच् छ्वेताम्̐ श्वेतवत्सां दुहन्ति /
text_mt: In the east they milk a white [cow] having a white calf.

sanskrit_iast: tat svayaṃ mūrchati svayaṃ mathyate svayam̐vilīnam ājyaṃ bhavati /
meaning: तत् स्वयं मूर्छति स्वयं मथ्यते स्वयम्̐विलीनम् आज्यं भवति /
text_mt: It coagulates by itself, is churned by itself, and becomes clarified butter melted by itself.

sanskrit_iast: atha maitrābārhaspatyam̐ havir nirvapati /
meaning: अथ मैत्राबार्हस्पत्यम्̐ हविर् निर्वपति /
text_mt: Then he apportions the oblation to Mitra and Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: ardhaṃ barhiṣo lunāty ardham̐ svayam̐lūnam ardham idhmasya karoty ardham̐ svayaṃkṛtam ardham̐ vedyāḥ karoty ardham̐ svayaṃkṛtam /
meaning: अर्धं बर्हिषो लुनात्य् अर्धम्̐ स्वयम्̐लूनम् अर्धम् इध्मस्य करोत्य् अर्धम्̐ स्वयंकृतम् अर्धम्̐ वेद्याः करोत्य् अर्धम्̐ स्वयंकृतम् /
text_mt: He cuts half of the sacrificial grass, and half is naturally cut; he prepares half of the sacrificial fuel, and half is naturally prepared; he prepares half of the altar, and half is naturally prepared.

sanskrit_iast: ye kṣodiṣṭhās taṇḍulās taṃ bārhaspatyaṃ carum̐ śṛtaṃ kurvanti /
meaning: ये क्षोदिष्ठास् तण्डुलास् तं बार्हस्पत्यं चरुम्̐ शृतं कुर्वन्ति /
text_mt: The grains of rice that are the smallest they cook as that boiled oblation to Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: tatrājyam ādhāya svayam̐vilīnam āsicya sthaviṣṭhān āvapanti /
meaning: तत्राज्यम् आधाय स्वयम्̐विलीनम् आसिच्य स्थविष्ठान् आवपन्ति /
text_mt: Having placed clarified butter there, having poured in [that which is] naturally melted, they throw in the largest [grains].

sanskrit_iast: ubhau samāhatya saha śṛtau kurvanti /
meaning: उभौ समाहत्य सह शृतौ कुर्वन्ति /
text_mt: Bringing both together, they cook them at the same time.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā sādanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ सादनात् /

sanskrit_iast: anuddhate maitram āsādayaty uddhate bārhaspatyam /
meaning: अनुद्धते मैत्रम् आसादयत्य् उद्धते बार्हस्पत्यम् /
text_mt: On the unraised [portion] he places [the oblation] for Mitra; on the raised [portion, that] for Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā pracaraṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ प्रचरणात् /

sanskrit_iast: maitreṇa pūrveṇa pracaranti /
meaning: मैत्रेण पूर्वेण प्रचरन्ति /
text_mt: They proceed with the [oblation] for Mitra first.

sanskrit_iast: aśvo maitrasya dakṣiṇā śitipṛṣṭho bārhaspatyasya śvetā vā savatsobhayoḥ /
meaning: अश्वो मैत्रस्य दक्षिणा शितिपृष्ठो बार्हस्पत्यस्य श्वेता वा सवत्सोभयोः /
text_mt: A horse is the sacrificial gift for the [offering] to Mitra; a white-backed [animal] for that to Bṛhaspati; or a white [cow] with its calf for both.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa dīkṣāḥ /
meaning: द्वादश दीक्षाः /

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā krayāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ क्रयात् /

sanskrit_iast: saha somau krīṇanty abhiṣecanīyadeśe yathoddeśair vatsataraiḥ sāṇḍaiḥ /
meaning: सह सोमौ क्रीणन्त्य् अभिषेचनीयदेशे यथोद्देशैर् वत्सतरैः साण्डैः /
text_mt: They buy both Somas together at the place of the consecration rite with uncastrated young bulls as specified.

sanskrit_iast: dāśapeyikaṃ brahmaṇo gṛhe nidadhāti /
meaning: दाशपेयिकं ब्रह्मणो गृहे निदधाति /
text_mt: He deposits the [Soma] for the Dāśapeya in the house of the brahman priest.

sanskrit_iast: siddham āgniṣomīyāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आग्निषोमीयात् /

sanskrit_iast: agnaye gṛhapataya āpatantānām ity aṣṭau devasuvām̐ havīm̐ṣy agnīṣomīyasya paśupuroḍāśam anunirvapati /
meaning: अग्नये गृहपतय आपतन्तानाम् इत्य् अष्टौ देवसुवाम्̐ हवीम्̐ष्य् अग्नीषोमीयस्य पशुपुरोडाशम् अनुनिर्वपति /
text_mt: With "To Agni, lord of the house..." he apportions after the animal cake of the [offering to] Agni and Soma the eight oblations to the divine quickeners that fall [in the prescribed order].

sanskrit_iast: yathā devikāhavirbhis tathā pracarati /
meaning: यथा देविकाहविर्भिस् तथा प्रचरति /
text_mt: He proceeds [with them] in the same manner as with the Devikā oblations.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā sviṣṭakṛtaḥ /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ स्विष्टकृतः /

sanskrit_iast: prāk sviṣṭakṛtaḥ savitā tvā prasavānām̐ suvatām iti brahmaṇo hastam ālabhya yajamānam āśravayanti //
meaning: प्राक् स्विष्टकृतः सविता त्वा प्रसवानाम्̐ सुवताम् इति ब्रह्मणो हस्तम् आलभ्य यजमानम् आश्रवयन्ति //
text_mt: Before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, with "May Savitṛ quicken you among the quickeners...", having taken the hand of the brahman priest, they make [the assembly] listen to [the proclamation of] the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: amum iti nāma gṛhṇāti \\ āmuṣyāyaṇam iti gotram amuṣyāḥ putram iti mātur amuṣyām̐ viśi \\ iti svārājyam āśāsate viśi mahate kṣatrāya mahate jānarājyāya \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati /
meaning: अमुम् इति नाम गृह्णाति \\ आमुष्यायणम् इति गोत्रम् अमुष्याः पुत्रम् इति मातुर् अमुष्याम्̐ विशि \\ इति स्वाराज्यम् आशासते विशि महते क्षत्राय महते जानराज्याय \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति /
text_mt: He mentions the name: "So-and-so"; the lineage: "of the lineage of so-and-so"; the mother: "the son of so-and-so"; they pray for self-rule among the people: "in the clan of so-and-so"; he appends everywhere: "for great dominion, for great sovereign rule over the people!"

sanskrit_iast: siddha upavasathaḥ /
meaning: सिद्ध उपवसथः /

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte 'bhiṣecanīyaḥ saptadaśa ukthyo bṛhatpṛṣṭhaḥ /
meaning: श्वोभूते ऽभिषेचनीयः सप्तदश उक्थ्यो बृहत्पृष्ठः /
text_mt: On the next day is the consecration rite, a seventeen-fold ukthya with the bṛhat as pṛṣṭha-sāman.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā madhyaṃdinīyānāṃ nirvapaṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ मध्यंदिनीयानां निर्वपणात् /
text_mt: [The procedure is] established up to the apportioning of the midday [oblations].

sanskrit_iast: madhyaṃdinīyān nirupya mārutam ekavim̐śatikapālaṃ nirvapati /
meaning: मध्यंदिनीयान् निरुप्य मारुतम् एकविम्̐शतिकपालं निर्वपति /
text_mt: Having apportioned the midday [oblations], he apportions a twenty-one-potsherd [cake] to the Maruts.

sanskrit_iast: siddham opadhānāt //
meaning: सिद्धम् ओपधानात् //

sanskrit_iast: śukrajyotiś ca citrajyotiś ca \\ itiprabhṛtibhir gaṇair ekavim̐śatiṃ kapālāny upadadhāti vaiśvadevīṃ ca payasīṃ tūṣṇīm̐ sam̐skaroti /
meaning: शुक्रज्योतिश् च चित्रज्योतिश् च \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् गणैर् एकविम्̐शतिं कपालान्य् उपदधाति वैश्वदेवीं च पयसीं तूष्णीम्̐ सम्̐स्करोति /
text_mt: With the groups [of mantras] beginning with "Śukrajyotis and Citrajyotis...", he places twenty-one potsherds and silently prepares the curd offering to the All-Gods.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā dakṣiṇākālāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ दक्षिणाकालात् /
text_mt: [The procedure is] established up to the time for the sacrificial gifts.

sanskrit_iast: evam asaṃmitā dakṣiṇā dadāty ayutam̐ vā /
meaning: एवम् असंमिता दक्षिणा ददात्य् अयुतम्̐ वा /
text_mt: In this manner he gives an immeasurable sacrificial gift, or ten thousand [cows].

sanskrit_iast: marutvatīyaiḥ pracarya mārutena pracarati payasyā ca //
meaning: मरुत्वतीयैः प्रचर्य मारुतेन प्रचरति पयस्या च //
text_mt: Having proceeded with the [offerings] to the Marutvats, he proceeds with the [offering] to the Maruts and with the curd offering.

sanskrit_iast: devīr āpo apāṃ napād ity abhihavam apāṃ ca trīṇi gṛhṇāti //
meaning: देवीर् आपो अपां नपाद् इत्य् अभिहवम् अपां च त्रीणि गृह्णाति //
text_mt: With "O divine waters, offspring of the waters...", he takes [water for] consecration and three [measures] of water.

sanskrit_iast: devīr āpo apāṃ napād iti sārasvatīnām̐ // rāṣṭradā stha rāṣṭram amuṣmai datta \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati //
meaning: देवीर् आपो अपां नपाद् इति सारस्वतीनाम्̐ // राष्ट्रदा स्थ राष्ट्रम् अमुष्मै दत्त \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति //
text_mt: With "O divine waters, offspring of the waters..." [he takes the water] of the Sarasvatī; he appends everywhere: "You are bestowal of kingship; bestow kingship upon so-and-so!"

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣormir asi \\ iti pratīpasāriṇīnām \\ vṛṣaseno 'si \\ ity anvīpasāriṇīnām apāṃ patir asi \\ iti nadād aprahāvarī stha \\ iti sthāvarāṇām \\ parivāhiṇī stha \\ iti vāhinīnām ojasvinī stha \\ iti yā uñśīya dhāveyur māndā stha \\ iti mandam̐ vahantīnām \\ vrajakṣita stha \\ iti kūpyānām \\ sūryavarcasa stha sūryatvacasa stha \\ iti yā ātapati varṣati yāś ca paridadṛśre marutām oja stha \\ iti hrādunīnām \\ vaśā stha \\ iti puṣpāṇām \\ śakvarī stha \\ iti gorulbyānām \\ viśvabhṛta stha janabhṛtas \\ iti dadhnaḥ ślakṣṇasya \\ anādhṛṣṭāsi \\ iti ghṛtasya \\ apām oṣadhīnām̐ rasas \\ iti madhunaḥ //
meaning: वृषोर्मिर् असि \\ इति प्रतीपसारिणीनाम् \\ वृषसेनो ऽसि \\ इत्य् अन्वीपसारिणीनाम् अपां पतिर् असि \\ इति नदाद् अप्रहावरी स्थ \\ इति स्थावराणाम् \\ परिवाहिणी स्थ \\ इति वाहिनीनाम् ओजस्विनी स्थ \\ इति या उञ्शीय धावेयुर् मान्दा स्थ \\ इति मन्दम्̐ वहन्तीनाम् \\ व्रजक्षित स्थ \\ इति कूप्यानाम् \\ सूर्यवर्चस स्थ सूर्यत्वचस स्थ \\ इति या आतपति वर्षति याश् च परिददृश्रे मरुताम् ओज स्थ \\ इति ह्रादुनीनाम् \\ वशा स्थ \\ इति पुष्पाणाम् \\ शक्वरी स्थ \\ इति गोरुल्ब्यानाम् \\ विश्वभृत स्थ जनभृतस् \\ इति दध्नः श्लक्ष्णस्य \\ अनाधृष्टासि \\ इति घृतस्य \\ अपाम् ओषधीनाम्̐ रसस् \\ इति मधुनः //
text_mt: "You are a bull-like wave," [he takes] of flowing waters running upstream; "You are a bull-like troop," of those running downstream; "You are the lord of waters," from a roaring river; "You are unhurried," of standing waters; "You are overflowing," of streaming waters; "You are vigorous," of those that run springing up; "You are sluggish," of those flowing slowly; "You are settled in the pen," of well-waters; "You have the lustre of the sun, you have the skin of the sun," of those that [fall] while the sun shines and rains, and which are seen around; "You are the strength of the Maruts," of hail-waters; "You are the barren cows," of dew on flowers; "You are the capable ones," of the afterbirth of a cow; "You are all-nourishing, people-nourishing," of smooth curds; "You are unassailable," of clarified butter; "The sap of waters and plants," of honey.

sanskrit_iast: devīr āpo madhumatīḥ sam̐sṛjyadhvam iti vistṛte pātre sam̐sṛjyottareṇa hotrīyaṃ parikramya \\ anādhṛṣṭāḥ sīdata \\ iti paścāt potur dhiṣṇyasya sādayati /
meaning: देवीर् आपो मधुमतीः सम्̐सृज्यध्वम् इति विस्तृते पात्रे सम्̐सृज्योत्तरेण होत्रीयं परिक्रम्य \\ अनाधृष्टाः सीदत \\ इति पश्चात् पोतुर् धिष्ण्यस्य सादयति /
text_mt: With "O divine waters, rich in honey, mingle together...", having mingled [them] in a broad vessel, having walked around north of the hotṛ's hearth, he places [them] behind the potṛ's hearth with "Sit down, unassailable ones!"

sanskrit_iast: darbhayoḥ pratimucya \\ anibhṛṣṭam asi \\ iti rukmam ādatte //
meaning: दर्भयोः प्रतिमुच्य \\ अनिभृष्टम् असि \\ इति रुक्मम् आदत्ते //
text_mt: Fastening two darbha-blades [to it], he takes the gold ornament with "You are uninjured."

sanskrit_iast: śukrā vaḥ śukreṇa punāmi \\ iti rukmeṇotpunāti //
meaning: शुक्रा वः शुक्रेण पुनामि \\ इति रुक्मेणोत्पुनाति //
