text_mt: With "Bright ones, I purify you with the bright," he purifies [the waters] with the gold ornament.

sanskrit_iast: svāhā rājasūyās \\ iti rukmam anvavasṛjati //
meaning: स्वाहा राजसूयास् \\ इति रुक्मम् अन्ववसृजति //
text_mt: With "Svāhā to the consecration waters!" he drops the gold ornament in [the waters].

sanskrit_iast: sadhamādo dyumnyā ūrjā ekās \\ iti vyānayati pālāśāśvatthaudumbaranaiyagrodhaiḥ //
meaning: सधमादो द्युम्न्या ऊर्जा एकास् \\ इति व्यानयति पालाशाश्वत्थौदुम्बरनैयग्रोधैः //
text_mt: With 'Feasting together, splendid, with nourishment, single', he separates [the waters] with [cups made of] parṇa, aśvattha, udumbara, and nyagrodha wood.

sanskrit_iast: rudra yat te giriparaṃ nāma \\ iti śeṣam āgnīdhrīye juhoti //
meaning: रुद्र यत् ते गिरिपरं नाम \\ इति शेषम् आग्नीध्रीये जुहोति //
text_mt: With 'O Rudra, whatever is your name that is beyond the mountain', he offers the remainder in the āgnīdhra fire.

sanskrit_iast: somā indro varuṇas \\ iti yajamānam̐ vācayati /
meaning: सोमा इन्द्रो वरुणस् \\ इति यजमानम्̐ वाचयति /
text_mt: He has the sacrificer recite, 'Soma, Indra, Varuṇa'.

sanskrit_iast: dadhi madhu śaṣpāṇy audumbare yajamānam āśayati //
meaning: दधि मधु शष्पाण्य् औदुम्बरे यजमानम् आशयति //
text_mt: He feeds the sacrificer curd, honey, and young sprouting grass in an udumbara [vessel].

sanskrit_iast: kṣatrasya yonir asi \\ iti tārpyeṇa dīkṣitavasanam abhidhatte // kṣatrasyolbam asi \\ iti pāṇḍaram̐ sam̐śuddham //
meaning: क्षत्रस्य योनिर् असि \\ इति तार्प्येण दीक्षितवसनम् अभिधत्ते // क्षत्रस्योल्बम् असि \\ इति पाण्डरम्̐ सम्̐शुद्धम् //
text_mt: With 'You are the womb of royal power', he puts on the consecrated cloth over the tārpya garment; with 'You are the amnion of royal power', a white, well-cleaned [cloth];

sanskrit_iast: kṣatrasya nābhir asi \\ ity uṣṇīṣeṇa saṃnahyati /
meaning: क्षत्रस्य नाभिर् असि \\ इत्य् उष्णीषेण संनह्यति /
text_mt: with 'You are the navel of royal power', he binds on the turban.

sanskrit_iast: navanītena saṃdhāpya pañcāśatā dakṣiṇam akṣi cāṅkta ekapañcāśatā /
meaning: नवनीतेन संधाप्य पञ्चाशता दक्षिणम् अक्षि चाङ्क्त एकपञ्चाशता /
text_mt: Having anointed [his body] with butter, he anoints his right eye with fifty [strokes/splints] and [the left] with fifty-one.

sanskrit_iast: apa upaspṛśya \\ āvitto agnir gṛhapatir iti gārhapatyānte yajamānam āvedayati \\ eṣa te janate rājā \\ iti yajamānam āha // somo 'smākaṃ brāhmaṇānām̐ rājā \\ iti japati //
meaning: अप उपस्पृश्य \\ आवित्तो अग्निर् गृहपतिर् इति गार्हपत्यान्ते यजमानम् आवेदयति \\ एष ते जनते राजा \\ इति यजमानम् आह // सोमो ऽस्माकं ब्राह्मणानाम्̐ राजा \\ इति जपति //
text_mt: Having touched water, he proclaims the sacrificer at the border of the gārhapatya fire with 'Agni the householder has been proclaimed!'; he says to the people, 'This is your king, O people!'; he whispers, 'Soma is the king of us Brahmins.'

sanskrit_iast: indrasya vajro 'si vārtraghnas \\ ity adhijyaṃ dhanuḥ prayachati //
meaning: इन्द्रस्य वज्रो ऽसि वार्त्रघ्नस् \\ इत्य् अधिज्यं धनुः प्रयछति //
text_mt: With 'You are Indra's vajra, slayer of Vṛtra', he hands over the strung bow.

sanskrit_iast: śatrubādhanā stha \\ iti trīn vāṇavataḥ pradāya pāta prāñcam \\ pāta pratyañcam iti japati //
meaning: शत्रुबाधना स्थ \\ इति त्रीन् वाणवतः प्रदाय पात प्राञ्चम् \\ पात प्रत्यञ्चम् इति जपति //
text_mt: Having handed over three barbed arrows with 'You are repressors of enemies', he whispers, 'Protect toward the east; protect toward the west.'

sanskrit_iast: mitro 'si \\ iti dakṣiṇam upāvaharati varuṇo 'si \\ iti savyam̐ saheṣubhiḥ //
meaning: मित्रो ऽसि \\ इति दक्षिणम् उपावहरति वरुणो ऽसि \\ इति सव्यम्̐ सहेषुभिः //
text_mt: With 'You are Mitra', he brings down the right [arm]; with 'You are Varuṇa', the left, together with the arrows.

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyavarṇam uṣaso vyuṣṭā ity etābhir abhimantrayeta //
meaning: हिरण्यवर्णम् उषसो व्युष्टा इत्य् एताभिर् अभिमन्त्रयेत //
text_mt: He should address [the quarters] with 'Golden-colored', [and] 'At the breakings of dawn'.

sanskrit_iast: samidham ā tiṣṭha \\ itiprabhṛtibhir diśo 'nunikrāmati manasā na padābhyām /
meaning: समिधम् आ तिष्ठ \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् दिशो ऽनुनिक्रामति मनसा न पदाभ्याम् /
text_mt: Beginning with 'Mount upon the fuel', he steps along the quarters in mind, not with his feet.

sanskrit_iast: agreṇa sadaḥ somasya tviṣir asi \\ iti vyāghracarma viveṣṭya prāggrīvalomam āstṛṇāti /
meaning: अग्रेण सदः सोमस्य त्विषिर् असि \\ इति व्याघ्रचर्म विवेष्ट्य प्राग्ग्रीवलोमम् आस्तृणाति /
text_mt: In front of the sadas, with 'You are Soma's luster', having rolled out a tiger skin, he spreads it out with the neck and hair turned to the east.

sanskrit_iast: tad āruhya japati yajamānaḥ pratyastaṃ namuceḥ śiras \\ iti padā sīsaṃ paṇḍagāya pratyasyati \\ aveṣṭā dandaśūkās \\ iti lohitāyasaṃ keśavāpāya //
meaning: तद् आरुह्य जपति यजमानः प्रत्यस्तं नमुचेः शिरस् \\ इति पदा सीसं पण्डगाय प्रत्यस्यति \\ अवेष्टा दन्दशूकास् \\ इति लोहितायसं केशवापाय //
text_mt: Having mounted it, the sacrificer whispers; with 'Cast back is the head of Namuci', he casts back a piece of lead to a eunuch with his foot; with 'Warded off are the biting serpents', a piece of copper to the barber.

sanskrit_iast: mṛtyoḥ pāhi \\ iti rājatam̐ rukmam adhastāt pādayor upakarṣati sauvarṇam̐ rukmam //
meaning: मृत्योः पाहि \\ इति राजतम्̐ रुक्मम् अधस्तात् पादयोर् उपकर्षति सौवर्णम्̐ रुक्मम् //
text_mt: With 'Protect from death', he slides a silver gold-plate under the [sacrificer's] feet, [and holds over his head] a golden gold-plate.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye svāhā somāya svāhā \\ iti ṣaṭ pārthāni juhoti //
meaning: अग्नये स्वाहा सोमाय स्वाहा \\ इति षट् पार्थानि जुहोति //
text_mt: With 'To Agni svāhā! To Soma svāhā!', he offers the six pärtha offerings.

sanskrit_iast: somasya tvā dyumnena \\ iti samayā sauvarṇam abhiṣiñcati pālāśena dakṣiṇato brahmāśvatthena paścād vaiśya audumbareṇottarato bhrātṛvyaḥ purastād yo janyo mitram̐ sa naiyagrodhena /
meaning: सोमस्य त्वा द्युम्नेन \\ इति समया सौवर्णम् अभिषिञ्चति पालाशेन दक्षिणतो ब्रह्माश्वत्थेन पश्चाद् वैश्य औदुम्बरेणोत्तरतो भ्रातृव्यः पुरस्ताद् यो जन्यो मित्रम्̐ स नैयग्रोधेन /
text_mt: With 'With Soma's brilliance I [anoint] you', he anoints [him] through the golden [plate]—the brahman priest from the south with a parṇa vessel, the vaiśya from behind with an aśvattha vessel, the rival kinsman from the north with an udumbara vessel, and he who is a friendly foreigner from the front with a nyagrodha vessel.

sanskrit_iast: pālāśe saṃpātān avanīyāgnīdhre sādayati //
meaning: पालाशे संपातान् अवनीयाग्नीध्रे सादयति //
text_mt: Having poured the remnants into the parṇa [vessel], he sets it down in the āgnīdhra fire-shed.

sanskrit_iast: indrāya svāhā \\ iti ṣaṭ pārthāni juhoti //
meaning: इन्द्राय स्वाहा \\ इति षट् पार्थानि जुहोति //
text_mt: With 'To Indra svāhā!', he offers the six pärtha offerings.

sanskrit_iast: indrasya yonir asi \\ iti viṣāṇām anumantrayate samāvavṛtrann adharāg udaktās \\ ity abhiṣekam ūrdhvaṃ nābhes triḥ //
meaning: इन्द्रस्य योनिर् असि \\ इति विषाणाम् अनुमन्त्रयते समाववृत्रन्न् अधराग् उदक्तास् \\ इत्य् अभिषेकम् ऊर्ध्वं नाभेस् त्रिः //
text_mt: With 'You are Indra's womb', he accompanies the [antelope] horn [with a mantra]; with 'Turned downward and upward, they have returned together', [he wipes] the unction three times upward from the navel.

sanskrit_iast: indrasya vajro 'si vājasanir iti cātvālānte ratham upāvaharati mitrāvaruṇayos tvā praśāstroḥ praśiṣā yunajmi \\ iti yunakti //
meaning: इन्द्रस्य वज्रो ऽसि वाजसनिर् इति चात्वालान्ते रथम् उपावहरति मित्रावरुणयोस् त्वा प्रशास्त्रोः प्रशिषा युनज्मि \\ इति युनक्ति //
text_mt: With 'You are Indra's vajra, winner of booty', he brings down the chariot at the border of the pit (cātvāla); with 'By the direction of Mitra and Varuṇa, the two directors, I yoke you', he yokes [it].

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇoḥ kramo 'si \\ iti cakre pādam ādadhāti sapatnahā \\ ity ārohati //
meaning: विष्णोः क्रमो ऽसि \\ इति चक्रे पादम् आदधाति सपत्नहा \\ इत्य् आरोहति //
text_mt: With 'You are the stride of Viṣṇu', he places his foot on the wheel; with 'Slayer of rivals', he mounts [the chariot].

sanskrit_iast: marutāṃ prasave jaya \\ iti yāntam anumantrayate /
meaning: मरुतां प्रसवे जय \\ इति यान्तम् अनुमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: With 'Conquer in the impulse of the Maruts!', he addresses [him] as he drives forth.

sanskrit_iast:
asāvi devaṃ goṛjīkam andhas\ ny asminn indro januṣem uvāca /
bodhāmasi tvā haryaśva yajñair \ bodhā na stomam andhaso madeṣu //
ity aindryā triṣṭubhā brahmānveti /
meaning:
असावि देवं गोऋजीकम् अन्धस्\ न्य् अस्मिन्न् इन्द्रो जनुषेम् उवाच /
बोधामसि त्वा हर्यश्व यज्ञैर् \ बोधा न स्तोमम् अन्धसो मदेषु //
इत्य् ऐन्द्र्या त्रिष्टुभा ब्रह्मान्वेति /
text_mt:
'The divine soma-juice, mixed with milk, has been pressed out; Indra has declared it in this one since his birth.'

'We perceive you, O bay-horsed one, with sacrifices; perceive our song of praise in the exhilarations of the soma-juice!'

With this triṣṭubh verse addressed to Indra, the brahman priest follows.

sanskrit_iast: rājanyaṃ jināti / tasmai tām iṣum asyati /
meaning: राजन्यं जिनाति / तस्मै ताम् इषुम् अस्यति /
text_mt: He overpowers a rājanya; he shoots that arrow at him.

sanskrit_iast: vrataṃ gṛhītvā \\ āptaṃ manaḥ \ sam indriyeṇa \\ ity uktvā vartate //
meaning: व्रतं गृहीत्वा \\ आप्तं मनः \ सम् इन्द्रियेण \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा वर्तते //
text_mt: Having taken the vow, having said, 'Attained is the mind, together with the faculties', he turns back.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa vajro vājasātamas tena nau putro vājam̐ set \\ iti patnyai dhanvāni prayachati /
meaning: एष वज्रो वाजसातमस् तेन नौ पुत्रो वाजम्̐ सेत् \\ इति पत्न्यै धन्वानि प्रयछति /
text_mt: With 'This is the vajra, most winning of booty; with it may our son win booty', he gives the bows to his wife.

sanskrit_iast: tāny añjalinā pratigṛhṇāti /
meaning: तान्य् अञ्जलिना प्रतिगृह्णाति /
text_mt: She receives them with cupped hands.

sanskrit_iast: mārutasya payasyāś ca samavadāyāniruktena sviṣṭakṛtā pracarya rukmān anumantrayata /
meaning: मारुतस्य पयस्याश् च समवदायानिरुक्तेन स्विष्टकृता प्रचर्य रुक्मान् अनुमन्त्रयत /
text_mt: Having cut portions together from the [offering] to the Maruts and from the curd offering, and having performed [the rite] with the unexpressed Sviṣṭakṛt, he accompanies the gold-plates with a mantra.

sanskrit_iast: iyad asi \\ iti rājatam̐ sauvarṇam̐ sūtram̐ yuṅṅ asi \\ iti sauvarṇam̐ sūtram ūrg asi \\ ity audumbaram̐ haritasūtram //
meaning: इयद् असि \\ इति राजतम्̐ सौवर्णम्̐ सूत्रम्̐ युङ्ङ् असि \\ इति सौवर्णम्̐ सूत्रम् ऊर्ग् असि \\ इत्य् औदुम्बरम्̐ हरितसूत्रम् //
text_mt: With 'So much you are', [he ties on] the silver plate with a golden thread; with 'You are joined', the golden plate with a [golden] thread; with 'You are food', the udumbara plate with a green thread.

sanskrit_iast: mitro 'si \\ iti dakṣiṇam upāvaharati varuṇo 'si \\ iti savyam /
meaning: मित्रो ऽसि \\ इति दक्षिणम् उपावहरति वरुणो ऽसि \\ इति सव्यम् /
text_mt: With 'You are Mitra', he lowers the right [arm]; with 'You are Varuṇa', the left.

sanskrit_iast: sahāyudhaṃ pratyañcaṃ kṛtvā pratihitāya prayachati //
meaning: सहायुधं प्रत्यञ्चं कृत्वा प्रतिहिताय प्रयछति //
text_mt: Having made it face west together with the weapon, he hands it over to the substitute (pratihita).

sanskrit_iast: sad asi \ sam aham̐ viśvair devair iti hastāv āmikṣām abhyavaharati /
meaning: सद् असि \ सम् अहम्̐ विश्वैर् देवैर् इति हस्ताव् आमिक्षाम् अभ्यवहरति /
text_mt: With 'You are the seat; united am I with all the gods', he brings his two hands down into the curd (āmikṣā).

sanskrit_iast: tatra te hiraṇye dadāty audumbaram̐ vābadhnīte //
meaning: तत्र ते हिरण्ये ददात्य् औदुम्बरम्̐ वाबध्नीते //
text_mt: There he gives those two pieces of gold; or he ties on the udumbara [amulet].

sanskrit_iast: namo mātre pṛthivyai \\ iti vārāhī upānahā abhyavarohati //
meaning: नमो मात्रे पृथिव्यै \\ इति वाराही उपानहा अभ्यवरोहति //
text_mt: With 'Homage to Mother Earth!', he steps down onto boar-skin sandals.

sanskrit_iast: paśūnāṃ manyur asi \ taveva me manyur bhūyād iti pratimuñcati //
meaning: पशूनां मन्युर् असि \ तवेव मे मन्युर् भूयाद् इति प्रतिमुञ्चति //
text_mt: With 'You are the anger of animals; may my anger be like yours', he puts them on.

sanskrit_iast: prati tyan nāma rājyam adhāyi \\ iti japati //
meaning: प्रति त्यन् नाम राज्यम् अधायि \\ इति जपति //
text_mt: He whispers, 'That celebrated royal power has been assumed.'

sanskrit_iast: syonāsi suṣadā \\ ity uttarata āhavanīyasyāsandīm avasthāpayati syonām āsīda \ suṣadām āsīda \\ ity āsandīm ārohantam anumantrayate niṣasāda ghṛtavratas \\ ity ārūḍham //
meaning: स्योनासि सुषदा \\ इत्य् उत्तरत आहवनीयस्यासन्दीम् अवस्थापयति स्योनाम् आसीद \ सुषदाम् आसीद \\ इत्य् आसन्दीम् आरोहन्तम् अनुमन्त्रयते निषसाद घृतव्रतस् \\ इत्य् आरूढम् //
text_mt: With 'You are pleasant, comfortable to sit on', he places the chair north of the āhavanīya fire; with 'Sit on the pleasant, sit on the comfortable', he accompanies [the sacrificer] mounting the chair; with 'He has sat down, he whose vow is steadfast', [he accompanies him when he is] seated.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye svāhā \ somāya svāhā \\ iti rathavimocanīnaṃ juhoti //
meaning: अग्नये स्वाहा \ सोमाय स्वाहा \\ इति रथविमोचनीनं जुहोति //
text_mt: With 'To Agni svāhā! To Soma svāhā!', he offers the chariot-releasing oblations.

sanskrit_iast: ham̐saḥ śuciṣad iti saha sārathinā rathavāhane ratham ādadhāti /
meaning: हम्̐सः शुचिषद् इति सह सारथिना रथवाहने रथम् आदधाति /
text_mt: With 'The swan seated in the pure', together with the charioteer, he places the chariot on the chariot-stand.

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryave śataṃ datvāvarohati dāsyan vā /
meaning: अध्वर्यवे शतं दत्वावरोहति दास्यन् वा /
text_mt: Having given a hundred [cows] to the adhvaryu, he steps down, or intending to give [them].

sanskrit_iast: kṣayamāṇo hiraṇyakūrce hiraṇyakaśipuni cāsīnaḥ śaunaḥśepam̐ hotā vyācaste /
meaning: क्षयमाणो हिरण्यकूर्चे हिरण्यकशिपुनि चासीनः शौनःशेपम्̐ होता व्याचस्ते /
text_mt: Seated at ease on a golden bundle of grass and a golden cushion, the hotṛ priest recites the story of Śunaḥśepa.

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryuḥ pratigṛṇāti \\ adhvaryo brahma vadāma \\ ity āmantrayate \\ om̐ hotar ity ṛkṣu tathā hotar iti gathām /
meaning: अध्वर्युः प्रतिगृणाति \\ अध्वर्यो ब्रह्म वदाम \\ इत्य् आमन्त्रयते \\ ओम्̐ होतर् इत्य् ऋक्षु तथा होतर् इति गथाम् /
text_mt: The adhvaryu responds; [the hotṛ] addresses [him] with 'O adhvaryu, let us speak the sacred word!'; [the adhvaryu responds] with 'Om, O hotṛ' to the verses, and with 'So, O hotṛ' to the narrative verses (gāthās).

sanskrit_iast: samāpte śatam̐ hotre dadāti sahasraṃ pratigaritre /
meaning: समाप्ते शतम्̐ होत्रे ददाति सहस्रं प्रतिगरित्रे /
text_mt: When it is completed, he gives a hundred [cows] to the hotṛ, and a thousand to the respondent (pratigartṛ).

sanskrit_iast: madhyataḥkāriṇo yajamānaṃ paryupaviśanti pratihitaś codañco ratninaḥ senānīprabhṛtayo 'nye takṣarathakārābhyām //
meaning: मध्यतःकारिणो यजमानं पर्युपविशन्ति प्रतिहितश् चोदञ्चो रत्निनः सेनानीप्रभृतयो ऽन्ये तक्षरथकाराभ्याम् //
text_mt: The central officiants sit around the sacrificer, and facing north, the substitute and the jewel-bearers (ratnins), beginning with the army commander, [and] others, including the carpenter and the chariot-maker.

sanskrit_iast: brahman \\ tvaṃ me brahmāsi \\ iti yajamāno madhyataḥkāriṇām ekaikam āmantrayate //
meaning: ब्रह्मन् \\ त्वं मे ब्रह्मासि \\ इति यजमानो मध्यतःकारिणाम् एकैकम् आमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: The sacrificer addresses each of the central officiants with 'O brahman, you are my brahman priest!'

sanskrit_iast: savitāsi satyasavas \\ iti brahmā pratyāha mitro 'si suśevas \\ ity udgātā \\ indro 'si satyaujās \\ iti hotā varuṇo 'si viśvaujās \\ ity adhvaryuḥ //
meaning: सवितासि सत्यसवस् \\ इति ब्रह्मा प्रत्याह मित्रो ऽसि सुशेवस् \\ इत्य् उद्गाता \\ इन्द्रो ऽसि सत्यौजास् \\ इति होता वरुणो ऽसि विश्वौजास् \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युः //
text_mt: The brahman responds, 'You are Savitṛ of true impulse'; the udgātṛ, 'You are Mitra of kindly favor'; the hotṛ, 'You are Indra of true strength'; the adhvaryu, 'You are Varuṇa of universal strength.'

sanskrit_iast: eṣa vajras tena me radhya \\ iti sphyaṃ prayachati brahmā yajamānāya yajamānaḥ pratihitāya pratihitaḥ senānye senānīprabhṛtaya ākṣaṇivapāt /
meaning: एष वज्रस् तेन मे रध्य \\ इति स्फ्यं प्रयछति ब्रह्मा यजमानाय यजमानः प्रतिहिताय प्रतिहितः सेनान्ये सेनानीप्रभृतय आक्षणिवपात् /
text_mt: With 'This is the vajra; through it be subject to me', the brahman priest hands the wooden sword to the sacrificer, the sacrificer to the substitute, the substitute to the army commander, and those beginning with the army commander down to the dice-thrower.

sanskrit_iast: sphyenādhidevanaṃ kṛtvā kṛtasaṃpūtān sūdayan nivapati /
meaning: स्फ्येनाधिदेवनं कृत्वा कृतसंपूतान् सूदयन् निवपति /
text_mt: Having prepared the gaming ground with the wooden sword, smoothing it, he casts down the dice purified as the winning set (kṛta).

sanskrit_iast: tatra paṣṭhauhī prasuvati /
meaning: तत्र पष्ठौही प्रसुवति /
text_mt: There they drive up a four-year-old cow.

sanskrit_iast: tāṃ catvāro vidīvyante brāhmaṇo rājanyo vaiśyaḥ śūdraḥ /
meaning: तां चत्वारो विदीव्यन्ते ब्राह्मणो राजन्यो वैश्यः शूद्रः /
text_mt: Four play for it: a Brahmin, a rājanya, a vaiśya, and a śūdra.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām̐ yaḥ parājayate sa yajamānasya goṣu paṣṭhauhīm apisṛjati /
meaning: तेषाम्̐ यः पराजयते स यजमानस्य गोषु पष्ठौहीम् अपिसृजति /
text_mt: Whichever of them loses, he releases that four-year-old cow among the cows of the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: tataś catuḥśatam akṣān avohyāha \\ udbhinnam̐ rājñas \\ iti // diśo abhyabhūd ayam iti pañcākṣān yajamānāya prayachati /
meaning: ततश् चतुःशतम् अक्षान् अवोह्याह \\ उद्भिन्नम्̐ राज्ञस् \\ इति // दिशो अभ्यभूद् अयम् इति पञ्चाक्षान् यजमानाय प्रयछति /
text_mt: Then, having set aside one hundred and four dice, he says, 'The king has won!' With 'This one has mastered the quarters', he hands five dice to the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: kṣetraṃ brahmaṇe dadāti / varam̐ vṛṇīte /
meaning: क्षेत्रं ब्रह्मणे ददाति / वरम्̐ वृणीते /
text_mt: He gives a field to the brahman priest; he chooses a boon.

sanskrit_iast: maṅgalyānāmno hvayati suślokāḥ \ sumaṅgalāḥ \ satyarājānas \\ iti /
meaning: मङ्गल्यानाम्नो ह्वयति सुश्लोकाः \ सुमङ्गलाः \ सत्यराजानस् \\ इति /
text_mt: He calls persons of auspicious names: 'O ones of fair renown, O ones of good auspices, O true kings!'

sanskrit_iast: patnīloke pratihitasya mātaram upaspṛśya pratihitam anvārabhya prajāpate na tvad ity etayā gārhapatye nāmavyatiṣaṅgaṃ juhoti pālāśasaṃpātam //
meaning: पत्नीलोके प्रतिहितस्य मातरम् उपस्पृश्य प्रतिहितम् अन्वारभ्य प्रजापते न त्वद् इत्य् एतया गार्हपत्ये नामव्यतिषङ्गं जुहोति पालाशसंपातम् //
text_mt: In the place of the wife, having touched the mother of the designated [substitute], having taken hold from behind of the designated [substitute], he offers the intertwined names into the gārhapatya fire with "O Prajāpati, no other than you...", accompanied by drops from a palāśa-leaf ladle.

sanskrit_iast: asā amuṣya putro 'muṣyāsau putras \\ iti nāmanī vyatiṣajati //
meaning: असा अमुष्य पुत्रो ऽमुष्यासौ पुत्रस् \\ इति नामनी व्यतिषजति //
text_mt: He intertwines the two names: "So-and-so, the son of so-and-so; so-and-so, the son of so-and-so."

sanskrit_iast: vayam̐ syāma patayo rayīṇām iti pratihitam̐ vācayati /
meaning: वयम्̐ स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् इति प्रतिहितम्̐ वाचयति /
text_mt: He makes the designated [substitute] recite: "May we be masters of riches!"

sanskrit_iast: mārutasya payasyāś ca samavādāyeḍām upahūya bhakṣayante /
meaning: मारुतस्य पयस्याश् च समवादायेडाम् उपहूय भक्षयन्ते /
text_mt: Having cut off together [portions] of the [cake] to the Maruts and of the curd offering, having invoked the iḍā portion, they eat [it].

sanskrit_iast: māhendreṇa pratipadya siddham āvabhṛthāt /
meaning: माहेन्द्रेण प्रतिपद्य सिद्धम् आवभृथात् /
text_mt: Beginning with the [cup] for Mahendra, [the procedure is] established up to the final bath.

sanskrit_iast: vāsām̐sy abhiṣekapātrāṇi vārāhī ca prativeśam avabhṛtham̐ hareyuḥ /
meaning: वासाम्̐स्य् अभिषेकपात्राणि वाराही च प्रतिवेशम् अवभृथम्̐ हरेयुः /
text_mt: They should take the garments, the vessels for the consecration, and the boar-skin [shoes] to a neighboring avabhṛtha.

sanskrit_iast: gāgulair avabhṛtham abhyavaiti //
meaning: गागुलैर् अवभृथम् अभ्यवैति //
text_mt: He goes down to the avabhṛtha wearing gāgula-garments.

sanskrit_iast: apāṃ naptre svāhā \\ ity avabhṛthe 'psu juhot \\ ūrjo naptre svāhā \\ iti darbhastambe dvitīyam agnaye gṛhapataye svāhā \\ iti gārhapatye /
meaning: अपां नप्त्रे स्वाहा \\ इत्य् अवभृथे ऽप्सु जुहोत् \\ ऊर्जो नप्त्रे स्वाहा \\ इति दर्भस्तम्बे द्वितीयम् अग्नये गृहपतये स्वाहा \\ इति गार्हपत्ये /
text_mt: He makes an offering into the water with: 'To the Child of the Waters, svāhā!' at the avabhṛtha, a second into a clump of darbha grass with: 'To the Child of Vigour, svāhā!', [and a third] into the gārhapatya with: 'To Agni, master of the household, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: siddham ānūbandhyāyāḥ /
meaning: सिद्धम् आनूबन्ध्यायाः /
text_mt: The procedure is established up to the anūbandhyā cow.

sanskrit_iast: sūtavaśānūbandhyāsūnayā catuṣpadyābhivikramayati /
meaning: सूतवशानूबन्ध्यासूनया चतुष्पद्याभिविक्रमयति /
text_mt: The anūbandhyā is a barren cow that has calved; he causes her to step across with a four-footed [verse] having the word 'asūnīti'.

sanskrit_iast: nīvārān paśupuroḍāśāya nirvapati /
meaning: नीवारान् पशुपुरोडाशाय निर्वपति /
text_mt: He apportions wild rice for the animal sacrificial cake.

sanskrit_iast: na keśaśmaśrū vāpayati /
meaning: न केशश्मश्रू वापयति /
text_mt: He does not have his hair and beard shaved.

sanskrit_iast: na dīkṣate daṇḍaṃ prayachati /
meaning: न दीक्षते दण्डं प्रयछति /
text_mt: He does not undergo consecration; he hands over the staff.

sanskrit_iast: sāvitreṇodavasyati gārhapatye yajamānāya dakṣiṇāgnau patnyai /
meaning: सावित्रेणोदवस्यति गार्हपत्ये यजमानाय दक्षिणाग्नौ पत्न्यै /
text_mt: He departs with the Sāvitra [offering]: [the portion] for the sacrificer in the gārhapatya, for the wife in the southern fire.

sanskrit_iast: sam̐sṛpsu tadbhakṣau bhakṣayataḥ / sā vratāgnihotrayoḥ saṃtatiḥ /
meaning: सम्̐सृप्सु तद्भक्षौ भक्षयतः / सा व्रताग्निहोत्रयोः संततिः /
text_mt: During the Saṃsṛp offerings they both consume their portions. That is the continuity of the vows and the agnihotra.

sanskrit_iast: sāvitro 'ṣṭākapāla itiprabhṛtayo daśa sam̐sṛpaḥ /
meaning: सावित्रो ऽष्टाकपाल इतिप्रभृतयो दश सम्̐सृपः /
text_mt: The ten Saṃsṛp offerings begin with the eight-potsherd cake to Savitṛ.

sanskrit_iast: tāsām āhavanīyasthāne gārhapatyaṃ nidhāya prācīnam̐ sam̐sarpann anvaham̐ yajeta /
meaning: तासाम् आहवनीयस्थाने गार्हपत्यं निधाय प्राचीनम्̐ सम्̐सर्पन्न् अन्वहम्̐ यजेत /
text_mt: Having placed the gārhapatya in the place of the āhavanīya for these, creeping eastward, he should sacrifice day after day.

sanskrit_iast: yathā vaiṣṇavaṃ daśapeyāya prāgvam̐śe kuryāt /
meaning: यथा वैष्णवं दशपेयाय प्राग्वम्̐शे कुर्यात् /
text_mt: Just as he would perform the Vaiṣṇava offering for the Daśapeya in the hall with eastward-pointing rafters,

sanskrit_iast: daśapeyāya dīkṣate / dvādaśapuṇḍarīkāṃ mālām̐ yajamānaḥ pratimuñcate / sāpsu dīkṣā /
meaning: दशपेयाय दीक्षते / द्वादशपुण्डरीकां मालाम्̐ यजमानः प्रतिमुञ्चते / साप्सु दीक्षा /
text_mt: he is consecrated for the Daśapeya. The sacrificer puts on a garland of twelve lotuses. That is the consecration in water.

sanskrit_iast: sadyaḥ sarvaṃ kurvanti / kṛṣṇājinamekhalāviṣāṇāstanugrahaṃ kuryād anyaddīkṣitaṃ na prayachati /
meaning: सद्यः सर्वं कुर्वन्ति / कृष्णाजिनमेखलाविषाणास्तनुग्रहं कुर्याद् अन्यद्दीक्षितं न प्रयछति /
text_mt: They perform everything in a single day. He should perform the retention of the body by means of the black antelope skin, the girdle, and the horn; he does not hand over anything else pertaining to a consecrated person.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaṇīyasya haviṣkṛtā vācam̐ visṛjyābhyardhe rājānaṃ nivapati /
meaning: प्रायणीयस्य हविष्कृता वाचम्̐ विसृज्याभ्यर्धे राजानं निवपति /
text_mt: Having released speech with the haviṣkṛt formula of the introductory offering, he apportions the King [Soma] aside.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaṇīyam̐ sam̐sthāpya purastāt krītasya vatsatarān apākaroti svajā asi \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ /
meaning: प्रायणीयम्̐ सम्̐स्थाप्य पुरस्तात् क्रीतस्य वत्सतरान् अपाकरोति स्वजा असि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः /
text_mt: Having concluded the introductory offering, he drives away the calves in front of the purchased [Soma] with the formulas beginning with: 'You are self-born.'

sanskrit_iast: siddham opasadbhyaḥ /
meaning: सिद्धम् ओपसद्भ्यः /

sanskrit_iast: tisra upasadaḥ /
meaning: तिस्र उपसदः /

sanskrit_iast: siddha upavasathaḥ /
meaning: सिद्ध उपवसथः /

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte daśapeyāgniṣṭomo rathaṃtarapṛṣṭhaḥ /
meaning: श्वोभूते दशपेयाग्निष्टोमो रथंतरपृष्ठः /
text_mt: On the next day, there is the Daśapeya-Agniṣṭoma having the Rathaṃtara as the pṛṣṭha-sāman.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā bhakṣaṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ भक्षणात् /

sanskrit_iast: śataṃ brāhmaṇāḥ somān bhakṣayanti daśadaśaikaikaṃ camasam ā daśamān mātṛtaḥ pitṛtaś cānvākhyāya /
meaning: शतं ब्राह्मणाः सोमान् भक्षयन्ति दशदशैकैकं चमसम् आ दशमान् मातृतः पितृतश् चान्वाख्याय /
text_mt: A hundred brāhmaṇas consume the Soma cups, ten to each single cup, after recounting [their ancestry] up to the tenth degree on both the mother's and father's sides.

sanskrit_iast: na brāhmaṇanyaṅgo bhakṣayed dāsīputro nanv ācakṣīta kāmaṃ bhakṣayet /
meaning: न ब्राह्मणन्यङ्गो भक्षयेद् दासीपुत्रो नन्व् आचक्षीत कामं भक्षयेत् /
text_mt: One who is deficient in brāhmaṇa status should not consume; [even] the son of a female slave, if he can recite [the lineage], may consume at will.

sanskrit_iast: sahasratamīm atikālyāṃ rukmo hotur itiprabhṛti yathāmnātam apākaroti /
meaning: सहस्रतमीम् अतिकाल्यां रुक्मो होतुर् इतिप्रभृति यथाम्नातम् अपाकरोति /
text_mt: He drives away the thousandth [cow] to be led past, and distributes the golden ornament of the hotṛ and so forth, as handed down.

sanskrit_iast: ajaḥ subrahmaṇyasya vatsataryun netuḥ sāṇḍas trivatso grāvastuto dvādaśa paṣṭhauhīr garbhiṇīr brahmaṇaḥ /
meaning: अजः सुब्रह्मण्यस्य वत्सतर्युन् नेतुः साण्डस् त्रिवत्सो ग्रावस्तुतो द्वादश पष्ठौहीर् गर्भिणीर् ब्रह्मणः /
text_mt: A goat is the subrahmaṇya's [gift], a heifer the unnetṛ's, an uncastrated three-year-old steer the grāvastut's, and twelve pregnant four-year-old heifers the brahman's.

sanskrit_iast: na prasarpakebhyo dadāti /
meaning: न प्रसर्पकेभ्यो ददाति /
text_mt: He does not give to those who creep forward.

sanskrit_iast: anūbandhyāyai sahasram atikālyā ṛtvigbhyaḥ somapebhyo dadāti /
meaning: अनूबन्ध्यायै सहस्रम् अतिकाल्या ऋत्विग्भ्यः सोमपेभ्यो ददाति /
text_mt: Along with the thousandth [cow] led past for the anūbandhyā, he gives [cows] to the officiating priests who drink Soma.

sanskrit_iast: vaśātirātraṃ karoti /
meaning: वशातिरात्रं करोति /

sanskrit_iast: na keśaśmaśrū vāpayati /
meaning: न केशश्मश्रू वापयति /
text_mt: He does not have his hair and beard shaved.

sanskrit_iast: diśām aveṣṭibhir udavasyati /
meaning: दिशाम् अवेष्टिभिर् उदवस्यति /
text_mt: He departs with the Aveṣṭis of the quarters.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyo 'ṣṭākapāla itiprabhṛtīni pañca nirvapati /
meaning: आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपाल इतिप्रभृतीनि पञ्च निर्वपति /
text_mt: He apportions five [oblations], beginning with the eight-potsherd cake to Agni.

sanskrit_iast: sāyaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ purastāt prātaragnihotrāt prayugbhir yajata āgneyo 'ṣṭākapālaḥ saumyaś carur itiprabhṛtīni ṣaḍ dakṣiṇo rathavāhanavāho dakṣiṇā /
meaning: सायं पौर्णमास्यां पुरस्तात् प्रातरग्निहोत्रात् प्रयुग्भिर् यजत आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपालः सौम्यश् चरुर् इतिप्रभृतीनि षड् दक्षिणो रथवाहनवाहो दक्षिणा /
text_mt: In the evening on the full-moon day, before the morning agnihotra, he sacrifices with the Prayuj offerings: six [oblations] beginning with the eight-potsherd cake to Agni and the caru to Soma; the sacrificial gift is the right draught-beast of the chariot.

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte paurṇamāsyeṣṭvottarāḥ prayuja upaiti sārasvataś caruḥ pauṣṇaś carur itiprabhṛtīni ṣaṭ savyo rathavāhanavāho dakṣiṇā /
meaning: श्वोभूते पौर्णमास्येष्ट्वोत्तराः प्रयुज उपैति सारस्वतश् चरुः पौष्णश् चरुर् इतिप्रभृतीनि षट् सव्यो रथवाहनवाहो दक्षिणा /
text_mt: On the next day, having sacrificed with the full-moon sacrifice, he undertakes the subsequent Prayuj offerings: six [oblations] beginning with the caru to Sarasvatī and the caru to Pūṣan; the sacrificial gift is the left draught-beast of the chariot.

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte paśubandho māruto pṛśniḥ paṣṭhauhī garbhiṇī /
meaning: श्वोभूते पशुबन्धो मारुतो पृश्निः पष्ठौही गर्भिणी /
text_mt: On the next day is an animal sacrifice to the Maruts: a spotted, pregnant four-year-old heifer.

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūta uttara ādityājā malihā garbhiṇī /
meaning: श्वोभूत उत्तर आदित्याजा मलिहा गर्भिणी /
text_mt: On the next day is the subsequent [animal sacrifice] to the Ādityas: a pregnant, [hornless] female goat.

sanskrit_iast: sāyam̐ somena pratipadya sam̐vatsaram agnihotram eva juhoty ā deśāt paśubandhād dvyahedvyahe vā /
meaning: सायम्̐ सोमेन प्रतिपद्य सम्̐वत्सरम् अग्निहोत्रम् एव जुहोत्य् आ देशात् पशुबन्धाद् द्व्यहेद्व्यहे वा /
text_mt: Having commenced with the Soma sacrifice in the evening, he offers only the agnihotra for a year, up to the designated animal sacrifice, or [he sacrifices] every second day.

sanskrit_iast: yo dhīvyavasitaḥ satyasitaḥ sātyadūtahavirbhir yajate savitre prasavitra itiprabhṛtīni trīṇi /
meaning: यो धीव्यवसितः सत्यसितः सात्यदूतहविर्भिर् यजते सवित्रे प्रसवित्र इतिप्रभृतीनि त्रीणि /
text_mt: He who is firm in resolve and fixed in truth sacrifices with the oblations of the true messenger: three [oblations] beginning with [the one] to Savitṛ Prasavitṛ.

sanskrit_iast: aśvaḥ śoṇakarṇo dakṣiṇā daṇḍa upānahau śuṣkadṛtiś ca /
meaning: अश्वः शोणकर्णो दक्षिणा दण्ड उपानहौ शुष्कदृतिश् च /
text_mt: The sacrificial gift is a horse with red ears, a staff, a pair of sandals, and a dried skin bag.

sanskrit_iast: tebhyaḥ pradāya prativeśāya rājñe prahinoti \\ abhyaṣikṣi rājābhūvam iti /
meaning: तेभ्यः प्रदाय प्रतिवेशाय राज्ञे प्रहिनोति \\ अभ्यषिक्षि राजाभूवम् इति /
text_mt: Having given [these gifts] to them, he sends a messenger to a neighboring king, [announcing]: 'I have been consecrated, I have become king!'

sanskrit_iast: paurṇamāsyāṃ keśavapanīyāya dīkṣate /
meaning: पौर्णमास्यां केशवपनीयाय दीक्षते /
text_mt: On the full-moon day, he is consecrated for the Keśavapanīya.

sanskrit_iast: amāvāsyāyām̐ yajanīye 'hany atirātraḥ kratur aṣoḍaśikaḥ sahasradakṣiṇaḥ /
meaning: अमावास्यायाम्̐ यजनीये ऽहन्य् अतिरात्रः क्रतुर् अषोडशिकः सहस्रदक्षिणः /
text_mt: On the new-moon day, the day of sacrificing, there is an Atirātra rite with no sixteenth recitation, with a thousand [cows] as sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast:
vapanakāla āsandyām āsīnaḥ
ye keśinaḥ prathame satram āsata \ yebhir idam̐ viśvaṃ bhuvanam ā virājati /
tasmā arcāma kṛṇavāma niṣkṛtim\ śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade //
iti nikhilaṃ keśaśmaśrū yajamāno vāpayate / prajñātam udavasānam /
meaning:
वपनकाल आसन्द्याम् आसीनः
ये केशिनः प्रथमे सत्रम् आसत \ येभिर् इदम्̐ विश्वं भुवनम् आ विराजति /
तस्मा अर्चाम कृणवाम निष्कृतिम्\ शं नो अस्तु द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे //
इति निखिलं केशश्मश्रू यजमानो वापयते / प्रज्ञातम् उदवसानम् /
text_mt:
At the time of shaving, seated on a throne,

'Those long-haired ones who first sat at the sacrificial session, / by whom this entire universe shines bright,

to him let us offer worship and make amends; / may there be well-being for our two-footed, well-being for our four-footed [creatures],'

reciting this, the sacrificer has his hair and beard entirely shaved. The departure is well known.

sanskrit_iast: anantaram akṣair dīkṣate 'hīnāya /
meaning: अनन्तरम् अक्षैर् दीक्षते ऽहीनाय /
text_mt: Immediately after, he is consecrated with the dice for the ahīna sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: jyotir agniṣṭomaḥ pūrvo 'māvāsyāyām̐ yajanīye 'hany atirātraḥ / prajñātam udavasānam /
meaning: ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमः पूर्वो ऽमावास्यायाम्̐ यजनीये ऽहन्य् अतिरात्रः / प्रज्ञातम् उदवसानम् /
text_mt: The first is the Jyotir-Agniṣṭoma; on the new-moon day, the day of sacrificing, there is an Atirātra. The departure is well known.

sanskrit_iast: anantaraṃ kṣatradhṛtaye dīkṣate /
meaning: अनन्तरं क्षत्रधृतये दीक्षते /
text_mt: Immediately after, he is consecrated for the Kṣatradhṛti.

sanskrit_iast: triṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomo rathantarapṛṣṭhaḥ / prajñātam udavasānam /
meaning: त्रिष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमो रथन्तरपृष्ठः / प्रज्ञातम् उदवसानम् /
text_mt: It is a Triṣṭoma-Agniṣṭoma having the Rathaṃtara as the pṛṣṭha-sāman. The departure is well known.

sanskrit_iast: anantaram iṣṭibhir yajeta devikābhir devasuvām̐ havirbhir aiṣṭikyā sautrāmaṇyā vaiśvānaravāruṇyā traidhātavyayā traidhātavyayā /
meaning: अनन्तरम् इष्टिभिर् यजेत देविकाभिर् देवसुवाम्̐ हविर्भिर् ऐष्टिक्या सौत्रामण्या वैश्वानरवारुण्या त्रैधातव्यया त्रैधातव्यया /
text_mt: Immediately after, he should sacrifice with the [following] iṣṭis: with the Devikā oblations, the Devasū oblations, the Sautrāmaṇī in iṣṭi form, the Vaiśvānarī-Vāruṇī, and the Traidhātavīyā, the Traidhātavīyā.

sanskrit_iast: puṇyanāmni devayajane rājāśvamedhena yajeta sarvān kāmān avarurutsamāno 'muṃ ca lokam abhijigīṣan /
meaning: पुण्यनाम्नि देवयजने राजाश्वमेधेन यजेत सर्वान् कामान् अवरुरुत्समानो ऽमुं च लोकम् अभिजिगीषन् /
text_mt: On a sacred-named sacrificial ground, a king should sacrifice with the Aśvamedha, desiring to secure all desires and wishing to conquer that world.

sanskrit_iast: apadātīn ṛtvijaḥ samān āvahanti /
meaning: अपदातीन् ऋत्विजः समान् आवहन्ति /
text_mt: They bring equal officiating priests who do not travel on foot.

sanskrit_iast: phālgunyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ prājāpatyam ṛṣabhaṃ tūparam̐ sarvarūpam ālabheta /
meaning: फाल्गुन्यां पौर्णमास्यां प्राजापत्यम् ऋषभं तूपरम्̐ सर्वरूपम् आलभेत /
text_mt: On the Phālguna full-moon day, he should seize a hornless, all-colored bull dedicated to Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: hutāyām̐ vapāyāṃ cātvāle mārjayitvā sarvā diśo rathā abhidhāvanti /
meaning: हुतायाम्̐ वपायां चात्वाले मार्जयित्वा सर्वा दिशो रथा अभिधावन्ति /
text_mt: When the omentum has been offered, having purified themselves at the cātvāla trench, chariots race out in all directions.

sanskrit_iast: rājāśvamedhena yajeta tam anujānīteti /
meaning: राजाश्वमेधेन यजेत तम् अनुजानीतेति /
text_mt: 'The king would sacrifice with the Aśvamedha; give him your consent!' [they proclaim].

sanskrit_iast: sa siddhaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate /
meaning: स सिद्धः संतिष्ठते /
text_mt: That [sacrifice] is established and concludes.

sanskrit_iast: etam evālabheta sarvakāmaḥ /
meaning: एतम् एवालभेत सर्वकामः /
text_mt: One who desires all things should seize this very [animal].

sanskrit_iast: pūrvāṃ paurṇamāsīm upoṣyottarām upavaset /
meaning: पूर्वां पौर्णमासीम् उपोष्योत्तराम् उपवसेत् /
text_mt: Having fasted on the first full-moon day, he should observe the Upavasatha on the second.

sanskrit_iast: brahmaudanāyāstamayam anu vācam̐ yachanti /
meaning: ब्रह्मौदनायास्तमयम् अनु वाचम्̐ यछन्ति /
text_mt: For the sake of the brahmaudana, they restrain their speech until sunset.

sanskrit_iast: udite vaitasam idhmam upasamādhāya draṣṭre namas \\ upadraṣṭre namas \\ itiprabhṛtibhir ādityam upatiṣṭhate //
meaning: उदिते वैतसम् इध्मम् उपसमाधाय द्रष्ट्रे नमस् \\ उपद्रष्ट्रे नमस् \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठते //
text_mt: When [the sun] has risen, having placed reed sacrificial fuel [on the fire], he worships the sun with the formulas beginning with, 'Homage to the beholder, homage to the onlooker.'

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyagarbhas \\ iti dvādaśa pūrṇāhutīr juhoti /
meaning: हिरण्यगर्भस् \\ इति द्वादश पूर्णाहुतीर् जुहोति /
text_mt: He offers twelve full oblations with the formulas beginning with, 'The Golden Embryo.'

sanskrit_iast: catuṣkeṣv apsu dakṣiṇāgnau brahmaudanam̐ śrapayati rukmān abhito 'dhastād rājatam upariṣṭāt sauvarṇam /
meaning: चतुष्केष्व् अप्सु दक्षिणाग्नौ ब्रह्मौदनम्̐ श्रपयति रुक्मान् अभितो ऽधस्ताद् राजतम् उपरिष्टात् सौवर्णम् /
text_mt: In four [measures of] water, he cooks the rice mess for the priests on the southern fire, with gold plates on both sides: a silver one below, a golden one above.

sanskrit_iast: paścād gārhapatyasya madhyātkāriṇaḥ prāśnanti /
meaning: पश्चाद् गार्हपत्यस्य मध्यात्कारिणः प्राश्नन्ति /
text_mt: Behind the gārhapatya fire, the principal officiating priests consume [it].

sanskrit_iast: tebhyaḥ śatamānaṃ dadāti /
meaning: तेभ्यः शतमानं ददाति /
text_mt: To them he gives a hundred-māna [weight of gold].

sanskrit_iast: mauñjīṃ darbhamayīm̐ vā dvādaśāratniṃ trayodaśāratnim̐ vābhidhānīṃ brahmaudanena nyudya \\ imām agṛbhṇann iti raśanām ādatte //
meaning: मौञ्जीं दर्भमयीम्̐ वा द्वादशारत्निं त्रयोदशारत्निम्̐ वाभिधानीं ब्रह्मौदनेन न्युद्य \\ इमाम् अगृभ्णन्न् इति रशनाम् आदत्ते //
text_mt: Having moistened a halter made of muñja grass or darbha grass, twelve cubits or thirteen cubits long, with the rice mess for the priests, he takes the halter with the formula, 'They have grasped this [halter of the cosmic order].'

sanskrit_iast: brahmann aśvaṃ bhantsyāmi \\ iti brahmāṇam āmantrayate //
meaning: ब्रह्मन्न् अश्वं भन्त्स्यामि \\ इति ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: He addresses the brahman priest with the words, 'O brahman, I shall bind the horse.'

sanskrit_iast: taṃ badhāna devebhyas \\ ity anujānāti //
meaning: तं बधान देवेभ्यस् \\ इत्य् अनुजानाति //
text_mt: [The brahman priest] gives assent with the words, 'Bind him for the gods.'

sanskrit_iast: abhidhā asi \\ iti trihāyaṇam aśvam abhinidadhāti kṛṣṇaṃ piśaṅgam aruṇapiśaṅgam̐ vā somapam̐ somapayoḥ putram /
meaning: अभिधा असि \\ इति त्रिहायणम् अश्वम् अभिनिदधाति कृष्णं पिशङ्गम् अरुणपिशङ्गम्̐ वा सोमपम्̐ सोमपयोः पुत्रम् /
text_mt: With the formula, 'You are the binder,' he fastens [the halter] on a three-year-old horse that is black, yellowish-brown, or reddish-brown, that drinks soma, the son of parents who drink soma.

sanskrit_iast: pitur anujāyāḥ putram agrato nayanti / śvānaṃ caturakṣam̐ saidhrakeṇa musalena paum̐ścaleyo 'nvaiti /
meaning: पितुर् अनुजायाः पुत्रम् अग्रतो नयन्ति / श्वानं चतुरक्षम्̐ सैध्रकेण मुसलेन पौम्̐श्चलेयो ऽन्वैति /
text_mt: They lead the son of the father's younger sister in front; a son of a courtesan follows behind with a four-eyed dog [and] a pestle of saidhraka wood.

sanskrit_iast: apo 'bhyavanīyāśvaṃ purastāt pratyaṅmukham avasthāpayati /
meaning: अपो ऽभ्यवनीयाश्वं पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ्मुखम् अवस्थापयति /
text_mt: Having led the horse down into the water, he makes him stand in the east facing west.

sanskrit_iast: sarvais taiḥ sārdhaṃ catvāro 'dhvaryavaḥ //
meaning: सर्वैस् तैः सार्धं चत्वारो ऽध्वर्यवः //
text_mt: Together with all of them, the four adhvaryu priests [act].

sanskrit_iast: prajāpataye tvā juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi \\ itiprabhṛtibhir ekaikāt prokṣati sarvebhyas tvā devebhyas \\ iti sarve sarvataḥ /
meaning: प्रजापतये त्वा जुष्टं प्रोक्षामि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् एकैकात् प्रोक्षति सर्वेभ्यस् त्वा देवेभ्यस् \\ इति सर्वे सर्वतः /
text_mt: Each one sprinkles [the horse] individually with the formulas beginning with, 'I sprinkle you agreeable to Prajāpati'; all of them sprinkle [him] from all sides with, 'To all the gods, you.'

sanskrit_iast: saidhrakeṇa musalena paum̐ścaleyaḥ śvānam̐ hanti //
meaning: सैध्रकेण मुसलेन पौम्̐श्चलेयः श्वानम्̐ हन्ति //
text_mt: The son of the courtesan kills the dog with the pestle of saidhraka wood.

sanskrit_iast: yo arvantaṃ jighām̐sati \\ iti hanyamāne japati yajamānaḥ /
meaning: यो अर्वन्तं जिघाम्̐सति \\ इति हन्यमाने जपति यजमानः /
text_mt: While it is being killed, the sacrificer mutters, 'Whoever seeks to kill the courser.'

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇaṃ padaṃ pūrvam upodyamya paro martaḥ paraḥ śvā \\ ity adhastāc chvānaṃ dakṣiṇāpaḥ plāvayati /
meaning: दक्षिणं पदं पूर्वम् उपोद्यम्य परो मर्तः परः श्वा \\ इत्य् अधस्ताच् छ्वानं दक्षिणापः प्लावयति /
text_mt: Having first lifted the [horse's] right foot, he floats the dog beneath [it] towards the south with the formula, 'Away is the mortal, away the dog.'

sanskrit_iast: utkrāmantam aśvam aiṣīkenodūhena vetasaśākhayābhyudūhanti //
meaning: उत्क्रामन्तम् अश्वम् ऐषीकेनोदूहेन वेतसशाखयाभ्युदूहन्ति //
text_mt: As the horse steps out, they brush him up with a whisk of reed grass [and] with a branch of rattan.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye svāhā \ somāya svāhā \\ ity anuvākena kṣarantam anumantrayate //
meaning: अग्नये स्वाहा \ सोमाय स्वाहा \\ इत्य् अनुवाकेन क्षरन्तम् अनुमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: With the section beginning with, 'To Agni svāhā! To Soma svāhā!', he accompanies with a mantra [the horse] as it steps forth.

sanskrit_iast: idam̐ viṣṇuḥ \ pra tad viṣṇur \ divo viṣṇa iti triṣu padeṣu juhoti prodake //
meaning: इदम्̐ विष्णुः \ प्र तद् विष्णुर् \ दिवो विष्ण इति त्रिषु पदेषु जुहोति प्रोदके //
text_mt: With the formulas, 'Here Viṣṇu [strode],' 'Forth that Viṣṇu,' and 'From the sky, Viṣṇu,' he offers [libations] on the three footprints in the water.

sanskrit_iast: vibhūr mātrā prabhūḥ pitrā \\ ity aśvam abhimantrayate //
meaning: विभूर् मात्रा प्रभूः पित्रा \\ इत्य् अश्वम् अभिमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: With the formula, 'Mighty by mother, prevailing by father,' he consecrates the horse.

sanskrit_iast: ādityānāṃ patvānvihi \\ ity utsṛjati /
meaning: आदित्यानां पत्वान्विहि \\ इत्य् उत्सृजति /
text_mt: With the formula, 'Follow the flight of the Ādityas,' he sets [the horse] free.

sanskrit_iast: śatāya kavacināṃ talpyebhyo rājaputrebhyas \\ devā āśāpālās \\ ity aśvaṃ paridadāti /
meaning: शताय कवचिनां तल्प्येभ्यो राजपुत्रेभ्यस् \\ देवा आशापालास् \\ इत्य् अश्वं परिददाति /
text_mt: With the formula, 'Gods who protect the quarters,' he entrusts the horse to a hundred princes of royal beds, clad in armor.

sanskrit_iast: catuḥśatāḥ pālayanty anivartayantaḥ /
meaning: चतुःशताः पालयन्त्य् अनिवर्तयन्तः /
text_mt: Four hundred [guards] protect him without turning him back.

sanskrit_iast: upām̐śu sāvitrībhiḥ pracarati /
meaning: उपाम्̐शु सावित्रीभिः प्रचरति /
text_mt: He proceeds with the Sāvitra offerings in a whisper.

sanskrit_iast: savitre 'ṣṭākapālaṃ pūrvāhṇe nirvapet //
meaning: सवित्रे ऽष्टाकपालं पूर्वाह्णे निर्वपेत् //
text_mt: In the forenoon, he should apportion [an oblation] on eight potsherds to Savitṛ.

sanskrit_iast: hiṃkārāya svāhā \\ itiprabhṛtibhir ekatra pañcāśatam āhutīr juhoti /
meaning: हिंकाराय स्वाहा \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् एकत्र पञ्चाशतम् आहुतीर् जुहोति /
text_mt: With the formulas beginning with, 'To the sound hiṃ svāhā!', he offers fifty-one oblations in one place.

sanskrit_iast: savitre prasavitra ekādaśakapālaṃ madhyaṃdine / savitre prasavitre dvādaśakapālam aparāhṇe //
meaning: सवित्रे प्रसवित्र एकादशकपालं मध्यंदिने / सवित्रे प्रसवित्रे द्वादशकपालम् अपराह्णे //
text_mt: At midday, [an oblation] on eleven potsherds to Savitṛ the Impeller; in the afternoon, [an oblation] on twelve potsherds to Savitṛ the Impeller.

sanskrit_iast: iha dhṛtir \ iha svadhṛtir itiprabhṛtibhiḥ prāk sviṣṭakṛtaś catasra āhutīr juhoti /
meaning: इह धृतिर् \ इह स्वधृतिर् इतिप्रभृतिभिः प्राक् स्विष्टकृतश् चतस्र आहुतीर् जुहोति /
text_mt: Before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, he offers four oblations with the formulas beginning with, 'Here is steadfastness, here is firm steadfastness.'

sanskrit_iast: sam̐vatsaram iṣṭibhir yajetāhutīś ca juhuyāt /
meaning: सम्̐वत्सरम् इष्टिभिर् यजेताहुतीश् च जुहुयात् /
text_mt: For a year he should sacrifice with the seasonal offerings and make the oblations.

sanskrit_iast: vīṇāgāthināv upagāyetām ity ayajathās \\ ity apacathās \\ ity adadās \\ iti tisṛbhir divā brāhmaṇas \\ ity ayudhyathās \\ iti kalyāṇam akuruthās \\ ity amum̐ saṃgrāmam ajayathās \\ iti tisṛbhir naktam̐ rājanya iti /
meaning: वीणागाथिनाव् उपगायेताम् इत्य् अयजथास् \\ इत्य् अपचथास् \\ इत्य् अददास् \\ इति तिसृभिर् दिवा ब्राह्मणस् \\ इत्य् अयुध्यथास् \\ इति कल्याणम् अकुरुथास् \\ इत्य् अमुम्̐ संग्रामम् अजयथास् \\ इति तिसृभिर् नक्तम्̐ राजन्य इति /
text_mt: Two lute-players should sing along: a brahmin by day with the three [verses], 'Thus did you sacrifice,' 'Thus did you cook,' 'Thus did you give,' [and] a noble by night with the three [verses], 'Thus did you fight,' 'Thus did you do good,' 'Thus did you conquer that battle.'

sanskrit_iast: saṃnipāte nityāpūrvānāśācetaśaṃketāśvākhare nirvaped āśvinībhir dhānā mṛgākhare yadi nāgachet /
meaning: संनिपाते नित्यापूर्वानाशाचेतशंकेताश्वाखरे निर्वपेद् आश्विनीभिर् धाना मृगाखरे यदि नागछेत् /
text_mt: In case of a clash, one should apportion regular unseen offerings [and] roasted grains at the horse's resting place with the Āśvina verses, or at a deer's resting place if he does not return.

sanskrit_iast: vaḍavāpyaye 'pīṣṭir āmnātā /
meaning: वडवाप्यये ऽपीष्टिर् आम्नाता /
text_mt: A sacrifice is also handed down in tradition in the case of mating with a mare.

sanskrit_iast: sam̐vatsarād ūrdhvam̐ ṣahamati yajati /
meaning: सम्̐वत्सराद् ऊर्ध्वम्̐ षहमति यजति /
text_mt: After a year, he performs the Ṣahamati sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: tasminn ukhām āchādanāntāṃ kurvanti /
meaning: तस्मिन्न् उखाम् आछादनान्तां कुर्वन्ति /
text_mt: At that [rite], they prepare the fire-pot up to the lid.

sanskrit_iast: samāpte vīṇāgāthibhyām̐ śate dadāty anasi yukte cāśvarathau /
meaning: समाप्ते वीणागाथिभ्याम्̐ शते ददात्य् अनसि युक्ते चाश्वरथौ /
text_mt: When it is concluded, he gives a hundred [cows] to the two lute-players, and a cart harnessed with two horses.

sanskrit_iast: vraje 'śvaṃ prarudhya damayanti /
meaning: व्रजे ऽश्वं प्ररुध्य दमयन्ति /
text_mt: Having confined the horse in an enclosure, they tame him.

sanskrit_iast: saptamyāṃ paśubandho 'ṣṭamyāṃ traidhātavyā dīkṣaṇīyā /
meaning: सप्तम्यां पशुबन्धो ऽष्टम्यां त्रैधातव्या दीक्षणीया /
text_mt: On the seventh [day] is the animal sacrifice; on the eighth is the Traidhātavī initiation offering.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ādhītayajurbhyaḥ //
meaning: सिद्धम् आधीतयजुर्भ्यः //
text_mt: The ritual is established up to the recited yajus formulas.

sanskrit_iast: kāya svāhā \ kasmai svāhā \\ itiprabhṛtīni trīṇi vaiśvadevyāny anvaham̐ saptamyāṃ pañcādhvarakāṇi hutvā ṣaḍ āgnikāni juhoty uttamāni ca vaiśvadevyāni /
meaning: काय स्वाहा \ कस्मै स्वाहा \\ इतिप्रभृतीनि त्रीणि वैश्वदेव्यान्य् अन्वहम्̐ सप्तम्यां पञ्चाध्वरकाणि हुत्वा षड् आग्निकानि जुहोत्य् उत्तमानि च वैश्वदेव्यानि /
text_mt: On the seventh day, having daily offered three Vaiśvadeva formulas beginning with, 'To Ka svāhā! To Kasmai svāhā!', [and] five offerings for the rites, he offers six fire offerings and the final Vaiśvadeva formulas.

sanskrit_iast: pūrṇāhutiprabhṛti siddham opasadbhyaḥ //
meaning: पूर्णाहुतिप्रभृति सिद्धम् ओपसद्भ्यः //
text_mt: From the full oblation onward, the ritual is established up to the upasad days.

sanskrit_iast: ā brahman brāhmaṇas \\ iti brahmā jātam ukhyam upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: आ ब्रह्मन् ब्राह्मणस् \\ इति ब्रह्मा जातम् उख्यम् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: With the formula, 'Into the brahman, the brahmin,' the brahman priest worships the fire produced in the pot.

sanskrit_iast: sam̐vatsaraṃ dīkṣā dvādaśopasadaḥ /
meaning: सम्̐वत्सरं दीक्षा द्वादशोपसदः /
text_mt: The initiation lasts a year; there are twelve upasad days.

sanskrit_iast: tristāvā vedis tathāgnir nottaravedī /
meaning: त्रिस्तावा वेदिस् तथाग्निर् नोत्तरवेदी /
text_mt: The altar is three times larger, likewise the fire-altar, but not the high altar.

sanskrit_iast: rathavāhane havirdhāne /
meaning: रथवाहने हविर्धाने /
text_mt: The two soma-cart sheds are chariot-stands.

sanskrit_iast: yūpān ekavim̐śatim̐ saṃminoti / naicudāravo 'gniṣṭha ekavim̐śatyaratniḥ pautudāravāv upasthāvānau ṣaṭ khādirāḥ ṣaṭ pālāśāḥ ṣaḍ bailvās trayo 'nye trayo 'nye / madhyame vāhani vim̐śatim̐ saṃminoti /
meaning: यूपान् एकविम्̐शतिम्̐ संमिनोति / नैचुदारवो ऽग्निष्ठ एकविम्̐शत्यरत्निः पौतुदारवाव् उपस्थावानौ षट् खादिराः षट् पालाशाः षड् बैल्वास् त्रयो ऽन्ये त्रयो ऽन्ये / मध्यमे वाहनि विम्̐शतिम्̐ संमिनोति /
text_mt: He sets up twenty-one sacrificial posts: the one facing the fire is made of pūtu-tree wood, twenty-one cubits long; the two flanking posts are made of pūtudāru wood; six are of khadira wood, six of palāśa wood, six of bilva wood, three of another kind, [and] three of yet another kind; or on the middle day he sets up twenty.

sanskrit_iast: yathākālaṃ digbhyo vasatīvarīr gṛhītvā samānīya sādayaty evam uttarābhyām ukthyātirātrābhyām /
meaning: यथाकालं दिग्भ्यो वसतीवरीर् गृहीत्वा समानीय सादयत्य् एवम् उत्तराभ्याम् उक्थ्यातिरात्राभ्याम् /
text_mt: Having collected the Vasatīvarī waters from the directions at the proper time, bringing them together, he places them; in the same way for the subsequent Ukthya and Atirātra days.

sanskrit_iast: anvahaṃ pṛṣṭhyān atigrāhyān gṛhṇāti /
meaning: अन्वहं पृष्ठ्यान् अतिग्राह्यान् गृह्णाति /
text_mt: Daily he draws the additional Pṛṣṭhya cups.

sanskrit_iast: madhyame pṛṣṭhaśilpaṃ kuryāt /
meaning: मध्यमे पृष्ठशिल्पं कुर्यात् /
text_mt: On the middle [day], he should execute the Pṛṣṭhaśilpa.

sanskrit_iast: siddha upavasathaḥ /
meaning: सिद्ध उपवसथः /

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte catuṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomo rathaṃtarapṛṣṭhaḥ /
meaning: श्वोभूते चतुष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमो रथंतरपृष्ठः /
text_mt: On the next day, there is a Catuṣṭoma Agniṣṭoma having the Rathaṃtara as its pṛṣṭha stotra.

sanskrit_iast: siddhaṃ patnīsam̐yājāntam̐ saṃtiṣṭhate /
meaning: सिद्धं पत्नीसम्̐याजान्तम्̐ संतिष्ठते /
text_mt: It concludes in the established manner ending with the offerings to the wives of the gods.

sanskrit_iast: upatalpayor āsīnāv abhyastamite sruvābhyāṃ juhutaḥ /
meaning: उपतल्पयोर् आसीनाव् अभ्यस्तमिते स्रुवाभ्यां जुहुतः /
text_mt: Sitting on low couches, both make offerings with two offering ladles at sunset.

sanskrit_iast: saktūn dhānā masūsyāni karambhām̐l lājān pṛthukān priyaṅgutaṇḍulān sam̐sṛjyānnena juhoti \\ agnaye svāhā \ somāya svāhā \\ itiprabhṛtibhir aikaśatāt //
meaning: सक्तून् धाना मसूस्यानि करम्भाम्̐ल् लाजान् पृथुकान् प्रियङ्गुतण्डुलान् सम्̐सृज्यान्नेन जुहोति \\ अग्नये स्वाहा \ सोमाय स्वाहा \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् ऐकशतात् //
text_mt: Having mixed barley groats, roasted grains, lentils, porridge, parched rice, flattened grains, and panic seeds, he offers with food, with formulas beginning with, 'To Agni svāhā! To Soma svāhā!', up to one hundred and one.

sanskrit_iast: ekasmai svāhā \ dvābhyām̐ svāhā \\ ity etenābhyāvartayan sarvarātraṃ juhoti yugbhir annam ayugbhir ājyam \\ vyuṣṭyai svāhā \\ iti vyuṣṭāyām \\ svargāya svāhā \\ ity abhudite /
meaning: एकस्मै स्वाहा \ द्वाभ्याम्̐ स्वाहा \\ इत्य् एतेनाभ्यावर्तयन् सर्वरात्रं जुहोति युग्भिर् अन्नम् अयुग्भिर् आज्यम् \\ व्युष्ट्यै स्वाहा \\ इति व्युष्टायाम् \\ स्वर्गाय स्वाहा \\ इत्य् अभुदिते /
text_mt: Repeating with the formulas, 'To one svāhā! To two svāhā!', he makes offerings throughout the whole night—food with the even ones, clarified butter with the odd ones; with, 'To dawn svāhā!', when dawn breaks; with, 'To heaven svāhā!', at sunrise.

sanskrit_iast: ekavim̐śa ukthyo madhyamāhaḥ /
meaning: एकविम्̐श उक्थ्यो मध्यमाहः /
text_mt: The middle day is a twenty-one-fold Ukthya.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā pātraprayojanāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ पात्रप्रयोजनात् /
text_mt: The procedure is established up to the employ of the vessels.

sanskrit_iast: antaryāmapātraṃ prayujya mahimnoḥ pātre prayunakti sauvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇam̐ rājatam uttaram /
meaning: अन्तर्यामपात्रं प्रयुज्य महिम्नोः पात्रे प्रयुनक्ति सौवर्णं दक्षिणम्̐ राजतम् उत्तरम् /
text_mt: Having employed the Antaryāma cup, he employs the two Mahiman cups: the golden one on the south, the silver one on the north.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā grahaṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ ग्रहणात् /

sanskrit_iast: antaryāmaṃ gṛhītvā mahimānau gṛhṇīte hiraṇyagarbhas \\ yaḥ prāṇatas \\ iti grahaṇasādane /
meaning: अन्तर्यामं गृहीत्वा महिमानौ गृह्णीते हिरण्यगर्भस् \\ यः प्राणतस् \\ इति ग्रहणसादने /
text_mt: Having drawn the Antaryāma cup, he draws the two Mahiman cups; the drawing and placing [are accompanied] by the verses, 'The Golden Embryo' [and] 'He who breathes.'

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā bahiṣpavamānāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ बहिष्पवमानात् /
text_mt: The ritual is established up to the out-of-doors laud.

sanskrit_iast:
jyotir yajñasya pavate madhu priyam\ pitā devānāṃ janitā vibhāvasuḥ /
dadhāti ratnam̐ svadhayor apīcyam\ maditamo matsara indriyo rasaḥ //
ity aśvasya grīvāsu niṣkaṃ pratimuñcati //
meaning:
ज्योतिर् यज्ञस्य पवते मधु प्रियम्\ पिता देवानां जनिता विभावसुः /
दधाति रत्नम्̐ स्वधयोर् अपीच्यम्\ मदितमो मत्सर इन्द्रियो रसः //
इत्य् अश्वस्य ग्रीवासु निष्कं प्रतिमुञ्चति //
text_mt:
'The light of the sacrifice is purified, the sweet soma, dear, / the father of the gods, the progenitor, possessing radiant wealth.'

"He sets the treasure in the secret place of the two worlds, / Most exhilarating, intoxicating, full of virile energy, the sap."

With this [verse] he fastens a gold ornament around the neck of the horse.

sanskrit_iast: śyeno 'si gāyatraṃ chandaḥ \ suparṇo 'si triṣṭupchandaḥ \ sakhāsi gāyatraṃ chandas \\ ity aśvasya pucham ārabhya pavamānam̐ sarpanti /
meaning: श्येनो ऽसि गायत्रं छन्दः \ सुपर्णो ऽसि त्रिष्टुप्छन्दः \ सखासि गायत्रं छन्दस् \\ इत्य् अश्वस्य पुछम् आरभ्य पवमानम्̐ सर्पन्ति /
text_mt: With: "You are a falcon, the gāyatrī metre; you are a bird of good wings, the triṣṭubh metre; you are a companion, the gāyatrī metre," they glide to the pavamāna chant, holding on to the tail of the horse.

sanskrit_iast: uttarataḥ śatena tvā pravṛṇajmi \\ ity udgātāram āha tasyāpavaram ṛtvijo 'pavṛtāḥ /
meaning: उत्तरतः शतेन त्वा प्रवृणज्मि \\ इत्य् उद्गातारम् आह तस्यापवरम् ऋत्विजो ऽपवृताः /
text_mt: "To the north, with a hundred I choose you," he says to the udgātṛ. At his choice, the officiating priests are chosen.

sanskrit_iast: śatam udgātre dadāti /
meaning: शतम् उद्गात्रे ददाति /

sanskrit_iast: āstāvānte vaḍavām apasādhyāśvam̐ saṃkramayanti /
meaning: आस्तावान्ते वडवाम् अपसाध्याश्वम्̐ संक्रमयन्ति /
text_mt: At the edge of the āstāva, having curbed a mare, they make the horse approach.

sanskrit_iast: uttaratas \\ niṣkeṇa tvā śatapareṇopahvayāmas \\ imāṃ devatām udgāya \\ ity udgātāram āha tasyopahvānam ṛtvija imāṃ devatām upahūtāḥ /
meaning: उत्तरतस् \\ निष्केण त्वा शतपरेणोपह्वयामस् \\ इमां देवताम् उद्गाय \\ इत्य् उद्गातारम् आह तस्योपह्वानम् ऋत्विज इमां देवताम् उपहूताः /
text_mt: To the north, [saying]: "With a gold ornament followed by a hundred we summon you; chant the udgītha for this deity," he speaks to the udgātṛ. At his summoning, the officiating priests are summoned for this deity.

sanskrit_iast: śataṃ niṣkaṃ codgātre dadāti /
meaning: शतं निष्कं चोद्गात्रे ददाति /
text_mt: And he gives a hundred and a gold ornament to the udgātṛ.

sanskrit_iast: ubhayaṃ kurvanty udgītham aśvasaṃkrandanaṃ ca /
meaning: उभयं कुर्वन्त्य् उद्गीथम् अश्वसंक्रन्दनं च /
text_mt: They perform both: the chanting of the udgītha and the neighing of the horse.

sanskrit_iast: samāpte śatamānam udgātṛbhyaḥ prayachati /
meaning: समाप्ते शतमानम् उद्गातृभ्यः प्रयछति /
text_mt: When it is finished, he presents a śatamāna [weight of gold] to the udgātṛs.

sanskrit_iast: siddham opākaraṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् ओपाकरणात् /

sanskrit_iast: dvayānaikādaśinān upākaroti plakṣaśākhayetarān aśve paryaṅgyān avachādayanto yāmam indrāya svapasyāya vehad vaiṣṇavo vāmana iti yūpabhājo babhrur aruṇababhrur itiprabhṛtīn viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ pṛṣata ity antān /
meaning: द्वयानैकादशिनान् उपाकरोति प्लक्षशाखयेतरान् अश्वे पर्यङ्ग्यान् अवछादयन्तो यामम् इन्द्राय स्वपस्याय वेहद् वैष्णवो वामन इति यूपभाजो बभ्रुर् अरुणबभ्रुर् इतिप्रभृतीन् विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः पृषत इत्य् अन्तान् /
text_mt: He brings up two sets of eleven [victims]; with a branch of the plakṣa tree the other [wild animals]; while they cover the horse with the victims tied around its limbs: "To Yama, to Indra, for good work... a barren cow... to Viṣṇu a dwarf"—these are the sharers of the sacrificial post; "A brown one, a reddish-brown one," etc., ending with "spotted ones to the Viśve Devas."

sanskrit_iast: bahuśabde trīn pratīyāt tryavayo gāyatryai \\ ity adhyardhahāyanān pañcāvayas triṣṭubhe pañcāvarān dityavāho jagatyai dvihāyanām̐s trivatsā anuṣṭubhe trihāyanām̐s turyavāha uṣṇihe caturhāyanān paṣṭhavāho virāje \\ iti paṣṭhauhaḥ //
meaning: बहुशब्दे त्रीन् प्रतीयात् त्र्यवयो गायत्र्यै \\ इत्य् अध्यर्धहायनान् पञ्चावयस् त्रिष्टुभे पञ्चावरान् दित्यवाहो जगत्यै द्विहायनाम्̐स् त्रिवत्सा अनुष्टुभे त्रिहायनाम्̐स् तुर्यवाह उष्णिहे चतुर्हायनान् पष्ठवाहो विराजे \\ इति पष्ठौहः //
text_mt: Where a plural word is used, one should understand three. "Three-year-olds to the gāyatrī"—[meaning] one-and-a-half-year-old [animals]; "five-year-olds to the triṣṭubh"—at least five; "two-year-olds (dityavāh) to the jagatī"—two-year-old [animals]; "three-year-olds (trivatsa) to the anuṣṭubh"—three-year-old [animals]; "four-year-olds (turyavāh) to the uṣṇih"—four-year-old [animals]; "six-year-olds (paṣṭhavāh) to the virāj"—a six-year-old ox (paṣṭhauh).

sanskrit_iast: yuñjanti bradhnam ity aruṇapiśaṅgam̐ yujyamānam anumantrayate yuñjanty asya kāmyā \\ ity uttarau ketuṃ kṛṇvann aketave \\ iti dhvajam \\ jīmūtasyeva \\ iti saṃnaddhakavacaṃ dhatte ... tīṣudhim̐ rathe tiṣṭhan nayati iti sārathiṃ tīvrān ghoṣān kṛṇvate \\ ity aśvān vanaspate vīḍvaṅgas \\ iti tisṛbhī ratham̐ svādupam̐sadas \\ iti tisṛbhir janayataḥ suparṇam̐ vaste \\ itīṣum ahir iva bhogair iti talam ājaṅghanti \\ ity aśvājanīm upaśvāsaya \\ iti dvābhyāṃ dundubhim //
meaning: युञ्जन्ति ब्रध्नम् इत्य् अरुणपिशङ्गम्̐ युज्यमानम् अनुमन्त्रयते युञ्जन्त्य् अस्य काम्या \\ इत्य् उत्तरौ केतुं कृण्वन्न् अकेतवे \\ इति ध्वजम् \\ जीमूतस्येव \\ इति संनद्धकवचं धत्ते ... तीषुधिम्̐ रथे तिष्ठन् नयति इति सारथिं तीव्रान् घोषान् कृण्वते \\ इत्य् अश्वान् वनस्पते वीड्वङ्गस् \\ इति तिसृभी रथम्̐ स्वादुपम्̐सदस् \\ इति तिसृभिर् जनयतः सुपर्णम्̐ वस्ते \\ इतीषुम् अहिर् इव भोगैर् इति तलम् आजङ्घन्ति \\ इत्य् अश्वाजनीम् उपश्वासय \\ इति द्वाभ्यां दुन्दुभिम् //
text_mt: With "They yoke the tawny steed..." he accompanies with a mantra the reddish-tawny one as it is being yoked; with "They yoke his two dear..." the two following ones; with "Making a sign for him who has no sign..." the banner; with "Like a cloud..." he puts on the armored one [...]; [with "..."] the quiver; with "Standing in the chariot he directs..." the charioteer; with "They make loud noises..." the horses; with "O lord of the forest, strong-limbed..." with three [verses], the chariot; with "Pleasant to sit upon..." with three [verses], the two produce [...]; with "He wears a good feather..." the arrow; with "Like a serpent with its coils..." the arm-guard; with "They strike..." the whip; with "Make sound..." with two [verses], the war-drum.

sanskrit_iast: āmūr aja \\ iti japati /
meaning: आमूर् अज \\ इति जपति /

sanskrit_iast: prāg abhiprayāya pradakṣiṇam āvartayati /
meaning: प्राग् अभिप्रयाय प्रदक्षिणम् आवर्तयति /
text_mt: Having driven forward towards the east, he turns around clockwise.

sanskrit_iast: prayuktānām aruṇapiśaṅgam apo 'bhyavanīya yad vāto 'po aganīgann iti pratyānayati yathopākṛtam avasthitam /
meaning: प्रयुक्तानाम् अरुणपिशङ्गम् अपो ऽभ्यवनीय यद् वातो ऽपो अगनीगन्न् इति प्रत्यानयति यथोपाकृतम् अवस्थितम् /
text_mt: Having led the reddish-tawny one among the yoked ones down to the water, he brings it back with: "Since the wind has reached the water...", standing as it was when brought forward.

sanskrit_iast: abhyañjanti vasavas tvāñjantu \\ iti kāsāmbavena mahiṣī mukhādadhyā bāhvas \\ rudrās tvāñjantu \\ iti gaulgulavena vāvātā nabher ādityās tvāñjantu \\ iti maustakṛtena parivṛktyā puchāt /
meaning: अभ्यञ्जन्ति वसवस् त्वाञ्जन्तु \\ इति कासाम्बवेन महिषी मुखादध्या बाह्वस् \\ रुद्रास् त्वाञ्जन्तु \\ इति गौल्गुलवेन वावाता नभेर् आदित्यास् त्वाञ्जन्तु \\ इति मौस्तकृतेन परिवृक्त्या पुछात् /
text_mt: They anoint it: the chief queen (mahiṣī) anoints it from the mouth down to the forelegs with ointment of kāsāmba with: "May the Vasus anoint you"; the favorite wife (vāvātā) from the navel with bdellium ointment with: "May the Rudras anoint you"; the discarded wife (parivṛktī) from the tail with nut-grass ointment with: "May the Ādityas anoint you."

sanskrit_iast: trisāhasrān kācām̐l lomasv āvayanti bhūr iti mahiṣī sauvarṇān bhuvas \\ iti vāvātā rājatān svar iti parivṛktī śaṅkhamayān //
meaning: त्रिसाहस्रान् काचाम्̐ल् लोमस्व् आवयन्ति भूर् इति महिषी सौवर्णान् भुवस् \\ इति वावाता राजतान् स्वर् इति परिवृक्ती शङ्खमयान् //
text_mt: They weave three thousand glass beads into the hair: the chief queen weaves golden ones with "Bhūḥ"; the favorite wife silver ones with "Bhuvaḥ"; the discarded wife ones made of conch shell with "Svaḥ".

sanskrit_iast: lājī śācī \\ ity annahomaśeṣaṃ patnyo 'śvāyopakiranti /
meaning: लाजी शाची \\ इत्य् अन्नहोमशेषं पत्न्यो ऽश्वायोपकिरन्ति /
text_mt: With: "Lājī śācī..." the wives scatter the remainder of the food oblation for the horse.

sanskrit_iast: yatrādyāt tad iṣṭake prakiret /
meaning: यत्राद्यात् तद् इष्टके प्रकिरेत् /
text_mt: Where it would eat, there he should scatter it on a brick.

sanskrit_iast: ājyam̐ homaśeṣam abhiṣekāya nidadhāti /
meaning: आज्यम्̐ होमशेषम् अभिषेकाय निदधाति /
text_mt: He sets aside the clarified butter that is the remainder of the oblation for the consecration.

sanskrit_iast: hotā brahmā cānvagniṣṭham abhito 'nyo'nyaṃ pṛchataḥ kaḥ svid ekākī carati \ sūrya ekākī carati \\ iti praśnaprativacanāt /
meaning: होता ब्रह्मा चान्वग्निष्ठम् अभितो ऽन्योऽन्यं पृछतः कः स्विद् एकाकी चरति \ सूर्य एकाकी चरति \\ इति प्रश्नप्रतिवचनात् /
text_mt: The hotṛ and the brahman priest ask each other on both sides of the central sacrificial post: "Who, indeed, roams alone?"—"The sun roams alone," following the questions and answers.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā niyojanāt //
meaning: सिद्धम् आ नियोजनात् //

sanskrit_iast: yuñjanti bradhnam ity aruṇapiśaṅgam agniṣṭhe niyunakti tūparagomṛgau cāśvam abhito daśa paryaṅgyān avachādayanto yāmam indrāya svapasyāya vehad vaiṣṇavo vāmana iti yūpabhājo babhrur aruṇababhrur itiprabhṛtīn /
meaning: युञ्जन्ति ब्रध्नम् इत्य् अरुणपिशङ्गम् अग्निष्ठे नियुनक्ति तूपरगोमृगौ चाश्वम् अभितो दश पर्यङ्ग्यान् अवछादयन्तो यामम् इन्द्राय स्वपस्याय वेहद् वैष्णवो वामन इति यूपभाजो बभ्रुर् अरुणबभ्रुर् इतिप्रभृतीन् /
text_mt: With "They yoke the tawny steed..." he binds the reddish-tawny horse to the central sacrificial post; and on both sides of the horse a hornless goat and a wild ox; the ten victims tied around the limbs; while they cover [it]: "To Yama, to Indra, for good work... a barren cow... to Viṣṇu a dwarf"—these belong to the sacrificial posts, "A brown one, a reddish-brown one," and so forth.

sanskrit_iast: vasantāya kapiñjalān itiprabhṛtaya āraṇyās teṣāṃ daśa pañcadaśina ekādaśa daśinaḥ /
meaning: वसन्ताय कपिञ्जलान् इतिप्रभृतय आरण्यास् तेषां दश पञ्चदशिन एकादश दशिनः /
text_mt: Those beginning with "Francolin partridges for spring..." are the wild animals; of them, there are ten sets of fifteen and eleven sets of ten.

sanskrit_iast: tān yūpāntareṣu trayodaśatrayodaśa vyatyāsaṃ / nāṅgiṣu pluṣimaśakān karaṇḍeṣu sarpān piñjareṣu mṛgavyāghrasim̐hān kumbheṣu makaramatsyamaṇḍūkāñjāleṣu pakṣiṇaḥ kārāsu hastinaḥ nauṣu caudakāni yathārtham itarān /
meaning: तान् यूपान्तरेषु त्रयोदशत्रयोदश व्यत्यासं / नाङ्गिषु प्लुषिमशकान् करण्डेषु सर्पान् पिञ्जरेषु मृगव्याघ्रसिम्̐हान् कुम्भेषु मकरमत्स्यमण्डूकाञ्जालेषु पक्षिणः कारासु हस्तिनः नौषु चौदकानि यथार्थम् इतरान् /
text_mt: He places them between the sacrificial posts, thirteen by thirteen alternately: the fleas and mosquitoes in vessels; the snakes in hampers; the wild beasts, tigers, and lions in cages; the sea monsters, fish, and frogs in jars; the birds in nets; the elephants in enclosures; and the aquatic animals in boats; the others according to their suitability.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā paryagnikaraṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ पर्यग्निकरणात् /
text_mt: [The procedure] is established up to the carrying of fire around [the victims] (paryagnikaraṇa).

sanskrit_iast: paryagnikṛtān utsṛjanti puruṣānye ca grāmyāṇām utsarjanadharmāṇaḥ /
meaning: पर्यग्निकृतान् उत्सृजन्ति पुरुषान्ये च ग्राम्याणाम् उत्सर्जनधर्माणः /
text_mt: After fire has been carried around them, they release the wild animals and whichever domestic animals have the rule of being released.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā prakramaṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ प्रक्रमणात् /

sanskrit_iast: pauṣṇam ajam aśvasyāgrato nayanti /
meaning: पौष्णम् अजम् अश्वस्याग्रतो नयन्ति /
text_mt: They lead the goat sacred to Pūṣan in front of the horse.

sanskrit_iast: avasthitāyāśvāya darbham upāsyati vāso 'dhīvāso hiraṇyakaśipūni ca /
meaning: अवस्थितायाश्वाय दर्भम् उपास्यति वासो ऽधीवासो हिरण्यकशिपूनि च /
text_mt: For the horse that has been brought to a standstill, he throws down darbha grass, a cloth, an upper garment, and gold cushions.

sanskrit_iast: galāpraveṣṭanena prājāpatyān saṃjñapayanti śāmūlenāśvam //
meaning: गलाप्रवेष्टनेन प्राजापत्यान् संज्ञपयन्ति शामूलेनाश्वम् //
text_mt: They suffocate the victims sacred to Prajāpati by encircling the neck, and the horse with a garment of wool (śāmūla).

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāya svāhā \\ apānāya svāhā \ vyānāya svāhā \\ iti saṃjñapyamāne tisra āhutīr juhoti //
meaning: प्राणाय स्वाहा \\ अपानाय स्वाहा \ व्यानाय स्वाहा \\ इति संज्ञप्यमाने तिस्र आहुतीर् जुहोति //
text_mt: While it is being suffocated, he offers three oblations with: "To the out-breath svāhā!", "To the in-breath svāhā!", "To the diffused breath svāhā!"

sanskrit_iast: amby ambike \\ iti mahiṣīm abhyudānayati tūṣṇīm itare śatam̐ sārdhaṃ patnyā /
meaning: अम्ब्य् अम्बिके \\ इति महिषीम् अभ्युदानयति तूष्णीम् इतरे शतम्̐ सार्धं पत्न्या /
text_mt: With: "O mother, little mother..." he brings the chief queen forward; the other [women], a hundred along with the wife, [come forward] silently.

sanskrit_iast: vihatya keśān udgrathya savyān dakṣiṇān ūrūn ghnānās \\ gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatim̐ havāmahe \\ iti dakṣiṇapādam aśvaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ triḥ pariyanty udgrathya dakṣiṇān keśān udakpādam̐ savyān ūrūn ghnānāḥ prasavyaṃ triḥ pariyanti //
meaning: विहत्य केशान् उद्ग्रथ्य सव्यान् दक्षिणान् ऊरून् घ्नानास् \\ गणानां त्वा गणपतिम्̐ हवामहे \\ इति दक्षिणपादम् अश्वं प्रदक्षिणं त्रिः परियन्त्य् उद्ग्रथ्य दक्षिणान् केशान् उदक्पादम्̐ सव्यान् ऊरून् घ्नानाः प्रसव्यं त्रिः परियन्ति //
text_mt: Having untied their hair and knotted it on the left, beating their right thighs, with: "We invoke you, lord of the hosts of hosts...", they circumambulate the horse three times clockwise keeping it on their right side; having knotted their hair on the right, beating their left thighs, they go around it three times counter-clockwise, facing north.

sanskrit_iast: vaso mama \\ iti pādāny aghrati pariśrite /
meaning: वसो मम \\ इति पादान्य् अघ्रति परिश्रिते /
text_mt: In the enclosed space, [the wife] smells the feet [of the horse] with: "O my treasure..."

sanskrit_iast: avākśirasam uttānam āham ajāni garbhadham iti patny aśvam abhimedhati //
meaning: अवाक्शिरसम् उत्तानम् आहम् अजानि गर्भधम् इति पत्न्य् अश्वम् अभिमेधति //
text_mt: Lying supine with her head downwards, the wife approaches the horse sexually with: "I will insert the seed-bearer..."

sanskrit_iast: dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣam ity ucchritāyām̐ sarve japanti /
meaning: दधिक्राव्णो अकारिषम् इत्य् उच्छ्रितायाम्̐ सर्वे जपन्ति /
text_mt: When she has stood up, all mutter: "I have praised Dadhikrāvan..."

sanskrit_iast: pratyakśirasaḥ sūcībhiḥ patnyo 'sipathān kalpayanti gāyatrī triṣṭub iti dvābhyāṃ mahiṣī sauvarṇībhir ā hanubhyāṃ bhṛdayāt kroḍād uttarābhyām̐ vāvātā rājatībhir ā puchāt /
meaning: प्रत्यक्शिरसः सूचीभिः पत्न्यो ऽसिपथान् कल्पयन्ति गायत्री त्रिष्टुब् इति द्वाभ्यां महिषी सौवर्णीभिर् आ हनुभ्यां भृदयात् क्रोडाद् उत्तराभ्याम्̐ वावाता राजतीभिर् आ पुछात् /
text_mt: While [the horse] lies with its head to the west, the wives trace the paths for the knife with needles: with the two [formulas] "The gāyatrī, the triṣṭubh..." the chief queen with golden ones from the jaws to the breast; with the two subsequent ones, the favorite wife with silver ones from the chest to the tail.

sanskrit_iast: nāśvasya vapā / candra iti meda ācakṣate tataś coddharanti /
meaning: नाश्वस्य वपा / चन्द्र इति मेद आचक्षते ततश् चोद्धरन्ति /
text_mt: The horse has no omentum (vapā). They call the fat "candra" (the moon); and from there they extract it.

sanskrit_iast: uttarato 'śvasya candram̐ śrapayati /
meaning: उत्तरतो ऽश्वस्य चन्द्रम्̐ श्रपयति /
text_mt: To the north of the horse, he cooks the candra.

sanskrit_iast:
ekas tvaṣṭur aśvasyā viśastā \ dvā yantārā bhavatas tathā ṛtuḥ /
yā te gātrāṇām ṛtuthā kṛṇomi \ tātā piṇḍānāṃ pra juhomy agnau //
svāhā \\ ity āhavanīye trīñ śṛtapaiṇḍān ādadhāti /
meaning:
एकस् त्वष्टुर् अश्वस्या विशस्ता \ द्वा यन्तारा भवतस् तथा ऋतुः /
या ते गात्राणाम् ऋतुथा कृणोमि \ ताता पिण्डानां प्र जुहोम्य् अग्नौ //
स्वाहा \\ इत्य् आहवनीये त्रीञ् शृतपैण्डान् आदधाति /
text_mt:
"Tvaṣṭṛ has one slaughterer of the horse, / Two are the restrainers; thus is the season.

Whatever limbs of yours I prepare in the seasonal order, / Those portions of balls I offer into the fire."

With: "Svāhā!" he deposits three cooked balls into the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: uttarato 'śvasya vaitase kaṭe 'vadāyātikramyetarayor avadyati /
meaning: उत्तरतो ऽश्वस्य वैतसे कटे ऽवदायातिक्रम्येतरयोर् अवद्यति /
text_mt: To the north of the horse, having cut portions onto a reed mat and having stepped across, he cuts portions of the other two [victims].

sanskrit_iast: abhito vapāṃ mahimānau juhoti svāhā devebhyas \\ iti purastāt sauvarṇena viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ svāhā \\ ity upariṣṭād rājatena //
meaning: अभितो वपां महिमानौ जुहोति स्वाहा देवेभ्यस् \\ इति पुरस्तात् सौवर्णेन विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः स्वाहा \\ इत्य् उपरिष्टाद् राजतेन //
text_mt: On both sides of the omentum, he offers the two Mahiman libations: before, with a golden [vessel], with "Svāhā to the gods!"; after, with a silver [vessel], with "Svāhā to the Viśve Devas!"

sanskrit_iast: prajāpataye \\ ity upām̐śu hayasya chāgasyosrasya candravapānāṃ medaso 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
meaning: प्रजापतये \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शु हयस्य छागस्योस्रस्य चन्द्रवपानां मेदसो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: He causes [the hotṛ] to recite in a whisper: "To Prajāpati... recite [the invitatory verse] for the fat of the candra-omentum of the horse, of the goat, [and] of the bull."

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya prajāpataye \\ ity upām̐śu hayasya chāgasyosrasya candravapānāṃ medasaḥ preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
meaning: आश्राव्य प्रजापतये \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शु हयस्य छागस्योस्रस्य चन्द्रवपानां मेदसः प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
text_mt: Having called for the śrauta call, he proceeds [saying]: 'To Prajāpati,' in a whisper, 'urge [the hotṛ] for the omenta and fat of the horse, the hornless goat, and the wild ox!'

sanskrit_iast: yathāvadānam̐ samavadāyottareṣāṃ paśūnām \\ viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ chāgānāṃ meṣāṇām usrāṇām̐ vapānāṃ medaso 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
meaning: यथावदानम्̐ समवदायोत्तरेषां पशूनाम् \\ विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः छागानां मेषाणाम् उस्राणाम्̐ वपानां मेदसो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
text_mt: Having cut the portions in the prescribed manner from the subsequent animals, he bids [the hotṛ] recite: 'For the All-Gods, recite [the invitatory verse] for the omenta and fat of the hornless goats, the rams, and the wild oxen!'

sanskrit_iast: āśrāvya viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ chāgānāṃ meṣāṇām usrāṇām̐ vapānāṃ medasaḥ preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
meaning: आश्राव्य विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः छागानां मेषाणाम् उस्राणाम्̐ वपानां मेदसः प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
text_mt: Having called for the śrauta call, he proceeds [saying]: 'For the All-Gods, urge [the hotṛ] for the omenta and fat of the hornless goats, the rams, and the wild oxen!'

sanskrit_iast: sūkaravikartaṃ prajāpatyam̐ viśasanti /
meaning: सूकरविकर्तं प्रजापत्यम्̐ विशसन्ति /
text_mt: They dissect the victims dedicated to Prajāpati [as in] the dissection of a boar.

sanskrit_iast: uttarato 'śvasya śoṇitam̐ śrapayati / śoṇite tejanīty ācakṣate /
meaning: उत्तरतो ऽश्वस्य शोणितम्̐ श्रपयति / शोणिते तेजनीत्य् आचक्षते /
text_mt: He cooks the blood of the horse to the north. They call the blood 'the sharp fire.'

sanskrit_iast: avadānāny avadāyāvadānaśaḥ prājāpatyāñ śrapayanti /
meaning: अवदानान्य् अवदायावदानशः प्राजापत्याञ् श्रपयन्ति /
text_mt: Having cut the portions portion by portion, they cook the portions of the victims dedicated to Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: śūlyam aśvasya kuryāt /
meaning: शूल्यम् अश्वस्य कुर्यात् /

sanskrit_iast: siddham ā dakṣiṇākālāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आ दक्षिणाकालात् /
text_mt: [The ritual] is established up to the time of the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: kāmaprāptā dakṣiṇā dadāti yadi kāmam āvayet /
meaning: कामप्राप्ता दक्षिणा ददाति यदि कामम् आवयेत् /
text_mt: He gives a sacrificial gift obtained according to desire, if he should invite desired objects.

sanskrit_iast: yat prācyāṃ diśy abrāhmaṇānām̐ vittam̐ syāt tad adhvaryave dadyāt kṣetradvipadavarjam̐ yad dakṣiṇasyāṃ tad brahmaṇe yat pratīcyāṃ tad dhotre yad udīcyāṃ tad udgātre /
meaning: यत् प्राच्यां दिश्य् अब्राह्मणानाम्̐ वित्तम्̐ स्यात् तद् अध्वर्यवे दद्यात् क्षेत्रद्विपदवर्जम्̐ यद् दक्षिणस्यां तद् ब्रह्मणे यत् प्रतीच्यां तद् धोत्रे यद् उदीच्यां तद् उद्गात्रे /
text_mt: Whatever property of non-Brahmins may be in the eastern quarter, that he should give to the adhvaryu priest, excluding land and two-footed beings [slaves]; whatever is in the southern, to the brahman priest; whatever is in the western, to the hotṛ priest; whatever is in the northern, to the udgātṛ priest.

sanskrit_iast: māhendraṃ gṛhītvā stotram upākaroti //
meaning: माहेन्द्रं गृहीत्वा स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति //
text_mt: Having drawn the Māhendra cup, he brings near the chant.

sanskrit_iast: agna āyūm̐ṣi pavase \\ iti saptānāṃ prathamās tāḥ purastād abhiṣekasya kuryāt prajāpatiś carati garbhe antar iti saptānāṃ prathamās tāḥ purastāt prāṇabhṛta upariṣṭād apānabhṛtaḥ /
meaning: अग्न आयूम्̐षि पवसे \\ इति सप्तानां प्रथमास् ताः पुरस्ताद् अभिषेकस्य कुर्यात् प्रजापतिश् चरति गर्भे अन्तर् इति सप्तानां प्रथमास् ताः पुरस्तात् प्राणभृत उपरिष्टाद् अपानभृतः /
text_mt: 'Agni, thou purifiest the spans of life'—these are the first of seven [formulas]; he should perform those before the royal unction; 'Prajāpati moves within the womb'—these are the first of seven; those [are performed] before the prāṇabhṛt [offerings] and after the apānabhṛt [offerings].

sanskrit_iast: sim̐hacarmaṇy abhiṣicyate /
meaning: सिम्̐हचर्मण्य् अभिषिच्यते /
text_mt: He is anointed upon a lion skin.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣabhacarmopariṣṭād dhriyate //
meaning: ऋषभचर्मोपरिष्टाद् ध्रियते //
text_mt: A bull skin is held above [him].

sanskrit_iast: sahasraśṛṅgo vṛṣabho jātavedās \\ iti sauvarṇam̐ rukmam upariṣṭād dhārayan saṃpātenābhiṣiñcati prajāpatiṃ pārameṣṭhyāya \\ iti yathākāmam //
meaning: सहस्रशृङ्गो वृषभो जातवेदास् \\ इति सौवर्णम्̐ रुक्मम् उपरिष्टाद् धारयन् संपातेनाभिषिञ्चति प्रजापतिं पारमेष्ठ्याय \\ इति यथाकामम् //
text_mt: Holding a gold ornament above with the mantra 'The thousand-horned bull, Jātavedas...', he anoints him with the remaining drops, reciting 'Prajāpati for supreme lordship...' according to desire.

sanskrit_iast: samiddho añjan kṛdaraṃ matīnām ity āprībhir hastaṃ gṛhṇāti /
meaning: समिद्धो अञ्जन् कृदरं मतीनाम् इत्य् आप्रीभिर् हस्तं गृह्णाति /
text_mt: With the Āprī verses, beginning with 'Kindled, anointing the chamber of prayers...', he takes [his] hand.

sanskrit_iast:
vi rakṣo vi mṛdho jahi \ vi vṛtrasya hanū ruja /
vi manyum indra vṛtrahann \ amitrasya śiro jahi //
iti mukham̐ vimṛṣṭe /
meaning:
वि रक्षो वि मृधो जहि \ वि वृत्रस्य हनू रुज /
वि मन्युम् इन्द्र वृत्रहन्न् \ अमित्रस्य शिरो जहि //
इति मुखम्̐ विमृष्टे /
text_mt:
'Smite away the demon, smite away the adversaries, break apart Vṛtra's jaws!

Dispel the fury, O Indra, slayer of Vṛtra; smash the enemy's head!'

sanskrit_iast: jāgatān viṣṇukramān krāmati /
meaning: जागतान् विष्णुक्रमान् क्रामति /
text_mt: He strides the Viṣṇukrama strides in the Jagatī meter.

sanskrit_iast: māsanāmāni juhoti /
meaning: मासनामानि जुहोति /

sanskrit_iast: uttarato 'śvasya vaitase kaṭe 'vadyati /
meaning: उत्तरतो ऽश्वस्य वैतसे कटे ऽवद्यति /
text_mt: To the north of the horse, he cuts the portions on a reed mat.

sanskrit_iast: gomṛgakaṇṭhena tejanyām̐ sviṣṭakṛto vaṣaṭkāro juhoti /
meaning: गोमृगकण्ठेन तेजन्याम्̐ स्विष्टकृतो वषट्कारो जुहोति /
text_mt: With the throat of the gomṛga upon the sharp fire, the vaṣaṭ-call of the Sviṣṭakṛt offering [is made], and he offers.

sanskrit_iast: aśvaśaphena patnīsam̐yājayaty ayasmayena varuṇāvabhṛtheṣṭau /
meaning: अश्वशफेन पत्नीसम्̐याजयत्य् अयस्मयेन वरुणावभृथेष्टौ /
text_mt: With a horse hoof made of iron, he makes the patnīsaṃyāja offerings in the avabhṛtha offering of Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: vaitase kaṭe prājāpatyān saṃcinoti prāñcāv aśvatūparau pratyañcaṃ gomṛgam /
meaning: वैतसे कटे प्राजापत्यान् संचिनोति प्राञ्चाव् अश्वतूपरौ प्रत्यञ्चं गोमृगम् /
text_mt: On a reed mat he arranges the victims dedicated to Prajāpati: the horse and the hornless goat facing east, and the gomṛga facing west.

sanskrit_iast: vaṣaṭkṛte rājaputrāś catvāra ādadhaty āhavanīye /
meaning: वषट्कृते राजपुत्राश् चत्वार आदधत्य् आहवनीये /
text_mt: When the vaṣaṭ-call is uttered, four princes place [them] on the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: pratyāhutyājyaṃ gṛhītvā śādaṃ dadbhiḥ svāhā yasyāraṇye 'dhītenānuvākena //
meaning: प्रत्याहुत्याज्यं गृहीत्वा शादं दद्भिः स्वाहा यस्यारण्ये ऽधीतेनानुवाकेन //
text_mt: Having taken clarified butter for each offering, [he offers] with the chapter learned in the forest beginning with 'Grass with the teeth, svāhā...'

sanskrit_iast: mā no mitro varuṇas \\ ity aśvastomīyāḥ ṣoḍaśāhutīr juhoti /
meaning: मा नो मित्रो वरुणस् \\ इत्य् अश्वस्तोमीयाः षोडशाहुतीर् जुहोति /
text_mt: With the mantra 'May not Mitra, Varuṇa...', he offers sixteen Aśvastomīya oblations.

sanskrit_iast: siddha upavasathaḥ /
meaning: सिद्ध उपवसथः /

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte sarvastomo 'tirātraḥ /
meaning: श्वोभूते सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रः /
text_mt: On the next day, there is the Atirātra sacrifice containing all stomas.

sanskrit_iast: siddham opākaraṇāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् ओपाकरणात् /

sanskrit_iast: gavyān aikādaśinān upākaroti /
meaning: गव्यान् ऐकादशिनान् उपाकरोति /
text_mt: He drives up the eleven bovine victims.

sanskrit_iast: siddham āvabhṛthāt /
meaning: सिद्धम् आवभृथात् /

sanskrit_iast: durmagadasyāsyadaghna udake 'vasthitasya jumbakāya svāhā \\ iti mūrdhani tisra āhutīrjuhoti mṛtyave svāhā \\ ity apsu brahmahatyāyai svāhā \\ iti dvitīyām /
meaning: दुर्मगदस्यास्यदघ्न उदके ऽवस्थितस्य जुम्बकाय स्वाहा \\ इति मूर्धनि तिस्र आहुतीर्जुहोति मृत्यवे स्वाहा \\ इत्य् अप्सु ब्रह्महत्यायै स्वाहा \\ इति द्वितीयाम् /
text_mt: Upon the head of a white-spotted, bald-headed man standing in mouth-deep water, he offers three oblations with 'To Jumbaka, svāhā!'; into the waters with 'To Death, svāhā!'; a second one with 'To Brahmin-murder, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: tarati mṛtyuṃ tarati pāpmānaṃ tarati brahmahatyām̐ yo 'śvamedhena yajate yaś caivam̐ veda /
meaning: तरति मृत्युं तरति पाप्मानं तरति ब्रह्महत्याम्̐ यो ऽश्वमेधेन यजते यश् चैवम्̐ वेद /
text_mt: He crosses beyond death, he crosses beyond evil, he crosses beyond Brahmin-murder, whoever sacrifices with the horse sacrifice and whoever knows thus.

sanskrit_iast: yāvanto 'śvasya hūyamānasya gandham avajighranti sarve te puṇyalokā bhavanti /
meaning: यावन्तो ऽश्वस्य हूयमानस्य गन्धम् अवजिघ्रन्ति सर्वे ते पुण्यलोका भवन्ति /
text_mt: As many as smell the scent of the horse being offered, all of them attain meritorious worlds.

sanskrit_iast: siddham ānūbandhyāyāḥ /
meaning: सिद्धम् आनूबन्ध्यायाः /
text_mt: [The procedure] is established up to the anūbandhyā cow.

sanskrit_iast: nava saurīḥ śvetā anūbandhyās tāsām̐ vapāsu hūyamānāsu prativātaṃ tiṣṭheran mucyante pāpakṛtaḥ /
meaning: नव सौरीः श्वेता अनूबन्ध्यास् तासाम्̐ वपासु हूयमानासु प्रतिवातं तिष्ठेरन् मुच्यन्ते पापकृतः /
text_mt: There are nine white anūbandhyā cows dedicated to Sūrya; while their omenta are being offered, the evil-doers should stand against the wind: they are freed [from sin].

sanskrit_iast: tāsāṃ paśupuroḍāśam anu \\ am̐homuce \\ iti daśahaviṣā mṛgāreṣṭiṃ nirvapati /
meaning: तासां पशुपुरोडाशम् अनु \\ अम्̐होमुचे \\ इति दशहविषा मृगारेष्टिं निर्वपति /
text_mt: Following the animal sacrificial cake for these, he apportions the Mṛgāreṣṭi with ten oblations, beginning with 'To the deliverer from distress...'

sanskrit_iast: sarvapṛṣṭhayā bhūtikāmo yajetābhiśasyamāno vā / bibhyan mṛgāreṣṭyāmayāvī vā /
meaning: सर्वपृष्ठया भूतिकामो यजेताभिशस्यमानो वा / बिभ्यन् मृगारेष्ट्यामयावी वा /
