meaning: यदि कूटः काणः श्रोणौ वा बार्हस्पत्यं चरुम्̐ यदि काणो वैव सौर्यम् एककपालम्̐ यदि स्वभ्रं गर्तम्̐ वा भौमम् एककपालम्̐ यदि पतेत्वायव्यं चरुम्̐ यद्य् अवसीदेन् नैरृतं चरुम्̐ यद्य् अन्यो ऽन्येनापतायेत प्राजापत्यं द्वादशकपालं निरुप्याथान्यं तद्रूपं तद्वर्णं तद्वयसम् उपाकरोति /
text_mt: If [an animal] is hornless, one-eyed, or lame, [he offers] a boiled oblation to Bṛhaspati; or if it is just one-eyed, [a cake] on one potsherd to Sūrya; if it falls into a pit or a hole, [a cake] on one potsherd to Bhūmi; if it falls down, a boiled oblation to Vāyu; if it collapses, a boiled oblation to Nirṛti; if they run into each other, having apportioned [a cake] on twelve potsherds to Prajāpati, he then dedicates another of the same form, the same colour, and the same age.

sanskrit_iast: marutyo vatsataryaḥ sam̐vatsare rājīvatyo dvitīye kalmāṣāḥ tṛtīye navanītapṛśnīr aruṇāś caturthe piśaṅgīḥ pañcame /
meaning: मरुत्यो वत्सतर्यः सम्̐वत्सरे राजीवत्यो द्वितीये कल्माषाः तृतीये नवनीतपृश्नीर् अरुणाश् चतुर्थे पिशङ्गीः पञ्चमे /
text_mt: The heifers are sacred to the Maruts: in the [first] year striped ones, in the second spotted ones, in the third butter-dappled ones, in the fourth reddish ones, in the fifth dun-coloured ones.

sanskrit_iast: somāsv asmin yajanīye dīkṣate /
meaning: सोमास्व् अस्मिन् यजनीये दीक्षते /
text_mt: On this day of sacrifice, he undergoes consecration for the Soma rituals.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭādaśa dīkṣā dvādaśopasadaḥ /
meaning: अष्टादश दीक्षा द्वादशोपसदः /
text_mt: There are eighteen days of consecration and twelve upasads.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛd agniṣṭomaḥ pañcadaśa ukthyaḥ pañcadaśo 'tirātraḥ saptadaśo 'tirātraḥ /
meaning: त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमः पञ्चदश उक्थ्यः पञ्चदशो ऽतिरात्रः सप्तदशो ऽतिरात्रः /
text_mt: [The days are:] a trivṛt agniṣṭoma, a fifteenfold ukthya, a fifteenfold atirātra, and a seventeenfold atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: aindrāmarutā ukṣāṇaḥ savanīyās traya ekasminn ahani pañcottame /
meaning: ऐन्द्रामरुता उक्षाणः सवनीयास् त्रय एकस्मिन्न् अहनि पञ्चोत्तमे /
text_mt: Draft bulls sacred to Indra and the Maruts are the animals connected with the pressings: three on each day, [and] five on the last.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpater vratavān annādyakāmo yajeta /
meaning: प्रजापतेर् व्रतवान् अन्नाद्यकामो यजेत /
text_mt: Desiring food-sustenance, one should perform Prajāpati's rite containing the vow.

sanskrit_iast: jyotir agniṣṭomo gaur ukthyo mahāvrataṃ gaur ukthyo āyur atirātraḥ /
meaning: ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमो गौर् उक्थ्यो महाव्रतं गौर् उक्थ्यो आयुर् अतिरात्रः /
text_mt: [It consists of:] a jyotis agniṣṭoma, a go ukthya, a mahāvrata, a go ukthya, [and] an āyus atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtūnām̐ ṣaḍahaḥ / pratiṣṭhākāmo yajeta /
meaning: ऋतूनाम्̐ षडहः / प्रतिष्ठाकामो यजेत /
text_mt: [Next is] the six-day rite of the Seasons; desiring firm standing, one should sacrifice [with it].

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahas trayastrim̐śaḥ triḥ /
meaning: पृष्ठ्यः षडहस् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शः त्रिः /
text_mt: [It consists of:] a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, a thirty-three-fold [stoma] thrice.

sanskrit_iast: indrasya sam̐hito vīryakāmo yajeta /
meaning: इन्द्रस्य सम्̐हितो वीर्यकामो यजेत /
text_mt: Desiring virile strength, one should sacrifice with Indra's combined [rite].

sanskrit_iast: trivṛd agniṣṭomaḥ pañcadaśa ukthyaḥ saptadaśa ukthyo jyotir gaur āyur atirātraḥ /
meaning: त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमः पञ्चदश उक्थ्यः सप्तदश उक्थ्यो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् अतिरात्रः /
text_mt: [It consists of:] a trivṛt agniṣṭoma, a fifteenfold ukthya, a seventeenfold ukthya, a jyotis, a go, [and] an āyus atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: devānāṃ pṛṣṭhyāvalambo rājā vijigīṣamāṇo yajeta /
meaning: देवानां पृष्ठ्यावलम्बो राजा विजिगीषमाणो यजेत /
text_mt: A king desiring conquest should sacrifice with the Gods' Support of the Pṛṣṭhya.

sanskrit_iast: abhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāho viśvajid atirātraḥ /
meaning: अभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहो विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रः /
text_mt: [It consists of:] an abhyāsaṅgya five-day rite [and] a viśvajit atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣīṇām̐ saptarātra ṛddhikāmo yajeta /
meaning: ऋषीणाम्̐ सप्तरात्र ऋद्धिकामो यजेत /
text_mt: Desiring prosperity, one should sacrifice with the seven-day rite of the Ṛṣis.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho mahāvratam atirātrabhūtam /
meaning: पृष्ठ्यः षडहो महाव्रतम् अतिरात्रभूतम् /
text_mt: [It consists of:] a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite and a mahāvrata becoming an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpater dvitīyaḥ / prajātikāmo yajeta /
meaning: प्रजापतेर् द्वितीयः / प्रजातिकामो यजेत /
text_mt: [Next is] the second [rite] of Prajāpati; desiring progeny, one should sacrifice [with it].

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ saptadaśaṃ mahāvratam atirātrābhūtam /
meaning: पृष्ठ्यः षडहः सप्तदशं महाव्रतम् अतिरात्राभूतम् /
text_mt: [It consists of:] a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite and a seventeenfold mahāvrata becoming an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: ādityānāṃ tṛtīyaḥ / paśukāmo yajeta /
meaning: आदित्यानां तृतीयः / पशुकामो यजेत /
text_mt: [Next is] the third [rite], of the Ādityas; desiring livestock, one should sacrifice [with it].

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahaś chandomapavamānaṃ mahāvratam atirātrabhūtam /
meaning: पृष्ठ्यः षडहश् छन्दोमपवमानं महाव्रतम् अतिरात्रभूतम् /
text_mt: [It consists of:] a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite and a chandoma-pavamāna mahāvrata becoming an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: jamadagneś caturtho / parimitāṃ puṣṭim ichan yajeta /
meaning: जमदग्नेश् चतुर्थो / परिमितां पुष्टिम् इछन् यजेत /
text_mt: [Next is] the fourth [rite], of Jamadagni; desiring abundant prosperity, one should sacrifice [with it].

sanskrit_iast: abhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāhas trayastrim̐śam̐ ṣaṣṭham ahaḥ saptadaśaṃ mahāvratam atirātrabhūtam /
meaning: अभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहस् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शम्̐ षष्ठम् अहः सप्तदशं महाव्रतम् अतिरात्रभूतम् /
text_mt: [It consists of:] an abhyāsaṅgya five-day rite, a thirty-three-fold sixth day, and a seventeenfold mahāvrata becoming an atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: indrasya pañcamo vīryakāmo yajeta /
meaning: इन्द्रस्य पञ्चमो वीर्यकामो यजेत /
text_mt: [Next is] the fifth [rite], of Indra; desiring virile strength, one should sacrifice [with it].

sanskrit_iast: trikadrukatryaho 'bhijid viśvajit sarvajit sarvastomo 'tirātraḥ /
meaning: त्रिकद्रुकत्र्यहो ऽभिजिद् विश्वजित् सर्वजित् सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रः /
text_mt: [It consists of:] a trikadruka three-day rite, an abhijit, a viśvajit, a sarvajit, [and] an all-stoma atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: prajāter janakasaptarātraḥ / prajātikamo yajeta /
meaning: प्रजातेर् जनकसप्तरात्रः / प्रजातिकमो यजेत /
text_mt: [Next is] Prajāpati's Janaka seven-day rite; desiring progeny, one should sacrifice [with it].

sanskrit_iast: catvāri trivṛd ahāny agniṣṭomam ukhyāni viśvajin mahāvrataṃ jyotir atirātraḥ /
meaning: चत्वारि त्रिवृद् अहान्य् अग्निष्टोमम् उख्यानि विश्वजिन् महाव्रतं ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रः /
text_mt: [It consists of:] four trivṛt days having the ukthya [form within an] agniṣṭoma, a viśvajit mahāvrata, [and] a jyotis atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: devānāṃ pṛṣṭhyastoma ubhau kāmāv avarurutsamāno yajeta yo yajñaḥ sattre ca /
meaning: देवानां पृष्ठ्यस्तोम उभौ कामाव् अवरुरुत्समानो यजेत यो यज्ञः सत्त्रे च /
text_mt: Desiring to obtain both desires—whatever [fruit belongs to] an individual sacrifice and in a sacrificial session—one should sacrifice with the Gods' Pṛṣṭhyastoma.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho bṛhadrathaṃtarasāmā viśvajid atirātraḥ /
meaning: पृष्ठ्यः षडहो बृहद्रथंतरसामा विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रः /
text_mt: [It consists of:] a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite with the Bṛhat and Rathaṃtara chants, [and] a viśvajit atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: vasūnām aṣṭarātro devatvakāmo yajeta /
meaning: वसूनाम् अष्टरात्रो देवत्वकामो यजेत /
text_mt: Desiring godhead, one should sacrifice with the eight-day rite of the Vasus.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho mahāvrataṃ jyotir atirātraḥ /
meaning: पृष्ठ्यः षडहो महाव्रतं ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रः /
text_mt: [It consists of:] a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, a mahāvrata, [and] a jyotis atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: devānāṃ navarātra āyuṣkāmo yajeta /
meaning: देवानां नवरात्र आयुष्कामो यजेत /
text_mt: Desiring a long life, one should sacrifice with the nine-day rite of the Gods.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho jyotir gaur āyur atirātraḥ /
meaning: पृष्ठ्यः षडहो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् अतिरात्रः /
text_mt: [It consists of:] a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, a jyotis, a go, [and] an āyus atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: ādityānāṃ dvitīyaḥ paśukāmo yajeta /
meaning: आदित्यानां द्वितीयः पशुकामो यजेत /
text_mt: Desiring livestock, one should sacrifice with the second [rite] of the Ādityas.

sanskrit_iast: trikadrukatryaho 'bhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāho viśvajid atirātraḥ /
meaning: त्रिकद्रुकत्र्यहो ऽभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहो विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रः /
text_mt: [It consists of:] a trikadruka three-day rite, an abhyāsaṅgya five-day rite, [and] a viśvajit atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: indrasya trikakud daśarātraḥ / pāpmano mokṣamāṇo yajeta /
meaning: इन्द्रस्य त्रिककुद् दशरात्रः / पाप्मनो मोक्षमाणो यजेत /
text_mt: Desiring release from evil, one should sacrifice with Indra's three-peaked ten-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛtāv agniṣṭomau pañcadaśa ukthyo madhye saptadaśāv agniṣṭomāv ekavim̐śa ukthyo madhye ... /
meaning: त्रिवृताव् अग्निष्टोमौ पञ्चदश उक्थ्यो मध्ये सप्तदशाव् अग्निष्टोमाव् एकविम्̐श उक्थ्यो मध्ये ... /
text_mt: [It consists of:] two trivṛt agniṣṭomas with a fifteenfold ukthya in between, two seventeenfold agniṣṭomas with a twenty-one-fold ukthya in between, […]

sanskrit_iast: ... yajeta /
trayas trivṛto 'gniṣṭomās trayaḥ pañcadaśā ukthyās trayaḥ saptadaśā ukthyā ekavim̐śo 'tirātraḥ /
meaning: त्रयस् त्रिवृतो ऽग्निष्टोमास् त्रयः पञ्चदशा उक्थ्यास् त्रयः सप्तदशा उक्थ्या एकविम्̐शो ऽतिरात्रः /
text_mt: [It consists of:] three trivṛt agniṣṭomas, three fifteenfold ukthyas, three seventeenfold ukthyas, [and] a twenty-one-fold atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: ādityānāṃ chandomadaśāhaḥ / paśukāmo yajeta /
meaning: आदित्यानां छन्दोमदशाहः / पशुकामो यजेत /
text_mt: [Next is] the chandoma ten-day rite of the Ādityas; desiring livestock, one should sacrifice [with it].

sanskrit_iast: abhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāhaś catvāraś chandomā viśvajid atirātraḥ /
meaning: अभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहश् चत्वारश् छन्दोमा विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रः /
text_mt: [It consists of:] an abhyāsaṅgya five-day rite, four chandomas, [and] a viśvajit atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: devānāṃ pūr daśarātro 'bhicaryamāṇo yajeta /
meaning: देवानां पूर् दशरात्रो ऽभिचर्यमाणो यजेत /
text_mt: One who is being practiced against with sorcery should sacrifice with the Gods' Citadel ten-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛd agniṣṭomo jyotir ukthyas trivṛd agniṣṭomo gaur ukthyo 'bhijid agniṣṭomo gaur ukthyo viśvajid agniṣṭoma āyur ukthyo viśvajid agniṣṭomaḥ sarvastomo 'tirātraḥ /
meaning: त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमो ज्योतिर् उक्थ्यस् त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमो गौर् उक्थ्यो ऽभिजिद् अग्निष्टोमो गौर् उक्थ्यो विश्वजिद् अग्निष्टोम आयुर् उक्थ्यो विश्वजिद् अग्निष्टोमः सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रः /
text_mt: [It consists of:] a trivṛt agniṣṭoma, a jyotis ukthya, a trivṛt agniṣṭoma, a go ukthya, an abhijit agniṣṭoma, a go ukthya, a viśvajit agniṣṭoma, an āyus ukthya, a viśvajit agniṣṭoma, [and] an all-stoma atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: kṣemadhanvā pauṇḍarīka ekādaśarātreṇa yajeta pārameṣṭhyakāmaḥ svārājyakāmo vā /
meaning: क्षेमधन्वा पौण्डरीक एकादशरात्रेण यजेत पारमेष्ठ्यकामः स्वाराज्यकामो वा /
text_mt: Kṣemadhanvan, desiring pre-eminence or desiring self-rule, should sacrifice with the Pauṇḍarīka eleven-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: abhyāsaṅgyaḥ ṣaḍa... /
meaning: अभ्यासङ्ग्यः षड... /

sanskrit_iast: ... anvaham̐ vihṛtya sahasrāṇi dadāti catuṣṭome 'śvasahasram /
meaning: ... अन्वहम्̐ विहृत्य सहस्राणि ददाति चतुष्टोमे ऽश्वसहस्रम् /
text_mt: […] day by day, distributing [them], he gives thousands [of cows], [and] a thousand horses at the four-stoma [rite].

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyāto dvādaśāho dvādaśāhaḥ /
meaning: व्याख्यातो द्वादशाहो द्वादशाहः /
text_mt: The twelve-day rite is explained; the twelve-day rite [is the archetype].

sanskrit_iast: atreṣv abhiplavam̐ ṣaḍahaṃ pratīyād daśarātre dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny anyat prāyaṇīyodayanīyābhyāṃ pañcāhe jyotir gaur āyur iti trikadrukaṃ pañcāhaṃ navarātre 'bhijitam̐ svarasāmno viṣuvatam āvṛttān svarasāmno viśvajitam̐ sarvapṛṣṭhaṃ trirātre jyotir gaur āyur iti trirātraṃ trayastrim̐śārambhaṇe pratilomaṃ pṛṣṭham upottamam̐ vratam anādeśe /
meaning: अत्रेष्व् अभिप्लवम्̐ षडहं प्रतीयाद् दशरात्रे द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अन्यत् प्रायणीयोदयनीयाभ्यां पञ्चाहे ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् इति त्रिकद्रुकं पञ्चाहं नवरात्रे ऽभिजितम्̐ स्वरसाम्नो विषुवतम् आवृत्तान् स्वरसाम्नो विश्वजितम्̐ सर्वपृष्ठं त्रिरात्रे ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् इति त्रिरात्रं त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शारम्भणे प्रतिलोमं पृष्ठम् उपोत्तमम्̐ व्रतम् अनादेशे /
text_mt: In these [rites], one should understand an abhiplava six-day rite [wherever a six-day rite is meant]; in a ten-day rite, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, other than the introductory and concluding [days]; in a five-day rite, the trikadruka five-day rite [comprising] jyotis, go, and āyus; in a nine-day rite, the abhijit, the svarasāmans, the viṣuvat, the reversed svarasāmans, [and] the viśvajit with all the pṛṣṭhas; in a three-day rite, the three-day rite of jyotis, go, and āyus; at the commencement of a thirty-three-fold stoma, the reverse pṛṣṭha; in the absence of an explicit rule, the rite [mahāvrata] is next to the last.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśāhaprabhṛtīni sattrāṇy ubhayato'tirātrāṇy aharabhyuccayenā catvārim̐śād rātrāt /
meaning: द्वादशाहप्रभृतीनि सत्त्राण्य् उभयतोऽतिरात्राण्य् अहरभ्युच्चयेना चत्वारिम्̐शाद् रात्रात् /
text_mt: The sacrificial sessions, beginning with the twelve-day rite, have atirātras at both ends, with the addition of a day up to forty nights.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām ahaḥkḷptiḥ /
meaning: तेषाम् अहःकॢप्तिः /

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśāhe purastācchanomānām̐ sarvastomo 'tirātra ṛddhikāmās trayodaśarātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: द्वादशाहे पुरस्ताच्छनोमानाम्̐ सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्र ऋद्धिकामास् त्रयोदशरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: Desiring prosperity, they should undertake a thirteen-day rite: in the twelve-day rite, an all-stoma atirātra before the chandomas.

sanskrit_iast: upottamam̐ vratam uttarasya / pratiṣṭhākāmās trayodaśarātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: उपोत्तमम्̐ व्रतम् उत्तरस्य / प्रतिष्ठाकामास् त्रयोदशरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: In the following [rite], the vow [mahāvrata] is next to the last; desiring firm standing, they should undertake a thirteen-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni viṣuvān devatvakāmās trayodaśarātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि विषुवान् देवत्वकामास् त्रयोदशरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: [In the third, there are] the ten days of the twelve-day rite [and] a viṣuvat; desiring godhead, they should undertake a thirteen-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: caturvim̐śa ukthyo navarātro mahāvrataṃ pratiṣṭhākāmās trayodaśarātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: चतुर्विम्̐श उक्थ्यो नवरात्रो महाव्रतं प्रतिष्ठाकामास् त्रयोदशरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: [In the fourth, there is] a twenty-four-fold ukthya, a nine-day rite, [and] the mahāvrata; desiring firm standing, they should undertake a thirteen-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: goāyuṣī daśarātraḥ / pratiṣṭhākāmāś caturdaśarātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: गोआयुषी दशरात्रः / प्रतिष्ठाकामाश् चतुर्दशरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: The Go and Āyus [days and] the ten-day rite: those desiring a firm foundation should undertake the fourteen-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhya āvṛttaḥ pṛṣṭhyo devatvakāmāś caturdaśarātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: पृष्ठ्य आवृत्तः पृष्ठ्यो देवत्वकामाश् चतुर्दशरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: A Pṛṣṭhya, [then] a reversed Pṛṣṭhya: those desiring divine status should undertake the fourteen-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: ubhayatastrirātrābhyāṃ pṛṣṭhyo yām̐s talpa udake vā vivāhe mīmām̐seram̐s ta eva caturdaśarātram epeyuḥ /
meaning: उभयतस्त्रिरात्राभ्यां पृष्ठ्यो याम्̐स् तल्प उदके वा विवाहे मीमाम्̐सेरम्̐स् त एव चतुर्दशरात्रम् एपेयुः /
text_mt: A Pṛṣṭhya flanked on both sides by three-day rites: those whom [people] would doubt regarding marriage bed or water, they indeed should undertake the fourteen-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyo mahāvrataṃ pṛṣṭhyas trayastrim̐śārambhaṇo yathā vaikāṣṭakāyāṃ mahāvratam̐ syād vratād brahmavarcasakāmāḥ pañcadaśarātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: पृष्ठ्यो महाव्रतं पृष्ठ्यस् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शारम्भणो यथा वैकाष्टकायां महाव्रतम्̐ स्याद् व्रताद् ब्रह्मवर्चसकामाः पञ्चदशरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: A Pṛṣṭhya, the Mahāvrata, a Pṛṣṭhya beginning with the thirty-three-versed [stoma], or just as the Mahāvrata may be on the Ekāṣṭakā: from [that] vow, those desiring spiritual radiance should undertake the fifteen-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛdagniṣṭud agniṣṭoma ubhayatastrirātrābhyāṃ pṛṣṭhyo brahmavarcasakāmāḥ pañcadaśarātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: त्रिवृदग्निष्टुद् अग्निष्टोम उभयतस्त्रिरात्राभ्यां पृष्ठ्यो ब्रह्मवर्चसकामाः पञ्चदशरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: A nine-versed Agniṣṭut Agniṣṭoma, a Pṛṣṭhya flanked on both sides by three-day rites: those desiring spiritual radiance should undertake the fifteen-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛdagniṣṭud agniṣṭomas trirātro daśarātraś cānya uttarato 'tirātraḥ / sattre yajñe carddhikāmam ichanta etaṃ pañcadaśarātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: त्रिवृदग्निष्टुद् अग्निष्टोमस् त्रिरात्रो दशरात्रश् चान्य उत्तरतो ऽतिरात्रः / सत्त्रे यज्ञे चर्द्धिकामम् इछन्त एतं पञ्चदशरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: A nine-versed Agniṣṭut Agniṣṭoma, a three-day rite, a ten-day rite, and another Atirātra at the end: those wishing for prosperous desire in sacrificial session or sacrifice should undertake this fifteen-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: etāsv eva vratam̐ vijitikāmāḥ ṣoḍaśarātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: एतास्व् एव व्रतम्̐ विजितिकामाः षोडशरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: With the vow [day added] to these very [days]: those desiring complete victory should undertake the sixteen-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: pañcāho daśarātraḥ / śrīkāmāḥ saptadaśarātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: पञ्चाहो दशरात्रः / श्रीकामाः सप्तदशरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: A five-day rite, a ten-day rite: those desiring prosperity should undertake the seventeen-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍaho daśarātra āyuḥkāmā aṣṭādaśarātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: षडहो दशरात्र आयुःकामा अष्टादशरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: A six-day rite, a ten-day rite: those desiring long life should undertake the eighteen-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: etāsv eva vrataṃ / ... /
meaning: एतास्व् एव व्रतं / ... /

sanskrit_iast: ... / brahmavarcasakāmā vim̐śatirātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: ... / ब्रह्मवर्चसकामा विम्̐शतिरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: [...]: those desiring spiritual radiance should undertake the twenty-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyaḥ svarasāmāno viṣuvān āvṛttāḥ svarasāmānaḥ pṛṣṭhyas trayastrim̐śārambhaṇo 'nnādyakāmā ekavim̐śatirātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: पृष्ठ्यः स्वरसामानो विषुवान् आवृत्ताः स्वरसामानः पृष्ठ्यस् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शारम्भणो ऽन्नाद्यकामा एकविम्̐शतिरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: A Pṛṣṭhya, the Svarasāman days, the Viṣuvant, reversed Svarasāman days, a Pṛṣṭhya beginning with the thirty-three-versed [stoma]: those desiring food and proper nourishment should undertake the twenty-one-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: trayaḥ ṣaḍahā ūrdhvaṃ prathamād atirātro 'nnādyakāmā ekavim̐śatirātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: त्रयः षडहा ऊर्ध्वं प्रथमाद् अतिरात्रो ऽन्नाद्यकामा एकविम्̐शतिरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: Three six-day rites above the first, [then] an Atirātra: those desiring food and proper nourishment should undertake the twenty-one-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: tryahaḥ ṣaḍaho daśarātro mahāvrataṃ paśukāmā dvāvim̐śatirātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: त्र्यहः षडहो दशरात्रो महाव्रतं पशुकामा द्वाविम्̐शतिरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: A three-day rite, a six-day rite, a ten-day rite, the Mahāvrata: those desiring cattle should undertake the twenty-two-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: pañcāhaḥ ṣaḍaho daśarātraḥ / pratiṣṭhākāmās trayovim̐śatirātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: पञ्चाहः षडहो दशरात्रः / प्रतिष्ठाकामास् त्रयोविम्̐शतिरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: A five-day rite, a six-day rite, a ten-day rite: those desiring a firm foundation should undertake the twenty-three-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: sam̐sadāmayanaṃ / pṛṣṭhyastomaḥ ṣaḍahas trayastrim̐śamahar aniruktam upahavyakḷptaṃ trayastrim̐śam ahar niruktaṃ triṇavaṃ dve ekavim̐śe triṇavaṃ trayastrim̐śam ahar niruktaṃ trayastrim̐śam ahar aniruktaṃ pṛṣṭhyastomaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ pratyaṅ trivṛd ahar aniruktaṃ jyotiṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomo 'nnādyakāmāś caturvim̐śatirātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: सम्̐सदामयनं / पृष्ठ्यस्तोमः षडहस् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शमहर् अनिरुक्तम् उपहव्यकॢप्तं त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शम् अहर् निरुक्तं त्रिणवं द्वे एकविम्̐शे त्रिणवं त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शम् अहर् निरुक्तं त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शम् अहर् अनिरुक्तं पृष्ठ्यस्तोमः षडहः प्रत्यङ् त्रिवृद् अहर् अनिरुक्तं ज्योतिष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमो ऽन्नाद्यकामाश् चतुर्विम्̐शतिरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: The Saṃsadāmayana rite: a Pṛṣṭhyastoma six-day rite, a non-enunciated thirty-three-versed day arranged like an Upahavya, an enunciated thirty-three-versed day, a twenty-seven-versed day, two twenty-one-versed days, a twenty-seven-versed day, an enunciated thirty-three-versed day, a non-enunciated thirty-three-versed day, a Pṛṣṭhyastoma six-day rite backwards, a non-enunciated nine-versed day, a Jyotiṣṭoma Agniṣṭoma: those desiring food and proper nourishment should undertake the twenty-four-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍahau daśarātro 'nnādyakāmāś caturvim̐śatirātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: षडहौ दशरात्रो ऽन्नाद्यकामाश् चतुर्विम्̐शतिरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: Two six-day rites, a ten-day rite: those desiring food and proper nourishment should undertake the twenty-four-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: etāsv eva vrataṃ brahmavarcasakāmāḥ pañcavim̐śatirātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: एतास्व् एव व्रतं ब्रह्मवर्चसकामाः पञ्चविम्̐शतिरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: With the vow [day added] to these very [days]: those desiring spiritual radiance should undertake the twenty-five-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: etāsv eva goāyuṣīpurastātṣaḍahānāṃ na vratam̐ vijitikāmāḥ ṣaḍvim̐śatirātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: एतास्व् एव गोआयुषीपुरस्तात्षडहानां न व्रतम्̐ विजितिकामाः षड्विम्̐शतिरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: With the Go and Āyus [days] before the six-day rites to these very [days, and] no vow [day]: those desiring complete victory should undertake the twenty-six-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: etāsv eva tryahaḥ purastātṣaḍahānāṃ na goāyuṣī / śrīkāmāḥ saptavim̐śatirātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: एतास्व् एव त्र्यहः पुरस्तात्षडहानां न गोआयुषी / श्रीकामाः सप्तविम्̐शतिरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: With a three-day rite before the six-day rites to these very [days, and] no Go and Āyus [days]: those desiring prosperity should undertake the twenty-seven-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: etāsv eva vratam āyuḥkāmā aṣṭāvim̐śatirātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: एतास्व् एव व्रतम् आयुःकामा अष्टाविम्̐शतिरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: With the vow [day added] to these very [days]: those desiring long life should undertake the twenty-eight-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: pañcāhaḥ ṣaḍahau daśarātro brahmavarcasakāmā ekonatrim̐śadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: पञ्चाहः षडहौ दशरात्रो ब्रह्मवर्चसकामा एकोनत्रिम्̐शद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: A five-day rite, two six-day rites, a ten-day rite: those desiring spiritual radiance should undertake the twenty-nine-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: trayaḥ ṣaḍahā daśarātraḥ / puruṣakāmās trim̐śadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: त्रयः षडहा दशरात्रः / पुरुषकामास् त्रिम्̐शद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: Three six-day rites, a ten-day rite: those desiring offspring should undertake the thirty-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: etāsv eva vratam ojaskāmā ekatrim̐śadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: एतास्व् एव व्रतम् ओजस्कामा एकत्रिम्̐शद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: With the vow [day added] to these very [days]: those desiring vigor should undertake the thirty-one-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: etāsv eva goāyuṣīpurastātṣaḍahānāṃ na vrataṃ paśukāmā dvātrim̐śadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: एतास्व् एव गोआयुषीपुरस्तात्षडहानां न व्रतं पशुकामा द्वात्रिम्̐शद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: With the Go and Āyus [days] before the six-day rites to these very [days, and] no vow [day]: those desiring cattle should undertake the thirty-two-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: ā trayastrim̐śāt trayaḥ pṛṣṭhyāḥ pañcāhā viśvajid atirātraḥ pañcāho daśarātraḥ / pratiṣṭhākāmās trayastrim̐śadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: आ त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शात् त्रयः पृष्ठ्याः पञ्चाहा विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रः पञ्चाहो दशरात्रः / प्रतिष्ठाकामास् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: Up to the thirty-three-versed [stoma], three Pṛṣṭhya five-day rites, a Viśvajit Atirātra, a five-day rite, a ten-day rite: those desiring a firm foundation should undertake the thirty-three-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: trayaḥ ṣaḍahā madhyam abhito 'tirātrau daśarātro mahāvrataṃ pratiṣṭhākāmās trayastrim̐śadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: त्रयः षडहा मध्यम् अभितो ऽतिरात्रौ दशरात्रो महाव्रतं प्रतिष्ठाकामास् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: Three six-day rites, two Atirātras flanking the middle, a ten-day rite, the Mahāvrata: those desiring a firm foundation should undertake the thirty-three-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: trayaḥ pṛṣṭhyāḥ pañcāhā viśvajid atirātras trayaḥ pṛṣṭhyāḥ pañcāhāḥ / pratiṣṭhākāmās trayastrim̐śadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: त्रयः पृष्ठ्याः पञ्चाहा विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रस् त्रयः पृष्ठ्याः पञ्चाहाः / प्रतिष्ठाकामास् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: Three Pṛṣṭhya five-day rites, a Viśvajit Atirātra, three Pṛṣṭhya five-day rites: those desiring a firm foundation should undertake the thirty-three-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: tryahas trayaḥ ṣaḍahā daśarātro mahāvratam annādyakāmāś catustrim̐śadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: त्र्यहस् त्रयः षडहा दशरात्रो महाव्रतम् अन्नाद्यकामाश् चतुस्त्रिम्̐शद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: A three-day rite, three six-day rites, a ten-day rite, the Mahāvrata: those desiring food and proper nourishment should undertake the thirty-four-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: trayas trayaḥ ṣaḍahā daśarātro goāyuṣī / brahmavarcasakāmāḥ pañcatrim̐śadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: त्रयस् त्रयः षडहा दशरात्रो गोआयुषी / ब्रह्मवर्चसकामाः पञ्चत्रिम्̐शद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: Three times three six-day rites, a ten-day rite, the Go and Āyus [days]: those desiring spiritual radiance should undertake the thirty-five-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: catvāraḥ ṣaḍahā daśarātro vijitikāmāḥ ṣaṭtrim̐śadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: चत्वारः षडहा दशरात्रो विजितिकामाः षट्त्रिम्̐शद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: Four six-day rites, a ten-day rite: those desiring complete victory should undertake the thirty-six-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: etāsv eva vratam̐ śrīkāmāḥ saptatrim̐śadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: एतास्व् एव व्रतम्̐ श्रीकामाः सप्तत्रिम्̐शद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: With the vow [day added] to these very [days]: those desiring prosperity should undertake the thirty-seven-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: etāsv eva goāyuṣī purastāt ṣaḍahānāṃ na vratam āyuḥkāmā aṣṭātrim̐śadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: एतास्व् एव गोआयुषी पुरस्तात् षडहानां न व्रतम् आयुःकामा अष्टात्रिम्̐शद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: With the Go and Āyus [days] before the six-day rites to these very [days, and] no vow [day]: those desiring long life should undertake the thirty-eight-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: etāsv eva tryahaḥ purastāt ṣaḍahānāṃ na goāyuṣī / brahmavarcasakāmā ekonacatvārim̐śadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: एतास्व् एव त्र्यहः पुरस्तात् षडहानां न गोआयुषी / ब्रह्मवर्चसकामा एकोनचत्वारिम्̐शद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: With a three-day rite before the six-day rites to these very [days, and] no Go and Āyus [days]: those desiring spiritual radiance should undertake the thirty-nine-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: etāsv eva vrataṃ / puruṣakāmāś catvārim̐śadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: एतास्व् एव व्रतं / पुरुषकामाश् चत्वारिम्̐शद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: With the vow [day added] to these very [days]: those desiring offspring should undertake the forty-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭomo dvāv ukthyau trivṛt stomas trayāṇām atirātro navokthyāḥ ṣoḍaśī daśamaḥ pañcadaśastomā atirātro dvādaśokthyāḥ saptadaśastomā atirātraḥ pṛṣṭhyo 'tirātro dvādaśokthyā ekavim̐śastomā / vāyor vidhṛtir vi pāpmanā vartemahītikāmas ta etam ekonapañcāśadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: अग्निष्टोमो द्वाव् उक्थ्यौ त्रिवृत् स्तोमस् त्रयाणाम् अतिरात्रो नवोक्थ्याः षोडशी दशमः पञ्चदशस्तोमा अतिरात्रो द्वादशोक्थ्याः सप्तदशस्तोमा अतिरात्रः पृष्ठ्यो ऽतिरात्रो द्वादशोक्थ्या एकविम्̐शस्तोमा / वायोर् विधृतिर् वि पाप्मना वर्तेमहीतिकामस् त एतम् एकोनपञ्चाशद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: An Agniṣṭoma, two Ukthyas, a nine-versed stoma for the three; an Atirātra, nine Ukthyas, the tenth a Ṣoḍaśin, [all] fifteen-versed stomas; an Atirātra, twelve Ukthyas, seventeen-versed stomas; an Atirātra, a Pṛṣṭhya; an Atirātra, twelve Ukthyas, twenty-one-versed stomas—desiring: 'May we, as Vāyu's support, turn away from evil', they should undertake this forty-nine-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: pañcānām̐ ṣaḍahānāṃ dvayordvayoḥ purastād dvaudvāv atirātrau pañcamasya purastād dvādaśarātro mahāvrataṃ pratiṣṭhākāmās ta etam ekonapañcāśadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: पञ्चानाम्̐ षडहानां द्वयोर्द्वयोः पुरस्ताद् द्वौद्वाव् अतिरात्रौ पञ्चमस्य पुरस्ताद् द्वादशरात्रो महाव्रतं प्रतिष्ठाकामास् त एतम् एकोनपञ्चाशद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: Of the five six-day rites, two Atirātras before each pair of two, a twelve-day rite before the fifth, the Mahāvrata: those desiring a firm foundation should undertake this forty-nine-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṇṇām̐ ṣaḍahānāṃ pañcamasya purastāt sarvastomo 'tirātraḥ ṣaṣṭhasyopariṣṭād daśarātraḥ /
meaning: षण्णाम्̐ षडहानां पञ्चमस्य पुरस्तात् सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रः षष्ठस्योपरिष्टाद् दशरात्रः /
text_mt: Of six six-day rites, an all-versed Atirātra before the fifth, a ten-day rite after the sixth.

sanskrit_iast: āñjīram̐ś cābhyañjīram̐ś ca teṣv ahaḥsu guggulaphāṇṭena prātaḥsavane saugandhikaphāṇṭena mādhyaṃdine savane pūtudāruphāṇṭena tṛtīyasavane prātaranuvākam anuvakṣyantaḥ prātaḥsavane prasarpantaś caivam uttarayoḥ savanayoḥ /
meaning: आञ्जीरम्̐श् चाभ्यञ्जीरम्̐श् च तेष्व् अहःसु गुग्गुलफाण्टेन प्रातःसवने सौगन्धिकफाण्टेन माध्यंदिने सवने पूतुदारुफाण्टेन तृतीयसवने प्रातरनुवाकम् अनुवक्ष्यन्तः प्रातःसवने प्रसर्पन्तश् चैवम् उत्तरयोः सवनयोः /
text_mt: And on those days they should smear [the eyes] and anoint [the body]: with an infusion of guggulu at the morning pressing, with an infusion of saugandhika at the midday pressing, with an infusion of pūtudāru at the third pressing, when about to recite the morning recitation, and when gliding at the morning pressing; and in the same way at the subsequent two pressings.

sanskrit_iast: ya ātmānaṃ naiva jānīram̐s ta etam ekonapañcāśadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: य आत्मानं नैव जानीरम्̐स् त एतम् एकोनपञ्चाशद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: Those who do not even recognize themselves: they should undertake this forty-nine-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: caturvim̐śa ukthyas trayaḥ ṣaḍahā navarātraḥ ṣaḍaho goāyuṣī daśarātro mahāvratam̐ sam̐vatsarasaṃmitam̐ sam̐vatsarakāmam ichantas ta etam ekonapañcāśadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: चतुर्विम्̐श उक्थ्यस् त्रयः षडहा नवरात्रः षडहो गोआयुषी दशरात्रो महाव्रतम्̐ सम्̐वत्सरसंमितम्̐ सम्̐वत्सरकामम् इछन्तस् त एतम् एकोनपञ्चाशद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: A twenty-four-versed Ukthya, three six-day rites, a nine-day rite, a six-day rite, the Go and Āyus [days], a ten-day rite, the Mahāvrata, matching a year: wishing for the desire of a year, they should undertake this forty-nine-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭomaḥ pañcokthyā agniṣṭomāv abhita ukthyo madhye trivṛtstomo navānām etena kalpena trayo navarātrā vyākhyātāḥ pañcadaśasaptadaśaikavim̐śastomā daśarātro mahāvratam̐ sāvitraṃ kakubhaṃ prasavakāmās ta etam ekonapañcāśadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: अग्निष्टोमः पञ्चोक्थ्या अग्निष्टोमाव् अभित उक्थ्यो मध्ये त्रिवृत्स्तोमो नवानाम् एतेन कल्पेन त्रयो नवरात्रा व्याख्याताः पञ्चदशसप्तदशैकविम्̐शस्तोमा दशरात्रो महाव्रतम्̐ सावित्रं ककुभं प्रसवकामास् त एतम् एकोनपञ्चाशद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: An Agniṣṭoma, five Ukthyas, two Agniṣṭomas on both sides and an Ukthya in the middle, a nine-versed stoma for nine; by this procedure the three nine-day rites are explained, having fifteen-versed, seventeen-versed, and twenty-one-versed stomas, a ten-day rite, the Mahāvrata, Sāvitra, Kakubha: those desiring progeny should undertake this forty-nine-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīyenopottamo vyākhyātaḥ sarvastomasya sthāne mahāvrataṃ nāñjīrann ābhyañjīran vi pāpmanā vartemahītikāmās ta etam ekonapañcāśadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: तृतीयेनोपोत्तमो व्याख्यातः सर्वस्तोमस्य स्थाने महाव्रतं नाञ्जीरन्न् आभ्यञ्जीरन् वि पाप्मना वर्तेमहीतिकामास् त एतम् एकोनपञ्चाशद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: The penultimate is explained by the third [form]: in place of the all-versed [Atirātra] is the Mahāvrata; they should not smear [their eyes] nor anoint [their bodies]; desiring: 'May we turn away from evil', they should undertake this forty-nine-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṭ ṣaḍahā daśarātro mahāvrataṃ pratiṣṭhākāmās ta etam ekonapañcāśadrātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: षट् षडहा दशरात्रो महाव्रतं प्रतिष्ठाकामास् त एतम् एकोनपञ्चाशद्रात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: Six six-day rites, a ten-day rite, the Mahāvrata: those desiring a firm foundation should undertake this forty-nine-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: sam̐vatsarasaṃmite pṛṣṭhyāvadhikau purastādabhijita upariṣṭādviśvajita ṛddhikāmā ekaṣaṣṭirātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: सम्̐वत्सरसंमिते पृष्ठ्यावधिकौ पुरस्तादभिजित उपरिष्टाद्विश्वजित ऋद्धिकामा एकषष्टिरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: In [a session] measured to a year, with two additional Pṛṣṭhya [six-day periods], [one] before the Abhijit and [one] after the Viśvajit, those desiring prosperity should undertake a sixty-one-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: tryahaś caturdaśa ṣaḍahā daśarātro mahāvratam āyuḥkāmāḥ śatarātram upeyuḥ /
meaning: त्र्यहश् चतुर्दश षडहा दशरात्रो महाव्रतम् आयुःकामाः शतरात्रम् उपेयुः /
text_mt: A three-day period, fourteen six-day periods, a ten-day period, [and] the Mahāvrata: those desiring a full life should undertake a hundred-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: abhiprayāyam abhiṣuṇvanti samānatrābhiṣuṇvanti /
meaning: अभिप्रयायम् अभिषुण्वन्ति समानत्राभिषुण्वन्ति /
text_mt: Moving forward, they press [the soma], or they press it in the same place.

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣodavasānam̐ vā /
meaning: दीक्षोदवसानम्̐ वा /

sanskrit_iast: āgneya aindāgno vaiṣṇavaḥ pauṣṇo vāyavya āśvinaḥ ṣaḍ atiriktāḥ paśavaḥ sattreṣu /
meaning: आग्नेय ऐन्दाग्नो वैष्णवः पौष्णो वायव्य आश्विनः षड् अतिरिक्ताः पशवः सत्त्रेषु /
text_mt: Dedicated to Agni, to Indra-Agni, to Viṣṇu, to Pūṣan, to Vāyu, [and] to the Aśvins: [these are] the six surplus animal victims in the sacrificial sessions.

sanskrit_iast: gavām ayanaṃ prajātikāmā upeyus tenādityānām ayanam̐ vyākhyātam aṅgirasāṃ ca /
meaning: गवाम् अयनं प्रजातिकामा उपेयुस् तेनादित्यानाम् अयनम्̐ व्याख्यातम् अङ्गिरसां च /
text_mt: Those desiring offspring should undertake the Gavām Ayana. By it the Ādityānām Ayana is explained, and that of the Aṅgirases.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛtpañcadaśastomaḥ ṣaḍahānāṃ purastāt pṛṣṭhyo māsānāṃ prāg viṣuvataḥ pañcadaśatrivṛd upariṣṭān madhye pṛṣṭhyo māsānām /
meaning: त्रिवृत्पञ्चदशस्तोमः षडहानां पुरस्तात् पृष्ठ्यो मासानां प्राग् विषुवतः पञ्चदशत्रिवृद् उपरिष्टान् मध्ये पृष्ठ्यो मासानाम् /
text_mt: The Trivṛt-Pañcadaśa stoma is prior to the six-day periods, the Pṛṣṭhya [prior] to the months before the Viṣuvant; the Pañcadaśa-Trivṛt is after [it], in the middle [is] the Pṛṣṭhya of the months.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspatisave 'bhijitaḥ sthāne viśvajita indrastomas tasmād uttaraḥ pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahaś ca daśarātro vyūḍhā agniṣṭomās trivṛta udbhidbalabhidau ca / so 'ṣṭāvim̐śatyahaḥ /
meaning: बृहस्पतिसवे ऽभिजितः स्थाने विश्वजित इन्द्रस्तोमस् तस्माद् उत्तरः पृष्ठ्यः षडहश् च दशरात्रो व्यूढा अग्निष्टोमास् त्रिवृत उद्भिद्बलभिदौ च / सो ऽष्टाविम्̐शत्यहः /
text_mt: In place of the Abhijit is the Bṛhaspatisava, [and] in place of the Viśvajit is the Indrastoma; following that is a Pṛṣṭhya six-day period and a ten-day period, the Agniṣṭomas are rearranged as Trivṛt, and [there are] the Udbhid and Balabhid: that is a twenty-eight-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho madhye goāyuṣī avarūḍhastomaś chandomadaśāhaḥ /
meaning: पृष्ठ्यः षडहो मध्ये गोआयुषी अवरूढस्तोमश् छन्दोमदशाहः /
text_mt: A Pṛṣṭhya six-day period is in the middle, the Go and Āyus [days], the Avarūḍhastoma, [and] the Chandoma-ten-day period.

sanskrit_iast: gavām ayanena śeṣo vyākhyātaḥ svargakāmā upeyuḥ /
meaning: गवाम् अयनेन शेषो व्याख्यातः स्वर्गकामा उपेयुः /
text_mt: The remainder is explained by the Gavām Ayana; those desiring heaven should undertake [it].

sanskrit_iast: aṅgirasām ayanaṃ trivṛtstomaḥ ṣaḍahānāṃ purastāt pṛṣṭhyo māsānāṃ prāg viṣuvata ūrdhvam upariṣṭāt pṛṣṭhyo māsānām /
meaning: अङ्गिरसाम् अयनं त्रिवृत्स्तोमः षडहानां पुरस्तात् पृष्ठ्यो मासानां प्राग् विषुवत ऊर्ध्वम् उपरिष्टात् पृष्ठ्यो मासानाम् /
text_mt: The Aṅgirasām Ayana: the Trivṛt stoma is before the six-day periods, the Pṛṣṭhya of the months is prior to the Viṣuvant; above, afterwards, is the Pṛṣṭhya of the months.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍahayoś cāyuś ca gauś cānulomaś chandomadaśāhaḥ /
meaning: षडहयोश् चायुश् च गौश् चानुलोमश् छन्दोमदशाहः /
text_mt: And of the two six-day periods, the Āyus and the Go, and in regular order the Chandoma-ten-day period.

sanskrit_iast: ādityānām ayanena śeṣo vyākhyātaḥ / svargakāmā upeyuḥ /
meaning: आदित्यानाम् अयनेन शेषो व्याख्यातः / स्वर्गकामा उपेयुः /
text_mt: The remainder is explained by the Ādityānām Ayana; those desiring heaven should undertake [it].

sanskrit_iast: dṛtivātavator ayanaṃ pṛṣṭhyasyaikaikenāhnā prāg viṣuvato māsān yanti / viṣuvataḥ sthāne mahāvrataṃ tair evāvṛttair upariṣṭāt prathamottame ahanī sātirātre / ṛddhikāmā upeyuḥ /
meaning: दृतिवातवतोर् अयनं पृष्ठ्यस्यैकैकेनाह्ना प्राग् विषुवतो मासान् यन्ति / विषुवतः स्थाने महाव्रतं तैर् एवावृत्तैर् उपरिष्टात् प्रथमोत्तमे अहनी सातिरात्रे / ऋद्धिकामा उपेयुः /
text_mt: The Dṛtivātavator Ayana: they proceed through the months with one single day of the Pṛṣṭhya [at a time] prior to the Viṣuvant; in place of the Viṣuvant is the Mahāvrata, [and] with those same [days] reversed, afterwards; the first and last days include Atirātras; those desiring prosperity should undertake [it].

sanskrit_iast: kuṇḍapāyinām ayanaṃ māsaṃ dīkṣitā bhavanti / te māsi rājānaṃ krīṇanti /
meaning: कुण्डपायिनाम् अयनं मासं दीक्षिता भवन्ति / ते मासि राजानं क्रीणन्ति /
text_mt: The Kuṇḍapāyinām Ayana: they are consecrated for a month; in [that] month they purchase the king [Soma].

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśopasada uttamāyām upasady āparāhṇikīm̐ sam̐sthāpya somaṃ mahāvīrām̐ś ca nidhāyāgnihotreṇa darśapaurṇamāsābhyāṃ caturbhiś cāturmāsyaparvabhir ekaikena māsān yanti /
meaning: द्वादशोपसद उत्तमायाम् उपसद्य् आपराह्णिकीम्̐ सम्̐स्थाप्य सोमं महावीराम्̐श् च निधायाग्निहोत्रेण दर्शपौर्णमासाभ्यां चतुर्भिश् चातुर्मास्यपर्वभिर् एकैकेन मासान् यन्ति /
text_mt: Twelve Upasads: having concluded the afternoon [Upasad] on the last Upasad day, having deposited the soma and the mahāvīra pots, they proceed through the months with the Agnihotra, with the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices, and with the four seasonal periods, one by one.

sanskrit_iast: ardhamāsaṃ paurṇamāsīm ardhamāsam amāvāsyām̐ sam̐sthāpya śunāsīryam utsādya mahāvīrān agnipraṇayanaprabhṛti payodohanāntaṃ kṛtvā vasanti /
meaning: अर्धमासं पौर्णमासीम् अर्धमासम् अमावास्याम्̐ सम्̐स्थाप्य शुनासीर्यम् उत्साद्य महावीरान् अग्निप्रणयनप्रभृति पयोदोहनान्तं कृत्वा वसन्ति /
text_mt: Having concluded the full-moon rite for half a month, [and] the new-moon rite for half a month, having celebrated the Śunāsīrya, having set aside the mahāvīra pots, having performed [the rites] beginning with the carrying forward of the fire and ending with the milking, they dwell [there].

sanskrit_iast: śvobhūte prātaranuvākaprabhṛti pañcabhiḥ pṛṣṭhyāhobhir ekaikena māsān yanti /
meaning: श्वोभूते प्रातरनुवाकप्रभृति पञ्चभिः पृष्ठ्याहोभिर् एकैकेन मासान् यन्ति /
text_mt: On the next day, beginning with the morning recitation, they proceed through the months with five Pṛṣṭhya days, one by one.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭādaśa trayastrim̐śāny ahāni daśarātro mahāvratam udayanīyo 'tirātraḥ sa māsaḥ /
meaning: अष्टादश त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शान्य् अहानि दशरात्रो महाव्रतम् उदयनीयो ऽतिरात्रः स मासः /
text_mt: Eighteen thirty-three-versed days, the ten-day period, the Mahāvrata, [and] the concluding Atirātra: that is a month.

sanskrit_iast: atsarukaiś camasaiḥ somān bhakṣayanti /
meaning: अत्सरुकैश् चमसैः सोमान् भक्षयन्ति /
text_mt: They consume the somas with handleless cups.

sanskrit_iast: yo hotā sādhvaryuḥ sa potā ya udgātā so 'chāvākaḥ sa neṣṭā yo maitrāvaruṇaḥ sa brahmā sa pratihartā yaḥ prastotā sa brāhmaṇācham̐sī sa grāvastud yaḥ pratiprasthātā so 'gnītsa unnetā / sa māsam adhīte / gṛhapatirgṛhapatiḥ subrahmaṇyaḥ subrahmaṇyaḥ /
meaning: यो होता साध्वर्युः स पोता य उद्गाता सो ऽछावाकः स नेष्टा यो मैत्रावरुणः स ब्रह्मा स प्रतिहर्ता यः प्रस्तोता स ब्राह्मणाछम्̐सी स ग्रावस्तुद् यः प्रतिप्रस्थाता सो ऽग्नीत्स उन्नेता / स मासम् अधीते / गृहपतिर्गृहपतिः सुब्रह्मण्यः सुब्रह्मण्यः /
text_mt: He who is the hotṛ priest is the adhvaryu and the potṛ; he who is the udgātṛ is the acchāvāka and the neṣṭṛ; he who is the maitrāvaruṇa is the brahman and the pratihartṛ; he who is the prastotṛ is the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin and the grāvastut; he who is the pratiprasthātṛ is the āgnīdhra and the unnetṛ; he studies for a month; the master of the house remains the master of the house, the subrahmaṇya remains the subrahmaṇya.

sanskrit_iast: na varuṇapraghāseṣv avabhṛtham̐ yanti / bhūtikāmā upeyuḥ /
meaning: न वरुणप्रघासेष्व् अवभृथम्̐ यन्ति / भूतिकामा उपेयुः /
text_mt: At the Varuṇapraghāsa rites they do not go to the final bath; those desiring welfare should undertake [it].

sanskrit_iast: kṣullakatāpaścitaṃ caturo māsān dīkṣitā bhavanti / catasṛbhir upasadbhiś caranti /
meaning: क्षुल्लकतापश्चितं चतुरो मासान् दीक्षिता भवन्ति / चतसृभिर् उपसद्भिश् चरन्ति /
text_mt: The minor Tāpaścita: they are consecrated for four months; they perform four Upasads.

sanskrit_iast: caturbhiḥ pṛṣṭhyāhobhir ekaikena māsān yanti / svargakāmā upeyuḥ /
meaning: चतुर्भिः पृष्ठ्याहोभिर् एकैकेन मासान् यन्ति / स्वर्गकामा उपेयुः /
text_mt: They proceed through the months with four Pṛṣṭhya days, one by one; those desiring heaven should undertake [it].

sanskrit_iast: madhyamatāpaścitaṃ sam̐vatsaraṃ dīkṣitā bhavanti / saṃvatsaram upasadbhiś caranti /
meaning: मध्यमतापश्चितं सम्̐वत्सरं दीक्षिता भवन्ति / संवत्सरम् उपसद्भिश् चरन्ति /
text_mt: The middle Tāpaścita: they are consecrated for a year; they perform Upasads for a year.

sanskrit_iast: gavām ayanam̐ sutyā / prajātikāmā upeyuḥ /
meaning: गवाम् अयनम्̐ सुत्या / प्रजातिकामा उपेयुः /
text_mt: The soma-pressing is the Gavām Ayana; those desiring offspring should undertake [it].

sanskrit_iast: gavām ayanam ādityānām ayanam aṅgirasāṃ ca triḥsam̐vatsaram̐ sutyā / prathamottame ahanī sātirātre / ṛddhikāmā upeyuḥ /
meaning: गवाम् अयनम् आदित्यानाम् अयनम् अङ्गिरसां च त्रिःसम्̐वत्सरम्̐ सुत्या / प्रथमोत्तमे अहनी सातिरात्रे / ऋद्धिकामा उपेयुः /
text_mt: The Gavām Ayana, the Ādityānām Ayana, and the Aṅgirasām Ayana: the soma-pressing is for three years; the first and last days include Atirātras; those desiring prosperity should undertake [it].

sanskrit_iast: naimiṣīyāṇām ayanaṃ dvādaśasam̐vatsaraṃ tair evāhobhir ekaikena trīm̐strīn sam̐vatsarān yanti / svargakāmā upeyuḥ /
meaning: नैमिषीयाणाम् अयनं द्वादशसम्̐वत्सरं तैर् एवाहोभिर् एकैकेन त्रीम्̐स्त्रीन् सम्̐वत्सरान् यन्ति / स्वर्गकामा उपेयुः /
text_mt: The Naimiṣīyāṇām Ayana is of twelve years: with those very days, one by one, they proceed for three years each; those desiring heaven should undertake [it].

sanskrit_iast: śāktyānām ayanam̐ ṣaṭtrim̐śatsam̐vatsaraṃ tair evāhobhir ekaikena navanava sam̐vatsarān yanti /
meaning: शाक्त्यानाम् अयनम्̐ षट्त्रिम्̐शत्सम्̐वत्सरं तैर् एवाहोभिर् एकैकेन नवनव सम्̐वत्सरान् यन्ति /
text_mt: The Śāktyānām Ayana is of thirty-six years: with those very days, one by one, they proceed for nine years each.

sanskrit_iast: tarasamayāḥ puroḍāśāḥ sutyāsu / mṛgapakṣiṇāṃ praśastānām̐ śukānāṃ mām̐sānāṃ pṛṣṭhyapuroḍāśān kurvanti yathocitam ṛddhikāmā upeyuḥ /
meaning: तरसमयाः पुरोडाशाः सुत्यासु / मृगपक्षिणां प्रशस्तानाम्̐ शुकानां माम्̐सानां पृष्ठ्यपुरोडाशान् कुर्वन्ति यथोचितम् ऋद्धिकामा उपेयुः /
text_mt: The sacrificial cakes at the soma-pressings are made of flesh; they make the Pṛṣṭhya sacrificial cakes from the meat of commended wild beasts and birds, [or] parakeets, as appropriate; those desiring prosperity should undertake [it].

sanskrit_iast: sādhyānām ayanam̐ śatasam̐vatsaraṃ tair evāhobhir ekaikena pañcavim̐śatiṃpañcavim̐śatim̐ sam̐vatsarān yanti / svargakāmā upeyuḥ /
meaning: साध्यानाम् अयनम्̐ शतसम्̐वत्सरं तैर् एवाहोभिर् एकैकेन पञ्चविम्̐शतिंपञ्चविम्̐शतिम्̐ सम्̐वत्सरान् यन्ति / स्वर्गकामा उपेयुः /
text_mt: The Sādhyānām Ayana is of a hundred years: with those very days, one by one, they proceed for twenty-five years each; those desiring heaven should undertake [it].

sanskrit_iast: atirātrayor madhye sahasram ahāni śatakṛtvo daśarātrasya veti sahasrasāvyam̐ vi pāpmanā vartemahītikāmā upeyuḥ /
meaning: अतिरात्रयोर् मध्ये सहस्रम् अहानि शतकृत्वो दशरात्रस्य वेति सहस्रसाव्यम्̐ वि पाप्मना वर्तेमहीतिकामा उपेयुः /
text_mt: Between the two Atirātras are a thousand days, or a hundred times the ten-day period: this is the Sahasrasāvya; those desiring 'may we be freed from evil' should undertake [it].

sanskrit_iast: sarasvatyā apyaye dīkṣate /
meaning: सरस्वत्या अप्यये दीक्षते /
text_mt: One is consecrated at the confluence of the Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast: cakrīvanti dīkṣitasya śālāgnīdhrasadohavirdhānāni ca /
meaning: चक्रीवन्ति दीक्षितस्य शालाग्नीध्रसदोहविर्धानानि च /
text_mt: For the consecrated one, the hall, the āgnīdhra shed, the sadas, and the havirdhāna shed are mounted on wheels.

sanskrit_iast: vedimātre saṃmimīyur na vediṃ mimīte nottaravedim /
meaning: वेदिमात्रे संमिमीयुर् न वेदिं मिमीते नोत्तरवेदिम् /
text_mt: They should measure out just the extent of the altar; he does not measure out the altar, nor the high altar.

sanskrit_iast: ulūkhalabaddho yūpaḥ prakṛṣyaḥ /
meaning: उलूखलबद्धो यूपः प्रकृष्यः /
text_mt: The sacrificial post is tied to a mortar, to be dragged along.

sanskrit_iast: abhiṣuṇvanti noparavān khananti /
meaning: अभिषुण्वन्ति नोपरवान् खनन्ति /
text_mt: They press [the soma]; they do not dig sound-holes.

sanskrit_iast: atirātre savanīyasya vapām̐ hutvendrāya sāṃnāyyāya vatsān apākaroti /
meaning: अतिरात्रे सवनीयस्य वपाम्̐ हुत्वेन्द्राय सांनाय्याय वत्सान् अपाकरोति /
text_mt: At the Atirātra, having offered the omentum of the soma-day victim, he separates the calves for the curd and milk offering to Indra.

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭomam̐ sam̐sthāpyedhmābarhiḥ saṃnahyati /
meaning: अग्निष्टोमम्̐ सम्̐स्थाप्येध्माबर्हिः संनह्यति /
text_mt: Having concluded the Agniṣṭoma, he ties together the sacrificial fuel and sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: ṣoḍaśinam̐ sam̐sthāpya sāyaṃ dohayati /
meaning: षोडशिनम्̐ सम्̐स्थाप्य सायं दोहयति /
text_mt: Having concluded the Ṣoḍaśin, he has the milking done in the evening.

sanskrit_iast: atirātram̐ sam̐sthāpya sāṃnāyyena yajante /
meaning: अतिरात्रम्̐ सम्̐स्थाप्य सांनाय्येन यजन्ते /
text_mt: Having concluded the Atirātra, they sacrifice with the curd and milk offering.

sanskrit_iast: sāṃnāyyam̐ sam̐sthāpyāgreṇāhavanīyam avasthāyādhvaryuḥ prācīm̐ śamyāṃ prāsyati / sā yatra nipatati tad gārhapatyasthānaṃ tataḥ ṣaṭtrim̐śatprakrameṣv āhavanīyaḥ /
meaning: सांनाय्यम्̐ सम्̐स्थाप्याग्रेणाहवनीयम् अवस्थायाध्वर्युः प्राचीम्̐ शम्यां प्रास्यति / सा यत्र निपतति तद् गार्हपत्यस्थानं ततः षट्त्रिम्̐शत्प्रक्रमेष्व् आहवनीयः /
text_mt: Having concluded the curd and milk offering, the adhvaryu, standing in front of the āhavanīya fire, throws a yoke-pin toward the east; where it falls, that is the site of the gārhapatya fire; thirty-six paces from there is the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: tatrānuparyāhṛtyāgnīdhravedimātre sadohavirdhānāni pratiṣṭhāpya sāṃnāyyena yajante / tena pūrvapakṣam̐ yanti /
meaning: तत्रानुपर्याहृत्याग्नीध्रवेदिमात्रे सदोहविर्धानानि प्रतिष्ठाप्य सांनाय्येन यजन्ते / तेन पूर्वपक्षम्̐ यन्ति /
text_mt: Having brought [the fires] around there, having set up the āgnīdhra shed, the sadas, and the havirdhāna sheds to the extent of the altar, they sacrifice with the curd and milk offering; by that they proceed through the bright fortnight.

sanskrit_iast: gaur ukthyaḥ paurṇamāsyām̐ sam̐sthite paurṇamāsena yajante / tenāparapakṣam̐ yanti /
meaning: गौर् उक्थ्यः पौर्णमास्याम्̐ सम्̐स्थिते पौर्णमासेन यजन्ते / तेनापरपक्षम्̐ यन्ति /
text_mt: The Go is an Ukthya; when the full-moon sacrifice is concluded, they sacrifice with the full-moon rite; by that they proceed through the dark fortnight.

sanskrit_iast: āyur ukthyo 'māvāsyāyām /
meaning: आयुर् उक्थ्यो ऽमावास्यायाम् /
text_mt: The Āyus is an Ukthya on the new-moon day.

sanskrit_iast: sāṃnāyyena pūrvapakṣān yanti paurṇamāsenāparapakṣān /
meaning: सांनाय्येन पूर्वपक्षान् यन्ति पौर्णमासेनापरपक्षान् /
text_mt: With the curd and milk offering they proceed through the bright fortnights, with the full-moon rite through the dark fortnights.

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣiṣyamāṇāḥ śate goṣv ṛṣabham utsṛjanti /
meaning: दीक्षिष्यमाणाः शते गोष्व् ऋषभम् उत्सृजन्ति /
text_mt: Intending to undergo consecration, they release a bull among a hundred cows.

sanskrit_iast: tā yatra sahasram̐ saṃpadyante tadutthānam̐ sarvāsūpahatāsūtthānaṃ gṛhapatau preta utthānaṃ plākṣaṃ prasravaṇaṃ prāpyotthānam /
meaning: ता यत्र सहस्रम्̐ संपद्यन्ते तदुत्थानम्̐ सर्वासूपहतासूत्थानं गृहपतौ प्रेत उत्थानं प्लाक्षं प्रस्रवणं प्राप्योत्थानम् /
text_mt: When these become a thousand, then is the rising; [or] when all are struck down, there is the rising; when the master of the house dies, there is the rising; having reached the Plākṣa Prasravaṇa, there is the rising.

sanskrit_iast: sahasre saṃpanne gaur udayanīyo 'tirātraḥ sarvāsūpahatāsu viśvajid gṛhapatau preta āyuḥ /
meaning: सहस्रे संपन्ने गौर् उदयनीयो ऽतिरात्रः सर्वासूपहतासु विश्वजिद् गृहपतौ प्रेत आयुः /
text_mt: When a thousand is reached, the concluding Atirātra is the Go; when all are struck down, the Viśvajit; when the master of the house dies, the Āyus.

sanskrit_iast: yady arvāk plākṣāt prasravaṇād uttiṣṭheran sthalair madhyasyottarato hrade 'vabhṛtham abhyaveyuḥ /
meaning: यद्य् अर्वाक् प्लाक्षात् प्रस्रवणाद् उत्तिष्ठेरन् स्थलैर् मध्यस्योत्तरतो ह्रदे ऽवभृथम् अभ्यवेयुः /
text_mt: If they should rise before the Plākṣa Prasravaṇa, they should descend into a pool to the north of the middle dry ground for the final bath.

sanskrit_iast: plākṣaṃ prasravaṇam̐ yanto dṛṣadvatyā apyaye nirvaped aponaptrīyaṃ carum /
meaning: प्लाक्षं प्रस्रवणम्̐ यन्तो दृषद्वत्या अप्यये निर्वपेद् अपोनप्त्रीयं चरुम् /
text_mt: Going to the Plākṣa Prasravaṇa, at the confluence of the Dṛṣadvatī he should apportion the boiled oblation to Apām Napāt.

sanskrit_iast: plākṣaṃ prasravaṇaṃ prāpya niṣadi nirupyam udayanīyam atirātram̐ sam̐sthāpyāgnaye kāmāyāṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet /
meaning: प्लाक्षं प्रस्रवणं प्राप्य निषदि निरुप्यम् उदयनीयम् अतिरात्रम्̐ सम्̐स्थाप्याग्नये कामायाष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत् /
text_mt: Having reached the Plākṣa Prasravaṇa, having apportioned [the oblations] at the settlement, and having brought the concluding atirātra sacrifice to completion, he should apportion an eight-potsherd cake for Agni Kāma.

sanskrit_iast: tasyām aśvāṃ ca puruṣīṃ ca dhenuke dakṣiṇe dattvā kārapacavaṃ prati yamunām avabhṛtham abhyaveyuḥ /
meaning: तस्याम् अश्वां च पुरुषीं च धेनुके दक्षिणे दत्त्वा कारपचवं प्रति यमुनाम् अवभृथम् अभ्यवेयुः /
text_mt: On that [occasion], having given a mare and a woman as milch cows for sacrificial gifts, they should go down for the purificatory bath into the Yamunā towards Kārapacava.

sanskrit_iast: mitrāvaruṇayor ayanam̐ sārasvatam̐ svargakāmā upeyuḥ /
meaning: मित्रावरुणयोर् अयनम्̐ सारस्वतम्̐ स्वर्गकामा उपेयुः /
text_mt: Those desiring heaven should undertake the course of Mitra and Varuṇa on the Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast: mitrāvaruṇayor ayanenendrāgnyor ayanam̐ vyākhyātam aryamṇaś ca /
meaning: मित्रावरुणयोर् अयनेनेन्द्राग्न्योर् अयनम्̐ व्याख्यातम् अर्यम्णश् च /
text_mt: By the course of Mitra and Varuṇa, the course of Indra and Agni and that of Aryaman are explained.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛtpañcadaśābhyām̐ vyatyāsam ardhayantīndrāgnyor ayane / tryaheṇatryaheṇābhyāvartayam aryamṇo 'yane 'bhijit paurṇamāsyām̐ viśvajid amāvāsyāyām̐ yathoktaṃ pūrvasmin /
meaning: त्रिवृत्पञ्चदशाभ्याम्̐ व्यत्यासम् अर्धयन्तीन्द्राग्न्योर् अयने / त्र्यहेणत्र्यहेणाभ्यावर्तयम् अर्यम्णो ऽयने ऽभिजित् पौर्णमास्याम्̐ विश्वजिद् अमावास्यायाम्̐ यथोक्तं पूर्वस्मिन् /
text_mt: In the course of Indra and Agni they complete [the rites] alternately with trivṛt and pañcadaśa stomas. In the course of Aryaman [they proceed] repeating three-day period by three-day period: the abhijit on the full-moon day, the viśvajit on the new-moon day, as stated in the previous [section].

sanskrit_iast: sarvāsāṃ prajānām̐ śreṣṭhāḥ syāmetikāmā upeyuḥ / pra devayānaṃ panthānam aśnavāmahā ity uttare /
meaning: सर्वासां प्रजानाम्̐ श्रेष्ठाः स्यामेतिकामा उपेयुः / प्र देवयानं पन्थानम् अश्नवामहा इत्य् उत्तरे /
text_mt: Those desiring: 'May we be the best of all creatures' should undertake [it]. 'May we attain the path traversed by the gods,' thus the subsequent ones.

sanskrit_iast: amāvāsyāyāṃ keśaśmaśrū yajamāno vāpayitvāplutyāhate kṣaume paridhāya paścād āhavanīyasyādīkṣitaḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ pratimuñcati /
meaning: अमावास्यायां केशश्मश्रू यजमानो वापयित्वाप्लुत्याहते क्षौमे परिधाय पश्चाद् आहवनीयस्यादीक्षितः कृष्णाजिनं प्रतिमुञ्चति /
text_mt: On the new-moon day, the sacrificer, having shaved his hair and beard, having bathed, and having put on an unwashed linen garment, puts on the black antelope skin behind the āhavanīya fire without having been consecrated.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyam aṣṭākapālaṃ pūrvāhṇe nirvaped aindrāgnam ekādaśakapālaṃ madhyaṃdine vaiśvadevaṃ carum aparāhṇe /
meaning: आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालं पूर्वाह्णे निर्वपेद् ऐन्द्राग्नम् एकादशकपालं मध्यंदिने वैश्वदेवं चरुम् अपराह्णे /
text_mt: He should apportion an eight-potsherd cake for Agni in the forenoon, an eleven-potsherd cake for Indra and Agni at midday, [and] a caru for the Viśve Devas in the afternoon.

sanskrit_iast: tadbhakṣa etām eva trihaviṣam iṣṭiṃ nirvapet /
meaning: तद्भक्ष एताम् एव त्रिहविषम् इष्टिं निर्वपेत् /
text_mt: Subsisting on that food alone, he should apportion this very three-oblation sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: tayā sam̐vatsaram̐ yajeta /
meaning: तया सम्̐वत्सरम्̐ यजेत /
text_mt: With it he should sacrifice for a year.

sanskrit_iast: nānyat kṛṣṇājinād dīkṣitavratānāṃ kuryāt /
meaning: नान्यत् कृष्णाजिनाद् दीक्षितव्रतानां कुर्यात् /
text_mt: Other than [wearing] the black antelope skin, he should observe none of the vows of an initiate.

sanskrit_iast: samāpte sam̐vatsare 'vabhṛthād udetya nikhilaṃ keśaśmaśrū yajamāno vāpayate /
meaning: समाप्ते सम्̐वत्सरे ऽवभृथाद् उदेत्य निखिलं केशश्मश्रू यजमानो वापयते /
text_mt: When the year has ended, having stepped up from the purificatory bath, the sacrificer has his hair and beard completely shaved.

sanskrit_iast: turāyaṇam ṛddhikāmā upeyuḥ /
meaning: तुरायणम् ऋद्धिकामा उपेयुः /
text_mt: Those desiring prosperity should undertake the Turāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: sam̐vatsaraṃ brāhmaṇasya gorakṣaḥ / sam̐vatsaram̐ vyarṇe naitandhave 'gnim indhaḥ /
meaning: सम्̐वत्सरं ब्राह्मणस्य गोरक्षः / सम्̐वत्सरम्̐ व्यर्णे नैतन्धवे ऽग्निम् इन्धः /
text_mt: For a year [he remains] the cowherd of a brahmin; for a year he kindles the fire at Vyarṇa Naitandhava.

sanskrit_iast: samāpte sam̐vatsare pariṇahyagnīn ādhāya dṛṣadvatyā apyaye nirvaped āgneyam aṣṭākapālam /
meaning: समाप्ते सम्̐वत्सरे परिणह्यग्नीन् आधाय दृषद्वत्या अप्यये निर्वपेद् आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालम् /
text_mt: When the year has ended, having established the fires at Pariṇah, he should apportion an eight-potsherd cake for Agni at the confluence of the Dṛṣadvatī.

sanskrit_iast: dṛṣadvatyā dakṣiṇena tīreṇa śamyāparāsīyāt triplakṣaṃ prāpya yamunām avabhṛtham abhyaveyāt /
meaning: दृषद्वत्या दक्षिणेन तीरेण शम्यापरासीयात् त्रिप्लक्षं प्राप्य यमुनाम् अवभृथम् अभ्यवेयात् /
text_mt: Along the southern bank of the Dṛṣadvatī he should advance by the distance of a yoke-pin's throw; having reached Triplakṣa, he should go down into the Yamunā for the purificatory bath.

sanskrit_iast: tad evā manuṣyebhyas tiro bhavati / svargakāmo dārṣadvatam upeyāt /
meaning: तद् एवा मनुष्येभ्यस् तिरो भवति / स्वर्गकामो दार्षद्वतम् उपेयात् /
text_mt: Right there he becomes concealed from humans. One desiring heaven should undertake the Dārṣadvata [session].

sanskrit_iast: atirātrayor madhye 'gniṣṭomāḥ / sarvo daśadaśī sam̐vatsaro dvādaśo viṣuvān sarpasāmāni viṣuvati kriyante /
meaning: अतिरात्रयोर् मध्ये ऽग्निष्टोमाः / सर्वो दशदशी सम्̐वत्सरो द्वादशो विषुवान् सर्पसामानि विषुवति क्रियन्ते /
text_mt: Between the two atirātras there are agniṣṭomas. The entire year consists of ten-day groups; the twelfth is the viṣuvant; snake-sāmans are performed on the viṣuvant.

sanskrit_iast: jarvaro gṛhapatir dhṛtarāṣṭra airāvato brahmety evamādīn sarpān āyur vijaye 'dhīyate /
meaning: जर्वरो गृहपतिर् धृतराष्ट्र ऐरावतो ब्रह्मेत्य् एवमादीन् सर्पान् आयुर् विजये ऽधीयते /
text_mt: 'Jarvara is the master of the house, Dhṛtarāṣṭra Airāvata is the brahman priest'—thus and so forth they recite snakes [conferring] longevity in victory.

sanskrit_iast: sarpasattram ṛddhikāmā amṛtatvakāmāḥ svargakāmāś copeyuḥ /
meaning: सर्पसत्त्रम् ऋद्धिकामा अमृतत्वकामाः स्वर्गकामाश् चोपेयुः /
text_mt: Those desiring prosperity, those desiring immortality, and those desiring heaven should undertake the snake session.

sanskrit_iast: atirātrayor madhye sahasraṃ trivṛtaḥ sam̐vatsarān daśarātram̐ vā saṃtatam ekaikam̐ sam̐vatsaram etya prajāpater evam̐ sahasrasam̐vatsaraṃ prajātikāmā upeyuḥ /
meaning: अतिरात्रयोर् मध्ये सहस्रं त्रिवृतः सम्̐वत्सरान् दशरात्रम्̐ वा संततम् एकैकम्̐ सम्̐वत्सरम् एत्य प्रजापतेर् एवम्̐ सहस्रसम्̐वत्सरं प्रजातिकामा उपेयुः /
text_mt: Between the two atirātras, going through a thousand trivṛt years or a continuous ten-day period year by year, those desiring offspring should undertake this thousand-year session of Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: caturbhiḥ pṛṣṭhyāhobhir ekaikena pañca pañcāśatam̐ sam̐vatsarān yanti /
meaning: चतुर्भिः पृष्ठ्याहोभिर् एकैकेन पञ्च पञ्चाशतम्̐ सम्̐वत्सरान् यन्ति /
text_mt: By means of four pṛṣṭhya days, with each one they proceed for fifty-five years.

sanskrit_iast: viśvasṛjām ayanam̐ sahasrasam̐vatsaram̐ sarvā naḥ prajā anuprajāyeran brahmalokaṃ ca gachemahītikāmā upeyuḥ /
meaning: विश्वसृजाम् अयनम्̐ सहस्रसम्̐वत्सरम्̐ सर्वा नः प्रजा अनुप्रजायेरन् ब्रह्मलोकं च गछेमहीतिकामा उपेयुः /
text_mt: Those desiring: 'May all offspring be born after us and may we go to the world of Brahman' should undertake the thousand-year course of the Viśvasṛjs.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra śloko 'pyuktaḥ
viśvasṛjaḥ prathame sattram āsata \ sahasrasavaṃ prasavena yantaḥ /
tato ha jajñe bhuvanasya goptās\ hiraṇmayaḥ śakuno brahmanāma //
iti /
meaning:
तत्र श्लोको ऽप्युक्तः
विश्वसृजः प्रथमे सत्त्रम् आसत \ सहस्रसवं प्रसवेन यन्तः /
ततो ह जज्ञे भुवनस्य गोप्तास्\ हिरण्मयः शकुनो ब्रह्मनाम //
इति /
text_mt:
'The Viśvasṛjs were the first to sit at the sacrificial session, / proceeding with the pressing that produces a thousand pressings;

therefrom was born the protector of the world, / the golden bird named Brahman.'

sanskrit_iast: sarasvatyūnāni kalpayatu kalpayatu /
meaning: सरस्वत्यूनानि कल्पयतु कल्पयतु /
text_mt: May Sarasvatī make up, make up the deficiencies!

sanskrit_iast: cāturhotṛkagonāmikam apy anāhitāgner dvādaśarātraṃ trirātram ekarātram̐ vā /
meaning: चातुर्होतृकगोनामिकम् अप्य् अनाहिताग्नेर् द्वादशरात्रं त्रिरात्रम् एकरात्रम्̐ वा /
text_mt: The Cāturhotṛka Gonāmika rite is performed even by one who has not established his sacred fires, for twelve nights, three nights, or one night.

sanskrit_iast: pākayajñopacārād agnim upacarati /
meaning: पाकयज्ञोपचाराद् अग्निम् उपचरति /
text_mt: He attends to the fire according to the ritual practice of domestic sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: sāṃgrāmikī jayasya dakṣiṇā saptasthavīryeṣu vāso deyam̐ hiraṇyam̐ vā deyam /
meaning: सांग्रामिकी जयस्य दक्षिणा सप्तस्थवीर्येषु वासो देयम्̐ हिरण्यम्̐ वा देयम् /
text_mt: The sacrificial gift of victory in battle is: in the Saptasthavīrya rites a garment is to be given, or gold is to be given.

sanskrit_iast: revatyāṃ citrāyām̐ vā paśukāmaḥ karma kurvīta /
meaning: रेवत्यां चित्रायाम्̐ वा पशुकामः कर्म कुर्वीत /
text_mt: One desiring cattle should perform the rite under the Revatī or Citrā nakṣatra.

sanskrit_iast: bhinnena sravatā na hastā avanenijīta na pibed ayaspātreṇety eke tad deśapratiṣedham ity apare /
meaning: भिन्नेन स्रवता न हस्ता अवनेनिजीत न पिबेद् अयस्पात्रेणेत्य् एके तद् देशप्रतिषेधम् इत्य् अपरे /
text_mt: He should not wash his hands with [water from] a broken, leaking vessel, nor should he drink from an iron vessel—so say some; others say this is a prohibition relating to the region.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ dviṣyāt tasya gavāṃ madhye 'raṇye 'dhītair gonāmabhir āhvayet /
meaning: यं द्विष्यात् तस्य गवां मध्ये ऽरण्ये ऽधीतैर् गोनामभिर् आह्वयेत् /
text_mt: Among the cows of the one whom he hates, he should call upon them in the forest with the cow-names he has learned.

sanskrit_iast: sam̐śṛṅgīṃ purastāt pratīcīm avasthāpyādhastād darbhān āstīrya kāmyāyai svāhā \\ iti mūrdhani tisra āhutīḥ paśukāmo juhuyāt /
meaning: सम्̐शृङ्गीं पुरस्तात् प्रतीचीम् अवस्थाप्याधस्ताद् दर्भान् आस्तीर्य काम्यायै स्वाहा \\ इति मूर्धनि तिस्र आहुतीः पशुकामो जुहुयात् /
text_mt: Having placed a cow whose horns point forward facing westward, and having spread darbha grass underneath, one desiring cattle should offer three oblations onto her head with: 'To Kāmyā, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: uttaro nigade vyākhyātaḥ /
meaning: उत्तरो निगदे व्याख्यातः /
text_mt: The subsequent [ritual detail] is explained in the recited text.

sanskrit_iast: prācīnapravaṇe samūle paśukāma upodaye sūryasya hastā avanijya darbhastamba udaśarāvaṃ ninayet kāmaṃkāmaṃ ma āvartaya \\ iti /
meaning: प्राचीनप्रवणे समूले पशुकाम उपोदये सूर्यस्य हस्ता अवनिज्य दर्भस्तम्ब उदशरावं निनयेत् कामंकामं म आवर्तय \\ इति /
text_mt: On a ground sloping eastwards with grass rooted in it, at sunrise, one desiring cattle, having washed his hands, should pour out a vessel of water onto a clump of darbha grass with: 'Bring every desire back to me!'

sanskrit_iast: gobhiḥ sahetya praśastāḥ stha kalyāṇyas \\ iti brūyāt /
meaning: गोभिः सहेत्य प्रशस्ताः स्थ कल्याण्यस् \\ इति ब्रूयात् /
text_mt: Approaching together with the cows, he should say: 'You are praiseworthy, auspicious!'

sanskrit_iast: ekāṣṭakāyāṃ catuṣpathe 'ṅgaśo gāṃ kārayed yoya āgachet tasmaitasmai dadyāt /
meaning: एकाष्टकायां चतुष्पथे ऽङ्गशो गां कारयेद् योय आगछेत् तस्मैतस्मै दद्यात् /
text_mt: On the Ekāṣṭakā day, at a crossroad, he should have a cow cut up limb by limb; to whoever approaches, to him he should give [a piece].

sanskrit_iast: śvo 'nyāṃ kārayitvā brāhmaṇān bhojayet paśukāmaḥ /
meaning: श्वो ऽन्यां कारयित्वा ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेत् पशुकामः /
text_mt: On the following day, having had another [cow] prepared, one desiring cattle should feed brahmins.

sanskrit_iast: uttaro nigade vyākhyātaḥ //
meaning: उत्तरो निगदे व्याख्यातः //
text_mt: The subsequent [ritual detail] is explained in the recited text.

sanskrit_iast: vasīyasy ehi \ śreyasy ehi \\ iti sapta devagavyas \\ cid asi \ manāsi \ dhīrasi \\ ity uttarāḥ sapta / tāsām anuprāṇāntāḥ prathamā ehyantā uttarāḥ //
meaning: वसीयस्य् एहि \ श्रेयस्य् एहि \\ इति सप्त देवगव्यस् \\ चिद् असि \ मनासि \ धीरसि \\ इत्य् उत्तराः सप्त / तासाम् अनुप्राणान्ताः प्रथमा एह्यन्ता उत्तराः //
text_mt: 'Come, O wealthier one! Come, O more excellent one!'—these are the seven divine cows; 'You are thought, you are mind, you are intellect'—these are the subsequent seven; among them, the first end with anūprāṇa, the subsequent end with ehi.

sanskrit_iast: saha rāyaspoṣeṇa \ devīr devīr ity anunigadati /
meaning: सह रायस्पोषेण \ देवीर् देवीर् इत्य् अनुनिगदति /
text_mt: He recites: 'Together with abundance of wealth, / O goddesses, O goddesses!'

sanskrit_iast: saṃgrāmaṃ jigīṣan senayoḥ saṃdṛśyamānayoḥ pūrvābhir hutvottarā nigadet /
meaning: संग्रामं जिगीषन् सेनयोः संदृश्यमानयोः पूर्वाभिर् हुत्वोत्तरा निगदेत् /
text_mt: Desiring to win a battle, when the two armies are visible to one another, having offered with the former [formulas], he should recite the subsequent ones.

sanskrit_iast: yatra samūlā oṣadhīr upagachet paśūn vā tad etā ehyantāḥ sapta japet /
meaning: यत्र समूला ओषधीर् उपगछेत् पशून् वा तद् एता एह्यन्ताः सप्त जपेत् /
text_mt: Whenever he approaches plants with their roots or cattle, then he should murmur these seven [formulas] ending with ehi.

sanskrit_iast: saptasthavīrye saptānāṃ gavām ājyam̐ saptānāṃ payasi sthālīpākaḥ /
meaning: सप्तस्थवीर्ये सप्तानां गवाम् आज्यम्̐ सप्तानां पयसि स्थालीपाकः /
text_mt: In the Saptasthavīrya rite, clarified butter is from seven cows; the cooked rice-pot offering is in the milk of seven cows.

sanskrit_iast: yasya sapta sthavirāś caramām antamā syuḥ pūrvābhir hutvottarā nigadet /
meaning: यस्य सप्त स्थविराश् चरमाम् अन्तमा स्युः पूर्वाभिर् हुत्वोत्तरा निगदेत् /
text_mt: For whom seven old [cows] are the very last and final, having offered with the former [formulas], he should recite the subsequent ones.

sanskrit_iast: yo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā bahupuṣṭaḥ syāt tasya gavām̐ sāṇḍam̐ vatsataram ilāndāḥ stha pūṣṇo nakṣatraṃ poṣayiṣṇu \\ ity apagamayeta //
meaning: यो वैश्यः शूद्रो वा बहुपुष्टः स्यात् तस्य गवाम्̐ साण्डम्̐ वत्सतरम् इलान्दाः स्थ पूष्णो नक्षत्रं पोषयिष्णु \\ इत्य् अपगमयेत //
text_mt: A vaiśya or a śūdra who is richly thriving—from his cows he should drive away an uncastrated yearling bull with: 'You are Ilāndās, the constellation of Pūṣan, nourishing!'

sanskrit_iast: āyur me dās \\ iti svāsu goṣṭhāsv avasṛjya vasīyasy ehi \ śreyasy ehi \\ iti parasyātyāhvayet /
meaning: आयुर् मे दास् \\ इति स्वासु गोष्ठास्व् अवसृज्य वसीयस्य् एहि \ श्रेयस्य् एहि \\ इति परस्यात्याह्वयेत् /
text_mt: Having released [the yearling bull] among his own cowpens with: 'Grant me life!', he should call [a cow] of the other away with: 'Come, O wealthier one! Come, O more excellent one!'

sanskrit_iast: sārasvataṃ payasi sthālīpākam̐ śrapayitvā sārasvata ṛgbhyām āhutīr juhuyād etena grāmakāmo yajeta tathā paśukāmaḥ /
meaning: सारस्वतं पयसि स्थालीपाकम्̐ श्रपयित्वा सारस्वत ऋग्भ्याम् आहुतीर् जुहुयाद् एतेन ग्रामकामो यजेत तथा पशुकामः /
text_mt: Having cooked a rice-pot offering in milk for Sarasvatī, he should offer oblations with the two Sarasvatī verses; one desiring a village should sacrifice with this, likewise one desiring cattle.

sanskrit_iast: sarvāsāṃ dugdhe catuḥśarāvam odanaṃ paced brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paśukāmaḥ /
meaning: सर्वासां दुग्धे चतुःशरावम् ओदनं पचेद् ब्राह्मणेभ्यः पशुकामः /
text_mt: One desiring cattle should cook a four-śarāva porridge in the milk of all [the cows] for the brahmins.

sanskrit_iast: na chinnaṃ deyam iti vyākhyātam /
meaning: न छिन्नं देयम् इति व्याख्यातम् /
text_mt: 'What is cut off must not be given' has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: tāṃ bhadraṃbhadram iti brūyād bhadraṃ kalyāṇam iti brūyāt puṇyaṃ praśastam iti brūyāt /
meaning: तां भद्रंभद्रम् इति ब्रूयाद् भद्रं कल्याणम् इति ब्रूयात् पुण्यं प्रशस्तम् इति ब्रूयात् /
text_mt: He should address her: 'Auspicious, auspicious!', he should say: 'Auspicious, fortunate!', he should say: 'Meritorious, praiseworthy!'

sanskrit_iast: adīkṣaṇīyāya gāṃ dattvā na me tad upadambhiṣar dhṛṣir iti japet /
meaning: अदीक्षणीयाय गां दत्त्वा न मे तद् उपदम्भिषर् धृषिर् इति जपेत् /
text_mt: Having given a cow to one who is not consecrated, he should murmur: 'May he not deceive that of mine; [he is] bold.'

sanskrit_iast: vīravatīr bhūyāsta iti vyākhyātam ā balihṛtaḥ //
meaning: वीरवतीर् भूयास्त इति व्याख्यातम् आ बलिहृतः //
text_mt: 'May you be full of heroes' has been explained, up to 'bringers of tribute'.

sanskrit_iast: bhūyām̐so bhūyāsta iti sabhāsadaḥ /
meaning: भूयाम्̐सो भूयास्त इति सभासदः /
text_mt: [He addresses] the members of the assembly: 'May you be more numerous!'

sanskrit_iast: pādau pratyavahared upopatiṣṭheta vā //
meaning: पादौ प्रत्यवहरेद् उपोपतिष्ठेत वा //
text_mt: He should step back his feet or wait upon [the assembly].

sanskrit_iast: puṇyā puṇyam asūd iti vyākhyātaṃ puṇyam asūd iti vā /
meaning: पुण्या पुण्यम् असूद् इति व्याख्यातं पुण्यम् असूद् इति वा /
text_mt: 'The auspicious one has given birth to the auspicious' has been explained, or 'She has given birth to the auspicious.'

sanskrit_iast: ekāṣṭakāyāṃ tūṣṇīm̐ sarvān sam̐sṛjya puṇyāḥ puṇyān asuvan \\ citrāś citrān asuvan \\ aiḍā me bhagavanto 'janiḍhvaṃ maitrāvaruṇas \\ ūrjā me bhagavantaḥ sahājaniḍhvam \\ sam̐vidaṃ me vindata \\ iti pum̐so jātān puṇyāḥ puṇyā asuvan \\ citrāś citrā asuvan \\ aiḍyo me bhagavatyo 'janiḍhvaṃ maitrāvaruṇyas \\ rāyaspoṣeṇa me bhagavatyaḥ sahājaniḍhvam \\ jñātraṃ me vindata \\ iti strīr jātās tān ubhayān sahābhimantrayeta //
meaning: एकाष्टकायां तूष्णीम्̐ सर्वान् सम्̐सृज्य पुण्याः पुण्यान् असुवन् \\ चित्राश् चित्रान् असुवन् \\ ऐडा मे भगवन्तो ऽजनिढ्वं मैत्रावरुणस् \\ ऊर्जा मे भगवन्तः सहाजनिढ्वम् \\ सम्̐विदं मे विन्दत \\ इति पुम्̐सो जातान् पुण्याः पुण्या असुवन् \\ चित्राश् चित्रा असुवन् \\ ऐड्यो मे भगवत्यो ऽजनिढ्वं मैत्रावरुण्यस् \\ रायस्पोषेण मे भगवत्यः सहाजनिढ्वम् \\ ज्ञात्रं मे विन्दत \\ इति स्त्रीर् जातास् तान् उभयान् सहाभिमन्त्रयेत //
text_mt: On the Ekāṣṭakā, having silently brought [the calves] together, he should address both together: to the newborn males with, 'Auspicious cows have brought forth auspicious males; speckled cows have brought forth speckled males; venerable sons of Iḍā, offspring of Mitra and Varuṇa, you have been born to me; venerable ones, you have been born together with nourishment for me; find agreement for me!'; to the newborn females with, 'Auspicious cows have brought forth auspicious females; speckled cows have brought forth speckled females; venerable daughters of Iḍā, offspring of Mitra and Varuṇa, you have been born to me; venerable ones, you have been born together with increase of wealth for me; find acquaintance for me!'

sanskrit_iast: dhenuṃdhenum iti brūyād dhenur bhavyā \\ iti brūyān na hata \\ iti brūyāt kuruta \\ iti brūyān nāntarvatnī \\ iti brūyād vijanyā \\ iti brūyāt /
meaning: धेनुंधेनुम् इति ब्रूयाद् धेनुर् भव्या \\ इति ब्रूयान् न हत \\ इति ब्रूयात् कुरुत \\ इति ब्रूयान् नान्तर्वत्नी \\ इति ब्रूयाद् विजन्या \\ इति ब्रूयात् /
text_mt: He should refer to every milch cow with, 'A milch cow should be maintained'; he should not say, 'Kill!'; he should say, 'Make [her flourish]!'; he should not say, 'She is pregnant'; he should say, 'She is about to give birth'.

sanskrit_iast: ikṣukāṇḍam apsu vāsayitvā lohitenāyasena vā //
meaning: इक्षुकाण्डम् अप्सु वासयित्वा लोहितेनायसेन वा //
text_mt: Having soaked a stalk of sugarcane in water, or with red iron,

sanskrit_iast: bhuvanam asi sāhasram \ indrāya tvā sṛmo 'dadād \ yāvatīnām idaṃ karomi bhūyasīnām uttarām̐ samāṃ kriyāsam iti gavām̐ lakṣma kuryāt ṣaṇṇāṃ catasṛṇām̐ vā / pum̐saḥ striya iti vyatyāsam /
meaning: भुवनम् असि साहस्रम् \ इन्द्राय त्वा सृमो ऽददाद् \ यावतीनाम् इदं करोमि भूयसीनाम् उत्तराम्̐ समां क्रियासम् इति गवाम्̐ लक्ष्म कुर्यात् षण्णां चतसृणाम्̐ वा / पुम्̐सः स्त्रिय इति व्यत्यासम् /
text_mt: with, 'You are being thousandfold, the sickle gave you to Indra; of as many as I do this [now], of more may I do it in the next year,' he should make a mark on six or four cows; alternately on males and females.

sanskrit_iast: yasya dakṣiṇataḥ pratibhinnam iti vyākhyātam //
meaning: यस्य दक्षिणतः प्रतिभिन्नम् इति व्याख्यातम् //
text_mt: The [ritual] of 'one pierced on the right' has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: iha prajā viśvarūpā ramantām iti gāḥ sāyam āyatīr abhimantrayeta //
meaning: इह प्रजा विश्वरूपा रमन्ताम् इति गाः सायम् आयतीर् अभिमन्त्रयेत //
text_mt: He should accompany the cows returning in the evening with, 'Here let varied offspring rejoice!'

sanskrit_iast: sam̐ vaḥ sṛjatv aryamā \\ iti gāḥ sam̐sṛjed yā asya purā syur yāś cānyato vindeta //
meaning: सम्̐ वः सृजत्व् अर्यमा \\ इति गाः सम्̐सृजेद् या अस्य पुरा स्युर् याश् चान्यतो विन्देत //
text_mt: He should unite the cows with, 'May Aryaman unite you,' both those he previously had and those he acquires from elsewhere.

sanskrit_iast: revatī tantir iti tantim̐ vitanuyāt prācīm udīcīm̐ vā /
meaning: रेवती तन्तिर् इति तन्तिम्̐ वितनुयात् प्राचीम् उदीचीम्̐ वा /
text_mt: With, 'You are the wealthy tether-rope,' he should stretch out the tether-rope eastwards or northwards.

sanskrit_iast: dadhi ghṛtena sam̐sṛjya rayyā tvā puṣṭyānumārjmi \\ ity anumārṣṭi /
meaning: दधि घृतेन सम्̐सृज्य रय्या त्वा पुष्ट्यानुमार्ज्मि \\ इत्य् अनुमार्ष्टि /
text_mt: Having mixed curd with clarified butter, he wipes [the cow] along with, 'With wealth, with nourishment I wipe you along.'

sanskrit_iast: tasyāḥ pramuktavatsāyā vratāni na riktā syāt /
meaning: तस्याः प्रमुक्तवत्साया व्रतानि न रिक्ता स्यात् /
text_mt: For that [cow] whose calf has been released, the observances are: she should not be left empty [unmilked];

sanskrit_iast: noparyupari saṃcareyur nābhivarṣen nābhitapet /
meaning: नोपर्युपरि संचरेयुर् नाभिवर्षेन् नाभितपेत् /
text_mt: they should not step over her, it should not rain on her, and the sun should not scorch her.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣabham utsrakṣyan pitā vatsānām ity ṛṣabhasya dakṣiṇe karṇe utsṛjamāno japet retodhāṃ tvā yaśodhām \\ rāyaspoṣāyotsṛje \\ ity utsṛṣṭe /
meaning: ऋषभम् उत्स्रक्ष्यन् पिता वत्सानाम् इत्य् ऋषभस्य दक्षिणे कर्णे उत्सृजमानो जपेत् रेतोधां त्वा यशोधाम् \\ रायस्पोषायोत्सृजे \\ इत्य् उत्सृष्टे /
text_mt: Intending to release a bull, in the right ear of the bull with, 'Father of the calves...,' he should whisper as it is being released; and when it has been released, with, 'I release you as the placer of semen, the placer of fame, for the increase of wealth.'

sanskrit_iast: yo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā bahupuṣṭaḥ syāt tasya gavāṃ goṣṭhād ekavim̐śatim̐ śakāny āhṛtyaikavim̐śatim āhutīḥ paśukāmo juhuyāt /
meaning: यो वैश्यः शूद्रो वा बहुपुष्टः स्यात् तस्य गवां गोष्ठाद् एकविम्̐शतिम्̐ शकान्य् आहृत्यैकविम्̐शतिम् आहुतीः पशुकामो जुहुयात् /
text_mt: One who desires cattle, having brought twenty-one pieces of dried cow-dung from the cow-pen of a Vaiśya or a Śūdra who possesses abundant prosperity, should offer twenty-one oblations.

sanskrit_iast: gonāmabhir devagavībhir ākṛtihomair agrato gāminīṃ paścāt pratīcīm avasthāpyādhastād darbhān āstīrya kāmyāyai svāhā \\ iti bhasadi tisra āhutīḥ paśukāmo juhuyāt //
meaning: गोनामभिर् देवगवीभिर् आकृतिहोमैर् अग्रतो गामिनीं पश्चात् प्रतीचीम् अवस्थाप्याधस्ताद् दर्भान् आस्तीर्य काम्यायै स्वाहा \\ इति भसदि तिस्र आहुतीः पशुकामो जुहुयात् //
text_mt: With the names of cows, the divine cows, and with intention-offerings, having made the cow going in front stand facing westward behind [the fire], and having spread darbha grass beneath, one desiring cattle should offer three oblations into her vulva with, 'Svāhā to the desirable one!'

sanskrit_iast: yāsām indra udājata \\ iti catvāra ākṛtihomā etaiḥ pūrvāhṇe goṣṭhāsu goṣu juhuyād etair madhyāhne goṣv ākṛtāsv etair aparāhṇe goṣṭhāsu gatāsv etaiḥ saṃgrāme //
meaning: यासाम् इन्द्र उदाजत \\ इति चत्वार आकृतिहोमा एतैः पूर्वाह्णे गोष्ठासु गोषु जुहुयाद् एतैर् मध्याह्ने गोष्व् आकृतास्व् एतैर् अपराह्णे गोष्ठासु गतास्व् एतैः संग्रामे //
text_mt: There are four intention-offerings beginning with, 'Which [cows] Indra drove forth...'; with these he should offer in the forenoon when the cows are in the pen, with these at midday when the cows are brought together, with these in the afternoon when they have gone to the pen, and with these during battle.

sanskrit_iast: mitrabhṛtaḥ kṣatrabhṛtaḥ ity aśvān abhimantrayate //
meaning: मित्रभृतः क्षत्रभृतः इत्य् अश्वान् अभिमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: With, 'Maintainers of friends, maintainers of dominion,' he accompanies the horses.

sanskrit_iast: rohiṇīr vo vṛñje \\ iti saptājyasyāhutīḥ paśukāmo juhuyāt //
meaning: रोहिणीर् वो वृञ्जे \\ इति सप्ताज्यस्याहुतीः पशुकामो जुहुयात् //
text_mt: One desiring cattle should offer seven oblations of clarified butter with, 'I ward off the red ones from you.'

sanskrit_iast: paurṇamāsīm aṣṭakām amāvāsyāṃ citrām aśvatthaṃ na gām apākuryāt /
meaning: पौर्णमासीम् अष्टकाम् अमावास्यां चित्राम् अश्वत्थं न गाम् अपाकुर्यात् /
text_mt: On the full-moon day, the Aṣṭakā, the new-moon day, [the asterism] Citrā, and [near] an Aśvattha tree, he should not turn away a cow.

sanskrit_iast: govarcasaṃ guptasyeti sarpiṣas \\ ubhayeṣāṃ tvā devamanuṣyāṇām iti vyākhyātaṃ priyaṃ karomi \\ iti śrotriyasya priyāṃ karomi \\ iti kumāryāḥ patikāmāyāś ca \\ amuṣya ca \\ ity avabhṛthe /
meaning: गोवर्चसं गुप्तस्येति सर्पिषस् \\ उभयेषां त्वा देवमनुष्याणाम् इति व्याख्यातं प्रियं करोमि \\ इति श्रोत्रियस्य प्रियां करोमि \\ इति कुमार्याः पतिकामायाश् च \\ अमुष्य च \\ इत्य् अवभृथे /
text_mt: Of clarified butter [he uses the mantra] 'Splendour of the cow, of the hidden one...'; 'I make you dear to both gods and men' is explained: for a learned brāhmaṇa, 'I make [you] dear [to him]'; for a maiden desiring a husband, 'I make [you] dear [to him]'; and 'to so-and-so' at the concluding bath.

sanskrit_iast: uttaro nigade vyākhyātaḥ /
meaning: उत्तरो निगदे व्याख्यातः /
text_mt: The subsequent [formula] has been explained in the recitation.

sanskrit_iast: annādyakāmaḥ śabalīkarma kuryāt /
meaning: अन्नाद्यकामः शबलीकर्म कुर्यात् /
text_mt: One desiring food should perform the Śabalī rite.

sanskrit_iast: trayodaśyām udite yatra grāmasya paśoḥ śabdaṃ nopaśṛṇuyāt tad araṇyaṃ paretya brāhmaṇaṃ bahuvidam upaviśya darbhastambam ārabhya śabali śabaly ehi \\ iti trir āhvayet /
meaning: त्रयोदश्याम् उदिते यत्र ग्रामस्य पशोः शब्दं नोपशृणुयात् तद् अरण्यं परेत्य ब्राह्मणं बहुविदम् उपविश्य दर्भस्तम्बम् आरभ्य शबलि शबल्य् एहि \\ इति त्रिर् आह्वयेत् /
text_mt: At sunrise on the thirteenth [day], having gone to a wilderness where he cannot hear the sound of domestic cattle, having approached a learned brāhmaṇa and grasped a clump of darbha grass, he should call three times: 'O Śabalī, O Śabalī, come!'

sanskrit_iast: yad anyac chuno gardabhād vā pratiśṛṇuyāt sā samiddhiḥ /
meaning: यद् अन्यच् छुनो गर्दभाद् वा प्रतिशृणुयात् सा समिद्धिः /
text_mt: If anything other than a dog or an ass responds, that is the attainment of success.

sanskrit_iast: yadi na pratiśṛṇuyāt sam̐vatsare punar āhvayen na tṛtīyakam āhvayet /
meaning: यदि न प्रतिशृणुयात् सम्̐वत्सरे पुनर् आह्वयेन् न तृतीयकम् आह्वयेत् /
text_mt: If there is no response, he should call again after a year; he should not call a third time.

sanskrit_iast: athātaḥ śulbam̐ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: अथातः शुल्बम्̐ व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: Now, therefore, we shall explain the measuring cord.

sanskrit_iast: rajjuṃ pāśavatīm̐ samāṃ nirāyatāṃ pṛṣṭhyām̐ yathārtham upakalpayet /
meaning: रज्जुं पाशवतीम्̐ समां निरायतां पृष्ठ्याम्̐ यथार्थम् उपकल्पयेत् /
text_mt: He should prepare according to need an equal, stretched spine-cord equipped with loops.

sanskrit_iast: antareṇa citrāsvātī śravaṇapratiśravaṇau kṛttikāpratikṛttike tiṣyapunarvasū ca prāgdeśo 'yaṃ yugamātroditayoḥ pāśāñ ca /
meaning: अन्तरेण चित्रास्वाती श्रवणप्रतिश्रवणौ कृत्तिकाप्रतिकृत्तिके तिष्यपुनर्वसू च प्राग्देशो ऽयं युगमात्रोदितयोः पाशाञ् च /
text_mt: Between Citrā and Svātī, Śravaṇa and Pratiśravaṇa, Kṛttikā and Pratikṛttikā, and Tiṣya and Punarvasu, when they have risen to the height of a yoke, this is the eastern direction, and [there are] loops [for it].

sanskrit_iast:
dārśikyāḥ śayāḥ ṣaṭtāni \ sapta saptadaśaiva tu /
ekaṃ dve pañca tair mītvā \ samaraiḥ parilekhayet /
meaning:
दार्शिक्याः शयाः षट्तानि \ सप्त सप्तदशैव तु /
एकं द्वे पञ्च तैर् मीत्वा \ समरैः परिलेखयेत् /
text_mt:
The lengths of cord for the New-Moon sacrifice altar are: these six, / seven, and seventeen.

Having measured one, two, and five with them, / he should draw around them with equal cords.

sanskrit_iast: am̐sāc chroṇau rajjvantaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya prācīm anulikhed am̐se pratiṣṭhāpya pratīcīm̐ samare rajjvantaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya śroṇer adhy am̐sād anulikhet /
meaning: अम्̐साच् छ्रोणौ रज्ज्वन्तं प्रतिष्ठाप्य प्राचीम् अनुलिखेद् अम्̐से प्रतिष्ठाप्य प्रतीचीम्̐ समरे रज्ज्वन्तं प्रतिष्ठाप्य श्रोणेर् अध्य् अम्̐साद् अनुलिखेत् /
text_mt: Having placed the end of the cord at the western corner from the shoulder, he should trace toward the east; having placed it at the shoulder, [he should trace] toward the west; having placed the end of the cord at the junction, he should trace from the shoulder over the western corner.

sanskrit_iast: evam uttarataḥ purastāt paścāc ca /
meaning: एवम् उत्तरतः पुरस्तात् पश्चाच् च /
text_mt: In this manner on the north, on the east, and on the west.

sanskrit_iast:
saratniś caturasras tu \ pūrvasyāgneḥ kharo bhavet /
rathacakrākṛtiḥ paścāt\ candrārdhena tu dakṣiṇe /
meaning:
सरत्निश् चतुरस्रस् तु \ पूर्वस्याग्नेः खरो भवेत् /
रथचक्राकृतिः पश्चात्\ चन्द्रार्धेन तु दक्षिणे /
text_mt:
