The mound of the eastern fire should be / square, of one aratni's measure.

In the west, in the form of a chariot wheel; / but in the south, in the shape of a half-moon.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyāt koṭipramāṇena \ maṇḍalaṃ parilekhayet /
atiriktatribhāgena \ sarvaṃ tu sahamaṇḍalam /
caturasre 'kṣṇayā rajjur \ madhyataḥ saṃnipātayet /
parilekhyā tadardhena\ ardhamaṇḍalam eva tat /
meaning:
मध्यात् कोटिप्रमाणेन \ मण्डलं परिलेखयेत् /
अतिरिक्तत्रिभागेन \ सर्वं तु सहमण्डलम् /
चतुरस्रे ऽक्ष्णया रज्जुर् \ मध्यतः संनिपातयेत् /
परिलेख्या तदर्धेन\ अर्धमण्डलम् एव तत् /
text_mt:
From the center, with the measure of the side, / he should draw around a circle.

With an excess of one-third, / the whole is together with the circle.

In a square, with a diagonal cord, / he should make them intersect from the center.

To be drawn around with its half; / that is precisely a semicircle.

sanskrit_iast: gārhapatyāhavanīyāv antarā rajjuṃ nimāyāparasmim̐s tṛtīye lakṣaṇaṃ madhyāt turīyam utsṛjya lakṣaṇaṃ pāśāntau samāhṛtya dakṣiṇato dakṣiṇāgner lakṣaṇam /
meaning: गार्हपत्याहवनीयाव् अन्तरा रज्जुं निमायापरस्मिम्̐स् तृतीये लक्षणं मध्यात् तुरीयम् उत्सृज्य लक्षणं पाशान्तौ समाहृत्य दक्षिणतो दक्षिणाग्नेर् लक्षणम् /
text_mt: Having measured a cord between the gārhapatya and the āhavanīya, placing a mark at the western third, releasing a fourth from the middle with a mark, and bringing the ends of the loops together on the south, there is the mark of the dakṣiṇāgni.

sanskrit_iast: etad eva viparyasyottarata utkarasya lakṣaṇam /
meaning: एतद् एव विपर्यस्योत्तरत उत्करस्य लक्षणम् /
text_mt: Inverting this very same [measure] on the north, there is the mark of the rubbish heap.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvat pramāṇā rajjuḥ syāt \ tāvad evāgamo bhavet /
āgamārdhe bhavec chaṅkuḥ \ śaṅkor ardhe nirāñchanam /
meaning:
यावत् प्रमाणा रज्जुः स्यात् \ तावद् एवागमो भवेत् /
आगमार्धे भवेच् छङ्कुः \ शङ्कोर् अर्धे निराञ्छनम् /
text_mt:
Of whatever measure the cord may be, / that very much will be the extent.

At half the extent should be the peg; / at half the peg is the notch.

sanskrit_iast: samantacaturasrāṇi \ vidhir eṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ /
meaning: समन्तचतुरस्राणि \ विधिर् एषः प्रकीर्तितः /
text_mt: For equilateral squares, / this rule is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāśītiḥ śatamīṣā \ tiryagakṣaś catuḥśatam /
ṣaḍaśītir yugaṃ cāsya \ rathaś cārakya ucyate /
meaning:
अष्टाशीतिः शतमीषा \ तिर्यगक्षश् चतुःशतम् /
षडशीतिर् युगं चास्य \ रथश् चारक्य उच्यते /
text_mt:
The pole is one hundred and eighty-eight [aṅgulas]; / the axle across is one hundred and four;

and the yoke of this is eighty-six; / and this chariot is called Cārakiya.

sanskrit_iast:
īṣāyā lakṣaṇaṃ mītvā \ ṣaṭsu navasu ca lakṣaṇe /
tricatvārim̐śake pāśas\ aṅgulānāṃ niyogataḥ /
meaning:
ईषाया लक्षणं मीत्वा \ षट्सु नवसु च लक्षणे /
त्रिचत्वारिम्̐शके पाशस्\ अङ्गुलानां नियोगतः /
text_mt:
Having measured the mark of the pole, / marks at six and nine,

the loop is at the forty-third, / according to the assignment of finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā vediḥ samākhyātā \ cārakyarathasaṃmitā /
aindrāgnasya paśor eṣā / \ paśuṣv anyeṣu ṣaṭśayā /
meaning:
एषा वेदिः समाख्याता \ चारक्यरथसंमिता /
ऐन्द्राग्नस्य पशोर् एषा / \ पशुष्व् अन्येषु षट्शया /
text_mt:
This altar has been declared / as measured according to the Cārakiya chariot.

This is for the animal sacrifice to Indra and Agni; / in other animal sacrifices it is of six cords.

sanskrit_iast:
prācyardhaḥ ṣaḍaratniḥ syād \ ardhāratner nirāñchanam /
ardhe śroṇī tato 'rdhe 'm̐sau\ adhyardha iti pāśukī /
meaning:
प्राच्यर्धः षडरत्निः स्याद् \ अर्धारत्नेर् निराञ्छनम् /
अर्धे श्रोणी ततो ऽर्धे ऽम्̐सौ\ अध्यर्ध इति पाशुकी /
text_mt:
The eastern half should be six aratnis; / the notch is at half an aratni.

The western corners are at half [the cord], then the shoulders are at half [that]; / one and a half [aratnis]—such is the altar for an animal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
pāśād ardhaśaye śroṇī \ dvayoḥ pṛṣṭhyāparā dvayoḥ /
prācyardhas tu tato 'dhyardhe \ tato 'dhyardhe nirāñchanam /
ardhe 'm̐so 'dhyardha evānyas \ tato 'dhyardhe 'm̐sa uttaraḥ /
aratnau tu tataḥ pāśo \ vedī mārutī vāruṇī /
meaning:
पाशाद् अर्धशये श्रोणी \ द्वयोः पृष्ठ्यापरा द्वयोः /
प्राच्यर्धस् तु ततो ऽध्यर्धे \ ततो ऽध्यर्धे निराञ्छनम् /
अर्धे ऽम्̐सो ऽध्यर्ध एवान्यस् \ ततो ऽध्यर्धे ऽम्̐स उत्तरः /
अरत्नौ तु ततः पाशो \ वेदी मारुती वारुणी /
text_mt:
From the loop, the western corners are at half a cord; / the western spine is at two; at two,

the eastern half is at one and a half from that; / the notch is at one and a half from that.

At half is the shoulder, another is at one and a half; / from that, the northern shoulder is at one and a half.

Then at an aratni is the loop: / [such is] the altar for the Maruts and Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvā daśaśayā rajjur \ madhye cāsyā nirāñchanam /
prācyardhaṃ pañcame kuryād \ dikkuṣṭhā paitṛtkī smṛtā /
meaning:
सर्वा दशशया रज्जुर् \ मध्ये चास्या निराञ्छनम् /
प्राच्यर्धं पञ्चमे कुर्याद् \ दिक्कुष्ठा पैतृत्की स्मृता /
text_mt:
The entire cord is ten lengths; / and its notch is in the middle.

He should make the eastern half at the fifth; / oriented to the intermediate quarters, it is known as belonging to the fathers.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvā saptaśayā rajjur \ madhye cāsyā nirāñchanam /
prācyardhaṃ pañcame kuryād \ dikkuṣṭhā paitṛkī smṛtā /
meaning:
सर्वा सप्तशया रज्जुर् \ मध्ये चास्या निराञ्छनम् /
प्राच्यर्धं पञ्चमे कुर्याद् \ दिक्कुष्ठा पैतृकी स्मृता /
text_mt:
The entire cord is seven lengths; / and its notch is in the middle.

He should make the eastern half at the fifth; / oriented to the intermediate quarters, it is known as belonging to the fathers.

sanskrit_iast:
prāgvam̐śaṃ daśakaṃ kuryāt \ patnīśālāṃ catuḥśayām /
prāgvam̐śāt triṣu vedyantas\ vedyantāt prakrame sadaḥ /
meaning:
प्राग्वम्̐शं दशकं कुर्यात् \ पत्नीशालां चतुःशयाम् /
प्राग्वम्̐शात् त्रिषु वेद्यन्तस्\ वेद्यन्तात् प्रक्रमे सदः /
text_mt:
One should make the prāgvaṃśa ten [steps long], and the patnīśālā four śayas [long].

Three [steps] from the prāgvaṃśa is the end of the vedi; one prakrama from the end of the vedi is the sadas.

sanskrit_iast:
navakaṃ tu sado vidyāt\ catvāraḥ sadaso 'ntaram /
catvāras trikā havirdhānam \ ardhaṣaṣṭhas tad anantaram /
meaning:
नवकं तु सदो विद्यात्\ चत्वारः सदसो ऽन्तरम् /
चत्वारस् त्रिका हविर्धानम् \ अर्धषष्ठस् तद् अनन्तरम् /
text_mt:
One should know the sadas to be nine [steps long]; the interval of the sadas is four [steps].

Four triads [i.e., twelve steps] is the havirdhāna shed; five and a half is next to that.

sanskrit_iast:
padam̐ yūpāvaṭe mītvā \ śeṣam auttaravedikam /
āgnīdhram̐ ṣaḍaratny eva \ ṣaṭtrim̐śatprakramā rajjuḥ /
meaning:
पदम्̐ यूपावटे मीत्वा \ शेषम् औत्तरवेदिकम् /
आग्नीध्रम्̐ षडरत्न्य् एव \ षट्त्रिम्̐शत्प्रक्रमा रज्जुः /
text_mt:
Having measured a pada for the post-hole of the sacrificial post, the remainder belongs to the high altar.

The āgnīdhra shed is six cubits [aratnis]; the cord is thirty-six prakramas.

sanskrit_iast: lakṣikā dvādaśa trikā / vedisadohavirdhānāni minoty evānupūrvaśaḥ pañcadaśakam ekavim̐śakaṃ trikam aparaṃ parato 'paras triko dvādaśasu ca pāśada ucyate / some rajjunimānam uttamam /
meaning: लक्षिका द्वादश त्रिका / वेदिसदोहविर्धानानि मिनोत्य् एवानुपूर्वशः पञ्चदशकम् एकविम्̐शकं त्रिकम् अपरं परतो ऽपरस् त्रिको द्वादशसु च पाशद उच्यते / सोमे रज्जुनिमानम् उत्तमम् /
text_mt: Marked [with units of] twelve and triads. He measures out the vedi, the sadas, and the havirdhāna shed in order: a fifteenfold [space], a twenty-onefold [space], a triad on the other [side], further on another triad; and at twelve [units], a cord-knot is stated. This is the highest measuring of the cord in the soma [sacrifice].

sanskrit_iast:
tripadā pārśvamānī syāt \ tiryaṅmānī padaṃ bhavet /
tasyākṣṇayā tu yā rajjuḥ \ kuryād daśapadāṃ tayā /
meaning:
त्रिपदा पार्श्वमानी स्यात् \ तिर्यङ्मानी पदं भवेत् /
तस्याक्ष्णया तु या रज्जुः \ कुर्याद् दशपदां तया /
text_mt:
The longitudinal side should be three padas; the transverse side should be one pada.

With that diagonal cord, one should make [the line] ten padas long.

sanskrit_iast:
pādād ardhaṃ caturdaśe \ navake tu tataḥ punaḥ /
ardhacaturdaśaḥ pāśaḥ \ sadasaś chedanam uttamam /
meaning:
पादाद् अर्धं चतुर्दशे \ नवके तु ततः पुनः /
अर्धचतुर्दशः पाशः \ सदसश् छेदनम् उत्तमम् /
text_mt:
Half a step beyond the fourteenth, and then again at the ninth [step]:

at thirteen and a half is the cord-knot; [this is] the highest dividing of the sadas.

sanskrit_iast: nimāya rajjuṃ daśabhī rathākṣair ekādaśabhiś coparabudhnamātrais tasyāś caturvim̐śatibhāgadheyam ekādaśinīṃ prati vedim āhuḥ /
meaning: निमाय रज्जुं दशभी रथाक्षैर् एकादशभिश् चोपरबुध्नमात्रैस् तस्याश् चतुर्विम्̐शतिभागधेयम् एकादशिनीं प्रति वेदिम् आहुः /
text_mt: Having measured the cord with ten axle lengths of a chariot and eleven lengths of the base of an uparā, they say a twenty-fourth part of it is the vedi for the set of eleven [posts].

sanskrit_iast:
śikhaṇḍinī cet kartavyā \ vedyantād dvyardham uddharet /
aṣṭāṅgulaṃ tadardham̐ syād \ devyavediprasiddhaye /
taṃ prāñcaṃ tu samīkṣeta \ tāṃs tu vidyāc chikhaṇḍinīm /
meaning:
शिखण्डिनी चेत् कर्तव्या \ वेद्यन्ताद् द्व्यर्धम् उद्धरेत् /
अष्टाङ्गुलं तदर्धम्̐ स्याद् \ देव्यवेदिप्रसिद्धये /
तं प्राञ्चं तु समीक्षेत \ तांस् तु विद्याच् छिखण्डिनीम् /
text_mt:
If a crested [vedi] is to be made, one should raise two and a half [measures] from the end of the vedi.

Half of that should be eight aṅgulas, for the sake of establishing the goddess-vedi.

One should look towards it pointing eastward; and one should know those to be crested.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcakam̐ saptakaṃ caiva \ ekamekaṃ tataḥ punaḥ /
eṣā vediḥ samākhyātā \ kaukilyās tv atha cārake /
meaning:
पञ्चकम्̐ सप्तकं चैव \ एकमेकं ततः पुनः /
एषा वेदिः समाख्याता \ कौकिल्यास् त्व् अथ चारके /
text_mt:
Fivefold and sevenfold, and then each one singly:

this vedi has been declared in the Kaukilī and Cāraka [traditions].

sanskrit_iast:
janmanā rogahīno vā \ yajamāno bhaved yadi /
kathaṃ tatra pramāṇāni \ prayoktavyāni kartṛbhiḥ /
meaning:
जन्मना रोगहीनो वा \ यजमानो भवेद् यदि /
कथं तत्र प्रमाणानि \ प्रयोक्तव्यानि कर्तृभिः /
text_mt:
If the sacrificer should be devoid of disease from birth,

how then are the measures to be applied there by the performers?

sanskrit_iast:
tuṇḍaṃ puṣkaranālasya \ ṣaḍguṇaṃ pariveṣṭitam /
trihāyaṇyā vatsataryā \ valena samamiṣyate /
meaning:
तुण्डं पुष्करनालस्य \ षड्गुणं परिवेष्टितम् /
त्रिहायण्या वत्सतर्या \ वलेन सममिष्यते /
text_mt:
The tip of a lotus stem, wound sixfold,

is held to be equal to the hair of a three-year-old heifer.

sanskrit_iast:
trayas trihāyaṇīvālāḥ \ sarṣapārdham̐ vidhīyate /
dviguṇam̐ sarṣapaṃ prāhur \ yavaḥ sarṣapār ... /
meaning:
त्रयस् त्रिहायणीवालाः \ सर्षपार्धम्̐ विधीयते /
द्विगुणम्̐ सर्षपं प्राहुर् \ यवः सर्षपार् ... /
text_mt:
Three hairs of a three-year-old [heifer] are prescribed as half a mustard-seed.

Twice that they call a mustard-seed; a barleycorn is [...] mustard-seeds.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgulasya pramāṇaṃ tu \ ṣaḍyavāḥ pārśvasam̐hitāḥ /
daśāṅgulas tu prādeśas\ vitastir dvādaśāṅgulaḥ /
dvivitastir aratniḥ syād \ vyāyām astu catuḥśayaḥ /
meaning:
अङ्गुलस्य प्रमाणं तु \ षड्यवाः पार्श्वसम्̐हिताः /
दशाङ्गुलस् तु प्रादेशस्\ वितस्तिर् द्वादशाङ्गुलः /
द्विवितस्तिर् अरत्निः स्याद् \ व्यायाम् अस्तु चतुःशयः /
text_mt:
The measure of an aṅgula is six barleycorns joined side by side.

A span (prādeśa) is ten aṅgulas; a vitasti is twelve aṅgulas.

Two vitastis is an aratni; a vyāyāma is four śayas.

sanskrit_iast:
vim̐śatiśatāṅgulataḥ \ puruṣaḥ svaiḥsvair aṅguliparvabhiḥ /
atha cet prapadotthānaḥ \ pañcavim̐śaśato bhavet /
meaning:
विम्̐शतिशताङ्गुलतः \ पुरुषः स्वैःस्वैर् अङ्गुलिपर्वभिः /
अथ चेत् प्रपदोत्थानः \ पञ्चविम्̐शशतो भवेत् /
text_mt:
A puruṣa is one hundred and twenty aṅgulas by his own finger-joints.

If he stands on the tips of his toes, he is one hundred and twenty-five [aṅgulas].

sanskrit_iast:
triyavaṃ kṛṣṇalam̐ vidyāt \ taṃ mānam̐ vidyāt trikṛṣṇalam /
anena kṛṣṇalapramāṇena \ niṣkam āhuś caturguṇam /
meaning:
त्रियवं कृष्णलम्̐ विद्यात् \ तं मानम्̐ विद्यात् त्रिकृष्णलम् /
अनेन कृष्णलप्रमाणेन \ निष्कम् आहुश् चतुर्गुणम् /
text_mt:
One should know three barleycorns to be a kṛṣṇala; that measure one should know as three kṛṣṇalas.

By this measure of a kṛṣṇala, they say a niṣka is fourfold [that].

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣasya tṛtīyapañcamau bhāgau \ tatkaraṇaṃ punaściteḥ /
tasyārdham athāparaṃ bhavet tricitikam agnicitiś cet /
meaning:
पुरुषस्य तृतीयपञ्चमौ भागौ \ तत्करणं पुनश्चितेः /
तस्यार्धम् अथापरं भवेत् त्रिचितिकम् अग्निचितिश् चेत् /
text_mt:
A third and a fifth part of a puruṣa: that is the measuring-instrument for the piling again.

Half of that should then be the other, if the fire-piling consists of three layers.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāvaṣṭau saṃmitā citir aṣṭaikādaśikā ca madhyamā /
vyatyāsavatīr upanyased aṣṭau dvādaśa cottamā citiḥ //
aṣṭau dvādaśa cottamā citir iti /
meaning:
अष्टावष्टौ संमिता चितिर् अष्टैकादशिका च मध्यमा /
व्यत्यासवतीर् उपन्यसेद् अष्टौ द्वादश चोत्तमा चितिः //
अष्टौ द्वादश चोत्तमा चितिर् इति /
text_mt: Eight by eight is the measured layer, and the middle layer is eight by eleven. / One should place them alternating; eight by twelve is the topmost layer. // "Eight by twelve is the topmost layer."

sanskrit_iast: athāta uttareṣṭakam̐ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: अथात उत्तरेष्टकम्̐ व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: Now, therefore, we shall explain the upper bricks.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvabāhunā yajamānena veṇum̐ vimimīte /
meaning: ऊर्ध्वबाहुना यजमानेन वेणुम्̐ विमिमीते /
text_mt: He measures out a bamboo reed by [the height of] the sacrificer with arms raised.

sanskrit_iast: tatsamo 'nyataraḥ sāratnir dvitīyas tasya puruṣe lakṣaṇam aratnivitastyoś cobhayor ardhapuruṣe /
meaning: तत्समो ऽन्यतरः सारत्निर् द्वितीयस् तस्य पुरुषे लक्षणम् अरत्निवितस्त्योश् चोभयोर् अर्धपुरुषे /
text_mt: The other is equal to that [puruṣa] together with an aratni; the second has its mark at a puruṣa, and both [have marks] at an aratni and a vitasti at half a puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast: śirasi pariśrite yūpāyāvaśiṣya śeṣam anurajju puruṣau saṃdhāya pañcāṅgyā śaṅkum̐ vinihanti tayoḥ saṃdhāv ardhayoś ca /
meaning: शिरसि परिश्रिते यूपायावशिष्य शेषम् अनुरज्जु पुरुषौ संधाय पञ्चाङ्ग्या शङ्कुम्̐ विनिहन्ति तयोः संधाव् अर्धयोश् च /
text_mt: When the head is enclosed, having left [space] for the sacrificial post, having joined the two puruṣa [lengths] along the cord for the remainder, he drives in a peg with a five-part cord at the junction of the two and at their halves.

sanskrit_iast: yāv abhito madhyamam̐ śaṅkuṃ tayor veṇū nidhāya dakṣiṇataḥ puruṣasaṃnipāte todaṃ karoti /
meaning: याव् अभितो मध्यमम्̐ शङ्कुं तयोर् वेणू निधाय दक्षिणतः पुरुषसंनिपाते तोदं करोति /
text_mt: Placing the two bamboo reeds on the two [pegs] on both sides of the middle peg, he makes a mark to the south where the puruṣa [lengths] meet.

sanskrit_iast: madhyame śaṅkau veṇuṃ nidhāyādhyadhi todam̐ hṛtvā dakṣiṇataḥ puruṣe śaṅkuṃ nihanti /
meaning: मध्यमे शङ्कौ वेणुं निधायाध्यधि तोदम्̐ हृत्वा दक्षिणतः पुरुषे शङ्कुं निहन्ति /
text_mt: Placing a bamboo reed on the middle peg and carrying it over the mark, he drives in a peg to the south at the puruṣa [length].

sanskrit_iast: pūrve śaṅkau veṇuṃ nidhāya dvitīyaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ purastāt puruṣasaṃnipāte śaṅkuṃ nihanty ardhe caivaṃ paścāt /
meaning: पूर्वे शङ्कौ वेणुं निधाय द्वितीयं दक्षिणतः पुरस्तात् पुरुषसंनिपाते शङ्कुं निहन्त्य् अर्धे चैवं पश्चात् /
text_mt: Placing a bamboo reed on the eastern peg, he drives in a second peg to the south where the puruṣa [lengths] meet in the east, and likewise at the half in the west.

sanskrit_iast: etenottarārdho vyākhyātaḥ /
meaning: एतेनोत्तरार्धो व्याख्यातः /
text_mt: By this the northern half has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇasya vargasya yāv abhito madhyamam̐ śaṅkum̐ tayor veṇū nidhāya dakṣiṇataḥ puruṣasaṃnipāte todaṃ karoti /
meaning: दक्षिणस्य वर्गस्य याव् अभितो मध्यमम्̐ शङ्कुम्̐ तयोर् वेणू निधाय दक्षिणतः पुरुषसंनिपाते तोदं करोति /
text_mt: Placing the two bamboo reeds on the two [pegs] on both sides of the middle peg of the southern group, he makes a mark to the south where the puruṣa [lengths] meet.

sanskrit_iast: madhyame śaṅkau veṇuṃ nidhāyādhyadhi todam̐ hṛtvā dakṣiṇataḥ sāratnau śaṅkuṃ nihanti /
meaning: मध्यमे शङ्कौ वेणुं निधायाध्यधि तोदम्̐ हृत्वा दक्षिणतः सारत्नौ शङ्कुं निहन्ति /
text_mt: Placing a bamboo reed on the middle peg and carrying it over the mark, he drives in a peg to the south at the [measure of a puruṣa] with an aratni.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ sāratnis taṃ madhyamasya pūrve nidhāya dvitīyaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ purastāt sāratnim ardhapuruṣeṇa saṃnipātya śaṅkuṃ nihanty evaṃ paścāt /
meaning: यः सारत्निस् तं मध्यमस्य पूर्वे निधाय द्वितीयं दक्षिणतः पुरस्तात् सारत्निम् अर्धपुरुषेण संनिपात्य शङ्कुं निहन्त्य् एवं पश्चात् /
text_mt: Placing that which is with an aratni to the east of the middle [peg], and bringing a second [reed] to meet that with an aratni to the south in the east by half a puruṣa, he drives in a peg; likewise in the west.

sanskrit_iast: etenaivottarapakṣo vyākhyātaḥ /
meaning: एतेनैवोत्तरपक्षो व्याख्यातः /
text_mt: By this very [procedure] the northern wing has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: pucham̐ savitastir aratnisthāne /
meaning: पुछम्̐ सवितस्तिर् अरत्निस्थाने /
text_mt: The tail has a vitasti in place of the aratni.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvasya purastād ardhapuruṣeṇa pañcāṅgyā śiro vimimīte /
meaning: पूर्वस्य पुरस्ताद् अर्धपुरुषेण पञ्चाङ्ग्या शिरो विमिमीते /
text_mt: To the east of the eastern [peg], he measures out the head with half a puruṣa by means of a five-part cord.

sanskrit_iast: vyāyāmasyāṣṭamam ekatas turīyam ekata ubhayatas turīyaṃ ca te gārhapatyaciteḥ karaṇe /
meaning: व्यायामस्याष्टमम् एकतस् तुरीयम् एकत उभयतस् तुरीयं च ते गार्हपत्यचितेः करणे /
text_mt: One-eighth of a vyāyāma on one side, one-fourth on one side, and one-fourth on both sides: those are the measuring-moulds for the gārhapatya piling.

sanskrit_iast: puruṣasya daśamena bhāgena prathamaṃ caturasraṃ karaṇaṃ kārayed daśamam ekato 'rdham ekatas tad dvitīyaṃ daśamam ekato 'dhyardham ekatas tat tṛtīyam ubhayatas turīyaṃ tac caturtham /
meaning: पुरुषस्य दशमेन भागेन प्रथमं चतुरस्रं करणं कारयेद् दशमम् एकतो ऽर्धम् एकतस् तद् द्वितीयं दशमम् एकतो ऽध्यर्धम् एकतस् तत् तृतीयम् उभयतस् तुरीयं तच् चतुर्थम् /
text_mt: With a tenth part of a puruṣa he should make the first square mould; a tenth on one side and half on the other is that second [mould]; a tenth on one side and one and a half on the other is that third [mould]; one-fourth on both sides is that fourth [mould].

sanskrit_iast: tāsām utsedhas trim̐śat pañcamabhāgenānyatra nākasadbhyaś ca cūḍābhya ṛtavyābhyo 'tha madhyamāyāṃ pañcamaṣaṣṭhībhyaś ca vaiśvadevībhyas tā ardhotsedhāḥ /
meaning: तासाम् उत्सेधस् त्रिम्̐शत् पञ्चमभागेनान्यत्र नाकसद्भ्यश् च चूडाभ्य ऋतव्याभ्यो ऽथ मध्यमायां पञ्चमषष्ठीभ्यश् च वैश्वदेवीभ्यस् ता अर्धोत्सेधाः /
text_mt: Their height is thirty [aṅgulas] by a fifth part, except for the nākasad, cūḍā, and seasonal (ṛtavyā) bricks; and on the middle [layer] for the fifth and sixth and the vaiśvadevī bricks: these are half that height.

sanskrit_iast: purīṣam antardhāyottarām upadadhyād gaṇasam̐sargāyāvichedāya /
meaning: पुरीषम् अन्तर्धायोत्तराम् उपदध्याद् गणसम्̐सर्गायाविछेदाय /
text_mt: Having strewn loose earth in between, he should lay the next layer for joining the group and for continuity.

sanskrit_iast: garteṣūpadadhyād yad anyad iṣṭakābhyaḥ /
meaning: गर्तेषूपदध्याद् यद् अन्यद् इष्टकाभ्यः /
text_mt: In cavities he should place whatever is other than bricks.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra śloko bhavati
ukhāyāḥ paśuśīrṣāṇām\ kūrmasyolūkhalasya ca /
srucoḥ kumbheṣṭakānāṃ ca \ caroś caivāvaṭān khanet /
meaning:
तत्र श्लोको भवति
उखायाः पशुशीर्षाणाम्\ कूर्मस्योलूखलस्य च /
स्रुचोः कुम्भेष्टकानां च \ चरोश् चैवावटान् खनेत् /
text_mt:
For the ukhā pot, the animal heads, / the tortoise, and the mortar,

and for the two ladles, the jar-bricks, / and the caru, he should dig cavities.

sanskrit_iast: pratidiśam upadadhyād ātmani madhye prācīḥ śirasi puche pakṣayoś cātmany apyayeśu samam̐ vibhajyottarāmuttarām apyayasam̐hitāṃ pūrvāparadakṣiṇottarā viṣayavacanād anyac catasraḥ purastāt pañcartavyābhyaḥ paścāc cottarapūrve cārdhe gārhapatyasya / śeṣaṃ caturasrābhiḥ /
meaning: प्रतिदिशम् उपदध्याद् आत्मनि मध्ये प्राचीः शिरसि पुछे पक्षयोश् चात्मन्य् अप्ययेशु समम्̐ विभज्योत्तरामुत्तराम् अप्ययसम्̐हितां पूर्वापरदक्षिणोत्तरा विषयवचनाद् अन्यच् चतस्रः पुरस्तात् पञ्चर्तव्याभ्यः पश्चाच् चोत्तरपूर्वे चार्धे गार्हपत्यस्य / शेषं चतुरस्राभिः /
text_mt: He should lay [the bricks] facing east in the middle of the body in each direction, on the head, the tail, and the two wings; and having divided evenly at the junctures on the body, [he places] each subsequent [brick] contiguous to the junction, [oriented] east-west or south-north according to the rule of the region, except four in front of the five seasonal bricks, and behind, and in the northeastern half of the gārhapatya [hearth]. The rest [he fills] with square [bricks].

sanskrit_iast: etā eva dakṣiṇottarā dvitīyasyām̐ śeṣaṃ caturasrābhiḥ /
meaning: एता एव दक्षिणोत्तरा द्वितीयस्याम्̐ शेषं चतुरस्राभिः /
text_mt: These very [bricks] are north-south in the second [layer]; the rest with square [bricks].

sanskrit_iast: yathā prathamaivaṃ tṛtīyā pañcamī ca yathā dvitīyaivaṃ caturthy etena dharmeṇa vyatyāsaṃ cinuyāt /
meaning: यथा प्रथमैवं तृतीया पञ्चमी च यथा द्वितीयैवं चतुर्थ्य् एतेन धर्मेण व्यत्यासं चिनुयात् /
text_mt: As the first [layer is], so is the third and the fifth; as the second, so the fourth: according to this rule he should pile alternately.

sanskrit_iast: athetarān āgnīdhrīyādīn navanava padāni karoty ekaikaṃ madhye 'śmānam āgnīdhrīye catvāricatvāri turīyāṇi pratidiśam̐ hotrīye catasro 'rdhāḥ kuṣṭhāsu brāhmaṇācham̐sya itareṣāṃ dvedve adhyardhe madhye prācīḥ ṣaḍ eva mārjālīye paśuśrapaṇe ca /
meaning: अथेतरान् आग्नीध्रीयादीन् नवनव पदानि करोत्य् एकैकं मध्ये ऽश्मानम् आग्नीध्रीये चत्वारिचत्वारि तुरीयाणि प्रतिदिशम्̐ होत्रीये चतस्रो ऽर्धाः कुष्ठासु ब्राह्मणाछम्̐स्य इतरेषां द्वेद्वे अध्यर्धे मध्ये प्राचीः षड् एव मार्जालीये पशुश्रपणे च /
text_mt: Then, for the other [hearths] beginning with the āgnīdhra, he makes nine padas each: one stone in the middle of the āgnīdhra; four fourth-parts in each direction in the hotṛ's hearth; four halves on the corners in the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin's hearth; for the others, two one-and-a-half-sized bricks in the middle pointing east; six in the mārjālīya and the animal-cooking hearth.

sanskrit_iast: vim̐śatim adhyardhāḥ prācīr am̐sayor dadyāc chroṇyoḥ puche ca vim̐śatiṃ dvādaśadvādaśa purastāt pakṣyoḥ prācīḥ paścāc ca pañcapañca codīcīr abhitaḥ śirasi / śeṣaṃ caturasrābhiḥ /
meaning: विम्̐शतिम् अध्यर्धाः प्राचीर् अम्̐सयोर् दद्याच् छ्रोण्योः पुछे च विम्̐शतिं द्वादशद्वादश पुरस्तात् पक्ष्योः प्राचीः पश्चाच् च पञ्चपञ्च चोदीचीर् अभितः शिरसि / शेषं चतुरस्राभिः /
text_mt: vim̐śatim adhyardhāḥ prācīr am̐sayor dadyāc chroṇyoḥ puche ca vim̐śatiṃ dvādaśadvādaśa purastāt pakṣyoḥ prācīḥ paścāc ca pañcapañca codīcīr abhitaḥ śirasi / śeṣaṃ caturasrābhiḥ

sanskrit_iast: vim̐śatim̐ śroṇyam̐sapakṣeṣūdīcīr dakṣiṇatas tathottarato dvitīyasyām ekādaśaikādaśābhitaḥ puche pañcapañca prācīr abhitaḥ śirasi / śeṣaṃ caturasrābhiḥ /
meaning: विम्̐शतिम्̐ श्रोण्यम्̐सपक्षेषूदीचीर् दक्षिणतस् तथोत्तरतो द्वितीयस्याम् एकादशैकादशाभितः पुछे पञ्चपञ्च प्राचीर् अभितः शिरसि / शेषं चतुरस्राभिः /
text_mt: vim̐śatim̐ śroṇyam̐sapakṣeṣūdīcīr dakṣiṇatas tathottarato dvitīyasyām ekādaśaikādaśābhitaḥ puche pañcapañca prācīr abhitaḥ śirasi / śeṣaṃ caturasrābhiḥ

sanskrit_iast: yathā prathamaivaṃ tṛtīyā pañcamī ca yathā dvitīyaivaṃ caturthy etena dharmeṇa vyatyāsaṃ cinuyāt /
meaning: यथा प्रथमैवं तृतीया पञ्चमी च यथा द्वितीयैवं चतुर्थ्य् एतेन धर्मेण व्यत्यासं चिनुयात् /
text_mt: yathā prathamaivaṃ tṛtīyā pañcamī ca yathā dvitīyaivaṃ caturthy etena dharmeṇa vyatyāsaṃ cinuyāt

sanskrit_iast: trir upasatsu dve pūrvasyāṃ tisro madhyamāyām̐ ṣaṭsu yathānupūrveṇa dvādaśasu vyatyāsaṃ citipurīṣe karoti /
meaning: त्रिर् उपसत्सु द्वे पूर्वस्यां तिस्रो मध्यमायाम्̐ षट्सु यथानुपूर्वेण द्वादशसु व्यत्यासं चितिपुरीषे करोति /
text_mt: trir upasatsu dve pūrvasyāṃ tisro madhyamāyām̐ ṣaṭsu yathānupūrveṇa dvādaśasu vyatyāsaṃ citipurīṣe karoti

sanskrit_iast: etena dharmeṇa sam̐vatsarāt samam̐ vibhajya jānudaghne 'sya dviguṇaṃ triguṇam uttareṣāṃ caikām uttarām uddhatyābhyāyanam̐ vardhāyātiriktā upadadhyāt /
meaning: एतेन धर्मेण सम्̐वत्सरात् समम्̐ विभज्य जानुदघ्ने ऽस्य द्विगुणं त्रिगुणम् उत्तरेषां चैकाम् उत्तराम् उद्धत्याभ्यायनम्̐ वर्धायातिरिक्ता उपदध्यात् /
text_mt: etena dharmeṇa sam̐vatsarāt samam̐ vibhajya jānudaghne 'sya dviguṇaṃ triguṇam uttareṣāṃ caikām uttarām uddhatyābhyāyanam̐ vardhāyātiriktā upadadhyāt

sanskrit_iast: mantrādy abhimarśanāntaṃ tat puruṣasya lakṣaṇam /
meaning: मन्त्राद्य् अभिमर्शनान्तं तत् पुरुषस्य लक्षणम् /
text_mt: mantrādy abhimarśanāntaṃ tat puruṣasya lakṣaṇam

sanskrit_iast: darbhastambaṃ puṣkaraparṇam̐ rukmapuruṣau hiraṇyeṣṭakām̐ śarkarām̐ svayamātṛṇṇāṃ dūrveṣṭakā naivāram iti madhyaṃ [ ā pañcam āśram̐ svayamātṛṇṇāyā abhitas tāṃ madhyaṃ ] / tasmin kumbheṣṭakā yā madhye dakṣiṇottare ca srucāv anūpamadhyeṣu śeṣāḥ paścāt svayamātṛṇṇāyāḥ kulāyinīṃ dviyajuś ca vam̐śayoḥ pārśvasam̐hite dviyajur uttare purastād retaḥsicau dve dakṣiṇe tasmin vam̐śe dvitīyām ṛtavyāṃ ca purastāc caturthe loke retaḥsicam̐ viśvajyotiṣaṃ maṇḍalām ṛtavyāṃ gharmeṣṭakām aṣāḍhāṃ kūrmam̐ vṛṣabham iti prāñcam uttare vam̐śe dakṣiṇataḥ purastāt svayamātṛṇṇāyāḥ prāñcam ulūkhalamusalam uttarapūrvye cokhāṃ madhye śirasām̐ śirobhiḥ sam̐hitām upadadhāti /
meaning: दर्भस्तम्बं पुष्करपर्णम्̐ रुक्मपुरुषौ हिरण्येष्टकाम्̐ शर्कराम्̐ स्वयमातृण्णां दूर्वेष्टका नैवारम् इति मध्यं [ आ पञ्चम् आश्रम्̐ स्वयमातृण्णाया अभितस् तां मध्यं ] / तस्मिन् कुम्भेष्टका या मध्ये दक्षिणोत्तरे च स्रुचाव् अनूपमध्येषु शेषाः पश्चात् स्वयमातृण्णायाः कुलायिनीं द्वियजुश् च वम्̐शयोः पार्श्वसम्̐हिते द्वियजुर् उत्तरे पुरस्ताद् रेतःसिचौ द्वे दक्षिणे तस्मिन् वम्̐शे द्वितीयाम् ऋतव्यां च पुरस्ताच् चतुर्थे लोके रेतःसिचम्̐ विश्वज्योतिषं मण्डलाम् ऋतव्यां घर्मेष्टकाम् अषाढां कूर्मम्̐ वृषभम् इति प्राञ्चम् उत्तरे वम्̐शे दक्षिणतः पुरस्तात् स्वयमातृण्णायाः प्राञ्चम् उलूखलमुसलम् उत्तरपूर्व्ये चोखां मध्ये शिरसाम्̐ शिरोभिः सम्̐हिताम् उपदधाति /
text_mt: darbhastambaṃ puṣkaraparṇam̐ rukmapuruṣau hiraṇyeṣṭakām̐ śarkarām̐ svayamātṛṇṇāṃ dūrveṣṭakā naivāram iti madhyaṃ [ ā pañcam āśram̐ svayamātṛṇṇāyā abhitas tāṃ madhyaṃ ] / tasmin kumbheṣṭakā yā madhye dakṣiṇottare ca srucāv anūpamadhyeṣu śeṣāḥ paścāt svayamātṛṇṇāyāḥ kulāyinīṃ dviyajuś ca vam̐śayoḥ pārśvasam̐hite dviyajur uttare purastād retaḥsicau dve dakṣiṇe tasmin vam̐śe dvitīyām ṛtavyāṃ ca purastāc caturthe loke retaḥsicam̐ viśvajyotiṣaṃ maṇḍalām ṛtavyāṃ gharmeṣṭakām aṣāḍhāṃ kūrmam̐ vṛṣabham iti prāñcam uttare vam̐śe dakṣiṇataḥ purastāt svayamātṛṇṇāyāḥ prāñcam ulūkhalamusalam uttarapūrvye cokhāṃ madhye śirasām̐ śirobhiḥ sam̐hitām upadadhāti

sanskrit_iast: tasyāḥ paścāt puruṣaśirasaḥ puruṣacitim upadadhāti ṣaṭtrim̐śataṃ pratīcīs trivargeṇa śroṇyām /
meaning: तस्याः पश्चात् पुरुषशिरसः पुरुषचितिम् उपदधाति षट्त्रिम्̐शतं प्रतीचीस् त्रिवर्गेण श्रोण्याम् /
text_mt: tasyāḥ paścāt puruṣaśirasaḥ puruṣacitim upadadhāti ṣaṭtrim̐śataṃ pratīcīs trivargeṇa śroṇyām
