tisro grīvāḥ ṣaḍam̐sayor \ dvedve bāhvor navātmani

uṅghayoru pañca paścād \ ekaikaṃ pāṇipādayoḥ

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭāv athāpasyāḥ samam̐ vibhajya vam̐śeṣu navamenavame prāṇabhṛtaḥ purastāduttare vam̐śe prathamaṃ paścāddakṣiṇe dakṣiṇataḥ pūrva uttarataḥ paścāddakṣiṇataḥ svayamātṛṇṇāyā dvitīye pañcamam anūpeṣu sam̐yato navame 'timātrā yathā prāṇabhṛtaḥ purastāddakṣiṇe vam̐śe prathamaṃ paścāduttare dakṣiṇataḥ paścāduttarataḥ pūrva uttarataḥ svayamātṛṇṇāyā dvitīye pañcamam̐ / vaiśvadevyaś cānūpeṣu pratidiśam uttarapūrveṣu vam̐śeṣvādyā / dakṣiṇottare ca sam̐yānyāv apyaye tayor vam̐śayor ādyāt purastād vātharvaśiraḥ /
meaning: अष्टाव् अथापस्याः समम्̐ विभज्य वम्̐शेषु नवमेनवमे प्राणभृतः पुरस्तादुत्तरे वम्̐शे प्रथमं पश्चाद्दक्षिणे दक्षिणतः पूर्व उत्तरतः पश्चाद्दक्षिणतः स्वयमातृण्णाया द्वितीये पञ्चमम् अनूपेषु सम्̐यतो नवमे ऽतिमात्रा यथा प्राणभृतः पुरस्ताद्दक्षिणे वम्̐शे प्रथमं पश्चादुत्तरे दक्षिणतः पश्चादुत्तरतः पूर्व उत्तरतः स्वयमातृण्णाया द्वितीये पञ्चमम्̐ / वैश्वदेव्यश् चानूपेषु प्रतिदिशम् उत्तरपूर्वेषु वम्̐शेष्वाद्या / दक्षिणोत्तरे च सम्̐यान्याव् अप्यये तयोर् वम्̐शयोर् आद्यात् पुरस्ताद् वाथर्वशिरः /
text_mt: aṣṭāv athāpasyāḥ samam̐ vibhajya vam̐śeṣu navamenavame prāṇabhṛtaḥ purastāduttare vam̐śe prathamaṃ paścāddakṣiṇe dakṣiṇataḥ pūrva uttarataḥ paścāddakṣiṇataḥ svayamātṛṇṇāyā dvitīye pañcamam anūpeṣu sam̐yato navame 'timātrā yathā prāṇabhṛtaḥ purastāddakṣiṇe vam̐śe prathamaṃ paścāduttare dakṣiṇataḥ paścāduttarataḥ pūrva uttarataḥ svayamātṛṇṇāyā dvitīye pañcamam̐ / vaiśvadevyaś cānūpeṣu pratidiśam uttarapūrveṣu vam̐śeṣvādyā / dakṣiṇottare ca sam̐yānyāv apyaye tayor vam̐śayor ādyāt purastād vātharvaśiraḥ

sanskrit_iast: samam̐ vibhajya vam̐śeṣu śiraḥ pakṣapuchāni prathameṣu vam̐śeṣu lokān vijānīyāt /
meaning: समम्̐ विभज्य वम्̐शेषु शिरः पक्षपुछानि प्रथमेषु वम्̐शेषु लोकान् विजानीयात् /
text_mt: samam̐ vibhajya vam̐śeṣu śiraḥ pakṣapuchāni prathameṣu vam̐śeṣu lokān vijānīyāt

sanskrit_iast: śirasi prathame vam̐śa uttarāmuttarām itareṣāṃ pakṣapuchānāṃ caturthe pakṣayoḥ prācīḥ puche codīcīr lokeṣṭakā upadadhyāc cheṣāḥ paścāt svayamātṛṇṇāyā ekaikāṃ pūrvām̐ sam̐hitāṃ dakṣiṇe vam̐śe vaiśvadevyādya uttare ca purīṣādyaḥ /
meaning: शिरसि प्रथमे वम्̐श उत्तरामुत्तराम् इतरेषां पक्षपुछानां चतुर्थे पक्षयोः प्राचीः पुछे चोदीचीर् लोकेष्टका उपदध्याच् छेषाः पश्चात् स्वयमातृण्णाया एकैकां पूर्वाम्̐ सम्̐हितां दक्षिणे वम्̐शे वैश्वदेव्याद्य उत्तरे च पुरीषाद्यः /
text_mt: śirasi prathame vam̐śa uttarāmuttarām itareṣāṃ pakṣapuchānāṃ caturthe pakṣayoḥ prācīḥ puche codīcīr lokeṣṭakā upadadhyāc cheṣāḥ paścāt svayamātṛṇṇāyā ekaikāṃ pūrvām̐ sam̐hitāṃ dakṣiṇe vam̐śe vaiśvadevyādya uttare ca purīṣādyaḥ

sanskrit_iast: gāyatraṃ madhye śirasi rathaṃtaraṃ bṛhad yajñāyajñiyam iti yathāmnātam /
meaning: गायत्रं मध्ये शिरसि रथंतरं बृहद् यज्ञायज्ञियम् इति यथाम्नातम् /
text_mt: gāyatraṃ madhye śirasi rathaṃtaraṃ bṛhad yajñāyajñiyam iti yathāmnātam

sanskrit_iast: dvitīyāyāṃ purastāt svayamātṛṇṇāyāḥ prathamadvitīyatṛtīyeṣv ṛtavyā vāyavyā apasyā iti yathāsaṃkhyaṃ tisrastisro dakṣiṇeṣu vam̐śeṣu dakṣiṇottarā dvedve uttarasyottarayor navame 'bhitaḥ śeṣā yathāpasyāḥ /
meaning: द्वितीयायां पुरस्तात् स्वयमातृण्णायाः प्रथमद्वितीयतृतीयेष्व् ऋतव्या वायव्या अपस्या इति यथासंख्यं तिस्रस्तिस्रो दक्षिणेषु वम्̐शेषु दक्षिणोत्तरा द्वेद्वे उत्तरस्योत्तरयोर् नवमे ऽभितः शेषा यथापस्याः /
text_mt: dvitīyāyāṃ purastāt svayamātṛṇṇāyāḥ prathamadvitīyatṛtīyeṣv ṛtavyā vāyavyā apasyā iti yathāsaṃkhyaṃ tisrastisro dakṣiṇeṣu vam̐śeṣu dakṣiṇottarā dvedve uttarasyottarayor navame 'bhitaḥ śeṣā yathāpasyāḥ

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīyāyāṃ daśa dvādaśa namave 'bhito 'ṣṭame sapta purastāt paścāc ca samīcīr abhitaḥ svayamātṛṇṇāyā ardhotsedhā aṣṭau nānāmantrā uttamāyām̐ vā /
meaning: तृतीयायां दश द्वादश नमवे ऽभितो ऽष्टमे सप्त पुरस्तात् पश्चाच् च समीचीर् अभितः स्वयमातृण्णाया अर्धोत्सेधा अष्टौ नानामन्त्रा उत्तमायाम्̐ वा /
text_mt: tṛtīyāyāṃ daśa dvādaśa namave 'bhito 'ṣṭame sapta purastāt paścāc ca samīcīr abhitaḥ svayamātṛṇṇāyā ardhotsedhā aṣṭau nānāmantrā uttamāyām̐ vā

sanskrit_iast: caturthyām ekaikāṃ navamenavame 'bhitaḥ purastāduttarasya vam̐śasya madhye prathamām̐ vyatyāsam itarā evam eva spṛtaḥ purastāddakṣiṇasya vam̐śasya madhye prathamām̐ vyatyāsam itarāḥ / ṣaṭsaptāṣṭameṣu dakṣiṇato yugmāyugmā uttaratas trivargān kuryāt saptadaśa dakṣiṇataḥ pañcadaśottarataḥ /
meaning: चतुर्थ्याम् एकैकां नवमेनवमे ऽभितः पुरस्तादुत्तरस्य वम्̐शस्य मध्ये प्रथमाम्̐ व्यत्यासम् इतरा एवम् एव स्पृतः पुरस्ताद्दक्षिणस्य वम्̐शस्य मध्ये प्रथमाम्̐ व्यत्यासम् इतराः / षट्सप्ताष्टमेषु दक्षिणतो युग्मायुग्मा उत्तरतस् त्रिवर्गान् कुर्यात् सप्तदश दक्षिणतः पञ्चदशोत्तरतः /
text_mt: caturthyām ekaikāṃ navamenavame 'bhitaḥ purastāduttarasya vam̐śasya madhye prathamām̐ vyatyāsam itarā evam eva spṛtaḥ purastāddakṣiṇasya vam̐śasya madhye prathamām̐ vyatyāsam itarāḥ / ṣaṭsaptāṣṭameṣu dakṣiṇato yugmāyugmā uttaratas trivargān kuryāt saptadaśa dakṣiṇataḥ pañcadaśottarataḥ

sanskrit_iast: pañcamyām ekaikāṃ prāṇabhṛdādhiṣu śeṣaṃ chandasām̐ virājaś ca yathātimātrāḥ ṣaṭsaptāṣṭameṣv abhito yathāsaṃkhyam /
meaning: पञ्चम्याम् एकैकां प्राणभृदाधिषु शेषं छन्दसाम्̐ विराजश् च यथातिमात्राः षट्सप्ताष्टमेष्व् अभितो यथासंख्यम् /
text_mt: pañcamyām ekaikāṃ prāṇabhṛdādhiṣu śeṣaṃ chandasām̐ virājaś ca yathātimātrāḥ ṣaṭsaptāṣṭameṣv abhito yathāsaṃkhyam

sanskrit_iast: ardheṣṭakābhiḥ pūrayitvā dakṣiṇataḥ prācīḥ stomabhāgāḥ paścimāś ca yugmā uttaratas trivargān kuryād ekatrim̐śataṃ paścāt pratyañcaṃ trivargeṇa nākasadaṃ ca paścāt purīṣavatyā yavādinā sanāmnīr upaśīvarīr ghṛtaplutā iti yathāsaṃkhyaṃ turīyāṇi madhye yathā prāṇabhṛto 'timātrā madhyamām̐ svayamātṛṇṇāsam̐hitām uttaratas tu vikarṇīm /
meaning: अर्धेष्टकाभिः पूरयित्वा दक्षिणतः प्राचीः स्तोमभागाः पश्चिमाश् च युग्मा उत्तरतस् त्रिवर्गान् कुर्याद् एकत्रिम्̐शतं पश्चात् प्रत्यञ्चं त्रिवर्गेण नाकसदं च पश्चात् पुरीषवत्या यवादिना सनाम्नीर् उपशीवरीर् घृतप्लुता इति यथासंख्यं तुरीयाणि मध्ये यथा प्राणभृतो ऽतिमात्रा मध्यमाम्̐ स्वयमातृण्णासम्̐हिताम् उत्तरतस् तु विकर्णीम् /
text_mt: ardheṣṭakābhiḥ pūrayitvā dakṣiṇataḥ prācīḥ stomabhāgāḥ paścimāś ca yugmā uttaratas trivargān kuryād ekatrim̐śataṃ paścāt pratyañcaṃ trivargeṇa nākasadaṃ ca paścāt purīṣavatyā yavādinā sanāmnīr upaśīvarīr ghṛtaplutā iti yathāsaṃkhyaṃ turīyāṇi madhye yathā prāṇabhṛto 'timātrā madhyamām̐ svayamātṛṇṇāsam̐hitām uttaratas tu vikarṇīm

sanskrit_iast: iti suparṇasya /
meaning: इति सुपर्णस्य /

sanskrit_iast:
yāvatī śoṣapākābhyām \ iṣṭakā hrasate kṛtā /
tāvat samadhikaṃ kāryam\ karaṇam̐ samam ichatā /
meaning:
यावती शोषपाकाभ्याम् \ इष्टका ह्रसते कृता /
तावत् समधिकं कार्यम्\ करणम्̐ समम् इछता /
text_mt:
yāvatī śoṣapākābhyām \ iṣṭakā hrasate kṛtā

tāvat samadhikaṃ kāryam\ karaṇam̐ samam ichatā

sanskrit_iast:
sadā ca trim̐śakaṃ bhāgam \ iṣṭakā hrasate kṛtā /
tāvat samadhikaṃ kāryam\ karaṇam̐ samam ichatā /
meaning:
सदा च त्रिम्̐शकं भागम् \ इष्टका ह्रसते कृता /
तावत् समधिकं कार्यम्\ करणम्̐ समम् इछता /
text_mt:
sadā ca trim̐śakaṃ bhāgam \ iṣṭakā hrasate kṛtā

tāvat samadhikaṃ kāryam\ karaṇam̐ samam ichatā

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikam̐ śatam adhyardham\ tad ūtam̐ ṣaḍbhir aṅgulaiḥ /
iṣṭakānāṃ parimāṇam\ vaikṛtam̐ yadato 'nyathā /
meaning:
एकैकम्̐ शतम् अध्यर्धम्\ तद् ऊतम्̐ षड्भिर् अङ्गुलैः /
इष्टकानां परिमाणम्\ वैकृतम्̐ यदतो ऽन्यथा /
text_mt:
ekaikam̐ śatam adhyardham\ tad ūtam̐ ṣaḍbhir aṅgulaiḥ

iṣṭakānāṃ parimāṇam\ vaikṛtam̐ yadato 'nyathā

sanskrit_iast:
navāṅgulasahasrāṇi \ dve śate ṣoḍaśottare /
aṅgulānāṃ parimāṇam\ vyāyāmasya tu nirdiśet /
meaning:
नवाङ्गुलसहस्राणि \ द्वे शते षोडशोत्तरे /
अङ्गुलानां परिमाणम्\ व्यायामस्य तु निर्दिशेत् /
text_mt:
navāṅgulasahasrāṇi \ dve śate ṣoḍaśottare

aṅgulānāṃ parimāṇam\ vyāyāmasya tu nirdiśet

sanskrit_iast:
itareṣāṃ tu dhiṣṇyānām\ sarveṣām eva niścayaḥ /
ekaikasya sahasram̐ syāt\ śate ṣaṇṇavatiḥ parā /
meaning:
इतरेषां तु धिष्ण्यानाम्\ सर्वेषाम् एव निश्चयः /
एकैकस्य सहस्रम्̐ स्यात्\ शते षण्णवतिः परा /
text_mt:
itareṣāṃ tu dhiṣṇyānām\ sarveṣām eva niścayaḥ

ekaikasya sahasram̐ syāt\ śate ṣaṇṇavatiḥ parā

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśa sahasrāṇi \ aṅgulānām̐ śatāni ṣaṭ /
śataṃ caiva sahasrāṇām\ kṣetram agner vidhīyate /
meaning:
एकादश सहस्राणि \ अङ्गुलानाम्̐ शतानि षट् /
शतं चैव सहस्राणाम्\ क्षेत्रम् अग्नेर् विधीयते /
text_mt:
ekādaśa sahasrāṇi \ aṅgulānām̐ śatāni ṣaṭ

śataṃ caiva sahasrāṇām\ kṣetram agner vidhīyate

sanskrit_iast:
prākṛtam̐ vaikṛtam̐ vāpi \ kṣetram ardhāṣṭamāntare /
pañcavim̐śam̐ śiraḥ kṛtvā \ tataḥ kṣetre samāvapet /
meaning:
प्राकृतम्̐ वैकृतम्̐ वापि \ क्षेत्रम् अर्धाष्टमान्तरे /
पञ्चविम्̐शम्̐ शिरः कृत्वा \ ततः क्षेत्रे समावपेत् /
text_mt:
prākṛtam̐ vaikṛtam̐ vāpi \ kṣetram ardhāṣṭamāntare

pañcavim̐śam̐ śiraḥ kṛtvā \ tataḥ kṣetre samāvapet

sanskrit_iast:
śatāny aṣṭau padonāni \ padānām iha kīrtyante /
sāṅgasya saśiraskasya \ kṣetraṃ kṣetravido viduḥ /
meaning:
शतान्य् अष्टौ पदोनानि \ पदानाम् इह कीर्त्यन्ते /
साङ्गस्य सशिरस्कस्य \ क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रविदो विदुः /
text_mt:
śatāny aṣṭau padonāni \ padānām iha kīrtyante

sāṅgasya saśiraskasya \ kṣetraṃ kṣetravido viduḥ

sanskrit_iast:
ātmā catuḥśataḥ kāryaḥ \ pakṣau trim̐śacchatau smṛtau /
daśa puche śataṃ caiva \ śiraḥ syāt pañcavim̐śakam /
meaning:
आत्मा चतुःशतः कार्यः \ पक्षौ त्रिम्̐शच्छतौ स्मृतौ /
दश पुछे शतं चैव \ शिरः स्यात् पञ्चविम्̐शकम् /
text_mt:
ātmā catuḥśataḥ kāryaḥ \ pakṣau trim̐śacchatau smṛtau

daśa puche śataṃ caiva \ śiraḥ syāt pañcavim̐śakam

sanskrit_iast:
ekatrim̐śas trayastrim̐śair \ vargaiḥ pañcāśakairapi /
asaṃbhavatsu vargeṣu \ dvidhā bhidyeta iṣṭakā /
meaning:
एकत्रिम्̐शस् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शैर् \ वर्गैः पञ्चाशकैरपि /
असंभवत्सु वर्गेषु \ द्विधा भिद्येत इष्टका /
text_mt:
The thirty-first with thirty-three / groups, and also with fifty.

When the groups do not fit, a brick may be divided into two parts.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭakāhrasavṛddhibhyām\ dṛdhāsu śatakeṣu ca /
matimān iṣṭakā bhāgair \ mantrāt saṃnāśayed iti /
meaning:
इष्टकाह्रसवृद्धिभ्याम्\ दृधासु शतकेषु च /
मतिमान् इष्टका भागैर् \ मन्त्रात् संनाशयेद् इति /
text_mt:
By decrease and increase of bricks, in fixed layers and in hundreds,

a wise man should adjust [the bricks] into portions according to the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
caturasre pṛṣṭau vāpi \ pakṣapuchaśireṣṭakāḥ /
dikto 'padhānam̐ lokāc ca \ tathā lokas tu lupyate /
meaning:
चतुरस्रे पृष्टौ वापि \ पक्षपुछशिरेष्टकाः /
दिक्तो ऽपधानम्̐ लोकाच् च \ तथा लोकस् तु लुप्यते /
text_mt:
Either on the square [body] or on the back [are laid] the bricks of the wings, tail, and head.

The laying [is done] according to direction and according to space; but thus space is omitted.

sanskrit_iast:
adhyātmani ha vijñeyam \ upadhānam̐ vijānatā /
rathaṃtarabṛhallokair \ anyaṃ gāyatrayājñiyaiḥ /
meaning:
अध्यात्मनि ह विज्ञेयम् \ उपधानम्̐ विजानता /
रथंतरबृहल्लोकैर् \ अन्यं गायत्रयाज्ञियैः /
text_mt:
The wise man should understand the laying down [of bricks] as pertaining to the self.

With the spaces of Rathantara and Bṛhat, and the other with those belonging to the Gāyatra sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast:
yajuṣmatīnām̐ saṃkhyā tu \ sarvāsāṃ caiva niścitā /
ekaikasyāṃ citau vāpi \ tāṃ me nigadataḥ śṛṇu /
meaning:
यजुष्मतीनाम्̐ संख्या तु \ सर्वासां चैव निश्चिता /
एकैकस्यां चितौ वापि \ तां मे निगदतः शृणु /
text_mt:
the number of all [bricks] consecrated with yajus formulas is indeed fixed.

Hear from me as I declare that [number] for each single layer:

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaśītiḥ śataṃ tv ādyā \ dvitīyā daśa saptatiḥ /
trayodaśa tṛtīyā syāt\ śataṃ cāhur manīṣiṇaḥ /
caturthī śatam ekā syāt \ tisraś caiveṣṭakāḥ smṛtāḥ /
śatāni trīṇi pañcāśat \ ṣaṭ caiva citir uttamā /
meaning:
षडशीतिः शतं त्व् आद्या \ द्वितीया दश सप्ततिः /
त्रयोदश तृतीया स्यात्\ शतं चाहुर् मनीषिणः /
चतुर्थी शतम् एका स्यात् \ तिस्रश् चैवेष्टकाः स्मृताः /
शतानि त्रीणि पञ्चाशत् \ षट् चैव चितिर् उत्तमा /

sanskrit_iast:
etāḥ sarvā yajuṣmatyas\ yābhir agniḥ prasūyate /
śeṣam̐ lokaṃpṛṇābhis tu \ citīnām abhipūrayet /
meaning:
एताः सर्वा यजुष्मत्यस्\ याभिर् अग्निः प्रसूयते /
शेषम्̐ लोकंपृणाभिस् तु \ चितीनाम् अभिपूरयेत् /
text_mt:
All these are accompanied by yajus formulas, by which the fire[-altar] is produced.

One should fill up the rest of the layers with space-filler [bricks].

sanskrit_iast:
etāḥ sarvā samāmnātāḥ \ yajur yāvat pravartate /
tad etad dhi sahasram̐ syāt\ śarkarābhiḥ sahocyate /
meaning:
एताः सर्वा समाम्नाताः \ यजुर् यावत् प्रवर्तते /
तद् एतद् धि सहस्रम्̐ स्यात्\ शर्कराभिः सहोच्यते /
text_mt:
All these are handed down as far as the yajus formula extends.

This indeed amounts to a thousand, together with the pebbles, it is said.

sanskrit_iast:
etā upahitāḥ samyag \ dhenavas tu prajāyante /
amuṣmin yajamānāya \ kāmān duhyati sarvaśaḥ /
meaning:
एता उपहिताः सम्यग् \ धेनवस् तु प्रजायन्ते /
अमुष्मिन् यजमानाय \ कामान् दुह्यति सर्वशः /
text_mt:
These, when properly laid down, become cows;

they milk desires in every way for the sacrificer in the other world.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭiṃ prajāpatim̐ veda \ yo hi sam̐vatsaraḥ smṛtaḥ /
gachati brahmaṇo lokam\ nākaṃ bradhnasya viṣṭapam //
iti /
meaning:
षष्टिं प्रजापतिम्̐ वेद \ यो हि सम्̐वत्सरः स्मृतः /
गछति ब्रह्मणो लोकम्\ नाकं ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपम् //
इति /
text_mt:
He who knows the sixty[-fold] Prajāpati, who is remembered as the year,

goes to the world of Brahman, to the firmament, the realm of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇave yā prameyāya \ śulbavidbhiś ca sarvaśaḥ /
saṃkhyātṛbhyaḥ pravaktṛbhyas\ namo bharanto ye mase /
idaṃ bhūbhyā bhajāmahe \ yā no mānakṛtām iva /
yajñiyaṃ mānam uttamam\ vardhamānam̐ sve dame /
meaning:
वैष्णवे या प्रमेयाय \ शुल्बविद्भिश् च सर्वशः /
संख्यातृभ्यः प्रवक्तृभ्यस्\ नमो भरन्तो ये मसे /
इदं भूभ्या भजामहे \ या नो मानकृताम् इव /
यज्ञियं मानम् उत्तमम्\ वर्धमानम्̐ स्वे दमे /
text_mt:
To the knowers of the cord in every respect, regarding what is to be measured for Viṣṇu,

to the reckoners and the teachers, bringing homage, whom we consider [in our mind]:

We partake of this from the two earths, as it were of those who make measurements,

the supreme sacrificial measure growing in its own home.

sanskrit_iast:
spaṣṭā bhūmir ṛjuḥ śaṅkur \ mauñjam̐ śulbam abandhuram /
citrādau nākṛtiḥ kāryā \ tithyṛkṣam̐ varuṇaśubham /
meaning:
स्पष्टा भूमिर् ऋजुः शङ्कुर् \ मौञ्जम्̐ शुल्बम् अबन्धुरम् /
चित्रादौ नाकृतिः कार्या \ तिथ्यृक्षम्̐ वरुणशुभम् /
text_mt:
A clear ground, a straight peg, a muñja cord without knots;

no form should be made under Citrā and so on; the lunar day and asterism should be propitious to Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāḥ prāgāyatā vedyaḥ \ karaṇam̐ yaskadehikam /
ardhenārvasamam̐ sarvam \ uchedo jānu pañcakam /
meaning:
सर्वाः प्रागायता वेद्यः \ करणम्̐ यस्कदेहिकम् /
अर्धेनार्वसमम्̐ सर्वम् \ उछेदो जानु पञ्चकम् /
text_mt:
All altars extend toward the east; the construction is described by Yāska.

All is equal to half an arva; the height is five knees.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyame 'rdham ṛtavyānām\ nākasat pañcacūḍayoḥ /
karaṇādyartham uddiśya \ kṣetram ardhāṣṭamān naraḥ /
meaning:
मध्यमे ऽर्धम् ऋतव्यानाम्\ नाकसत् पञ्चचूडयोः /
करणाद्यर्थम् उद्दिश्य \ क्षेत्रम् अर्धाष्टमान् नरः /
text_mt:
In the middle is half of the seasonal [bricks], between the Nākasad and Pañcacūḍā [bricks].

Indicating the ground for the purpose of construction and so forth, a man [measures] seven and a half [puruṣas].

sanskrit_iast:
anaḥsiddham̐ havirdhānam\ pātrasiddhāḥ kharāḥkharāḥ /
cātvālaḥ paśubhiḥ siddhas\ havirbhiḥ sāgnikāḥ kharāḥ /
meaning:
अनःसिद्धम्̐ हविर्धानम्\ पात्रसिद्धाः खराःखराः /
चात्वालः पशुभिः सिद्धस्\ हविर्भिः साग्निकाः खराः /
text_mt:
The havirdhāna shed is measured by the cart; the mounds are measured by the vessels;

the pit is measured by the animals; the mounds with fires [are measured] by the oblations.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍalārdhaṃ catuḥsrakti \ ratninām̐ vihitāḥ kharāḥ /
aratnir ghana eteṣām\ bhūyas tve bhūyasīvidhau /
meaning:
मण्डलार्धं चतुःस्रक्ति \ रत्निनाम्̐ विहिताः खराः /
अरत्निर् घन एतेषाम्\ भूयस् त्वे भूयसीविधौ /
text_mt:
Semicircular, four-cornered mounds are prescribed in cubits.

Their depth is one cubit; in the case of increase, [it increases] according to the rule of increase.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvaś caturvim̐śatibhāge lekhyaś caturvim̐śair ālikhitas tu paścimaḥ syād dakṣiṇe 'ṣṭadviguṇena lekhyas trim̐śadbhir āyamya haret tu rāyam /
meaning: पूर्वश् चतुर्विम्̐शतिभागे लेख्यश् चतुर्विम्̐शैर् आलिखितस् तु पश्चिमः स्याद् दक्षिणे ऽष्टद्विगुणेन लेख्यस् त्रिम्̐शद्भिर् आयम्य हरेत् तु रायम् /
text_mt: The eastern [line] should be drawn at the twenty-fourth part; the western should be drawn with twenty-four; in the south, it should be drawn with twice eight; stretching with thirty, he should take the property.

sanskrit_iast:
udakprakramya cātvālam \\ śāmitraṃ prakrame tataḥ /
bhūyas tat paśubhūyastve \ vṛddhir uttarato bhavet /
meaning:
उदक्प्रक्रम्य चात्वालम् \\ शामित्रं प्रक्रमे ततः /
भूयस् तत् पशुभूयस्त्वे \ वृद्धिर् उत्तरतो भवेत् /
text_mt: Stepping northward to the pit, then a step to the Śāmitra [shed]; / in the case of a greater number of animals, it should increase toward the north.

sanskrit_iast:
āyāmabāhuṃ nikṣipya \ vistaras tu tathā pṛthak /
so 'dhyardhaṃ guṇayed rāśim \\ sa sarvaguṇito ghanaḥ /
meaning:
आयामबाहुं निक्षिप्य \ विस्तरस् तु तथा पृथक् /
सो ऽध्यर्धं गुणयेद् राशिम् \\ स सर्वगुणितो घनः /
text_mt: Having laid down the length-side, and likewise the breadth separately, / he should multiply that quantity by one and a half; that multiplied by all is the solid content.

sanskrit_iast:
āyāmam āyāmaguṇam \\ vistāram̐ vistareṇa tu /
samasya vargamūlam̐ yat \ tatkarṇaṃ tadvido viduḥ /
meaning:
आयामम् आयामगुणम् \\ विस्तारम्̐ विस्तरेण तु /
समस्य वर्गमूलम्̐ यत् \ तत्कर्णं तद्विदो विदुः /
text_mt: The length multiplied by the length, and the breadth by the breadth: / the square root of the sum, those who know it know as the diagonal.

sanskrit_iast: śravaṇābhijitor bahulātiṣyayor vā citrāsvātyor antare 'psv agninā vā /
meaning: श्रवणाभिजितोर् बहुलातिष्ययोर् वा चित्रास्वात्योर् अन्तरे ऽप्स्व् अग्निना वा /
text_mt: Between Śravaṇā and Abhijit, or Bahulā and Tiṣya, or Citrā and Svātī, in waters, or by fire;

sanskrit_iast: naktaṃ prācībhāskaraśrāyamāhuḥ / śaṅkulipte maṇḍale prāk parāk ceti /
meaning: नक्तं प्राचीभास्करश्रायमाहुः / शङ्कुलिप्ते मण्डले प्राक् पराक् चेति /
text_mt: at night, they say the east is determined by the sun; on a circular [line] marked by a peg, eastward and westward.

sanskrit_iast:
janmanā rogahīno vā \ yajamāno bhaved yadi /
kathaṃ tatra pramāṇāni \ prayoktavyāni kartṛbhiḥ /
meaning:
जन्मना रोगहीनो वा \ यजमानो भवेद् यदि /
कथं तत्र प्रमाणानि \ प्रयोक्तव्यानि कर्तृभिः /
text_mt:
If the sacrificer should be free from disease from birth,

how are the measures to be applied there by the performers?

sanskrit_iast: yady urutantuḥ keśo vāstṛtaḥ sarṣapo yavaś caiva ṣaḍguṇitaḥṣaḍguṇito bhavati narasyāṅgulaṃ māne taddvādaśakaṃ prādeśam ity āhuḥ /
meaning: यद्य् उरुतन्तुः केशो वास्तृतः सर्षपो यवश् चैव षड्गुणितःषड्गुणितो भवति नरस्याङ्गुलं माने तद्द्वादशकं प्रादेशम् इत्य् आहुः /
text_mt: A wide thread, or a hair laid out, a mustard seed, and a barleycorn—each multiplied sixfold is an aṅgula in the measure of a man; twelve of that they call a span;

sanskrit_iast: taddvayam̐ smṛto 'ratniḥ prakramo 'ratnisamaḥ sa dviḥprādeśo bhavec citiṣu /
meaning: तद्द्वयम्̐ स्मृतो ऽरत्निः प्रक्रमो ऽरत्निसमः स द्विःप्रादेशो भवेच् चितिषु /
text_mt: two of that is remembered as a cubit; a step is equal to a cubit; it should be two spans in the layers;

sanskrit_iast: adhyardhāṅgulahīnāś catvāraḥ prakramā bhaven niyatāḥ /
meaning: अध्यर्धाङ्गुलहीनाश् चत्वारः प्रक्रमा भवेन् नियताः /
text_mt: four steps diminished by one and a half aṅgula are fixed;

sanskrit_iast: tatraikādaśa yūpāś catvāraś caturuttarāḥ sattresattre /
meaning: तत्रैकादश यूपाश् चत्वारश् चतुरुत्तराः सत्त्रेसत्त्रे /
text_mt: there are eleven sacrificial posts, [or] four, increasing by four in each sacrificial session.

sanskrit_iast: ekasyām̐ vedyām agnidvayam iṣṭakāriktaṃ bhavati / pṛthag ato vediḥ cet pṛthag agniḥ kḷptaḥ /
meaning: एकस्याम्̐ वेद्याम् अग्निद्वयम् इष्टकारिक्तं भवति / पृथग् अतो वेदिः चेत् पृथग् अग्निः कॢप्तः /
text_mt: On one altar there are two fires without bricks; if there is a separate altar, a separate fire is arranged.

sanskrit_iast: vim̐śatyaṅgulaḥ śataṃ niyataḥ pañcāratnir naro daśapado vā / hīnātiriktayuktyā dehedehe pramāṇaṃ tu /
meaning: विम्̐शत्यङ्गुलः शतं नियतः पञ्चारत्निर् नरो दशपदो वा / हीनातिरिक्तयुक्त्या देहेदेहे प्रमाणं तु /
text_mt: A man is fixed as one hundred and twenty aṅgulas, or five cubits, or ten feet; but in each body the measure is [determined] by adjusting for deficiency or excess.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍaśītir yugam uktam̐ sāṣṭādaśa ucyate tvakṣas tantrasamasamastaṃ dvyujam̐ ratham īṣām̐ vyavāsyanti /
meaning: षडशीतिर् युगम् उक्तम्̐ साष्टादश उच्यते त्वक्षस् तन्त्रसमसमस्तं द्व्युजम्̐ रथम् ईषाम्̐ व्यवास्यन्ति /
text_mt: The yoke is declared to be eighty-six [aṅgulas]; the axle is said to be with eighteen; together with the framework they unharness the two-wheeled chariot and the pole.

sanskrit_iast: maṇḍalam atha caturasraṃ maṇḍalaṃ ca yaḥ kuryāt tasyemaṃ karaṇavidhiṃ tadvidām udāhṛtam̐ śṛṇuta /
meaning: मण्डलम् अथ चतुरस्रं मण्डलं च यः कुर्यात् तस्येमं करणविधिं तद्विदाम् उदाहृतम्̐ शृणुत /
text_mt: Now, hear this rule of construction, proclaimed by the experts, for one who would make a circle, a square, and a circle:

sanskrit_iast: maṇḍalaviṣkambhasamas tribhujād avalambakaś catuḥsraktiḥ prāgāyatāt tribhāgāt karṇāt sa maṇḍalaṃ bhavati /
meaning: मण्डलविष्कम्भसमस् त्रिभुजाद् अवलम्बकश् चतुःस्रक्तिः प्रागायतात् त्रिभागात् कर्णात् स मण्डलं भवति /
text_mt: Equal to the diameter of a circle is the perpendicular of a triangle; a four-cornered [figure] from a third part of the diagonal extending eastward becomes a circle.

sanskrit_iast: puruṣaḥ puruṣaṃ kuryāt tasyākṣṇayā dvipuruṣaṃ bhavec caturastasyāpyakṣṇayā dvābhyām̐ vā syāś catuḥpuruṣam /
meaning: पुरुषः पुरुषं कुर्यात् तस्याक्ष्णया द्विपुरुषं भवेच् चतुरस्तस्याप्यक्ष्णया द्वाभ्याम्̐ वा स्याश् चतुःपुरुषम् /
text_mt: A puruṣa makes a puruṣa; diagonally it becomes two puruṣas; or diagonally with two, a square becomes four puruṣas.

sanskrit_iast: dvipuruṣaḥ karaṇī śroṇī bāhus tu dviguṇo bhavet triṃkuṣṭhavat tryavalambakas tato yaś caturasre dvāṣṭamāḥ puruṣāḥ /
meaning: द्विपुरुषः करणी श्रोणी बाहुस् तु द्विगुणो भवेत् त्रिंकुष्ठवत् त्र्यवलम्बकस् ततो यश् चतुरस्रे द्वाष्टमाः पुरुषाः /
text_mt: The base is two puruṣas, the flank and side are doubled; like a triangle with three perpendiculars, then what is in the square is two-eighths puruṣas.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣkambhaḥ pañcabhāgaś ca \ viṣkambhas triguṇaś ca yaḥ /
sa maṇḍalaparikṣepas\ na vālam atiricyate /
meaning:
विष्कम्भः पञ्चभागश् च \ विष्कम्भस् त्रिगुणश् च यः /
स मण्डलपरिक्षेपस्\ न वालम् अतिरिच्यते /
text_mt:
The diameter and a fifth part, and three times the diameter:

that is the circumference of a circle; it does not exceed by a hair.

sanskrit_iast:
daśadhā chidya viṣkambham\ tribhāgān uddharet tataḥ /
tena yac caturasraṃ syāt\ maṇḍale tadapaprathiḥ /
meaning:
दशधा छिद्य विष्कम्भम्\ त्रिभागान् उद्धरेत् ततः /
तेन यच् चतुरस्रं स्यात्\ मण्डले तदपप्रथिः /
text_mt:
Dividing the diameter into ten parts, he should then remove three parts;

the square that results from that is its spreading out in a circle.

sanskrit_iast:
caturasraṃ navadhā kuryād \ dhanuḥkoṭyas tridhātridhā /
utsedhāt pañcamam̐ lumpet \ purīṣeṇeha tāvat samam /
meaning:
चतुरस्रं नवधा कुर्याद् \ धनुःकोट्यस् त्रिधात्रिधा /
उत्सेधात् पञ्चमम्̐ लुम्पेत् \ पुरीषेणेह तावत् समम् /
text_mt:
He should divide the square into nine parts; / the bow-tips three by three.

From the height he should take away a fifth; / it is equal here [in level] with the loose earth.

sanskrit_iast: caturaratnir vā naraḥ sikatākaraṇe tv ardhaṃ bhujaḥ pradiśyate /
meaning: चतुररत्निर् वा नरः सिकताकरणे त्व् अर्धं भुजः प्रदिश्यते /
text_mt: Or a puruṣa is four aratnis; but in making the sand-bed, half an arm's length is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast: karaṇāni tato 'syāḥ kārayet tricatuḥpañca trir abhiparyasya yac chubhaṃ cayaneṣu vidhiḥ purātanair ṛṣibhir yo 'bhihitaś ca nityaśaḥ /
meaning: करणानि ततो ऽस्याः कारयेत् त्रिचतुःपञ्च त्रिर् अभिपर्यस्य यच् छुभं चयनेषु विधिः पुरातनैर् ऋषिभिर् यो ऽभिहितश् च नित्यशः /
text_mt: Then he should cause its making-bricks of three, four, and five [parts] to be made, turning [the cord] threefold, which is auspicious; that rule for piling [fire altars] was proclaimed perpetually by the ancient seers.

sanskrit_iast: parilekhanamānasaṃcayair vyatyāsaiḥ parimāṇasaṃpadā vedyaḥ sarvāḥ pramāṇair āyāmena ca vistareṇa ca mimīyāt /
meaning: परिलेखनमानसंचयैर् व्यत्यासैः परिमाणसंपदा वेद्यः सर्वाः प्रमाणैर् आयामेन च विस्तरेण च मिमीयात् /
text_mt: By delineations, mental constructions, layers, interchanges, and perfection of dimensions, he should measure all the altars by their measures, by their length and by their breadth.

sanskrit_iast: caturasrasam̐padā dvayāyām asamāpanāḥ smṛtā pañcāṅgyātha vā purātanair yāḥ pūrvair ṛṣibhiḥ pradarśitāḥ /
meaning: चतुरस्रसम्̐पदा द्वयायाम् असमापनाः स्मृता पञ्चाङ्ग्याथ वा पुरातनैर् याः पूर्वैर् ऋषिभिः प्रदर्शिताः /
text_mt: Through the perfection of the square, those [altars] of two [measures] are handed down as unfinished, or through the five-limbed [cord], which were shown by the ancient, early seers.

sanskrit_iast:
yaś caiṣa vidhir maryākṛtas \ tatraiṣā mithunāt samam /
pañcāṅgī tāvatī rajjur \ yayā sarvaṃ mimīmahe /
ṛte kaṅkālajaśyenān\ teṣām̐ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam /
meaning:
यश् चैष विधिर् मर्याकृतस् \ तत्रैषा मिथुनात् समम् /
पञ्चाङ्गी तावती रज्जुर् \ यया सर्वं मिमीमहे /
ऋते कङ्कालजश्येनान्\ तेषाम्̐ वक्ष्यामि लक्षणम् /
text_mt:
And whatever this rule has established as the boundary, / there it is equal from the couple.

So great is the five-limbed cord / by which we measure everything,

except for the skeleton-shaped eagle; / I shall declare their characteristic marks.

sanskrit_iast: iyaṃ mitā yā samayārdhalakṣaṇā tataś caturthe bhaven nirāñchanaṃ tato 'rdhaśiṣṭā vistārasamā cayasya / yat tataś catuḥkuṣṭham ihānayā caret /
meaning: इयं मिता या समयार्धलक्षणा ततश् चतुर्थे भवेन् निराञ्छनं ततो ऽर्धशिष्टा विस्तारसमा चयस्य / यत् ततश् चतुःकुष्ठम् इहानया चरेत् /
text_mt: This [cord] is measured, marked at the halfway point; at the fourth [mark] there should be a tied-knot; then the half-remaining [part] is equal to the breadth of the layer. From that he should proceed here with the four-cornered shape using this [cord].

sanskrit_iast: prācīm athāyāmasamāṃ nidadhyāt pāśau nikhanyād atha madhyamaṃ ca /
meaning: प्राचीम् अथायामसमां निदध्यात् पाशौ निखन्याद् अथ मध्यमं च /
text_mt: Then he should lay out the eastward line equal to the length; he should drive in pegs at both loops and in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: unmucya paścād atha madhyame tat prāgdakṣiṇāyamya nirāñchanena vistārato 'rdhe nikhaneta śaṅkuṃ pratyak tathottaramadhyame ca / sa vāsuvedīṣu /
meaning: उन्मुच्य पश्चाद् अथ मध्यमे तत् प्राग्दक्षिणायम्य निराञ्छनेन विस्तारतो ऽर्धे निखनेत शङ्कुं प्रत्यक् तथोत्तरमध्यमे च / स वासुवेदीषु /
text_mt: Releasing [the cord] at the back and then stretching it from the middle towards the east-south with the tied-knot, he should drive in a peg at half the breadth, and likewise westwards in the northern middle. That is the procedure on the earth-altars.

sanskrit_iast: atha mānam etac chroṇyāṃ tu pāśoddharaṇaṃ kriyeta /
meaning: अथ मानम् एतच् छ्रोण्यां तु पाशोद्धरणं क्रियेत /
text_mt: Now this measurement: on the southern hip, however, the lifting of the loop should be done.

sanskrit_iast: am̐saśroṇyor likheta dikṣu lekhāḥ śaṅkū nihanyāt samareṣu teṣu / tebhyaḥ samantāt parilekhayeta /
meaning: अम्̐सश्रोण्योर् लिखेत दिक्षु लेखाः शङ्कू निहन्यात् समरेषु तेषु / तेभ्यः समन्तात् परिलेखयेत /
text_mt: He should draw the lines at the shoulder and hip in the cardinal directions; he should drive in pegs in those equal areas; he should trace around them on all sides.

sanskrit_iast: yady aiṣṭikā nobhau likheta śiṣṭau /
meaning: यद्य् ऐष्टिका नोभौ लिखेत शिष्टौ /
text_mt: If it is made of bricks, he should not mark both remaining ones.

sanskrit_iast: pūrve tribhāge tv apare ca siddhopasthitāv utkaradakṣiṇāgnī /
meaning: पूर्वे त्रिभागे त्व् अपरे च सिद्धोपस्थिताव् उत्करदक्षिणाग्नी /
text_mt: In the eastern third and in the western [third], the rubbish heap and the dakṣiṇāgni are established and positioned.

sanskrit_iast: athānyad asya parilekhanaṃ tu madhye bhaved dikṣu navāṅguleneti /
meaning: अथान्यद् अस्य परिलेखनं तु मध्ये भवेद् दिक्षु नवाङ्गुलेनेति /
text_mt: Now, another tracing of it: in the middle it should be nine aṅgulas in the cardinal directions.

sanskrit_iast:
pramāṇārdhaṃ tu ṣaṣṭyūnam\ viśeṣa iti saṃjñitam /
viśeṣaś ca pramāṇaṃ ca \ pramāṇasyājñayā bhavet /
meaning:
प्रमाणार्धं तु षष्ट्यूनम्\ विशेष इति संज्ञितम् /
विशेषश् च प्रमाणं च \ प्रमाणस्याज्ञया भवेत् /
text_mt:
Half the measure, however, diminished by a sixtieth, / is designated as the 'difference'.

Both the difference and the measure / should exist according to the prescription of the measure.

sanskrit_iast: pramāṇārdham anyat syāt pāśaṣaṣṭhe sacaturvim̐śe lakṣaṇaṃ karoti tan nirāñchanam akṣṇayā tiryaṅmānī śeṣaḥ / pāśād ardhaśaye śroṇī dva... /
meaning: प्रमाणार्धम् अन्यत् स्यात् पाशषष्ठे सचतुर्विम्̐शे लक्षणं करोति तन् निराञ्छनम् अक्ष्णया तिर्यङ्मानी शेषः / पाशाद् अर्धशये श्रोणी द्व... /
text_mt: There should be another half of the measure: at the twenty-fourth [mark] from the sixth loop he makes a mark; that is the tied-knot diagonally; the remainder measures across. At half the resting place from the loop, the two hips […]

sanskrit_iast: ... cāgnīdhram ihopadiśyate /
meaning: ... चाग्नीध्रम् इहोपदिश्यते /
text_mt: […] and the āgnīdhra [hearth] is prescribed here.

sanskrit_iast:
agner yadakṣṇayāmānam\ tasya caiva tadakṣṇayā /
tad āśvamedhikam̐ vidyād \ ekavim̐śadvidhau 'tha vā /
meaning:
अग्नेर् यदक्ष्णयामानम्\ तस्य चैव तदक्ष्णया /
तद् आश्वमेधिकम्̐ विद्याद् \ एकविम्̐शद्विधौ ऽथ वा /
text_mt:
Whatever diagonal measure belongs to the fire altar, / and of that, by its diagonal,

one should know that as pertaining to the horse sacrifice, / or in the twenty-one-fold [altar].

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣas tiryag bhaved yad \ anudaśadhā yo mitaḥ /
tasya karṇena yat kṣetram\ vidyād ekādaśaṃ tu tat /
meaning:
पुरुषस् तिर्यग् भवेद् यद् \ अनुदशधा यो मितः /
तस्य कर्णेन यत् क्षेत्रम्\ विद्याद् एकादशं तु तत् /
text_mt:
If a puruṣa lies across, / which is measured according to ten parts,

what field [is formed] by its diagonal, / one should know that as the eleventh [field].

sanskrit_iast:
ubhau bāhū naśakṣṇāṃ tu \ naras tiryak tadakṣṇayā /
ekoccatānaikaśatād \ bāhuvṛddhyā vivardhayet //
iti /
meaning:
उभौ बाहू नशक्ष्णां तु \ नरस् तिर्यक् तदक्ष्णया /
एकोच्चतानैकशताद् \ बाहुवृद्ध्या विवर्धयेत् //
इति /
text_mt:
Indeed, both arms without diagonal / are a man across by its diagonal;

from one hundred and one upright / he should enlarge it by the increase of arms.

sanskrit_iast:
avalambakakuṣṭhe tu \ yo bhavet ṣoḍaśāṅgule /
sautrāmaṇyā bhaved eṣa \ prakramo mānakarmaṇi /
meaning:
अवलम्बककुष्ठे तु \ यो भवेत् षोडशाङ्गुले /
सौत्रामण्या भवेद् एष \ प्रक्रमो मानकर्मणि /
text_mt:
When it is sixteen aṅgulas / in the plumb-line corner,

this should be the step (prakrama) of the Sautrāmaṇī / in the act of measuring.

sanskrit_iast:
prakramasya tṛtīyena \ saumikī sārparājñikī /
saṃtṛtīyais tribhiś cānyaiḥ \ siddham auttaravedikam /
meaning:
प्रक्रमस्य तृतीयेन \ सौमिकी सार्पराज्ञिकी /
संतृतीयैस् त्रिभिश् चान्यैः \ सिद्धम् औत्तरवेदिकम् /
text_mt:
By a third of a prakrama / [is measured] the Somakā and the Sārparājñikī [altar];

together with three other thirds, / the high altar (uttaravedi) is accomplished.

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśāṅgulo vā syāt \ prakramas tena saumikī /
śatair dvādaśabhir vāpi \ minuyāt pāśukām iva /
meaning:
चतुर्दशाङ्गुलो वा स्यात् \ प्रक्रमस् तेन सौमिकी /
शतैर् द्वादशभिर् वापि \ मिनुयात् पाशुकाम् इव /
text_mt:
Or the prakrama may be fourteen aṅgulas; / by that [is measured] the Soma altar;

or he may measure it with twelve hundred [aṅgulas], / like that of the animal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
sacaturthe vanam̐ ṣaḍbhir \ navabhir vātha saptabhiḥ /
navabhir vāparaṃ cakram\ karaṇārdhe na lekhayet /
meaning:
सचतुर्थे वनम्̐ षड्भिर् \ नवभिर् वाथ सप्तभिः /
नवभिर् वापरं चक्रम्\ करणार्धे न लेखयेत् /
text_mt:
With a fourth, the grove with six, / or nine, or seven;

or with nine another circle; / he should not draw it on half of the making-brick.

sanskrit_iast:
caturṣu nivaped eṣām\ sāvitrādiṣu yo vidhiḥ /
aruṇe jānudaghne nikhanyād adbhis tu pūrayet /
meaning:
चतुर्षु निवपेद् एषाम्\ सावित्रादिषु यो विधिः /
अरुणे जानुदघ्ने निखन्याद् अद्भिस् तु पूरयेत् /
text_mt:
In four he should scatter them; / which is the rule in the Sāvitra and other [altars].

In the Aruṇa [altar] he should dig knee-deep, / but fill it with water.

sanskrit_iast: caturasram athāpi maṇḍalaṃ dvividhaṃ gārhapatyalakṣaṇam̐ vyāyāmamitaṃ caturbhujaṃ puruṣārdhena tu maṇḍalaṃ parilikhet /
meaning: चतुरस्रम् अथापि मण्डलं द्विविधं गार्हपत्यलक्षणम्̐ व्यायाममितं चतुर्भुजं पुरुषार्धेन तु मण्डलं परिलिखेत् /
text_mt: A square or also a circle: two-fold is the characteristic mark of the gārhapatya; he should trace the four-sided one measured as a fathom (vyāyāma), but the circle by half a puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast: vyāyāmatṛtīyamāyāntaṃ caturasram̐ saptamabhāgavistṛtaṃ prāgācitam uttarācitam̐ vyatyāse tad athaikavim̐śakam /
meaning: व्यायामतृतीयमायान्तं चतुरस्रम्̐ सप्तमभागविस्तृतं प्रागाचितम् उत्तराचितम्̐ व्यत्यासे तद् अथैकविम्̐शकम् /
text_mt: A square having a length of a third of a fathom and a width of a seventh part, laid eastwards and laid northwards in alteration, is then twenty-one [bricks].

sanskrit_iast: puruṣasya tṛtīyamāyāntaṃ caturasram̐ ṣaḍbhāgavistṛtaṃ prathikaś ca tadāyato bhaven madhye tena samāyato bhaven madhye tena samāstike ... śeṣau koṇau prathikam itau samau tadvistārakṛtau viśākhaḥ /
meaning: पुरुषस्य तृतीयमायान्तं चतुरस्रम्̐ षड्भागविस्तृतं प्रथिकश् च तदायतो भवेन् मध्ये तेन समायतो भवेन् मध्ये तेन समास्तिके ... शेषौ कोणौ प्रथिकम् इतौ समौ तद्विस्तारकृतौ विशाखः /
text_mt: A square having a length of a third of a puruṣa and a width of a sixth part; and a prathikā brick should be that long in the middle, and equal in length to it in the middle […] the two remaining corners are measured like the prathikā, equal, made of its width, forked.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍbhāgakṛtāyāmo bhaved dvyardhe tu trikoṇasam̐sthite /
meaning: षड्भागकृतायामो भवेद् द्व्यर्धे तु त्रिकोणसम्̐स्थिते /
text_mt: The length should be made of six parts, but in one and a half it stands triangular.

sanskrit_iast: caturasravipāṇakaḥ prathiko 'rdhaṃ prathikaś ca yo mitaḥ /
meaning: चतुरस्रविपाणकः प्रथिको ऽर्धं प्रथिकश् च यो मितः /
text_mt: The square corner-brick is a prathikā, and half is that which is measured as a prathikā.

sanskrit_iast: karaṇāni bhavanti maṇḍale catvāri pramitāni bhāgaśaḥ /
meaning: करणानि भवन्ति मण्डले चत्वारि प्रमितानि भागशः /
text_mt: In the circle there are four making-bricks measured out by parts.

sanskrit_iast: madhye 'sya catasra iṣṭakāḥ tatpūrvāparayor dvayordvayaṃ pratiko 'rdhaviṣāṇikadvayaṃ punar eva punar aiti maṇḍalam ardhaprathikadvaye samam̐ saṃpūrṇaṃ tad athaikavim̐śakam /
meaning: मध्ये ऽस्य चतस्र इष्टकाः तत्पूर्वापरयोर् द्वयोर्द्वयं प्रतिको ऽर्धविषाणिकद्वयं पुनर् एव पुनर् ऐति मण्डलम् अर्धप्रथिकद्वये समम्̐ संपूर्णं तद् अथैकविम्̐शकम् /
text_mt: In its middle are four bricks; to the east and west of it, two and two; a prathikā and two half-horns; again it reaches the circle; with two half-prathikās it is equal, complete, then twenty-one [bricks].

sanskrit_iast: vyatyāsam udaṅmukhena saha vyatyasyed vety uttarottaram /
meaning: व्यत्यासम् उदङ्मुखेन सह व्यत्यस्येद् वेत्य् उत्तरोत्तरम् /
text_mt: Alternately, he should alternate [the layers] facing north, higher and higher.

sanskrit_iast: adhyardhaṃ padyaṃ ca padyārdhapadyapādavat padyārdhotsedham ity āhur gāyatre karaṇāni ca /
meaning: अध्यर्धं पद्यं च पद्यार्धपद्यपादवत् पद्यार्धोत्सेधम् इत्य् आहुर् गायत्रे करणानि च /
text_mt: One and a half, a foot-brick, and having half-foot and quarter-foot bricks, with a height of half a foot: these they call the making-bricks in the Gāyatra [altar].

sanskrit_iast:
caturguṇāṃ dvipuruṣām\ rajjuṃ kṛtvā samāhitām /
saṃbhāgajñātṛtodāntām\ pañcāṅgīṃ tadvido viduḥ /
meaning:
चतुर्गुणां द्विपुरुषाम्\ रज्जुं कृत्वा समाहिताम् /
संभागज्ञातृतोदान्ताम्\ पञ्चाङ्गीं तद्विदो विदुः /
text_mt:
Having made a firm rope / of four folds, two puruṣas long,

the experts know it as five-limbed, / ending with a prick that marks equal parts.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyamāt pāśayos todas\ gāyatramānam ucyate /
sāratnāv ardhapuruṣe / \ caturasras tayā mitaḥ /
pakṣapuchāntayor vṛddhyā \ gāyatreṇetareṣubhiḥ /
meaning:
मध्यमात् पाशयोस् तोदस्\ गायत्रमानम् उच्यते /
सारत्नाव् अर्धपुरुषे / \ चतुरस्रस् तया मितः /
पक्षपुछान्तयोर् वृद्ध्या \ गायत्रेणेतरेषुभिः /

sanskrit_iast: iṣṭakā śoṣapākābhyām\ trim̐śanmānāt tu hīyate /
meaning: इष्टका शोषपाकाभ्याम्\ त्रिम्̐शन्मानात् तु हीयते /
text_mt: the brick, however, from drying and baking, / decreases from the thirty-measure.

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ kṣetraṃ tricaturbhāgaṃ niruhyādāpayec chivam /
meaning: ततः क्षेत्रं त्रिचतुर्भागं निरुह्यादापयेच् छिवम् /
text_mt: Then, removing a three-quarter part of the area, / he should cause it to be given auspiciously.

sanskrit_iast: am̐sa uttare 'm̐se ca prācyo 'dhyardhās tu vim̐śatir daśa puche dvir dvādaśakau pakṣayor abhitaḥ puche tu pañca deyāḥ pañca prācīḥ pañcadaśa dadyāc chirasi / caturaśītī pakṣayoḥ pañcāśataṃ trim̐śatam ātmani padyā bhavanti śatam ekonaṃ puche 'm̐saśroṇyor vim̐śatirvim̐śatiḥ puche pakṣayor daśadaśāhuḥ /
meaning: अम्̐स उत्तरे ऽम्̐से च प्राच्यो ऽध्यर्धास् तु विम्̐शतिर् दश पुछे द्विर् द्वादशकौ पक्षयोर् अभितः पुछे तु पञ्च देयाः पञ्च प्राचीः पञ्चदश दद्याच् छिरसि / चतुरशीती पक्षयोः पञ्चाशतं त्रिम्̐शतम् आत्मनि पद्या भवन्ति शतम् एकोनं पुछे ऽम्̐सश्रोण्योर् विम्̐शतिर्विम्̐शतिः पुछे पक्षयोर् दशदशाहुः /
text_mt: On the shoulder and on the northern shoulder are twenty one-and-a-half-sized bricks pointing east; ten on the tail; twice twelve on both sides of the wings; but five are to be placed on the tail; he should place five pointing east, fifteen on the head; eighty-four on the wings, fifty and thirty on the body, are foot-bricks; ninety-nine on the tail, twenty on each of the shoulder and hip, ten on each of the tail and the wings, they say.

sanskrit_iast: adhyardhā daśa śirasi prācyudīcyo bhavanti /
meaning: अध्यर्धा दश शिरसि प्राच्युदीच्यो भवन्ति /
text_mt: Ten one-and-a-half-sized bricks on the head face east and north.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvopahitā prathamā padayujaḥ sarvā dvitīyāvāgyujo 'śvinī /
meaning: पूर्वोपहिता प्रथमा पदयुजः सर्वा द्वितीयावाग्युजो ऽश्विनी /
text_mt: The first [layer] is laid eastward with even-numbered feet; all the second [layer] with uneven-numbered feet, sacred to the Aśvins.

sanskrit_iast: vyatyāsaṃ cinuyād evaṃ jānunāsya vartmasu /
meaning: व्यत्यासं चिनुयाद् एवं जानुनास्य वर्त्मसु /
text_mt: In this way he should pile in alternation / at its courses with his knee.

sanskrit_iast: tripadā alpakṣetrā ekacitikāś catuḥ karaṇayuktāḥ dhiṣṇyā bhavanti sāgnicityamantrāḥ sātiriktāś ca /
meaning: त्रिपदा अल्पक्षेत्रा एकचितिकाश् चतुः करणयुक्ताः धिष्ण्या भवन्ति साग्निचित्यमन्त्राः सातिरिक्ताश् च /
text_mt: The dhiṣṇya hearths are three-footed, small in area, having a single layer, provided with four making-bricks, having mantras for piling the fire, and having surplus [bricks].

sanskrit_iast: adhyardhās tu catasro dve madhye nakulaś caturbhāgaḥ /
meaning: अध्यर्धास् तु चतस्रो द्वे मध्ये नकुलश् चतुर्भागः /
text_mt: There are four one-and-a-half-sized bricks, two in the middle, [and] an ichneumon-brick of a fourth part.

sanskrit_iast: aśmā navamo 'gnīdhre /
meaning: अश्मा नवमो ऽग्नीध्रे /

sanskrit_iast: hotrīyamataḥ sam̐vakṣyāmo 'm̐saśroṇyoḥ padyāśrayā nakulakā bahis tisṛṣu dikṣv antaś caturdaśa padakacaturthāḥ sa...yaḥ pratidiśam aṣṭau padyā dikṣu vidikṣu /
meaning: होत्रीयमतः सम्̐वक्ष्यामो ऽम्̐सश्रोण्योः पद्याश्रया नकुलका बहिस् तिसृषु दिक्ष्व् अन्तश् चतुर्दश पदकचतुर्थाः स...यः प्रतिदिशम् अष्टौ पद्या दिक्षु विदिक्षु /
text_mt: Next we shall explain the [dhiṣṇya] of the hotṛ: at the shoulders and thighs, foot-bricks are placed; on the outside in three directions are the nakulaka bricks, and inside fourteen quarter-foot bricks [...]; there are eight foot-bricks in each direction, in the intermediate and cardinal directions.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇācham̐sye daśa caikā syur madhye dvaudvau caturthyau nakulakaś ca /
meaning: ब्राह्मणाछम्̐स्ये दश चैका स्युर् मध्ये द्वौद्वौ चतुर्थ्यौ नकुलकश् च /
text_mt: In the [dhiṣṇya] of the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin there should be eleven; in the middle two each of quarter bricks and a nakulaka.

sanskrit_iast: abhitas tisraḥ padyā dve madhye 'dhyardhe śiṣṭeṣv aṣṭau /
meaning: अभितस् तिस्रः पद्या द्वे मध्ये ऽध्यर्धे शिष्टेष्व् अष्टौ /
text_mt: Around it are three foot-bricks, in the middle two one-and-a-half-foot bricks, [and] in the remaining [dhiṣṇyas] eight [bricks each].

sanskrit_iast: adhyardhāḥ ṣaṇ mārjalīye 'saṃ mārjālīyam̐ syād dakṣiṇapārśvena śāmitraṃ cātvālasya ca paścād avabhṛthakalpe 'py evaṃ padam ekatas tripadas tisro 'tirikteṣv iti /
meaning: अध्यर्धाः षण् मार्जलीये ऽसं मार्जालीयम्̐ स्याद् दक्षिणपार्श्वेन शामित्रं चात्वालस्य च पश्चाद् अवभृथकल्पे ऽप्य् एवं पदम् एकतस् त्रिपदस् तिस्रो ऽतिरिक्तेष्व् इति /
text_mt: Six one-and-a-half-foot bricks in the mārjālīya; the mārjālīya should be unbroken (?); along the southern flank [is] the śāmitra [hearth], and behind the cātvāla; in the procedure of the avabhṛtha also in this way: a foot-brick on one side, a three-foot brick, [and] three in the surplus [parts].

sanskrit_iast: saptatrim̐śatsārdhāḥ pakṣaḥ savyaś ca śirasi catvāraḥ ṣaḍvim̐śakas tathātmā śyene pañcadaśakaṃ puchaṃ saptadaśakaṃ puchaṃ dvayam̐ śirasy ātmapakṣayoḥ kḷptam alajasya / bhāgasaṃdhāntayajñaiḥ pratimā naracaturthe /
meaning: सप्तत्रिम्̐शत्सार्धाः पक्षः सव्यश् च शिरसि चत्वारः षड्विम्̐शकस् तथात्मा श्येने पञ्चदशकं पुछं सप्तदशकं पुछं द्वयम्̐ शिरस्य् आत्मपक्षयोः कॢप्तम् अलजस्य / भागसंधान्तयज्ञैः प्रतिमा नरचतुर्थे /
text_mt: Thirty-seven and a half [units] is the left wing, and four at the head; similarly the body has twenty-six [units]; in the falcon [altar], the tail has fifteen [units]; the tail has seventeen [units]; two at the head are arranged for the body and wings of the alaja; by the parts, joints, and ends of sacrifices, the image [is formed] in the fourth [layer] of a man's height.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭau bhāgāḥ puchaṃ kaṅkacite bhavati pādayoś caturaḥ śirasi tu sapta jñeyāḥ śyenavad ātmā ca pakṣau ca /
meaning: अष्टौ भागाः पुछं कङ्कचिते भवति पादयोश् चतुरः शिरसि तु सप्त ज्ञेयाः श्येनवद् आत्मा च पक्षौ च /
text_mt: In the heron-shaped altar (kaṅkacit), the tail consists of eight parts; four at the feet, but seven are to be known at the head; the body and wings are like the falcon.

sanskrit_iast: śyenālajakaṅkānām aṣṭau sārdhā vistṛtaṃ puchaṃ catvāro tmā dvau ca śiraḥ sarveṣāṃ pñcakau pakṣau /
meaning: श्येनालजकङ्कानाम् अष्टौ सार्धा विस्तृतं पुछं चत्वारो त्मा द्वौ च शिरः सर्वेषां प्ञ्चकौ पक्षौ /
text_mt: Of the falcon, alaja, and heron, the extended tail is eight and a half [parts], the body four, and the head two; the two wings of all are of five [parts] each.

sanskrit_iast: śyenālajakaṅkānāṃ dvitricatuḥ kuṣṭham ity ucyate puchaṃ pañcākṣṇāḥ pakṣapātrās tvakṣṇābhiḥ pariśritāḥ /
meaning: श्येनालजकङ्कानां द्वित्रिचतुः कुष्ठम् इत्य् उच्यते पुछं पञ्चाक्ष्णाः पक्षपात्रास् त्वक्ष्णाभिः परिश्रिताः /
text_mt: The tail of the falcon, alaja, and heron is said to have two, three, and four bends (kuṣṭha); the wing-feathers are diagonal, five, enclosed by diagonal [bricks].

sanskrit_iast: puche dvau bhāgāv ānayet pucham alajena trikuṣṭhavat trīn śyenapuchāc chirasi kaṅke pādau tu haret /
meaning: पुछे द्वौ भागाव् आनयेत् पुछम् अलजेन त्रिकुष्ठवत् त्रीन् श्येनपुछाच् छिरसि कङ्के पादौ तु हरेत् /
text_mt: One should bring two parts into the tail; the tail with the alaja is like having three bends; [one should bring] three from the falcon-tail to the head, but in the heron one should remove the two feet.

sanskrit_iast: prācīr dvādaśa sārdhā vim̐śatir udīcīr bhaven mitā bhāgā daśa pañca kaṅkacitāv alaja udīcīs trayodaśa sārdhāś ca /
meaning: प्राचीर् द्वादश सार्धा विम्̐शतिर् उदीचीर् भवेन् मिता भागा दश पञ्च कङ्कचिताव् अलज उदीचीस् त्रयोदश सार्धाश् च /
text_mt: Twelve and a half eastward [parts], twenty northward should be the measure; fifteen parts in the heron-altar; in the alaja, thirteen and a half northward.

sanskrit_iast:
tricaturbhāgamānī syād \ rajjur ardhatrayodaśī /
madhye ca lakṣaṇaṃ tasyās\ caturbhāgair nirāñchanam /
meaning:
त्रिचतुर्भागमानी स्याद् \ रज्जुर् अर्धत्रयोदशी /
मध्ये च लक्षणं तस्यास्\ चतुर्भागैर् निराञ्छनम् /
text_mt:
Measuring three-quarters [of a part], the cord should be twelve and a half [measures long].

And in the middle of it is a mark; the marking-off is by quarter-parts.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāgikāś catvāras todās\ ardhaṣaṣṭhe 'paraḥ smṛtaḥ /
ardhāś ca me 'ṣṭame caiva \ navame daśame 'paraḥ /
ardhadvādaśo vānyaḥ /
meaning:
भागिकाश् चत्वारस् तोदास्\ अर्धषष्ठे ऽपरः स्मृतः /
अर्धाश् च मे ऽष्टमे चैव \ नवमे दशमे ऽपरः /
अर्धद्वादशो वान्यः /
text_mt:
The pointers are four parts [each]; another is prescribed at five and a half.

And half-parts are at the eighth, and another at the ninth and tenth.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prācīḥ prasārya tu \ tasyā nikhānayec chaṅkum /
pāśayor madhyame 'ṣṭame / \ caturthe vāhatya pāśam /
āsajya madhyame nirāñchanam /
meaning:
ततः प्राचीः प्रसार्य तु \ तस्या निखानयेच् छङ्कुम् /
पाशयोर् मध्यमे ऽष्टमे / \ चतुर्थे वाहत्य पाशम् /
आसज्य मध्यमे निराञ्छनम् /
text_mt:
Then, having stretched [the cord] eastwards, one should drive a peg for it.

At the middle of the two loops, at the eighth, or having struck the loop at the fourth,

Having attached the marker at the middle,

sanskrit_iast:
nirāyamya vinudonmucya madhyamāt /
abhito daśama āyamya bhāgā dvikacatuṣkāḥ /
ardhaṣaṣṭhe 'pi cāhatya \ pūrvādevam̐ samācaret /
tulyaṃ śaṅkuṃ turye /
meaning:
निरायम्य विनुदोन्मुच्य मध्यमात् /
अभितो दशम आयम्य भागा द्विकचतुष्काः /
अर्धषष्ठे ऽपि चाहत्य \ पूर्वादेवम्̐ समाचरेत् /
तुल्यं शङ्कुं तुर्ये /
text_mt:
Having stretched out, pushing away, having unfastened from the middle,

Having stretched on both sides at the tenth, the parts are groups of two and four.

And having struck at five and a half, one should proceed thus from the east.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prācīḥ prasārya tu \ ardhaṣaṣṭhakayoḥ pāśau /
śaṅkū ardhāṣṭame 'ṣṭame / \ pragṛhya paścimaśaṅkū /
dvikayor votsṛjet tataḥ /
meaning:
ततः प्राचीः प्रसार्य तु \ अर्धषष्ठकयोः पाशौ /
शङ्कू अर्धाष्टमे ऽष्टमे / \ प्रगृह्य पश्चिमशङ्कू /
द्विकयोर् वोत्सृजेत् ततः /
text_mt:
Then having stretched eastwards, the two loops at five and a half,

Two pegs at seven and a half and eight; having taken hold of the two western pegs,

Or one should then release them at the two two-part [marks].

sanskrit_iast: caturthanavamau śaṅkū \ pravṛhed antimāv ubhau /
meaning: चतुर्थनवमौ शङ्कू \ प्रवृहेद् अन्तिमाव् उभौ /
text_mt: One should pull out the fourth and ninth pegs, both the last ones.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭame pāśam āsajya \ aṣṭamenaiva nigrahaḥ /
bhāgebhāge tataḥ śaṅkū tayoḥ /
meaning:
अष्टमे पाशम् आसज्य \ अष्टमेनैव निग्रहः /
भागेभागे ततः शङ्कू तयोः /
text_mt:
Having attached the loop at the eighth, the fastening is made with the eighth itself.

Then two pegs for those two in each part.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭame pāśam āsajya \ ādiśaṅkau nigṛhya ca /
daśame śaṅkum āhanyāt \ puchārdhe alajasya tu /
meaning:
अष्टमे पाशम् आसज्य \ आदिशङ्कौ निगृह्य च /
दशमे शङ्कुम् आहन्यात् \ पुछार्धे अलजस्य तु /
text_mt:
Having attached the loop at the eighth, and having fastened at the first peg,

One should drive a peg at the tenth, at the half-tail of the alaja.

sanskrit_iast: ...syārdhaṣṭame śaṅkuḥ \ kaṅkasya darśane smṛtaḥ /
meaning: ...स्यार्धष्टमे शङ्कुः \ कङ्कस्य दर्शने स्मृतः /
text_mt: A peg at seven and a half [...] is taught in the view concerning the heron.

sanskrit_iast:
trike pāśam̐ samāsajya \ daśakena nigṛhya ca /
etābhyām eva todābhyām\ śaṅkū deyau tathottarau /
meaning:
त्रिके पाशम्̐ समासज्य \ दशकेन निगृह्य च /
एताभ्याम् एव तोदाभ्याम्\ शङ्कू देयौ तथोत्तरौ /
text_mt:
Having fastened the loop at the third [mark], and having held it with the tenth,

With these very two pointers, two northern pegs should likewise be placed.

sanskrit_iast:
ardhadvādaśame pāśas \ triko nigrahaṇo bhavet /
ādipāśe dvike caiva \ śaṅkū deyau tathottarau /
meaning:
अर्धद्वादशमे पाशस् \ त्रिको निग्रहणो भवेत् /
आदिपाशे द्विके चैव \ शङ्कू देयौ तथोत्तरौ /
text_mt:
At eleven and a half is the loop; the third [mark] should be the holding point.

At the first loop and at the second [mark], two northern pegs should likewise be placed.

sanskrit_iast: uttare dvikam āsajya \ dakṣiṇam̐ samayor haret /
meaning: उत्तरे द्विकम् आसज्य \ दक्षिणम्̐ समयोर् हरेत् /
text_mt: Having attached the second [mark] to the north, one should bring the southern [end] between equals.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthe śaṅkum āhanyād \ viparītam̐ samācaret /
caturthe tu tadarthena \ nigṛhya ca ... /
meaning:
चतुर्थे शङ्कुम् आहन्याद् \ विपरीतम्̐ समाचरेत् /
चतुर्थे तु तदर्थेन \ निगृह्य च ... /
text_mt:
At the fourth one should drive a peg; one should perform the reverse.

At the fourth, however, having held it by half of that, and [...].

sanskrit_iast: iti śyenasya rajjur dvādaśalakṣaṇā /
meaning: इति श्येनस्य रज्जुर् द्वादशलक्षणा /
text_mt: Thus is the twelve-marked cord of the falcon [altar].

sanskrit_iast:
catvāri karaṇāny eṣām\ tricaturthena kārayet /
navabhāgā akṣṇārdhākṣṇāḥ \ pañcakoṇāḥ ca bhāgaśaḥ /
meaning:
चत्वारि करणान्य् एषाम्\ त्रिचतुर्थेन कारयेत् /
नवभागा अक्ष्णार्धाक्ष्णाः \ पञ्चकोणाः च भागशः /
text_mt:
One should prepare four bricks of these by means of three-quarters.

Nine-part [bricks], diagonal, half-diagonal, and five-cornered, part by part.

sanskrit_iast:
prācīne pañcakoṇe dve \ athārdhākṣṇādvayaṃ nyaset /
am̐sāgrayor athaikaikā \ evaṃ pakṣavipakṣayoḥ /
meaning:
प्राचीने पञ्चकोणे द्वे \ अथार्धाक्ष्णाद्वयं न्यसेत् /
अम्̐साग्रयोर् अथैकैका \ एवं पक्षविपक्षयोः /
text_mt:
Two eastern five-cornered [bricks], then one should place two half-diagonal bricks.

Then one each at the tips of the shoulders; thus on the wings and opposite sides.

sanskrit_iast:
navabhāgaiś citaṃ madhyam \ akṣṇābhiḥ pariṣiñcate /
pakṣāgre pañca patrāṇi\ evaṃ cākṣṇā vidhīyate /
meaning:
नवभागैश् चितं मध्यम् \ अक्ष्णाभिः परिषिञ्चते /
पक्षाग्रे पञ्च पत्राणि\ एवं चाक्ष्णा विधीयते /
text_mt:
The middle is piled with nine-part [bricks]; one encloses with diagonal bricks.

Five feathers at the wing-tip; and thus the diagonal [brick] is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
vyatyāsākṣṇādvayaṃ tunde \ pañcakoṇe pratyaksthite /
ardhākṣṇe kaṇṭhasaṃdhyoś ca \ pūrayed amitam̐ śiraḥ /
meaning:
व्यत्यासाक्ष्णाद्वयं तुन्दे \ पञ्चकोणे प्रत्यक्स्थिते /
अर्धाक्ष्णे कण्ठसंध्योश् च \ पूरयेद् अमितम्̐ शिरः /
text_mt:
Two alternating diagonal bricks on the belly, situated facing west at the five-cornered [brick].

And at the two throat-joints, two half-diagonal [bricks]; one should fill up the unmeasured head.

sanskrit_iast:
dve pakṣasaṃdhyor ardhākṣṇe \ puchasaṃdhyos tathāpare /
daśa pañca ca puchāgre \ pakṣāgra ekavim̐śatim /
meaning:
द्वे पक्षसंध्योर् अर्धाक्ष्णे \ पुछसंध्योस् तथापरे /
दश पञ्च च पुछाग्रे \ पक्षाग्र एकविम्̐शतिम् /
text_mt:
Two half-diagonal bricks at the two wing-joints, and others likewise at the two tail-joints.

Fifteen at the tail-tip; twenty-one at the wing-tip.

sanskrit_iast:
aupamāne cayane caiṣām\ vyatyāse karaṇeṣu ca /
rajjvāś cāvapanam̐ hrāso \ śyenasiddhir iti sthitaḥ /
meaning:
औपमाने चयने चैषाम्\ व्यत्यासे करणेषु च /
रज्ज्वाश् चावपनम्̐ ह्रासो \ श्येनसिद्धिर् इति स्थितः /
text_mt:
In the model piling of these, and in the alternation, and in the bricks,

By the expansion and reduction of the cord, the accomplishment of the falcon is established.

sanskrit_iast:
avakrapakṣam alajaṃ ca \ pūrvapakṣe tathāyutam /
madhyāt prasiddhaṃ pucham̐ śyene \ dāmnā prasidhyata iti /
meaning:
अवक्रपक्षम् अलजं च \ पूर्वपक्षे तथायुतम् /
मध्यात् प्रसिद्धं पुछम्̐ श्येने \ दाम्ना प्रसिध्यत इति /
text_mt:
And the straight-winged alaja is likewise combined in the first wing.

From the middle the tail is produced in the falcon; it is produced by a cord.

sanskrit_iast:
navamāt prāgbhāge śaṅkū \ turīyasya karaṇam /
alaje pakṣārdham avakratād dhy evaṃ bhavet /
meaning:
नवमात् प्राग्भागे शङ्कू \ तुरीयस्य करणम् /
अलजे पक्षार्धम् अवक्रताद् ध्य् एवं भवेत् /
text_mt:
Eastward from the ninth part are two pegs: the making of the fourth.

In the alaja, half a wing would indeed be thus from straightness.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣasya tṛtīyapañcamau bhāgau tatkaraṇaṃ punaściteḥ /
tasyārdham athāparaṃ bhavet tricitikam agnicitiś cet /
meaning:
पुरुषस्य तृतीयपञ्चमौ भागौ तत्करणं पुनश्चितेः /
तस्यार्धम् अथापरं भवेत् त्रिचितिकम् अग्निचितिश् चेत् /
text_mt:
The third and fifth parts of a man are the brick for the piling again.

Its half would be another, if the fire-altar piling is of three layers.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāvaṣṭau saṃmitā citir aṣṭaikādaśikā ca madhyamā /
vyatyāsavatīr upanyased aṣṭau dvādaśa cottamā citiḥ /
meaning:
अष्टावष्टौ संमिता चितिर् अष्टैकादशिका च मध्यमा /
व्यत्यासवतीर् उपन्यसेद् अष्टौ द्वादश चोत्तमा चितिः /
text_mt:
Eight by eight is the measured layer, and the middle one is eight by eleven.

One should place [them] with alternation; eight and twelve is the highest layer.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcadaśanaraṃ kṣetraṃ praugacit tatas tv ardham /
madhyād daśake trikuṣṭham etat tathā karaṇam /
meaning:
पञ्चदशनरं क्षेत्रं प्रौगचित् ततस् त्व् अर्धम् /
मध्याद् दशके त्रिकुष्ठम् एतत् तथा करणम् /
text_mt:
The ground for the praugacit is fifteen puruṣas, but half of that from it.

From the middle in a [span of] ten, this is triangular; likewise is the construction.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhvor ekavim̐śa ubhakaraṇe tathārdho 'nyaś ca /
am̐saśroṇyoś chedas tasyobhayato bhavet praugaḥ /
meaning:
बाह्वोर् एकविम्̐श उभकरणे तथार्धो ऽन्यश् च /
अम्̐सश्रोण्योश् छेदस् तस्योभयतो भवेत् प्रौगः /
text_mt:
On the two arms, a twenty-first part is the construction of both; likewise another is a half.

The cut of the two shoulders and two buttocks would be the triangle on both sides of it.

sanskrit_iast:
cātvālebhyaś caturbhyas tu samūhyo 'gnir aniṣṭakaḥ /
digbhyaḥ purīṣaiḥ samūhyo bhāgaśo yuktito vidhiḥ /
meaning:
चात्वालेभ्यश् चतुर्भ्यस् तु समूह्यो ऽग्निर् अनिष्टकः /
दिग्भ्यः पुरीषैः समूह्यो भागशो युक्तितो विधिः /
text_mt:
The brickless fire should be gathered together from the four pits.

It should be gathered from the directions with soil; the rule is portion by portion according to suitability.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍalacaturasro 'dya parivāryaḥ śmaśānacit /
droṇacit tsarumāneṣāṃ daśabhāgo bhavet tsaruḥ /
meaning:
मण्डलचतुरस्रो ऽद्य परिवार्यः श्मशानचित् /
द्रोणचित् त्सरुमानेषां दशभागो भवेत् त्सरुः /
text_mt:
Now, the cemetery-pile fire altar is circular-square, to be enclosed.

In the trough-pile fire altar, according to the handle measure of these, the tenth part shall be the handle.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍale caturasraṃ tu kuryād gārhapatyavat /
bāhvor vim̐śatibhāgena vāruṇam̐ sārdham eva tu /
meaning:
मण्डले चतुरस्रं तु कुर्याद् गार्हपत्यवत् /
बाह्वोर् विम्̐शतिभागेन वारुणम्̐ सार्धम् एव तु /
text_mt:
In the circle, one should make a square, as in the case of the gārhapatya fire.

By a twentieth part of the two arms, indeed along with a half, [is the square] sacred to Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
prasiddhaṃ daśadhā kuryād bahir antaś ca yuktitaḥ /
trikuṣṭhaś ca viṣāṇaḥ syāt saṃdhau vyatyāsa eva saḥ /
meaning:
प्रसिद्धं दशधा कुर्याद् बहिर् अन्तश् च युक्तितः /
त्रिकुष्ठश् च विषाणः स्यात् संधौ व्यत्यास एव सः /
text_mt:
One should make the well-known [area] into ten parts, outside and inside according to suitability.

And the horn should be triangular; at the joint, that is indeed alternation.

sanskrit_iast:
caturasrasya karaṇaṃ bāhvor dvātrim̐śadbhāgikam /
caturasram athādhyardhaṃ tābhyāṃ gāyatravadvidhiḥ /
meaning:
चतुरस्रस्य करणं बाह्वोर् द्वात्रिम्̐शद्भागिकम् /
चतुरस्रम् अथाध्यर्धं ताभ्यां गायत्रवद्विधिः /
text_mt:
The making of the square is by a thirty-second part of the two arms.

Then the square is one and a half [times]; by those two, the rule is like the gāyatra.

sanskrit_iast:
sāhasrasya karaṇaṃ bāhvoḥ pañcadaśabhāgaṃ caturasram /
adhyardhās tu tataḥ syur dviśatāś citayaḥ smṛtāḥ /
meaning:
साहस्रस्य करणं बाह्वोः पञ्चदशभागं चतुरस्रम् /
अध्यर्धास् तु ततः स्युर् द्विशताश् चितयः स्मृताः /
text_mt:
The making of the thousand-[brick altar] is a square of a fifteenth part of the two arms.

The one-and-a-half-[sized bricks] from that would be two hundred; the layers are stated.

sanskrit_iast:
pañca pañcāśatam adhyardhās tisraḥ pañcāśataṃ caturasrāḥ /
sahasrāc chataṃ pakṣāḥ syur uṣā sahasratamī /
meaning:
पञ्च पञ्चाशतम् अध्यर्धास् तिस्रः पञ्चाशतं चतुरस्राः /
सहस्राच् छतं पक्षाः स्युर् उषा सहस्रतमी /
text_mt:
Fifty-five one-and-a-half-[sized bricks], three fifties of square [bricks].

From a thousand, a hundred would be the wings; the dawn is the thousandth.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhvor ekatrim̐śo bhāgaḥ karaṇaṃ citis tathottarayoḥ /
caturasrānām̐ sāhasram\ savanike vyavāsyanti /
meaning:
बाह्वोर् एकत्रिम्̐शो भागः करणं चितिस् तथोत्तरयोः /
चतुरस्रानाम्̐ साहस्रम्\ सवनिके व्यवास्यन्ति /
text_mt:
A thirty-first part of the two arms is the making, and likewise the layer of the upper two.

They arrange a thousand square [bricks] in the pressing [ritual].

sanskrit_iast: ardhaikādaśapuruṣaṃ ghanaṃ bhaved bhaven maṇḍalam̐ rathacakraṃ / nābhir arā vivaradhā nemir arebhyo yady atiriktam /
meaning: अर्धैकादशपुरुषं घनं भवेद् भवेन् मण्डलम्̐ रथचक्रं / नाभिर् अरा विवरधा नेमिर् अरेभ्यो यद्य् अतिरिक्तम् /
text_mt: The circle should be ten and a half puruṣas solid, it should be a chariot wheel; the hub, spokes, [and] the openings between, the rim if there is excess beyond the spokes.

sanskrit_iast: tadardhāḥ puruṣāyāmāḥ puruṣāṣṭabhāgavistṛtāḥ caturvim̐śatis trinaranāyāḥ /
meaning: तदर्धाः पुरुषायामाः पुरुषाष्टभागविस्तृताः चतुर्विम्̐शतिस् त्रिनरनायाः /
text_mt: Half of that in length are the puruṣas, an eighth of a puruṣa wide; twenty-four are the guide for three men.

sanskrit_iast: vivarakaraṇamataḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi / dvisaptamena nemyasrakaraṇaṃ bhaved arasyāṣṭabhāgena vaikṛtaś caturvim̐śatibhāgena nābhyām antaram antaro 'ṣṭamabhāgena praugavad bhavet /
meaning: विवरकरणमतः संप्रवक्ष्यामि / द्विसप्तमेन नेम्यस्रकरणं भवेद् अरस्याष्टभागेन वैकृतश् चतुर्विम्̐शतिभागेन नाभ्याम् अन्तरम् अन्तरो ऽष्टमभागेन प्रौगवद् भवेत् /
text_mt: Henceforth I shall explain the making of the openings: by a two-sevenths part the rim-corner construction should be done; by an eighth part of a spoke is the modified [brick]; by a twenty-fourth part in the hub the space; the space inside by an eighth part should be like a triangle.

sanskrit_iast:
dvīṣṭakām̐ cinuyān nābhim\ caturbhiś cinuyād arān /
tribhir nemim̐ yathābhāgam̐ / \ vyatyāsaḥ kūpavat smṛtaḥ /
meaning:
द्वीष्टकाम्̐ चिनुयान् नाभिम्\ चतुर्भिश् चिनुयाद् अरान् /
त्रिभिर् नेमिम्̐ यथाभागम्̐ / \ व्यत्यासः कूपवत् स्मृतः /
text_mt:
One should pile the hub with two bricks, one should pile the spokes with four;

the rim with three according to division; / the alternation is remembered as being like a well.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣkambhasya caturthena \ nābhyās tu vivaram̐ likhet /
tricatvārim̐śāṅgulāṃ nemim̐ sārdhacaturaṅgulām /
meaning:
विष्कम्भस्य चतुर्थेन \ नाभ्यास् तु विवरम्̐ लिखेत् /
त्रिचत्वारिम्̐शाङ्गुलां नेमिम्̐ सार्धचतुरङ्गुलाम् /
text_mt:
With a fourth part of the diameter, / one should draw the opening of the hub;

the rim forty-three aṅgulas, / [and] four and a half aṅgulas.

sanskrit_iast: siddham anyad yathā yuktis\ cayane yāś ca saṃpadaḥ /
meaning: सिद्धम् अन्यद् यथा युक्तिस्\ चयने याश् च संपदः /
text_mt: The rest is established as appropriate, / and whichever arrangements [occur] in the piling.

sanskrit_iast: ya idam api yathātatham̐ smṛtim̐ vidhim̐ yad ādhītya mimīte rauravam̐ samavati khalu kṛtsnasaṃmato vrajati ca śulbakṛtām̐ salokatām /
meaning: य इदम् अपि यथातथम्̐ स्मृतिम्̐ विधिम्̐ यद् आधीत्य मिमीते रौरवम्̐ समवति खलु कृत्स्नसंमतो व्रजति च शुल्बकृताम्̐ सलोकताम् /
text_mt: He who, having studied this traditional rule according to fact, measures it out, saves [ancestors] from the Raurava [hell], approved by all, and goes to the same world as the cord-makers.

sanskrit_iast:
rathacakrasya cityasya \ saṃkṣepoktasya viṣṇunā /
atha dhātur niviṣṭhasya \ triguṇānyaṃ bahirbahiḥ /
līyante maṇḍale yasya \ sapta sārdhā narā budhaiḥ /
meaning:
रथचक्रस्य चित्यस्य \ संक्षेपोक्तस्य विष्णुना /
अथ धातुर् निविष्ठस्य \ त्रिगुणान्यं बहिर्बहिः /
लीयन्ते मण्डले यस्य \ सप्त सार्धा नरा बुधैः /

sanskrit_iast: mucyante vivareṣv anye \ kṣetrād abhyadhikās trayaḥ /
meaning: मुच्यन्ते विवरेष्व् अन्ये \ क्षेत्राद् अभ्यधिकास् त्रयः /
text_mt: three in excess of the field / are left free in the openings.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya cakravidhānaṃ tu / \ nemir arebhyo vistaraḥ /
maṇḍalānāṃ ca viṣkambhaḥ \ tribhāgaḥ karaṇāni ca /
meaning:
तस्य चक्रविधानं तु / \ नेमिर् अरेभ्यो विस्तरः /
मण्डलानां च विष्कम्भः \ त्रिभागः करणानि च /
text_mt:
The rule for that wheel, however, is: / the rim is the extension beyond the spokes;

and the diameter of the circles / is a third part, and the constructions.

sanskrit_iast:
narārdhenābhilikhen nābhis \ tataḥ prastāragocarā /
arebhyo 'bhyadhikā nemis \ triṣaṣṭhenākṣarāgāram /
trim̐śatena savim̐śena \ adhikaiś cārdhapañcamaiḥ /
mimāyāṅgulair vā madhyaṃ kuryād vim̐śena parilekhanam /
meaning:
नरार्धेनाभिलिखेन् नाभिस् \ ततः प्रस्तारगोचरा /
अरेभ्यो ऽभ्यधिका नेमिस् \ त्रिषष्ठेनाक्षरागारम् /
त्रिम्̐शतेन सविम्̐शेन \ अधिकैश् चार्धपञ्चमैः /
मिमायाङ्गुलैर् वा मध्यं कुर्याद् विम्̐शेन परिलेखनम् /

sanskrit_iast:
prathame prastare rathacakrasya śṛṇuteṣṭakāḥ /
caturbhir adhikam̐ vettha \ catvārim̐śac chatatrayam /
meaning:
प्रथमे प्रस्तरे रथचक्रस्य शृणुतेष्टकाः /
चतुर्भिर् अधिकम्̐ वेत्थ \ चत्वारिम्̐शच् छतत्रयम् /
text_mt:
In the first layer of the chariot wheel, listen to the bricks:

you know [it is] four in excess / of three hundred and forty.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye 'bhyadhikā yāntu \ caturvim̐śatir iṣṭakāḥ /
pañcakoṇās trikoṇāś ca \ nemyarebhyaḥ ca saṃdhiṣu /
meaning:
द्वितीये ऽभ्यधिका यान्तु \ चतुर्विम्̐शतिर् इष्टकाः /
पञ्चकोणास् त्रिकोणाश् च \ नेम्यरेभ्यः च संधिषु /
text_mt:
In the second, let twenty-four / bricks be in excess.

Five-cornered and three-cornered, / from the rim and spokes, and at the joints.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭakānām̐ sahasreṇa \ śataiḥ saptabhir eva ca /
aṣṭaṣaṣṭyā ca cakrasya \ citayaḥ pañca pūritāḥ /
meaning:
इष्टकानाम्̐ सहस्रेण \ शतैः सप्तभिर् एव च /
अष्टषष्ट्या च चक्रस्य \ चितयः पञ्च पूरिताः /
text_mt:
With one thousand / and seven hundred bricks,

and sixty-eight, / the five layers of the wheel are completed.

sanskrit_iast: athātaḥ pratigrahakalpam̐ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: अथातः प्रतिग्रहकल्पम्̐ व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: Now then, we shall explain the ritual procedure for accepting gifts.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāṃ pratigṛhṇīyād nāvedavin nāśucir nāyajñopavītī na muktaśikho nārtaś ca nānudake na cākāle /
meaning: दक्षिणां प्रतिगृह्णीयाद् नावेदविन् नाशुचिर् नायज्ञोपवीती न मुक्तशिखो नार्तश् च नानुदके न चाकाले /
text_mt: One should accept a sacrificial gift: not if one is ignorant of the Veda, not impure, not without wearing the sacred thread over the left shoulder, not with loosened hair-tuft, not afflicted, not when away from water, and not at an improper time.

sanskrit_iast: sāvitraḥ purastāt ka idam iti paścāt //
meaning: सावित्रः पुरस्तात् क इदम् इति पश्चात् //
text_mt: The [formula] to Savitṛ is in front; 'Who [gives] this…?' is behind.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpataye tvā \\ iti puruṣīṃ pratigṛhṇīyād dhastinaṃ puruṣaṃ bhūmiṃ prāṇi cānyat sarvaṃ jīvam anūrvarāṃ candrāya tvā \\ iti śiras \\ yamāya tvā \\ ity ekaśapham \\ rudrāya tvā \\ iti gām agnaye tvā \\ iti hiraṇyaṃ trapu sīsamayo lohaṃ ca gnās tvākṛntan \\ apaso 'tanvata \ dhiyo 'vayan \ bṛhaspataye tvā \\ iti vāsas \\ uttānāya tvā \\ ity aprāṇad viśvebhyo devebhyas tvā \\ iti chattraṃ gṛhaṃ grāmaṃ ca śrīkāmāya tvā \\ iti śayyām indrāgnibhyāṃ tvā \\ iti chāgaṃ meṣaṃ mahiṣaṃ ca varuṇāya tvā \\ ity udakumbhaṃ kūpaṃ taḍāgaṃ ca samudrāya tvā \\ iti karakaśaṅkhaśuktipravālāni yac cānyat kiṃcit sāmudraṃ tvaṣṭre \\ ity uṣṭrān somāya rasān dravān gandhasrajo vanaspatīm̐ś ca vaiśvānarāya tvā \\ iti tvā \\ iti rathān /
meaning: प्रजापतये त्वा \\ इति पुरुषीं प्रतिगृह्णीयाद् धस्तिनं पुरुषं भूमिं प्राणि चान्यत् सर्वं जीवम् अनूर्वरां चन्द्राय त्वा \\ इति शिरस् \\ यमाय त्वा \\ इत्य् एकशफम् \\ रुद्राय त्वा \\ इति गाम् अग्नये त्वा \\ इति हिरण्यं त्रपु सीसमयो लोहं च ग्नास् त्वाकृन्तन् \\ अपसो ऽतन्वत \ धियो ऽवयन् \ बृहस्पतये त्वा \\ इति वासस् \\ उत्तानाय त्वा \\ इत्य् अप्राणद् विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यस् त्वा \\ इति छत्त्रं गृहं ग्रामं च श्रीकामाय त्वा \\ इति शय्याम् इन्द्राग्निभ्यां त्वा \\ इति छागं मेषं महिषं च वरुणाय त्वा \\ इत्य् उदकुम्भं कूपं तडागं च समुद्राय त्वा \\ इति करकशङ्खशुक्तिप्रवालानि यच् चान्यत् किंचित् सामुद्रं त्वष्ट्रे \\ इत्य् उष्ट्रान् सोमाय रसान् द्रवान् गन्धस्रजो वनस्पतीम्̐श् च वैश्वानराय त्वा \\ इति त्वा \\ इति रथान् /
text_mt: With 'To Prajāpati thee,' he should accept a woman, an elephant, a man, land, any other living breath-possessing creature, [and] untilled land; with 'To Candra thee,' a head; with 'To Yama thee,' a one-hoofed animal; with 'To Rudra thee,' a cow; with 'To Agni thee,' gold, tin, lead, iron, and copper; with 'The divine wives cut thee, the active ones stretched [thee], the thoughtful ones wove [thee]; to Bṛhaspati thee,' a garment; with 'To Uttāna thee,' an inanimate object; with 'To the All-Gods thee,' an umbrella, a house, and a village; with 'To him who desires prosperity thee,' a bed; with 'To Indra and Agni thee,' a he-goat, a ram, and a buffalo; with 'To Varuṇa thee,' a water jar, a well, and a pond; with 'To the ocean thee,' a water pot, a conch shell, pearl-oyster shells, corals, and whatever other oceanic item there is; with 'To Tvaṣṭṛ,' camels; with 'To Soma,' saps, liquids, scents, garlands, and trees; with 'To Vaiśvānara thee,' chariots.

sanskrit_iast:
yady āsaṃbhṛtā nānādakṣiṇās tāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ pratigṛhṇīyāt
pṛthivyāṃ puṇyaṃ ca pāpam\ ca kas te pratipaśyati /
iṣṭapuṇyaṃ ca pāpaṃ ca \ ādityaḥ pratipaśyati //
yadā dātā pramīyeta \ yasmai dattam̐ sa jīvati /
antarāvartamānābhyām\ dakṣiṇā kasya tiṣṭhati //
varuṇo dakṣiṇāḥ pratigṛhya viṣṭāve prayachati /
sa dātā sarvasatyānām\ janmakāle punaḥpunaḥ //
iti /
meaning:

text_mt:
If various sacrificial gifts have not been gathered together, he should accept that sacrificial gift [with]:

"On earth, both merit and sin, / who watches over thee?"

"Both sacrificed merit and sin, / Āditya watches over."

"When the giver passes away, / and he to whom it was given lives,

between the two turning around, / to whom does the sacrificial gift belong?"

Varuṇa, having accepted the sacrificial gifts, / distributes them in the course [of rites];

he is the giver of all true things, / time and again at the time of birth.

text_mt:
He who, knowing thus, accepts [a gift], purifies the giver, purifies himself, [and] purifies the sacrificial gift among the gods, [saying,] 'I know'.

Now, therefore, we shall explain the ritual rule for one born under [the asterism] Mūla.

In the first quarter of Mūla, it is unfavorable for the father; in the second, for the mother; in the third, for wealth; in the fourth, it brings sorrow to the family, or he becomes an enjoyer of merit himself.

There he should set up a water jar, having muttered into it the Rudra hymns, the Apratiratha hymn, and the demon-destroying hymn.

There is a second water jar, provided with four spouts; in it he should place roots prepared in a bamboo vessel.

text_mt:
I shall declare their principal roots: first, kāśmarya, sahadevī, aparājitā, adhaḥpuṣpī, śaṅkhapuṣpī, balā, pāṭalā, mayūraśikhā, madhupuṣpikā, cakrāṅkitā, kākajaṅghā, kumārī; second, vaijayantī, apāmārga, bhṛṅgarāja, lakṣmaṇā, jātī, vyāghra, pattraka, cakramarda, kapileśvarā, aśvattha, saha, palāśa, udumbara, plakṣa, śamī, arka, rohitaka, bilva. Having filled [the jar] root by root with these and others of such kind, he should also place in the middle a golden root together with the seven grains.

I shall declare their forbidden roots: tilvaka, dhava, nimba, śālmalī, rājavṛkṣa, śleṣmātaka, excluding all thorny plants.

There he should perform the sprinkling: for the father, the infant, the mother, and the brother-in-law, who are seated on a wicker seat, he sprinkles with the residue [of the water] from the head down over the face.

text_mt:
With "My head is fortune, fame…", he touches the limbs according to their characteristic marks.

After they have bathed, having cooked a boiled pot-offering dedicated to Nirṛti in milk, having wiped the kāśmarya enclosing sticks, the fuel, the ladles, and the dipping spoon, having offered the two libations of clarified butter and the two clarified butter portions, having offered four portions of the boiled pot-offering with "The one who presses not, who sacrifices not…", he should offer fifteen clarified butter oblations with "With what splendor, of the same age…"; with "Not our children…" and "Whatever body of thine is auspicious, O Rudra…", five.

Having offered to Agni Sviṣṭakṛt with the two verses, "O Agni, protect…" and "The web with lead…", when it is concluded, he should give to the teacher a black cow, a black and blue [cloth], the golden root, and the seven grains; to the brahman priest, a black ox; [and] according to his means, he should give gold to the brāhmaṇas.

He should feed the brāhmaṇas with kṛsara, rice-milk pudding, and food mixed with clarified butter.

All is splendid, secure, healthy, accompanied by the fulfillment of all wishes and by the fulfillment of all auspiciousness.

Thus the rule for the divinity Nirṛti and for the conjunction of poisons was taught by Manu: "In the pacifying eye it is favorable, propitious, bringing increase of wealth and grain, protecting the entire family, removing fear and grief, and bringing good fortune in strength and luck."

text_mt:
If to him twin sons, two cows, or two mares should be born,

when a year is completed, or in the twelfth year, or after twelve nights, he should fetch the seven astringents: aśvattha, udumbara, vikaṅkata, nyagrodha, plakṣa, śamī, śamaka, and priyaṅgu and white mustard.

If he does not find them, [there is] a gold-bath. With the four [verses] "Golden-colored, pure…", having seated them facing east on a four-legged auspicious seat, with an earthen pot having a hundred perforations, holding over them a vessel with a thousand perforations, four widows or four celibate students should bathe them with the two sections "Those plants which…" and "Together the others go…".

Bathed and adorned, the couple should lead [each other] around the fire clockwise.

Sitting behind the fire on darbha grass, cutting portions seven times from the boiled pot-offering dedicated to the Maruts, he offers with the two verses containing the word 'priya'.

अथात आश्लेषाविधिम्म्̐ व्याख्यास्यामः /

text_mt:
Cows with a bull as the first are the sacrificial gift.

Having dug seven furrows to the east of the fire, having filled them with fragrant water, before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, [offering] clarified butter with the Jaya formulas and the rest, he should cross over [the furrows] verse by verse with the eight verses "The Golden Germ…", and should mutter the eighth [verse].

We shall explain the rule by the injunction for one who has established the sacred fires.

He should apportion a sacrificial cake on thirteen potsherds for the Maruts.

Its sacrificial gift is a milch cow.

If he does not find that, he should give a good, very prosperous field, a barley field or a sesame field.

If he does not find those, covered with a woolen cloth and skin, he should enter the submarine fire; that is the concession for this.

Now, therefore, we shall explain the rule for [one born under the asterism] Āśleṣā.

text_mt:
In the first quarter there is destruction of the mother; in the fourth, destruction of the father.

There, having taken the hundred herbs mentioned in the rule for Mūla, having placed them in a copper vessel or a fine bamboo vessel, having arranged raw rice around, having set up upon it a gold serpent weighing a niṣka with its face downward, having performed an ablution with the five products of the cow, he should wrap it with a pair of garments and a sacred thread, [and worship it] with fragrant perfumes, flowers of five colors, incenses, lamps, various refreshments and foods, betel and the like, and various kinds of fruits.

He should worship the golden serpent with "Homage be to the serpents…".

text_mt: Then, having established four jars, having filled the first with waterfall water and the others likewise—placing in the first the seven earths, in the second devadāru, mustā, white mustard, blue lotus, turmeric, guḍūcī, and sandalwood, in the third all the herbs, and in the fourth having done all this—having consecrated them with the four sacred formulas "Go to the ocean…", having honored them with perfumes, flowers, and the like, on an auspicious day, under an auspicious constellation, at an auspicious ascendant, at an auspicious time, the sacrificer, having become pure, having put on two unwashed garments, having bowed to the teacher adorned with perfumes and the like, having recited the declaration of an auspicious day together with the officiating priests, having made an earthen mound in the middle of the jars, having established the fire, having cooked the boiled pot-offering, having offered the two libations of clarified butter and the two clarified butter portions, should then offer a hundred and eight [oblations] separately with the Sāvitrī verse to Savitṛ, with "We of Soma…" to Soma, with "The one who presses not, who sacrifices not…" to Nirṛti, and with "Thousand-headed…" to Viṣṇu.

text_mt:
With "Homage be to the serpents…", he should offer kindling sticks, boiled oblation, sesame, and clarified butter.

Having offered to Sviṣṭakṛt, having offered the expiation oblations, and having offered the full oblation, the teacher, drawing out from the jar the water mixed with all the herbs, sesame, and mustard seeds, should, together with the officiating priests, sprinkle the infant, the mother, and the father with the four jars.

The remainder is explained by "The sacrificial gift is as before".

"Learn that mark regarding the appearance / of teeth in children:

For whichever child the teeth / appear first on the upper jaw,

Or if one should be born with teeth, O best of the Bhārgavas,

he will devour his mother, his father, or indeed himself.

I shall explain the appeasement rite for that; listen to it as I declare it.

The twice-born should place the child mounted on the back of an elephant, or situated in a boat.

In the absence of that, one who knows the sacred law [should place him] on an excellent seat made of gold.

With all medicinal herbs, all fragrant substances, seeds, flowers, and fruits,

with the five products of the cow, jewels, and banners, O Bhārgava,

he should immediately thereafter worship Dhātṛ with a boiled oblation in a pot.

And feeding of brāhmaṇas must be performed in this rite for seven days.

On the eighth day, a sacrificial gift must likewise be given to the priests:

gold, silver, land, and indeed oneself.

Now hear further about the bath in the case of ordinary birth of teeth.

Having seated him on an auspicious seat, with earths, roots, and fruits,

with all medicinal herbs together with seeds, and likewise with all fragrant substances,

he should bathe him while worshipping Agni, Soma, and Vāyu.

First he should install Keśava, the god of gods, there.

He should offer clarified butter in the fire according to the ritual rule to those [deities] alone.

Worship and a sacrificial gift must then be given to the brāhmaṇas.

Then one should bathe the shining child well on the head with seeds under an umbrella.

And with very unctuous [oils] the body of the child is thoroughly adorned.

And non-widowed women, brāhmaṇas, and friends are to be honored.

If women give premature birth, or their offspring are born past the proper time,

or if inhuman beings, those without genitalia, or those without secondary sex characteristics are born,

meaning: नमः शंभवे च \\ इति स्नात्वा \\ असंख्याता सहस्राणि \\ इति दशभिर् मार्जनम् उत्तीर्य वस्त्रे च परिधायाचम्य रुद्रं न्यसेद् या ते रुद्र \\ इति शिखायाम् \\ ये अस्मिन् महत्य् अर्णवे \\ इति शिरसि \\ असंख्यातास् \\ इति ललाटे नमो नीलकपर्दाय \\ इति चक्षुषोर् नमः श्रुताय च श्रुतसेनाय च \\ इति कर्णयोर् अवतत्य धनुष् ट्वम् इति मुखे नमो नीलग्रीवाय \\ इति कण्ठे नमस् ता आयुधायानातताय \\ इति बाह्वोर् नमो गिरिकेभ्यस् \\ इति हृदये हिरण्यगर्भस् \\ इति नाभ्यां नमो गणेभ्यस् \\ इति पृष्टौ नमो मीढुष्टराय च \\ इति कट्याम् इमा रुद्राय तवसे \\ इति गुह्ये मा नो महान्तम् इत्य् ऊर्वोर् ये पथां पथिरक्षयस् \\ इति पादयोर् अध्यवोचद् इति कवचं नमो बिल्मिने च \\ इत्य् उपकवचं प्रमुञ्च धन्वनस् \\ इत्य् अस्त्रम् //
text_mt: Having bathed with "Homage to Śambhu...", having sprinkled oneself with the ten verses beginning with "The unnumbered thousands...", emerged [from the water], put on two garments, and sipped water, he should project Rudra onto the body: with "That form of yours, O Rudra..." on the topknot; with "Those who are in this great ocean..." on the head; with "The unnumbered..." on the forehead; with "Homage to the blue-braided one..." on the two eyes; with "Homage to the famed and to the army of fame..." on the two ears; with "Having unstrung your bow..." on the mouth; with "Homage to the blue-necked one..." on the throat; with "Homage to your weapon that is not strung..." on the two arms; with "Homage to those living on mountains..." on the heart; with "The golden embryo..." on the navel; with "Homage to the hosts..." on the back; with "Homage to the most generous one..." on the waist; with "These [prayers] to the mighty Rudra..." on the private parts; with "Do not harm our great one..." on the two thighs; with "Those who are protectors of the paths..." on the two feet; with "He spoke in defense...", this is the armor; with "Homage to the helmeted one...", this is the auxiliary armor; with "Unstring the bow...", this is the weapon.

sanskrit_iast: ya etāvantas \\ iti digbandhaḥ //
meaning: य एतावन्तस् \\ इति दिग्बन्धः //
text_mt: With "Those who are so many..." is the sealing of the quarters.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya \\ iti vinyaset /
oṃkāraṃ mūrdhni vinyasya \ nakāraṃ nāsike tathā /
mokāraṃ tu lalāṭe vai \ bhakāraṃ mukhamadhyataḥ /
gakāraṃ kaṇṭhadeśe tu \ vakāram̐ hṛdaye nyaset /
tekāraṃ dakṣiṇe haste \ rukāram̐ vāmato nyaset /
drākāraṃ nābhimadhye tu \ yakāraṃ pādayos tathā /
meaning:
ओं नमो भगवते रुद्राय \\ इति विन्यसेत् /
ओंकारं मूर्ध्नि विन्यस्य \ नकारं नासिके तथा /
मोकारं तु ललाटे वै \ भकारं मुखमध्यतः /
गकारं कण्ठदेशे तु \ वकारम्̐ हृदये न्यसेत् /
तेकारं दक्षिणे हस्ते \ रुकारम्̐ वामतो न्यसेत् /
द्राकारं नाभिमध्ये तु \ यकारं पादयोस् तथा /
text_mt:
He should project [the syllables] with: "Om, homage to the Blessed Lord Rudra."

Having placed the syllable *om* on the crown of the head, and the syllable *na* on the nose,

the syllable *mo* on the forehead, and the syllable *bha* in the center of the face,

the syllable *ga* on the region of the throat, and the syllable *va* on the heart,

the syllable *te* on the right hand, and the syllable *ru* on the left,

the syllable *drā* in the center of the navel, and the syllable *ya* on the two feet.

sanskrit_iast: trātāram indram \\ prācīdigadhipataya indrāya namaḥ // \ tvaṃ no agna \ āgneyadigadhipataye 'gnaye namaḥ // \ sugaṃ nu panthām \\ dakṣiṇādigadhipataye yamāya namaḥ // \ asunvantam ayajamānam \\ nairṛtyadigadhipataye nirṛtaye namaḥ // \ tat tvā yāmi \ paścimadigadhipataye varuṇāya namaḥ // \ ā no niyudbhir \ vāyavyadigadhipataye vāyave namaḥ // \ tvam̐ soma kratubhir \ udagdigadhipataye kuberāya namaḥ // \ tam īśānam \ īśānadigadhipataya īśānāya namaḥ // \ imā rudrāya tavase \\ ūrdhvādigadhipataye brahmaṇe namaḥ // \ syonā pṛthivi \\ adhodigadhipataye 'nantāya namas \\ ity etad diksaṃpuṭam /
