meaning: त्रातारम् इन्द्रम् \\ प्राचीदिगधिपतय इन्द्राय नमः // \ त्वं नो अग्न \ आग्नेयदिगधिपतये ऽग्नये नमः // \ सुगं नु पन्थाम् \\ दक्षिणादिगधिपतये यमाय नमः // \ असुन्वन्तम् अयजमानम् \\ नैरृत्यदिगधिपतये निरृतये नमः // \ तत् त्वा यामि \ पश्चिमदिगधिपतये वरुणाय नमः // \ आ नो नियुद्भिर् \ वायव्यदिगधिपतये वायवे नमः // \ त्वम्̐ सोम क्रतुभिर् \ उदग्दिगधिपतये कुबेराय नमः // \ तम् ईशानम् \ ईशानदिगधिपतय ईशानाय नमः // \ इमा रुद्राय तवसे \\ ऊर्ध्वादिगधिपतये ब्रह्मणे नमः // \ स्योना पृथिवि \\ अधोदिगधिपतये ऽनन्ताय नमस् \\ इत्य् एतद् दिक्संपुटम् /
text_mt: With "Indra the protector...", "Homage to Indra, the lord of the eastern quarter"; with "You, O Agni, to us...", "Homage to Agni, the lord of the south-eastern quarter"; with "The easy path...", "Homage to Yama, the lord of the southern quarter"; with "Him who does not press, who does not sacrifice...", "Homage to Nirṛti, the lord of the south-western quarter"; with "That of you I implore...", "Homage to Varuṇa, the lord of the western quarter"; with "To us with your teams...", "Homage to Vāyu, the lord of the north-western quarter"; with "You, O Soma, through sacred acts...", "Homage to Kubera, the lord of the northern quarter"; with "Him the ruler...", "Homage to Īśāna, the lord of the north-eastern quarter"; with "These [prayers] to the mighty Rudra...", "Homage to Brahman, the lord of the upper quarter"; with "Kind, O Earth...", "Homage to Ananta, the lord of the lower quarter"—this is the enclosing of the directions.

sanskrit_iast: evam evātmani raudrīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā tvagasthigataiḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate /
meaning: एवम् एवात्मनि रौद्रीकरणं कृत्वा त्वगस्थिगतैः पापैः प्रमुच्यते /
text_mt: Having thus effected the assimilation to Rudra within oneself, one is freed from sins residing in skin and bones.

sanskrit_iast: anena vidhinā na grāme na strīsravaṇe na śrāddha āmantrite na paśusaṃnidhau yakṣarākṣasabhūtapretapiśācayamadūtaśākinītaskarādyupaghātāḥ /
meaning: अनेन विधिना न ग्रामे न स्त्रीस्रवणे न श्राद्ध आमन्त्रिते न पशुसंनिधौ यक्षराक्षसभूतप्रेतपिशाचयमदूतशाकिनीतस्कराद्युपघाताः /
text_mt: By this rule, neither in a village, nor during the monthly courses of women, nor when invited to an ancestral rite, nor in the presence of beasts, do afflictions by yakṣas, rākṣasas, bhūtas, pretas, piśācas, messengers of Yama, śākinīs, thieves, and the like occur.

sanskrit_iast: sarve te jvalantaṃ paśyanti /
meaning: सर्वे ते ज्वलन्तं पश्यन्ति /
text_mt: All of them see him as blazing.

sanskrit_iast: ātmānam̐ rudrarūpaṃ dhyāyet /
meaning: आत्मानम्̐ रुद्ररूपं ध्यायेत् /
text_mt: He should meditate upon himself as possessing the form of Rudra:

sanskrit_iast: trinetraṃ pañcavaktraṃ daśabhujam̐ saumyam̐ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ nīlagrīvam̐ śaśāṅkacihnam̐ śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ nāgayajñopavītinam̐ vyāghracarmottarīyakaṃ kamaṇḍalvakṣasūtrahastam abhayapradaṃ triśūlahastaṃ pinākapāṇinam̐ vṛṣabhaskandhasamārūḍham umādehārdhadhāriṇaṃ jvalantaṃ kapilajaṭaṃ jaṭāmukuṭasam̐yuktam̐ śikhām uddyotakāriṇam amṛtenāplutam̐ hṛṣṭam̐ surāsurair namaskṛtaṃ digdevataiḥ samāyuktaṃ nityaṃ ca śāśvatam̐ śivaṃ dhruvam akṣayam avyayam̐ sarvavyāpinirañjanam īśānam̐ rudram̐ viśvarūpiṇam evaṃ dhyātvā dvijaḥ samyak tato japam ārabhet /
meaning: त्रिनेत्रं पञ्चवक्त्रं दशभुजम्̐ सौम्यम्̐ सर्वाभरणभूषितं नीलग्रीवम्̐ शशाङ्कचिह्नम्̐ शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशं नागयज्ञोपवीतिनम्̐ व्याघ्रचर्मोत्तरीयकं कमण्डल्वक्षसूत्रहस्तम् अभयप्रदं त्रिशूलहस्तं पिनाकपाणिनम्̐ वृषभस्कन्धसमारूढम् उमादेहार्धधारिणं ज्वलन्तं कपिलजटं जटामुकुटसम्̐युक्तम्̐ शिखाम् उद्द्योतकारिणम् अमृतेनाप्लुतम्̐ हृष्टम्̐ सुरासुरैर् नमस्कृतं दिग्देवतैः समायुक्तं नित्यं च शाश्वतम्̐ शिवं ध्रुवम् अक्षयम् अव्ययम्̐ सर्वव्यापिनिरञ्जनम् ईशानम्̐ रुद्रम्̐ विश्वरूपिणम् एवं ध्यात्वा द्विजः सम्यक् ततो जपम् आरभेत् /
text_mt: three-eyed, five-faced, ten-armed, gentle, adorned with all ornaments, blue-necked, marked with the crescent moon, resembling pure crystal, wearing a serpent as the sacred thread, having a tiger skin as an upper garment, holding a water-pot and a rosary in his hand, granting fearlessness, holding a trident, holding the Pināka bow, mounted on the shoulder of a bull, bearing half of Umā's body, blazing, with tawny matted hair, endowed with a crown of matted hair, causing his topknot to shine, bathed in nectar, delighted, saluted by gods and asuras, accompanied by the deities of the quarters, eternal, everlasting, benevolent, steadfast, imperishable, immutable, all-pervading, taintless, the ruler, Rudra of universal form—having thus properly meditated, the twice-born should then begin the recitation.

sanskrit_iast: suguptadeśe gocarmamātre 'sthansv anulipte vā liṅgapadmākṛtiṃ prakalpya prokṣya mā no mahāntam iti sthāpayed namaḥ śaṃbhave ca \\ ity arcayet //
meaning: सुगुप्तदेशे गोचर्ममात्रे ऽस्थन्स्व् अनुलिप्ते वा लिङ्गपद्माकृतिं प्रकल्प्य प्रोक्ष्य मा नो महान्तम् इति स्थापयेद् नमः शंभवे च \\ इत्य् अर्चयेत् //
text_mt: In a well-concealed place, an area of the size of a cowhide smeared with bone-free [cow dung], having formed the shape of a liṅga or a lotus and sprinkled it, he should install [the deity] with "Do not harm our great one...", and worship him with "Homage to Śambhu...".

sanskrit_iast: sadyavāmāghoratatpuruṣeśāneti rudrasyāvāhanam̐ // sadyo jātas \\ ity asya sadyojāta ṛṣir brahmā devatā triṣṭup chandaḥ ham̐savāhanaḥ paścimavaktraḥ pṛthivī tattvaḥ brahmarūpāya hrāṃ paścimavaktrāvāhane viniyogaḥ sadyo jātaḥ \ paścimavaktrāya namas \\ ā vāhayāmi // \ vāmam adya savitar ity asya vāmadeva ṛṣiḥ viṣṇur devatā triṣṭup chando garuḍavāhana uttaravaktra āpas tattvo viṣṇurūpāya hrīm uttaravaktrāvāhane viniyogo vāmam adya savitar \ uttaravaktrāya namas \\ ā vāhayāmi // \ aghorebhyas \\ ity asyāghora ṛṣī rudro devatā bṛhatī chando vṛṣabhavāhano dakṣiṇavaktras tejas tattvo rudrarūpāya hrūṃ dakṣiṇavaktrāvāhane viniyogo aghorebhyas \\ dakṣiṇavaktrāya namas \\ ā vāhayāmi // \ tatpuruṣāya \\ ity asya tatpuruṣa ṛṣiḥ sūryo devatā gāyatrī chando 'śvavāhanaḥ pūrvavaktro vāyus tattvaḥ sūryarūpāya hraiṃ pūrvavaktrāvāhane viniyogas tatpuruṣāya \ pūrvavaktrāya namas \\ ā vāhayāmi // \ tam īśānam ity asyeśāna ṛṣiḥ śabdo devatā bṛhatī chandaḥ kūrmavāhana ūrdhvavaktra ākāśatattvaḥ śvetarūpāya hraum ūrdhvavaktrāvāhane viniyogas tam īśānam \ ūrdhvavaktrāya namas \\ ā vāhayāmi // \ ā tvā vahantu \\ iti rudragāyatrīm aṣṭau kṛtvaḥ prayuñjīta /
meaning: सद्यवामाघोरतत्पुरुषेशानेति रुद्रस्यावाहनम्̐ // सद्यो जातस् \\ इत्य् अस्य सद्योजात ऋषिर् ब्रह्मा देवता त्रिष्टुप् छन्दः हम्̐सवाहनः पश्चिमवक्त्रः पृथिवी तत्त्वः ब्रह्मरूपाय ह्रां पश्चिमवक्त्रावाहने विनियोगः सद्यो जातः \ पश्चिमवक्त्राय नमस् \\ आ वाहयामि // \ वामम् अद्य सवितर् इत्य् अस्य वामदेव ऋषिः विष्णुर् देवता त्रिष्टुप् छन्दो गरुडवाहन उत्तरवक्त्र आपस् तत्त्वो विष्णुरूपाय ह्रीम् उत्तरवक्त्रावाहने विनियोगो वामम् अद्य सवितर् \ उत्तरवक्त्राय नमस् \\ आ वाहयामि // \ अघोरेभ्यस् \\ इत्य् अस्याघोर ऋषी रुद्रो देवता बृहती छन्दो वृषभवाहनो दक्षिणवक्त्रस् तेजस् तत्त्वो रुद्ररूपाय ह्रूं दक्षिणवक्त्रावाहने विनियोगो अघोरेभ्यस् \\ दक्षिणवक्त्राय नमस् \\ आ वाहयामि // \ तत्पुरुषाय \\ इत्य् अस्य तत्पुरुष ऋषिः सूर्यो देवता गायत्री छन्दो ऽश्ववाहनः पूर्ववक्त्रो वायुस् तत्त्वः सूर्यरूपाय ह्रैं पूर्ववक्त्रावाहने विनियोगस् तत्पुरुषाय \ पूर्ववक्त्राय नमस् \\ आ वाहयामि // \ तम् ईशानम् इत्य् अस्येशान ऋषिः शब्दो देवता बृहती छन्दः कूर्मवाहन ऊर्ध्ववक्त्र आकाशतत्त्वः श्वेतरूपाय ह्रौम् ऊर्ध्ववक्त्रावाहने विनियोगस् तम् ईशानम् \ ऊर्ध्ववक्त्राय नमस् \\ आ वाहयामि // \ आ त्वा वहन्तु \\ इति रुद्रगायत्रीम् अष्टौ कृत्वः प्रयुञ्जीत /
text_mt: The invocation of Rudra is with [the mantras of] Sadyojāta, Vāmadeva, Aghora, Tatpuruṣa, and Īśāna. Of the mantra 'Sadyojātaḥ', Sadyojāta is the seer, Brahmā is the deity, triṣṭubh is the metre, [the deity] has a swan mount, the western face, earth is the element; 'Hrāṃ, to the one whose form is Brahmā' is the application in invoking the western face: 'Sadyojātaḥ... Obeisance to the western face; I invoke [you]'. Of the mantra 'Vāmam adya savitar', Vāmadeva is the seer, Viṣṇu is the deity, triṣṭubh is the metre, [the deity] has a Garuḍa mount, the northern face, water is the element; 'Hrīm, to the one whose form is Viṣṇu' is the application in invoking the northern face: 'Vāmam adya savitar... Obeisance to the northern face; I invoke [you]'. Of the mantra 'Aghorebhyaḥ', Aghora is the seer, Rudra is the deity, bṛhatī is the metre, [the deity] has a bull mount, the southern face, fire is the element; 'Hrūṃ, to the one whose form is Rudra' is the application in invoking the southern face: 'Aghorebhyaḥ... Obeisance to the southern face; I invoke [you]'. Of the mantra 'Tatpuruṣāya', Tatpuruṣa is the seer, Sūrya is the deity, gāyatrī is the metre, [the deity] has a horse mount, the eastern face, wind is the element; 'Hraiṃ, to the one whose form is Sūrya' is the application in invoking the eastern face: 'Tatpuruṣāya... Obeisance to the eastern face; I invoke [you]'. Of the mantra 'Tam īśānam', Īśāna is the seer, Śabda is the deity, bṛhatī is the metre, [the deity] has a tortoise mount, the upward face, space is the element; 'Hraum, to the one whose form is white' is the application in invoking the upward face: 'Tam īśānam... Obeisance to the upward face; I invoke [you]'. He should employ the Rudragāyatrī 'Ā tvā vahantu' eight times.

sanskrit_iast: rudraṃ dhyāyet /
meaning: रुद्रं ध्यायेत् /

sanskrit_iast: nīlakaṇṭhaṃ mahādevaṃ kailāsastham̐ sahomayā trinetram īśvaraṃ caiva dhyātvā siddhim avāpnuyāt /
meaning: नीलकण्ठं महादेवं कैलासस्थम्̐ सहोमया त्रिनेत्रम् ईश्वरं चैव ध्यात्वा सिद्धिम् अवाप्नुयात् /
text_mt: Having meditated on the blue-throated Great God residing on Kailāsa along with Umā, / the three-eyed Lord, one attains accomplishment.

sanskrit_iast: tato japam ārabhed namas te rudra manyave \\ iti prabhṛtibhir aṣṭābhir anuvākaiḥ /
meaning: ततो जपम् आरभेद् नमस् ते रुद्र मन्यवे \\ इति प्रभृतिभिर् अष्टाभिर् अनुवाकैः /
text_mt: Then he should begin the silent recitation with the eight sections beginning with 'Namas te rudra manyave'.

sanskrit_iast: prathamānuvāke gāyatrī chandas tisras triṣṭubhas tisraḥ paṅktayaḥ saptānuṣṭubho 'ntyānuvāke prathamā bṛhatī dve triṣṭubhau dvādaśānuṣṭubho dve jagatyau //
meaning: प्रथमानुवाके गायत्री छन्दस् तिस्रस् त्रिष्टुभस् तिस्रः पङ्क्तयः सप्तानुष्टुभो ऽन्त्यानुवाके प्रथमा बृहती द्वे त्रिष्टुभौ द्वादशानुष्टुभो द्वे जगत्यौ //
text_mt: In the first section, the metre is gāyatrī, [then] three triṣṭubhs, three paṅktis, and seven anuṣṭubhs; in the final section, the first is a bṛhatī, two are triṣṭubhs, twelve are anuṣṭubhs, and two are jagatīs.

sanskrit_iast: śeṣānāṃ nānāchandasām̐ rudrānām̐ rudro devatā ghora ṛṣiḥ /
meaning: शेषानां नानाछन्दसाम्̐ रुद्रानाम्̐ रुद्रो देवता घोर ऋषिः /
text_mt: Of the remaining Rudra [mantras] in various metres, Rudra is the deity and Ghora is the seer.

sanskrit_iast: śatarudriyāyām̐ sam̐hitāyām̐ sarvapāpakṣayārthe jape viniyogaḥ //
meaning: शतरुद्रियायाम्̐ सम्̐हितायाम्̐ सर्वपापक्षयार्थे जपे विनियोगः //
text_mt: The application is for the silent recitation in the Śatarudrīya Saṃhitā for the sake of the destruction of all sins.

sanskrit_iast: namas te rudra manyave \\ ityādir aṣṭānuvākāḥ //
meaning: नमस् ते रुद्र मन्यवे \\ इत्यादिर् अष्टानुवाकाः //
text_mt: There are eight sections beginning with 'Namas te rudra manyave'.

sanskrit_iast: asaṃkhyātā sahasrāṇi \\ iti yathāliṅgam̐ sthāpanaṃ dhyātvā namo astu rudrebhyo ye divi \\ ity am̐sadaghne dhyāyed namo astu rudrebhyo ye antarikṣe \\ iti nābhidaghne namo astu rudrebhyo ye pṛthivyām iti jānudaghne dhyāyet //
meaning: असंख्याता सहस्राणि \\ इति यथालिङ्गम्̐ स्थापनं ध्यात्वा नमो अस्तु रुद्रेभ्यो ये दिवि \\ इत्य् अम्̐सदघ्ने ध्यायेद् नमो अस्तु रुद्रेभ्यो ये अन्तरिक्षे \\ इति नाभिदघ्ने नमो अस्तु रुद्रेभ्यो ये पृथिव्याम् इति जानुदघ्ने ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: Having meditated on the placement according to the characteristic marks with 'Asaṃkhyātāḥ sahasrāṇi', he should meditate [on him] at shoulder height with 'Namo 'stu rudrebhyo ye divi', at navel height with 'Namo 'stu rudrebhyo ye 'ntarikṣe', and at knee height with 'Namo 'stu rudrebhyo ye pṛthivyām'.

sanskrit_iast: aghorebhyas \\ iti japitvā yaḥ pathas \\ iti visarjayet /
meaning: अघोरेभ्यस् \\ इति जपित्वा यः पथस् \\ इति विसर्जयेत् /
text_mt: Having recited 'Aghorebhyaḥ', he should dismiss [him] with 'Yaḥ pathaḥ'.

sanskrit_iast: apratirathaṃ japan gṛham āvrajet /
meaning: अप्रतिरथं जपन् गृहम् आव्रजेत् /
text_mt: Reciting the Apratiratha hymn, he should walk home.

sanskrit_iast: tenodakenātmānam abhiṣiñcet /
meaning: तेनोदकेनात्मानम् अभिषिञ्चेत् /
text_mt: With that water he should sprinkle himself.

sanskrit_iast: dvipadaś catuṣpadaś cetann ity ajapasya vidhānam /
meaning: द्विपदश् चतुष्पदश् चेतन्न् इत्य् अजपस्य विधानम् /
text_mt: This is the rule of daily recitation for bipeds and quadrupeds.

sanskrit_iast: naimittikasya punar vakṣyāmi /
meaning: नैमित्तिकस्य पुनर् वक्ष्यामि /
text_mt: Now I shall explain [the rule] of the occasional [recitation].

sanskrit_iast: pūrvoktena vidhinā snātvā nyāsaṃ kṛtvā śaṅkha udakaṃ gṛhītvā yathālābhe pātre vā dūrvāpuṣpā ekodakam akṣatam īśānābhimukhaṃ prakṣipet /
meaning: पूर्वोक्तेन विधिना स्नात्वा न्यासं कृत्वा शङ्ख उदकं गृहीत्वा यथालाभे पात्रे वा दूर्वापुष्पा एकोदकम् अक्षतम् ईशानाभिमुखं प्रक्षिपेत् /
text_mt: Having bathed according to the previously stated rule and performed the nyāsa, taking water in a conch shell or in whatever vessel is available, he should cast dūrvā grass, flowers, pure water, and unhusked barley grains facing the northeast.

sanskrit_iast: yam uddiśya japet tasya caivam eva dhīr ekāvartaṃ dvirāvartaṃ trirāvartam̐ saptāvartam̐ yady ārogyārtham aṣṭāvartam ekatrasthe trirāvartaṃ nitye naimittike 'parimitam /
meaning: यम् उद्दिश्य जपेत् तस्य चैवम् एव धीर् एकावर्तं द्विरावर्तं त्रिरावर्तम्̐ सप्तावर्तम्̐ यद्य् आरोग्यार्थम् अष्टावर्तम् एकत्रस्थे त्रिरावर्तं नित्ये नैमित्तिके ऽपरिमितम् /
text_mt: The intention of the one for whose sake he recites should be likewise: one repetition, two repetitions, three repetitions, or seven repetitions; if for health, eight repetitions; staying in one place, three repetitions; in the regular [rite], [and] in the occasional rite, unlimited.

sanskrit_iast: yadi rudraḥ prajā abhiśāmayetottarapūrvasyāṃ diśi śatarudriyaṃ japam̐ś caṅkramamāṇo japet /
meaning: यदि रुद्रः प्रजा अभिशामयेतोत्तरपूर्वस्यां दिशि शतरुद्रियं जपम्̐श् चङ्क्रममाणो जपेत् /
text_mt: If Rudra should afflict the creatures, he should recite the Śatarudriya in the north-eastern direction, pacing back and forth as he recites.

sanskrit_iast: ekāhe japterogapāpaiḥ pramucyeta /
meaning: एकाहे जप्तेरोगपापैः प्रमुच्येत /
text_mt: Through recitation for one day, one is freed from diseases and sins.

sanskrit_iast: tryahajaptena brahmahatyādipāpaiḥ kuṣṭhādibhyaḥ pramucyeta /
meaning: त्र्यहजप्तेन ब्रह्महत्यादिपापैः कुष्ठादिभ्यः प्रमुच्येत /
text_mt: Through recitation for three days, one is freed from sins such as the killing of a brāhmaṇa, and from leprosy and the like.

sanskrit_iast: anena vidhinā na grāme na strīsravaṇe na śrāddha āmantrito na paśusaṃnidhau na pūrvāparām̐ rātriṃ brahmacārī nāntyajadarśane na rajasvalādarśane na vyāyāmaṃ kurvīta /
meaning: अनेन विधिना न ग्रामे न स्त्रीस्रवणे न श्राद्ध आमन्त्रितो न पशुसंनिधौ न पूर्वापराम्̐ रात्रिं ब्रह्मचारी नान्त्यजदर्शने न रजस्वलादर्शने न व्यायामं कुर्वीत /
text_mt: According to this rule, [he should recite] not in a village, not within hearing of a woman, not when invited to an ancestral rite, not near animals, not in the first or last [watch of the] night, remaining celibate, not at the sight of an outcaste, not at the sight of a menstruating woman, nor should he engage in physical exertion.

sanskrit_iast: samāpteṣu yathākāmaṃ prārthayitvā \\ aghorebhyas \\ iti japitvā yaḥ pathas \\ iti visarjayet /
meaning: समाप्तेषु यथाकामं प्रार्थयित्वा \\ अघोरेभ्यस् \\ इति जपित्वा यः पथस् \\ इति विसर्जयेत् /
text_mt: When [the recitations] are completed, having prayed according to his desire, having recited 'Aghorebhyaḥ', he should dismiss [the deity] with 'Yaḥ pathaḥ'.

sanskrit_iast: tenodakena yajamānam abhiṣiñcet /
meaning: तेनोदकेन यजमानम् अभिषिञ्चेत् /
text_mt: With that water he should sprinkle the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: apratirathaṃ japan gṛham āvartayet /
meaning: अप्रतिरथं जपन् गृहम् आवर्तयेत् /
text_mt: Reciting the Apratiratha hymn, he should cause [him] to return home.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇe yo japet sa sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt /
meaning: ब्राह्मणे यो जपेत् स सर्वान् कामान् अवाप्नुयात् /
text_mt: He who recites [this] when a brāhmaṇa [is present] obtains all desires.

sanskrit_iast: vidhihīne viparītam̐ syād brāhmaṇasya yajamānasya ca /
meaning: विधिहीने विपरीतम्̐ स्याद् ब्राह्मणस्य यजमानस्य च /
text_mt: If devoid of the proper rule, it would be the opposite for the brāhmaṇa and for the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: śucisnāto jitendriyo labdhāśīr ṛṣichandodevatāviniyogo nyāsapūrvakam̐ rudraṃ japet /
meaning: शुचिस्नातो जितेन्द्रियो लब्धाशीर् ऋषिछन्दोदेवताविनियोगो न्यासपूर्वकम्̐ रुद्रं जपेत् /
text_mt: Clean and bathed, with senses subdued, having obtained blessings, having [recited] the seer, metre, deity, and application, he should recite the Rudra [hymn] preceded by nyāsa.

sanskrit_iast: aghora ṛṣī rudro devatā bṛhatī chandaḥ sarvakarmaṇi nyāse viniyogas \\ ākhuṃ te rudra paśuṃ karomi \\ ity āntād anuvākasyeti hṛdayam idam̐ viṣṇur vicakrame \\ ity āntād anuvākasyeti śiras \\ brahmaṇaspate \\ iti ṣaḍṛcam \\ brahma jajñānam \\ brahmā devānām iti śikhām apratiratham iti kavacam ādityānām avasā nūtanena \\ iti dve ṣaḍṛcau cakṣuṣī śatarudriyam ity astram /
meaning: अघोर ऋषी रुद्रो देवता बृहती छन्दः सर्वकर्मणि न्यासे विनियोगस् \\ आखुं ते रुद्र पशुं करोमि \\ इत्य् आन्ताद् अनुवाकस्येति हृदयम् इदम्̐ विष्णुर् विचक्रमे \\ इत्य् आन्ताद् अनुवाकस्येति शिरस् \\ ब्रह्मणस्पते \\ इति षडृचम् \\ ब्रह्म जज्ञानम् \\ ब्रह्मा देवानाम् इति शिखाम् अप्रतिरथम् इति कवचम् आदित्यानाम् अवसा नूतनेन \\ इति द्वे षडृचौ चक्षुषी शतरुद्रियम् इत्य् अस्त्रम् /
text_mt: Aghora is the seer, Rudra is the deity, bṛhatī is the metre, the application is in the nyāsa for all rites: 'Ākhuṃ te rudra paśuṃ karomi' up to the end of the section is the heart; 'Idaṃ viṣṇur vicakrame' up to the end of the section is the head; the six verses 'Brahmaṇas pate', 'Brahma jajñānam', and 'Brahmā devānām' are the tuft of hair; the Apratiratha hymn is the armor; the two six-verse [hymns] 'Ādityānām avasā nūtanena' are the eyes; the Śatarudrīya is the weapon.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ nyāsam āvāhanavisarjanāntam /
meaning: एवं न्यासम् आवाहनविसर्जनान्तम् /
text_mt: Thus the nyāsa ends with the invocation and the dismissal.

sanskrit_iast: praṇamya japaṃ nivedayet /
meaning: प्रणम्य जपं निवेदयेत् /
text_mt: Having bowed down, he should offer the recitation.

sanskrit_iast: pālāśasamidha ājyaplutās tilāhutibhir namaḥ śaṃbhave ca \\ iti tisṛbhiḥ ṣaḍdvādaśa vā juhuyāt /
meaning: पालाशसमिध आज्यप्लुतास् तिलाहुतिभिर् नमः शंभवे च \\ इति तिसृभिः षड्द्वादश वा जुहुयात् /
text_mt: He should offer palāśa fire-sticks soaked in clarified butter with sesame offerings, or six or twelve, with the three [verses] beginning with 'Namaḥ śaṃbhave ca'.

sanskrit_iast:
snānatarpaṇajapahomārcanarato yaḥ sam̐vatsare japet
sa daśāphalam āpnoti \ brahmaghno 'tiviśudhyati /
surāpaḥ suvarṇahartā \ goghno vā vṛṣalīpatiḥ /
mucyate sarvapāpebhyas\ rudralokaṃ sa gachati /
meaning:
स्नानतर्पणजपहोमार्चनरतो यः सम्̐वत्सरे जपेत्
स दशाफलम् आप्नोति \ ब्रह्मघ्नो ऽतिविशुध्यति /
सुरापः सुवर्णहर्ता \ गोघ्नो वा वृषलीपतिः /
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यस्\ रुद्रलोकं स गछति /
text_mt:
He who, devoted to bathing, libations, silent recitation, oblations, and worship, recites for a year,

attains tenfold the fruit; [even] the killer of a brāhmaṇa is thoroughly purified.

A drinker of liquor, a stealer of gold, / a cow-killer, or the husband of a śūdra woman,

is freed from all sins; / he goes to the realm of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast: rudrajāpīhataṃ dattam anantyāya kalpate /
meaning: रुद्रजापीहतं दत्तम् अनन्त्याय कल्पते /
text_mt: What is given to or offered by a reciter of the Rudra hymn leads to endlessness.

sanskrit_iast: athātaḥ pravarādhyāyam̐ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: अथातः प्रवराध्यायम्̐ व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: Now, therefore, we shall explain the chapter on ancestral lineages.

sanskrit_iast: tad etad brāhmaṇaṃ bhavaty ārṣeyam̐ vṛṇīte bandhor eva naity atho saṃtatyā iti /
meaning: तद् एतद् ब्राह्मणं भवत्य् आर्षेयम्̐ वृणीते बन्धोर् एव नैत्य् अथो संतत्या इति /
text_mt: Regarding this, there is this Brāhmaṇa passage: 'He chooses the ancestral lineage; he does not depart from kinship, and also for continuity'.

sanskrit_iast: ekam̐ vṛṇīte dvau vṛṇīte trīnvṛṇīte na caturo vṛṇīte na pañcātipravṛṇīte vā /
meaning: एकम्̐ वृणीते द्वौ वृणीते त्रीन्वृणीते न चतुरो वृणीते न पञ्चातिप्रवृणीते वा /
text_mt: He chooses one, he chooses two, he chooses three; he does not choose four, nor does he choose beyond five.

sanskrit_iast: ihaike manuvad ity evaikārṣeyam̐ sārvavarṇikaṃ pradiśanti / kasyo hetor iti / mānavyo hi prajā iti /
meaning: इहैके मनुवद् इत्य् एवैकार्षेयम्̐ सार्ववर्णिकं प्रदिशन्ति / कस्यो हेतोर् इति / मानव्यो हि प्रजा इति /
text_mt: Here, some prescribe a single ancestral lineage for all social classes, saying: 'Like Manu'. For what reason? 'Because creatures are descendants of Manu'.

sanskrit_iast: na devair na manuṣyair ārṣeyam̐ vṛṇīta / ṛṣibhir evārṣeyam̐ vṛṇīte /
meaning: न देवैर् न मनुष्यैर् आर्षेयम्̐ वृणीत / ऋषिभिर् एवार्षेयम्̐ वृणीते /
text_mt: He should not choose an ancestral lineage through gods, nor through mortals; he chooses an ancestral lineage only through seers.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ parārṣeyam̐ vṛṇīte param̐ yajñasyāśīr gached iti śrutir āvṛścyate vā eṣa oṣadhībhyaḥ paśubhyaḥ pitṛbhyo yaś ca parapravarān pravṛṇīte /
meaning: यः परार्षेयम्̐ वृणीते परम्̐ यज्ञस्याशीर् गछेद् इति श्रुतिर् आवृश्च्यते वा एष ओषधीभ्यः पशुभ्यः पितृभ्यो यश् च परप्रवरान् प्रवृणीते /
text_mt: He who chooses the ancestral lineage of another—'The blessing of the sacrifice would go to another,' so says the sacred text; or indeed he who chooses another's lineage is cut off from plants, animals, and ancestors.

sanskrit_iast: tad etad anyatra brāhmaṇakṣatriyābhyām itarāsāṃ prajānām uktaṃ bhavati /
meaning: तद् एतद् अन्यत्र ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियाभ्याम् इतरासां प्रजानाम् उक्तं भवति /
text_mt: This is stated for the other people, apart from brāhmaṇas and kṣatriyas.

sanskrit_iast: ita evordhvān adhvaryur vṛṇīte pūrvavad amutaś cāmuto 'rvāco hotā dvitavad āmantritavac ca /
meaning: इत एवोर्ध्वान् अध्वर्युर् वृणीते पूर्ववद् अमुतश् चामुतो ऽर्वाचो होता द्वितवद् आमन्त्रितवच् च /
text_mt: The adhvaryu chooses [the ancestral ṛṣis] ascending upwards from this [sacrificer] onward, with [the suffix] -vat as before; the hotṛ [chooses them descending] downwards from that one and from that one onward, with [the suffix] -vat and with the vocative case.

sanskrit_iast: bhṛgūn evāgre vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: भृगून् एवाग्रे व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: We shall explain the Bhṛgus first.

sanskrit_iast: jāmadagnyā vātsyāḥ /
meaning: जामदग्न्या वात्स्याः /

sanskrit_iast: ānuśātaki vaihati paila śaunakāyani jīvanti kāmbalodari vaihīnari vairohitya ḷekhyāyani vaiśāki vaiśvānara vairūpākṣi paukāśeraḷānāṃ pārṇili vṛkāśvakānā muccairmanyu sāvarṇi vālmīkiśeralānām̐ vaiṣṭapureya pālākṣi taulakeśināma samṛtabhāgārtabhāga mārkaṇḍeya maṇḍu māṇḍavya vibhāṇḍaka māṇḍūkeyārvanānām̐ sphenamadbhūtī sthaulapiṇḍi śaiṣāpatya śārkarākṣa devamatīnā māyaṇārcāyanāhvāyana gāṅgāyana vaiśampāyana vāyavyāyanauduntyāyana saurayī dārbhi mālāyana śārṅgarava gālava cāṇūkeya vaikarṇiḥ śaunakarṇiḥ śauṇḍakarṇiḥ sāṃkṛtyaitiśāyanānām̐ yājñeya bhrāṣṭreya kṣmālā aṇḍa pārimaṇḍalāyanālundhiḥ krauṣṭi saudhakīnāṃ paiṅgalāyana sātyakāyana kaucahasti kovahnaṇḍi sāṃkhyamitra cāndramitra cāndramasyānulomi kauṭilya śaunakāyani kām̐sya śāradvata maudgalyo vādyāḷehreyi nimithi śākalyoṣṭrākṣi vākāyanyanumati jaihmyāśama śokajihvātmadamani vāṭāra kirāṇi mājānāti kāśakṛtsnauṣu srucato trāna vaihīkāri śaukrāyaṇāḥ śākṛṇiḥ śākaṭāyanā goṣṭhāyanā golāyanā ḍākavyāyanā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: आनुशातकि वैहति पैल शौनकायनि जीवन्ति काम्बलोदरि वैहीनरि वैरोहित्य ऌएख्यायनि वैशाकि वैश्वानर वैरूपाक्षि पौकाशेरऌआनां पार्णिलि वृकाश्वकाना मुच्चैर्मन्यु सावर्णि वाल्मीकिशेरलानाम्̐ वैष्टपुरेय पालाक्षि तौलकेशिनाम समृतभागार्तभाग मार्कण्डेय मण्डु माण्डव्य विभाण्डक माण्डूकेयार्वनानाम्̐ स्फेनमद्भूती स्थौलपिण्डि शैषापत्य शार्कराक्ष देवमतीना मायणार्चायनाह्वायन गाङ्गायन वैशम्पायन वायव्यायनौदुन्त्यायन सौरयी दार्भि मालायन शार्ङ्गरव गालव चाणूकेय वैकर्णिः शौनकर्णिः शौण्डकर्णिः सांकृत्यैतिशायनानाम्̐ याज्ञेय भ्राष्ट्रेय क्ष्माला अण्ड पारिमण्डलायनालुन्धिः क्रौष्टि सौधकीनां पैङ्गलायन सात्यकायन कौचहस्ति कोवह्नण्डि सांख्यमित्र चान्द्रमित्र चान्द्रमस्यानुलोमि कौटिल्य शौनकायनि काम्̐स्य शारद्वत मौद्गल्यो वाद्याऌएह्रेयि निमिथि शाकल्योष्ट्राक्षि वाकायन्यनुमति जैह्म्याशम शोकजिह्वात्मदमनि वाटार किराणि माजानाति काशकृत्स्नौषु स्रुचतो त्रान वैहीकारि शौक्रायणाः शाकृणिः शाकटायना गोष्ठायना गोलायना डाकव्यायना इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Ānuśātakis, Vaihatis, Pailas, Śaunakāyanis, Jīvantis, Kāmbalodaris, Vaihīnaris, Vairohityas, Lekhyāyanis, Vaiśākis, Vaiśvānaras, Vairūpākṣis, the Paukāśerala-Pārṇilis, Vṛkāśvakas, Uccairmanyus, Sāvarṇis, Vālmīkiśeralas, Vaiṣṭapureyas, Pālākṣis, Taulakeśins, Samṛtabhāgas, Ārtabhāgas, Mārkaṇḍeyas, Maṇḍus, Māṇḍavyas, Vibhāṇḍakas, Māṇḍūkeyas, Arvanas, Sphenas, Madbhūtis, Sthaulapiṇḍis, Śaiṣāpatyas, Śārkarākṣas, Devamatis, Āyaṇas, Ārcāyanas, Āhvāyanas, Gāṅgāyanas, Vaiśampāyanas, Vāyavyāyanas, Auduntyāyanas, Saurayīs, Dārbhis, Mālāyanas, Śārṅgaravas, Gālavas, Cāṇūkeyas, Vaikarṇi, Śaunakarṇi, Śauṇḍakarṇi, Sāṃkṛtyaitiśāyanas, Yājñeyas, Bhrāṣṭreyas, Kṣmālās, Aṇḍas, Pārimaṇḍalāyanas, Ālundhi, Krauṣṭi, Saudhakīs, Paiṅgalāyanas, Sātyakāyanas, Kaucahastis, Kovahnaṇḍis, Sāṃkhyamitras, Cāndramitras, Cāndramasyānulomis, Kauṭilyas, Śaunakāyanis, Kāṃsyas, Śāradvatas, Maudgalya, Vādyālehreyi, Nimithi, Śākalya, Uṣṭrākṣi, Vākāyani, Anumati, Jaihmyāśama, Śokajihva, Ātmadamani, Vāṭāras, Kirāṇis, Mājānātis, Kāśakṛtsnas, Uṣusrucātattrānas, Vaihīkāris, Śaukrāyaṇas, Śākṛṇi, Śākaṭāyanas, Goṣṭhāyanas, Golāyanas, Ḍākavyāyanas: among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ pañcārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / bhārgava cyāvanāpnavānaurva jāmadagnyeti hotā jamadagnivad ūrvavad apnavānavac cyavanavad bhṛguvad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां पञ्चार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / भार्गव च्यावनाप्नवानौर्व जामदग्न्येति होता जमदग्निवद् ऊर्ववद् अप्नवानवच् च्यवनवद् भृगुवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Theirs is a pravara of five ṛṣis. 'O Bhārgava, Cyāvana, Āpnavāna, Aurva, Jāmadagnya!' says the hotṛ; 'Like Jamadagni, like Ūrva, like Apnavāna, like Cyavana, like Bhṛgu,' says the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: vaidā nimathitās teṣāṃ pañcārṣeḥ pravaro bhavati / bhārgava cyāvanāpnavāna vaida naimathiteti hotā nimathitavad vidavad apnavānavac cyavanavad bhṛguvad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: वैदा निमथितास् तेषां पञ्चार्षेः प्रवरो भवति / भार्गव च्यावनाप्नवान वैद नैमथितेति होता निमथितवद् विदवद् अप्नवानवच् च्यवनवद् भृगुवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: The Vaidas [and] Nimathitas: theirs is a pravara of five ṛṣis. 'O Bhārgava, Cyāvana, Āpnavāna, Vaida, Naimathita!' says the hotṛ; 'Like Nimathita, like Vida, like Apnavāna, like Cyavana, like Bhṛgu,' says the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: āvadhyāyanā mauñjāyanās teṣām̐ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / bhārgava cyāvanāvadhyeti hotāvadhyavac cyavanavad bhṛguvad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: आवध्यायना मौञ्जायनास् तेषाम्̐ त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / भार्गव च्यावनावध्येति होतावध्यवच् च्यवनवद् भृगुवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: The Āvadhyāyanas [and] Mauñjāyanas: theirs is a pravara of three ṛṣis. 'O Bhārgava, Cyāvana, Āvadhya!' says the hotṛ; 'Like Avadhya, like Cyavana, like Bhṛgu,' says the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: atha jamadagnīnām̐ vidāḥ /
meaning: अथ जमदग्नीनाम्̐ विदाः /
text_mt: Now the Vidas among the Jamadagnis.

sanskrit_iast: prācīnayogyāḥ pulastyā traidabhṛtāḥ krauñcāyanābhyajātās taugāyanā āvaṭāḥ śākarṇinā bhālvaśayo bhārgavā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: प्राचीनयोग्याः पुलस्त्या त्रैदभृताः क्रौञ्चायनाभ्यजातास् तौगायना आवटाः शाकर्णिना भाल्वशयो भार्गवा इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Prācīnayogyas, Pulastyas, Traidabhṛtas, Krauñcāyanas, Abhyajātas, Taugāyanas, Āvaṭas, Śākarṇis, Bhālvaśayas, [and] Bhārgavas: among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / bhārgava cyāvanāpnavāneti hotāpnavānavac cyavanavad bhṛguvad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / भार्गव च्यावनाप्नवानेति होताप्नवानवच् च्यवनवद् भृगुवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Theirs is a pravara of three ṛṣis. 'O Bhārgava, Cyāvana, Āpnavāna!' says the hotṛ; 'Like Apnavāna, like Cyavana, like Bhṛgu,' says the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: braudheyā mārgapathā grāmyāyaṇir atha naikasī āpastambir vibhīlli kārṇi kārdamir ārṣṭiṣeṇa gardabha śātapathi ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: ब्रौधेया मार्गपथा ग्राम्यायणिर् अथ नैकसी आपस्तम्बिर् विभील्लि कार्णि कार्दमिर् आर्ष्टिषेण गर्दभ शातपथि इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Braudheyas, Mārgapathas, Grāmyāyaṇi, then Naikasī, Āpastambi, Vibhīlli, Kārṇi, Kārdami, Ārṣṭiṣeṇa, Gardabha, [and] Śātapathi: among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ pañcārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / bhārgava cyāvanāpnavānārṣṭiṣeṇānūpeti hotānūpavad ṛṣṭiṣeṇavad apnavānavac cyavanavad bhṛguvad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां पञ्चार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / भार्गव च्यावनाप्नवानार्ष्टिषेणानूपेति होतानूपवद् ऋष्टिषेणवद् अप्नवानवच् च्यवनवद् भृगुवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Theirs is a pravara of five ṛṣis. 'O Bhārgava, Cyāvana, Āpnavāna, Ārṣṭiṣeṇa, Anūpa!' says the hotṛ; 'Like Anūpa, like Ṛṣṭiṣeṇa, like Apnavāna, like Cyavana, like Bhṛgu,' says the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: āpiśāyanāḥ kāpiśāyanāḥ drauṇāyanāḥ khālāyanāḥ avicakṣā maitreyā atha iya āmodāyanā āpiśalā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: आपिशायनाः कापिशायनाः द्रौणायनाः खालायनाः अविचक्षा मैत्रेया अथ इय आमोदायना आपिशला इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Āpiśāyanas, Kāpiśāyanas, Drauṇāyanas, Khālāyanas, Avicakṣas, Maitreyas, then these Āmodāyanas, [and] Āpiśalas: among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / bhārgava vādhryaśva daivodāseti hotā divodāsavad vadhryaśvavad bhṛguvad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / भार्गव वाध्र्यश्व दैवोदासेति होता दिवोदासवद् वध्र्यश्ववद् भृगुवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Theirs is a pravara of three ṛṣis. 'O Bhārgava, Vādhryaśva, Daivodāsa!' says the hotṛ; 'Like Divodāsa, like Vadhryaśva, like Bhṛgu,' says the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: vaitahavya yāska mādhūna mauka jīvantyāyano atha bhāgaleya bhāgavijñeya kauśāmbeya vṛkāśvaki mādāhi gaurikṣita dairghyacita vāleya pāñcadhanā pauṣṇāvatā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: वैतहव्य यास्क माधून मौक जीवन्त्यायनो अथ भागलेय भागविज्ञेय कौशाम्बेय वृकाश्वकि मादाहि गौरिक्षित दैर्घ्यचित वालेय पाञ्चधना पौष्णावता इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Vaitahavyas, Yāskas, Mādhūnas, Maukas, Jīvantyāyanas, then Bhāgaleyas, Bhāgavijñeyas, Kauśāmbeyas, Vṛkāśvakis, Mādāhis, Gaurikṣitas, Dairghyacitas, Vāleyas, Pāñcadhanas, [and] Pauṣṇāvatas: among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / bhārgava vaitahavya sāvedaseti hotā savedovad vītahavyavad bhṛguvad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / भार्गव वैतहव्य सावेदसेति होता सवेदोवद् वीतहव्यवद् भृगुवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Theirs is a pravara of three ṛṣis. 'O Bhārgava, Vaitahavya, Sāvedasa!' says the hotṛ; 'Like Savedas, like Vītahavya, like Bhṛgu,' says the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: vatsapurodhasānāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / bhārgava vātsa paurodhaseti hotā purodhasavad vatsavad bhṛguvad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: वत्सपुरोधसानां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / भार्गव वात्स पौरोधसेति होता पुरोधसवद् वत्सवद् भृगुवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Of the Vatsapurodhasas, there is a pravara of three ṛṣis. 'O Bhārgava, Vātsa, Paurodhasa!' says the hotṛ; 'Like Purodhas, like Vatsa, like Bhṛgu,' says the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: vedaviśvajyotiṣās teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / bhārgava veda viśvajyotiṣeti hotā viśvajyotiṣavad vedavad bhṛguvad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: वेदविश्वज्योतिषास् तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / भार्गव वेद विश्वज्योतिषेति होता विश्वज्योतिषवद् वेदवद् भृगुवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: The Vedaviśvajyotiṣas: theirs is a pravara of three ṛṣis. 'O Bhārgava, Veda, Viśvajyotiṣa!' says the hotṛ; 'Like Viśvajyotis, like Veda, like Bhṛgu,' says the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: pārthavainyānāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / bhārgava vainya pārtheti hotā pṛthuvad venavad bhṛguvad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: पार्थवैन्यानां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / भार्गव वैन्य पार्थेति होता पृथुवद् वेनवद् भृगुवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Of the Pārthavainyas, there is a pravara of three ṛṣis. 'O Bhārgava, Vainya, Pārtha!' says the hotṛ; 'Like Pṛthu, like Vena, like Bhṛgu,' says the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: gārtsamadāḥ śunakāḥ /
meaning: गार्त्समदाः शुनकाः /

sanskrit_iast: yajñavacā saukariḥ kārdamāyanā rājabādhavyāś caukṣāś corāḥ śrotriyāḥ pratyarā śunakā ity eteṣām avivāḥ /
meaning: यज्ञवचा सौकरिः कार्दमायना राजबाधव्याश् चौक्षाश् चोराः श्रोत्रियाः प्रत्यरा शुनका इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाः /
text_mt: The Yajñavacas, Saukaris, Kārdamāyanas, Rājabādhavas, Caukṣas, Coras, Śrotriyas, Pratyaras, [and] Śunakas: among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām ekārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / gārtsamadeti hotā gṛtsamadavad ity adhvaryur yadi vā dvyārṣeyo bhārgava gārtsamadeti hotā gṛtsamadavad bhṛguvad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषाम् एकार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / गार्त्समदेति होता गृत्समदवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युर् यदि वा द्व्यार्षेयो भार्गव गार्त्समदेति होता गृत्समदवद् भृगुवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Theirs is a pravara of one ṛṣi. 'O Gārtsamada!' says the hotṛ; 'Like Gṛtsamada,' says the adhvaryu. Or [their pravara is] of two ṛṣis: 'O Bhārgava, Gārtsamada!' says the hotṛ; 'Like Gṛtsamada, like Bhṛgu,' says the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: aṅgiraso vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: अङ्गिरसो व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: We shall explain the Aṅgirases.

sanskrit_iast: aucathyā gautamāḥ /
meaning: औचथ्या गौतमाः /

sanskrit_iast: tauḍeyā abhijita voghāya naikākṣa rāhugaṇyāḥ kṣairakaṭaikastamarāṇāṃ kairāti sāralopānām̐ karoti kāśapārīṇāṃ pauṣpiṇḍa bhāgala vaḍauḍavānām upabindu mānthareṣāṇām̐ rauhiṇāyanā amalakā krolayimāḥ krauṃcāḥ kroṣṭā āruṇayaḥ pārthivā saudāmini kācākṣa kauralyā akṣa apādapakṣa vāsamūli vam̐śamulmim̐ śapitṛ vāsapuṣpiḥ sauṣya saukṣmāyaṇa kauḍalyā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: तौडेया अभिजित वोघाय नैकाक्ष राहुगण्याः क्षैरकटैकस्तमराणां कैराति सारलोपानाम्̐ करोति काशपारीणां पौष्पिण्ड भागल वडौडवानाम् उपबिन्दु मान्थरेषाणाम्̐ रौहिणायना अमलका क्रोलयिमाः क्रौंचाः क्रोष्टा आरुणयः पार्थिवा सौदामिनि काचाक्ष कौरल्या अक्ष अपादपक्ष वासमूलि वम्̐शमुल्मिम्̐ शपितृ वासपुष्पिः सौष्य सौक्ष्मायण कौडल्या इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Tauḍeyas, Abhijitas, Voghāyas, Naikākṣas, Rāhugaṇyas, the Kṣairakaṭa-Ekastamaras, Kairātis, Sāralopas, Karotis, Kāśapārīṇas, the Pauṣpiṇḍa-Bhāgala-Vaḍauḍavas, Upabindus, Mānthareṣas, Rauhiṇāyanas, Amalakas, Krolayimas, Krauñcas, Kroṣṭas, Āruṇis, Pārthivas, Saudāminis, Kācākṣas, Kauralyas, Akṣas, Apādapakṣas, Vāsamūlis, Vaṃśamulmis, Śapitṛs, Vāsapuṣpis, Sauṣyas, Saukṣmāyaṇas, Kauḍalyas: among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ pañcārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty āṅgirasaucathya gautamauśija kākṣīvateti hotā kakṣīvadvad uśijavad gotamavad ucathyavad aṅgirovad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां पञ्चार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आङ्गिरसौचथ्य गौतमौशिज काक्षीवतेति होता कक्षीवद्वद् उशिजवद् गोतमवद् उचथ्यवद् अङ्गिरोवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Theirs is a pravara of five ṛṣis. 'O Āṅgirasa, Aucathya, Gautama, Auśija, Kākṣīvata!' says the hotṛ; 'Like Kakṣīvat, like Uśij, like Gotama, like Ucathya, like Aṅgiras,' says the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: āyāsyānāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty āṅgirasāyāsya gautameti hotā gotamavad ayāsyavad aṅgirovad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: आयास्यानां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आङ्गिरसायास्य गौतमेति होता गोतमवद् अयास्यवद् अङ्गिरोवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Of the Āyāsyas, there is a pravara of three ṛṣis. 'O Āṅgirasa, Āyāsya, Gautama!' says the hotṛ; 'Like Gotama, like Ayāsya, like Aṅgiras,' says the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: athātreyāyaṇi mādhūkarṇi vālkali saupiṣṭyāgniveśyānām̐ śālāthala vārāha śauṅga kṛpaṇaparṇa prāvāhaṇeyānāṃ māślāya vyāyogichaṃdāta khārigrīvīṇām aiṣumati śādya kāvakikāvikāyanānāṃ naitundi lira vaidhaṃkīnāṃ vaidhakīkayā carātaki manahālānāṃ sauvastambi taulvali pauṣuyāvaddiśīnām̐ śāla vāḷauha devamata harikarṇa drāṅgava cauceya kaumudagandhi khāriṇādi rājastambi sāmastambi somastambi audameghi gāṇḍaki lauhitaki kāṇḍaka dhānā kulaka sātyamugri śaivayatha bhāradvāja ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: अथात्रेयायणि माधूकर्णि वाल्कलि सौपिष्ट्याग्निवेश्यानाम्̐ शालाथल वाराह शौङ्ग कृपणपर्ण प्रावाहणेयानां माश्लाय व्यायोगिछंदात खारिग्रीवीणाम् ऐषुमति शाद्य कावकिकाविकायनानां नैतुन्दि लिर वैधंकीनां वैधकीकया चरातकि मनहालानां सौवस्तम्बि तौल्वलि पौषुयावद्दिशीनाम्̐ शाल वाऌऔह देवमत हरिकर्ण द्राङ्गव चौचेय कौमुदगन्धि खारिणादि राजस्तम्बि सामस्तम्बि सोमस्तम्बि औदमेघि गाण्डकि लौहितकि काण्डक धाना कुलक सात्यमुग्रि शैवयथ भारद्वाज इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: Now the Ātreyāyaṇis, Mādhūkarṇis, Vālkalis, the Saupiṣṭi-Agniveśyas, Śālāthalas, Vārāhas, Śauṅgas, Kṛpaṇaparṇas, Prāvāhaṇeyas, Māślāyas, Vyāyogichandātas, Khārigrīvīs, Aiṣumatis, Śādyas, Kāvakikāvikāyanas, Naitundis, Liras, the Vaidhaṃkī-Vaidhakīkayas, Carātakis, Manahālas, Sauvastambis, Taulvalis, Pauṣuyāvaddiśīs, Śālas, Vāḷauhas, Devamatas, Harikarṇas, Drāṅgavas, Cauceyas, Kaumudagandhis, Khāriṇādis, Rājastambis, Sāmastambis, Somastambis, Audameghis, Gāṇḍakis, Lauhitakis, Kāṇḍakas, Dhānās, Kulakas, Sātyamugris, Śaivayathas, Bhāradvājas: among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty āṅgirasa bārhaspatya bhāradvājeti hotā bharadvājavad bṛhaspativad aṅgirovad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आङ्गिरस बार्हस्पत्य भारद्वाजेति होता भरद्वाजवद् बृहस्पतिवद् अङ्गिरोवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis. The hotṛ says: 'O descendant of Aṅgiras, descendant of Bṛhaspati, descendant of Bharadvāja!'; the adhvaryu says: 'Like Bharadvāja, like Bṛhaspati, like Aṅgiras!'

sanskrit_iast: kāṇāyaṇāḥ kaivalayo 'tha vatsatarāyaṇāḥ krauṇḍāyanā vārddhanayo 'tho vām̐śāyanāś ca ye bhrāṣṭrakṛdbhrāṣṭrabinduś caindrāli sāyakāyanaḥ kolī ca krīkā nīsāṃtvakṛtsnāpurāvaṭa lāvaki bhālūvirupamarkaṭi protsaṅgiḥ śyāmāyana paiṅgalāyana sāṃbharabhāmat ... ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: काणायणाः कैवलयो ऽथ वत्सतरायणाः क्रौण्डायना वार्द्धनयो ऽथो वाम्̐शायनाश् च ये भ्राष्ट्रकृद्भ्राष्ट्रबिन्दुश् चैन्द्रालि सायकायनः कोली च क्रीका नीसांत्वकृत्स्नापुरावट लावकि भालूविरुपमर्कटि प्रोत्सङ्गिः श्यामायन पैङ्गलायन सांभरभामत् ... इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Kāṇāyaṇas, Kaivalis, then Vatsatarāyaṇas, Krauṇḍāyanas, Vārddhanis, and also those who are Vāṃśāyanas, Bhrāṣṭrakṛt, Bhrāṣṭrabindu, and Aindrāli, Sāyakāyana, Kolī, and Krīkā, Nīsāṃtva, Kṛtsnāpurāvaṭa, Lāvaki, Bhālūvi, Rupamarkaṭi, Protsaṅgi, Śyāmāyana, Paiṅgalāyana, Sāṃbharabhāmat [...]—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ pañcārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty āṅgirasa bārhaspatya bhāradvāja śainya gārgyeti hotā gargavacchinivad bharadvājavad bṛhaspativad aṅgirovad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां पञ्चार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आङ्गिरस बार्हस्पत्य भारद्वाज शैन्य गार्ग्येति होता गर्गवच्छिनिवद् भरद्वाजवद् बृहस्पतिवद् अङ्गिरोवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of five ṛṣis. The hotṛ says: 'O descendant of Aṅgiras, descendant of Bṛhaspati, descendant of Bharadvāja, descendant of Śini, descendant of Garga!'; the adhvaryu says: 'Like Garga, like Śini, like Bharadvāja, like Bṛhaspati, like Aṅgiras!'

sanskrit_iast: tetirari kavibhūmo gargā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: तेतिररि कविभूमो गर्गा इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: Tetirari, Kavibhūma, and the Gargas—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty āṅgirasa śainya gārgyeti hotā gargavacchinivad aṅgirovad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आङ्गिरस शैन्य गार्ग्येति होता गर्गवच्छिनिवद् अङ्गिरोवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis. The hotṛ says: 'O descendant of Aṅgiras, descendant of Śini, descendant of Garga!'; the adhvaryu says: 'Like Garga, like Śini, like Aṅgiras!'

sanskrit_iast: kapistaraḥ svastitaro bindur daṇḍiḥ śaktiḥ patañjalir bhojava jrarudhuś caivadviśālī śītakiḥ addham̐ rājakeśo cauccuṭī śāṃśāpi kalaśīkaṇṭhaḥ kārīrayo vānyāyanā vāmadhyāyanāḥ kāpyāḥ kavaya ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: कपिस्तरः स्वस्तितरो बिन्दुर् दण्डिः शक्तिः पतञ्जलिर् भोजव ज्ररुधुश् चैवद्विशाली शीतकिः अद्धम्̐ राजकेशो चौच्चुटी शांशापि कलशीकण्ठः कारीरयो वान्यायना वामध्यायनाः काप्याः कवय इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: Kapistara, Svastitara, Bindu, Daṇḍi, Śakti, Patañjali, Bhojava, and Jrarudhu, and Viśālī, Śītaki, Addha, Rājakeśa, Cauccuṭī, Śāṃśāpi, Kalaśīkaṇṭha, the Kārīrayas, Vānyāyanas, Vāmadhyāyanas, Kāpyas, and Kavis—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty āṅgirasāmahīyaurukṣayeti hotorukṣayavad amahīyavad aṅgirovad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आङ्गिरसामहीयौरुक्षयेति होतोरुक्षयवद् अमहीयवद् अङ्गिरोवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis. The hotṛ says: 'O descendant of Aṅgiras, descendant of Amahīyu, descendant of Urukṣaya!'; the adhvaryu says: 'Like Urukṣaya, like Amahīyu, like Aṅgiras!'

sanskrit_iast: saṃkṛti pautimāṣi taṇḍi śambhuḥ śevapāyanānāṃ jānaki tenailvakādvyalātavyārṣabhi lāṃgaṃdhi cārāyaṇī ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: संकृति पौतिमाषि तण्डि शम्भुः शेवपायनानां जानकि तेनैल्वकाद्व्यलातव्यार्षभि लांगंधि चारायणी इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: Saṃkṛti, Pautimāṣi, Taṇḍi, Śambhu, of the Śevapāyanas, Jānaki, Tenailvaka, Ādvyalātavya, Ārṣabhi, Lāṃgaṃdhi, and Cārāyaṇī—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty āṅgirasa sāṃkṛtya gaurivīteti hotā gaurivītivat saṃkṛtivad aṅgirovad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आङ्गिरस सांकृत्य गौरिवीतेति होता गौरिवीतिवत् संकृतिवद् अङ्गिरोवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis. The hotṛ says: 'O descendant of Aṅgiras, descendant of Saṃkṛti, descendant of Gaurivīti!'; the adhvaryu says: 'Like Gaurivīti, like Saṃkṛti, like Aṅgiras!'

sanskrit_iast: haritaḥ kautsa śaṅkha darbha paiṅga bhaimagava mādrakāri gāṇakāri hāstidāsi lāveraṇi kālaśīte ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: हरितः कौत्स शङ्ख दर्भ पैङ्ग भैमगव माद्रकारि गाणकारि हास्तिदासि लावेरणि कालशीते इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: Harita, Kautsa, Śaṅkha, Darbha, Paiṅga, Bhaimagava, Mādrakāri, Gāṇakāri, Hāstidāsi, Lāveraṇi, and Kālaśīti—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty āṅgirasāmbarīṣa yauvanāśveti hotā yuvanāśvavad ambarīṣavad aṅgirovad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आङ्गिरसाम्बरीष यौवनाश्वेति होता युवनाश्ववद् अम्बरीषवद् अङ्गिरोवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis. The hotṛ says: 'O descendant of Aṅgiras, descendant of Ambarīṣa, descendant of Yuvanāśva!'; the adhvaryu says: 'Like Yuvanāśva, like Ambarīṣa, like Aṅgiras!'

sanskrit_iast: ruruṃgākyāyanā ḍaśca tṛtīyaḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ caturtho gardabho nārī tataḥ prākāra sauvāra markaṭo ramaṇaḥ śaṇaḥ kaṇvā mārkaṭayo rāmaṇeyāḥ śāṇāyanā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: रुरुंगाक्यायना डश्च तृतीयः शाकटायनः चतुर्थो गर्दभो नारी ततः प्राकार सौवार मर्कटो रमणः शणः कण्वा मार्कटयो रामणेयाः शाणायना इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: Ruru, Gākyāyana, and Ḍa the third, Śākaṭāyana, the fourth Gardabha, Nārī, then Prākāra, Sauvāra, Markaṭa, Ramaṇa, Śaṇa, the Kaṇvas, Mārkaṭis, Rāmaṇeyas, and Śāṇāyanas—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty āṅgirasājamīḍha kāṇveti hotā kaṇvavad ajamīḍhavad aṅgirovad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आङ्गिरसाजमीढ काण्वेति होता कण्ववद् अजमीढवद् अङ्गिरोवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis. The hotṛ says: 'O descendant of Aṅgiras, descendant of Ajamīḍha, descendant of Kaṇva!'; the adhvaryu says: 'Like Kaṇva, like Ajamīḍha, like Aṅgiras!'

sanskrit_iast: atha vaiṣṇuvṛddhi śaṭhamarṣaṇa chatṛṇa potṛṇa gotṛṇa bādarāyaṇā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: अथ वैष्णुवृद्धि शठमर्षण छतृण पोतृण गोतृण बादरायणा इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: Now, the Vaiṣṇuvṛddhis, Śaṭhamarṣaṇas, Chatṛṇas, Potṛṇas, Gotṛṇas, and Bādarāyaṇas—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty āṅgirasa paurukutsa trāsadasyaveti hotā trasadasyuvat purukutsavad aṅgirovad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आङ्गिरस पौरुकुत्स त्रासदस्यवेति होता त्रसदस्युवत् पुरुकुत्सवद् अङ्गिरोवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis. The hotṛ says: 'O descendant of Aṅgiras, descendant of Purukutsa, descendant of Trasadasyu!'; the adhvaryu says: 'Like Trasadasyu, like Purukutsa, like Aṅgiras!'

sanskrit_iast: rathītarāṇāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty āṅgirasa vairūpa pārṣadaśveti hotā pṛṣadaśvavad virūpavad aṅgirovad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: रथीतराणां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आङ्गिरस वैरूप पार्षदश्वेति होता पृषदश्ववद् विरूपवद् अङ्गिरोवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Of the Rathītaras, the pravara consists of three ṛṣis. The hotṛ says: 'O descendant of Aṅgiras, descendant of Virūpa, descendant of Pṛṣadaśva!'; the adhvaryu says: 'Like Pṛṣadaśva, like Virūpa, like Aṅgiras!'

sanskrit_iast: raṣābhagānāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty āṅgirasa vāmadevya gautameti hotā gotamavad vāmadevavad aṅgirovad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: रषाभगानां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आङ्गिरस वामदेव्य गौतमेति होता गोतमवद् वामदेववद् अङ्गिरोवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Of the Raṣābhagas, the pravara consists of three ṛṣis. The hotṛ says: 'O descendant of Aṅgiras, descendant of Vāmadeva, descendant of Gotama!'; the adhvaryu says: 'Like Gotama, like Vāmadeva, like Aṅgiras!'

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyagarbha chatrakayo mudgalā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: हिरण्यगर्भ छत्रकयो मुद्गला इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: Hiraṇyagarbha, Chatraki, and the Mudgalas—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavatyāṅgirasa bhārmyaśva maudgalyeti hotā mudgalavad bhṛmyaśvavad aṅgirovad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्याङ्गिरस भार्म्यश्व मौद्गल्येति होता मुद्गलवद् भृम्यश्ववद् अङ्गिरोवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis. The hotṛ says: 'O descendant of Aṅgiras, descendant of Bhṛmyaśva, descendant of Mudgala!'; the adhvaryu says: 'Like Mudgala, like Bhṛmyaśva, like Aṅgiras!'

sanskrit_iast: ṛkṣabharadvājānāṃ pañcārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty āṅgirasa bārhaspatya bhāradvāja vāndana mātavacaseti hotā matavacovad vandavad bharadvājavad bṛhaspativad aṅgirovad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: ऋक्षभरद्वाजानां पञ्चार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आङ्गिरस बार्हस्पत्य भारद्वाज वान्दन मातवचसेति होता मतवचोवद् वन्दवद् भरद्वाजवद् बृहस्पतिवद् अङ्गिरोवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Of the Ṛkṣabharadvājas, the pravara consists of five ṛṣis. The hotṛ says: 'O descendant of Aṅgiras, descendant of Bṛhaspati, descendant of Bharadvāja, descendant of Vandana, descendant of Mātarivaśvan!'; the adhvaryu says: 'Like Mātarivaśvan, like Vandana, like Bharadvāja, like Bṛhaspati, like Aṅgiras!'

sanskrit_iast: atha yāny etāni dvyāmuṣyāyaṇāni kulāni bhavanti yathaitac chauṅgaśaiśirayor bharadvājāḥ śauṅgāḥ katāḥ śaiśiraya ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: अथ यान्य् एतानि द्व्यामुष्यायणानि कुलानि भवन्ति यथैतच् छौङ्गशैशिरयोर् भरद्वाजाः शौङ्गाः कताः शैशिरय इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: Now, those families which have two lineages, as in the case of the Śauṅga-Śaiśiras: the Bharadvājas, Śauṅgas, Katas, and Śaiśiras—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ pañcārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty āṅgirasa bārhaspatya bhāradvāja śauṅga śaiśireti hotā śiśiravac chuṅgavad bharadvājavad bṛhaspativad aṅgarovad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां पञ्चार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आङ्गिरस बार्हस्पत्य भारद्वाज शौङ्ग शैशिरेति होता शिशिरवच् छुङ्गवद् भरद्वाजवद् बृहस्पतिवद् अङ्गरोवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of five ṛṣis. The hotṛ says: 'O descendant of Aṅgiras, descendant of Bṛhaspati, descendant of Bharadvāja, descendant of Śuṅga, descendant of Śiśira!'; the adhvaryu says: 'Like Śiśira, like Śuṅga, like Bharadvāja, like Bṛhaspati, like Aṅgiras!'

sanskrit_iast: viśvāmitrān vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: विश्वामित्रान् व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: We shall explain the Viśvāmitras.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvāmitrā devarātāś caikita gālava vāratantavāḥ kuśikā vātaṇḍaś ca śalaṅkā āśvāvatāyanāḥ śyāmāyanā yājñavalkyā jāvālāḥ saindhavāyanā bābhravyā yaś ca varṣīya sāsityā atha sauśrutā audheprāḥ saurathāyaḥ kājāliyājaya ārjunākṣi pāryodari sumantu jaimini kharavākhali ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: वैश्वामित्रा देवराताश् चैकित गालव वारतन्तवाः कुशिका वातण्डश् च शलङ्का आश्वावतायनाः श्यामायना याज्ञवल्क्या जावालाः सैन्धवायना बाभ्रव्या यश् च वर्षीय सासित्या अथ सौश्रुता औधेप्राः सौरथायः काजालियाजय आर्जुनाक्षि पार्योदरि सुमन्तु जैमिनि खरवाखलि इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Vaiśvāmitras, Devarātas, Caikitas, Gālavas, Vāratantavas, Kuśikas, Vātaṇḍas, Śalaṅkas, Āśvāvatāyanas, Śyāmāyanas, Yājñavalkyas, Jābālas, Saindhavāyanas, Bābhravyas, and Yaśas, Varṣīyas, Sāsityas, then the Sauśrutas, Audhepras, Saurathis, Kājālis, Yājas, Ārjunākṣis, Pāryodaris, Sumantus, Jaiminis, and Kharavākhalis—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / vaiśvāmitra daivarātaudaleti hotodalavad devarātavad viśvāmitravad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / वैश्वामित्र दैवरातौदलेति होतोदलवद् देवरातवद् विश्वामित्रवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis. The hotṛ says: 'O descendant of Viśvāmitra, descendant of Devarāta, descendant of Udala!'; the adhvaryu says: 'Like Udala, like Devarāta, like Viśvāmitra!'

sanskrit_iast: devaśravasā devatarasā śraumata kāmakāyanā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: देवश्रवसा देवतरसा श्रौमत कामकायना इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Devaśravases, Devatarases, Śraumatas, and Kāmakāyanas—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / vaiśvāmitra daivaśravasa daivataraseti hotā devatarovad devaśravovad viśvāmitravad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / वैश्वामित्र दैवश्रवस दैवतरसेति होता देवतरोवद् देवश्रवोवद् विश्वामित्रवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis. The hotṛ says: 'O descendant of Viśvāmitra, descendant of Devaśravas, descendant of Devataras!'; the adhvaryu says: 'Like Devataras, like Devaśravas, like Viśvāmitra!'

sanskrit_iast: trīṇy etāni raiṇavāni kulāni bhavanti kathyakā śvodūraṇa śvodūhayaś cety eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: त्रीण्य् एतानि रैणवानि कुलानि भवन्ति कथ्यका श्वोदूरण श्वोदूहयश् चेत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: There are these three families descended from Reṇu: the Kathyakas, Śvodūraṇas, and Śvodūhayas—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / vaiśvāmitra kāthaka kāthyaketi hotā kathyakavat kāthavad viśvāmitravad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / वैश्वामित्र काथक काथ्यकेति होता कथ्यकवत् काथवद् विश्वामित्रवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis. The hotṛ says: 'O descendant of Viśvāmitra, descendant of Katha, descendant of Kathyaka!'; the adhvaryu says: 'Like Kathyaka, like Katha, like Viśvāmitra!'

sanskrit_iast: atha kamandaka dhanaṃjaya piḷakaṭa pārthiva bandhala pāṇinānām ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: अथ कमन्दक धनंजय पिऌअकट पार्थिव बन्धल पाणिनानाम् इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: Now, among the Kamandakas, Dhanaṃjayas, Piḷakaṭas, Pārthivas, Bandhalas, and Pāṇinis—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / vaiśvāmitra mādhuchandasāghamarṣaṇeti hotāghamarṣaṇavan madhuchandovad viśvāmitravad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / वैश्वामित्र माधुछन्दसाघमर्षणेति होताघमर्षणवन् मधुछन्दोवद् विश्वामित्रवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis. The hotṛ says: 'O descendant of Viśvāmitra, descendant of Madhuchandas, descendant of Aghamarṣaṇa!'; the adhvaryu says: 'Like Aghamarṣaṇa, like Madhuchandas, like Viśvāmitra!'

sanskrit_iast: ajā mādhuchandasā mārgamitrā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: अजा माधुछन्दसा मार्गमित्रा इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Ajas, Mādhuchandasas, and Mārgamitras—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / vaiśvāmitra mādhuchandasājyoti hotājavan madhuchandovad viśvāmitravad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / वैश्वामित्र माधुछन्दसाज्योति होताजवन् मधुछन्दोवद् विश्वामित्रवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis. The hotṛ says: 'O descendant of Viśvāmitra, descendant of Madhuchandas, descendant of Aja!'; the adhvaryu says: 'Like Aja, like Madhuchandas, like Viśvāmitra!'

sanskrit_iast: āśmarathyāḥ kāmalāyatino bandhula kauśiketihotā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: आश्मरथ्याः कामलायतिनो बन्धुल कौशिकेतिहोता इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Āśmarathyas, Kāmalāyatinas, Bandhulas, and Kauśikas—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ dvyārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / vaiśvāmitrāṣṭaketi hotāṣṭakavad viśvāmitravad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां द्व्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / वैश्वामित्राष्टकेति होताष्टकवद् विश्वामित्रवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of two ṛṣis. The hotṛ says: 'O descendant of Viśvāmitra, descendant of Aṣṭaka!'; the adhvaryu says: 'Like Aṣṭaka, like Viśvāmitra!'

sanskrit_iast: pūraṇā vāridhāpayantā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: पूरणा वारिधापयन्ता इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Pūraṇas and Vāridhāpayantas—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ dvyārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / vaiśvāmitra pauraṇeti hotā pūraṇavad viśvāmitravad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां द्व्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / वैश्वामित्र पौरणेति होता पूरणवद् विश्वामित्रवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of two ṛṣis. The hotṛ says: 'O descendant of Viśvāmitra, descendant of Pūraṇa!'; the adhvaryu says: 'Like Pūraṇa, like Viśvāmitra!'

sanskrit_iast: gāthino raiṇavāsteṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / vaiśvāmitra gāthina raiṇaveti hotā reṇuvad gāthivad viśvāmitravad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: गाथिनो रैणवास्तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / वैश्वामित्र गाथिन रैणवेति होता रेणुवद् गाथिवद् विश्वामित्रवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: For the Gāthinas and Raiṇavas, there is a three-seer ancestral invocation. The hotṛ [says]: 'O descendant of Viśvāmitra, descendant of Gāthin, descendant of Reṇu!'; the adhvaryu [says]: 'Like Reṇu, like Gāthin, like Viśvāmitra!'

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyaretasānāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / vaiśvāmitra hiraṇya retaseti hotā retasavad dhiraṇyavad viśvāmitravad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: हिरण्यरेतसानां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / वैश्वामित्र हिरण्य रेतसेति होता रेतसवद् धिरण्यवद् विश्वामित्रवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: For the Hiraṇyaretases, there is a three-seer ancestral invocation. The hotṛ [says]: 'O descendant of Viśvāmitra, descendant of Hiraṇya, descendant of Retas!'; the adhvaryu [says]: 'Like Retas, like Hiraṇya, like Viśvāmitra!'

sanskrit_iast: suvarṇaretasānāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / vaiśvāmitra sauvarṇa retaseti hotā retasavat suvarṇavad viśvāmitravad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: सुवर्णरेतसानां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / वैश्वामित्र सौवर्ण रेतसेति होता रेतसवत् सुवर्णवद् विश्वामित्रवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: For the Suvarṇaretases, there is a three-seer ancestral invocation. The hotṛ [says]: 'O descendant of Viśvāmitra, descendant of Suvarṇa, descendant of Retas!'; the adhvaryu [says]: 'Like Retas, like Suvarṇa, like Viśvāmitra!'

sanskrit_iast: kapotaretasānāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / vaiśvāmitra kāpota retaseti hotā retasavat kapotavad viśvāmitravad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: कपोतरेतसानां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / वैश्वामित्र कापोत रेतसेति होता रेतसवत् कपोतवद् विश्वामित्रवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: For the Kapotaretases, there is a three-seer ancestral invocation. The hotṛ [says]: 'O descendant of Viśvāmitra, descendant of Kapota, descendant of Retas!'; the adhvaryu [says]: 'Like Retas, like Kapota, like Viśvāmitra!'

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtakauśikānāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / vaiśvāmitra ghārta kauśiketi hotā kuśikavad ghṛtavad viśvāmitravad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: घृतकौशिकानां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / वैश्वामित्र घार्त कौशिकेति होता कुशिकवद् घृतवद् विश्वामित्रवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: For the Ghṛtakauśikas, there is a three-seer ancestral invocation. The hotṛ [says]: 'O descendant of Viśvāmitra, descendant of Ghṛta, descendant of Kuśika!'; the adhvaryu [says]: 'Like Kuśika, like Ghṛta, like Viśvāmitra!'

sanskrit_iast: śāṭharamāṭharāṇāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / vaiśvāmitra śāṭhara māṭhareti hotā maṭharavac chaṭharavad viśvāmitravad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: शाठरमाठराणां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / वैश्वामित्र शाठर माठरेति होता मठरवच् छठरवद् विश्वामित्रवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: For the Śāṭharamāṭharas, there is a three-seer ancestral invocation. The hotṛ [says]: 'O descendant of Viśvāmitra, descendant of Śāṭhara, descendant of Māṭhara!'; the adhvaryu [says]: 'Like Maṭhara, like Śaṭhara, like Viśvāmitra!'

sanskrit_iast: atha sāhula māhula uhala kohala jaṃvila śāvila śātila phāhula yāmila yādadhi śādadhi ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: अथ साहुल माहुल उहल कोहल जंविल शाविल शातिल फाहुल यामिल यादधि शादधि इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: Now: the Sāhulas, Māhulas, Uhalas, Kohalas, Jaṃvilas, Śāvilas, Śātilas, Phāhulas, Yāmilas, Yādadhis, and Śādadhis—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / vaiśvāmitra sāhula māhuleti hotā māhulavat sāhulavad viśvāmitravad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / वैश्वामित्र साहुल माहुलेति होता माहुलवत् साहुलवद् विश्वामित्रवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: For them there is a three-seer ancestral invocation. The hotṛ [says]: 'O descendant of Viśvāmitra, descendant of Sāhula, descendant of Māhula!'; the adhvaryu [says]: 'Like Māhula, like Sāhula, like Viśvāmitra!'

sanskrit_iast: athodumbarāyaṇiḥ śaiśira taikāyanti tārukṣyāyaṇi velāyana vedāyana maudāyana caudāyana gaṅgāyana kātyāyana kātyātkīla kārī lācakīty eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: अथोदुम्बरायणिः शैशिर तैकायन्ति तारुक्ष्यायणि वेलायन वेदायन मौदायन चौदायन गङ्गायन कात्यायन कात्यात्कील कारी लाचकीत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: Now: the Udumbarāyaṇis, Śaiśiras, Taikāyantis, Tārukṣyāyaṇis, Velāyanas, Vedāyanas, Maudāyanas, Caudāyanas, Gaṅgāyanas, Kātyāyanas, Kātyātkīlas, Kārīs, and Lācakīs—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / vaiśvāmitra kātyātkīleti hotātkīlavat katavad viśvāmitravad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / वैश्वामित्र कात्यात्कीलेति होतात्कीलवत् कतवद् विश्वामित्रवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: For them there is a three-seer ancestral invocation. The hotṛ [says]: 'O descendant of Viśvāmitra, Kātya, Atkīla!'; the adhvaryu [says]: 'Like Atkīla, like Kata, like Viśvāmitra!'

sanskrit_iast: vasiṣṭhān vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: वसिष्ठान् व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: We shall explain the Vasiṣṭhas.

sanskrit_iast: vasiṣṭhānām ekārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati ye 'nya upamanyuparāśarebhyaḥ kuṇḍinebhyaś ca /
meaning: वसिष्ठानाम् एकार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति ये ऽन्य उपमन्युपराशरेभ्यः कुण्डिनेभ्यश् च /
text_mt: For the Vasiṣṭhas there is a single-seer ancestral invocation, for those who are other than the Upamanyus, the Parāśaras, and the Kuṇḍinas.

sanskrit_iast: vaidyāghrapadyā aupagavā vaigrayaḥ sāsāmalāyanāḥ kapiṣṭhalā auḍulomāśvalāyanā vaiṭārakā gopāyanā baudhāyanāś cūḍākavyāyanā atha vāhyākī jātūkarṇyā haritayo 'tho vākurayaś ca ye āyaḥsthūṇāḥ śucivṛkṣā laumāyanya bahyavādi bahmakṛdeya bahmavideya bahmavileyaḥ svastikaraḥ kāṇṭheviddhi maṇḍi cauli caulikā kālohalī saumanasāyaṇirāvaṇi cauli gauriśravasārjunākṣā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: वैद्याघ्रपद्या औपगवा वैग्रयः सासामलायनाः कपिष्ठला औडुलोमाश्वलायना वैटारका गोपायना बौधायनाश् चूडाकव्यायना अथ वाह्याकी जातूकर्ण्या हरितयो ऽथो वाकुरयश् च ये आयःस्थूणाः शुचिवृक्षा लौमायन्य बह्यवादि बह्मकृदेय बह्मविदेय बह्मविलेयः स्वस्तिकरः काण्ठेविद्धि मण्डि चौलि चौलिका कालोहली सौमनसायणिरावणि चौलि गौरिश्रवसार्जुनाक्षा इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Vaidyāghrapadyas, Aupagavas, Vaigrayas, Sāsāmalāyanas, Kapiṣṭhalas, Auḍulomas, Āśvalāyanas, Vaiṭārakas, Gopāyanas, Baudhāyanas, Cūḍākavyāyanas; then the Vāhyākīs, Jātūkarṇyas, Haritayas, and also those who are Vākurayas, Āyaḥsthūṇas, Śucivṛkṣas, Laumāyanyas, Bahyavādins, Bahmakṛdeyas, Bahmavideyas, Bahmavileyas, Svastikaras, Kāṇṭheviddhis, Maṇḍis, Caulis, Caulikās, Kālohalīs, Saumanasāyaṇis, Rāvaṇis, Caulis, Gaurīśravasas, and Arjunākṣas—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām ekārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / vāsiṣṭheti hotā vasiṣṭhavad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषाम् एकार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / वासिष्ठेति होता वसिष्ठवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: For them there is a single-seer ancestral invocation. The hotṛ [says]: 'O descendant of Vasiṣṭha!'; the adhvaryu [says]: 'Like Vasiṣṭha!'

sanskrit_iast: upamanyūn vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: उपमन्यून् व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: We shall explain the Upamanyus.

sanskrit_iast: śailālayo mahākarṇāḥ kauravyā atha traivarṇāḥ kapiñjalā dāvalaśikhī bhāgavittāyanāś ca ye ḍokavyāyanā oṃpālakhī vāvālkalayaḥ śāntātapāḥ kārḍurirākatmāveyā atho lavayaś ca ye yortha atha sachāgyāyana ālavyāyanā kaumārāyaṇāḥ kaulodakiraudgāhamānayaḥ evākari lākṣmaṇeyāḥ gāṇḍūlavoddhaki sāṃkhyāyanā aupamanyavāḥ kauṇḍodari kaidarbhi nāhaki bāhavi dhaumāvata mauñjāyana śaśakāyanā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: शैलालयो महाकर्णाः कौरव्या अथ त्रैवर्णाः कपिञ्जला दावलशिखी भागवित्तायनाश् च ये डोकव्यायना ओंपालखी वावाल्कलयः शान्तातपाः कार्डुरिराकत्मावेया अथो लवयश् च ये योर्थ अथ सछाग्यायन आलव्यायना कौमारायणाः कौलोदकिरौद्गाहमानयः एवाकरि लाक्ष्मणेयाः गाण्डूलवोद्धकि सांख्यायना औपमन्यवाः कौण्डोदरि कैदर्भि नाहकि बाहवि धौमावत मौञ्जायन शशकायना इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Śailālayas, Mahākarṇas, Kauravyas; then the Traivarṇas, Kapiñjalas, Dāvalaśikhīs, and those who are Bhāgavittāyanas, Ḍokavyāyanas, Oṃpālakhīs, Vāvālkalayas, Śāntātapas, Kārḍuris, Ākatmāveyas; and also those who are Lavayas, Yorthas; then the Sachāgyāyanas, Ālavyāyanas, Kaumārāyaṇas, Kaulodakis, Raudgāhamānayas, Evākaris, Lākṣmaṇeyas, Gāṇḍūlavoddhakis, Sāṃkhyāyanas, Aupamanyavas, Kauṇḍodaris, Kaidarbhis, Nāhakis, Bāhavis, Dhaumāvatas, Mauñjāyanas, and Śaśakāyanas—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / vāsiṣṭhābharadvasavaindrapramadeti hotendrapramadavad ābharadvasuvad vasiṣṭhavad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / वासिष्ठाभरद्वसवैन्द्रप्रमदेति होतेन्द्रप्रमदवद् आभरद्वसुवद् वसिष्ठवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: For them there is a three-seer ancestral invocation. The hotṛ [says]: 'O descendant of Vasiṣṭha, descendant of Bharadvasu, descendant of Indrapramada!'; the adhvaryu [says]: 'Like Indrapramada, like Ābharadvasu, like Vasiṣṭha!'

sanskrit_iast:
prārohayo vaikalayaḥ \ plākṣayaḥ kaumudādayaḥ /
hāryaśvir eṣāṃ pañcamas\ ete raktāḥ parāśarāḥ //
kāṇḍūśayo vāhatayā \ jāṃjayo maimanāyanāḥ /
gopālireṣāṃ pañcamas\ ete nīlāḥ parāśarāḥ //
kārṣṇājināḥ kapiśroḍhāḥ \ kārkayaḥ śāntātapāḥ /
puṣkarasādireṣāṃ pañcamas\ ete kṛṣṇāḥ parāśarāḥ //
āviṣṭāyanā vārṣṇāyanā \ śmāmeya lokāyaś ca /
vaikṣireṣāṃ pañcamas\ ete gaurāḥ parāśarāḥ //
khāllāyanā vārṣāyaṇi \ pūrṇayo bilvayūpayaḥ /
nārṇireṣāṃ pañcamas\ ete śuklāḥ parāśarāḥ //
ete trim̐śatparāśarā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning:
प्रारोहयो वैकलयः \ प्लाक्षयः कौमुदादयः /
हार्यश्विर् एषां पञ्चमस्\ एते रक्ताः पराशराः //
काण्डूशयो वाहतया \ जांजयो मैमनायनाः /
गोपालिरेषां पञ्चमस्\ एते नीलाः पराशराः //
कार्ष्णाजिनाः कपिश्रोढाः \ कार्कयः शान्तातपाः /
पुष्करसादिरेषां पञ्चमस्\ एते कृष्णाः पराशराः //
आविष्टायना वार्ष्णायना \ श्मामेय लोकायश् च /
वैक्षिरेषां पञ्चमस्\ एते गौराः पराशराः //
खाल्लायना वार्षायणि \ पूर्णयो बिल्वयूपयः /
नार्णिरेषां पञ्चमस्\ एते शुक्लाः पराशराः //
एते त्रिम्̐शत्पराशरा इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / vāsiṣṭha śāktya pārāśaryeti hotā parāśaravac chaktivad vasiṣṭhavad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / वासिष्ठ शाक्त्य पाराशर्येति होता पराशरवच् छक्तिवद् वसिष्ठवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt:
These are the thirty Parāśaras; among these there is no intermarriage.

For them there is a three-seer ancestral invocation. The hotṛ [says]: 'O descendant of Vasiṣṭha, descendant of Śakti, descendant of Parāśara!'; the adhvaryu [says]: 'Like Parāśara, like Śakti, like Vasiṣṭha!'

sanskrit_iast: aupasvastiḥ svastayaś cālohāyanāś ca ye mādhyaṃdinā ākṣitayaḥ paippalādi divaṃkarṣī kuṇḍino mitrāvaruṇā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: औपस्वस्तिः स्वस्तयश् चालोहायनाश् च ये माध्यंदिना आक्षितयः पैप्पलादि दिवंकर्षी कुण्डिनो मित्रावरुणा इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Aupasvastis, Svastis, and those who are Alohāyanas, the Mādhyaṃdinas, Ākṣitis, Paippalādis, Divaṃkarṣis, Kuṇḍinas, and Mitrāvaruṇas—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / vāsiṣṭha kauṇḍinya maitrāvaruṇeti hotā mitrāvaruṇavat kuṇḍinavad vasiṣṭhavad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / वासिष्ठ कौण्डिन्य मैत्रावरुणेति होता मित्रावरुणवत् कुण्डिनवद् वसिष्ठवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: For them there is a three-seer ancestral invocation. The hotṛ [says]: 'O descendant of Vasiṣṭha, descendant of Kuṇḍina, descendant of Mitrāvaruṇa!'; the adhvaryu [says]: 'Like Mitrāvaruṇa, like Kuṇḍina, like Vasiṣṭha!'

sanskrit_iast: kaśyapān vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: कश्यपान् व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: We shall explain the Kaśyapas.

sanskrit_iast: āgrāyaṇāś cāgrāyaṇā graivāyaṇā vṛṣagaṇā somabhūtā śonavyā mauṣakiritikāyanā audavrajirmāṭharaś ca kaijāli atha lākṣmaṇayo vaidhakayaḥ ślokatyā yaś ca bhaumani devatayā gomeyādā athotthāsvayaṃsvāpa dhūmrāyaṇāḥ subabhruś cāthorṣyāyaṇā kārṣyāyaṇā svāroyaṇā ḍākavāyaṇāḥ śatrubhayo bhiryogādiḥ śarakāḥ kāṣṭāyaṇāḥ śākādaḥ śālihotrāś cāyamājānanāthāḥ kuvamimāḥ cakridāḥ dākṣapāṇayo mārīcayo māṣaśarāvir agniśarmāyaṇaś ca ye hāstidāsi yailmailitānyakṛti kauṣītakī saumiśrī kāṇḍā vāyani vāruṇi vaivarī śaivarayo jighāna hastikāśyapa paiṭhīnasa kaikaseya pratiṣeya sauśyavasamoya saryāgnā vasamopa dārbhaḥ pālaśāyinaḥ kaduka bhaikṣi ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: आग्रायणाश् चाग्रायणा ग्रैवायणा वृषगणा सोमभूता शोनव्या मौषकिरितिकायना औदव्रजिर्माठरश् च कैजालि अथ लाक्ष्मणयो वैधकयः श्लोकत्या यश् च भौमनि देवतया गोमेयादा अथोत्थास्वयंस्वाप धूम्रायणाः सुबभ्रुश् चाथोर्ष्यायणा कार्ष्यायणा स्वारोयणा डाकवायणाः शत्रुभयो भिर्योगादिः शरकाः काष्टायणाः शाकादः शालिहोत्राश् चायमाजाननाथाः कुवमिमाः चक्रिदाः दाक्षपाणयो मारीचयो माषशराविर् अग्निशर्मायणश् च ये हास्तिदासि यैल्मैलितान्यकृति कौषीतकी सौमिश्री काण्डा वायनि वारुणि वैवरी शैवरयो जिघान हस्तिकाश्यप पैठीनस कैकसेय प्रतिषेय सौश्यवसमोय सर्याग्ना वसमोप दार्भः पालशायिनः कदुक भैक्षि इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Āgrāyaṇas, Agrāyaṇas, Graivāyaṇas, Vṛṣagaṇas, Somabhūtas, Śonavayas, Mauṣakiritikāyanas, Audavraji and Māṭhara, Kaijāli; then the Lākṣmaṇayas, Vaidhakayas, and Ślokatyas, and Bhaumani, Devatayā, Gomeyādas; then the Utthāsvayaṃsvāpas, Dhūmrāyaṇas, Subabhru; and also the Urṣyāyaṇas, Kārṣyāyaṇas, Svāroyaṇas, Ḍākavāyaṇas, Śatrubhayas, Bhiryogādis, Śarakas, Kāṣṭhāyanas, Śākādas, Śālihotras, Ayamājānanāthas, Kuvamimas, Cakridas, Dākṣapāṇis, Mārīcas, Māṣaśarāvis, and those who are Agniśarmāyaṇas, Hāstidāsis, Yailmailitānyakṛtis, Kauṣītakīs, Saumiśrīs, Kāṇḍāvayanis, Vāruṇis, Vaivaris, Śaivarayas, Jighānas, Hastikāśyapas, Paiṭhīnasas, Kaikaseyas, Pratiṣeyas, Sauśyavasamoyas, Saryāgnāvasamopas, Dārbhas, Pālaśāyins, Kadukas, and Bhaikṣis—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / kāśyapāvatsāra naidhruveti hotā nidhruvavad avatsāravat kaśyapavad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / काश्यपावत्सार नैध्रुवेति होता निध्रुववद् अवत्सारवत् कश्यपवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: For them there is a three-seer ancestral invocation. The hotṛ [says]: 'O descendant of Kaśyapa, descendant of Avatsāra, descendant of Nidhruva!'; the adhvaryu [says]: 'Like Nidhruva, like Avatsāra, like Kaśyapa!'

sanskrit_iast: ānaṣṭayo bhāgurayaḥ śyenapo 'thājāpālayaḥ śairī ṣiraudavāhī ca śairaṃdhri aupaśavīyaḥ saumyakṛkoyuṣī kālāśi laukkākṣa idaṃdha ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: आनष्टयो भागुरयः श्येनपो ऽथाजापालयः शैरी षिरौदवाही च शैरंध्रि औपशवीयः सौम्यकृकोयुषी कालाशि लौक्काक्ष इदंध इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Ānaṣṭis, Bhāguris, Śyenapas; then the Ajāpālis, Śairīṣis, Audavāhis, Śairaṃdhris, Aupaśavīyas, Saumyakṛs, Koyuṣīs, Kālāśis, Laukkākṣas, and Idaṃdhas—among these there is no intermarriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / kāśyapāvatsāra vāsiṣṭheti hotā vasiṣṭhavad avatsāravat kaśyapavad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / काश्यपावत्सार वासिष्ठेति होता वसिष्ठवद् अवत्सारवत् कश्यपवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: For them there is a three-seer ancestral invocation. The hotṛ [says]: 'O descendant of Kaśyapa, descendant of Avatsāra, descendant of Vasiṣṭha!'; the adhvaryu [says]: 'Like Vasiṣṭha, like Avatsāra, like Kaśyapa!'

sanskrit_iast: sáṃbhujā jalibhraśvobhau bhūpapurodha jalaṃdhara mujo mayūraḥ paryagoṣṭho gardabhīmukho hiraṇyavāhur ādityavarṇaḥ saudāmilubho śauśila gobhilo kuhalo vṛkakhaṇḍaś cety ete gukuraṇṭayaḥ uttaraḥ śāntiketuś cety ete devajātayaḥ vedāyana jāṅgharāyaṇa śatrūhāyana audameghāstṛṇavasta śaṇḍilo mahākā bhallakaś ca vāyukīstārkalistetṛcodvudi sauṣmiṇeyā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: स्áंभुजा जलिभ्रश्वोभौ भूपपुरोध जलंधर मुजो मयूरः पर्यगोष्ठो गर्दभीमुखो हिरण्यवाहुर् आदित्यवर्णः सौदामिलुभो शौशिल गोभिलो कुहलो वृकखण्डश् चेत्य् एते गुकुरण्टयः उत्तरः शान्तिकेतुश् चेत्य् एते देवजातयः वेदायन जाङ्घरायण शत्रूहायन औदमेघास्तृणवस्त शण्डिलो महाका भल्लकश् च वायुकीस्तार्कलिस्तेतृचोद्वुदि सौष्मिणेया इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Sambhujas, Jalibhraśvas, both Bhūpapurodhas, Jalaṃdharas, Mujas, Mayūras, Paryagoṣṭhas, Gardabhīmukhas, Hiraṇyavāhus, Ādityavarṇas, Saudāmilubhas, Śauśilas, Gobhilas, Kuhalas, and Vṛkakhaṇḍas—these are the Gukuraṇṭis; the Uttaras and Śāntiketus—these are the Devajātayas; the Vedāyanas, Jāṅgharāyaṇas, Śatrūhāyanas, Audameghas, Tṛṇavastas, Śaṇḍilas, Mahākās, Bhallakas, Vāyukis, Tārkalistis, Ṛcodvudis, and Sauṣmiṇeyas: between these there is no marriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavati / kāśyapāsita daivaleti hotā śāṇḍilāsita daivaleti vā devalavad asitavat kaśyapavad ity adhvaryur devalavad asitavac chaṇḍilavad iti vā /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवति / काश्यपासित दैवलेति होता शाण्डिलासित दैवलेति वा देवलवद् असितवत् कश्यपवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युर् देवलवद् असितवच् छण्डिलवद् इति वा /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis. 'O descendant of Kaśyapa, of Asita, of Devala!' the hotṛ [says]; or 'O descendant of Śaṇḍila, of Asita, of Devala!' 'Like Devala, like Asita, like Kaśyapa,' the adhvaryu [says]; or 'Like Devala, like Asita, like Śaṇḍila.'

sanskrit_iast: atrīn vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: अत्रीन् व्याख्यास्यामः /

sanskrit_iast: kārmaryāyāṇi śaṃkilayaṃścādyo śākhārathayaś ca ye āghrāyaṇā vāmarathyā gopavanās tārṇabindava auddālakī śaunakarṇyatho vālūtapayaś ca ye gauragrīviḥ kairandiś ca caitrāyaṇāś ca ye nākarṣyayaṃti pauriṃdyatho vatsāthapāś ca ye gali chāgali bhāgali vāhudantyendreya dauchāyātreyaḥ sauddhūtakī varṣāṇaki kṛṣṇa chandogīty eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: कार्मर्यायाणि शंकिलयंश्चाद्यो शाखारथयश् च ये आघ्रायणा वामरथ्या गोपवनास् तार्णबिन्दव औद्दालकी शौनकर्ण्यथो वालूतपयश् च ये गौरग्रीविः कैरन्दिश् च चैत्रायणाश् च ये नाकर्ष्ययंति पौरिंद्यथो वत्साथपाश् च ये गलि छागलि भागलि वाहुदन्त्येन्द्रेय दौछायात्रेयः सौद्धूतकी वर्षाणकि कृष्ण छन्दोगीत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Kārmaryāyaṇis, Śaṃkilas, the foremost Śākhārathyas, the Āghrāyaṇas, Vāmarathyas, Gopavanas, Tārṇabindus, Auddālakis, Śaunakarṇis, the Vālūtapayas, Gauragrīvis, Kairandis, Caitrāyaṇas, Nākarṣyis, Pauriṃdis, Vatsāthapās, Galis, Chāgalis, Bhāgalis, Vāhudantis, Indreyas, Dauchāyātreyas, Sauddhūtakis, Varṣāṇakis, Kṛṣṇas, and Chāndogis: between these there is no marriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty ātreyārcanānasa śyāvāśveti hotā śyāvāśvavad arcanānasavad atrivad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आत्रेयार्चनानस श्यावाश्वेति होता श्यावाश्ववद् अर्चनानसवद् अत्रिवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis: 'O descendant of Atri, of Arcanānas, of Śyāvāśva!' the hotṛ [says]; 'Like Śyāvāśva, like Arcanānas, like Atri,' the adhvaryu [says].

sanskrit_iast: plākṣirdākṣirvyāliḥ paurṇaviraurṇavāpi śilaṃvino mauñjakeśī bhalandano baijavāpi śirīṣaś ca maiyaṇyo dūtiḥ saupuṣpiḥ sāmapuṣpiḥ somapuṣpiḥ hiraṇyapuṣpiścandrikardraki kākaśīrpi kākālaśīty eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: प्लाक्षिर्दाक्षिर्व्यालिः पौर्णविरौर्णवापि शिलंविनो मौञ्जकेशी भलन्दनो बैजवापि शिरीषश् च मैयण्यो दूतिः सौपुष्पिः सामपुष्पिः सोमपुष्पिः हिरण्यपुष्पिश्चन्द्रिकर्द्रकि काकशीर्पि काकालशीत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Plākṣis, Dākṣis, Vyālis, Paurṇavis, Aurṇavāpis, Śilaṃvins, Mauñjakeśins, Bhalandanas, Baijavāpis, Śirīṣas, Maiyaṇyas, Dūtis, Saupuṣpis, Sāmapuṣpis, Somapuṣpis, Hiraṇyapuṣpis, Candrikardrakis, Kākaśīrpis, and Kākālaśis: between these there is no marriage.

sanskrit_iast: tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty ātreya gāviṣṭhira paurvātitheti hotā pūrvātithivad gaviṣṭhiravad atrivad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आत्रेय गाविष्ठिर पौर्वातिथेति होता पूर्वातिथिवद् गविष्ठिरवद् अत्रिवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis: 'O descendant of Atri, of Gaviṣṭhira, of Pūrvātithi!' the hotṛ [says]; 'Like Pūrvātithi, like Gaviṣṭhira, like Atri,' the adhvaryu [says].

sanskrit_iast: putrikāputrān vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: पुत्रिकापुत्रान् व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: We shall explain the sons of an appointed daughter.

sanskrit_iast: hāleyā vāleyā daubheyā śaubhreyā kaubhreyā vāmarathya gopavana viṣṭira putrikāputrā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: हालेया वालेया दौभेया शौभ्रेया कौभ्रेया वामरथ्य गोपवन विष्टिर पुत्रिकापुत्रा इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Hāleyas, Vāleyas, Daubheyas, Śaubhreyas, Kaubhreyas, Vāmarathyas, Gopavanas, and the sons of an appointed daughter of Viṣṭira: between these there is no marriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavatyātreya gāviṣṭhira pautriketi hotā putrikāvad gaviṣṭhiravad atrivad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्यात्रेय गाविष्ठिर पौत्रिकेति होता पुत्रिकावद् गविष्ठिरवद् अत्रिवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis: 'O descendant of Atri, of Gaviṣṭhira, of an appointed daughter!' the hotṛ [says]; 'Like the son of an appointed daughter, like Gaviṣṭhira, like Atri,' the adhvaryu [says].

sanskrit_iast: agastīn vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: अगस्तीन् व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: We shall explain the Agastis.

sanskrit_iast: kukūla upaka balakā lāṃvakāyana śālaṃkāyana dhāriṇi dhauraṇī saudhanvā saukṛtya kalmāṣadaṇḍirapauturauturāyaṇānām̐ śaurbhyāṃyanā govyādhilā śilādya śaivapathārbudānām aidilamā evayāyadūtā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: कुकूल उपक बलका लांवकायन शालंकायन धारिणि धौरणी सौधन्वा सौकृत्य कल्माषदण्डिरपौतुरौतुरायणानाम्̐ शौर्भ्यांयना गोव्याधिला शिलाद्य शैवपथार्बुदानाम् ऐदिलमा एवयायदूता इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Kukūlas, Upakas, Balakās, Lāṃvakāyanas, Śālaṃkāyanas, Dhāriṇis, Dhauraṇīs, Saudhanvas, Saukṛtyas, Kalmāṣadaṇḍis, Apauturauturāyaṇas, Śaurbhyāṃyanas, Govyādhilas, Śilādyas, the [descendants] of the Śaivapathārbudas, Idilamas, and the messengers of Evayā: between these there is no marriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty āgastya dārḍhacyutaidhmavāheti hotedhmavāhavad dṛḍhacyutavad agastivad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आगस्त्य दार्ढच्युतैध्मवाहेति होतेध्मवाहवद् दृढच्युतवद् अगस्तिवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis: 'O descendant of Agastya, of Dṛḍhacyuta, of Idhmavāha!' the hotṛ [says]; 'Like Idhmavāha, like Dṛḍhacyuta, like Agastya,' the adhvaryu [says].

sanskrit_iast: akra śakra śukra jātye haimaudakīty eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: अक्र शक्र शुक्र जात्ये हैमौदकीत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Akras, Śakras, Śukras, Jātyas, and Haimaudakis: between these there is no marriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty āgastya māhendra māyobhuveti hotā mayobhuvavan mahendravad agstivad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आगस्त्य माहेन्द्र मायोभुवेति होता मयोभुववन् महेन्द्रवद् अग्स्तिवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis: 'O descendant of Agastya, of Mahendra, of Mayobhū!' the hotṛ [says]; 'Like Mayobhū, like Mahendra, like Agastya,' the adhvaryu [says].

sanskrit_iast: prācīnapravaṇāḥ kāyeyāḥ akra śukra śuddha ham̐sa cāṣa bhāṣa haimavarca himodakāḥ ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: प्राचीनप्रवणाः कायेयाः अक्र शुक्र शुद्ध हम्̐स चाष भाष हैमवर्च हिमोदकाः इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Prācīnapravaṇas, Kāyeyas, Akras, Śukras, Śuddhas, Haṃsas, Cāṣas, Bhāṣas, Haimavarcas, and Himodakas: between these there is no marriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty āgastya haimavarca haimodaketi hotā himodakavad dhimavarcavad agastivad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आगस्त्य हैमवर्च हैमोदकेति होता हिमोदकवद् धिमवर्चवद् अगस्तिवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis: 'O descendant of Agastya, of Haimavarca, of Haimodaka!' the hotṛ [says]; 'Like Himodaka, like Himavarca, like Agastya,' the adhvaryu [says].

sanskrit_iast: akri cakri arci carci himodaki pāriṇakā ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: अक्रि चक्रि अर्चि चर्चि हिमोदकि पारिणका इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Akris, Cakris, Arcis, Carcis, Himodakis, and Pāriṇakas: between these there is no marriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty āgastya pināyaka pāriṇaketi hotā pāriṇakavat pināyakavad agastivad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आगस्त्य पिनायक पारिणकेति होता पारिणकवत् पिनायकवद् अगस्तिवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis: 'O descendant of Agastya, of Pināyaka, of Pāriṇaka!' the hotṛ [says]; 'Like Pāriṇaka, like Pināyaka, like Agastya,' the adhvaryu [says].

sanskrit_iast: naṃdi vimali dhimali mimītaki pināyaki sāyaki ity eteṣām avivāhaḥ /
meaning: नंदि विमलि धिमलि मिमीतकि पिनायकि सायकि इत्य् एतेषाम् अविवाहः /
text_mt: The Naṃdis, Vimalis, Dhimalis, Mimītakis, Pināyakis, and Sāyakis: between these there is no marriage.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty āgastya pināyaka sāyaketi hotā sāyakavat pināyakavad agastivad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आगस्त्य पिनायक सायकेति होता सायकवत् पिनायकवद् अगस्तिवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: Their pravara consists of three ṛṣis: 'O descendant of Agastya, of Pināyaka, of Sāyaki!' the hotṛ [says]; 'Like Sāyaki, like Pināyaka, like Agastya,' the adhvaryu [says].

sanskrit_iast: madhyamapūraṇās teṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavaty āgastya mādhyama pauraṇeti hotā puraṇavan madhyamavad agastivad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: मध्यमपूरणास् तेषां त्र्यार्षेयः प्रवरो भवत्य् आगस्त्य माध्यम पौरणेति होता पुरणवन् मध्यमवद् अगस्तिवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: The Madhyamapūraṇas: their pravara consists of three ṛṣis: 'O descendant of Agastya, of Madhyama, of Pūraṇa!' the hotṛ [says]; 'Like Pūraṇa, like Madhyama, like Agastya,' the adhvaryu [says].

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātāḥ pravarāḥ / vaikṛtāni vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: व्याख्याताः प्रवराः / वैकृतानि व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: The pravaras have been explained. We shall explain the modified cases.

sanskrit_iast: atha dvitayyo brāhmaṇānām̐ samutpattayo bhavanti / teṣām̐ samutpattiṃ pratipattiṃ ca vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: अथ द्वितय्यो ब्राह्मणानाम्̐ समुत्पत्तयो भवन्ति / तेषाम्̐ समुत्पत्तिं प्रतिपत्तिं च व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: Now there are two kinds of origins of the brahmins. We shall explain their origin and their ritual procedure.

sanskrit_iast: yeṣāṃ puruṣataḥ prajotpattir avichinnā bhavati te sam̐hitakulīnāḥ /
meaning: येषां पुरुषतः प्रजोत्पत्तिर् अविछिन्ना भवति ते सम्̐हितकुलीनाः /
text_mt: Those whose generation of offspring has proceeded unbroken from person to person are of unified family.
