sanskrit_iast: ye sapta bhūyaḥ pañcapuruṣam̐ vā yoniśrutivṛttaśīlasaṃpannā ṛtavatām ṛtavantas te pitṛmantaḥ paitṛmatyārṣeyā bhavanty ārtvijīnām /
meaning: ये सप्त भूयः पञ्चपुरुषम्̐ वा योनिश्रुतिवृत्तशीलसंपन्ना ऋतवताम् ऋतवन्तस् ते पितृमन्तः पैतृमत्यार्षेया भवन्त्य् आर्त्विजीनाम् /
text_mt: Those who, for seven or more, or for five generations, are endowed with [purity of] origin, Vedic learning, conduct, and character, possessing sacred truth among those who possess sacred truth—they, possessing ancestors, are fit to serve as officiating priests through their ancestral ancestral lineages.

sanskrit_iast: atha dattakakrītakakṛtimaputrikāputrāḥ paraparigraheṇa nānārṣeyā ye jātā dvyāmuṣyāyaṇā bhavanti yathaitac chauṅgaśaiśirīṇāṃ bharadvājaudamedhīnām̐ laukākṣīnāṃ ca yāni cānyāny evam̐ samutpattīni kulāni bhavanti /
meaning: अथ दत्तकक्रीतककृतिमपुत्रिकापुत्राः परपरिग्रहेण नानार्षेया ये जाता द्व्यामुष्यायणा भवन्ति यथैतच् छौङ्गशैशिरीणां भरद्वाजौदमेधीनाम्̐ लौकाक्षीनां च यानि चान्यान्य् एवम्̐ समुत्पत्तीनि कुलानि भवन्ति /
text_mt: Now, the adopted sons, purchased sons, artificially made sons, and sons of an appointed daughter, who are born by the adoption of another, having different ancestral lineages, become sons of two fathers, just as this is the case for the Śauṅgaśaiśiris, the Bharadvājaudamedhis, and the Laukākṣis, and whatever other families are of such origin.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ tathaiva pravarāḥ syur dvipravarasaṃnipāte pūrvaḥ pravara utpādayitur uttaraḥ parigrahītuḥ /
meaning: तेषां तथैव प्रवराः स्युर् द्विप्रवरसंनिपाते पूर्वः प्रवर उत्पादयितुर् उत्तरः परिग्रहीतुः /
text_mt: Their pravaras should be just like that: when two pravaras are combined, the former pravara belongs to the progenitor, the latter to the adopter.

sanskrit_iast: api vā trayo 'nye trayo 'nye / tan na tathā kuryāt tasmāt trīn eva pañca vā pravṛṇīte /
meaning: अपि वा त्रयो ऽन्ये त्रयो ऽन्ये / तन् न तथा कुर्यात् तस्मात् त्रीन् एव पञ्च वा प्रवृणीते /
text_mt: Or else three of one and three of the other. One should not do it that way; therefore, one chooses only three or five.

sanskrit_iast: atha yadi pitṛvyeṇa jñātinaikārṣeyeṇa ye jātāḥ sam̐hitakulīnāḥ teṣāṃ parigrahītur eva bhavati /
meaning: अथ यदि पितृव्येण ज्ञातिनैकार्षेयेण ये जाताः सम्̐हितकुलीनाः तेषां परिग्रहीतुर् एव भवति /
text_mt: Now, if those born through a paternal uncle or a kinsman of the same ancestral lineage are of unified family, [their pravara] belongs to the adopter alone.

sanskrit_iast: atha yady eṣām̐ svāsu bhāryāsv apatyaṃ na syād riktham̐ hareyuḥ piṇḍaṃ caibhyas tripuruṣaṃ dadyur yadi syād ubhābhyām eva dadyur ity ācāryavacanam /
meaning: अथ यद्य् एषाम्̐ स्वासु भार्यास्व् अपत्यं न स्याद् रिक्थम्̐ हरेयुः पिण्डं चैभ्यस् त्रिपुरुषं दद्युर् यदि स्याद् उभाभ्याम् एव दद्युर् इत्य् आचार्यवचनम् /
text_mt: Now, if there should be no offspring born to them of their own wives, they should take the inheritance and give them ancestral balls for three generations; if there should be [offspring], they should give [ancestral balls] to both—such is the statement of the teachers.

sanskrit_iast: dve kuryād ekaśrāddhe kuryād vā pṛthag anudiśyaikapiṇḍe dvāv anukīrtayet parigrahītāraṃ cotpādayitāraṃ cā tṛtīyāt puruṣāt /
meaning: द्वे कुर्याद् एकश्राद्धे कुर्याद् वा पृथग् अनुदिश्यैकपिण्डे द्वाव् अनुकीर्तयेत् परिग्रहीतारं चोत्पादयितारं चा तृतीयात् पुरुषात् /
text_mt: One may perform two [offerings] in a single ancestral rite, or having designated them separately, he should recite two on a single ancestral ball—both the adopter and the progenitor—up to the third generation.

sanskrit_iast: ārṣeyasyāparijñānād eteṣām eva pravarāṇām ādyaṃ pravaraṃ pravṛṇīte / paripraśnena vā yam̐ yasyopapannaṃ manyeta taṃ tasya kuryāt /
meaning: आर्षेयस्यापरिज्ञानाद् एतेषाम् एव प्रवराणाम् आद्यं प्रवरं प्रवृणीते / परिप्रश्नेन वा यम्̐ यस्योपपन्नं मन्येत तं तस्य कुर्यात् /
text_mt: When the ancestral lineage is not known, one chooses the first pravara among these very pravaras; or by inquiry, whatever one considers appropriate for someone, that one should assign to him.

sanskrit_iast: purohitapravaro vā syād ācāryapravaro vā rājanya etenaiva tu pravareṇa vaiśyapravaro vyākhyātaḥ /
meaning: पुरोहितप्रवरो वा स्याद् आचार्यप्रवरो वा राजन्य एतेनैव तु प्रवरेण वैश्यप्रवरो व्याख्यातः /
text_mt: The pravara of a rājanya may be the pravara of his domestic priest or the pravara of his teacher; by this very pravara the pravara of a vaiśya is explained.

sanskrit_iast: yadi sārṣṭiṃ pravṛṇīte mānavaiḍa paurūravaseti hotā purūravovad iḍāvan manuvad ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: यदि सार्ष्टिं प्रवृणीते मानवैड पौरूरवसेति होता पुरूरवोवद् इडावन् मनुवद् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: If he chooses [the formula indicating] equal status: 'O descendant of Manu, of Iḍā, of Purūravas!' the hotṛ [says]; 'Like Purūravas, like Iḍā, like Manu,' the adhvaryu [says].

sanskrit_iast: sārṣṭiṃ pravṛṇīyuḥ ... /
purohitapravarāv eva rājanyavaiśyau syātām /
meaning: पुरोहितप्रवराव् एव राजन्यवैश्यौ स्याताम् /
text_mt: The rājanya and the vaiśya should have the pravara of their domestic priest alone.

sanskrit_iast: dhanam̐ yaśasyam āyuṣyam ṛṣīṇāṃ kīrtanam̐ śubham /
meaning: धनम्̐ यशस्यम् आयुष्यम् ऋषीणां कीर्तनम्̐ शुभम् /
text_mt: The recitation of the ṛṣis brings wealth, fame, long life, and good fortune.

sanskrit_iast: divyam̐ varṣasahasram ekaikasyarṣer ātithyaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati yaḥ pravarādhyāyam adhīte /
meaning: दिव्यम्̐ वर्षसहस्रम् एकैकस्यर्षेर् आतिथ्यं कृतं भवति यः प्रवराध्यायम् अधीते /
text_mt: Hospitality for a divine thousand years has been offered to each individual ṛṣi by him who recites the chapter on pravaras.

sanskrit_iast: maithunagotrālābha ṛṣyantarāṇām avirodhīti /
meaning: मैथुनगोत्रालाभ ऋष्यन्तराणाम् अविरोधीति /
text_mt: When a gotra for marriage cannot be found, there is no conflict with other ṛṣis.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa mahāñ śakuniḥ samāpto vedānāṃ mūlaṃ dharmasya cāgram̐ rudraiḥ samadhikam̐ vṛddham̐ vṛddhaiḥ /
meaning: एष महाञ् शकुनिः समाप्तो वेदानां मूलं धर्मस्य चाग्रम्̐ रुद्रैः समधिकम्̐ वृद्धम्̐ वृद्धैः /
text_mt: This great omen is concluded, the root of the Vedas and the summit of dharma, augmented by the Rudras, increased by the elders.

sanskrit_iast: nāputrāya nāśiṣyāya nāsam̐vatsaroṣitāya dadyāt /
meaning: नापुत्राय नाशिष्याय नासम्̐वत्सरोषिताय दद्यात् /
text_mt: One should not give it to one who is not a son, nor to one who is not a student, nor to one who has not dwelt [with the teacher] for a year.

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣāṃ paṅktipāvanānām upariṣṭād bhavati yaḥ pravarādhyāyam adhīte yaḥ pravarādhyāyam adhīta iti /
meaning: सर्वेषां पङ्क्तिपावनानाम् उपरिष्टाद् भवति यः प्रवराध्यायम् अधीते यः प्रवराध्यायम् अधीत इति /
text_mt: He stands above all purifiers of the assembly who studies the pravara chapter, who studies the pravara chapter.

sanskrit_iast: athātaḥ śrāddhakalpam̐ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: अथातः श्राद्धकल्पम्̐ व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: Now then, we shall explain the ritual procedure for the ancestral rite.

sanskrit_iast: agnim upasamādhāya nirmanthya cāsagotrān ayugmān apradakṣiṇam āmantrya brāhmaṇān pūrvedyur ye mātṛtaḥ pitṛtaś ca daśapuruṣam̐ samanusthitā vidyātapobhyāṃ kalyāṇakarmaṇaḥ śucayaḥ śuklavāsaso 'parāhṇe prācīnāvavītikṛtamaṇḍaloparipacchaucān ācāntān prāṅmukhān pitṝn udaṅmukhān viśvedevān bhojayet /
meaning: अग्निम् उपसमाधाय निर्मन्थ्य चासगोत्रान् अयुग्मान् अप्रदक्षिणम् आमन्त्र्य ब्राह्मणान् पूर्वेद्युर् ये मातृतः पितृतश् च दशपुरुषम्̐ समनुस्थिता विद्यातपोभ्यां कल्याणकर्मणः शुचयः शुक्लवाससो ऽपराह्णे प्राचीनाववीतिकृतमण्डलोपरिपच्छौचान् आचान्तान् प्राङ्मुखान् पितॄन् उदङ्मुखान् विश्वेदेवान् भोजयेत् /
text_mt: Having added fuel to the fire, or having churned it out, having invited on the previous day brāhmaṇas not of the same gotra, uneven in number, counter-clockwise, who on the mother's and father's side are established [in virtue] through ten generations, endowed with learning and ascetic practice, performing auspicious deeds, pure, wearing white clothes; in the afternoon, having their feet washed above an altar-circle, having sipped water, wearing the sacred thread over the right shoulder, he should feed the fathers facing east and the Viśvedevas facing north.

sanskrit_iast: arghyapātrāṇy upakalpayed dvau daive trīn pitrya ekaikam ubhayatra vā //
meaning: अर्घ्यपात्राण्य् उपकल्पयेद् द्वौ दैवे त्रीन् पित्र्य एकैकम् उभयत्र वा //
text_mt: He should prepare the guest-offering vessels: two for the divine rite, three for the ancestral rite, or one in each case.

sanskrit_iast: sam anyā yanti \\ ity apa āsicya sumanasaś cotpūya yavān prakṣipya viśvān devān āvāhayiṣyāmi \\ ity uktvā brāhmaṇair anujñātas \\ viśve devā ṛtāvṛdhas \\ viśve devāso asridhas \\ iti yavān pradakṣiṇaṃ prakiret /
meaning: सम् अन्या यन्ति \\ इत्य् अप आसिच्य सुमनसश् चोत्पूय यवान् प्रक्षिप्य विश्वान् देवान् आवाहयिष्यामि \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा ब्राह्मणैर् अनुज्ञातस् \\ विश्वे देवा ऋतावृधस् \\ विश्वे देवासो अस्रिधस् \\ इति यवान् प्रदक्षिणं प्रकिरेत् /
text_mt: Having poured water with: 'Together come the other [waters]', having purified flowers, and having scattered barley grains into it, having said: 'I shall invoke the Viśvedevas,' permitted by the brāhmaṇas, he should scatter barley grains clockwise with: 'The All-gods who foster cosmic order,' and 'The All-gods who do not stumble.'

sanskrit_iast: pavitre pāṇau pradāya hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayas \\ ity uktvā viśve devā eṣa vo arghyaḥ // \ pitṝn pitāmahān prapitāmahān āvāhayiṣyāmi \\ ity uktvā brahmaṇair anujñātas \\ uśantas tvā havāmahe \ paretana pitaraḥ somyāsas \\ iti tilān pradakṣiṇaṃ prakiret /
meaning: पवित्रे पाणौ प्रदाय हिरण्यवर्णाः शुचयस् \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा विश्वे देवा एष वो अर्घ्यः // \ पितॄन् पितामहान् प्रपितामहान् आवाहयिष्यामि \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा ब्रह्मणैर् अनुज्ञातस् \\ उशन्तस् त्वा हवामहे \ परेतन पितरः सोम्यासस् \\ इति तिलान् प्रदक्षिणं प्रकिरेत् /
text_mt: Having placed two strainers in the hand, having spoken with: 'Golden-hued, pure...', [and] 'O All-gods, this is your guest-offering'; having said: 'I shall invoke the fathers, grandfathers, and great-grandfathers,' permitted by the brāhmaṇas, he should scatter sesame seeds clockwise with: 'Willing, we call you,' and 'Depart, O soma-bearing fathers.'

sanskrit_iast: pavitre pāṇu pradāya nāmagotre samuccārya mama pitar eṣa te 'rghyaḥ pitāmaha prapitāma \\ iti / gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpāchādanāntair arcayitvā ghṛtāktam annam ādāya mekṣaṇapāṇir agnau karaṇaṃ kariṣyāmi \\ ity uktvā brāhmaṇair anujñātaḥ somāya pitṛmate svadhā namas \\ iti juhoti //
meaning: पवित्रे पाणु प्रदाय नामगोत्रे समुच्चार्य मम पितर् एष ते ऽर्घ्यः पितामह प्रपिताम \\ इति / गन्धपुष्पधूपदीपाछादनान्तैर् अर्चयित्वा घृताक्तम् अन्नम् आदाय मेक्षणपाणिर् अग्नौ करणं करिष्यामि \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा ब्राह्मणैर् अनुज्ञातः सोमाय पितृमते स्वधा नमस् \\ इति जुहोति //
text_mt: Having placed two strainers in the hand, having pronounced the name and gotra, [saying]: 'O my father, this is your guest-offering; O grandfather; O great-grandfather'; having worshipped them with fragrant substances, flowers, incense, lamps, and garments as the last item; having taken food smeared with clarified butter, with stirring stick in hand, having said: 'I shall make the offering in the fire,' permitted by the brāhmaṇas, he offers with: 'To Soma accompanied by the fathers, svadhā, obeisance!'

sanskrit_iast: yamāyāṅgirasvate pitṛmate svadhā namas \\ iti dvitīyām agnaye kavyavāhanāya svadhā namas \\ ity asam̐saktān dakṣiṇārdhapūrvārdhe tṛtīyām̐ hutvocchiṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāya śeṣaṃ piṇḍapitṛyajñavan nidadhyāt /
meaning: यमायाङ्गिरस्वते पितृमते स्वधा नमस् \\ इति द्वितीयाम् अग्नये कव्यवाहनाय स्वधा नमस् \\ इत्य् असम्̐सक्तान् दक्षिणार्धपूर्वार्धे तृतीयाम्̐ हुत्वोच्छिष्टं ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रदाय शेषं पिण्डपितृयज्ञवन् निदध्यात् /
text_mt: With: 'To Yama accompanied by the Aṅgirases and accompanied by the fathers, svadhā, obeisance!' [he offers] the second; with: 'To Agni, bearer of the kavyas, svadhā, obeisance!' in the eastern half of the southern half, not touching each other, having offered the third, having given the remainder of the food to the brāhmaṇas, he should deposit the rest like in the ancestral ball-offering.

sanskrit_iast:
api naḥ svakule bhūyād \ yo no dadyāt trayodaśīm /
pāyasaṃ madhusarpirbhyām\ varṣāsu ca maghāsu ca /
meaning:
अपि नः स्वकुले भूयाद् \ यो नो दद्यात् त्रयोदशीम् /
पायसं मधुसर्पिर्भ्याम्\ वर्षासु च मघासु च /
text_mt:
[Saying:] 'May there be in our family / someone who would give to us on the thirteenth day,

milk-rice with honey and clarified butter, / during the rains, under the Maghā asterism;'

sanskrit_iast:
sauvarṇeṣu ca pātreṣu \ rājataudumbareṣu ca /
dattam akṣayyatām̐ yāti \ khaḍgenāryakṛtena ca /
meaning:
सौवर्णेषु च पात्रेषु \ राजतौदुम्बरेषु च /
दत्तम् अक्षय्यताम्̐ याति \ खड्गेनार्यकृतेन च /
text_mt:
and in golden vessels, / and in silver and udumbara vessels,

what is given attains imperishability, / and with [meat of] the rhinoceros prepared by noble persons.

sanskrit_iast: payaḥ pṛthivyām iti pāyasaṃ dadyāt \\ madhu vātā ṛtāyate \\ iti madhu \\ āyurdā \\ iti ghṛtaṃ dadyāt //
meaning: पयः पृथिव्याम् इति पायसं दद्यात् \\ मधु वाता ऋतायते \\ इति मधु \\ आयुर्दा \\ इति घृतं दद्यात् //
text_mt: With: 'Milk on earth,' he should give milk-rice; with: 'The winds blow honey to the one who observes cosmic order,' honey; with: 'Life-giving,' he should give clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: satyaṃ tvartena pariṣiñcāmi \\ iti pariṣicya tūṣṇīm̐ vā pṛthivī te pātram iti pātrābhimantraṇam /
meaning: सत्यं त्वर्तेन परिषिञ्चामि \\ इति परिषिच्य तूष्णीम्̐ वा पृथिवी ते पात्रम् इति पात्राभिमन्त्रणम् /
text_mt: Having sprinkled around with: 'I sprinkle you with truth and cosmic order,' or silently, the addressing of the vessel is with: 'The earth is your vessel.'

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇāṅguṣṭham ādāya viṣṇo havyam̐ rakṣasva \\ iti viśvedevān viṣṇo kavyam̐ rakṣasva \\ iti pitṝn udakaṃ pāṇau pradāya oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar iti trir uktvā madhu vātā ṛtāyate \\ iti tryṛcaṃ prīyantāṃ pitaraḥ prīyantāṃ pitāmahāḥ prīyantāṃ prapitāmahās \\ iti vāgyatas tṛpyantu \\ itīṣṭatamāny annāni dadyāt /
meaning: ब्राह्मणाङ्गुष्ठम् आदाय विष्णो हव्यम्̐ रक्षस्व \\ इति विश्वेदेवान् विष्णो कव्यम्̐ रक्षस्व \\ इति पितॄन् उदकं पाणौ प्रदाय ओं भूर् भुवः स्वर् इति त्रिर् उक्त्वा मधु वाता ऋतायते \\ इति त्र्यृचं प्रीयन्तां पितरः प्रीयन्तां पितामहाः प्रीयन्तां प्रपितामहास् \\ इति वाग्यतस् तृप्यन्तु \\ इतीष्टतमान्य् अन्नानि दद्यात् /
text_mt: Taking the thumb of a brāhmaṇa, [he addresses] the Viśvedevas with: 'O Viṣṇu, protect the havis-oblation'; the fathers with: 'O Viṣṇu, protect the kavya-oblation'; having placed water in the hand, having recited 'Oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ' three times, the three-verse hymn 'The winds blow honey to the one who observes cosmic order,' [and] 'May the fathers be pleased, may the grandfathers be pleased, may the great-grandfathers be pleased,' restrained in speech, he should give the most desired foods, [saying]: 'May they be satisfied.'

sanskrit_iast: triḥ sāvitrīm adhīte trīm̐ś cādito 'nuvākān //
meaning: त्रिः सावित्रीम् अधीते त्रीम्̐श् चादितो ऽनुवाकान् //
text_mt: He recites the Sāvitrī verse three times, and three anuvākas from the beginning.

sanskrit_iast: atra pitaro mādayadhvam \\ prajāḥ sṛṣṭvām̐ho 'vayajya \\ uśantas tvā havāmahe \\ atra pitaro mādayadhvam ity uktvā parāyanti //
meaning: अत्र पितरो मादयध्वम् \\ प्रजाः सृष्ट्वाम्̐हो ऽवयज्य \\ उशन्तस् त्वा हवामहे \\ अत्र पितरो मादयध्वम् इत्य् उक्त्वा परायन्ति //
text_mt: Having said: 'Here, O fathers, rejoice,' 'Having created offspring, having warded off distress,' 'Willing, we call you,' [and] 'Here, O fathers, rejoice,' they turn away.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṇuṣva pājās \\ iti pañca sa te jānāti \\ ā no agne \ punantu mā pitaras \\ iti pitṝn aśnatsu japet //
meaning: कृणुष्व पाजास् \\ इति पञ्च स ते जानाति \\ आ नो अग्ने \ पुनन्तु मा पितरस् \\ इति पितॄन् अश्नत्सु जपेत् //
text_mt: While the fathers eat, he should murmur the five verses: 'Display your vigor,' 'He knows that,' 'Come to us, O Agni,' and 'May the fathers purify me.'

sanskrit_iast: tṛptāḥ stha iti pṛchet tṛptāḥ smas \\ iti pratyāhuḥ /
meaning: तृप्ताः स्थ इति पृछेत् तृप्ताः स्मस् \\ इति प्रत्याहुः /
text_mt: He should ask: 'Are you satisfied?' They reply: 'We are satisfied.'

sanskrit_iast: sakṛdācānteṣu \\ agnidagdhās \\ iti bhūmau vikiraṃ ninayet /
meaning: सकृदाचान्तेषु \\ अग्निदग्धास् \\ इति भूमौ विकिरं निनयेत् /
text_mt: When they have sipped water once, he should scatter the scattered offering on the ground with: 'Those burnt by fire...'

sanskrit_iast:
agnidagdhās tu ye jīvās\ ye 'py adagdhāḥ kule mama /
bhūmau dattena toyena \ tṛptā yāntu parāṃ gatim //
ity udakaṃ ninīya piṇḍapitṛyajñavat piṇḍān nidadhyāt /
meaning:
अग्निदग्धास् तु ये जीवास्\ ये ऽप्य् अदग्धाः कुले मम /
भूमौ दत्तेन तोयेन \ तृप्ता यान्तु परां गतिम् //
इत्य् उदकं निनीय पिण्डपितृयज्ञवत् पिण्डान् निदध्यात् /
text_mt:
'Those beings who were burnt by fire, / and those who were not burnt in my family,

satisfied by the water given on the ground, / may they attain the highest state.'

Having poured water with this [verse], he should deposit the ancestral balls like in the ancestral ball-offering.

sanskrit_iast: athāgrabhūmim āsicya suprokṣitam astu \\ ity akṣayyam uttiṣṭha \\ ity upotthāpya vājevāje \\ ity abhipravrajya \\ ā mā vājasya \\ iti pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryād rajataṃ dadyāt pūrṇapātram̐ vā /
meaning: अथाग्रभूमिम् आसिच्य सुप्रोक्षितम् अस्तु \\ इत्य् अक्षय्यम् उत्तिष्ठ \\ इत्य् उपोत्थाप्य वाजेवाजे \\ इत्य् अभिप्रव्रज्य \\ आ मा वाजस्य \\ इति प्रदक्षिणं कुर्याद् रजतं दद्यात् पूर्णपात्रम्̐ वा /
text_mt: Then, having sprinkled the forward ground with: 'May it be well sprinkled,' having made them rise with: 'Imperishable, arise,' having walked towards them with: 'At every prize...', he should circumambulate clockwise with: 'May the prize... to me,' and should give silver or a full vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
daśa pūrvān daśāparān \ ātmānaṃ caikavim̐śakam /
śrāddhakṛn mocayet pāpāt\ mahato 'py enasaḥ pitṝn /
meaning:
दश पूर्वान् दशापरान् \ आत्मानं चैकविम्̐शकम् /
श्राद्धकृन् मोचयेत् पापात्\ महतो ऽप्य् एनसः पितॄन् /
text_mt:
Ten ancestors and ten descendants, / and himself as the twenty-first,

the performer of the ancestral rite frees from evil, / even his fathers from great sin.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhaṃ ca yo na dadyāt \ pitṛbhyaś ca kadācana /
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi \ viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ /
meaning:
श्राद्धं च यो न दद्यात् \ पितृभ्यश् च कदाचन /
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि \ विष्ठायां जायते कृमिः /
text_mt:
And whoever should not offer an ancestral rite / to the fathers at any time,

for sixty thousand years / is born as a worm in excrement.

sanskrit_iast:
yad eva tarpayaty adbhiḥ \ pitṝñ śrāddhe samāhitaḥ /
tenaiva sarvam āpnoti \ pitṛyajñakriyāphalam /
pitṛyajñakriyāphalam iti /
meaning:
यद् एव तर्पयत्य् अद्भिः \ पितॄञ् श्राद्धे समाहितः /
तेनैव सर्वम् आप्नोति \ पितृयज्ञक्रियाफलम् /
पितृयज्ञक्रियाफलम् इति /
text_mt:
Whatever [offering] he makes with water, / concentrated in mind, to the fathers in the ancestral rite,

by that alone he obtains all / the fruit of the performance of the ancestral sacrifice.

'The fruit of the performance of the ancestral sacrifice' [marks the end of the section].

sanskrit_iast: atha vṛddhiśrāddhakalpam̐ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: अथ वृद्धिश्राद्धकल्पम्̐ व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: Now we shall explain the ritual procedure for the prosperity ancestral rite.

sanskrit_iast:
atha cābhyudaye prāpte \ devatāsthāpanam̐ smṛtam /
jātidharmakulāmnātam\ lokānām̐ vṛddhikāraṇam /
meaning:
अथ चाभ्युदये प्राप्ते \ देवतास्थापनम्̐ स्मृतम् /
जातिधर्मकुलाम्नातम्\ लोकानाम्̐ वृद्धिकारणम् /
text_mt:
Now, when an auspicious event has arrived, / the installation of deities is prescribed by tradition,

handed down by caste rule and family tradition, / the cause of prosperity for people.

sanskrit_iast:
karmādiṣu ca sarveṣu \ mātaraḥ sagaṇādhipāḥ /
pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena \ pūjitāḥ pūjayanti tāḥ /
meaning:
कर्मादिषु च सर्वेषु \ मातरः सगणाधिपाः /
पूजनीयाः प्रयत्नेन \ पूजिताः पूजयन्ति ताः /
text_mt:
And at the beginning of all ritual acts, / the Mothers along with the Lord of Hosts

are to be worshipped with effort; / worshipped, they bestow honor.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇyādyāḥ smṛtāḥ sapta \ durgākṣetrādhipas tathā /
vṛddhauvṛddhau sadā pūjyāḥ \ paścān nāndīmukhān pitṝn /
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्याद्याः स्मृताः सप्त \ दुर्गाक्षेत्राधिपस् तथा /
वृद्धौवृद्धौ सदा पूज्याः \ पश्चान् नान्दीमुखान् पितॄन् /
text_mt:
The seven beginning with Brahmāṇī are remembered, / and likewise Durgā and the guardian of the field;

they must always be worshipped at every prosperity rite, / and afterwards the nāndīmukha fathers.

sanskrit_iast:
tisraḥ pūjyāḥ pituḥ pakṣe \ tisro mātāmahe tathā /
ity etā mātaraḥ proktā \ pitṛmātṛṣvasāṣṭamī /
meaning:
तिस्रः पूज्याः पितुः पक्षे \ तिस्रो मातामहे तथा /
इत्य् एता मातरः प्रोक्ता \ पितृमातृष्वसाष्टमी /
text_mt:
Three are to be worshipped on the father's side, / and three on the maternal grandfather's side;

these are declared to be the Mothers, / with the father's or mother's sister as the eighth.

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāsu ca śrubhrāsu \ likhitvā vā paṭādiṣu /
api vākṣatapuñjeṣu \ naivedyaiś ca pṛthakpṛthak /
kuḍyalagnām̐ vasordhārām\ ghṛtenaiva tu kārayet /
kārayet sapta vā pañca \ nātinīcāṃ ca nocchritām /
meaning:
प्रतिमासु च श्रुभ्रासु \ लिखित्वा वा पटादिषु /
अपि वाक्षतपुञ्जेषु \ नैवेद्यैश् च पृथक्पृथक् /
कुड्यलग्नाम्̐ वसोर्धाराम्\ घृतेनैव तु कारयेत् /
कारयेत् सप्त वा पञ्च \ नातिनीचां च नोच्छ्रिताम् /
text_mt:
Either on bright images, / or having drawn them on cloth and the like,

or on heaps of unbroken rice grains, / [they are worshipped] separately with food offerings.

He should make the stream of Vasu attached to the wall / with clarified butter alone;

he should make seven or five [streams], / neither too low nor too high.

sanskrit_iast:
āyuṣyāṇi ca śāntyartham\ japetatra samāhitaḥ /
māṅgalyair gītavāditrair \ mātṝṇāṃ pūjanam̐ smṛtam /
meaning:
आयुष्याणि च शान्त्यर्थम्\ जपेतत्र समाहितः /
माङ्गल्यैर् गीतवादित्रैर् \ मातॄणां पूजनम्̐ स्मृतम् /
text_mt:
And concentrated in mind, he should murmur there / the longevity-giving verses for peace.

The worship of the Mothers is remembered / with auspicious songs and musical instruments.

sanskrit_iast:
asakṛd yāni karmāṇi \ kriyeran karmakāribhiḥ /
pratiprayogaṃ naitāḥ \ syur mātaraḥ śrāddham eva ca /
meaning:
असकृद् यानि कर्माणि \ क्रियेरन् कर्मकारिभिः /
प्रतिप्रयोगं नैताः \ स्युर् मातरः श्राद्धम् एव च /
text_mt:
The ritual acts that may be performed / repeatedly by the performers,

at each application, these Mothers / and the ancestral rite should not be [repeated].

sanskrit_iast: sakṛd eva bhavec chrāddham\ homamantrāḥ pṛthakpṛthak /
meaning: सकृद् एव भवेच् छ्राद्धम्\ होममन्त्राः पृथक्पृथक् /
text_mt: The ancestral rite should be performed only once; / the offering formulas are separate.

sanskrit_iast: ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi \ viśeṣa iha yo bhavet /
meaning: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि \ विशेष इह यो भवेत् /
text_mt: Henceforth I shall declare / whatever distinction there is here:

sanskrit_iast:
prātarāmantritān viprān \ yugmān ubhayatas tathā /
upaveśya kuśān dadyād \ ṛjunaiva hi pāṇinā /
meaning:
प्रातरामन्त्रितान् विप्रान् \ युग्मान् उभयतस् तथा /
उपवेश्य कुशान् दद्याद् \ ऋजुनैव हि पाणिना /
text_mt:
Having invited brāhmaṇas in the morning, / even in number on both sides,

having seated them, he should give kuśa blades / with an upright hand.

sanskrit_iast:
haritā yajñiyā darbhāḥ \ pītakāḥ pākayajñikāḥ /
samūlāḥ pitṛdaivatyāḥ \ kalmāṣā vaiśvadevikāḥ /
dvādaśāṅgulapramāṇena \ pitṛtīrthena sam̐skṛtāḥ /
meaning:
हरिता यज्ञिया दर्भाः \ पीतकाः पाकयज्ञिकाः /
समूलाः पितृदैवत्याः \ कल्माषा वैश्वदेविकाः /
द्वादशाङ्गुलप्रमाणेन \ पितृतीर्थेन सम्̐स्कृताः /

sanskrit_iast: sadā paricared bhaktyā \ pitṝn apy atra devavat /
meaning: सदा परिचरेद् भक्त्या \ पितॄन् अप्य् अत्र देववत् /
text_mt: he should always attend upon the fathers here with devotion, just like a god.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛbhya iti datteṣu \ upaveśya kuśeṣu tān /
gotranāmāni varjanti \ pitṛbhyo 'rghyaṃ pradāpayet /
meaning:
पितृभ्य इति दत्तेषु \ उपवेश्य कुशेषु तान् /
गोत्रनामानि वर्जन्ति \ पितृभ्यो ऽर्घ्यं प्रदापयेत् /
text_mt:
Having seated them upon the kuśa grasses that were given with [the word] "To the fathers,"

avoiding the lineage names, he should have the guest-water presented to the fathers.

sanskrit_iast:
nātrāpasavyakaraṇam\ na pitryaṃ tīrtham iṣyate /
pātrāṇāṃ pūraṇādīni \ devatīrthena kārayet /
meaning:
नात्रापसव्यकरणम्\ न पित्र्यं तीर्थम् इष्यते /
पात्राणां पूरणादीनि \ देवतीर्थेन कारयेत् /
text_mt:
Here, placing [the sacred thread] over the right shoulder is not desired, nor is the sacred part of the hand sacred to the fathers.

He should perform the filling of the vessels and the other rites with the sacred part of the hand sacred to the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhottarakarān yugmān \ karāgrāgrapavitrakān /
kṛtvārghyam̐ saṃpradātavyam\ naikaikasyātra dīyate /
meaning:
ज्येष्ठोत्तरकरान् युग्मान् \ कराग्राग्रपवित्रकान् /
कृत्वार्घ्यम्̐ संप्रदातव्यम्\ नैकैकस्यात्र दीयते /
text_mt:
Having made them in pairs, with the elder's hand higher, with strainers placed on the tips of their hands,

the guest-water should be presented; here it is not given to each one individually.

sanskrit_iast:
madhu madhv iti yas tatra \ trir japo 'śitum ichatām /
gāyatryanantaram̐ so 'tra \ madhumantratrivarjitaḥ /
meaning:
मधु मध्व् इति यस् तत्र \ त्रिर् जपो ऽशितुम् इछताम् /
गायत्र्यनन्तरम्̐ सो ऽत्र \ मधुमन्त्रत्रिवर्जितः /
text_mt:
The three-fold muttering "honey, honey" that is performed there for those wishing to eat—

that [muttering] here, immediately following the Gāyatrī, is free from the three honey mantras.

sanskrit_iast: anya eva japaḥ kāryas\ rākṣoghnaḥ suradevavat /
meaning: अन्य एव जपः कार्यस्\ राक्षोघ्नः सुरदेववत् /
text_mt: A completely different muttering is to be performed, destroying demons, as in the rite for the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpannam iti tṛptāḥ stha \ praśnasthāne vidhīyate /
susaṃpannam iti prokte \ śeṣam annaṃ nivedayet /
meaning:
संपन्नम् इति तृप्ताः स्थ \ प्रश्नस्थाने विधीयते /
सुसंपन्नम् इति प्रोक्ते \ शेषम् अन्नं निवेदयेत् /
text_mt:
[The word] "Is it accomplished?" is prescribed in place of the inquiry "Are you satiated?"

When "It is well accomplished" has been said, he should offer the remainder of the food.

sanskrit_iast:
brūyāt tṛpteṣu saṃpannam \ iti tṛptāḥ stha pārvaṇe /
vikiraṃ ca tathā dadyāt\ juhuyāc ca ṛcām̐ vinā /
meaning:
ब्रूयात् तृप्तेषु संपन्नम् \ इति तृप्ताः स्थ पार्वणे /
विकिरं च तथा दद्यात्\ जुहुयाच् च ऋचाम्̐ विना /
text_mt:
When they are satiated, he should say "It is accomplished"; at the parvan rite [the inquiry is] "Are you satiated?"

And likewise he should distribute the scattered offering, and he should make an offering [in the fire] without verses.

sanskrit_iast:
asomapāś ca ye devās\ yajñabhāgabahiṣkṛtāḥ /
teṣām annaṃ pradātavyam\ vikiram̐ vaiśvadevikam /
meaning:
असोमपाश् च ये देवास्\ यज्ञभागबहिष्कृताः /
तेषाम् अन्नं प्रदातव्यम्\ विकिरम्̐ वैश्वदेविकम् /
text_mt:
And the gods who do not drink soma, who are excluded from a share of the sacrifice—

to them food is to be given, the scattered offering dedicated to the All-gods.

sanskrit_iast: navāvarān bhojayed yugmān vṛddhiṣu pradakṣiṇam upacāro yavais tilārthān kurvanti / >
meaning: नवावरान् भोजयेद् युग्मान् वृद्धिषु प्रदक्षिणम् उपचारो यवैस् तिलार्थान् कुर्वन्ति / >
text_mt: He should feed at least nine [brahmins], in pairs. In rites for prosperity, the attendance is clockwise; they perform the rites meant for sesame with barley grains.

sanskrit_iast: dadhyakṣatabadaramiśrān piṇḍan nidadhyāt /
meaning: दध्यक्षतबदरमिश्रान् पिण्डन् निदध्यात् /
text_mt: He should deposit the balls mixed with curd, unbroken grains, and jujube fruits.

sanskrit_iast: nāndīmukhān pitṝn prīṇanti /
meaning: नान्दीमुखान् पितॄन् प्रीणन्ति /
text_mt: They gratify the cheerful-faced fathers.

sanskrit_iast:
nāndīmukhāḥ pitara iti \ kuryād āvāhanādikam /
prīyantām iti ca brūyuḥ \ piṇḍān svāheti nikṣipet /
meaning:
नान्दीमुखाः पितर इति \ कुर्याद् आवाहनादिकम् /
प्रीयन्ताम् इति च ब्रूयुः \ पिण्डान् स्वाहेति निक्षिपेत् /
text_mt:
With "O cheerful-faced fathers," he should perform the invitation and other acts.

And they should say: "May they be pleased"; he should put down the balls with "Svāhā."

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛpūrvān pitṝn pūjya \ tato mātāmahām̐s tathā /
mātāmahīs tathā kecid \ yugmām̐ś ca bhojayed dvijān /
meaning:
मातृपूर्वान् पितॄन् पूज्य \ ततो मातामहाम्̐स् तथा /
मातामहीस् तथा केचिद् \ युग्माम्̐श् च भोजयेद् द्विजान् /
text_mt:
Having honoured the fathers beginning with the mother, then likewise the maternal grandfathers,

some also [honour] the maternal grandmothers, and he should feed brahmins in pairs.

sanskrit_iast:
dvaudvāv abhyudaye piṇḍau\ ekaikasya pituḥpituḥ /
pārvaṇe piṇḍam ekaikam\ trayāṇāṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak /
meaning:
द्वौद्वाव् अभ्युदये पिण्डौ\ एकैकस्य पितुःपितुः /
पार्वणे पिण्डम् एकैकम्\ त्रयाणां च पृथक्पृथक् /
text_mt:
At a rite for prosperity there are two balls each for each [ancestor] of the father's father.

At the parvan rite there is a single ball, separately for each of the three [ancestors].

sanskrit_iast:
trayāṇām udakaṃ kāryam\ triṣu piṇḍaḥ pravartate /
ūrdhvaṃ nāndīmukhaṃ proktam\ nāmagotrāpaharakam /
meaning:
त्रयाणाम् उदकं कार्यम्\ त्रिषु पिण्डः प्रवर्तते /
ऊर्ध्वं नान्दीमुखं प्रोक्तम्\ नामगोत्रापहरकम् /
text_mt:
Water is to be offered to the three; the ball belongs to three.

The cheerful-faced rite is said to be higher, taking away name and lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
svapitṛbhyaḥ pitā dadyāt \ sutasam̐skārakarmasu /
vivāhādau svapitṛbhyaḥ \ putro dadyāt sadaiva hi /
meaning:
स्वपितृभ्यः पिता दद्यात् \ सुतसम्̐स्कारकर्मसु /
विवाहादौ स्वपितृभ्यः \ पुत्रो दद्यात् सदैव हि /
text_mt:
The father should give to his own fathers in the consecratory rites of a son.

In a marriage and the like, the son should indeed always give to his own fathers.

sanskrit_iast:
nāniṣṭvā tu pitṝñ śrāddhe \ vaidikaṃ karma ārabhet /
tebhyo 'pi pūrvedyuḥ pūrvam\ paścān nāndīmukhān pitṝn /
meaning:
नानिष्ट्वा तु पितॄञ् श्राद्धे \ वैदिकं कर्म आरभेत् /
तेभ्यो ऽपि पूर्वेद्युः पूर्वम्\ पश्चान् नान्दीमुखान् पितॄन् /
text_mt:
Not having offered to the fathers in an ancestral rite, one should not begin a Vedic ritual act.

Even prior to them, on the preceding day, [he should honour] the earlier [ancestors], and afterwards the cheerful-faced fathers.

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāne homayoś caiva \ vaiśvadeve tathaiva ca /
balikarmaṇi darśe ca \ paurṇamāse tathaiva ca /
āgrāyaṇyāṃ pākayajñe \ vadanty evaṃ manīṣiṇaḥ /
ekam eva bhavec chrāddham \ eteṣu na pṛthakpṛthak /
meaning:
आधाने होमयोश् चैव \ वैश्वदेवे तथैव च /
बलिकर्मणि दर्शे च \ पौर्णमासे तथैव च /
आग्रायण्यां पाकयज्ञे \ वदन्त्य् एवं मनीषिणः /
एकम् एव भवेच् छ्राद्धम् \ एतेषु न पृथक्पृथक् /
text_mt:
At the establishment [of the fires] and at the two morning and evening oblations, and likewise at the Vaiśvadeva offering,

at the bali offering and on the new-moon day, and likewise on the full-moon day,

at the first-fruits rite, and at a simple domestic offering—thus the wise declare:

there should be only one ancestral rite for these, not separately for each.

sanskrit_iast: athāgrabhūmim āsicya suprokṣitam astu \\ iti śivā āpaḥ santu \\ iti yugmān evodakena ca saumanasyam astu \\ iti ca puṣpam akṣataṃ cāriṣṭaṃ cāstu \\ ity akṣatān pratipādayet /
meaning: अथाग्रभूमिम् आसिच्य सुप्रोक्षितम् अस्तु \\ इति शिवा आपः सन्तु \\ इति युग्मान् एवोदकेन च सौमनस्यम् अस्तु \\ इति च पुष्पम् अक्षतं चारिष्टं चास्तु \\ इत्य् अक्षतान् प्रतिपादयेत् /
text_mt: Then, having sprinkled the ground in front with "May it be well sprinkled," and with "May there be auspicious waters" [he pours] water for the pairs, and with "May there be goodwill" [he presents] a flower and unbroken grains, and with "May there be freedom from misfortune" he should present unbroken grains.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣayodakadānaṃ ca tv \ arghyadānavad iṣyate /
ṣaṣṭhyaiva nityaṃ tat kuryāt\ na caturthyā kadācana /
meaning:
अक्षयोदकदानं च त्व् \ अर्घ्यदानवद् इष्यते /
षष्ठ्यैव नित्यं तत् कुर्यात्\ न चतुर्थ्या कदाचन /
text_mt:
And the offering of imperishable water is prescribed just like the offering of guest-water.

He should always perform it with the genitive case alone, never with the dative.

sanskrit_iast:
prāthanāsu pratiprokte \ sarvāsv eva dvijottamaiḥ /
yugmān eva svastivācya \ aṅguṣṭhāgragraham̐ sadā /
kṛtvā dhuryasya viprasya \ praṇamyānuvrajet tataḥ /
meaning:
प्राथनासु प्रतिप्रोक्ते \ सर्वास्व् एव द्विजोत्तमैः /
युग्मान् एव स्वस्तिवाच्य \ अङ्गुष्ठाग्रग्रहम्̐ सदा /
कृत्वा धुर्यस्य विप्रस्य \ प्रणम्यानुव्रजेत् ततः /
text_mt:
When reply has been made to all the prayers by the foremost of the brahmins,

having had the pairs pronounce a blessing, always grasping the tip of the thumb

of the leading brahmin, having bowed, he should then follow after [them].

sanskrit_iast: atha pariśiṣṭam /
meaning: अथ परिशिष्टम् /

sanskrit_iast: sam̐vatsaraḥ prajāpatis tasya yad udagayanam̐ śuklo 'haḥ pūrvāhṇas tad devānāṃ madhyaṃdino manuṣyāṇām aparāhṇas tat pitṝṇām atha yathobhayata ijyate /
meaning: सम्̐वत्सरः प्रजापतिस् तस्य यद् उदगयनम्̐ शुक्लो ऽहः पूर्वाह्णस् तद् देवानां मध्यंदिनो मनुष्याणाम् अपराह्णस् तत् पितॄणाम् अथ यथोभयत इज्यते /
text_mt: The year is Prajāpati. His northern course [of the sun], the bright half of the month, the day, the morning—that belongs to the gods; midday belongs to men; the afternoon—that belongs to the fathers. Now, how the sacrifice is performed on both sides:

sanskrit_iast:
kuryād aharahaḥ śrāddham \ annādyenodakena vā /
payomūlaphalair vāpi \ pitṛbhyaḥ prītim āharet /
meaning:
कुर्याद् अहरहः श्राद्धम् \ अन्नाद्येनोदकेन वा /
पयोमूलफलैर् वापि \ पितृभ्यः प्रीतिम् आहरेत् /
text_mt:
Day after day he should perform an ancestral rite with food or with water,

or even with milk, roots, and fruits, he should bring pleasure to the fathers.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭakāpārvaṇaśrāddham\ kṛṣṇapakṣo 'yanadvayam /
dravyabrāhmaṇasaṃpattiḥ \ śrāddhakālāḥ prakīrtitāḥ /
meaning:
अष्टकापार्वणश्राद्धम्\ कृष्णपक्षो ऽयनद्वयम् /
द्रव्यब्राह्मणसंपत्तिः \ श्राद्धकालाः प्रकीर्तिताः /
text_mt:
The aṣṭakā rites, the ancestral rite on parvan days, the dark fortnight, the two solstices,

the availability of materials and brahmins—these are proclaimed as the times for an ancestral rite.

sanskrit_iast:
udvāhe putrajanane \ pitryeṣṭyām̐ saumike makhe /
tīrthe brāhmaṇa āyāte \ ṣaḍ ete jīvataḥ pituḥ /
meaning:
उद्वाहे पुत्रजनने \ पित्र्येष्ट्याम्̐ सौमिके मखे /
तीर्थे ब्राह्मण आयाते \ षड् एते जीवतः पितुः /
text_mt:
At a marriage, at the birth of a son, at an offering to the fathers, at a soma sacrifice,

at a sacred bathing place, and when a [worthy] brahmin has arrived—these are the six [occasions] while the father is living.

sanskrit_iast:
anvaṣṭakyaṃ gayāpraptau \ satyām̐ yac ca mṛte 'hani /
matuḥ śrāddham̐ sutaḥ kuryāt \ pitary api ca jīvati /
meaning:
अन्वष्टक्यं गयाप्रप्तौ \ सत्याम्̐ यच् च मृते ऽहनि /
मतुः श्राद्धम्̐ सुतः कुर्यात् \ पितर्य् अपि च जीवति /
text_mt:
At the after-aṣṭakā rite, upon arriving at Gayā, and on the day of death that occurs,

a son should perform the ancestral rite for the mother even while the father is living.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāgate savitari \ yāny ahāni ca ṣoḍaśa /
kratubhis tāni tulyāni / \ pitṝṇāṃ dattam akṣayam /
meaning:
कन्यागते सवितरि \ यान्य् अहानि च षोडश /
क्रतुभिस् तानि तुल्यानि / \ पितॄणां दत्तम् अक्षयम् /
text_mt:
When the sun has entered the sign of Virgo, whatever sixteen days there are—

they are equal to solemn sacrifices; what is given to the fathers [then] is imperishable.

sanskrit_iast: pañcamīprabhṛtyaparapakṣasya / pañcamīṃ putrakāmaḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ dhanakāmaḥ saptamīṃ paśukāmo 'ṣṭamīm ārogyakāmo navamīṃ tejaskāmo daśamīm annādyakāma ekādaśīm ṛddhikāmo dvādaśīm̐ vṛddhikāmas trayodaśīm̐ yaśaskāmaś caturdásīm̐ śastrahatasyārogyakāmo 'māvāsyāyām̐ sarvakāmaḥ /
meaning: पञ्चमीप्रभृत्यपरपक्षस्य / पञ्चमीं पुत्रकामः षष्ठीं धनकामः सप्तमीं पशुकामो ऽष्टमीम् आरोग्यकामो नवमीं तेजस्कामो दशमीम् अन्नाद्यकाम एकादशीम् ऋद्धिकामो द्वादशीम्̐ वृद्धिकामस् त्रयोदशीम्̐ यशस्कामश् चतुर्द्áसीम्̐ शस्त्रहतस्यारोग्यकामो ऽमावास्यायाम्̐ सर्वकामः /
text_mt: Beginning with the fifth lunar day of the dark fortnight: one desiring a son [should perform it] on the fifth; one desiring wealth on the sixth; one desiring cattle on the seventh; one desiring health on the eighth; one desiring splendour on the ninth; one desiring proper food on the tenth; one desiring prosperity on the eleventh; one desiring growth on the twelfth; one desiring fame on the thirteenth; one desiring health for one slain by weapons on the fourteenth; on the new-moon day, one desiring all wishes.

sanskrit_iast: tilaiḥ śrāddhaṃ puṣṭikāmaḥ kuryād apūpair ṛddhikāmo ghṛtaguḍatilais tejaskāmaḥ svastikāmaḥ saubhāgyakāma ārogyakāmo vā paramānnakṛsarānnamāṣadadhiyavāgūbhiḥ sarvakāmaḥ /
meaning: तिलैः श्राद्धं पुष्टिकामः कुर्याद् अपूपैर् ऋद्धिकामो घृतगुडतिलैस् तेजस्कामः स्वस्तिकामः सौभाग्यकाम आरोग्यकामो वा परमान्नकृसरान्नमाषदधियवागूभिः सर्वकामः /
text_mt: One desiring nourishment should perform the ancestral rite with sesame seeds; one desiring prosperity with cakes; one desiring splendour with clarified butter, molasses, and sesame seeds; one desiring welfare, good fortune, or health, or one desiring all wishes, [should perform it] with milk-rice, rice with sesame, beans, curd, and barley gruel.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvedyur āmantritair vipraiḥ \ pitaraḥ sam̐viśanti vai /
yajamānaś ca tām̐ rātrim\ vaseyur brahmacāriṇaḥ /
meaning:
पूर्वेद्युर् आमन्त्रितैर् विप्रैः \ पितरः सम्̐विशन्ति वै /
यजमानश् च ताम्̐ रात्रिम्\ वसेयुर् ब्रह्मचारिणः /
text_mt:
Together with the brahmins invited on the preceding day, the fathers indeed enter;

and the sacrificer during that night should live as a student of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhaṃ dattvā ca bhuktvā ca \ adhvānam̐ yo 'dhigachati /
taṃ māsaṃ tasya pitaras\ bhuñjate pām̐śubhojanāḥ /
meaning:
श्राद्धं दत्त्वा च भुक्त्वा च \ अध्वानम्̐ यो ऽधिगछति /
तं मासं तस्य पितरस्\ भुञ्जते पाम्̐शुभोजनाः /
text_mt:
Having given an ancestral rite and eaten of it, he who sets out on a journey—

for that month his fathers eat, having dust for their food.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhaṃ dattvā ca bhuktvā ca \ maithunam̐ yo 'dhigachati /
taṃ māsaṃ tasya pitaras\ bhuñjate retabhojanāḥ /
meaning:
श्राद्धं दत्त्वा च भुक्त्वा च \ मैथुनम्̐ यो ऽधिगछति /
तं मासं तस्य पितरस्\ भुञ्जते रेतभोजनाः /
text_mt:
If having given or eaten [at] an ancestral rite, / one engages in sexual intercourse,

for that month his fathers / feed on semen.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddham adhvā bhaved aśvaḥ \ punar bhuṅkte tu vāyasaḥ /
karmakṛj jāyate dāsaḥ \ strīgamyo grāmaśūkaraḥ /
meaning:
श्राद्धम् अध्वा भवेद् अश्वः \ पुनर् भुङ्क्ते तु वायसः /
कर्मकृज् जायते दासः \ स्त्रीगम्यो ग्रामशूकरः /
text_mt:
[Travelling on] a journey [after] an ancestral rite, he becomes a horse; / eating again, he becomes a crow;

performing manual labor, he is born a servant; / having intercourse with a woman, a village pig.

sanskrit_iast:
dvau daive trīn pitrya ekaikam ubhayatra vā /
bhojayet susamṛddho 'pi \ na prasajjeti vistaram /
meaning:
द्वौ दैवे त्रीन् पित्र्य एकैकम् उभयत्र वा /
भोजयेत् सुसमृद्धो ऽपि \ न प्रसज्जेति विस्तरम् /
text_mt:
Two in the rite for the gods, three in the rite for the fathers, / or one in each [rite],

he should feed, even if very wealthy; / he should not attach himself to vast expansion.

sanskrit_iast:
satkriyāṃ deśakālau ca \ dravyaṃ brāhmaṇasaṃpadaḥ /
pañcaitān vistaro hanti \ tasyānnehatu vistaram /
meaning:
सत्क्रियां देशकालौ च \ द्रव्यं ब्राह्मणसंपदः /
पञ्चैतान् विस्तरो हन्ति \ तस्यान्नेहतु विस्तरम् /
text_mt:
Hospitable reception, place and time, / material requisites, and the excellence of the brāhmaṇas:

these five vast expansion ruins; / therefore, let him not desire vast expansion.

sanskrit_iast:
yatnena bhojayec chrāddhe \ bahvṛcam̐ vedapāragam /
śākhāntagam athādhvaryum\ chandogam̐ vā samāptigam /
meaning:
यत्नेन भोजयेच् छ्राद्धे \ बह्वृचम्̐ वेदपारगम् /
शाखान्तगम् अथाध्वर्युम्\ छन्दोगम्̐ वा समाप्तिगम् /
text_mt:
One should assiduously feed at an ancestral rite / a Ṛgvedic priest who has crossed over the Veda,

or an adhvaryu priest who has reached the end of his Vedic branch, / or a Chāndoga (Sāmavedic singer) who has completed his study;

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāgnis trisuparṇaś ca \ triṇāciketaḥ ṣaḍaṅgavit /
brahmadeyānusaṃtānas\ jyeṣṭhasāmaga eva ca /
meaning:
पञ्चाग्निस् त्रिसुपर्णश् च \ त्रिणाचिकेतः षडङ्गवित् /
ब्रह्मदेयानुसंतानस्\ ज्येष्ठसामग एव च /
text_mt:
one who maintains five fires, one who knows the Trisuparṇa, / one who knows the Triṇāciketa fire, one who knows the six auxiliary sciences,

the offspring of a marriage by the Brahma rite, / and one who sings the Jyeṣṭhasāman;

sanskrit_iast:
mātāmahaṃ mātulaṃ ca \ svasrīyam̐ śvaśraṃ gurum /
dauhitram̐ viṭpatiṃ bandhum \ ṛtvigyājyau ca bhojayet /
meaning:
मातामहं मातुलं च \ स्वस्रीयम्̐ श्वश्रं गुरुम् /
दौहित्रम्̐ विट्पतिं बन्धुम् \ ऋत्विग्याज्यौ च भोजयेत् /
text_mt:
a maternal grandfather, a maternal uncle, / a sister's son, a father-in-law, a teacher,

a daughter's son, a son-in-law, a kinsman, / and an officiating priest and a sacrificer he should feed.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya śrāddhe na bhuñjanti \ brahmaṇā vedapāragāḥ /
akṛtaṃ tad bhavec chrāddham\ pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭhati /
meaning:
यस्य श्राद्धे न भुञ्जन्ति \ ब्रह्मणा वेदपारगाः /
अकृतं तद् भवेच् छ्राद्धम्\ पितॄणां नोपतिष्ठति /
text_mt:
At whose ancestral rite there do not eat / brāhmaṇas who have crossed over the Veda,

unperformed that ancestral rite becomes; / it does not reach the fathers.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya śrāddhe na bhuñjante \ brāhmaṇāḥ svaśākhinaḥ /
āsuraṃ tad bhavec chrāddham\ pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭhati /
meaning:
यस्य श्राद्धे न भुञ्जन्ते \ ब्राह्मणाः स्वशाखिनः /
आसुरं तद् भवेच् छ्राद्धम्\ पितॄणां नोपतिष्ठति /
text_mt:
At whose ancestral rite there do not eat / brāhmaṇas belonging to one's own Vedic branch,

demonic that ancestral rite becomes; / it does not reach the fathers.

sanskrit_iast:
vedārthavit pravaktā ca \ brahmacārī sadā sthitaḥ /
śatāyuś caiva vijñeyās\ brāhmaṇāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ /
meaning:
वेदार्थवित् प्रवक्ता च \ ब्रह्मचारी सदा स्थितः /
शतायुश् चैव विज्ञेयास्\ ब्राह्मणाः पङ्क्तिपावनाः /
text_mt:
One who knows the meaning of the Veda, an expounder, / one who is continually established as a student of the Veda,

and a centenarian—these should be recognized / as brāhmaṇas who are purifiers of the assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣām anyatamo yasya \ bhuñjīta śrāddham arcitaḥ /
pitṝṇāṃ tasya tṛptiḥ syāt\ śāśvatī sāptapauruṣī /
meaning:
एषाम् अन्यतमो यस्य \ भुञ्जीत श्राद्धम् अर्चितः /
पितॄणां तस्य तृप्तिः स्यात्\ शाश्वती साप्तपौरुषी /
text_mt:
If any one of these, being honored, / should eat at someone's ancestral rite,

for his fathers there would be satisfaction / eternal, lasting seven generations.

sanskrit_iast:
tilā rakṣantu daiteyān \ darbhā rakṣantu rākṣasān /
tasmād dāneṣu dātavyās\ ātmano bhūtim ichatā /
meaning:
तिला रक्षन्तु दैतेयान् \ दर्भा रक्षन्तु राक्षसान् /
तस्माद् दानेषु दातव्यास्\ आत्मनो भूतिम् इछता /
text_mt:
Sesame seeds protect from the sons of Diti; / darbha grass protects from the rākṣasas;

therefore, they should be given in gifts / by one who desires prosperity for himself.
